Keep your reactions quick by staying alert to changes in the wave. Shift your focus as soon as a new threat appears.
Expect each challenge to get harder. Treat early waves as practice for learning the rhythm, and save your calm decisions for the tougher ones.
faq: What is the goal of The Room?
Your goal is to defend the heart of your domain against relentless waves of enemies. Staying alive while protecting it is the core challenge.
How does the difficulty change?
Each challenge escalates, so the waves become more demanding as you progress. Early rounds are a good time to get used to the pace.

halloween-tile-tumble.intro: Halloween Tile Tumble is a block-clearing puzzle where you match connected spooky blocks, trigger chain reactions, and reach target scores to unlock harder levels. It is played with a mouse or touchpad.
tips: Before you click, scan the whole board for the largest connected group of matching blocks, since clearing bigger groups usually earns more points.
Watch for chain reactions. Clearing one group can drop blocks into new positions, so a single move may set up a second match for free.
Keep an eye on the target score for each level so you know how many points you need and can plan moves to reach it.
Save your boosters for tricky layouts where normal matches are hard to reach, rather than using them on easy openings.
If a board looks stuck, try clearing blocks from the side that opens up the most space, so the remaining pieces can move and connect.
faq: How do I play Halloween Tile Tumble?
Click or select a group of connected matching blocks to clear it and earn points. Work toward the target score on each level to unlock the next one.
How do I earn more points?
Clear larger connected groups and take advantage of chain reactions, which can add extra matches after a single move.

puzzle-drive.intro: Puzzle Drive is a puzzle game where solving each puzzle moves your car forward. Collect coins along the way to unlock new worlds.
tips: Read each puzzle fully before you start working on it, so you know what the solution needs to do.
Take your time on early puzzles to learn how the challenges are built, since later levels get more involved.
Keep an eye out for coins as you progress, because collecting them is part of the reward for your journey.
If you get stuck, step back and try a different approach rather than repeating the same move.
Stay patient with the variety of levels, since each one is designed to feel fresh and rewarding.
faq: What is the main goal in Puzzle Drive?
Your goal is to solve the puzzles so your car can keep moving forward on its journey. Each solution takes you further along the route.
What do I collect in Puzzle Drive?
You collect coins as you travel. Coins are part of what keeps your adventure going and help you unlock new worlds.

snail-clicker.intro: Snail Clicker is a clicking game where you build your snail empire. Click to earn snail coins, spend them on upgrades and skins, and climb the ranks.
tips: Spend your coins on upgrades that boost your coin gains first, since more coins make every later purchase faster.
Compare the upgrades you can afford before buying, and choose the one that helps your progress the most.
Keep clicking steadily rather than in short bursts, because each click adds to your total coins.
Check your coin count regularly so you do not miss the moment you can afford your next upgrade or skin.
Think of skins as a reward for your progress, and only buy them once your key upgrades are covered.
faq: What is the main goal of Snail Clicker?
The goal is to build your snail empire by multiplying your snail coins, unlocking upgrades and skins, and climbing the ranks.
How do I earn snail coins?
You earn snail coins by clicking. Every click adds to your total, which you can then spend on upgrades and skins.

magikmon.intro: Magikmon is a monster RPG where you capture and train quirky creatures, build your own team, and battle your way through a magical world full of exploration.
tips: Capture a range of creatures early so you have options for your team instead of relying on one favorite.
Train the creatures you plan to use often, since a team that has grown together will handle battles more steadily.
Take time to explore the world rather than rushing ahead, because the surprises and encounters along the way can shape your team.
After each battle, think about what worked and what didn't, and adjust your team choices before the next fight.
Keep your team balanced so that one weak member does not hold back the rest during longer battles.
faq: What is the main goal in Magikmon?
The main goal is to capture and train creatures, build a strong monster team, and progress through battles and exploration in a magical world.
How do I build a strong monster team?
Capture several different creatures, train the ones that suit your style, and test them in battles to see which combinations work best together.

my-castle-merge-and-story.intro: My Castle: Merge & Story is a calm merge puzzle about restoring an old medieval castle while following a princess's story. You combine matching items, uncover rare finds, and decorate the castle at your own pace.
tips: Look for matching items before you act, and merge the pairs that lead to upgraded tools or resources first, since those help with later steps.
Keep an eye out for rare medieval objects. Some items belong to hidden chains, so following a chain you have started can reveal new pieces.
Check your progress on the castle often. New crafting options unlock as the castle grows, so restoring areas can open up new merges.
Use stars for castle repairs and story progress, and save crystals for restoring energy when you run low.
Claim your daily reward each time you log in, since it is mandatory and adds up over time. Because there are no timers, you can also take breaks without losing progress.
faq: What is the main goal of My Castle: Merge & Story?
The goal is to restore a large, run-down castle by merging items, helping its inhabitants, and following the princess's story.
How do I level up faster?
Merge items and help the castle's inhabitants, since both are listed as ways to level up.

robby-double-jump-for-brainrots.intro: Robby is a jumping obby where you collect brainrots, bring them to your base, and build up your speed and jumps to reach new areas. A single fall sends you back to the start, so careful movement matters.
tips: Upgrade your jump and speed early by putting brainrots on the base, since higher jumps and speed make the later sections easier to reach.
Use E to pick up or put down a brainrot, and avoid carrying more than you need while you are jumping across gaps.
Plan your route before each jump, because a fall means starting over and losing progress.
Use the camera rotation often to check where your next platform is before you commit to a jump.
Use F to drop a brainrot when you need your hands free for a tricky jump, rather than risking a fall while holding it.
faq: What is the goal of Robby: Double Jump for Brainrots?
Jump higher, go further, and collect as many brainrots as you can to reach new areas. Improving your jump and speed helps you get there.
How do I make my character jump higher and move faster?
Catch brainrots and put them on the base. This improves your speed and jumps so you can go further.

popping-candies.intro: Popping Candies is a match-3 puzzle where you swap adjacent candies to form lines and reach each level's objective. Your moves are limited, so every swap should count toward the goal.
tips: Check the level objective before you start, whether it is a score, specific candies, or clearing jelly. Let that goal decide which matches you make.
Try to match four candies in a row when you can, since the striped candy it creates clears a whole row or column.
Save color bombs for when a color is common on the board, because combining one with any candy clears every candy of that color.
Watch for chocolate and blockers early and make moves that open up space around them, so they do not cover the board and waste your moves.
Count your remaining moves often and avoid swaps that only remove a few candies unless they help with the objective.
faq: What happens if I run out of moves in a level?
You lose a life. You start with five lives, and the game says you can earn more over time or purchase them.
How do I make a striped candy?
Match four candies in a row. When matched later, a striped candy clears an entire row or column.

hidden-objects-home-sweet-home.intro: Hidden Objects: Home Sweet Home is a relaxed search game set in cozy houses, courtyards and natural landscapes. Find the listed items in each scene and click them to take them.
tips: Read the item list at the bottom of the screen before you start searching, so you know what shape, color or type of object to look for.
Scan each scene in sections, such as one wall or corner at a time, instead of sweeping your eyes across the whole picture.
Check the edges and corners of the scene, since small objects often sit at the borders of rooms, shelves or garden areas.
Click the bottom panel to hide it when you need a clear view of the scene, and bring it back when you want to check the list again.
Take breaks between scenes if you start to lose focus, because the game is designed to be played without haste.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Your goal is to find all the hidden objects in each scene. The items you need to find are shown at the bottom of the screen.
How do I collect an object once I spot it?
Click on the hidden object in the scene to take it. It will then be marked as found in the item panel.

golf-king-3d.intro: Golf King 3D is a multiplayer golf game with real-time 1v1 matches on 3D courses. You hit the ball by swiping and releasing, a bit like playing pool.
tips: Before each shot, look at the distance and the lie of the ball, then pick the club that matches. Clubs range from drivers to putters, so choosing well matters.
Practice the swipe on a few shots to learn how strength and direction respond. A small change in your swipe can noticeably change where the ball goes.
Keep your upgraded clubs in mind. Improving the clubs you use most can make your results more consistent over a round.
Watch your opponent's shots and learn the course layout as you play. Knowing the courses helps you plan safer routes to the hole.
Use the leaderboards and trophy goals as targets. Winning matches earns trophies that unlock higher tours, so steady wins help you progress.
faq: How do I hit the ball in Golf King 3D?
Swipe with the mouse in the direction you want, then release to hit the ball. The control works like playing pool.
How do I win a match?
You compete in 1v1 online battles against rivals. Winning matches is how you collect trophies and unlock higher tours.

bouncing-bug.intro: Bouncing Bug is a reflex game where you guide a quirky bug around a bouncy box full of monsters. Steer clear of threats while collecting treasures and treats to survive.
tips: Watch the monsters' positions before each bounce so you can plan a safe path instead of reacting at the last second.
Treat the treasures and treats as a reason to move through open space, but don't chase them into a corner where a monster can trap you.
Change direction early when you see a threat coming, since small timing adjustments are easier than big last-moment swerves.
Keep your eyes on the whole box rather than only on your bug, so you notice where danger is building up.
Use short play sessions to build up your reflexes, and try to beat your own survival time before pushing for more treasure.
faq: What is the main goal of Bouncing Bug?
Your goal is to keep your bug alive inside the bouncy box by dodging the lurking monsters while collecting shiny treasures and tasty treats.
How do I avoid the monsters?
Skillfully change your bug's direction when a threat gets close, and plan your bounces ahead so you have room to escape.

cargo-truck-game.intro: Cargo Truck Game puts you in the driver's seat of a heavy yellow dump truck loaded with coal. You drive over dirt tracks, mud, and steep mountain slopes while keeping your cargo secure.
tips: Ease into the throttle on muddy and uneven sections so the heavy load does not slide or shift.
Steer gently on bumpy dirt tracks, since sharp turns can make a loaded truck harder to control.
Take steep mountain slopes slowly and steadily rather than accelerating hard partway up.
Watch the road ahead and plan your line early, so you can adjust your speed before rough patches arrive.
Pay attention to how the truck responds after each bump and correct with small steering inputs.
faq: What is the main goal of Cargo Truck Game?
You drive a heavily loaded dump truck across rugged terrain and complete transport missions. The aim is to deliver your coal while keeping the cargo secure.
Which keys control the truck?
Use W, A, S, and D or the Arrow Keys to drive and steer. Throttle and steering are the main inputs you need to manage.

breach-ops.intro: Breach Ops is a tactical first-person shooter against smart bots, with a team bomb mode and a free-for-all Arena mode. This guide covers how to get the most out of both.
tips: In Bomb Defusal, spend your money from the buy menu (B) on the weapons and armor you will actually use each round, and save when your economy is low.
Use Shift to walk when you want to move quietly and stay accurate, and crouch with C when you need a lower target profile during a fight.
Press Q to swap back to your last weapon quickly, and use the 1-4 wheel to switch between weapons in the middle of a firefight.
In Arena, hold Space to bunny hop for faster movement, and use jump pads and power-ups to reposition before other players or bots can react.
If a fight goes badly, use the medkit (H) as soon as you can get some cover, and check the scores (Tab) to see where you stand.
faq: What is the goal of Bomb Defusal?
Raiders try to plant the bomb, while Wardens defend and try to defuse it in 5v5 rounds. Pick the role that fits your style and focus on the objective each round.
How does the Arena mode work?
Arena is a Quake-style free-for-all where every player fights for themselves. Use power-ups, jump pads and bunny hopping to move around the map and stay ahead of your opponents.

arrows-out.intro: Arrow Escape is a logic puzzle where you clear a board of arrows by tapping them in the right order. Plan each move carefully, because collisions cost hearts and time is limited.
tips: Before you tap anything, study the whole board and trace where each arrow would travel once it moves away.
Look for arrows that have a clear path out first, since removing them can open the way for the arrows blocked behind them.
Use the zoom controls to get a closer look at dense or tangled areas, then zoom back out to check the overall layout.
Keep track of your hearts. Since three mistakes end the attempt, slowing down on risky moves is often better than rushing.
Watch the timer on harder levels and avoid spending too long on a single decision, but never tap until you have a plan.
faq: How do I clear an arrow?
Left-click an arrow on PC or tap it on mobile to move it away. Choose the order of your taps carefully, because the correct sequence is what clears the board.
What happens when I make a mistake?
If arrows collide, you lose a heart. You start with three hearts, and losing all three ends the attempt right away.

strykon.intro: Strykon is a first person shooter that mixes tactical command with fast firefights. You fight across several modes, and you can customize and upgrade your weapons as you go.
tips: Try each mode before settling on one, so you learn which style of fight suits you best.
Spend your upgrades on the weapons you use most often instead of spreading them thinly across the arsenal.
Think about your forces' positions before each firefight, since strategy matters as much as quick reflexes here.
Get comfortable with the controls in a calm moment first, so you can react quickly when the action heats up.
Keep an eye on the continuous challenges, as they give you a clear next goal whenever a fight ends.
faq: What is the main goal of Strykon?
The game focuses on commanding your forces and winning firefights across its different modes. Strategy and combat both play a part in reaching your objectives.
How can I get stronger in Strykon?
You can customize and upgrade your arsenal, so improving your weapons is the main way to build power. Choose upgrades that match how you like to fight.

last-play-ragdoll-sandbox.intro: Last Play: Ragdoll Sandbox is a physics sandbox where you set up battles, interact with objects, and unlock new items and characters by completing challenges and mini-games.
tips: Move your character with W, A, S and D, and get a feel for how it moves before you start setting up a battle.
Use the left and right mouse buttons to test how objects and ragdolls react, so you know what to expect before you arrange a full fight.
Try placing objects and characters in different arrangements and watch how the physics plays out, since small changes can lead to very different results.
Play the mini-games to unlock new characters for the sandbox, and keep an eye on which challenge genres you have not tried yet.
Look at the community sharing features to see how other players have built their sandboxes, then adapt their ideas to your own setups.
faq: What is the main goal of Last Play: Ragdoll Sandbox?
There is no fixed goal described in the game. You build your own scenes, arrange battles, and experiment with the physics however you like.
How do I unlock new items and characters?
Pass challenges across a variety of genres to unlock new items. Go through the mini-games to unlock new characters for the sandbox.

commando-gun-shooting.intro: Commando Gun Shooting is a first-person shooter built around missions. You take on terrorists, defuse bombs, plant explosives, and rescue hostages across four battle gun modes.
tips: Read each mission's objective before you start shooting, since eliminating enemies, defusing bombs, planting explosives, and rescuing hostages each call for different priorities.
Try all four battle gun modes early on to find the one that suits your style, then go back to the others when a mission calls for something different.
When a mission includes hostages or bombs, keep them in mind as you move so you do not lose track of the main goal in the middle of a firefight.
Use the mouse for every button press, and take a moment to find the menu buttons before a mission so you are not fumbling for them under pressure.
Stay patient and think before each move, because the game rewards strategy and courage together rather than rushing in.
faq: What is the main goal of Commando Gun Shooting?
Your goal is to complete each mission, whether that means eliminating terrorists, defusing bombs, planting explosives, or rescuing hostages. Each mission tests your skill and strategy.
How do I control the game?
The game is played with the mouse, and you use it to click any button in the game. Check the on-screen buttons at the start of each mission to see what they do.

dta-6.intro: DTA 6 is a chaotic browser sandbox where you explore a surreal world, interact with meme-talking ragdolls, and use a range of weapons in a city you can shape however you like.
tips: Experiment with limb control early on, since the game is built around it. Try different movements to see how the ragdolls react before you start causing bigger chaos.
Gather a few different weapons and test each one on the same target. Knowing how each weapon behaves will help you decide what to use in a given situation.
Explore the whole city before you settle on a plan. Learning the layout and what is there will give you more options for where and how you play.
Pay attention to the ragdolls and their meme-style talk, since they are a central part of the world. Watching how they respond can suggest new ways to play.
Play in short sessions and try one new idea at a time. This makes it easier to notice which actions and weapons create the results you enjoy most.
faq: What is the goal of DTA 6?
The game is a sandbox, so there is no fixed goal listed. You play by exploring the world, gathering weapons, and trying out what you can do in the city.
How do I control the ragdolls?
The game does not list specific controls, so the best approach is to test movements and see how your character responds. Limb control is a key part of the experience.

find-the-needle.intro: Find the Needle is a clicker about digging through a huge haystack layer by layer. Clear the hay, unlock better tools and upgrades, and work your way down to the one tiny needle hidden inside.
tips: Check the upgrade menu with TAB often so you know which upgrades you can afford and which ones will help you clear hay faster.
Spend the resources you earn in the shops on upgrades that speed up your progress, since faster clearing gets you closer to the needle sooner.
Try the different ways of collecting hay as you unlock them, and see which one works best for the layer you are on.
Work through the stack one layer at a time, since the goal is to shrink the pile until the needle is revealed.
Use WASD to move and LMB to interact, and keep your movement efficient so you spend more time clearing hay than walking around.
faq: What is the goal of Find the Needle?
Your goal is to dig through the haystack layer by layer until you find the one tiny needle hidden inside.
How do I spend the resources I earn?
You can spend them in shops on further upgrades and progression, which help you clear the hay more quickly and efficiently.

perfect-tongue.intro: Perfect Tongue is a casual 3D game where you stretch a long tongue to eat food while steering clear of dangerous props. Tap to play and choose your path through the many roads.
tips: Scan the road ahead before you commit, so you can spot dangerous props early and line up your tongue well in advance.
Prioritize clusters of food that are close together, since grabbing several in a row keeps your run efficient.
Treat fire and other hazards as the first thing to avoid, because a single bad hit matters more than missing one piece of food.
Pay attention to which road you are on, since the game offers many routes and some may give you a cleaner path to the food.
Play in short sessions and reset your focus between runs, as the game is designed to be relaxing rather than high pressure.
faq: What is the goal of Perfect Tongue?
You eat as much food as you can with your long tongue while avoiding dangerous props. Finishing your eating quickly is part of the challenge.
How do I start the game?
Tap the screen to play. The game is controlled with taps, as described in its instructions.

stickman-ghost-online.intro: Stickman Ghost Online is a side-scrolling action game where you play a stickman warrior fighting ninja enemies across the city. Clear each level, collect coins, and reach the boss to save the world.
tips: Collect coins as you move through each level, since they are what you use to upgrade your character.
Try the different weapons you find to see which one suits your style, then stick with it for a while so you learn its timing.
Chain attacks into combos rather than clicking randomly, because combos are how you deal the most damage to tougher enemies.
Use jumps to reposition during fights instead of standing still, which makes it harder for enemies to land hits on you.
Spend time on regular enemies to practice your combos before you reach the boss at the end of the level.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Take your stickman warrior to the end of each level by defeating the ninja enemies, then beat the boss to save the city.
How do I move and attack?
Use W, A, S and D to move, the Spacebar to jump, and click to attack. On mobile devices, use the on-screen buttons instead.

basketball-stars.intro: Basketball Stars is a fast, comical basketball game featuring iconic NBA-style players. You can face AI opponents or share the keyboard with a friend in one-on-one or two-on-two matches.
tips: Spend your first match learning which keyboard control does each action, since shooting, stealing and dunking all depend on quick input.
Try the AI opponents first to get comfortable with the pace before you challenge a friend.
Use steals when your opponent is moving toward the basket, since stopping their attack can be as valuable as scoring yourself.
When sharing a keyboard, agree with your partner or opponent on who controls which player before the match starts to avoid confusion.
In two-on-two games, coordinate with your teammate so one player pressures the ball while the other stays ready to receive a pass or defend.
faq: What is the goal of Basketball Stars?
You win by outplaying your opponent with shots, steals and slam dunks during your basketball match.
Can I play with a friend?
Yes. The game supports local play where you share the keyboard with a friend in one-on-one or two-on-two matches.

your-obby-escape.intro: Your Obby Escape is a 3D escape adventure where you move through traps, puzzles, and checkpoints to reach the end. You can team up with other players, chat, and explore hidden paths together.
tips: Use E to interact with doors, levers, buttons, and keys, and try each one you pass, since many of them are needed to move forward.
Save your progress by reaching checkpoints before attempting a hard section, so a mistake does not send you back far.
Use the mouse wheel to zoom out when you need a wider view of traps and jump gaps before you commit to a move.
Pay attention to the messages and secrets you find along the way, as they often point toward hidden paths.
If you are playing with friends, split up to check different areas and share what you discover in chat.
faq: What is the goal of Your Obby Escape?
Your goal is to get to the end of each escape. Along the way you can find hidden paths, secrets, and prizes.
Which keys do I use to move and jump?
Use WASD to move and the Space bar to jump. Press E to interact with objects such as doors, levers, buttons, and keys.

pool-shoot-tournament.intro: Pool Shoot Tournament is a bubble shooter where you clear colored balls by matching groups of three or more. Your aim is to build the highest score you can while keeping the wall from reaching the bottom.
tips: Look for a large cluster of one color before you shoot, since bigger groups earn more points in a single shot.
Check both direct hits and ricochet angles before firing, because a bounce off the side can reach a group that a straight shot cannot.
Clear the balls that hang off the edges or sit at the bottom of a cluster first, so the groups above can fall into play more easily.
Keep an eye on the lowest row of balls at all times, and take a safer shot early if the wall is getting close to the bottom.
Aim for precision over speed when the layout is tight, since a missed shot can leave the wall closer to the loss line.
faq: What is the main goal of Pool Shoot Tournament?
The goal is to earn the highest possible score by shooting bubbles. You get the most points by clearing large groups in one shot.
How many balls do I need to match?
You need to group at least three balls of the same color to clear them. Any group of three or more of one color will work.

sniper-hero-urban-strike.intro: Sniper Hero: Urban Strike is a single-player shooting game where you clear urban missions one stage at a time. Aim carefully, because your ammunition is limited and every shot matters.
tips: Hold the left mouse button to aim and take your time lining up the shot before you release it.
Before each shot, check the whole area for civilians so you do not fire on the wrong target.
Count your remaining ammunition at the start of a stage and plan which targets are worth a shot.
Watch targets for a moment before firing, since their movement can change where your shot needs to land.
Replay earlier stages if you struggle, because practicing your aim and timing will help you move forward.
faq: How do I fire my weapon?
Hold the left mouse button to aim, then release it to fire. Releasing the button is what sends the shot.
What is the main goal of each stage?
Clear the targets in each urban mission to complete the stage and move on to the next one.

fractal-combat-x.intro: Fractal Combat X is a 3D shooter where you pilot advanced jets on missions over foreign planets. Speed and strategy matter as you fight, upgrade your aircraft, and unlock new jets and skills.
tips: Use evasive maneuvers early in each battle, since dodging incoming fire keeps your jet in the fight longer.
Balance speed and positioning. Moving fast helps you escape danger, but you still need control to line up precise shots.
Spend upgrades on the areas that match how you fly, so your aircraft improves in a way that suits your style.
Once you unlock new jets and skills, compare them to your current aircraft and try them in a battle to see how they handle.
Pay attention to your surroundings in the 3D space, because knowing where enemies are coming from makes it easier to plan your next move.
faq: What is the goal of Fractal Combat X?
You pilot advanced jets on aerial combat missions on foreign planets, using speed and strategy to win battles. Upgrading your aircraft and unlocking new jets and skills are part of progressing.
What are the controls in Fractal Combat X?
The game's description does not list specific controls, so check the in-game instructions or the controls screen before you start flying.

save-the-kitten.intro: Save the Kitten is a one-player arcade action game. Angry cat Tom has lured the kittens to his tower, and you must use a trampoline cat to rescue as many as you can and return them to their mother's basket.
tips: Keep your eye on the kittens and move the trampoline so they land on it before they can be caught by Tom.
Plan your route to the mother's basket before you start carrying kittens, so you don't waste time crossing the screen with a full load.
Use the arrow keys with small, steady movements rather than quick jerks, which makes it easier to line up each jump.
Spend what you earn on new trampolines and sneakers as soon as you can afford them, since the game lets you buy upgrades.
Watch the path of each kitten after it jumps, so you can predict where it will go and get under it in time.
faq: What is the goal of Save the Kitten?
Your goal is to rescue as many kittens as you can from Tom's tower and carry them to the basket of mommy kitty.
How do I control the trampoline cat?
Use the arrow keys to move the trampoline cat and help the kittens jump to their mother's basket.

naughty-baby-prankster.intro: Naughty Baby Prankster is an adventure where you play a mischievous baby exploring the house and turning everyday moments into funny surprises. Each room hides toys, tools, and prank chances to discover.
tips: Explore each room fully before moving on, since every room hides new toys, tools, and prank opportunities.
Use running with Shift when you need to cover long distances quickly, and switch to crawling with G when you need to move quietly or get into tight spaces.
Look for combinations: an item you find in one room may work well with a prank opportunity in another, so keep track of what you have picked up.
Plan your pranks with a bit of strategy rather than acting at random, since the game mixes humor with light strategy.
Press F near doors to open them or move forward, and check what is behind each door before you commit to going through.
faq: What is the goal of Naughty Baby Prankster?

The game is about exploring the house as a mischievous baby, finding toys and tools, and creating funny pranks from ordinary moments. The description does not list a fixed win condition, so play freely and experiment.
How do I move my character on PC?
Use WASD to move. Hold Shift to run and press G to crawl. Press F to open a door or move on.

obby-rainbow-parkour-two-player.intro: Obby Rainbow Parkour Two Player is an adventure game about running and jumping through colorful obstacle courses. You can play alone or team up with a friend to reach the finish line of each rainbow level.
tips: Use Shift to sprint before a long gap, since the extra speed helps you clear it.
Take short pauses before tricky jumps so you can line up your landing instead of rushing it.
If you play with a friend, agree on who goes first so you do not block each other on narrow platforms.
Use Q to shove when your partner or a rival is in the way, but only when it helps you stay on track.
When you fall, retry the same obstacle with a clear plan rather than repeating the same jump without changing anything.
faq: How do I move and jump in the game?
Player one uses W, A, S and D to move and Space to jump, while player two uses the arrow keys to move and L to jump. Shift sprints for both players.
Can I play this game by myself?
Yes, the game can be played alone or with a friend in the same session. Playing solo lets you focus on timing your jumps without coordinating with a partner.

build-an-aquapark.intro: Build an Aquapark is a simulation game where you buy water slide parts, combine them into your own track, and ride it at full speed. Your aim is to create the longest, fastest, and craziest slide you can.
tips: Try different part combinations before settling on a layout, since the game lets you connect parts however you like.
Ride your slide after each change to see how it actually performs, rather than guessing from the parts alone.
Use upgrades to improve the parts you already have, so you can keep building on a track you know works.
Focus on one goal at a time, such as making the track longer or faster, so you can judge which changes help most.
Jump on the water ring at the start of each ride to get going before you slide down.
faq: What is the main goal of Build an Aquapark?
The goal is to build your own water slide and create the longest, fastest, and craziest track possible. You can then show it off to others.
How do I start a ride on my slide?
Jump on the water ring and slide down. Once you have built your track, this is how you test it at full speed.

gym-boss.intro: Gym Boss is a casual sports game where you start with basic exercises and build your strength over time. Tap or click to complete sets, move up to heavier gear, and work your way to the ring bosses.
tips: Move on to heavier equipment once your current gear feels easy, since harder gear makes your strength grow faster.
Check each boss's required strength level before you enter the ring, and train until you meet it so you do not waste attempts.
Keep an eye on the other gym-goers on the map, because overtaking them in level earns bonuses.
Use boosters when you have them to speed up your progress through the early stages.
Do not stay on light weights for too long. Steady growth is what carries you through the tougher bosses.
faq: How do I earn strength points?
Tap the screen or click to perform sets, and each set earns you strength points.
What do I need to do to win?
Defeat all the bosses in the ring. Doing so earns you the title of Ultimate Gym Boss.

hit-tank-battle.intro: Hit Tank Battle is a 3D tank shooter where you drive a battle tank around arenas, dodge enemy fire, and destroy every opponent. Movement uses W, A, S and D, and you fire with Space or the left mouse button.
tips: Keep moving rather than standing still, since stationary tanks make easy targets for enemy fire.
Hold Space or the left mouse button for continuous fire, and release it when you need to focus on dodging.
Check where enemies are before you advance so you can plan your route through the arena.
Use short, deliberate movements to line up your shots instead of spinning the tank wildly.
Watch for incoming shots and change direction early, because reacting late usually means taking damage.
faq: What is the goal of Hit Tank Battle?
You need to destroy every opponent in each arena to win the battle. Each fight tests your shooting, reflexes and tactics.
Which keys control the tank?
Use W to move forward, S to move backward, A to move left and D to move right. Space or holding the left mouse button fires continuously.

super-candy-jewels.intro: Super Candy Jewels is a match-3 puzzle game where you swap candies to line up three or more of the same color. Clear enough candies to finish each level before your moves or time run out.
tips: Look for moves that line up four or more candies in a row, since longer matches create candy bombs that can clear more of the board.
Plan a few swaps ahead instead of picking the first match you see, so you do not waste moves on small matches.
Save your boosters for levels where you are close to the goal but running low on moves or time.
Watch the move counter or timer at all times and check how many candies you still need to collect.
Try to set up combos where a bomb you create clears candies that then trigger another match.
faq: What is the basic goal of Super Candy Jewels?
Swap neighboring candies to match three or more of the same color and collect enough candies to finish each level. You must do this before you run out of moves or time.
How do I make a candy bomb?
Match three or more candies in a row to create candy bombs. Longer rows give you more points and stronger effects.

speakerman-revenge.intro: Speakerman Revenge is a clicker action game where you fight foes from a toilet seat. You tap in rhythm to launch sound waves, then upgrade your speakers to handle tougher challenges.
tips: Focus on keeping a steady tapping rhythm, since the game is built around timing your taps to the beat.
Spend upgrades on your speakers as soon as you can afford them, because stronger speakers make later challenges easier to handle.
Pay attention to how each foe responds to your sound waves so you can tell which approach works best against them.
Take short breaks when you feel your timing slipping, then return with a fresh tempo rather than tapping faster and losing accuracy.
Replay earlier challenges after upgrading to see how much easier they feel, which helps you judge whether your build is ready for harder ones.
faq: How do I attack the foes in Speakerman Revenge?
You battle foes by tapping in rhythm, and each well-timed tap launches a sound wave at your enemies.
What should I spend my progress on?
Use it to upgrade your speakers, since stronger speakers help you deal with the relentless challenges the game throws at you.

battle-simluator-counter-stickman.intro: Counter Stickman is a 3D strategy shooter where you command stickman soldiers across changing terrain. Each level brings new environments and tougher challenges to test your tactics.
tips: Study the terrain before you move your soldiers, since each area can offer cover or openings that change how you approach the fight.
Plan your tactical maneuvers ahead of time rather than rushing forward, so your soldiers reach key positions together.
Take your time with precision shooting. Aiming carefully at the most important targets is usually better than firing wildly.
Pay attention to how each new level changes the environment, and adjust your strategy instead of repeating the same approach.
Keep your overall objective in mind, which is to secure victory, and avoid spending your soldiers on fights that do not move you toward it.
faq: What is the goal of Counter Stickman?
Your goal is to secure victory by commanding your stickman soldiers through each 3D battle. The game focuses on strategic planning as much as combat.
How does the game get harder as I progress?
Each level raises the stakes with unique environments and new challenges. Expect the terrain and battle setup to test your strategy more as you advance.

in-space.intro: In Space is a 2D top-down adventure where you play as an elite soldier fighting alien swarms across the starscape. Survive as threats grow stronger and upgrade your futuristic weapons to last longer.
tips: Spend upgrades on the weapons that help you handle the swarms you face most often, rather than spreading them thin across everything.
Keep track of where enemies are coming from in the top-down view so you can reposition before you get surrounded.
Pace yourself early on, since the threats keep evolving and staying alive matters more than clearing quickly.
Plan each choice before acting, because the game rewards strategy as much as quick reactions.
Watch how enemy behavior changes over time so you can adjust your approach as the challenge increases.
faq: What is the main goal of In Space?
Your goal is to survive against relentless alien swarms by fighting, upgrading, and outlasting the evolving threats in the starscape.
How do I get stronger during a run?
You can upgrade your futuristic weaponry as you progress, which helps you deal with tougher enemies as they appear.

maple-lake.intro: Maple Lake is a cozy merge game where you rebuild Theo's lakeside camp into a luxury resort. Combine matching buildings, grow your income, and follow the story through its contracts.
tips: Merge identical buildings whenever you can, since combining two of the same piece is the main way to reach higher-level buildings.
Use BUILD to create new pieces, and use UPGRADE to raise the level of the buildings it produces so your merges start higher up.
Aim to get buildings to level 5 or above early, because only those generate passive income.
Place decorations like trees, fountains, lanterns, and wells, since they boost your income and help your passive earnings grow faster.
Check your contracts regularly, because completing them earns cash and unlocks free land, which gives you more room to expand.
faq: How do I merge buildings in Maple Lake?
Drag two identical buildings together and they will combine into a higher-level building. If you drop a building onto a different one, the two will swap positions instead.
What do I do with buildings I don't want?
Drag them to the bin to remove them from your resort. This clears space for new buildings you create with BUILD.

bff-christmas-cookie-challenge.intro: Play as a princess in festive cookie decorating battles. Pick colors and decorations to create holiday treats that stand out, and outdo your rivals in this cheerful Christmas challenge.
tips: Choose a clear theme early, such as snowflakes or candy canes, so every decoration you add supports the same festive look.
Pick a few vibrant colors that contrast well with each other, since bright pairings make a cookie easier to notice.
Use unique decorations sparingly. One or two standout details often look more polished than covering the whole cookie.
Keep an eye on presentation, because the description names it as a key part of winning, so think about how the finished cookie looks at a glance.
Play against the AI first to get a feel for the style, then challenge friends when you want a tougher, more creative contest.
faq: What is the goal of Bff Christmas Cookie Challenge?
You compete in cookie decorating battles by designing festive treats with vibrant colors and unique decorations. The aim is to outsmart your opponents, whether they are friends or the AI.
What makes a winning cookie in this game?
The game points to imagination and presentation as the keys to victory. Creative choices that look good together are likely to help you most.

skyslime-adventures.intro: Skyslime Adventures is a puzzle game where you guide a slime across floating platforms to reach hidden treasure. Each level mixes physics, terrain, and timing to test your logic.
tips: Before you move, study the whole level and note where the key, the chest, and any traps or obstacles are.
Use the terrain and the platforms' positions to plan a route, since the slime's path depends on where it can land.
Pay close attention to timing around moving hazards, and wait for a clear gap instead of rushing through.
If a level stalls, try a different order of actions rather than repeating the same move, because many puzzles have more than one solution.
Take short breaks between tricky levels so you can look at the layout again with fresh eyes.
faq: What is the goal of Skyslime Adventures?
Your goal is to move the key to the treasure chest in each level, using the slime to get past traps and obstacles.
How do I control the slime?
The game is played with the mouse, so use it to move and interact with the slime and the level pieces as the game prompts you.

sunfield-vegetable-farm.intro: Sunfield Vegetable Farm is a cozy 3D farming game where you plant, water, harvest and sell vegetables. Grow your farm at your own pace and expand as your money builds up.
tips: Plant a few crops you can keep up with, like carrots, tomatoes or cabbages, before you add more beds, so watering and harvesting never fall behind.
Keep your market carts stocked so customers at the checkout can be served quickly and your earnings keep coming in.
Spend your earnings on new land when your current beds and carts are busy, since more space lets you grow and sell more at once.
Hire your cashier and farm workers early to free yourself up for planting, watering and restocking.
Learn the 1-5 tool keys and the E or Space action key so switching between tasks becomes quick and natural.
faq: What is the main goal of Sunfield Vegetable Farm?
The goal is to grow, harvest and sell vegetables, then use your money to expand your farm. Progress is endless, so you can keep growing your farm as long as you like.
How do I move around the farm?
Use W, A, S, D or the arrow keys to move, or click where you want to walk. On mobile, use the joystick.

stickman3d-shooter.intro: Stickman3D Shooter is a single-player, level-based 3D shooter where you control a stickman with a pistol. Each stage is a puzzle that asks you to find the right angle and line up your shots.
tips: Before you fire, look at the whole level and work out the order you want to eliminate enemies in rather than shooting at the nearest one first.
Take a moment to find the right angle before each shot, since the puzzle is built around precise aim.
Watch how the layout of the level can help your shots reach enemies in creative ways, not just in a straight line.
Expect each level to get harder, so use what you learned in earlier stages to plan your approach.
Aim with care and fire deliberately, because accuracy matters more here than speed.
faq: What is the goal of Stickman3D Shooter?
Your goal is to eliminate the enemies in each level by lining up your shots with the pistol. Each level is a puzzle that tests precision and problem-solving.
How do I control the stickman?
The game is played with the mouse or touch controls. Use them to aim and fire your pistol at enemies.

saguaro.intro: Saguaro is a colorful arcade game where you dash through a Mexican landscape as a lively cactus. Dodge balloons, collect glowing maracas, and keep your stylish gear intact.
tips: Keep your eyes moving ahead of the cactus so you can spot balloons early and adjust before you reach them.
Look for glowing maracas on your route, since collecting them both recovers lost items and raises your score.
Plan your next few moves rather than reacting only to what is directly in front of you, because the landscape changes quickly.
Spend the first few seconds testing the controls in a safe stretch so your movements feel natural before the action picks up.
Protect your gear first, then chase maracas, so a single mistake does not cost you more than it needs to.
faq: What is the main goal in Saguaro?
You play as a cactus dashing through the landscape, aiming to dodge balloons, keep your gear intact, and collect glowing maracas.
How do I increase my score?
Collect the glowing maracas, which also help you reclaim lost items.

knight-s-arena-castle-defense.intro: Knight's Arena is a 3D action defense game where one hero holds off waves of enemies trying to reach the castle. Fight up close, collect gear, and keep the fortress standing.
tips: Attack when you have room to act, and step back from the horde if too many enemies surround you at once.
Pick up weapons and armor as you find them, and compare them before switching so you keep the stronger option.
Spend your upgrades on the stats that match how you fight, rather than spreading them evenly across everything.
Watch which enemies are closest to the castle gate and deal with them first, since a single breakthrough is what ends a run.
Use short, controlled moves with WASD or swipes to reposition, then strike when enemies are lined up in front of you.
faq: What is the main goal of Knight's Arena?
Protect the castle by defeating enemies and stopping them from breaking through to the fortress. Each victory also makes your hero stronger.
How do I attack and interact?
On desktop, use the left mouse button. On mobile, tap the screen. Both controls handle attacking and interacting with items.

hoops-the-game.intro: HOOPS is a basketball game where you toss a ball from hoop to hoop. Precision and timing matter most, and direct shots earn bonus points on the way to a high score.
tips: Take a moment to line up each throw before you release, since precision matters more than speed.
Watch the rhythm of your movement and time your shots rather than rushing them.
Go for direct shots when you can, because they earn bonus points that add up quickly.
Pick up coins along the way when you can do so without risking a miss, as they unlock customizations for your ball.
Track your score after each attempt and note which shots worked, so you can repeat that approach in the high score challenge.
faq: What is the main goal in HOOPS?
Toss your basketball from hoop to hoop and aim for direct shots to rack up bonus points. The game also challenges you to reach a high score.
How do I earn bonus points?
Bonus points come from direct shots. Focus on accurate throws so you can land them consistently.

my-sugar-factory.intro: My Sugar Factory is a turn-based management game where you grow a sugar business from a single tap. You expand with factories and labs, develop new sugarcane varieties, and aim to maximize profits.
tips: Plan your expansion order before buying anything, since each factory and lab you add shapes what you can earn next.
Treat sugarcane innovation as a long-term investment and compare what each new variety offers before committing.
Because the game is turn-based, take a moment to review your options each turn rather than rushing through decisions.
Check back periodically, since you keep earning while idle, and use those returns to fund your next expansion.
Keep your focus on profit over time: a decision that looks small can affect your income later, so think ahead.
faq: What is the main goal of My Sugar Factory?
Your goal is to build a sweet empire from scratch and maximize your profits. You do this by expanding your operation and improving your sugarcane varieties.
Do I need to keep playing to keep earning?
No. The game lets you earn even while you are idle, so your operation keeps producing when you step away.

tiles-hop-edm-rush.intro: Tiles Hop: EDM Rush! is an endless jumping and running game set to music. You control everything with the mouse, and you can upload your own favorite songs to play along to.
tips: Listen to the beat before you start, since the music is the main rhythm to follow.
Keep your mouse movements small and steady so your timing stays consistent as the run continues.
Try a song with a clear, steady tempo first to learn the pattern before moving to faster tracks.
Stay relaxed and focus on the next jump rather than the one you just made, since the run never ends.
Take short breaks between sessions so your timing stays sharp and the game stays fun.
faq: How do I play Tiles Hop: EDM Rush!?
Use your mouse to control the jumps and keep the character moving along the tiles. The game is endless, so the aim is to keep going as long as you can.
Can I play my own music?
Yes. The game lets you upload your own favorite songs to play with, so you can run and jump to the tracks you like best.

dungeon-shop-rush.intro: Dungeon Shop Rush is a shop management game where you serve a line of hurried heroes by matching them with the right swords, potions and scrolls. Keep customers happy, build combos, and grow your shop between shifts.
tips: Look at which item each hero wants before you start dragging, and keep the shelf stocked so you are never searching for a missing ware.
Tap empty shelf items to restock them early, before a shift gets busy and heroes start waiting.
Serve heroes back-to-back to keep your combo rising, since combo chests reward you for it.
When an order is marked Enchanted, drop the ordinary item on the enchanting station first and give the glowing result to the hero, so plan that step ahead of time.
Before a shift, read the contract, since it changes the rules, and spend your coins on upgrades that speed up restocks or give you bigger shelves.
faq: What is the goal of each shift?
You need to reach a coin goal for the shift. Half the goal passes the shift, and the full goal earns three stars.
How do I serve a hero?
Drag the item from the shelf onto the hero who ordered it, or tap the item and then tap the hero.

drink-drive-survive.intro: Drink Drive Survive is a racing survival game where you dodge hazards while your reflexes are tested. Each level asks for sharper focus, and your score depends on how long you last.
tips: Keep your attention on the road ahead rather than on any single hazard, since the game is built around constant distractions.
Expect the screen to feel unreliable, and avoid overcorrecting when things look off, because small, steady movements tend to keep you alive longer.
Watch how each new level changes the challenge and adjust your focus early instead of reacting only after hazards appear.
Because your score rides on endurance, prioritize staying alive over chasing risky moves, even if progress feels slower.
Take a short mental reset after a close call so one mistake does not lead to several more in a row.
faq: What is the main goal of Drink Drive Survive?
The goal is to survive the hazards for as long as possible while moving through the levels. The game is built around endurance rather than simply finishing a course.
How is the score determined?
Your score depends on endurance, so the longer you keep going, the more your score reflects your survival.

colonora-colony-survival.intro: Colonora is a colony survival sim where a small group of survivors lands on a wild planet and must build a settlement that lasts. You manage shelter, food, crafting, and daily work.
tips: Build shelter and a food supply before anything else, since the colony depends on both to stay alive.
Check each colonist's needs and mood regularly, and ease their workload before someone is pushed far enough to have a mental break.
Set work priorities so colonists handle routine tasks on their own, and leave your attention for urgent problems.
Use double click or double tap to select all similar objects at once, which makes it faster to manage many buildings or colonists.
Prepare weapons and armor ahead of raids and random events, since each colony's story will test your defenses differently.
faq: What is the main goal of Colonora?
Your goal is to keep your colony alive and growing by building shelter, growing and cooking food, crafting gear, and managing colonist work.
How do I avoid mental breaks among my colonists?
Watch each colonist's needs and mood, and reduce their pressure before it gets too high. A colonist pushed too far may break down.

maritime-sniper.intro: Maritime Sniper is a shooting game where you pick up guns, guard ships and beat all the enemies. You play with the mouse, so precise clicks matter most.
tips: Keep your attention on the ships you are guarding, since protecting them is the core job in each round.
Pick up a new gun when you can, and get a feel for how each one handles before you rely on it in a tight moment.
Click with patience rather than rapidly firing, because one well-placed shot is usually more useful than several rushed ones.
Scan the whole scene before each shot so you spot the next enemy coming toward your ships.
Focus on clearing the enemies closest to your ships first, as they are the most immediate threat.
faq: What is the goal of Maritime Sniper?
Your goal is to guard the ships and beat all the enemies. The game is about defending your fleet while you take out threats.
How do I control the game?
You play by clicking the mouse. Every shot is made with a click, so your aim and timing are what decide how well you do.

tentrix-blast.intro: TenTrix Blast is a puzzle game where you drag blocks onto a grid to fill it and score points. The game ends when you run out of room, so placement matters from the first move.
tips: Before you drag a block, look at the shape you are holding and find the spot where it fits with the least leftover gaps.
Keep open space spread across the grid rather than stacking everything in one corner, so larger blocks still have somewhere to go.
Avoid leaving single isolated empty squares, since they are hard to fill and can slowly eat up your available room.
When the board gets crowded, prioritise placements that complete filled areas, because freeing up space is what keeps the game going.
Plan one or two moves ahead by checking which blocks are waiting next, so you do not trap yourself with a shape that has no good position.
faq: What is the goal of TenTrix Blast?
The goal is to fill the grid by dragging blocks into place and score as many points as you can. The game ends when there is no room left for the blocks you have.
How do I move the blocks?
You control the game by dragging blocks onto the grid. Pick a spot that fits the shape before you let go.

vehicle-masters.intro: Vehicle Masters is a minimalist parking game with over 40 levels that grow harder over time. Steer through tight spaces, avoid obstacles, and park inside the green zone.
tips: Slow down before tight turns and narrow alleys, since most collisions happen when you carry too much speed into a corner.
On desktop, use the brake with Spacebar early instead of braking at the last moment, so you keep control of the car's position.
Check each layout before moving: note where the walls, moving barriers, and parked cars are, and plan a route to the green zone first.
Make small steering adjustments and reverse slowly when you need to line up with the spot, rather than correcting with large turns.
If a level keeps defeating you, pause on the layout and try a different approach, since each level must be completed before the next one unlocks.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Park your car inside the green zone without hitting any walls or obstacles. Completing a level unlocks the next one.
How do the controls work on desktop?
Use the arrow keys or WASD to steer, press R for reverse gear and D for drive gear, and use Spacebar to brake.

snackrab.intro: Snackrab is a cosy merge game on a beach. You make snacks from machines, merge matching treats, and serve guests before their patience runs out. Coins pay for your stall and the beach.
tips: Merge matching snacks early so the tray does not fill up, since machines need a short breather after a few taps.
Watch the ring around each guest and serve those still smiling first, because a quick serve earns a tip on top.
Drag snacks you do not need onto the crab, and feed it when you can so it dances and every guest gets its patience back.
Use the slots in the tray to hold a snack you will need soon, and keep the round undo arrow in mind if you make a mistake.
Check the book when you are unsure what merges into what, and try to have a few snacks ready before a rush hour bell rings.
faq: How do I merge two snacks?
Drag one snack onto an identical one, or tap one snack and then the other. The two combine into the next treat.
What happens when a guest's patience runs out?
The ring around the guest empties and the guest walks away. Serve each guest while the ring still has time left.

mr-santa-run-2.intro: Mr Santa Run 2 is a holiday-themed arcade runner where you guide Santa through obstacles while collecting stars to raise your score. Quick reactions and good timing are the core skills.
tips: Watch the path ahead rather than the obstacle right in front of Santa, so you have time to choose when to jump.
Time your jumps early for longer gaps; a late jump is the most common way to lose a run.
Try to collect stars when they are on your route, but do not risk a dangerous jump just to grab one.
Stay calm after a mistake and restart with a clear plan, since short practice runs help you learn the timing of each section.
Pay attention to the rhythm of the obstacles, because repeated patterns become easier to predict the longer you play.
faq: What is the main goal of Mr Santa Run 2?
Guide Santa through the obstacle-filled world, avoid dangers, and collect stars to build up your score.
How do I get a higher score?
Collect as many stars as you can while staying alive, since stars are what boost your score.

bean-tower.intro: Bean Tower is an endless arcade climber where you run, jump and bounce off walls to climb as high as you can before the scrolling tower leaves you behind. Chaining big jumps into combos is the key to a high score.
tips: Build up your running speed before each jump, since faster running gives you a higher jump.
Use the walls to change direction. They bounce you back at full speed, so you can turn without losing momentum.
Try to jump two or more floors at a time, again and again within 3 seconds, to keep your combo going. Longer combos give bigger bonuses.
Keep an eye on the tower's pace. It speeds up every 30 seconds, so plan your climb to stay ahead of it.

Pick up coins, diamonds and power-up bubbles when they are safe to reach, then spend them in the shop between runs. Practice mode lets you restart from any checkpoint you have reached, which is useful for learning tricky sections.
faq: What is the goal of Bean Tower?
Climb as high as you can before the scrolling tower leaves you behind. Your run ends if you fall off the bottom of the screen.
How do I get a higher jump?
Run faster before you jump, because the faster you run, the higher you jump. Build speed on flat ground before you leap.

master-of-break-an-eggs.intro: Master of Break an Eggs is a 3D egg-stealing simulator where you break eggs, grab the pets inside, and run them home before the zone guardian catches you. Build your pen and work your way from the Easy zone up to Insane.
tips: Use Auto Swing when you want to focus on running. It breaks eggs for you, so you can spend your attention on the route back to your pen.
Save the money your pets earn and spend it on pickaxe upgrades first. A stronger pickaxe is the quickest way to make each egg trip more productive.
Keep an eye on the guardian while carrying a pet. Plan a route that keeps you moving toward home rather than stopping to look around.
Use the right mouse button to look around while you run, so you can check where the guardian is without losing track of your path.
Bring up to four pets along for bonuses. Choose pets whose bonuses fit your plan, and don't wait too long before moving to a harder zone for rarer pets.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Break eggs with your pickaxe, grab the pet that hatches, and carry it back to your pen before the zone guardian catches you.
How do I earn money?
Pets in your pen earn money every second. You can spend it on stronger pickaxes, pen upgrades, and the treadmill.

merge-to-agi.intro: Merge to AGI is a cozy merge-2 puzzle where you run a garage AI lab. You combine items, fill customer orders, and expand your empire across ten districts while rival labs compete on the leaderboard.
tips: Keep your board from filling up by merging pairs as soon as they appear, since clutter makes it harder to spot the next match.
Check which items customers are asking for before you start a long merge chain, so you can build toward those orders.
Tap generators steadily but not blindly; making items you cannot merge soon can crowd your workspace.
Save coins for the projects and districts that give you the most room to grow, rather than spending on the first option you see.
Watch the leaderboard to see how you stack up against the rival labs, and use that as a gauge for how fast you should be progressing.
faq: What is the main goal of Merge to AGI?
Your goal is to grow your garage AI lab into an AGI empire by merging items, filling customer orders, and unlocking districts. Ten districts are available to expand into.
How do I merge items?
Drag two identical items together to merge them into the next tier. Merging is the core action of the game.

clearfell-forest-outpost.intro: Clearfell is a 3D base-building survival game set in a forest clearing. You expand from a single tent, gather resources, and defend against goblin raids that come every other night.
tips: Chop your way out of the clearing early, then spread your gathering so you collect wood, stone, gold and iron without running short of any one of them.
Use the day to build up production and defenses, since the goblins only raid every other night and you need stock ready before the attack.
Place turrets and mortars along the paths goblins use to reach your base, so enemies are under fire before they reach your walls.
Keep your guns and grenades ready for raid nights, and use the dash to get out of trouble when enemies close in.
When you clear a goblin lair, check the trails before you go deeper, because new camps appear further into the woods.
faq: What is the main goal of Clearfell: Forest Outpost?
Build and grow your base from one tent, survive the goblin raids that come every other night, and push back into the forest by burning goblin lairs.
How do I shoot and throw grenades?
Aim with the mouse and press left mouse button to shoot. Press right mouse button or G to throw a grenade.

truck-slam.intro: Truck Slam is a 2D arena arcade game where trucks ram, slam, and swing at each other to knock opponents off the platform. Win fights, pick up stat upgrades, and work through tougher arenas.
tips: Use speed to build momentum before you ram, since a truck that is already moving will usually push its opponent harder.
Jump to dodge incoming attacks and to get above an opponent before you slam down on them.
Watch the arena obstacles and the edge of the platform, and try to keep your opponent positioned near the edge when you attack.
After each victory, put your upgrade points into the stat that matches your style, such as power for pushing or durability for surviving heavy hits.
In 2-player mode on one device, agree on who uses which set of controls before the match so you do not fumble the keys mid-fight.
faq: What is the goal of Truck Slam?
Knock your opponent off the platform using ramming, slams, or swings. Complete levels to move on to harder arenas.
How do I control my truck in Player 1 mode?
Use A and D to move, W to jump, and S to swing.

wear-the-helmet.intro: Wear the Helmet is a 2D endless runner where you steer a scooter down dangerous roads using simple keyboard controls. Your aim is to ride as far as you can while avoiding barricades, roadblocks, and open sewer holes.
tips: Watch the road ahead rather than the obstacle right in front of you, so you have time to react to each barricade, roadblock, or sewer hole.
Try a run with the helmet and a run without it, since the game frames the choice as extra bounce versus relying on skill. Pick the approach that feels more controllable to you.
Keep your steering smooth and avoid large, sudden movements, which can push you into the next hazard.
Plan your moves a few obstacles ahead, especially when the road narrows or hazards come in quick succession.
Play in short sessions and review what caused each crash, so you can improve your timing for the next attempt.
faq: What is the goal of Wear the Helmet?
The goal is to ride your scooter as far as possible along the road without crashing into the obstacles.
What obstacles do I need to avoid?
You need to dodge barricades, roadblocks, and open sewer holes that appear along the road.

offroad-jeep-simulation.intro: Offroad Jeep Simulation is a 3D driving game where you guide 4x4 jeeps over rocky mountains, muddy trails, steep hills, and dense forests. Complete missions, avoid obstacles, and reach your destination to earn rewards.
tips: Look ahead to pick your line before you reach rocks, mud, or tree cover, since a route planned early is easier to hold than one corrected at the last second.
Ease off on steep hills and use small inputs so the jeep keeps its grip instead of spinning its wheels.
Tap the brake with Space on steep downhill sections to keep your speed under control and avoid sliding into obstacles.
On muddy trails, steer gently and avoid sudden turns, because the realistic physics can make the jeep slide when you rush.
Take the time to learn how the jeep handles on flat ground first, then apply that feel to harder terrain in later missions.
faq: What is the goal of Offroad Jeep Simulation?
Your goal is to drive your 4x4 jeep through difficult terrain, avoid obstacles, and reach your mission destination safely to earn rewards.
Which keys control the jeep?
Use W, A, S, D or the Arrow Keys to drive and steer, and press Space to brake.

log-flyer-grandpa-takes-off.intro: Log Flyer: Grandpa Takes Off is an arcade flying game where you launch Grandpa on a flying log across a snowy valley. Balance your flight, spend coins on upgrades, and push for a longer single-flight distance.
tips: Spend your first coins on the parts that help you go farther, such as the engine or fuel tank, before cosmetic items like paint jobs.
Use short bursts of engine thrust and release Space to glide when you want to save fuel for the middle of the flight.
Keep the nose at a steady angle rather than making large swings. Quick, constant corrections help you stay in the air longer.
Check your missions in the workshop often, since they are permanent and their rewards can help fund upgrades.
Treat each flight as a chance to beat your best single-flight distance, because the SCORE leaderboard tracks that record rather than totals.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Fly Grandpa as far as you can. Reaching the village at 6 km is an early milestone, and you can keep flying to set a new distance record.
How do I control the flight on desktop?
Hold W or Up Arrow to raise the nose and S or Down Arrow to lower it. Hold Space to run the engine, and release it to glide and save fuel.

pet-riders.intro: Pet Riders is a 3D simulation where you start on a slow snail and work your way up to dragons. Search the valley for eggs, bring them home to your ranch, and see which pet hatches.
tips: Check the map with M when you are looking for eggs, so you can cover different parts of the valley instead of retracing your steps.
Bring eggs back to your ranch as you find them, since that is where new pets hatch.
Use B to review your pets and see which ones you still need to complete the collection.
Set the camera behind you with C when riding, so you can see where you are heading. Use H to return home quickly when you want to get back to the ranch.
Try the flying pets once you have them, using Space to rise and Shift to descend. If flight feels hard to control, look at the one-tap flight option in the settings.
faq: What is the goal of Pet Riders?
Complete the pet collection, build the best ranch in the valley, and become the fastest rider. Each new pet you hatch is faster than the last.
How do I get new pets?
Search the valley for eggs and bring them home to your ranch. Each egg hatches a pet when you bring it back.

babel-tower.intro: Babel Tower is a puzzle strategy game about mining resources, turning them into bricks, and building the Tower of Babel higher. Planning your upgrades and automation is the key to growing faster.
tips: Spend early resources on the operations that produce the most materials, since faster income speeds up everything else.
Balance mining and brick crafting so neither one becomes a bottleneck that leaves the other waiting.
Prioritize automation once it is available, because it keeps progress moving while you plan your next steps.
Save up for upgrades that boost several parts of your operation at once rather than small single improvements.
Check your resource totals before each purchase so you always know what you can afford and what to build next.
faq: What is the main goal of Babel Tower?
The goal is to mine resources, craft them into bricks, and build the tower as high as you can. Growing your operation efficiently is how you reach the heavens faster.
How should I approach upgrades?
Focus on upgrades that improve your resource output or automation first, since they compound over time. Plan a few steps ahead so each upgrade supports the next one.

hexa-bloom.intro: Hexa Bloom is a calm hexagon puzzle where you stack colorful tiles on a honeycomb board. Match colors to trigger cascades, collect ten of one color to bloom a stack, and reach the level goal before the board fills.
tips: Before you drop a stack, check the top colors of the stacks next to the empty cell. Placing a tile where it lines up with a neighbour can start a chain reaction.
Look for moves that set up a second match, not just the first one. Cascades that clear several colors at once are where the best progress comes from.
Keep an eye on the level goal at the top of the screen. If a level asks for a single color, steer your stacks toward that color rather than spreading tiles across the board.
Save boosters for when you are truly stuck. Try a different placement first, and use Undo to take back a move that closed off your options.
Aim for three stars on each level by clearing it with room to spare. Finishing with more empty cells left gives you more room to work with on harder levels.
faq: How do I win a level?
Reach the goal shown at the top of the screen before the board fills up. The goal varies by level, so read it at the start of each one.
How do I make a stack bloom?
Collect 10 tiles of one color on the same stack. When it reaches ten, the stack bursts into a bloom and clears.

ragdoll-revenge-throw-at-annoying-people.intro: Ragdoll Revenge! is an arcade physics game where you throw things at annoying people across 200 levels. Each level asks you to knock everyone down before time runs out, with some using traps to send people flying.
tips: Look at each level before throwing and find the trap first, such as a button, rope, cannon, or the platform someone is standing on. Setting off a trap often takes out several people at once.
Aim for the people who are about to be hit by a trap or are close to others, so one throw can clear more than one person.
Keep an eye on the clock from the start. Earning three stars means finishing before time runs out, so avoid spending long on a single target.
Some people dodge, so if a throw misses, keep throwing rather than waiting. Pick a new target when someone moves out of the way.
Try different items with the item button. Some throws may work better on certain people or setups, and clearing boss levels unlocks new things to throw.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Knock everyone down before the clock runs out. Finishing in time is needed for three stars.
How do I control the game?
Tap or click on a person to throw at them. Use the item button to switch what you throw, and the level button to replay levels you have opened.

merge-cats-idle-army.intro: Merge Cats Idle Army is an idle merge game where you combine identical cats into stronger ones and send your army into battles against waves of rival cats and bosses. Your cats keep fighting while you are away.
tips: Merge cats as soon as you have two identical ones, since a higher-level cat makes the battles easier to win.
Keep your spawn button in mind: spend Soul Fragments on recruits when you can, and save some for upgrading your spawn level and speed.
Send cats to the battle tiles regularly, because enemies drop Soul Fragments with every hit and those fragments fund both recruits and upgrades.
Use your boosts during tougher waves or boss fights, and grab the free boosts that fly across the screen when they appear.
Claim your offline loot, daily rewards and quest prizes each time you return, and use Ascend when progress slows to restart with permanent bonuses.
faq: How do I merge cats in Merge Cats Idle Army?
Drag one cat onto another cat of the same level, and the two will merge into a stronger cat. You can do this with click and drag on PC or tap and drag on mobile.
What should I do when my progress slows down?
Consider using Ascend, which restarts your game with permanent bonuses so you come back stronger. You can also spin the Ascend Wheel once you Ascend.

worm-hunt-snake-game-io-zone.intro: Worm Hunt is a snake-style .io game set on large fields where you eat food, grow, and compete against other worms in real-time battles. Your aim is to outmaneuver rivals and climb the leaderboard.
tips: Scan the field often so you know where opponents are before you commit to a path. Staying aware of nearby worms is the easiest way to avoid costly mistakes.
Pick up food along routes that also keep you away from crowded areas. Steady growth matters more than chasing one fast gain.
Think about when to use power-ups instead of grabbing them randomly. Save them for a moment when they can help you escape or win a fight.
Try to trap or pressure rivals rather than running straight at them. Outwitting an opponent often pays off more than a head-on clash.
Play a few rounds to learn the layout of the larger fields. Knowing where food tends to gather helps you plan your next move.
faq: What is the main goal in Worm Hunt?
Grow your worm by consuming food and evolving with power-ups, then outwit opponents to climb the leaderboard and claim victory.
How do I get ahead of other players?
Focus on staying aware of opponents, growing steadily, and using power-ups at the right time rather than just chasing the biggest gain.

sonik-run.intro: SoniK Run is a runner game featuring Sonic the Hedgehog and his friends. You play with the mouse or by touch, and it works on both mobile and desktop devices.
tips: Keep your attention on what is coming up ahead rather than on the character alone, so you can react in time.
Start with short play sessions to learn how your mouse or touch input feels before aiming for longer runs.
Stay calm and steady with your timing, since rushing inputs is a common reason runs end early.
If you lose a run, think about which moment caused it and try to react sooner next time.
Play on the device you find most comfortable, since the game supports both mobile and desktop.
faq: How do I control the character in SoniK Run?
The game is played with the mouse or with touch, so use whichever your device supports. Check the on-screen prompts as you start to get comfortable with the input.
Can I play SoniK Run on both a computer and a phone?
Yes, the game is made for both mobile and desktop devices. The controls work with mouse or touch depending on the device you are using.

zombie-grave-yard.intro: Zombie Grave Yard is a fast-paced arcade shooter set in a haunted cemetery. You fight the undead with a pistol, shotgun, and power-ups in either Campaign or Survival mode.
tips: Keep an eye on the graves, since tougher zombies can rise from them and tombs can break apart, so track where new threats may come from.
Use WASD or the arrow keys to keep moving while you aim with the mouse, so you are never standing still in one spot.
Reload with R during a quiet moment rather than in the middle of a crowd, so you are not left empty when zombies close in.
Try the shotgun when zombies are bunched together and the pistol when they are spread out, and pick up power-ups when it is safe to do so.
