snake-warz.intro: Snake Warz is a .io-style arena game where you grow your snake by feasting while rival snakes hunt you. Your goal is to outmaneuver them and become the largest snake in the arena.
tips: Scan the arena often so you always know where the other snakes are heading before they reach you.
Avoid head-on collisions with bigger snakes, since a rival that is larger than you is the most dangerous threat.
Feast on food whenever it is safe to do so, because growing bigger is how you gain strength.
Use the space around you to dodge attacks rather than turning sharply into a crowded area.
Pay attention to smaller snakes you can pressure, and focus on outmaneuvering them to grow without taking unnecessary risks.
faq: How do I control my snake?
Use a mouse click or tap to steer and play the game. Click or tap in the direction you want to move.
What is the main goal of Snake Warz?
Grow your snake by feasting and avoid rival attacks until you become the largest snake in the arena.

monster-school-challenges.intro: Monster School Challenges is a pixel-art game where Minecraft-style characters take on quirky challenges through teamwork and friendly competition. Each task changes as you go.
tips: Use the point-and-click controls carefully, since each click is your main way to move characters through a challenge.
Pay attention to how the tasks change over time, because a method that worked early may need adjusting later.
Think about teamwork first: the game is built around characters working together, so plan each step with the whole group in mind.
Try each challenge slowly at first to learn how the characters respond before you commit to a plan.
Treat the humorous disputes as part of the game and watch how the characters settle them, since they can hint at what to do next.
faq: What is the goal of Monster School Challenges?

The description says characters hone their skills and settle humorous disputes through a series of quirky challenges. It does not list a specific win condition, so explore each task to learn what it asks for.
What controls does the game use?
The game uses simple point-and-click controls. No other control scheme is described.

going-up.intro: Going Up is a pixel-style arcade game where you guide a lone bird through obstacles, collect coins, and unlock new skins. Good timing matters more than speed.
tips: Watch a few obstacles before you commit to a rhythm, so you can see the gaps and how far apart they sit.
Keep your taps timed to the bird's position rather than tapping constantly, since timing is what keeps the bird on course.
Treat each run as practice: when you hit an obstacle, note what caused it and adjust your timing on the next attempt.
Collect coins when they sit on your safe path, but don't risk a collision just to grab one.
Save your coins to unlock new skins if you enjoy changing how your bird looks as you play.
faq: What is the main goal in Going Up?
Guide the bird through the pixelated world by tapping to fly, dodging obstacles, and getting it safely along its route. The description asks whether your skills can carry the bird home.
How do the controls work?
You control the bird with simple tap-to-fly input. Tap to lift the bird and let it fall between taps to stay clear of obstacles.

temple-quest.intro: Temple Quest is an endless running game set in a maze of temple ruins. You collect treasure, dodge obstacles, and complete objectives to build your score multiplier and see how far you can get.
tips: Check your current objectives often, since completing them grows your score multiplier.
Pick up golden idols, ancient coins and power-ups as you run, because they all add to your score.
Put your upgrades into the power-ups you use most, so each upgrade has a real effect on your runs.
Try different outfits to find one whose special ability suits how you like to play.
Watch ahead for obstacles and react early rather than at the last moment.
faq: What is the goal of Temple Quest?
Run as far as you can through the endless maze of temple ruins, fulfill your objectives, and avoid obstacles to reach the highest score possible.
How do I raise my score multiplier?
Fulfill objectives, since the game ties completing them to growing your score multiplier.

cork-and-cauldron.intro: Cork & Cauldron is a cozy potion brewing puzzle where you pour glowing liquids to gather ingredients, brew potions by recipe, and fill customer orders. Each filled order earns stars for restoring an old shop.
tips: Read the recipe card fully before you pour anything, especially for two-step brews and double orders, so you know which potion to brew first.
Plan which colors you need to gather before you start moving liquids, since a flask only gets corked once it is filled with a single color.
Watch for murky layers that hide their color, and work out what is underneath before committing a flask to a plan.
Use Undo freely while you test ideas. It lets you explore a pour without losing progress.
Save the Hint and Extra flask buttons for when you are truly stuck. Try a different flask arrangement first, and if you want the golden edition, avoid boosters on that order.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Fill the customer's order shown on the recipe card. You do this by gathering the right ingredients, brewing them in the cauldron, and pouring the potion into a flask.
Where can I pour liquid?
You can only pour onto a flask of the same color or into an empty flask. Pouring onto a mismatched color is not allowed.

shadobirds.intro: Shadobirds is an animal game where you guide a determined bird through a shadowy world by tapping to fly. You dodge obstacles across 20 levels, testing your reflexes and patience.
tips: Tap in small, steady bursts rather than holding your finger down, so you can keep control of the bird's height.
Watch the obstacles a moment before they reach you and plan your next tap early instead of reacting at the last second.
Keep your attention on the path ahead rather than on the bird itself, since the next obstacle matters more than the one you just passed.
If you keep losing at the same spot, pause and try a slightly different tap rhythm there before pushing on.
Play in short sessions when you feel tired, because steady focus tends to matter more than long, rushed attempts in a game built on reflexes.
faq: What is the goal of Shadobirds?
You guide your bird through a shadow-filled world, dodging obstacles across 20 levels. The description frames it as joining the elite ranks of those who have triumphed.
How do I control the bird?
You control the bird with taps, which make it fly. Timing each tap precisely is the key skill in the game.

french-fries-tycoon-farm-to-fryer.intro: Run a blocky potato farm and fry shop. Plant, harvest, prep and fry fries, then serve the queue while spending coins on upgrades. Nights bring silly surprises.
tips: Keep the chain moving from garden bed to sink, cutting board, fryer and counter, so no station sits empty while customers wait.
Spend early coins on upgrades that speed up your bottleneck. If you are always waiting on potatoes, prioritise more garden beds before anything else.
Helpers work on their own, so they are worth buying once your routine is steady and you have coins to spare.
When night falls, plan a short detour to catch the runaway potato, since it is the one night event the instructions offer a bonus for.
Use Q/E or right mouse drag to turn the camera before you walk across the shop, so you can see the fryer and counter at the same time.
faq: What is the main goal of French Fries Tycoon?
You grow potatoes, prepare them, fry golden fries and hand them to customers at the counter. Coins earned from sales let you buy upgrades on purchase pads.
How do I unlock upgrades?
Step on a purchase pad or tap the Buy button. Upgrades include more garden beds, a bigger sack, a hotter fryer and helpers.

sea-kings.intro: Sea Kings is a naval battle game where you command a pirate ship, fire cannons at rival pirates, and survive wave after wave of real-time combat. Upgrades and special weapons help you keep afloat.
tips: Spend upgrades on the stat that matches your fight, such as firepower for close battles or speed if you want to keep your distance.
Lock on to a target before you fire so your cannon shots land on the ship you chose instead of wasting shots.
Keep an eye on your armor as the waves get harder, and try to avoid taking hits from every enemy at once.
Save your special weapons for tougher enemies or crowded moments rather than using them on the first ships you see.
Watch how each wave plays out and adjust your positioning, since real-time combat rewards quick decisions over waiting.
faq: How do I win a battle in Sea Kings?
You fight rival pirates in ship-to-ship combat and sink enemy ships while you survive each wave. Staying alive and upgrading your vessel between battles helps you last longer.
What should I upgrade first?
The game lets you improve firepower, armor, speed, and special weapons. Pick the area that fits how you like to play, and balance your upgrades so you are not weak in one category.

one-shot-duel-snipe-hide.intro: One Shot Duel: Snipe Hide mixes shooting duels with hide-and-seek. This guide covers the keyboard and on-screen controls and some habits that help you make the most of each duel.
tips: Learn the crouch and jump keys early so you can change your position quickly when a duel starts.
Use the aim key before you shoot so your first shot counts, since the title focuses on one-shot duels.
Reload with R during quiet moments rather than in the middle of an exchange.
Check your bag with C and use the number keys 1-4 to reach your items quickly when you need them.
On mobile, get comfortable with the on-screen buttons before a tough round so you are not searching for them under pressure.
faq: How do I move and shoot on PC?
Use A and D or W, A, S, D to move, and press J or F to shoot. Check the in-game controls if your layout differs.
What do the crouch and jump keys do?
Shift makes your character crouch and Space makes them jump. Use them to change position while staying out of sight.

purr-magic-merge-balls.intro: Drop matching balls into the jar, merge them into bigger ones, and set off chain reactions. Plan each drop, watch the next ball, and keep enough room in the jar to keep playing.
tips: Check the next-ball preview before you drop. Choosing where to place the current ball so it can merge with the one coming up helps you keep the jar clear.
Keep the middle of the jar open where possible. Stacking balls at the edges can leave gaps that trap later drops above the dotted line.
Watch the dotted line closely. If balls sit above it for too long the run ends, so clear them by merging as soon as a match is available.
Use the boosters at the right moment. Shake can loosen a crowded jar, Eraser can remove one awkward ball, and Power Throws lets new balls reach the bottom for 10 seconds.
In daily challenges, count your drops before each move. Each challenge has a limited number of drops, so aim for merges that also move you toward the goal.
faq: What is the goal of Purr Magic: Merge Balls?
Merge matching balls into bigger ones, and try to reach the level 11 ball and beat your personal best. Daily challenges have their own goals that you must complete within the drop limit.
How do I score more points?
Quick merges build combos, which give extra points. Plan drops so that one merge sets off another soon after.

2048-merge-runner.intro: Run down the track, merge runners that match your number, and grow your number as high as you can. Pick your lane carefully, then shoot the boss at the finish line.
tips: Only merge with runners that show your own number, since any other number turns grey and falls off the road. Check the numbers ahead before you commit to a lane.
Aim for x2 and x4 gates early and avoid the halving gates, because a hit from an obstacle also halves your number. A bigger number makes the boss fight much easier.
Smash number walls only when they are smaller than your number. Walls larger than you will stop your progress.
Use ramps to reach the upper road when you want the gems there. Gems are the currency for upgrades, so collecting them helps your next run.
Remember that boss damage carries over between runs. Even a short run that hits the boss is worth it, because the next try starts from that damage.
faq: How do I merge runners?
Steer into a runner that has the same number as yours. The two merge and your number doubles, such as 2 becoming 4.
What happens if I hit an obstacle?
A hit halves your number, so try to dodge saws, hammers, spinners, spikes and other hazards. Choosing the right lane keeps your number high.

goblin-defense-merge.intro: Goblin Defense Merge is a puzzle game where you merge goblins of the same rank into stronger warriors and deploy them to hold off waves of human invaders. Your goal is to build a army strong enough to protect your village.
tips: Merge goblins as soon as you have two of the same rank, since stronger units are what you need as waves get harder.
Before merging, look at which goblins you have spare, so you do not waste units you will need later for deployment.
Think about the battlefield before you assign units, and place your strongest goblins where enemies are most likely to reach your village.
Keep a steady flow of merges going rather than saving everything up, so your army grows alongside the invasion.
If a wave overwhelms your defense, try a different mix of goblin ranks next time instead of repeating the same setup.
faq: What is the goal of Goblin Defense Merge?
The goal is to build a powerful goblin army and survive the human invasion by stopping the waves of enemies from reaching your village.
How do I make stronger goblins?
Click on the grid to select two goblins of the same rank, then merge them to evolve them into a stronger goblin.

football-masters.intro: Football Masters is a fast 2D soccer game with cartoon characters. You play short matches against friends or the AI, using unique supershots to win.
tips: Learn the controls in a short match first, since the game keeps them simple and you can pick them up quickly.
Watch how the AI moves before you commit to a shot, so you can spot when it leaves an opening.
Save your supershots for moments when the opponent is out of position, rather than using them as soon as they are available.
Keep matches short and focused. Each one is quick, so it helps to reset your approach after every game.
If you play with a friend, try to notice which characters suit your style and stick with them for a few rounds.
faq: What is the goal of Football Masters?
The goal is to win quick 2D soccer matches by scoring more goals than your opponent. You can play against friends or the AI.
What are supershots and how should I use them?
Supershots are special moves unique to the game. Use them when the timing is right, such as when the defence is out of position.

obby-cut-master.intro: Obby Cut Master is a first-person sword game where you swipe across the screen to slice enemies along your line. Cut limbs for critical hits, stop enemies from reaching you, and build up through levels or endless Survival.
tips: Plan your swipe so the line crosses an arm or leg for a critical hit, since a limb cut is stronger than a standard cut.
Watch the sword's stamina and release your swipe to let it rest before starting a long run of cuts.
Prioritize enemies that are closest to you, because each one that reaches you costs a heart.
Slice flying bones, snowballs and fireballs as they come, so they do not get through to you.
In Survival, read each set of 3 perks carefully and pick the one that best fits how you are playing, since you only get to choose one every 3-5 waves.
faq: What is the goal of Obby Cut Master?
Defeat enemies by swiping your sword across them, cutting through the head or body to defeat regular enemies. Progress through the 100 levels or survive as long as you can in Survival mode.
How do I get a critical hit?
Swipe so your line cuts off an arm or a leg of the enemy. Critical hits are the key way to deal extra damage.

cars-vs-zombies.intro: Cars vs Zombies is an arcade survival driving game where you crush waves of zombies and smash the environment in arenas. Use your earnings in the garage to make your vehicle tougher and faster.
tips: Steer with the arrow keys or WASD and keep moving so you can keep reaching zombies on the road.
Watch the arena for objects you can destroy, since breaking the environment is part of how you collect points.
Spend your resources in the garage on stats first if you keep losing your car quickly, then add armor for extra protection.
Try different vehicle types and maps to find a setup that suits how you like to drive.
Equip boosters when you need a burst of speed to escape a crowd or reach a cluster of zombies.
faq: What is the goal of Cars vs Zombies?
Drive your car, collect points, and crush as many zombies on the road as you can. Waves of zombies keep coming in the arenas.
Which keys control the car?
Use the arrow keys or the WASD keys to steer and move your vehicle.

twerk-eat-and-run.intro: Twerk: Eat & Run is a beach track runner where you steer through food and obstacles toward a rival at the finish. Your food choices change your runner's shape, so each run plays out differently.
tips: Plan your route a few steps ahead so you can reach burgers and donuts while steering around broccoli and salads.
Keep steering smoothly with small drags instead of large swings, so you stay in position to collect food and dodge obstacles.
Watch the finish indicator closely before you tap, since the timing decides how hard you hit your rival.
Spend coins on upgrades for your runner early, then save some for new looks if you enjoy changing her style.
Treat each round as a chance to learn the track layout, and note which food choices helped your runner grow or shrink.
faq: How do I run and steer my character?
Hold the left mouse button or keep a finger on the screen to run. Drag left or right to steer your runner.
What makes my runner smaller?
Broccoli and salads reduce your runner's size, so try to avoid them on your route.

color-shot-throw-the-ball.intro: Color Shot is a one-tap arcade game where you wait for the right color and throw the ball. Patience and careful timing are the keys to a high score.
tips: Hold off on throwing until the color you want is showing, since rushing is the most common way to lose points.
If you cannot wait for the right color, slow down and plan each shot before you tap.
Treat each throw as a small decision rather than a reflex, and watch the pattern of colors before committing.
Practice a few rounds without worrying about the score so you learn how the timing feels with one tap.
Stay calm and focused across a session, because the game rewards patience more than speed.
faq: What is the goal of Color Shot?
The goal is to throw the ball at the right moment, waiting for the correct color to get the highest score.
What controls does the game use?
The game is played with one tap, so each throw is made by tapping at the moment you choose.

anime-couple-dress-up.intro: Anime Couple Dress Up is a styling game where you dress anime couples for dates or weddings. With over 250 clothing items to mix and match, you can build many different looks and capture the ones you like.
tips: Decide whether your couple is going on a date or to a wedding before you start, then choose pieces that suit that setting.
Try mixing items that you would not normally pair together, since the game has a large collection and some surprising combinations can work well.
Work on one character's outfit at a time so the couple's looks stay balanced and easy to compare.
Check how the two outfits look side by side, so their styles feel like a matching pair.
Capture a look once you are happy with it, so you can come back to your favorite combinations later.
faq: What is the goal of Anime Couple Dress Up?
The game is about creative styling rather than a set goal. You dress anime couples in outfits for dates or weddings and capture the looks you create.
How many clothing items are included?
The game includes over 250 unique clothing items that you can mix and match to build different outfits.

brazen-ball.intro: Brazen Ball is a side-view arcade platformer where you guide a robotic ball through hazards to reach the end marker quickly. Collect as many orbs as you can along the way.
tips: Watch each obstacle for a moment before committing, since sawblades, lasers and meteors follow patterns you can learn.
Use short jumps when you need precision, and save full jumps for gaps that need the extra distance.
Keep your speed steady instead of tapping left and right, which can make it harder to react to traps like gates and spikes.
Plan your route to pick up orbs when they sit on the way to the end marker, so you do not lose time making detours.
If you keep losing time to one section, slow down and practice that part before trying to rush the rest of the level.
faq: What is the goal of Brazen Ball?
Reach the end marker in as little time as possible while collecting as many orbs as you can.
How do I move and jump?
Use A or Left Arrow to roll left, D or Right Arrow to roll right, and W or Spacebar to jump.

crazy-plane-shooter.intro: Crazy Plane Shooter is an arcade adventure where you fly through the skies, dodge enemy fire, and clear hostile forces from the screen. Quick reflexes and smart movement are key to lasting through endless aerial battles.
tips: Keep your plane moving instead of staying in one spot, since staying still makes it easier for enemies to hit you.
Watch the enemy fire patterns for a few seconds before committing to a route, so you can slip through gaps.
Save your most powerful shots for groups of hostile planes, so you clear more of the screen with each blast.
When you upgrade your plane, choose improvements that match how you like to fly, whether that means more firepower or better survival.
Stay calm during long battles. Quick reflexes help most when you stop reacting to every shot and focus on the next safe position.
faq: What is the goal of Crazy Plane Shooter?
The goal is to fly through the skies, dodge enemy fire, and shoot down hostile forces until the screen is clear. The battles are endless, so you keep playing for as long as you can survive.
How can I get a higher score or last longer?
Focus on staying alive by moving strategically and avoiding enemy fire. Use your powerful shots when enemies are grouped together so each attack clears more of the sky.

kitty-knight-survive-till-new-year.intro: Kitty Knight is an arcade survival game where a tiny kitten knight fights through three months of seasonal foes until New Year. Swing, parry, roll, and pick upgrades to last as long as you can.
tips: Visit the Training Yard from the menu before your first run so you can practice swinging, parrying, and rolling without pressure.
Time your second click so it lands while the blade is in the golden zone at the end of a swing, since that is what triggers a parry.
Use the roll to escape attacks, because nothing can hit you while you are rolling. Roll early rather than waiting until you are already cornered.
Keep the cursor pointed where you want to strike, since your sword swings toward it. Position yourself before foes close in.
Read each of the three upgrade cards carefully and choose the one that fits how you are fighting, rather than simply taking the first option.
faq: How do I attack in Kitty Knight?
Left-click to swing the sword toward your cursor, and hold the button to keep swinging. J, K, or Enter work as alternatives.
What is a parry and how do I do one?
Click again while the blade is in the golden zone at the end of a swing. A successful parry knocks foes back and sends sparks flying at them.

dino-squad-battle-mission.intro: Dino Squad Battle Mission puts you in control of a lone dinosaur trying to survive. You will cross dangerous ground, fight with strategy, and escape from cunning prehistoric foes.
tips: Study the terrain before you commit to a route, since the ground is described as treacherous and a wrong step can cost you.
Do not rush every fight. Choose when to engage and when to slip past, because the game rewards strategic combat over reckless attacks.
Watch how each enemy behaves in its first encounter, then adjust your approach. The game is built around adapting to each new foe.
Keep an eye out for ways to evolve your abilities and use the new strengths to handle the threats that gave you trouble earlier.
Think of outsmarting enemies as the main skill. Use your surroundings and timing to escape or gain an advantage instead of relying only on direct confrontation.
faq: What is the main goal in Dino Squad Battle Mission?
You play as a lone dinosaur fighting to survive, navigating dangerous terrain and escaping from prehistoric foes.
How do I improve my dinosaur during the game?
The game lets you evolve your abilities as you go. Pay attention to the encounters you face, since adapting to them is a core part of progressing.

pull-up-bar-tricks.intro: Pull-up Bar Tricks is an arcade gymnastics game where you swing a stickman on a bar, release, flip and catch it again. Timing and body position decide whether each trick works.
tips: Build momentum by moving the arms and legs before you let go, since your swing speed sets how far the flip can carry you.
Slow the game down in Settings when you are working out a hard move, then return to normal speed once the timing feels natural.
Practise flips and landings on the ground first, so you know how the body rotates before you attempt the same motion on the bar.
Watch your saved replays in slow motion to see exactly when you let go and when you reached for the bar, and adjust from there.
Once single moves are consistent, link them into short combinations, and remember that a clean regrab matters more than a big swing.
faq: How do I start a trick on the bar?
Build momentum by moving the arms and legs, then press Space to let go of the bar. Tuck the body for a flip and reach towards the bar to regrab it.
What is the difference between mouse mode and keyboard controls?
On a computer, the arrow keys control the legs, A and D control the arms, and Q and E twist the body. In mouse mode, the left button tucks the body and the right button arches it.

hatchfire-dragon-brick-breaker.intro: Hatchfire is a dragon brick breaker where you aim and fire fireballs that bounce around an egg. Break every glowing rune, then fire through the gap to hatch your dragon before the frost timer runs out.
tips: Aim once and then watch the whole chain of bounces before you fire again, since a single shot can clear several runes.
Clear the glowing runes first and leave a path open so you can fire through the gap when the egg cracks.
Save bombs for dense clusters of blocks, where one blast can take out a whole section at once.
Treat Turbo with caution: a faster fireball leaves less time to react, so use it when your path is already clear.
Keep an eye on the frost timer on each level, because hatching quickly is the only way to earn all 3 stars.
faq: How do I aim and fire my fireball?
With a mouse, click and drag to aim and the dragon fires automatically. On touch screens, touch and drag to aim.
What do I need to do to hatch the dragon?
Break every glowing rune to crack the egg open, then fire a fireball through the gap to hatch your dragon.

squard-shooter.intro: Squad Shooter is an action shooting game where you lead your squad through dangerous missions and fight enemies in intense gunfights. Strategy and teamwork matter as much as aim.
tips: Read each mission's challenge before you start, since every mission brings new problems and different opponents.
Plan your approach before pushing into a battlefield instead of rushing in, because strategy is central to winning.
Keep your squad working together rather than letting one member run ahead alone into enemy fire.
Pay attention to the more powerful opponents and decide early whether to engage them or work around them.
Use the mouse to click every button in menus and during play, so make sure you are comfortable with that control before a tough mission.
faq: What is the main goal of Squad Shooter?
You lead your squad through missions and eliminate enemies in gunfights. Winning depends on strategy, teamwork, and combat skills.
How do I control the game?
All buttons are clicked with the mouse. Get used to this early so you can respond quickly during battles.

jungle-mart.intro: Jungle Mart is a casual idle farming and market management game. You run a jungle shop with the help of monkeys, animals, and helpers, growing crops, processing food, and keeping your workers going.
tips: Check your farm and production areas regularly, since idle games reward you for keeping things moving while you are away.
Spend early earnings on the upgrades that speed up growing or processing, because faster output compounds over time.
Hire employees when you can afford them, and balance the number of helpers against the work your shop is producing.
Keep an eye on your workers' energy so they stay productive and your shop keeps running smoothly.
Reinvest your earnings in systems that increase your market's output rather than saving everything you earn.
faq: What is the main goal of Jungle Mart?
Your goal is to run the best jungle market by growing crops, processing food, hiring employees, and upgrading your systems.
How do I make money in Jungle Mart?
You earn by growing crops, processing food, and selling through your market, then using that money to expand.

merge-dragons.intro: Merge Dragons is a casual merging game where you combine dragons to unlock new species and grow your dragon guide. Its controls are simple, so the fun comes from experimenting with combinations.
tips: Merge with a purpose: before combining two dragons, think about which new species the result could unlock.
Check your dragon guide regularly to see which species you have found and which ones are still missing.
Plan a few moves ahead so you do not run out of space for the dragons you want to create.
When a reward race is available, focus on finishing it while you still have room to merge the dragons you need.
Experiment freely, since the simple controls make it easy to try different combinations and learn what works.
faq: What is the main goal of Merge Dragons?
The goal is to merge dragons to unlock new species, transform and grow them, and fill your dragon guide. You also race them for rewards.
How do the controls work?
The game uses simple controls, so you mainly select and combine dragons to create new ones.

frame-agent-hidden-object-puzzle.intro: Frame Agent is a hidden-object puzzle set in a museum of famous paintings. Your job is to find the camouflaged agent in each artwork before the timer runs out.
tips: Open the case file first and study the close-up of your target so you know what to look for before you start scanning.
Scan the painting in a steady pattern, panning across one section at a time, so you don't miss areas you've already checked.
Zoom in only when you need to. Since faster finds and less zooming both earn more gold, keep the view wide until you have a likely spot.
Save the UV flashlight for when you are stuck. Zoom locks while it is on, so decide on your zoom level before you switch it on.
Use the Tip Line and daily quiz between levels to build your sense of each artist's style, which can help you spot details that look out of place.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Find the hidden agent in the painting before the timer runs out. Tap or click him once you spot him.
How do I earn more gold?
Gold goes up when you find the agent faster and use less zoom. Completing the daily art quiz also gives bonus gold.

asmr-keyboard-escape-classic.intro: ASMR Keyboard Escape Classic is a 3D parkour adventure across a giant keyboard. You jump between keys, avoid traps, and buy or build helpers on the way to the finish line of each course.
tips: Look ahead before each jump and line up your landing on the next key, since falling sends you back.
Use the mouse to rotate the camera so you can see the gaps and traps ahead before you commit to a jump.
Spend what you earn on helpers early in a course, because they can make the harder jumps and traps easier to handle.
Use F to attack when enemies or obstacles are in your way instead of trying to run past them.
Slow down near traps and moving parts, and make short, controlled jumps rather than long risky ones.
faq: What is the goal of ASMR Keyboard Escape Classic?
Your goal is to reach the end of each keyboard course without falling. Jump between keys, avoid traps, and escape to the finish line.
What do the controls do?
Move with WASD, jump with Space, and rotate the camera with the mouse. Press F to attack and E to buy or build.

cozy-puzzles.intro: Cozy Puzzles is a relaxed jigsaw game with over 1500 images in 44 themed collections. Choose a picture, pick a piece count from 16 to 1024, and rebuild the image on the table.
tips: Start with a lower piece count to get comfortable with how pieces snap together, then move up as you feel ready.
Zoom out to see the whole picture before you begin, so you can judge where colors and shapes belong.
Join pieces into groups as soon as they snap together, since connected groups move as one and are easier to place.
Use the daily puzzle, weekly tasks, and reward calendar to earn extra coins and stars steadily.
Save hints and auto-solve for pieces that are truly stuck, because they are unlocked items you may want to use sparingly.
faq: How do I finish a puzzle?
Drag every piece onto the table so the full picture is complete. Matching pieces snap together when placed near their correct position.
What piece counts can I choose?
You can choose any difficulty from 16 to 1024 pieces for each image.

deadly-zombie-virus.intro: Deadly Zombie Virus is a top-down survival shooter where you fight waves of zombies, mutant bosses, and elite enemies across three maps. Pick a character, upgrade your weapons, and see how long you can last.
tips: Use Space to dash out of crowds before you get surrounded, rather than standing still and shooting.
Save your right-click special attack and Q ultimate for tough moments, like when a boss or a large group closes in.
Try each character to find one whose abilities suit your style, since Soldier, Ninja, and Mage likely play differently.
Spend upgrades on the weapon you use most often so your damage improves where you rely on it.
Keep moving with WASD while aiming with the mouse so you can avoid enemies and still shoot them.
faq: What is the goal of Deadly Zombie Virus?
You survive waves of zombies, mutant bosses, and elite enemies across the Forest, City, and House maps. The game asks whether you can survive the virus.
What do the Q and right-click buttons do?
Q activates your ultimate ability, and right-click performs a special attack. Both are useful for dealing with dangerous enemies or groups.

shoe-race.intro: Shoe Race is a fast hypercasual race against the clock. You pick the right footwear for each wacky scenario and think quickly to get through quirky challenges.
tips: Before each challenge, check which shoe fits the situation best, since choosing the right footwear is central to the game.
Think quickly but avoid rushing your first decision, because the race clock keeps running and a wrong shoe choice costs you time.
Pay attention to how each scenario is set up so you can spot the key detail that points to the right shoe.
Use your timing as well as your shoe choice, since the game rewards both rapid thinking and well-timed moves.
If you get a challenge wrong, shake it off and focus on the next scenario, because each one is a fresh chance to recover.
faq: What is the main goal in Shoe Race?
Your goal is to dash through a series of wacky scenarios and finish the race before the clock runs out. Choosing the right footwear for each challenge is how you get through.
Does Shoe Race reward quick thinking?
Yes, the game is built around rapid thinking and timing, so you need to decide fast while still picking the right shoe for each challenge.

steal-an-egg-3d.intro: Steal an Egg 3D is a 3D clicker where you sneak past guardians, carry stolen eggs back to your base, and hatch pets. This guide covers the basics of moving, stealing safely, and growing your collection.
tips: Watch the guardians before you move in. Slow, careful steps near them are safer than rushing past while they are close to your path.
Bring each stolen egg back to your base before trying for another one, so a single mistake doesn't cost you the egg you're carrying.
Spend the income you collect on training your speed early. Faster movement makes sneaking and carrying eggs back to base easier.
Hatch eggs at your base as you earn them, then keep an eye on your collection so you know which pets you still need among the 141 available.
Use the drag-to-look control often to check the area around you before each move. Knowing where rival bots and guardians are helps you pick a safer route.
faq: How do I move and jump in Steal an Egg 3D?
On desktop, use WASD or the arrow keys to move, drag to look around, and press Space to jump. On mobile, use the joystick to move, swipe to look, and tap the action buttons.
How do I get pets in this game?
Steal eggs and bring them safely to your base, then hatch them there. Each hatch can add a pet to your collection.

worldcup2026.intro: WorldCup2026 is a football game where you must win on the final group stage day to reach the knockout rounds, then win four more matches to lift the cup. You move your player and shoot using the mouse or touch controls.
tips: Watch your player's position before each shot, since the game rewards well-placed volleys and free kicks rather than shots taken at random.
Move into a clear spot first, then shoot, so you are not rushing a finish from a crowded area.
Treat the final group match as a must-win: go forward with purpose, because a draw or loss ends your run before the elimination rounds.
Save your best shooting attempts for the knockout matches, where you need to win four games in a row to reach the trophy.
Use short, controlled movements to line up each shot instead of chasing the ball, which makes your timing more reliable.
faq: How do I shoot the ball?
Click the mouse or lift your finger on touch screens to shoot. Timing your shot after positioning your player gives you the best chance to score.
What do I need to do to advance past the group stage?
On the last group day you have to win to move into the elimination rounds. Winning is the only result that moves you forward.

racing-ball-3d.intro: Racing Ball 3D is a two-player racing game set on 3D tracks full of obstacles and tight turns. It rewards precision, quick reactions and planned moves.
tips: Watch the upcoming section of the track rather than only what is directly ahead, so you can prepare for turns before you reach them.
Slow down slightly before tight turns instead of braking late, which helps you keep control and avoid losing momentum.
Learn where the obstacles sit on each track and plan your line around them so you are not reacting at the last second.
In two-player mode, pay attention to your opponent's position and choose when to push ahead or hold back.
Stay calm after a mistake and focus on the next section, since steady precision usually beats rushing to recover lost ground.
faq: What is the goal of Racing Ball 3D?
The goal is to race through the 3D tracks, get past the obstacles and finish ahead of your rival. The game is built around precision and reflexes.
Can I play against a friend?
Yes, the game includes a two-player mode where you challenge a friend in a head-to-head race.

jungle-game.intro: Jungle Game is a retro reflex game where you leap over creatures in a dangerous jungle. Survival depends on quick reactions and good timing as the challenges increase.
tips: Watch the pattern of the creatures for a few moments before you commit to a jump, since the challenges grow over time.
Focus on timing rather than speed. Leaping too early or too late is a common way to lose, so wait for the right moment.
Stay relaxed and keep your eyes on the approaching danger instead of reacting to the last thing you saw.
Practice in short sessions. Reflex games like this reward repeated attempts, and each run helps you learn the rhythm of the challenges.
Expect the difficulty to rise, so treat early runs as practice and stay patient as the game gets harder.
faq: What is the main goal in Jungle Game?
The goal is to survive by leaping over the bizarre creatures in the jungle. The game describes a quest for enduring glory built around your agility and timing.
Does the game get harder the longer I play?
Yes. The description says the world adapts to increasing challenges, so the danger grows as you continue.

block-drop-escape-puzzle.intro: Block Drop Escape Puzzle is a colorful puzzle about picking the right blocks in the right order. Release pieces, match colors to boxes, and clear the board across 71 levels.
tips: Before you tap a piece, look at which colored boxes it could fill and whether those boxes are already waiting for that color.
Keep the limited holding space in mind and avoid filling it with blocks you cannot place yet.
Work out the release order on paper or in your head for tricky levels before you start tapping.
If a level stalls, check which colors are left on the board and make sure you still have a way to reach each matching box.
Your progress is saved in your current browser, so keep playing in the same browser to pick up where you left off.
faq: What is the main goal of each level?
Fill each colored box with blocks of the matching color and clear the board completely.
How do I release blocks?
Click or tap a piece to release its blocks, and the controls work with either a mouse or touch.

nomad-guardians.intro: Nomad Guardians is a path-drawing action puzzle where you lead grazing animals to the ger before predators catch them. Plan each line so the flock stays together and reaches safety.
tips: Draw short, smooth lines rather than long zigzags, since your ink is limited and every wasted stroke leaves less for later.
Route your line around rocks and trees early instead of trying to correct a path after the animals have already drifted off.
Keep your line close to the animals you want to save, because only animals near the line will follow it.
Tap the eagle and the fox to scare them off before they reach your flock, rather than waiting until the animals are in danger.
Check the time remaining before you start drawing, and make sure you can save enough animals before the timer runs out.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Lead enough animals to the ger before the wolves, bears, snow leopards and eagles catch them. You must save a minimum number of animals before time runs out.
How does the drawing work?
Drag your finger from the animals to the ger to create a path. Animals that are close to your line will follow it.

siren-head-scp-6789-the-hunt-continues.intro: Siren Head SCP-6789: The Hunt Continues is a 3D adventure where you fight Siren Head in the mountains over five long days. Your goal is to protect your family while hunting and surviving.
tips: Learn the movement keys early, including sprint, crouch, prone, and jump, so you can switch between moving fast and staying low.
Keep your reload on R and use it between encounters rather than in the middle of a fight, so you are not caught with an empty weapon.
Use Mouse 2 to raise your sights or block when you expect an attack, and fire with Mouse 1 when you have a clear shot.
Check your supplies regularly and use F to use items before your health or ammo runs low.
Save your grenades on G for dangerous moments rather than using them on every enemy you see.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
You must survive the five days in the mountains while fighting Siren Head to protect your family. The description frames it as a hunt, so stay alert throughout.
Which key throws grenades?
The G key is listed for grenades in the game's controls.

battle-shot-elite.intro: Battle Shot Elite is a first person shooter with team battles and solo skirmishes on dynamic battlefields. You can coordinate with a squad, customize your gear, and earn rewards as you play.
tips: Pick your mode before you start: team battles reward coordination with your squad, while solo skirmishes depend on your own positioning and aim.
Talk through a plan with your squad before each round, such as who covers which area and who moves forward.
Because the battlefields are dynamic, keep checking how the map changes and adjust your position rather than staying in one spot.
Try different gear setups and keep the ones that suit your playstyle, since the game lets you personalize your equipment.
Play several matches to get a feel for the pace, then focus on the rewards you are working toward so each session has a clear goal.
faq: What game modes does Battle Shot Elite offer?
The game offers team battles with a squad and intense solo skirmishes. Choose the mode that fits how you like to play.
How do I win a match?
The game description does not spell out the exact win conditions. Focus on staying aware of your squad and the changing battlefield to improve your chances.

tower-crush.intro: Tower Crush is a strategy puzzle about building customizable towers, equipping weapons, and bringing down opposing structures. Planning ahead matters as much as raw firepower.
tips: Keep your own structure stable while you attack, since losing your tower ends your chances no matter how strong your offense is.
Spend upgrades on the weapons and power-ups that fit your plan, rather than spreading them thinly across everything.
Study how the opposing tower is built before you fire, and aim for the parts that will cause the most damage to its stability.
Try different tower layouts and note which designs hold up best, so you can reuse what works in later rounds.
Save your most powerful power-ups for moments when they can decide the outcome, instead of using them early.
faq: What is the main goal in Tower Crush?
You build and defend your own tower while attacking your opponent's structure, aiming to bring it down. Balancing both sides is the key to winning.
How should I spend upgrades?
Focus on a few weapons or power-ups that match how you like to attack. Consistent upgrades usually work better than many small ones.

slime-jelly-bouncer.intro: Slime Jelly Bouncer is a puzzle game where a green jelly blob moves only by jumping. Charge each launch and aim carefully to land on the checkered platform in each of its 50 levels.
tips: Watch the aim line before you release, and make small adjustments to the angle rather than rushing the shot.
Try a few short charges first to learn how far each power level sends the blob before attempting a long jump.
Use obstacles as bounce points: a well-placed rebound can carry you to a platform that a direct jump cannot reach.
On icy platforms, remember that you will slide after landing, so aim for a spot that lets the slide stop on the target.
If you keep missing the same jump, pause and plan the route through the level before charging again, since one perfect shot earns 3 stars.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Your goal is to land the jelly blob on the checkered platform to clear the level. Each level has its own layout and obstacles.
How do I control the jelly?
Aim with your mouse or finger, hold to charge your power, then release to launch. The blob can only move by jumping.

flying-grimace.intro: Flying Grimace is a colorful arcade shooter where you play as a sniper. Each shot counts, and your ammo is limited, so careful aiming matters.
tips: Take your time before each shot, since the game rewards precision over rapid firing.
Treat your limited ammo as a resource and avoid wasting shots on targets that are hard to hit.
Watch how the cunning targets move and aim for where they will be, not where they are right now.
Pay attention to your remaining ammo during each round so you can plan which targets to prioritize.
If you miss a shot, reset your focus before firing again, because patience is part of the challenge.
faq: What is the main goal of Flying Grimace?
You play as a sniper and try to hit targets with your shots. Each shot should be used carefully because your ammo is limited.
How does the limited ammo affect the game?
Because you have only a set amount of shots, the game adds tension to every decision. Choosing when to fire is just as important as hitting the target.

1-monkey-escape-speed-obby-mode.intro: Run, jump off walls and clear obstacles as a monkey in this 3D obby runner. Build speed with every step, earn trophies and wins, and push further with rebirths and pets.
tips: Keep moving forward steadily, since the game says every step makes you faster. Stopping often can cost you the speed you have built up.
Watch the path ahead so you can line up each obstacle before you reach it. Careful positioning matters more than rushing into a jump.
Use the camera controls to check the next section before you commit. Looking ahead helps you plan your route through the course.
Try to earn wins steadily rather than chasing one big run. Consistent progress builds toward the rebirth goal.
Rebirth is there to help you go beyond your current limits, so it is worth reaching it when you are ready. Use your trophies from pet hatching to support your progress.
faq: How do I move my monkey on PC?
Use the W, A, S and D keys to move. Hold the right mouse button to control the camera.
How do I move on mobile?
Use the joystick in the bottom-left corner to move. Swipe the screen to control the camera.

gooey-lab.intro: Oozy is a squishy blob of slime bouncing through a wild scientist's lab. Stretch across gaps, use springs and balloons, dodge buzzing saws, and flip gravity as each room gets trickier.
tips: Hold the jump input for a higher bounce when you need to clear a wide gap, and tap for shorter hops when you need precise landings.
Watch how Oozy wobbles after each jump before you commit to the next one, since the physics makes landings less predictable than they look.
Learn each new gadget or hazard when it first appears in a world, because later rooms combine them and timing matters more.
Coins are optional, so only take a risky detour for them when you are confident you can get back to the main route safely.
If you get stuck, use the on-screen reset button or press R on desktop to restart the room quickly rather than struggling on in a bad position.
faq: How do I make Oozy jump higher?
Hold the jump button or the Space, Up or W key for a higher bounce. A quick tap gives a shorter jump.
What should I do if I get stuck in a room?
Use the on-screen reset button on mobile or press R on desktop to restart the current room. This is quicker than trying to recover from a bad position.

treadbreaker.intro: Treadbreaker is a road-runner where your robot fires on its own and you only steer. Grab upgrade pods, dodge danger, and beat the boss at the end of each land.
tips: Watch for pods marked STRONG HERE, since they counter the monsters of the current land. Steering toward them is often worth more than chasing gears.
Each weapon works better against different monsters, so change your build when you move to a new land instead of keeping the same setup.
Learn the red warning zones of boss attacks early and move out of them before the attack lands. Keep some space between your robot and the boss.
Between runs, spend your gears in the garage. Upgrades last forever, so every gear you save for them carries over to later runs.
Collect gears and crystals as you go, and keep an eye on obstacles so you can pick up items without taking damage.
faq: How do I finish a chapter?
Defeat the boss at the end of each of the three lands in a chapter. Earning three stars per chapter is also part of the goal.
How do I unlock the Endless Road?
Clear Chapter 6 to open the Endless Road.

throw-an-egg.intro: Throw an Egg! is an arcade game where you build Power by lifting weights, launch your egg across themed zones, then race home before a tsunami arrives. Hatch pets and grow your cash as you go.
tips: Use AUTO lifting when you want to focus on other parts of the game, since holding or tapping by hand takes attention away from timing your throw.
Aim for a PERFECT throw by watching the throw meter closely and stopping it inside the green section on the yellow launch pad.
Start running for home as soon as the egg lands, because the tsunami is a constant threat and every second counts.
Let your pets work while you play, since they earn cash every second, even when you are offline.
Spend cash on heavier weights and faster shoes first, since both help you build Power and get home sooner, then add more pens for extra income.
faq: How do I build Power for a throw?
Stand on the orange pad and use LIFT by tapping, holding, or using AUTO. Your Power builds up from lifting, and you then use it on the yellow launch pad.
What does a PERFECT throw require?
Press THROW on the yellow launch pad and stop the meter inside the green area. Landing that stop gives you a PERFECT throw.

snack-stack.intro: Snack Stack is a restaurant tycoon where you start with a small snack bar and grow it into a busy restaurant. Cook orders, serve tables, and reinvest your cash in dishes, staff and upgrades.
tips: Spend early money on speed or tray size upgrades, since moving faster and carrying more food helps you serve every table sooner.
Keep dirty tables cleaned quickly so new customers can sit down, because empty seats are lost income.
Batch your trips: pick up cooked food for several tables at once before walking back to the dining room.
Hire waiters and cashiers once the restaurant starts getting busy, so service keeps up while you focus on cooking.
Check the goals on screen and plan your next purchase around them, then expand with a new dining area when the place is packed.
faq: What is the main goal of Snack Stack?
Grow your snack bar from a small corner shop into a busy restaurant by serving customers, unlocking dishes and expanding the dining area. Following the on-screen goals will guide your progress.
How do I spend money in the game?
Stand on a floor area to spend your cash on new tables, dishes, staff and upgrades. Each purchase is made from the spot you stand on.

empire-tower-defense-zombie-fortress.intro: Empire Tower Defense: Zombie Fortress is a strategy puzzle where you defend your fortress from waves of zombies. You place archers, manage your resources, and plan tactics to hold the line.
tips: Place your archers with purpose. Look at the path the zombies take and position archers so they can cover the same area for as long as possible.
Spend resources carefully. Avoid using everything at once, so you can respond when a new wave shows up in a different spot.
Watch which way the horde is coming from. Focusing your defenses on the main approach is often better than spreading them thin.
Adjust your plan after each wave. If one spot keeps getting overrun, move your archers or rethink how you are using your resources there.
Think ahead rather than reacting only to the current attack. Planning your next placement while the current wave is still moving can keep your fortress steady.
faq: What is the goal of Empire Tower Defense: Zombie Fortress?
The goal is to keep your fortress standing against relentless zombie hordes. You do this by placing archers, managing resources, and outsmarting the invaders.
How do I place archers?
The game description says you strategically place your skilled archers to defend the fortress. Choose positions that cover the zombies' approach and keep the fortress protected.

hex-a-mong.intro: HEX-A-MONG is a space-themed arena game where you keep running on disappearing hexagon panels. You can play alone or with a friend in 2-player mode.
tips: Keep moving at all times, since stopping or slowing down makes you fall.
Look ahead to plan your route, because each hexagon you touch disappears in about a second.
Treat your two allowed falls as a buffer and save them for moments when you have no safe path.
Use the jump key to hop over gaps in the panels instead of stepping into empty space.
In 2-player mode, agree with your friend on who covers which part of the platform so you do not block each other.
faq: How do I win HEX-A-MONG?
You win by staying on the platform as long as possible. The game ends for you when you fall for the third time.
How many times can I fall before I lose?
You have the right to fall twice. The third fall ends the game.

gem-clicker.intro: Gem Clicker is an action game where each click on a gem earns rewards. You can strengthen your income with upgrades and automation while working through gemstone puzzles that grow harder over time.
tips: Spend your early rewards on upgrades that raise your income, since faster earnings make every later purchase easier.
Check which upgrades help your clicking and which help automatic income, then choose based on how you like to play.
Let automated income build up between sessions so you have more to spend when you return.
Take a short break when a gemstone puzzle gets tricky, then come back with fresh focus.
Plan your upgrades before you buy, because the game rewards strategy as well as steady clicking.
faq: What is the main goal in Gem Clicker?
Your goal is to crack gems by clicking them to earn rewards, then use those rewards to upgrade and progress through harder gemstone puzzles.
How do I earn more in Gem Clicker?
Combine active clicking with upgrades and automated income generation, and prioritize the upgrades that boost your earnings the most.

naval-base.intro: Naval Base is a tactical battle game where you command a coastal base, build a mixed fleet and push back enemy formations to destroy their base before time runs out. Each operation ends with a different boss.
tips: Keep the counter triangle in mind: ships beat aircraft, aircraft beat submarines, and submarines threaten ships. Check what the enemy is fielding before you spend.
Build a balanced mix rather than one unit type, so you always have an answer to whatever formation the enemy sends.
Watch the bottom bar and buy units early enough that they reach the fight in time, since they enter combat automatically.
Use the coastal gun aiming controls during battles to help with threats your units cannot handle on their own.
Spend upgrades on defenses when your fleet is stable, and keep an eye on the clock so you still have time to push into the enemy base.
faq: What is the goal of Naval Base?
Your goal is to destroy the enemy base before time runs out in each operation. Each operation also features a different boss to defeat.
How do I buy units?
Buy units from the bottom bar, or press the number keys on desktop. Once bought, units enter combat automatically.

worm-puzzle-snake-apple.intro: Worm Puzzle: Snake Apple mixes classic snake movement with puzzle levels. You guide snakes, solve spatial problems, and escape traps in a relaxed, playful style.
tips: Look over the whole level before you move, since the traps and spatial layout are the core of each puzzle.
Make one move at a time and check where the snake ends up before committing to the next one.
If you get stuck, try a different route instead of repeating the same moves, as the levels reward trying new approaches.
Pay attention to the playful snake movements, because they often hint at how each level is meant to be solved.
Take breaks between levels if you want to keep the calm pace, since the game is designed for relaxed play.
faq: What is the goal of Worm Puzzle: Snake Apple?
Your goal is to solve each level by guiding the snake through spatial puzzles and escaping traps. The game combines this with classic snake gameplay.
How do I move the snake on a PC?
Use the arrow keys to move the snake. You can also drag to move, based on the game's instructions.

horse-simulator-3d.intro: Horse Simulator 3D is an adventure set on an open-world island where you raise a horse family, take on quests, and race. The description does not list specific controls, so the tips below focus on general habits.
tips: Explore the island early to learn where quests and races are located before committing to a long task.
Keep your horse trained and customized as you go, since racing and protecting your herd both depend on it.
Check on your herd regularly so you notice threats before they spread to other members.
Balance family-raising with quests so one area does not fall behind while you focus on another.
Take short breaks to look around the landscape and plan your next goal rather than rushing from task to task.
faq: What is the main goal of Horse Simulator 3D?
The game centers on raising a family of horses, completing quests, competing in races, and protecting your herd on an open-world island.
Can I customize my horse?
Yes, the description says you can customize and train your horse, which can help you in races and when facing threats.

crash-rampage.intro: Crash Rampage is a 3D arcade driving game where you smash buildings, dodge police, and earn gold to upgrade your car. You can play a timed City mode or survive waves of enemies in Arena.
tips: In City mode, plan a route through clusters of buildings and objects rather than wandering, since time runs out and you need to earn gold quickly.
Use Nitro (Shift) in open stretches to reach the next cluster of targets faster, then ease off before tight turns so you keep control.
Keep an eye on the police and avoid getting boxed in by cars; moving away early is often better than trying to crash through them.
Spend gold in the garage on upgrades that match your style, such as those that help you survive longer or smash more objects.
In Arena, pick upgrade cards that work together, so your abilities build on each other instead of being spread across unrelated effects.
faq: What is the goal of Crash Rampage?
The goal is to cause as much destruction as you can while escaping the police. In City mode you earn gold by destroying objects and buildings before time runs out.
How do I control the car?
Drive with WASD or the arrow keys, press Shift for Nitro, Space to brake, and R to reset your car. On mobile, use the joystick and on-screen buttons.

guilty-sniper.intro: Guilty Sniper is an arcade shooter that tests precision and speed. You complete risky missions across pixel landscapes while managing limited time and ammo.
tips: Count your shots before you fire, since ammo is limited and every wasted shot leaves you with less for later missions.
Take a moment to line up each target before pulling the trigger, because precision matters more than rapid firing.
Spend your early moments learning how the landscape is laid out so you know where threats are likely to appear.
Keep an eye on the clock throughout each mission and decide early which targets are worth your remaining time.
Expect the challenges to ramp up, so stay calm and adjust your pace rather than rushing as the pressure builds.
faq: What is the main goal in Guilty Sniper?
You complete perilous missions while managing time and ammo. The game rewards precise aiming and careful use of your resources.
How do I avoid running out of ammo?
Fire only when you have a clear shot. Holding back on uncertain targets helps you keep enough ammo for the harder parts of a mission.

rossroads.intro: Crossroads is a one-player puzzle game about filling the empty spaces with lines. You move the lines until their value reaches zero, and each level gets harder.
tips: Look at the whole level before your first move, and note which empty spaces are hardest to fill.
Keep track of the line value after every move so you can see whether you are getting closer to zero.
Avoid moves that fix one spot but create a new problem nearby. Think a step ahead.
Stay calm and try a different approach if a level stops making progress, rather than repeating the same moves.
Expect the later levels to demand more planning, so spend extra time on each one.
faq: What is the goal of Crossroads?
Fill all the empty spaces with lines so that the line value becomes zero. Completing this finishes the level.
How do I move the lines?
Use your finger or your mouse to move the lines around the level.

one-line-drawing-mini-games.intro: One Line Drawing Mini Games is an arcade puzzle game built around tracing full pictures without lifting your finger or pen. It offers both relaxed drawing play and harder puzzle-style challenges.
tips: Look at the whole picture before you start moving, and find a starting point that lets you pass through every line once.
Plan a route through the shapes in your head first, especially where lines cross or meet, so you do not get stuck halfway.
If the puzzle versions feel tough, switch to the easier one-line drawing gameplay to ease off and come back with fresh eyes.
Take short breaks between drawings. The game is designed to help you unwind, so playing slowly tends to be more enjoyable.
When you make a mistake, pause and trace the path back in your mind before continuing rather than rushing to the next attempt.
faq: What is the main goal of One Line Drawing Mini Games?
The goal is to draw each picture in one continuous line, covering every part of the drawing without lifting your finger or pen.
Can I play in a relaxed way without much pressure?
Yes. The easy one line drawing gameplay is meant to help you relax and enjoy a calm game time.

floppy-pipe.intro: Floppy Pipe is a one-tap flying game where you guide a pipe through the sky while dodging quirky chickens. Keep your timing steady and try to beat your own high score.
tips: Tap in small, steady bursts rather than holding back and forth, so you can keep the pipe at a height you control.
Watch the chickens a moment before they reach you and start adjusting early instead of reacting at the last second.
Pay attention to the rhythm of the game. Learning the pattern of the tapping will help you make cleaner moves.
Focus on one obstacle at a time and avoid overcorrecting after a near miss, since that often causes the next crash.
Play in short rounds to practice timing. Short focused sessions can help you improve faster than long, tired ones.
faq: How do I control the pipe in Floppy Pipe?
You tap to stay airborne. Timing your taps is the main skill in the game.
What is the goal of Floppy Pipe?
Fly as far as you can while dodging the chickens, and aim for a high score.

drift-car-driving.intro: Drift Car Driving is a highway racing game where you steer powerful sports cars through busy traffic at high speed. Use the arrow keys or W, A, S, D to move and control your drift.
tips: Ease off the throttle before sharp turns so the car keeps its grip and you can start the drift smoothly.
Watch traffic ahead early and shift lanes gently, since sudden swerves at high speed are the easiest way to lose control.
Practice short, controlled drifts first and build up to longer ones once you can hold a slide without spinning out.
Keep your eyes on the road ahead rather than the car itself, so you can plan each lane change and corner before you reach it.
If a drift goes wrong, ease off the controls and steer into the slide rather than fighting it with quick corrections.
faq: What is the main goal of Drift Car Driving?

You race across busy highways in sports cars, using drifting and high speed while avoiding traffic. The description does not list a specific finish condition, so focus on driving cleanly and staying in control.
How do I control the car?
Use W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move back, and A or D (or the Left and Right Arrows) to steer left and right. Mouse clicks are used for on-screen buttons.

tribal-zuma.intro: Tribal Zuma is a puzzle game set in a cursed ancient totem world. You launch marbles to clear them from the track, and the curse lifts once every marble is gone.
tips: Look for a spot where your marble would join two matching marbles to make a group of three or more, since that is the way to remove them.
Before you launch, check which colors are already lined up near the front so you can plan a shot that builds on them.
Focus on clearing the marbles closest to the end of the track first, so the line does not reach a point you cannot control.
Pay attention to the color of the marble you are about to launch and choose a target where it fits, rather than firing at random.
Keep your shots steady and deliberate, because every marble you fire is one less you have to deal with later.
faq: What is the goal of Tribal Zuma?
You need to launch marbles so that three or more identical marbles connect and are eliminated. The curse only disappears once all marbles are cleared.
How do I play the game?
The instructions say to click to play. Click to launch marbles and aim them at the marbles on the track.

popsy-blocks.intro: Popsy Blocks is a candy-colored block puzzle where you drag shapes onto a board to fill rows and columns. Campaign levels add new mechanics, and Marathon mode offers endless rounds.
tips: Keep the board open by placing shapes where they don't block future rows or columns. Gaps that stay isolated are harder to fill later.
Before each drop, check which row or column is closest to full and aim to finish it. Clearing lines frees up space quickly.
When a level introduces a new mechanic like locks, trains, safes, or ice, read what it does before placing pieces near it. Plan your moves around it instead of reacting after it blocks you.
If you get stuck, use a booster to clear space rather than forcing shapes into awkward spots. Creating room often gets you back on track faster.
Try Marathon mode when you want practice without campaign twists. It is a good way to sharpen your placement habits.
faq: What is the goal of Popsy Blocks?
Drag shapes onto the board and fill an entire row or column to clear it. Each campaign level adds new mechanics on top of this basic goal.
How do I use boosters?
Boosters are there to help when you are stuck on a tricky spot. Use them to clear space so you can keep placing shapes.

fair-blocks.intro: Fair Blocks is a wooden block puzzle on an 8x8 board. Place pieces to fill whole rows or columns, clear them, and chain clears together for bigger combos.
tips: Pieces cannot be rotated, so check the shape and orientation before you drag it onto the board.
Keep a few gaps open that can take different piece shapes, so you don't run out of places for the pieces in your tray.
Look for moves that complete a row and a column at the same time, since clearing both at once helps build combos.
In Adventure, read each level's goal before you start, whether it asks for lines, score, gems or stones, and plan your moves around it.
Count your remaining moves in Adventure and avoid placements that leave holes you cannot fill within the move limit.
faq: What is the goal of Fair Blocks?
Fill whole rows or columns on the 8x8 board to clear them. In Adventure, you also need to reach each level's goal within the move limit.
Can I rotate the pieces?
No. Pieces cannot be rotated, so you need to plan where each one fits before you place it.

don-t-look-down-kitty.intro: Help a brave little cat climb a tall tower, hopping across blocks and chasing the Trashy Dragon, who has kidnapped your puppy buddy. Reach the top and save your friend.
tips: Grab every flag you pass, because a fall sends you back to the last one you reached.
Before a long gap, pause and line up your jump, then press jump again in the air to double jump across.
On wobbly lifts, press S or the down arrow to stand still and steady yourself before moving on.
Watch for sliding walls, hail, meteors and pigeons, and time your moves so you pass them between their movements.
Collect coins on the way up, and visit Capy's shop at camps to spend them on new looks for your cat.
faq: What is the goal of Don't Look Down, Kitty!?
Climb as high as you can and chase the Trashy Dragon. At the end of each chapter, beat the Dragon in the arena to rescue a friend and unlock the next world.
What happens if my cat falls?
You are sent back to your last flag, so keep moving forward and grab flags as you go to reduce how far you lose.

mice-hunt.intro: Mice Hunt is a platformer where you play as a swift owl racing ahead of a pursuing dragon. Capture mice to gain lives and push for a high score.
tips: Capturing mice extends your lives, so treat them as a priority whenever you can reach one without putting yourself in the dragon's path.
Potion power-ups give you an edge in the chase, so grab them when they are within easy reach rather than detouring far for them.
Keep checking where the dragon is before each move, since a mouse that pulls you toward it can cost you a life.
Your score rewards progress, so balance quick mouse captures with steady movement away from the dragon instead of stopping to chase every target.
Early runs are a good way to learn how the chase feels and which routes stay clear, before you start pushing for a higher score.
faq: What is the goal of Mice Hunt?
You play as an owl trying to stay ahead of a dragon that is chasing you. Capture mice and aim for a high score while you race.
How do lives work in Mice Hunt?
Capturing mice extends your lives, which gives you more room to recover from mistakes during the chase.

keyboard-rush.intro: Keyboard Rush is a 3D running game where you sprint across giant colorful keys toward a glowing gift. Stay sharp, jump the gaps, and keep moving to reach the finish line.
tips: Look ahead rather than at your feet so you can spot gaps and obstacles early enough to react.
Time your jumps just before the edge of a gap instead of early, since a late jump is safer than a short one.
Keep a steady rhythm through the level, because your speed rises as you level up and sudden changes can throw off your timing.
Stay on the middle of each key when possible, which gives you more room to correct your path if you drift toward an edge.
If you fall, restart the section with calm focus, since each level rewards careful timing more than fast reactions.
faq: What is the main goal in Keyboard Rush?
Run across the giant keyboard, avoid obstacles, and reach the finish line to complete the level and unlock the next challenge.
How do I earn points?
You earn 1 point each time you step on a keyboard key, and collecting points lets you level up.

animal-hair-salon.intro: Animal Hair Salon is a styling game where you pick an animal client and give it a new look using hair tools and accessories. It is a relaxed, creative game with no set goal beyond making a style you like.
tips: Choose your animal first, then plan the look before you start cutting or coloring so the steps feel purposeful.
Work on the hair in stages: cut the shape first, then color, then add accessories last so earlier choices are not hidden.
Try a few tools on the same spot to see how each one changes the hair before you commit to a final style.
Pick accessories that match the hairstyle's colors and length so the finished look feels cohesive.
Make a few different animal makeovers in a row to get a feel for which tools work best on different hair types.
faq: What is the goal of Animal Hair Salon?
The goal is to create a hairstyle you like for an animal. You choose the animal, design the hair, and then add accessories to finish the look.
How do I use the tools?
Click a tool at the bottom of the screen, then click the animal's hair to use it. Repeat this with other tools to shape and color the style.

toss-the-ring.intro: Toss The Ring is a colorful ring-toss game where you test your aim across levels. Click and drag to throw, and expect new surprises as you advance.
tips: Before each throw, look at the target and any new obstacles or changes the level introduces, since each level adds something different.
Use short, controlled drags while you learn how your throw responds, then adjust gradually rather than making big changes.
Make small corrections after every throw. Noting whether the ring fell short, went long, or drifted to one side makes your next attempt more accurate.
Stay relaxed and take your time. The game rewards steady aim more than rushed throws.
If a level feels hard, pause for a moment and plan your next throw instead of repeating the same motion.
faq: What is the goal of Toss The Ring?
Your goal is to land rings on the target by aiming and throwing them. Each level brings new surprises that change how you play.
How do I throw the ring?
Click and drag to play. Your drag controls the throw, so practice a few times to see how the ring responds.

helicopter-rescue-games-3d.intro: Helicopter Rescue Games 3D is a rescue simulation where you fly a helicopter through mountain and city settings. You steer with a joystick, change height with a slider, and manage your fuel on each mission.
tips: Check the fuel gauge before each mission starts so you know how much flying you have to work with.
Use the joystick for small, gentle movements when you are near injured people or passengers, since sudden moves can make precise positioning harder.
Adjust altitude with the slider in small steps, especially when you are close to buildings or mountain terrain.
Try the 2x speed setting to cross long distances faster, then switch back to 1x for careful approaches and landings.
Plan your route before you begin, since the missions include both mountain and city environments that may call for different flying heights.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You complete rescue missions in each level, such as saving injured people, transporting passengers, and handling emergency situations. The instructions do not describe a separate scoring system.
How do I control the helicopter?
Use the on-screen joystick to move forward, backward, left, and right. Use the slider to fly higher or descend.

green-slaughter.intro: Green Slaughter is a shooter set in an apocalyptic world overrun by hordes of monstrous creatures. You play as a fearless warrior who fights through the chaos, upgrades your arsenal, and uncovers a conspiracy.
tips: The controls are described as intricate, so spend a little time learning them before you face a large group of enemies.
Use your upgrades on the weapons or abilities that suit how you like to fight, rather than spreading them thinly across everything.
Foes get more powerful as you go, so check how a new enemy moves and attacks before you commit to a direct fight.
Avoid standing still in the middle of a horde, since surrounding creatures can overwhelm you quickly.
Pay attention to story details, because the conspiracy you are unraveling may give you context for what comes next.
faq: What is the main goal in Green Slaughter?
You fight off hordes of monstrous creatures, unravel the conspiracy behind the apocalypse, and work to save humanity.
How do I get stronger during a run?
You upgrade your arsenal to improve your firepower, so choose upgrades that match the enemies you struggle with most.

jewel-box-block-puzzle.intro: Jewel Box is a cozy block puzzle where you drag gem-shaped pieces onto a board to fill rows and columns. Work through 300 adventure levels or chase high scores in Classic and 9x9 mode.
tips: Look at all three pieces before placing one, so you don't block the spaces the others need.
Keep open space near the middle of the board so bigger pieces still have room to fit.
Hit ice early, since it takes two hits to break and is easier to clear while the board is still open.
Clear vines before they spread, because they grow if you leave them alone for two moves.
