Aim for combos by lining up shots that set up the next pop. Chaining pops is usually worth more than a single big shot on its own.
faq: What is the main goal of Fruits Shooter Pop Master?
Pop the colorful fruit clusters before time runs out. Each level becomes more complex as the patterns get harder.
How do I get a higher score?
Build combos and use special power-ups well. Clearing several fruit in quick succession is the main way to push your score up.

penalty-shooter.intro: Penalty Shooter is a football penalty game where you take turns as the kicker and the goalkeeper. Aim carefully as the taker, and watch your opponent closely when you are in goal.
tips: When you are the taker, draw your shot path with a clear plan before you release. Decide where the ball will end up before you start dragging.
Try curved and angled shots instead of straight ones. A shot that bends away from the goalkeeper's likely dive can be harder to stop.
Vary your shots rather than repeating the same placement. If the goalkeeper keeps reacting to one side, switch to the other.
As the goalkeeper, pay attention to how the taker sets up the run and aims. Their early movements can hint at where the shot is going.
Take your time with the release on the taker's turn. Good timing matters as much as aim, so a quick, careless kick often misses the net.
faq: How do I take a penalty shot?
Drag your finger or mouse to draw the shot path, then release to kick the ball. Use curves and angles to get past the goalkeeper.
What do I do when I am the goalkeeper?
Read what the opponent seems to be planning and try to make the save. Watching their approach is the key to stopping the shot.

offroad-jeep-game-suv-driving.intro: Offroad Jeep Game: SUV Driving is an off-road driving game where you drive powerful SUVs through Career Mode. Each of its 7 levels mixes checkpoint missions with racing challenges across mountains, mud, hills, and city roads.
tips: Ease off the accelerator on muddy and hilly stretches so the wheels keep their grip instead of spinning out.
Look ahead to the next checkpoint before you reach it, so you can take the line that keeps your speed up.
Use the brake to slow down before sharp turns rather than braking mid-corner, which can send the SUV sliding.
Keep your pace steady on checkpoint runs, since you need to reach each one on time, and save full speed for open stretches.
In races, watch the terrain changes and adjust your speed early, since a rough patch or a hill can cost you more time than a short detour.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
You progress through Career Mode by completing checkpoint missions and winning racing challenges across its 7 levels. Reaching checkpoints on time is part of the challenge.
How do I control the SUV on PC?
Use WASD or the Arrow Keys to drive. The on-screen buttons are used for mobile controls.

stickman-killing-zombie-3d.intro: Stickman Killing Zombie 3D is a fast action game where you slice through waves of zombies on chaotic 3D streets. Use your crimson blade, collect gold and health, and complete each level's objectives to survive.
tips: Keep moving rather than standing still, since the zombies come in large hordes and getting surrounded is the quickest way to lose health.
Use the wide swing of your blade on groups of enemies, so each swipe can hit several zombies at once.
Watch your health as you fight, and pick up health when it is safe to do so instead of waiting until you are nearly defeated.
Grab the gold you pass along the way, but do not chase it into crowds of zombies if your health is low.
Read each level's objective before you start and plan your route around it, so you do not waste time clearing areas that do not help you finish.
faq: What is the main goal of Stickman Killing Zombie 3D?
You play as a stickman and his bird companion, slicing zombies to survive the undead streets and complete the objectives of each level.
What should I collect during a run?
Collect gold and health as you go, since gold is part of the game and health keeps you alive against the zombie hordes.

winter-clash-3d.intro: Winter Clash 3D is a team shooter where you play as Santa and fight to stop evil elves from summoning the Pagan Idol. Move with WASD, aim with the right mouse button, and use the score table to track your team.
tips: Use crouch (C) to lower your profile when you are pinned down or waiting for an enemy to pass, then stand up to move.
Aim with the right mouse button before you fire when you have a clear line of sight, rather than shooting from the hip at distant targets.
Jump (SPACE) to change height or reposition quickly, but keep in mind that you are more exposed while airborne.
Check the score table (TAB) regularly to see how your team is doing and where you may need to shift your focus.
Stay close to your teammates when you can, since the game is built around team play and coordinated pushes tend to be more effective than lone runs.
faq: What is the goal of Winter Clash 3D?
You take the role of Santa and work with your team to capture the Pagan Idol from a deserted lighthouse island. The game describes burning it in your Christmas fire as the final step.
What do the controls do?
WASD moves your character, SPACE jumps, C crouches, and the right mouse button aims. Hold TAB to view the score table.

head-puzzle-shooter.intro: Head Puzzle Shooter is an animal-themed puzzle game where you guide an animated head to burst colorful animal bubbles. Each level gets harder as you go, so careful aiming matters.
tips: Take a moment to study the bubble layout before you fire, and pick a shot that matches or pops the most bubbles.
Use the walls to bounce your shots toward spots you cannot reach directly, since the game rewards precise angles.
Look for groups of matching animal bubbles, because clearing a cluster often opens up the rest of the board.
Aim with patience rather than rushing, as a slightly better angle usually beats a quick shot that misses.
Expect the difficulty to climb, so stay calm and adjust your approach when a board starts to feel crowded.
faq: What is the main goal of Head Puzzle Shooter?
The goal is to match and pop the animal bubbles by guiding the animated head to shoot them. Clearing the bubbles lets you move on as the challenge increases.
How can I aim more accurately?
Plan your shot before firing and use the walls to bounce bubbles into hard-to-reach positions. Taking your time with the angle helps you hit your target more often.

idle-game-dev-simulator.intro: Idle Game Dev Simulator is a clicker tycoon where you grow a small garage studio into a large game company. You create games, test genre, theme and platform combinations, and upgrade your team and office.
tips: Try different genre, theme, and platform combinations early on, and note which ones lead to hits so you can repeat them.
Check the reviews and ratings after each release to see what players respond to before you choose your next project.
Spend on research in the Research tab when you can, since it unlocks new content and boosts your creative power.
Compare upgrades in the right panel and favor the ones that improve production speed or efficiency, since those speed up everything else.
Expand your team and automate production when you can, so your studio keeps making progress while you are away from the screen.
faq: How do I start making a game?
Tap the center of the room to open the action menu, then choose what to develop next.
Where do I buy upgrades?
Upgrades are in the right panel, and they are aimed at improving efficiency and production speed.

robby-the-speed-maze.intro: Robby: The Speed Maze is an obby set in intricate mazes full of monsters, traps and obstacles. Train on simulators, collect coins, and build your speed and stamina as you move through the course.
tips: Spend time training on the simulators in the lobby before heading into the mazes, since that is where you build your speed and stamina.
Collect coins steadily and spend them on upgrades so each run gets a little easier than the last.
Buy pets early, because they give bonuses that can help you progress faster over time.
Use the mouse to look around before each section so you can spot monsters and traps ahead of time.
Pause with Tab or Escape when you need a moment to plan your route, then use Space Bar to jump over obstacles.
faq: What is the goal of Robby: The Speed Maze?
You move through intricate mazes while avoiding monsters and traps. Along the way you train, collect coins, and improve your speed and stamina.
How do I move and jump on a computer?
Use WASD to move, the mouse to change the camera view, and the Space Bar to jump. Press Tab or Escape to pause.

gangsters.intro: Gangsters is a pixelated shooter where you lead a gang of three to defend your turf against rival gangs. It supports one or two players, and the physics-based fights are fast and bloody.
tips: Keep your three members spread out so a single rival cannot hit all of them at once.
Use the E key to raise arms for shooting or punching, and time your presses so you hit before the enemy closes in.
Because the gameplay is physics-based, watch how your members move and fall, and position them so they do not get knocked off balance.
If you have a second player, agree on roles in advance: one person handles movement and the other focuses on weapons.
Check the instructions for the jump and weapon keys for each player before the first fight so you do not waste time searching for them mid-battle.
faq: What is the goal of Gangsters?
Defend your turf against rival gangs and conquer the other gangs to prove you are the top mafia boss.
How many gang members do I control?
You control all three members of your gang, so you need to manage each one during a fight.

stickman-hooks.intro: Stickman: Hooks is a physics-based action game where you tap to attach to hooks, swing between them, and build momentum to reach the finish line while avoiding obstacles.
tips: Watch the arc of your swing and time your taps for the moment you reach the lowest point, where you have the most speed.
Look at the next hook before you release the current one so you can plan the jump instead of reacting late.
Keep your momentum going rather than stopping between hooks, since speed is what carries you across longer gaps.
Study where obstacles sit relative to your swing path so you can adjust your timing early.
If a jump fails, restart your attempt with a clear plan for the first two or three hooks to build a steady rhythm.
faq: What do I do to play Stickman: Hooks?
Click or tap to attach your stickman to a hook, then time your next tap to release and jump toward the following hook.
What is the goal of the game?
Swing from hook to hook, build enough momentum, and fly across the finish line while avoiding the obstacles in your path.

metal-animals.intro: Metal Animals puts you in charge of a band of tank-riding fluffy soldiers who take on a cute but fierce enemy. Success depends on swapping troops at the right moments and keeping your fighters' energy under control.
tips: Keep an eye on each soldier's energy level before you commit them, since a low-energy fighter may not last through a tough fight.
Swap troops based on the situation rather than sticking with one favourite, so you always have a fresh fighter ready for the next threat.
Plan a few moves ahead, because the game rewards tactical thinking more than quick, careless reactions.
Rotate your soldiers to spread the energy cost across the band instead of wearing out one unit early.
Stay focused during fast-paced stretches and check the state of your whole team before each new wave of action.
faq: What is the main goal in Metal Animals?
You lead your band of tank-riding soldiers to fend off the enemy by swapping troops and managing their energy levels. The game is about staying in the fight through tactical choices.
How does energy affect my soldiers?
Each soldier's energy level matters, so using a fighter until it is exhausted can leave you weaker in later moments. Managing energy across the team helps you keep your strongest troops available.

obby-defend-your-base-from-67.intro: Defend your base against zombie waves and the meme enemy 67 for as long as you can. Use auto shooting, build your towers and soldiers, and grow your resources between attacks.
tips: Start by farming, since hired farmers and harvested crops are your steady source of resources for everything else.
Buy weapons before an attack arrives so your firepower is ready when the zombie crowds reach your base.
Spread your spending across weapons, soldiers, and tower upgrades instead of putting everything into one area, because the description says the best defense combines all three.
Upgrade your towers as waves grow, since each wave is harder than the last and your current defense may fall behind quickly.
Open chests when you have spare resources to see whether the random loot gives you a weapon or upgrade that helps your next wave.
faq: What is the main goal of Obby: Defend your base from 67?
You defend your base from waves of zombies and the monster 67 for as long as possible. Each wave gets harder, so you need to keep growing your defense.
How do I earn resources?
Hire farmers, grow crops and harvest them. The farm is your main way to earn extra resources for buying upgrades.

grimace-penalty.intro: Grimace Penalty is a soccer challenge where you take penalty shots against an elusive goalkeeper. Your aim is to place shots well and keep scoring before three misses end the game.
tips: Watch the goalkeeper's movement before you commit to a shot, since the challenge rewards placing the ball rather than just kicking hard.
Vary where you aim instead of repeating the same corner, so the goalkeeper has a harder time guessing your next move.
Focus on timing your shot, because the description puts weight on precision and timing when you are trying to score.
Keep track of your misses, since three missed goals end the game and you can afford fewer mistakes as the suspense builds.
Stay calm and steady between shots to protect your momentum, as quick reflexes help you keep scoring in a row.
faq: What is the goal of Grimace Penalty?
Your goal is to score penalty goals against the Grimace goalkeeper and reach the winning goal. The game ends after three missed goals.
How many misses can I have before I lose?
The game ends once you have three missed goals. Every miss brings you closer to defeat, so aim carefully.

nail-salon.intro: Nail Salon is a nail art game where you welcome clients and transform their nails with painting, shaping, and decorative jewels. Each makeover follows a set sequence of steps.
tips: Line up your paint with the stencil carefully, since the stencil guides the whole design.
Take your time when filing the nails, because a neat, even shape makes the finished look stand out.
Choose a jewel that complements the colors and design you painted rather than competing with them.
Keep your color choices consistent across a client's nails so the makeover looks coordinated.
Try the new stencils and marble designs as they unlock to build a wider range of styles.
faq: What is the goal of Nail Salon?
Your goal is to turn each client's nails into a finished design by painting, filing, and adding a decorative jewel. The result should make the nails look shiny and beautiful.
What order do you work in during a makeover?
You start by painting the nails using a stencil, then file them into a shape, and finish by choosing an adhesive jewel. Following this order is how each client's look comes together.

faily-skater.intro: Faily Skater is a 3D endless runner where you skate through a busy city, dodge obstacles, pull off stunts, and pick your way along different paths. Customize your skater and aim to become a pro.
tips: Look ahead of your skater, not just at them, so you can react to obstacles before they reach you.
Pay attention to the different paths on offer and choose the one that keeps your speed up and your options open.
Try tricks when the route is clear, since landing a stunt while something is coming at you is much harder.
Keep practising the early stretches of the run to learn where obstacles tend to appear and how the course is laid out.
Experiment with your skater's look between runs if you enjoy the customization side, and see how it suits your style.
faq: What is the main goal in Faily Skater?
You skate through a chaotic urban course, dodging obstacles and performing stunts, with the aim of becoming a pro skateboarder.
How do I perform tricks?
The game description mentions daring tricks and stunts, but the instructions do not list the exact controls, so check the in-game prompts for how to perform them.

mystery-of-the-old-house-hidden-objects.intro: Mystery of the Old House is a hidden object adventure where you search old rooms full of antiques and forgotten things. Find the listed items to uncover the secrets hidden in the house.
tips: Read the item names at the bottom of the screen before you start searching, so you know exactly what you are looking for.
Scan each room in sections, from left to right and top to bottom, so you do not skip areas.
Look closely at antiques and old objects, since small or partly hidden items can blend into the background.
Use the hint option when you get stuck rather than wasting time clicking at random.
Play slowly and take breaks between rooms; careful searching is usually faster than rushing.
faq: How do I know which objects to find?
The names of the items you need are shown at the bottom of the screen in each room. Check them again whenever you move to a new scene.
What should I do when I cannot find an item?
Use the hints available in the game. They are meant to help you move forward when a room becomes difficult.

mini-car-simulator.intro: Mini Car Simulator is an arcade driving game with 40 levels across city streets, forests, and beach roads. Each level tests your handling on tight turns and tricky paths, using on-screen controls.
tips: Ease off the forward button before tight turns, then steer through the bend rather than hitting it at full speed.
Save the booster for straight stretches where you can keep your car under control afterward.
Switch camera angles before a difficult section so you can see the turn or obstacle ahead more clearly.
If your car gets stuck or crashes, press the reborn button right away instead of trying to force it free.
Learn the layout of each environment, since city, forest, and beach roads each present different kinds of tight paths.
faq: What is the goal of Mini Car Simulator?
Complete each of the 40 levels by driving through its challenges and obstacles without getting stuck or crashing.
How do I move the car?
Use the on-screen buttons to drive forward, drive backward, and steer left or right.

where-are-the-puffies.intro: A cozy seek-and-find game where tiny Puffies hide among books, plants and everyday treasures across 30 illustrated scenes. Find them all to complete each level and fill your album.
tips: Zoom in on one area at a time instead of scanning the whole picture, since the Puffies are small and easy to miss at full size.
Work through the scene in sections, such as shelves, plants, and corners, so you know which areas you have already checked.
Look at the counter in the top-left corner to see how many Puffies are left before you decide a scene is finished.
Tap carefully, because each wrong tap costs a heart. Take a moment to confirm a Puffie is really there before you click.
Since there is no countdown, you can take your time. Save the lightbulb hint for a Puffie you have searched for a while.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Find every hidden Puffie in the picture to complete the level. The counter in the top-left corner shows how many you have found so far.
What happens if I tap the wrong spot?
A wrong tap costs a heart. Tap carefully and look closely before you click.

survive-the-glass-bridge.intro: Survive The Glass Bridge is an arcade jumping game where you cross a bridge of glass panels. One panel in each pair is fake, so you need to pick the safe one and reach the end before time runs out.
tips: Start on an easier difficulty from the main menu to get a head start on spotting the difference between the safe and fake glass.
Use the mouse to look ahead and study the next pair of panels before you commit to a jump.
Line up your character with WASD or the arrow keys before pressing Space, so you land squarely on the panel you chose.
Keep an eye on the time limit and avoid long pauses, since you must reach the other side within it.
Once you learn how the difficulty level changes what you can see, move up gradually rather than jumping straight to the hardest setting.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
You need to find the real glass panels, jump across them one by one, and reach the final platform before the time runs out.
What happens if I pick the wrong glass?
The glass breaks and your character falls down, which ends that attempt.

geometry-arrow.intro: Geometry Arrow is a skill game where you steer an arrow through a cave full of obstacles and spikes to reach the portal at the end. Pick one of the 13 levels in the menu to begin.
tips: Watch the obstacle pattern for a few seconds before you start moving, so you can plan your first dodges.
Make small, steady inputs rather than rapid clicks or taps, since quick overcorrections are a common way to hit spikes.
Practice the early part of each level until its layout feels familiar, then focus on the harder sections later on.
Keep your eyes a little ahead of the arrow so you can react to the next obstacle before it reaches you.
Because each level gets harder than the one before, use the earlier levels to build timing before moving on to the tougher ones.
faq: What is the goal of Geometry Arrow?
Guide the arrow through the cave to the portal at the end of the level while staying alive. Dodge the unique obstacles and spikes along the way.
How do I control the arrow on PC?
Use the left mouse button or the spacebar to move the arrow. On mobile, touch the screen to move it.

super-hitmasters.intro: Super HitMasters is an arcade shooter where you play a spy who must eliminate every enemy in each room. Levels start simple and grow harder, and you aim with a swipe and fire.
tips: Before you shoot, look at the whole room and work out which enemies can be reached by a single shot or by a crate you can fire.
Count your remaining bullets before each attempt, since running out mid-stage can end your run.
Fire large boxes at groups of enemies, and consider throwing boxes into the vacuum or letting them crash to clear targets faster.
Look for the exact point to aim at, because a precise shot often removes more enemies than a rushed one.
Collect coins whenever you can, so you can unlock new weapons, clothes, and characters for later stages.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You must destroy all the opponents in the room to finish the stage. Some levels also require you to work out how objects relate to each other before you can move on.
How do I aim and fire?
Swipe across the screen to aim, then release to fire your shot. Mouse or touch controls both work for this.

break-a-tower-obby.intro: Break a Tower: Obby is a blocky demolition game where you punch your way through a tower floor by floor. Train your strength, upgrade your stats, and collect pets to break through taller towers faster.
tips: Train regularly by doing push-ups, since strength raises the damage you deal to every floor.
Expect floors to gain HP as you climb, so keep your strength growing before moving on to harder towers.
Save coins for higher-tier pets, and combine duplicate pets, because pets boost the coins you earn from breaking floors.
Claim your daily rewards whenever you log in to build up resources over time.
Consider rebirthing once progress slows down, since it earns trophies that help you keep advancing.
faq: What is the goal of Break a Tower: Obby?
You break through the floors of a tower by tapping, climbing higher to improve your stats and progress. Each tower is destroyed floor by floor until it is fully demolished.
How do I get stronger?
Train by doing push-ups in the mini-idle mechanic to build your strength. Higher strength means more damage to each tower floor.

buba-jump.intro: Buba Jump is an arcade game where you keep Buba alive by timing your taps well. Platforms get scarcer as the challenges grow harder, so precise timing matters more over time.
tips: Watch the next platform before you tap, not after you land, so you can plan the timing of your next jump.
Keep a steady rhythm in the early moments to get a feel for how Buba responds to each tap.
Stay calm when the challenge ramps up. Rushed taps are the most common reason to fall into the abyss.
Pay attention to how many platforms remain ahead, and adjust your pace so you are not caught with no safe landing.
Use short play sessions to build your reflexes, then come back and try to beat your previous run.
faq: What is the goal of Buba Jump?
Your goal is to keep Buba from falling into the abyss by landing on platforms with well-timed taps. The game gets harder as platforms become fewer and challenges increase.
How do the controls work?
The game uses simple tap controls, and the key skill is tapping at exactly the right moment. Focus on timing rather than tapping quickly.

zap.intro: ZAP is a fast card game where you match colors or numbers to empty your hand before your opponents do. Each turn is quick, so reading the discard pile carefully pays off.
tips: Match on color or number, and check which option leaves you with more playable cards next turn.
Hold on to cards that match the color you have the most of, so you always have a follow-up play ready.
Keep an eye on how many cards each opponent has left, and play more aggressively when someone is close to finishing.
Remember to press the "1" button as soon as you are down to one card, since forgetting it costs you two penalty cards.
When you have no playable card, draw from the pile only until you find one, and then plan your next move from there.
faq: What is the main goal of ZAP?
The goal is to get rid of all your cards before every other player does. You do this by matching the color or number of the card placed before yours.
What happens if I cannot play a card?
You must draw cards from the pile until you get one you can play. Keep drawing until a playable card appears.

jigsaw-puzzles.intro: Jigsaw Puzzles lets you assemble pictures piece by piece in a calm, relaxed setting. Pick a category and a piece count, then drag the pieces onto the board to build the picture.
tips: Start with a lower piece count to get a feel for how the pieces fit, then increase it once you are comfortable.
The game recommends turning on rotation, so try it at least once to see how it changes the pace of play.
Tap a piece to rotate it before dragging it into place, which helps you avoid trying to force a piece that is turned the wrong way.
Choose a category with a picture you enjoy, since you will spend more time looking at the image while you work.
Work on one area of the picture at a time and group pieces with similar colors together to make matches easier to spot.
faq: What is the goal of Jigsaw Puzzles?
The goal is to drag all the pieces onto the board and arrange them until the full picture is put together.
How do I move and rotate the pieces?
Drag a piece to place it on the board, and tap it to rotate it so it fits into the jigsaw.

jigsaw-sort.intro: Jigsaw Sort is a puzzle game where you swap pieces around to reveal a hidden picture. Each level gets more complex as you go, so you'll need to pay attention to every piece.
tips: Start by looking at the whole image and noting which pieces show edges, corners, or distinctive colors, since these give you clues about where they belong.
Focus on one area of the picture at a time instead of jumping between pieces, so you don't lose track of what you've already placed.
Before each swap, check whether the piece you're moving is already in a good spot, so you don't undo progress you've made.
Keep an eye on the picture's larger shapes, such as a sky, a shoreline, or a face, and build those sections first.
When a level feels stuck, step back and scan the board again, because a fresh look often shows a mismatch you missed.
faq: What is the goal of Jigsaw Sort?
The goal is to swap pieces until every piece is aligned, which uncovers the hidden image on each level.
How does the difficulty change?
The levels become progressively more complex, so later puzzles ask more of your attention and reasoning.

stickman-broken-bones-io.intro: Stickman Broken Bones io is an action game about guiding stickmen down chaotic descents. Smash through obstacles, use vehicles and upgrades, and aim for high scores by causing as much damage as you can.
tips: Look at the obstacles ahead before you commit to a path. Choosing a route that hits more of them usually helps your score more than a safe, slow line.
Try vehicles and upgrades early to see how each one changes your speed and impact, then stick with the ones that suit your run.
Focus on timing. Hitting obstacles at the right moment tends to produce bigger crashes than rushing into them.
Keep your stickman moving with controlled maneuvering so you can line up the next smash instead of drifting off course.
Play a few runs in a row and notice which obstacles give the best results, then plan future descents around them.
faq: What is the main goal in Stickman Broken Bones io?
The goal is to guide your stickman down each descent and cause as much bone-breaking destruction as possible to earn a high score.
How do I get a higher score?
Smash through as many obstacles as you can, use vehicles and upgrades to increase your impact, and time your hits well.

mini-dice-chess.intro: Mini Dice Chess mixes classic chess with dice rolls. Each turn the dice decide which pieces you can move, so you need to plan around luck as well as board position.
tips: Before you roll, look at which pieces you have on the board so you know what a good result would be.
When the dice give you an awkward roll, pick the move that keeps your key pieces safe rather than forcing an attack.
Watch your opponent's likely rolls as well as their current pieces, since a threat they can't activate this turn may not matter yet.
Keep your pieces grouped and defended so that whichever ones the dice allow you to move still support each other.
Adjust your plan every turn instead of sticking to one long-term idea, because the available moves change with each roll.
faq: What is the goal of Mini Dice Chess?
The description does not list a win condition, so play as you would in chess and aim to outmaneuver your opponent on the board. Watch the game's own prompts for how a game ends.
How do I move my pieces?
Use mouse click or tap to select and move pieces. The dice roll decides which pieces you are able to move on that turn.

gt-truck-racer.intro: GT Truck Racer is a truck driving game set across different cities and weather conditions. You steer heavy trucks along challenging roads, avoid obstacles, and try to reach your destination safely.
tips: Tap the left and right steer buttons in short, measured presses rather than holding them, so the truck stays stable on curves.
Switch camera views whenever you need a better look at the road ahead or the traffic around you, especially before a tight turn.
Save the booster for straight stretches with clear road ahead, since an instant speed boost is harder to control in busy or obstacle-heavy areas.
Pay attention to the weather, because rain or other conditions can change how the truck handles and how far ahead you need to plan your moves.
Slow down early when a route looks crowded with obstacles, then speed up again once the path clears to keep your run safe.
faq: What is the main goal of GT Truck Racer?
Your goal is to drive your truck to the destination safely while avoiding obstacles on the road. Completing missions is also part of the challenge.
How do I steer the truck?
Use the left and right on-screen buttons to steer. Tapping them gives you smoother control over the vehicle.

space-destroyer.intro: Space Destroyer is a top-down shoot-em-up where you defend the galaxy from alien ships. You clear three stages, each ending with three bosses, while chasing a high score.
tips: Watch enemy movement patterns early in each stage so you can predict where shots will come from before they reach your ship.
Prioritize enemy ships that fire at you first, since clearing the most dangerous targets keeps your position safe while you work through the rest.
Treat each boss fight as a separate challenge: learn its attack rhythm over the first few moments and move between shots rather than standing still.
Aim for points steadily rather than chasing one big score, because destroying enemy ships in each stage adds up across the whole run.
Since the game is controlled with a mouse click or tap, keep small, steady movements so you stay responsive when enemies close in.
faq: What is the main goal of Space Destroyer?
Your mission is to save the galaxy by destroying all enemy ships and earning as many points as possible. You must complete three stages to finish the run.
How do I control the ship?
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps. Use these inputs to move and act as you fight through each stage.

satisfying-ball-clicker.intro: Satisfying Ball Clicker is a clicker game where you spawn balls and earn coins from their bounces. You can upgrade, unlock skins, evolve for new abilities, and collect gems along the way.
tips: Spend your early coins on upgrades that increase earnings, since more income makes every later purchase faster.
Check your coin rate after each upgrade to see which one actually helps, and avoid buying things that do not change your income.
Save up for evolving when you can afford it, because the game presents it as a way to gain new abilities.
Try different skins and setups now and then, since the game encourages you to personalize your experience.
Keep an eye out for gems and collect them whenever they appear, as they are part of the rewards you are working toward.
faq: What is the main goal of Satisfying Ball Clicker?
The goal is to spawn balls, earn coins from each bounce, and maximize your earnings while collecting gems. Upgrades, skins, and evolving add to how you progress.
How do I earn coins?
You earn coins with each bounce of the balls you spawn. Upgrading your setup can help you earn more from every bounce.

robot-bar-find-the-differences.intro: Robot Bar is a spot-the-difference puzzle set in a sci-fi club with cheerful robots. You compare two pictures and find the differences before the clock runs out.
tips: Scan the two pictures in a consistent order, such as left to right and top to bottom, so you do not skip areas.
Compare small details like robot faces, lights, drinks, and objects on tables, since differences are often subtle.
You only have five chances, so confirm a difference carefully before you select it rather than guessing.
Keep an eye on the timer and move on from a tough area if you are stuck, then return to it with fresh eyes.
Stay calm and focused; quick glances tend to miss changes that a slower second look would catch.
faq: What is the goal of Robot Bar?
The goal is to find the differences between two pictures of a robot club before time runs out.
How many mistakes can I make?
You have five chances, so a wrong guess uses one of them and you should aim for precision.

hero-defense-king.intro: Hero Defense King is an action tower defense game where you command a hero to hold off waves of enemies and protect your tower. Enemies grow stronger as the battle goes on, so planning your upgrades matters.
tips: Spend early resources on upgrades that help you survive the first waves, since you will need a stable base before the harder enemies arrive.
Watch which enemy types are coming next and adjust your towers and hero choices to match, rather than sticking to one setup.
Use your hero's skills at the right moment, especially when a large group is close to your tower, instead of spending them as soon as they are ready.
Keep your hero near the most dangerous part of the attack path so it can respond quickly to new threats.
If a wave gets through, pause to rethink your layout and upgrade order before the next one starts.
faq: What is the goal of Hero Defense King?
Your goal is to stop waves of enemies from reaching your tower and survive increasingly difficult battles.
How do enemies change as the game goes on?
Stronger enemies spawn as the game progresses, so the challenge rises with each stage of the battle.

super-rocket-buddy.intro: Super Rocket Buddy is an arcade puzzler where you fire Buddies from a cannon toward a target. Each level asks you to solve a puzzle, avoid obstacles, and use as many Buddies as you need.
tips: Before you fire, look at the whole level to find the target and the obstacles between you and it. Plan a route rather than shooting at random.
Don't worry about saving Buddies. The game lets you use as many as you need, so it's fine to spend a few on testing a shot.
Watch how the ragdoll physics move your Buddies after launch. Their bounces and tumbles can carry them past spots you didn't expect.
If a level stalls, try a different angle or timing on your next launch instead of repeating the same shot.
Play in short sessions and take a moment to study each puzzle. Many of the challenges reward careful observation.
faq: What is the goal of Super Rocket Buddy?
Your goal is to get a Buddy to the target from the cannon. You complete each level by solving its puzzle and avoiding obstacles along the way.
How do I control the cannon?
The game is played with a mouse on desktop or touch on mobile devices. Use whichever input you have to aim and fire.

the-malevolent-mansion-of-evil.intro: The Malevolent Mansion of Evil is a first-person action horror adventure set in a gothic manor. You explore haunting corridors and work to uncover the mysteries hidden inside the mansion.
tips: Explore each corridor slowly and look around before moving on, since the mysteries are uncovered by paying attention to your surroundings.
Treat the beautiful but sinister rooms as clues. Details in the architecture and décor may point toward what is happening in the manor.
Keep track of places you have already searched so you do not waste time backtracking through the same halls.
Stay calm when the atmosphere gets intense. Pausing for a moment to take in your surroundings can help you spot what you would otherwise miss.
Play in a quiet, dimly lit setting with the sound on if you can, because the game's tension is built around its atmosphere and story.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You navigate the haunting corridors of a gothic manor and uncover the mysteries lurking within the mansion as the story unfolds.
What kind of gameplay should I expect?
The game is a first-person action horror adventure, so expect intense, spine-tingling moments as you move through the mansion.

masked-forces.intro: Masked Forces is a 3D shooter where you fight enemies on a battlefield in single-player or multiplayer missions. Your goal is to eliminate all enemies, survive, and win the battle.
tips: Use crouch (C) when you stop to aim, since staying low makes it harder for enemies to hit you while you shoot.
Keep moving with WASD and jump with Space rather than standing still in one open spot.
Reload (R) during quieter moments so your weapon is full when enemies appear.
Switch weapons with the mouse scroll wheel early in a fight to use whichever one suits the distance to your target.
Check the armory and weapons shop features before a mission so you know what options you have to prepare.
faq: What is the goal of Masked Forces?
Your mission is to kill all your enemies, survive in the battlefield environment, and win the battle.
How do I shoot and reload?
Press the left mouse button to fire and press R to reload.

sink-hole.intro: Sink Hole is a 3D city game where you control a hungry sinkhole that grows by swallowing buildings, objects and rivals. Across four modes, you eat smaller targets, avoid bigger threats and chain combos to get bigger.
tips: Grow on small targets first so you get bigger before you challenge rivals.
Check the size of a rival before moving in, and steer away from anything larger than you.
Try to chain swallows quickly, since building a x5 combo is a strong way to boost your growth.
Grab boosts when they are close to your path, but do not turn away from a bigger rival to reach one.
Use the pause key when you need a moment to plan your route, then check your stats after a run to see what to improve.
faq: What is the main goal in Sink Hole?
Swallow smaller objects and holes to grow, and avoid bigger rivals that can take you down.
How do I move on PC and on mobile?
On PC, use the mouse, WASD or the arrow keys. On mobile, touch and drag to move.

blindbat.intro: BlindBat is a 2D arcade game where you play as a sun-loving bat flying through the sky. You navigate with sonar, outwit birds, and manage your ammo.
tips: Use your sonar to read the sky before you move, so you know where the birds are before they reach you.
Save your ammo for shots you are likely to land, since every missed shot raises the risk for you.
Hitting targets restores your supplies, so take shots that you can connect with rather than firing at random.
Plan your attacks ahead instead of reacting to each bird as it appears, which helps you stay in the air longer.
Watch how the birds move and try to predict their path so you can avoid them while keeping your ammo in reserve.
faq: What is the main goal of BlindBat?
You fly as a sun-loving bat through the sky, using sonar to navigate and outwitting the birds while you keep soaring.
How do I keep my ammo from running out?
Be selective with your shots, because missed shots increase the risk, while hitting targets restores your supplies.

solitaire-tripeaks.intro: Solitaire TriPeaks is a card puzzle where you clear three peaks of cards by matching ranks with the card showing from the deck. Each move brings you closer to clearing the board.
tips: Before each move, scan all the face-up cards on the peaks and look for ones one rank above or below the current deck card.
Pay attention to which peak cards are blocking others, since clearing a blocking card can open up new options.
Keep an eye on the deck: if no card on the board fits, you will need to draw, so plan ahead when you have a choice.
When you have more than one valid move, prefer the one that uncovers a hidden card, because that gives you more options next turn.
faq: What is the goal of Solitaire TriPeaks?
The goal is to remove the cards from the three peaks by selecting cards that are one rank higher or lower than the card from the deck.
How do I remove a card from the board?
Select a face-up card on the peaks that is one rank higher or lower than the card currently shown from the deck. It is then removed from the board.

ice-ball-run.intro: Ice Ball Run is an arcade game where you guide a frosty ball across platforms filled with obstacles. Each level tests your control, timing, and planning.
tips: Study each platform layout before you move, and spot the obstacles that could knock you off course.
Practice the ball's movement on the first few steps of a level so you learn how it responds before the harder sections.
Make one calculated move at a time instead of rushing, since the game rewards precision over speed.
If a level keeps defeating you, pause to plan a route through the tricky section rather than retrying the same approach.
Pay attention to the unique challenge of each level, because the tactics that work in one may not carry over to the next.
faq: What is the goal of Ice Ball Run?
Guide the frosty ball through each level's platforms and obstacles to complete it. The game focuses on precise, well-planned moves.
Are there instructions for the controls?
No separate control instructions are listed for this game, so try a few small movements early on to learn how the ball responds.

car-eats-car-underwater-adventure.intro: Car Eats Car: Underwater Adventure is a racing game where you overtake rivals on the highway, build your own car, and escape police chases. Good driving and quick use of your turbo are key to winning races.
tips: Save your turbo (X) for the moments you need a burst of speed, such as passing a rival or pulling away from the cops, rather than using it all at the start.
Use A and D to keep your car balanced, especially when you are steering through turns or at high speed, so you don't lose control.
Tap S to brake before tight corners and then press W to accelerate out of them, rather than braking and accelerating at the same time.
Fire bombs with Space when a rival car is close enough to hit, since a missed shot wastes the chance to slow them down.
Spend time in the incubator and upgrade your cars between races, so your builds match the kind of racing you are doing, whether that is overtaking or evading the police.
faq: What is the main goal of Car Eats Car: Underwater Adventure?
You race on the highway to overtake enemy cars, create and upgrade your own vehicle, and survive police chases and boss fights. The game rewards good driving and smart use of your speed.
Which keys control the car?
W is gas, S is brake, and A and D balance the car. You can also use the arrow keys for gas, brake, and balancing, and press X for turbo and Space to use bombs.

panda-adventure.intro: Panda Adventure is a platformer where you guide a curious panda through colorful, challenging worlds. You explore environments, take on action, and work through a range of fun challenges.
tips: Use either the W, A, S, D keys or the arrow keys to move, and pick whichever feels more comfortable for you.
Take time to explore each area before rushing ahead, since the game encourages exploration alongside action.
Pay close attention to the layout of each world, because the challenges are built into the environment and studying it can help you plan your moves.
Use the mouse to click any on-screen buttons, so you do not have to switch back to the keyboard for menus.
If you get stuck on a challenge, step back and look at the area from a different angle before trying again.
faq: How do I move the panda?
Press W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move back, A or the Left Arrow to move left, and D or the Right Arrow to move right.
How do I click buttons in the game?
Use your mouse to click any button on screen.

the-adventure-of-finn-and-bonnie.intro: The Adventure of Finn & Bonnie is an adventure shooter where Finn and Bonnie fight back against robots that have colonized planet X. You collect weapons, mix them, and upgrade them to take the robots down.
tips: Pick up weapons whenever you can, since you need a good stock of them to deal with the robots.
Try combining different weapons to see what new options you can create, and keep the stronger results.
Upgrade your weapons as soon as you are able, because a stronger weapon makes the tougher robots easier to handle.
Move with the mouse or touch controls and keep an eye on where the robots are coming from before you fire.
Take your time in each area to gather weapons before pushing ahead, so you are better prepared for the next fight.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Finn and Bonnie must collect many weapons and use them to destroy all the robots that have colonized planet X.
How do I make my weapons stronger?
Mix and upgrade your weapons. Combining them gives you new options, and upgrading makes them more powerful.

parkourcraft.intro: ParkourCraft is a blocky 3D platforming game built around fluid movement. You jump across courses, avoid pitfalls, and work through tricky terrain to unlock treasures.
tips: Look ahead before each jump and pick your landing spot first, so you are not reacting at the last moment.
Slow down on tricky sections and check the terrain before committing, since precision matters more than speed.
Think about where you stand between jumps, because strategic positioning can make the next leap much easier.
If a course keeps catching you in the same spot, study that section and try a different approach rather than repeating the same jump.
Pay attention to pitfalls as you move through each course so you can plan a safe route to any treasures you spot.
faq: What is the main goal in ParkourCraft?
Your aim is to move through the 3D platforming courses, dodge pitfalls, and navigate the terrain to unlock treasures.
What makes a good run in ParkourCraft?
Clean, skillful jumps and well-chosen positions help you stay on course and reach treasures without falling into pitfalls.

ropeman-3d.intro: Ropeman 3D is a 3D hypercasual action game built around strategy and combat. You use special powers to manipulate nature, move through gangster territory, and outwit enemies in tense battles.
tips: Spend your first few minutes learning the controls, since the game is described as intuitive and quick practice makes the battles easier to handle.
Before you engage a foe, look at where they are and how they move so you can choose a good moment to attack rather than rushing in.
Use your nature powers deliberately. Save them for tougher fights or situations where you can outsmart a group, instead of spending them all at once.
When a fight goes badly, pause and think about what went wrong, then try a different approach next time instead of repeating the same move.
If you want to climb the global leaderboard, aim for steady, careful wins over risky plays, because a single mistake in a high-stakes battle can cost you the run.
faq: What is the main goal in Ropeman 3D?
The description focuses on strategy, combat, and outsmarting foes while moving through gangster domains. It also mentions climbing the global leaderboard as a long-term aim.
How do the controls work?
The game describes its controls as intuitive, so the best approach is to try the basic actions early and get a feel for them before facing harder battles.

obby-rainbow-tower.intro: Obby Rainbow Tower is a winter-themed tower race where you climb floor by floor, dodging moving platforms, icy tiles and spinning lava bars. You can race your own best time or go head to head with a friend in 2 player mode.
tips: Use the Sprint key to build speed before long gaps, but ease off before icy tiles so you don't overshoot the next platform.
Watch the moving platforms for a few cycles before jumping so you can time your landing for the moment they reach you.
Learn the spinning lava bars on each floor by pausing your route in your head, then go when the gap is clear rather than rushing in.
Plan your double jump before you leave the ground, since it is the main way to recover if you misjudge a jump.
In 2 player mode, keep an eye on your rival's position so you can react to snowballs and snowstorms they may push you toward.
faq: What is the goal of Obby Rainbow Tower?
Climb the tower as fast as you can, floor by floor, without falling into the void. Each run is a chance to beat your own best time.
What controls do I use in 1 player mode?
Use W, A, S and D to move, Shift to sprint, and Space to jump. Press Space again in the air to double jump.

dinosaur-city-hunting-destroy.intro: Dinosaur City Hunting Destroy puts you in control of a massive dinosaur loose in a modern city. Smash buildings, crush cars, and complete hunting missions while you survive the city forces.
tips: Check your mission objectives before you start smashing, so you know which targets to hunt first.
Use WASD to move around the open world and keep your path clear of obstacles that could slow you down.
Smash buildings and crush cars along your route, since destruction is a core part of the gameplay.
Keep an eye on the city forces and move on before they surround you, rather than standing still in one spot.
Use mouse clicks or taps to interact with the game, and pause to scan the streets for your next target.
faq: What is the main goal of Dinosaur City Hunting Destroy?
The main goal is to complete missions by hunting down specific targets while causing chaos in the city. Smashing buildings and crushing cars are part of the rampage.
How do I move the dinosaur?
Use the W, A, S, and D keys to control the dinosaur. Mouse click or tap is used to play the game.

delete-part-in-lovestory.intro: Delete Part in LoveStory is a puzzle game where you erase parts of a scene to uncover the hidden solution. Each level presents a small story or challenge to work through.
tips: Study the whole image before you erase anything, and note which details look out of place or incomplete.
Ask yourself what is missing from the scene, since the solution is usually tied to that gap rather than to the most obvious object.
Erase in small, careful strokes at first so you can see what each part reveals before you commit to a larger area.
If you get stuck, try a different approach on the same scene, because the instructions say each puzzle has a humorous or surprising twist.
Expect the puzzles to get trickier as you advance, so take a moment to re-read the scene when a new level feels confusing.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You need to figure out what is missing or needs to be uncovered in the scene, then erase part of the image to reveal the solution. Completing the level lets you move on to the next challenge.
How do I erase parts of the image?
Use your finger to erase a section of the picture, and the hidden solution or fix will appear in the erased area.

castel-war-3d.intro: Castel War 3D is a strategy puzzle where you lead troops in 3D battles. You defend your fortress, gather resources, and plan attacks as the situation changes.
tips: Gather resources early so you have what you need to support your defenses and your army.
Keep your fortress protected before you commit troops to an attack, since losing it ends your chances of winning.
Try different types of units and notice which ones work best against the enemy forces you face.
Watch how the battle changes from moment to moment and adjust your plan instead of sticking to your first idea.
Balance your time between building up your economy and attacking, so you are not caught with too few troops when the enemy pushes.
faq: What is the main goal in Castel War 3D?
You lead your troops to defend your fortress, gather resources, and attack in order to secure victory.
Which units can I command?
The game lets you command diverse units, and choosing the right ones for each situation is part of the strategy.

obby-craft-build-a-plane.intro: Obby Craft: Build a Plane is a flight game where you design an airplane from parts, launch it with a slingshot, and fly through a course collecting coins. Your builds can be saved in up to 4 slots.
tips: Test each new part by launching the plane, since every block affects how it flies. Small changes can make a big difference in flight.
Spend your early coins on slingshot upgrades first, because a stronger launch gives you more height and speed to reach coins across the map.
Plan your flight path before you take off so you can grab the coins that are scattered around the map while you are in the air.
Save a working build in one of your 4 slots before you try a risky redesign, so you can always go back to a plane that flies well.
Take your 2 free skins right away, then spin the roulette wheel when you have spare coins to try for rare items or more currency.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You build an airplane from parts, fly it off the slingshot, collect coins on the map, and get through the obstacle course called Obbi.
How do I add parts to my plane?
Stand near the plane in the crafting area, select a part from the inventory at the bottom, and click to install it next to the plane. If you run out of parts, buy more in the store.

color-snake-run.intro: Color Snake Run is a 3D arcade runner where you steer a colorful snake along fast tracks and match its color to pass obstacles. Mouse clicks or taps are all you need to play.
tips: Watch the track ahead rather than the snake's head so you can plan which color you need before each obstacle reaches you.
Keep your snake's color in mind as you approach a gate or barrier, and make your change early instead of at the last moment.
Stay focused during the twists and turns, since the track changes quickly and a late reaction is the most common cause of failure.
Learn the pattern of the obstacles over a few runs; repeated layouts make it easier to time your taps.
Take short breaks when your focus drops, because steady attention matters more than speed in this game.
faq: How do I control the snake?
You play with mouse clicks or taps. Use them to guide the snake through the track and line up with the correct colors.
What is the goal of the game?
Your goal is to guide the snake through obstacles by matching the correct colors while the track keeps moving forward.

catch-the-roober.intro: Catch the Robber is a fast-paced action game where you play a sheriff chasing a gang of red-masked thieves through the streets. Use mouse clicks or taps to corner them and protect the town.
tips: Watch where the thieves are heading before you move, since they are ready to run and chasing them blindly wastes time.
Use stealth and approach from angles that cut off their escape routes instead of charging straight at them.
Keep an eye on the giant loot bottles, as they are the thieves' weapons and you should plan your position to avoid them.
Try to corner the thieves in a tight area where they have fewer places to run, then knock them out.
Stay calm and make deliberate clicks or taps rather than rapid, random ones, because precise timing is what lets you catch them.
faq: What is the goal of Catch the Robber?
Your goal is to chase down the red-masked thieves, corner them, and knock them out to protect the town.
What controls does the game use?
You play with mouse clicks or taps only, so focus on timing and accuracy with each input.

car-eats-car-winter-adventure.intro: Car Eats Car: Winter Adventure is a 2D racing game where you overtake rivals on the highway, build your own car, and take on the cops and a boss. Good driving and smart use of your tools matter most.
tips: Save turbo (X) for straights or moments when you are close to a rival, so you do not run out of speed when you need it most.
Use A and D to keep your car balanced, especially when you are cornering or jumping, so you do not lose control at high speed.
Use Space for bombs when a rival or police car is directly in front of you, rather than firing at long range where they can easily dodge.
Ease off the gas (W) and tap brake (S) before tight turns, then accelerate out of them, which is usually faster than braking hard mid-corner.
Upgrade your car as you earn progress, since the game rewards building a stronger vehicle before you face the boss.
faq: What is the main goal of Car Eats Car: Winter Adventure?
You race on the highway to overtake enemies, escape the police, and free your friends from prison. Surviving the boss fight is part of the challenge.
Which keys control the car?
W is gas and S is brake, while A and D balance the car. The arrow keys can also be used for gas, brake, and balancing, and X activates turbo.

desolate-isle-survival.intro: Desolate Isle: Survival is an open-world survival adventure where you gather resources, craft tools, build a base, and explore the island to find a way out. Planning ahead is the key to progress.
tips: Gather resources in several areas before you start crafting, so you do not have to backtrack for missing materials.
Craft the tools you need first, then use them to collect the materials you need for bigger projects.
Build your base in a spot that is easy to return to, since you will bring resources back to it while you explore.
Pay attention to the button prompts that appear above some objects, because those objects will not work unless you press the button.
Complete quests when you can, since they unlock new territories and reveal more of the island's secrets.
faq: What is the main goal of Desolate Isle: Survival?
Your goal is to survive and escape the mysterious island. You do this by gathering resources, crafting tools, building a base, and completing quests to explore new areas.
How do I move my character on keyboard and mobile?
On keyboard, use WASD or the arrow keys to move. On mobile, use the joystick to move and turn.

football-free-kick.intro: Football Free Kick is a 3D arcade shootout where you curl free kicks over a wall and past a diving keeper. Each stage asks you to score enough goals before you run out of balls.
tips: Use a curved swipe when the wall is in the way, and try a straighter, softer shot when the wall is low or the keeper is still.
Vary your swipe speed on purpose. A faster swipe lifts the ball higher, which can help you clear the wall, but it is harder to control.
Watch for wind before you shoot, and adjust your aim to offset it rather than hitting your usual spot.
Keep your streak going when you can, since bonus points reward consecutive goals. Playing it safe on a shot you are unsure about can protect the streak.
Pick perks between stages with your next few stages in mind, and remember that the keepers get sharper as you progress.
faq: How do I aim and curve the ball with the keyboard?
Use the arrow keys to aim, hold A or D to add curve, and press Space or Enter to shoot.
How does the mouse control work?
Drag from the ball and release to shoot. The direction and strength of your drag decide where and how the ball travels.

super-chains.intro: Super Chains is a math puzzle game where you connect blocks of numbers to reveal mystical creatures. Chain carefully, decide quickly, and use Heroic Helpers to get through tougher challenges.
tips: Before you place a chain, scan the board for blocks that ascend, descend, or match, so you can plan a longer connection.
Think a few moves ahead. A block that looks useful now may be better saved for a chain you can build later.
Practice quick decisions on easier challenges so you can respond faster when the board gets crowded.
Save your Heroic Helpers for the hardest challenges rather than using them early, when simpler chains can still work.
If you get stuck, step back and look for matching numbers you have overlooked, since they can open up new routes.
faq: What is the main goal of Super Chains?
The goal is to connect blocks of numbers into chains and use them to unveil mystical creatures. Completing challenges helps you claim the champion title.
What kinds of chains can I make?
You can connect blocks of ascending numbers, descending numbers, or matching numbers. Looking for all three types helps you find more options on each board.

dash-masters.intro: Dash Masters is a vertical climbing game where you ascend a metal shaft using hops and dashes. You fight robotic foes, collect rewards, and stay ahead of a laser chasing you from below.
tips: Build a steady hopping rhythm early, since the game rewards good timing in every vertical leap.
Keep an eye on the laser behind you and avoid lingering in one place, because it is always closing in.
Save your powerful dashes for moments when you need to gain distance or get past a dangerous spot.
Pick up rewards when they are safely within reach, but don't let chasing them cost you the lead over the laser.
Take a moment to watch how robotic foes move before engaging so you can time your attacks more confidently.
faq: What is the goal of Dash Masters?
Climb as high as you can up the towering metallic shaft while staying ahead of the laser that is chasing you.
What moves do I use in Dash Masters?
The game describes rhythmic hops and powerful dashes as your main ways of moving upward. The game does not list specific keys or buttons.

break-stick-completely.intro: Break Stick Completely is an arcade game where you set up a stick figure with a vehicle and obstacles, then press Start and watch the chaos unfold. Your goal is to earn points through stunts and unlock new levels.
tips: Try a different vehicle on each run, from the motorcycle to the supermarket cart, to see how each one changes the stunts Stick performs.
Place giant ramps where they can launch Stick into the air, since airborne moves are a natural way to build up stunt action.
Test one obstacle at a time before combining several, so you can tell which trap or ramp produces the most points.
Pay attention to what the crazy stunts look like after each run, and repeat the setups that score well.
Use your experiments to find new combinations, because trying something unusual is how you can discover fresh results and progress further.
faq: What is the main goal of Break Stick Completely?
The goal is to create comical chaos with your stick figure by choosing a vehicle and adding obstacles, then earn points through fun stunts.
How do I earn points?
Points come from the stunts Stick performs once you press Start, so the setup you build directly affects your score.

throw-sword.intro: Throw Sword is a stickman action game where you aim and throw swords at opponents. Time your throws well to eliminate enemies before you are defeated.
tips: Use A and D, or the Left and Right arrows, to rotate and line up your aim before every throw.
Take a moment to aim carefully, since a rushed throw is easy to waste.
Press Z to collect your sword, and make sure you have it back before you try to throw again.
Watch the enemies' timing and strike at the right moment instead of throwing as soon as you can.
Focus on throwing with precise force, because the strength of your throw affects whether you eliminate an enemy.
faq: What is the goal of Throw Sword?
You control a stickman who throws swords to defeat opponents before you are defeated yourself. The description also mentions aiming for high scores.
How do I aim my sword?
Use A and D or the Left and Right arrow keys to rotate your aim. Line up the shot before you throw.

bad-cat-simulator-pet-game.intro: Bad Cat Simulator Pet Game puts you in control of a mischievous cat roaming a cozy home. Your goal is to cause chaos with pranks on the humans while leveling up for new abilities.
tips: Explore the whole house before starting a prank so you know where each object and human is located.
Use sneaking to get close to people unseen, since being spotted can ruin a prank setup.
Try the interactive objects in each room, as they are the main source of mischief.
Complete the fun challenges as they come, since leveling up unlocks new cat abilities that can open up new pranks.
Vary your pranks instead of repeating one, so you keep finding fresh ways to cause trouble.
faq: What is the main goal of Bad Cat Simulator Pet Game?
The goal is to roam a cozy home and cause chaos through pranks on unsuspecting humans. Completing challenges helps you level up.
How do I unlock new cat abilities?
You unlock new abilities by leveling up, which comes from completing the fun challenges in the game.

draw-bridge-puzzle-2.intro: Draw Bridge Puzzle 2 is a drawing puzzle where you sketch bridges and shields to get a car across gaps or keep a stick figure safe. Levels get more complex as you move forward, so planning matters.
tips: Before you draw, look at the whole level to see where the gaps, broken roads, and obstacles are. Plan a path that covers the danger points first.
Use your ink carefully. The description says to save ink while keeping the bridge stable, so try to draw the fewest and shortest lines that still work.
In car mode, make sure the bridge connects firmly on both sides of a gap. A bridge that does not reach solid ground will not carry the motor across.
In save mode, think about where the danger is coming from and place the protective shield so it fully covers the stick figure's path.
If a design fails, study what went wrong and adjust just that part instead of starting over. Small changes often fix a level faster than a full redraw.
faq: What is the goal of Draw Bridge Puzzle 2?
In car mode, your goal is to draw a bridge that helps the motor cross gaps and obstacles to reach the goal. In save mode, you draw a protective shield to keep the stick figure safe from danger.
How do I play the game?
Tap and drag to draw your bridge or shield. The game is played with one player.

3d-laane-runner.intro: 3D Laane Runner is an arcade runner where you race through 3D landscapes, dodging obstacles and collecting power-ups to build a high score. You can also challenge friends to beat your results.
tips: Watch the path ahead rather than the obstacle right in front of you, so you have time to react.
Try adjusting the camera angle to see what is coming, especially when the landscape turns or rises.
Pick up power-ups when they are safe to reach, but do not chase them into danger.
Practice the platformer-style jumps and movements in early runs to learn how far you can travel from each position.
Play several runs in a row and note where you lost the most distance, then focus on that section next time.
faq: What is the main goal of 3D Laane Runner?
Run as far as you can through the 3D landscapes while dodging obstacles and collecting power-ups to raise your high score.
How can I get a higher score?
Stay alive longer by avoiding obstacles, and collect power-ups along the way to add to your total.

pop-it-3d-fidget.intro: Pop it 3D Fidget is a clicker game with more than 30 fidget toys in 3D, made to help with anxiety and stress. You can try a range of objects and find the ones that feel most satisfying to you.
tips: Work through the different toys one at a time so you can compare how each one feels before settling on a favourite.
Use the game when you feel restless or stressed, rather than waiting until the tension builds up.
Pay attention to which objects you return to most, since those are likely the ones that suit your way of fidgeting.
Keep sessions short and take a breather when you notice your focus drifting, so the game still helps you relax.
Because the game is tagged for colour and coloring, try changing the look of a toy if that adds to your enjoyment.
faq: What is the goal of Pop it 3D Fidget?
The game is about fidgeting with a collection of 3D toys to relieve tension. It is designed to help with anxiety and stress management.
How many toys are included?
The game compiles more than 30 fidget toys from different designers, covering objects of all kinds.

obby-1-speed-car-escape.intro: Obby: +1 Speed Car Escape is a driving obby where you race through obstacle tracks, collect fuel, and outrun police chases. Build your speed, keep your engine running, and unlock wings as you go.
tips: Watch your fuel as you drive so you are not caught short on a long run. Grab fuel cans when they are on or near your path.
Use the camera rotation to look behind you before a sharp turn, so you can judge how close the police are.
Zoom the camera out with the mouse wheel to spot obstacles earlier, giving you more time to react and steer around them.
Practice the same track several times. Learning where the hazards sit lets you save speed for the parts that matter.
Keep your speed up through open stretches, but ease off before tight obstacle sections so you do not crash and lose momentum.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Race through tracks full of obstacles, collect fuel, and escape police chases while building your speed. Collecting rare items also lets you unlock wings.
How do I steer my car on PC?
Use the WASD keys to control the car. Hold the right mouse button to rotate the view, and use the mouse wheel to zoom the camera in or out.

home-design-match-3.intro: Home Design - Match 3 combines match-three puzzles with home decorating. You match items on a grid, use boosters, and complete level objectives to earn rewards for your decor.
tips: Look for moves that match more than three items at once, since larger matches help you progress faster on the board.
Save your boosters for levels with tougher objectives instead of using them early on easy boards.
Check the level objectives before you start each board so you know which items to prioritize.
Plan your matches to set up chain reactions, because cascading matches can clear objectives without extra moves.
Spend the rewards you earn on decor pieces you like, so each finished level feels like progress in your home design.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Each level has objectives you need to complete by matching items on the board. Finishing them earns rewards you can use to decorate your home.
How do I make a match?
Match three or more matching items. You can use your mouse or tap the screen to select and swap items.

spiral-blitz.intro: Spiral Blitz is an arcade skill game where you guide a bouncing ball through twisting tumbler mazes. You rotate platforms to open a safe path, avoid colored barriers, and use speed to push through each helix level.
tips: Look ahead before you rotate. Scan the next section of the helix so you know which platform positions will open a safe path.
Stop and plan when a barrier looks tight. A short pause to judge the gap is often better than a rushed move that sends the ball into a colored barrier.
Build speed only where the path is clear. Pushing hard through open sections helps you smash ahead, but slow down before tricky turns.
Keep track of the colored barriers as you go. Noticing their pattern early gives you more time to set up each rotation.
Replay levels to sharpen your timing. Repeated runs train your reflexes and spatial awareness, which the helix challenge depends on.
faq: What is the main goal in Spiral Blitz?
Guide the bouncing ball through each twisting tumbler maze by rotating platforms to clear a safe path. Reach the end of each helix level without hitting the colored barriers.
What skills matter most in this game?
Quick reflexes and spatial awareness are the key skills. You need to judge where the ball will go and react fast when the platforms turn.

obby-climb-up-and-slide-down-on-minecart.intro: Obby: Climb Up and Slide Down on Minecarts is a climbing game where you ride carts up a track, collect money, and upgrade your ride. Push your progress higher through zones and levels with pets by your side.
tips: Spend the money you earn on a new cart before pushing into harder sections, since a better ride makes the climb more manageable.
Treat each run as a practice attempt. The track gets harder as you climb, so use early runs to learn the layout of each level.
Level up your pets and pay attention to their abilities, since those are meant to help you finish levels faster and more efficiently.
Use the camera often to scan the track ahead so you can plan your route before you reach a tricky stretch.
Compare your best score with friends to see where you can improve, then focus your next runs on the part of the climb where you lose the most time.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Your goal is to climb upward on carts, push your progress higher through the levels, and set the best score you can.
How do I move and control the camera on PC?
Use WASD to move and the mouse to control the camera.

ladder-to-brainhot-climb-obby.intro: Ladder to Brainhot: Climb Obby is an obstacle course game where you climb through different obby locations, each with its own boss, to steal Brainhot creatures. You can also upgrade and sell them at your own base.
tips: Log in every day so you collect the daily gifts, since the bonuses help you upgrade your base and boost your speed.
Use the spare time between climbs to upgrade your base, because faster progress makes later raids easier.
Spend a few moments watching how each obstacle moves before you jump, so you don't rush into a fall.
Use the camera rotation to check the path ahead before committing to a jump, especially on higher sections.
Try different locations as you go, since each one has its own boss and a different challenge to prepare for.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Climb through the obby locations, beat each location's boss, and steal Brainhots. The more Brainhots you collect, the further you progress in the meta-game.
How do I move and jump on a computer?
Use WASD to move your character and the Space bar to jump.

mine-brothers-the-magic-temple.intro: Mine Brothers The Magic Temple is an adventure puzzle game where you guide a fire character and a water character through each level. Both must reach the same goal while avoiding obstacles and enemies.
tips: Before moving, look over the whole level to find where each character needs to end up and what sits between them and that spot.
Switch characters often with the Spacebar and check where the other one is, so neither gets stuck or caught by an enemy while you control the first.
Use the E key when you are near an object you can interact with, and pay attention to what happens after you press it.
Move in short steps when you are close to enemies or hazards, so you can react and back off instead of committing to a long run.
If you get stuck on a puzzle, pause and think about what each character can reach, then try the order of moves you have not tested yet.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Both characters must reach the same place to finish the level. You need to control them together while avoiding obstacles, puzzles, and dangerous enemies.
Which keys control the game?
Use WASD or the arrow keys to move, the Spacebar to switch between characters, and E for actions. On mobile devices, use the on-screen game buttons instead.

save-the-planet.intro: Save The Planet is a puzzle game about waste sorting. Drag each item into the correct recycling bin, based on Italian waste management strategies, and race the clock as the levels get harder.
tips: Look at each item before you drag it, and decide which bin it belongs in before you move it. This saves time when the clock is running.
Pay attention to which bins you get right and wrong early on, so the same mistakes don't repeat as the levels grow harder.
Stay calm and sort steadily rather than rushing. A wrong drop can cost more time than a short pause to think.
Use the early levels to learn the sorting pattern, since the later levels build on the same ideas with more challenge.
Keep an eye on the timer throughout each level so you can pace yourself across all the items.
faq: What is the goal of Save The Planet?
The goal is to drag and drop each item into the correct recycling bin. You race against time while the levels become more challenging.
How do I play?
Drag each waste item and drop it into the bin that matches it. Each correct sort helps you progress through the game.

going-rolling-ball.intro: Going Rolling Ball is a fast arcade puzzler where you keep a ball balanced while it rolls along narrow tracks, sharp turns, and moving barriers. Levels get harder as you go.
tips: Look ahead along the track before the ball reaches a sharp turn, so you can start adjusting early instead of reacting at the last second.
Watch the timing of moving barriers for a few seconds before you commit to a narrow section, and move through when the gap is clear.
Stay near the center of the track on narrow sections, since a small drift is harder to correct when there is little room to recover.
Pick up points when they are on your route, but do not steer far off the track to chase them if it puts the ball at risk of falling.
Expect the difficulty to rise, so use early levels to get comfortable with the ball's response before the harder sections appear.
faq: What is the goal of Going Rolling Ball?
Keep the ball balanced and on the track while you move through paths and obstacles. Collect points and try to reach the highest score.
What causes a run to end?
