The ball falling off the track ends the attempt, so staying on the path is the main priority.

geometry-gunner.intro: Geometry Gunner is an arcade shooter where you dodge and destroy relentless geometric enemies. Success depends on quick decisions, precise aiming, and staying agile under pressure.
tips: Keep moving rather than standing still, since the foes are described as relentless and staying in one spot makes you an easy target.
Watch how the geometric enemies approach before you fire, so you can time your shots instead of reacting late.
Pick your targets carefully and deal with the most dangerous threats first when several foes are on screen at once.
Make your decisions quickly but deliberately, because the game rewards split-second choices that keep you alive.
Play in short sessions at first to learn enemy patterns, then build on what you noticed in later runs.
faq: What is the main goal in Geometry Gunner?
The goal is to outmaneuver geometric foes, shoot them down, and survive the battle. The game focuses on precision and staying alive.
What controls does Geometry Gunner use?
The page does not list specific controls. Check any on-screen prompts or the in-game help once the game starts to learn how to move and shoot.

bouncy-dunk.intro: Bouncy Dunk is an arcade game about timing and focus. You take rapid-fire basketball shots using a single click, aiming to build long scoring streaks while unlocking new players.
tips: Use the single click with steady timing rather than rushing, since each shot depends on when you press.
Stay focused on each shot one at a time instead of thinking ahead to the streak you want to build.
Pay attention to the rhythm of the shots, and try to find a timing pattern that you can repeat consistently.
After a missed shot, reset your focus before the next one so that one mistake does not carry into the next attempt.
Keep your streaks as the main goal, because the game rewards long runs of successful scoring.
faq: What is the goal of Bouncy Dunk?
The goal is to make basketball shots in quick succession and achieve long scoring streaks. The game tests your timing and focus as the shots come rapidly.
How do I control the game?
You play with just a click. Your timing of that click determines how each shot goes.

bubbla-boing.intro: Bubbla Boing is a classic breakout-style arcade game. Bounce the ball off your paddle to destroy every bubble, and keep the ball from falling off the bottom of the screen.
tips: Watch the angle of the ball as it leaves the paddle, since it bounces differently depending on where it hits. Aim for the gaps you want to open up.
Keep your paddle moving gently with the arrow keys rather than making sudden jerks, so you can react to fast-moving balls.
Pay attention to power-ups and bonuses as they fall, and try to catch the useful ones without drifting far from the ball's path.
Clear the easier bubbles first in each level to get comfortable with the pace before the difficulty ramps up.
Use the Space Bar to launch the ball deliberately so you can set up your starting angle before play resumes.
faq: What is the goal of Bubbla Boing?
Destroy all the bubbles on each level by bouncing the ball off your paddle, and clear all levels to reach the highest score.
How do I control the paddle?
Use the left and right arrow keys to move the paddle. The movement is smooth, so small adjustments are enough to track the ball.

epic-robot-combat-simulator.intro: Pilot a robot combat suit through space and hunt down enemies with your weapons. Move with WASD or the left joystick, aim and shoot with the mouse or right joystick, and test your piloting skill.
tips: Keep moving rather than standing still, since your position is what keeps you clear of incoming fire. Use short, unpredictable movements.
Use Shift to dash out of danger when an enemy is about to hit you, and save it for those moments so you have it ready when you need it.
Switch weapons with the number keys (or the buttons on the bottom right on mobile) to match the enemy in front of you instead of sticking with one weapon.
On mobile, keep the left joystick moving while the right joystick aims and shoots, so you are never a stationary target.
Aim ahead of fast-moving enemies rather than at where they currently are, and fire in short bursts to avoid wasting shots.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Your goal is to hunt down all the enemies across space using your combat suit and weaponry. Stay alive while you track them down.
How do I aim and shoot?
On desktop, move the mouse to aim and click to shoot. On mobile, use the right joystick to aim and shoot.

find-the-pets.intro: Find The Pets is a 3D platformer where you search for and collect 150 pets spread across themed maps. Each pet you discover adds to your collection.
tips: Open the map with M and the location menu with L before you explore, so you know which areas you haven't searched yet.
Check the pets menu with P often to see which pets you still need, and focus your search on the areas where they are likely to be.
Save the radar boost for pets that are hard to spot, and use fast running or super jump when you need to cover ground or reach high routes quickly.
Obby sections have tricky routes and hidden secrets, so slow down near narrow platforms and look around corners for shortcuts or hidden spots.
Press Tab to show the mouse cursor when you need to click in-game buttons, and rotate the camera with the mouse to check high and low areas.
faq: What is the goal of Find The Pets?
Your goal is to track down and collect 150 pets hidden across the game's themed maps. Each discovery adds to your collection.
How do I move and jump on PC?
Use WASD or the arrow keys to move, Space to jump, and the mouse to rotate the camera. Press Tab to show or hide the mouse cursor.

smart-looter.intro: Smart Looter is a stealth heist game where you sneak past vigilant guards to collect treasure across action-packed levels. Success depends on patience, planning, and quick reflexes.
tips: Watch the guards for a few moments before you move, so you can spot a safe window to slip through.
Move with patience. Rushing into a guard's path is the fastest way to get caught.
Plan your route before you start grabbing treasure, and think about how you will leave the area afterward.
Stay alert for sudden changes in the level, and be ready to react quickly when a guard turns toward you.
If you get spotted, try to reset your approach rather than pushing forward on the same path.
faq: What is the main goal in Smart Looter?
Your goal is to loot treasures from high-stakes heists without being caught by the guards. Stealth and careful timing matter more than speed.
How do I avoid getting caught by guards?
Observe where the guards are and when they look or move, then wait for a safe moment to advance. Staying unseen is the core of the game.

zynpavo-rhythm-piano.intro: Zynpavo is a rhythm piano game where you play classical pieces by Beethoven, Mozart, and Chopin. Hit each note as it lines up with the keys at the bottom of the screen to score points and build your combo.
tips: Start on Novice and move up through the difficulty modes once you can hit notes consistently. Symphony is the hardest setting.
Watch the notes as they land on the keys rather than reacting only when they reach the bottom. Timing is judged by the exact alignment.
Keep your combo going by staying steady, since a missed note breaks the streak you have built.
Practice a song you already know well before trying an unfamiliar one, so you can focus on timing instead of memorizing the melody.
If you have a MIDI keyboard, connect it for Pro Mode to play with real piano keys. Otherwise, use the letter keys on a computer or tap the virtual keys on a touch screen.
faq: What is the goal of Zynpavo?
Your goal is to play each song flawlessly by hitting the falling notes exactly as they align with the piano keys at the bottom of the screen. Doing this scores points and builds your combo.
How do I play on a computer?
Press the corresponding letter keys on your computer keyboard as the notes fall. On a touch screen, tap the virtual piano keys instead.

coloring-by-numbers-pixel-room.intro: Coloring by Numbers. Pixel Room is a calm pixel coloring game where you decorate houses as a designer. Tap the picture to fill each area with the color that matches its number, and build rooms with a relaxing soundtrack playing.
tips: Choose a small color palette before you start, such as two or three shades that go together, so the finished room feels cohesive.
Work on one part of the room at a time, like the walls or furniture, so you can judge how each color looks next to its neighbors.
Look at the whole picture between taps to see how the colors balance, and adjust your choices if one area feels too strong.
Try a different color scheme for each new room you create so you can compare styles and find ones you like.
Turn on the music player and set a slow pace, since the game works best when you focus on color combinations rather than speed.
faq: How do I color a section?
Tap or click the part of the picture you want to fill. The color that matches that area's number is applied to it.
What is the goal of the game?
The goal is to design unique rooms by coloring the pictures with color schemes you choose. There is no score to chase, so focus on the look of your room.

darkhood.intro: DarkHood is a short arcade platformer where you guide a boy in a dark hoodie through candle-lit caves. Collect every glowing gem in each level, avoid hazards, and reach the exit gate.
tips: Before you move, look at the whole level to spot where the gems sit and where the bombs, pits and traps are placed.
Use short jumps when you are close to a pit or trap so you can land with control instead of overshooting.
Collect the gems on your way to the exit, but do not rush past a hazard just to grab one; the gate only opens once you have what the level asks for.
Sleeping monsters are a good reason to slow down and watch their pattern before you pass them.
Play in short sessions and restart a level calmly if you get caught, since the game is built for relaxed play rather than speed.
faq: What is the goal of DarkHood?
Your goal is to collect every glowing gem in each level and then unlock the exit gate to move on.
What controls do I use on desktop?
Use the arrow keys or A and D to move, and press Space or W or Up to jump.

garfield-rush.intro: Garfield Rush is an endless runner where you play as Garfield, Odie or Nemo, chasing the sneaky cat Harry. Collect coins and keep running as the speed rises.
tips: Watch the objects and vehicles ahead rather than only the ones right in front of you, so you have time to react before a collision.
Use the tops of vehicles when you can reach them, since they can open up shortcuts that keep your run moving.
Grab coins whenever they are safe to reach, because the faster you go, the more coins and score you can collect.
Pay attention to the power-ups such as elastic shoes, jetpacks, magnets and booster packs, and plan your route to pick them up when you can.
Stay calm as the speed increases. Quick, steady input usually works better than rushing your moves.
faq: What is the goal of Garfield Rush?
You run endlessly while chasing Harry, collecting coins and score and avoiding collisions with vehicles and other objects. There is no finish line, so the aim is to go as far as you can.
How do I control the character?
The game is played with a mouse or by clicking. Use your clicks to move and jump, and jump onto vehicles when you want to find a shortcut.

mansion-design-match-3.intro: Mansion Design - Match 3 mixes match-3 puzzles with room makeovers. You clear levels to earn boosters and scrolls, then use them to decorate the mansion and garden.
tips: Look for matches of three or more of the same item first, since bigger matches are what create the more powerful boosters.
Save boosters for levels or moments when the board is stuck or the objective is close, rather than spending them early.
Check the level objective before you start moving pieces so you can aim your matches toward it.
Keep an eye on your task list between levels, because completing tasks is one of the ways to collect scrolls.
Try to set up explosive combinations by planning a swap that lines up several pieces, rather than making single small matches.
faq: What is the main goal of each level?
Each level has an objective that you need to complete by matching pieces. Finishing it lets you move on and earn rewards.
How do I get more powerful boosters?
Match three or more items of the same type to build stronger boosters. Larger matches generally give better results.

frogtastic-marble-adventure.intro: Frogtastic Marble Adventure is a puzzle game where you shoot colored spheres and clear matching groups before they reach the end of a winding path. It rewards quick thinking and planning ahead.
tips: Look for a shot that completes a group of three or more matching spheres, since that is what makes them explode.
Watch the spheres closest to the final destination first, because they are the most urgent threat.
Plan your next shot while the current one is still in motion so you are not caught waiting.
Pay attention to the bends in the path, since spheres that bunch up there can be easier to clear as a group.
Keep an eye on the color of the sphere you are about to shoot so you can choose the target with the most matches available.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Stop the colored spheres from reaching the final destination by matching and clearing them before they get there.
What counts as a match?
A match is a group of at least three spheres of the same color, which will explode when formed.

bubble-war.intro: Bubble War is a bubble shooting game with a solo mode of many levels and a real-time multiplayer mode against other players. Match three or more bubbles of the same color to clear the board.
tips: Before you shoot, look at the whole board and find the color groups that already have three or more matching bubbles in reach.
Use the aim line to check where your bubble will land, and make small drag adjustments before you release.
Plan one shot ahead by noticing which color you will need next, so you are not forced into a poor shot.
In single-player mode, aim for shots that clear the board's edges and hanging bubbles, since these can be efficient to remove.
In multiplayer, stay focused on your own board and avoid rushed shots, because real-time battles reward steady accuracy.
faq: What is the goal of Bubble War?
In single-player mode, your goal is to clear each level by matching three or more bubbles of the same color. In multiplayer, you compete against players in real-time battles.
How do I aim and shoot?
Press and hold to start aiming, drag to set your direction, then release to shoot your bubble.

exitblocks-color-match-puzzle.intro: ExitBlocks is a color matching puzzle where you slide blocks through gates of the same color before the timer runs out. Each level is a crowded board that needs a clear plan.
tips: Before you move anything, look at which blocks are boxed in and which gates they need. Start with blocks that have a clear path to their matching gate.
Watch for blocks that trap others. Moving a blocker out of the way early often frees several pieces at once.
Check the route of a block before you drag it, so you do not push it into a spot where it blocks another color.
If a layout feels stuck, step back and map the order of exits. Solving the blocks in the right sequence matters more than speed.
Save your boosters for layouts that truly stall you, rather than using them on the first confusing moment.
faq: What is the goal of ExitBlocks?
Clear every colored block from the board by moving each one into a gate of the same color. You must finish before the timer reaches zero.
How do I move a block?
Click and drag a block with the left mouse button on desktop, or touch and drag it with one finger on touch screens. A correctly matched block leaves the board.

2d-platformer-coin.intro: 2D Platformer Coin is an adventure platformer where you explore a whimsical world, collect elusive gold coins, and get past challenging obstacles. Your goal is to gather all the treasures.
tips: Look at each area before you move so you can spot where the coins are and which paths look hidden.
Practice your hover and dive skills in safe spots first, so you know how far you travel before trying a difficult jump.
When an obstacle blocks you, pause and plan a route with a clear order of moves instead of rushing forward.
Watch for paths that seem out of reach, since the game says hidden paths can be unlocked and may lead to coins you would otherwise miss.
If you keep falling at the same obstacle, change your approach and try a different skill rather than repeating the same attempt.
faq: What is the goal of 2D Platformer Coin?
The goal is to collect all the gold coins and treasures in the world while getting past the obstacles and environments along the way.
Which skills do I need to play well?
The game highlights hover and dive as key skills for reaching coins and getting past obstacles. Using them in the right places is central to progressing.

save-nemo.intro: Save Nemo is an underwater puzzle adventure where you help a little fish escape traps, outsmart a shark and rescue the Fish Princess. Each puzzle type asks you to think before you act.
tips: Read the whole puzzle before you click or tap anything, since choice and pin puzzles often depend on what you do first.
In pin puzzles, think about the order of pulls before you release water or open a path, because a wrong order can cost you progress.
For pipe puzzles, look at where the route needs to start and end, then turn the pieces that connect to that path first.
Keep an eye on the shark and the traps in each scene, and pick the option that keeps the fish away from danger.
Spend time decorating your island when you finish a section, so the adventure feels more like your own.
faq: What is the goal of Save Nemo?
The goal is to help the little fish escape dangerous situations and save the Fish Princess by solving each puzzle.
How do I control the puzzles?

On desktop, use the left mouse button. On a tablet or phone, tap and drag on the screen. In choice puzzles you click or tap an option, in pin puzzles you click or tap or drag the right pin, and in pipe puzzles you click or tap pieces to turn them.

sunrise-mall-tycoon.intro: Sunrise Mall Tycoon is a side-view mall-building game where you start with one burger stall on an empty lot in Maple Town. Grow it into a full mall while keeping shoppers happy and cash flowing.
tips: Connect every floor early with stairs, escalators or elevators, since a floor that shoppers cannot reach earns you nothing.
Keep a cash buffer before each night so you can comfortably pay the nightly bill without having to sell or demolish shops.
Watch for litter and breakdowns between days, because messy floors and broken lifts quietly drain money.
Hire guards before rush days and nights are reached, as burglars arrive at night and are harder to deal with once they have started.
Use the 2x and 3x speed buttons once your routine is stable, but pause first to check queues and empty registers.
faq: How do I earn money in Sunrise Mall Tycoon?
Shops earn cash over time, and you can tap coin bubbles to collect it. Keeping registers busy and queues short helps your income grow.
What costs me money in the game?
Messy floors, broken lifts, long queues, empty registers and the nightly bill all cost you money. Plan your cash so these expenses do not catch you short.

the-lost-joystick.intro: The Lost Joystick is a pixel-art platformer about recovering a stolen joystick. You move through traps, fight creatures, and search for hidden treasure along the way.
tips: Slow down before each new section and look at where the traps are placed before you jump. Careful timing usually beats rushing.
Treat every creature encounter as a chance to learn its movement pattern. Watching it for a moment first can make the fight safer.
Explore the areas you pass through for hidden treasures. A short detour can be worth it, especially if you are not under pressure.
If you fail a trial, pay attention to exactly where you were hit. Using that knowledge on your next attempt can save time.
Take short breaks between trials to stay focused. Platforming with traps rewards steady, patient play more than fast reactions.
faq: What is the goal of The Lost Joystick?
You work your way through a series of trials and traps to reclaim your stolen joystick. Each trial brings you closer to that goal.
What kinds of challenges will I face?
You will need to handle tricky platforming, avoid traps, and combat bizarre creatures. Hidden treasures are also spread through the game for you to find.

supermarket-expert-idle.intro: Supermarket Expert Idle is a management game where you start with a small shop and grow it into a larger store. You manage resources, upgrade facilities, and keep customers happy as the business expands.
tips: Reinvest your earnings early on upgrades that raise your income, since a faster start makes everything after it easier.
Keep an eye on customer satisfaction, because a shop that serves people well is better placed to keep growing.
Check your resources regularly so you do not run short of what your store needs to keep selling.
Expand in steps rather than all at once, and compare the cost of each facility upgrade against how much it improves your business.
Come back between sessions to see how your supermarket has grown, since idle games reward steady progress over long bursts of play.
faq: What is the main goal of Supermarket Expert Idle?
The goal is to grow a small supermarket into a large business empire by managing resources, upgrading facilities, and keeping customers satisfied.
How should I spend my money as I play?
Focus first on upgrades that increase your income, then add facilities as your business can support them. Spending on the right upgrades early helps your store grow faster.

k-challenge-456.intro: K Challenge 456 is a 3D hypercasual game where you are trapped on an unknown island and must clear a series of challenges to escape. Use tap and slide controls to get through each one.
tips: Treat each of the five challenges, 123, Stop, Glass Bridge, Marbles, and Tug of War, as a separate test and learn its rhythm before moving on.
Since the game is tagged with Memory, pay attention to patterns and remember what happened in earlier attempts so you can plan your next move.
Keep your taps and slides short and controlled, because quick, careless inputs are a common way to lose progress.
Before each challenge begins, take a moment to read the screen so you know exactly what the goal is.
If you lose a challenge, retry it calmly and focus on one mistake at a time rather than rushing through the rest.
faq: What is the goal of K Challenge 456?
You are trapped on an unknown island and must complete the challenges to reach the prize of 456 million and escape the secret area.
What are the challenges in the game?
The five challenges are 123, Stop, Glass Bridge, Marbles, Tug of War, and Ppopgi.

arrows-escape-tap-puzzle.intro: Arrows: Escape is a logic puzzle where you tap colorful snake-like arrows to slide them off the board. Clear every arrow to reveal the picture, and keep all three hearts for a perfect score.
tips: Before each tap, follow an arrow's path to the edge and check that nothing blocks it. Arrows that already have an open path are the safest first moves.
Work from the outside of the picture inward, since arrows on the edges often block the ones behind them.
Keep your hearts for later boards by pausing to plan the order instead of guessing, because each collision costs one of your three hearts.
Save the Hint for when you are truly stuck, and remember it shows a free arrow you can clear right away.
Reserve the Laser for a tangled spot that no other move can solve, since it can remove any arrow.
faq: How do I complete a level?
Clear every arrow on the board by tapping each one so it escapes to the edge. Finishing the picture completes the level and earns coins.
What happens if an arrow hits another arrow?
The arrow does not escape and you lose one heart. You start with three hearts, so plan carefully.

world-archery-league.intro: World Archery League is an archery sport simulation with realistic physics, set on a range that aims to capture the feel of Olympic competition. You play by clicking or tapping, so the focus is on timing and aim.
tips: Take a moment before each shot to line up your aim, since the realistic physics means small timing or aim errors can change where the arrow lands.
Watch how each arrow travels and note where it lands, then adjust your next shot based on what you see rather than guessing.
Keep your clicks or taps steady and consistent so your shots feel controlled and repeatable from one to the next.
Try to stay calm and patient during the competition, as rushing shots is a common reason for missing the target.
Practice the timing of your click or tap until it feels natural, because the game rewards precise action more than speed.
faq: What is the goal of World Archery League?
The goal is to become a skilled marksman by hitting the target accurately in this archery sport simulation. Focus on placing each arrow carefully.
How do I control the archer?
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps only. Use your click or tap to take each shot.

diamant-match-3-sky-story.intro: Diamant: Match 3 Sky Story combines gem matching puzzles with a story about building a floating island city. Line up colorful gems, overcome obstacles, and call on golem helpers to clear tough boards.
tips: Look for special gem combinations before making a simple match, since they can clear more of the board at once.
Save your golem helpers for the hardest fields, where a single superpower can make the biggest difference.
Pay attention to the obstacles on each level, such as stone blockades, webs, and rivers, and clear the ones that block your progress first.
Study the blueprints you find and decide which buildings to unlock first, so your artifacts go toward the upgrades you want most.
Develop the golems you use most often, since their superpowers can be upgraded over time.
faq: How do I play Diamant: Match 3 Sky Story?
Swap neighboring gems to line up three or more of the same color. Each match helps you reach the goals of the level.
What are the golem helpers used for?
Golems are called to help you clear difficult boards. There are 8 types, and each has its own superpower that can be developed.

unscrew-odyssey.intro: Unscrew Odyssey is a 3D screw-puzzle game where you match coloured screws to boxes of the same colour. Rotate the model, free stuck parts, and clear every screw to finish each level.
tips: Before you tap anything, drag the model to look for hidden screws on the back and sides. Rotating first helps you see which screws are free to remove.
Watch your free box slots. Sending a screw into a box only works if there is room, so avoid filling slots with screws you cannot match yet.
Pick out screws that are easy to reach and match. Clearing the open ones often reveals the screws underneath.
Save your booster for a board that feels stuck. If you have no clear next move, rotating the puzzle and checking your box slots is a good first step.
Keep an eye on your win streak and the leaderboard if you want a challenge. Playing calmly and planning each move tends to help you keep the streak going.
faq: What is the goal of Unscrew Odyssey?
Your goal is to remove every screw from the model in each level. You do this by sending coloured screws into free boxes of the same colour.
How do I rotate the puzzle?
On desktop, drag across the model with the mouse. On mobile, tap and drag with one finger to turn the puzzle and reveal hidden screws.

granny-horror-village.intro: Granny Horror Village is a first-person horror escape game in which you look around your surroundings and solve puzzles to get out. Move with WASD, jump with Space, and run with Shift.
tips: Look carefully at everything around you before moving on, since the game asks you to read your surroundings to find solutions.
Save Shift for when you really need to get away, so you still have the speed available when a situation gets tense.
Stop and think through each puzzle before acting, because the challenges are described as plentiful and difficult.
Use Space to jump only when you need to reach or cross something, which helps you keep control of your movement in tight spaces.
Keep your pace steady rather than rushing, since the gameplay is intense and hasty moves can make it harder to think clearly.
faq: What is the goal of Granny Horror Village?
The goal is to escape by solving a range of puzzles while exploring the village in first person.
How do I move and run in the game?
Use WASD to move, hold Shift to run, and press Space to jump.

car-crash-sandbox.intro: Car Crash Sandbox is a driving simulator where you launch vehicles down slopes and smash them into destructible obstacles. Its physics focus on deformation, damage, and breaking parts.
tips: Use slow motion (V) after a big impact to watch how the body panels deform and break apart.
Press R to repair your car between crashes so you can keep testing different impacts from the same starting condition.
Try several vehicles by pressing N to go to the next car, since each one reacts to damage in its own way.
Switch camera angles with C to see how a crash looks from different sides and distances.
Use the handbrake (Space) with WASD to change direction quickly before a slope run, so you can aim your impacts more precisely.
faq: What is the goal of Car Crash Sandbox?
The goal is open-ended: drive around and smash cars however you like. There is no set target, so you decide what to crash and how.
How do I switch to a different vehicle?
Press N to go to the next car. The game offers multiple vehicles to choose from.

size-up-giant-fighter-game.intro: Size Up is a fast hyper casual game about growing your crowd while dashing through colorful streets. You collect matching allies, dodge traps, and outmaneuver rival groups to take over each level.
tips: Focus on allies that match your color, since those are the ones that help you grow stronger.
Look ahead for traps and dynamic obstacles so you can change course before you reach them.
Merge with crowds when the path is clear, but do not rush into groups you cannot handle.
Keep an eye on rival groups and plan routes that let you gain size while staying out of their way.
Replay levels to learn where the traps and crowds usually appear, then plan a smoother route next time.
faq: What is the main goal of Size Up?
Your goal is to dash through the streets, grow your group, and conquer the battlefield by outsmarting rival groups.
How do I grow bigger in the game?
You grow by collecting allies that match your color and by merging with crowds along the way.

toon-blast-puzzle.intro: Toon Blast Puzzle is a match-3 adventure where you blast colorful cubes and solve brain-teasing puzzles across many levels. You play with touch or mouse, so the controls stay simple.
tips: Scan the whole board before your first move and look for the color groups that are largest or easiest to reach.
Start with the cubes near the top or edges when a level allows it, since clearing lower cubes first can leave hard-to-reach pieces stuck.
Pay attention to the color mix on each stage, because some levels are built around clearing one color group at a time.
If you get stuck, pause and look at the board from a new angle rather than repeating the same blast.
Take short breaks between stages, since the game is meant to be relaxing and fresh eyes often spot better solutions.
faq: What is the goal of Toon Blast Puzzle?
Your goal is to blast the colorful cubes and solve each stage's puzzle as you move through the levels.
How do I control the game?
Use your touch or mouse to select and blast cubes. The controls are simple, so most of the challenge comes from planning.

the-eggsecutioner.intro: The Eggsecutioner is a fast-paced game where you smash eggs by timing your hits well. It rewards speed and accuracy, and each successful crack adds to your score.
tips: Focus on timing before speed. Landing your hit at the right moment usually does more for your score than rushing.
Watch the eggs for a few seconds before you act so you can spot their pattern and rhythm.
Keep your accuracy high even when the pace picks up. Missed hits can cost you more than a slower, cleaner round.
Play a few short rounds to get used to the feel of the controls, since no instructions are provided for this game.
Take a short break if your timing starts to slip. Fresh focus often makes precision easier to recover.
faq: What is the main goal of The Eggsecutioner?
The game is about smashing eggs with precise timing and accuracy. The description does not list a set number of eggs or a specific target to reach.
How does scoring work?
The description describes the scoring as action-packed but does not explain point values. Playing with accuracy and good timing is the most reliable way to build your score.

lipuzz-water-sort-puzzle.intro: Lipuzz is a water sort puzzle where you pour colored liquids between containers until each one holds a single color. The levels grow harder as you go, so careful planning matters more than speed.
tips: Before each pour, check the top layer of every container so you know which colors can move where.
Avoid filling an empty container with a mix early on, since that can block the colors you need to sort later.
Look for moves that free up a container with a single color on the bottom, as this often opens the most options.
Try a few moves ahead in your head when a level looks crowded, and undo mentally any pour that leaves you stuck.
If you reach a deadlock where no pour helps, restart the level rather than spending time trying to force a solution.
faq: What is the goal of Lipuzz?
The goal is to pour the colored liquids between containers so that each container ends up holding only one color.
How do I avoid getting stuck?
Plan your pours before you make them and avoid moves that bury a color you still need to reach. Deadlocks come from making several mixed pours in a row without a clear plan.

car-eats-car-volcanic-adventure.intro: Race along a busy highway, overtake rivals, and use bombs and turbo to get ahead. Build and upgrade your own car while you dodge the police and face the boss.
tips: Save turbo for straight stretches or right after a corner, when the car is already moving well, so the speed boost is not wasted.
Use the A and D keys to keep the car balanced, especially when you land or hit uneven ground, so you do not lose control in the middle of a race.
Tap the brake with S before a tight turn instead of braking hard in the middle of it, which helps you keep speed through the corner.
Fire bombs with Space when a rival is directly ahead or beside you, rather than wasting them on empty road.
Before a boss fight, spend time upgrading your car in the incubator so you have more to work with against the stronger opponent.
faq: What is the main goal of Car Eats Car: Volcanic Adventure?
You race on the highway to overtake enemies, free your imprisoned friends and evil cars, and fight the boss to survive. The game also lets you build and upgrade your own car along the way.
Which keys control the car?
W is gas and S is brake, while the arrow keys can also be used for gas, brake and balancing. A and D handle balancing, X activates turbo, and Space drops bombs.

subway-surfer-seoul.intro: Subway Surfers: Seoul is an endless runner where you race down the subway tracks, dodging obstacles and trains while collecting coins. Keep moving and stay ahead of the grumpy inspector for as long as you can.
tips: Look ahead early and start changing lanes before an obstacle is close, since last-second moves are where most runs end.
Collect coins when they are on your safe path, but do not swerve into danger just to grab one.
Keep your run going as long as possible, because the longer you survive, the more ground you put between you and the inspector.
Pay attention to trains, as they cover more of the track and leave fewer safe lanes to choose from.
Use short breaks in your focus to scan the next section of track, so you are not caught off guard by a sudden obstacle.
faq: What is the goal of Subway Surfers: Seoul?
The goal is to run as far as you can down the subway while dodging obstacles and trains. Staying ahead of the grumpy inspector is what keeps your run going.
What do I collect while running?
You collect coins along the track. Grabbing them is useful, but staying alive matters more than picking up every coin.

ringo-starfish.intro: Ringo Starfish is a retro arcade platformer about exploring a mystical island and underwater areas to collect shimmering crystals and find hidden treasure. Expect platform jumps, traps, and foes.
tips: Read each new area before moving on, and look for traps and enemy positions first so you can plan your path.
Use checkpoints as safe save points. Before a hard jump or fight, make sure you have reached the latest one.
Take time on platform sections. Slowing down to time your jumps usually costs less than losing progress to a missed landing.
Deal with foes deliberately. Use your firepower when enemies block a route, and avoid wasting shots on ones you can easily get past.
Collect the crystals you pass, and check nearby spots for hidden treasure, since side paths often hold rewards that are easy to miss.
faq: What is the goal of Ringo Starfish?
You play as Ringo on an underwater quest, exploring a mystical island to discover hidden treasures and collect shimmering crystals while overcoming foes and traps.
How do I make progress when I keep losing?
Focus on learning the traps and platform layouts one section at a time, and use checkpoints so you do not have to repeat long stretches.

terrifying-zombies-tower-defense-ii.intro: Terrifying Zombies: Tower Defense II mixes tower defense with hands-on shooting. You move your hero, build defenses, and fight off waves of zombies that grow tougher as days pass.
tips: Shoot zombies yourself whenever you can, since hand kills give the most XP while defense kills give less.
Place fences early, because they automatically upgrade Max HP and Regen every round and make your defenses last longer.
Expect zombie damage to rise as you survive more days, so strengthen your defenses steadily rather than waiting.
Keep Gold in reserve for cloning your hero, which lets you revive and get back into the fight if you fall.
Watch the boss countdown so you can prepare for the big fight before it arrives, and use the P key to pause and check your setup when needed.
faq: How do I get the most XP?
Shoot zombies yourself with a left click, because kills made by your defenses give less XP.
What happens if my hero dies?
You can spend Gold to clone and revive your hero so you can keep fighting.

super-pork.intro: Super Pork is a retro-style shooter where you pilot a flying pig against an alien invasion. You dodge incoming fire, shoot back, and use power-ups across challenging levels.
tips: Watch enemy movement and bullet patterns before you commit to a shot, since dodging is central to staying alive.
Keep your pig moving rather than hovering in one spot, which makes it harder for foes to line up hits.
Save power-ups for tough moments, such as a crowded screen or a dangerous enemy, instead of using them the moment you get them.
Learn each level's layout and where threats usually appear so you can plan your route and shots ahead of time.
Use surprise tactics: wait for enemies to commit to an approach, then strike when they are most exposed.
faq: What is the main goal of Super Pork?
You control a flying pig fighting off an alien invasion, so your aim is to survive, dodge the aliens' attacks, and shoot down foes as you advance through the levels.
How important is dodging in Super Pork?
Dodging is one of the core skills the game is built around, so avoiding incoming attacks is just as important as shooting accurately.

keep-her-alive.intro: Keep Her Alive is a precision puzzle shooter where you turn enemies against each other by rotating the world. Line up the angles so their own bullets do the work.
tips: Study the whole scene before you touch anything. Work out where each enemy's bullets will travel once the world is rotated.
Make small rotations with A and D or the Arrow keys, then pause to check the new angle before adding another change.
Think about the girl's position first. Make sure no bullet path crosses her before you commit to a shot.
Use the Left Mouse Button or Space Bar only when you are confident the angles line up, since there are no second chances.
If a shot goes wrong, restart and try a different order of rotations rather than repeating the same approach.
faq: What is the goal of Keep Her Alive?
Your goal is to keep the girl alive by rotating the world so that enemies' own bullets hit the enemies instead of her.
How do I rotate objects?
Use A and D or the Left and Right Arrow keys to rotate objects in the scene.

extreme-monster-truck.intro: Extreme Monster Truck is a racing game where you drive large trucks over hills, mud, desert roads and obstacles. Each level tests precision, speed and control.
tips: Ease off the throttle before rough sections so the truck keeps its balance instead of tipping over.
Use short, steady inputs on muddy or uneven ground rather than holding a single direction for long.
Watch the terrain ahead and plan your line early, since each level is built around precise driving.
When you attempt stunts on hills, land with the truck level to avoid losing control on the way down.
If a level keeps defeating you, slow your pace and learn the obstacle layout before trying to go faster.
faq: How do I drive the monster truck?
Use W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move back, and A/D or the Left/Right Arrows to steer. Use the mouse to click any on-screen buttons.
What is the main goal of each level?
Each level is a challenging track with terrain and obstacles that you need to get through while testing your precision, speed and control.

tank-1944.intro: Tanks 1944 is a tank shooting game set on the battlefield. You pick a tank, aim your gun, and work to defeat every opponent you face.
tips: Before you fire, look at where your shell will land and adjust your aim so the shot reaches the target rather than firing at random.
Try each tank you can choose to see how it handles, then stick with the one whose style suits you best.
Watch how the enemy moves and fires, and use that pattern to decide when to take your shot.
Pay attention to the terrain, since the game includes realistic physics and grass physics that can affect how your shots and your tank behave.
Take your time with each shot. Calculating a good shot is more useful than firing quickly and missing.
faq: What is the goal of Tanks 1944?
Your goal is to defeat everyone on the battlefield. Each opponent must be destroyed to win.
How do I take a shot?
Choose your tank, start the game, calculate the shot of the gun, and then pull the trigger.

blackriver-mystery-hidden-objects.intro: Blackriver Mystery mixes hidden object searches with puzzles and mini-games as you rebuild a ruined town and uncover what happened at Black River. Each location holds clues, items, and story progress.
tips: Scan each scene in a steady pattern, such as left to right and top to bottom, so you do not miss small items near the edges.
Look at the item list before you start searching and note the shapes or colors that stand out, since many objects are hard to spot at first glance.
Save your boosters for tough moments, such as a Three-in-a-Row board with few obvious moves, instead of spending them early.
Between searches, pay attention to the story details, because clues often explain which location or item to focus on next.
If you get stuck on a hidden object scene, switch to a mini-game or another quest and return later with fresh eyes.
faq: What is the main goal of Blackriver Mystery?
Your goal is to complete the whole game, which includes its quests, mini-games, and story. Progress through these to rebuild the town and solve the mystery.
How do I control the game?
On a PC, use the left mouse button to click on items and options. On a mobile device, use touch.

the-machinegg.intro: The MachinEGG is a relaxing idle clicker about growing a chicken farm, collecting eggs, and taking them to market. Your aim is to earn enough money to retire.
tips: Start by learning the basic loop of buying chickens, feeding them, collecting eggs, and selling them before you chase bigger goals.
Keep an eye on your farm as it grows, since unlocking automation systems can cut down on the repeated steps you would otherwise do by hand.
Try normal mode first to get a feel for pacing, then move to speedrun mode once you know which steps are worth your time.
Treat the handicap challenges as a way to test your planning, because their rules change how you approach the farm and they can be replayed.
Check in on your chickens regularly, since the game asks you to treat them well and a neglected flock is harder to keep producing.
faq: What is the main goal of The MachinEGG?
Your goal is to earn enough money to retire. You do this by growing your farm, collecting eggs, and selling them at market.
How do I play The MachinEGG?
Choose a game mode, then use left click or touch to interact, spawn chickens, collect eggs, and buy upgrades.

obby-1-power.intro: Obby +1 Power! is a clicking game about building a bodybuilder from scratch. Click to perform exercises, grow your stats, and work toward winning competitions.
tips: Keep clicking steadily, since every click earns experience and resources that drive your progress.
Use the resources you collect to improve your stats instead of saving them all up without a plan.
Hover over menu options before choosing them so you know what each upgrade does.
Build up your stats before entering competitions, so your character is stronger when it counts.
Take short breaks from clicking if your hand gets tired, and come back focused to keep your pace steady.
faq: How do I earn experience and resources?
Each click on the exercise button gives you experience and resources. The more you click, the more you gain.
What do I do with the resources I collect?
Use them to improve your stats and upgrade your character. Stronger stats help you win competitions.

basket-champs.intro: Basket Champs is a basketball simulator where skill and strategy matter more than height. Pick your team, outscore your rivals, and climb through the championships.
tips: Choose a team early and stick with it for a few games so you learn how it plays.
Focus on outscoring your rivals steadily rather than chasing one big lead, since every point counts toward the win.
Watch how your opponents play and adjust your approach to their strengths and weaknesses.
Because height does not decide matches, rely on timing and smart choices instead of trying to match taller opponents.
Take each championship in order and treat early wins as practice for the tougher rounds ahead.
faq: What is the goal of Basket Champs?
Your goal is to choose a team, outscore your rivals, and move up through the championships.
Does height affect how well I play?
No, the game is built so that height does not matter, and skill and strategy decide the outcome.

tiny-track-rally.intro: Tiny Track Rally is a colourful 3D arcade racer where you drive toy cars against up to seven rivals. Drift through corners, collect pickups and use nitro on the straights to reach the finish first.
tips: Use the brake before corners rather than in the middle of them, then ease back on the gas as you steer through. This keeps your car under control on tight bends.
Save nitro for the straights. Firing it while you are already drifting or turning can throw your car off line.
Grab coins, nitro refills and boost pads when they are on your route, but do not swerve across the track for them if it costs you your position.
In Cup 2, watch for crates, barrels, cones, narrow walls and moving barriers. Slow down a little earlier for these, since a clean line usually matters more than top speed.
Try different camera views. The close chase view helps with steering, while the top-down view shows rival positions and upcoming corners more clearly.
faq: How do I steer and use nitro?
Use A and D or the Left and Right arrow keys to steer. Press Shift or Space to fire nitro, or use the A button on a gamepad.
How do I get my car back on track if I crash or get stuck?
Press R on the keyboard or the Y button on a gamepad to reset your car.

tanks-2d-battle-with-ratte.intro: Tanks 2D Battle with Ratte is a tank shooter where you move across changing terrain, plan your maneuvers, and upgrade your tank to outplay AI opponents. Each battle rewards careful positioning and steady improvement.
tips: Read the terrain before you move. Changing ground can shape where you can hide, advance, and line up a shot.
Think about your route as well as your aim. Strategic maneuvers often matter more than firing quickly.
Pick upgrades that suit how you like to fight. Choosing a focused set is usually easier to work with than spreading upgrades thinly.
Watch how the enemy tanks move and react. Adjust your tactics when an opponent keeps repeating the same pattern.
Treat each battle as a chance to test one change. Trying a different approach and noting what worked helps you refine your tactics over time.
faq: What is the main goal of Tanks 2D Battle with Ratte?
The goal is to outsmart enemy tanks in tank battles across dynamic terrains. Planning moves and using your upgrades well are central to winning.
How does difficulty work against the AI opponents?
The enemy is an AI that the game describes as challenging, so you will need to keep adapting your tactics. Learning how the AI responds to your moves helps you improve.

color-snake-3d-online.intro: Color Snake 3D Online is a snake game where you take the shape of cute animals and match colors as obstacles change. Reflexes and precision decide how long you last.
tips: Watch the color of each obstacle as it approaches so you can adjust before you reach it.
Plan your route a few moves ahead instead of reacting only at the last second.
Stay alert for sudden color changes, since they are the main test of your reflexes.
Keep your movements precise rather than rushed, because one mismatch can end your run.
Try short practice runs to learn the pace of the arcade action before aiming for a long survival.
faq: What is the goal of Color Snake 3D Online?
The description says the game is about navigating a colorful world by matching colors while obstacles keep changing. Your aim is to survive as long as you can.
Does the game get harder over time?
The description highlights fast-paced arcade action, so the challenge comes from quick changes and the need for fast decisions. It also notes that survival is never guaranteed.

super-stickman-hook.intro: Super Stickman Hook is a hypercasual jumping game where you tap to hook and swing your stickman over obstacles. The goal is to chain acrobatic jumps together without a miss.
tips: Watch the obstacle ahead before each tap so you can plan your next hook early instead of reacting at the last second.
Keep a steady rhythm between jumps, since chaining tricks one after another is what the game asks for.
Start with short practice runs to learn how far each jump carries your stickman before you try longer sequences.
If you miss a jump, reset your focus on the next obstacle rather than the one you just failed.
Use the mouse or touch input consistently, and tap at the same point in each swing to build reliable timing.
faq: What is the goal of Super Stickman Hook?
Tap to hook and make jumps that carry your stickman past every obstacle in its path. The aim is to pull off these acrobatic tricks in a row.
How do I control the stickman?
The game uses mouse or touch input. Tap or click to hook and launch each jump.

robot-astro-party.intro: Robot Astro Party is a fast-paced multiplayer running game with racing and running maps. Each match brings a new, unpredictable scenario, so adapting quickly matters as much as speed.
tips: Spend your first few matches on each map learning its layout, since every racing and running map calls for a different approach.
Expect the unexpected: scenarios change from match to match, so stay alert rather than following one fixed route.
Keep an eye on the other robots during a race so you can react to their moves and avoid getting caught in the same trouble.
Use short, deliberate clicks or taps instead of rapid mashing, which makes it easier to time your moves on busy maps.
Treat each new match as a fresh start and adjust your strategy based on what happened in the last one.
faq: What is the goal of Robot Astro Party?
You compete against other players in multiplayer matches on racing and running maps. Finishing ahead of the other robots is the main objective.
How do I control my robot?
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps, so you only need a single input method to play.

jump-will-jump.intro: Jump Will Jump is a one-control clicker adventure where you jump, dash and use weapons to clear your path. The goal is to reach the highest score you can and unlock costumes for your hero.
tips: Learn the rhythm of the single control early, since every action depends on when you press it.
Pay attention to which weapon you have and use it on the enemies closest to your hero before they reach you.
Try to keep moving forward rather than stopping, so each jump or dash carries you further up the score.
Watch for obstacles ahead and time your next press so you land cleanly instead of rushing into danger.
Play several short runs to get comfortable with the timing, then aim to beat your own best score.
faq: How do I play Jump Will Jump?
Use the right mouse button, or tap the screen on a touch device, to jump, dash and attack. The game is controlled with this one input only.
How is the score earned?
Your score grows the further and longer you keep going, so the aim is to reach the highest score you can. Staying alive and moving forward are the main ways to add to it.

battleops.intro: Battleops is an offline military shooter set during a zombie apocalypse. You work through missions, uncover the story, and face tougher bosses and varied enemies across changing levels.
tips: Set the difficulty to a level that lets you survive the first few missions, then raise it once you are comfortable with the enemies.
Learn how each type of enemy behaves so you can decide which ones to take on first and which to avoid.
Treat boss fights as tests of patience: watch how the boss moves for a few seconds before committing to attacks.
Pick up and try new weapons as you find them, and keep the one that suits the enemies you meet most often.
Pay attention to the layout of each level, since the environments change and cover can make the difference in a tough mission.
faq: What is the goal of Battleops?
You play through a military shooter story set amid a zombie apocalypse, completing missions and facing bosses along the way.
Can I change how hard the game is?
Yes, the game has adjustable difficulty, so you can pick a setting that matches your skill level and raise it later.

draw-or-delete-lovestory.intro: Draw or Delete LoveStory is a point-and-click puzzle where you play a detective uncovering a couple's secrets. You read each task, then change the scene by drawing or erasing elements.
tips: Study the whole picture before you touch anything, since small details often hold the clue you need.
Read the task carefully first so you know whether you should draw something new or delete something that is in the way.
Try one change at a time and look at how the scene responds, which makes it easier to spot what worked.
If you are stuck, look again at elements that seem unimportant, because they may be the ones that complete the task.
Keep your pace relaxed; the game is built to be cozy, so careful observation usually beats rushing.
faq: What is the main goal of Draw or Delete LoveStory?
You play a detective who reveals a couple's secrets by completing the task shown in each picture. Each scene asks you to draw or erase an element to finish it.
How do I interact with the scenes?
Look at the picture, read the task, and then either draw or erase the element the task requires. You change the scene directly with your drawing or deleting actions.

the-black-and-white.intro: The Black And White is a platformer puzzle game where two heroes with different abilities work together to find their way home. Solve mysteries by thinking strategically and using each hero's strengths.
tips: Before you move, figure out what each hero can do. Their abilities are the key to most puzzles, so know which one fits each obstacle.
Look at the whole room before acting. Portals and switches can be connected in ways that are not obvious at first glance.
When you get stuck, test one small idea at a time. Changing one thing at a time makes it easier to see what actually works.
Treat the two heroes as a team. Plan which one goes first and how the other can help once they are in position.
Take a short break if a puzzle frustrates you. Coming back with fresh eyes often reveals the solution you missed.
faq: What is the goal of The Black And White?
You guide two heroes through a portal-filled world and solve puzzles to help them find their way home.
How do the two heroes differ?
Each hero has a unique ability. Using both abilities together is central to solving the puzzles.

poison-candy-obby-1-or-2-player.intro: Poison Candy is a two-player obby where you hide a poisonous candy and try to make your opponent eat it. Play with a friend on one device or against a random opponent, and win by outthinking them.
tips: Pick a poisoned candy you can plausibly lead your opponent toward, rather than one that is hard to reach or hidden in an obvious spot.
Save your skip turns for moments when your opponent is starting to read your route, since bluffing works best when they are already watching you closely.
Watch which way your opponent moves and what they avoid, because each choice they make gives you information about where they think the poison is.
Rotate the camera by swiping on mobile, or adjust your view on the computer, so you can see the full path before committing to a move.
Vary your own moves so your opponent cannot predict your pattern, and mix real and misleading steps to keep them unsure of your intentions.
faq: What is the goal of Poison Candy?
You choose a poisonous candy and use clever moves to make your opponent eat it. The player who gets their opponent to eat the poison wins the round.
How do I move and jump on a computer?
Use WASD to move your character and the Space bar to jump.

4-colors.intro: 4 Colors is a card game where you play against up to three computer opponents. Match cards by color or number and be the first to empty your hand.
tips: Before each move, check which color and which number appear most in your hand, and play the card that keeps your options open for the next turn.
Hold on to a card that matches more than one option when you can, since it gives you flexibility if the top card changes color or number.
Watch the cards your opponents play, because the colors they keep playing hint at what they may be short of.
Get into the habit of calling Uno as soon as you reach your last card, since forgetting it costs you two extra cards.
Think about action cards before you play them, because they can shift the game quickly and may help or hurt you depending on the situation.
faq: What is the goal of 4 Colors?
The goal is to be the first player to get rid of all your cards by matching them by color or number.
What do I do if I have no matching card?
Draw a card from the deck and try again. Every move counts, so think carefully before you choose.

roller-ski-queen.intro: Roller Ski Queen is a fast icy race where you combine flips, spins, and quick evasion while collecting coins and upgrades. The challenges get harder as you go, so steady practice pays off.
tips: Look ahead on the icy track so you can spot obstacles early and start your evasive moves before you reach them.
Use flips and spins for tricks rather than at random, and save them for moments when the track is clear enough to land cleanly.
Grab coins when they are safely in reach, but do not take risky detours that could cost you a run.
Spend upgrades on what helps your current run most, since the challenges escalate and you will need them.
Replay early stages to get comfortable with the ice and the timing of your moves before pushing into harder challenges.
faq: What is the main goal in Roller Ski Queen?
You race through icy tracks, master tricks and evasion, and work toward claiming the crown through escalating challenges.
What can I collect while playing?
You can collect coins and upgrades, and stylish outfits are also part of the experience.

save-the-pets-draw-to-save.intro: Save the Pets: Draw to Save is a drawing puzzle where you draw protective lines to block bees and keep a dog safe from lava, water, spikes, and bombs.
tips: Plan your line before you draw. Look at where the bees are coming from and where the dog is standing, then decide the spot that blocks the most threats.
Aim for short lines. The instructions say a shorter line earns more stars, so use the smallest line that still keeps the dog safe.
Keep the dog protected for the full 10 seconds. Watch the screen until the timer finishes, since a fast block that fails early still costs you the run.
Watch for hazards other than bees. Lava, water, spikes, and bombs can all hurt the dog, so check the whole path before committing to a line.
Stay calm and draw in short, controlled drags. Quick thinking helps, but a steady drag gives you more control over where the line ends up.
faq: What is the goal of Save the Pets: Draw to Save?
Your goal is to keep the dog safe from the bees and other dangers. You do this by drawing a line that blocks the threats.
How do I draw a protective line?
Touch the screen and drag to draw the line. Release when you have placed it where it needs to go.

busy-bites-tycoon.intro: Busy Bites Tycoon is a cozy restaurant game where you carry ingredients, cook, serve customers and reinvest your cash. Start with one counter and grow it into a restaurant that runs itself.
tips: Start by following the arrow through the short tutorial, since it shows you the carry, cook and serve loop you will repeat all game.
Spend cash on the price pads that speed up your current bottleneck, such as the room where customers are waiting longest.
You can pay for a pad a little at a time, so you do not need to save for the full price before starting. Your partial payment stays on the pad.
Hire cashiers, runners and workers early so the routine jobs happen without you, and you can focus on the rooms that need you most.
When a bus arrives, serve every rider before the horn to earn the FULL BUS bonus.
faq: What is the goal of Busy Bites Tycoon?
Unlock machines, workers and new rooms until the whole restaurant runs on its own. Then fly to the next country on the World Tour.
How do I pick up and drop off items?
Walk up to a pallet or machine to pick items up, then walk up to the next machine or shelf to drop them off. No buttons are needed.

super-cute-cat.intro: Super Cute Cat is a pixel-art action game where you guide a feline through dangerous levels filled with mutated cats. Candies grant special abilities, and keys unlock your path forward.
tips: Collect candies whenever it is safe to do so, since they give you special abilities that can help you handle tougher threats.
Look for keys early in each level and keep track of where they are, because you need them to move on.
Pay attention to the enemy patterns before you rush in. Watching a foe for a moment can reveal when it is safe to pass.
Move slowly through new areas and build up your reflexes gradually, as the challenges increase as you advance.
If a level feels overwhelming, retreat to a safer spot and reset your approach rather than pushing through under pressure.
faq: What is the main goal of Super Cute Cat?
You guide the cat through perilous levels, outmaneuvering mutated cats, collecting candies, and finding keys to progress. Survival is the core challenge.
How do I control the cat?
The game does not list specific control instructions in its description, so check the in-game prompts or on-screen hints when you start playing.

squad-assembler-merge.intro: Squad Assembler: Merge is a puzzle game where you build a squad from weapons, armor and body parts, then send it into battle against enemy squads. Combining items and opening loot boxes are the core of your progress.
tips: Merge two identical items to raise their level, so look for matching pairs in your inventory before buying new loot boxes.
Open loot boxes from your inventory as they come in, then combine the parts you get to strengthen your squad members step by step.
Build each fighter in the equipment cells one at a time, checking that the parts you add fit the role you want that fighter to play.
Save your stronger squad for bosses, since they are described as very tough and need a well-built squad to defeat.
Use the hired heroes in harder battles, and try to capture enemy outposts and collect treasure chests when you have a spare moment.
faq: How do I win a level?
You win a level by defeating the enemy squad, so send your squad into battle with the TO BATTLE button once it is ready.
How do I make my fighters stronger?
Merge two identical items to increase their level, and combine parts from opened loot boxes to upgrade your squad members.

robby-climb-and-jump-tower.intro: Robby: Climb and Jump Tower is an obby where you climb a very tall tower using wings for fast ascent. Higher climbs earn more coins, which you can use to buy pets that help collect even more.
tips: Use the mouse to look ahead before each jump so you can see the next platform and plan your route.
Save your wing boosts for long vertical stretches where they will carry you the furthest, rather than using them on short gaps.
Since coins grow with height, keep moving upward steadily instead of lingering on low levels.
Pick up pets when you can afford them, because their coin help adds up the longer you climb.
Press Tab or Escape to pause when you need a break, so you can plan your next section calmly.
faq: How do I move and jump?
Use WASD to move and the Space Bar to jump. Move the mouse to change the camera view.
How do I earn coins?
The higher you climb on the tower, the more coins you collect. Pets can help you gather even more.

cave-miner.intro: Cave Miner is a tapping game about digging through underground layers to uncover rare ores. Upgrade your tools, go deeper, and build your wealth cave by cave.
tips: Keep tapping steadily rather than in short bursts, since the game rewards persistence.
Spend upgrades on your tools as soon as you can afford them, because better tools help you dig deeper.
Push further down into the layers when your mining is progressing well, since deeper levels hold rarer and more valuable ores.
Pay attention to each new cave, because the layouts change and what works in one may not work in the next.
Check your progress regularly so you can see how your mining prowess is growing and plan your next upgrade.
faq: What is the main goal of Cave Miner?
Your goal is to mine through the underground layers, uncover valuable ores, and grow your wealth as you go deeper.
How do I mine in Cave Miner?
The game is built around relentless tapping, so keep tapping to unearth the treasures hidden in each cave.

basket-ball-for-two-player.intro: Basket Ball For Two Player is a 1v1 basketball game for two people sharing one device. Each player controls a sphere with a single jump button, and the goal is to get your ball into the central hoop before your rival.
tips: Watch the timing of your jumps, since the game is built around a single button and the right moment matters more than pressing fast.
Keep an eye on your rival's position as well as your own so you can react when they are about to score.
Practice a few short rounds to learn how high and how far a jump carries your sphere before trying to score under pressure.
Use the shared screen to call out timing with your opponent so both players stay focused on the hoop in the middle.
Stay calm when you miss; with only one button to control, steady rhythm usually beats frantic tapping.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Send your ball into the central hoop before your rival does. Each player controls one sphere in a shared arena.
How do I control my ball?
Player 1 (blue, left side) jumps with W or by tapping the screen. Player 2 (purple, right side) jumps with the UP arrow or by tapping the screen.

police-chase-simulator.intro: Police Chase Simulator is a 3D driving game built around police chases, crashes, and racing. You can pick from many vehicles, tune their looks and wheels, and explore four different maps.
tips: Try a few cars in the sandbox mode first so you can learn how each one handles before you enter a race.
Use the handbrake with Spacebar to turn sharply at corners, especially on the wide city streets.
Save Shift for straight sections of road, where a burst of nitro helps you gain distance without losing control.
Press B to slow time before a tricky jump or turn on the countryside hills, then return to normal speed once you are through.
If your car gets badly damaged or ends up in a bad position, use R to reset it or K to restore it instead of losing time.
faq: What is the goal of Police Chase Simulator?
The game is about driving, chasing, and crashing through different maps. You can choose racing mode or sandbox mode for free driving.
Which keys control the car?
Use WASD to drive, Spacebar for the handbrake, and Shift for nitro. Press C to change the camera view.

mom-life-simulator-baby-care.intro: Mom Life Simulator Baby Care puts you in charge of a family's daily routine, from cooking and cleaning to looking after the kids. Move through the home, complete missions across several game modes, and keep the household running smoothly.
tips: Press I to reread the instructions whenever you are unsure what a mission needs, since the controls are simple but the tasks vary.
Use Left Shift to sprint between rooms when you have several chores to finish, and save walking for short trips.
Use P to pause when a task list gets busy, so you can plan the order of cooking, cleaning, and childcare before you continue.
Try different game modes to see which mix of cooking, shopping, parenting, and home management you enjoy most.
Keep an eye on the children and pet while you work on other chores, since parenting and pet care are part of the same daily routine.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You play as a caring virtual mom, completing household tasks, preparing meals, looking after the kids, and spending time with your family across many levels.
How do I move and look around?
Use W, A, S, and D to move your character, and move the mouse to change the camera view. Press F to perform actions.

mad-day-2-special.intro: Mad Day 2 Special is a 2D racing runner where you drive through alien-filled levels with Bob, shooting, jumping and smashing your way forward. Timing your jumps and using your rockets well are the keys to going further.
tips: Use the space bar for jumps and tap it a second time in the air to double jump when you need extra height or distance over obstacles.
Save your rockets for tough stretches, such as a crowd of enemies or a difficult gap, rather than spending them early.
Watch the ground ahead as well as the enemies so you can plan your jump before you reach an obstacle.
Keep shooting while you move so you clear threats before they close in on Bob's car.
If you fail a section, try it again with a steady rhythm of jumps instead of rushing, since precise timing matters more than speed.
faq: What is the goal of Mad Day 2 Special?
You play as ex-Marine Bob, driving forward through alien-filled levels to battle the invaders and rescue his kidnapped pet octopus.
How do I double jump?
Press space once to jump, then press space again while in the air to perform a double jump.

courageous-sniper.intro: Courageous Sniper is a sniper game built around precise shots. You take out threats with a sniper rifle in intense missions while keeping civilians safe.
tips: Before every shot, check the whole scene for civilians so you can confirm the target is a real threat.
Treat each mission as a set of separate decisions rather than a race, since every shot tests your judgment.
Stay calm when the pressure rises. Losing composure is the easiest way to rush a shot and miss.
Pay attention to how each new scenario is laid out before you start shooting, so you know where threats and civilians are likely to be.
Use each mission to sharpen your aim, and try to notice which kinds of shots you tend to miss so you can adjust.
faq: What is the main goal of Courageous Sniper?
You complete missions by eliminating threats with a sniper rifle. You also need to keep civilians safe while doing it.
What happens if I hit a civilian?
The description stresses civilian safety as part of every mission, so treat any shot near civilians as high risk and only take it when you are sure of the target.

thief-puzzle-long-hand-game.intro: Thief Puzzle Long Hand Game is a puzzle game where you guide a thief with a very long, flexible hand to grab target objects. You must reach them while avoiding traps, obstacles, guards, and other dangers.
tips: Before you move, look at the whole layout and find where the target objects are and which dangers sit between you and them. A short plan saves attempts.
Pay attention to where the guards are and how they are positioned, so you can time your reach for moments when the path is clearer.
Try to keep your long hand away from traps and obstacles, since touching them can end your attempt. Approach slowly around them rather than rushing.
If a route keeps failing, stop and try a different path instead of repeating the same move. Puzzle games like this often reward trying an alternative approach.
Use the mouse to click the on-screen buttons, and take a moment to check the screen after each action so you understand what changed.
faq: What is my goal in this game?
Your goal is to carefully reach and grab the target objects with your thief's long hand. You need to steal them while avoiding traps, obstacles, guards, and other dangers.
How do I control the game?
Use the mouse to click any buttons in the game. Follow the on-screen prompts to move through each stage.

motorcycle-racer-road-mayhem.intro: Motorcycle Racer: Road Mayhem puts you on a bike through city streets and highways, where you race, avoid other vehicles, and upgrade your motorcycles to win every level.
tips: Watch traffic ahead and plan your line early, since avoiding collisions is central to the game.
Try each motorcycle you unlock, because each one handles differently and a faster bike may feel harder to control.
Spend upgrades on the characteristics that match your riding style, so your bike feels more reliable in the situations you face most often.
Pay attention to how the physics respond to speed and turns, and ease off before tight bends rather than correcting late.
Replay earlier levels with your upgraded bike if you struggle, since better handling can make a tough race much more manageable.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Your goal is to upgrade and buy motorcycles, take part in races, and win at all levels while avoiding collisions with other vehicles.
How do I control the motorcycle?
On a touch device you use touch controls, and on a PC you use the arrow keys to move through traffic.

stock-car-hero.intro: Stock Car Hero is a 3D racing game where you compete across North America in the Stock Car Series. Dodge traffic, boost through banked corners, and collect coins to upgrade your car between races.
tips: Steer early and gently so you have time to react to traffic ahead rather than correcting at the last second.
Use boost on straights or after you have cleared a stretch of traffic, so it helps you get ahead instead of putting you into a crowd.
Take banked corners at a steady line; sharp steering can push your car wide into traffic or the edge of the track.
Pick up coins when it is safe to do so, since they are the resource you use to upgrade your car for the next race.
Spend your coins on the upgrade that addresses your biggest weakness, such as the one that slows your car down the most in tight traffic.
faq: What is the goal of Stock Car Hero?
You race across North America in the Stock Car Series, dodging traffic and finishing races so you can progress and upgrade your car.
How do I steer the car?
On desktop, use the cursor keys or WASD. On mobile, use touch to steer.

ragdoll-robots-sandbox.intro: Ragdoll Robots: Sandbox is a physics playground where you place items, patients, weapons and machines into a scene. Use the instructions to set things up and see how the wild physics react.
tips: Pick an item first, then tap the screen or click the left mouse button to drop it into the scene.
Connect levers and wires early so you know which machines, such as doors and conveyors, are powered before you add more objects.
Test one machine at a time, like a rocket silo or firework, so you can see exactly how it affects nearby patients.
Place patients in different spots and watch how they tumble, since the ragdoll physics change a lot based on position.
Try running a few different shift setups back to back to compare which combinations create the most chaotic results.
faq: What is the goal of Ragdoll Robots: Sandbox?
The game is open-ended and has no fixed score. You build scenes, place patients and machines, and see what happens.
How do I place an item in the scene?
Pick an item first, then tap the screen or click the left mouse button to put it down.

mad-truck-challenge-special.intro: Mad Truck Challenge Special is a racing and shooting game where you pick a monster truck armed with rockets and race rough off-road rivals. Your aim is to win races and earn the MTC trophy.
tips: Use the left and right arrow keys to keep your balance, especially on bumpy terrain, so your truck stays steady and doesn't tip over.
Save nitro with the Space bar for straightaways or moments when you need a burst of speed to pull ahead or catch a rival.
Fire rockets with the X key when an opponent is directly in front of you, rather than spending them at long range where they may miss.
Try extreme stunts when the truck is in the air, but land carefully so you don't lose speed or control on the next stretch.
Pay attention to how your truck handles after each jump or crash, and adjust your balance inputs early to avoid losing momentum.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Race against the toughest off-road drivers, crush and blast your opponents, and win to earn the coveted MTC trophy.
What do the arrow keys do?
The left and right arrow keys control balance, which helps you keep your monster truck steady while driving.

carrush.intro: Car Rush is an endless highway racer where one mistake ends the run. Steer through unpredictable traffic, earn coins, and see how long you can last.
tips: Hold a side of the screen only as long as you need to move. Releasing centers the car, so short holds help you stay in control in dense traffic.
