faq: What is the main goal in Attack & Dash?
Defeat every opponent in the arena and reach the end of the level. Each arena is short, so every dash matters.
How do I aim my dash on desktop?
Hold the left mouse button, point in the direction you want to move, and release to launch the hero into a sword dash.

pixel-jam-bus-puzzle.intro: Pixel Jam Bus Puzzle is a sorting puzzle where you send colored vehicles into limited parking spaces to collect matching passengers and reveal a pixel picture. Plan each move so the picture clears before your spaces fill up.
tips: Before you tap a vehicle, check which colors the picture needs next, so each full vehicle sends off passengers you actually use.
Keep at least one parking space open whenever you can, because a full lot with no exit can leave you stuck.
Look for moves that free a space by completing a vehicle, since leaving vehicles to fill up can block later colors.
Save the Clear and Shuffle helpers for levels where you are truly stuck, rather than using them at the start.
If a level feels hard, try an easier stage, and use pickup speed upgrades to make collecting passengers quicker.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Clear the pixel picture by collecting the right passengers, and you do not need to fill every parking space to win.
How do I collect passengers?
Click or tap a vehicle to collect passengers of the same color. When a vehicle is full, it leaves and frees up a parking space.

paper-panzer.intro: Paper Panzer puts you in command of a German tank in World War II battles. Aim your turret carefully, plan your purchases, and use your firepower with care.
tips: Learn how the turret moves before you start fighting, so you can line up shots quickly when enemies appear.
Treat each battle as a chance to test your command skills by watching where enemies come from and deciding where to position your tank.
Think ahead about which rare tanks you buy, since a purchase should match the kind of battles you expect to face.
Use your firepower deliberately rather than firing at every target, and save strong shots for threats that matter most.
After each battle, consider what worked and what did not, then adjust your positioning and purchases for the next one.
faq: What is the main goal of Paper Panzer?
You command a German tank in World War II tank battles and aim to dominate the battlefield using your turret and firepower.
How important is turret control in this game?
Turret movement is central to the game, so practicing aiming helps you hit targets more reliably during battles.

nail-salon-manicure-fashion-girl.intro: Nail Salon Manicure - Fashion Girl is a dress-up style game where you paint, decorate and style nails on hands. You pick a hand tone, choose a nail shape, then build your look with polish, rings and gems.
tips: Start by choosing a hand tone and nail shape you like, since these shape the rest of your design.
Paint each of the five fingers in a different color if you want a bright, mixed look, as the game encourages.
Add rings and gems last so they sit on top of your polish and do not get covered up.
Try a simple base color first, then layer one or two decorations, so the design stays clean and easy to read.
Compare a few finished looks side by side to see which color and decoration combinations work best for you.
faq: What is the main goal of this game?
The goal is to act as a manicure artist and finish a stylish set of nails on a chosen hand. You do this by painting, shaping and decorating the nails.
How do I start a design?
Choose the color tone of the hands first, then pick the nail shape you want before moving on to polish and decorations.

coffee-color-blocks.intro: Coffee Color Blocks is a relaxing puzzle where you slide colored shapes across the board to matching-color gates. Fill every cup in each figure to finish the level.
tips: Before you move anything, look at the whole board and find which shape is closest to its matching gate.
Plan the path for each block before sliding it, since a block placed carelessly can trap another block.
Watch for dead ends and avoid moves that leave a shape with no clear route to its gate.
Move blocks that are blocking the way first, so the others have room to reach their gates.
When a new shape, color mix or special mechanic appears, try a few slow moves to learn how it behaves before committing.
faq: What is the goal of Coffee Color Blocks?
Your goal is to slide each colored shape to the gate of the same color so that every cup inside the figure gets filled. A level is complete when the whole figure is filled.
How do I move the blocks?
Tap a shape and slide it across the board toward a gate of the same color. A block only fills when it reaches its matching gate.

outfit-love-queen.intro: Outfit Love Queen is a 3D running game where you walk along a track and pick up beautifying items to get prettier. Slide your finger or mouse to move and begin your beauty run.
tips: Look ahead along the track so you can line up with beautifying items before you reach them.
Make small, steady slides rather than quick swipes, so you stay in control of where your character goes.
Pay attention to which items are on each side of the track and plan your route to collect as many as possible.
Keep your character moving forward at all times, since the run is about getting prettier as you go along the track.
Practice a few runs to get comfortable with how sensitive the slide movement is before you aim for a higher result.
faq: What is the goal of Outfit Love Queen?
The goal is to get prettier as you walk along the track by picking up beautifying items. The game is a run, so keep moving forward.
How do I move my character?
Slide to move. The instructions only mention sliding, so use that to steer left and right along the track.

maze-evolution.intro: Maze Evolution is a single-player puzzle game with 28 mazes that start easy and get harder as you go. Each level is started by touching the black star, then you guide your player through the maze.
tips: Use the early levels to learn how your player responds to the mouse or touch input before the mazes get harder.
Before you move, scan the whole maze and look for the route that leads away from dead ends.
Move in short, controlled steps so you can correct course quickly if you reach a wall or a wrong turn.
If you get stuck, stop and study the layout again instead of repeating the same path, since harder levels reward planning.
Take breaks between levels, because the mazes become more demanding and a fresh look often helps.
faq: How do I start a level?
Touch or click the black star first. After you touch the player, you can control it through the maze.
How do I control the player?
On a computer, use your mouse. On mobile devices, use your finger or a touch pen.

geom-etrys.intro: Geom-etrys is a puzzle game built around combining geometric figures. Each level gets more complex, so you need to plan your moves carefully to keep the game going.
tips: Look at the whole board before you move, and check how the shapes relate to each other.
Focus on moves that set up chain reactions, since one well-placed move can lead to several results.
Think a step ahead and ask what each move will open up or block on the next turn.
Expect later levels to be harder, so use the early ones to get comfortable with how the shapes behave.
If you get stuck, step back and try a different combination instead of repeating the same approach.
faq: What is the goal of Geom-etrys?
The goal is to keep the game alive by making smart moves and chain reactions with the geometric figures. Each level asks you to craft more intricate combinations.
How does difficulty change as I play?
Each level escalates in complexity, so the combinations become more intricate the further you get. Early levels are a good place to learn how the figures work together.

body-drop.intro: Body Drop is a physics game where you test a dummy's body by dropping it from different structures. Your aim is to launch balls at the dummy and cause as much damage as you can.
tips: Use the mouse wheel to zoom in before you shoot so you can see exactly where the dummy is hit and how it reacts.
Rotate the camera with the right mouse button to check the angle of your target from more than one side before you launch.
Watch how the dummy moves after each hit, then adjust your next shot to strike the area that caused the most movement or damage.
Try different targets on the dummy instead of repeating the same spot, so you can learn which points are most effective.
Take your time between launches. Rushing makes it harder to tell which shot worked best.
faq: What is the goal of Body Drop?
You need to launch balls at the dummy so that you inflict the greatest amount of damage to it.
How do I launch the balls?
Left-click with the mouse to launch a ball.

the-dwarf-planet.intro: The Dwarf Planet is an action game in which you guide Mark through mysterious landscapes. You solve puzzles and piece together stories as you uncover the secrets of the planet.
tips: Take time to look around each new area, since the game rewards exploration with new wonders.
Try the adjustable resolution settings early so the landscapes and details are easy to see on your screen.
Pay attention to small details in each scene, because the puzzles and story pieces are connected to what you find.
Get comfortable with the controls before tackling harder puzzles, as the game is built around smooth movement.
Pause and think through a puzzle before acting, especially if you feel stuck, instead of repeating the same moves.
faq: What is the goal of The Dwarf Planet?
The game focuses on uncovering the secrets of a mysterious world by exploring landscapes, solving puzzles, and piecing together stories as Mark.
Are there puzzles in The Dwarf Planet?
Yes, solving puzzles is a core part of the game, and they are tied to the story you uncover as you progress.

gt-cars-mega-ramps.intro: GT Cars Mega Ramps is a driving game with three modes, Face to Face, Mega Ramps, and Color Lands. You can play alone or with a friend, and you can customize your car's look before you race.
tips: In Face to Face, watch for crashes ahead of you, since debris from a wreck can end your run instantly. Swerving early gives you more room than reacting at the last moment.
In Color Lands, keep your speed up. The description warns that slowing down can send you off the road into the abyss.
In Mega Ramps, pick a line early and watch the rolling balls and crate walls as they approach. Quick, small steering adjustments usually work better than sharp swerves.
Use the R key to reset your car position if it gets stuck or flipped, so you can get back into the action quickly.
Try the C key to switch camera views and choose the one that shows the road ahead most clearly for the mode you are playing.
faq: What is the goal of GT Cars Mega Ramps?
You race through each mode while launching off ramps, performing stunts, and avoiding obstacles. The game rewards careful driving and quick reactions.
What happens if I crash in Face to Face mode?
If one car crashes, the debris can hit you at full speed and end the game immediately. Staying alert and steering around wrecks is the main way to keep going.

black-hole-eat-the-universe.intro: Black Hole: Eat the Universe is a clicker where you tap to feed a black hole, growing it from atoms up to whole galaxies. Upgrades, boosts, and a prestige reset keep each run moving forward.
tips: Spend early upgrades on things that widen your pull, since a bigger pull makes every later tap and auto-feed more productive.
Check the spin wheel whenever you have a moment to spare, because its boosts can speed up growth for a short stretch.
Keep tapping while you wait for upgrades to become affordable, as manual feeding is the main source of matter early on.
Collapse the universe once progress starts to slow, since the Dark Matter you earn carries over and makes the next run grow faster.
Pick skins and hats mainly for fun, and treat your upgrade purchases as the real driver of how quickly your black hole grows.
faq: What is the goal of Black Hole: Eat the Universe?
The goal is to grow your black hole by pulling in matter, moving from atoms to planets, stars, and eventually whole galaxies.
How do I feed the black hole?
Tap or click the black hole to pull in matter. Buying upgrades can also widen your pull and add auto-feeding.

extreme-ball-balancer-3d.intro: Roll a ball across wooden bridges, narrow rails, and shifting traps over deep blue water. Use WASD to move and the mouse to swing the camera, and try to reach the finish line without falling.
tips: Make small, short key presses instead of holding a direction, since the physics is realistic and the ball keeps rolling after you let go.
Slow down before you reach a narrow rail, because a small sideways drift is hard to correct at speed.
Turn the mouse to look ahead at the path and the moving traps before you commit to a move.
Keep your camera angle steady when crossing wooden bridges so you can judge the edges and the gaps clearly.
Watch the shifting traps for a moment to learn their rhythm before you step onto them.
faq: What is the goal of Extreme Ball Balancer 3D?
Your goal is to guide the rolling ball along the path and reach the finish line. One wrong move sends the ball into the water.
How do I control the ball?
Use the W, A, S, and D keys to move the ball. Use the mouse to move the camera left and right to see the course.

daruma-matching.intro: Daruma Matching is an arcade puzzle game where you connect colorful Daruma dolls to build high scores. Difficulty rises as you play, so each choice matters.
tips: Look over the whole board before each move so you can spot which dolls connect best.
Plan two or three moves ahead, since a quick match can leave a poor setup for what comes next.
Keep an eye on how the difficulty changes, and slow down a little when the board gets busier.
Stay consistent with your approach rather than rushing, because small mistakes add up as the game gets harder.
Play a few short rounds to learn the patterns, then focus on beating your own best score.
faq: What is the goal of Daruma Matching?
The goal is to connect colorful Daruma dolls and reach as high a score as you can. The game is built around strategic choices that get harder over time.
How does difficulty change in the game?
The description says difficulty escalates as you play, so the challenge increases the longer you keep going. Staying calm and planning ahead helps you handle the rising pace.

fall-boys-ultimate-knockout.intro: Fall Boys: Ultimate Knockout is a 3D action game for one player where you compete against others to reach the end of the map first. The only control is a left mouse click.
tips: Keep your goal in mind from the start: the win comes from reaching the end of the map, so avoid wasting time on anything that does not move you toward it.
Watch the other players as they move, since their paths can show you where the route is going and which parts are crowded.
Use short, deliberate clicks rather than rapid clicking, so you can react to what is happening around you without losing control.
Pay attention to your position during the race, and adjust your pace if you fall behind or if others start to pull ahead.
Play several rounds to learn the layout of the map, because knowing where the course is most demanding will help you plan your moves.
faq: How do I win Fall Boys: Ultimate Knockout?
You win by competing with other players to the end of the map and being the first to get there.
What controls does the game use?
The game uses only a left mouse click, so every action you take is made with that one button.

fragment.intro: FRAGMENT is a 2D arcade shooter where you play a weaponized test subject disguised as a robot. Shoot through roughly 40 levels to reach the heart behind your creation, ideally as fast as you can.
tips: Speed is the goal, so plan your route through each level before you start moving. Working out the path first usually saves more time than rushing.
Use the mouse to aim before you fire, and keep your shots lined up with your next move so you are not wasting time repositioning.
Combine jumping and sliding with movement so you keep your momentum instead of stopping between actions.
If you get stuck in a bad position, press R to reset rather than struggling on, since a fresh start is often quicker.
Use P or ESC to pause when you need a moment to plan a difficult section, then return to play with a clear route in mind.
faq: What is the main goal of FRAGMENT?
Your aim is to shoot through the test and destroy the heart behind your creation by completing the roughly 40 levels. The game also encourages you to finish as fast as possible.
How do I aim and shoot?
Use the mouse to aim and right-click to shoot.

tangle-tails.intro: Tangle Tails is a top-down arcade roguelite where you control a creature made of bendy joints. Hit enemies with your head, circle them with your body, and close the loop to crush everything inside.
tips: Hit a group of enemies with your head first so they stay close together, then wrap your body around them before you close the loop.
Keep your path wide and open when you circle a swarm, so the loop covers more enemies at once.
Collect essence gems steadily, since each level-up lets you pick one of three mutations that change how your body looks and fights. Choose the one that suits your play style.
Expect bosses to get angrier once they reach half health, so be ready to change how you move and attack when their health drops.
Use Esc or P to pause when you need a moment to plan your next loop, and check your quests, relics, shrines, and permanent upgrades to vary each run.
faq: How do I crush enemies?
Hit enemies with your head, circle them with your body, then touch your body with your head to close the loop. Everything inside the loop gets crushed.
How do I level up and change my body?
Collect essence gems to level up. Each level-up gives you a choice of one of three mutations, and each mutation changes how your body looks and fights.

cake-maker-girls-cooking-games.intro: Cake Maker: Girls Cooking Games is a baking and decorating game where you choose a flavor, mix ingredients, bake, and decorate cakes and cupcakes. Follow the on-screen steps to build each treat from start to finish.
tips: Pick your flavor first, since the rest of the steps depend on it. Think about what you want to serve before you start adding ingredients.
Check which ingredients you need (flour, milk, egg, butter, chocolate, or fruit) before adding them, so you do not have to start over.
Watch the mixture closely while it is in the oven, and take the bowl out when the on-screen steps tell you the mixture is ready.
Save your decorating for last and work slowly, using sprinkles, icing, beads, or candles to finish the cake neatly.
Keep the on-screen steps in view as you go, and use them to decide what to do next. Clicking and dragging carefully makes each step easier to get right.
faq: How do I move ingredients and decorations?
Click and drag with the left mouse button to pick up and place ingredients, tools, and decorations. Hold the button while you move each item to where it needs to go.
What should I do first in each cake?
Start by choosing the flavor you want to make, then follow the on-screen steps in order. The game guides you through mixing, baking, and decorating.

stickman-gun-battle-simulator.intro: Stickman Gun Battle Simulator is a tactical action game where you command a stickman army in 3D battles. Deploy different units, manage your resources, and outwit tough enemies.
tips: Mix your unit types instead of relying on one kind of fighter, since the game is built around balancing your forces.
Spend resources carefully early on, and decide which units matter most before you commit them to a fight.
Before sending troops into a battle, think about the kind of enemy you are facing, especially when facing monstrous adversaries.
Use the fighters you unlock to adjust your army over time rather than sticking with the same lineup throughout.
Watch how the 3D battlefield changes during a fight and reposition your units to keep your strongest fighters in useful positions.
faq: What is the goal of Stickman Gun Battle Simulator?
You win by commanding your stickman army and securing victory over every challenging foe on the battlefield.
Do I need to know specific controls to start?
The game does not list detailed controls in its instructions, so try out the options on the battlefield to learn how your units respond.

john-is-a-lifeguard.intro: John is a lifeguard is an adventure platformer where you collect rings to save the planet. You jump across the level and deal with anyone blocking your path.
tips: Spend a minute testing the mouse click and the A, W, D and Shift keys before you go far, so your moves feel natural when enemies appear.
Keep moving forward and look ahead for gaps and enemies, so you can time your jumps instead of reacting too late.
Plan your jumps before you leave the ground, since jumping a lot is a core part of getting to the rings.
Deal with enemies that stand in your way right away, rather than letting them crowd you near a difficult jump.
Collect rings whenever they are safe to reach, because the goal is to gather a lot of them.
faq: What is the main goal of John is a lifeguard?
Your goal is to collect a lot of rings to help save the planet. You do this by jumping through the level and getting past anyone in your way.
How do I deal with enemies in the game?
The game says you need to destroy anyone who gets in your way. Clear enemies that block a path so you can keep moving toward the rings.

block-vs-block-ii.intro: Block vs Block II is a two player puzzle game where you arrange colorful blocks to form lines and score points. You can play against a computer opponent or a friend.
tips: Plan a few moves ahead rather than reacting only to the block in front of you. Looking at where the next pieces could go helps you keep the board open.
Try to complete lines as you go instead of leaving many half-finished rows. Gaps that stay open for a long time make the board harder to manage.
When you play the AI, watch how it places blocks and notice which lines it is building. Adjust your own plan to block or take advantage of its moves.
Keep the middle of the board clear when you can, since a crowded center leaves you fewer safe spots for new blocks. Spreading your pieces out gives you more options.
Stay calm when the pace picks up. Quick decisions are useful, but a short pause to check the layout often prevents costly mistakes.
faq: What is the goal of Block vs Block II?
Your aim is to fit colorful blocks together to form lines and rack up points. In the two player mode you are competing against a smart AI or a friend.
How does scoring work?
Points come from forming lines with your blocks. Clearing lines more often and keeping your board tidy are the best ways to build your score.

ragdoll-runner-run-but-don-t-break.intro: Ragdoll Runner pits a clumsy stickman against an opponent in funny 3D races. Run, steer around traps and obstacles, and be the first to reach the finish line.
tips: Keep your run going from the start, since the race is decided by speed as well as dodging. Tapping or holding to run should be your default state.
Look ahead and decide which side you want to be on before you reach a trap. Small, early steering corrections are usually safer than sudden last-second swipes or mouse moves.
Watch your opponent's position to judge how much risk you can afford. If you are behind, take a few more chances on bonuses; if you are ahead, focus on clean dodges.
Ragdoll physics makes the stickman react unpredictably, so avoid overcorrecting after a stumble. Steady, measured inputs tend to keep the character more under control.
Collect bonuses when they sit on your path, but do not steer into a trap just to grab one. Staying on the track matters more than any single pickup.
faq: How do I start a run on PC?
Hold or press the left mouse button (LMB) to start running. Move the mouse left and right to steer the stickman around obstacles.
How do I control the stickman on a mobile device?
Tap the screen to run and swipe left or right to dodge traps and steer the stickman.

sausage-flip-free.intro: Sausage Flip Free is an arcade jumping game where you guide a bouncy sausage through levels full of obstacles. Each level asks for good timing and precise flips to reach the finish line.
tips: Watch the sausage for a moment before each launch so you can see where it will land on the next pot or shelf.
Keep your taps consistent and avoid rushing; a small change in timing can decide whether you clear an obstacle.
Study the vine and the spacing between platforms before you launch, since the path to the next landing spot is the key to each level.
If you fall, try the same section again with a slightly different tap timing rather than repeating the exact same input.
Focus on one obstacle at a time instead of planning the whole level, and move on once you have the timing for the current jump.
faq: How do I play Sausage Flip Free?
Click or tap to launch your sausage with a flip. Time each launch so the sausage lands on the next pot, shelf, or vine and keeps moving toward the finish line.
What is the goal of each level?
Your goal is to keep moving forward through the obstacles and cross the finish line to win the level.

ola-solitaire.intro: Ola! Solitaire is a classic Klondike card game with large cards and simple controls. Your goal is to move all 52 cards onto the four foundation piles, building each suit from Ace to King.
tips: Before each move, look for face-down cards you can uncover. Revealing new cards gives you more options than shuffling already visible ones.
Use Undo when a move closes off your plan. It restores the previous position so you can try a different route.
Empty columns are valuable, but only a King can fill one. Keep a King at the bottom of a column when you can, so the empty space is useful.
Use Auto move when you are sure a card is safe to send to the foundations, but check the table first so you do not lose a card you still need to build on.
When you are stuck, ask for a Hint to see a move from the current position, then think about why it works before you play it.
faq: What is the goal of Ola! Solitaire?
You win when all 52 cards are on the four foundation piles, with each suit built upward from Ace to King.
How do I build the tableau columns?
Build downward in alternating red and black cards. You can also move a correctly ordered face-up sequence as a group.

merge-battler.intro: Merge Battler is a real-time strategy puzzle about merging units to build armies of warriors and mages. You balance your troops as stronger foes arrive, building toward a final boss.
tips: Plan your merges before you act. Think about which units you will need when the next, tougher foes arrive.
Keep a balance of warriors and mages rather than building only one type. Your army should be able to handle different kinds of enemies.
Watch the pace of the battle. Since the game runs in real time, hesitating too long can leave you under pressure.
Expect each wave to be harder than the last. Use early rounds to set up a strong army instead of spending everything at once.
Save your strongest forces for the final boss. Its challenge is the peak of the escalating showdown, so enter that stage with a well-balanced army.
faq: What is the main goal of Merge Battler?
Your goal is to merge units into powerful armies and defeat increasingly fierce foes. The game builds up to a formidable final boss.
What kinds of units can I create?
You can forge warriors and mages by merging. Combining both types helps you build a more balanced army.

pilot-life-flight-game-3d.intro: Pilot Life is a 3D flight simulator where you fly a plane as a novice pilot. You face bad weather and mechanical failures while working on take-offs, landings, and onboard puzzles.
tips: Focus on take-offs and landings first, since the game highlights mastering them and smooth landings are part of the challenge.
Watch the weather closely and adjust your flight early rather than reacting at the last moment.
When a mechanical failure happens, stay calm and deal with the problem before moving on to anything else.
Take your time with onboard puzzles so that you do not rush and make mistakes while the plane is in the air.
Treat each flight as a chance to improve your handling, and try the same approach again after learning from a rough landing.
faq: What is the main goal in Pilot Life?
You command a plane as a novice pilot, handling weather, mechanical failures, take-offs, landings, and onboard puzzles. Success comes from flying safely and landing smoothly.
How do I get a better score?
The game rewards smooth landings, so a gentle touchdown matters more than a fast one. Keep your approach steady to get the best results.

99-nights-in-the-forest-horror-multiplay.intro: Survive the dark forest with other players while a deer-monster hunts each night. Craft gear at the workbench, cook at the cauldron, and work toward saving the lost boys before the 99 days run out.
tips: Stay close to your teammates, since the game is built around surviving side by side. Splitting up leaves you more exposed when the deer-monster arrives.
Craft a flashlight early so you can see the forest during the dark nights. Light is your best view of what is coming.
Listen for the monster's footsteps and roar to judge how close it is. Use that warning to decide whether to keep gathering or head back toward your group.
The monster gets more dangerous every night, so build up your weapons and supplies early rather than waiting. Gearing up in the first days makes the later nights far less punishing.
Remember that only the money you find and earn carries over after a run. Spend it deliberately on unlocking new character classes and achievements that suit how your group plays.
faq: What is the main goal of 99 Nights in the Forest?
Your goal is to save the lost boys and escape the forest. You have 99 days to do it while surviving the deer-monster each night.
How do I move and interact with objects?
Use W, A, S and D to move around the forest. Press E to interact with objects such as the workbench and cauldron.

ricopop.intro: RICOPOP is a ricochet puzzle where you aim and fire balls that bounce off walls to shatter crystals. Clear every crystal in as few shots as possible across 50 levels.
tips: Before firing, look for a wall bounce that reaches a crystal from an angle a straight shot cannot, and plan the path first.
Try to set up chain reactions, since one well-placed hit can break several crystals in a row and save shots.
Watch how the balls return automatically and time your next aim so you are not waiting on a volley that is still in motion.
Use the speed button when a volley has a long, predictable path, and slow your thinking down on tricky layouts instead.
Aim with small drag adjustments and check the line before you release, because a slightly different angle can change the whole bounce pattern.
faq: What is the main goal of RICOPOP?
Shatter every crystal on each level using as few shots as possible. Collecting the three stars depends on how efficiently you clear the board.
How do I aim and fire?
Drag with the mouse or your finger to aim, then release to fire the ball. The balls return to you automatically after each volley.

duel-of-builders.intro: Duel of Builders is a 2D pixel platform action game for one or two players. Face off against a friend or the computer, moving, switching weapons, and attacking your opponent.
tips: Try a few rounds against the computer first to learn how your character moves and how quickly your attacks land before you play a friend.
Get in the habit of pressing your weapon-change key after each exchange so you always know which weapon you are holding when the next fight starts.
Keep moving rather than standing still, since staying in one spot makes you an easier target for your opponent's attacks.
Watch what your opponent does before you attack, and time your strikes for the moments they are moving toward you or have just finished an attack.
In two-player games, agree with your friend on a simple rhythm of attacks and movement, so you are not accidentally blocking each other's space on the platform.
faq: How do I move and attack in Player 1 mode?
Use W, A, S and D to move, and press Space to attack. Press R to change your weapon.
How do I control Player 2?
Use the arrow keys to move, press P to attack, and press O to change weapons.

zombie-survival-last-stand.intro: Zombie Survival: Last Stand is a first-person shooter where you hold off waves of zombies in a city. Shoot accurately, watch your ammo, and keep your kill count climbing.
tips: Use right click to scope before you take a headshot, since precise aim matters more than rapid fire when zombies close in.
Reload when you have a brief gap between waves rather than in the middle of a crowd, so you are not left empty-handed.
Keep moving with WASD instead of standing still, because zombies chase you through narrow streets and standing still makes you an easy target.
Switch weapons with the middle mouse button early, so you have a suitable weapon ready for both distant zombies and close-range fights.
Press Z to lock the cursor for steady aim, and use ESC if you need to unlock it and check your surroundings.
faq: How do I shoot and aim?
Left click fires your weapon and right click scopes in for more accurate shots. Aim for the head to line up quick kills.
Do zombies get harder as I play?
Yes, the game states that zombies become more dangerous the longer you survive, so your reactions need to keep pace.

zombie-survival-2.intro: Zombie Survival 2 is an arcade shooter where you fight off zombie waves across abandoned cities, dark alleys, and forests. You collect weapons and items while setting traps to hold your ground.
tips: Pick up weapons whenever you can, and try a few to see which one handles the zombie types you face most often.
Use traps before a wave arrives rather than waiting until zombies are already close to you.
Keep moving rather than standing still, so you don't get surrounded when a large group closes in.
Collect useful items early in each level, since they can repair your broken tools when you need them most.
Take time to prepare before a big zombie boss appears, and plan which weapons and traps you will use against it.
faq: How do I play Zombie Survival 2?
Use mouse clicks or taps to play. Attack zombies with your weapons and set traps to defend yourself from waves.
What should I focus on to survive longer?
Focus on moving smartly, keeping your distance from zombie groups, and placing traps where enemies will walk through them.

disc-golf-3d-frisbee-for-masters.intro: Disc Golf 3D is a cartoon frisbee golf game where you aim, shape and power each throw to land the disc in the basket in as few throws as possible. Here is how to play smoothly and keep your scores low.
tips: In Classic mode, check the yellow landing ring on the power slider before you commit, and adjust power until the ring sits where you want the disc to land.
Use the curve setting (W/S) deliberately: pick a curve that matches the shape of the hole so the disc bends toward the basket instead of away from it.
Treat the release mini-game as the accuracy check. Stay steady and time your tap or Space press carefully, since it decides how true the throw flies.
In Swipe mode, aim for a smooth upward draw when you need accuracy, and use a faster, bendier draw when you need distance or a curve.
Watch how the weather changes between parks, forests and lakes, and adjust your throw and curve choice to suit the conditions on each course.
faq: How do I aim and throw in Classic mode?
Drag to aim or use A and D, pick a curve with W and S, and choose a throw type with Q. Then drag the power slider and tap or press Space to win the release mini-game.
How does Swipe mode control the throw?
You draw the throw upward with your finger. A faster draw sends the disc farther, a bend adds curve, and a smooth line improves accuracy. Check the landing ring, then tap Throw.

memorybot.intro: Memorybot is a card game where you flip animated cards and match pairs before time runs out. It tests your memory under time pressure, and your score depends on how well you match.
tips: Use the first flips to learn where cards are, even if they do not match, since every card you see becomes useful information later.
Flip cards in a steady order, such as left to right, so you can recall which positions you have already checked.
Keep your attention on the cards you have revealed rather than hunting randomly, because remembering positions is what saves time.
When you find a match, move on quickly so the time limit does not run down while you hesitate.
Build a simple routine each round and stick to it, since consistent habits make it easier to improve your score over repeated plays.
faq: What is the goal of Memorybot?
The goal is to match pairs of cards before the time runs out. Your score reflects how well you do this.
How do I improve my score?
Focus on remembering where cards are and matching pairs quickly. Steady, consistent play tends to earn better results.

diy-phone-case-maker.intro: Make a custom phone case by mixing painting, acrylic art, stickers, pop it pieces, and keychains. This guide covers how to approach each part so your design comes together.
tips: Test a few colors from the pastel and neon range before committing, so you can see which palette fits the style you want.
Try acrylic art early, since swirling and pouring creates the base pattern that the other decorations sit on top of.
Choose stickers that match your overall theme, whether that is quotes, quirky characters, or something more edgy, so the case looks like one design.
Add pop it or fidget pieces in places where they will not block your main artwork, so the case still looks good as well as being fun to handle.
Pick keychains last, and choose ones that complement the colors and stickers you have already placed.
faq: What is the goal of DIY Phone Case Maker?
The goal is to design a phone case that expresses your style by combining painting, acrylic art, stickers, pop it pieces, and keychains.
Which decoration options are available?
You can paint with vibrant colors, create acrylic abstract designs, add stickers, incorporate pop it or fidget toys, and attach keychains.

flick-shot-soccer.intro: Flick Shot Soccer is a soccer shooting game where you aim with a drag and release to kick the ball into the net. Precision and timing decide whether each shot scores.
tips: Take a moment to plan your angle before you drag, since the direction you set determines where the ball goes.
Pay attention to the position of the ball and the net so you can choose a line that gives you a clear path.
Try different angles on early attempts to learn how the ball responds to your drag and release.
Focus on consistent timing when you release, because a small change in timing can noticeably change where the shot lands.
Slow down and aim carefully rather than rushing, since precision is the main skill the game rewards.
faq: How do I shoot the ball?
Click or tap and drag to aim and position your shot, then release to kick the ball toward the net.
What skills matter most for scoring?
Smart angles and timing are the key skills. Careful aiming and a steady release help you score more consistently.

card-solitaire-word-game.intro: Card Solitaire: Word Game is a puzzle where you sort image and word cards into the right categories before your moves run out. Each level brings a new topic and a new way to connect the cards.
tips: Before each tap, look at the whole board and find which cards share a topic, such as fruits, animals, or objects, so you know where your next match is.
Since moves are limited, avoid making quick choices that use a move without moving you closer to clearing the cards.
Image cards and word cards can belong to the same category, so check both types when you search for a connection.
Plan two or three steps ahead, especially on tricky levels where one early mistake can block the cards you need later.
Keep a steady pace and stay relaxed; the simple tap controls make it easy to test an idea and think again.
faq: What is the main goal of Card Solitaire: Word Game?
Your goal is to sort every card into the correct category before you run out of moves. Each level is cleared once all cards are placed.
How do I know which cards belong together?
Look for the connection between image cards and word cards, such as a shared topic like fruits or animals. Each puzzle has its own topic, so the link changes from level to level.

needle-rush.intro: Needle Rush is an idle clicker where you dig through a huge haystack to find one hidden needle. You earn coins from the hay you dig up and use them to buy better tools and helpers.
tips: Start by digging by hand and selling hay, then reinvest your early coins in the cheapest upgrades that speed up digging.
Keep an eye on the shop and buy automatic diggers as soon as you can afford them, since they keep working while you are away.
Hay slides and caves in as you dig, so work around the edges and watch how the pile shifts before committing to one spot.
Balance your spending between farmhands and machines rather than putting everything into one type, so your income keeps growing.
Check the achievements list now and then, since they track your progress and show you what to aim for on each run.
faq: What is the goal of Needle Rush?
Your goal is to dig through the haystack until you uncover the needle hidden inside, then tap it to win.
How do I dig on a computer?
Hold the left mouse button on the haystack to dig. Click a card in the shop to buy it.

downhill-car-ride-crash-test.intro: Downhill Car Ride Crash Test is a hypercasual game where you send crash-test dummies down a slope on scooters and bikes. Timing and upgrades decide how far and how hard each ride goes.
tips: Watch the start of each run and time your launch so you pick up as much speed as possible before the slope gets steep.
Look at what each reward is tied to, since the game pays for both damage and distance, and aim for the mix that earns you more per run.
Spend upgrades on stats that help the run you play most often, rather than spreading them thinly across everything.
After each crash, note what caused the biggest damage or the longest ride, then repeat that approach on your next attempt.
Try different scooters and bikes, because each vehicle can suit a different style of run and may pay out differently.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
The goal is to send your dummy downhill for spectacular crashes, earning rewards for both the damage you cause and the distance you travel.
How do I earn rewards?
You earn rewards for damage and distance, so a run that crashes hard or goes far can both pay off.

burger-game-burger-shop.intro: Burger Shop IDLE is a clicker and idle cooking game where you run a small burger shop and grow it into a burger empire. You serve customers, hire staff, upgrade equipment, and open new branches.
tips: Spend early progress on the upgrades that speed up serving, since a faster kitchen lets you handle more customers as the shop gets busier.
Hire staff and improve their skills before rush hours arrive, so your team can keep up when several tasks need attention at once.
Keep an eye on customer satisfaction and handle difficult customers promptly, because unhappy customers are less likely to return.
Try secret recipes and decorations as you unlock them, since both are tied to attracting more customers to your shop.
Open new branches only after your original shop runs smoothly, because each location brings its own customers and demands.
faq: What is the main goal of Burger Shop IDLE?
Your goal is to build a burger empire by serving customers, expanding your shop, and opening branches in different locations.
How do I handle rush hours?
Prepare ahead by hiring staff and upgrading your kitchen equipment so you can juggle multiple orders without falling behind.

border-battleground.intro: Border Battleground is a first-person shooter set in a snowy war zone. You play as a soldier who relies on stealth and careful planning to finish objectives without drawing attention.
tips: Move slowly and check your surroundings before each step, since staying unseen is central to this game's stealth approach.
Pick up weapons when you find them, but think about which ones suit the situation ahead rather than grabbing everything.
Plan your route through each area before you commit, so you can reach your objective without being spotted.
If you are detected, consider pulling back to a safer position and reassessing instead of pushing forward into open fire.
Focus on the mission objectives first, because every decision you make affects how the situation develops.
faq: What is the main goal in Border Battleground?
Your goal is to complete challenging objectives and prevent the looming chaos in the border area. Every decision you make affects how your mission turns out.
Is stealth or direct combat the better approach?
The game is built around stealth and strategic thinking, so avoiding detection is usually the safer choice. Use direct combat only when a situation leaves you no other option.

noob-s-chicken-farm-tycoon.intro: Noob's Chicken Farm Tycoon is a farming game about breeding quirky chickens, upgrading your farm, and selling eggs. You also need to keep foxes away from your flock while you grow your operation.
tips: Treat egg sales as your main income source and check which eggs earn the most before you spend on new items.
Spend early upgrades on things that help your farm run well, since a stronger base makes later expansion easier.
Watch for foxes and act before losses build up, because a damaged flock slows down your egg production.
Try the zany locations and bizarre items, such as the dinosaur eggs and the Skibidi Toilet, to see which ones fit your strategy best.
Plan ahead for breeding by thinking about which chickens you want to keep, so your flock grows in a direction that supports your goals.
faq: What is the main goal of Noob's Chicken Farm Tycoon?
The goal is to build a thriving chicken farm by breeding chickens, upgrading your operation, and selling eggs. The game also includes a playful goal of world domination.
How do I protect my chickens from foxes?
Foxes are the main threat to your flock, so keep an eye out for them and invest in ways to defend your farm. Acting early helps you avoid losing chickens.

flower-magnet.intro: Flower Magnet is a calm puzzle game where you guide a magnet through dreamy gardens to gather blossoms. Each level asks you to plan your route around obstacles and tricky paths.
tips: Look at the whole level before you move, and note where the obstacles and narrow paths are so you can plan a route that reaches every bloom.
Pay attention to the colors of the flowers, since they are different and collecting them in a sensible order can keep your path clear.
Move slowly and check each slide before you commit. Timing matters, so a small pause can save you from a dead end.
If you get stuck, step back and try a different path rather than repeating the same move. Trying new routes is often the quickest way forward.
Play at a relaxed pace. The puzzles grow more clever as you progress, so steady, careful thinking will serve you better than rushing.
faq: What is the main goal of Flower Magnet?
Your goal is to guide the magnet through each garden level and gather every bloom. You complete a level by collecting all of its flowers while avoiding obstacles.
How do I control the magnet?
You play with the mouse. Swipe and slide to move the magnet through the garden and attract the flowers.

road-designer.intro: Road Designer is a building game where you lay out roadways and watch cars move through the streets you create. It focuses on planning efficient traffic flow in your own city layout.
tips: Start with a simple main road and add branches only after you see how traffic moves on it.
Watch the cars for a while after each change, since bottlenecks and loops show up once vehicles start moving.
Avoid long dead ends where cars have to turn back, because they slow the whole network down.
Try a few different layouts for the same area and compare how smoothly the cars get through.
Keep your roads easy to follow so the traffic stays readable and you can spot problems quickly.
faq: What is the goal of Road Designer?
The game is about designing roadways that let vehicles move through your city efficiently. Success comes from building layouts where the traffic flows well.
Are there instructions on how to place roads?
No specific instructions are listed for this game. Experiment with the road building and watch how the cars respond to find what works.

frontline-commando-shooting-gun-games.intro: Frontline Commando Shooting is a first-person shooter built around gun battles, missions, and survival challenges. It offers a wide range of weapons, from pistols and sniper rifles to heavy machine guns.
tips: Learn how each weapon type feels before committing to one, since pistols, SMGs, shotguns, and sniper rifles all play very differently.
Use the W, A, S, and D keys to keep moving rather than standing still, which makes you a harder target during firefights.
Press Tab to toggle mouse lock when you need to click on on-screen buttons, then press it again to return to aiming.
Pick weapons that suit the situation: sniper rifles for distant threats and shotguns or SMGs for close-range fights.
Stay alert during survival challenges and watch your surroundings constantly so you can react before enemies close in.
faq: What is the main goal of Frontline Commando Shooting?
The game focuses on intense gun battles, thrilling missions, and survival challenges from a first-person view. Completing missions and surviving the fights are the core objectives.
How do I move my character?
Use W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move back, and A or D (or the Left and Right Arrows) to strafe. The Tab key locks and unlocks the mouse.

bus-out-bus-away-traffic-jam.intro: Bus Out is a sliding puzzle where you clear a traffic jam so the bus can get out. Each level is a new layout, and harder jams unlock as you beat earlier ones.
tips: Before you slide anything, check which vehicle is blocking the bus and trace the path it needs to take.
Look for vehicles that block several others at once, and move those first to open more space.
Undo your thinking before you commit: if a move leaves the road more crowded, try a different order instead.
Plan two or three moves ahead, since one wrong slide can lock the road and force you to start over.
When a level stalls, stop and reread the layout for the vehicles that can only move in one direction.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Your goal is to free the bus by unblocking the cars and removing the obstacles in its way. The bus must be able to reach the exit.
How do I move the vehicles?
You slide each vehicle in the correct direction to clear the path. Only the direction that leaves a clear route will help you solve the jam.

hunting-master.intro: Hunting Master is a strategy puzzle where you pick wolf targets, compare attack power, and build a team of wolves that grows with every win. Plan each battle before you commit.
tips: Before you confirm a battle, compare your total attack power with the prey's strength so you only fight enemies you can beat.
Defeated prey join your team automatically, so every win makes your pack stronger for the next challenge.
Spend your upgrades on total attack power whenever you can, since a stronger team opens up tougher targets sooner.
Scout the hunting areas by swiping before you choose a target, because different areas offer different prey to recruit.
Take on stronger prey step by step rather than rushing ahead, so your team keeps pace with the challenge.
faq: What is the goal of Hunting Master?
Your goal is to defeat prey, recruit them into your hunting team, and grow your pack into a strong force.
How do I start a battle?
Tap to select a prey and check its attack power, then tap again to confirm and start the battle.

big-shark.intro: Big Shark puts you in control of a hungry shark that grows by eating smaller fish. Tap to move through the underwater world and avoid bigger creatures that could eat you.
tips: Start by hunting the smallest fish you can reach, since eating them lets you grow safely.
Before moving toward a fish, check its size compared to yours and steer away from anything clearly larger.
Keep an eye on the whole screen rather than just the fish directly ahead, so you can spot larger threats coming from the sides.
Take short, deliberate taps instead of rapid tapping, which can make it harder to control where your shark ends up.
Use the moments after a successful meal to reposition, because your bigger size may change which fish and threats you can safely approach.
faq: What is the main goal in Big Shark?
Your goal is to grow by consuming smaller fish while avoiding larger threats, working your way up to become the top predator of the ocean.
How do the controls work?
The game uses tap-to-move controls, so you tap to direct your shark through the water.

city-constructor.intro: City Constructor is a physics-based puzzle game where you operate excavators, cranes, and trucks to move cargo and finish construction tasks. Precision and planning matter more than speed.
tips: Before you grab anything, check how the load sits and where it needs to end up. Plan the route for the arm and the vehicle together.
Make small, slow movements with the arm keys. Heavy cargo swings and tips easily, so gentle adjustments keep it balanced.
Use TAB to switch between vehicles when a task needs more than one machine. Position each vehicle for the next step before you move on.
Release the grab only once the cargo is fully supported in its target spot. Dropping it early can undo progress and cost you time.
Pause with ESC when a level feels tricky and think through the sequence of moves. Trying a plan in your head first saves retries as difficulty rises.
faq: What is the main goal of City Constructor?
You solve physics-based puzzles by using machinery to transport cargo and complete construction tasks on sites, bridges, and mountain terrain.
How do I control the machines?

On desktop, use A and D to move left and right, W and S to move up and down, and the arrow keys to control the arm. Space grabs and releases cargo, and TAB switches vehicles. On mobile, use the on-screen controls.

robots-world-battle.intro: Robots World Battle is a puzzle game where you assemble your own robot and enter a tournament to destroy every enemy. Click to play and work your way toward being the last robot standing.
tips: Before each match, look closely at how your robot is put together and decide whether it suits the fight you are about to face.
Try different robot assemblies rather than sticking with the first one that works, since the puzzle side of the game rewards experimenting.
Pay attention to what each opponent brings into the arena so you can adjust your build for the next round.
Keep your approach consistent across rounds and note which combinations held up best, so you can repeat them when you need to.
If a fight goes badly, step back and rebuild rather than repeating the same setup, because the tournament only ends when one robot remains.
faq: What is the goal of Robots World Battle?
The goal is to assemble robots and fight through the tournament until you have destroyed all of your enemies. The game's description says there can be only one winner.
How do I start playing?
The game's instructions say to click to play. Click the start option to begin assembling your robot and entering the tournament.

my-kitties-catworld.intro: My Kitties. Catworld is a cat-themed browser game where you build a colorful household of unique kittens. You mix colors, expand your collection, and finish playful tasks.
tips: Test color combinations one change at a time so you can tell which mix produced a surprising result.
Keep notes on the colors that gave you unexpected hues such as neon-green and pink, so you can repeat them later.
Look at your current tasks before choosing what to do next, since completing them is part of building your household.
Add new kittens steadily rather than all at once, so each one fits well with the look you are building.
Return to the game regularly and try new experiments, since the description points to endless ways to personalize your space.
faq: What is the main goal of My Kitties. Catworld?

The goal is to craft a household of unique kittens, experiment with colors, grow your collection, and complete amusing tasks. The game describes it as a personalized purring paradise you shape over time.
How do I get unexpected colors like neon-green or pink?
The game encourages experimenting with colors to discover unexpected hues. Trying different combinations and noting which ones work is the most direct way to find them.

granny-chapter-3-high-school.intro: Granny Chapter 3: High School is a third-person horror game where you explore an abandoned school, collect keys and ammo, and try to survive while Granny and Slendrina chase you. The goal is to stay alive as long as you can.
tips: Pick up the revolver and its ammo early, so you have a way to defend yourself when Granny or Slendrina gets close.
Save shots for emergencies. Right click fires the revolver, so aim carefully rather than firing at every shadow.
Keep track of which keys you have collected and which classroom doors they open, so you do not waste time backtracking while being chased.
Read the notes and desks you find inside classrooms, since the game points to a single desk that holds a clue about the locked door.
Use F to interact with items and doors quickly, and keep moving with WASD so the chasers do not catch you in a corner.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
The goal is to survive as long as you can by collecting items, hiding, and escaping from Granny and Slendrina.
How do I shoot in the game?
Right click fires the revolver. You need to find the revolver and its ammo first.

monster-wheels-apocalypse.intro: Monster Wheels Apocalypse is a car combat game where you drive a monster vehicle, aim and shoot at enemy vehicles, planes, and soldiers, and spend gold on upgrades between attempts.
tips: Spend your gold on upgrades early, especially the ones that help you survive, so you can stay on the road longer in each attempt.
Balance your upgrades instead of putting everything into one stat. Weapon power, shield, and speed each help in different situations.
Keep your shield in mind when enemies gather around you. Pulling back to recover before pushing forward can keep you alive longer.
Aim carefully before each shot. Taking down the enemies that threaten you most first can prevent your vehicle from being overwhelmed.
Try to beat your previous score on each attempt. Note what cost you the most health or time, then adjust your upgrades to fix that weakness.
faq: What is the goal of Monster Wheels Apocalypse?
Your goal is to eliminate all enemy vehicles on the road and get a higher score with each attempt.
How do I control my vehicle and shoot?
Control the vehicle and use the mouse to point and shoot. On mobile devices, touch the screen to aim and fire.

build-car-for-kill-zombies.intro: Build a car from engines, wheels, fuel tanks, armour and weapons, then drive down zombie-filled roads. Your parts, fuel and durability decide how far you get.
tips: Buy an engine first, then add wheels, a fuel tank and a weapon in the workshop before you press DRIVE, since those are the parts the instructions list to get moving.
Keep an eye on your fuel while you drive, because running out ends your run and the farther you go, the more fuel and durability matter.
Weapons fire on their own, so spend your attention on steering around wreckage and staying in a safe lane rather than aiming.
Use the money you earn to buy new parts at the stands, and try merging duplicate parts into rarer ones to improve your build over time.
Save durability where you can by dodging obstacles, since damage you take on one run carries your build into the harder zones ahead.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Drive down the road full of zombies as far as you can, earning money the farther you go. Use that money to build a stronger car for the more dangerous zones.
What are the desktop controls?
Use WASD to walk, A or D or the arrow keys to steer, W to speed up and S to brake. Weapons fire automatically, so you do not need a fire button.

archer-2023.intro: Archer 2023 is an archery game set in a futuristic world. You aim, draw, and release your bow to hit targets while racing against the clock through increasingly tricky levels.
tips: Take a moment to line up your shot before you release, since precision matters more than speed in this game.
Pay attention to your draw and release timing, because a well-timed release is what lands hits on the targets.
Keep an eye on the clock so you can decide when to slow down for accuracy and when to push for speed.
Expect the challenges to change as you go, so stay flexible and adjust how you approach each new setup.
Work through the intricate levels one at a time and learn from missed shots before moving on.
faq: What is the main goal of Archer 2023?
The goal is to hit targets with your bow while racing against time. You progress by working through intricate levels with evolving challenges.
What steps do I follow to shoot an arrow?
The game asks you to aim, draw, and release your shot. Good timing on the release is key to hitting your target.

candy-pop-mania.intro: Candy Pop Mania is a match 3 puzzle game with hundreds of levels. Swap neighboring candies to line up matches, and use special candies and power-ups to clear tricky boards.
tips: Look at the level objective and any obstacles before you move, so you know what you are working toward.
Try to make matches of four or more on purpose, since they create special candies with unique abilities.
Save power-ups for the hardest parts of the board instead of using them on easy early matches.
When a board gets crowded, check for moves that clear obstacles or open up space, not only the largest match.
Check the daily bonus wheel each day, since it can give you free boosters and items to use on difficult levels.
faq: How do I move the candies?
Swipe a tile horizontally or vertically to swap it, which should create a line of three or more matching items.
How do I win a level?
Complete the objective for that level, which can differ from level to level, and matching candies is how you progress toward it.

death-run.intro: Death Run is a race through obstacle courses where you control your runner with timed clicks. Sprint past traps, dodge swinging blades, and stay ahead of your rivals.
tips: Watch the hazards ahead before you commit to a sprint. Sprinting into a trap at full speed is the most common way to lose a run.
Try to time your clicks to the rhythm of the swinging blades so you pass each one at the right moment.
Use the strategic halts when a stretch looks risky. Pausing briefly to read the next obstacle can be better than rushing through it.
After a slip, don't panic. Reset your timing for the next section instead of trying to catch up in one burst.
Keep an eye on your rivals' positions. Pushing harder when you're close to them can help you pull ahead near the end.
faq: What is the main goal in Death Run?
Your goal is to finish the race before your rivals by getting past the traps and swinging blades on each course.
How do I control my runner?
You control your runner by clicking, and the timing of your clicks decides when you sprint and when you halt.

chicken-merge-2.intro: Chicken Merge 2 is a tower defense puzzle where you train chickens, merge matching units into stronger defenders, and place them to hold back waves of enemies. Clearing waves earns coins to train more units.
tips: Merge units as soon as you have two of the same level, since a stronger chicken usually does more for your defense than several weak ones.
Put your most elite units in the defense positions, because those are the ones that attack the enemies.
Spend coins on training more units after each cleared wave so your flock keeps growing between fights.
Save power ups for the hardest moments of a wave, since they have a cool down and you cannot use them again right away.
Rearrange your units by dragging them between slots as your flock changes, so your strongest chickens stay in the best positions.
faq: What is the main goal of Chicken Merge 2?
Your goal is to stop waves of enemies from reaching your base by training, merging, and placing chickens on the battlefield. Clearing each wave also earns coins.
How do I merge chickens?
Drag and drop one unit onto another unit of the same level to merge them into a stronger unit. You can do this on desktop with the mouse or on a touch screen.

steals-eggs-from-animals.intro: Steal Eggs From Animals is an adventure game where you sneak into animal zones, grab an egg, and run it back to your safe base. Collect rare animals and fill your pen as you go.
tips: Upgrade your speed early, since running fast is what gets you back to base with the egg while the animals chase you.
Plan your route before you enter an animal's zone so you know the quickest way back to the safe zone.
Go a bit farther into the map when you feel comfortable, because the description says the farther you run, the cooler the animals you find.
Use the camera rotation (hold the right mouse button on PC) to check where animals are around you before you commit to a run.
Keep an eye on your money from the animals you own, and use it to build up your pen and your progress.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Run into an animal's zone, steal its egg, and escape back to the safe zone. Repeating this helps you collect rare animals and fill your pen.
What are the PC controls?
Use WASD to move, Space to jump, hold E to interact, and hold the right mouse button to rotate the camera.

merge-home-ball-2048.intro: Merge Home Ball 2048 combines 2048-style number merging with 3D ball drops. Shoot numbered balls, combine matching pairs, and spend the stars you earn on renovating rooms.
tips: Aim for spots where a new ball will touch an identical one, since matching pairs like 2 and 2 are what create the next number.
Before each shot, look at which balls are already stacked and plan where the new one can join them to start a chain reaction.
Keep the board from filling up near the drop point by merging regularly, so you still have room to aim your next shot.
Pay attention to combos, because chain merges are the main way to earn stars quickly for furniture and decorations.
Spread your merges across the board rather than piling everything in one spot, which makes it easier to set up future matches.
faq: What is the goal of Merge Home Ball 2048?
You shoot numbered balls into the board and merge identical ones to make bigger numbers. Stars earned from merges are used to renovate and decorate rooms.
How do I earn stars?
Stars are earned by completing merges, and larger combos and chain reactions help you collect them faster. Spend them on furniture, wallpapers, and upgrades.

double-boy-jump.intro: Double Boy Jump is an arcade platformer where you guide two rope-linked heroes across gaps and platforms. Timing each jump and switching between partners is the core challenge.
tips: Watch both characters at once, since the rope links them and a mistake with one can put the other in danger.
Press and hold to jump, then release at the moment that lands you safely on the next platform. Short, controlled holds are a good way to practise the timing.
Use the switch to the other character when it is available so you can set up the next jump before you commit to it.
Collect coins while it is safe to do so, but do not risk a dangerous landing just to grab one.
Try the different themed modes, such as Snow Dash or Monster Escape, to practise timing in new layouts before aiming for a higher score.
faq: What is the main goal in Double Boy Jump?
Guide both rope-linked heroes across the platforms and gaps while keeping them out of danger. Collecting coins helps you aim for a higher score.
How do the controls work?
Hold the left mouse button or touch the screen to jump, then release to descend. On desktop you use a mouse, and on mobile you use touch controls.

stickman-fighting.intro: Stickman Fighting is a 2.5D fighting game where you pick a stickman champion and battle rivals in arenas. Success depends on combos and timing as you climb the ranks.
tips: Watch how your opponent moves before committing to an attack, since timing matters more than button mashing.
Try a few different stickman champions early on to find the one whose moves fit your style.
Start on an easier difficulty level to learn how combos connect, then raise the challenge once your timing feels reliable.
Pay attention to the arena layout and keep track of your position so you are not pushed into a corner.
Take your time between fights to reset and focus, because rushing into matches tends to lead to sloppy combos.
faq: What is the main goal of Stickman Fighting?
Win battles against a range of rivals and climb the ranks in the arenas to become the strongest stickman warrior.
Why are combos important in this game?
Combos chain attacks together, and the description highlights mastering them alongside timing as the key to winning fights.

thief-puzzle-online.intro: Thief Puzzle Online is a point-and-click puzzle game where you guide a stickman thief to retrieve valuable objects through a series of challenging levels. Use your mouse or finger to move the hand and grab what you need.
tips: Before you move the hand, look at the whole level to spot the objects you need and the obstacles between them.
Move slowly and deliberately, since small hand movements can make a big difference when you are reaching for items.
If a level stalls, step back and try a different route or order of actions rather than repeating the same move.
Pay attention to the order in which things can be picked up, as some items may only be reachable after clearing something else.
Take short breaks between hard levels so you can come back with a fresh view of the puzzle.
faq: How do I move the thief's hand?
On PC, use the mouse to move the hand. On touch screens, touch the screen and drag your hand where you want it to go.
What is the main goal of each level?
Your mission is to help the stickman thief retrieve precious objects while working through the level's puzzle.

tic-tac-toe-mania.intro: Tic Tac Toe Mania is a modern take on the classic game of wits. Play on a three-by-three or five-by-five grid, line up your symbols, and block your opponent, either against a friend or the AI.
tips: Always check whether your opponent has a line about to be completed before you make your own move, since blocking comes first.
Look for moves that set up two lines at once, so your opponent cannot stop both with a single turn.
On the five-by-five grid, start near the center, where a symbol can contribute to more possible lines.
Keep track of which lines are still open for each side, and avoid placing symbols in spots that only help the opponent.
Play several games against the AI or a friend to learn how they respond to different openings.
faq: What is the goal of Tic Tac Toe Mania?
The goal is to line up your symbols while preventing your opponent from doing the same. You can play on a three-by-three or five-by-five grid.
Can I play against someone else?
Yes, you can challenge a friend or play against the AI.

six-fold.intro: SIXFOLD is an arcade snake game in 3D. You steer one ink line across the six panels of a paper cube, eating marks to grow longer and faster. Your score is the number of links you eat.
tips: Start on CALM to learn how the cube rolls when you cross an edge before you try the faster paces.
Each mark you eat makes the line faster, so make your turns early and leave yourself room to react.
Plan a loop path with space inside it instead of tight curls, since the line ends the run if it crosses itself.
Use the pause key to stop and check your route on a busy board, then resume when you are ready.
Keep your BEST score in mind as a target and try to beat it on each new run rather than chasing a fast start.
faq: What ends a run in SIXFOLD?
The run ends when the line crosses itself. There is no floor and no finish, so only your own line can stop you.
How is the score counted?
SCORE is the number of links you eat during the run. BEST keeps your highest record.

professional-archerist.intro: Professional Archerist is a fast-paced 3D shooting game where you keep moving while you aim at targets that appear at different heights, angles, and speeds. Timing and smooth movement matter most.
tips: Keep moving rather than stopping to aim, since the game is built around running, sliding, jumping, and pivoting while you line up shots.
Watch where targets appear before you commit to a shot, and adjust your position early so you are not reacting at the last second.
Pay attention to target speed and angle, and aim a little ahead of moving targets so your shot lands where they will be.
Chain hits to build a steady rhythm, and avoid rushing a shot after a miss, because consistency is what keeps a run going.
Use short practice runs in each arena to learn how the mobility and accuracy demands change, and try to stay calm as pressure builds.
faq: What is the goal of Professional Archerist?
Hit targets while staying in motion, chaining hits together across arenas that test your mobility and accuracy. Perfect runs reward awareness and consistency.
How do I control the character?
The instructions say to click to interact, and the game is built around running, sliding, jumping, and pivoting while you aim. Check the in-game prompts for the exact actions.

betweenmarine.intro: Betweenmarine is a one-player 3D arcade game where you steer a submarine through obstacles. Survive as long as you can to earn points and beat your best score.
tips: Keep your eyes a little ahead of the submarine rather than on it, so you can react to obstacles before they reach you.
Make small, steady steering moves instead of sharp jerks, which helps you stay in control in tight gaps.
Pick a consistent line through the obstacles and return to the middle of your path after each dodge.
Practice on short runs first to learn how quickly the submarine responds to your input before aiming for a high score.
If you use the keyboard, tap W, A, S, or D with short presses to adjust position precisely, or use the arrow keys if you prefer.
faq: What is the goal of Betweenmarine?
The goal is to guide your submarine through the obstacles for as long as possible to earn points and beat your high score.
How do I control the submarine?
On a touchscreen, use your finger to guide the submarine. On a keyboard, use W, A, S, and D or the arrow keys.

super-onion-boy.intro: Super Onion Boy is a retro platformer where you leap, collect coins, and fight foes on your way to rescue your beloved. Its 15 levels reward careful play and a strong run for a high score.
tips: Collect coins as you go, since they are part of the core loop and can help you build a higher score.
Read each level before you rush through it, and note where foes appear so you can time your leaps safely.
Practice the controls on the early levels until your jumps feel automatic, because precise landings matter more as levels grow.
Take a short break between levels if you start making mistakes, then return with a clear head.
Replay levels you cleared with a lower score to look for coins or safer routes you missed the first time.
faq: What is the goal of Super Onion Boy?
Your goal is to travel through the levels, battle the foes you meet, and rescue your beloved. Along the way you can aim for a high score.
How does scoring work in this game?
Score is built by collecting coins and defeating foes as you play. Focus on both to raise your total as you progress.

rewarp.intro: Rewarp is a fast 2D arcade game built around instant teleportation. You use quick movement to dodge traps, skip past barriers, and find hidden paths through each challenge.
tips: Plan your teleport before you move. Look at where the barriers and traps are first, then decide where a jump will take you safely.
Use the mouse or keyboard for desktop play, or touch controls on a mobile device, and get comfortable with your chosen input before you hurry.
Pay attention to hidden paths. If a route looks blocked, check the edges of the screen and nearby areas for another way through.
Keep your speed steady rather than rushing every move. Precision matters more than speed when traps are close together.
Pause to think when a section feels hard. The game rewards clever thinking as much as quick reactions, so a short look at the layout can save several retries.
faq: What is the goal of Rewarp?
The goal is to get through the world's challenges by using your teleportation skill to dodge danger and skip past barriers. Survive the fast-paced journey by moving through the level.
How do I control the character?
On desktop, use the mouse and keyboard. On a mobile device, use the touch controls.

challenge-the-zombies.intro: Challenge the Zombies is a zombie shooting game where you play a survivor fighting through missions to stop a zombie apocalypse. Each level brings tougher zombies, so quick reactions and planning matter.
tips: Clear the closest threats first so you are not surrounded as the zombies grow stronger on later levels.
Save your fastest shooting for the most dangerous zombies and avoid wasting shots on easy targets.
Think about which weapon you use before each fight, since your weapon skills are a key part of surviving.
Take a moment to plan your approach at the start of each level instead of rushing in.
Use the mouse for every button in the game, so keep your hand on it and click quickly when menus appear.
faq: What is the goal of Challenge the Zombies?
You play as a brave survivor and fight dangerous zombies to save the world from the zombie apocalypse, completing missions level by level.
How do the levels get harder?
Each level brings more powerful zombies, so you need to adjust your strategy as you move forward.

mechaspider-cyber-strike.intro: MechaSpider: Cyber Strike puts you in control of a high-tech spider mech in futuristic city battles. Use your weapons, webs, and agility to take down rogue machine legions.
tips: Switch between weapons 1-4 based on the enemy in front of you rather than sticking with one option the whole time.
Use Left Click to aim before you fire so your shots land on targets instead of spreading across the battlefield.
Press V to lock or unlock the mouse as needed, so you can line up your aim without losing control of your view.
Move across skyscrapers and rooftops to get above enemies and find better angles for attacks.
Save your heavy artillery for tougher machines and use lighter shots on smaller threats to keep your attacks efficient.
faq: How do I shoot in MechaSpider: Cyber Strike?
Click to shoot. Hold Left Click to aim first if you want more precise shots.
How do I change weapons?
In robot form, press keys 1 through 4 to choose the weapon you want to use.
