faq: What is the goal of Tractor Trial?
Your goal is to drive the tractor through the off-road course, passing all the obstacles and traps while keeping it balanced.
How do I control the tractor on desktop?
Use the arrow keys or W A S D to drive the tractor.

noob-vs-zombie.intro: Noob vs Zombie is an action game about moving through maze-like landscapes, fighting, solving puzzles, and collecting coins to unmask a traitor. This guide covers habits that help you get further.
tips: Look at each maze before you move, and note which paths you have already tried so you do not waste time going back and forth.
Pick up coins along the way, since collecting them is part of uncovering the traitor.
Use your upgrades to prepare for combat, and think about which ones suit the fights ahead of you.
Watch for traps and slow down near them, so you can dodge them rather than rushing into danger.
Explore the different biomes and talk to villagers, as they can reveal challenges and secrets that help you progress.
faq: What is the main goal of Noob vs Zombie?
The main goal is to collect coins and use them to unmask a traitor while moving through maze-like landscapes. Combat and puzzle-solving help you reach that goal.
How do I make progress in the maze levels?
Explore carefully, avoid traps, and keep track of routes you have already checked. Speaking with villagers can also point you toward the next challenge.

tung-sahur-io.intro: Tung Sahur IO is a multiplayer infection game for up to 100 players. You start as a school kid trying to survive, and if you get infected you switch sides to hunt your former classmates.
tips: Stay near other players when you can, since a crowd makes it harder for an infected player to pick you out.
Use the jump action to get away from close threats, and keep moving rather than standing still in one spot.
Watch where the infected players are gathering so you can change direction before you get cornered.
Once you are infected, close in on the kids who are still running and use your attack when you have a clear shot.
Keep your camera moving with the mouse so you can see who is coming from behind before they reach you.
faq: What is the goal of Tung Sahur IO?
As a school kid, your goal is to survive the infection. If you get infected, your goal becomes hunting down your former classmates with the Tung Sahur army.
How do I move and take action?

Use WASD or the arrow keys to move. The left mouse button is your action: it makes a school kid jump and makes an infected player attack. On mobile, drag with your left finger to move and tap the green button for the action.

mahjong-solitaire-zodiac.intro: Mahjong Solitaire Zodiac is a tile-matching puzzle. Find pairs of identical open tiles and remove them until the board is clear. It suits both new and experienced players.
tips: Before each move, check which tiles are open, meaning nothing sits on top of them and at least one side is free. Only open tiles can be matched.
Prioritize tiles that block others. Clearing a tile that sits on top of or beside several others can open up more options.
Scan the whole board for every matching pair before tapping. Pairs can be spread across different areas, so a quick search helps you avoid getting stuck.
Be careful with the last few tiles. If the remaining tiles are locked in and no identical open pairs exist, you cannot continue, so plan earlier moves to keep the board flexible.
Play at a relaxed pace. Taking a moment to study the layout usually works better than tapping quickly, and it suits the calm style of the game.
faq: How do I know if a tile is open?
A tile is open when no other tile sits on top of it and at least one of its sides, left or right, is free. Only open tiles can be matched.
What counts as a match?
You match two identical tiles that are both open. Tap both of them to remove them from the board.

d-copter-reloaded.intro: D. Copter Reloaded is a 3D shooter where you pilot a helicopter through gangster skirmishes. You mix aerial combat with tactical sniping and upgrade your gear as the missions get harder.
tips: Pick your moment for sniping: use the precise shots when you have time to aim, and switch to direct combat when enemies close in.
Keep moving rather than hovering in one spot, since the game rewards cunning maneuvers that keep you out of enemy fire.
Spend upgrades on the areas you struggle with most, whether that is your weapons or your helicopter's handling and durability.
Scan each mission for threats before engaging, so you know which targets pose the biggest danger to your helicopter.
Replay earlier missions if you find the later ones hard, since your upgrades carry forward and make the harder challenges more manageable.
faq: What is the main goal of D. Copter Reloaded?
You pilot a helicopter through gangster skirmishes and complete increasingly challenging missions. Combining aerial combat with tactical sniping is central to the game.
How do I get stronger during the game?
You can upgrade your arsenal and your helicopter as you progress. Choosing upgrades that fit your play style helps you handle tougher missions.

wonder-goal-fun-football-kick.intro: Wonder Goal is a soccer game where you swipe to guide the ball past defenders and aim for a super goal. Dribble, dodge, and score to build your skills and fill your trophy library.
tips: Watch the defenders before you swipe. Pick a path with open space so you can steer around them instead of into them.
Plan your swipe as one clear movement. A smooth, deliberate line usually keeps the ball under control better than quick, scattered swipes.
Line up your shot before you commit to it. Aim for the open part of the goal and avoid rushing a kick while defenders are close.
Save power-ups for tougher moments when a clean shot is hard to get. Using them at the right time can help more than using them early.
Use your daily rewards and try for the 2X, 3X, 4X and 5X bonuses when you feel confident. Scoring cleanly is the surest way to earn them.
faq: How do I control the ball?
You control the ball by swiping the screen with one finger. The swipe guides the ball toward the goal.
How do I win the game?
Dodge the defenders, aim your shot carefully, and score goals. Your rewards and trophies build up as you score and win.

your-majesty-build-and-conquer.intro: Your Majesty - Build & Conquer is a strategy game where you rebuild a ruined settlement into a thriving capital and then expand by conquering nearby lands. Balance building, resources, and army as you grow your kingdom.
tips: Start by restoring the ruined settlement, since it gives you the base you need before anything else.
Farm resources steadily and sell the surplus when you need coins or materials for new structures.
Build new structures in an order that supports your economy first, so your later construction and army hiring are easier to afford.
Hire warriors before you attack, and make sure your army is strong enough to take on a new territory.
Check your resources before each conquest attempt so you do not spend everything and leave your capital short.
faq: What is the main goal of Your Majesty - Build & Conquer?
Your goal is to restore a ruined settlement, turn it into a thriving capital, and expand your territories by conquering new lands.
How do I grow my kingdom in this game?
Restore the settlement, build new structures, farm and sell resources, hire warriors, and then conquer territories to expand.

ironwake-tank-combat.intro: IRONWAKE is a tank combat game with 10 missions, where you aim, move, and fight your way through convoys, objectives, and two bosses. Upgrade your tank with salvage between battles to suit your style.
tips: Use buildings as cover so enemy fire has to get through obstacles before it reaches your tank.
Keep an eye on the minimap to track both enemies and your current objective, so you are not caught off guard while focusing on one target.
Hold the left mouse button for continuous fire when a target is in range, and release it when you need to reposition.
Switch between your four weapons with keys 1 to 4 depending on the target, and use Space to dash out of danger when you are cornered.
Visit the garage with G after collecting salvage and decide whether armor, firepower, or mobility will help you most in the mission ahead.
faq: What is the main goal of IRONWAKE?

You complete 10 missions, each with its own objective such as ambushing convoys, capturing uplinks, or escorting an evacuation vehicle. Two bosses, including the three-phase Dreadnought, stand in your way.
How do I aim and fire my tank?
Move the mouse to aim the turret and hold the left mouse button to fire continuously. Use WASD to move your tank while you shoot.

fail-run-online.intro: Fail Run Online is an arcade game about walking carefully along tricky paths. Each step tests your balance and patience, and the goal is to get through without a comedic stumble.
tips: Move slowly and deliberately, since rushing is the most likely way to lose your balance.
Look ahead at the path before each step so you can plan where your feet will land.
When a section feels tricky, take smaller steps and focus on steady, precise footwork.
After a near stumble, pause and regain your rhythm before moving on.
Replay the harder sections as often as you need, because patience improves your footwork over time.
faq: What is the main goal of Fail Run Online?
The goal is to walk along tricky paths without wobbling or stumbling. Each step needs precise footwork and balance.
Does the game explain its controls?
This page does not list specific controls, so watch for any on-screen prompts when you start playing.

arctic-truck-driver.intro: Arctic Truck Driver is a 3D ice road trucking game where you haul cargo across frozen lakes. Your speed depends on how thick the ice is, so reading the surface matters as much as driving.
tips: Check the ice before you accelerate. Thick ice is safe for higher speeds, while dark ice with glowing cracks is thin and can break under your truck.
Watch the ice stress meter as a guide to how hard the ice is under you. If it climbs, ease off the gas before you reach a risky patch.
Brake gently with the fuel tanker. Its load sloshes when you brake hard, so smooth inputs keep the cargo steady.
Slow down before pressure ridges and steer around open water rather than trying to cut through it at speed.
In convoys, keep your distance from the truck ahead so you have room to react if the ice or the road changes suddenly.
faq: How do I control the truck?
Use W or the Up Arrow to accelerate and S or the Down Arrow to brake. Use A and D or the Left and Right Arrows to steer, and hold brake when stopped to reverse.
What makes the ice break?
Driving too fast over thin ice causes it to break under your truck. Dark ice with glowing cracks is the warning sign that the ice is thin.

primal-druid-kingdom-of-animals.intro: Primal Druid - Kingdom of Animals is an adventure RPG where you capture, train, and command a squad of creatures in a dangerous open world. Forage, craft, and complete quests to grow your army.
tips: Forage for resources as you explore, since rare materials are needed to craft artifacts that upgrade your creatures.
Spend crafted upgrades on the creatures you use most, so your strongest fighters get stronger rather than spreading resources thin.
Build a varied squad by taming both fierce battle cats and smaller critters, so you have options for different fights.
Be cautious when exploring near water, because aquatic monsters are part of the dangers in the wilderness.
Check your quest log for missions you can complete, and aim for quests that match what your squad can currently handle.
faq: How do I move my character on PC?
Use the W, A, S, and D keys to move your character around the world.
How do I move my character on mobile?
Tap and drag on the screen to move your character.

alchemist-lab-jewel-crush.intro: Alchemist Lab - Jewel Crush is a match-3 puzzle game where you swipe colorful gems to clear jewels and build alchemy bonuses across more than 100 levels.
tips: Look for matches of four or five gems first, since they create bonuses that can help you later in a level.
Activate a bonus by matching it with a gem, and plan your swipes so the bonus lands where it will clear the most pieces.
Try to line up two bonuses next to each other so they can combine and help you make a philosopher's stone.
Keep a simple three-gem match in mind as a fallback when no bigger combination is available.
Take a moment to scan the whole board before each swipe, because the harder levels reward planning over quick moves.
faq: What is the main goal of Alchemist Lab - Jewel Crush?
Your goal is to clear jewels by making matches of three gems, and to use bonuses and philosopher's stones to progress through the levels.
How do I make a match?
Swipe across the colorful gems to line them up. Matching three clears jewels, while matching four or five creates bonuses.

natural-disaster-survival-obby.intro: Natural Disaster Survival Obby is an adventure game where you cross dangerous courses while floods, lava, and tornadoes threaten to end your run. Quick reflexes and careful movement help you last the longest.
tips: Keep an eye on the hazard around you before each move, since the disasters can change the safest route.
Stay calm and avoid rushing your jumps, because a single mistake on a challenging course can end your run.
Plan your path ahead rather than reacting only at the last second, so you have time to react when a disaster hits.
Play with friends when you can, since teaming up lets you share what you learn about each course.
Use the time between hazards to reset your position and get ready for the next stretch of the course.
faq: What is the main goal of Natural Disaster Survival Obby?
The goal is to get through challenging courses while surviving constant disasters such as floods, lava, and tornadoes. The game asks how long you can endure the chaos.
Do I need quick reflexes to do well?
Yes, the game is built around reacting quickly to dangers as they appear. Staying alert gives you the best chance to avoid them.

goods-sort-3d-triple-puzzle.intro: Goods Sort 3D: Triple Puzzle is a relaxing sorting game. Move colorful goods between shelves, group three identical items, and clear every shelf before the timer runs out.
tips: Before moving a good, check which shelves already hold the same item, so you can build a group of three there.
Keep one or two shelves partly open for matching instead of spreading goods across every shelf, which makes the board harder to clear.
Save boosters for stuck moments. Use the hammer when one item blocks progress, freeze when time is running low, and shuffle when the board looks locked.
Try to chain matches quickly, since combos earn more stars.
Check your daily quests and log in each day to collect rewards and helpful items that can support later levels.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Clear all goods from the shelves before the timer runs out. You do this by grouping three identical goods on the same shelf.
What do the boosters do?
The hammer removes an item, freeze stops the clock, shuffle rearranges the board, and the magic staff clears a full set instantly.

truck-transport-simulator.intro: Truck Transport Simulator asks you to drive a truck through transport missions across different landscapes. You carry cargo such as boxes and barrels, then park in the marked spots without losing anything.
tips: Slow down on uneven, rocky roads, since bumps are the main way your cargo can fall off.
Before starting a mission, check what you are carrying and plan a steady route to the drop-off point.
Take corners gently, because quick turns can shift the load even on smooth ground.
Aim for the designated parking location with care, and make small adjustments rather than sharp ones near the end.
If a load looks unstable, ease off the speed right away instead of trying to recover at full speed.
faq: How do I control the truck?
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps, as described in the instructions. Use these inputs to steer and move the truck through each mission.
What makes a mission fail?
According to the description, the mission fails if your cargo falls off, which usually happens when you drive too fast over rough terrain.

baby-bear.intro: Baby Bear is a click-and-play game about helping Mummy and Daddy Bear get ready for their new arrival and caring for their baby. It focuses on parenting scenarios and bear family adventures.
tips: Explore the customization options early so you know what you can change before moving on to the care scenarios.
Work through the preparation tasks for the new arrival first, since the game frames the early part of the story around getting ready.
Pay attention to what the baby seems to need in each scenario and respond to that rather than rushing through every click.
Try different customization choices and see how they change the look of the characters and the scenes.
Take your time with each scenario, because the challenges are meant to be worked through step by step.
faq: What is the main goal of Baby Bear?
The goal is to help Mummy and Daddy Bear prepare for their new baby and look after it through a series of parenting scenarios.
How do I play Baby Bear?
The game is played by clicking through its scenes and choices. Watch what each scenario asks for and respond with the actions that fit the moment.

red-stickman-vs-monster-school.intro: Red Stickman vs Monster School is a 2D action fighter where a red stickman battles monsters and giant bosses in a simplified Minecraft-style world. Progress comes from defeating enemies and upgrading your abilities.
tips: Watch each enemy's movement for a moment before engaging, since reflexes matter more than rushing in.
Use platforming to create distance from fast enemies so you can choose when to fight rather than being surrounded.
Spend upgrades on the abilities that match how you fight, and stick with them so your build stays consistent.
Against giant bosses, learn their attack pattern first and strike when the opening appears instead of trading blows randomly.
Keep a steady pace through the fights, because the game rewards clearing enemies and moving forward rather than lingering.
faq: What is the main goal in Red Stickman vs Monster School?
The goal is to defeat monsters and giant bosses, which lets you progress through the game.
How do I get stronger during the game?
Defeating enemies lets you upgrade your abilities, which helps you handle tougher foes later.

gun-clone.intro: Gun Clone is an arcade runner where you move through levels, defeat foes, and build up your weapons. It suits both short and longer play sessions.
tips: Since shooting happens automatically, put your attention on positioning. Steer toward open space and away from incoming threats so your weapons can keep firing.
Check your weapon upgrades before each new level. Spending time in the menu to set up your arsenal can make the next run easier.
Try different weapon setups across runs to see which ones suit your play style. Keep notes on which combinations felt strongest.
Use short sessions to learn the level layouts and enemy patterns. Longer sessions give you more chances to build a stronger arsenal.
Keep your movement smooth with your finger or cursor. Quick, sudden changes can carry you into danger, so small adjustments usually work better.
faq: How do I move my character in Gun Clone?
You move by dragging with your finger or moving your mouse cursor. Your character follows the position you are guiding it toward.
Do I need to press a button to shoot?
No. Shooting happens automatically, so your focus can stay on moving and avoiding danger.

sell-lemons-idle.intro: Sell Lemons Idle is a clicker where you start with one lemon and build a lemonade empire. You grow and harvest lemons, open farms, and buy upgrades to make production run faster over time.
tips: Spend your lemons on upgrades that raise production before buying anything decorative, since faster output compounds over time.
Check your automation options regularly, because automated production keeps earning while you are away from the game.
Compare upgrade costs against how much income each one adds, and buy the ones that pay back the fastest first.
Keep an eye out for multipliers, since boosting production with them can speed up everything else you own.
Collect rewards when they appear, and look for secret upgrades as your empire grows, since they can give a noticeable boost.
faq: How do I move around the farm on PC?
Use W, A, S and D to move, Space to jump, and the mouse to move the camera around your farm.
What is the main goal of the game?
Your goal is to grow your lemon economy and expand your lemonade empire to the largest scale you can reach.

fnf-music-clash.intro: Gear Shift Race is a rhythm racing game where you shift gears and hit boosts in time with the music. Each race tests your timing against rivals and bosses.
tips: Listen to the soundtrack first and find the beat before you start shifting, since timing matters more than speed.
Focus on the rhythm rather than rushing. A well-timed gear change keeps your car moving smoothly.
Save your boosts for the beat. Pressing a boost off-rhythm wastes it and can leave you slowing down.
Watch how your rivals and bosses move through each stage, then adjust your timing to match their pace.
If you crash, restart with a calmer tap rhythm. Short, steady taps are usually easier to keep on beat than fast, frantic ones.
faq: What is the main goal of Gear Shift Race?
Race through the story-driven battles, beat your rivals and bosses, and get through each stage by shifting gears and boosting in rhythm.
How do you control the car?
You play with mouse taps. Tap on the beat to shift gears and trigger boosts.

i-am-crazy-bird.intro: I Love Web Games presents I am Crazy Bird, a sandbox adventure where you play a city bird flying across rooftops and streets. Fly, steal food, use odd weapons, and complete missions in an open world.
tips: Take off with Spacebar early so you can cover rooftops and streets quickly instead of walking everywhere.
Use Shift to boost while flying when you need to reach a far spot fast, then ease off to steer more precisely.
Stay close to the ground when you want to pick up items with E, since interacting is easier when you are near them.
Try out Left Mouse Button hits on different objects to learn how the world reacts before you rely on them in missions.
Combine flying and item use: pick something up with E, then fly to a new area to see what surprises the open world offers.
faq: What is the main goal of I am Crazy Bird?
The game is a sandbox adventure about causing chaos as a city bird. You fly, steal food, use weapons, explore, and complete missions to build your reputation.
How do I move and fly?
Use WASD to move. Press Spacebar to take off into the sky, and hold Shift to boost while flying.

neon-shot.intro: Neon Shot is an action game where you catapult projectiles at targets across levels that get harder over time. Aim carefully, adjust your trajectories, and collect coins along the way.
tips: Start each level by studying where the targets sit before you fire, since precise aim matters more than speed.
Test a shot early and watch where the projectile lands, then correct your next shot based on that result.
Expect the early levels to be the easy targets, so use them to get a feel for how your trajectory changes with each shot.
When a level gets tricky, slow down and plan one shot at a time instead of rushing through attempts.
Keep an eye out for coins as you play, since collecting them is part of the challenge alongside shattering targets.
faq: What is the goal of Neon Shot?
Your goal is to shatter targets by launching vibrant projectiles with precise aim. Each level gets more challenging as you go.
How does aiming work in Neon Shot?
The game focuses on adjusting trajectories to hit targets accurately. The description does not list specific controls, so try a few shots on the first level to learn how aiming responds.

escape-from-the-portal.intro: Escape from the Portal is a dark adventure set in gloomy catacombs. You explore, dodge traps, fight monsters, and use magical artifacts to open the portal and get out of the underworld.
tips: Move slowly through unfamiliar rooms and watch for traps before you step forward, since avoiding them is as important as fighting.
Check your inventory with TAB often so you know which artifacts you have before you need them in a fight.
Assign your magic to the 1-4 keys ahead of time so you can use quick actions without stopping to find them mid-battle.
Press H for a hint whenever you are stuck, rather than backtracking through the same areas over and over.
Visit the shop with C when you have something to spend, and compare what it offers before you commit to a purchase.
faq: What is the goal of Escape from the Portal?
Your goal is to use magical artifacts to open the portal and escape the underworld. Uncovering secrets of the past along the way will help you reach it.
What are the basic controls?
Move with WASD and use objects or act with E or the left mouse button. Press TAB for your inventory and C to open the shop.

candy-egg-blast.intro: Candy Egg Blast is a match-3 puzzle game where you line up colorful eggs to hatch birds and keep them safe. Work through each level by planning matches and building combos.
tips: Look for matches that set up a second match before you make the first one, since chaining moves together is how you build combos.
Scan the whole board before each move so you can spot which colors are most common and which matches will clear the most eggs.
Keep an eye on the challenge in each level, whether it is a time limit or a goal, and pick moves that work toward it.
Think quickly but not carelessly: a short pause to check your options often beats rushing into a match that leaves a poor board.
Replay a tough level after you have seen its layout once, because knowing where the key eggs sit makes planning easier.
faq: What is the main goal of Candy Egg Blast?
You match colorful eggs to hatch birds and save them from danger, clearing each level as you go.
How do combos help me in this game?
Combos come from matching eggs in a sequence, and mastering them is part of how you conquer the levels.

eatable-birds.intro: Eatable Birds is an animal game about flying through colorful landscapes and dodging enemies like angry eagles and bees. Your reflexes decide how far you get in each level.
tips: Watch where the eagles and bees are moving before you commit to a path, and aim for the gaps rather than reacting at the last second.
Spend the first few seconds of each level getting a feel for how your bird responds, since the controls are meant to be simple but still need to be learned.
Stay calm when several threats appear at once. Pick the safest open space and move there instead of trying to avoid everything.
Play in short sessions so your reflexes stay sharp, and take a break if you start making the same mistake repeatedly.
Pay attention to how each new level changes the layout and enemy pattern, and adjust your approach to match.
faq: What is the goal of Eatable Birds?
Your goal is to survive while flying through each level. Survival depends on dodging enemies such as angry eagles and bees.
How do the controls work?
The game uses simple, intuitive controls. Try a few moves at the start of the first level to learn how your bird responds.

snake-2048-io.intro: Snake 2048.io combines snake-style growth with 2048 number merging in a 3D arena. Merge numbered cubes, grow your snake, and outmaneuver rivals on your way toward 2048.
tips: Look for matching numbered cubes you can merge before you chase bigger ones, since each merge helps you climb toward 2048.
Plan your route a few moves ahead so your snake grows into cubes you can combine rather than ones that leave you boxed in.
Keep an eye on rivals in the arena and avoid steering into spaces where they can cut you off or trap you.
Be patient: waiting for the right cube to line up is often better than rushing into a risky merge.
Watch how your snake's length changes as you collect cubes, and make sure you still have room to turn safely.
faq: What is the main goal in Snake 2048.io?
The goal is to merge numbered cubes, grow your snake, and reach the legendary 2048 tile while staying ahead of rivals.
How do I grow my snake?
Collect and merge numbered cubes in the arena to grow your snake, while planning moves that keep you from running into obstacles or other players.

scary-rooms-idle-horror.intro: Scary Rooms: Idle Horror is a clicker tycoon where you run a horror attraction. You improve rooms, hire actors and staff, and keep visitors frightened and satisfied so your park earns more.
tips: Keep your rooms clean and repaired so customer satisfaction stays high. Check room condition regularly rather than waiting for problems to pile up.
Spend your earnings on rooms and decorations that bring in more visitors, since a stronger park makes every later upgrade easier to afford.
Hire actors with different horror characters to see which ones your visitors respond to, and keep the most effective ones working.
Watch the reviews of your establishment, because they show what visitors enjoyed and what they didn't, so you know where to improve.
When a frightened client needs rescuing, go to them quickly so they leave with a good experience and you keep the goodwill of future visitors.
faq: How do I move my character?
On PC, use WASD or the arrow keys, or hold the left mouse button and drag in the direction you want to go. On mobile, press and drag your finger on the screen.
How do I select customers to serve?
Customers are selected automatically when your hero comes close to them, so move near a client to serve them.

offroad-jeep-hills-driving.intro: Offroad Jeep Hills Driving is an action driving game set in rugged hills and dense fog. You steer a powerful jeep across uneven terrain while weaving between palm trees, using WASD to drive.
tips: Ease off the throttle when the terrain gets steep or bumpy, since keeping a steady speed usually gives the jeep better grip.
Keep an eye on the palm trees ahead and plan your line early so you have room to weave between them.
Use short taps of the controls on rough patches instead of holding keys down, which makes it easier to correct the jeep's direction.
Because fog limits how far you can see, slow down when visibility drops and watch for obstacles that appear close to you.
Pay attention to how the jeep reacts to slopes and bumps, and adjust your speed before you reach challenging ground rather than after.
faq: How do I control the jeep?
Use the W, A, S and D keys to drive. The game is controlled entirely from the keyboard.
What is the main goal of the game?
The game focuses on driving a jeep across challenging hill terrain and weaving between palm trees. Your aim is to keep the jeep moving through the rugged landscape.

survive-lava-for-brainrots.intro: Survive Lava for Brainrots! is a clicker survival game where you run forward, collect Brainrots, and stay ahead of the rising lava. Upgrade your characters and base to grow your collection.
tips: Keep moving forward so you stay ahead of the rising lava, and check its position regularly so it does not catch you by surprise.
Collect Brainrots along your route, since they are how you earn and build up your collection.
Spend your earnings on upgrading Brainrots first, because the description says upgrades help you earn more.
Once your earnings are steady, improve your base so you can place more Brainrots.
Balance upgrades and base expansion rather than putting everything into one, so your income keeps growing as the run gets harder.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Run forward, collect Brainrots, and avoid being caught by the rising lava for as long as you can.
How do I earn more over time?
Upgrade your Brainrots, since the game says upgrades help you earn more.

baby-race-galaxy-2.intro: Baby Race Galaxy 2 is a 3D racing game where you drive a baby race car through different galaxies. You upgrade your car for speed and buy accessories to help on long races.
tips: Spend your early earnings on speed upgrades first, since a faster car makes every later race easier to win.
Check which accessories you can buy and pick the ones that help most with the kind of race you are about to enter.
Use WASD or the arrow keys to steer smoothly through turns instead of making sharp corrections, which can slow you down.
Try the space bar at the right moment rather than mashing it, so you get the benefit without losing control.
Explore the different galaxies in order and keep an eye on how each one changes the race, so you know what to expect as you progress.
faq: What is the goal of Baby Race Galaxy 2?
The goal is to race, upgrade your car to its maximum speed, and become the best baby racer in the universe by exploring different galaxies.
What controls do I use to play?
Use the WASD keys or the arrow keys to drive, and the space bar for the additional action the game uses.

shadow-fist-kung-fu.intro: Shadow Fist is a stickman kung fu beat 'em up where you play Kai, fighting floor by floor through buildings to recover the stolen Dragon Scroll. Each level has waves of enemies, a boss, and a golden key.
tips: Press attack repeatedly to chain combos, since a string of hits usually does more than single strikes.
Use block when an enemy is about to strike, then counter right after, instead of trading hits.
Use the dash to slip past a crowd or dodge an incoming attack, since it gives brief invincibility.
Save the spinning special move for groups of enemies surrounding you, where it can clear space quickly.
Before heading to the exit door, make sure you have the golden key, because the door won't open without it.
faq: What is the goal of Shadow Fist?
You play Kai, the last disciple of Master Lin, and must fight through each building floor by floor to take back the stolen Dragon Scroll. Each level ends with a boss and the exit door.
How do I get through the exit door?
Collect the golden key in the level, then press Enter at the exit door. The key is needed to open it.

realistic-monster-truck-offroad-simulato.intro: Realistic Monster Truck Offroad Simulator puts you behind the wheel of a monster truck on rough natural terrain. Drive with WASD and work your way through trees, grass, and other obstacles.
tips: Ease off the throttle when the truck climbs steep or uneven ground so it keeps its grip instead of spinning out.
Approach trees and natural obstacles at a slow, steady speed to get a feel for how much room your truck needs.
Pick a line through dense grass that keeps the wheels on firmer ground rather than charging straight through.
Stop and reverse out of a bad angle instead of forcing the truck over a rock or log it cannot clear.
Practice on flatter sections first to learn how the truck responds to acceleration, braking, and turning before tackling the toughest terrain.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
The game is a realistic offroad driving simulator focused on tackling tough terrain and natural obstacles with a monster truck. Use the environment to test how well you can keep the truck moving.
How do I control the truck?
Use the W, A, S, and D keys to drive the truck. Pressing the keys combines throttle, braking, and steering.

boombitz-bomb-chips.intro: BoomBitz: Bomb Chips is a puzzle game where you match colorful chips, set off bomb blasts, and clear each board across a series of levels. Plan ahead to build chain reactions and combos.
tips: Look over the whole board before your first move, and find where the matching chips sit so you can plan a sequence instead of reacting one move at a time.
Pay attention to chain reactions. A blast can set off nearby bombs, so check what a move will trigger before you make it.
Save special power-ups for tricky layouts where a normal match will not clear enough pieces.
Use the arrow keys with Space or Enter for precise control, or click chips with the mouse if that feels faster.
Each level adds new challenges, so slow down on new layouts and test your timing and logic before committing to a move.
faq: What is the main goal of BoomBitz: Bomb Chips?
Your goal is to clear every board by matching chips and setting off bomb blasts. Each new level brings a new layout to solve.
How do I select and move chips?
Use the arrow keys to move the selection around the board, then press Space or Enter to select a chip or confirm a move. You can also click chips directly with the mouse.

butterfly-matching.intro: Butterfly Matching is a match-3 puzzle game where you find and pair identical butterfly patterns across many species. It rewards careful observation and quick decisions.
tips: Scan the whole board before you move. Patterns that look alike at a glance can differ in wing markings, so compare details before committing.
Look for the pairs that are easiest to see first. Clearing obvious matches early can open up space and make the trickier ones easier to spot.
Keep your eyes moving across the board instead of fixating on one spot. Fast-paced puzzles often punish tunnel vision, where you miss a match in another corner.
Stay steady when the pace picks up. Rushed choices lead to mismatched pairs, so a brief pause to confirm a pattern can save time overall.
Work on your pattern memory over several rounds. Recognizing the same markings again and again makes identifying matches faster as you play.
faq: What is the goal of Butterfly Matching?
The goal is to identify and pair identical butterfly patterns on the board. Matching them correctly is how you make progress through the puzzle.
How can I tell two butterflies apart when they look similar?
Compare the wing patterns carefully, since species can share a general look while differing in small markings. Taking a moment to check the details before you pick a pair helps avoid mistakes.

knit-loop-yarn-jam-puzzle.intro: Knit Loop: Yarn Jam Puzzle is a cozy logic game where you sort colorful wool, untangle thread loops and free blocked pieces. Each level asks you to find the right order of moves to finish.
tips: Before you tap anything, look at the color, order and direction of each thread so you know what the level is asking for.
If a yarn piece is blocked, find the pieces standing in its way and move those first instead of trying the blocked one again.
Plan two or three moves ahead, especially in later levels where more yarn and tangled patterns appear.
Work through the levels in order, since each one builds on new combinations and trickier tangles.
Take your time and stop for a short break when a level feels crowded; a calm pace usually makes the logic easier to see.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Your goal is to sort the threads, untangle the wool loops and free all the pieces on the level. A level is complete when every piece is free and sorted.
How do I move a yarn piece?
Tap a yarn piece and move it to the right place. The controls are simple and smooth, so most of the challenge is in choosing the right move.

graffiti-time.intro: Graffiti Time is a 2D platformer where you play as Cap, an alien tagging city walls while slipping past futuristic security. Movement, stealth, and timing matter as much as your artwork.
tips: Watch the patrols for a few moments before you move, so you can spot their route and the gaps between them.
Plan your path before you start tagging. Think about which surfaces you need to reach and in what order.
Keep an eye on the clock, since the time pressure is part of the challenge. Avoid spending too long on one spot.
Collect the cash you pass along the way, and check which styles you can unlock with it to suit your approach.
If a patrol catches you, take a moment to reset your route instead of rushing back in the same way.
faq: What is the main goal in Graffiti Time?
You play as Cap, tagging urban landscapes while dodging security and outsmarting patrols before time runs out.
How do I avoid getting caught?
Focus on strategic movement and stealth. Study the patrol patterns and pick paths that keep you out of their sight.

super-world-adventure.intro: Super World Adventure is a platform adventure where you guide a little hero through many fantasy levels to rescue the princess. Collect coins, use power-ups, and defeat enemies on the way to every castle.
tips: Collect coins as you go, since they are part of every level's route and grabbing them along the way is easier than backtracking later.
Save power-ups for tougher moments, such as a crowded stretch of enemies or a difficult obstacle, rather than using them at the first chance.
Watch how enemies move for a few seconds before you approach, so you can time your jumps and attacks instead of running into them.
Take each level slowly at first and look ahead for obstacles, so you can plan a safe path to the castle.
Treat a lost life as practice: note which part of the level caused trouble and approach that section more carefully on your next try.
faq: What is the main goal of Super World Adventure?
Your goal is to help the little hero travel through the levels, reach every castle, and rescue the princess in the fantasy world.
What should I collect in the game?
Collect coins as you move through the levels. You can also pick up power-ups to help you defeat enemies and overcome obstacles.

drawrider.intro: Drawrider is a physics racing game where you draw the wheels and the track of your bike, then race through each level. Your drawing shapes how the bike moves, so planning before you draw matters.
tips: Study the level layout first to see where the bike has to climb, jump or stay steady before you start drawing.
Draw a new pair of wheels for each level, since different challenges need different wheel shapes.
Try to keep your lines smooth and connected so the bike does not catch on gaps or sharp corners.
If a run goes badly, redraw with a different shape rather than repeating the same design.
Race fast once the bike is moving well, but do not rush the drawing step, because a poor setup will cost you more time than it saves.
faq: What is the goal of Drawrider?
The goal is to draw wheels that help your bike win the race and get through all the levels successfully.
Do I need to draw new wheels for every level?
Yes, the game asks you to draw a new pair each time because different challenges need different wheel shapes.

crust-crusher.intro: Crust Crusher is an arcade clicker where you throw rocks at voxel planets, carve craters, and crack each planet's molten core. Spend gems on upgrades to smash faster and harder.
tips: Spend your first gems on Power or Rate, since harder hits and faster throws speed up every planet you crack.
Buy moonlets early, because they keep smashing on their own and add progress while you are not tapping.
Watch for the golden comet and tap it for a bonus whenever it appears.
Use the Auto-loader and hold to keep throwing when you want to stay active without constant tapping.
Before going Supernova, check your upgrades in the Menu stats, because the black hole and the moon are kept for good.
faq: How do I crack a planet?
Tap or click the planet to throw your rock. Each hit carves a crater, pays gems and fills the crack meter, and the planet cracks when the meter is full.
What happens in a Supernova?
A Supernova trades your galaxy for stardust and permanent upgrades, and you start again in a recoloured galaxy with its own twist.

stickman-mega-boss-battles.intro: Stickman Mega Boss Battles pits your stickman against waves of mobs and large bosses. Win battles to move through the modes and climb the leaderboard.
tips: Clear the smaller mobs carefully, since they keep coming and can wear you down before a boss fight begins.
Save your strength for mega-bosses by watching their attack patterns for a moment before committing to close-range hits.
Pay attention to the armor you can unlock and choose the piece that suits how you like to fight.
Try different swords when you have the option, and keep the one that feels most effective against the enemies you face most often.
Play for steady progress rather than rushing. Each win moves you closer to the top of the leaderboard, so consistency matters more than one lucky battle.
faq: What is the main goal of Stickman Mega Boss Battles?
The goal is to defeat mobs and mega-bosses, progress through the game's modes, and rank high on the leaderboard.
How do I unlock better armor and swords?
The game description says you unlock armor as you progress, and you can wield different swords. Check the in-game menus for the exact requirements.

smash-and-speed.intro: Smash & Speed is a driving and destruction game set across three environments. You can race, jump, smash cars, and tune your vehicle to suit your style. Use the controls to drive, crash, and experiment.
tips: Try the three environments before you commit to a challenge, so you can see where the ramps, presses, and traps are placed.
Use the tune-up options for wheels and suspension to test a bouncy setup for jumps against a firmer one for faster, straighter runs.
Press B for slow motion after a crash to see which parts break and how the wheels react, then use that to plan your next smash.
Use R to repair your car when it takes heavy damage, so you can keep testing runs rather than restarting from scratch.
Dynamic traffic is the easiest way to set up pile-ups, so approach moving vehicles at different angles and speeds to see which combinations cause the most chaos.
faq: What is the main goal of Smash & Speed?
The game has no set score or level order in its description. The stated objective is to wreck, tune, and explore as much as you like.
How do I drive and crash my car?
Use WASD to drive and Space for the handbrake. Hold Shift to boost, and press N to switch to a new vehicle.

quizmania-trivia-game.intro: Quizmania is a trivia puzzle game where you pick the correct answer from four options across questions on many topics. Hints help you work through harder rounds as difficulty rises.
tips: Read all four options before choosing, since wrong answers are often close to the right one.
Save hints for questions you truly cannot narrow down, so they are available when a round gets harder.
Keep an eye on the progress bar, because it fills as you play and shows when you can unlock new clues.
If a topic is weaker for you, slow down on those questions and use the elimination of obvious wrong options before guessing.
Treat each new level as practice: the difficulty climbs gradually, so early correct answers build the knowledge you need later.
faq: What is the goal of Quizmania?
The goal is to answer quiz questions correctly by selecting the right option from four choices. The questions cover different topics and get harder as you progress.
How do I answer a question?
Click or tap the option you believe is correct from the four choices shown. Each question has one correct answer.

doges-battle-royale.intro: Doges Battle Royale is an arcade survival shooter where you control the legendary Doge on a battlefield of guns, weapons, and opponents. Your aim is to outlast everyone else.
tips: Pick up items from defeated enemies, since that is how you gain new weapons on the battlefield.
Think before you move. Choose when to advance and when to hold your position instead of rushing into every fight.
Take your time with each shot. Precise aim matters more than firing quickly, especially when you are outnumbered.
Keep track of where your opponents are so you are not caught out in the open.
Try different weapons you find to learn which ones suit your style of play.
faq: What is the goal of Doges Battle Royale?
The goal is to survive the battle by defeating enemies and outlasting the rest of the opponents on the battlefield.
How do I control the game?
Use mouse clicks to play, or tap on a touch screen.

penalty-kick.intro: Penalty Kick is a football shootout where you aim and time your shots to get past the goalie and defenders. Score goals to earn points and unlock new balls, with no time limit to rush you.
tips: Take your time before each shot, since there is no time limit and precise aim matters more than speed.
Watch how the goalie and defenders are positioned before you commit, and look for a gap they are not covering.
Pay attention to timing as well as aim, because a well-aimed shot can still be saved if it is released at the wrong moment.
Use your points to track which approach works best, and keep returning to the shots that have scored for you.
Try to build a steady rhythm rather than changing your approach after every miss, so you can learn what the goalie tends to do.
faq: What is the goal of Penalty Kick?
Your goal is to score penalty goals past the goalie and defenders. Each goal earns you points.
How do I earn points?
You earn points by scoring goals. The description does not list other scoring methods.

idle-gravity-breakout.intro: Idle Gravity Breakout is a puzzle-strategy idle game where you tap to crush gravity-defying orbs, earn wealth, and upgrade your balls. The goal is to build up your combat strength over time.
tips: Spend your wealth on upgrades as soon as you can afford them, since stronger balls help you earn more wealth in the long run.
Compare upgrades before buying and favor the one that raises your combat strength the most for the cost.
Keep the game open for a while after you start, because idle progress builds up even when you are not tapping.
Return now and then to check for new upgrades you can afford, so your arsenal keeps growing.
Tap steadily on orbs that are easy to hit, and avoid long pauses that slow your progress.
faq: What is the goal of Idle Gravity Breakout?
The goal is to crush gravity-defying orbs, earn wealth, and upgrade your arsenal of balls to grow your combat strength.
How do I control the game?
You play by tapping to crush the orbs on screen.

santa-city-run.intro: Santa City Run is an arcade running game where you guide Santa down busy city streets while dodging obstacles. Your aim is to rack up as many points as you can on each run.
tips: Look ahead rather than only at the obstacle directly in front of Santa, so you have time to change lanes or position before you reach it.
Keep Santa moving toward open space instead of stopping, since standing still near obstacles makes it harder to escape.
Use the arrow keys for quick, small adjustments, and tap controls if you are playing on a touch screen, pressing early rather than at the last second.
Stay calm after a close call and reset your focus, because a rushed correction is a common reason runs end early.
Play a few short runs to learn the rhythm of the obstacles before aiming for a high score.
faq: What is the goal of Santa City Run?
Help Santa deliver presents by running down the city streets, avoiding obstacles, and scoring as many points as possible.
How do I control Santa?
Use the arrow keys on a keyboard, or tap the controls if you are using a touch device, to move Santa.

super-bowling-mania.intro: Super Bowling Mania is a bowling simulator where you aim, curve and roll your way to knocking down more pins than your opponents. Matches use smooth controls and physics that reward careful shots.
tips: Drag to aim before you swipe, and make small adjustments rather than big ones so you can keep control of where the ball travels.
Try adding spin and curve on different shots to see how the ball reacts, then repeat the shots that leave the most pins standing for you to clean up.
Focus on converting spares as well as strikes, since knocking down all the remaining pins keeps you competitive against opponents.
Play the competitive mode to earn trophies, which is how you move up in ranking and change the arena.
Keep an eye on the gold you earn, because it is what you spend on new ball and pin skins as you progress.
faq: How do you win a match in Super Bowling Mania?
You win by knocking down more pins than your opponent. The game is built around scoring strikes and spares to outperform them.
How do I aim and roll the ball?
Drag to aim your bowling ball, then swipe forward to roll it. You can add spin and curve to shape the path of your shot.

bowling-stars.intro: Bowling Stars is a classic bowling game where you throw by swiping across the screen. Win matches and bowl strikes to earn trophies and unlock better balls for tougher opponents.
tips: Watch how your swipe sets both direction and curve, and practice small changes in your swipe to learn how the ball reacts before a match that matters.
Focus on bowling strikes, since the progression guide points to strikes and match wins as the way to earn trophies.
Spend your cash on bowling ball boosts with a plan: weight, speed, hook, and hook control each change how the ball behaves, so pick the one that fixes your weakest throws.
Expect the skilled opponents to be a real challenge, and treat each match as a chance to learn their pace and how they score before pushing ahead.
Keep the sound on if you enjoy it, since the music adds to the atmosphere, but know it is not needed to play well.
faq: What is the goal of Bowling Stars?
The goal is to beat your opponents using classic bowling rules. Earning trophies unlocks better bowling balls that help you win against more skilled players.
How do I control the ball?
Swipe across the screen to set the trajectory and curve of your throw. The direction and length of your swipe shape where the ball goes and how it bends.

ragdoll-gun-shooter-cannon-spinner-playg.intro: Ragdoll Gun Shooter! Cannon Spinner Playground is a 3D shooting game where you fire a rotating cannon at ragdoll stickmen. Clear every mob on each level to finish it.
tips: Watch the cannon turn for a moment before you fire, and wait until it points at a group of stickmen rather than a single target.
Look for exploding barrels and other objects near the enemies, since hitting them can deal extra damage to several mobs at once.
Try the different guns on the levels, because a stronger weapon may clear a crowded area faster than a pistol.
Use the level layout to plan your shots, starting with the enemies that are easiest to reach so the rest of the level becomes simpler.
Fire with a steady rhythm instead of tapping rapidly, so each shot is timed to the cannon's position.
faq: How do I fire the cannon?
On PC, click the left mouse button, and on mobile, tap the screen. The cannon rotates on its own, so the timing of your click decides where the shot goes.
What is the goal of each level?
Shoot the ragdoll stickmen and destroy all of them on the level. Once the mobs are cleared, you move on.

outer-planet.intro: Outer Planet is a space combat game where you defend your world from alien invasions. Success depends on moving well and shooting accurately as you work to free planets.
tips: Pay attention to your position before you fire, since staying in a good spot often matters as much as hitting the target.
Aim with patience. Taking a moment to line up a shot usually beats firing quickly and missing.
Watch where enemies come from so you can plan your movement and shots ahead of each wave.
Think about which planet to free first, because a clear plan makes the later challenges easier to handle.
Use each new challenge you unlock to practice, and try to spot patterns in how the invasions arrive.
faq: What is the main goal in Outer Planet?
Your goal is to defend your world from alien invasions and save your planet from doom. You do this by fighting in space battles and freeing planets.
How do you win battles in Outer Planet?
Success comes from skillful navigation and precise shooting. Every aim counts, so careful shots matter more than rushing.

geometry-black-ball.intro: Geometry: Black Ball is an arcade game based on Geometry Dash. You guide a ball through obstacles by switching its gravity to reach the finish line of each of the 10 levels.
tips: Pick an early level first and learn how the ball responds to each gravity change before moving on to harder ones.
Use the space bar or right mouse button with steady timing rather than tapping rapidly, so you can judge where the ball will land.
Watch the level ahead as you go and plan your gravity changes before each obstacle reaches the ball.
Expect obstacles to get harder the further you advance, so when you fail, retry the section you struggled with instead of restarting from scratch in your head.
If you enjoy the game, the shop lets you buy skins for your ball. Choosing one is purely cosmetic, so pick the look you like best without worrying about it affecting play.
faq: What is the goal of Geometry: Black Ball?
Your goal is to get through all the obstacles on each level and reach the finish line. There are 10 levels in total.
How do I control the ball?
Press the space bar or the right mouse button to change the ball's gravity. This changes its direction so you can get past obstacles.

pixel-color-quest.intro: Pixel Color Quest is a calm coloring game where you fill a numbered grid to reveal a bright pixel picture. Pick a theme, choose a level, and color one cell at a time.
tips: Pick one number at a time and fill every cell with that number before moving on, so you don't lose track of where you are.
Start with a simple picture to learn how the numbered palette matches the cells before trying large, detailed levels.
Before choosing a color, read the number inside the cell and confirm it matches the palette number exactly.
On big pictures, work section by section, finishing one area fully before starting another, to keep your attention on the details.
Check your progress periodically by scanning the grid for any cells you skipped, since the picture is only complete when every section has its correct color.
faq: What is the goal of Pixel Color Quest?
The goal is to completely color the selected picture. Each cell's number tells you which palette color to use.
How do I color a cell?
Select the color with the matching number from the palette, then click or tap the cell to fill it. Repeat for every cell with that number.

one-bit.intro: One Bit is a 2D pixel platform adventure for one player. Guide your one-bit character along the tracks, set checkpoints, and win by completing the obstacles.
tips: Move with W A S D or the arrow keys, and get a feel for your character's movement on the early obstacles before attempting harder sections.
Press C to set a checkpoint before a difficult obstacle, so a mistake sends you back to a point you have already cleared.
Save a checkpoint only once you are standing somewhere safe, so you do not respawn right next to danger.
Pause before each obstacle to study the layout and plan your route instead of rushing through.
If you play on a mobile device, use the on-screen touch controls, and keep your thumbs on the controls so you can react quickly.
faq: What is the goal of One Bit?
Your goal is to overcome the obstacles along the tracks and complete the game.
How do I move my character?
Use W A S D or the arrow keys to move. On mobile devices, you can use the touch controls on the screen.

dragon-fly.intro: Dragon Fly is a one-control hypercasual game where a young dragon with tiny wings uses hills to build speed and launch into the sky. Timing your touches well is the key to a longer adventure.
tips: Watch the shape of each hill before you touch anything, since the slope ahead determines how much speed you can carry into a jump.
Time your touches to the crest of a hill rather than the bottom of a dip, so your momentum carries you upward.
Keep your touches consistent instead of tapping rapidly, because the description says precise timing is what builds momentum.
Do not rush early on; a slightly slower run that keeps your speed up will usually go further than a fast, uneven one.
Stay focused the whole time, since the description notes that Dragon Mum is coming, which suggests the run is meant to be played quickly and without long pauses.
faq: How do I control the dragon?
Use the mouse. The instructions say the game is played with mouse controls, and you time your clicks to build momentum on the hills.
How do I take off into the sky?
Slide along the curvy hills and time your touches with precision so your speed carries you off the top of a hill and into the air.

block-breaker-game.intro: Block Breaker Game is a retro-style arcade game about breaking bricks across challenging levels. Your timing and tactics decide how well you do and where you land on the leaderboards.
tips: Keep your timing steady rather than rushing each shot, since the description puts timing alongside tactics as the key skill.
Try the different blasters available to you and notice which one suits your play style before you commit to a strategy.
Plan your approach on harder levels before you start, looking for which bricks are most worth clearing first.
Use the single-handed controls to keep your movements simple and deliberate, so you stay accurate when levels get tough.
Aim to improve your score on each run, since the leaderboards reward players who master the tactics over time.
faq: What is the goal of Block Breaker Game?
You break bricks through a series of challenging levels while using timing and tactics. The game is built around climbing the competitive leaderboards.
How do the controls work?
The game uses single-handed controls, so you can play with one hand. Focus on smooth, precise movements to stay in control of each level.

volley-beans.intro: Volley Beans is a wobbly-physics volleyball game with short matches against AI or friends. Learn the jump and smash controls, then use them to win rallies.
tips: Start each match by pressing SPACE and getting a feel for how your bean wobbles before rallies get fast.
Use left click to jump when the ball is coming toward you, rather than jumping too early and drifting away from it.
Save the double click smash for balls that are high and close to the net, since a smash is most useful when the opponent has to react quickly.
Because matches last about 2 minutes, avoid getting stuck on one long rally; keep your position centered so you can reach both sides of the court.
Try Career Mode or Tournament Mode against the AI first to learn how each opponent plays before you challenge friends online or in pass-and-play.
faq: What are the basic controls in Volley Beans?
Use the left mouse click to jump and a double click to smash the ball. Press SPACE to start the game and enter the action.
How long does a match last?
Matches are quick, about 2 minutes each, so you can play a few in a short break.

grow-slime.intro: Grow Slime is a relaxing farm game about raising unusual slimes. Buy eggs, plant them, and sell the drops you collect to build a profitable farm.
tips: Check your slimes often, since each one grows through several stages and the best drops usually come from the later ones.
Sell drops regularly so you have coins to unlock new eggs and upgrade your farm rather than letting items pile up.
Spend your coins on upgrades that help your farm run more smoothly before buying lots of eggs you may not be able to support.
Walk around with WASD or the arrow keys and press E near a slime to collect from it, so you can keep up with several slimes at once.
Use right-click or a swipe to rotate the camera and get a clear view of your farm before deciding where to plant new eggs.
faq: What is the main goal of Grow Slime?
The goal is to build the biggest and most profitable slime farm by raising, collecting from, and selling slimes. Unlocking new eggs and upgrading your farm also helps you grow.
How do I collect drops from slimes?
Move close to a slime and press E to get it. You can hit slimes to collect their drops, which you can then sell for coins.

the-escape-series.intro: The Escape Series is a point-and-click room escape adventure where you explore detailed rooms, gather clues, and solve puzzles and codes to find a way out. It is built around logic and careful observation.
tips: Click on everything in a room at least once, since clues can hide in ordinary-looking objects.
Pick up items and keep them in your inventory, then try combining or using them on other objects when you get stuck.
Write down any numbers, symbols, or words you find so you can compare them when you reach a code lock.
When a puzzle seems unsolvable, step back and look at the room again for objects or areas you have not examined yet.
Work on one puzzle at a time and note which clues connect to which lock, which keeps you from second-guessing yourself.
faq: How do I play The Escape Series?
Use the mouse to select and interact with objects in each room. Search for clues, solve the codes and puzzles, and use logic to find a way out.
What should I do first in each room?
Look around the whole room before focusing on one object. Noting every interactive item and clue early makes it easier to connect them later.

fastlane-road-to-revenge.intro: Fastlane: Road to Revenge is an action racing game where you pick a vehicle and a weapon, clear street barriers, and fight a wanted man. The whole game is played with the mouse.
tips: Look at your vehicle and weapon choices before you start, and pick a combination that suits how you like to play, whether that is speed or firepower.
Pay attention to the barriers ahead so you can deal with them in time instead of reacting at the last moment.
Keep your mouse movements steady and controlled, since the mouse is your only input and sudden jerky moves can cost you position.
Save your strongest weapon for the fight with the wanted man, and use your weaker options on the smaller obstacles along the way.
Play a few rounds to learn how your chosen vehicle handles, then adjust your approach to the road ahead.
faq: What is the goal of Fastlane: Road to Revenge?
Your goal is to race down the street, clear the barriers, and fight the most fierce and cruel wanted man. Speed and combat both matter.
What controls does the game use?
The game is played entirely with the mouse. Use it to steer and to take actions during the race and the fight.

school-of-basketball.intro: School Of Basketball is a shooting arcade game with three modes: Arcade, Time Attack and Distance. Each mode rewards accurate throws in a different way, so your approach should change with the mode you pick.
tips: In Arcade mode you only have 10 balls, so do not rush. Take a moment to line up each throw, because every miss costs you a ball.
In Arcade mode the shots get harder each time you score, so expect the difficulty to climb and stay steady rather than hurrying.
In Time Attack mode you have unlimited balls but limited time, so focus on making quick, accurate throws rather than spending seconds on each one.
In Distance mode, push your shot distance only when you are confident, since a miss shortens the distance and you must keep it above zero to avoid game over.
Watch how your throws land and adjust your aim after each attempt. Small corrections make a big difference when you are trying to make consecutive baskets.
faq: What is the goal of School Of Basketball?
Score as many baskets as you can in the mode you choose. Arcade, Time Attack and Distance each measure success in a different way.
How do I throw the ball?
Touch and drag anywhere on the screen to throw a ball. Release to send it toward the basket.

bobr-turbo-craft-cars.intro: Bobr Turbo: Craft Cars is an arcade builder where you assemble a fighting machine from blocks, then watch it battle in automatic arena showdowns. Your build decides the outcome.
tips: Start by placing the blocks that hold your machine together, so the frame stays solid before you add weapons and boosters.
Balance your build. A machine with heavy weapons but weak structure may fall apart fast once the fight begins.
Upgrade the parts you already use before crafting new ones, so your strongest pieces become tougher, faster, or more destructive.
Open chests when you can and check what they give you, since new loot can change which blocks and weapons are worth using.
Because fights run automatically, test your design in a few battles and adjust the layout based on where it takes damage.
faq: How do I start building my machine?
Use the left mouse button on PC or touch the screen on a phone to pick blocks from your inventory and place them. Keep adding pieces until you have a complete fighting machine.
Can I control my machine during a battle?
No. Fighting takes place automatically, so the outcome depends on how you built and upgraded your machine before the arena showdown.

hide-and-luig.intro: Hide and Luig is a point-and-click hide-and-seek puzzle where you search playful scenes to find Luig, who hides inside unusual objects. Click around each scene carefully to uncover where he is hiding.
tips: Scan each scene slowly before clicking, since Luig's hiding spots can be small or blend into the background.
Pay attention to objects that look out of place or oddly shaped, because Luig tends to hide inside unexpected things.
Click on suspicious items to see whether they react, as a hiding spot may only reveal itself after a click.
If you get stuck, try revisiting areas you already checked, because a fresh look often reveals details you missed the first time.
Work through the scene in a consistent pattern, such as left to right, so you do not skip any part of the picture.
faq: What is the goal of Hide and Luig?
Your only goal is to find Luig in each scene. He keeps hiding inside strange objects, so you need to look closely at everything around you.
How do I control the game?
You play with mouse clicks or taps. Click on objects in the scene to explore and check whether Luig is hiding inside them.

bounce-ball-hook.intro: Bounce Ball Hook is a ball game built around timing and precision. You guide the ball through tricky levels, bouncing and hooking to collect stars while keeping it from falling.
tips: Study each obstacle before you commit to a move, since the levels reward careful timing over rushing.
Plan your hooks ahead so the ball is already moving toward the next star rather than reacting after it has drifted.
Treat every bounce as a setup for the next one, and avoid bounces that send the ball toward a dangerous drop.
Go for stars that are on your route first, then take detours only when the ball is stable and you have room to recover.
If a level keeps ending in a fall, slow down and repeat the section, focusing on one obstacle at a time.
faq: What is the main goal in Bounce Ball Hook?
Guide the ball through each level, collect stars to raise your score, and keep the ball from falling.
How is the score earned?
Your score goes up as you collect stars, so grabbing them while staying on course is the main way to improve.

asphalt-legend.intro: Asphalt Legend is a 3D driving simulation with racing elements. You drive famous sports cars and complete missions to earn new vehicles for your garage.
tips: Use the WASD keys to steer and control speed, and practice smooth inputs so the car stays stable on turns.
Pay attention to the mission goals before each run so you know what counts toward unlocking a new car.
Take a few laps or runs to learn how each sports car handles before attempting harder missions.
Avoid sudden steering changes at high speed, since they can throw the car off line and cost you time.
Replay missions you nearly finished, because small improvements in driving often make the difference.
faq: How do I move the car?
Use the W, A, S and D keys to drive. The game uses these keys to move the car.
How do I earn new cars?
Complete missions to earn the sports cars you want to add to your garage.

mantis-clicker.intro: Mantis Clicker is a clicking game where your taps multiply mantis coins. You spend your coins on upgrades and skins that raise your gains over time.
tips: Keep clicking steadily from the start, since every tap adds to your mantis coin total and builds the base for everything else.
Check the upgrade options regularly and compare what each one does for your gains before you spend your coins.
Look at the skins as well, because the game says they can boost your gains, so they are not only for looks.
Buy upgrades that raise your gains per tap or per second first, so your coin total grows faster for the rest of the run.
Come back to the game often to see how far your coin total has grown, and use each new boost to reach the next one sooner.
faq: What is the main goal in Mantis Clicker?
The main goal is to grow your mantis coin total by clicking and to dominate the mantis universe through upgrades and skins that boost your gains.
How do I earn coins?
You earn mantis coins by tapping or clicking, and the game says your taps multiply the coins you collect.

spooky-racing.intro: Spooky Racing is a Halloween kart race in 3D. You pick a classic monster, race through spooky tracks, and use items and drift boosts to win gold trophies in the Grand Prix.
tips: Drift to build up boosts, since drifting charges blue, orange and purple boost levels you can spend on the straights.
Keep an eye on item boxes and save your item for the moment it matters most, such as when a rival is just ahead of you.
Learn the track layouts. Knowing where the turns and open stretches are in the pumpkin patches, swamps, ghost town and vampire castle helps you plan your drifts.
Use Boost on straight sections where you are not turning, so you get the most speed from it.
Work through the Grand Prix one difficulty at a time, from 50cc upward, so you learn how each track handles before moving to harder cups.
faq: What is the goal of Spooky Racing?
Race through the tracks in the Grand Prix and finish high enough to win gold trophies.
How do I use boosts and items on desktop?
Press Up or W, or Shift, to boost. Press E or Enter to use an item. Drift with Space to charge boosts.

destruction-simulator.intro: Destruction Simulator is a physics sandbox where you blow up buildings with a range of explosives, weapons and natural disasters. Pick a prebuilt map or build your own, then experiment with time, gravity and effects.
tips: Slow the simulation down before a big blast so you can see how debris, walls and floors fall apart and which supports give way first.
Turn off or reduce explosion visuals when debris is hard to see, keeping only smoke or flashes so the wreckage stays readable.
Use the debris limit option when the scene gets crowded, so older pieces fade out smoothly and the game keeps running well.
Raise the destructibility level if a building barely breaks, and lower it if you want more controlled, gradual damage.
Try the same map with different gravity settings, including off, to compare how far and how fast the debris moves.
faq: How do I rotate the camera on a computer?
Press and hold the left mouse button and swipe across the screen to rotate the view. Use WASD to move around and Q and E to raise the camera.
What can I use to destroy buildings?
The game offers about 13 different explosives such as missiles, dynamites and bombs, plus earthquakes, tornadoes, singularities and cannon balls of different sizes.

schoolboy-escape-runaway.intro: Schoolboy Escape: Runaway is a stealth adventure where you sneak through a locked house, avoid your parents, and use clever tricks to get out and reach your friends.
tips: Stop and listen before you move. Footsteps and rustles tell you where your parents are heading, so wait for the sound to fade before crossing a room.
Use the camera to check corners and doorways before stepping into them. Knowing what is ahead lets you choose a safer path.
Explore each part of the house carefully. Clues found in rooms can help you work out how to get past obstacles later.
Keep your distance and hide when a parent gets close. Getting noticed is the main way to fall behind, so slow down near them.
Press R for a hint when you are stuck, but try a few ideas first. Pausing with P lets you think through your next move without pressure.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You need to sneak out of your locked home without being caught by your parents and reach your friends outside.
How do I move and look around?
On desktop, use WASD to move and the mouse to rotate the camera. On mobile, use the joystick to move and swipe the screen to rotate the camera.

fleet-merge.intro: Fleet Merge is an auto-battler where you buy starships, merge identical ones into stronger tiers, and arrange them in a dock before the battle plays out on its own. Reading the enemy on the radar is the key to placing the right counters.
tips: Check the radar before you arrange your dock, then place a counter in front of each enemy type you see.
Keep Artillery in the back row, since it is the ship type that needs protection from the front line.
Merge ships as soon as you have two identical ones of the same tier, because a higher tier ship is stronger than two lower ones.
Use the counter triangle to plan: Line ships against Lancers, Lancers against Artillery, and Artillery against Line ships.
Position Lancers where they can attack from the side or behind, since those angles give them extra damage.
faq: How do I win a battle in Fleet Merge?
Build and arrange your fleet so the right counters face each enemy, then press FIGHT and let the automatic battle play out. Earning three stars in every sector is the goal of the Star Map.
What does the top row of my dock do?
The top row is your front line, so ships placed there take the first contact with the enemy. Place your sturdier counters there and keep Artillery further back.

splatcha.intro: Splatcha! is a fast territorial paint duel where two blobby rivals fight for floor in a 90-second round. The player who covers the most of the arena wins.
tips: Hold the paint button early and keep moving, since painting happens automatically while you hold it and the round is only 90 seconds.
Spread your paint across open floor first so you claim territory before your rival does.
Grab power-ups when they are close to your path, and keep an eye on where they appear so you can reach them before your rival.
Use the dash to cut across a gap or escape a corner, rather than running in a straight line that your rival can predict.
Try the 1-player bot on an easier difficulty first to learn how the paint spreads, then move up to harder levels.
faq: How do you win a round of Splatcha!?
The round lasts 90 seconds, and the player who covers the most of the floor when time runs out wins.
What are the controls for Player 1 and Player 2?
Player 1 moves with WASD and dashes with SPACE, while Player 2 moves with the arrow keys and dashes with 0 or ENTER. Gamepads are also supported.

2048-rush-multiplayer.intro: 2048 Rush is a nine-player race to build a 2048 tile on a shared-style 5x7 board. Every merge you make also sends a blocker tile to your rivals, so fast climbing doubles as attack.
tips: Watch the live scoreboard closely, since the lowest scorer is knocked out every 60 seconds. Staying above the bottom group matters as much as chasing the top.
Build vertical matches first, because a merge only starts from a vertical match. Plan your shots so the new block lands where a chain can grow.
Look for sideways equal tiles before you shoot. The cascade takes every connected equal tile, so a well-placed shot can clear a lot at once.
Keep an eye on your board height. If it tops out you can watch a rewarded ad to clear a column, but otherwise you are eliminated, so keep space open.

Remember that each merge sends a blocker to all eight rivals, and the cooldown between those blockers grows through the match. Push your merges early when they are less frequent and you can still build a lead.
faq: What is the goal of 2048 Rush?
Be the first player to build a 2048 tile. Reaching it wins the race and ends the match for everyone else.
