How do I shoot a block onto the board?
Aim with the mouse or your finger, then tap or click to drop the next numbered block onto the 5x7 board.

spooky-boxing.intro: Spooky Boxing is a Halloween-themed boxing game set in a haunted ring. You pick one of 12 monsters, fight through spooky arenas, and unlock each fighter's comic ending.
tips: Mix your jabs, crosses and charged uppercuts instead of repeating one attack, so opponents have a harder time guessing your next move.
Hold guard when an enemy is about to attack, and dodge when you see a big swing coming so you can counter while they recover.
Save the charged uppercut for openings rather than throwing it at random, since a mistimed big punch leaves you exposed.
Use movement to keep distance and reset the fight when you are under pressure, then step back in with attacks.
When you are knocked down, tap repeatedly to get back up quickly, and keep an eye on the fight so you are ready when you rise.
faq: How do I move and attack in Spooky Boxing?
On desktop, use A and D or the Left and Right arrows to move, and press J for jab, K for cross, and L for uppercut. On mobile, use the on-screen buttons.
How do I guard and dodge?
Hold S or Down to guard, and press Z to dodge. On mobile, hold the guard button and tap the dodge button.

zombie-siege.intro: Zombie Siege puts you on the last line of defense in a fallen city. Rescue survivors, build a squad, and push through the horde as it grows tougher level by level.
tips: Rescue survivors early so your squad forms before the waves get heavy. Each role covers a different job: the shield tank holds the front, the sharpshooter supports from your side, and the medic stays in the back.
Keep your escort moving toward the safe zone rather than clearing every zombie in sight. Survivors you are protecting need to reach the end.
Save bombs for crowds or towering zombie kings instead of using them on a few stragglers. Kills drop bombs, so pick moments when a large group is closing in.
Watch for medkits dropped by kills and grab them when your health runs low. Dashing out of a crowd can buy you the space to reach them.
Bosses drop permanent upgrades, so take on their fights with your squad in position. Those upgrades carry into the rest of your run, which makes them worth the risk.
faq: What is the goal of Zombie Siege?
Survive the zombie horde while rescuing trapped survivors and escorting them to the safe zone. The game asks how far you can survive, so the longer you last, the better.
How do I move and attack?

On desktop, use WASD or the arrow keys to move, and your weapon fires automatically when zombies get close. On mobile in landscape, use the left stick to move and tap the buttons for bombs and dashes.

wrench-and-roll.intro: Wrench and Roll is a garage puzzle where you tap crates, send them to a workbench, and merge matching sets to repair rusty cars across 120 levels. Each level helps restore a wreck.
tips: Before tapping, look at which crates are connected to the open road, since only those can be sent to your workbench.
Your workbench holds just 6 crates, so avoid sending a crate that doesn't match something already there unless you have no better choice.
Clear the crates around padlocked plates and blocked paths early, because they open up more options for the rest of the level.
Save bomb crates for steel plates that are blocking your way, and check what is around a steel plate before you use one.
Keep the Magnet, Rewind, and Hammer boosters for moments when you are stuck, so you have a way out when the workbench fills up.
faq: What is the main goal of each level?
Tap crates, send them to the workbench, and merge 3 matching crates to create repair parts for the car. Each level helps fix part of a car.
How many stars can I earn?
You can earn up to 3 stars for each completed level. Complete levels and repair cars to collect them.

nitro-racing-gear.intro: Nitro Racing Gear is a high-speed arcade racer with 40 stages across eight worlds. You can race, sprint, drift, and drag duel your way toward the final championship.
tips: Learn the mode before you start, since drag mode uses Space to shift gears while race and drift modes use Space for nitro.
Save your nitro boost for straight roads or the moment you exit a corner, when it will add the most speed.
Upgrade your car in the garage as you unlock new ones, and pick the setup that suits the kind of event you are entering.
Use gentle steering with A and D or the arrow keys on tight turns so you keep your speed instead of sliding off the track.
In drift challenges, ease off the throttle with W or Up Arrow to control your slide, and use the pause key P to reset your focus if a stage gets busy.
faq: What is the goal of Nitro Racing Gear?
Your goal is to win races, sprints, drift challenges, and drag duels across 40 stages, working toward the final championship.
How do I use nitro?
Press Space to use nitro in race and drift modes, or press N to use it. Timing your boost well matters more than using it constantly.

the-aesthetic-world-of-obby.intro: The Aesthetic World of Obby is a parkour adventure set in an open world with 10 locations. You jump across colored platforms, complete obby courses, and customize your character's look.
tips: Use Shift for acceleration on long, flat stretches, then ease off before a jump so you can land on small platforms.
Check the camera with the mouse before each jump so you can see where the next platform sits.
Practice short hops on easier platforms first, then try longer jumps once your timing feels steady.
Press Tab to browse the 72 customization options when you want to change your look, and use E for any interactions in the world.
The music is optional, so turn it down or off if you find it distracting while you focus on jumps.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Complete the parkour levels by jumping across colored platforms in each of the 10 locations. There is no traditional leveling system, so success depends on skill and agility.
What is the money used for?
Money can be spent on skins and clothing items to customize your obby character.

flock-fence.intro: Flock Fence is a cozy logic puzzle where you draw fences around your sheepdog to protect the flock from wolves. Plan a closed pen that holds as many tiles and sheep as you can.
tips: Before placing fences, look at which sheep you can afford to leave out, since you only have a limited number of fences.
Check the whole outline of your pen before finishing, because a single gap lets the wolves in.
Tap a fence again to remove it if a better route becomes clear, so you can adjust without restarting the level.
If you are stuck, use the Hint button to reveal one fence from the best answer, then build the rest of the pen from there. Hints still allow 3 stars.
On the Daily Puzzle, take your time planning, since you only get one sunset to solve it.
faq: What is the goal of Flock Fence?
Close a pen around your sheepdog so the wolves cannot get in. Each tile inside the pen scores a point, and each sheep you keep safe adds extra points.
How do I finish a level?
Reach the goal score and night falls automatically. You can also press DONE to end early, but you will earn fewer stars.

bubble-word-jam.intro: Bubble Word Jam is a word puzzle where you pop and merge word bubbles to find a hidden theme and sort every word. Each level has a goal to reach before your moves run out.
tips: Before you merge anything, scan the board for the hidden category so your first pairs point toward the same group.
Pairs that clearly share a theme, like two animal words, are usually better moves than pairs you are unsure about.
Keep track of how many moves you have left and work out which merges reach the level goal in the fewest moves.
Save your boosters for blockers such as locks, ice and screws, since those can stop progress on the board.
There is no time limit, so take a moment to study the board before each tap.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Merge bubbles to reach the level goal before you run out of moves. Clearing the goal wins the level and lets you progress on the map.
How do I merge bubbles?
Tap or click two bubbles with related words, such as DOG and CAT for ANIMALS, to merge them.

solitaire-the-eternal-deck.intro: Solitaire: The Eternal Deck is a classic card solitaire game where you build each suit from ace to king on four foundation piles. Tap or drag cards, use undo freely, and think through each move.
tips: Favor moves that reveal face-down cards, since new cards give you more options to work with.
Before moving a card to a foundation pile, check whether it is needed to build a sequence on the playing field, and keep it there if so.
Use the undo feature to test a line of play. If a move leaves you with no useful options, step back and try a different one.
Don't empty a column just for the sake of it. A column with a king at the top can only be filled by another king, so keep empty spaces for kings you need to place.
Look for a chance to play a card onto the playing field before sending it to a foundation pile, since that earns bonus points.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Move all cards into the four foundation piles, one for each suit, building each pile in order from ace to king.
Which cards can go into an empty space on the playing field?
Only a king can be placed on an empty space. Other cards must wait until a king is placed there first.

car-smash-simulator-crash-and-tune.intro: Car Smash Simulator is a crash-focused driving sandbox where you smash cars, use destruction tools, and tune your rides. This guide covers controls and habits that help you get more out of each crash.
tips: Use B for slow motion when a crash happens fast, so you can see which parts are breaking and plan your next hit.
Keep K in mind for repairs. Repairing between smashes lets you keep testing the same car's damage instead of starting over with a wrecked vehicle.
Use Space for the handbrake to slide your car into turns and line up hits on hammers, crushers, or ramps.
Try the camera switch with C to change your view. A different angle can make it easier to judge where a wheel or door will fly off.
If your car lands upside down or gets stuck, press R to flip it back over and keep going without losing time.
faq: How do I drive the car?
Use the WASD keys to drive, Space for the handbrake, and Shift for nitro. On mobile devices, use the on-screen buttons instead.
How do I fix my car after it gets damaged?
Press K to repair the car. You can use it between crashes to reset your vehicle and try a new smash.

catch-a-fish-obby.intro: Catch a Fish Obby is a two-player collecting game set in a bright obby world. Build a coin-producing fish base, steal from rivals, and defend your own tank from bots and other players.
tips: Your fish earn coins while you move around the map, so keep moving between tasks instead of standing still.
Spend coins on stronger fish early, since each fish's coin rate depends on its rarity tier and better fish compound your income.
Check rival bases for their best fish before sneaking in, and pick a moment when your own tank is well guarded.
In 2 Player mode, agree with your partner on who buys and who steals, because both players share one device and can get in each other's way.
Save some coins for event and ticket machine rolls when you can afford them, since Mythic and Omega fish come from those draws.
faq: How do I earn coins in Catch a Fish Obby?
Every fish you own generates coins over time, and the amount depends on its rarity tier. Moving around the map while you own fish keeps your coins coming in.
How do I steal fish from other bases?
Sneak into a rival base and use the Buy or Steal key to take their fish. Player 1 uses E and Player 2 uses O.

wacky-strike.intro: Wacky Strike is a tower defense battle where you pick the boys or the girls side, build your forces, and push across the map to destroy the enemy castle.
tips: Claim ground between the two castles as you advance, since holding territory is what moves your front line forward.
Mix your unit purchases with your base building so your castle stays protected while your troops march out.
Save powerups from keys 8, 9, and 0 for moments when the enemy has grouped up, so their effect counts most.
Use the left and right arrow keys to scroll the map and check both the front line and your castle before spending.
Keep an eye on your upgrades and air strikes, and use them to break enemy defenses before sending your main army in.
faq: What is the goal of Wacky Strike?
Your goal is to march from your castle across the map, claim ground in between, and destroy the enemy castle as quickly as you can.
How do I build units and base structures?
Press keys 1 to 4 to build units and keys 5 to 7 to build base structures. You can also use the mouse to control the game.

merge-fruit-characters.intro: Merge Fruit Characters is a physics puzzle where you drop fruits into a glass and combine matching pairs to grow them into new fruit characters. Plan your drops carefully, because one fruit falling out ends the game.
tips: Keep the largest fruits near the bottom and place smaller ones on top, so the glass stays stable as it fills.
Hold and move to use the laser sight when you need a precise drop, and use a quick click when the spot is already clear.
Save the Multicolor bonus for a fruit that has no matching partner nearby, since it merges with any fruit.
Use Magnet to pull out a fruit that is blocking a merge, rather than waiting for the pile to shift on its own.
Check your daily quests and spin the wheel of fortune regularly, since the rewards can give you bonuses to use later.
faq: How do I end up losing the game?
The game ends if even one fruit falls out of the glass. Keep the pile controlled and avoid placing fruits near the rim.
How do I aim my drops?
A quick click throws a fruit straight down. Holding and moving the pointer activates a laser sight for more accurate placement.

obby-online-with-friends-draw-and-jump.intro: Obby Online with Friends mixes parkour jumping with drawing your own platforms. You can practice alone or team up and compete with other players online. Learn the controls first, then take on the puzzles together.
tips: Start in single-player mode to get comfortable with jumping and drawing before you join a multiplayer game.
Before you draw a platform, look at where you need to land. Plan the line so your character can reach it in one jump.
Use the eraser to remove a line that blocks your path or traps you, instead of trying to jump around it.
In multiplayer, talk with your team about who draws which part of a puzzle so you don't cover each other's lines.
Check the leaderboard to see how you compare, and use it as a goal to improve your parkour timing.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
You complete obstacle courses and solve logic puzzles by jumping and drawing platforms to get past traps. You can do this alone or with other players.
How do I draw and erase lines?
On a computer, hold the left mouse button and move the mouse to draw or erase. On a smartphone, swipe your finger across the screen.

sniper-for-brainrots.intro: Sniper for Brainrots is a shooting and survival game where you hit balloons to collect Brainrots and race a tsunami to the Safe Zone. This guide covers how to balance long shots, speed, and your escape.
tips: Each shot at a balloon above a Brainrot turns you into it, so aim carefully before you fire. A clean hit is worth more time than a fast, wild shot.
Long shots give rarer Brainrots, but the wave speeds up as you shoot farther. Decide before each shot whether the reward is worth the tighter escape.
Use Scope (F or Right Mouse Button) to line up distant balloons. Zoom with the mouse wheel to check your aim before shooting.
Sprint with Shift when you need to reach the Safe Zone quickly. Save your sprint for the moments when the tsunami is closing in.
Press Q to upgrade your Brainrot and T to open the Rebirth Menu when you are ready to check your progress. Keep an eye on your Base and collection as you go.
faq: What is the main goal of Sniper for Brainrots?
Hit the balloon above a Brainrot to transform into it, then reach the Safe Zone before the tsunami catches you. Each successful shot unlocks a new Brainrot for your collection.
Why does shooting farther matter?
The farther you shoot, the rarer the Brainrot you can collect. However, the wave also becomes faster, so you have less time to escape.

rocket-clash-3d.intro: Rocket Clash 3D is a 3D shooter where you lead a resistance squad defending a missile base from enemy agents. Move through underground tunnels, avoid toxic fuel pools, and use your rifle and a hidden secret weapon.
tips: Learn the movement keys early: WASD to move, C to crouch, and SPACE to jump. Practising jumps and crouches in open areas will make tight tunnel sections easier.
Watch the floor for acid pools of toxic rocket fuel and jump over or route around them rather than running through them.
Explore the underground tunnel network carefully, since the level rewards players who look around rather than rushing straight through.
Look for the secret weapon hidden in the depths of the level and save it for tougher fights where your standard rifle may not be enough.
Use crouching to lower your profile when you need to reposition or wait for an opening, and keep moving rather than standing still in one spot.
faq: What is the goal of Rocket Clash 3D?
You lead a resistance squad that must stop enemy intelligence agents from taking control of the missile base. Fight through the level and push back the attackers.
What are the controls?
Use WASD to move, C to crouch, and SPACE to jump. Shooting controls are not listed in the instructions, so check the in-game prompts when you start.

english-checkers-online-multiplayer.intro: English Checkers Online Multiplayer is a two-player board game where you capture your opponent's checkers or block them in. You can play against a computer engine at 10 difficulty levels, against real players online, or with a friend on the same screen.
tips: Before each move, check whether any capture is available, since jumps are mandatory and you must take one when it exists.
Keep your checkers together in a group rather than spreading them out, so that a single opponent jump is less likely to leave you open.
Try to keep a few checkers on your back row for as long as you can, which makes it harder for your opponent to crown a king.
Use the possible-moves display to look a step ahead, especially before you move a checker that could be jumped on the next turn.
After a match, open the game analysis and the move history to find the moves where you lost material, then replay those positions.
faq: How do I win a game of English Checkers?
You win by capturing all of your opponent's checkers or by blocking them so they have no legal move left. Keep track of how many pieces each side has during the game.
What happens if I have more than one capture available?
You must capture, but you can choose which of the available jumps to make. If a capture leads to another capture, you must keep jumping as long as you can.

yummy-shelf.intro: Yummy Shelf is a relaxing 3D puzzle where you tap sets of three identical food items to clear them from the shelves. Clear every shelf before the timer runs out to win each level.
tips: Before tapping, look over the whole shelf and find which items have a matching pair or trio that is easy to reach.
Plan your moves so you do not leave single items stuck under others; clearing top items first often opens up the ones below.
Save your boosters for tricky layouts. Use Hint when you cannot spot a match, and Freeze when the timer is getting low and you need more room to think.
Use Shuffle only when every remaining option looks blocked, since it changes the layout and may not help right away.
Keep an eye on the timer from the start of each level so you are not rushing the final shelves.
faq: What is the goal of Yummy Shelf?
The goal is to tap and remove matching sets of three identical food items and clear all items from the shelves before the timer expires.
How do I match items?
Tap three identical food items to match and remove them from the shelves. Only three identical items can be cleared together.

sunny-bay-heroes.intro: Sunny Bay Heroes is a 3D open-city arcade game where you drive, fly and sail around a seaside town to stop Baron Rust's Grand Race plot. Story missions, side jobs and stunts keep you busy between races.
tips: Use the city map (M or Tab) to plan a route between story missions and nearby side jobs so you spend less time driving aimlessly.
Spend coins on the turbo and the coin magnet in the SHOP early, since both make collecting coin trails and bonus coins faster.
Aim for the stunt ramps and close calls, because big air and slow-motion jumps are a reliable way to earn bonus coins.
Check the daily gift each time you play, as it can give you a brand-new car on certain days.
Call your favourite ride with C when you need a vehicle quickly, rather than walking across the city to find one.
faq: How do I pull a goon out of a getaway van?
Walk up to the driver's van and press E or Enter to pull them out. You can then soak them with the water blaster or foam bat.
What is the fastest way to earn coins?
Stunt ramps, close calls and big air give bonus coins, and coin trails add more as you go. Spending time on these between missions is a good way to build up funds for the SHOP.

i-get-you.intro: I Get You is a troll platformer where the level itself is your opponent. Its floors, walls and doors set traps, and every death reveals a new trick. Clear 40 levels across two corridors.
tips: Watch the level before you move. Eyes, yawns, goosebumps and other body signs often hint at the trap that is coming.
Use the hold jump when you need extra height. A short tap and a held press cover different distances, so decide which one the gap needs.
Treat each death as information. Note what killed you and change your approach on the next attempt instead of repeating the same move.
Keep your levels short in mind. Respawn is instant, so restart quickly and test a new route rather than sitting on a failed one.
Use R to restart when you are stuck in a bad position, and use P or Esc to pause if you need a moment to plan your next jump.
faq: What is the goal of I Get You?
Reach the end of each short level to delete it. Beat all 40 levels across the two corridors to finish the game.
Do beaten levels stay gone?
Beaten levels are deleted, but the game says the deleted ones come back and they are angry. Expect them to be harder to read.

hex-hamlet.intro: Hex Hamlet is a cozy 3D village builder where you clear a forested island, grow a small camp into a castle, and sail on to the next island. Each island has its own weather and challenges.
tips: Keep your pointer moving along the forest edge so you chop continuously, and clear the trees closest to your settlement first so your buildings have room to grow.
Hire villagers early, since they chop and carry wood without you, which frees your pointer for the trees that are harder to reach.
Before placing a building, check which neighbours it will sit beside, because the bonuses depend on putting the right buildings next to each other.
Upgrade buildings you already own by clicking them instead of always spending on new ones, which can be a cheaper way to strengthen your village.
Read the island's three goals before you start, then plan your build order around them so you can aim for all three stars rather than just finishing the island.
faq: How do I chop trees?
Move the mouse over the edge of the forest and the trees are chopped without clicking. Villagers you hire at the town hall will also chop and carry wood home on their own.
What do I need to finish an island and move on?
Clear every tree, build the ship on the beach, and set sail to the next island. Completing the island's three goals earns you up to three stars.

1-speed-escape-school.intro: Escape a school full of moving platforms, traps, and an evil teacher while your speed builds with every section you clear. This guide covers controls, upgrades, and habits that help you go further.
tips: Spend time in the main hub on upgrades early, since the treadmill raises your speed and the punching bag raises your energy.
Keep your camera rotated so you can see the next platform before you commit to a jump, especially as the levels speed up.
Slow down your planning rather than your movement: study a tricky section once, then run it with a clear route in mind.
Look for secret paths in each level, because they can offer a different route past traps and dangerous obstacles.
Check the leaderboard after a few runs to see where you stand, and use the times to set a specific escape record to beat.
faq: How do I move and jump on PC?
Use WASD or the arrow keys to move, the Space bar to jump, and hold the right mouse button to rotate the camera.
How does my speed increase?
You gain +1 to your speed with each section you complete, and you can also raise it with the treadmill in the main hub.

voxelbomb.intro: VoxelBomb is a 3D demolition puzzle where you place dynamite on voxel buildings and set off chain reactions to bring every structure below the red line. Fewer charges earn more stars.
tips: Before placing anything, look at how the building is held up and which supports, if removed, would bring the most of it down.
Use fewer charges to earn more stars. Right click to retrieve a charge you placed in the wrong spot so you can reuse it.
Try a few different demolition tools on the same structure to learn their effects, since you can unlock and upgrade ten tools.
Detonate in stages rather than all at once, and check where the debris has landed before placing your next charges.
After finishing a level, sandbox mode lets you keep experimenting with chain reactions without the star goal, which is a good way to test new ideas.
faq: What is the goal of VoxelBomb?
Your goal is to bring every structure in the level below the red line. Each level is completed when all buildings are brought below that line.
How do I place and detonate dynamite?
On desktop, left click on a wall to place dynamite and press E to detonate. On mobile, tap a wall to place dynamite and tap BOOM to set it off.

tactical-response-team.intro: Tactical Response Team puts you in the role of an elite marksman providing long-range support. You zoom in, pick out high-value targets, and take shots that keep your pinned teammates alive.
tips: Use right click to aim before you fire so you can check the target through the scope rather than shooting from the hip.
Scan the area with the mouse before committing to a shot, and prioritize the threats that could eliminate your teammates first.
Adjust your zoom with the scroll wheel to find a level that lets you see the whole area at a distance and still pick out small targets.
Be patient between shots. Waiting for the right moment to fire matters more than shooting quickly.
Each shot counts, so avoid wasting them on targets that are not an immediate danger to your team.
faq: What is the main goal of Tactical Response Team?
Your goal is to neutralize high-value targets and suppress hostile forces before they can eliminate your pinned teammates. Precision and timing decide how well you do.
How do I aim and shoot?
Move the mouse to look around, hold right click to aim, and left click to shoot. Use the mouse scroll wheel to zoom in or out.

mike-lost-in-desert-hidden-object.intro: Mike Lost in Desert is a hidden object adventure where you help Mike find his way out of the desert. You have about 8 minutes to search five locations and find 10 objects in each one.
tips: Keep an eye on the clock from the start, since you have about 8 minutes for all five locations. Glance at it briefly after each area so you know how much time you can spend on the next one.
Scan each scene in a systematic pattern, such as left to right or top to bottom, so you don't miss objects you have already passed over.
Look for items that are partly hidden, unusually shaped, or out of place in the desert setting, since hidden objects often blend into the painted backgrounds.
Don't linger on one object you can't spot. Move on to the others in the scene and come back to the difficult ones, because the time limit applies to the whole run.
Stay calm and focused. The desert atmosphere is designed to feel tense, so slowing your search pace and checking each corner of the scene usually works better than rushing.
faq: What is the main goal of Mike Lost in Desert?
Your goal is to help Mike escape the desert by finding all 10 hidden objects in each of the five locations before the roughly 8-minute timer runs out.
What happens if the time runs out?
If the time ends before you finish all five locations, the bandits catch Mike and the run is lost.

fresh-drop-triple-match.intro: Fresh Drop: Triple Match is a 3D puzzle game about collecting sets of three identical products and clearing the board before the timer runs out. Each level adds new obstacles and boosters to work with.
tips: Before each tap, look at which products are uncovered and which are stacked underneath, so you pick items that free up the rest of the board.
Keep an eye on the tray. Sending an item there that has no matching pair yet can fill slots quickly and end the level early.
Try to finish a match of three as soon as you have one available, so the tray stays clear for the next products you send over.
Save boosters for levels that feel stuck. Using one early can leave you without help when the board gets harder.
Watch the timer as you go. If the board is getting crowded, slow down and check for matches before tapping again.
faq: What is the goal of Fresh Drop: Triple Match?
Your goal is to remove every product from the board before the timer expires. You do this by collecting three identical products in the tray.
How do I play with the mouse?
Use the left mouse button to click an available product and send it to the tray. Clicking a product that is covered or blocked is not possible until it is uncovered.

2048-merge-blocks.intro: Merge Puzzle is a number merging game based on 2048. You tap connected tiles with matching numbers to combine them into higher values and reach a target or set a high score.
tips: Before you tap, look for the largest group of matching tiles, since the merge formula rewards connecting more tiles with bigger values.
Remember that tiles connect diagonally as well as horizontally and vertically, so check diagonal groups when scanning the board.
In level mode, count your remaining moves against the target tile shown at the top, and plan merges that move you toward it.
Save Undo for when a move goes wrong, and use Hammer or Shuffle only when the board is truly stuck.
Watch for chain reactions after tiles fall, because a merge can create new matching groups you did not expect.
faq: How do I merge tiles?
Tap any numbered tile to highlight all connected tiles with the same number, then tap again to merge them into one higher-value tile.
What do the power-ups do?
Undo takes back your last move, Hammer removes any single tile from the board, and Shuffle rearranges all the tiles.

ski-king-2022.intro: Ski King 2022 is a sports game where you ski down slopes, collect coins, and dodge obstacles while an avalanche chases you. Upgrading your skills helps you go further.
tips: Keep an eye on the avalanche behind you and make sure you stay ahead of it, since escaping it is part of the challenge.
Look ahead on the slope so you can spot obstacles early and steer around them instead of reacting at the last moment.
Pick up coins when you can do so safely, but do not risk a crash just to grab one.
Spend the coins you collect on upgrades to your skills, and choose the ones that help you most with dodging and staying ahead.
Play a few runs in a row to learn how the controls respond, since the game is built around intuitive movement.
faq: What is the main goal in Ski King 2022?
You ski down the slopes, dodge obstacles, and escape the avalanche while collecting coins. The game challenges you to become the Ski King.
What do I do with the coins I collect?
You use coins to upgrade your skills. Better skills can make it easier to handle the slopes and the challenges ahead.

loaf-clicker.intro: Loaf Clicker is a strategy puzzle where each click adds loaves to your inventory. Invest in automatic generators and upgrades to grow your bread empire and earn achievements.
tips: Keep clicking early on, since your manual clicks build the loaves you need to buy your first automatic generators.
Buy generators as soon as you can afford them, because automatic production keeps your inventory growing while you are away from the game.
Compare upgrades before spending. Choose the ones that boost your loaf production most, rather than buying whatever is cheapest.
Check your achievements list now and then to see which goals are close, and let them guide what you invest in next.
Balance your spending between clicking-focused upgrades and generators so that your growth does not stall at one stage.
faq: What is the main goal of Loaf Clicker?
The goal is to grow your loaf inventory by clicking, investing in automatic generators and strategic upgrades, and unlocking achievements along the way.
Should I spend loaves on generators or upgrades first?
Generators give you steady automatic gains, so they are usually a good early investment. Upgrades are most useful once you can see which ones multiply your current production.

warehouse-wobble-3d.intro: Drive a forklift through busy warehouses, balancing wobbly loads like boxes, TVs and barrels, and deliver them to the green zone in one piece. Tipping, sliding and collisions are the main risks.
tips: Ease off the throttle before corners, since taking a turn too fast is the quickest way to send cargo flying.
Brake gently with Shift rather than stopping hard, because a sudden stop can topple a tall stack.
Watch how each load sways and leans before you move, and slow down early if a stack looks unstable.
Plan your route around patrol robots and roller doors so you are not forced to stop or swerve at the last second.
On icy floors, make small steering inputs and avoid sharp turns, as the forklift will slide more easily.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You need to pick up your cargo and drive it to the green delivery zone without letting it tip over. Your performance affects how many stars you earn.
How do I earn stars and coins?
You can earn up to 3 stars per level, and coins are collected along the way. Keeping your cargo intact and collecting coins are the main ways to improve your results.

hop-ballz-3d.intro: Hop Ballz 3D is a one-player arcade rhythm game where you keep a bouncing ball landing on music tiles in time with the beat. Miss a tile and you fall, so timing is everything.
tips: Watch the tiles ahead of the ball rather than the ball itself, so you can plan each jump before it happens.
Listen to the beat drops and try to match your jumps to the rhythm instead of guessing.
Stay calm after a near miss; rushing the next jump is a common reason to fall.
Collect the stars you pass along the way, since they are used to buy new ballz in the shop.
Use your first few runs to learn the rhythm of the tiles, then push for a higher score on the leaderboards.
faq: What is the goal of Hop Ballz 3D?
Keep the bouncing ball jumping on the music tiles while following the beat. Do not miss a tile, or the ball will fall.
How do I control the ball?
The game is played with touch or mouse. Use your touch or click to make the ball jump onto the next tile.

ninja-adventure-game.intro: Ninja Adventure is a timing-based course game where you move through obstacles, collect coins, and search for hidden rewards. Levels grow harder as you go.
tips: Watch a obstacle pattern for a few seconds before you commit, since the game rewards good timing over quick guesses.
Collect coins when they are safe to reach, but do not risk a run for a coin you can get on the next pass.
Look around each course for hidden rewards, as the description notes they are tucked into the levels.
Expect the surprises to appear in new places as you progress, so stay alert instead of memorizing one route.
If you fail a section, retry it with the same focus on timing and reflexes before moving on to harder levels.
faq: What is the main goal of Ninja Adventure?
Move through each course, overcome its obstacles, collect coins, and push through progressively challenging levels.
How is progress scored?
The description does not explain a scoring system, so focus on collecting coins and finding hidden rewards as you move forward.

dead-land-survival.intro: Dead Land: Survival is a multiplayer survival game in a zombie-filled post-apocalyptic world. You improve your hero, rebuild your shelter, scavenge beyond the safe zone, and craft gear, alone or with a clan.
tips: Repair broken gear at the Workshop under the Repair tab before heading out, so your equipment is ready when you venture beyond the safe zone.
Keep an eye on which items settler quests and building upgrades need, and hold onto those rather than selling them.
Sell surplus items to the trader in your settlement, but check first whether you might need them later for quests or upgrades.
When a location requires a specific item count, check the slot requirement in your inventory, since some locations only open when the right items are placed in the matching slot.
Team up with other players in a clan to take on elite bosses and clan challenges, which are harder to handle alone.
faq: How do I repair broken items?
Open the Workshop building and go to the Repair tab. Broken items can be fixed there.
How do I install a new chest in my warehouse?
Free up space by removing one of the installed boxes and clearing out its items. Then place the new chest in that spot.

iron-defense.intro: Iron Defense is a one-screen shooter where you hold a turret on a scrap wall and fire at waves of junk robots marching in from the right. Survive every wave in each stage and spend what you salvage between fights.
tips: Keep your finger or mouse held on the field so the turret fires constantly, since waves can arrive quickly.
Save your abilities for crowded moments instead of casting them on single robots, because energy refills only over time.
Watch your energy bar before a big wave, and use the + button only when a stage is getting dangerous and you have crystals to spare.
Between stages, decide whether your wall or your turret needs help more, since a fallen wall ends the stage before you finish the waves.
Use gold and crystals on the electrified floor and auto-gun pylons when robots reach the wall in groups, since these add defense without needing you to aim.
faq: How do I win a stage?
You win by destroying every wave in the stage before the wall falls. If the wall falls first, the stage is lost.
How do I cast an ability?
Drag the fire, ice or lightning button onto the field and release it there. Release it on a button instead to cancel the cast.

beach-bowling-3d.intro: Beach Bowling 3D mixes a beach setting with bowling. You can take on computer opponents or challenge others in multiplayer duels, and try to beat your own high score.
tips: Start with the easy-going pace of the game to get a feel for how your throws behave before you face tougher opponents.
Play a few rounds against the skilled opponents and watch how they handle their throws, then apply what works to your own play.
Treat each round as a chance to beat your last high score rather than chasing a big result all at once.
If you play a multiplayer duel, keep your focus on your own turns and avoid rushing, since a single careless throw can cost you the round.
Come back after a short break when a run goes badly, so you can keep your attention on the next throw instead of repeating the same mistake.
faq: What is the main goal of Beach Bowling 3D?
The goal is to score well in bowling matches on a beach-themed setting, either against skilled opponents or in multiplayer duels. The game also encourages you to break your own high scores.
How can I get a higher score?
Practice regularly and pay attention to how each throw goes, so you can repeat what works. Compare each new session with your previous best to see how you are improving.

misregister.intro: MISREGISTER is an arcade puzzler played across a four-page seam proof on a turning cuboid. Aim your ink, pop matching groups of three or more, and keep the drifting rows from spoiling the edition.
tips: The press turns to a page you did not choose after every shot, so plan where the next ink will land before you fire the current one.
Use shots that carry across a corner onto the next page when a cluster on the visible face is hard to reach, since one pop can cross several pages for bonus points.
Watch the trim rail at the top of the block and clear bubbles early, because a single bubble over it spoils the edition.
Drift adds a row to all four pages on a timer, so do not leave the board unchanged for long; keep popping to make room.
Use A and D or the TURN pads to rotate the block when the ink you need is on a side you cannot reach easily.
faq: What is the goal of MISREGISTER?
Pop groups of three or more matching inks and avoid letting a bubble go over the trim rail, which spoils the edition.
How do I aim and fire?
Drag to aim and release to fire a shot. A shot that reaches a corner carries onto the next page.

1-strength-for-escape.intro: Train to build your Strength, then smash through walls to escape each zone. Each new zone is tougher but offers bigger rewards, so steady training matters.
tips: Keep training between wall attempts. Approaching a wall only works once your accumulated Strength is high enough, so build up before you push forward.
Use heavier weights when you can. The game says they improve your training efficiency, which means you gain Strength faster over time.
Spend your wins on progress as soon as you earn them. They are meant to move you forward, so saving them without a plan can slow you down.
Before entering a new zone, make sure your Strength can handle its tougher walls. Zones offer greater rewards, but pushing in too early can waste time.
Consider Rebirth when your progress slows down. It resets your current progress, but the permanent bonuses help you grow stronger in each new cycle.
faq: What is the goal of +1 Strength to Escape?
The goal is to become strong enough to break through the walls standing between you and freedom. Each wall you smash lets you move forward and unlock new zones.
How do I break a wall?
Train to build up your Strength, then approach the wall. If you have enough accumulated strength, you can break it and move ahead.

snake-arena.intro: Snake Arena is a multiplayer snake game set in colorful arenas. You move around, outsmart rivals, and gather power-ups to help your snake grow. This guide covers the basics of movement, boosting, and growing.
tips: Keep your snake moving toward open space rather than heading into the edges or into crowded areas. Turning early gives you more room to react.
Use the speed boost in short bursts to get past a rival or reach a power-up quickly, then go back to normal speed.
Watch where other snakes are heading and try to predict their next move. Cutting off a rival's path is often safer than racing them head-on.
Look for power-ups on your route, but check the surrounding area first so you do not collect them at the cost of a risky turn.
Focus on collecting points steadily, since each one adds to your snake's growth. Consistent play usually matters more than one big move.
faq: How do I move my snake on mobile?
Use the virtual joystick to steer the snake in the direction you want it to go.
How do I move my snake on PC?
Move your mouse, and the snake will travel in the direction of the cursor. Left click to boost your speed.

speed-car-race-madness.intro: Speed Car Race Madness is an arcade street racing game set in Blackridge city and the mountains. You drive, use nitro, tune your cars, and try stunts like flips and drifts.
tips: Use the Right Arrow to drive and the Left Arrow to go back, and practise both until steering feels natural before you race.
Save your nitro for straight stretches or moments when you need a burst of speed, rather than using it up on the first corner.
Since drifting is part of the game, practise taking corners at a controlled speed so you can keep your car on the asphalt.
Try the X and Z keys for front and back flips on mountain routes, but only when you are sure you can land safely.
Tune your cars to suit the track you are racing on, and switch between the many 3D cars to find one you handle well.
faq: What is the goal of Speed Car Race Madness?
The game is a street racing game where you race through Blackridge city and the mountains. Your aim is to win races while handling your car well.
Which keys control the car?
The Right Arrow drives forward and the Left Arrow goes back. The X key does a front flip and the Z key does a back flip.

homo-evolution.intro: Homo Evolution is a merge puzzle where you combine two individuals to guide life from simple creatures toward more modern forms. You move through four worlds and eight evolution stages across the planet.
tips: Start by clicking your small lizard to build up coins, since coins are what you use to buy new species to merge.
Try merging different pairs early on to see which new life forms appear, because the results vary a lot.
Explore each branch rather than rushing one line, since exploring a branch is what opens the next one.
Focus on the last two life forms at a stage, because tapping them is how you reach a new, previously unknown world.
Use the offline autoclicker to keep coins coming in while you are away, so you have more to spend when you return.
faq: How do I start playing Homo Evolution?
You begin in the BEGINNING world with a small lizard. Click creatures to earn coins, then use those coins to buy species to merge.
How do I unlock new stages or worlds?
Explore each branch to open the next stage. Tapping the last two life forms at a stage gives you access to a new world.

banana-quest.intro: Banana Quest is a jungle endless runner where you guide a monkey to collect bananas while avoiding spikes, obstacles and enemies. Your score rises with every banana you grab.
tips: Watch the ground ahead rather than the monkey, so you can time your jump before a spike or obstacle reaches you.
Use short, well-timed jumps to stay in control; tapping or clicking too early can leave you landing right in the path of danger.
Keep an eye on bananas floating above the path and plan jumps that let you collect them without breaking your rhythm.
Practice the first few seconds of each run to learn the pattern of obstacles and enemies, since the runner speeds up as you go.
Stay calm when the screen gets busy; focusing on one obstacle at a time usually works better than reacting to everything at once.
faq: How do I make the monkey jump?
On desktop, press the left mouse button. On a mobile device, tap the screen.
What is the goal of Banana Quest?
Collect as many bananas as you can while dodging spikes, jumping over obstacles and avoiding enemies. The more bananas you collect, the higher your score.

a-mole-in-a-hole.intro: A Mole in a Hole is a race against the clock where you guide a forgetful mole through twisting tunnels back home. Memory and map reading are the main skills you will use.
tips: Take a few seconds at the start to look at the layout and note where the tunnels split and where home is.
Try to remember the route you have already taken, since the mole is forgetful and you need to rely on your own memory.
Watch for dangers and distractions near junctions, and slow down a little when a choice could send you the wrong way.
Keep an eye on the timer and avoid long detours, because the race against time becomes harder as the challenges increase.
Treat each move as important, since the description says every choice counts, so plan a few steps ahead when you can.
faq: What is the goal of A Mole in a Hole?
Your goal is to guide the forgetful mole through the twisting tunnels and reach home before time runs out.
What skills does this game test?
The game relies on your memory and map skills to find a safe path past dangers and distractions.

people-blaster.intro: People Blaster is a fast 3D runner where you recruit stickmen, turn them into weapons, and blast your way to the finish line. You control it with mouse clicks or taps.
tips: Gather stickmen as you run, since a larger crowd gives you more firepower to clear targets ahead.
Steer through multipliers when you can, because they can raise the number of stickmen you carry into the next section.
Keep an eye on the city obstacles ahead and move out of their way early rather than reacting at the last second.
Fire in bursts at the targets in your path so you clear the route before reaching the next obstacle.
Aim to reach the finish line with as many stickmen as possible, because you need to keep moving forward to finish the run.
faq: What is the goal of People Blaster?
Your goal is to recruit stickmen along the track, use them as weapons to blast through targets, and reach the finish line.
How do I control the game?
Use mouse clicks or taps to play. Tap or click to fire and move through the track.

mega-ramp-stunt-moto-fun-and-run-3d-game.intro: Mega Ramp Stunt Moto is a 3D motorcycle game where you ride on an aerial platform, perform stunts, and dodge obstacles. Tap or click to control your bike and race past other players.
tips: Watch the track ahead so you can react to obstacles before you reach them rather than after.
Save your acceleration items for moments when you need to pass other players, instead of using them at the very start.
Pay attention to how your bike is positioned during jumps, since your stunts are the main way you show your driving skill.
Practice the timing of your taps or clicks in short runs to get a feel for how the bike responds before a longer race.
If you fall behind, use an acceleration item to close the gap, then stay focused on keeping your speed up.
faq: What is the goal of Mega Ramp Stunt Moto?
You ride a motorcycle on an aerial platform, perform driving stunts, avoid obstacles, and try to get ahead of the other players.
How do I control the motorcycle?
The game is controlled by tapping or clicking. Use your taps to steer through the course and time your stunts.

sausage-man-shooting-adventure.intro: Sausage Man Shooting Adventure is a side-scrolling shooter where you guide a energetic sausage hero through waves of enemies. You run forward, dodge traps, jump platforms, and blast enemies as you go.
tips: Keep an eye on the traps ahead and react early, since dodging them is part of staying alive.
Watch the platforms before you jump so you land safely and still have room to keep shooting.
Grab airdrops when you can, because they increase your damage and make the waves easier to clear.
Pay attention to where enemies appear in each wave and aim your shots before they close in.
Don't rush forward blindly. Moving at a steady pace lets you handle threats from both enemies and traps.
faq: What is the goal of Sausage Man Shooting Adventure?
You control a sausage hero who runs forward through the level, shooting enemies in waves while dodging traps and jumping platforms.
How do I control the sausage hero?
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps, which is the only control listed in the instructions.

stunt-rider.intro: Stunt Rider is a sports game where you race through levels and perform motorcycle stunts. It focuses on balance and precision, and you can upgrade your bike as you go.
tips: Treat balance as the main skill. Before attempting a stunt, pause to think about where your bike is tilted and correct it early rather than late.
Read each level's challenge before you start, so you know what the level wants from you and can plan your run.
Practice the controls on the early levels until they feel natural. Smooth, small inputs usually give more control than sudden ones.
Spend upgrades on the part of your ride that helps your current problem, such as handling if you struggle to stay balanced.
If a stunt keeps failing, slow down and try again with a steadier approach instead of repeating the same rushed attempt.
faq: What is the goal of Stunt Rider?
You race through levels while performing motorcycle stunts, and each level has its own challenge to complete.
How do I get better at the stunts?
Focus on balance and precision. Practicing the controls on early levels and making small, steady adjustments will help you improve.

neon-circuit-rush.intro: Neon Circuit Rush is a 3D arcade racer where you pick a car, race around the track, and earn coins to spend in the shop. It uses keyboard or on-screen controls for fast-paced drifting and driving.
tips: Ease off the accelerator before tight corners so you keep control of the car instead of sliding wide.
Tap steering in short bursts with A and D rather than holding them down, which helps you stay on the line through turns.
Brake before a corner rather than in the middle of it, so you can exit the turn with speed.
Try each of the three ways to play to see which one suits your driving style before you spend coins.
If you are using the on-screen buttons, press and release them smoothly so you can still react to the track ahead.
faq: What is the goal of Neon Circuit Rush?
You pick a car, hit the track, and steer through the race while earning coins. The coins can be used to explore the shop.
Which keys control the car?
Press A to steer left, D to steer right, Up Arrow to accelerate, and Down Arrow to brake.

zombie-vacation-2.intro: Zombie Vacation 2 is a 3D zombie survival shooter where a special forces soldier fights off waves of zombies on a tropical island. Unlock new guns as you go to stay alive.
tips: Aim with the right mouse button when zombies are at range, since steadier shots help you spend less ammo on each zombie.
Keep moving with WASD instead of standing still, so you don't get surrounded as zombies close in from several directions.
Reload with R during quieter moments rather than in the middle of a crowd, so you're not left empty-handed when enemies arrive.
Use the mouse wheel to switch to the weapon that suits the situation, and keep an eye on which guns you've unlocked so you can match them to the threat.
Save bullet time with T for dangerous moments when several zombies reach you at once, instead of spending it on a single easy target.
faq: What is the goal of Zombie Vacation 2?
You play as a special forces soldier lost on a tropical island, and your mission is to shoot all the incoming zombies and survive.
How do I shoot and aim?
Use the left mouse button to shoot and hold the right mouse button to aim. Move with WASD and use Space to jump.

roll-kingdoms.intro: Roll Kingdoms is a colorful 3D dice board game where you roll to move, collect rewards, and rebuild three floating kingdoms. This guide covers how to plan your rolls and spend your coins.
tips: Check which tiles your two dice can reach before you roll, and aim for coin, crown, upgrade, or mini-game tiles when you have a choice.
Save coins for upgrades that finish a building or bring you closer to completing a kingdom, rather than spreading them thinly across many buildings.
Treat mystery tiles as a gamble: keep some coins in reserve so you can still afford a key upgrade if the reward turns out to be small.
Play the mini-games when you have time to read the on-screen keyboard or touch prompts, since each one is a different challenge.
Work through one kingdom at a time, checking your missions list so you know which buildings still need upgrades before the Royal Festival.
faq: What is the main goal of Roll Kingdoms?
Your goal is to build up Sunny Keep, Pirate Cove, and Ember Kingdom by upgrading their buildings, then finish the Royal Festival to complete the campaign.
How do I move around the board?
Press or tap ROLL to throw two dice, and your piece moves by the total. Each landing can trigger a reward or event.

stickman-rush.intro: StickMan Rush is an arcade platformer where you run and jump across platforms to help your stickman survive a tough world. Your aim is to turn every platform and level colored while avoiding spikes and other deadly objects.
tips: Watch the spikes and hazards ahead before you commit to a run, and slow your timing when a gap or obstacle comes up.
Use short, controlled jumps when you are near an edge, since a small mistake in the air is often what costs you a life.
Learn the spacing of each jump in a level on your first pass, then repeat the route with confidence once you know where the dangers sit.
Cover each platform fully rather than rushing past, so every part of the level is turned colored before you move on.
If you keep falling in the same spot, pause your rhythm and approach that section more slowly instead of running at full speed.
faq: How do I move and jump?
Use the arrow keys on a keyboard, or tap the screen if you are playing by touch.
What is the main goal?
Turn all the platforms and levels colored while your stickman survives the hazards in the way.

epic-racing-descent-on-cars.intro: Epic Racing - Descent on Cars is a racing game built around close-quarters contact. You compete against rivals across several tracks, with physics that make collisions a real part of each race.
tips: Keep an eye on rivals before you commit to a pass, since a crowded corner is where most collisions happen.
Because the physics are realistic, your speed and momentum matter, so think about how a hit will affect your line before you make contact.
Take a few laps or races to learn how each track's turns and layout behave, and note where you tend to lose ground.
Avoid pushing too hard into every corner. Losing control after a collision can cost more time than a cautious line would.
Stay focused all the way to the finish line, because a race can change quickly when rivals are fighting for the same space.
faq: What is the goal of Epic Racing - Descent on Cars?
Your goal is to outmaneuver your rivals and be the first to reach the finish line on each track.
How does collision work in this game?
Collisions are part of the racing, and the realistic physics mean hits affect how your car moves. Plan your positioning with contact in mind.

ash-of-the-front.intro: Ash of the Front is a real-time strategy game set in a fictional dieselpunk world, where you command gas-masked infantry, tanks and artillery to hold the Valley of Sorrow. Each mission starts with orders from Marshal Weyland.
tips: Read the marshal's orders in the top left before each move, since they tell you which points to take and hold, which batteries and tanks to destroy, and what to protect at your HQ.
Tap a building to have a company occupy it, then let them fire from the windows. This is useful for holding ground that you need to keep.
Use the Line tool to draw a firing line when you want a group of units to cover a stretch of ground, rather than sending each squad separately.
Keep an eye on the enemy's route toward your HQ and send a squad or tank to block it early, because a breach there is hard to recover from.
Spend the tokens you earn in battle on the upgrades that match how you fight, such as the units you rely on most, instead of spreading them out.
faq: How do I win a mission?

Follow the objectives the marshal gives you, which usually means taking and holding points, destroying batteries and tanks, and stopping the enemy from reaching your HQ. Winning earns tokens for upgrades in the HQ Arsenal.
How do I select and move units?
Tap a squad to select it, then tap the ground to send it there, and it will fire while it moves. On a PC, left-click selects a squad, drag a box to select several, and right-click gives orders.

fantasticlandia.intro: FantasticLandia is a 2D single-player adventure where you jump through bright landscapes, solve challenges, and explore every corner of the world. The controls use the WASD keys and the space bar.
tips: Start by moving left and right with A and D and jumping with the space bar, so you know how far you travel in each jump before you reach a challenge.
Use W and S to check how the game responds to vertical movement, then take a moment to look at the layout of each area before you move on.
Explore slowly at first. Looking around each landscape helps you spot paths and challenges you might otherwise miss.
When you get stuck on a challenge, step back and try a different approach, such as changing your jump timing or exploring another direction.
Take short breaks between sessions. The game is built for long, relaxed exploration, so pacing yourself keeps the experience fun.
faq: What is the goal of FantasticLandia?
The goal is to explore the world, jump through its landscapes, and solve the challenges you find along the way.
Which keys control the game?
Use W, A, S and D to move and the space bar to jump.

ant-colony-idle.intro: Ant Colony Idle is a relaxing clicker where you tap the soil for food and grow a small nest into a busy underground colony. Upgrades, chambers, and prestige keep your colony growing over time.
tips: Tap the soil early on to build up food, then spend it on upgrades that help your colony earn more over time.
Expand and improve rooms like the Food Storage, Nursery, and Queen Chamber, since each one supports a different part of your colony.
Check the Upgrades tab regularly so you don't miss new upgrade cards you can afford.
Let your ants keep working while you are away, because progress continues in the background.
Save prestige for when you have built a strong base, since it restarts your progress with bonuses for faster growth.
faq: What is the main goal of Ant Colony Idle?
Your goal is to grow a tiny ant nest into a thriving underground colony by finding food, unlocking workers, and expanding chambers.
How do I get food in the game?
Tap or click the soil to discover food, then use that food to buy upgrades and expand your nest.

princess-nail-art.intro: Princess Nail Art is a relaxed puzzle game where you design elegant nails on hands and feet using drag-and-drop tools. There are no time limits or scores, so you can take your time.
tips: Since there is no timer, work at a slow pace and take your time placing each element.
Start with a simple base design, then add details one at a time so you can see how each change looks.
Try out a few tools on a small area first to learn how drag-and-drop responds before committing to a full design.
Step back and look at the whole hand or foot after each change to check that your style feels balanced.
Take breaks whenever you like and return later, since there is no pressure to finish quickly.
faq: Can I fail or lose in Princess Nail Art?
No. The game has no time limits or scores, so there is no way to fail. You can design at your own pace.
What can I customize in this game?
You can customize nail designs on both hands and feet. The description highlights elegant designs made with drag-and-drop tools.

real-car-parking-game.intro: Real Car Parking Game is a driving and parking challenge set on city streets. You take the driver's seat and test your skills on parking and driving tasks.
tips: Use the mouse to click every button you need, such as menu options and game controls, so you don't lose time searching for them.
Start slow when you're learning. Parking is easier to get right when you move carefully and stop to check your position before each move.
Look around your car before you park. Street parking is full of challenges, so keep track of the space you have and any vehicles or obstacles nearby.
Practice the driving part as well as the parking. Getting a feel for how your car handles on the road makes the tight parking spots much easier.
If you make a mistake, take a moment to reset your approach instead of rushing. Calm, steady moves usually lead to better results than quick ones.
faq: What is the main goal of Real Car Parking Game?
The goal is to show your driving and parking skills by completing street car parking challenges. The game focuses on both driving and parking.
How do I control the game?
Use the mouse to click any button in the game. The game is designed around mouse clicks for its buttons and options.

my-little-park-3d.intro: My Little Park 3D is a clicker and tycoon game where you turn an empty plot into a busy amusement park. You move your character around, clear land, and reinvest the money your visitors bring in.
tips: Walk up to income collection points regularly, since visitor earnings are how you pay for new areas and rides.
Reinvest profits as soon as you can afford it, because a bigger park attracts more guests and speeds up your progress.
Clear trees and construction zones near your current area first so you can expand your park without wasting time.
Build a mix of attractions such as swings and carousels, since visitors enjoy different rides and a variety keeps the park lively.
Check the upgrades for park infrastructure occasionally, as better facilities help the park grow faster over time.
faq: What is the main goal of My Little Park 3D?
Your goal is to build every attraction and create a dream park filled with happy guests. You do this by growing your park step by step from a small plot.
How do I move my character?
Use the virtual joystick to move your character. Actions like clearing trees, building, upgrading, and collecting income happen automatically when you walk up to them.

color-by-numbers-anti-stress-drawings.intro: Color by Numbers is a relaxing drawing game where you fill numbered areas of a picture with the matching color. You pick an illustration and build it up one fragment at a time.
tips: Pick a picture that matches your level: simple drawings with large fragments suit beginners, while complex compositions suit more experienced players.
Start with the large fragments and move to the small details later, so the picture takes shape steadily and you stay on track.
Check the palette before each tap so you use the color that matches the number on the fragment.
Take your time and focus on one area at a time, since the game is meant to help you relax and let worries fade.
When the drawing is finished, save it to your gallery or share it with friends to keep a record of your work.
faq: What is the goal of Color by Numbers?
The goal is to turn an empty outline into a finished colored picture. Each numbered fragment is filled with the color shown in the palette for that number.
How do I color a fragment?
Tap on a fragment and it will fill with the correct color. The palette shows which color belongs to each number.

super-onion-boy-2.intro: Super Onion Boy 2 is a retro-style platformer about rescuing a friend from a powerful beast. You transform with superpowers, search for hidden treasure, and face tough bosses across colorful levels.
tips: Explore each level slowly enough to spot secret paths and hidden treasure, since side routes are part of the experience.
Test your superpowers on different enemies and obstacles to learn which transformation suits which challenge.
Watch how an enemy moves for a few seconds before engaging, so you can outsmart it instead of rushing in.
Before a boss fight, study its attacks and openings from a safe distance, then act when you have a clear chance.
Keep the goal of rescuing your friend in mind, and return to areas you skipped once you have new powers that may open them.
faq: What is the main goal in Super Onion Boy 2?
Your goal is to rescue your friend from a powerful beast by moving through the levels, outsmarting enemies, and defeating the bosses along the way.
How do the superpowers work?

You can transform with superpowers during play, so try each one on different enemies and obstacles to see how it changes what you can do. The game's instructions do not list specific controls, so check for on-screen prompts when you first unlock a power.

candy-clicker-2.intro: Candy Clicker 2 is a light clicking game where each click adds to your growing candy hoard. Click steadily, watch your total climb, and enjoy the cheerful music as you play.
tips: Keep your clicks steady rather than rushing in bursts, since the game rewards consistent play with a growing hoard.
Take short breaks now and then so the repetitive clicking stays relaxed and you can notice how your total is growing.
Focus on one click rhythm you can keep up comfortably for a long session instead of trying to click as fast as possible.
Turn the music up or keep it on, since the whimsical soundtrack is a big part of the game's light-hearted mood.
Check your candy total after each stretch of play to see how far you have come and set a small goal for your next session.
faq: What is the goal of Candy Clicker 2?
The goal is to collect as much candy as you can by clicking, building your candy hoard over time.
What controls does Candy Clicker 2 use?
The game is played by clicking, and each click adds to your candy total. No other controls are listed in the instructions.

basketball-io.intro: Basketball.io is a multiplayer 3D basketball game where you dribble, shoot, and score against other players. Use the arrow keys or WASD to move and drag the mouse to aim your shots.
tips: Learn the aiming drag early in a match, since a small change in how far you drag can send the ball well short of or past the hoop.
Keep the ball moving with dribbling when a defender is near, so it is harder for them to steal it.
Shoot when you have clear space around you instead of rushing into a crowded area where your shot can be blocked.
Watch where other players are heading and pass or reposition to a free spot rather than forcing a contested shot.
Practice on the court for a few rounds to get a feel for the timing and distance before trying to win a close match.
faq: How do I move my player?
Use the arrow keys or the WASD keys to move around the court.
How do I shoot the ball?
Drag the mouse to aim and set your shot, then release to throw the ball toward the hoop.

kick-the-santa-christmas-buddy.intro: Kick The Santa: Christmas Buddy is a short, silly hypercasual game with a Christmas theme. You play by clicking or tapping, and the aim is to blow off steam with some chaotic, lighthearted action.
tips: Use quick, single clicks or taps rather than rapid mashing, so you can see how each action affects Santa before you repeat it.
Try a few different weapons from the game to find out which ones feel most satisfying and produce the funniest reactions.
Watch how Santa reacts after each hit, since that can show you which kicks or actions cause the biggest response.
Play in short sessions when you need a break; the game is built for quick, casual fun rather than long runs.
Experiment freely, because the game is meant to be chaotic and there is no wrong way to have fun with it.
faq: How do I play Kick The Santa: Christmas Buddy?
Use your mouse to click or tap on the screen to perform actions. The controls are simple, so you can start right away.
Is there a specific goal in the game?
The game is a casual stress-relief experience, so there is no strict goal stated in the description. Play around with the actions and see what results you enjoy most.

street-race-master.intro: Street Race Master is a 3D street racing game with 10+ cars, 3 tracks, and several levels of increasing difficulty. You steer with the mouse or touch and try to stay on the track.
tips: Pick a car that feels comfortable to steer before you move on to harder races, since every race depends on keeping control.
Spend a few runs on each track to learn its bends and straight sections before you aim for faster times.
Make small, steady left and right movements instead of sharp jerks, which can push your car off the track.
Watch the road ahead rather than your car, so you can start turning before each curve arrives.
When a new level feels too hard, go back and practice the earlier races to sharpen your steering.
faq: What is the goal of Street Race Master?
Your goal is to race through the streets, stay on the track, and progress through the increasingly challenging races.
How do I steer my car?
Move left and right with your mouse or touch controls to steer and keep your car on the road.

pull-the-pin-rescue.intro: Pull the Pin Rescue is a puzzle game where you pull out pins in the correct order to free a trapped character. Your strategy decides whether the rescue succeeds.
tips: Before pulling any pin, look at the whole scene and think about which pin is holding back the hazard or the trapped character.
Pull pins one at a time and watch what happens after each move, since the right order matters more than speed.
If a rescue fails, study where things went wrong and try a different sequence rather than repeating the same moves.
Keep your moves deliberate: a tap and slide control is easy to do quickly, so slow down on the pins that look most critical.
Treat each attempt as a test of the layout, noting which pins seem to block others so you can plan the next sequence.
faq: What is the goal of Pull the Pin Rescue?
The goal is to pull the pins in the right order so you can rescue the trapped guy before he is harmed.
How do I move in the game?
Tap and slide to move. Use the same tap and slide action to pull the pins.

penalty-challenge.intro: Penalty Challenge is a football game where you take penalty kicks as a striker or defend as a goalkeeper. Compete against the AI or players worldwide to earn experience points and climb the global leaderboard.
tips: Try both roles before settling on one. Playing as a striker and as a goalkeeper gives you a feel for each side of the penalty.
Pick a team that suits your style and stick with it for a while, so you can judge your progress more clearly.
Play against other players as well as the AI. Matches against people from around the world give a better sense of where you stand on the leaderboard.
As a goalkeeper, watch the striker closely before you commit to a dive. Reacting to the kick itself is often more reliable than guessing early.
Check the leaderboard regularly to see how your points compare, and use that to decide whether to keep playing your current role or switch.
faq: What is the main goal of Penalty Challenge?
The goal is to earn experience points by playing penalties against the AI or other players, and to rise up the global leaderboard.
Can I play as both a striker and a goalkeeper?
Yes. You can choose to play as a striker or a goalkeeper, and you can switch between the two roles.

cut-it-3d.intro: Cut It 3D is a skill game where you flip a knife to slice obstacles in your path into equal halves. Tap at the right moment to keep the knife moving and reach the end.
tips: Watch the knife's angle as it rises and falls, and time your tap so the blade meets each obstacle straight on for a clean, equal cut.
Focus on keeping the knife in the air. Tapping too early or too late can cause a missed cut and a fall.
Use the handle to bounce off an obstacle when you need to flip back over. This gives you another chance to cut rather than losing the knife.
Look ahead at the next obstacle, since different shapes like pencils, pipes, and anvils may call for different timing.
Stay calm and tap with a steady rhythm instead of tapping rapidly, which makes it harder to hit the right moment.
faq: How do I control the knife?
Tap the left mouse button on a computer, or tap the screen on a smartphone, to flip the knife. Timing your taps is the main skill.
What is the goal of the game?
Slice the obstacles in front of you into equal halves and keep going until you reach the end.

pocket-zone.intro: Pocket ZONE is a survival RPG set in the Chernobyl exclusion zone and the anomalous deserts of the Zone. You make choices in text events and manage your survival against a hostile environment.
tips: Read each text event carefully before choosing, since the outcome depends on your choice and on external factors that affect your survival.
Pay attention to the conditions around you before you act, because the description says external factors directly change your chances of survival.
Treat the mining system as a core part of your progress and give it regular attention rather than only reacting when you run short.
With more than a hundred random events, avoid repeating the same risky choice; try a different approach when one path goes badly.
Use the mouse wheel to scroll through long lists of weapons, armor, helmets, backpacks and costumes so you can compare options before equipping anything.
faq: What is the main goal of Pocket ZONE?

The game is about surviving in the Zone while pursuing your goals, whether that is reaching the Chernobyl plant or wandering the harsh deserts. Your choices and the environment decide how long you last.
How do I control the game on a PC?
Use the left mouse click to interact with game elements, and use the mouse wheel to scroll through lists. On a mobile device, touch the screen to interact with elements.

dop2-draw-love.intro: DOP2: Draw Love is a drawing puzzle where you help a couple out of funny situations by sketching the missing element in each picture. Each level reveals how the pair reacts once you get the drawing right.
tips: Study the whole picture before you draw. Look for what is missing and what the characters are doing or looking at, since that usually shows what the detail should be.
Keep your drawing simple and clear. The goal is to complete the missing part, so a readable shape matters more than fine detail.
If a level is stuck, look again at the surrounding objects and faces for clues about the expected shape or position.
Pay attention to the story hints in the scene, such as who is nearby or what someone is trying to hide, because they point toward the solution.
Try a different approach if your first drawing does not work. Erasing and redrawing the element is often faster than trying to fix a messy shape.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You need to look at the picture and draw the missing element so the couple can get out of their funny situation.
How do I know if I finished a level correctly?
When your drawing completes the task, you will see how the couple reacts to the result.

rotate-to-escape.intro: Rotate to Escape is a puzzle game with 60 dungeon levels. You rotate the whole dungeon to change gravity and reach the key, while avoiding traps, falling crates, and thorns.
tips: Before you rotate, look at where your character would fall after the turn. Gravity pulls you toward the bottom of the screen, so plan the drop path first.
Use rotation to turn walls into walkways. If a route looks blocked, check whether turning the dungeon opens a path instead of pushing forward.
Watch falling crates and move out of their path early. Timing matters more than speed when hazards are close together.
Plan several moves ahead on harder levels. Sketch the route to the key in your head, then test it one step at a time.
If a level traps you, do not panic-click. Pause, study the layout again, and try a different rotation order.
faq: What is the goal of Rotate to Escape?
Your goal is to find the key on each dungeon level and escape. There are 60 levels to work through.
How do I control the game?
Click or tap to play. Rotating the dungeon is the main action that changes gravity and reveals new paths.

robby-1-to-jump-power-per-second.intro: Robby +1 To Jump Power Per Second is an obby where your jump power grows every second. Climb the towers on the Day or Night map, score as many points as you can, and aim for the top of the leaderboard.
