tips: Your jump power rises by 1 each second, so the longer you keep going without stopping, the higher you can reach. Avoid restarting a run early if you are close to a harder section.
Try both the Day and Night maps, since each has its own towers and finishing platforms. Pick the one whose layout suits your jumping style better.
Use Space to jump and WASD to adjust your landing spot mid-air. Small movements in the air often make the difference between landing a jump and falling.
Use Tab or Escape to free your cursor when you need to check the screen, then return to camera control with the mouse for a clear view of the next platform.
Keep an eye on the leaderboard to see how your score compares. Use the points you earn as a guide for how much risk to take on the harder jumps.
faq: How do I score points in this game?
Points come from progressing through the obby, and the game asks you to score as many as possible to reach the top of the leaderboard. Steady progress with few falls usually helps you score more.
What do the pets do?
The game lets you unlock pets, but the description does not say how they affect gameplay. Check the in-game menus to see what each pet offers.

giant-wanted-monster.intro: Giant Wanted Monster is an arcade sniper game where you defend a city from giant monsters. Every shot counts, so aim carefully and hit each monster's weak spot.
tips: Take a moment to study each monster before you fire, so you can spot its weak point rather than shooting at its general body.
Save your shots for clear openings. Since every bullet matters, a steady, accurate shot is better than a rushed one.
Keep your aim steady while you wait for the right moment, and avoid clicking or tapping in quick bursts that can pull your shot off target.
Watch how the monsters move and choose your timing around those movements so you can line up the Achilles heel more easily.
Stay calm and focused throughout, since the goal is to protect the city and each mistake matters more than speed.
faq: What is the main goal of Giant Wanted Monster?
You play as an elite sniper defending the city from giant monsters by shooting them from a distance. The goal is to protect humanity by hitting each monster's weak spot.
How do I shoot in Giant Wanted Monster?
Use a mouse click or a tap to fire your sniper gun. Each click or tap is one shot, so aim before you fire.

super-chop-forest-hero.intro: Super Chop: Forest Hero is a 3D lumberjack adventure where you chop trees, haul logs to the truck, and upgrade your tools. You can play solo or online with up to 8 heroes.
tips: Keep your backpack filling up with logs, then fly to the truck with H to sell them for coins. Selling in batches saves you from running back and forth.
Spend coins on upgrades to your strength, backpack, speed, and Hero Flight. A bigger backpack and faster movement make every trip more productive.
Move to the higher forest zones when you can, since the description says every tree there is worth more. Check which zones you have unlocked before you start chopping.
Use the shop (B) to buy stronger tools as soon as you can afford them. Each new tool should make chopping quicker and more profitable.
Take side activities like monster dens, rescue missions, and buried treasure when you need rare materials or relics. Those rewards can help you unlock helpers and new gloves.
faq: How do I earn coins in Super Chop: Forest Hero?
Chop trees, fill your backpack with logs, and fly to the truck with H to sell them. Each sale turns your logs into coins.
What controls do I use to chop trees on desktop?
Hold left click to chop, and use WASD to move and the mouse to look around. Press E to use items and Q for Hero Smash.

fastlaners.intro: FastLaners is a street racing game where you pick a car and a weapon, clear barriers on the road, and fight a tough wanted rival. Collect money to upgrade your ride and gear as you go.
tips: Spend your first earnings carefully and check what each car and weapon offers before buying, since upgrades carry you further than anything else.
Watch the road ahead early so you can line up on clear lanes and avoid obstacles instead of reacting at the last moment.
Use your weapon on barriers that block your path, but keep an eye on it so you are not caught without a working option when the boss appears.
Steer with smooth, small movements using the mouse or touch controls; quick, jerky inputs make it easy to clip obstacles.
Save money for the stronger cars and weapons rather than spending it all at once, so you can handle the tougher fights ahead.
faq: What is the main goal in FastLaners?
Race down the street, clear the barriers, and fight the boss to progress toward becoming a legend of the street.
How do I control my car?
You play with the mouse or by touch, so move your pointer or finger to steer and use the same input to aim and fire your weapon.

hunters-and-props.intro: Hunters and Props is a hide and seek game where you disguise yourself as everyday objects to avoid detection or hunt down decoys. Matches take place in cluttered environments and can be played solo or with friends.
tips: Choose a disguise that fits the room you are in, since an object that stands out from its surroundings is easier to spot.
Stay still when you are hidden. Movement is often what gives a player away.
Watch the clutter around you for objects that look out of place, because a decoy may blend in just as well as a real prop.
If you are hunting, scan slowly and check areas you have not looked at yet rather than revisiting the same spot.
When playing with friends, agree on a rough plan before the match, such as who covers which part of the room, to make your team more effective.
faq: What is the goal of Hunters and Props?
You play a hide and seek match either as a prop hiding among everyday objects or as a hunter searching for elusive decoys. The game description says each match is a test of your wits.
Can I play Hunters and Props alone?
Yes, the game can be played solo or with friends, so you can choose the mode that suits you.

crazy-three-puzzle.intro: Crazy Three Puzzle is a 3D triple match game where you sort and organize colorful tiles into matches of three. It offers hundreds of levels, from relaxed starters to tougher brain teasers.
tips: Hold the left mouse button steadily and move slowly at first so you can see which tiles you are picking up before committing.
Scan the whole board before each move and look for sets of three matching items you can clear together.
Save the trickier brain-teasing levels for when you are fresh, and use the easier levels to get comfortable with the controls.
If a level feels stuck, step back and look for matches you missed near the edges or underneath other pieces.
Play in short sessions. Taking a break between levels helps you spot patterns more clearly when you return.
faq: How do I control the game?
Tap and hold the left mouse button to interact with the pieces, as the game instructions describe.
What is the goal of each level?
Match and sort groups of three identical items to clear the board in the 3D puzzle.

two-punk-racing-2.intro: Two Punk Racing 2 is a 3D car racing game with three modes: racing rivals, a two player race, and collecting rewards on a large open map. Buy and customize cars in the garage as you go.
tips: Explore the big map between races to find rewards, since collecting is a core part of the game.
Save your rewards for upgrades or a new car when you can afford one, rather than spending them as soon as you get them.
Use the look back key when you need to check where rivals are behind you before deciding how to race.
Save nitro for straight stretches or moments when you need a quick burst to pass a rival, rather than using it all at once.
If a race goes badly, use the restart key to try again quickly instead of finishing a losing run.
faq: What is the goal of Two Punk Racing 2?
You race against rivals, collect rewards, and use them to buy new cars or improve your current one. The game has three modes: racing rivals, a two player race, and collecting rewards on the map.
How do I control the car in two player mode?
Player 1 uses the arrow keys to move, N for nitro, and B to look back. Player 2 uses W, A, S, and D to move, T for nitro, and C to look back.

line-control.intro: Line Control is a tactical map game where you draw routes between points to send squads and take over the map. Each level asks you to think through a new logic puzzle under time pressure.
tips: Read the numbers on every point before you draw a line, since they show attack and defense strength and tell you whether a capture is realistic.
Capture free neutral points early, because each one you hold adds to your advantage for the rest of the level.
Do not send all of your squads at once. Keep some back so your own bases stay protected while you attack.
Look for routes that reach enemy bases quickly, since one well-chosen line can shift the whole match.
When a base is under threat, decide whether to defend it or let it go, and focus your squads on the positions that matter most.
faq: What is the goal of Line Control?
Your goal is to take control of all enemy points on the map. You do this by drawing lines from your bases and sending squads to capture neutral and enemy positions.
How do I send a squad?
Draw a line from one of your bases to another point on the map. The squad then travels along that route to attack or capture the point.

noob-hero-adventure.intro: Noob Hero Adventure is a 3D action-adventure where you guide a young hero through dangerous lands. You learn as you go, fight foes, explore varied terrain, and search for hidden treasure.
tips: Explore each new area slowly so you can spot hidden treasures before moving on.
Watch how enemies move and attack for a few seconds before you engage, since learning their patterns makes fights easier.
Treat early battles as practice and try to improve your timing and positioning as you go.
Change your approach when a terrain or foe gives you trouble, because each area may call for a different strategy.
Keep track of what you have already searched so you do not miss treasure in places you have passed.
faq: What is the main goal of Noob Hero Adventure?
The goal is to guide your hero through perilous lands, learn new skills, defeat formidable foes, and grow from a noob into a hero.
How can I get better at fighting in the game?
Practice in the early stages, observe how enemies behave, and adjust your tactics when a fight is not going well.

deorbit-space-survivors.intro: Deorbit is a fast 3D survivor roguelike where your ship fires automatically while you dodge swarms of enemies. Each run builds your setup from upgrades, and gold carries over for permanent progress.
tips: Keep your ship moving rather than standing still, since you need to dodge attacks while your weapons fire on their own.
Save Dash for real emergencies, when you are boxed in by a crowd or about to take a hit you cannot avoid.
Pick level-up upgrades that match how your ship is already fighting, so your weapons and passives work together instead of spreading thin.
Pick up XP orbs when it is safe to do so, because leveling up gives you upgrade choices more often.
Spend your gold on permanent upgrades after each run, and try different ships to see which playstyle suits you.
faq: What is the main goal in Deorbit?
Survive the waves, defeat minibosses, and beat the sector boss to unlock the next area. There are 10 sectors and 100 total waves in all.
Do I need to aim my ship?
No. Your ship attacks nearby enemies automatically, so your focus should go to movement, dodging, and choosing upgrades.

urban-sniper-multiplayer-2.intro: Urban Sniper Multiplayer 2 is a multiplayer action game set in a dynamic city. You use powerful sniper rifles and elevated positions to outsmart opponents and climb the leaderboard.
tips: Pick your position before the action starts. Elevated vantage points give you a wider view of the streets, so look for a spot you can hold and that gives you clear lines of sight.
Try each sniper rifle in the selection and notice how it feels. Choose the one that suits your aiming style rather than sticking with the first one you pick up.
Slow down and take careful shots. The game rewards precision, so a single well-placed shot is usually worth more than rushing to fire.
Watch how the cityscape changes around you and move when your position becomes known. Staying in one place for too long can make you an easy target.
Think about your opponents' likely routes and sightlines. Anticipating where they will show up is a key part of outsmarting them.
faq: What is the main goal of Urban Sniper Multiplayer 2?
Your aim is to outsmart opponents in multiplayer battles and climb the leaderboard by showing precision and tactical skill.
What kind of weapons can I use?
You can choose from a selection of powerful sniper rifles, so it is worth testing them to find the one that fits how you play.

high-pizza.intro: High Pizza is a fast-paced arcade game about delivering hot pizzas. You weave past hurdles, dodge spoiled ingredients, and serve feasts while racing for a spot on the leaderboard.
tips: Watch the path ahead rather than your current position, so you have time to react to hurdles before you reach them.
Keep your movements deliberate. Quick, careless moves can cost precision, so plan each step before you make it.
Learn to spot spoiled ingredients early and steer clear of them, since they are one of the main threats in each run.
Stay calm when the pace picks up. Sharp reflexes matter most when the game speeds up, so avoid panicking and overcorrecting.
Treat each run as practice. Repeating a run helps you learn the layout and improve your speed and precision for the leaderboard.
faq: What is the main goal in High Pizza?
Deliver hot pizzas and serve feasts while navigating hurdles and dodging spoiled ingredients. Speed and precision both count.
How do I get a high score?
Aim for steady, precise runs rather than rushed ones. Each run that avoids mistakes gives you a better chance to climb the competitive leaderboard.

battle-hamsters.intro: Battle Hamsters is a turn-based shooting game where you lead a squad of fighting hamsters against an enemy squad. Take turns firing at the enemy and work toward unlocking new levels, hamsters and locations.
tips: Aim with care on each turn, since you only get one shot before the enemy responds.
Watch where the enemy hamsters are positioned after each shot and adjust your aim to hit the closest threats first.
Pay attention to how hard your shot feels when you hold, and practice a few times to learn how your aim changes with the input.
Try a few different hamsters as they unlock to see which one suits your style, and keep using the one that gives you the most consistent hits.
Finish levels when you can rather than rushing, so you build up progress toward new levels, hamsters and locations.
faq: What is the goal of Battle Hamsters?
Your goal is to destroy the enemy squad by taking turns shooting at them with your hamsters. Winning levels unlocks new levels, hamsters and locations.
How do I shoot on desktop?
Click with your mouse to take your shot. Each turn you fire once, then the enemy takes its turn.

deep-drill-run.intro: Deep Drill Run is a fast 3D mining arcade game built around short runs. Drill through rock, grab ore and money, and decide when to head back to base with your loot.
tips: Plan your exit before you go deep. The farther you move from the base, the richer the resources but the greater the danger, so pick a rough depth where you will turn back.
Go for the glowing bonus blocks when they are close to your path. They take longer to break, but a brighter glow means a bigger reward.
Spend upgrade cards on the stats that match your style, such as power or speed, and stick with that direction. Focusing your build makes each run more predictable.
Keep an eye on heat and instability as they climb. You cannot see the exact limit, so treat rising warning signs as a cue to start heading back.
Use your earnings between runs on mine upgrades as well as miner upgrades. Better mines bring more ore, extra oxygen, and cooling supplies, which help you survive deeper runs.
faq: What is the main goal of Deep Drill Run?
Drill through rock in each mine, collect ore and money, and escape with as much loot as you can carry back. Each run is a risk-and-reward choice about how deep to go.
How do I move and drill?
Use the arrow keys or the virtual joystick to move your miner. Drilling starts automatically when your character pushes into a block.

mr-bouncemaster.intro: Mr BounceMaster is an adventure game where you launch a penguin as far as you can, bouncing high and avoiding obstacles across several locations. Collect coins and diamonds to unlock upgrades and weapons.
tips: Spend your coins and diamonds on upgrades as soon as you can afford them, since better gear makes every later run easier.
Pay attention to the friends in the air, because hitting them is what helps you fly higher.
Watch the obstacles before each bounce and plan your route instead of reacting only at the last moment.
Try the different locations in turn, since each one has its own obstacles and you may learn useful habits in one before moving on.
Use each new weapon or shock equipment you unlock when it helps you clear a hard spot, rather than saving it for no reason.
faq: What is the main goal of Mr BounceMaster?
Your aim is to launch the penguin as far as you can, using bounces and hits on friends to fly higher while avoiding obstacles.
How do I control the game?
The game is played with the mouse or by touch, as stated in the instructions.

air-fighter-3d.intro: Air Fighter 3D is a shooting game where you pilot a fighter jet through aerial dogfights. You can fly alone or lead a fleet of acrobatic aircraft to gain control of the battlefield.
tips: Use short, controlled drags left and right to line up your plane with enemies rather than making large sweeping moves that can carry you past them.
Keep an eye on where enemies are before performing acrobatic maneuvers, so you do not lose track of targets while turning.
Get the enemy into your sights first, then fire, instead of shooting at distant targets that are hard to hit.
If you are flying with a fleet, think about how your aircraft are spread out so they can cover each other during dogfights.
Stay alert during the fight and reposition often, since staying in one spot makes you an easier target.
faq: How do I steer my jet?
Tap and hold the left mouse button, then drag left or right to change your position.
What is the goal of the game?
Shoot down enemy aircraft and establish air superiority over the battlefield.

smash-master.intro: Smash Master is a 3D physics puzzle where you aim a cannon at stacked objects and knock them down with limited shots. Each level brings a new structure to solve.
tips: Before firing, study the whole structure and look for the support piece that, if removed, would bring down the most objects.
Aim at weak points such as thin supports or objects balanced on top of others rather than the strongest-looking block.
Use chain reactions to your advantage: a well-placed shot that topples one object can often bring down several more on its own.
Since your shots are limited, pause to plan each one instead of firing quickly, and adjust your aim after watching how the last shot played out.
If a level stalls, try a different target point on the structure rather than repeating the same shot, since a new angle can change how the objects fall.
faq: What is the goal of Smash Master?
Knock down the stacked objects in each level and complete the required objective before you run out of cannonball shots.
How do I fire the cannon?
Aim the cannon at the structure, then tap or release to fire the cannonball.

putt-party.intro: Putt Party is a mini-golf puzzler where you pull back and release to send the ball across twisting holes. Aim for the cup in as few strokes as you can to earn stars.
tips: Turn on Aim Line before a tricky shot to see a longer trajectory preview, then compare it with where you want the ball to end up.
Pull back gently at first to learn how much power each drag gives you, since the farther you pull, the harder the hit.
Use the walls to your advantage by planning bank shots, but check the angle first so the ball doesn't ricochet into water or sand.
If a shot goes wrong, use Ball Back to rewind your last stroke instead of starting the hole over.
Look at the whole hole before you shoot, especially on doglegs, funnels and crosses, and note any boosters or portals that could shorten your route.
faq: How do I hit the ball?
Drag back from the ball and release. The farther you pull, the harder the hit, so adjust your drag to control the distance.
How do stars work?
Reach the hole in as few strokes as you can to earn up to three stars on each hole.

fireball-vs-ice-cream.intro: Fireball Vs Ice Cream is a survival arcade game where you control a nimble ice cream dodging fireballs through fiery arenas. Your goal is to last as long as possible while your score climbs.
tips: Watch where the fireballs are coming from before you move, and pick a path that gives you room to keep going.
Avoid backing yourself into a corner, since the arena gets harder and open space is what keeps you alive.
Stay patient rather than rushing. Small, controlled movements usually work better than sudden dashes.
Check the edges of the arena often so you always know which escape routes are still open.
Keep your focus steady as challenges escalate, because a single missed dodge can end the run.
faq: What is the main goal of Fireball Vs Ice Cream?
The goal is to survive the fireballs for as long as possible and increase your score while you outlast the heat.
Why does the game get harder over time?
The description says the challenges escalate, so the fireballs and arena pressure become more demanding the longer you last.

boat-attack.intro: Boat Attack is a one-player boat racing game set on emerald water beside limestone islands. You drive a speed boat through narrow track turns to beat your opponents in the championship.
tips: Ease off the throttle before narrow turns, since carrying too much speed into a tight bend is the easiest way to lose ground.
Try both boat types early on and stick with the one that feels more controllable through corners.
Learn the shape of the track on your first laps so you can line up for the next turn before you reach it.
Use R to reload your boat when it ends up stuck or badly off course, rather than losing time struggling to get back on track.
Use P to pause when you need a moment to plan your route, and paint your boat a bright color so it is easy to spot among the opponents.
faq: What is the goal of Boat Attack?
You race as a motorboat driver in a boat racing championship and try to beat all of your opponents.
How do I steer the boat?
Use the WASD keys or the arrow keys to drive the boat.

2048-classic-puzzle-challenge.intro: 2048 Classic Puzzle is a sliding tile game where you slide and merge tiles to reach the 2048 target. Planning ahead matters more than speed, so take time with each move.
tips: Keep your highest tile in one corner and build the other tiles in order from it, so it stays safe from being moved out of place.
Before each slide, look at where every tile will land. Choose the move that keeps matching numbers next to each other.
Keep empty spaces open on the board. When the board fills up, it becomes much harder to set up merges.
Avoid making the same move again and again without checking the board. A quick check each turn prevents most mistakes.
If you get stuck, try a different direction that does not shift your biggest tile out of its corner.
faq: What is the goal of 2048 Classic Puzzle?
Slide and merge tiles to build up to the 2048 target on the board.
How do I play?
Slide the tiles across the board using the controls, and matching numbers merge into one larger tile when they meet.

mystical-blade-3d.intro: Mystical Blade 3D is a simulation game where you build your own B-Blades by mixing elements, blades, and rings, then test them against other players. Each combination you try can change how your creature performs in battle.
tips: Try a few different combinations of blades, rings, and elements before settling on a build, since each mix can produce a different creature.
Pay attention to how each part changes your B-Blade, and note which combinations work well together so you can repeat them.
Plan your build around the kind of battles you want to win, rather than picking parts at random.
Use battles against other players to see which tactics succeed, and adjust your design based on what you learn.
Check the rankings regularly to track your progress and compare your results with other players' creations.
faq: What is the main goal of Mystical Blade 3D?
The main goal is to create your own B-Blades by mixing elements, blades, and rings, then use them to battle other players and rise up the rankings.
How do I make a strong B-Blade?
Experiment with different combinations of blades, rings, and elements, and keep the ones that perform best in battle. Strategic thinking matters as much as the parts you choose.

candy-cutter-saga.intro: Candy Cutter Saga is a physics-based puzzle where you cut ropes to guide candy past obstacles, collect the stars, and drop it into the hungry player's mouth. Timing and planning your cuts are the keys to success.
tips: Before you cut anything, look at the whole path from the candy to the mouth and check which obstacles it has to pass.
Plan the order of your cuts, since cutting one rope can change where the candy swings next.
Watch the swing after each cut before making another one, so you can judge the timing of the next move.
Try to collect the stars along the way, not just reach the mouth, because the stars are part of the goal.
If a try fails, think about why the candy moved the way it did, then change your plan instead of repeating the same cut.
faq: What is the main goal in Candy Cutter Saga?
Your goal is to guide the candy through the obstacles, collect all the stars, and land it perfectly in the mouth of the hungry player object.
How do I control the candy?
You control the candy by cutting the rope at the right moment, so the physics carry it toward the mouth.

alien-shooter.intro: Alien Shooter is an arcade airplane game where you upgrade your arsenal and fight off waves of alien enemies across a series of missions. Strategy and firepower both matter.
tips: Spend upgrades on the weapons that suit how you play, and keep an eye on which ones improve your firepower the most.
Plan each mission before you start by noting what the objectives are and what kind of enemies you will face.
Stay alert for incoming alien hordes so you can prioritise the biggest threats before they overwhelm you.
Treat each mission as a chance to test a different approach, then keep the upgrades and tactics that work best for you.
If a mission gets hard, step back and review your strategy rather than repeating the same approach.
faq: What is the goal of Alien Shooter?
The goal is to fend off relentless alien hordes and save humanity from extinction by completing missions with your upgraded arsenal.
How do I upgrade my weapons?
The game lets you upgrade your arsenal to boost your firepower, so check the in-game menus for the available upgrade options.

gram-simulator.intro: Gram Simulator is an arcade simulation about building an influencer career. You snap and share posts, engage with fans, grow your audience, and climb the social ladder.
tips: Treat every post as a chance to grow. Think about what makes a post stand out before you share it.
Spend time engaging with fans, not only posting. The game centers on your audience, so their response matters as much as the content.
Pay attention to which kinds of posts bring the most attention and repeat those approaches. Adjust your style based on what works.
Take your time crafting each post rather than rushing through. A well-made post is the core of the experience.
Keep an eye on your progress up the social ladder and aim to build momentum steadily instead of chasing quick spikes.
faq: What is the main goal of Gram Simulator?
Your goal is to grow your audience and climb the social ladder by crafting posts and engaging with fans.
Is posting enough to succeed in the game?
Posting is only part of it. The game also asks you to engage with your fans, which is key to growing your audience.

squid-gun-fest.intro: Squid Gun Fest is a shooting game where you upgrade your weapons with math gates and destroy Squid Game employees. You aim and fire with a mouse or touchpad.
tips: Check the math before you move into a gate, since the weapon you get depends on the calculation.
Build up your weapon count early, because the boss Squid Game baby needs many weapons to destroy.
Keep track of your points as you go, since they decide how many different weapons you can reach.
When you reach the final line, stop and focus on the truck trying to escape the island so it does not get away.
Use short, steady mouse or touchpad movements to line up shots instead of rushing your aim.
faq: What is the main goal of Squid Gun Fest?
Duplicate your weapons by solving math, destroy the Squid Game employees, and stop the truck from escaping the island at the final line.
How do I get 6 different weapons?
Accumulate the points you earn at the end of each level, which unlocks the different weapon types.

hidden-objects-recipe-collection.intro: Hidden Objects: Recipe Collection is a cozy kitchen search game. Find every item on the list among pots, plates, mugs, and spices, then enjoy a real recipe as your level bonus.
tips: Read the full list before you start searching so you know exactly which shapes and colors to look for.
Scan the screen in sections, such as one corner or one shelf at a time, instead of jumping around. This keeps you from missing items you have already passed.
Pay extra attention to items that look like their neighbors, such as two similar mugs or spice jars. Compare the details before you tap.
Look for partly covered items by spotting edges, handles, or colors that stick out from behind other objects.
Save hints for items you have checked several times. Spending a little time on an item first can still help you earn more points, since the goal is to finish quickly.
faq: How do I earn the most points?
The goal is to find all the hidden objects as quickly as possible. Working through the list in a steady order helps you move faster.
What should I do when I cannot find an item?
Use a hint to get help with a tricky item. You can then continue searching for the rest of the list.

archer-ragdoll.intro: Archer Ragdoll is a stickman archery game with ragdoll physics, bouncing arrows, and a body damage system. You upgrade your archer, face opponents and bosses, and compete on a player ranking.
tips: Draw the bow by holding behind the archer's back rather than pulling it sideways, then keep holding while you aim before you release.
Arrows ricochet and bounce unpredictably off surfaces and armor, so watch where a shot lands and use bounces to your advantage.
Each part of the body takes a different amount of damage, so pay attention to where your hits land and adjust your aim to match.
Try the unique arrows to see which ones suit different opponents, since each one has its own gameplay features.
Upgrade your hero steadily as you progress, and take on bosses only once your archer feels comfortable against regular opponents.
faq: How do I shoot an arrow?
Hold the mouse or touch the highlighted left side of the screen to draw the bow behind the archer's back. Keep holding to aim, then release to fire.
How does progress work in this game?
You level up your hero and can take part in the general player ranking. Daily player ratings also change as you improve.

anime-avatar-maker-anime-doll.intro: Anime Avatar Maker: Anime Doll is a dress-up game where you build an anime girl from skin tone, hair, eyes, outfits and decorations. You can work in Doll maker mode or PK mode and save photos of your creations.
tips: Start with the base look first by choosing skin tone, hairstyle and hair color, since these set the feel for the rest of the outfit.
Pick one theme or colour mood before you add dresses and decorations, so the accessories match instead of clashing.
Try a few different hairstyles and eye expressions on the same outfit to see which combination makes the character stand out.
If you are working on a styling challenge, read the goal carefully and keep checking your look against it as you go.
Take a photo when you are happy with the result, because the game is built around the photo experience and it is the best way to keep your favourite creations.
faq: What is the goal of Anime Avatar Maker: Anime Doll?

The goal is to create unique anime girl looks using skin tones, hair styles, hair colours, eye expressions, dresses and decorations. You can also meet styling challenges and compete with other players.
What are the two modes in this game?
The game has Doll maker mode and PK mode. Doll maker is for building and dressing your character, and PK mode lets you compete with other players.

connect-hero.intro: Connect Hero is a puzzle game where you aim a cannon and fire bullets to push superhero symbol gems back into their correct positions. Each level asks you to plan your shots carefully.
tips: Before you fire, look at where every gem sits and where it needs to go, so you know which gem each shot should affect.
Aim with the mouse and take a moment to judge the angle, since a single wrong shot can knock gems off their path.
Pay attention to the terrain around the gems. Bouncing or sliding shots off surfaces can reach spots a straight shot cannot.
Think about how hard you shoot before you commit. Testing a weaker shot first can show you how the gems will react.
If a shot goes badly, start by working out which gems moved and what they need next, rather than firing again right away.
faq: How do I control the cannon?
Use the mouse to aim and fire the cannon. The instructions say the game is played entirely with the mouse.
What is the main goal of each level?
You need to push the superhero symbol gems back to their correct positions using the bullets you shoot.

final-fight-harbor-justice.intro: Final Fight: Harbor Justice is a 2D arcade brawler where you fight through docks and city blocks as Nessa or Ivo. Expect patrols, bonus rounds and boss encounters along a scrolling campaign.
tips: Pick Nessa if you prefer powerful hits and a steadier pace, or Ivo if you like to move quickly and reposition around enemies.
Watch for the readable attack warnings before enemies strike, and use block or a well-timed jump to avoid taking damage.
Pick up pipes when you need extra reach or power, and smash crates when you need supplies, especially before a tough patrol or boss.
Use grabs and throws on enemies that crowd you, since moving them out of the way can make a group fight much easier.
Keep an eye on the local checkpoints and reach them before risky sections, so a defeat sends you back to a safer point.
faq: What is the goal of Final Fight: Harbor Justice?
You take back the waterfront by fighting through the scrolling campaign, demolition bonus rounds and boss encounters.
How do I attack and defend?
Press J or click to punch and hold Shift to block. Use L or E to grab enemies or pick up objects, and use Q for a rally burst.

stealthy-heist.intro: Stealthy Heist is a stealth game where you plan heists as a master thief. Sneak past guards, disable alarms, crack safes, and collect treasure without getting caught.
tips: Before you move, look at the whole room and work out a route that keeps you away from guards. Each heist is described as a puzzle, so a little planning goes a long way.
Timing matters as much as speed. Wait for the right moment to pass a guard instead of rushing, since a bit of luck is part of every heist.
Disable alarms early when you can. An alarm that goes off can make the rest of the heist much harder to finish quietly.
Collect treasure as you go, but do not let greed pull you into risky spots. Getting caught ends the job, so the safest loot is the loot you can carry out.
Spend your rewards on gadget upgrades and new skills as soon as you can afford them. Later missions get harder, and better tools make the quiet approach easier to keep up.
faq: What is the goal of Stealthy Heist?
Your goal is to pull off a heist without leaving a trace. That means stealing valuable treasure while staying undetected by security guards and alarms.
How do I get better at the heists?
Think before each move, plan your route, and pay attention to timing. Practice on earlier missions so you can handle the harder ones that come later.

amaze-escape.intro: Amaze Escape is a maze puzzle set in a high-security prison, where you must outwit guards and work through harder challenges to reach freedom. Each choice you make moves you closer to the exit.
tips: Before you move, look at the whole maze layout and plan a route to the exit rather than wandering into dead ends.
Watch where the guards are and how they move, and time your steps so you are not in their path.
Treat every decision as important, since one wrong move can have consequences, so slow down at tricky junctions.
Expect the challenges to get harder as you go, so use what you learned in earlier stages to plan the next one.
If you fail, think about which decision caused the problem and try a different approach next time instead of repeating the same route.
faq: What is the main goal of Amaze Escape?
Your goal is to escape the prison by getting through the maze and its challenges while avoiding the guards. Each decision brings you closer to freedom.
What makes a wrong move so costly?
The game warns that one wrong move leads to consequences, so a mistake can set you back or end your attempt. Careful, deliberate decisions help you avoid this.

aquapark-shark.intro: Aquapark Shark is a casual clicker racing game where you guide a little character down water slides to the finish line with the best score you can manage. Hold the mouse or touch to speed up and release to slow down.
tips: Watch how your speed changes when you press and release, and try to stay fast on straight sections without losing control.
Release the button before sharp turns or drops so you do not overshoot the track.
Practice short holds and releases instead of holding constantly, so you can react to each part of the course.
Pay attention to the finish line distance as you go, and save your strongest push for the final stretch.
Play several runs in a row to learn where the slides slow you down, then focus on those spots to improve your score.
faq: What is the goal of Aquapark Shark?
Help the little character reach the finish line in the water park with the best score you can get.
How do I control the character on a computer?
Hold the left mouse button to accelerate and release it to brake.

musketeers-gunpowder-vs-steel.intro: Musketeers: Gunpowder vs Steel is a 17th-century strategy game where you command a mixed team of soldiers through intense battles. Your choices and orders decide how each fight unfolds.
tips: Use A to have your squad follow you when you need them close, and use S to hold them in place when you want them to stay put.
Press D to mark a target for your squad, then use W to advance once they are aimed at the right enemy.
Use Q and E to turn your squad left or right so they face the threat, rather than walking them into the wrong position.
Use X to pull your squad back when they are getting overwhelmed, then regroup before moving forward again.
Press Space to switch camera views when you need a better look at the battlefield before giving your next order.
faq: What is the goal of the game?

You command a team of diverse soldiers during 17th-century battles and make orders and choices to win each fight. The description does not list specific win conditions, so watch the battle state closely.
Which keys control my squad?
W moves the squad forward, X moves them backward, Q and E turn them left and right, A makes them follow you, S stops their movement, and D marks a target for them.

aidan-in-danger.intro: Aidan in Danger is a pixel platformer where you play as Aidan, a young elf with a slingshot. You fight monsters and move through challenging levels to protect Drakor, the last dragon on Earth.
tips: Learn the roll (C or K) and dash (Space) early, since both help you get past danger quickly. Practice using them to dodge enemies rather than only relying on jumping.
Use short jumps and check where you will land before you commit, especially on tricky platforms. Careless leaps are a common way to lose progress.
Aim your slingshot shots (X or J) at enemies from a safe distance when you can. Stopping to shoot while under attack leaves you open to damage.
Pause (P or Tab) to look at the layout of a tough section before you move on. A short break can help you plan your route.
Keep moving forward through each level with steady, controlled movement instead of rushing. Slowing down at tricky spots tends to be safer than running into trouble.
faq: What is the main goal in Aidan in Danger?
You play as Aidan and must protect Drakor, the last dragon on Earth, from an interdimensional villain. You do this by battling monsters and getting through the levels.
Which keys do I use to shoot?
Press X or J to shoot your slingshot. Use the left and right arrow keys or A and D to move.

qblock-puzzle.intro: QBlock Puzzle is a block-placing game where you drag pieces onto a board and clear full rows or columns. There is no time limit, so you can take your time planning each move.
tips: Before dropping a block, check which rows and columns are close to full, and aim to finish one of them.
Use block rotation to test whether a piece fits a gap before you commit to placing it.
Avoid scattering single-cell gaps across the board, since they make it harder for larger blocks to fit later.
Keep some open space in the middle of the board so you always have a place for the next block.
Clear lines when you can, because each cleared line gives you points and more room to keep playing.
faq: What is the goal of QBlock Puzzle?
The goal is to fill an entire horizontal or vertical line with blocks so it clears. You also aim to beat your high score.
How do I place a block?
Drag and drop a block onto the board. Rotate it first if that helps it fit the open spaces.

defender-tanks-merge.intro: Defender: Tanks Merge is a strategy game where you build an army by merging tanks with abilities to face growing waves of enemies. Plan your merges and use your bombs and mines with care.
tips: Merge tanks as soon as you can, since a stronger tank in the field is often more useful than several weak ones.
Use the trash can on tanks you no longer need so your base stays open for better merges.
Before placing a mine, check where your tanks are, because mines can't be placed near tanks. Plan the spot ahead of time.
Tap an ability button only when you are ready to pick a target, and remember you can cancel by tapping the same button or the base area.
Keep an eye on the auto-merge feature and let it handle routine merges, so you can focus your attention on bombs, mines, and the next wave.
faq: How do I merge tanks?
Drag one tank onto another to combine them. Dragging unwanted tanks to the trash can removes them from your army.
How do I use bombs or mines?
Tap the ability button to activate it, then tap the target area. To cancel, tap the ability button again or tap the base area.

pacific-ocean-adventure.intro: Pacific Ocean Adventure is a 2D fishing shooter set in the depths of the Pacific. You hunt fish and fight sharks to earn gold, using simple keyboard or touch controls.
tips: Keep moving rather than staying in one spot, since sharks can come at you from any direction.
Use short bursts of Space to attack instead of holding it down, so you can see where your shots land.
Before engaging a shark, watch its movement for a moment and decide whether the fight is worth the risk.
Use the open water to reposition after each attack so you are not cornered between sharks and other fish.
Focus on the fish that are easiest to reach first, then turn to the sharks once you have a steady rhythm.
faq: What is the main goal of Pacific Ocean Adventure?
Your goal is to hunt other fish and fight sharks to earn gold.
How do I move my character?
Use W, A, S, D or the arrow keys to move around the ocean.

ford-f-100-eluminator-slide.intro: Ford F-100 Eluminator Slide is a car-themed slide puzzle with three images and three grid sizes: 3x3, 4x4 and 5x5 pieces. You use the mouse to rearrange the pieces until the picture is back in order.
tips: Start with the 3x3 mode to learn how the pieces move before trying the larger grids.
Solve the top row first, then the next row, and so on, so finished pieces stay in place.
Look for the piece that belongs next to the empty space and move it there before planning further moves.
On the bigger 4x4 and 5x5 grids, check the reference picture often so you don't lose track of where each part of the car belongs.
If you get stuck, undo your last few moves in your head and try a different order for the same pieces.
faq: What is the goal of Ford F-100 Eluminator Slide?
The goal is to slide the scrambled pieces into their correct positions so the car picture is complete.
Which mode should I pick first?
The 3x3 mode has the fewest pieces, so it is the easiest place to start. The 4x4 and 5x5 modes are harder because they have more pieces to arrange.

drive-pro-3d.intro: Drive Pro 3D is a one-touch racing game where you hold to speed up and release to brake. Weave through traffic and obstacles to reach the finish line of each level.
tips: Focus on timing rather than speed. Releasing the button stops the car instantly, so short holds often work better than constant acceleration.
Watch the gaps between moving hazards before you commit. Pick a gap early and plan your path through it.
Brake early when a clean dodge is not available. Stopping for a moment can keep you alive and let the traffic pass.
Practice short, controlled bursts of speed in each level to learn how the car responds to your input.
Completed levels give coins, so finish runs cleanly to build up enough to unlock new vehicles in the car shop.
faq: How do I control the car?
Press and hold the mouse button or tap the screen to accelerate. Release to brake instantly.
What is the goal of each level?
Weave through traffic, swing past obstacles, and avoid moving hazards to reach the finish line.

baby-hazel-fun-time.intro: Baby Hazel Fun Time asks you to keep a baby smiling through her day. You look after her needs, from waking her up to joining in fun activities.
tips: Start by waking Baby Hazel up, since her day depends on that first step.
Watch for the hints the game shows, because they point to what she needs next to stay cheerful.
Try clicking and dragging on different things to see how she responds before deciding what to do next.
Keep an eye on her mood throughout the day rather than only at the start, so you can respond when her smile begins to fade.
Mix in the fun activities as well as her basic care, since keeping her happy depends on both.
faq: What is the goal of Baby Hazel Fun Time?
Your goal is to keep Baby Hazel smiling by taking care of her needs and keeping her happy through the day.
How do I play the game?
You play by using clicks and drags to take care of Baby Hazel, such as waking her up and joining in her activities.

hole-feast.intro: Hole Feast is a fast arcade game where you guide a growing hole across colorful maps, swallowing objects and rival holes. Drag or use the keyboard to move, and grow fast enough to win each 90-second battle or clear the whole map.
tips: Start by swallowing the small objects near your hole, since anything smaller than your hole falls in and helps you grow.
Check the size of an object before you move toward it; if it is bigger than your hole, go around it until you have grown.
Swallow smaller rival holes when you can, and keep away from bigger ones, because a bigger rival can end your run.
Chain gulps quickly to build combos, and keep moving so the combo does not break.
Spend your earned coins on the upgrades that fit your plan: start size for a faster opening, speed for reaching objects sooner, or time if you struggle to finish battles.
faq: What is the goal of Hole Feast?
Outgrow the three rival holes in the 90-second battle, or clear 100% of the map. Either way you win coins.
How do I move my hole?
Drag anywhere on the screen, or use the WASD or arrow keys. The hole glides toward where you move.

mahjong-tide.intro: Mahjong Tide is a Mahjong Solitaire puzzle where you match pairs of free, identical tiles until the table is clear. You can play an endless flow, a daily puzzle, a 55-station journey, or Free Play.
tips: Before each move, look for tiles that sit on top of others or block a side, and remove those first to free up more options.
Check both the left and right sides of a tile, since a tile is free only when at least one side is open and nothing lies on top of it.
Use the wildcard-style matching rules to your advantage: any two flowers pair together and any two seasons pair together, so keep track of them to clear awkward tiles.
Build a chain by matching pairs quickly, but do not rush a move that frees a tile you will need later.
When you get stuck, use a hint to find a possible move, and use undo to step back if a removal leaves you with no good options.
faq: What is the goal of each board?
Clear every tile from the table by matching identical pairs of free tiles. Clearing all tiles wins the board.
What makes a tile free?
A tile is free when no tile lies on top of it and either its left or right side is open. Only free tiles can be selected for a match.

swamp-attack-online.intro: Swamp Attack Online is an action game where you defend your swamp home from waves of invading monsters. You pick up weapons, shoot back, and try to survive each attack.
tips: Switch between the 1, 2 and 3 keys early to learn what each weapon does before the waves get harder.
Use the mouse to aim carefully, since each monster type is a different challenge and wild shots waste ammo and time.
Save the Q, W, E and R special attacks for crowds or tougher monsters rather than spending them on the first few enemies.
Watch which monsters are coming closest to your home and deal with those first, so the swamp stays protected.
Think about a plan for each wave, such as which weapon suits fast zombies versus slower crocodiles or aliens, instead of firing at random.
faq: What is the goal of Swamp Attack Online?
Your goal is to defend your swamp home by shooting the invading monsters and surviving the attack. The game asks you to beat every monster that comes at you.
Which controls do I need to play?
Use the mouse to aim and shoot, the 1, 2 and 3 keys to pick weapons, and the Q, W, E and R keys for special attacks.

parkour-obby-jump-to-victory.intro: Parkour Obby Jump to Victory is a parkour course game where you leap across obstacles and avoid traps while racing the clock. Each course is a test of precise jumps and quick choices.
tips: Look ahead to the next platform before you jump so you can plan the route instead of reacting at the last second.
Pay attention to where traps sit and how they move, and time your jumps around them rather than rushing past.
Because the game is a race against time, avoid hesitating on long stretches. Commit to clear jumps and keep your pace steady.
When a jump feels risky, slow down for a moment and check your landing spot. A short pause can save a full restart.
Replay courses you have already cleared to learn their layouts, which helps you make faster decisions on later attempts.
faq: What is the main goal of Parkour Obby Jump to Victory?
Your goal is to get through each parkour course by leaping across obstacles, avoiding traps, and finishing before time runs out.
Is there a time limit on the courses?
Yes, the game is described as a race against time, so you need to keep moving with purpose rather than stopping to think for too long.

butterfly-dash.intro: Butterfly Dash is an adventure where you guide a butterfly through detailed worlds, collecting nectar while avoiding challenges and enemies. Timing and reflexes matter as much as careful planning.
tips: Watch the enemies for a moment before you move, so you can spot their pattern and time your route between them.
Look over the whole landscape before committing to a path, since the route that looks shortest may be guarded by a challenge.
Collect nectar as you go when it is safe, but do not take risky detours that could cost you progress.
Treat each strategic puzzle as a timing problem: if a section keeps defeating you, pause and try a different approach rather than repeating the same move.
Stay patient with the harder sections, because steady, deliberate moves usually work better than rushing through.
faq: What is the goal of Butterfly Dash?
You guide a butterfly through beautifully detailed worlds, collecting nectar while getting past challenges and enemies along the way.
Does the game rely more on reflexes or on puzzles?
It combines both, so you will need quick reactions for enemies and careful thinking for the strategic puzzles that test your timing and patience.

summon-tribe.intro: Summon Tribe is a merge and defense game where you combine identical units to build stronger ones and stop enemies. It is easy to pick up and also works well for idle play.
tips: Merge identical units early to build stronger ones before enemy waves become difficult.
Since space is limited, plan where each facility, trap, and turret goes before placing it.
Mix facilities, traps, and turrets so your defense covers different threats rather than relying on one type.
Check your skill choices regularly and look for combinations that work well together.
If you want to play idly, make sure your defense is strong enough to hold while you are away.
faq: What is the main goal of Summon Tribe?
The goal is to merge units into stronger ones and build a defense that stops the enemies.
How do I get stronger units?
Combine two identical units by merging them, which creates a stronger unit of the next level.

2244-number-match.intro: 2244 Number Match is a merging puzzle where you swipe to slide matching number tiles together and build larger numbers. Aim for 2048, 4096, and beyond while planning each move to score as high as you can.
tips: Plan two or three moves ahead before each swipe, since tiles can end up in awkward spots after a single careless move.
Keep your highest-value tile anchored in one area of the board so that bigger tiles don't get blocked in by smaller ones.
Try to line up pairs of identical tiles so that a single swipe merges several of them at once.
Use the 8 movement directions to reach merges that a simple up, down, left or right swipe might miss.
If you are short on time, play a few quick rounds to warm up, then switch to a longer session when you want to focus on strategy.
faq: What is the goal of 2244 Number Match?
Swipe to move and merge matching number tiles to build bigger numbers, aiming for 2048, 4096, and beyond. Your score rises as you merge more tiles.
How do I move the tiles?
Swipe in any direction to move the tiles, and matching tiles that touch will merge. The game also describes movement in 8 directions, so experiment with diagonal options.

bus-n-ball-jam.intro: Bus n Ball Jam is a color puzzle where you clear buses from the track so their colored balls can land on the conveyor belt. Match every ball to its slot before the belt overloads.
tips: Check the direction of each bus before you tap it, since every bus moves in its own way. A wrong move can block the path for other buses.
When a bus leaves the track, note the color of the ball that drops. Look for its matching slot before you make your next move.
Pick moves that open the path for other buses, not just the one closest to you. Thinking one or two moves ahead helps you avoid dead ends.
Fill matching slots as soon as you can so balls leave the belt. This keeps the belt from getting crowded.
Keep an eye on how many balls are waiting on the belt. If the pile grows, focus on the colors that have open slots first.
faq: What is the goal of Bus n Ball Jam?
Fill all the slots with the correct colored balls to solve the color puzzle. Each ball comes from a bus that leaves the track.
How do I move the buses?
Tap and move the buses at the bottom of the screen to clear the path. Each bus has its own direction, so choose your moves carefully.

stick-war-tower-mighty-defense.intro: Stick War: Tower Mighty Defense is a stickman rescue game where you guide a blue hero through enemy towers to save the princess. Each level gets harder, so planning each move matters.
tips: Check the strength number on each enemy before you drag your hero onto it, since you only win a fight when your number is higher.
Collect weapons whenever you can reach them, because they raise your power and make tougher enemies possible to beat.
Keep a running total of your strength after each weapon pickup so you know which enemies you can defeat next.
Look over the whole layout before making your first move, since a careful order of attacks is more useful than rushing into the nearest tower.
Expect later levels to demand more planning, so slow down and think through your next two or three moves each time.
faq: How do I win a level?
You win by clearing all the enemies, which rescues the princess. Each enemy has to be defeated before the level is complete.
How do I attack an enemy?
Drag and drop the blue stickman onto an enemy to start the attack. The fight is decided by the strength numbers involved.

yarn-untangled.intro: Yarn Untangled is a hyper casual puzzle where you work through tangled yarn balls with a playful kitty. Each level asks you to think through knots step by step.
tips: Before you move anything, study the whole tangle and look for the loops or ends that seem to hold the rest in place.
Work on one knot at a time rather than trying to fix everything at once, so you don't create new tangles.
Watch how the yarn responds after each move, and undo your thinking if a change makes the knot harder to read.
Take a short break when a level starts to feel frustrating, since a fresh look often reveals the path you missed.
Pay attention to how the levels increase in difficulty, and use the simpler early puzzles to get comfortable with the controls.
faq: What is the main goal of Yarn Untangled?
The goal is to untangle each yarn ball so the knots come apart, helped by a playful kitty. The puzzles get harder as you progress.
What skills does this game test?
It tests problem-solving and strategic thinking, since you need to plan how each knot will loosen before you act.

click-and-colors-dinosaurs.intro: Click and Color Dinosaurs is a coloring game where you fill outlined parts of dinosaur pictures with colors from a palette. It is built for young artists who like dinosaurs and want a relaxed, creative activity.
tips: Pick one area of the picture, such as a dinosaur's body, and finish it before moving on so the drawing looks tidy.
Choose a few colors you like before you start, then switch between them as you go rather than searching the palette for every part.
Try planning a color scheme, like one main color for the dinosaur and a second for the background, to keep the picture balanced.
Work on the bigger outlined shapes first and save the small details for last, since they are quicker to fill once the main colors are in place.
Take your time with each click so you land inside the correct outline, which helps the finished picture look neat.
faq: How do I color a part of the picture?
Click or tap on an outlined part of the image, and it fills with the color you have selected from the palette.
How do I finish a picture?
Keep filling the outlined parts until the whole picture is colored. The game is about completing the drawing rather than scoring points.

pixel-destroyer.intro: Pixel Destroyer is a physics-based arcade puzzle. Each level has a pixel shape made of blocks, and you aim and fire bouncing balls to destroy all of them using a limited number of shots.
tips: Before you fire, look at the whole shape and find the blocks that are hardest to reach. Plan your shots around those first.
Drag to aim and watch the path before you release. A small change in angle can send balls somewhere very different.
Use the walls to bounce your balls into protected areas instead of firing straight at blocks you cannot easily hit.
Since your shots are limited, avoid firing at the same spot repeatedly. Try a different angle if a shot clears little.
Observe how the balls move after each burst and adjust your next aim based on where they actually landed.
faq: What is the main goal of each level?
Destroy all the pixel blocks on the screen to complete the level. You need to do this within a limited number of moves.
How do I fire the balls?
Touch the screen or hold the mouse button and drag to aim. Release your finger or the mouse button to fire a burst of balls.

watermelon-run.intro: Watermelon Run is an adventure race where you carry watermelon bricks, look for shortcuts on the water, and build bridges to get ahead of your opponents. You can play with friends or match your skills alone.
tips: Keep an eye out for shortcuts on the water, since getting ahead of opponents is the main way to win the race.
Plan where you will build your bridge before you commit your bricks, so you do not run short while others pass you.
Try the props and weapons early to learn which combinations help you most, and use them when opponents are close.
Complete the game's tasks to unlock new watermelon clothes, and pick a character whose style suits the way you like to play.
If you are playing alone, try different approaches each round to see which routes and bridge spots work best.
faq: What is the main goal of Watermelon Run?
You carry watermelon bricks, find shortcuts on the water, and build bridges to get past your opponents. Staying ahead of the other racers is the core objective.
Can I play Watermelon Run with friends?
Yes, the game is designed to be played by many people. You can also play on your own and try different playing methods.

sand-sorting-challenge.intro: Sand Sorting Challenge is a color sorting puzzle where you pour sand between bottles until each one holds a single color. It rewards focus and planning as you work through levels.
tips: Before pouring, look at the top layer of every bottle and plan a sequence of moves rather than tapping at random.
Only pour onto a bottle whose top sand matches the color you are moving, so you never bury a color under the wrong one.
Pick a bottle to empty early when it holds only one or two colors, since clearing a bottle gives you space to separate mixed colors.
If you get stuck, step back and look for a bottle you can free up completely instead of forcing moves that mix colors further.
Work calmly and check each bottle's color before you tap, because the game is about careful sorting rather than speed.
faq: What is the goal of Sand Sorting Challenge?
The goal is to pour sand so that every bottle ends up holding only one color. Each level is complete when all the bottles are sorted.
Can I pour sand of different colors into the same bottle?
No. Only sand of the same color can be combined, so you need to match the top layer before you pour.

madness-combat-fangame.intro: Madness Combat Fangame is a shooter where you battle relentless enemies with a range of unique weapons while escaping the pursuit of Tricky the Clown. Strategy and speed both matter.
tips: Try each weapon early so you know which one suits which kind of enemy before the pressure builds.
Match your approach to the foe in front of you, since the enemies are described as diverse and need different responses.
Keep moving rather than standing still, because speed is one of the main things that keeps you ahead of the pursuit.
Plan a route or a retreat point before you commit to a fight, so you are not cornered while reloading or repositioning.
Think before you act each time: a calm, deliberate choice often beats a rushed one when enemies keep coming.
faq: What is the main goal of Madness Combat Fangame?
You need to survive the relentless pursuit of Tricky the Clown while fighting off enemies. The game asks whether you can conquer the madness.
What makes the weapons in this game worth learning?
The game offers an arsenal of unique weapons, so each one can play differently. Learning their strengths helps you handle different threats.

train-master.intro: Train Master is a puzzle game about steering a train along winding tracks, picking up passengers, and avoiding collisions. Use your rewards to upgrade your train as you go.
tips: Tap and hold to speed up, then release early when a bend or obstacle is coming, so you have time to slow down and stay on the track.
Watch for cars and people before you commit to a path. A collision is the main way to fail, so a slightly slower run is often better than a fast crash.
Plan your route through the complex paths before you move. Look ahead to see which track gives you the cleanest line to the next passenger stop.
Keep an eye on the schedule. When time is tight, prioritize the passengers closest to your route rather than detours that cost seconds.
Spend your coins and rewards on upgrades that match your play style. Speed helps with tight schedules, while capacity helps you carry more passengers per trip.
faq: What is the main goal in Train Master?
Gather passengers, drop them off, and avoid hitting cars or people. Doing this well earns rewards you can use to upgrade your train.
How do I control the train?
Tap and hold to accelerate and release to stop. Timing your releases is the key to handling curves and obstacles.

mr-bouncemasters-2.intro: Mr Bouncemasters 2 is a shooting and jumping game where you launch a penguin as far as you can. Bounce, fly fast, dodge obstacles across different locations, and upgrade your penguin to climb the leaderboard.
tips: Use each bounce to plan your next launch rather than reacting only after you land. Keeping your momentum helps you travel further.
Watch the obstacles before each launch so you know which ones you need to clear or avoid.
Spend your upgrades on the improvements that help your penguin go farther, and try to beat your own best distance each run.
Try the different locations in turn, since the obstacles change and you may find a route that suits your play style.
Keep your launches consistent and short sessions focused, then compare your results on the leaderboard to see where you can improve.
faq: How do I control the penguin?
The game uses the mouse or touch controls, so you aim and launch with whichever input you are using.
What is the goal of Mr Bouncemasters 2?
Your goal is to launch the penguin as far as you can, flying fast, bouncing high, and escaping obstacles along the way.

vehicle-driving-master-game.intro: Vehicle Driving Master is a 3D adventure where you drive and park a range of vehicles, from sports cars to heavy trucks, in designated spots. Each vehicle handles differently, so careful driving matters as much as speed.
tips: Before a parking challenge, notice how the vehicle you have chosen handles, since each one feels different on the road.
Take heavy trucks slower than sports cars, and give yourself extra room for turns and reversing.
Focus on reaching the designated spot cleanly rather than racing to the finish, because the game rewards careful parking.
Try a few different vehicles to learn their strengths, then return to the ones that suit your driving style best.
If a parking attempt goes wrong, stop, check your angle to the marked spot, and make small corrections before continuing.
faq: What is the main goal of Vehicle Driving Master?
The main goal is to drive your vehicle and park it on its designated spot with full care. The game focuses on careful parking and driving challenges rather than racing.
How do I control the game?
The instructions say to use the mouse to click any button. Use the on-screen buttons to move through the game.

spider-evolution.intro: Spider Evolution is an arcade game where you start as a tiny spider and grow into a powerful creature by outwitting opponents. This guide covers the controls and some habits that help you progress.
tips: Choose one control method and stick with it. Use the arrow keys or A and D for precise left and right movement, or switch to the mouse slider if that feels more natural.
Watch your opponents before you move. Outwitting them depends on reading where they are heading, so avoid rushing into open space.
Practice small, controlled movements. Staying steady makes it easier to react when a threat appears from either side.
Pay attention to how your spider changes as it evolves, and adjust your approach to match its new strength.
Take short breaks between runs. Coming back with a fresh view often makes it easier to spot the openings you missed.
faq: What is the main goal of Spider Evolution?
You begin as a tiny spider and aim to evolve into a powerful creature by outwitting opponents and building your skills. Progress comes from staying alert and reacting well during play.
How do I move my spider?
Use the left and right arrow keys or the A and D keys to move. You can also use the mouse slider on the right or left side of the screen to move your spider.

mahjong-sweet-connection-easter.intro: Mahjong Sweet Connection Easter is a match-3 and mahjong hybrid puzzle. Connect three or more identical Easter candies, eggs, or chocolates in a straight line to clear the board before your moves run out.
tips: Scan the whole board for three identical pieces lined up horizontally or vertically before making a move. Spotting every available line helps you plan your moves.
Aim for moves that create combos, since matching more pieces at once clears the level faster.
Keep an eye on your remaining moves and avoid wasting them on small matches that clear only a few tiles.
Pick off the less common candy types when you can, so the board does not end up with scattered single pieces you cannot match.
Play in short sessions if you prefer, and come back with fresh eyes to spot lines you may have missed.
faq: How do I win a level?
You win by removing all the sweet tiles from the board before you run out of moves.
What counts as a valid match?
Connect three or more identical candies, eggs, or chocolates in a straight line, either horizontally or vertically.

obby-prison-barry-escape.intro: Obby Prison Barry Escape is an obstacle course adventure where you break out of a secure prison and race to a waiting helicopter. Jumping, timing and careful movement are the keys to getting out.
tips: Look ahead before each jump and pick your landing spot first, since obby courses punish rushed leaps.
Use the mouse to rotate the camera often so you can see gaps, platforms and hazards before you commit to a move.
If you fall, take a moment to study the section again rather than retrying at full speed, which tends to cause repeated mistakes.
Press Tab to pause when you need a break or want to plan your route through a tricky challenge without pressure.
Check your costumes and accessories in the upgrade menu, and choose a look you enjoy so exploring the prison stays fun.
faq: What is the main goal of Obby Prison Barry Escape?
Your goal is to overcome the challenges across the prison and reach the helicopter to escape.
How do I move and jump in the game on a computer?
Use WASD to move, the mouse to rotate the camera, and the Space bar to jump. On a touch device, use the joysticks and buttons on the screen instead.

cake-shop-cafe-pastries-and-waffles-cook.intro: Cake Shop Cafe is a puzzle and strategy game where you run a café, bake pastries and waffles, serve customers, and grow your business into new locations. Planning ahead is the key to keeping every order on time.
tips: Watch your supplies closely and restock before you run out, since running short of ingredients can stop you from filling orders.
Spend your early earnings on equipment upgrades first, because faster or better tools make every later order easier to handle.
Focus on one or two best-selling items at the start rather than trying to make everything, so your kitchen stays organized.
Before expanding to a new location, make sure your current café runs smoothly, because a second shop adds more resources to manage.
Think about what each customer wants before you start baking, so you can prepare the right treats in the right order.
faq: What is the main goal of Cake Shop Cafe?
You run a café where you craft pastries and waffles, serve customers, and expand your business to new locations. Success depends on managing your resources well.
How do I improve my café over time?
The game lets you upgrade your equipment and expand to new locations. Investing in upgrades that speed up your kitchen can help you serve more customers.

watermelon-merging.intro: Watermelon Merging is a calm puzzle game where you tap to combine fruit into a giant watermelon. The goal is to keep merging until you reach the big fruit at the end.
tips: Tap with purpose rather than rapidly, since each tap adds to the merge you are building.
Look across the board for matching fruit before you act, so you can plan a chain of merges.
Play in short sessions when you like, since the game is designed to be picked up at any time.
If the board starts to feel crowded, focus on the merges that free up the most space first.
Pay attention to the colors of each fruit, because matching colors are what let you combine them.
faq: What is the goal of Watermelon Merging?
The goal is to combine fruit step by step until you create a giant watermelon.
What controls does the game use?
The game is played by tapping, and quick taps are what drive the merges.

escape-waves-for-lucky-blocks.intro: Escape Waves for Lucky Blocks is a survival game where you run across the map, collect Lucky Blocks, and dodge waves that keep coming. Build up your base with Brainrots while you stay alive.
tips: Collect Lucky Blocks early while the map is calm, since the waves arrive regularly and will make running around harder.
Keep an eye on where the next wave is coming from so you can pick a hiding spot or escape route before it reaches you.
Pick a route through the map that lets you grab Lucky Blocks and still stay close to safe ground.
Spend your resources on Brainrots steadily rather than all at once, so your base grows over time.
Upgrade your area once you have room for more Brainrots, because the game lets you place more of them that way.
faq: What is the main goal of Escape Waves for Lucky Blocks?
Your goal is to stay alive as long as possible while collecting Lucky Blocks and building up your base with Brainrots.
How do I avoid losing in this game?
Watch for incoming waves, then hide or run to safety when they approach. Keep moving rather than standing still near the wave path.

fly-car-stunt-5.intro: Fly Car Stunt 5 is a racing game set in a futuristic Space City, where you race against the clock in flying cars. You can play alone or challenge a friend in two-player mode.
tips: Save your nitro for stretches where you need a burst of speed, and avoid using it all at once early in a level.
Use the air control to line up your landing before you come back down, since the new physics reward steady, deliberate steering.
Watch for obstacles ahead and adjust your path early rather than swerving at the last moment.
Press R to restart a level as soon as you go off course, since racing against the time means a fresh start is often faster than recovering.
If you play two-player, agree on a key set before you start so each of you knows which keys to use for steering, nitro, and looking back.
faq: What is the goal of Fly Car Stunt 5?
Race against the time to finish each level, and unlock new flying cars as you progress through the game's 10 levels.
How do I control the car?
Player 1 uses the arrow keys to move, N for nitro, and B to look back. Player 2 uses W, A, S, and D to move, T for nitro, and C to look back.

slalom-hero.intro: Slalom Hero is a downhill racing game where you weave through gates down snowy slopes. Collect boosts and coins while racing rivals for the fastest time and a chance at the gold medal.
tips: Focus on passing each gate cleanly before thinking about speed, since missing gates is a quick way to lose time.
Plan your line a few gates ahead so you can turn smoothly instead of correcting at the last second.
Grab boosts when they are on or near your route, but don't take a big detour just to reach one.
Pick up coins along your path when it costs you little time, because they help improve your hero's abilities.
Replay the course to learn where the tight turns are, then aim to beat your own best time before chasing rivals.
faq: What is the main goal in Slalom Hero?
The goal is to race down the snowy slopes, passing between the gates, and finish with the fastest time possible. Doing well can earn you the gold medal.
What do the coins do?
Coins are used to enhance your hero's abilities. Collecting them along the way can help you race better in later runs.

obby-warriors-of-the-sword.intro: Obby: Warriors of The Sword is a hero RPG where you collect and upgrade swords, fight enemies, and go through rebirth to get stronger. Battles mix combat with obstacle-course movement.
tips: Upgrade the swords you already own before buying new ones, so your current weapon keeps pace with the enemies you face.
Keep an eye on which abilities you have unlocked and use them in fights instead of relying only on basic hits.
Recruit allies early, since the game highlights loyal allies as a way to strengthen your hero.
Work through missions and challenges as you go, because they unlock new levels and offer rare rewards.
Consider going through rebirth once your hero has grown as far as it can, since the game presents it as a way to become stronger and open new battle opportunities.
faq: What is the main goal of Obby: Warriors of The Sword?
The goal is to become a stronger hero by collecting powerful swords, defeating enemies, unlocking new abilities, and going through rebirth to become a legend.
What are the controls on desktop?
Use WASD to move, the left mouse button to take a hit, Space to jump, and the right mouse button with mouse movement to rotate the camera.

punch-the-wall.intro: Punch The Wall is a simple hypercasual game where you break walls standing in your way. The main control is the space bar, which you use to punch.
tips: Watch the wall ahead of you and time your punches so each one lands as you reach it.
Keep your rhythm steady rather than mashing space as fast as you can, since timing matters more than speed.
Pay attention to how each wall reacts so you can tell when a hit has landed fully.
Stay focused on the next wall in line instead of reacting only to the one you are currently breaking.
Take short breaks between sessions to keep your reactions sharp and your presses consistent.
faq: What is the goal of Punch The Wall?
Your goal is to run forward and break every wall that stands in your way by punching it.
Which key do I use to punch?
Press the space bar to punch the wall in front of you.

mfps-military-combat.intro: MFPS: Military Combat is a 3D first-person shooter where you fight in gunfights, survive the chaos, and eliminate rivals. Move with WASD and attack with the left mouse button.
