tips: Keep moving with WASD instead of standing still, since staying in one place makes you an easy target during gunfights.
Use the left mouse button to attack when a rival is clearly in your sights rather than firing at every moment.
Try the right mouse button's special actions early so you know what they do before a fight gets chaotic.
Pay attention to where enemies come from and reposition after each engagement to stay alive longer.
Focus on surviving first, because staying alive is what gives you the chance to eliminate more rivals and climb toward champion.
faq: How do I move my character?
Use the W, A, S and D keys to move. Keeping your movement varied makes it harder for rivals to line up their shots.
What do the mouse buttons do?
The left mouse click is used to attack, and the right mouse click triggers special actions.

obby-pogo-parkour.intro: Obby Pogo Parkour! is a parkour game where you bounce on a pogo ride through challenging levels, past obstacles, and against the clock of a global leaderboard. Upgrade your ride and aim for the top spot.
tips: Watch each obstacle before you commit to a bounce, so you can plan your landing spot before you jump.
Spend upgrades on the abilities that help you most with the obstacles you struggle with, rather than picking at random.
If you fall, restart the level quickly and focus on the one section that stopped you instead of replaying the whole course.
Take your time on the early levels to build a feel for how your bouncy ride responds, since the later levels rely on the same timing.
Check the global leaderboards after you improve so you can see how far you still have to go and set a clear target.
faq: What is the main goal of Obby Pogo Parkour!?
Your goal is to bounce through challenging levels, leap past obstacles, and climb the global leaderboards by racing against other players around the world.
How can I get better at the bouncing and landing?
Practice on the earlier levels first and pay attention to how high and far each bounce carries you, then apply that timing to harder sections.

the-zombie-house.intro: The Zombie House is a survival shooter where you defend your home against waves of zombies. Shoot zombies, collect coins, and spend them on upgrades for yourself and your house as the threat grows.
tips: Spend coins early on upgrades that keep your house standing, since the house is what you are protecting and losing it ends the run.
Pick up ability drops when they are safe to reach, because they can help you in a tight spot.
Keep moving with WASD on PC or the left joystick on mobile so zombies do not crowd you against the house.
Aim before you fire by lining up your shots with the zombies coming toward your home rather than chasing single targets.
Expect each level to make zombies tougher, so review your upgrade choices after every level instead of buying the same thing each time.
faq: What is the goal of The Zombie House?
Survive as long as you can while protecting your home from endless waves of zombies. Each level makes the zombies stronger, so the challenge keeps growing.
How do I shoot on PC?
Move with W, A, S, and D, then click on a zombie to shoot in that direction.

princess-glitter-coloring-for-kids.intro: Princess Glitter Coloring is a drawing game for kids where you color and decorate princess pictures. It is simple to start, with a single instruction to tap or click.
tips: Start with one part of the picture, such as the dress, and finish it before moving on so the page looks complete.
Try using a few different colors on the same princess to see how the outfit changes, since the game is about dressing up and decorating.
Take your time with small areas like hair and accessories, which help build steady hand-eye coordination.
If you want a calmer session, choose one picture and focus on filling it neatly rather than rushing through several.
Experiment with bright and unusual color combinations to explore your creative side.
faq: What do I do in Princess Glitter Coloring?
You color and decorate princess pictures by tapping or clicking on the areas you want to fill.
What are the controls?
The only control is tap or click, so you select the areas and colors you want on the picture.

angry-battle-birds-mania.intro: Angry Battle Birds Mania is a bird-flinging game where you aim a catapult and launch birds to smash enemy structures. Fewer shots mean a higher score, so every launch counts.
tips: Before each shot, look at how the structures are supported and aim for the weakest point so one hit can cause a bigger collapse.
Try to clear obstacles with as few launches as possible, since the score goes up when you use fewer shots.
Pay attention to how the physics makes blocks and structures fall, and use that to predict where a bird will do the most damage.
Experiment with your birds' abilities early on so you know which bird suits which kind of structure.
If a level is tough, step back and plan a shot that clears a path for the rest, instead of rushing each launch.
faq: How do I aim and launch a bird?
Click and aim, then use the slingshot to launch your bird at the enemy structures. Take a moment to line up the shot before you release.
How is my score determined?
The fewer shots you use to destroy all the obstacles, the higher your score will be. Focus on precise shots rather than many attempts.

crazy-plinko.intro: Crazy Plinko is a single-player puzzle game about dropping pieces through a peg board and trying to reach your target score. It rewards careful planning and learning how the board behaves.
tips: Watch several drops before committing to a strategy, since the early moves can reveal patterns in how pieces bounce.
Pay attention to where your pieces tend to land and aim for the slots that bring you closest to your target score.
Use upgrades carefully, because each one changes how gravity, angles, or timing affect your drops, so pick the change that fits your current plan.
Adjust your approach when a board changes rather than repeating the same drop, since the peg layout can make a previous method less effective.
Keep a rough record of which drops worked well so you can repeat successful choices and avoid the ones that cost you points.
faq: What is the goal of Crazy Plinko?
Your goal is to drop your pieces and hit your target score on each board. The game asks you to predict the unpredictable and test your strategy.
How do upgrades affect the game?
Upgrades let you influence gravity, angles, and timing. Choosing them well can make the board's chaotic bounces easier to control.

snack-sort.intro: Snack Sort is a tap-based puzzle where you clear vending machines by grouping matching snacks together. Plan each tap carefully, since the limited sorting slots are where most levels are won or lost.
tips: Before tapping, scan the whole machine and note which snack types have the most pieces, since those are easiest to group first.
Keep at least one sorting slot open whenever you can, because a full row of mixed snacks is the most common way to get stuck.
Try to finish a snack type completely once you start it, so its slot frees up for the next group.
Look for moves that line up two matching snacks in the same slot before moving a single snack to a new spot.
Play in short sessions and return with fresh eyes if a level stalls, since spotting a better order is often easier after a break.
faq: What is the goal of Snack Sort?
Your goal is to match all snacks of the same type so that every shelf in the vending machine is cleared.
How do the controls work?
Tap any snack to move it to an empty slot at the bottom of the screen. There are no other controls to learn.

princess-hair-spa-salon.intro: Princess Hair Spa Salon is a makeover game where you transform your character through three stages: cleanse, style, and accessorize. Work at your own pace and experiment to see how your character changes.
tips: Follow the three stages in order, starting with cleanse, so each later step builds on a clean base.
Try several hairstyles before settling on one, since changing styles is a big part of the fun.
Choose accessories that complement your chosen style rather than adding everything at once.
Look at your character after each stage to spot anything you want to adjust before moving on.
Experiment with different combinations to find looks you like, since the game encourages creativity.
faq: What is the goal of Princess Hair Spa Salon?
The goal is to give your character a relaxing makeover through cleansing, styling, and accessorizing so they leave the salon looking radiantly transformed.
How many stages does the makeover have?
The makeover has three stages: cleanse, style, and accessorize.

realistic-car-destruction-sandbox.intro: Realistic Car Destruction Sandbox is a 3D physics playground where you drive, jump, and crash cars through varied terrain and crushing machines. You set your own challenges, repair your vehicle, and test again.
tips: Pick one test per run, such as a single jump or one impact against a fence, so you can clearly see how the car body deforms and which parts break away.
Repair your vehicle with R before each new experiment so every crash starts from the same condition and your results are easier to compare.
Try the same jump or impact from different angles and speeds to learn how the physics responds to small changes.
Switch camera views with C during a crash to judge where damage happens, since the view you use for driving may hide what is breaking.
If you join a multiplayer session, take turns setting up the test so each player can watch the results from a clear position.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
It is a sandbox with no fixed goal. You choose a vehicle and environment, then set your own challenges, such as jumps, impacts, or crushing tests.
How do I drive and use the handbrake?
Use WASD or the arrow keys to drive, and hold Space for the handbrake. Left Shift gives you a boost.

cat-from-hell-cat-simulator.intro: Cat From Hell - Cat Simulator is a mischievous browser game where you play a cat causing chaos around Granny's house. You knock things over, make a mess, and try to escape before she catches you.
tips: Look around each room before you start knocking things over, so you know which objects are worth breaking and where you can run to.
Keep an eye on where Granny is at all times, and move away from her path before she gets close.
Plan a clear escape route in each area so you are not cornered once the mess starts.
Explore every corner, since the description notes that secrets can be destroyed in hidden spots.
Pace your pranks: a quick, well-timed mess is often safer than trying to wreck the whole house at once.
faq: What is the goal of Cat From Hell Cat Simulator?
You play as a troublemaking cat inside Granny's house, knocking things over and causing chaos while you escape before she catches you.
How do I control the cat?
Use a mouse click or tap to play. The game is controlled entirely with clicks or taps.

blocks-shooter-3d-run-shoot-merge-weapon.intro: Blocks Shooter 3D! is an arcade runner where you swipe to run along a track, shoot stickmen, and combine weapon parts into stronger guns. Reach the finish line alive to clear each round.
tips: Grab weapon parts whenever you can, since each new part you combine makes your gun stronger. Plan your route so you pass through them rather than ignoring them.
Swipe early to line up with traps instead of reacting at the last moment. Watching the track a few steps ahead gives you time to dodge.
Visit the workshop after every round and spend your upgrades before the next one. Enemies get stronger, so a weapon that was enough last time may fall behind.
Keep your hero moving toward the finish rather than lingering in a crowd. Staying in one place gives enemies more time to surround you.
Use each round to test which weapon combinations work best for you, and note what helped you stay alive. Adjusting your build over time is the main way to keep up with tougher enemies.
faq: What is the goal of Blocks Shooter 3D!?
Destroy enemies, upgrade your gun, and reach the finish line alive. Each round gets harder as enemies grow stronger.
How do I control my hero?
Swipe left or right to move the hero along the track while destroying enemies on the way.

stickman-miners-wars.intro: Stickman Miners Wars puts you in charge of a stickman king who builds miners and warriors to take on enemy castles. Plan your economy early, then time your attacks to break the opponent's towers first.
tips: Buy a few miners right away, since they start earning gold for you while you do other tasks. Mining gold yourself alongside them gives you a faster start.
Save up for warriors once your gold income feels steady, so you can build a real army instead of spending everything on a small group.
Keep an eye on your own castle while your army is away. The opponent is trying to reach it too, so leave enough defense at home.
Send your army at the right moment using the sword icon or the E key. Attacking after you have gathered a solid group usually works better than sending units in one at a time.
Focus your attacks on the enemy towers before the castle, since the goal is to destroy the towers first and then the castle.
faq: What is the main goal of Stickman Miners Wars?
Your goal is to destroy the opponent's towers first and then their castle. The opponent is working toward the same goal against your castle.
How do I build my army?
Go to the miner purchase zone and buy a few miners to gather gold. Once you have enough gold, head to the warrior purchase zone to add warriors to your army.

zombie-horde-build-and-survive.intro: Zombie Horde: Build & Survive is a Halloween strategy game where you defend your base from waves of zombies. You shoot them with different weapons and set up turrets, barricades and traps.
tips: Place barricades and traps where zombies approach your base, so they slow down while your turrets and weapons deal damage.
Spread your turrets so that one side of your base is not left unprotected when the horde comes from another direction.
Keep your character moving rather than standing still, so you can reach zombies that get past your defenses and shoot them.
Stay near your base where your turrets can cover you, and step out only to shoot zombies that are close enough to hit.
Check which zombies are getting through and add a barricade or turret in that spot before the next group arrives.
faq: What is the goal of Zombie Horde: Build & Survive?
Your goal is to defend your base from hordes of zombies. You do this by shooting them and placing turrets, barricades and traps.
How do I move my character on PC?
Use the WASD keys or the arrow keys to move your character.

bucket-crusher-asmr.intro: Bucket Crusher ASMR is a relaxing demolition game where you use a crusher arm to break down pixel walls and structures. Click or tap to control the bucket and work through each level.
tips: Start by looking at the whole structure before you crush anything, so you can see which parts will bring the level's progress up fastest.
Work in small, steady sections instead of rushing. Pulverizing each brick and pixel with precision keeps the arm aimed where it counts.
Pay attention to how far the arm can reach and clear nearby pieces first. Moving on before a section is finished can leave parts you have to come back to.
Upgrade your machine as you go, focusing on the length, size and power of the arm. A longer reach and more power make later levels much easier to clear.
Take short breaks between levels if you are playing for relaxation. The game is paced for calm, repeated crushing rather than quick reactions.
faq: What is the goal of Bucket Crusher ASMR?
Your goal is to crush the pixel walls and structures into pieces. Doing this completes the level's progress so you can move on.
How do I control the crusher arm?
Use a mouse click or tap to control the bucket arm and aim your crushing.

tiny-tomb.intro: Tiny Tomb is a 3D voxel adventure set in enigmatic chambers. You explore, dodge traps and enemies, complete quests, and collect coins and treasure.
tips: Explore each chamber fully before moving on, since treasure, coins, and clues to the tomb's puzzles are spread out.
Watch how traps are placed and time your movement around them rather than rushing through a room.
Keep track of your active quests so you know which rooms or items matter most for progress.
Use your unique abilities in situations where they can reveal hidden paths or mysteries, not just when you are in danger.
When an enemy is nearby, plan your route so you can keep moving toward your goal instead of getting cornered.
faq: What is the main goal in Tiny Tomb?
Your main goals are to explore the tomb, uncover its hidden mysteries, collect treasures and coins, and complete quests. Progress also comes from unlocking the puzzled passageways.
How do I avoid losing progress?
Move carefully around traps and keep an eye on lurking enemies. Slowing down to check your surroundings often prevents costly mistakes.

shortcut-race-3d.intro: Shortcut Race 3D! is a racing game where you collect boards along the track, use them to build shortcuts, and compete against opponents. Swipe to steer and balance your speed against your load.
tips: Collect boards steadily rather than grabbing as many as possible at once, since each extra board you carry slows you down.
Watch your speed as your stack grows, and aim to keep enough boards to build shortcuts without falling too far behind.
Use shortcuts when you have enough boards to build them, since they help you gain ground on opponents.
Keep an eye on where opponents are positioned and adjust how many boards you carry to stay competitive in the race.
Swipe in small, controlled movements so you stay on the track and reach the boards you want to collect.
faq: What is the goal of Shortcut Race 3D!?
The goal is to race against opponents while collecting boards along the track and using them to build shortcuts. Balancing your board count against your speed helps you win.
How do I move my character?
Touch and swipe the screen to move. Swiping lets you steer along the track and reach boards.

word-search-offline-puzzle.intro: Word Search: Offline Puzzle is a calm letter-tracing game where you swipe across tiles to spell hidden words. Clear levels to climb an evolution ladder from atom to mind.
tips: Start by scanning for the first letter of each word, then trace outward in every direction, not just straight lines.
Remember that paths can bend around corners, so a word that seems missing may curve through the grid.
Work on one word at a time and try a different path if a submission fails, since wrong attempts cost nothing.
Use a Hint when a word stalls instead of searching the same area, because there is no timer and hints save time.
Tap solved words to read their meanings, which helps you recognize longer words faster on later levels.
faq: Is there a time limit in each level?
No. The game has no timer, so you can take as long as you need to find every word.
What happens if I trace the wrong word?
Nothing is lost. The tiles do not lock in, and you can simply try a different path.

monster-escape-logic-puzzle-adventure.intro: Monster Escape is a logic puzzle where you rotate the dungeon to guide your monster to the key and out through the exit. Each of its 60 levels adds new obstacles and asks you to plan your moves.
tips: Before you rotate, look at where the monster will end up after each turn. Rotations move everything at once, so a move that helps the monster now can drop it into a trap.
Use the walk controls when you only need to shift the monster a little. Tapping left or right of the monster moves it without rotating the level, which saves rotations for bigger changes.
Watch for falling boxes and pause your plan to see when they drop. Timing your moves around them is often safer than rushing through.
Keep sharp thorns and other obstacles in mind when choosing a rotation. Check the path to the key before you commit to a turn.
Take it slowly on later levels. The description says each level gets harder, so a short pause to map out the route is usually worth it.
faq: What is the goal of Monster Escape?
Guide your monster to the key and then reach the escape point to leave the dungeon. Avoid traps along the way.
How do I move the monster?
Use the onscreen buttons to rotate the world. Tap to the left or right of the monster to walk it without rotating the level.

knight-crown-idle.intro: Knight Crown Idle is a pixel-style idle RPG where you click or tap enemies, earn gold and experience, and upgrade your hero. Each fight makes your character a little stronger for the next challenge.
tips: Spend your gold and experience on upgrades as soon as you can afford them, since a stronger hero makes later fights faster and safer.
Compare your hero's stats and abilities before buying an upgrade, and favor the ones that help you defeat enemies more quickly.
Keep an eye on the enemies you face. When they start to feel much harder, it is a sign to upgrade before pushing further.
Move on to new areas once you unlock them, but make sure your hero is strong enough to handle the challenges there.
Check your achievements from time to time, since completing them is part of building a more powerful character.
faq: How do I defeat monsters in Knight Crown Idle?
Click or tap on enemies to defeat them. Each battle earns gold and experience that you can use to grow your hero.
What should I spend gold and experience on?
Use them to upgrade your hero's stats and abilities. Stronger stats make it easier to handle tougher enemies later on.

2-player-games-mini-games.intro: 2 Player Games is a collection of short mini-games for two people sharing one screen, including tennis, air hockey, curling and billiards. You can also play alone against the AI opponent.
tips: Pick a mini-game that suits your group's style, such as air hockey for fast reactions or tic-tac-toe for slower, planned moves.
Agree on who uses which set of controls before you start, so both players know their side and do not clash during a round.
Play a few rounds against the AI first to learn how each mode behaves before you challenge a real opponent.
Since rounds are short, stay focused from the first moment, because a single lucky point can decide the match.
In modes that get harder over time, keep your moves steady rather than rushing, since careless mistakes cost more as the difficulty rises.
faq: How do I start a game?
Choose a mini-game from the menu, check that the controls for both players are shown on screen, then press start.
How do I win a round?
Follow the rules of the mode you picked, such as hitting the ball or placing marks, and the player with the highest score at the end of the round wins.

simple-words.intro: Simple Words combines word building with a falling-block puzzle. Tap letters to make words, and clear rows by using every letter in them.
tips: Before you tap, look at which rows are close to being finished. Words that use the last few letters of a row clear it faster.
Pay attention to which letters are going dark. Once a letter is used, it can no longer help you, so plan around the letters that remain available.
Do not rush every word. Sometimes a short word that clears a row now is better than a long word that leaves awkward letters behind.
If you are new, try Round Mode first. It lets you play at your own pace, so you can learn how rows clear without any time pressure.
In Moves Mode, every tap counts. Choose words that use several letters at once so you get further before you run out of moves.
faq: What is the goal of Simple Words?
Make words by tapping letters, and clear rows by using all of the letters in them. The game is about clearing rows as you go.
How do I select letters?
Tap or click any letters to form a word. Letters you have used turn dark, so they cannot be used again.

rocket-bloom.intro: Rocket Bloom is a physics arcade flyer where you control thrust by holding the screen. Collect coins, rings and fuel while climbing toward space.
tips: Release the screen briefly when you are low on fuel or drifting off course, since the rocket's weight will slow it and let you plan the next burn.
Watch for the green ring at each stage separation and tap right on time to get the PERFECT boost, which is worth more than a sloppy separation.
Steer early toward the coin trails you can reach, and aim for the fuel cans before you run dry so a long climb doesn't end in a fall.
Save coins for the engine and fuel tank upgrades first, since a stronger engine makes the long climb toward 100,000 m much easier.
Try to keep a streak of ten coins going for AFTERBURN, because the triple coins it unlocks can speed up your upgrades.
faq: What is the main goal of Rocket Bloom?
Your main goal is to reach SPACE at 100,000 m. After that, you can keep climbing all the way to the Moon.
How do I control the rocket?
Hold anywhere on the screen or press SPACE to run the engine, and let go to let the rocket fall. Slide your finger or use the arrow keys to steer.

flappyball.intro: FlappyBall asks you to guide a flapping ball through a maze of obstacles. Each tap moves you through tighter spaces, and the challenge never ends.
tips: Tap with a steady rhythm rather than in bursts, since the game rewards consistent timing as the spaces get tighter.
Watch the gap ahead rather than the ball itself, so you can start adjusting before you reach an obstacle.
Ease off on tapping when you are high in the screen to avoid overcorrecting into the next obstacle.
Practice short runs to learn how far each tap lifts the ball, then build up to longer runs as your reflexes sharpen.
Keep an eye on your score as a benchmark, and try to beat your previous best before comparing with friends.
faq: What is the goal of FlappyBall?
The goal is to guide the flapping ball through the maze of obstacles and reach higher scores. Because the game is endless, you keep going until you hit an obstacle.
How do I control the ball?
Each tap makes the ball flap, so your tapping controls how high and how fast it moves through the maze.

fastlane-revenge-online.intro: Fastlane Revenge Online is a 2D arcade racing and shooting game where you work your way back to first place by beating rival racers and bosses. It is played with the mouse or by touch.
tips: Watch your position on the track early on, since getting back to first place is the whole goal and every lead you hold matters.
Learn the boss patterns before you commit to a head-on fight, because bosses are the toughest obstacles in the race.
Use the shooting side of the game when a rival is blocking your line, rather than trying to overtake them in a crowded spot.
Keep your car moving with steady mouse or touch input so you do not drift into hazards or lose ground on corners.
Retry a stage with a clear plan for the bosses and rivals you faced last time, since small improvements add up quickly.
faq: What is the main goal in Fastlane Revenge Online?
Your goal is to recover first place by beating the other players and the bosses along the way.
How do I control the car?
The game is played with the mouse or touch controls, which you use to steer and shoot.

moonshine-runners-samogonki.intro: Moonshine Runners Samogonki is a kart racing game set on an alien world. You pick a racer, cast spells, dodge rogue robots, and race unpredictable tracks to reclaim your planet.
tips: Try a few different racers early on, since each one is described as unique, and keep the one whose style suits you best.
Collect the energy pickups when you can do so without losing your position, because the description calls energy crucial.
Save your spells for moments when rivals or robots are close, rather than using them as soon as you have them.
Expect the tracks to surprise you and keep your eyes on the road ahead so you can react to turns and hazards in time.
Keep an eye on rogue robots and steer away from them early, since outmaneuvering them is a core part of the challenge.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
You race to win, and victory reclaims your planet. The race is set against rogue robots on unpredictable tracks.
How do energy and spells work together?
The description does not explain how they connect, so watch how energy and spells behave in your first few races to learn the link.

ultimate-bike-stunt-racing.intro: Ultimate Bike Stunt Racing is a browser bike game where you race through challenging tracks and perform stunts. Choose from a range of bikes, from fast motorcycles to agile stunt bikes.
tips: Most levels are easy to finish, so use your first attempts to learn how each track flows before you chase the top time.
Use the up and down arrows for flips only when you are in the air, so you keep control of the bike when you land.
Try a few different bikes, since a fast motorcycle and a nimble stunt bike may suit different tracks.
Practice the jump with the space bar on a level you have already passed, so you can time it better when the race counts.
Once you can finish a level, focus on small improvements such as steadier landings and smoother braking to beat your best time.
faq: What is the goal of Ultimate Bike Stunt Racing?
You race through each track and try to finish it, with the hardest challenge being to beat the top time on a level.
Which keys do I use to control the bike?
Use the right arrow to drive, the left arrow to brake, the up arrow for a front flip, the down arrow for a back flip, and the space bar to jump.

idle-zombie-wave.intro: Idle Zombie Wave is a tower defense shooter set in an apocalypse. You lead a team of survivors and hold back wave after wave of undead to defend your home.
tips: Watch each wave as it approaches before you react, so you can see which direction the zombies are coming from.
Keep your attention on the defense line instead of the edges of the screen, since the horde keeps coming and gaps close quickly.
Pace your taps or clicks rather than rushing them, because steady, deliberate choices tend to hold up better than frantic ones.
Think like a decisive leader: when a wave starts to overwhelm one spot, shift your focus there before it breaks through.
Take a short break between waves to reset your focus, since the undead keep returning and fatigue can cause missed targets.
faq: What is the goal of Idle Zombie Wave?
The goal is to defend your home by commanding your survivors through waves of zombies. Each wave brings more undead, so the challenge grows over time.
How do I control the game?
You play by tapping or clicking. Use your input to direct your survivors and respond to the incoming horde.

knight-360.intro: Knight 360 is an action game where you play a knight fighting monsters like skeletons and ghosts using spin attacks. Each level brings new enemy tactics and tougher survival ttests.
tips: Watch how enemies move before committing to an attack, since their tactics change as you progress.
Use spin attacks when several enemies are close together so one swing can hit more than one target.
Keep track of your surroundings in the 3D environments so you do not get pinned in a corner.
Take a moment to reassess when a new enemy type appears instead of rushing in with the same approach.
Stay patient and pick your openings; survival matters more than clearing a room as fast as possible.
faq: What is the main goal of Knight 360?
You play as a knight who fights eerie monsters, including skeletons and ghosts, and survives each level as the challenge increases.
What makes the combat in Knight 360 different?
The game focuses on strategic spin attacks, so positioning and timing your swings matter as much as raw attack power.

build-a-keycap-pyramid.intro: Build a Keycap Pyramid is a 3D building game where you collect keycaps, carry them up a wobbling tower and raise a pyramid layer by layer. Chain combos, train your strength and defend your pyramid from Glitch raiders.
tips: Keep your combos going, since chaining them is a steady way to earn more keycaps as you collect them.
Watch for gold (x10) and rainbow (x50) keycaps and route yourself past them when you can, because they are worth far more than common ones.
Train on benches and treadmills at a steady pace, focusing on the letter shown so you get perfect reps instead of rushing and missing.
When raiders approach, throw keycaps at them early and save your typing for the boss, where you need to type the word to break its shield.
Before you leave, check that your pyramid and your Keycap Pets are set up, since builder bots keep earning while you are away and daily challenges reward regular visits.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Your goal is to gather keycaps, carry them to your pyramid and build it up layer by layer. Each finished pyramid is saved to your plot, and the next one is bigger.
How do I defend my pyramid from raiders?
Throw keycaps at Glitch raiders with F or a click. To break the shield of a boss raider, type the word it shows.

school-escape-obby.intro: School Escape Obby is a platforming game where you escape from school by jumping, dodging, and solving puzzles across different zones. You also need to play for time while you move through each challenge.
tips: Learn the jump timing early, since most obstacles depend on landing cleanly before moving on.
Use TAB to pause when you need a moment to plan your next move, then return with a clear route in mind.
Try the F key on enemies when they block your path, and save your movement for the gaps between them.
Press E or click on objects to interact with them, and check puzzle pieces around you before trying to escape a section.
If you are playing on a phone, get comfortable with the on-screen controls in a calm area before entering harder zones.
faq: What is the main goal in School Escape Obby?
Your goal is to escape from school while playing for time. You move through zones, handle obstacles, and solve puzzles to get out.
How do I move and jump on PC?
Use WASD to move and Space to jump. Press Shift to show your cursor when you need it.

99-night-survivor.intro: Survive 99 nights in a foggy forest by gathering by day and defending your campfire from monsters by night. Rescue four lost kids and face the boss in the final nights.
tips: Use daylight to chop trees, gather food and craft gear at camp, so you enter each night with supplies ready.
Keep the campfire fed before dusk, since monsters come for it once night falls.
Stand near the fire and press F to upgrade it; each upgrade helps push back the fog, so save resources for it when you can.
Check the map (M) and quests (J) often, and read the forest notes (N) to track the four lost kids and plan which zone to explore next.
If you want a bigger challenge, try hardcore mode with a single heart, but practice the day and night routine on normal settings first.
faq: What is the main goal of 99 Night Survivor?
Survive 99 nights and rescue the four lost kids. Keeping the campfire burning and upgrading it are central to reaching that goal.
How do I upgrade the campfire?
Stand near the fire and press F. Upgrading the fire clears the fog, which lets you explore further.

my-parking-lot.intro: My Parking Lot is a puzzle game about clearing tangled cars by plotting safe routes to the exits. Each arrangement tests how well you plan moves ahead of time.
tips: Before you move anything, scan the whole lot and find which car is blocking the exit path. Start your plan from that bottleneck.
Try planning a route in your head for the car nearest the exit first, since clearing that space often opens up the rest of the puzzle.
Use small, careful drags rather than rushing. Checking each move for possible collisions helps you avoid having to restart.
If you get stuck, step back and try moving a car you have not touched yet. Trying a different car can reveal a new path.
As puzzles become more intricate, slow down and map out two or three moves before committing. Thinking ahead is the main skill the game builds.
faq: What is the goal of My Parking Lot?
The goal is to clear the traffic jam by moving cars to the exits without any of them colliding. Each puzzle has its own arrangement to solve.
How do I move the cars?
You use intuitive drag controls, so you click or touch a car and drag it along a path. Plan the route before you release it.

push-to-go.intro: Push to Go is a 2D puzzle platformer where you tap the right buttons to get past obstacles. Plan each move, then collect stars to unlock new stages.
tips: Before you press anything, look at the whole stage and work out the order of moves you need. Planning ahead is central to this game.
Watch how each button changes the stage before you commit to it. Small test presses can show you what an obstacle will do.
Pay attention to timing. Some puzzles depend on when you press, not just which button you press.
Collect the stars you pass along the way, since they are tied to unlocking new stages.
If you get stuck, step back and try a different sequence instead of repeating the same taps. Levels get harder as you go, so a fresh approach often helps.
faq: What is the goal of Push to Go?
Move through each stage by tapping the right buttons to get past obstacles. Collecting stars helps you unlock new stages.
How do I control the character?
You play with mouse clicks or taps. Each press moves you through the stage.

geometryrush.intro: Geometry Rush is an arcade runner where you guide a cube through a colorful geometric world. Time your jumps to clear spikes and obstacles, and collect coins across multiple levels.
tips: Use practice mode on a new course first to learn where the spikes and obstacles appear before you try it for real.
Watch the ground ahead rather than the cube itself, so you can start each jump early enough to clear the next hazard.
Try holding your tap or click on flat stretches where you need to keep jumping, and tap quickly when you only need a single hop.
Pay attention to checkpoints and try to reach the next one before pushing further, since they let you restart closer to where you left off.
Expect the difficulty to rise as you go, so if a section keeps stopping you, slow your rhythm and focus on one obstacle at a time.
faq: How do I control the cube?
Click or tap to make the cube jump. The controls are one-tap, so you only need one input for each jump.
What does holding the jump do?
Holding the click or tap makes the cube jump continuously. This can help on stretches where you need to keep moving over hazards.

washing-toilets.intro: Washing Toilets is a cleaning game where you collect trash and clean messy areas across different locations. Complete levels, earn money, and clean up every mess you find.
tips: Scan each location before you start cleaning so you can see all the trash and messy spots. Planning a route saves time from walking back and forth.
Collect the loose trash first to clear the area, then move on to the messy spots. This keeps the space easier to work through.
Keep your movement steady and avoid stopping in tight corners. Smooth routes make it easier to reach every dirty place.
Try a few different locations to get comfortable with how each one is laid out. Familiar layouts make it faster to spot what needs cleaning.
Finish all the cleaning in a level before moving on, since completing levels is how you earn money. Checking the whole area helps you catch anything you missed.
faq: What is the goal of Washing Toilets?
Your goal is to clean every dirty place by collecting trash and cleaning messy areas. Completing levels is how you earn money.
How do I control my character on PC?
Use the W, A, S and D keys to move your character. These are the only controls you need for this game.

army-guns-collector.intro: Army Guns Collector is a short arcade war game where you have 15 seconds to collect different weapons. Quick reactions and steady aim help you level up as the challenge grows.
tips: Scan the whole screen before you move so you can plan a route to the weapons that are closest to you.
Keep your eyes on the next target while you collect the current one, since the 15-second clock leaves little room for pauses.
Focus on precision over speed. Missing a pickup costs time you cannot get back.
Expect each level to get more complicated, so practice early rounds until the basic rhythm feels natural.
Use short runs to build reflexes, and stop to rest your focus when your reactions start to slow down.
faq: What is the main goal of Army Guns Collector?
Collect the weapons shown on screen within the 15-second time limit. The game is built around speed and accuracy.
Does the game get harder as I play?
Yes. The description says levels increase in complexity, so the challenge grows the further you progress.

world-soccer-game-championship.intro: World Soccer Game Championship is a football game where you build a career as a professional player and lead your team through a long series of matches. Use your passing, shots and running to win and climb the leaderboard.
tips: Use Pass (K) to keep the ball moving before the defense closes in, rather than dribbling into a crowd of opponents.
Save Long Shot (Space Bar) for when you are at a distance and have a clear line to goal, since a rushed shot from far out is easy to waste.
Try High Hit (N) and Throw (M) in practice matches first so you know what each one does before you need them in a close game.
Keep an eye on your progress as you win matches, because the game tracks your career and rewards your results with prizes.
Use Fast Run with the arrow keys when you are on the attack, but ease off when you need to stay balanced to defend or change direction.
faq: How do I win a match in World Soccer Game Championship?

The description says you win by scoring goals and conquering opponents, so your main focus should be building attacks that create clear shooting chances. Use Pass and Long Shot to create and take those chances.
Which keys do I use to move and shoot?
Movement uses the Up, Down, Left and Right arrow keys, Fast Run is listed with the arrows, Pass uses K, High Hit uses N, Throw uses M, and Long Shot uses the Space Bar.

ragdoll-arena.intro: Ragdoll Arena is a physics brawler across 10 arenas where every hit launches enemies. Shoot, slash and bounce wobbly ragdolls into each other to set off chain reactions.
tips: Bounce enemies off walls and knock them into each other, since one hit can set off a chain reaction that clears several targets at once.
Hold the fire button to keep shooting instead of tapping, which keeps pressure on enemies that are flying around the arena.
Switch weapons often so you can match the weapon to the crowd in front of you rather than sticking with one option.
Save your SUPER attack for a moment when a group is clustered together or when you are facing the arena's giant boss.
Use platform drops and jumps to reposition quickly, so you stay out of reach while you aim at the next wave of ragdolls.
faq: What is the main goal of Ragdoll Arena?
Smash and launch the ragdolls in each arena and defeat the giant boss that ends every arena.
How do I aim my shots?
On desktop, left click on an enemy to shoot, since aiming is automatic. On mobile, tap the red attack stick to shoot or drag it to aim and release to fire.

ride-a-bike-for-brainrots.intro: Ride Your Bike for Brainrots is an obby game where you speed through obstacle courses, keep your balance, and jump across tricky stages. You can also collect and merge Brainrots while upgrading your bike and base.
tips: Slow down before tricky jumps so you can line up your landing, since one mistake sends you into the void.
Keep an eye on the stage layout ahead of you so you can plan your route instead of reacting at the last second.
Collect Brainrots as you go, because they boost your income and help you progress faster.
Spend your earnings on upgrading your bike and base, since upgrades unlock more slots and make you stronger for harder stages.
Use merging to combine your Brainrots, and keep an eye out for the secret creatures you can collect.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Your goal is to ride your bike through each obby stage, overcome the obstacles, and conquer every course without falling into the void.
What happens if I make a mistake?
One mistake will make you fall into the void, so you need to restart the stage and try again more carefully.

subway-princess-run.intro: Subway Princess Run is a fast arcade runner where you move along railway tracks, jump hurdles, and dodge obstacles. Quick reflexes and good timing are the main skills it rewards.
tips: Watch the track a few steps ahead rather than only the obstacle directly in front of you, so you have time to react.
Time your jumps to clear hurdles at the peak of your movement instead of jumping too early or too late.
Notice how obstacles are spaced and repeated, and use those patterns to predict what comes next.
Stay calm after a mistake and restart with a clear head, since the parkour challenges depend on steady timing.
Practice short stretches of the run until your reactions feel automatic before trying to push further.
faq: What is the main goal in Subway Princess Run?
The description focuses on running along railway tracks, jumping hurdles, and dodging obstacles while mastering parkour challenges. Keep moving forward and avoid hitting anything in your path.
Are there instructions for the controls?
No control instructions are listed for this game, so try the inputs yourself at the start to learn how jumping and dodging work.

far-island-tactical-warfare.intro: Far Island: Tactical Warfare is a third-person action game set on a tropical island. You capture enemy bases, hold them against counterattacks, and spend earned resources on weapons and upgrades.
tips: Study the map before you land so you know which bases to take first and how the terrain around each one is laid out.
Clear every enemy inside a base's perimeter before expecting the capture to hold, since the base only counts once the area is empty.
Right after a capture, deploy turrets and use fortifications, because the enemy will try to retake the position quickly.
Pick a weapon mix suited to each base, such as a sniper rifle for open ground and an assault rifle or grenades for close quarters.
Save resources for upgrades on the weapons you use most, and take on harder missions once your loadout can handle them, since they pay more.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Your goal is to capture enemy bases on the island and hold them against enemy attempts to retake them. Each capture and successful defense earns resources.
How do I capture an enemy base?
Eliminate all enemies within the base's perimeter. Once the area is cleared, the base is captured and you must defend it afterward.

home-run-master.intro: Home Run Master is a baseball game where your goal is to hit big home runs out of the park. Use the click or touch controls to swing and aim your shots.
tips: Watch the pitch closely before you swing, since timing decides whether you make solid contact.
Pay attention to where you aim, because a well-aimed hit travels farther than a rushed one.
On a phone, take a moment to line up your aim before you lift your finger so you don't release too early.
Try a few swings to learn how the timing feels, then stay patient and swing only at pitches you can reach well.
Focus on clean, powerful hits instead of swinging at everything, since the goal is to hit home runs rather than just making contact.
faq: What is the goal of Home Run Master?
The goal is to become the Home Run master by hitting home runs out of the park.
How do I swing and aim?
Click to swing or aim. On mobile, use your finger to aim and lift your finger to release the swing.

fun-fishing.intro: Fun Fishing is a relaxed clicker about casting, catching, and selling fish. Upgrade your rods and gear, explore new areas, and work toward rarer catches.
tips: Sell your catch regularly, since selling fish is how you earn money for upgrades.
Save up for fishing rod upgrades early, because better gear is central to the game's progression.
Explore different locations rather than staying in one spot, as each area is meant to offer new opportunities.
Look into boats when you can afford them, since they unlock new areas to explore.
Get comfortable with the controls first: use LMB to interact and E for objects on PC, or the joystick and camera on the right side on mobile.
faq: What is the goal of Fun Fishing?
The goal is to catch fish, sell your haul for money, and use that money to upgrade your rods and gear. Rarer fish and new areas give you more to aim for over time.
How do I earn money?
You earn money by selling the fish you catch. Building up a good haul before you sell is one way to fund your next upgrade.

brainrots-merge.intro: Brainrots Merge mixes clicking, merging and battling. Earn currency by clicking characters, combine identical ones to unlock new brainrots, and choose your fighters when other players attack.
tips: Keep clicking characters between other actions so your currency keeps building up.
Look for identical characters as soon as you have them, since merging is how you unlock new brainrots.
Before a battle, compare the characters you have and pick the ones you think will hold up best rather than sending whatever is on screen.
Check back regularly, because battles with other players happen periodically and you may be attacked while you are away.
Use each merge to work toward unlocking the whole collection, and avoid spending all your currency on the first option you see.
faq: How do I earn currency?
Click on the characters on screen to earn currency. Keep clicking regularly to build up your funds over time.
How do I unlock a new character?
Drag two identical characters onto each other to merge them into a new one. Repeat this to work toward unlocking all the brainrots.

sky-flight.intro: Sky Flight is an action game where you guide a bird through open skies. You steer with your mouse, fly through rings, and avoid obstacles to stay in the air.
tips: Move the mouse gently rather than in quick jerks, since the bird responds to your pointer and sharp movements can carry you into obstacles.
Look ahead toward the next ring and the gaps between obstacles so you can line up your path early.
Pass through rings in a smooth line, which keeps your flight steady and gives you more time to react to what is coming.
Keep an eye on the open space around you and move away from obstacles before you reach them, not at the last second.
Take short breaks in your play if you start to rush, because calm, deliberate movement is what keeps the bird aloft.
faq: What is the goal of Sky Flight?
Your goal is to fly the bird through rings while dodging obstacles so you stay aloft.
How do I control the bird?
You control the bird with your mouse, and the game is designed to feel effortless to steer.

night-city-racing.intro: Night City Racing is a 3D car driving simulator with 10 super-sport cars, customizable engines and visuals, and both 1 player and 2 player modes. This guide covers controls and habits that help you drive better.
tips: Try the cars before you commit to upgrades, since each one handles differently and the right pick depends on how you drive.
Use the camera switch (C) to pick the view that gives you the clearest sense of the road ahead, and switch back if you lose your bearings.
Press T to look back when you are being chased or need to check your position, then return your eyes to the road quickly.
Save your NOS boost (L-Shift or R-Shift) for straight stretches where you can keep speed, rather than using it on tight turns where it can push you off line.
If you get stuck or flipped, use the restart key (R) instead of wasting time trying to recover the car by hand.
faq: What is the main goal of Night City Racing?
The game is a car driving simulator where you drive one of 10 super-sport cars through the adventure. Focus on keeping control of your car while you drive.
How do I control the car in single player?
Use W, A, S, D or the arrow keys to move. Hold L-Shift or R-Shift to use NOS, and press R to restart the car's position.

the-secret-of-the-toy-factory.intro: An atmospheric first-person horror adventure set in an abandoned factory. Explore the dark rooms, solve puzzles, and piece together why the toys came to life.
tips: Search every area for useful items, since you will need them to solve puzzles and get through the factory.
Read the notes you find, because they gradually reveal what happened at the factory and explain the mystery behind the toys.
Investigate dark rooms slowly and carefully, as danger can appear at any moment.
When Plush or BOTY are nearby, decide quickly whether to hide or run, and use the objects around you to stay out of sight.
Pay attention to every corridor, since each one hides a new mystery that may help you move forward.
faq: What is the goal of The Secret of the Toy Factory?
Explore the abandoned factory, uncover its dark secrets, solve puzzles, and survive the encounters with Plush and BOTY while learning why the toys came to life.
How do I read notes in the game?
On PC, press E to read notes. On mobile, use the "Read Note" button.

darkside-stunt-car-driving-3d.intro: Darkside Stunt Car Driving 3D is a night-time racing game where you drive supercars across extreme tracks high in the sky. Stay on the track, complete stunts, and earn money to unlock new cars.
tips: Stay on the track at all times, since the description warns that falling off ends your run. Slow down before sharp turns and jumps so you keep control of the car.
Save nitro for straight stretches or before a jump, when a burst of speed helps you clear the gap rather than in tight corners where it can throw you off line.
Use the handbrake with the spacebar sparingly. It is most useful for tightening a turn or adjusting your angle before a stunt, not for slowing down on every corner.
Press C to switch camera views and pick the one that gives you the clearest view of the track ahead. Check which view helps you judge landings best.
Play the levels you already know well to earn money steadily, then use it to buy a new supercar when you feel your current car is holding you back on the harder tracks.
faq: What is the goal of Darkside Stunt Car Driving 3D?
Race across the extreme tracks high in the sky and perform stunts to survive without falling off the track. Money earned from playing levels can be used to buy new supercars.
How do I control the car?
Use the arrow keys to drive, F for nitro, the spacebar for the handbrake, and C to change the camera.

pudding-monsters.intro: Pudding Monsters is a brain-teasing puzzle game where you slide jiggly pudding creatures, merge them, and get them to rest on star tiles. Each pudding type has its own quirky traits to work with.
tips: Before each slide, check where the star tiles are and which pudding should end up on each one. Working backward from the goal often saves moves.
Pay attention to each pudding type's traits, since they can change which merges and positions are useful.
Try a few different merge orders on a puzzle before committing. Small changes in the order can open up very different solutions.
If you get stuck, step back and look at which pudding is blocking the path to a star tile. Moving that one first can free up the rest of the board.
Take your time and experiment. The puzzles reward careful thinking more than quick guesses.
faq: What is the goal of Pudding Monsters?
Your goal is to merge and slide the pudding monsters so that they rest perfectly on the star tiles.
How do I get better at the puzzles?
Study how each pudding type and trait behaves, and plan a few moves ahead instead of reacting to each slide.

pop-it-duel.intro: Pop It! Duel is a 1v1 pop-it battle played as a best-of-3 match. Pop your Pop It faster than your opponent to win each round, and win two rounds to take theirs.
tips: Since the first player to pop their Pop It wins the round, focus on speed from the very start rather than waiting to see what your opponent does.
Keep your attention on your own Pop It while watching your opponent, so you can react quickly if they get ahead.
Because you need two round wins to claim a Pop It, treat the first round as important. Losing it puts you under pressure in the rest of the match.
Your opponent can also take your Pop It if they win two rounds, so every round matters for protecting your collection.
Stay calm between rounds. Quick, steady inputs usually beat rushed ones that cause you to miss.
faq: How do you win a round in Pop It! Duel?
The first player to pop their Pop It in a round wins that round. Speed is the main factor.
What happens if you win a match?
If you win two rounds in a best-of-3 match, you can steal your opponent's Pop It and add it to your collection. Your opponent can do the same to you.

grandfather-road-chase-realistic-shooter.intro: Grandfather Road Chase Realistic Shooter is a first person shooter where you escape a fast pursuit using a range of weapons. The game features over 50 levels, tactical targeting of vehicle parts, and boss fights.
tips: Pick the weapon that fits the enemy in front of you, since the game asks you to deploy weapons strategically against different foes.
Aim for vehicle parts when chasers are close, because disabling a part can be more useful than trying to destroy the whole vehicle.
Keep track of how each boss fight goes and note which attacks hurt you most so you can change your approach on the next try.
Spend upgrades on the weapons you use most often instead of spreading them thin across the arsenal.
Pace yourself across the 50-plus levels by replaying earlier ones when you need a break from harder chases.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You need to escape a relentless high-speed chase by fighting off enemies and surviving through each level.
How do I deal with enemy vehicles?
Target their vehicle parts with tactical shots, since this is a key part of the combat described in the game.

attack-hole.intro: Attack Hole is an action game where you grow a black hole by swallowing weapons before the timer runs out. The weapons you collect are then used in a final fight against a giant enemy.
tips: Keep an eye on the timer from the start so you know how much time you have to collect weapons.
Look for weapons across the play area rather than focusing on one spot, since the goal is to swallow as many as you can.
Track how many weapons you have gathered, because the final battle depends on the arsenal you bring into it.
Balance speed and thoroughness: grabbing weapons quickly matters, but missing a cluster of them can cost you later.
Think of the timer and the boss fight as two stages, and avoid spending so long collecting that you enter the final battle with too little time or preparation.
faq: What is the main goal of Attack Hole?
Swallow as many weapons as you can before the timer expires, then use the weapons you collected to fight and destroy the giant enemy.
What happens if the timer runs out?
The description does not say exactly what happens when the timer expires, so focus on collecting weapons while there is still time left.

rescue-sharp-turn.intro: Rescue Sharp Turn is a short 3D puzzle where you click the right objects in a small scene to set off mechanisms and clear the way to rescue an injured character. Each level is quick, so you can play in small bursts.
tips: Before clicking anything, scan the whole scene and note which objects look interactive, such as switches, rocks, or water sources.
Think in chains: many levels need one action to set up the next, so look for what each click would cause before you make it.
If a level stops making progress, try a different object or reset the scene rather than repeating the same move.
Pay attention to the hint that a wrong move can end the attempt, so check your choice before you commit to it.
Because levels are short, play one at a time and step away from any that frustrate you; a fresh look often reveals the solution.
faq: What is the goal of Rescue Sharp Turn?
Your goal is to click the correct objects in each 3D scene so the level conditions are met and the injured character is rescued.
What controls does the game use?
You play with mouse clicks or taps on the objects in the scene.

streets-of-rage.intro: Streets Of Rage is an arcade-style street brawler where you fight through waves of enemies. You punch, kick, and use special moves to push back the forces of evil on the streets.
tips: Pick your starting power-up with your play style in mind, since the choices are Fire Whirlwind Kick, ATK SPD Up, and Fire Blast.
Keep an eye on how many enemies are on screen before each wave arrives, so you can decide whether to save a special move or use it early.
Practice chaining punches and kicks into combos, because stringing hits together is the main way to deal with groups of enemies.
Use your special moves when you are surrounded or when a wave is getting too crowded, rather than spending them on a single weak enemy.
Take short breaks between waves to reset your focus, since each new wave can throw in enemies you have not fought yet.
faq: How do I control my fighter?
Mouse click or tap to play. Use clicks or taps to punch, kick, and trigger your special moves.
What is the goal of the game?
Fight through waves of enemies and keep your battle going as the streets get harder.

home-hauler-simulator.intro: Drive heavy trucks and operate precision cranes to build custom houses from scratch. Move floors, walls, and roofs across rough terrain to complete residential contracts.
tips: Switch between Car and Crane mode with the mode switch key (C) whenever you need to change tasks. Drive to the site first, then switch to the crane to place materials.
Use small, gentle crane movements. Combining the arm (W and S) with the hook and elbow (Up and Down Arrow) controls takes practice, so make slow adjustments when placing pieces.
Plan your route before loading a heavy piece. Challenging terrain can make the truck harder to control, so take corners slowly and avoid sudden acceleration.
Use Space to brake before stopping near a load or a build spot. Early braking helps you avoid overshooting your position.

Practice rotating the crane (A and D) and raising or lowering the arm before you start a contract. Getting comfortable with each control will make it easier to place floors, walls, and roofs in the right order.
faq: How do I drive the truck?
Use WASD to drive and Space to brake. Switch to Car mode first if you are in Crane mode.
How do I control the crane?
Use A and D to rotate the crane left and right, W and S to raise and lower the arm, and the Up and Down Arrow keys to extend and retract the hook and elbow.

wash-master.intro: Wash Master is a relaxing 3D cleaning game in first-person view. Aim your pressure washer, spray away thick mud, and bring each neighborhood back to bright, clean colors.
tips: Work through one area at a time so you can clearly see which surfaces are still dirty before you move on.
Keep an eye on your coins and spend them in the shop (B) on upgrades that help you clean faster.
Try new tools as you unlock them to see which one suits the shape and size of each surface.
Hold the spray steadily on a stubborn patch of mud instead of sweeping quickly across it, so the grime fully lifts.
If you get stuck on a tough area, press V to request a bonus tool, then return to your regular washer.
faq: What is the goal of Wash Master?
Your goal is to clean every dirty surface to complete each level. Keep spraying until no mud is left on the houses and other areas.
What are the basic controls on desktop?
Move with WASD or the arrow keys, aim with the mouse, and hold the left mouse button to spray. Press B to open the shop and V to get a bonus tool.

no-i-m-not-a-plankton.intro: No, I'm not a Plankton is an arcade shift game where you run the Krusty Krab as Mr. Krabs. Your job is to let real customers in and throw out the robots hiding among them.
tips: Watch each visitor closely before deciding, since robots are made to look like ordinary customers.
Check for small telltale signs of a robot rather than judging by the overall look of a visitor.
Stay focused through the whole shift, because unexpected events and inspections can come at any time.
Use the short tutorial first so you know how to admit and remove visitors before the busy part of the shift starts.
If you want to beat the record for successful shifts, aim for steady accuracy rather than rushing each decision.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You play as Mr. Krabs and must decide who to let into the Krusty Krab and who to throw out. Your aim is to spot the robots disguised as visitors.
How do I control the game?
Use your mouse or tap the screen to decide whether each visitor enters or gets thrown out of the restaurant.

super-drive.intro: Super Drive is a 3D racing game where you drive fast cars through a busy city full of pedestrians. You can drive quickly and try different stunts along the way.
tips: Use W, A, S and D to steer and control your speed, and ease off early when a turn is coming up so you keep control of the car.
Keep an eye on the pedestrians crossing the streets and steer around them, since a crowded city leaves little room for mistakes.
Use the Space bar to brake before corners rather than in the middle of them, which helps you hold a steadier line.
Press C to switch camera views and find the one that gives you the clearest look at the road ahead.
Try stunts when the road is clear so you can focus on landing them while keeping the car under control.
faq: What is the goal of Super Drive?
The description says to drive as fast as you can across the big city and try to perform different stunts on the way.
Which keys control the car?
Use W, A, S and D to drive, Space to brake, and C to change the camera view.

green-man-smash.intro: Green Man Smash is an action game where you play a hulking green monster defending a city from invading zombies. Smash through the crowds and keep the bad guys from taking over.
tips: Use the kick, punch, and power attack keys in turn instead of pressing one button over and over, so you can respond to whichever zombies are closest.
Jump with Space to get out of a crowd or line up a landing on a zombie, rather than standing still while they close in.
Keep moving with WASD or the arrow keys so you are not surrounded, since the zombies will gather around you.
Save the power attack, on C or 3, for moments when several enemies are near you at once.
Watch how the zombies approach and attack, and time your own attacks to hit them before they reach you.
faq: What is the goal of Green Man Smash?
You play a monster hulk trying to save the city and stop the bad guys from conquering it by smashing the zombies.
What are the controls?
Move with WASD or the arrow keys, jump with Space, kick with Z or 1, punch with X or 2, and use the power attack with C or 3.

power-puncher.intro: Power Puncher is an arcade boxing game where you smash incoming wooden boxes before they hurt you. Timing and accuracy decide how long you last and how high your score climbs.
tips: Watch the incoming boxes for a moment before you punch, so you can judge their size and shape rather than reacting late.
Aim for the center of each box, since the description says that gives the most powerful blow.
Keep an eye on the sharp edges and be ready to dodge them rather than taking every box head-on.
Try to keep landing punches one after another, because consecutive hits build combos that raise your score and unlock power-ups.
Stay calm when the boxes come in faster; steady, accurate clicks usually work better than rapid, careless ones.
faq: What is the goal of Power Puncher?
Your goal is to survive the barrage of wooden boxes by smashing them to pieces while avoiding their sharp edges.
How do I punch in Power Puncher?
Click to punch. Time your click as the box approaches and aim for its center for the strongest blow.

sandwich-runner.intro: Sandwich Runner is a fast-paced runner where you sprint through food-filled pathways to satisfy a hungry diner. Collect tasty treats, avoid the spoiled ones, and keep the orders flowing.
tips: Look ahead along the path before you commit to a lane, since the description stresses precise navigation. Spotting a spoiled item early gives you more room to react.
Treat each run as a chance to learn the layout of the pathways. Repeating a stage helps you recognise where treats and hazards tend to appear.
Grab the fiery power-ups when they are within reach, since they are part of the game's core toolkit. Try not to chase them into danger.
Expect the challenges to escalate, so stay alert as the pace picks up. Staying calm at the start makes the harder sections easier to handle.
Don't rush every run. Focus on clean collections and steady movement rather than grabbing everything at once.
faq: What is the main goal in Sandwich Runner?
You run through food-filled pathways to collect treats and tame a ravenous diner's hunger. Each run is about collecting the good food while avoiding spoiled surprises.
What should I avoid while playing?
Avoid the spoiled surprises scattered along the pathways. Colliding with them is the main way to lose progress in your run.

chroma-trek.intro: Chroma Trek is a neon platformer where you run and jump through obstacles to reach the Finish Crystal. Each level has its own layout and challenges, so careful timing matters.
tips: Watch the hazards for a moment before you commit to a route. Traps, pits, and other obstacles often follow a pattern you can learn.
Use short, controlled jumps when you are near a pit or ledge. Overshooting is a common reason to fall.
Pay attention to how the color-switching mechanic affects which obstacles you can pass through. Knowing this early helps you plan each section.
If you fall, try the same section again with a slightly different timing or path rather than rushing through. Small changes in jump timing can make a big difference.
Keep your eyes on the route ahead, not just the ground under your character. Spotting the next hazard early gives you more time to react.
faq: What is the goal of Chroma Trek?
Your goal is to navigate through the obstacles in each level and touch the Finish Crystal to complete it.
How do I move and jump?
Use A or the Left Arrow to move left, and D or the Right Arrow to move right. Press W or the Spacebar to jump.

asmr-spa.intro: ASMR Spa is a relaxing simulation where you pick a spa concept, enjoy soothing ASMR sounds, and treat yourself or a puppy to a makeover. It is built around calm, cozy play.
tips: Try each of the four concepts at least once to find the treatment that suits your mood best.
Wear headphones so you can hear the soundscapes and whispers clearly, since the sound is a big part of the experience.
Experiment with a few hairstyles and color options before settling on a final look, so you can compare how each one turns out.
If you enjoy animal care, start with Puppy Rescue and Makeover, then move to other concepts to see how the pace and feel differ.
Play in a quiet room with few distractions so you can slow down and focus on each treatment step.
faq: What concepts can I choose from in ASMR Spa?
You can pick from Wednesday Makeover, Puppy Rescue and Makeover, Skincare, and Makeup. Each one offers a different spa or beauty experience.
Can I customize the look of my character?
Yes. You can experiment with different hairstyles, colors, and accessories to create your own style.

army-base.intro: Army Base is a 3D clicker and tycoon game where you train new recruits, send them into battle, and grow your base. You pick up recruits by approaching them and take them to training stations.
tips: Match each recruit to the zone that fits what they need. The shooting range builds accuracy, the sports area builds strength, and the medical center helps with skill recovery and healing.
Check on soldiers who have come back from battle and send any injured ones to the infirmary before you train them again. Recovery keeps your squad from losing trained fighters.
Spend early earnings on upgrading buildings that speed up training, since faster training gets recruits into battle sooner.
Open new training zones once your current ones are busy, so no recruit waits too long for a free station.
Keep accepting new recruits steadily so your squad grows, but avoid crowding the base faster than you can train and heal the soldiers you already have.
faq: What is the main goal of Army Base?
Your goal is to turn ordinary privates into skilled fighters by training them in different zones, then sending them into battle against the enemy. You also grow the base over time.
How do I move recruits between training stations?
Approach a recruit to pick them up, then take them to the training station you want. Recruits develop gradually as they train.

obby-arena-1-frag.intro: Obby Arena: +1 Frag is a fast first-person shooter with blocky characters and colorful arenas. This guide covers the controls, match types, and habits that help you get more eliminations.
tips: Learn the movement keys early. Combine Space to jump, Shift while moving to slide, and C to crouch so you can change your height and speed in a fight.
Use Right mouse button or E to aim when you need precision, and fire in short bursts with the Left mouse button to keep your shots on target.
Switch weapons with 1 to 4, the mouse wheel, or Q as soon as the situation changes. Reload with R when you have a quiet moment rather than in the middle of a firefight.
Chain eliminations to build killstreaks. Stay on the move between kills so enemies have a harder time lining up a shot on you.
Press Tab to check the scoreboard during a match and see how your team and opponents are doing. In plant-and-defuse matches, hold F near the bomb only when your team can cover you.
faq: What is the goal of Obby Arena: +1 Frag?
The game is a fast-paced shooter where you battle in deathmatch, team fights, and plant-and-defuse matches. You score eliminations and can chain them into killstreaks.
How do I plant or defuse the bomb?
Hold F to plant or defuse the bomb in plant-and-defuse matches. Staying near the bomb while you hold the key is needed to complete the action.

football-panda.intro: Football Panda is a fast arcade game where you score goals with panda-themed charm. Quick reflexes and good timing help you move through levels with different challenges.
tips: Watch the whole screen before each move, since the levels are described as dynamic and the situation can change quickly.
Time your actions rather than rushing them; sharp timing is central to this game, so a well-timed input often beats a fast one.
Pay attention to the unique challenge in each level and adjust your approach to it instead of repeating the same moves.
Stay calm after a missed goal and reset your focus for the next attempt, because steady reflexes matter more than speed alone.
Practice early levels to learn how the game responds to your inputs before you try the harder stages.
faq: What is the main goal of Football Panda?
The goal is to score goals while getting through each level's challenges. The game focuses on fast action and timing.
What skills matter most in Football Panda?
Quick reflexes and sharp timing are the main skills the game rewards. Staying focused on each moment helps you act at the right time.

swimming-pool-romance.intro: Swimming Pool Romance is a short story-style game where Lucas meets Natasha at the pool and tries to win her over with his charm. Your job is to help him attract her so they can share a romantic evening.
tips: Read each line of text and scene carefully, since the story gives clues about how Natasha is feeling.
Try clicking or tapping on different parts of the scene to see what responds before committing to a choice.
Pay attention to Natasha's reactions after each interaction and repeat the moves that seem to please her.
If a choice doesn't seem to work, go back and try a different option rather than repeating the same action.
Take your time between clicks or taps, because rushing can make it harder to notice what changes.
faq: What is the goal of Swimming Pool Romance?
Help Lucas attract Natasha, using his mojo, so the two of them can spend a romantic evening together.
How do I control the game on a computer?
Use your mouse and click to interact with the scene and its options.

people-playground-ragdoll-arena.intro: People Playground! Ragdoll Arena! is a physics sandbox where you hurl objects at ragdolls and watch the reactions. Its description mentions endless scenarios, so you can keep experimenting.
tips: Start with one object at a time, such as a vehicle or a rock, so you can see how the ragdolls react before adding more.
Vary where and how you drop or launch objects. Changing the height or angle shows you which setups create the biggest reactions.
Try the same scenario twice with a small change to compare results and learn what makes the physics more dramatic.
Plan a sequence of actions rather than acting randomly, since the description suggests devising unique strategies to maximize mayhem.
With the doubled number of dolls, spread your attention across the group so you can watch how the reactions spread between them.
faq: Is there a set goal in People Playground! Ragdoll Arena!?
The description does not list a fixed goal. It focuses on experimenting with physics and creating chaotic scenarios of your own.
What kinds of objects can I use?
The description mentions dropping vehicles and launching rocks as examples. You can experiment with other objects the game offers.

basketball-beans.intro: Basketball Beans is a basketball game built around passing, stealing the ball, and sinking three-pointers. You can compete in tournaments to earn basketballs and uniforms as rewards.
tips: Pass the ball to a teammate who has a clear path to the basket instead of forcing a difficult shot yourself.
Watch the opponent closely and look for moments when they pass or hesitate, since those are good chances to steal the ball.
Take three-pointers when you have space and time, and avoid rushing them when a defender is close.
Use the early matches in a tournament to get comfortable with the controls before you face tougher opponents.
Keep your focus on the strategy of each match rather than only scoring, because controlling possession often leads to more good chances.
faq: How do I unlock new basketballs and uniforms?
The game offers basketballs and stylish uniforms as exclusive rewards for taking part in its tournaments. Playing tournaments is the main way to earn them.
What should I focus on most to win matches?
Focus on passing well, stealing the ball when the chance appears, and only shooting three-pointers when you are open. Good possession decisions matter as much as scoring.

modern-fps-strike-zombie-gun-war-ops.intro: Modern FPS Strike: Zombie Gun War Ops is a first-person shooter where you fight zombies and enemies through tactical missions and firefights. You play by clicking the mouse or tapping the screen.
tips: Look around before you move on. In a first-person shooter, checking your surroundings helps you spot zombies coming from the sides or behind you.
Keep your aim steady and fire in short bursts instead of holding the button. Controlled shots waste less ammunition and stay on target.
Pay attention to the mission goal before you start shooting. Knowing what you need to do helps you decide when to fight and when to move forward.
Try different guns to see which one suits your style. The game offers several advanced weapons, and each may work better in different situations.
Stay on the move during firefights when you can. Standing still makes you an easy target for groups of zombies and enemies.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
