You fight zombies and enemy forces while completing tactical missions in a modern warzone. Finishing the missions and defeating your enemies is the core objective.
How do I play the game?
Use a mouse click or a tap to play. The instructions do not list other controls, so experiment with clicking or tapping to aim and fire.

grand-zombie-swarm.intro: Grand Zombie Swarm is a 3D open world shooter where you play a special forces soldier fighting hordes of zombies. Use different weapons to survive each level.
tips: Switch weapons with the mouse wheel before a fight starts, so you are already holding the right gun when zombies arrive.
Use right-click to aim when zombies are at a distance, since steadier shots help you conserve ammo.
Reload with R during quiet moments rather than in the middle of a crowd, so you are never caught with an empty weapon.
Keep moving with WASD and use Space to jump, which helps you avoid getting surrounded in the open world.
Pause with P to take a breath and plan your route when a level starts to feel overwhelming.
faq: What is the goal of Grand Zombie Swarm?
Your mission is to use different types of weapons to shoot zombie hordes and survive each level.
How do I change weapons?
Scroll the mouse wheel to switch between your weapons.

drive-chained-car-3d.intro: Drive Chained Car 3D is a racing game where your car is linked by chains to other vehicles while you drive through city streets. You steer with WASD and must reach your target before time runs out.
tips: Keep your speed controlled, since the description says the goal is to maintain speed without colliding with other cars.
Watch the cars attached to your chain before turning sharply, because their weight and position can pull your vehicle off course.
Use gentle steering with W, A, S and D rather than sudden taps, which helps you stay on line when the chain pulls.
Pay attention to the timer and check the direction of your target early, so you are not forced into last-second turns.
Practise parking and handling on quieter stretches first, since the game asks for precise driving as well as racing.
faq: What is the goal of Drive Chained Car 3D?
Your aim is to bring your chained cars toward the target within the given amount of time. Stay on course and avoid collisions with other vehicles along the way.
Which keys control the car?
Use the WASD keys to drive. W and S handle forward and back movement, and A and D steer left and right.

roll-away-3d.intro: Roll Away 3D is an adventure game where you guide a ball through 3D levels using the arrow keys and spacebar. Obstacles and challenges test your skill and patience as you explore each course.
tips: Use small, gentle arrow key presses rather than holding keys down, since the ball responds to subtle inputs.
Scan each level for obstacles before moving, so you can plan your route instead of reacting at the last moment.
Use the spacebar to jump only when you have a clear target, because mistimed jumps can send the ball off course.
If you get stuck, take a moment to look around the level, as the game encourages exploration and discovery.
Stay patient after a failed attempt and repeat the tricky section slowly to build control of the ball's movement.
faq: What is the goal of Roll Away 3D?
You roll a ball through meticulously crafted 3D levels, navigating obstacles and challenges to move forward. The game focuses on skill, patience and exploration.
How do I control the ball?
Use the Left, Right, Up and Down arrow keys to move the ball. Press the spacebar to jump.

stickman-vs-monster-school.intro: Stickman vs Monster School is an action-platformer where you guide a stickman through monster-filled levels. Use a range of weapons, switch between them, and push through 60 levels that get harder as they go.
tips: Switch weapons based on the enemy in front of you rather than sticking with one weapon for the whole run.
Pay attention to how each new foe behaves so you can choose the weapon and approach that fits it.
Treat each level as a set of short fights and move on only when the area around you is under control.
Use your agile movement to reposition during fights instead of standing still and taking hits.
When you reach a boss, stay patient, watch its pattern for a moment, and then attack with a weapon suited to it.
faq: What is the goal of Stickman vs Monster School?
Your goal is to guide the stickman through monster school, get past its tougher foes, and defeat the fearsome bosses across the 60 levels.
How do weapons work in this game?
The game offers a variety of weapons, and you can switch between them. Choosing the right one for each situation is a key part of surviving.

k-pop-stars-inspired-look.intro: In this fashion game, you act as a stylist preparing K-pop fans for a club party. You create outfits and makeup while working against the clock.
tips: Look at the fan's style before you start choosing pieces, so the outfit and makeup match the look you are aiming for.
Pick a main outfit first, then build the makeup around it so the two parts feel like one complete style.
Keep an eye on the timer and make the bigger decisions early, saving small details for the final minutes.
Avoid mixing too many bold colors or trends at once, since a focused look usually reads as more polished.
If you feel rushed, work on one element at a time rather than jumping between outfit and makeup.
faq: What is the goal of K-Pop Stars Inspired Look?
Your goal is to style each fan with trendy outfits and makeup before the club party starts. You need to finish before time runs out.
Is there a time limit in this game?
Yes, the game is a race against the clock. You need to finish each look before the party begins.

parking-skills.intro: Parking Skills is a top-down car parking game where you steer through an urban setting full of obstacles to reach the designated parking spot.控制 uses mouse or touch input.
tips: Before you move, look at the whole route to the parking spot and note which obstacles sit close to your path.
Go slowly around corners and tight gaps, since small mistakes are easier to correct at low speed.
Plan your approach so you enter the spot in one smooth line rather than making many small corrections.
If you get stuck, reverse a short distance to reset your angle instead of forcing the car forward.
Keep practicing the same maneuvers, because repeated runs help you judge the car's size and turning space.
faq: What is the goal of Parking Skills?
Your goal is to park your car in the designated spot on each challenge while avoiding the obstacles around you.
How do I control the car?
Use your mouse or touch the screen to steer the car through each level.

model-wedding-girl-games.intro: Model Wedding is a dress-up game where you style four different brides using over 200 items, from dresses to accessories. Your goal is to build a bridal look you like.
tips: Pick one bride first and decide on a theme, such as classic, glamorous, or modern, before you start choosing items. A clear direction keeps the look cohesive.
Choose the dress before anything else, since it sets the mood. Then add accessories that complement its neckline, sleeves, and overall style.
Try several options for each category and compare them side by side before settling on a final choice. Small changes can make a big difference.
Keep the bride's overall look balanced, so the jewelry, shoes, and headpiece don't compete with the dress. Fewer, well-chosen pieces often look more polished.
Use the four brides to test different styles, so you learn which combinations you enjoy most. Then apply those ideas to your next look.
faq: What is the goal of Model Wedding?
The goal is to style four unique brides for their wedding day. You can experiment freely with the available dresses and accessories to create the look you prefer.
How many items can I use to dress the brides?
The game offers over 200 luxurious items, including glamorous dresses and chic accessories. You can mix and match them as you like.

stickman-duel-battle.intro: Stickman Duel Battle is a two-player fighting game where stickmen grab weapons that fall from the sky and shoot each other. Players share one screen and control separate stickmen with their own key sets.
tips: Weapons fall onto the field at set intervals, so keep an eye on the sky and move toward the next drop before your opponent does.
Grab a weapon as soon as it lands, since the description says to hurry in order to disarm your enemy.
Some tracks move, so keep your balance and avoid edges, because falling is an easy way to lose a round.
Keep your attention on the field and focus on two things: collecting weapons and aiming at your enemy.
Play with a friend on the 2-player option, and try to learn your own keys well so aiming and moving feel natural.
faq: What is the goal of Stickman Duel Battle?
Your goal is to collect weapons and kill your enemy stickman. The description says this should be your only focus during play.
What are the controls for each player?
Player 1 moves with the Arrow Keys and shoots with the L Key. Player 2 moves with the WASD Keys and shoots with the F Key.

big-boom-building-smash.intro: Big Boom! Building Smash! is an action game about destroying structures. You blow up buildings with dynamite, bombs, and rockets, and you can play solo or with friends.
tips: Rotate the building before placing anything so you can see its full shape and find the spots that will bring down the most of it.
Test different placements on the same structure to learn which spots cause the biggest collapse.
Spend upgrades on your weapons early, since the game says they increase destruction and efficiency.
Clear obstacles in your path first so your explosives can reach the main structure.
If you want to compete, aim for efficient blasts and check the leaderboards to see how your results compare.
faq: What is the goal of Big Boom! Building Smash!?
Your goal is to blow up buildings with dynamite, bombs, and rockets until each structure becomes rubble.
How do I place explosives on desktop?
Hold down the left mouse button to rotate around the object, then choose the spot where you want to place your explosives.

block-puzzle-jewel.intro: Block Puzzle Jewel is a puzzle game where you place colorful blocks on a grid to complete full lines. There is no time limit, so you can plan each move carefully.
tips: Look at the shape of each block before you place it and think about where the rest of the grid will need to be filled.
Keep open spaces connected rather than leaving isolated gaps that only one block shape can fit.
Try to clear lines steadily instead of waiting, since a crowded grid gives you fewer options for the next block.
Scan the whole grid for nearly complete lines before each move, because one well-placed block can finish more than one line.
Since there is no time limit, take a moment to compare a few possible placements before committing to one.
faq: What is the main goal of Block Puzzle Jewel?
The goal is to arrange the colorful blocks so that they fill complete lines on the grid. Your aim is to keep clearing lines before the grid fills up.
Is there a time limit in Block Puzzle Jewel?
No, the game has no time limit. You can think through each placement at your own pace.

bouncing-eggs.intro: Bouncing Eggs is a one-player arcade physics game where you keep falling eggs in the air and aim them into a basket. Steer the bunnies with the arrow keys to reach the target in each of the ten levels.
tips: Watch the arc of each egg before it lands so you can predict where it will bounce.
Move the bunnies early rather than at the last second, since the cloth needs time to reach the egg's path.
Use short, controlled movements instead of holding an arrow key down, which can overshoot the egg.
Pay attention to the angle of the cloth when an egg hits it, because that angle decides where the egg goes next.
Aim for the basket in a steady rhythm and keep the eggs moving rather than letting them drop to the ground.
faq: What is the goal of Bouncing Eggs?
Bounce the falling eggs off the cloth carried by the bunnies so they land in the basket. Reach the target for each of the ten levels to advance.
How do I control the bunnies?
Use the left and right arrow keys to move the bunnies sideways. The cloth they carry is what bounces the eggs.

architects-of-tomorrow.intro: Architects of Tomorrow is an arcade urban builder about shaping a future skyline, balancing resource networks, and adapting to environmental challenges. The controls are simple: arrow keys to drive and the spacebar to brake.
tips: Use the spacebar to slow down before sharp turns so you keep control of your vehicle.
Tap the arrow keys in short bursts when you need precise movement rather than holding them down.
Learn how your vehicle responds at different speeds in an open area before you head into busier parts of the city.
The description mentions dynamic environmental challenges, so watch for changes around you and adjust your speed and route when conditions shift.
Think about the big picture of your city, since the game asks you to balance resource networks and build toward a sustainable future.
faq: What is the main goal of Architects of Tomorrow?
The game asks you to shape a growing city, from basic zoning up to high-tech hubs, while keeping resource networks balanced and the future sustainable.
How do I control the vehicle?
Use the arrow keys to drive and the spacebar to brake.

truck-simulator-power-slider.intro: Truck Simulator Power Slider is a sliding tile puzzle built around fragmented pictures of trucks. You rebuild each image by moving tiles into their correct places.
tips: Look at the full picture before you start moving tiles, and note the truck's key features like the cab, wheels, and trailer so you know where each piece belongs.
Start with the pieces that have clear edges or distinctive colors, such as the sky, road, or chrome parts, since they are easier to place first.
Work on one section at a time, like the front of the truck, and finish it before moving on so you don't undo progress elsewhere.
Avoid moving a tile you have already placed correctly unless you have a clear plan, because each slide can push other pieces out of position.
Take a short pause when you get stuck and compare the current image with the reference picture to spot which tile is out of place.
faq: What is the goal of Truck Simulator Power Slider?
The goal is to slide the tiles into place until the fragmented truck image is fully assembled. Each completed puzzle shows a complete powerful vehicle.
What skills does this game test?
The game tests your spatial skills, since you need to picture where each fragment belongs in the finished image. Careful planning helps you use fewer wasted moves.

hot-diggity-dogs.intro: Hot Diggity Dogs is a cosy cooking game where you run a hotdog van in the park. Build each hotdog step by step and serve customers who each have their own secret tastes.
tips: Flip sausages only once the underside turns golden, so they are properly cooked before you move them onto the bun.
Pay attention to how each customer reacts after you serve them, and note which toppings they seem to enjoy or dislike.
Make the order a customer asks for first before you try extras, so you learn their basic taste before experimenting.
Go easy on sauce: draw ketchup and mustard in measured lines rather than flooding the bun, since the physics means too much can look messy.
Spend the coins and stars you earn each shift on ingredients or upgrades that help you serve the regulars you see most often.
faq: What is the goal of Hot Diggity Dogs?
You run a hotdog van in the park, serving customers at the window. You earn coins and stars each shift, which you can spend in the shop on ingredients, upgrades and van decor.
How do I cook the sausage?
Drag a sausage onto the grill or into the boiling pot. On the grill, tap the sausage to flip it once the underside turns golden.

deadly-catch.intro: Deadly Catch! is a fishing game where you cast your line, wait for a bite, and reel in fish. You earn coins by selling your catch and use them to upgrade your gear and sail to new islands.
tips: Sell your fish regularly so you have coins ready for the next rod or float upgrade.
Watch for the bite before you click to hook, since the left mouse button or Cast button needs to be pressed at the right moment.
Upgrade your rods and floats when you can afford them, because stronger gear speeds up fishing and improves your chances with rare species.
Explore the different fishing spots on each island to discover more species and complete your fish collection.
Save up for a boat if you want to reach new islands, since each one has its own fishing spots and special challenges.
faq: What is the main goal of Deadly Catch!?
The main goal is to catch fish, sell them for coins, and use those coins to upgrade your gear. You also aim to discover new species and complete your fish collection.
How do I catch a fish?
Cast your line, wait for a bite, and then click at the right moment to hook the fish and reel it in. On PC, use the left mouse button; on mobile, tap the Cast button again to hook.

port-bike-stunt.intro: Port Bike Stunt is a 3D motorcycle stunt racer set on a road made of shipping containers, with traps and tilted containers to handle. It supports a two-player mode for head-to-head play.
tips: Watch the tilted containers ahead and ease off the throttle before you reach them so the bike stays under control.
You have 5 lives per level, so slow down near traps rather than rushing through and losing a life early.
Save NITRO for long tunnel ramps where you need extra speed to clear the jump, instead of spending it on open road.
Use the camera key to switch views when you need a better look at the road ahead and the upcoming obstacles.
In 2 Player mode, keep your eyes on your own bike and the path ahead; a crash costs you the same lives as in single player.
faq: What is the goal of Port Bike Stunt?
Ride across the shipping container road, avoid the traps, and get through each level without running out of your 5 lives.
When should I use NITRO?
Save NITRO for the long tunnel ramps, where the extra speed helps you pass the jump safely.

crazy-obstacle-blitz-going-ball-3d.intro: Crazy Obstacle Blitz is a fast 3D arcade game where you steer a ball left and right to dodge obstacles and keep moving forward. One hit ends the run, so steady control matters most.
tips: Keep your eyes a little ahead of the ball so you can react to obstacles before they reach it.
Make small, early left and right movements instead of sudden sharp turns, which are easy to overcorrect.
Use the acceleration belts to gain speed when the path is clear, but expect obstacles to come faster as well.
Stay near the center of the track when you can, since it gives you more room to dodge in either direction.
Practice in short sessions, as there is no time limit and steady reflexes improve with repetition.
faq: What is the goal of Crazy Obstacle Blitz?
The goal is to keep the ball moving forward while avoiding obstacles. The ball is destroyed as soon as it hits one, so the run ends on contact.
How do I move the ball?
You steer the ball left and right to dodge obstacles. The game uses simple one-touch style controls, so you only need to respond to what is ahead.

soda-sandbox.intro: Soda Sandbox is a 3D sandbox where you play as a soda bottle exploring islands and deserts, racing, fighting rival bottles, and testing physics. Use it to try different playstyles and see what each map offers.
tips: Move with W, A, S and D, and use left mouse click to shoot and select items. Practise these basics in a quiet area before you head into a fight or a race.
Try a few different modes before settling in. Drifting, ramp jumps, gunfights and build mode each ask for different skills, so it helps to know which one you enjoy most.
When you race, focus on drifting through corners and using ramps to get air. Flipping the bottle mid-air is a skill that improves with repeated attempts.
Look closely at the map for hidden secrets, such as the vanishing water puzzles in the survival-style areas. Slow exploration often reveals more than rushing from one objective to the next.
Use build mode to run ragdoll physics experiments and see how objects react. Knowing how bodies tumble and collide can help you predict outcomes in later fights and stunts.
faq: What is the main goal of Soda Sandbox?
The game has no single fixed goal. You can explore freely, race and drift, battle rival bottles, solve map secrets, or experiment in build mode.
Which keys control the bottle?
Use W, A, S and D to move your character. Left mouse click shoots and selects items.

reindeer-escape.intro: Reindeer Escape is a shooting game where you play a rebellious reindeer fighting to break free. You cross snowy landscapes, dodge obstacles, and battle enemies in a charming pixel art world.
tips: Watch an obstacle's movement for a moment before you commit to a route, since timing matters more than speed when you dodge.
Plan your path ahead of time. The game rewards strategic thinking, so try to see which enemies you can avoid and which you need to deal with.
Keep moving rather than standing still in one spot, because staying put makes it easier for enemies and obstacles to catch you.
When a fight starts, focus on one threat at a time instead of reacting to everything at once.
If you lose, note what caught you and try a different approach on your next run, since learning the patterns is the main way to improve.
faq: What is the goal of Reindeer Escape?
You play as a rebellious reindeer trying to escape by surviving snowy landscapes, dodging obstacles, and battling enemies to earn your freedom.
What skills do I need to do well?
The game calls for nimble reflexes for dodging and strategic planning for outsmarting enemies, so both quick reactions and careful thinking help.

connect-associations.intro: Connect Associations is a word puzzle where you find sets of four words that share a theme and merge them into groups. Correct merges reveal categories, and later levels add new word sets and ice obstacles.
tips: Before you tap, name the theme you think a pair shares, then check whether the other words fit that same idea.
Start with the pairs you feel most sure about, since each correct merge also damages the ice.
Free frozen words early, because they can't be used in a group until the ice is cleared.
If the words feel stuck in a bad layout, use shuffle to change their positions and look for new pairings.
Save hints for especially tricky connections so you can keep the puzzle moving without guessing.
faq: How do I complete a level?
Keep merging related words until each group holds all four, then reveal every category on the board.
What happens if I pick the wrong pair?
An incorrect pair costs one attempt, so it helps to think through the theme before you merge.

wild-west-mafia-redemption-gun.intro: Wild West Mafia Redemption Gun is a first-person shooter where you take on outlaw gangs in shootouts across open western landscapes. Mix stealth and strategy to be the last one standing.
tips: Scout the area before you engage. Knowing where enemies are positioned lets you choose when to move in and when to wait.
Use stealth when you can. Approaching quietly can help you thin out a gang before a full shootout starts.
Pick your gear with the mission in mind. Think about whether the job calls for close-range firepower or a more careful approach.
Stay on the move during firefights. Standing still in the open makes you an easy target when outlaws start shooting back.
Try different tactics on each mission. Outsmarting a gang sometimes works better than facing them head-on, so experiment to see what suits you.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You fight through missions against outlaws and gangs, using stealth and strategy to be the last one standing.
Should I always fight head-on?
Not necessarily. The game rewards outsmarting enemies, so stealth and planning can be just as useful as direct shootouts.

robby-the-lava-tsunami.intro: Robby The Lava Tsunami is a running game where you race ahead of a flowing lava wave. It has a colorful setting, unique skills, and customization options for fans of speed and acrobatics.
tips: Keep moving forward steadily rather than stopping, since the lava wave is always chasing you.
Try each ability on the number keys 1 through 5 early on so you know what it does before you need it in a tight spot.
Use the Space key to jump across gaps and obstacles, and time your jumps before you reach the edge.
Use the mouse to look around the course so you can spot what is coming before you reach it.
Pause with Tab or Escape when you need a moment to plan your route, then return to the race.
faq: What is the goal of Robby The Lava Tsunami?
You race against a flowing lava wave and try to win by staying ahead of it.
How do I move and jump?
Use W, A, S, and D to move and the Space key to jump. The mouse controls the camera view.

anti-terrorist-shooting-game.intro: Anti Terrorist Shooting Game is a first-person shooter where you play as an elite commando fighting terrorists across several mission types. You move with WASD, aim with the right mouse button, and shoot with a left click or tap.
tips: Use the offline PVP mode to get used to the aim and movement against AI enemies before you start the story-based Campaign.
Aim with the right mouse button before you fire at distant targets, since steady aim makes shots more reliable than firing from the hip.
Press R to reload when there is a short gap in the fighting, so you are not caught with an empty weapon when enemies close in.
In Survival, pace yourself. Waves keep coming, so save your strongest weapons and explosives for the larger groups.
In Defuse Mode, plan your route to the bombs before you move so you can reach them while keeping enemy fire to a minimum.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
The goal depends on the mode you pick. In Campaign you complete story missions to take down terrorists, while in Survival you aim to stay alive through endless enemy waves.
How do I shoot and aim?
Use a left click or tap to shoot, and hold the right mouse button to aim. Move with W, A, S and D.

fruits-slice-challenge.intro: Fruits Slice Challenge is a 3D hypercasual game where you chop fruit with a knife while steering clear of boards that damage your blade. Your goal is to reach the finish line.
tips: Hold down to chop and release to stop, so keep your timing short and deliberate rather than holding the whole way.
Watch the path ahead for boards before you start chopping, since each one that hits your knife reduces its condition.
Slow down slightly when a board is close so you can line up a safe cut instead of rushing past it.
Try short bursts of chopping and check your position often, which makes it easier to correct your route.
Replay levels with a calm pace at first to learn how far each board sits from your knife before going faster.
faq: How do I play Fruits Slice Challenge?
Tap and hold to chop, then release to stop. Move through the course and avoid the boards to reach the finish line.
What damages the knife?
The various boards in the course damage your knife when you hit them, so you should steer around them.

crazy-kick-ball.intro: Crazy Kick Ball is a 3D football game about dribbling past defenders, faking out the keeper and shooting to score. Try to beat your high score by finding gaps and dodging tackles.
tips: Watch the defenders before you move and look for a clear gap to run through.
Use a fake to pull the keeper to one side, then shoot toward the open area on the other side.
Time your shot for when the path to goal is clear rather than shooting as soon as you can.
Keep your touches on the ball simple when defenders are close, so you can change direction quickly.
Play a few rounds in a row to learn how the defenders move, since the same patterns make gaps easier to spot.
faq: What is the goal of Crazy Kick Ball?
Dribble the ball past defenders, fake the keeper and score goals. Your main aim is to beat your own high score.
How do I control the player?
You play with mouse clicks or taps. Click or tap at the right moments to dribble, fake and shoot.

tidy-up-satisfeel-asmr.intro: Tidy Up is a calm puzzle game about sorting scattered objects into their proper places. You clean messy scenes by dragging, placing, and organizing items across relaxing minigames.
tips: Before you start moving things, scan the whole scene to see which item types and colors are present. A quick look helps you plan the order you will sort them in.
Group similar items first, such as all items of one color or one category, and place them together. This makes the rest of the scene easier to finish.
Pay attention to size as well as color, since some levels ask you to arrange items by size. Comparing neighbors side by side can prevent mistakes.
Take your time when placing objects, because the puzzles reward careful thinking and attention to detail. Rushing is more likely to leave a few items in the wrong spot.
If you are on a touch screen, use single-finger taps and drags, and tap an item to select it before moving it to its spot. Keeping your movements slow and steady makes precise placement easier.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Your goal is to sort, organize, and place every item in its proper spot. A level is complete once everything is sorted correctly.
How do I move items?
On desktop, click and drag with the left mouse button to pick up, move, and place objects. On mobile, tap and drag items into their correct position.

crazy-bus-station.intro: Crazy Bus Station! is a puzzle game where you clear a colorful parking lot by matching cars with their passengers. Each level brings new challenges, from easy to advanced.
tips: Before clicking anything, look at the arrow on each car and check which way it will travel. Cars can only leave along their arrow.
Find the cars that are blocking others. Clearing the front of a jam first usually opens up the rest of the lot.
A car only leaves if its path is completely free. If a click does nothing, look for another car or vehicle in its way.
When you get stuck, try the queue sorting booster to reorder the line. It can help you see a new route forward.
If the lot still looks blocked, use the car shuffling booster to rearrange the cars and try a different order.
faq: What is the goal of Crazy Bus Station!?
Your goal is to match each car with its passengers and clear the whole parking lot. Each level must be fully cleared to finish it.
How do I move a car?
Click on a car and it will move away in the direction of its arrow. It will only leave if the path in front of it is free.

funny-finds-hidden-object-game.intro: Funny Finds is a classic hidden object game where you search each scene for the items listed in the task. Click on each required object to find it on the level.
tips: Read the task list before you start searching so you know exactly which objects you need to find.
Scan the scene in sections, such as left to right or top to bottom, so you do not miss items in corners or along the edges.
Look for objects that are partly hidden or blend into the background, since these are often the hardest to spot.
Move around the screen to view different parts of the scene rather than staring at one spot for too long.
Keep track of the objects you have already found so you can focus your search on the ones that remain.
faq: What is the goal of Funny Finds?
The goal is to find the required objects shown in the task on each level by clicking on them in the scene.
How do I play each level?
Move around the screen, pay attention to the highlighted objects in the task, and click on each one you find.

sand-truck.intro: Sand Truck is a puzzle game about guiding colored sand through pipelines so it reaches the matching trucks. It has 30 levels with layouts that get trickier as you go.
tips: Before you change anything, study the whole pipeline layout and trace where each color of sand will end up.
Identify which truck needs which color first, then plan the route the sand has to take to reach it.
Pay attention to where pipelines split or cross, since a single wrong turn can send the wrong sand to a truck.
If a level feels stuck, step back and map out the flow again instead of making quick, random changes.
Take your time on the harder layouts; slowing down to plan usually works better than rushing through trial and error.
faq: What is the goal of Sand Truck?
The goal is to manage the flow of colorful sand through pipelines so that each batch reaches the truck that matches its color. You need to do this across 30 levels.
How difficult do the levels get?
The game describes its levels as challenging, with complex pipelines and tricky layouts. Early levels are a good place to learn how the sand flows before the puzzles get harder.

winter-tale-secrets-and-mergings.intro: Winter Tale: Secrets and Mergings is a Christmas-themed merge puzzle. You combine identical items on the board to uncover the forest's secrets and restore its magic.
tips: Merge identical items whenever you can, since each merge is what moves the story forward.
Check your active quests before spending resources, so you save what you need for the rewards and artifacts you are working toward.
Look at which items are still unmerged on the board and plan a few moves ahead to avoid getting stuck.
Come back for the daily events and quests, because they are a steady way to earn prizes.
Use the controls that feel most comfortable to you, whether touchscreen or mouse, so you can focus on spotting combinations.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You merge identical items on the board to uncover the forest's main secret and restore the lost magic of Christmas. Completing tasks and quests helps you reach that goal.
How do I create new items?
Merge two or more identical items on the board to unlock new combinations and rare magical artifacts.

monster-makeup-3d.intro: Monster Makeup 3D is a Halloween-themed girls game where you disguise monsters as humans using makeup and tools. Your job is to change their features so they can blend in without being spotted.
tips: Work slowly and check each change before moving on, since the game warns that one mistake could backfire.
Look at the monster's features first and decide which ones need to be hidden or changed before you pick up any tool.
Try different tools on the same feature to see how each one changes the look, so you learn what works best.
Pay attention to the small details, because a tiny leftover feature can give the monster away.
Expect funny failures as part of the experience, and try again to see how a cleaner disguise turns out.
faq: What is the main goal of Monster Makeup 3D?
The goal is to disguise monsters as humans by using various tools to change their features so they are hidden from people.
What happens if I make a mistake?
The game says one mistake could backfire, and failed attempts lead to funny animations. You can start the look again to get a better result.

retro-basketball.intro: Retro Basketball is a pixel-art sports challenge where you aim and shoot with click-and-drag controls. Your goal is to score high and climb the leaderboard by making accurate shots.
tips: Spend your first few shots learning how the click-and-drag motion affects where the ball goes. Small, consistent drags are easier to repeat than large ones.
Focus on accuracy over speed. The game rewards precise shots, so take a moment to line up each one before you release.
Keep your drag movements smooth and steady. Rushing a drag often leads to a shot that misses the target.
Pay attention to what worked on your best shots and repeat that approach. Consistency is the key to building a high score.
Play a few rounds in a row to build rhythm. Getting into a steady routine can help you hit more shots as the pace picks up.
faq: What is the goal of Retro Basketball?
The goal is to shoot accurately and earn high scores. Your results can help you climb the leaderboard.
How do I control the ball?
You use click-and-drag controls to aim and shoot. Practice the motion to get a feel for how your drag affects each shot.

choco-ball-draw-line-and-happy-girl.intro: Choco Ball-Draw Line & Happy Girl is a sports puzzle where you draw lines to guide cascading choco balls toward a girl who loves sweets. You steer around fireballs and ice cubes while the challenges grow harder.
tips: Look at where the choco balls will fall before you draw, and plan the route to the girl first.
Keep your lines precise. A small mistake can send balls into a fireball or an ice cube.
Watch the obstacles closely and note which paths they block before you commit to a line.
Expect the challenges to escalate, so be ready to change your approach when your first plan stops working.
Stay flexible and think quickly. Adapting to each new setup matters more than repeating one method.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
You guide the cascading choco balls so they satisfy the girl's sweet tooth. You do this by drawing lines that carry the balls past the fireballs and ice cubes.
What makes the game harder as you go?
The challenges escalate, so the layouts become more demanding. Careful planning and quick adjustments help you keep up.

panda-fight.intro: Panda Fight is an animal battle game where you use drag-and-drop moves to fight through pixelated realms. Collect stars along the way and work toward rescuing the Panda Princess.
tips: Collect stars whenever the route allows it, since they are part of the 100% completion goal.
Before each battle, think about which panda to move and where to drop it, rather than dragging quickly without a plan.
Watch how each fight plays out and note which moves work well, so you can repeat strong strategies in later battles.
If you get stuck, go back and look for stars you may have skipped, as they can help you complete a realm fully.
Take short breaks between realms so you can plan your next moves calmly and keep your focus on the strategic side of combat.
faq: What is the main goal of Panda Fight?
Your main goal is to journey through the pixelated realms, win panda battles, and rescue the Panda Princess. Collecting stars along the way helps you work toward full completion.
How do the controls work?
The game uses drag-and-drop mechanics to move your pandas during battles. Drag a panda to the spot you want and drop it to act.

gorilla-multiplayer.intro: Gorilla Multiplayer is an online game where you climb, swing, and jump through challenging terrain alongside or against other players. Move your gorilla, aim with the mouse, and get used to the swinging.
tips: Spend a few moments practicing movement before joining a busy session, so you learn how your gorilla responds to jumps and swings.
Keep an eye on the camera and aim with the mouse on PC, since knowing where you are heading helps you avoid missed grabs.
Plan each leap before you take it. Agility matters, but a short pause to check your route often saves you from falling behind.
If you are playing with friends, coordinate who goes first and who follows, because teamwork is a key part of the experience.
On mobile, use small, steady joystick movements and time your jump button taps, so your leaps land where you intend.
faq: What is the main goal of Gorilla Multiplayer?
The game is built around climbing, swinging, and jumping through challenging terrain while competing or collaborating with other players. Your aim is to move well and stay in the action.
How do I move my gorilla on PC?
Use the Arrow Keys to move your gorilla. Use the mouse to control the camera and aim.

haunted-panic.intro: Haunted Panic is a Halloween shooting game where you guard twelve haunted doors by tapping monsters before they reach them. Watch out for friendly ghosts, which you should leave alone.
tips: Check all three pages regularly with the arrows, since the twelve doors are spread across them and a monster can break through one you have not been watching.
Leave friendly ghosts untouched for two seconds so their doors stay protected, and avoid tapping them when a monster is close by.
Save Pumpkin Blast for crowded moments, because it hits enemies and spares ghosts, making it a safer choice when several monsters are gathered together.
Tap bonus chests five times each when you have a spare moment, since the gold they give helps you improve your Arcade powers.
If you want a harder run, try Classic mode, where you have one life, and focus on quick, accurate taps from the start.
faq: What is the main goal of Haunted Panic?
You guard twelve haunted doors by tapping monsters before they can strike. Keeping doors protected across the nights is how you keep playing.
How do I stop monsters?
Tap or click a monster to zap it. Act quickly, since monsters strike if you wait too long.

keyboard-escape-1-speed-sweets.intro: Keyboard Escape: +1 Speed | Sweets is a running game across a giant chocolate and candy keyboard. Your speed builds with every step, and one wrong move can send you back to the start.
tips: Keep moving steadily from the start, since every step you take raises your speed and makes later sections easier to clear.
Time your jumps carefully before leaping over gaps or obstacles, because a fall sends you back to the start.
Use the camera controls to look ahead on the track so you can spot upcoming obstacles before you reach them.
Collect rewards along the way and spend them on power-ups and upgrades to move faster.
Check the leaderboard after a run to see where you stand and aim to beat your own best time.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Race across the keyboard track, avoid falls and obstacles, and reach the finish line as quickly as you can.
How do I control my character on PC?
Use W, A, S and D to move, the Spacebar to jump, and hold the right mouse button while moving the mouse to control the camera.

my-pet-care-salon-obby-dress-up-3d.intro: My Pet Care Salon: Obby Dress-Up 3D is a relaxing simulation where you run your own animal care salon. Wash, care for, decorate, and train pets to keep them happy and healthy.
tips: Check on every pet regularly, since the description says each one needs attention and care. Visiting them one by one helps you avoid neglecting any of them.
Finish simple tasks first to build up your resources, then put what you earn into upgrading the salon. This makes it easier to unlock new features later.
Use the camera controls to look around the salon before you start a task, so you can spot which pet needs washing, decorating, or training.
Mix grooming, decorating, and training instead of focusing on only one activity, so each pet becomes both happier and healthier.
Move slowly and take your time, since the game is built around a calm, casual pace and small moments with each pet.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?

You run an animal care salon by washing, caring for, decorating, and training your pets so they become happier and healthier. Completing simple tasks and upgrading the salon also helps you unlock new features.
How do I move and look around on PC?
Use WASD to move, hold the mouse button to move the camera, and press the spacebar to jump.

creative-puzzle.intro: Creative Puzzle combines coloring with puzzle solving across 32 vibrant scenes. The challenge grows as you go, so each scene builds on the skills you've already practiced.
tips: Look at the whole scene before you start coloring so you can see how the pieces fit together.
Start with the areas that have the clearest shapes or edges, since they give you the most clues for the rest of the picture.
Pay attention to patterns and color groups, which can help you work out where a piece belongs.
Take a short break when a puzzle feels stuck, then return to it with fresh eyes.
Try the earlier scenes first so you can get comfortable before the challenge increases.
faq: What is the goal of Creative Puzzle?
The goal is to color and piece together the puzzles in each of the 32 scenes. You combine art with logic as you work through them.
Does the game get harder as I play?
Yes, the description says the challenge grows over time. Working through the scenes in order can help you build skills gradually.

minimissions.intro: MiniMissions is a run of 80 short skill games played with mouse clicks. Each game is about timing, and one mistake ends the run.
tips: Watch the whole screen for a moment before your first click so you know what the mission is asking for.
Click at the moment the action lines up rather than reacting late, since timing is the core skill in every game.
On time-based missions, stay focused on the clock and avoid spending extra seconds on small details.
Stay calm after a near miss. Taking a breath and keeping your pace steady helps you avoid the single mistake that ends the game.
Use each new mission as a fresh start and don't carry frustration from the last one into your timing.
faq: What is the goal of MiniMissions?
The goal is to complete as many of the 80 mini missions as you can. Finishing one game brings up a new one.
How do you control the game?
All play is done with mouse clicks. You click at the right time to move forward in each mission.

robby-superhero-obby.intro: Robby Superhero Obby is a parkour challenge where you reach the end of each level by using superpowers to get past obstacles. Falling sends you back to your last checkpoint.
tips: Learn which powers you have on each map before you start a hard section, since the first map and the second map offer different sets.
Use the number keys 1 through 5 to switch to the power you need, and check the on-screen interface to confirm which one is active.
Save your progress by reaching checkpoints often, so a fall only sends you back a short distance.
Use Right Click to look around before each jump, so you can judge distances and spot hidden routes.
Pause with Tab or Escape to plan a tricky section and catch your breath before trying it again.
faq: What is the goal of Robby Superhero Obby?
The goal is to reach the end of the level by overcoming all of the obstacles using different superpowers. There are 10 superpowers in total across the two maps.
What happens if I fall?
You respawn at the most recent checkpoint you reached, so reaching checkpoints regularly is the best way to limit lost progress.

build-and-fly-obby.intro: Build and Fly Obby lets you assemble planes from random parts and test whether they can fly. Each build behaves differently, so experiment, watch what happens, and improve your next design.
tips: Parts are random, so try different combinations rather than repeating a build that wobbled or spun.
Pay attention to how your plane moves in the first moments of flight, since wobbling or spinning shows which part of the design needs changing.
Fly forward steadily and keep an eye on obstacles ahead so you have time to dodge them.
Collect coins and bonuses on the way, and aim for rings and gates to keep your run on track.
Flying farther unlocks more parts, so each longer flight gives you more options for your next build. Use the camera rotation to check your plane from different angles.
faq: How do I add a part to my plane?
Select the item in your inventory, then tap on the plane to attach it. Each part you add changes how the plane flies.
How do I unlock new parts?
The farther you fly, the more parts you unlock. Longer flights are the main way to expand your options.

homeowner-3d.intro: Homeowner 3D is a relaxed first-person game about cleaning, renovating, and decorating run-down houses. You take jobs from the laptop, travel there in your van, and earn money to build up your property.
tips: Check the laptop for available jobs and read what the owner wants before you drive off. Taking on jobs you can finish quickly helps you build up money early.
Work through the room in a set order, such as clearing trash and dirt first, then washing surfaces, then painting or laying floors. This keeps you from walking back over finished areas.
Hold the action button or left mouse button steadily when cleaning or dismantling old items. Short taps may not finish the job.
Before placing furniture, use the rotate controls to check how each piece fits the room. Matching the owner's arrangement is what the job is judged on.
Take photos of finished rooms, since your work is rated from them. Make sure surfaces are clean and the furniture is in place before you snap the shot.
faq: What is the main goal of Homeowner 3D?
Your goal is to complete orders by cleaning, renovating, and decorating houses the way each owner wants. Finished work earns money, which you can use to buy furniture, pets, and real estate.
How do I earn money in the game?
You earn money by completing jobs and getting your work rated from photos. Better results on each order help you afford more furniture and property.

tanks-2d-war-and-heroes.intro: Tanks 2D War and Heroes is a tank battle game where you destroy enemy forces, cross challenging terrain, and upgrade your arsenal. This guide covers practical habits to help you progress.
tips: Spend your first few minutes learning the controls before engaging enemies, so your movement and aiming feel natural under pressure.
Study the terrain before you move in. Challenging ground can slow you or expose you, so pick routes that keep you protected.
Use upgrades deliberately. Choose the improvements that match how you like to fight rather than grabbing whatever is available.
Think about positioning before each fight. Outmaneuvering foes often matters more than trading shots head on.
Stay patient and watch enemy movement. Quick reflexes work best when paired with a clear plan for each engagement.
faq: What is the main goal of Tanks 2D War and Heroes?
The goal is to destroy enemy forces and conquer the challenging terrain across the battlefield. Success depends on both your reflexes and your tactics.
How can I get stronger during a game?
You can upgrade your arsenal as you play. Pick upgrades that suit your playstyle and focus on the ones that help you win battles.

truck-simulator-arcade-championship.intro: Truck Simulator Arcade Championship is a fast-paced truck racing game. You drive large, heavy trucks through racing events across different tracks and terrains, competing against rivals.
tips: Spend your first few minutes learning how the truck responds to WASD or the arrow keys, since heavy trucks react differently from cars.
Try different truck types to find one whose handling suits your style before committing to a race.
Ease off the keys before tight turns instead of braking hard mid-corner, which helps keep the truck steady.
Watch how the surface changes between tracks and terrains, and adjust your speed when the ground gets rough.
Stay calm when rivals push close; steady, controlled driving usually wins more races than reckless overtaking.
faq: What is the goal of Truck Simulator Arcade Championship?
The goal is to win racing events against rivals by driving your truck across a variety of challenging tracks and terrains.
How do I control the truck?
Use the WASD keys or the arrow keys to move the truck.

hard-puzzle-color-lines.intro: Hard Puzzle: Color Lines asks you to connect matching colored pairs with paths that never cross. Each level gets tighter as more colors and fewer open spaces appear.
tips: Start with the pairs that have the fewest possible routes, such as colors whose endpoints sit near edges or corners. Locking them in early keeps the rest of the board open.
Before drawing a line, check whether it will split the empty space into pieces that are too small to finish. Blocking a region is the most common reason a level fails.
Plan the whole board rather than one color at a time. Look for spots where two paths would have to pass through the same cell and reroute one of them first.
Use undo or restart without hesitation when a move leaves you stuck. Trying a different route on a fresh attempt is often faster than fixing a broken board.
Take short breaks between harder levels. Looking at a board with fresh eyes makes it easier to spot a crossing or a gap you missed.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Connect every pair of the same color with a line so that all pairs are linked and the board is completed.
Can lines cross each other?
No. Lines must not cross, so plan routes so that each color stays on its own path.

trash-baron.intro: Trash Baron is a management game about building a waste recycling empire. You start with a small landfill, sort plastic, glass, metal and rubber, and grow it into a high-tech recycling plant.
tips: Sort every batch carefully before you process it, since the description says all waste should be sorted properly.
Pay attention to quality, because higher-quality recycled products bring higher profit, so a little extra care in production pays off.
Reinvest your earnings early in equipment, workshops and employees, as growth is what lets you handle more waste and sell more.
Start production lines for materials you can reliably sort, such as turning plastic bottles back into new bottles, before spreading into other materials.
Keep your workshops running steadily rather than letting them sit idle, since the game rewards steady selling and expansion over time.
faq: What is the main goal of Trash Baron?
Your goal is to grow from a small waste collection point into the largest waste recycling plant in the city by collecting, sorting, recycling and selling goods.
How do I control the game on a computer?
Use the WASD keys to move, or use your mouse, as described in the game's instructions.

space-war-symphony.intro: Space War Symphony is a rhythm-based arcade shooter where you steer a starship with the mouse and fire in time with the beat. Timing your shots brings bonus damage, score, and spread patterns.
tips: Listen to the beat before you start firing, and try to find a steady rhythm for your clicks instead of random bursts.
Use the hold-to-auto-fire option when you need steady pressure on a wave, then switch to tapped, beat-timed clicks when you want the bonus damage and score.
Keep your ship moving side to side with the mouse so you stay clear of incoming bullets while you fire.
Watch enemy bullet patterns closely during waves and boss fights, and position the ship where the gaps are before you commit to shooting.
Pause with P when a wave gets crowded to reset your focus, then return with a clear plan for the next section.
faq: What is the main goal of Space War Symphony?
Survive the enemy waves and defeat the bosses while building your score. Clicks timed to the beat give extra damage, score, and combo bonuses.
How do I move and shoot?
Move the mouse left and right to glide your ship. Left-click to fire, and hold the button to auto-fire.

head-soccer-2023.intro: Head Soccer 2023 is a fast sports game built around one-on-one matches and tournaments. Timing your jumps and kicks against quick opponents is the core skill to develop.
tips: Watch the ball closely before you jump, since most of your success will come from reading where it is going to land.
Practice your jumps and kicks in one-on-one matches first, so the timing feels natural before you enter a tournament.
Stay alert during fast exchanges and avoid rushing every shot, because a calm, well-timed kick often beats a hurried one.
Try playing against a friend, which can help you notice how different opponents react and adjust your own play.
In tournaments, treat each match as a chance to refine one skill, such as defending or attacking, rather than trying everything at once.
faq: What is the main goal of Head Soccer 2023?
The goal is to win matches against your opponents, whether in one-on-one games or in tournaments, and work toward championship glory.
Can I play alone or with other people?
Yes. You can compete solo against the game or play with friends.

funny-angela-haircut.intro: Funny Angela Haircut is a girls' styling game where you give Angela a new look. You work through hair tools, hair color, and outfits to finish a full makeover.
tips: Shape the hair first with the scissors and hair growing spray before you move on to curling or drying, so later steps have a clear base to work from.
Try a color on a small part of the hair before committing to a full dye, so you can see how it looks with her skin tone and the outfit you plan to use.
Choose the outfit last and pick pieces that match the hairstyle and color, so the whole look feels coordinated.
Use the blow dryer and curling iron after cutting, since styling heat tools work best on hair that is already the length and shape you want.
Take a moment to check the finished look from different angles before you finish, so you catch any spots you want to adjust.
faq: What is the goal of Funny Angela Haircut?
The goal is to give Angela the best hairstyle you can, then finish her makeover with hair color and a stylish outfit.
How do I control the game on a computer?
Use the mouse to pick tools, cut, style, and dress Angela. Click or drag as the game asks for each step.

rope-bowing-puzzle.intro: Rope Bowing Puzzle asks you to guide a bowling ball through mazes while planning your route and avoiding obstacles. Each level gets harder, so careful planning matters as much as quick reactions.
tips: Look at the whole maze before you move. Plan the route from start to finish so you know which turns to take.
Watch for obstacles that appear unexpectedly and slow down when the path gets tight, rather than rushing past them.
Pay attention to the layout of each new level. Noticing how the walls and paths connect will help you spot dead ends sooner.
If you get stuck, pause and re-plan a different path instead of repeating the same move that failed.
Stay focused for the whole run. The game rewards sharp attention, so short breaks can help you return with a clear head.
faq: What is the main goal of Rope Bowing Puzzle?
Your goal is to guide the bowling ball through each maze to finish the level while dodging obstacles. The levels become more complex as you progress.
What controls does the game use?
The game description does not list specific controls, so check the in-game prompts or any on-screen help when you start a level.

final-freeway-2r.intro: Final Freeway 2R is a retro-style arcade racer where you weave through traffic, keep your speed under control, and race a rival to the finish line. Its route choices add a strategic layer to each run.
tips: Keep your speed in check when traffic gets dense, since the game asks you to balance speed and control.
Watch the traffic ahead a few moments early so you can plan your gaps instead of reacting at the last second.
Treat each route choice as a decision: a shorter path is not always the faster one once traffic is factored in.
Keep an eye on your rival's position and use it to decide when to push harder and when to hold back.
Stay focused on the finish line for the whole run, because the game is built around a fast-paced dash toward it.
faq: What is the goal of Final Freeway 2R?
Your goal is to dash to the finish line ahead of your rival while weaving through traffic. The game rewards careful speed and smart route choices along the way.
How do I control my car?
The game does not list specific controls in its instructions, so check the on-screen prompts or any help shown when you start playing. Practice early runs to get a feel for steering and speed.

minni-family-home-play-house.intro: Minni Family Home is a relaxed pretend-play game where you create the Minni family, dress them up, and visit places around town. With no scores or timers, you set the pace and make up your own stories.
tips: Start with the four places that are open from the start, such as the house or the café, to learn how objects and characters behave before deciding on the video unlock.
Pick up items and drop them onto different characters or places to see what happens, since much of the fun comes from testing combinations.
Spend a few minutes on the hairstyles, outfits, hats, eyes and expressions before you start a story, so your characters are ready for each scene.
Collect your free tickets every day and save them for the Prize Pop machine, which gives you a random new outfit each time you use them.
Use the mouse wheel on desktop to scroll quickly through long outfit and shop lists, so you can compare options without clicking through each one.
faq: Is there a goal I need to reach?
No. The game has no score, no timer and no way to lose, so the goal is simply to explore, find surprises and play out your own stories.
How do I unlock the other five places on the map?
Watch one short optional video, which opens the other five places for your play session.

makeup-fruits.intro: Makeup Fruits lets you give fruits a glamorous makeover. Pick a fruit, then build its look with makeup, eyelashes, stickers, and accessories.
tips: Try a few different brands and powder colors on the same fruit before settling on a look, so you can compare how each one suits it.
Start with the bigger changes, like powder and lipstick, then add smaller details such as eyelashes and stickers so the look stays balanced.
Drag headbands and accessories onto the fruit one at a time and check how each one sits before adding the next.
Keep your gems in mind as you play, since you can use them to unlock new items for future creations.
Take your time with the final step, because the selfie is the last view of your creation and the one you can share with friends.
faq: How do I start a new makeover?
Use your mouse to click the fruit you want to transform. Then you can move on to choosing makeup and accessories for it.
How do I add makeup to my fruit?
Drag and drop headbands and other components onto the fruit, and select lipstick and eye colors from the options. The game offers many components to try.

hugie-wugie-coloring.intro: Hugie Wugie Coloring is a coloring game built around the blue monster character, with a collection of pages for players of all ages. You color the pictures using your mouse or by tapping the screen.
tips: Choose a page that matches your mood or skill level, since the collection covers a range of ages. Simpler outlines are easier to fill neatly.
Work on one section at a time, such as the body, then the eyes, then the background. This keeps the picture from looking patchy.
Pick two or three contrasting colors before you start so the monster's blue body stands out against the other parts of the picture.
If you are using a touchscreen, tap steadily and move slowly near the outlines to stay inside the lines.
Take a short break between pages to look at your work with fresh eyes, then decide whether a few extra touches would finish it.
faq: What is the goal of Hugie Wugie Coloring?
The goal is to color in the Hugie Wugie pictures from the game's collection. There is no set winning condition described, so the aim is simply to finish a page the way you like it.
How do I color the pictures?
Use your mouse or tap the screen, as the game instructions describe. Apply your colors to the areas of the page you want to fill.

glossy-garage-car-asmr.intro: Glossy Garage is a relaxing car repair game where you wash grime off rusty cars, fix engine parts, and polish them up. Once they are finished, you sell them to grow your own auto shop.
tips: Clean the dirtiest areas first, since thick grime can hide damage underneath. Seeing the full condition of a car early helps you plan the rest of the job.
Work through the car in a steady order, such as one panel at a time, so you do not miss spots before you move on to polishing.
Take your time with the cleaning drags. Slow, even strokes are the calmest way to play and help you cover the surface evenly.
Replace badly damaged parts before you focus on looks. A car with fixed engine parts and better performance is worth more when you trade it.
Apply the custom paint last, once the car is clean, repaired, and polished. Paint on a dirty body would not show off your finished work.
faq: What is the goal of Glossy Garage?
You restore rusty, broken-down cars by cleaning, repairing, upgrading, and painting them. Finished vehicles can be traded for virtual profit to expand your auto body shop.
How do I clean a car?
On PC, click and drag with the left mouse button. On mobile, touch and drag across the screen.

gusano-io-worms-snake-game.intro: Gusano.io is a snake game set in a busy arena where you grow by eating treats, outwit rival snakes, and use attacks and stealth to win battles. Customizing your snake is part of the fun.
tips: Keep an eye on the arena as you move, since rivals can appear from any direction and the challenges grow over time.
Pick your treats with care. Growing makes your snake longer and can change how easily you can move around the arena.
Watch what your rivals do before committing to a route. Predicting their moves is often more useful than racing toward the nearest treat.
Save your attacks for moments when they will count most, such as when a rival is cornered or distracted.
Use stealth to approach a rival quietly instead of charging straight at them, which gives you more room to choose your timing.
faq: What is the main goal of Gusano.io?
The description says you grow by munching treats, outwit rivals, and conquer in battles within the arena. Winning battles and staying in the game as you grow are the core aims.
How do I control my snake?
The game does not list specific controls in its instructions, so check the in-game prompts or start screen to learn how to move, attack, and use stealth.

grave-blast.intro: Grave Blast is a fast-paced 3D twin-stick survival shooter where you fight endless waves of voxel-style zombies in a spooky Halloween setting. Move, aim, and blast your way to survive as long as you can.
tips: Keep moving rather than standing still, since the zombies arrive in endless waves and staying in one spot lets them surround you.
Use the freedom to shoot in all directions by checking where enemies are gathering before you commit to a route through the level.
Pick up your pace early in each wave so you can thin out the zombies before they crowd the open areas.
On mobile, keep your left thumb on the joystick to dodge and hold the right button to keep firing instead of tapping over and over.
Watch the edges of the screen for zombies approaching from behind so you can turn and clear them before they close in.
faq: What is the goal of Grave Blast?
The goal is to survive as long as possible while blasting through endless waves of zombies. Each wave keeps coming, so staying alive is the main challenge.
What are the controls on desktop?
Use WASD or the Arrow Keys to move, move the mouse to aim, and click the left mouse button to shoot.

dumplings-who-will-you-get.intro: Dumplings: Who Will You Get? is a cute merge and idle game where you open boxes, combine matching dumplings, and collect all 12 characters. Tapping your dumplings earns coins that fund new boxes and kitchen upgrades.
tips: Merge whenever you have two matching dumplings, since each merge moves you closer to the rarer characters in the collection.
Keep track of your box count so you know when the next rare box is coming, which guarantees a level 2 or higher dumpling.
Tap your unlocked dumplings regularly early on, because coins are what let you buy more boxes and upgrades.
Spend coins on kitchen upgrades before buying more boxes if your income is still slow, since a higher income speeds up the rest of the run.
Check your orders often and complete them when you can, as they are a steady source of progress toward the full collection.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
The goal is to unlock all 12 dumpling characters by merging matching dumplings into new, rarer levels.
How do I merge dumplings?
Drag one dumpling onto another of the same level with the mouse on desktop or with your finger on mobile to create the next level.

paper-doll-diary-chibi-dolls.intro: Paper Doll Diary - Chibi Dolls is a dress-up game where you style your own dolls and build scenes to capture as photos or videos. This guide covers how to get the most from its outfits, backdrops, and decorations.
tips: Plan a look before you start dressing your doll. Choosing a colour theme or style first makes it easier to pick pieces that match.
Pick your background first, then choose outfits and props that suit it. A scene sets the mood, so the doll's outfit should fit the setting.
Use props and stickers sparingly. A few well-placed extras usually look better than covering the whole scene with decorations.
Check your doll from several angles and in the final scene before taking a photo. Small mismatches in colour or layering are easier to fix at this stage.
Try recording a short video as well as a photo. Movement can show off outfits and scenes in a way a still image cannot.
faq: What is the main goal of Paper Doll Diary - Chibi Dolls?
The goal is to create photos and videos featuring your own personalised dolls. You do this by dressing up dolls and building scenes around them.
How can I make my doll's scene look more complete?
Add backgrounds, props, and stickers that complement your doll's outfit. Combining these elements helps the whole picture feel cohesive.

delta-force-airborne.intro: Delta Force Airborne is a team-based shooter set across diverse maps. You coordinate with teammates, get past obstacles, and use tactics to secure victory.
tips: Look at each map's layout before rushing in, so you know where obstacles and open ground are.
Coordinate with your team before pushing forward instead of advancing alone.
Change your approach if a tactic is not working, since different choices lead to different outcomes.
Think about each decision, because the description notes that every choice you make shapes the result.
Stay focused on the team objective rather than chasing individual fights.
faq: What is the main goal in Delta Force Airborne?
The goal is to secure victory with your team by using strategy and clever tactics across the game's maps.
Do my choices really affect the outcome?
Yes. The game is built so that every choice you make shapes how the match turns out.

twining-color-switch-game.intro: Twining Color Switch Game asks you to rotate a color wheel so it matches falling candies. The pace rises with every correct match, and the game continues without an end.
tips: Watch the falling candies early and decide which color is coming next, so you are not reacting only at the last moment.
Rotate the wheel in small, steady moves rather than large jumps, since the wheel needs to be in position when a candy reaches it.
Keep your eyes on the next candy in line instead of the one closest to the bottom, which gives you more time to plan.
Pay attention to the rhythm of the game as it speeds up, and try to predict color changes based on the pattern you have seen so far.
Take short breaks between sessions, because steady focus matters more than long play when the challenge keeps increasing.
faq: What is the goal of Twining Color Switch Game?
The goal is to rotate the color wheel so it matches the falling candies. Each correct match raises the intensity of the game.
Does the game get harder as I play?
Yes. The description says the pace increases with each correct match, so you will need quicker reactions the longer you play.

battle-arena-race-to-win.intro: Battle Arena Race to Win is a racing game where you join the Red or Blue team and battle in arenas with upgradable cars. Your choice of car, upgrades, and items shapes how you handle each fight.
tips: Pick a car early and learn how it handles, since the game asks you to balance speed, durability, and acceleration.
Use the handbrake (Space) to drift through tight turns so you keep your speed instead of slowing down.
Save Left Shift nitro for a clear straight or a moment to pass an opponent, not for the start of a run where it may be wasted.
Keep an eye on your car's durability during fights and use R to restore position if you get stuck or flipped.
Spend upgrades on the stats that match your play style, then check the leaderboard to see how your team is doing.
faq: What is the goal of Battle Arena Race to Win?
Join the Red or Blue team, battle opponents in the arena, and climb the leaderboard to help your team win.
How do I steer and move my car?
Use W or the up arrow to accelerate, S or the down arrow to reverse, and A/D or the left/right arrows to turn.

idle-zoo.intro: Idle Zoo asks you to bring forgotten zoos back to life by investing in habitats, attracting visitors, and growing your animal empire. It mixes clicker play with management.
tips: Spend your earnings on habitats that bring in more visitors rather than spreading money thinly across everything.
Balance your investments between strategy and management so that no single part of the zoo falls behind.
Check your zoo regularly to see what visitors are responding to, and put your next investment where earnings are growing.
Keep clicking early on to build up the funds you need for bigger expansions, then let the zoo run on its own.
Before you leave the game, make sure your zoo is in a good state, since it is designed to keep working while you are away.
faq: What is the main goal in Idle Zoo?
The goal is to revitalize forgotten zoos by investing wisely, expanding diverse habitats, and attracting visitors to boost earnings. Over time you build a thriving animal empire.
Does my zoo keep earning when I am not playing?
Yes. The game is built so your zoo can thrive even in your absence, so your earnings can continue to grow while you are away.

deep-space-horror-outpost.intro: You are stranded at an abandoned deep space outpost with a dead cruiser. Collect 8 Energy Cells to restart your journey, while avoiding the bloodthirsty creatures that now control the station.
tips: Check your weapon with the mouse wheel before entering a new area so you are ready for whatever is waiting.
Use Right Mouse Button to aim before firing, since careful shots matter more than rapid fire when monsters close in.
Keep grenades for groups of enemies or tight spots, and save your regular weapons for single targets.
Reload during quiet moments rather than in the middle of a fight, so you are not caught with an empty weapon.
Use melee with V when an enemy is close and you want to conserve ammunition for longer range.
faq: What is the main goal of Deep Space Horror: Outpost?
You need to collect 8 Energy Cells so your space cruiser has enough energy to continue its journey. Each cell you find brings you closer to leaving the station.
How do I attack the monsters?
Left Mouse Button fires your current weapon, and Mouse Wheel lets you switch between weapons. Right Mouse Button aims, and G throws grenades.

two-bike-stunts.intro: Two Bike Stunts is a racing game where you ride motorcycles across two large 3D maps. You can collect coins to unlock locked bikes and perform stunts on the ramps.
tips: Collect coins as you ride, since they are the way to unlock the three locked motorcycles in the garage.
Save nitro for twisting roads, where it helps you keep your bike on the road.
Use the ramps on the two maps that have them to practice stunts, and try to land cleanly before moving on.
Try out the different bikes to find one that suits your riding style, since eight are available to ride.
If you get into trouble on the track, use the restart key to try the level again quickly.
faq: How do I unlock new motorcycles?
Collect the coins on the map to unlock the locked motorcycles. The garage starts with three locked bikes.
What are the controls for two players?
Player 1 uses the arrow keys to move, N for nitro and C for camera. Player 2 uses W, A, S and D to move, T for nitro and Q for camera.

aliens-hunter.intro: Aliens Hunter is a shooting game where you search a city for hidden aliens and take them out with your gun. Each round changes where the aliens are hiding, so careful searching matters as much as aiming.
tips: Scan each area fully before you fire, since aliens are hidden in different spots every round.
Take your time aiming. The game rewards accurate shots, so a slower, deliberate shot is better than a rushed one.
Use your abilities to locate targets early in a round so you are not hunting for them under pressure.
Pay attention to the mission for each level and focus on the aliens it requires, rather than shooting at everything you see.
If you miss a target, reset your search and look again from the start of the area instead of firing at guesses.
faq: What is the goal of Aliens Hunter?
Find the aliens hidden in the city and shoot them accurately to complete each level's mission and earn rewards.
How do I score well in Aliens Hunter?
Score comes from accurate shots at hidden aliens, so precision and careful searching are more useful than firing quickly.

the-flowers-merge-and-sell-bouquets.intro: The Flowers is a relaxing merge puzzle set in a summer garden. Combine matching flowers, fill customer orders for bouquets, and earn coins to climb the leaderboard.
tips: Move the flower left or right with your finger or cursor before releasing, so it lands where you want it on the stack.
Keep identical flowers next to each other so they collide and merge into the next flower type.
Watch for the letter icon at the top of the screen, since it signals a new bouquet order you can fill for coins.
Use the pruning shears to clear flowers you no longer need instead of letting the play area fill up.
Plan a few merges ahead so the doorway-shaped area does not get crowded with flowers that cannot combine.
faq: How do I drop a flower?
Move your finger or mouse cursor to position the flower at the top, then release the mouse button or your finger to make it fly down.
How do I earn coins?
Coins come from selling bouquets to customers and from the play you do in the garden. The goal is to earn more coins than other players to reach the leaderboard.

colored-water-and-pin.intro: Colored Water & Pin is a puzzle game where you guide colorful liquids through levels by pulling pins in the right order. Each level adds challenge while testing your logic and timing.
tips: Study the whole layout before you pull anything, and trace where each color would flow once a pin is removed.
Look for the pin that holds back the most liquid or blocks the most paths, since removing it often opens up the rest of the puzzle.
Think in sequences: a pin that looks harmless may be blocking a route that another pin depends on, so plan two or three moves ahead.
Pay attention to timing as well as order, because the liquid moves when a pin is released and you can watch how it settles.
If you get stuck, stop and reset your thinking by tracing the colors from their starting point again rather than trying random pins.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You need to guide the colored liquids through the puzzle by pulling the pins strategically. The description focuses on solving each layout with logic and timing.
How do the puzzles get harder?
The description says the challenges increase as you progress, with each level presenting a new layout to solve. Early levels are a good place to learn how the pins and liquids behave.

rolling-donut.intro: Rolling Donut is an arcade game where you guide a whimsical hero through waves of chattering dentures. Quick moves and well-timed jumps are the core of the challenge.
tips: Watch the incoming waves before you commit to a move, so you can position yourself early instead of reacting at the last second.
Practice your jump timing on the first few waves to learn how far and how high your hero travels.
Stay mobile rather than standing still, since staying in one place makes it harder to dodge a sudden rush of enemies.
Aim to crush foes in sequence where you can, because the game rewards points for taking out enemies.
