Keep your pace steady and avoid rushing every move; short, controlled inputs usually work better than frantic button mashing.
faq: What is the main goal of Rolling Donut?
You guide your hero through waves of chattering dentures, crushing foes and scoring points while avoiding being caught.
What skills does the game test?
The game tests your dexterity, mainly through quick maneuvers and timely jumps during fast-moving waves.

be-like-a-lucky-block.intro: Be like a Lucky Block is a fast running game where bosses chase you down the track. Survive long enough, pick your moments to get caught by the right boss, and you may unlock rare transformations.
tips: Spend your early upgrades on speed first, since a faster Lucky Block gives you more room to dodge and keep your run going.
Pay attention to which boss is closing in on you and avoid the weaker ones when you have the option to steer away.
Do not rush into a catch. Stay in the run long enough to reach the stronger bosses, because they offer the better outcomes.
Watch your timing closely, since each run is a balance between taking risks and staying safe from early defeat.
Keep practicing the quick decisions needed to dodge danger, as the flow of the chase becomes easier to read with each attempt.
faq: What is the main goal in Be like a Lucky Block?
Your goal is to avoid weaker bosses, stay in the run long enough to meet stronger ones, and be caught by the right boss to transform your Lucky Block.
Why is getting caught always bad?
Getting caught is not always bad, but getting caught too early ends the run. Being caught by a tougher boss at the right time can lead to a rare and powerful secret form.

real-car-pro-racing.intro: Real Car Pro Racing is a 3D car racing game set in a modern city. You race super-sport cars against AI opponents, and each level gets harder. Finish in the top 3 to unlock the next level.
tips: Keep your eyes ahead on the road so you can spot obstacles early and steer around them before you reach them.
Save nitro for difficult moments, such as when you are boxed in or need a fast pass, rather than using it on open straight stretches.
Use the handbrake (SPACE) before tight corners to help the car turn sharply, and ease off the throttle until the car settles.
Try the camera switch (C) to find the view that gives you the clearest look at the track and nearby opponents.
After each race, check your results and spend any earnings on car upgrades or customization, or buy a new car if your current one is holding you back.
faq: How do I move on to the next level?
You must finish in the top 3 when the race ends. Races get harder as you progress, so consistent finishes matter.
How do I use nitro?
Press N to activate nitro. Use it when you are in a difficult situation during a race, such as when you need to catch up or get out of a tight spot.

hit-em-up.intro: Hit Em Up is a puzzle-arcade shooter where you play a soldier clearing zombie-infested levels with explosive shots. Each level rewards careful aiming and efficient use of your shots.
tips: Plan each shot before you fire, since the game asks you to conserve shots and a wasted shot can make a level harder to finish.
Look for ways to use the surroundings, because the description highlights manipulating the environment to reach zombies you could not hit directly.
Use explosions to hit several zombies at once where possible, as clustered targets give you the most value from each shot.
Take a moment to study a level's layout before shooting so you can spot the order that clears the most zombies with the fewest shots.
Aim for high scores by replaying levels once you understand them, focusing on cleaner shots rather than rushing.
faq: What is the goal of Hit Em Up?
Clear each zombie-infested level using explosive shots while aiming to achieve a high score.
How do I get a higher score?
Master your aim, conserve your shots, and use the environment so each shot removes as many zombies as possible.

tennis-open-2024.intro: Tennis Open 2024 is a sports game built around realistic ball physics and tournament-style play. You climb the ranks by timing your shots, placing them precisely, and outthinking adaptive AI opponents.
tips: Focus on timing before power. Well-timed hits tend to matter more than swinging as hard as you can, so watch the ball closely as it approaches.
Use the physics to your advantage. Notice how the ball bounces and moves, and aim for spots that force your opponent to move and recover.
Pay attention to how the AI responds. Because opponents adapt, vary your shot placement instead of repeating the same pattern.
Treat each serve as the start of a point you plan. A consistent serve gives you control, so build your next shot around where the serve sends the ball.
Stay patient during long rallies. Wait for a clear opening rather than forcing a risky shot, especially when the tension rises.
faq: What is the main goal of Tennis Open 2024?
You work your way up the ranks by winning matches against increasingly strong AI opponents. Each win moves you closer to the top.
How do I improve my results in matches?
Focus on timing, precision, and placement rather than only hitting hard. Adjust your strategy based on how the AI opponent is playing.

a-and-b-kids.intro: A & B Kids is an animal-themed game where children tap letters in alphabetical order. It helps practice the ABCs while building reflexes and hand-eye coordination.
tips: Go through the alphabet in order from A, since the game asks you to tap letters in sequence.
Scan ahead for the next letter before you tap, so your hand is already moving toward it.
Keep a steady, relaxed rhythm instead of rushing, which helps your tapping stay accurate.
Play in short sessions and come back regularly, since the challenges build up gradually.
If a letter is hard to remember, say it out loud as you tap it to reinforce the sound.
faq: What is the main goal of A & B Kids?
The goal is to tap the letters in order while learning the ABCs. Each correct tap helps you move through the alphabet.
How do I control the game?
You play by tapping the letters on the screen. Tap them in the correct alphabetical order.

biozombie-outbreak.intro: Biozombie Outbreak is a 3D shooter where you fight off waves of zombies on city streets with several weapons. Your goal is to shoot every incoming zombie and survive until the timer runs out.
tips: Switch weapons with the mouse wheel to match the threat, using a faster weapon for close zombies and a stronger option for tougher targets.
Keep moving with WASD and use Space to jump, so you are not standing still while zombies close in from several directions.
Use right mouse button to aim when zombies are further away, then release it to move quickly when they get close.
Reload with R during a lull rather than in the middle of a crowd, since an empty magazine at the wrong moment can cost you a survival window.
Save the grenade with G for groups of zombies bunched together, where one throw can clear more than one target.
faq: What is the main goal in Biozombie Outbreak?
You need to shoot all the incoming zombies and survive before the time runs out.
How do I shoot and aim?
Left mouse button fires your weapon and right mouse button aims. Combine the two to hit targets more accurately.

nut-sort-build-the-city.intro: Nut Sort: Build the City is a color-sorting puzzle where you move nuts between bolts until each bolt holds only one color. Finished levels earn nuts that you spend on building houses and parks in your city.
tips: Look at the top nut on every bolt before moving anything, and plan a short sequence of moves rather than reacting to the first option you see.
Empty bolts are your most valuable space, so avoid filling one with a mixed stack unless it clears a color underneath.
Try to free up a bolt that holds a single color first, since it gives you a place to collect matching nuts.
If a level stalls, use the hint to view the solution or add an extra bolt, and then keep going rather than pushing through a dead end.
Bonus levels arrive after every five regular levels, so a short break between sets can help you come back with a fresh view of the bolts.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You need to sort all the nuts so that every bolt holds nuts of only one color. The level is complete once that is true.
Which nut can I move?
You can only move the topmost nut from a bolt. It can go onto a nut of the same color or onto an empty bolt.

runner-soldiers.intro: Runner Soldiers is an arcade runner where you lead a growing army through obstacle courses and tactical battles. It mixes fast action with strategic choices.
tips: Keep your army together where you can, since a larger force gives you more room to absorb mistakes in obstacle courses.
Before each section, look ahead at the path and decide which route keeps your forces strongest for the battle that follows.
Prioritize ways to multiply your forces early, because a bigger army makes the tougher foes later in the run easier to handle.
Try the different game modes and challenges to learn how each one rewards precision and timing.
Stay focused and move steadily rather than rushing, since precision is central to lasting through the harder courses.
faq: What is the goal of Runner Soldiers?
Lead your army through obstacle courses and tactical battles, and aim for victory against formidable foes.
How do I grow my army?
The game is built around multiplying your forces, so look for ways to increase your army as you move through each course.

moto-maniac-3.intro: Moto Maniac 3 is a tilting trial bike game set in a forest. You race over trees and rocks as fast as you can while a bear chases you after the loud engine noise.
tips: Use the tilt controls to keep your front wheel up on steep climbs, since a bike that tips too far can stall or flip.
Balance your throttle with your tilt: moving forward too fast on rough ground can make you lose control, so ease off before big rocks or tree roots.
Keep an eye on the bear's distance and avoid stopping to correct a bad tilt when it is close behind you.
Learn the layout of each obstacle on your first run, then attempt it faster on the next try, as speed is the main goal.
Use the pause key (P) to reset your focus if a section is frustrating, then return with a clear plan for the next obstacle.
faq: What is the main goal of Moto Maniac 3?
Your main goal is to get past all the obstacles as quickly as you can. You also need to avoid being caught by the bear that is chasing you.
Which keys control the bike?
Use Up or W and Down or S to drive forward and backward. Use Left or A and Right or D to tilt the bike left and right, and P to pause.

bumper-car-demolition-race.intro: Bumper Car Demolition Race is an arcade-style racing game set in pixelated arenas. You crash into opponents to knock them out, collect treasure chests for items, and work your way toward the championship.
tips: Start with Arena Mode to get a feel for how your car moves and how the arena is laid out before you try a custom setup.
Keep an eye on where opponents are heading and aim your hits so you knock them out rather than just bumping them.
Grab treasure chests when they are close to your path, since the items inside can boost your damage or freeze opponents.
Avoid driving in open space near rivals for long stretches, because a sudden collision can send you out of position.
Use your items at the right moment, such as when a group of opponents is bunched together or when you need to stop a chaser.
faq: What is the main goal of Bumper Car Demolition Race?
Your goal is to crash into opponents, knock them out, and defeat them to compete for the championship.
How do I control my car?
You play with a mouse click or a tap, so click or tap to steer and move your car around the arena.

jelly-gobble.intro: Jelly Gobble is a mouse-controlled arcade game where you play a little jelly that grows by eating smaller food and rival jellies. Your aim is to become the biggest jelly before the timer runs out.
tips: Only gobble things smaller than you. Anything bigger can end your growth, so check sizes before you move in.
Start with small snacks like candies and cones to grow quickly, then move up to bikes, cars and buses as you get bigger.
Watch the colour craving. Following it earns double points, so it is worth steering toward that colour when you can.
Use the spit goo on a rival when it is close to you. A stunned rival cannot defend its lunch, so you can steal its food.
Spend coins between rounds on upgrades and new flavours. Choose upgrades that match how you like to play, such as growing faster or defending yourself.
faq: How do I grow in Jelly Gobble?
Move into anything smaller than your jelly to gobble it. Every bite makes you bigger and unlocks larger food to eat.
How do I stun a rival?
Press Space or use the spit button to launch a blob of goo at a rival. A stunned rival lets you steal its lunch.

star-wing.intro: Star Wing is a retro space shooter where you pilot a lone spaceship against growing alien swarms. Collect items to upgrade or change your weapons as the enemies get tougher.
tips: Pick up weapon and upgrade items whenever it is safe to do so, since your firepower is what keeps the swarms under control.
Watch the enemy patterns early in each stage so you know where the waves will come from and can position your ship before they arrive.
Stay toward the middle or open areas of the screen rather than cornering yourself, which leaves you room to dodge when enemies close in.
Switch to a different weapon when the current one struggles against a particular enemy type, rather than sticking with one option.
Be careful in the hazardous environments, as they add pressure on top of the enemy fire, so keep some attention on the terrain as well as the swarms.
faq: What is the goal of Star Wing?
You pilot a lone spaceship to protect Earth and save the Universe from alien swarms. The game gets harder as enemies grow in number.
How do I get stronger in Star Wing?
Collect items during play to upgrade your spacecraft or change your weapons. Upgrades help you unleash more firepower against larger enemy waves.

mine-tycoon.intro: Mine Tycoon is an arcade digging game where you mine blocks, sell loot to villagers and upgrade your tools and mine. Dig deeper to reach new ores and eventually unlock new worlds.
tips: Match your tool to the block you are digging, since the right tool breaks blocks faster. Check your forge options before heading into a harder layer.
Keep your digging going without long pauses so your combos build and each block brings in more loot.
Fill your bag, then head to the market to sell in batches. Check the villagers' orders first, because completing them can be more profitable than selling loot alone.
Hire golems before you step away, since they keep digging while you are offline and you collect their income when you return.
Finish digging out a whole mine to get its reward and a fresh mine with new ores. Use that new mine to push deeper toward the 96-block quarry.
faq: How do I earn emeralds?
Bring the loot from your bag to the market, where villagers buy it for emeralds. Completing their orders can give you extra rewards.
What do iron golems do?
Golems keep digging while you are away from the game. When you come back, you can collect the income they earned.

check-wednesday-phone.intro: Check Wednesday Phone! is a creepy-cute point-and-click horror game set in Wednesday Addams' digital world. You explore her phone and dorm room, read eerie messages, and solve mysteries hidden around Nevermore.
tips: Read every email carefully, since the cryptic messages are what move the story forward and hint at what to look for next.
Keep an eye out for new messages as they appear, because they tell you which mystery to focus on.
Save your coins for the tasks you need to unlock the next mystery rather than spending them on decorations or extras early on.
When exploring the room, click on strange objects one at a time and note any clues they give, since secrets are often tied to them.
When a password puzzle comes up, look for clues in the emails and objects you have already found before guessing.
faq: How do I start the game?
Tap Wednesday's phone on the screen to begin. The first messages and tasks appear from there.
How do I earn coins?
You earn coins by completing the tasks and mini-games in the game. You need coins to unlock the next mystery.

obunga-nextbot-spot-difference.intro: Obunga Nextbot Spot Difference is a brain game where you compare two images and find the subtle differences between them. Each level tests your observation and how quickly you can react.
tips: Scan both images in the same order, such as top to bottom or left to right, so you do not miss a difference in one corner.
Start with the large, obvious shapes like characters, objects, and backgrounds before checking small details like colors, patterns, or tiny items.
Compare one area at a time instead of jumping around, which helps you notice changes that are easy to overlook.
Balance speed with care: if you rush, you may mark the wrong spot, so slow down a little when you feel stuck.
If you are stuck, look away briefly and return with fresh eyes, since a short break often makes the difference easier to spot.
faq: What is the goal of Obunga Nextbot Spot Difference?
Your goal is to examine two images and identify the subtle differences between them on each level.
How is scoring handled in this game?
The game rewards players who spot differences carefully but swiftly, so accuracy and speed both help you score high.

bowling-hero-multiplayer.intro: Bowling Hero Multiplayer is a bowling game where you compete with friends or global players. You pick from six heroes and aim to knock down every pin before your opponents.
tips: Focus on consistent swipes rather than hard ones, since a clean, repeatable motion makes your strikes more predictable.
Pay attention to where the remaining pins are standing after each throw and adjust your next shot to target them.
Try different heroes to see which play style fits you best, then stick with that hero for a few rounds to learn its feel.
Think about each shot strategically instead of throwing the same way every time, especially when a lane or pin setup changes.
Play a few matches against friends first to get comfortable with the swipe timing before taking on global players.
faq: How do I play Bowling Hero Multiplayer?
You launch the ball by making precise swipes and aim to knock down every pin in each frame. The goal is to claim victory over your opponents.
Can I play against other people?
Yes, you can compete with friends or challenge global players in multiplayer matches.

repeat-pixel-arts.intro: Repeat Pixel Arts is a puzzle where you copy a pixel drawing from the reference canvas onto the game board. Each level has its own colors and pixel layout, so careful comparison is the key to finishing.
tips: Before you start, study the reference canvas and note which colors appear most often so you can pick them quickly.
Work one color at a time: select a color, then fill every matching pixel on the board before switching to the next.
Compare the board to the reference row by row or column by column to avoid skipping pixels.
Check the colors you have already placed against the reference now and then, so small mistakes don't build up.
Keep your attention on the pixel arrangement, not just the overall look, since levels differ in both color and layout.
faq: What is the goal of Repeat Pixel Arts?
Your goal is to reproduce the pixel pattern shown on the adjacent canvas on the game board. You finish the level once the drawing is fully repeated.
How do I change the color of a pixel?
Select the color you want from the palette, then click the pixel on the game board that you want to change.

truck-simulation.intro: Truck Simulation puts you behind the wheel of a worn-out truck and lets you build up to owning a large trucking company. Drive long routes across a big open world and get used to its realistic handling.
tips: Take the first few minutes slowly to learn how the truck responds to W-A-S-D before picking up speed on longer roads.
Use the handbrake on Space sparingly, mainly to slow a turn or stop cleanly, since braking too hard can upset the truck.
Switch camera views with C often so you can check your surroundings, especially when reversing or merging.
Use the gear keys T and G to match your speed to the road, keeping the engine in a comfortable range when climbing hills or slowing down.
Tap the horn on H when traffic gets close to warn other drivers, and pause with Esc if you need a moment to plan your next route.
faq: How do I control the truck?
Use W, A, S and D to drive, and move the mouse to look around. Space applies the handbrake.
How do I change gears?
Press T to shift up a gear and G to shift down. Shifting at the right moment helps the truck handle more smoothly.

call-of-ops-3-zombies.intro: Call of Ops 3 Zombies is a 3D shooter where you survive rounds by eliminating a set number of zombies. Clearing each round earns you new weapons across three detailed maps.
tips: Keep moving with WASD so zombies cannot line up on you from one direction, and use Space to jump when you need to reposition quickly.
Use RMB to aim for steadier, more accurate shots, especially when zombies are still at a distance.
Save bullet time with T for tough moments, such as when a crowd closes in or you need precise headshots.
Reload with R during quieter moments rather than mid-fight, so you are not caught with an empty weapon.
Switch weapons with the mouse wheel to match the situation, and keep an eye on which guns you unlock as each round is cleared.
faq: What is the goal of Call of Ops 3 Zombies?
Your mission is to shoot the required number of zombies in each round to survive and move on. Clearing rounds rewards you with new weapons.
How do I shoot and aim?
Use the left mouse button to shoot and the right mouse button to aim. Aiming helps you hit targets more reliably at range.

hospital-doctor.intro: Hospital Doctor puts you in charge of a busy hospital, where you treat a range of patients in kid-friendly medical scenarios. Work through each case carefully as you unlock harder levels.
tips: Keep an eye on the clock from the start, since managing time is a core part of the game. Plan which patient to see first before rushing into treatment.
Learn each medical tool by using it early in a level, so you are not searching for the right one when patients are waiting.
Look closely at each patient's case before acting. Noticing small details can help you pick the right treatment.
Replay earlier levels if a case feels tricky, so you are better prepared when the cases get harder.
Stay calm when several patients need help at once, and focus on one at a time instead of switching back and forth.
faq: What is the goal of Hospital Doctor?
Your goal is to treat patients in a busy hospital, manage your time well, and unlock new levels with more challenging cases.
How do I keep up when the hospital gets busy?
Manage your time by working through patients in an order that makes sense, and avoid leaving one case half finished while you start another.

tidy-bot.intro: Tidy Bot is a relaxing 3D cleaning game where you steer a small robot vacuum through cosy rooms. Clean up every speck of dirt, collect coins, and return to the dock before the battery runs out.
tips: Plan a route that covers the whole room before you head back, so you don't have to double back when the battery is low.
Grab coins on the way past them rather than making detours, since coins are what you use for upgrades.
Spend your first coins on battery upgrades if you find yourself running low before finishing a room.
Try Easy difficulty first to learn how the robot turns and how much battery a room takes, then move up to Medium or Hard.
Use the pause key when you need a moment to look at the layout and plan your next path.
faq: What is the goal of Tidy Bot?
Clean up all the dirt in each room, collect coins, and get back to the dock before the battery runs out.
How do I move the robot?
Drag with your mouse or finger to drive it, or use WASD, the arrow keys, or ZQSD on the keyboard.

football-rumble.intro: Football Rumble is a fast-paced soccer game where you lead your team on the pitch under the pressure of a clock. Quick decisions and strategy are key to outmaneuvering opponents.
tips: Keep an eye on the clock from the start, since the game puts pressure on you to act before time runs out.
Think one or two moves ahead rather than reacting only to the ball, so you can outmaneuver defenders.
Make quick decisions in each moment on the pitch, but avoid rushing when a slower, planned move is more likely to work.
Watch how opponents position themselves and look for gaps they leave open.
Pay attention to what is happening during the first few minutes so you can adjust your approach before the match gets tighter.
faq: What is the goal of Football Rumble?
Your goal is to lead your team to victory in a fast-paced soccer match while playing under the pressure of the clock. Outmaneuvering opponents and dominating the game are how you get there.
Does the game rely more on speed or strategy?
The game asks for both, since each moment on the pitch needs quick thinking and strategic moves. Balancing fast reactions with planned play is the best way to approach it.

figure-skating-on-ice.intro: Figure Skating: On Ice! is a relaxed sports game about dressing up and posing a skater through pirouettes. You control the skater's pose by moving a cursor along a color scale.
tips: Move the cursor slowly up and down the scale rather than jumping between positions, so you can see how each pose changes before you pick one.
Before you click, decide which color you want to land on, then move toward it in small steps to avoid overshooting.
Pay attention to where the cursor sits on the scale, since the skater's pose depends on that position. Try a few spots to learn which poses match which parts of the scale.
Take short breaks between sessions if you find the pace too slow or repetitive, since the game is designed to be calm and meditative.
Experiment with different outfits and cavaliers before you settle on a look, so you can compare how each one suits the routine.
faq: How do I control the skater?
Hold the left mouse button or tap the screen, then move the cursor up or down the scale. The skater changes pose based on where the cursor sits.
What is the goal of the game?
The game is about creating a beautiful figure skating routine by choosing poses and colors. Focus on making each move look smooth and deliberate.

the-elevator-clicker.intro: The Elevator Clicker is a clicker game where you help Mr. D. through a comical elevator trip. You tap strategically, race the clock, and spend upgrades to click faster.
tips: Think about timing from the start, since the game is a race against time and every early tap counts.
Spend upgrades on what boosts your clicking first, because faster tapping gives you more progress for the same effort.
Pace your taps rather than clicking as fast as you can at all times, so you keep up your speed for the whole run.
Check your progress often and adjust your plan if you are falling behind the clock.
Play a few rounds to learn how the upgrades change your results, then aim for a cleaner finish each time.
faq: What is the goal of The Elevator Clicker?
Your goal is to guide Mr. D. through his elevator escapade and reach a definitive conclusion before time runs out.
How do I get better at this game?
Focus on strategic tapping and choose upgrades that improve your clicking, then replay to refine your timing.

temple-runner.intro: Temple Runner is an arcade game where you play an explorer running through ruined temples. Collect gold, dodge obstacles, and pick up power-ups to keep going.
tips: Keep an eye on what is coming up ahead, not just what is directly in front of you, so you have time to react to obstacles.
Use the arrow keys early rather than at the last second, since a late move is the most common way to crash.
Grab gold when it sits on your safe path, but do not chase it into danger, because a crash ends the run.
Save your attention for power-ups when they appear, and remember they are there to help you get further.
Play a few short runs to learn the layout of the temples and the timing of the obstacles before aiming for a long run.
faq: What is the goal of Temple Runner?
Run through the ruined temples, avoid obstacles, and collect as much gold as you can while going as far as possible.
How do I move my explorer?
Use the arrow keys to move.

island-mayhem-tiki-blast-3d.intro: Island Mayhem: Tiki Blast 3D is a physics puzzle where you aim and fire a cannon to knock down towers, forts and walls on tropical islands. Each shot changes how the structures fall, so planning before you fire matters.
tips: Before you fire, look at how the blocks, barrels and tikis are connected. Target the support piece that holds the most weight, since one well-placed hit can bring down the whole structure.
Use small power changes to test your aim. Shorter and longer shots land in very different places, so adjust the POWER bar a little at a time.

Pay attention to the special features of each island, such as slippery ice, moving platforms, wind and low gravity. These change how objects move, so a shot that worked on one island may miss on another.
Try a few different cannonballs on tough layouts. Switch using the buttons at the bottom of the screen to see which one suits the structure in front of you.
Prepare for the giant tiki boss at the end of each island by saving a flexible cannonball if you can. Being able to adapt your shot helps when the first attempt does not go as planned.
faq: How do I aim the cannon?
On desktop, drag left or right on the island to aim. On touch controls, use the same left or right drag gesture.
How does the power bar work?
Slide the POWER bar on the right up for longer shots and down for shorter ones. Set it before you click or tap FIRE.

wood-color-block.intro: Wood Color Block is a puzzle game where you slide colorful wooden blocks into matching color crushers to break them before time runs out. Each level adds new arrangements and more challenge.
tips: Before you slide anything, check which crusher matches each color block and plan a route that clears the path to it.
Think about how each move affects the blocks around it, since a block you move can end up in the way of another one.
Keep an eye on the timer and clear the blocks that are blocking the most others early, rather than leaving them for last.
Save new boosters and power-ups for the harder puzzles where you are truly stuck, so they make the biggest difference.
If a level stalls, step back and look at the whole arrangement again, then try a different order of moves.
faq: What is the goal of Wood Color Block?
Your goal is to break all the color blocks by getting each one into the matching color crusher.
How do I move the blocks?
You slide, move, and align the color blocks, and each action should be planned carefully because it affects the rest of the board.

defend-military-base.intro: Defend Military Base is a war game where you stop enemy tanks before they break through your defenses. Tap to aim, time your shots carefully, and use bonuses wisely.
tips: Watch which tank is closest to breaching your defenses and prioritize it, since letting one through is the main way to lose ground.
Take a moment to line up each shot. The game rewards precision, so a careful tap usually beats a rushed one.
Pay attention to how your ball chains build up, and try to keep them going rather than letting them break off early.
Save powerful bonuses for tough moments, such as when several tanks are approaching at once, instead of using them on easy targets.
Treat every shot as important. Think about where the tanks are heading before you fire, because wasted shots make survival harder.
faq: What is the main goal of Defend Military Base?
Your goal is to destroy enemy tanks before they breach your defenses. Staying ahead of the tanks is how you survive.
How do I control the game?
The game uses intuitive tap controls. Tap to aim and fire, focusing on precision rather than speed.

world-war-zombie.intro: World War Zombie is a shooting game where you defend humanity against waves of zombies. Aim carefully, use helpful items, and save your ammo to stay in the fight.
tips: Take your time before each shot, since the game rewards precise aiming more than rapid firing.
Save your ammo for dangerous targets and avoid spraying shots at zombies that are far away.
Pick up and use the useful items you find, because they can help you clear zombies without spending extra ammo.
Think a step ahead about which zombie is closest to you and which one you can deal with later.
Keep an eye on your remaining ammo so you are not caught empty when a crowd arrives.
faq: How do I start World War Zombie?
Click or touch the screen to begin playing. The game is controlled with a single click or tap.
What is the main skill needed to do well?
Precise shooting is the core skill, so aim carefully rather than firing as fast as you can. Playing smart with your ammo and items matters as much as accuracy.

duck-you.intro: Duck You is a tap-based arcade game about launching ducks onto a moving track. You time each tap to find gaps and keep the flow going without crashes.
tips: Watch the moving track for a few seconds before you tap, so you can spot where the gaps will open.
Tap on the timing rather than rapidly, since every tap counts and a bad launch can cause a crash.
Follow the on-screen hints, as they point you toward the gaps and tricky moves you need to master.
Keep the ducks moving steadily; a slow pace can make it harder to fit the next duck in the right place.
Expect the challenge to get crazier, so stay calm and focus on one duck at a time when things speed up.
faq: What is the main goal of Duck You?
Launch ducks onto the moving track, find the perfect gaps, and keep them flowing without crashing. The longer you avoid crashes, the more the challenge grows.
How do I control the ducks?
You control the game with taps. Tap to launch each duck onto the track at the right moment.

word-string.intro: Word String is a word-linking puzzle where you build a chain from a starting word. Each new word must form a compound word or complete a well-known phrase with the word before it.
tips: Before picking a word, check both options: a compound word with the previous word, and a familiar phrase that uses it. Having two ways to link often helps you find the next step.
Think of compound words that start with your current word, such as the first half of a common two-word term. Then check whether any of those can lead into another good link.
Try saying the pairs out loud, like 'sun' followed by 'flower.' Hearing the combination can make a phrase or compound easier to spot.
If you get stuck, look back a step and try a different link from an earlier word, rather than forcing an unlikely pairing.
Keep your attention on the end of the chain as you go. Choosing words that open up more options can keep the puzzle moving toward completion.
faq: What is the goal of Word String?
The goal is to keep linking words, starting from the first given word, until you complete the full chain.
What counts as a valid next word?
The next word must either form a compound word with the previous word or complete a well-known phrase with it. For example, Sun leads to Flower and then Pot.

box-playground-punch-it.intro: Box Playground Punch It is a 3D boxing game where you use extendable arms and tap-to-strike punches to conquer levels. Ragdoll physics make every hit unpredictable and funny.
tips: Watch how each punch lands before you commit to the next one, since the ragdoll physics can send opponents flying in unexpected directions.
Think about your moves rather than tapping randomly, because the game rewards strategic play over button mashing.
Use your extendable arms to reach targets at different distances, and try different approaches when a level feels stuck.
Spend upgrades on the skills that fit how you like to fight, so your build feels consistent from level to level.
Save your superpowers for tougher moments in a level so they have the most impact.
faq: What is the main goal of Box Playground Punch It?
You conquer levels in a 3D boxing realm by using strategic moves and your extendable arms. The game focuses on landing punches that create chaotic physics-based reactions.
How do I control my character?
You tap to strike. Each tap sends a punch, so timing your taps matters more than tapping quickly.

army-commander.intro: Army Commander is a strategy puzzle where you build and upgrade an army of tanks, bazookas, and planes. Plan ahead to outmaneuver your opponents and win the battle.
tips: Gather a mix of tanks, bazookas, and planes early so you are not relying on only one unit type.
Spend your resources on upgrades for the units you use most, rather than spreading them thinly across the whole army.
Watch for reinforcement drops and think about where they will land before you commit your forces elsewhere.
Look at the enemy's position before each move and aim to overpower their weakest area rather than attacking head on.
If a battle is going badly, pause and reassess the balance of forces instead of sending in more units without a plan.
faq: What is the main goal of Army Commander?
Your goal is to lead your army to victory by using your tanks, bazookas, and planes to overpower your foes. Winning depends on shifting the balance of the war in your favor.
What types of units can I use?
You can gather and command tanks, bazookas, and planes. Upgrading these units makes your force stronger over the course of the game.

egg-escape-tycoon.intro: Egg Escape Tycoon is a blocky multiplayer tycoon game about sneaking into guarded biomes, stealing eggs, and racing them home to your base. Build up pets and coins, then push for bigger multipliers.
tips: Watch the guards before you grab an egg, and pick a route back to your base that keeps you away from them.
Keep an eye on the clock during each run. When night falls, the biomes lock, so plan your last trips before it gets dark.
Get your eggs planted early, since pets earn coins every second and that income keeps the rest of your progress moving.
Spend coins on speed training on the treadmill, because being faster makes escaping with a stolen egg much more likely.
If you play with friends, split roles: one player can distract or scout while another focuses on carrying eggs home.
faq: What is the main goal of Egg Escape Tycoon?
Steal an egg from a biome nest, bring it back to your base before the guards catch you, and use the resulting pets and coins to grow your base.
How do I earn coins?
Plant eggs in your base to hatch pets, and those pets earn coins every second. You can then spend coins in the shops or on treadmill training.

sniper-mission-war.intro: Sniper Mission War puts you in the role of an elite sniper who must complete difficult tasks across stages. Stay hidden, follow the orders, and take careful shots.
tips: Before you take a shot, check where guards are moving and wait for a clear line. Rushing a shot is the most common way to get spotted.
Use right click to aim before you fire with left click, so your first shot counts. Save shots for targets that matter to the mission.
Read the directions at the start of each stage and keep the objective in mind. Knowing what you need to do helps you decide when to move and when to wait.
Move with WASD and use Ctrl to run only when you are clear of enemy sight. Walking quietly is safer when you are close to targets.
Use F to interact with objects you need for the mission, and press Esc to open the menu if you need to pause and plan your next move.
faq: What is the goal of Sniper Mission War?
You play as an elite sniper and must complete tasks in each stage while following the directions. Your job is to finish the mission without being found.
What happens if I am found during a mission?
The game says that being found can make you lose your chance to accomplish the job. Move carefully and watch for enemies to avoid this.

guns-n-glory-zombies.intro: Guns'n'Glory Zombies is a zombie defense game where a squad of four women holds back waves of the undead. You position your team, upgrade their gear, and protect the city.
tips: Place each of your four squad members where they can cover different approaches, so one direction does not get overwhelmed.
Spend upgrades on the gear that matches how your team is fighting, rather than spreading them thinly across everyone.
Try different weapons and tactics early so you learn which combinations handle the zombie hordes best.
Watch where enemies are gathering and reposition your squad before they reach the city's defenses, not after.
Stay patient and hold your ground in tough moments, since defense play rewards steady positioning over rushing.
faq: What is the main goal of Guns'n'Glory Zombies?
Your goal is to protect the city by fending off relentless hordes of zombies with your squad of four women. Defense is the core of the gameplay.
How do I get better at defending against the zombie hordes?
Focus on strategic positioning of your team and smart use of upgrades. Experimenting with the game's diverse weapons and tactics will help you find what works best.

piano-master.intro: Piano Master is a music tile game where you pick a song and tap the tiles at the right moment to play it. Missing a single tile ends your run.
tips: Before you start, pick a song you already know well, so you can anticipate the rhythm of the tiles.
Keep your eyes on the tiles coming down the screen rather than on the tile you just tapped, so you can time your next tap early.
Tap with a steady, consistent rhythm instead of rushing, since a single early or late tap counts as a miss.
Start with a slower or more familiar song to learn the timing, then move on to faster tracks once you feel comfortable.
If you feel your focus slipping, pause for a moment and reset your attention before the next section of the song.
faq: What is the goal of Piano Master?
The goal is to touch all the tiles at the right moment so the song plays through. Missing a tile ends the game.
What controls does Piano Master use?
You play by tapping or clicking on the tiles as they reach the bottom of the screen.

mosquito-bite-3d.intro: Mosquito Bite 3D is a puzzle simulator where you play a buzzing mosquito. You fly through different environments, sneak up on a target, and bite at the right moment.
tips: Watch your target before moving in, and pick the moment when she is least likely to swat at you.
Approach from a direction that keeps you out of her direct line of sight when possible.
Pay attention to which body part you are going for, since the task may call for a head or legs.
Stay alert at all times, because the target can swat at you without warning, so keep some distance between attacks.
Use short, controlled movements with the mouse or tap instead of rushing, which makes it easier to line up your bite.
faq: What is the goal of Mosquito Bite 3D?
Your goal is to find the best moment to sneak up on your target and bite her. Tasks may ask you to attack a human's head or legs.
How do I control the mosquito?
Use mouse click or tap to play. The game is controlled entirely with clicks or taps.

deep-in-the-lab-chapter-1.intro: Deep in the Lab Chapter 1 is a 2D survival horror shooter in an old 90s style. You explore a five-floor lab, solve puzzles, collect keys, and decide whether to avoid or fight the monsters.
tips: Resources are scarce, so avoid fights you don't need to win. Monsters can be avoided, and that often saves ammo and health for harder moments.
Save only when you reach a safe point, since saves are limited and losing progress hurts more than it would in a game with frequent saves.
Before moving on, check each room for keys and puzzle clues. Keys are needed to progress, so backtracking to pick up anything you missed is usually worth it.
Stop and look at the pre-rendered backgrounds carefully. Small details in the scenery often point toward puzzle solutions or hidden items.
Expect jumpscares. Keep your pace steady and don't rush into unexplored corners, because sudden surprises are part of the design.
faq: What is the main goal of Deep in the Lab Chapter 1?
You explore a five-floor lab, solve puzzles, and collect keys while surviving the monsters inside. The game is built around survival horror, with limited resources and saves.
Do I have to fight the monsters?
No. The description says you can choose whether to avoid or defeat the monsters, so you can decide what fits your playstyle.

cartoon-cat-naughty-kitten.intro: Cartoon Cat: Naughty Kitten is a stealth game where you guide a nimble kitten to collect sausages while avoiding robot vacuums, dogs, cars, and the people in the apartments. Each level ends at an exit.
tips: Before you move, look at where the vacuum cleaners and dogs are heading. Wait in a secluded corner until the path is clear.
Use furniture, boxes, and shadows as cover whenever an enemy is close. Staying hidden is safer than running.
Plan your route between sausages so you do not walk into an enemy's line of sight. Grab nearby sausages first and leave the farther ones for when the way is quiet.
When you are in a room with residents, pause and watch their movement before making a prank. Distracting them only works if you stay out of their view.
Keep track of your lives and the exit location while you collect sausages. If you lose a life, reassess the route before trying again.
faq: How do I move the cat on a computer?
Use W, A, S, and D or the arrow keys to move forward, left, back, and right. Press the left or right mouse button to kick.
What is the main goal of each level?
Collect as many sausages as possible, save all your lives, and find the exit. You need to get through enemies and traps to do this.

obby-1-jump-per-click.intro: Obby: +1 Jump per Click is an arcade obby where you build jump power by clicking, then use it to cross giant chasms and parkour tracks. Upgrades, pets, and rebirths help you climb higher over time.
tips: Build your jump power with clicks before you attempt a big gap, since your jump strength depends on how much you have charged.
Use WASD and Space on a computer to line up your jumps precisely, especially when landing on small or moving platforms.
Spend upgrades on the stat that matches your next obstacle: jump strength for wide chasms, height for tall climbs, or flight speed for long distances.
Pay attention to moving platforms, traps, and puzzles on each track so you can time your jumps instead of rushing them.
Use pets for their jump boosts and special abilities, and consider when a rebirth would multiply your power enough to be worth it.
faq: What is the goal of Obby: +1 Jump per Click?
The goal is to climb as high as you can by charging your jump power with clicks and overcoming chasms and parkour challenges. The game describes reaching the maximum height as the main aim.
How do I control my character?
On a computer, use WASD to move and Space to jump. On mobile, use the joystick to move, the button in the lower right corner to jump, and swipe the screen to rotate the camera.

crown-guard.intro: Crown Guard is an action tower defense game where you move your king around the castle, collect gold, and build towers to hold back waves of enemies. Each map is won by surviving five waves.
tips: Stop moving when you want to shoot, since your king fires automatically only while standing still. Plan your moves so you are not wandering through the middle of a fight.
Pick up dropped gold as soon as you can, because gold is what pays for towers and upgrades on the building plots.
Stand still on a marked plot to build or upgrade defenses. Choose spots near the paths enemies use so your towers can cover them.
Keep your royal strike for groups of enemies close to you. Press Space or tap the strike button when several are nearby to get the most from it.
Think carefully about the reward you choose after each wave. Spend the crowns you earn in the pause menu on permanent upgrades that help you in later maps.
faq: What is the goal of Crown Guard?
Your goal is to protect your castle from enemy hordes. Survive five waves on a map to unlock the next one.
How do I move and attack?
Move with WASD, the arrow keys, or by holding and dragging with a mouse or finger. Stop moving and your king shoots automatically, and Space or the strike button hits nearby enemies.

obby-pet-simulator-x.intro: Obby Pet Simulator X is a girls-category obby where you collect unique pets, open eggs to summon rare creatures, break obstacles, and upgrade your skills. It plays in the browser on both computer and mobile.
tips: Learn the jump timing early, since the obby part depends on landing jumps cleanly.
Use Space on the computer or the on-screen buttons on the phone to jump, and keep your movement steady rather than rushing each jump.
Look ahead at obstacles before you reach them so you can decide which ones you can break and which you need to go around.
Keep an eye on your upgrades and spend them on the skills that help you move through the course most easily.
Open eggs when you are ready to see what creature you get, and check your collection regularly to track which pets you still need.
faq: How do I move and jump on a computer?
Use WASD to move, Space to jump, and left mouse button (LMB) to click. Press Esc to go back to the menu.
How do I play on a phone?
Tap the screen to click, and use the joystick and on-screen buttons to move and jump.

call-of-modern-world-war.intro: Call of Modern World War is a 3D first-person shooter where you complete missions by using stealth, surprise, and high-powered weapons against larger enemy forces. Careful planning matters as much as firepower.
tips: Scout before you engage. Take a moment to look at where enemies are and how they are positioned before you move into open ground.
Use the element of surprise. Enemies who have not spotted you are easier to handle, so pick your moments to strike rather than rushing in.
Save your most powerful weapon for threats that matter. Overwhelming numbers mean ammunition and damage can run out quickly if you spend it carelessly.
Adjust your approach when a plan stops working. If an area becomes too crowded, reposition and try a different route instead of pushing forward through the same danger.
Focus on precise shots rather than spraying fire. Aiming carefully helps you conserve resources and stay hidden longer.
faq: What is the main goal in Call of Modern World War?
Your goal is to complete missions and claim victory by outsmarting enemy forces. The game rewards planning and precise action.
How do I deal with large groups of enemies?
Avoid fighting them all at once. Use stealth and surprise to take them on in smaller groups or find a position where you can control the fight.

hill-racing.intro: Hill Racing is a physics-driven racing game where you climb treacherous terrain and balance your vehicle on steep slopes. Collect coins to upgrade your vehicle as you tackle diverse landscapes and obstacles.
tips: Watch the slope ahead before each climb, since the terrain changes often and planning your balance early helps you avoid tipping over.
Pay attention to how your vehicle tilts on hills and ease off when it starts to lean too far, because keeping it stable matters more than speed.
Grab coins when you can do so safely, as they fund vehicle upgrades that can help with later, harder courses.
Treat each new landscape as a fresh test and learn how its obstacles behave before pushing your luck on them.
Use short practice runs on unfamiliar terrain to get a feel for the physics, then apply what you learned to longer races.
faq: What is the main goal in Hill Racing?
Your goal is to get through each race across hilly, uneven terrain while keeping your vehicle balanced. The game rewards careful driving on steep slopes.
What are coins used for?
Coins let you upgrade your vehicle. Collecting them while you race can help you prepare for tougher terrains and obstacles.

one2one.intro: One2One is a speed and focus game where you tap numbers or letters on a grid in order as fast as you can. Your completion time is shown when you finish, so each round gives you a score to beat.
tips: Scan the whole grid for the next target before you tap, so your eyes are already moving to the following number or letter.
Pick a smaller grid while you learn the layout, then move up to bigger grids once your taps are consistently correct.
Try both the numbers and letters modes, since switching between them can help you stay alert to different symbols.
Keep your taps steady rather than rushed, because a wrong tap flashes red and costs you time.
Practice in short sessions and compare your completion times day to day to see your progress.
faq: What is the goal of One2One?
The goal is to tap the tiles in ascending order, such as 1 to 2 to 3 or A to B to C, as quickly as possible. The timer stops when you tap the last tile.
What happens when I tap a wrong tile?
A wrong tap flashes red. Correct taps turn green and stay locked in place.

happy-gunman.intro: Happy Gunman is a 3D shooting arcade game where you stay alive by hitting pursuers, including dinosaurs, with accurate shots. Control is simple: click or tap to play.
tips: Aim before you fire, since accurate shots are what keep you alive against the pursuers.
Watch which enemy is closest and deal with that threat first before it reaches you.
Keep track of the dinosaurs, which are part of the chase, and plan your shots around their approach.
Use short, deliberate clicks or taps rather than rapid fire so each shot counts.
Stay calm and keep your eyes moving, since the pursuit comes from more than one direction.
faq: What is the goal of Happy Gunman?
Survive the pursuit by taking accurate shots at the forces and dinosaurs chasing you.
How do I control the game?
Use a mouse click or a tap to play, which is the only input the game lists.

igi-commando-mission-cover-the-fire.intro: You play as a lone commando moving through diverse missions and 3D environments. Success depends on stealth, precise shooting, and choosing the right loadout for each situation.
tips: Before each mission, look at your loadout and think about what you will need most, since the game asks you to master it for success.
Try to avoid being spotted early. Stealth and precision are central to the game, so slow, careful movement often works better than charging in.
Use the terrain and cover in each 3D environment to plan your approach before you engage enemy forces.
Stay tactically flexible. If a plan starts to fail, change your position or method instead of pushing forward in the same way.
Keep your reflexes sharp during firefights, because the game rewards quick reactions when enemies appear suddenly.
faq: What is the main goal of IGI Commando Mission: Cover the Fire?
You play as a lone commando completing diverse missions by using stealth, precision, and tactical planning to overcome enemy forces.
Does the game reward stealth or direct combat?
The description emphasizes stealth and precision, so a careful approach that avoids unnecessary fights is usually the stronger strategy.

soccer-rebound.intro: Soccer Rebound mixes football with a pinball table. You work two flippers in front of your goal while your toy teammates chase, pass, and shoot on their own.
tips: Keep your flippers near your goal, since the ball is most dangerous when it gets close to your net.
Use the side rails to bank the ball around the keeper instead of aiming straight at the goal.
Flip the ball toward your playmaker when they are open, so they can take a first-time finish.
From stage 4, save the Bend Shot for when a defender blocks the direct path, and curl your next flip around them.
Watch where your teammates are running before you flip, so you send the ball to a player who can use it.
faq: What is the goal of Soccer Rebound?
Keep the ball out of your own net while using your flippers to set up attacks on the opponent's goal.
How do I use the Bend Shot?
From stage 4, press Up Arrow, W, or Space, then flip with the left or right flipper to curl the ball around a defender.

tiny-chick.intro: Tiny Chick is an endless runner where you guide a baby chick through obstacles by timing its jumps. The goal is to keep going and build a high score while you customize your chick's look.
tips: Watch the gaps ahead rather than the chick itself, so you can start each jump early enough to clear the next obstacle.
Focus on rhythm. Steady, evenly timed jumps tend to hold up better than rushed ones over a long run.
Try to recover calmly after a near miss instead of overcorrecting, since staying composed keeps the run going.
Play in short sessions at first to learn how the timing feels, then aim to beat your previous score bit by bit.
faq: What is the main goal in Tiny Chick?
Your goal is to launch your chick over obstacles and navigate the gaps to keep a continuous run going and reach high scores.
How do I get a higher score?
Keep the chick moving through obstacles without stopping, since the game rewards continuous progress through the gaps.

mahjong-3d-match.intro: Mahjong 3D Match is a puzzle game where you collect sets of identical 3D tiles before the timer runs out. Plan ahead, rotate the board to see hidden pieces, and clear levels that get harder as you go.
tips: Rotate the board to view it from different angles before you tap, so you can spot matching pieces that are partly hidden.
Look for pieces that are already easy to reach and collect them first, so the buried tiles are freed up for later.
Keep an eye on the timer and try to clear the board quickly, since faster clears earn more stars and coins.
Save your shuffling and extra time aids for levels where you are stuck, rather than using them at the start.
Check the daily events and the shop's skills as you progress, since they can help with the harder levels.
faq: What is the goal of Mahjong 3D Match?
Tap three identical pieces to collect them before time runs out. Keep collecting sets until the board is clear.
How do I earn more stars and coins?
Clear the board quickly. Faster clears earn more stars and coins.

football-io.intro: Football.io is a fast-paced io sports game where you compete against three other players. Your goal is to eliminate them and be the last one standing.
tips: Move with the mouse or arrow keys, whichever feels more precise to you, and stick with it so your movements become consistent.
Keep an eye on all three opponents at once rather than chasing only one, so you know who is closest to you at any moment.
Stay near the edges of the field only when you need to; open space gives you more room to dodge and change direction.
Watch where opponents are heading and try to position yourself so they come to you instead of you running into them.
Stay on the move rather than standing still, since a player who waits in one spot is easier to corner.
faq: What is the goal of Football.io?
You compete against three other players and try to eliminate them. The last player remaining wins the round.
What controls does Football.io use?
You can play with the mouse or the arrow keys. Choose whichever gives you better control and keep using it.

line-of-defense.intro: Line of Defense: Tanks mixes shooting and puzzle play. You match your shell colors to incoming tanks, and a mismatch means instant defeat. Quick reactions keep your defense standing.
tips: Watch the color of each incoming tank before you fire, since a wrong shell color ends the game instantly.
Check the next tank as soon as one is handled so you are ready for the color change rather than reacting late.
Keep the purple bomb for emergencies. Use it when you feel overwhelmed, because it clears the battlefield.
Stay calm and look ahead across the whole line of tanks instead of focusing only on the closest one.
Practice reading the colors quickly. Speed and accuracy both matter in this game.
faq: What is the main goal of Line of Defense: Tanks?
Defend your line by firing shells that match the color of each incoming tank. Keep matching colors to stay in the fight.
What happens if I fire the wrong color?
A mismatch leads to instant defeat, so checking the color before every shot is important.

thief-puzzle.intro: Thief Puzzle is a puzzle game where each level calls for careful planning. You work through cleverly designed spaces and get past security systems by swiping your way to the goal.
tips: Study the whole layout before you move, and look for security systems and routes that could block you.
Think a few steps ahead, since a move that looks fine now may leave you stuck later.
Try a swipe, watch what happens, and adjust your plan rather than repeating the same move.
Keep your swipes deliberate, because the game rewards precision as much as quick thinking.
If a level stops making progress, step back, reconsider the environment from a fresh angle, and test a different approach.
faq: What is the goal of Thief Puzzle?
Each level asks you to outsmart the security systems and escape like a master thief. Your aim is to find a route through the puzzle that gets you out.
How do I control the game?
You play by swiping. Use swipes deliberately so each move does what you intend.

flip-master.intro: Flip Master is an acrobatics and parkour game where you perform tricks, flips, and jumps over obstacles. This guide covers practical habits to help you land cleanly and progress.
tips: Focus on landing before you start a big flip. A clean landing matters more than a complicated trick, so plan your rotation around where you need to touch down.
Use short, controlled taps or clicks when you are learning the jumps. Once you know how far your character travels, you can time longer flips more reliably.
Watch the obstacle ahead before you jump. Note its height and distance so you can decide how much air time you need.
Upgrade the skills you use most often. Focusing on the moves that help your current route keeps your progress steady.
When you reach a new location, spend a few attempts learning how its obstacles change your timing. Each place may need a slightly different approach.
faq: What is the main goal in Flip Master?
Your goal is to perform acrobatic tricks and flips, conquer obstacles, and land each jump cleanly. Improving your technique over time is central to the game.
How do I control my character?
Use mouse clicks or taps to play. Timing your input determines how your character moves through the air and how it lands.

rogue-runner.intro: Rogue Runner is an action driving game where you play a wanted fugitive trying to escape an growing police force through busy city streets. Each click or tap helps you stay ahead of the chase.
tips: Think before each risky move, since smashed barriers and near-misses make the pursuit more intense.
Use the surrounding city and its traffic to your advantage rather than driving in a straight line.
Keep an eye out for spike strips and tactical units, which signal that the pursuit is escalating.
Stay calm and plan your route early, because survival time is the main measure of how well you are doing.
Try a few short runs to learn how quickly the police and SWAT teams build up before pushing your luck.
faq: What is the goal of Rogue Runner?
Your goal is to escape the police and survive as long as possible while the pursuit grows around you.
How do I control the car?
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps, so use those inputs to drive and react during the chase.

obby-battle-arena.intro: Obby: Battle Arena is a third-person shooter with several game modes, maps, and guns to try. This guide covers the PC controls and some habits that help you in battles.
tips: Hide your weapon with F when you need to cover ground quickly, since it increases movement speed. Bring it back out before you expect a fight.
Use Shift for fast running only when no enemies are near, because it hides your weapon and you cannot shoot while it is hidden.
Reload with R during quiet moments rather than in the middle of a firefight, so you are not left empty when a target appears.
Switch between your guns with keys 1 to 4 to find the one that suits your playstyle, then keep it ready for the situations you face most.
Hold RMB to aim before you shoot at distant targets, and check the Tab leaderboard now and then to see how you are doing against other players.
faq: What do the WASD keys do?
WASD moves your character around the arena. Use them together with the mouse to position yourself before you shoot.
How do I shoot and aim?
Left mouse button fires your weapon and right mouse button aims. Aiming first makes it easier to hit targets at a distance.

sniper-shooter-save-the-fish.intro: Sniper Shooter-Save The Fish is a physics-based bubble shooter where you aim and launch bubbles at a rotating hexagonal structure. Clear bubbles and complete each level's objective while the structure changes angle and motion around you.
tips: Watch the hexagon for a moment before you fire, since its rotation changes where your bubbles will travel.
Aim for impacts that set the structure turning in a direction that helps you, because one hit can change how other bubbles behave.
Use timing as well as angle: a shot that looks right when the structure is in one position may miss once it has rotated.
Pay attention to how bubbles move after they hit, so you can predict which ones will drop or cluster and plan your next shot around them.
Take your time on early levels to learn how rotation and impacts interact, then apply the same habits to the harder setups.
faq: What is the goal of Sniper Shooter-Save The Fish?
Aim and launch bubbles toward the hexagonal structure and clear them to complete each level's objectives.
How do I aim and shoot?
Aim your launcher at the hexagonal structure and fire bubbles toward it, timing your shots with the structure's movement.

fishing-online.intro: Fishing Online is a browser fishing game where you pick a spot, cast your line, and reel in a range of fish. It rewards skill and patience on each trip.
tips: Try a few different spots before settling in, since each one is a separate choice in the game and may suit your style of play.
Be patient after you cast. Waiting for the right moment is central to the game, so avoid reeling in too early.
Pay close attention to the on-screen feedback when a fish is caught, so you can recognize the signs and respond the same way next time.
Stay focused for the whole trip rather than rushing. The game's realistic mechanics reward careful, steady play over quick actions.
faq: What is the goal of Fishing Online?
The goal is to master fishing by choosing a spot, casting your line, and reeling in a variety of fish. The game focuses on skill and patience.
How do I control the line and reel in a fish?
The game does not list specific controls, so check the on-screen prompts after you cast and follow them as they appear.

launch-the-dummy.intro: Launch the Dummy is a physics arcade game where you push a crash test dummy down a hill and launch him through objects to earn cash. Use the cash on upgrades to fly farther and reach the lake at 1500 m.
tips: Spend your early cash on hill and ride upgrades first, since a longer run gives you more distance and more chances to smash objects.
Time your second tap at the ramp carefully, because the launch is the moment that decides how far the dummy flies.
Hold to glide with the wingsuit once you have it, and use the glide to stay in the air long enough to reach targets and boost rings.
Aim for boost rings and fly through them in a row to build combos, since chaining smashes is a good way to keep your flight going.
Try different characters and vehicles as you unlock them, and compare how far each one travels before settling on a setup.
faq: What is the main goal of Launch the Dummy?
Launch the dummy as far as you can and cause as much damage as possible to earn cash. Use that cash to upgrade and reach the lake at 1500 m.
How do I control the dummy?
Tap or click to push off and jump in, then tap or click again at the ramp to launch. Hold the screen or mouse button to glide with the wingsuit.

red-and-blue-snipers.intro: Red and Blue Snipers is a sniper shooter built around precise aiming and tactical thinking across several map types. You move with WASD, shoot with the left mouse button, and aim with the right.
tips: Hold right mouse to aim before you need the shot, so you are not scoping in while an opponent is already firing at you.
Learn each map's sightlines first, then pick positions that cover the openings enemies must cross.
Reload with R when you have a safe moment, not in the middle of a duel, so you always have a round ready.
Watch how opponents move and where they tend to show up, and adjust your position to predict their next move.
Spend the in-game currency on weapons that suit your playstyle, and use the experience from good matches to climb the leaderboard steadily.
faq: What is the main goal of Red and Blue Snipers?
Your goal is to win firefights through precise shooting and tactical positioning, gaining experience and currency that help you rise in the leaderboard.
How do I shoot and aim?
Use the left mouse button to shoot and hold the right mouse button to aim. Move with the WASD keys and press R to reload.

draw-path-to-home.intro: Draw Path to Home is a casual puzzle game where you draw lines to guide your characters safely to the house. It builds logic and creative thinking as you plan each route.
tips: Before you draw, look at the whole screen and find the obstacles and enemies first. Plan a route that keeps the hero well clear of them.
Aim for the shortest safe path, not just any path. The instructions ask for the fastest and safest route, so a quick check of your line before you finish can save a retry.
Start with the simplest route you can see and adjust from there. Trying the obvious option first helps you spot where the hard parts of a level are.
If a level gets stuck, look at it from a different angle. Consider routes that go around an enemy instead of straight through the middle.
Pay attention to the different difficulty levels and take the easier ones first. Working up to harder puzzles lets you practice the drawing and planning before the challenge increases.
faq: How do I start drawing a path?
Click on the character you want to move, and then draw the line that will take them toward the house.
What is the goal of each puzzle?
Your goal is to help the hero reach home by drawing a route while avoiding obstacles and enemies.

war-of-islands-mine-and-craft.intro: War of Islands Mine and Craft is a strategy game where you mine resources, turn them into gold, and grow your military camp. You build barracks, upgrade facilities, and recruit warriors to take on rivals in battle.
tips: Mine resources steadily before spending, since gold comes from exchanging what you mine and you need enough to fund your expansion.
Plan your camp layout early so each barracks and facility you construct supports the army you want to field.
Upgrade facilities alongside recruiting, so your warriors are not left waiting on weaker support buildings.
Recruit a mix of warriors rather than only one type, so your army can handle different rivals in battle.
Check your army's strength before each battle and wait until it is ready, rather than rushing into a fight you may lose.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Your goal is to lead your army to victory by growing your military camp and defeating rivals in battle.
How do I get gold?
You mine resources and exchange them for gold, which you then use to expand your military camp.

mineguy-unblockable.intro: MineGuy: Unblockable is a fast-paced first-person shooter set in a Minecraft-inspired world. You fight AI-controlled mercenaries and zombies, and the controls let you aim, move, crouch, and slow time to help you survive.
tips: Use Left Ctrl to crouch and X to go prone when enemies are shooting at you, so you present a smaller target while you line up your shots.
Hold Mouse 2 to aim before you fire with Mouse 1 when you have time, since careful shots are more reliable than spraying bullets.
Keep moving with W-A-S-D and jump with Space so you are not standing still in one spot where enemies can focus on you.
Save the T slow-motion ability for busy moments with several enemies nearby, so you can plan your next move before you use it.
Use G for grenades and V for melee attacks when enemies get close or when you run low on ammo, and reload with R during quiet moments.
faq: What is the goal of MineGuy: Unblockable?
The game is a first-person shooter where you battle AI-controlled mercenaries and zombies in a Minecraft-inspired world. Your main focus is staying alive while you fight through these enemies.
How do I use slow motion?
Press T to activate slow motion. It gives you more time to react, so it is most useful when several enemies are attacking at once.

ramp-race.intro: Ramp Race is a high-speed racing game with ramp jumps, sharp turns and unexpected obstacles across many levels. Drive against rivals, customize your car, and climb the leaderboard.
tips: Use Space to stop the car when you need to set up for a sharp turn, then accelerate out with W once the line is clear.
Before taking a ramp, line the car up straight and keep your speed steady so you land in a controlled way.
Scout each level's obstacles on your first attempt, then approach the same spots more carefully on later runs.
If you fall far behind or get stuck, press R to restart the level instead of losing time driving back.
Collect your daily gifts and bonuses, since they are meant to help you progress faster.
faq: What is the goal of Ramp Race?
You race on high-speed tracks against other players and rivals, aiming to finish first and climb the leaderboard.
What do the controls do?
WASD drives the car forward, backward, left and right. Space stops the car, R restarts the level, and H returns you to the main menu.

flip-gun-3d-ragdoll-shooter.intro: Flip Gun 3D Ragdoll Shooter is a physics shooter where you tap to fire and watch your gun flip while you knock down ragdoll targets. Each level is cleared by taking down every target within a limited number of shots.
tips: Plan each shot before you tap, since your shots are limited and wasting one can leave a target out of reach.
Look for obstacles you can break, because a well-placed hit on a structure can bring down several targets at once.
Watch how your gun flips after each shot so you can predict where the next shot will land.
Try the different weapons you unlock, since each one gives a different flipping and shooting effect that may suit certain targets better.
If a level seems stuck, step back and look for the layout's weak points rather than repeating the same aim.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You complete a level by knocking down all of the targets before you run out of shots.
How do the controls work?
You tap to shoot, and the gun flips as you aim at the ragdoll targets.

gloom-gargoyle.intro: Gloom: Gargoyle is a 1-player, third-person adventure set across three magical locations. You move through the game's first act, using three auras and exploring two dungeons to find divine artifacts.
tips: Keep an eye on your mana before using the fiery aura, since it draws mana from you while it lights up the area around you.
Use the aura of time when you need to cover ground faster, but remember it is a tool for moving quickly rather than something to leave running constantly.
The aura of magic costs life force to refill your mana, so only use it when your mana is low and you can afford the loss.
Switch between auras as the situation changes instead of holding onto one, since each one solves a different problem.
Explore both magical dungeons carefully, because you need to find the divine artifacts there before you can move forward.
faq: What is the main goal of Gloom: Gargoyle?
You progress through the game by going through two magical dungeons and finding the divine artifacts inside them. The game is the first act of the story and covers three locations.
How do I move and jump?
Use W, A, S and D to move, and hold Shift to walk. Press Space to jump.

ramp-truck-mayhem.intro: Ramp Truck Mayhem is an arcade driving game where you control the monster truck Bandit, launching off wooden ramps and flying across arenas toward the checkered flag. Use the arrow keys to drive and the camera key to find the best view of your jumps.
tips: Build speed before you reach a ramp, since a faster approach usually sends the truck farther through the air.
Use the brake on the way down to keep the landing steady rather than tipping forward or sideways.
Switch camera angles with C during a jump so you can judge the distance to the next ramp or the finish.
Try a few gentle runs at each arena to learn where the ramps sit before you commit to full speed.
Keep an eye on the checkered flag as your main target and steer toward it between jumps.
faq: What is the main goal of Ramp Truck Mayhem?
Drive the Bandit monster truck across the arena, use the ramps to launch and fly, and reach the checkered flag to win.
How do I control the truck?
Use the arrow keys to drive, hold Space to brake, and press C to change the camera angle. Clicking lets you interact with the game.

miss-robins-dream-home.intro: Miss Robins Dream Home is a match 3 puzzle game about renovating houses in sunny places. Solve candy matching levels to unlock the design work, then choose the decor and furniture for each home.
tips: Look for matches that line up several candies at once, since these are the best way to build up power-ups for harder moments.
Save a power-up for a board that looks stuck instead of using it right away, so it can clear more candy when you need it most.
Pay attention to which candy colors are most common on the board and aim your matches there to clear space quickly.
Keep moves short and steady rather than rushing, because the game is designed to be light and relaxed.
Think about how each room's decor and furniture fit together before you place pieces, so the final home looks balanced.
faq: What is the main goal of Miss Robins Dream Home?
Your goal is to solve match 3 puzzles with candy and use the results to design and renovate houses with decor and furniture.
How do I control the game?
Use your mouse to click any button in the game, including selecting candy and moving through menus.

zombie-reform.intro: Zombie Reform is a 3D zombie shooter where you survive waves of zombies that grow stronger with each level. Move through six maps, and defeat the boss battles to unlock the next one.
tips: Keep moving with WASD instead of standing still, since the zombies become stronger as you advance.
Save the Bazooka (U) for the tougher fights, because the FULL BOSS battles are described as extremely powerful.
Press R to reload during quieter moments so you are not caught with an empty weapon when zombies close in.
Use keys 1, 2 and 3 to switch weapons quickly, so you can change to the right one without pausing.
Try right-click to switch camera when you need a clearer view of the zombies around you before you fire.
faq: What is the main goal of Zombie Reform?
You survive zombie attacks, level up, and destroy the FULL BOSS at the end of each stage so you can move on to the next map.
How do I move to the next map?
Maps change every 12 levels, and you must defeat the FULL BOSS battle before each level change to advance.
