kind-shelter-animal-care-and-treatment.intro: Kind Shelter is a relaxed animal-care game where you treat stray pets as a vet, then style them with outfits, accessories and hairstyles. Choose a pet to start and work through each step at your own pace.
tips: Start with the pet's health: follow the on-screen instructions for skin, eyes, ears and claws before moving on to grooming or styling.
Switch tools often using the tool selection so each action matches the area you are treating.
When using a cosmetic tool, tap it first and then drag it slowly over the target area so you can see the result clearly.
Take your time with the sounds and visuals; the game is designed to be calm, so rushing is not needed.
Save dressing and accessories for last, after the pet has been bathed, groomed and treated, so the final look is easy to enjoy.
faq: What is the main goal of Kind Shelter?
You care for stray cats and other pets by examining, healing and grooming them, then dress them up with outfits, accessories and hairstyles.
How do I choose and use tools?
Pick the pet you want to work on first, then tap the screen or use the mouse to select a tool and perform an action.

pop-us.intro: Pop Us lets you pop bubbles and build your own fidget toy from a wide range of colors and shapes. It is a relaxing game for mouse or tap play, with puzzles to solve along the way.
tips: Look at the whole toy before you start popping, so you can plan which parts to merge first.
Pop bubbles in a steady order rather than jumping around, so you don't miss any and have to go back.
Try a few different color and shape combinations to see which ones look best together before you commit.
When a puzzle feels stuck, step back and check which parts are still unmerged, since that is often the missing piece.
Take short breaks between popping sessions if you want a calm, relaxing pace.
faq: What is the goal of Pop Us?
Pop all the bubbles to create a new fidget toy. Along the way you can also merge parts and solve puzzles.
How do I control the game?
Use your mouse or tap the screen to pop bubbles, merge parts, and make your choices.

fishdom.intro: Fishdom is a puzzle game about rescuing fish across an ocean of levels. Along the way you can unlock aquariums, meet adorable fish and pets, and join underwater events.
tips: Make saving the fish your main focus on each level, since that is the goal you are working toward.
Work on unlocking aquariums as you go, because they give you a reason to return to earlier levels when you want a steadier pace.
Keep an eye out for the events, since they add extra fun to the game and are worth checking in on regularly.
Play with calm, deliberate moves using your mouse or touch so you don't rush past a layout you have not fully studied.
If a level feels stuck, step away for a moment and come back with fresh eyes before trying again.
faq: How do I control the game?
You play with the mouse or with touch. Use whichever feels more comfortable for you.
What is the main goal in Fishdom?
Your goal is to save the fish on every level while progressing through the ocean of puzzles.

sokoban-puzzle-game.intro: Sokoban is a one-player puzzle game where you guide a box pusher and move every box onto its target spot. Each move matters, so plan ahead before you push.
tips: Look at the whole board before your first move and note which boxes are closest to their targets.
Avoid pushing a box into a corner or against a wall where it cannot be moved again, since that can make the level unsolvable.
Only push boxes in straight lines, because you cannot pull them back the way you came.
If you get stuck, press the reset option, if the game offers one, and try a different order for the boxes rather than forcing a push.
Play in short sessions and take breaks when your focus drops, which helps you spot routes you missed.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
You win when all the boxes are pushed onto their specified positions.
How do I control the pusher?
Use the four direction buttons, up, down, left and right, to move the box pusher around the board.

knightbit-far-lands.intro: KnightBit: Far Lands is an action game where you fight Vikings across snowy fjords and burning kingdom borders. Win by capturing flags and destroying enemies to score points against the opposing team.
tips: Capture flags as well as fighting, since flags are one of the two listed ways to build your score toward victory.
Use Sprint (Shift) to reach flags and objectives faster, and save it for moving across open ground rather than holding it constantly.
Use Jump (Spacebar) to get over obstacles and reposition during fights rather than standing still in one spot.
Pick up stronger weapons when you find them, since the game rewards rank progress with more powerful weapons.
Level up your rank whenever you can, because higher ranks unlock new skills that can make later battles easier.
faq: How do I win a match?
You win by defeating the opposing team, which means scoring a set number of points. Points come from capturing flags and destroying enemies.
What are the basic controls?
Move with WASD, jump with Spacebar, sprint with Shift, and use the interact control to pick up weapons or use objects.

pixel-differences.intro: Pixel Differences asks you to compare two images and find the items that look different between them. A counter at the top shows how many differences you still need to find.
tips: Scan the two images in a fixed order, such as top-left to bottom-right, so you cover every area instead of jumping around.
Start with the largest or most obvious shapes and colors, then move on to small details like patterns, edges, and tiny objects.
Check whether an item is missing, added, recolored, or moved, since differences can take any of these forms.
Keep track of the counter at the top so you know how many differences remain and whether you should keep searching a particular area.
If you get stuck, look away for a moment and come back to the images, since fresh eyes often notice what you missed.
faq: How do I play Pixel Differences?
Compare the two images and click or tap on each item that looks different between them. The counter at the top shows how many differences you still need to find.
How do I know how many differences are left?
The number at the top of the screen shows how many items you need to find. It goes down as you locate each difference.

extreme-police-chase.intro: Extreme Police Chase is a high-speed highway driving game where you pursue escaping cars through busy traffic. Drive, steer and overtake to keep your target in sight.
tips: Look ahead for gaps in the traffic and aim for them early, rather than reacting at the last moment.
Brake before tight spots so you keep control and can steer back up to speed quickly.
Keep your target in view at all times; losing sight of them makes the chase much harder to recover.
Try the Race Mode first to learn how the traffic and targets behave before moving on to League or Elite Mode.
Use your upgraded police cars to gain speed, then adjust how hard you push based on how crowded the road is.
faq: What is the goal of Extreme Police Chase?
Your goal is to chase down escaping cars on the highway before they get away. Drive as fast as you can while avoiding obstacles and traffic.
How do I control the police car?
Use the arrow keys or WASD to accelerate, brake and steer your vehicle.

airport-clash-3d.intro: Airport Clash 3D is a multiplayer shooter where you lead the Bloodhounds gang to take an abandoned airport from the rival Vipers. Use a heavy minigun and a powerful bomb to wear down the enemy base.
tips: Move with WASD and keep moving so you are harder to hit while you fire.
Use crouch (C) to lower your profile when you are taking cover or lining up a shot.
Hold right mouse button to zoom when you want more precision at range.
Press TAB often to check the score table and see how your team is doing.
Save the big bomb for a moment when enemies are grouped up or their base is weakened, so its damage counts most.
faq: What is the goal of Airport Clash 3D?
Your gang, the Bloodhounds, must capture the abandoned airport from the Vipers. You win by taking control of the location and defeating enemy goons.
How do I move and jump?
Use W, A, S and D to move around, and press SPACE to jump. Jumping can help you reach higher spots or dodge fire.

super-pop-it.intro: Super Pop It is a tap-to-destroy ball game where you pop bombs under time pressure. Its difficulty can be adjusted, so you can build up your speed and precision at your own pace.
tips: Scan the whole screen before you tap so you can plan a route that keeps your taps quick and efficient.
Pay attention to the different kinds of bombs, since each one may need a different response from you.
Start on a lower difficulty to learn the rhythm of the game, then raise it once your taps feel accurate.
Keep an eye on the time pressure and avoid rushing wild taps, because precision usually saves more time than speed alone.
Take short breaks between rounds to reset your focus, especially in longer sessions.
faq: What is the main goal of Super Pop It?
Your goal is to pop the bombs on screen by tapping them before time runs out. Each round tests how quickly and accurately you can clear them.
How do I control the game?
You play by tapping the bombs to destroy them. No other controls are needed to play.

dino-dash.intro: Dino Dash puts you in control of a baby dinosaur fleeing predators in an endless chase. Quick reactions and steady focus are what keep you alive as the pace picks up.
tips: Scan the path ahead rather than staring at your dinosaur, so you can spot predators and obstacles before they reach you.
React early. Starting your dodge a little sooner gives you more room to recover if the next danger arrives quickly.
Pay attention to how the landscape changes as you run, since different areas can bring different threats to watch for.
Stay relaxed and keep your attention on the screen. Panicked, rushed inputs are a common reason runs end early in chase games.
Try short practice runs to get a feel for the timing. Each run gives you a better sense of when predators tend to close in.
faq: What is the goal of Dino Dash?
You play as a baby dinosaur escaping predators in an endless pursuit. The aim is to keep running and dodging danger for as long as you can.
What skill matters most in this game?
Swift reflexes are the main skill, since the game is built around fast chases and quick dodges. Staying alert and reacting early will help you survive longer.

jigsaw-collections.intro: Jigsaw Collections offers a range of puzzles where you assemble scattered fragments into complete images. It includes a zoom feature to help you work on the details.
tips: Start with the pieces that have straight edges so you can build a border first. This gives you a fixed frame to work inward from.
Group pieces by color and pattern before placing them. Sky, water, and foliage are often easier to sort into piles than to match one at a time.
Use the zoom feature to check small details, such as faces, text, or thin lines, before deciding where a piece belongs. Zooming out again helps you see how the piece fits the whole picture.
Work on one section at a time instead of scanning the entire board. Finishing a small area gives you a clear sense of progress and keeps you focused.
Pick a puzzle with a picture you already find engaging, especially when you are new to the collection. Liking the image makes it easier to stay with a challenge until it is finished.
faq: What is the goal of Jigsaw Collections?
The goal is to assemble the scattered fragments of each puzzle until the complete image appears. Choose a puzzle from the collection and work through its pieces.
How does the zoom feature help?
Zoom lets you look closely at small parts of the picture so you can match pieces more accurately. Use it when a piece looks similar to others or when the detail is hard to see.

arrowgami-arrow-puzzle.intro: ArrowGami is a puzzle where you clear the board by untangling colorful winding arrows. Tap an arrow to send it off the screen in the direction it points, and plan your order so each path stays clear.
tips: Before tapping anything, follow each arrow's path with your eyes to see which other arrows or obstacles block it.
Start with arrows that have a clear route. Removing them often opens the way for the tangled ones behind them.
Plan a few moves ahead so that no arrow's path will cross a spot where another arrow still sits.
If a pattern stalls you, use a hint rather than tapping at random, since random taps can lead to collisions.
Finishing a level reveals a pixel art silhouette, so keep an eye on the shape as you go. Coins earned along the way can unlock new visual themes.
faq: What is the goal of ArrowGami?
The goal is to clear the board by sliding every arrow off the screen. Finishing a level reveals a completed pixel art silhouette.
How do I remove an arrow?
Tap or click the arrow and it will slide off the screen in the direction it points, as long as its path is clear of obstacles.

desert-gunship.intro: Desert Gunship puts you in an attack helicopter over a hostile desert airbase. Fly low between the hangars, choose your weapons, and clear the camp before it clears you.
tips: Use the N and M keys to cycle through targets so you can pick off the most dangerous threats first.
Try both the chase and free-look cameras with V, and switch to whichever gives you a clearer view of your objective.
Pick a weapon for the job at hand: the rapid-fire gun suits quick clearing, while the guided missiles are better for tougher targets.
Before each sortie, think about the objective type, whether it is a kill, rescue, destroy, survive, or reach-zone mission, and plan your route around it.
In the Tournament a single loss ends your run, so start on a difficulty level and battlefield you can handle consistently before pushing harder.
faq: What is the main goal of Desert Gunship?
Each operation has its own objective, such as wiping out a camp, raiding a supply depot, or running a bomb to its target. You complete the mission while staying alive.
How do I fire and switch weapons?
Use the left mouse button to fire, the 1 to 3 keys to select a weapon, and X to cycle through them. Aim with the mouse.

flappy-twist.intro: Flappy Twist is a skill game where you guide a flying character along a twisting, zigzagging path. Tap or click to flap, and steer carefully to avoid obstacles and reach a high score.
tips: Use short, light taps rather than holding steady pressure, so you can make small height corrections on the zigzags.
Watch the path a few obstacles ahead instead of only the character, so you have time to adjust before each turn.
Take a moment to get a feel for the flap timing before pushing for distance, since the controls are smooth but responsive.
Stay near the middle of the open path when you can, which leaves you room to react when the course suddenly changes.
Keep your attention steady during long runs, because the ever-changing course rewards precision more than speed.
faq: What is the goal of Flappy Twist?
Guide your flying character through the twisting path while avoiding obstacles, and try to get the highest score you can.
What controls do I use?
Mouse click or tap to flap. Each tap lifts your character, so timing your taps is the main skill in the game.

moto-x3m-winter.intro: Moto X3M Winter is a bike stunt game where you ride through tracks full of traps, ramps, explosives and obstacles. Reach the finish line alive, and aim for three stars on every level.
tips: Treat each track as a speed run. Earning three stars depends on how fast you finish, so don't slow down more than you need to on easy sections.
Study each ramp before you hit it. Watch where the bike lands and plan your speed so you don't come down nose-first or crash on the next obstacle.
Use front and backflips whenever you're airborne and it's safe to do so. They give you extra seconds, which can help you reach the three-star time.
Look ahead for explosives and traps before you reach them. Adjust your line early instead of reacting at the last moment.
Replay levels you finished with one or two stars. Learning the layout is often the fastest way to improve your time and reach the goal of three stars everywhere.
faq: What is the main goal of Moto X3M Winter?
Drive your bike through each track, avoid the traps and obstacles, and reach the finish line alive. Finishing quickly earns you more stars.
How do I control the bike?
The game is played with the arrow keys.

alien-shooting-survival.intro: Alien Shooting Survival is a shooting game set in a ruined forest and town, where you fight waves of alien creatures and soldier invaders. You can also drive vehicles through dangerous zones to reach your objectives.
tips: Use WASD to keep moving so you are never standing still while enemies close in on you.
Aim with the mouse before you fire, and focus on one threat at a time instead of spraying shots across the screen.
Check where enemies are coming from before each wave arrives, and pick a position where you can see more than one approach.
When you need to cross a dangerous zone quickly, switch to a vehicle and drive past the worst of the fighting toward your objective.
Keep track of your mission goal so you do not waste time clearing areas that are not needed to complete it.
faq: How do I move and drive?
Use the W, A, S and D keys to walk. When you are in a vehicle, the same keys drive it.
How do I shoot?
Aim with the mouse and fire with the mouse button, as shown in the game's instructions.

beauty-salon-and-makeover-game.intro: Beauty Salon & Makeover Game is a simulation where you run your own hair salon. You wash and style customers' hair, then add jewelry and makeup accessories to finish each look.
tips: Wash the hair first, since the description lists washing as the starting step of the salon work before styling begins.
Try a few different hairstyles on the same customer before settling on one, because the game offers a wide range of options to compare.
Match the makeup and jewelry to the hairstyle so the finished look feels coordinated rather than random.
Experiment freely with combinations; the game is built around creativity, so trying unusual pairings is a good way to learn what works.
Give each customer a look that suits their personality, since the characters are described as quirky and the goal is a style that is uniquely theirs.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You run a hair salon and give each customer the hairstyle and makeover they want. The description focuses on creative styling rather than a fixed score target.
What steps do I go through with each customer?
The game covers washing, styling the hair, and then adding luxurious jewelry and makeup accessories. Work through them in that order for each client.

bank-tycoon-simulator-money-empire.intro: Run a small branch into a city-wide bank by serving customers, collecting cash, and expanding your services. This idle tycoon game keeps earning while you plan your next upgrades.
tips: Collect cash from the service desks regularly so it doesn't pile up while you work on other tasks.
Keep your ATMs stocked early, since running them smoothly is part of keeping the bank working well.
Check the Info panel (I) and the Shop (Q) often to see what you can afford next and which upgrade would help most.
Hire staff to automate routine jobs, then spend your time on expansion and new counters, where the bigger gains are.
Use Sprint (Space) to cover ground faster between the vault, desks, and ATMs when you're carrying out a busy round of tasks.
faq: How do I earn money in Bank Tycoon Simulator Money Empire?
Help customers with deposits and withdrawals, then collect the money from service desks and store it in the vault. Your bank also keeps earning while you are away.
What do the right-click controls do?
Right-click drops cash you are carrying, and right-click again picks up cash. Use it to move money around the bank as you work.

city-pop-drive.intro: City Pop Drive is a one-thumb arcade driver set in pastel 80s city scenery. You steer past traffic, beat checkpoint timers, and pick a scenic or express route at each fork.
tips: Lean into near misses on purpose, since they add time and fill the Breeze meter, which keeps you in the race.
Save a full Breeze meter for a crowded stretch, because the Boost knocks cars aside and clears your path.
Check the timer as you approach each fork, and take the express road when you are running low on time.
Take the scenic road when the timer is comfortable, so you can explore and pass more traffic for Breeze.
Keep small steering corrections rather than sharp jerks, since the car accelerates on its own and overcorrecting can cost you a close pass.
faq: What is the goal of City Pop Drive?
Reach each checkpoint before the timer runs out, and reach a goal to collect its record-sleeve cover. There are 25 covers to collect across five maps.
How do I steer the car?
Tap to start, then drag left or right with a mouse, or use the arrow keys or A and D on desktop. The car accelerates by itself, so you only need to steer.

mad-racing-hill-climb.intro: Mad Racing: Hill Climb is an off-road racing game across 15 levels of rugged terrain. Success depends on precision, timing, and balancing speed with sharp control.
tips: Ease off the speed before steep climbs and rough patches, since losing control on the slope is the quickest way to fall behind.
Watch how the terrain ahead rises and dips so you can time your acceleration for the top of each hill rather than the bottom.
Treat each level as a learning run: note where the ground gets tricky and adjust your pace the next time you reach that spot.
Avoid pushing full speed everywhere. Save your fastest driving for flat or downhill stretches where you can recover easily.
Keep your inputs small and steady on uneven ground, because quick, sharp corrections often make the vehicle wobble and lose balance.
faq: What is the main goal of Mad Racing: Hill Climb?
You race across off-road hills and rugged terrain, working through 15 challenging levels. The game rewards precise driving and good timing.
How do I balance speed and control?
Go fast where the road is safe and slow down before difficult hills or bumps. Smooth, controlled driving usually keeps you moving forward better than constant full throttle.

planet-escape.intro: Planet Escape is an arcade game where you fly a rocket through alien worlds, collecting minerals while racing against the clock to get out in time. Choose a difficulty level before you start.
tips: Start on an easier difficulty level to learn how the terrain behaves before you try harder settings.
Keep an eye on the route ahead rather than only the rocket, so you can react early to obstacles.
Collect minerals when it is safe to do so, and avoid detours that leave you short on time to escape.
Each planet holds different treasures, so play through a few worlds to learn which ones are worth going after.
Replay a planet you found difficult, focusing on one section at a time, to build up your reflexes.
faq: What is the goal of Planet Escape?
You pilot your rocket through alien planets, collect minerals, and escape each planet just in time.
How does difficulty work?
You can select a difficulty level before playing, so you can pick a challenge that matches your reflexes.

targetter-game.intro: Targetter is a ball game where you aim and launch objects at targets inspired by golf and archery. Dodge obstacles, fine-tune your accuracy, and try to score higher as the levels grow more complex.
tips: Take a moment to check your aim before each launch, since small changes in direction can decide whether you hit the target.
Watch the obstacles before you fire and plan a path that avoids them rather than rushing your shot.
Make small adjustments between attempts instead of big swings, so you can learn how your aim affects where the object lands.
Expect the levels to get harder, so focus on steady accuracy early on rather than chasing high scores too quickly.
If a shot misses, note what went wrong, such as going too far or too wide, and correct that on your next try.
faq: What is the main goal in Targetter?
You aim and launch objects at targets while dodging obstacles, and your aim and accuracy help you score higher.
What makes the later levels harder?
The game describes its levels as becoming increasingly complex, so you should expect more to manage as you progress.

subway-santa-princess-runner.intro: Subway Santa Princess Runner is an endless runner where you guide the princess along the subway tracks, dodging trains and escaping the policeman while collecting coins and power components.
tips: Look ahead early and switch lanes before a train reaches you, since a late swipe leaves little room to react.
Swipe down to slide when a low obstacle is coming and you cannot safely jump over it.
Save your skateboard for a moment when several obstacles are close together, so its protection covers the most danger.
Pick up the surprise boxes and jump boots rather than steering around them, because they can help you survive longer.
Use the jet-pack stretch to grab as many coins and gifts as you can, and keep an eye on which lanes they are in.
faq: What is the goal of Subway Santa Princess Runner?
The goal is to keep running as long as possible by dodging trains and the policeman while collecting coins, gifts and power components along the subway road.
How do I change lanes and jump?
Swipe left or right with one finger to change your running path, swipe up to jump, and swipe down to slide.

merge-number-up.intro: Merge number up is a number puzzle where you tap connected tiles with the same number to combine them into a higher number. Bigger groups earn more points, so planning ahead helps you keep your combos going.
tips: Look for the largest connected group of matching numbers before you tap, since merging more blocks in one move earns more points.
Scan the whole board first and note which tiles of the same number touch each other, so you can spot future merges.
Avoid breaking up a promising group early; a tap on a small pair can remove tiles you might have used for a bigger combo.
Pay attention to where new tiles will fall from the top, because they fill the gaps and can create new matches or block existing ones.
As higher numbers appear, slow down and plan two or three moves ahead to keep the board open for combos.
faq: What is the goal of Merge number up?
Tap connected tiles with the same number to merge them into a higher number. Keep merging to reach higher numbers and beat your high score.
How do I merge tiles?
Tap on two or more connected tiles that show the same number. They combine into one tile with a higher number.

beach-volley-clash.intro: Beach Volley Clash is a sports game set in a lively beach arena where you face powerful opponents in volleyball matches. Use quick reflexes and precise hits to win every match.
tips: Watch the ball closely from the moment your opponent serves so you have time to move into position before it arrives.
Aim your hits toward open areas of the court rather than straight at your opponent, since precise placement is key to scoring.
Keep your reactions quick by staying ready near the center of your side and returning to it after each hit.
Control your timing: a well-timed click or tap usually produces a stronger, more accurate hit than rushing the action.
Pay attention to how your opponents move and adjust your shots to exploit gaps they leave behind.
faq: What is the goal of Beach Volley Clash?
The goal is to win each volleyball match by hitting the ball precisely past your powerful opponents.
How do I control my player?
Use mouse clicks or taps to play, and time each click or tap to hit the ball.

pocket-league-3d.intro: Pocket League 3D is a car soccer game for one or two players, with optional AI bots on your team. Drive, jump and flip your car to hit the ball into the opponent's goal before time runs out.
tips: Jump to hit the ball harder, but time your jump so the car meets the ball at its peak rather than leaving the ground too early.
Use a double jump and flip when the ball is high in the air, since the flip sends your car through the air and gives a stronger hit.
Keep an eye on where the ball is heading and position your car between it and your goal before trying an attacking shot.
If you play with AI bots, let them handle nearby play while you look for openings to score, so you are not both chasing the ball at once.
In two player mode, each player uses a different set of keys, so learn your own jump and flip keys early to avoid mistakes during a match.
faq: How do I score a goal?
Hit the ball into the opponent's goal by driving into it, jumping, or flipping with your car. The player who scores the most goals before time runs out wins the match.
What is the difference between a jump and a double jump?
A normal jump is pressed with SPACE in single player or L or G for the two player controls. Pressing jump a second time, the double jump, makes your car flip through the air for a stronger hit.

cube-snake-2048.intro: Cube Snake 2048 is a snake game set in a large arena where you grow by collecting and combining numbered cubes. Steer with the mouse or keys, and use boost when you need a quick move.
tips: Aim for cubes that are lower than or equal to your snake's current number, since those are the ones you can collect.
Plan routes ahead of time instead of reacting only to the cube right in front of you, so you can line up the next combination.
Use boost sparingly. It helps you catch a cube or escape a tight spot, but it can take you into danger if you rely on it constantly.
Keep an eye on power-ups as you move around the map, since they can give your snake extra advantages.
Stay toward open areas of the arena when your snake is long, so you have room to turn without running into yourself or others.
faq: What is the main goal of Cube Snake 2048?
Your goal is to make your snake bigger by collecting lower or equal numbered cubes and combining their numbers. You start with a low number of snakes and build from there.
How do I move and boost my snake?
Move with the mouse or the left and right arrow keys, or the A and D keys. Boost with a left-click or the space bar.

vector-parkour.intro: Vector Parkour is an arcade-style runner where you play as a free runner escaping pursuit. You run, jump and climb using parkour moves while Big Brother chases you.
tips: Keep moving forward. Pausing gives the chase time to close in, so build momentum before each jump.
Look ahead for the next wall, ledge or gap before you reach it. Planning your line early makes climbs and jumps much easier.
Use your jumps and climbs to keep a steady rhythm. Smooth, continuous movement is usually safer than rushing and overcommitting.
Try a different route if you keep getting caught at the same spot. Changing how you move through a section can reveal a safer path.
Switch between keyboard and mouse to find what feels more precise for you. Stick with whichever gives you better control over your jumps.
faq: What is the goal of Vector Parkour?
You play as a free runner trying to escape Big Brother, who is in hot pursuit. Keep running, jumping and climbing to get away.
What techniques do you use in the game?
The game is built around running, jumping and climbing based on the urban-ninja sport of parkour. Combine these moves to keep your escape going.

patch-garden.intro: Patch Garden is a rectangle logic puzzle where each seed clue marks one patch whose area must match the number. Your job is to cover the whole board with rectangles that do not overlap.
tips: Start with the clues that have the fewest possible shapes, such as small numbers or clues near edges and corners, since they limit where neighboring patches can go.
Look for cells that can only belong to one patch. A corner cell with only one clue able to reach it often tells you the exact shape to draw.
Count the cells around each seed before drawing. If a rectangle of the right area would run into another seed or leave an isolated gap, try a different shape.
Draw a patch, then check the cells next to it. If a leftover strip is too thin to fill with any clue's area, the patch is probably in the wrong place.
Use Undo freely while you explore. Trying a shape and reversing it is faster than planning every move in your head, and Erase mode helps when you want to rework one area.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Fill every cell of the board with rectangular patches so that each seed clue sits inside exactly one patch whose area matches its number. No cell can be left empty or covered twice.
How do I draw a patch?
On desktop, click and drag across the grid; on mobile, drag from one cell to another. The rectangle you make from the start cell to the end cell is placed on the board.

real-truck-fire-drive-sim.intro: Real Truck Fire Drive Sim is a racing driving game where you control a fire truck on the way to emergencies. You drive with WASD, brake with Space, and fill your truck with water before heading out.
tips: Before you drive, line up the truck carefully under the water tank and hose nozzle so you can see when the tank reaches its limit.
Avoid overfilling the tank, since too much water above the permitted level makes the truck harder to control on the road.
Ease into turns and use Space to brake early rather than braking hard at the last moment, which helps keep the truck steady.
Keep an eye on how the truck handles after you fill it, and take corners more slowly if it feels heavy or unsteady.
Plan your route before you set off so you spend less time correcting mistakes and more time reaching the emergency.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You drive a fire truck to finish your mission successfully, which includes filling the truck with water and reaching the emergency.
How do I control the truck?
Use W, A, S and D to drive, and press Space to brake.

1-damage-evolution.intro: Shoot robots and training dummies to watch your damage climb, then unlock new guns and push through the rogue AI's robot army. Each stage gets harder, and bosses wait at the end.
tips: Use the trainers early to build up your damage multipliers before you take on tougher robots.
Turn on AUTO AIM when you are learning the controls, so your shots go to the nearest enemy in view while you focus on movement.
Keep moving with WASD and jump or dash to reposition, since standing still makes it harder to stay in the fight.
Check the Trophy Shop with a hold of E whenever you have a new option, so your gun matches the stage you are facing.
Consider rebirthing once progress slows down, because it gives permanent bonuses that carry into your next run.
faq: How do I increase my damage?
Every hit adds to your damage, and training dummies with trainers give large multipliers that boost it further.
How do I buy or change my gun?
Open the Trophy Shop and hold E to buy or equip a gun.

air-force-commando-online-game.intro: Air Force Commando is a shooting game set in 1945, where you pilot warplanes in fast dogfights against rivals. Survival depends on skill, reflexes, and strategy.
tips: Scan the sky often and locate rivals before you commit to an attack, since surprise is a big advantage in aerial combat.
Use tactical maneuvers to reposition yourself behind an enemy plane rather than turning head-on into their fire.
Pick your shots carefully and wait for a clear, precise opening instead of firing at long range and wasting attempts.
Avoid flying in predictable straight lines during a fight; changing direction makes it harder for rivals to line up on you.
After each battle, think about which move worked and which one left you exposed, then adjust your approach in the next fight.
faq: What is the main goal of Air Force Commando?
The game challenges you to win aerial battles and become the top pilot of the skies. Surviving intense dogfights is central to reaching that goal.
How do I stay alive longer in the dogfights?
Focus on combining tactical maneuvers with careful, precise attacks rather than rushing in. Staying aware of nearby rivals gives you time to react.

super-droid-adventure.intro: Super Droid Adventure is a platformer where a robot fights through traps and enemies, breaks blocks for surprises, and works toward a final boss battle at its castle.
tips: Break blocks you pass by, since the description says they can unlock surprises. Hitting unfamiliar blocks is worth a try when it is safe to do so.
Collect power-ups when you can reach them safely, because your firepower is key for dealing with fierce enemies.
Grab coins along your route, but do not let them pull you into a dangerous trap or a risky jump.
Study each trap before you move forward. Pausing for a moment to see how a hazard repeats often prevents a quick loss.
Save your firepower for tougher enemies and the boss rather than using it on every small foe. Plan your moves before the boss fight so you arrive with what you need.
faq: What is the main goal of Super Droid Adventure?
You play as a courageous robot navigating traps and enemies to conquer the final boss and reclaim your castle.
How do I get surprises in the game?
Break blocks as you move through the levels, since the game says breaking blocks can unlock surprises.

fragen.intro: Fragen is a first person shooter built around intense gunfights. You can play solo or with a team, switch between game modes, and customize a large arsenal of weapons.
tips: Try several game modes before settling on one, so you learn which style of fighting suits you best.
Spend time on the beautifully designed maps to learn sightlines, cover spots, and routes you can use in a fight.
Work on your weapon setup gradually. Test a few weapons in short matches and keep the ones that feel right for your play.
Pay attention to the rewards you can unlock and aim for them steadily, since they add to your options over time.
If you play with a team, coordinate your positions so you are not all exposed in the same area at once.
faq: What is the goal of Fragen?
The goal is to win intense gunfights and prove you are the best shooter. Victory depends on your skill in each fight.
Can I play Fragen alone or with others?
Yes, the game supports both solo play and team play, so you can choose the format that suits you.

rage-road-online.intro: Rage Road Online is a car shooter where you play a cowboy chasing and destroying enemy vehicles on the road. You aim and fire with the mouse or by touching the screen, and you collect coins to unlock hat costumes.
tips: Keep your aim steady as enemies approach, since shooting accurately is the core of the game.
Watch where enemy vehicles are heading and fire ahead of them rather than at where they already are.
Collect coins whenever it is safe, because they are what you need to unlock new hat costumes.
Try different hats, since each one has its own special ability, and pick the one that suits how you like to drive and shoot.
Use the road itself to keep moving and avoid getting cornered while you take out enemies.
faq: What is the goal of Rage Road Online?
Your goal is to shoot all the enemies, destroy their vehicles, and keep rampaging down the road as the cowboy.
How do I aim and shoot?
Use the mouse to aim and click to shoot, or touch the screen to aim and fire if you are playing with touch.

stick-doors-and-island.intro: Stick Doors and Island is a horror escape game where you are stranded on an island or locked in a room. Each option you pick may lead to freedom or to failure.
tips: Look at every available option before you act, since some lead to success and others lead to failure.
Treat each choice as a test of logic and ask what the scene is showing you before you commit.
If an option looks risky, consider whether a safer path exists first, because the game rewards careful thinking.
Pay attention to details in both the rooms and the island, since clues can point toward the one true path.
If you fail, go back and try a different route, using what you learned from the failed attempt.
faq: What is the goal of Stick Doors and Island?
Your goal is to find all the successful ways to escape from the rooms and the island. The game asks you to uncover the one true path to freedom.
How do I control the game?
Use your computer mouse to select options and interact with the scenes. On a mobile device, a stylus or your finger works instead.

capitalist-hunter.intro: Capitalist Hunter is a clicker and tycoon game where you hunt animals, collect meat, cook it for villagers, and grow your hunting business. Move around the wilderness, gather your haul, and bring it back to town to earn cash.
tips: Hunt the animals near you first, then carry the meat you collect back to the cooking and selling areas before your load gets too heavy to manage comfortably.
Plan a loop: hunt, collect, cook, sell. Keeping this cycle going is what keeps money coming in while you are away from the town.
Spend the cash you earn on equipment upgrades early, since faster hunting and carrying will speed up every round after that.
Check which areas you can unlock as your business grows, and save up for them so you can reach new animals and better meat.
Keep your movement short and direct. Use the joystick or WASD/arrow keys to reach targets quickly, which is where the fast-paced progression comes from.
faq: What is the main goal of Capitalist Hunter?
The goal is to grow your hunting business into a successful one by hunting animals, selling meat and food, and becoming the richest hunter in town.
How do I move my character?
Use the joystick or the WASD or arrow keys to move around the wilderness and town.

snail-odyssey-hardest-game.intro: Guide a snail through a trap-filled world where timing and wits matter. This guide offers practical habits for getting further in each level.
tips: Before moving, watch the traps and obstacles for a few seconds to learn how they repeat.
Plan each step before you commit to it, since each level demands sharp timing.
Pay attention to the clever AI's moves and look for patterns you can use to get ahead of it.
When you fail, note exactly where and why, then change your approach rather than repeating the same move.
Take short breaks between attempts so you can keep your timing sharp on harder sections.
faq: What is the goal of Snail Odyssey?
Guide the snail through each trap-filled level by outsmarting the AI and dodging obstacles until you complete the journey.
Does the game have a scoring system?
The description does not mention a scoring system, so focus on reaching the end of each level and completing the journey.

knee-surgery-clicker.intro: Knee Surgery Clicker is a humorous clicker where you perform zany knee operations, grow your surgical business, and unlock meme-inspired boosts. Balancing taps with upgrades is the core of the game.
tips: Keep tapping steadily from the start, since your surgical progress depends on it as you build up.
Spend upgrades with a plan rather than buying whatever is affordable, so each purchase supports your overall growth.
Check which boosts you have unlocked and think about when they will help most, especially as your progress speeds up.
Balance your time between tapping and buying upgrades instead of focusing on only one of them.
Come back to the game regularly to see how your surgical empire has grown and decide what to prioritize next.
faq: What is the main goal of Knee Surgery Clicker?
The goal is to perform knee operations, grow your surgery empire, and reach maximum surgical success by balancing tapping with strategic upgrades.
How do I get better results in the game?
Focus on balancing your tapping with well-chosen upgrades, and plan ahead so that each purchase helps your long-term growth.

decorate-my-dream-castle-home-design.intro: Decorate My Dream Castle is a hypercasual design game where you help a little princess redecorate her castle for a grand ball. The controls are tap or click, and the goal is to make the castle look gorgeous and beautiful.
tips: Look at the whole castle before you start placing items, so you can pick a style that suits the ball and stick with it.
Try a few different combinations of decorations and compare how each room looks before deciding on a final version.
Work room by room instead of jumping around, so each space feels finished before you move on.
Balance bright and bold pieces with softer ones so the castle does not feel crowded.
Keep an eye on the princess's plans for the ball, since the whole castle is meant to match that event.
faq: How do I play Decorate My Dream Castle?
You play by tapping or clicking to choose and place decorations in the castle. Your aim is to redecorate it so it looks ready for the princess's grand ball.
Is there a way to win or lose?
The description does not mention a win or lose condition. The game is about creating a design you are happy with, so focus on making the castle look its best.

tap-away-block-puzzle-3d.intro: Tap Away Block Puzzle 3D is a relaxing logic puzzle where you clear the screen by tapping blocks. Blocks can only move in one direction, so you need to find the right order to send them all away.
tips: Before tapping anything, swipe to rotate the puzzle and check which way each block is pointing, since blocks only move one way.
Look for blocks that have a clear path out of the board and send those first, so they stop blocking the others.
Rotate the view often. A block that looks stuck from one angle may have a clear route from another.
Save the Remover Power-up for a moment when you are truly stuck, so you can use it where it matters most.
Take a short break if you keep getting stuck. Coming back with fresh eyes can help you spot the order you missed.
faq: How do I win a level?
You win a level by clearing the board, which means sending away every block on the screen.
Which way do the blocks move?
Each block can only move in one direction, so check the direction of a block before you tap it.

puzzle-parents-baby-s-path-home.intro: Puzzle Parents: Baby's Path Home is a drawing puzzle where you plan routes that bring a little one safely home. Each level has winding paths, obstacles, and rewards to work through with logic and creativity.
tips: Before you draw, trace the whole route from the child to home with your eyes to spot obstacles and tricky turns.
Start with the path that looks hardest to plan, since the easier routes are usually simpler to fit around it.
Keep your lines clear of obstacles, and check each one before you move on so you don't have to redo a long route.
Make sure every character reaches their baby and returns home with them, because the level isn't complete until all of them do.
In the optional mode, look around the level for the favorite toy first, then plan your route so the baby gets it on the way.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Your goal is to make sure the child gets back home safely by drawing a path that avoids obstacles. In each level, every character must reach their baby and bring them home.
How do I start drawing a path?
Click on a character to start drawing lines. Then draw a line toward the kid while avoiding the obstacles in the way.

chicken-charge-race.intro: Chicken Charge Race is an arcade jumping game where you guide a chicken to the finish line. You charge each jump with the mouse and time your leaps to avoid obstacles.
tips: Hold the mouse to charge your jump and watch how far the chicken is set to travel before you let go. Short practice jumps help you judge the distance.
Before each jump, look ahead at the next obstacle and decide when to leap, rather than reacting once you are already close to it.
Keep the chicken moving forward. Hesitating too long can leave you in a position where the next hazard is hard to clear.
If you miss a jump, reset your rhythm on the next safe spot instead of rushing. Calm, steady timing usually beats fast, uneven jumps.
Focus on the finish line as your end goal, and use each jump to get a little closer to it while staying clear of hazards.
faq: How do I control the chicken?
Use the mouse. Press and hold to charge your jump, then release to leap forward.
What is the goal of the game?
Guide the chicken to the finish line while avoiding obstacles along the way.

arrow-survival-15-seconds.intro: Arrow Survival: 15 Seconds is a pixel art platformer with 40 levels. Each level asks you to survive 15 seconds while dodging hazards and firing arrows at the right moments.
tips: Watch how arrows behave off bouncing platforms before you commit to a shot, since those platforms can redirect your arrows.
Treat the 15-second timer as your guide. Keep moving between safe spots instead of standing still to aim.
Learn the spikes and hazard patterns on each level before pushing for a risky route.
Use the Restart Level key (R) without frustration when a level goes wrong early, because a quick retry helps you learn its layout.
Use Pause (P) to step back and plan your next move when a level gets crowded.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You need to survive for 15 seconds while dodging deadly hazards and firing arrows as needed.
Which keys control the archer?
Use A and D or the left and right arrow keys to move, and W, the up arrow, or Spacebar to jump. J or X fires arrows.

spra-racing-cars-speed.intro: Speed Racing Cars is a racing game where you pick cars, unlock supercars, and tune your vehicles to beat the competition. Drive with WASD and switch views with C.
tips: Learn the WASD controls on a track before a serious race so your steering feels natural when the pace picks up.
Press C to try different camera views and choose the one that lets you see upcoming corners and the competition most clearly.
Visit the customization menu after each race to adjust your car and see how the changes affect how it handles on the track.
Spend your upgrades on the performance areas that match your driving style, rather than spreading them thinly across everything.
Try your current car across different environments, since the stunning tracks may suit different setups and driving approaches.
faq: How do I drive my car?
Use the W, A, S and D keys to drive. The game's instructions only list WASD, so that is the main control to learn.
How do I change the camera view?
Press the C key to change the camera. Trying each view helps you find the one that gives you the best sight of the road ahead.

chaotic-spin.intro: Chaotic Spin is a puzzle arcade game where you steer a white ball around a circular track. Collect white dots, dodge flying objects, and keep the ball moving as long as you can.
tips: Keep an eye on the flying objects before you move, since they are the main threat to your run.
Slow down your planning around rotating objects, because they change position and can catch you off guard.
Prioritize the white dots that sit in safe spots on the track so you earn points without taking extra risks.
Move the ball in small, controlled steps rather than rushing, which makes it easier to react when something new appears.
Watch the whole track instead of only the ball, so you can spot danger coming from either direction.
faq: What is the goal of Chaotic Spin?
The goal is to collect as many white dots as you can while avoiding objects on the track. Hitting an object ends the game.
How do I control the ball?
Tap the screen to play, and move the ball forward or backward around the track to dodge objects and reach dots.

gun-bounce-idle.intro: Gun Bounce Idle is a clicker where you drop weapons into an arena, and they ricochet, deal damage, and earn coins. You spend those coins on talents and use Prestige to grow stronger over time.
tips: Spend coins on talents that match your current weak point, such as damage, attack speed, crit chance, or income, rather than buying one type over and over.
Watch the field while your weapons bounce. Since coins come from damage dealt, a setup that hits more targets will usually earn faster.
Level up regularly, because each level makes you stronger, unlocks new upgrades, and brings in stronger targets.
Try newly unlocked guns to see how their behaviors change your shots, and keep the ones that work best with your current talents.
Prestige once progress has clearly slowed down, since resetting gives permanent bonuses that make your next run faster.
faq: What is the main goal of Gun Bounce Idle?
Your goal is to build a damage setup that keeps the arena filled with bouncing shots, earn coins from that damage, and push your numbers as high as possible.
How do I earn coins in this game?
Your weapons earn coins automatically by dealing damage while they bounce, so the more damage you deal, the more coins you earn.

pictures-by-numbers-nubik-and-mobs-mine.intro: Pictures by Numbers - Nubik and Mobs Mine is a coloring game where you fill in Minecraft-inspired scenes by following number-based puzzles. It is built for a relaxed pace, with simple controls and bright graphics.
tips: Look for the number in each section first, then pick the matching color before you start filling. Working one color at a time keeps you from switching back and forth.
Start with the larger areas that share a number, since they fill quickly and help you see how the picture is taking shape.
Leave the tiny or narrow sections for last, when you can zoom in or take your time to fill them accurately.
Check your finished areas now and then against the numbers to catch mistakes early, before a wrong color spreads to neighboring sections.
Take short breaks between sections and let the scene come together gradually, since the game is designed to be a relaxing experience.
faq: How do I know which color goes where?
Each section of the picture shows a number, and that number tells you which color belongs in it. Match the number to the color key and fill the section.
Is there a time limit I need to beat?
The description does not mention a timer, so the game is best approached at your own pace as a relaxing coloring activity.

mining-rush.intro: Mining Rush is a puzzle strategy game about digging for minerals underground and using what you find to build up a city. Your mining choices shape how quickly your progress grows.
tips: Think about efficiency before each dig, since the game is built around getting more out of every mining run.
Save up minerals for the tools you can unlock rather than spending them on the first option you see, because better tools can speed up your later progress.
Push deeper when you can, since the description says deeper digs bring richer rewards, but keep an eye on whether the extra risk is worth it.
Watch for rare treasures as you go, and plan your route so you do not miss them.
Invest your underground gains into your city steadily, so your progress keeps moving forward instead of stalling in one area.
faq: What is the main goal of Mining Rush?
The goal is to extract precious minerals and use them to transform your underground gains into a growing city. Progress comes from mining well and building up what you earn.
Does digging deeper always pay off?
The description says the deeper you dig, the richer the rewards. Going deeper can bring better returns, so it helps to balance how far you go with what you can safely collect.

tile-matcher-triple-fun.intro: Tile Matcher Triple Fun is a calm puzzle where you find and clear sets of three identical fruit tiles on a stacked tropical board. Each level gets harder as you go.
tips: Before you tap, scan the whole board for matching fruit tiles, including ones partly hidden under the stack.
Start with fruit types that have tiles on the top layer, since clearing them can reveal tiles underneath.
Look for a group of three that you can clear without leaving a single leftover tile of that fruit stuck in a corner.
Use the lightbulb hint when you are stuck, but first check the board yourself so you still get the practice of finding matches.
If no clear move is left, press the shuffle button to rearrange the tiles, then scan the board again for triples.
faq: What is the goal of Tile Matcher Triple Fun?
Your goal is to tap and match three identical fruit tiles at a time until the stacked board is cleared. Each new level is more challenging than the last.
How do I select and match tiles?
On desktop, click a tile to select it, and on mobile, tap it. Select three identical tiles to clear them from the board.

shoot-some-fish.intro: Shoot Some Fish! puts you in control of a worm with a harpoon, dangling from a fishing hook. Survive 10 levels of faster, smarter fish to avenge your family.
tips: Watch how each fish moves before you swipe, since the seven fish types travel at different speeds and need different timing.
Dodge incoming attacks when you can, because you only have five lives and every hit costs one.
Fish get faster and smarter as you progress, so aim for steady, accurate shots rather than rapid swiping.
Use the early levels to learn how the fish behave before the challenge ramps up.
Stay calm and focus on one target at a time instead of reacting to every fish on screen.
faq: How do I shoot the fish?
You use a mouse swipe to fire your harpoon at the fish.
How many lives do I get?
You have five lives, and you lose one when you are hit by an attack.

knights-vs-dragons-battle-simulator.intro: Knights vs Dragons Battle Simulator is a 3D action battle game where you lead an army of knights against fierce monsters. Success depends on building the right forces and making careful choices in each fight.
tips: Before each battle, think about which knights suit the enemy you are facing, since each unit has its own strengths.
Spend your resources carefully. Avoid committing everything early, so you still have forces to respond when the fight changes.
Pay attention to how your formation sits on the battlefield. Keeping units grouped in a sensible arrangement can help them support each other.
Watch how the monsters move and attack, then adjust your plan rather than sticking to one approach.
Protecting your knights matters as much as winning. Pulling back a damaged unit to keep it alive can pay off later in the battle.
faq: What is the goal of Knights vs Dragons Battle Simulator?
You lead a army of knights into 3D battles and aim to outwit and overpower fierce monsters while keeping your knights alive.
How do I get better at winning battles?
Focus on matching each unit's strengths to the enemy and managing your resources wisely. Good formation and timely decisions make a clear difference.

knife-tower.intro: Knife Tower is a 3D race up a colorful tower where you throw knives into blocks. Break blocks, build combos, and reach the final block before your rival.
tips: Watch the bouncing ball before each throw, and time your shots so the knife does not hit it.
Focus on accurate hits first. Clean breaks are what set up combos and help you climb faster.
Keep your combos going by landing precise shots one after another instead of rushing throws.
Spend early coins on the upgrade that fits your play, such as speed if you want to climb faster or combo range if you are building chains.
Keep an eye on your rival's progress so you know how hard you need to push to reach the final block first.
faq: How do you win Knife Tower?
You win by reaching the final block before your opponent. Break blocks and climb quickly to get there first.
What should I avoid while playing?
Avoid hitting the bouncing ball with your knives. Careful timing around it helps you keep your progress.

mowmentum.intro: Mowmentum is a relaxing idle lawn-mowing game where you steer a tool through an overgrown garden, cut grass and plants, and spend your earnings on upgrades. Progress keeps going even when you are not actively mowing.
tips: Keep the mouse moving across thick grass patches so your tool cuts as much as possible, since earnings come from what you cut.
Open the shop often with Tab or the Shop button and check what you can afford, so spending stays steady as your money grows.
Save up for stronger hand tools early, because a better tool makes every pass through the garden more productive.
Once you have automated mowers, use your time to focus on new zones and seeds rather than cutting by hand.
Come back to the game between sessions to collect progress, since idle earnings build up while you are away.
faq: What is the main goal of Mowmentum?
Your goal is to cut grass and plants, earn money, and use it to buy upgrades that transform the overgrown garden. Unlocking new tools, zones, and seeds helps you grow your collection.
How do I move my tool?
Move the mouse to guide your equipped tool around the garden. The tool cuts whatever it passes over.

penalty-superstar.intro: Penalty Superstar puts you in goal as you try to stop increasingly skilled penalty shots. Grow with water bottle boosts, avoid shrinking potions, and keep playing through endless rounds.
tips: Pay attention to the shooter before the ball is kicked, since reading their approach is the best early clue for where the shot will go.
Collect water bottle boosts when you can, because a bigger goalkeeper covers more of the net.
Stay alert for shrinking potions and steer clear of them, as they make it harder to block shots.
Expect shots to get harder over time, so stay focused and keep your reactions sharp rather than relaxing after a good save.
Since the game is endless, try short sessions and focus on beating your own previous best rather than chasing a fixed finish.
faq: What is the goal of Penalty Superstar?
You play as a goalkeeper trying to block penalty shots that become more skilled as the game goes on. The game is described as endless, so the aim is to keep saving shots and do as well as you can.
What controls does Penalty Superstar use?
The game does not list its controls in the provided instructions, so check the on-screen prompts when you start playing. Quick reflexes are key to blocking shots.

shoot-the-turtle.intro: Shoot the Turtle is an adventure game where you launch your turtle as far as possible using cannons, bombs, and jetpacks. Touch or mouse controls handle all the play.
tips: Aim before you fire the cannon, since the launch direction sets up the rest of your flight.
Save bombs and jetpacks for moments when your turtle is already moving, so each boost adds distance instead of wasting it.
Pay attention to the turtle's path after each launch and use what you learn to adjust your next shot.
Try different combinations of cannons, bombs, and jetpacks to see which order carries the turtle farthest.
Keep your timing consistent with touch or mouse input so you can repeat the moves that worked best.
faq: What is the goal of Shoot the Turtle?
The goal is to shoot your turtle as far as possible using cannons, bombs, and jetpacks.
How do I control the turtle?
You play with touch or the mouse, so tap or click at the right moments to fire cannons, use bombs, and activate jetpacks.

emoji-guess.intro: Emoji Guess is a puzzle game where you translate a phrase, saying, or movie title into a sequence of emojis. Each level gives you a prompt and a set of emojis to choose from, and you pick them in the right order.
tips: Read the whole prompt before tapping anything, and note how many words or ideas it contains so you can plan how many emojis you need.
Start with the easiest picture in the phrase, such as a noun, and build the rest of the sequence around it.
Pay attention to order. Emojis for a phrase usually follow the same word order as the original text, so think of it as reading left to right.
Think about sound-alikes and everyday meanings. A single emoji can stand for a word, a sound, or an action, so consider each option in more than one way.
Try to get the level right on your first attempt for the full star reward, and save hints for puzzles that stay stuck after a few tries.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You need to pick the correct sequence of emojis that matches the phrase, saying, or movie title shown above. The emojis must be chosen in the exact order needed.
How do I earn all the stars for a level?
Get the answer correct on your first try. If you need extra attempts, you can still finish the level but you will receive fewer stars.

allpeopletug.intro: AllPeopleTUG drops you onto a map with no weapons, where you must scavenge gear and outlast other players. The safe zone shrinks over time, so every match ends in a fight for the last survivor.
tips: Explore early and pick up weapons and equipment before you engage anyone, since you start with nothing.
Keep an eye on the edge of the safe zone so you can move toward the center before it closes in around you.
Expect encounters near the central area as the zone shrinks, and try to arrive with a weapon and healing items ready.
Use the sprint and heal actions deliberately, especially when you are moving between cover or after taking damage.
Reload when you have a safe moment rather than in the middle of a firefight, so you are not caught with an empty weapon.
faq: What is the goal of AllPeopleTUG?
The goal is to be the last survivor among the players who are randomly placed on the map. Players are dropped in without weapons, so you need to collect items to survive.
How do I move my character on desktop?
Use the W, A, S and D keys to move around the map. Click the on-screen icons to fire, sprint, heal, or reload.

bazooka-boy.intro: Bazooka Boy is a physics shooter where you blast through levels by destroying enemies, bases, and buildings with a range of weapons. Each level works like a small action puzzle that you solve with well-aimed shots.
tips: Before each shot, look at where the enemies, bases, and buildings are placed and find the one shot that can bring down the most of them.
Try different weapons on the same level to see how each one behaves, since their qualities differ and some suit certain targets better.
Watch how explosions push objects and enemies around, and aim at supports or structures that will cause the rest to collapse.
Keep your distance when you fire at close targets, because explosions can hit you as well as the enemies.
If a level feels stuck, reset your approach and try a different angle or weapon rather than repeating the same shot.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You need to wipe out all the enemies in the level to win. Destroying their bases and buildings helps you reach that goal.
How do I aim and shoot?
On a computer, use right click to aim and shoot. On mobile devices, touch the screen to aim and shoot.

finnie-escape.intro: Finnie Escape is a puzzle adventure where you guide a small fish through underwater mazes on a grid. Each level adds new obstacles, so plan each move before you make it.
tips: Before moving, trace the full route to the exit in your head so you can spot dead ends and enemy paths early.
Watch how enemies move for a few turns before committing, since their pattern is often the key to finding a safe gap.
Try the environment on early moves to learn what each object does, and keep notes on what works for later levels.
Save your special abilities for moments when the path is blocked or an enemy is closing in, rather than using them right away.
If a level feels stuck, step back and look for a different route instead of repeating the same moves, since the safest path is rarely the first one you try.
faq: How do I move Finnie?
Use the arrow keys or the W, A, S and D keys to move one step at a time across the grid.
What should I focus on in each level?
Look for the safest path to the exit, keep track of enemy positions, and notice the new obstacles each level introduces.

animal-impossible-track-rush.intro: Animal Impossible Track Rush is a 3D racing game where you control an animal running across a track. You race, perform parkour-style stunts, and bounce through a challenging course.
tips: Watch the track ahead rather than only your animal, so you can see stunts and bounces coming before you reach them.
Use your click or tap input with timing in mind, since the stunts depend on when you act rather than how often you act.
Stay calm after a bad bounce or stumble and refocus on the next section, because the course is built to test steady control.
Keep your attention on your position in the race, and avoid taking risks early that could cost you the lead later.
Replay the course to learn where the hardest stunts appear, then aim to handle those sections more cleanly each run.
faq: What is the goal of Animal Impossible Track Rush?
The goal is to race your animal across the track while performing impossible stunts and bounces. Finishing ahead of the competition is the main aim.
How do I control the animal?
You play with a mouse click or by tapping the screen. Use the same input to respond to the course as it unfolds.

car-rush-game.intro: Car Rush is a racing game set on retro-style tracks full of obstacles. You race against the clock and need to handle speed and control as the terrain gets harder.
tips: Watch the road a few seconds ahead rather than the obstacle right in front of you, so you have time to adjust your line.
Ease off speed before tight sections and obstacles instead of braking late, since losing control costs more time than slowing down briefly.
Treat the early tracks as practice for learning how your car responds, then carry those habits into the harder terrain.
Keep track of the clock throughout each run, and avoid taking risks that could send you off course when you are already behind.
After a crash or mistake, restart with a clear plan for the trickiest spot rather than rushing back into the same problem.
faq: What is the main goal in Car Rush?
You race through each track with diverse obstacles and try to beat the clock. Every second counts toward how well you do.
How do I get better at handling the harder terrains?
Focus on managing your speed and staying in control through each difficult section. Precision matters more than going flat out everywhere.

my-bakery.intro: My Bakery is a cozy cooking game where you bake pastries, serve customers, and grow your café. Its simple pace suits a relaxed session.
tips: Keep an eye on arriving customers and try to serve them quickly, since that is the core loop of the game.
Bake ahead when you can so that pastries are ready as soon as guests arrive.
Spend your earnings on expanding your dining area when you can, because more seats let you serve more people.
Check newly unlocked recipes regularly and try them out, as they can help you keep up with a busier café.
Take short breaks between busy moments to keep the game relaxing rather than rushed.
faq: What is the main goal of My Bakery?
Your goal is to bake pastries and satisfy customers so that your café business grows. Serving guests quickly is central to how you progress.
How do I control the game?
On a computer, use the WASD keys or the mouse. On a phone, use your finger to play.

sword-master-slice-your-enemies.intro: Sword Master: Slice Your Enemies! is a 3D blade game where you slice enemies and destroy obstacles across many levels. Use a range of melee weapons, from knives to lightsabers, to clear each stage.
tips: Watch the direction of your mouse or swipe before you strike, since the game rewards precise slicing of enemies.
Pay attention to obstacles as well as enemies, because completing a level with maximum efficiency is part of the goal.
Try to keep your strikes steady rather than random, so each hold or swipe lands where you intend.
Unlock new weapons as you progress and experiment with them, since each one may suit different enemies or situations.
Take advantage of the slow-motion moments after a strike to study where the next enemies are coming from.
faq: What is the main goal of Sword Master: Slice Your Enemies!?
Your task is to slice enemies, destroy obstacles, and complete levels with maximum efficiency. You also unlock new weapons as you move forward.
How do I attack on a PC?
Hold down the left mouse button to strike, then move the mouse in the direction you want to slice.

tap-hunters.intro: Tap Hunters is a colorful clicker game where you tap monsters, build a team of heroes, and upgrade your gear. Each run helps you reach higher zones and stronger rewards.
tips: Coins collect automatically after a few seconds, so you can keep your attention on tapping monsters and only tap coins when they are close to you.
Spend coins on hero hires and upgrades as you go, since your team keeps defeating monsters for you as you build it.
Work toward zone 50, which unlocks the portal to a new world. Keep track of your progress so you know how far you still have to go.
Push into higher zones before you move on, because higher zones give better rewards in the new worlds.
When you start a new world, decide how to spend your gems and souls on upgrades, auto clicks, hero upgrades, or weapons based on what slows you down most.
faq: What is the main goal of Tap Hunters?
Defeat monsters, grow your hero team, and reach zone 50 to open the portal to a new world. Each new world gives you gems and souls to spend on upgrades.
How do I defeat monsters?
Tap or click on the monsters with your mouse or touch input to defeat them.

mother-simulator-beach-party-games.intro: Mother Simulator Beach Party Games is a 3D family holiday sim where you drive 4x4 jeeps, join beach races and picnics, and complete family missions across beaches, mountains and camping spots.
tips: Press I early to reread the instructions, then practise moving with WASD before you start a mission so the controls feel natural.
Save Left Shift for longer stretches of open ground, since sprinting is quicker but makes it harder to steer carefully on rough off-road tracks.
Take your time on challenging terrain in the 4x4 jeep and go slowly over steep or uneven sections rather than racing through them.
Use F to interact with people and objects, and check your current mission goal often so you do not wander off without completing the task.
Explore the beaches, mountains and picnic spots between missions, since unlocking rewards and completing challenging objectives is part of the fun.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You move through a family holiday by completing missions and activities such as beach races, camping, picnics and sightseeing. Completing objectives also unlocks new rewards.
What controls do I use on desktop?
Use WASD to move, Left Shift to sprint, and F for actions. Press P or Tab to pause, Ctrl to open settings, and I to see the instructions again.

obby-easy-grow.intro: Obby Easy Grow! is an obstacle course game where you change your character's size to get past obstacles and reach the finish. Checkpoints save your progress, and each level is also a race against the timer.
tips: Try a different size before you give up on an obstacle. Some gaps and barriers may be easier to handle when your character is bigger or smaller.
Use checkpoints as your safety net. If you fall, you restart from the last checkpoint instead of the beginning, so it's worth pushing forward carefully.
Hold the right mouse button to rotate the camera and look at the course ahead before you commit to a jump.
Since each level is timed, focus on smooth, steady movement and avoid wasting time on the same mistake. Repeating a level helps you improve your result.
Press F to push enemies that get in your way, and use TAB to pause if you need a moment to plan your next move.
faq: How do I change my character's size?
Move the slider on the screen or use the mouse wheel forward and backward. Size changes are the main way to overcome obstacles.
What happens if I fall off the course?
You don't have to start the whole level over. Checkpoints save your progress, so you return to the most recent one.

dream-castle.intro: Dream Castle is a match-3 puzzle game where you match apples, bells and magic crystals to help a princess restore her ruined castle. Coins earned in levels pay for repairs, cleaning and furniture.
tips: Look for moves that clear several matches at once, since each successful combo earns more coins and magical energy.
Spend coins on the repairs that open up the most rooms or tasks first, so you can unlock new areas sooner.
Save boosters for levels that stall you, rather than using them on early, easy levels.
Check the characters and their tasks between levels, because finishing them can unlock new rooms.
Come back each day to collect the daily bonuses and login rewards to build up coins for furniture.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Match three or more identical items such as apples, bells or crystals in a row to collect them. The level is about collecting items through matches.
How do I earn coins?
Each successful combo earns you coins and magical energy. You then spend coins on restoring halls, cleaning and buying furniture.

funny-cars-reload.intro: Funny Cars Reload is a 3D cartoon racing game where you drive colorful cars through tracks with obstacles. Each level gets harder as you progress.
tips: Use A and D in small, steady taps rather than holding them, so the car stays under control on curves.
Tap S before a sharp turn to slow down, then press W again once you are pointing the right way.
Watch the obstacles ahead and adjust your steering early instead of correcting at the last moment.
Try the early levels a few times to learn how each car handles before moving on to harder tracks.
If you crash or fall behind, use S to reverse and get back on the route quickly rather than pushing forward off-track.
faq: What is the goal of Funny Cars Reload?
Race through each cartoon track, overcome the obstacles, and progress through the levels as the challenges increase.
Which keys control the car?
Use W or the up arrow to accelerate, S or the down arrow to brake or reverse, A or the left arrow to steer left, and D or the right arrow to steer right.

goal-io.intro: Goal.io is a fast football game played in your browser. You have 3 minutes to score as many goals as you can and climb the leaderboard. Move with the W, A, S and D keys.
tips: Keep track of the 3-minute timer, since every second you spend out of position is time you can't use to score.
Move early toward where the ball is heading rather than chasing it once it arrives, which saves time and keeps you in control.
Pay attention to your timing: rushing a shot when you aren't set up often wastes the chance.
Start each attempt by watching how the ball moves for a moment before you act, so your reactions are based on what's happening.
Use short bursts of movement to adjust your position instead of running in one direction, which makes it easier to line up a shot.
faq: What is the goal of Goal.io?
The goal is to score big within the 3-minute time limit and rank high on the leaderboard.
How do I move my player?
Use the W, A, S and D keys to move. The instructions list these as WADS.

kuli.intro: KULI is a zombie survival game split into two phases. You build defenses during the day and fight off the undead at night, aiming to last through the apocalypse.
tips: Spend the daytime phase on defenses that cover the directions zombies approach from, rather than building everything in one spot.
Check your defenses for weak points before night falls, since repairs and fixes are harder to make once the attack starts.
Keep some resources in reserve after building so you can adjust your setup if the first night goes differently than planned.
Treat each mini-challenge as practice for your building and firing, and note which approaches work so you can repeat them.
Save your strongest firepower for the most dangerous moments of the night instead of spending it on the first waves.
faq: What is the main goal of KULI?
Survive the zombie apocalypse by building defenses during the day and holding them off through the night.
How do the day and night phases work together?
