Daytime is for strategy and construction, and nighttime is when you use your firepower against the undead. What you build by day determines how well you hold up after dark.

mary-run.intro: Mary Run is a fast-paced adventure where you sprint through changing landscapes, dodge shadows, and gather coins and treasures. Each run reveals new secrets and challenges.
tips: Pick up coins whenever it is safe, since they are the resource you use for upgrades and abilities.
Watch the shadows closely and plan your route around them so you can keep your speed up.
Pay attention to how the terrain changes between runs, as the layout can make the same path feel different.
Take a moment to look for treasures and hidden areas, because the game rewards exploration as well as speed.
Decide early which enemies are worth dealing with and which are best avoided to stay on course during each sprint.
faq: What is the main goal in Mary Run?

You move through fast sprints across shifting terrains, dodging shadows, discovering treasures, and conquering enemies along the way. The game encourages you to uncover secrets and meet its challenges.
What are coins used for in Mary Run?
Coins can be collected and used for upgrades and powerful abilities. Gathering them during your runs helps you strengthen your character over time.

fishing-catch-the-moment.intro: Fishing: Catch the Moment! is a relaxing 3D fishing game where you aim, cast, and reel in fish across changing weather and times of day. Build your collection and go after the heaviest trophy.
tips: Aim before you charge the cast. Move the mouse or swipe to pick a spot first, since the line goes where you point it.
Watch the indicator closely during the mini-game and try to keep it inside the yellow zone. Small, steady corrections usually work better than big jerky ones.
Take your time with critical catches. Landing them successfully is how you get the heavier and rarer fish.
Sell your catch regularly so you have money to upgrade your tackle. Better gear makes the bigger fish easier to handle.
Unlock new locations when you can. Each spot brings different fish, so moving around helps you build a wider collection.
faq: How do I cast my line?
Press and hold to prepare the cast, then release to send the line out. Aim first by moving the mouse or swiping left and right.
What do I do when a fish bites?
Press the screen or mouse button to hook it, then keep the indicator inside the yellow zone during the mini-game.

bubble-shooter-mega.intro: Bubble Shooter Mega is a bubble-popping puzzle game where you aim and shoot red, yellow, and blue bubbles to clear the board. Plan each shot carefully, since you have a limited number of shots to reach the score goal.
tips: Check both next-bubble previews before you aim, so you can plan which color to shoot next.
Watch the trajectory line while dragging, and adjust until it lands where you want before you release.
Aim for shots that drop bubbles into groups of three or more of the same color to start chain reactions.
Keep an eye on the walls moving in, and clear the rows closest to them first.
Track your shots remaining against your score so you can decide whether to take a safe match or a riskier shot.
faq: What is the main goal of Bubble Shooter Mega?
Reach the trophy score goal, such as 1100, while clearing the encroaching walls. You also have a set number of shots, shown as 16 shots remaining at the start.
How do I shoot a bubble?
On desktop, drag the mouse to aim along the trajectory line, then click or release to shoot. On touch controls, drag to aim and tap or release to shoot.

bridge-builders.intro: Bridge Builders is a race against the clock where you gather materials, build bridges quickly, and try to finish ahead of your rivals. Win the race to earn rewards.
tips: Collect materials steadily instead of rushing ahead with too few, since you need them to keep building bridges.
Plan each bridge before you start it so you spend your time on the crossing rather than on fixing mistakes.
Watch where the tactical pitfalls are and avoid them, because a single setback can cost you the lead.
Keep an eye on your rivals' positions so you know when to push for speed and when to play it safer.
Focus on the finish line as your final goal, since the race is won by crossing it first.
faq: What is the main goal of Bridge Builders?
The goal is to race against time and cross the finish line before your rivals to claim victory and rewards.
What do I need in order to build bridges?
You collect materials during the race and use them to construct bridges, so gathering enough is key to keeping your pace.

drift-tycoon.intro: Drift Tycoon is an idle game where you buy cars, upgrade them and let them earn coins while they drive around the track. Build a bigger garage to grow your income over time.
tips: Keep the game running while you check other panels, since your cars earn income as they drive around the track.
Spend coins on the cars or upgrades that add the most income for their cost, so your earnings grow faster.
Check the tasks panel regularly, because completing tasks gives extra rewards you can use for new cars or upgrades.
Look at the achievements panel to see which goals are close, and focus your spending on the ones that help you reach them.
Wait until you have made good progress before using prestige, since it resets your current progress in exchange for prestige points and perks.
faq: What is the main goal of Drift Tycoon?
The goal is to build a strong garage of cars that earn coins while driving around the track. A stronger garage generates more coins over time.
How do upgrades affect my income?
Upgrades increase the income your cars generate, which helps you grow your garage faster. Spending coins on upgrades is one of the main ways to speed up progress.

fighter-car-shooting.intro: Fighter Car Shooting is a fast vehicle combat game where you pick a car and weapons, then blast opponents across explosive battle modes. You can face multiplayer rivals or AI adversaries.
tips: Try a few vehicle and weapon combinations before settling on one, since the game lets you customize both. Notice which setup feels right for your driving and shooting style.
Keep an eye out for power-ups as you move around the battlefield. Grabbing them can give you an edge in a fight.
Study the layout of each battlefield before engaging. Knowing where you can move quickly and where you might get cornered helps you plan your route.
Pay attention to how each explosive mode changes the goal of a match. Adjusting your approach to the mode can matter more than raw firepower.
If you are new, play against AI opponents first to learn how fights flow. Then move on to multiplayer matches once you feel comfortable with the pace.
faq: What is the main goal of Fighter Car Shooting?
The goal is to blast your foes in high-speed vehicle combat. Navigate the battlefield, use your weapons, and outmaneuver your opponents.
Can I customize my car in this game?
Yes, you can choose from a range of customizable vehicles and weapons. Trying different combinations can help you find a setup that suits how you like to fight.

stunt-planes.intro: Stunt Planes is a racing game where you pilot World War II-inspired warplanes through 3D environments. Races are action-packed, with power-ups and realistic physics to handle.
tips: Use Break (C) before tight turns instead of turning hard at full speed, so the plane stays under control.
Save Booster (X) for open stretches where you are already lined up, rather than using it while you are still correcting your heading.
Use the Camera (N) key to switch views when you need a clearer sense of your position relative to obstacles or other planes.
Use Space to activate power-ups as soon as you have them, especially when you are in a close race and a boost could change your position.
If you play two-player, set your own keys in the settings so your hands are comfortable and do not overlap on the keyboard.
faq: How do I steer my plane?
Player 1 uses the arrow keys to turn left and right and to move up and down. Player 2 uses W, A, S and D.
How do I pause the game?
Press P or Escape to pause. Press the same key to return to play.

whiskers-adventures.intro: Whiskers Adventures is a 3D puzzle adventure where you guide a clever cat through levels full of puzzles, obstacles, and rewards. Explore each new world and work toward its goals.
tips: Before you move, look around each level and find the goal and any obstacles in your way.
Use Q and E to rotate the view or pieces and check the puzzle from more than one angle before committing to a move.
Move the cat with W, A, S, and D in small steps so you can react to obstacles as they appear.
Pay attention to the environment, since the clues for solving a puzzle are often in the details of each world.
If you get stuck, step back, rotate the view, and check the layout again instead of repeating the same move.
faq: What is the goal of Whiskers Adventures?
You guide a clever cat through levels filled with puzzles and obstacles, working toward the goals of each level and earning rewards along the way.
How do I control the cat?
Use W, A, S, and D to move the cat, and use Q and E to rotate. You can also click or tap to play.

basketball-rush.intro: Basketball Rush is a two-minute arcade shooting game. Drag to set the arc of each throw, release to shoot, and build a multiplier by making shots in a row.
tips: Build a streak before you chase distance. A miss resets your multiplier, so consistent makes at a moderate range can beat a few long shots that miss.
Use the dotted arc line to judge how the ball will travel before you let go. Adjusting the top of the arc is the main way to control where it lands.
Aim for clean swishes when you can. They add 1 point on top of the shot's value, which helps your score more than a rattling shot.
Use Practice to learn the long shots, since it has no clock and doesn't count toward your score. Then use what you learned in ranked games.
Watch the last seconds. A shot released before 0:00 that drops after the buzzer still earns 5 extra points, so a late release can still pay off.
faq: What is the goal of Basketball Rush?
Score as many points as you can before the two-minute clock runs out. Each make is worth the length of the shot times your multiplier.
How does the multiplier work?
A clean swish adds 1, a bank shot adds 0.5, and each make in a row adds another 1, up to a maximum of x10. One miss ends the streak.

crazy-flying-car.intro: Crazy Flying Car is a racing game where you drive a winged car along the track or launch off it over the abyss to shortcut your way to the finish line. Overtake rivals and be first across.
tips: Watch the track ahead before you take a jump. Launching off the edge only pays off when the air route is clearly shorter than the road.
Use the ground for steady speed and save flights for sections where the track bends a lot or drops away.
When rivals are close, pushing them on the road can be a safer way to gain position than risking a long flight.
Practice the timing of your takeoff and landing on a few laps so you learn how far your car carries in the air.
Keep an eye on where your rivals are. If you are already ahead, a cautious drive usually beats a risky flight.
faq: What is the goal of Crazy Flying Car?
The goal is to reach the finish line before your rivals. You can drive along the track or fly off it to shorten the path.
How do I steer on PC?
Use the A and D keys to control the car. The instructions also mention the arrow keys for control.

sworded-io-spin-and-rub.intro: Sworded io - Spin and Rub is a fast-paced arcade sword-fighting game where you battle waves of opponents in arenas. You move around with WASD, arrow keys, or mouse drag, and you can pick up weapons and power-ups as you go.
tips: Move constantly rather than standing still, since the game is built around fast-paced, spin-powered action.
Try different weapons such as swords, axes, and knives to find which one suits your playstyle before committing to a fight.
Grab power-ups when it is safe to do so, because they can shift the tide of combat in your favor.
Watch how opponents move and time your attacks for moments when they are exposed, rather than attacking randomly.
Try both Domination and Battle Royal modes to learn which format rewards your timing and tactics more.
faq: What is the goal of Sworded io - Spin and Rub?

The game asks you to test your reflexes, tactics, and timing against waves of opponents, upgrade your fighter, and conquer battle arenas. The description also says you can compete and rise as the ultimate warrior.
How do I move my fighter on PC?
Use the WASD keys or the arrow keys to move, or drag with the left mouse button. On mobile, use the in-game joystick.

top-shootout-the-saloon.intro: Top Shootout: The Saloon is a Wild West arcade shooter where you rescue hostages held by bandits inside a saloon. Shoot the bandits and their bosses while keeping your gun loaded.
tips: Tap to shoot, and let your gun recharge between shots so you are never caught with an empty weapon.
Pay attention to where bandits appear and aim at the ones closest to the hostages first.
Watch the bosses carefully, since they need to be defeated along with the other bandits to clear the saloon.
Keep a steady rhythm of shooting and recharging instead of tapping rapidly, which can leave you without ammo at the critical moment.
Stay focused on the hostages' safety, as the goal is to rescue them rather than just shooting everything in sight.
faq: What is the goal of Top Shootout: The Saloon?
Your goal is to rescue the hostages held in the saloon by shooting all the bandits and their bosses.
How do I shoot and reload?
Tap the screen to shoot, and the tap also recharges your gun, so tap again once it is ready.

basket-sport-stars.intro: Basket Sport Stars is a fast arcade basketball game where you score as many baskets as you can before the buzzer. You can play a quick 90-second match, a tournament, practice, or a local two-player game on one keyboard.
tips: Spend a few minutes in Practice Mode before your first Quick Match so you learn how the jump timing and aiming line behave.
Watch the dotted trajectory line as you hold the shoot key, and release when the aiming indicator turns green, since that window closes quickly.
Do not rush your shots. A calm, well-timed release usually beats a fast press, because the green window is short and easy to miss.
When your opponent has the ball, step in and attack when they are lining up a shot, then get back to your own basket before they recover.
Avoid attacking non-stop, because a rushed attack can leave your basket open. Pressure only when it counts, especially near the end of a 90-second match.
faq: What is the goal of Basket Sport Stars?
Score more baskets than your opponent before the time runs out. In Quick Match, the player with the most points when the 90 seconds end wins.
How do I know when a shot is likely to go in?
The aiming indicator briefly turns green when the shot has a strong chance of reaching the hoop. Release the shoot key during that short window for the most accurate attempt.

soccer-heroes.intro: Soccer Heroes is a fast-paced football game where you lead your squad against opponents. Success depends on strong timing, quick swipes, and both scoring and defending.
tips: Watch the opponents' movement before you act, since the game rewards good timing over rushing in.
Use short, quick swipes to keep the ball moving rather than making slow, predictable passes.
Focus on one attack at a time so you can finish with a clear shot instead of spreading your effort.
When the other team has the ball, prioritize defending over chasing, and return to a position that blocks their path to goal.
Pay attention to the controls early in a match so your swipes become automatic before the pace picks up.
faq: What is the main goal of Soccer Heroes?
You command your football squad to outmaneuver opponents, score goals, and defend your own goal during fast-paced matches.
What skills matter most in Soccer Heroes?
Mastering timings and making swift swipes are the core skills, combined with positioning both in attack and defense.

ultimate-horse-simulator.intro: Ultimate Horse Simulator puts you in charge of a wild Arabian horse in a savanna jungle. Find a mate, raise your foals, and survive the predators that hunt them.
tips: Keep an eye on your energy and look for food and water before you need them, since your horse depends on both to stay strong.
Keep your baby horses close to the family and stay between them and predators when a threat appears.
Save your special attacks for dangerous fights, such as when a lion or tiger reaches your herd, instead of using them on every encounter.
Use Sprint to break away from a predator or reach a safe spot quickly, and save it for when you really need the speed.
Explore the forest early to find safe places for your family, so you know where to retreat when a fight goes badly.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You survive in the wild, protect and raise your horse family, and complete survival and fighting missions to become the strongest horse in the jungle.
What are the attack controls on desktop?
Press E for a basic attack, V for Special Attack 1, and X for Special Attack 2. Coins are used to unlock new horses and upgrades.

stickman-epic-fall.intro: Stickman Epic Fall is an action game about ragdoll physics and freefalling from great heights. Your run is a race against gravity, and each descent plays out differently.
tips: Watch how your stickman tumbles and bounces on the first drop, since ragdoll physics makes every fall a little different.
Plan your fall before it starts. Think about which obstacles lie on your path and where you want to land.
Treat each descent as a new challenge rather than repeating the last one, because the game is built around unpredictable outcomes.
Pay attention to what increases damage, since the game asks you to maximize it, and adjust your approach to aim for bigger impacts.
Keep your attempts short and focused. Learning from one fall at a time makes it easier to improve on the next.
faq: What is the goal of Stickman Epic Fall?
Your goal is to plummet from dizzying heights, get past treacherous obstacles, and maximize damage in a race against gravity.
Are there written instructions for the controls?
No written instructions are provided for this game, so try small movements early on to see how your stickman responds.

car-chase-parking.intro: Car Chase Parking is a racing arcade game where you dodge police cars on crowded streets and try to park in open spots. Timing and quick reactions matter most.
tips: Scan the road ahead early so you can spot police cars and gaps in traffic before they get close.
Brake with timing rather than all at once, since a well-timed stop is what lets you park in a tight spot.
Pick your parking spot before you commit to a turn, so you are not forced into a risky move at the last second.
Keep your speed under control in crowded areas, because going faster leaves you less room to react.
Focus on staying out of capture first, then go for parking spots, as escaping keeps your run going.
faq: What is the main goal in Car Chase Parking?
You dodge police cars, avoid being caught, and snag parking spots to score points. The game is built around reflexes and strategy.
What makes this game hard?
Crowded streets and fast police cars leave little time to react. Good braking timing and steady focus help you stay ahead of pursuit.

cube-zone-master.intro: Cube Zone Master is a 3D .io game where you command a cube, devour smaller cubes, and outmaneuver rivals in a shifting geometric realm. Strategy and quick reflexes decide how far you get.
tips: Look for smaller cubes you can safely devour, since growing by eating them is the core of the game.
Keep track of rival cubes around you and avoid moving into open ground near larger ones.
Use quick reflexes to dodge threats, especially when the arena changes around you.
Plan your route before you commit, so you are not cornered between bigger rivals.
Pick your targets carefully: a few safe meals usually beat a risky chase after a fast-moving cube.
faq: What is the main goal in Cube Zone Master?
The goal is to control and conquer the realm by outmaneuvering rivals and ruling the zone. You do this by commanding your cube and devouring smaller ones.
How does my cube get bigger?
You grow by devouring smaller cubes, so target those whenever you can do it safely.

steal-and-catch-obby-mini-games.intro: Steal and Catch Obby: Mini-Games is an arcade game built around earning money, upgrading your base, and planning ahead. You buy creatures, bring them back to your territory, and collect passive income from them.
tips: Save up for the rarer, more expensive units early on, since the description says they bring higher profits and faster development.
Look at the value of each creature before you buy it, and pick the ones that will pay you back the most over time.
Get your captured creatures back to your territory as soon as you can, because your passive income depends on having them there.
Use the 1 to 5 keys to switch weapons quickly so you are ready to punch or defend when you run into trouble.
Use Shift to run when you need to cover ground fast, and save Space for jumps over obstacles on the obby parts.
faq: What is the main goal of Steal and Catch Obby: Mini-Games?
The main goal is to earn money, upgrade your base, and grow your territory. Buying and bringing back creatures is how you build passive income.
How do I earn money in the game?
You earn money by buying creatures, transporting them to your territory, and collecting the passive income they produce. Rarer and more expensive units give you higher profits.

no-shorts.intro: No Shorts is a ragdoll physics game where you aim a cannon at stickmen and the environment to cause as much damage as you can. You can swipe through levels quickly and build your own scenarios.
tips: Before you fire, look at where the stickmen and objects are placed, since the damage depends on what your shot hits.
Try clicking in different places on the same level to see how the ragdolls and the stage react, and note which spots cause the most damage.
Swipe up and down between levels often. Each stage sets up different targets, so comparing them helps you learn what works.
If you want to test a setup, open the level designer and build a simple stage first, then add more objects once you see how the physics behaves.
Like the levels you enjoy most, since that is how you can show support for creators and find the designs worth playing again.
faq: What is the goal of No Shorts?
Your goal is to cause as much damage as possible to the stickmen and the environment by shooting from a cannon. Each shot is a chance to see how the ragdolls react.
How do I shoot in the game?
Click in the right place on the screen to shoot. The game is controlled with one finger, so a single click is all you need to interact.

subway-winter-vacation.intro: Subway Winter Vacation is a racing game set on snowy subway rails. Your character runs forward on its own while you avoid dangers coming from several directions on a three-lane track.
tips: Watch the three lanes ahead rather than your character, so you can plan which lane to move into before a danger reaches you.
Keep your attention on the lanes that look clear and avoid switching lanes at the last moment, since that leaves little room to react.
Expect danger from all sides, so check behind and beside your character as well as in front.
Notice the policeman mentioned in the instructions and treat him as a threat to avoid, not something to run into.
Play a few short rounds to learn how the snowy track and obstacles move before aiming for a longer run.
faq: What is the goal of Subway Winter Vacation?
Your character runs forward along the snowy rails automatically, and your job is to keep running while avoiding danger from every side.
Do I need to steer the character forward?
No, the character runs forward on its own, so your focus is on staying safe in the lanes.

nubik-vs-herobrin-s-army.intro: Nubik vs Herobrin's Army is a pixel adventure where you play as Nubik, crafting and upgrading weapons to fight Herobrine's army and rescue your brother. Battles and challenges change as you go.
tips: Craft and upgrade weapons whenever you can, since your gear is central to surviving the fights.
Try different weapons against different foes to see which ones work best in each situation.
Pay attention to how enemies change during battles, and adjust your approach instead of repeating the same moves.
Explore each area before pushing forward so you can find resources and prepare for what lies ahead.
Mix careful strategy with quick reactions, because the game rewards both planning and dexterity.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You play as Nubik, and your goal is to rescue your brother by facing Herobrine's army and getting through a range of challenges.
How do weapons work in this game?
You craft weapons and upgrade them as you progress, and the description highlights these weapons as dynamic, so it pays to experiment with them.

killmaster-secret-agent.intro: KillMaster Secret Agent is a shooting game where you guide a secret agent through snowy streets, eliminating masked men and dealing with tough bosses. Aim carefully and use the explosive barrels to clear groups of enemies.
tips: Aim at explosive barrels when enemies are standing close to them, since one blast can take out several targets at once.
Watch the agent's movement and line up your shots before firing, because the game rewards shooting at the right angle.
Save your fire for bosses if you can, and pay attention to their pattern rather than shooting wildly.
Keep moving through the snowy streets to stay out of enemy lines of fire while you look for clean shots.
If you collect enough to buy other avatars, consider which one suits your play style to improve your agent's skills.
faq: How do I shoot in KillMaster Secret Agent?
Use the right mouse button on a computer. On touch screen devices, tap the screen to shoot.
What is the main goal of the game?
Control the agent's movement and eliminate the masked men across the levels, while dealing with the bosses you meet along the way.

build-a-go-kart.intro: Build a go-kart track from modular blocks, then drive it to earn money for each segment. Your layout decides how much you make, so the goal is to balance speed against profit.
tips: Start with a simple track of straights and turns so you can see how much each segment earns before adding more complex parts.
Test your track after each change. Drive the full route to check which sections pay well and which slow you down.
Boosters speed you up, but dangerous sections can cost you. Add risky parts only where the extra speed or income clearly makes up for the risk.
Spend your earnings on the blocks that add the most profit to your current route, rather than on skins or decoration.
Check the daily rewards every day, since they give you a steady boost to your progress without extra driving.
faq: What is the main goal of Build a Go-Kart?
Build a track from different blocks, then drive your kart along it to earn money for each segment. Use the income to unlock new blocks, expand your building area, and improve your track.
How do I control my kart on PC?
Use WASD to move, Space to jump or exit the kart, E to interact, and the mouse to move the camera. On mobile, use the virtual joystick to move and the buttons for jump and interact.

boss-level-shootout.intro: Boss Level Shootout puts you in control of Billy, who is trapped in a retro console world. Run, jump, and blast your way through challenging levels and face off against formidable bosses.
tips: Watch each boss for a few seconds before you commit to an attack so you can spot its pattern.
Grab power-ups whenever they are safe to reach, since they can help you handle the harder parts of a level.
Use jumps to get out of the way of incoming threats instead of trying to tank every hit.
Expect to lose a few runs while you learn a level; each attempt shows you where the danger spots are.
Stay steady rather than rushing, because bosses often punish careless movement more than slow play.
faq: What is the goal of Boss Level Shootout?
You guide Billy through challenging levels, blasting enemies and defeating the bosses you face along the way.
What actions does Billy use?
The description highlights running, jumping, and shooting, so focus on combining those to move past obstacles and attack bosses.

bank-robbery-puzzle-shooter.intro: Bank Robbery Puzzle Shooter is a 3D strategy game where you guide your character from point to point toward the money counter. Collect cash to raise your score while handling obstacles along the way.
tips: Plan your route before each move, since every step between points is a chance to meet an obstacle. Choosing a safer path can keep your character moving toward the money counter.
Watch the scene after each click or tap so you can see where obstacles are about to appear. Reacting early gives you more time to defend.
Do not rush every move. Pausing to read the layout can help you pick the point that gets you closer to the cash with less risk.
Treat collecting cash as the main goal, because the score rises with each reward you gather. Keep your focus on reaching the money counter rather than wandering.
Stay calm if you lose ground to an obstacle and reassess your path from where you stand. A steady approach often works better than repeated fast clicks.
faq: How do I move my character?
Use a mouse click or tap to move your character from one point to the next. Each move takes you closer to the money counter.
How do I increase my score?
Collect the cash by reaching the money counter, since collecting cash is what raises your score.

alex-whiskers.intro: Play as Alex Whiskers, a town cat hunting for fish through busy streets. Jump, dodge traffic, and keep away from the bulldogs in this fast 3D platformer.
tips: Use the spacebar to time jumps before you reach a gap or obstacle, since jumping is how you get past most danger.
Land on springs when you want extra height, and plan your next move while you are in the air.
Keep an eye on speeding cars and wait for a safe gap before crossing a street instead of rushing in.
Use the mouse to look left and right ahead of time so you can spot bulldogs before they get close.
Keep your movement smooth rather than tapping randomly, because small steady adjustments help you avoid getting caught.
faq: What is the goal of Alex Whiskers?
You guide Alex through the town to hunt for tasty fish while avoiding cars and bulldogs.
How do I move and jump?
Use the arrow keys or WASD to move and the spacebar to jump. You can also use the mouse to look left and right.

roar-of-city.intro: Roar of City is a retro action fighter where you face waves of adversaries as a lone fighter in chaotic city streets. Its thumping sound effects and groovy soundtrack set a nostalgic mood.
tips: Save your special moves for when you are surrounded or facing a tougher opponent, since the game rewards using them strategically.
Pay attention to the space around you. Keeping room to move helps you avoid getting boxed in by a crowd of adversaries.
Use the rhythm of the thumping sound effects and soundtrack to notice when enemies are attacking or when a new wave is arriving.
Clear each wave before the next one builds up, so you do not end up fighting several groups at the same time.
Think of each fight as a short exchange rather than a race. Patience and well-timed attacks usually matter more than button mashing.
faq: What is the goal of Roar of City?
You play as a lone fighter who has to fend off waves of adversaries in a chaotic city setting. Keep fighting through each wave to survive.
How do special moves work?
Special moves deal powerful damage and can open up space around you. Use them strategically rather than spamming them, especially when you are crowded.

fashion-foot-shop-game.intro: Fashion Foot Shop is a makeover game where you run a foot shop, treat customers' foot problems, and design nail styles to suit each person. It is played with a mouse or by tapping.
tips: Look at each customer's foot problem first, such as long or dirty nails or wounds, and deal with that before moving on to decoration.
Work through the basic care steps in order so the nails are clean and ready before you add any nail art.
Pay attention to each customer's characteristics, since the game asks you to design nails that suit them rather than one style for everyone.
Take your time with the nail design step, because it is the creative part of the game and a well-matched style is the goal.
Try different colours and designs on different customers to see which combinations work best for each character.
faq: What is the goal of Fashion Foot Shop?
Your goal is to run the foot shop, help customers with their foot problems, and design nail styles that match each customer's characteristics.
What kinds of problems do customers have?
The game mentions problems such as long nails, dirty nails and wounds on the feet.

racing-project-kit.intro: Racing Project Kit combines fast driving with creative track building. You can design your own circuits, tune your car, and race friends in split-screen mode.
tips: Build a short, simple circuit first so you can test how your track plays before adding complexity.
Change one car setting at a time and rerun the same track, so you can see exactly what each adjustment does to your speed and handling.
Use a varied layout with a mix of straights and corners, since a track that tests both skill and imagination gives you more to learn from.
Race your own track several times to spot spots where you lose time, then redesign those sections to make them more fun or fairer.
When playing split-screen, agree on the rules with your friend before starting, such as how many laps you will race, so the contest feels fair.
faq: How do I win a race in Racing Project Kit?

The description does not spell out a win condition, so check the results screen after your first race to see how placement is shown. Focus on clean, consistent driving to improve your finishing position.
What should I adjust when tuning my car?
Start with one setting at a time and rerun the same track to compare results. This makes it easier to tell which change actually helps your performance.

words-and-bubbles.intro: Words and Bubbles is a word association puzzle where you tap bubbles that share a common meaning and merge them into a named category. Each level asks you to find every useful combination before your moves run out.
tips: Look for the shared meaning first, not the exact spelling or sound of the words. Connections are based on what the words mean together.
Before tapping, check whether a word could fit more than one group. Choosing the wrong pairing can use up a move and block a better combination.
Pay attention to categories you have already completed. The instructions say they can be used in later combinations, so a finished category may unlock new links.
Keep an eye on your remaining moves and aim to clear the easiest connections early so you are not left with tricky words at the end.
Save boosters for levels where you are truly stuck. Spend a little time looking for connections on your own first.
faq: What is the goal of Words and Bubbles?
Your goal is to tap bubbles containing words with a common meaning, merge them into a bubble showing the category name, and complete every available combination in each level.
What happens when I pick a wrong combination?
The bubbles do not merge when the combination is incorrect. Check the word meanings again and try a different pairing before your moves run out.

diggy.intro: Diggy puts you in the role of an astronaut digging through the Moon's depths in search of minerals and riches. Your controls take some getting used to, and a ticking clock keeps every descent moving.
tips: Spend your first few digs getting a feel for the controls before you try to collect anything valuable, since the controls are described as mind-bending.
Keep an eye on the clock as you go, and avoid digging so far that you run out of time before you can use what you have found.
Collect minerals you pass along the way instead of only racing downward, so each trip brings back something useful.
Use your earnings to upgrade your gear when you can afford it, because better equipment can make deeper digs more practical.
Treat each run as a chance to learn more about the layout below, and plan your next descent based on what you saw on the last one.
faq: What is the main goal of Diggy?
You explore the Moon by digging deeper, collecting precious minerals, and upgrading your gear. The game asks whether you can uncover the Moon's secrets.
How much does the clock matter?
The clock is always ticking, so time is a limit you need to plan around. Balancing how deep you dig with how much time you have left is a key part of playing well.

neo-traffic-rider-championship.intro: Neo Traffic Rider Championship is a sportbike racing game where you race seven rivals across six destinations. Steer through traffic, use slipstreams and boost, and work through 18 championship events.
tips: Use the slipstream from riders ahead of you to build speed for a slingshot pass, then time your boost for the moment you pull out.
Save boost for the right moment rather than spending it early, since you replenish it over the course of a run.
Pick your passing line early, especially in dense traffic, so you are not forced to swerve at the last second.
Brake with S or Down Arrow before tight bends on winding roads instead of braking late, which keeps your bike under control.
Between events, spend upgrades on your engine and tyres, and try Rider Trials or Unlimited Run to practise and beat your personal distance record.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Your goal is to win championship events across six destinations against seven rivals, and to keep riding in Unlimited Run to beat your personal distance record.
Which keys control the bike?
Use A and D or the Left and Right Arrows to steer, W or Up Arrow to accelerate when Auto Throttle is off, and S or Down Arrow to brake. Space or Shift activates boost, and Esc or P pauses the game.

archer-ro.intro: Archer.ro is a strategy shooter where you build up your empire and fight off endless waves of zombies with your hero archer. Move with WASD and shoot with the left mouse button.
tips: Keep your hero moving with WASD so you are never standing still while zombies close in.
Pick a steady rhythm of shots instead of firing in bursts, so you do not run out of position when a new wave arrives.
Build your structures early, since they support you for the rest of the run and make later waves easier to handle.
Spend upgrades on the improvements that help you most right now rather than spreading them thinly across everything.
Watch which direction the zombies come from each wave and place your defenses on that side first.
faq: What is the goal of Archer.ro?
The goal is to defend your empire against endless waves of zombies using your hero archer and the buildings you construct. The game keeps going as long as you can hold out.
How do I control the archer?
Use the W, A, S and D keys to move, and click the left mouse button to shoot. Movement and shooting are both needed to survive.

mr-shooter.intro: Mr Shooter is an arcade game where you tap to fire needles at spinning cactus targets. Pop all the balloons across the levels to win.
tips: Watch the target's spin for a moment before you fire, and aim your taps for the gaps between the needles already stuck in it.
Keep your taps steady and deliberate. Firing too quickly makes it easy to land a needle on one that is already in the target.
Each level gets faster and trickier, so expect your timing to need adjusting as you progress.
Pay attention to the cards you unlock and choose the ones that suit your playstyle before each level.
If a level feels too hard, slow down and reset your rhythm rather than rushing shots.
faq: What is the goal of Mr Shooter?
The goal is to pop all the balloons to win. You do this by hitting the spinning cactus targets with your needles.
How do you shoot in Mr Shooter?
Tap anywhere on the screen to shoot needles from Mr. Shooter.

abandoned-mansion.intro: Abandoned Mansion is a first-person horror game where a distress call brings you to an abandoned mansion. You explore, solve puzzles, and face monsters and bosses to uncover what happened inside.
tips: Check your inventory with Tab regularly so you know which items you are carrying before you enter a new area.
Interact with objects using E in every room, since puzzle clues and hidden items may be easy to miss at first glance.
Crouch with C when moving through dark or unfamiliar spaces to keep your movement quieter and more controlled.
Use R to reload before you walk into a tense room, so you are not caught with an empty weapon during an enemy encounter.
Conserve ammunition for boss fights and dangerous enemies, and avoid shooting at every monster you pass.
faq: What is the main goal of Abandoned Mansion?
You investigate the mansion after a distress call, solve its puzzles, and try to unravel its mystery while surviving the monsters inside.
How do I attack or shoot in the game?
Press the left mouse button to attack or shoot. Use R to reload your weapon when needed.

tom-and-angela-insta-fashion.intro: Tom and Angela Insta Fashion is a dress-up game where you style two characters for Instagram. You pick clothes, hairstyles and accessories to suit their moods and occasions, then take photos to post.
tips: Check each character's mood before you dress them, since the outfit and hair choices should match how they feel.
Think about the occasion first, so the look fits the setting instead of only looking good on its own.
Try a few combinations before taking a photo, and compare how the picture looks in the Instagram-style post.
Add accessories last to finish the look, and remove any item that clashes with the rest of the outfit.
Keep a fresh mix of styles across different occasions so your posts don't all look the same.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
The goal is to help Tom and Angela become Instagram famous by styling them and posting photos that get lots of likes.
How do I choose clothes and hairstyles?
Click items, tools and buttons with a mouse, or tap the screen on a touch device to select and apply each choice.

humans-playground-sandbox.intro: Humans Playground Sandbox is a physics-based sandbox where you craft, destroy, and manipulate objects and ragdoll characters. It has no set goal, so you decide what to build and test.
tips: Start by experimenting with a few objects and characters to see how the physics reacts before trying larger scenes.
Check the customizable settings early, since they can change how the sandbox behaves and suit the kind of scenario you want.
Try crafting a simple setup first, then destroy or move parts of it to see how each piece affects the rest.
Work in small steps and reset or adjust your scene when it gets cluttered, so you can clearly see cause and effect.
Keep a few different scenarios in mind, such as building, breaking, or arranging characters, and switch between them to keep things fresh.
faq: What is the goal of Humans Playground Sandbox?
The game is an open sandbox with no set goal. You create your own scenarios by crafting, destroying, and manipulating objects and ragdoll characters.
Is there a score or a way to win?
The game description does not mention scoring or winning conditions. It is built around experimenting and imaginative play.

jungle-fury-mutant-rhino-mayhem.intro: Jungle Fury Mutant Rhino Mayhem is a side-scrolling adventure where a tribal hero fights mutant rhino warriors, rescues captured villagers, and defeats rhino bosses across 20 levels.
tips: Rescue the villagers in each level, since completing a level requires it. Keep track of where they are before you head toward the exit.
Try different weapons, such as bows and axes, against different enemies to see which works best for each threat.
Spend upgrades carefully at the Blacksmith Shop rather than buying everything at once. Choose the gear that fits how you fight.
Pick up health herbs when your health is getting low, and grab gold mushrooms as you explore to build up your resources.
Before facing a rhino boss, watch its attacks for a moment and time your jumps and strikes around them rather than rushing in.
faq: What is the main goal of each level?
Rescue the captured villagers to complete the level. Defeating enemies and rhino bosses along the way helps you get there.
How do I defeat enemies?
Use your attack and jump controls to fight through enemies. Different weapons, including bows and axes, can be used to deal with them.

dusk-warz.intro: Dusk WarZ is a survival shooter where you fight waves of zombies with your guns and wits. Click or tap to play and build your strategy as the enemies keep coming.
tips: Pick your fights carefully, since the number of enemies keeps rising and you cannot take on everything at once.
Use your upgrades as part of your plan rather than choosing at random, and think about what will help you survive the next battle.
Keep moving between shots when you can, so zombies do not get a chance to close in on you from several directions.
Watch how the enemies approach and aim for the ones closest to you first to keep the pressure under control.
Take short breaks in your play to reset your focus, because staying calm makes it easier to make sound decisions under pressure.
faq: What is the goal of Dusk WarZ?
Your goal is to survive a dangerous world full of zombies by fighting an ever-increasing number of enemies. The game focuses on combat, shooting, and strategy.
How do I control the game?
You play by clicking the mouse or tapping the screen. Everything else is handled through the in-game interactions.

watermelon-game.intro: Watermelon Game is a fruit-merging puzzle where identical fruits combine into larger ones. Your aim is to build up to a massive watermelon without letting fruits spill out of the box.
tips: Keep the largest fruits near the bottom of the box so they form a stable base for the rest.
Look for identical fruits that can meet, and place new fruits so they are likely to collide with a matching one.
Avoid stacking fruits high in one spot. Spread them out so the box stays open and you have room to make merges.
Plan a few moves ahead by checking which fruit you are holding next and where it could fit with its twin.
If the box is getting crowded, focus on merges that clear space rather than adding more fruit to the top.
faq: What is the main goal of Watermelon Game?
The goal is to combine identical fruits so they evolve into larger ones, eventually creating a massive watermelon. You must also keep fruits from falling out of the box.
How do fruits grow in this game?
When two identical fruits collide, they transform into a new, larger kind of fruit. Turning small fruits into bigger ones is the core of the strategy.

window-jump-guy.intro: Window Jump Guy is a jumping game where you launch from great heights, dodge obstacles, and earn cash to buy upgrades. Timing is the core challenge, so each jump matters.
tips: Watch the obstacles for a moment before you launch so you can plan a clean path rather than reacting late.
Focus on timing over speed. The game rewards precise jumps, so a slower, well-timed launch is usually better than a rushed one.
Pay attention to where your cash comes from on each run, and use what you earn to buy upgrades that help you go further.
Treat early attempts as practice for reading the layout. Learning where obstacles appear makes later jumps much more consistent.
If a run goes badly, restart and try to fix one specific mistake at a time instead of changing everything at once.
faq: What is the main goal in Window Jump Guy?
Your goal is to make daring jumps from great heights, get past obstacles, and earn as much cash as you can. That cash is used for upgrades.
How do I earn money?
Each successful jump toward your goal earns cash. Clearing obstacles cleanly while you fly helps you build up your total.

boo-chains.intro: Boo Chains is a Halloween matching puzzle where you link neighbouring monsters that share a number or sit one apart. Longer chains unlock bigger explosions and combos across a spooky, five-zone map.
tips: Look for longer chains before short pairs. The description says long chains create pumpkin bombs, lightning and a wild ghost, so building them is how you get the strongest combos.
Scan the whole board for monsters whose numbers differ by one, not just exact matches. Remembering that both neighbours count gives you more possible links.
If you get stuck, use the hint (H) to see a possible move, and use shuffle (R) when the board offers no good options. Don't spend too long searching a board that has no moves left.
Use pause (P or Esc) to step away and plan your next chain when a stage feels crowded. A short break helps you spot links you missed.
Before a boss stage, think about which special pieces you have ready to use with Space. Saving them for a moment when they can clear several monsters is usually more useful than firing them early.
faq: How do I link monsters together?
On desktop, click and drag across neighbouring monsters that have the same number or numbers one apart, then release. On mobile, slide your finger across the monsters in the same way.
What do the special pieces do?
Long chains create pumpkin bombs, lightning and a wild ghost, which explode together for large combos. You can use a collected power with the Space key.

subway-surfers-havana-2021.intro: Subway Surfers Havana 2021 is an endless runner where you flee an inspector and his dog along the city subway. Dodge trains, trams and other obstacles to get as far as you can.
tips: Keep an eye on the lanes ahead and move early, since trains and trams leave little time to react.
Use the arrow keys to switch lanes and the space bar to activate your skateboard or other bonuses at the right moment.
Save bonuses for tricky stretches where obstacles come quickly, rather than using them the moment you get them.
Pick up coins whenever it is safe to do so, because they help you unlock bonuses that lead to new characters.
Stay calm and focus on one obstacle at a time, as a single mistake ends the run and resets your progress for that attempt.
faq: What is the goal of Subway Surfers Havana 2021?
The goal is to speed up and run as far as possible while overcoming obstacles and staying ahead of the inspector and his dog.
How do I control my character?
Use the arrow keys to move between lanes and dodge obstacles, and press the space bar to activate the skateboard or other available bonuses.

number-run-3d-casual-game.intro: Number Run 3D is a casual 3D game that tests your reflexes as you move through a world full of obstacles. You play with simple mouse clicks or taps.
tips: Watch the path ahead rather than the obstacle right in front of you, so you have time to react.
Keep your clicks or taps light and steady instead of rapid-firing, which makes it easier to time your moves.
Stay relaxed and focused for short sessions, since reflex-based games are often harder to play well when you are tired or distracted.
Pay attention to the rhythm of the obstacles and notice patterns, so you can anticipate what comes next.
If you keep making the same mistake, slow down for a few runs and focus on that one part of the course before trying to speed up.
faq: How do I control the character in Number Run 3D?
You control the game with mouse clicks or taps. Use a single, deliberate click or tap for each action rather than clicking rapidly.
What is the main challenge in Number Run 3D?
The game tests your skills and reflexes as you move through a world filled with obstacles. Reacting quickly and staying focused on the path ahead are the key parts of the challenge.

grand-city-missions.intro: Grand City Missions is a racing game set in a large city with tall buildings, wide roads, and a stunt arena. You can race or play career mode, and it supports two players on one keyboard.
tips: Pick a car from the garage before you start, since the seven cars each have their own features. Try a few to see which handles best for your style.
Use the customize menu to change the paint and wheels if you want your car to stand out, though these options only change how it looks.
Use the stunt arena to practice drifting and control before you enter a race on the wide city roads.
Try the racing mode first to learn the city layout, then move on to career mode for a longer challenge.
In two-player mode, agree on which keys each player uses before starting, so the controls do not get mixed up mid-race. Player 1 uses W, A, S, D, and Player 2 uses the arrow keys.
faq: What is the goal of Grand City Missions?
The game offers racing and career modes, so your goal depends on the mode you choose. Racing focuses on getting through the course, while career mode gives you a longer set of goals to work through.
How do I control my car?
Player 1 moves with W, A, S, and D, and Player 2 moves with the arrow keys. Each player also has a nitro key, F for Player 1 and K for Player 2, and a restart key, R for Player 1 and O for Player 2.

school-stories-teacher-sim.intro: School Stories: Teacher Sim puts you in charge of a high school class, where you grade papers, watch for cheaters, and move through school life. Each level builds on the last as you unlock new activities.
tips: Keep an eye on students during tests, since catching hidden phones or notes is a core part of keeping order.
Grade papers steadily rather than letting them pile up, so your workload stays manageable as levels get harder.
Explore the different school areas like the art room, basketball court, and swimming pool, as each one offers its own mini game.
Try a few mini games before moving on, since they are a good way to learn how the school areas work.
Balance enforcing rules with the rest of school life, because managing students fairly is what keeps your classroom running well.
faq: What is the goal of School Stories: Teacher Sim?
You manage students and school life as a teacher, grading papers and maintaining discipline. Passing levels unlocks new activities.
How do I play the game?
Use mouse clicks or taps to interact with students, papers, and school areas. The game is played entirely with one click or tap.

muscle-clicker-2.intro: Muscle Clicker 2 is a sports clicker where you build a virtual body by tapping through strength training like bench presses and squats. Earn upgrades, use different equipment, and take on challenges.
tips: Spend your earnings on upgrades early, since they speed up your progress for the rest of the run.
Try different equipment rather than sticking to one piece, because the game emphasizes a balance of muscle development.
Alternate between exercises such as bench presses and squats so your build develops evenly instead of in one area.
Check your upgrades before each challenge and choose the ones that match the challenge you are about to face.
Come back to the competitive side after you have some upgrades, so you can compare your progress with others.
faq: What is the main goal in Muscle Clicker 2?
The goal is to build your virtual body by tapping through strength training and reaching muscle mastery. Upgrades and challenges help you move forward.
How do upgrades help my progress?
Upgrades are a central part of the game and help you develop your virtual body more effectively. Choosing them with a plan makes your progress more steady.

elements-craft-ultimate.intro: Elements Craft Ultimate is an alchemy puzzle where you combine Fire, Water, Earth, and Wind to discover new items. You can play freely or aim for goals like quests, Time Mode, and Quiz Mode.
tips: Try combining elements that seem like they should react, such as Water and Fire, and note the results so you can build on them later.
Work through the daily tasks and standard quests as you go, since they earn Coins that you can spend on Smart Hints.
Save Smart Hints for when you are truly stuck, so your Coins last and you still get to make most discoveries yourself.
In Time Mode, plan a route from the basic elements to your target before you start, so you do not waste seconds on unrelated combinations.
In Quiz Mode, think about which elements share a theme with the target, such as nature, weather, or technology, to narrow down your guesses.
faq: What is the main goal of Elements Craft Ultimate?

The main goal is to combine the four basic elements to discover hundreds of unique creations. The game is open-ended, and you can also win by discovering every element, completing quests, or beating Time Mode and Quiz Mode.
How do I combine elements?
Drag and drop an item from your inventory onto another item. For example, combining Water and Fire creates Steam.

block-puzzle-jewel-block.intro: Block Puzzle: Jewel Block is an endless grid puzzle where you drag jewel pieces onto the board to complete rows and columns. The game ends when no remaining piece fits, so every placement matters.
tips: Keep open space spread across the board instead of filling one corner, so larger pieces still have somewhere to go.
Look at the pieces in the tray before placing one, and plan which shape you will need next.
Aim placements so that one piece completes both a row and a column at the same time for a bigger clear.
Use consecutive clears to build combos, and avoid leaving isolated single gaps that are hard to fill later.
Save your boosters for crowded moments when the board is nearly full, rather than using them early.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Fill complete horizontal rows or vertical columns to clear them and earn points, while trying to beat your saved high score.
How do I place a piece?
Hold the left mouse button or touch a piece in the tray, drag it onto an empty area of the board, then release or lift your finger to drop it.

world-of-military-tanks.intro: World of Military Tanks is a shooting game where you pick a tank, complete missions and destroy enemy tanks. It includes regular missions, base defense, survival and 5v5 battles.
tips: Aim with the scope on the enemy tank and wait for the scope to turn red before you fire, since that signals the target is captured.
Watch for the red circle in the scope and shoot only when it appears to avoid wasting shots.
Read the mission objective before each run so you know whether you need to destroy targets, defend a base or survive.
Use base defense and survival modes to practise patience and positioning, since waiting for targets to come to you is part of the challenge.
Spend rewards from completed missions on tank upgrades or a new tank that suits the mode you play most.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Complete the mission objective, which is usually to destroy enemy tanks. The game also includes base defense, survival and 5v5 battles.
How do I shoot?
Point the scope at the enemy tank and right-click. Fire when the red circle appears in the scope, which is the signal that the target is captured.

pop-pop-kitties.intro: Pop-Pop Kitties is a Match-3 puzzle shooter where you connect identical cats before they descend or time runs out. Collect stars across more than 100 levels while keeping every kitty safe.
tips: Watch how far the cats are from descending before you aim, and clear the lowest rows first when pressure builds.
Look for chances to set up matches that clear several identical cats in one go, since this helps you stay ahead of the clock.
Keep an eye on the timer and make quick decisions when it is running low instead of waiting for a perfect shot.
Aim for perfection by playing each level carefully, since the game rewards play that does not harm a single kitty.
Replay levels you finished with only a few stars to see if you can improve your reflexes and collect more stars.
faq: What is the main goal in Pop-Pop Kitties?
Connect identical cats before they descend or before time runs out. Clearing the board keeps you moving forward through the levels.
How do stars work in this game?
You collect stars as you play, and the game encourages you to aim for perfection. Playing without harming any kitty is part of that challenge.

noob-vs-stickman-zombies.intro: Noob vs Stickman Zombies is a pixel art arcade game where you defend a peaceful cabin from waves of stickman zombies using archery. Precise aim and a bit of puzzle solving help you hold your ground.
tips: Take a moment to line up each shot, since precise aiming is the core skill this game rewards.
Pay attention to the stronger foes and decide which threat is closest to your cabin before you fire.
Look at the layout of each stage for puzzle elements, and plan your approach before rushing into action.
Stay calm under pressure; rushed shots tend to miss, so steady timing keeps your defense holding.
Use short play sessions to stay focused, because the action can build quickly and mistakes add up.
faq: What is the main goal of Noob vs Stickman Zombies?
You play as Noob and defend your peaceful cabin from relentless stickman zombies. Keeping them from reaching the cabin is the core task.
What skill matters most in this game?
Archery with precise aiming is central, since you need accurate shots to stop stronger foes. Careful aim usually matters more than speed.

xmas-rooftop-battles.intro: Xmas Rooftop Battles is a two-player Christmas shooter where you try to shoot your opponent off the rooftop. Each player uses their own set of keys to shoot and jump.
tips: Learn which key does which action before you start, since the instructions list the shoot and jump keys in that order for each player.
Jump to dodge incoming shots and to keep your position on the roof, rather than standing still and waiting to be hit.
Take your shots when your opponent has just landed from a jump, because they have less room to move at that moment.
Stay near the middle of the rooftop when you can, so one well-timed shot is less likely to knock you off the edge.
Watch your opponent's pattern for a few rounds and try to predict where they will jump before you commit to a shot.
faq: What is the goal of Xmas Rooftop Battles?
The goal is to shoot your opponent off the rooftop. It is played by two players at the same keyboard.
Which keys control each player?
The instructions list W and E for one player and O and P for the other, with the first key of each pair used to shoot and the second to jump.

car-wash-diy.intro: Car Wash DIY is a relaxing simulation where you clean, repair, and shine vehicles using simple finger controls. Work through each car at your own pace.
tips: Work in one section at a time, such as one door or one side panel, so you can keep track of which dirty spots you have already covered.
Before polishing, make sure the car is fully clean, since the task only finishes once every dirty spot has been covered.
Use the sprayer first to loosen dirt, then switch to the sponge to scrub it away, which keeps the work moving quickly.
Check the car for scratches once the washing is done, then use the repair tool by tapping or dragging over each mark.
Use the sander and polish near the end to add shine, and look over the whole car one more time before moving on.
faq: What is the main goal of Car Wash DIY?
Your goal is to clean, repair, and shine each vehicle. A task is finished when you have covered all the dirty spots on the car.
How do I use the tools in the game?
Drag or tap to use the sprayer, sponge, sander, and polish. To fix scratches, tap or drag the repair tool over the marked areas.

bobb-s-world.intro: Bobb's World is a retro pixel adventure where you guide Bobb through 30 levels set on different planets. Collect treats, avoid traps, and bounce on enemies to get through each stage.
tips: Look at the whole layout before you move, since traps are often placed where a quick jump might land you.
Use bouncing on foes as a way to deal with enemies, and plan your jumps so you land on them safely.
Collect the treats you pass on the way, because Bobb's appetite is part of the game's goal.
Learn how each planet feels in the first few moves, since the levels change in style and challenge from world to world.
If a level keeps catching you, stop and study where the traps are, then try a slower and more careful route.
faq: How many levels are there in Bobb's World?
The game has 30 exotic levels spread across diverse planets. Each one brings its own layout and challenges.
What is the main goal in each level?
Your aim is to collect delectable treats while outsmarting traps and bouncing on foes. Treats are central to satisfying Bobb's appetite.

guess-monster-voice.intro: Guess Monster Voice is a sound-based trivia quiz where you listen to a monster's noise and pick the legendary creature it belongs to. One wrong answer ends the round, so careful listening matters.
tips: Listen to the whole sound before choosing. Pay attention to the distinctive noises, since those are the clues the game is built around.
Compare the options against each other, not just the first one that sounds familiar. Eliminate the monsters whose sounds clearly don't match.
Replay the voice if the game allows it, and focus on one feature at a time, such as a growl, a screech, or a rumble.
Save the hint for a sound you truly cannot place. Using it early on a question you could have worked out wastes its help when you need it most.
If you lose, start over with a fresh mind. Think about which sounds gave you trouble so you can recognise them next time.
faq: What is the goal of Guess Monster Voice?
The goal is to hear a monster's voice and select the correct monster from the answer options. Each correct guess moves you forward.
What happens if I choose the wrong monster?
You lose and have to start over. There is no second chance on the same question, so take your time before selecting.

shoot-the-bubble.intro: Shoot the Bubble is a color-matching puzzle where you aim and launch bubbles to pop groups of three or more of the same color. Clear the board in Adventure Mode or hold back the descending wall in endless Challenge Mode.
tips: Before every shot, look for loose bubbles hanging off the cluster. Removing them often drops more bubbles with them, so they are usually worth targeting first.
Use the aiming line to plan bank shots off the side walls when a color group is blocked from a direct angle. Check the bounce path before you release.
Think about what your shot will leave behind. Popping one small group can leave a gap that makes the next shot harder, so aim for shots that open up the board.
In Challenge Mode, focus on building combos rather than single pops. Pushing the wall back gives you more room, so it is worth taking a slightly slower shot to set up a big clear.
Save special bubbles for tough spots. A Bomb Bubble works best when it lands in the middle of a crowded area, and a Lightning Bubble can help when one color is spread across the board.
faq: What is the main goal of Shoot the Bubble?
Pop bubbles by matching three or more bubbles of the same color. In Adventure Mode you aim to clear the board, and in Challenge Mode you try to keep the wall of bubbles from crossing the danger line.
How do bank shots work?
Bubbles bounce off the side walls, so you can use the aiming line to angle a shot and hit groups that are hard to reach directly.

rider-online-pro.intro: Rider Online Pro is a racing stunt game where you ride a futuristic motorcycle through an endless world. Pull off tricks, collect diamonds, and build points to unlock some of the 16 bikes.
tips: Hold left click while in the air to cartwheel, since this is how you add to your score during jumps. Plan your cartwheels so you start them as soon as you leave the ground.
Try to land without flipping over, because the game is built around staying upright while you perform stunts. A clean landing keeps your combo going and protects your progress.
Keep your speed up by holding left click to move forward, which gives you more room and time for tricks. Slowing down makes it harder to chain stunts together.
Pick up diamonds when you can, but do not swerve off your line too far to chase them. Staying on a steady run usually matters more than small detours.
Focus on building combos, since your score rises with each stunt you chain together. Aim to beat your own high score each run rather than rushing to unlock everything at once.
faq: How do I control my motorcycle?
Press and hold left click to move your bike forward. While you are in the air, keep left click held to do a cartwheel that adds to your score.
How do I unlock new motorcycles?
There are 16 motorcycles to unlock, and you earn them by collecting points as you play. Keep scoring across runs to work toward the next bike.

1-speed-keyboard-escape-halloween-update.intro: A fast arcade running game where every key you press raises your speed. Build momentum, get through the obstacles, and survive as long as you can across the stages.
tips: Keep pressing keys steadily, since each press is what raises your speed. Pausing to think can cost you momentum.
Watch the obstacles ahead rather than your own speed, because the stages get harder as you go faster.
On PC, use WASD to move and the mouse to look around, so you can line up your path before obstacles reach you.
On mobile, use the joystick to move and tap the controls when you need to interact.
Treat each new speed level as a checkpoint. Settle into a rhythm before the next stage gets harder.
faq: What is the goal of +1 Speed Keyboard Escape?
Survive as long as possible, reach new speed levels, and try to complete all stages.
How do I increase my speed?
Press keyboard keys. Each key press makes you faster.

cricket-championship.intro: Cricket Championship is a fast-paced 2D cricket game where mouse precision and timing decide how far you hit the ball. Learn your batting technique, position yourself well, and protect your wicket to score big.
tips: Focus on timing before power. Wait until the ball is close before you swing, since an early or late swing usually wastes the shot.
Keep your mouse movements smooth and controlled. Small, precise adjustments tend to work better than fast, jerky ones.
Use your early rounds to learn how the ball moves and how quickly it arrives. Noticing these patterns makes your timing more consistent.
Think about where you stand as well as when you swing. Positioning affects both your chance to hit the ball far and your ability to defend your wicket.
Protect your wicket first when the pace picks up. A safe defensive shot keeps you in the game, and scoring chances tend to come back.
faq: What is the main goal of Cricket Championship?
Hit the ball far to score runs while defending your wicket. Good timing and positioning are the keys to doing both.
What does the mouse control in this game?
The mouse controls your batting, so precision and timing are what determine how well each shot lands.

lost-adventure-new.intro: Lost Adventure New puts you in the role of a pilot whose plane crashes in a mysterious wild land. You gather supplies, craft tools, and work to reach passengers stranded on separate islands.
tips: Search the plane wreckage early and collect everything you can, since the resources you gather there feed your crafting.
Craft tools before you push deep into the wild grass so you are not caught without what you need.
Mine only when you need specific materials for a craft or puzzle, so you do not waste time on unneeded resources.
Look closely at each island's puzzle before rushing ahead, because solving it is how you move your rescue forward.
Keep track of which passengers you have already reached and which islands are still left, so you can plan your route efficiently.
faq: What is the main goal of Lost Adventure New?
Your goal is to rescue the passengers stranded on separate islands and escape the mysterious land together. You must do this before the dangers of the wilderness reach you.
How do I move my character?
On desktop, use W, A, S and D or the arrow keys to move forward, left, backward and right. On mobile, drag the on-screen joystick to move in any direction.

tiny-sports-empire-idle.intro: Tiny Sports Empire Idle is a sports management idle game where you grow a small hoops team into a multi-sport franchise. Matches play out automatically while you spend cash on upgrades, players, gear and new sports.
tips: Check your upgrades regularly, since matches run on their own and your team power and win chance depend on what you have bought.
Spend cash on the upgrades that raise your win chance or income first, then move on to the rest as your funds grow.
Open the Sports button to see league progress and decide which sport to focus on before you unlock a new one.
Recruit players and equip gear as you go, because both feed into team power and help the franchise keep pace as it expands.
Claim offline rewards and special event rewards whenever you return, so your idle income keeps adding up while you are away.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Your goal is to keep improving your win chance, team power, income and league progress until your franchise becomes a sports dynasty.
Do I need to play matches manually?
No. Matches are simulated automatically, so your progress comes from the upgrades and choices you make between them.

netherton-volleyball.intro: Netherton Volleyball is a pixel-art volleyball game where you run a 6v6 team through an 18-team ladder. Time your taps, pick the right hitter, and work your way to the cup.
tips: Watch for the ring to turn green before you tap, since timing your taps is how you serve, pass, dig and block.
Compare the hitters' ring colors before choosing one, because the color shows each player's chance to score.
Use Q, W and E to set the front row and A, S and D to set the back row, so you can choose the right attacker quickly.
If a line call looks close, press V to challenge it rather than accepting the call.
Press P to pause when you need a moment to plan your next play, then resume with the same key.
faq: How do I score points?
Tap when the ring turns green to serve, pass, dig, block or spike, and pick a hitter whose ring shows a good chance to score.
How do my players get better?
Your players level up after every match and learn new moves, such as quick sets, pipes, jump serves and diving saves.

super-traffic-racer.intro: Super Traffic Racer is an endless arcade racer where you drive through highway traffic, earn cash, and upgrade or buy new cars. You steer with the arrow keys or by touching the screen.
tips: Keep your moves small and steady so you can slip between traffic cars without losing speed.
Spend earned cash on upgrades early, since a faster or better-handling car makes the rest of the run easier.
Watch the cars two or three lanes ahead rather than only the one directly in front of you, so you have time to switch lanes.
Pick a moment to change lanes when there is a clear gap, instead of swerving in a hurry at the last second.
Try to beat your own best run before aiming for the global leaderboards, so each attempt builds on what you learned.
faq: How do I control the car?
Use the arrow keys on a keyboard, or touch the screen to steer. The instructions do not list other controls.
What is the goal of the game?
Drive through highway traffic, earn cash, and try to rank among the fastest drivers on the global leaderboards.

fast-ball-jump.intro: Fast Ball Jump is a bowling-style game where you roll a ball through 3D obstacle courses, collect coins, and finish by striking pins. Each run is short, so you can play a few quick rounds at a time.
tips: Keep your speed under control so you can react to obstacles. Rolling too fast makes it harder to stay on track through tight sections.
Look ahead toward the next part of the course rather than focusing only on the ball. Spotting turns and gaps early gives you time to adjust.
Prioritize balance over grabbing every coin. Missing a coin is usually less costly than losing control near an obstacle.
Aim your final approach carefully at the finish line, since the pins are the goal of each course. A clean, precise roll there is worth more than a rushed one.
Use short sessions to learn each course's layout. Replaying a section with a clear goal in mind helps you improve your precision over time.
faq: What is the main goal of Fast Ball Jump?
Your goal is to guide your ball through the 3D obstacle course, collect coins along the way, and strike the pins at the finish line.
How do I keep the ball from falling off the course?
Focus on precise rolling and keeping your ball balanced. Slowing down before tricky sections can help you stay on the track.

merge-cats-2048.intro: Merge Cats: 2048! is a puzzle game where falling cat balls join together when they match. Your aim is to build the biggest cat and collect as many points as you can.
tips: Keep the play area as open as possible so that matching cat balls have room to meet.
Look for pairs of the same cat ball before you drop a new one, and place the new ball next to its match.
Start with a calm, steady pace while the game is still easy, since the screen fills up more as time goes on.
Avoid stacking balls in tall piles that leave no space for the next ones to fall.
Aim for larger merges one step at a time, because each connection adds to your points.
faq: What is the goal of Merge Cats: 2048!?
The goal is to connect cat balls of the same kind to create the biggest one you can. Points are collected as you merge.
How do cat balls combine?
Cat balls fall into the game zone and connect when two of the same type touch. Each connection builds a larger ball.

steal-memerot-zoo-tycoon.intro: Steal Memerot: Zoo Tycoon is a 3D tycoon game where you build a zoo, buy rare brainrot animals, and place them on special spots to grow your income. Your goal is to collect a large animal collection and expand your base.
tips: Use WASD to walk around your base and check which special spots are free before spending money on a new creature.
Place each new animal on a spot as soon as you buy it, since your income grows as the collection grows.
Spend your earnings on income upgrades early, because a faster income makes it easier to afford rare pets later.
Expand your territory once your current base feels full, so you always have room for new creatures.
Use RMB to rotate the camera and look at your zoo from different angles to spot empty spots and new areas.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Collect a large brainrot animal collection, grow your zoo, unlock rare pets, and increase your income.
How do I earn more money?
Buy new creatures and place them on special spots, because the more rare pets you collect, the faster your income grows.

bounce-up.intro: Bounce Up! is an arcade roguelite where you launch balls onto a pachinko-style board. You earn points and coins by hitting pegs and landing in scoring slots, then spend coins on upgrades between runs.
tips: Aim for pegs that set up chains rather than single hits, since combos are a key source of points in a run.
Spend coins between runs with a plan for your ball setup, and avoid buying upgrades that do not fit the strategy you want to build.
Watch where your balls tend to land and adjust your aim toward the scoring slots that pay best for your current setup.
Try different launch angles early in a run to learn how the pegs bounce the ball, then repeat the shots that work well.
Pause with Esc when you need a moment to plan your next launch instead of rushing shots.
