faq: What is the goal of Bounce Up!?
Your goal is to earn as many points and coins as possible in a single run. Coins can then be used to buy upgrades before the next run.
How do I launch a ball?
Move the mouse to aim and left-click or press Space to launch. On touch screens, tap the main game area to launch.

break-a-lucky-block.intro: Break Lucky Blocks, grab the brainrots that spawn, and carry them back to your plot while staying ahead of the guards. Each trip home adds to your collection.
tips: Keep an eye on the guards before you break a block, since getting caught can cost you what you are carrying.
Watch for brainrots as they spawn and grab the ones you can reach before heading back to your plot.
Plan your route home before you leave so you spend less time out in the open with brainrots in hand.
Break Lucky Blocks when the area looks quiet, and treat each one as a chance to unlock a rare reward.
Make a habit of returning to your plot regularly so your collection grows steadily instead of risking everything on one long run.
faq: What is the main goal of Break a Lucky Block!?
The goal is to break Lucky Blocks, collect brainrots, and bring them back to your plot to build up a full collection.
How do I keep my brainrots safe?
Get them back to your plot before you are caught by the guards, because the game is about escaping with what you have collected.

the-green-mission-inside-a-cave.intro: The Green Mission Inside a Cave is a whimsical underground adventure where you play as a color-changing cucumber. You solve puzzles, look for secret recipes, and get past enemies across several levels.
tips: Look at each puzzle before you act. Working out the pattern first is usually quicker than trying moves at random.
Pay attention to changes in your cucumber's color, since the game's color-changing mechanic is central to the adventure.
Keep an eye out for secret recipes as you explore. They are part of the game's cave world, so check unusual spots and side paths.
When an enemy is in your way, watch how it moves for a moment before you try to get past it.
Take your time between levels. Note what worked in one puzzle, because similar ideas may return in later levels.
faq: What is the goal of The Green Mission Inside a Cave?
You guide a color-changing cucumber through an underground cave, solving puzzles, finding secret recipes, and outsmarting enemies as you move through the levels.
Does the game use a score?
The game description does not mention scoring, so progress is best measured by how far you get through the levels and the puzzles you solve.

mix-and-paint-3d.intro: Mix & Paint 3D is a color-mixing puzzle where you match a target shade on your palette, then paint a 3D object. Your accuracy score decides whether you pass each level.
tips: Start by mixing small amounts of pigment, then add more slowly, since it is easier to move toward the target than to undo a shade that has gone too far.
Compare your palette color with the target often while you blend, and adjust one pigment at a time so you can tell which change made the difference.
Aim for the 90% perfect result rather than just the 60% pass mark by painting with steady, even strokes across the whole object.
Use Clear when your palette becomes muddy and start the mix again from a clean state instead of pushing a bad color further.
Save Hint for when you are truly stuck on a shade, and try a few mixes on your own first so you learn how each pigment behaves.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You need to recreate the target color on your palette and then paint the 3D object with it. Reaching at least 60% accuracy passes the level.
What accuracy do I need for a perfect result?
Aim for 90% or higher to get a perfect result. Anything from 60% up passes the level.

ball-io.intro: Ball.io is a hypercasual game where you guide a ball along its path, removing obstacles in the way to reach the finish line. The controls use the mouse.
tips: Look at the whole route before you start moving so you can spot which obstacles stand between the ball and the finish line.
Clear the obstacles closest to the ball first, since they are the ones that will block its path soonest.
Move the mouse in small, steady motions rather than fast sweeps so you keep control of where the ball goes.
If you get stuck, pause and check which obstacle is really in the way instead of trying the same move again.
Play a few short rounds in a row to get a feel for how the ball responds to your mouse movements.
faq: What is the goal of Ball.io?
The goal is to remove the obstacles in the ball's path so it can reach the finish line.
How do I control the ball?
You play with the mouse, so move it to guide the ball and clear obstacles.

happy-color-sort-puzzle.intro: Happy Color Sort Puzzle asks you to sort colors into matching containers. Levels grow more complex as you go, so careful observation pays off.
tips: Scan the whole board before your first move so you can see which colors are buried under others.
Look for containers that already hold a single color and try to build on them rather than starting new stacks.
Avoid filling an empty container with a mixed stack early, since it can block the colors you need later.
When you get stuck, step back and check which top colors can be moved to create space, instead of repeating the same moves.
Play in short sessions and take a moment to re-check the layout when a level becomes crowded.
faq: What is the main goal of Happy Color Sort Puzzle?
The goal is to sort the colors so that each matching container holds only one color. The description says levels become more complex over time.
How do I get past a level that seems impossible?
Look at the top of each container and plan a few moves ahead. Freeing one container often opens a path for the rest of the colors.

how-many-mice.intro: How Many Mice is a trivia-style counting game where you try to work out how many mice are hidden on screen. Each touch can reveal more, but touching too much can lower your score.
tips: Keep a running count in your head as mice appear so you can judge whether another touch is worth the risk.
Reveal areas that look most likely to hold mice first, and avoid repeatedly touching spots that have already shown everything they hold.
Pause before each touch and ask whether the possible gain is worth the chance of losing points.
Watch for patterns in how mice are placed, such as clusters or edges, to guess where the rest may be hiding.
If your score is dropping quickly, slow down and switch to more careful observation before continuing.
faq: What is the goal of How Many Mice?
The goal is to discover how many mice are hidden in the scene. You need to estimate or count the total population to answer correctly.
Why does touching things lower my score?
Each touch can reveal more mice, but the game warns that curiosity can diminish your score. Every extra touch is a trade-off between information and points.

draw-bridge-puzzle.intro: Draw Bridge Puzzle is a physics-based brain game where you draw paths to help a stranded car get past obstacles and reach its destination. Each solution is a small building challenge.
tips: Study the whole scene before you draw anything. Note where the car starts, where it needs to end up, and which obstacles are in between.
Plan the simplest route first. A short, direct path is often easier for the car to follow than a long, complicated one.
Pay attention to how the car moves once it is released. Watch the physics closely so you can see what your path is doing wrong.
If a path fails, change one thing at a time. This makes it easier to see which part of your drawing caused the problem.
Think about the height and angle of each section of road. Smooth, gradual changes often help the car stay on track.
faq: What is the goal of Draw Bridge Puzzle?
Your goal is to draw roads or bridges that let the stranded car get past the obstacles and reach its destination.
How can I get better at solving the puzzles?
Plan your route before drawing, watch how the car behaves in the physics simulation, and adjust your path based on what goes wrong.

cs-upgrade-gun.intro: CS Upgrade Gun puts you in command of a self-operating cannon in a busy arena. Hunt targets, collect powerful boosters, and see how long you can last against the constant attacks.
tips: Take boosters as you find them, since upgrades are the main way to get stronger during a run.
Watch the arena for targets and focus on the ones that threaten your cannon most.
Plan your upgrades so they build on each other rather than picking them at random.
Stay alert as the pace picks up, because the onslaught keeps coming and mistakes add up fast.
Try a few runs to learn how the waves build, then aim to beat your previous survival time.
faq: What is the goal of CS Upgrade Gun?
The goal is to hunt targets in the arena and survive as long as you can against the relentless onslaught. Upgrading your cannon with boosters helps you last longer.
How do I get stronger in CS Upgrade Gun?
You upgrade your cannon with powerful boosters, which help you push your skills further during the game. Choosing useful boosters early can make a big difference later.

chess-master-3d.intro: Chess Master 3D is a chess game with 3D visuals where you move your pieces against an AI opponent. Your aim is to capture the opponent's king through careful, tactical play.
tips: Before every move, check which of your pieces the opponent could capture next, and make sure your move does not leave anything unprotected.
Look for moves that threaten two things at once, since the AI can only answer one threat at a time.
Keep your king sheltered behind your pawns and other pieces, because an exposed king gives the opponent more ways to attack.
Avoid trading pieces without a clear reason, and count the material on each side before you accept an exchange.
Think a few moves ahead by asking what your opponent is likely to do after your move, rather than only looking at the current position.
faq: What is the goal of Chess Master 3D?
The goal is to capture the opponent's king. Every move should bring you closer to that aim while protecting your own king.
How should I approach the AI opponent?
Play deliberately and look for tactical chances, such as attacks on two pieces at once. Check the opponent's threats before each move so the AI cannot win material easily.

one-level-stickman-jailbreak.intro: Tommy is locked in a jail cell and wants out. Help him escape by solving logical puzzles, starting with the key he steals to open the cell.
tips: Look at everything in the cell before acting, since the key Tommy steals is the first step toward escaping.
Try one idea at a time and watch what happens, so you can tell which action actually changes the situation.
If you get stuck, go back and check objects or spots you passed earlier, because the next clue is often nearby.
Keep track of what you have already tried so you do not repeat the same failed steps.
Take short breaks when a puzzle feels confusing, then return with fresh eyes to spot details you missed.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Your goal is to help Tommy escape from jail by solving the logical puzzles along the way.
How does Tommy get out of his cell?
Tommy steals a key and uses it to get out of the jail cell, which is where your help begins.

space-rovers.intro: Space Rovers is a physics-based game where you build your own Mars rover from wheels and blocks, then use it to haul cargo across rough terrain. Your design choices decide how well it handles the journey.
tips: Start with a simple build and test how it drives before adding more blocks, so you can see which changes help and which cause problems.
Keep the weight balanced over your wheels. Because the game is physics-based, a top-heavy rover is more likely to tip over on uneven ground.
Try both compact and large designs to see which suits your cargo. A small rover may handle bumps better, while a bigger hauler may carry more per trip.
Use the forward and backward controls gently. Quick, hard inputs can make a rover lose grip or flip, so smooth movement usually gives better control.
If a design keeps failing on the same stretch, rebuild the parts that affect balance and grip rather than only adding more of the same blocks.
faq: What is the goal of Space Rovers?
Your goal is to design a rover that can transport goods across Martian landscapes. The game focuses on engineering and problem-solving with your vehicle design.
How do I move my rover on desktop?
Use the Up Arrow or Right Arrow to move forward and the Down Arrow or Left Arrow to move backwards.

deconstruct-cube-create-hotel.intro: Deconstruct Cube: Create Hotel is a puzzle game where you take apart a cube, match and connect pieces, and earn points to build a pearl hotel. It uses a 2048-style cube puzzle.
tips: Look at the whole board before each move so you can see which pieces match and connect.
Save your best matches for moments when they will clear space or set up the next connection.
Keep your board tidy. Leaving scattered pieces makes later matches harder to find.
Pay attention to the points you earn, since they are what pay for building up your hotel.
If you get stuck, step back and check which pieces you have not yet connected before making a random move.
faq: What is the goal of Deconstruct Cube: Create Hotel?
The goal is to take apart the cube, play connect-and-match puzzles, earn points, and use them to build a pearl hotel.
How do I earn points in the game?
You earn points by completing connect-and-match puzzles while you disassemble the cube. Points are used to upgrade your hotel.

aquarium-of-surprises.intro: Aquarium of Surprises is a calm idle game where fish earn coins on their own while you choose what to add to your tank. There is nothing to click for income, so you can focus on planning your aquarium.
tips: Check the Upgrades tab early, since each card shows the current effect and the next level. Raising income first will speed up everything you buy afterwards.
Keep an eye on the event icons as they appear. Tapping coin bubbles, glass spots and the drifting chest quickly is a free boost you can get whenever you are watching the tank.
When a rare visitor appears, tap it before it swims away. Missing it means it leaves without joining your collection.
Each extra fish of the same kind costs a little more, so spread your coins across different fish kinds instead of buying only one type.
Look at the three current tasks before you spend. They pay coins and sometimes a pearl, and pearls are what unlock special decorations and themes.
faq: Do I need to click the fish to earn coins?
No. Every fish earns coins by itself, so you only need to tap for events such as bubbles, glass spots, the chest and rare visitors.
What should I buy first?
Start with fish to raise income, then look at Upgrades to see which effect helps most. Plants and decorations are bought once, so choose them when you have spare coins.

sort-master-satisfeel-asmr.intro: Sort Master Satisfeel ASMR is a calm puzzle game where you arrange foods, cabinets, and other objects into their correct spots. It uses simple drag-and-drop controls and is meant to be a relaxed break.
tips: Scan the whole screen before moving anything so you can see which objects belong together.
Group similar items first, such as all foods of one kind, before placing them in their final spots.
Drop each object gently and check that it settles in the right place before picking up the next one.
If a placement feels wrong, drag the object back out and try another spot rather than forcing it.
Take short breaks between levels or mini-games to keep the experience relaxing.
faq: How do I move objects in Sort Master Satisfeel ASMR?
Tap and drag an object to pick it up, then drag it to its correct position and release it. The controls are simple drag-and-drop.
What is the goal of each challenge?
The goal is to place every object in its correct position. Each organizing challenge is solved when all items are arranged in their right places.

real-car-parking-and-stunt.intro: Real Car Parking And Stunt is a driving simulation where you park a car accurately in parking mode or perform stunts in stunt mode. Each level tests both skills.
tips: Pick the mode that fits your mood first. Parking mode rewards precision, while stunt mode rewards bold driving.
In parking levels, slow down as you get close to your spot. Small corrections are easier to make than large ones near the end.
Take a moment to look at the layout before you start moving. Knowing where the target space sits helps you plan a clean approach.
When trying stunts, focus on control rather than speed. A stunt that ends with a stable landing usually matters more than a risky one.
If a level feels hard, try again and change one thing at a time, such as your approach angle or how early you start turning.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
The goal is to park your car accurately in each level while also performing exciting stunts. You can play either stunt mode or parking mode.
How do I control the car?
Use mouse clicks or taps to play. The game is built around clicking or tapping to drive and act on each level.

city-driver-destroy-car.intro: City Driver Destroy Car is a sports driving game set in a large city, where you crash and wreck cars to earn cash. You can explore events, complete missions, and build your driving skills.
tips: Try a few crashes early to see how your car handles at different speeds before you aim for bigger wrecks.
Pay attention to which crashes earn the most cash, and repeat those kinds of wrecks rather than chasing random damage.
Use the infinite car resets freely to test a risky idea, since restarting carries no penalty.
Check the available events and missions often, because completing them is a clear way to focus your play.
Spend time practicing turns and braking in open areas of the city so you can control your car during tight crashes.
faq: How do I earn cash in City Driver Destroy Car?
You earn cash through spectacular wrecks, so the more damage your crashes cause, the more you are likely to earn. Focus on crashes that create big impacts.
Do I lose progress when my car gets wrecked?
No. The game gives you infinite car resets, so you can start again without consequences and keep experimenting.

draw-save-puzzles.intro: Draw Save Puzzles asks you to draw lines or shapes that guide a Stickman to safety. Each level adds a new challenge that tests your logic and problem-solving.
tips: Look at the whole level before you draw anything. Notice where the Stickman starts, where safety is, and what might get in the way.
Start with the simplest route you can see. A short, clean line is often easier to plan around than a long, complicated one.
Think about how the Stickman will move once your line is in place, so you can spot problems before you commit.
If a level isn't working, try a different approach instead of repeating the same shape. Each level can have more than one possible solution.
Take your time with tap or click input, since a small mistake in where you draw can change the outcome.
faq: What is the goal of Draw Save Puzzles?
Your goal is to draw lines or shapes that guide the Stickman safely through each level. You work through the puzzles one by one.
How do I play?
Tap or click to draw. The game is played entirely with taps or mouse clicks.

need-for-drift.intro: Need For Drift is an arcade street racing game where you drift through sharp corners, outrun police chases, and upgrade your car. Drive with the WASD keys and use Shift for a burst of nitro speed.
tips: Save nitro for straights or the exit of a corner rather than spending it while you are still turning. A burst of speed is most useful once the car is pointed where you want to go.
Practise drifting on quieter parts of the city before taking on police chases. Learning how your car responds makes sharp corners far easier under pressure.
Pay attention to where the police are and plan an escape route before you commit to a tight turn. Keeping some distance from them gives you more room to manoeuvre.
Complete races and challenges to earn rewards, then spend them on upgrades. Upgrading steadily helps with both top speed and handling, which matter in both races and chases.
If a chase is going badly, try to break line of sight and keep moving through side streets rather than driving straight ahead. Staying unpredictable is often better than racing in a straight line.
faq: What is the main goal of Need For Drift?
Your goal is to race through the city, drift through corners, and escape police chases. You earn rewards from races and challenges, which you can use to upgrade your car.
How do I use nitro?
Press Shift to activate nitro and get a short burst of extra speed. Use it when the road is clear so you can make the most of the boost.

skip-love.intro: Skip Love is a puzzle game where a stickman hero tries to win his beloved while avoiding dangers. Each level has its own brain teaser, and you solve them by clicking or tapping.
tips: Look at everything on the screen before you click, since the solution is often in an object or detail you might pass over.
When a puzzle seems stuck, try a few different actions in turn instead of repeating the same one.
Pay attention to the disguise and chaos ideas the game hints at, such as dressing up or causing a distraction, because they often point toward the answer.
Take a short break after a hard level and come back with fresh eyes, since many of these puzzles are easier to see once you step away.
Expect each level to work differently, so do not carry one solution over to the next and check what is new each time.
faq: What is the goal of Skip Love?
You help the stickman hero win the heart of his beloved by getting past dangers and solving the puzzle in each level.
How do I control the game?
Use mouse clicks or taps to interact with objects and solve each puzzle.

connecting-flowers-garden-merge.intro: Connecting Flowers: Garden Merge is a calm puzzle where you drop flowers and merge matching pairs into bigger ones. You earn points as you go and can compare your result with other players on the global nectar rankings.
tips: Before you drop a flower, look at where the matching flower sits, so that when they collide they merge rather than stacking awkwardly.
Aim for the spot where the flower will land directly on a matching one, since a clean collision is the key to a merge.
Bigger flowers are worth more points, so keep building toward larger merges instead of only clearing small ones.
Take your time with each drop. The game is calm and rewards careful placement more than quick clicks.
Check your position on the nectar rankings after a run and try again to climb higher.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Connect as many flowers as possible by merging identical ones, earn points, and aim for the top spot among the nectar collectors.
How do I control the flowers?
Drag a flower to where you want to drop it. It will fall and merge with any identical flower it hits.

your-queen-destiny.intro: Your Queen Destiny is a dress-up game where your answers to questions reveal your queenly traits. Each playthrough can lead to a different royal style.
tips: Answer each question based on how you actually want your queen to be, since your answers shape the traits that define her.
Try a second playthrough with different answers to see how your royal destiny and available outfits change.
Keep track of the dress-up combinations you like so you can recreate or build on them in later runs.
Look for outfit pairings that suit the traits your answers have revealed, since the game links style and strategy.
Experiment with a few unlocked combinations before settling on a final look, so you can compare how each one fits your queen.
faq: What is the goal of Your Queen Destiny?
The goal is to discover your regal alter ego by answering questions that reveal your queenly traits. Your answers also unlock dress-up combinations.
How do I unlock new dress-up combinations?
New combinations are unlocked as you answer questions and progress through the game. The game description does not list specific unlock requirements.

car-sales-empire-simulator.intro: Car Sales Empire Simulator is a city business game where you buy, repair, and resell cars to grow your dealership. This guide covers the basics of trading, controls, and how to build your money early.
tips: Keep part of your starting 7000 dollars in reserve so you can afford tuning on the car you buy first.
Buy at lower prices, since paying less per car is the most direct way to increase your profit on each resale.
Before committing to a purchase, check how much tuning or repair the car needs and factor that cost into your resale price.
Complete quests to earn in-game dollars, which can help you afford more expensive cars sooner.
Drive carefully through traffic, because the game rewards maneuvering the city without accidents. If performance feels slow on your device, try the Low graphics mode.
faq: What is the main goal of Car Sales Empire Simulator?
Buy cars at markets, upgrade them, and sell them for a profit. Higher sales open up more opportunities to grow your dealership.
How do I move my character and car?
Use WASD to drive the car and move the character. Press F to get into the car and Enter to get out.

outpost-9.intro: Outpost 9 is a first-person horror shooter where you are the last survivor, holding off endless zombie waves. Earn points, open doors, restore power and see how long you can last.
tips: Use the doors and power restoration to open up new areas of the facility, but only spend points when you have a clear plan for them.
Aim for headshots when you can, since they count toward your leaderboard score and can save ammunition.
Keep the melee attack ready for zombies that get close, so you do not waste reloads on enemies you can handle at short range.
Throw grenades at groups of zombies rather than single targets, especially when you are being surrounded.
Turn on your flashlight in dark areas so you can see approaching zombies before they reach you, and keep moving rather than standing still.
faq: What is the main goal in Outpost 9?
Survive as many zombie waves as you can while earning points, unlocking doors, restoring power and lighting the beacon. Your survival time and kills are tracked on the leaderboards.
How do I repair things in the facility?
Stand near the object and hold the E key on desktop, or hold the USE button on mobile. Repairs take holding the button rather than a single tap.

kitten-rescue.intro: Kitten Rescue is a physics puzzle where you cut the ropes holding a trapped kitten and guide him to safety. Each level gets harder as you go, and you can collect more cats along the way.
tips: Before you cut anything, look at the whole room and work out which rope is holding the kitten and which ones are connected to traps.
Cut the ropes that drop the kitten away from danger first, so you are not forced to react to a trap at the last moment.
Make your swipe or mouse movement a clean, deliberate line across the rope rather than a quick scribble, so you cut only where you intend.
Watch how the kitten swings and falls after each cut, and plan your next move around where he will be, not where he is now.
If a level gets difficult, pause and reconsider the order of your cuts instead of rushing, since the levels are built around solving the room in the right sequence.
faq: What is the goal of Kitten Rescue?
Your goal is to cut the ropes holding the trapped kitten, avoid the dangerous traps, and help him escape the room. Rescuing and collecting extra cats is part of the challenge too.
How do I cut the ropes?
On mobile, swipe your finger across the screen over the ropes. On desktop, move your mouse or touchpad across them to cut.

tanks-battle-royale.intro: Tanks Battle Royale is an action game about tank combat on a shrinking battlefield. Collect loot, upgrade your tank, and be the last one still rolling.
tips: Keep moving toward the safe area as the battlefield shrinks, so you are not caught outside it when the closing zone reaches you.
Pick up loot early but stay aware of where other tanks are, so you can grab upgrades without getting trapped in the open.
Spend upgrades on what fits your style, whether that is firepower or durability, rather than spreading them across everything.
Watch how opponents move and fight, then change your approach if your first plan is not working.
Use the edges and cover of the map to set up surprises, because outsmarting foes often matters more than fighting head on.
faq: What is the goal of Tanks Battle Royale?
The goal is to be the last tank left on the battlefield. You do this by surviving the shrinking map, collecting loot, and defeating your opponents.
How do I get stronger during a match?
Collect powerful loot scattered across the battlefield and use it to upgrade your arsenal. Choose upgrades that match how you like to play.

save-kitten.intro: Save Kitten is a time-limited rescue game where you bounce kittens into a basket using a trampoline. Move carefully through the tower, avoid bombs, and pick up boosters and coins as you go.
tips: Keep your eyes on the falling kittens first and position your hero early, rather than reacting at the last second.
Watch for bombs before they reach your path and steer around them, since a hit costs you progress.
Grab boosters and coins when they are safe to reach, but do not chase them into danger near the edges of the tower.
Use short, controlled movements instead of large swings so you stay under control while the clock runs down.
Aim to fill the basket steadily rather than waiting for a big rush, which keeps your score climbing for the leaderboard.
faq: What is the main goal in Save Kitten?
Catch falling kittens on your trampoline and fill the basket before time runs out. Your performance also determines your place on the leaderboard.
What should I avoid while playing?
Bombs are the main hazard, so steer away from them while you move around the tower. Hitting them slows your progress toward filling the basket.

smash-and-break.intro: Smash and Break is a voxel destruction sandbox with 100 objects to take apart. Hit, hold, and rotate to see how each one breaks, and collect the hidden stars for bonus XP.
tips: Rotate the object before you commit to a spot, so you can see which side has the most cubes to remove and where the stars might be hidden.
Try different tools from the left panel on the same object, since each one destroys in its own way and you can compare the results.
Hold down the mouse or touch on a weapon that fires automatically so you don't have to keep clicking.
Work through the object steadily, because you need to break most of it before the next object unlocks.
Look for the stars inside the cubes as you go, and keep an eye on glass, liquids, and flammable parts that react in their own way.
faq: What is the goal of Smash and Break?
There is no set goal, timer, or game over. You destroy objects freely, and breaking most of one unlocks the next.
How do I rotate an object to see it from another side?
Use the right mouse button, two fingers on a touch screen, or the arrow keys or A and D keys.

super-watermelon.intro: Super Watermelon is a fruit merging puzzle. You combine smaller fruits to build a watermelon in tight spaces, using quirky physics and surprise elements along the way.
tips: Plan each drop before you make it, since a poorly placed fruit can crowd the space and block later merges.
Keep the middle of the play area as open as you can, so fruits have room to roll and meet their matches.
Watch how the physics behaves with small fruits first, because the rules for how they settle will affect every bigger merge.
Pay attention to surprise elements as they appear and adjust your plan rather than sticking to a fixed approach.
Save your unlocked moves for situations that are truly stuck, so you are not using them up early on easy setups.
faq: What is the main goal of Super Watermelon?
The goal is to merge smaller fruits together until you create a watermelon, the juicy reward the game is built around.
Are there written instructions for the controls?
No instructions are listed for this game, so the best way to learn the controls is to experiment with a few small fruits before planning bigger merges.

bloxdhop.intro: BloxdHop is an arcade parkour game built around running and jumping across intricate worlds. Earn gold, improve your avatar's agility, and work your way to the top.
tips: Take each jump slowly at first so you learn how far your avatar travels before you try longer gaps.
Treat the fear of falling as the main obstacle: pause on a safe platform, check your landing spot, and then commit to the leap.
Collect gold whenever it's on your route, since it's one of the game's main rewards and worth grabbing without detours that put you at risk.
Spend time improving your avatar's agility early, because a faster, more responsive character makes the harder obstacles easier to clear.
If you get stuck on one section, try replaying it with a different path or timing rather than repeating the same jump over and over.
faq: What is the goal of BloxdHop?
The goal is to master the parkour moves and commands, clear the obstacles in each world, and climb to the top of the rankings.
How do I earn gold in BloxdHop?
Gold is earned while you play through the worlds, so collecting it along your route is the main way to build up your total.

arms-race.intro: Arms Race is an arcade game about merging identical weapons into stronger ones to build up your firepower. Click to interact and keep upgrading your arsenal as the battle escalates.
tips: Watch for two identical weapons before you commit, since merging only works with duplicates of the same firearm.
Plan your merges early rather than waiting, so your firepower keeps pace with the rising challenge.
Keep your attention on the battlefield while you upgrade, because the game moves quickly and rewards steady combat.
Try to build toward higher-tier guns steadily instead of spreading your effort across many weak weapons.
Take short breaks between rounds to reset your focus, since the endless format can make it easy to lose track of your progress.
faq: What is the main goal of Arms Race?
Your goal is to merge duplicate weapons into higher-tier guns and grow your firepower as far as you can. The game is endless, so there is no fixed finish line.
How do I interact with the game?
The game is controlled with clicks. Click to interact with the weapons and the battle.

noobik-parkour-in-a-cave.intro: Noobik Parkour in a Cave! is a 3D parkour game with 10 hardcore levels. Your goal is to reach the finish line while overcoming obstacles and dodging traps along the way.
tips: Rotate the camera before you commit to a jump so you can see the platform's exact position and the gap you need to cross.
Watch the traps for a moment before moving through them, since their timing tells you when it is safe to pass.
Keep your movements short and controlled rather than running at full speed, which makes it easier to stop or correct a jump.
Use the pause menu to step away and reset your focus when a level becomes frustrating, then return to the route you planned.
Treat each of the 10 levels as a route to memorize, noting where the obstacles appear so you can plan your next jumps in advance.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You need to get to the finish line while overcoming obstacles and dodging traps along the way.
How do I move and jump on a computer?
Use WASD to move, Space to jump, and the mouse to rotate the camera. Press Escape to open the pause menu.

red-coloring-book.intro: Red Coloring Book is a drawing game where you color favorite cartoons using shades of red. It is designed to build creativity and attention to detail.
tips: Pick one shade of red first and fill the largest areas, then add darker or lighter reds to give the picture depth.
Work slowly around small sections and outlines, since careful edges are what make a coloring look clean.
Compare different shades side by side before committing, so your red tones feel balanced across the whole image.
Step back from the picture now and then to check whether the colors look dynamic and vibrant as a whole.
Try several shades in one image to see how much variety red can offer, rather than using one tone everywhere.
faq: What is the goal of Red Coloring Book?
The goal is to color cartoon images using shades of red to create dynamic, vibrant pictures.
Do I have to use only red?
The game is built around shades of red, so the focus is on exploring different reds rather than mixing in many other colors.

perfect-car-parking.intro: Perfect Car Parking is a racing puzzle about precise parking. You steer different vehicles through detailed levels, where accuracy and patience matter more than speed.
tips: Before you move, study the whole layout, including the walls, other objects and the exact space your car needs. Most mistakes come from rushing in without checking the gaps.
Take slow, small steps when you get close to the target spot. Easing off early gives you more room to correct your angle.
Pay attention to how each vehicle handles, since different cars can be different sizes and turn differently. Adjust your approach to the car you are driving.
If you end up at a bad angle, reverse and reset your line rather than forcing the car into place. Repeated pushing often makes the position worse.
Take a short break when you feel frustrated. Coming back with a clear head makes it easier to spot the details that matter.
faq: What is the goal of Perfect Car Parking?
The goal is to park your vehicle precisely in the designated spot on each intricate level. Accuracy is the main challenge.
Is speed important in this game?
Speed is not the focus. The game rewards careful, controlled moves, so slowing down usually helps you park more accurately.

princess-dental-dentist-games.intro: Princess Dental is a point-and-click puzzle where you examine princess patients, find dental problems, and treat them with the right tools. Each patient has a different issue to solve.
tips: Look over the whole mouth before you pick a tool, so you can spot every cavity, patch of dirt, and other problem first.
Choose the tool that matches the problem you found, since each treatment step depends on using the correct dentist tool.
Work through the treatment one step at a time rather than jumping ahead, because the steps are meant to be completed in order.
Check that every problem is treated before you finish, so the princess ends up with a clean, healthy smile.
Handle the tools carefully and keep an eye on each step, since the description notes that each procedure needs care.
faq: What is the goal of each patient visit?
Find all the dental problems, treat them with the correct tools, and make sure the princess is left with a healthy, beautiful smile.
How do I know which tool to use?
Examine the teeth closely first to identify the problem, then select the dentist tool that fits that treatment.

merge-racer-stunts-car.intro: Merge Racer Stunts Car is an arcade racing game where you combine matching cars to build stronger machines. Play is controlled with a mouse click or a tap.
tips: Merge matching car types as often as you can, since combining the same kind is how you build stronger racing machines.
Plan your moves before each tap so you keep matching cars close together instead of spreading out the same types.
Watch which cars are already on the board and aim to create a merge soon rather than waiting until the space fills up.
Keep your clicks or taps steady and deliberate; quick, careless input makes it easier to place cars in the wrong spot.
If a run starts to go badly, look for any available merge first, because one good combination can open up more room.
faq: What is the main goal of Merge Racer Stunts Car?

The goal is to merge the same types of cars to build stronger supercars while showing your driving skills. The description and instructions do not list a specific win condition, so focus on building the strongest machines you can.
How do I control the game?
Use a mouse click or tap to play. There are no other controls listed in the game's instructions.

moto-x3m-halloween.intro: Moto X3M Halloween is a bike racing game with stunts, deadly obstacles and explosive crashes across challenging levels. This Spooky Land version asks you to ride fast while staying in control.
tips: Use the arrow keys with small, steady inputs instead of pressing hard, since sudden movements are what tend to send you off the bike.
Watch the obstacles ahead before you reach them so you have time to adjust your speed and position.
Go fast where the track is clear, but ease off before tricky sections so you do not crash at full speed.
Try a level's stunts in calm sections first to learn how your bike reacts before attempting them on dangerous ground.
When a crash happens, restart quickly and note exactly where it went wrong, then change that one part of your approach.
faq: What is the goal of Moto X3M Halloween?
You race your bike through the levels and challenges of the Spooky Land version, performing stunts while avoiding deadly obstacles and crashes.
How do I control the bike?
Use the arrow keys to control your bike throughout the race.

freekick-hero.intro: Freekick Hero is a 3D arcade football game where you bend free kicks around walls and past goalkeepers. You can climb through a Career season by season or chase a high score in the Free Kick Challenge.
tips: Read the wind before every shot. Adjust your aim to counter it, since wind can push the ball off a line that looks correct.
Pick your strike point with care. The point you release on controls both height and curve, so try a few shots to learn how each point changes the flight.
Use the info button on the strike screen when you are unsure where to hit the ball. The strike-point guide helps you choose before you commit.
Spend upgrades on the stat that matches your play. Power helps with long distances, while curve helps when you need to wrap the ball around a wall.
In the Free Kick Challenge, avoid rushing. You only have a limited number of lives, so a careful, accurate shot is usually worth more than a fast one.
faq: How do I aim and shoot?
Drag the ball backward to aim and set power, then release to choose your strike point. On a mobile device you use touch and drag instead of the mouse.
What is the difference between the two modes?
Career has you play seasons and climb the leagues. The Free Kick Challenge asks you to chase your highest score before you run out of lives.

speed-pool-king.intro: Speed Pool King is a pool table puzzle game where you aim with the mouse, plan angles, and pot balls. Precision and planning matter more than quick shots.
tips: Use the indicator lines before every shot to check where the cue ball will travel and whether it will hit the target ball cleanly.
Think about the angle you want the cue ball to take after impact, not just whether the target ball goes in, so your next shot is easier to reach.
Start with the easier balls that are close to pockets and clear the table gradually, so you are not left with awkward shots at the end.
Save the black 8-ball for last and avoid potting it early, since that can end your run before the table is cleared.
Use power and spin deliberately: test lighter shots first to learn how the cue ball responds, then adjust for the harder shots.
faq: How do I aim my shot?
Move your cue with the mouse and follow the indicator lines to see the likely path of the cue ball. Adjust the angle until the line points to the ball you want to pot.
When should I pot the black 8-ball?
Leave the black 8-ball until you have dealt with the other balls, because potting it too early can cost you the game. Plan your final shots so the 8-ball is in a good position when you need it.

world-flags-quiz.intro: World Flags Quiz is a flag matching game. You see a country name and pick the correct flag from four options using your mouse. It is a single mode that tests your knowledge one country at a time.
tips: Before reading the four options, picture the flag you expect for the country name shown. This helps you spot the right one faster.
Check small details like the exact arrangement of stripes, the position of a symbol, or the colors used. The wrong options are chosen to look similar, so these details decide the answer.
Use elimination. Rule out any flag with colors or layouts that clearly do not match before choosing between the remaining ones.
Keep a mental list of flags you confuse with each other, such as ones with similar colors or stripes, and look at those pairs more carefully.
Stay focused on each round separately. Do not let a wrong answer affect how you approach the next country.
faq: How do I play World Flags Quiz?
A country name appears, and you choose the matching flag from four options by clicking it with your mouse. Only one option is correct.
Are there different game modes?
No. The game offers one single mode where each round asks you to match a country with its flag.

shape-connect.intro: Shape Connect is a puzzle where you help two teddy bears reach each other. Fill the gaps in a broken road with the matching shapes so they can cross.
tips: Look at the whole road before you start, so you know how many gaps need filling.
Compare each gap's outline with the shapes at the bottom, paying attention to edges and corners.
If a shape does not fit, drag it to a different gap or try another shape rather than guessing the same one again.
Say the name of each shape out loud as you pick it, which helps with shape recognition.
Work from the gap you are most sure about, since placing one correct shape can make the next choice easier.
faq: What is the goal of Shape Connect?
The goal is to place the right shapes into the gaps in the broken road so the two teddy bears can cross and meet.
How do I place a shape?
On desktop, click and drag a shape from the bottom of the screen into the road. On mobile, touch and drag the shape into place.

candy-sweet.intro: Candy Sweet is a match-style puzzle game where you line up colorful treats to set off effects and combos across a range of candy-themed levels. It rewards careful planning more than quick taps.
tips: Before each move, scan the board for setups that could trigger a chain reaction, since explosive combos often score the most.
Vary your approach from level to level, because the layouts are described as varied and a strategy that works in one may fail in another.
Look for moves that set up a combo for your next turn, not just the one that clears the most treats right now.
Pay attention to which treats create special effects when matched, and try to save those for spots where they can clear more of the board.
If a level stalls, pause and map out two or three possible moves before committing, which helps you avoid wasting turns.
faq: What is the goal of Candy Sweet?
The game asks you to match treats and use their effects to work through its varied levels. Clearing each level with clever moves is the main objective.
How do I create explosive combos?
Match treats in ways that set off their effects, and plan moves so one effect can lead into another. Strategic setups usually lead to bigger combos.

dd-bubble-up.intro: DD Bubble Up is a bubble shooter where you clear groups of matching balls to score points and finish each level. Aim carefully, use boosters when you get stuck, and try to clear the field in as few shots as possible.
tips: Before each shot, look for the largest group of matching balls you can reach and aim for it, since clearing bigger groups usually helps you finish faster.
Count your shots as you go, because the goal is to clear the field in the least number of shots.
Save the bomb and rocket boosters for stubborn spots, such as balls buried in the middle of the field that are hard to reach with a normal shot.
Think about what will be left behind after you clear a group, and avoid shots that leave isolated balls that are difficult to reach later.
Keep an eye out for the rainbow and lightning boosters, and use them when a level has many balls of mixed colors that are blocking your progress.
faq: What is the main goal of DD Bubble Up?
Your goal is to destroy balls of the same color by aiming and shooting until the field is clear. Try to do it in the least number of shots.
How do I score points?
You score points by clearing groups of matching balls. Larger groups in a single shot are a good way to build your score.

zombie-hell-shooter.intro: Zombie Hell Shooter is a shooting game set in a ruined city full of zombies. You survive by shooting your way through the horde, and the only control is tapping to fire.
tips: Keep your taps steady rather than rapid-firing without aiming, so each shot counts.
Pick off the nearest zombies first, since they reach you soonest and are the biggest immediate threat.
Watch the direction the zombies are coming from and turn your attention there before they close in.
Stay alert for lulls in the attack and use them to reposition or reset your focus for the next wave.
Play in short sessions at first to learn the rhythm of the attacks before pushing for a longer run.
faq: What is the goal of Zombie Hell Shooter?
The goal is to survive the zombie-filled city ruin by fighting off the horde with your weapon. The description frames survival as your only hope.
How do I shoot in Zombie Hell Shooter?
You shoot by tapping the screen. Tapping is the only control listed in the instructions.

amazing-sheriff.intro: Amazing Sheriff is a space adventure where you hop between spinning planetoids, collect coins, and dodge hazards. Precise timing is the key to keeping your run going.
tips: Watch a planetoid through a full rotation before you jump, so you know where it will be when you land.
Build your chain of jumps one safe hop at a time rather than rushing, since a single misstep can end the run.
Keep an eye on hazards ahead of you so you can plan your next landing before you leave the current planetoid.
Grab coins when they sit on your natural path, but don't take a risky jump just to reach one.
Practice a steady rhythm on the early planetoids, then carry that same timing into longer combo chains.
faq: What is the main goal in Amazing Sheriff?
Hop between spinning planetoids, collect coins, and chain jumps for combos while avoiding hazards. The description says the aim is to keep your cosmic quest going.
What happens if I make a mistake?
One misstep can end your cosmic quest, so a mistimed jump usually means the run is over.

sword-play-ninja-slice-runner.intro: Sword Play! Ninja Slice Runner is a slicing action game where you fight through waves of ninja assassins and samurai missions across a range of levels. It can be played offline.
tips: Watch how enemies approach before you commit to a slice, since waves of assassins can come from different directions and timing matters.
Start each new level by checking what kind of foes appear, so you can plan your first few slices instead of reacting late.
Keep a steady rhythm rather than rushing every cut; precision tends to matter more than speed in this game.
If a level feels hard, replay it to learn the enemy patterns before moving on to the next challenge.
Pay attention to the surroundings in each level, as the landscapes can change the way you need to move through a stage.
faq: What is the main goal of Sword Play! Ninja Slice Runner?
You play as a sword fighter cutting through numerous foes, working through a set of challenging levels and samurai missions.
What kind of gameplay should I expect?
The game focuses on intuitive slicing, where each slash is used to take down enemies in waves of ninja assassins.

triangle-way.intro: Triangle Way is a hyper casual arcade game where you pilot a neon plane through busy skies. Dodge enemies and obstacles, collect power-ups, and aim for a high score as the difficulty rises.
tips: Spend your first few runs getting a feel for how the plane responds before trying to chase high scores.
Watch the enemies and obstacles a moment ahead rather than reacting only when they are close, since the difficulty escalates over time.
Treat power-ups as strategic choices: grab them when it helps you get through a tricky stretch, not just whenever one is nearby.
Stay calm when the pace picks up. Short, steady corrections usually keep you safer than sudden large movements.
Use each run to notice which kinds of obstacles give you the most trouble, then focus your attention on those patterns next time.
faq: What is the main goal in Triangle Way?
Pilot your neon plane through the sky, dodge enemies and obstacles, and aim for a high score.
Why do the levels feel harder the longer I play?
The game uses escalating difficulty, so the obstacles and enemies become more challenging the longer you keep flying.

obby-ragdoll-boxing.intro: Obby: Ragdoll Boxing is a ragdoll fighting game where you control a floppy boxer through arena trials, training and improvised fights. Win battles and become the strongest Obby boxer.
tips: Watch how your ragdoll moves after each hit, since the physics are unpredictable and knowing how your fighter reacts helps you plan the next punch.
Pay attention to your opponent's movements and try to dodge before you throw a punch, because a well-timed dodge often matters more than a fast attack.
Use the training areas to get a feel for the controls before you enter a real fight, so your punches and dodges feel natural when it counts.
Try different arenas and locations, since each one can change how you move and how fights play out.
If you want to just enjoy the chaos, let your fighter fly around and see what happens, but switch to careful, precise punches when you are working toward passing an arena test.
faq: What is the goal of Obby: Ragdoll Boxing?
The goal is to win battles with your ragdoll fighter, pass arena tests, improve your skills and become the strongest Obby boxer.
How do I control my fighter?
You control punches and dodges with simple controls, and you can aim for precise hits or simply watch the chaotic physics play out.

orc-breach.intro: Orc Breach is a tower defense game where you hold back waves of orcs by placing and aiming turrets along their route. Each wave grows bigger, so planning your defenses matters as much as quick reactions.
tips: Place turrets close to the enemy route so they can fire on the horde for longer before it reaches your base.
Mix turret types so that slowing, burning and blasting work together rather than relying on one weapon.
Save your support abilities for the largest assaults, when a well-timed slow or blast can prevent a breakthrough.
Spend upgrades on the turrets that already cover the most of the path instead of spreading them thinly.
Keep the camera zoomed to a level where you can see both the approaching orcs and the turrets you are aiming, so you react before the horde closes in.
faq: What is the goal of Orc Breach?
Stop the enormous orc hordes from breaking through your defenses and reaching your base. You need to survive the increasingly massive assaults across the campaign.
How do I place and aim turrets on PC?
Use the mouse to place and aim turrets, and use the mouse wheel to zoom. Move the camera with WASD or the arrow keys.

circle-zombie.intro: Circle Zombie is an arcade adventure where you guide a leaping circle past undead obstacles. Precise timing and rhythmic jumps are central, and the game gets tenser as you go.
tips: Watch the obstacles for a few moments before your first jump so you can read their pattern and rhythm.
Focus on timing over speed. A well-timed leap is usually safer than a rushed one, especially as the tension rises.
Practice the rhythm of the jumps in short runs. Repeating a section helps you learn when to leap without overthinking it.
Stay calm when the challenge escalates. Staying relaxed helps you keep your timing steady.
Play for a few runs and note where you lose the most. Aim to improve one section at a time if you want to climb the global leaderboard.
faq: What is the main goal in Circle Zombie?
Guide your leaping circle past undead obstacles using precise timing and rhythmic jumps. Your results can also place you on the global leaderboard.
How does difficulty change as I play?
The game's tension escalates over time, so the challenges become harder the longer you keep going.

mathematics-frenzy.intro: Mathematics Frenzy is a fast-paced runner where you race through obstacle courses and solve math gates in real time. Quick calculations and steady focus help you build a high score.
tips: Read each math gate as soon as it appears so you have more time to work out the answer before you reach it.
Practice simple mental arithmetic, such as adding, subtracting, and multiplying small numbers, so you can answer quickly under pressure.
Keep your attention on the upcoming obstacles and gates rather than the one you just passed, since reacting early leaves more room for error.
Use the mouse click or tap control deliberately, timing each input to the obstacle or gate in front of you instead of tapping rapidly.
Pay attention to how the numbers grow when you expand them, and aim to keep your number value high as you move toward a higher score.
faq: What is the main goal of Mathematics Frenzy?
The goal is to run through the obstacle courses, solve the math gates in real time, and reach a high score.
How do I control the game?
Use a mouse click or a tap to play. The game is controlled with this single input.

slope-racing.intro: Slope Racing is a casual racing game where you drive a car down different slopes, collecting coins along the way. Use WASD or the arrow keys to steer and control your car.
tips: Keep your eyes a few seconds ahead on the slope so you can react to turns and bumps before you reach them.
Try to collect coins whenever it is safe to do so, since they are what you need to buy cars and new environments such as the desert.
Avoid sharp, sudden steering on steep sections, because quick direction changes are the easiest way to lose control of the car.
Take short practice runs on a slope to learn how your car handles before attempting longer routes.
Stay relaxed and make small corrections with the keys rather than large swings, which keeps the car steadier over long runs.
faq: What is the goal of Slope Racing?
The goal is to drive your car down the slopes and collect coins. Coins let you buy new cars and other environments like the desert.
How do I control the car?
Use the WASD keys or the arrow keys to move the car. Steer gently to keep it stable on the slope.

merge-a-rocket.intro: Merge a Rocket! is a 3D puzzle game where you combine matching rockets to build stronger ones and launch them at the enemy base. Keep your town safe while you grow your arsenal.
tips: Before merging, check that both rockets are the same level, since only matching rockets combine into a higher-level one.
Plan your route so you can carry a rocket to its matching partner without wandering across the map.
Spend your in-game coins on Upgrades early so you can carry more rockets at once and build up faster.
Keep an eye on the enemy base and save your Shield for when the enemy attacks, rather than using it at random.
Consider using Rebirth once your progress slows down, since it resets your run in exchange for a bigger in-game bonus.
faq: What is the main goal of Merge a Rocket!?
You merge rockets of the same level into stronger ones, then launch them at the enemy base before it destroys your town.
How do I merge two rockets?
Pick up one rocket, carry it to another rocket of the same level, and it will merge into a higher-level rocket.

crazy-runner-boy.intro: Crazy Runner Boy is a fast arcade runner where you dodge obstacles, pull off flips, and collect coins while the pace keeps rising. Quick reactions and smooth movement are the keys to a high score.
tips: Watch the path ahead rather than the obstacle right in front of you, so you have time to react as the game speeds up.
Stay calm during the early stages, when the pace is still manageable, and build a steady rhythm before the speed climbs.
Grab coins when it is safe to do so, but do not risk a collision just to reach one, since a crash ends the run.
Use flips as a way to clear obstacles you cannot easily dodge, and practice timing them so they feel natural.
Keep your focus fully on the screen; short lapses in attention are more costly when the game is moving at its fastest.
faq: What is the main goal in Crazy Runner Boy?
Your goal is to dodge obstacles, collect coins, and boost your score for as long as you can keep running. The game gets faster over time, so survival gets harder.
How does the game get harder?
The game accelerates to a faster pace as you play, which means obstacles come at you more quickly. Staying focused and reacting fast becomes more important the longer you last.

kids-flurry-educational-puzzle-game.intro: Kids Flurry is an animal puzzle game where you search intricate patterns to find hidden animals. It builds logic and observation skills through colorful visuals and challenges that grow harder over time.
tips: Scan the whole picture before focusing on one area, so you can notice where the animal's outline might begin.
Pay attention to color changes, since a shade that looks slightly different from its neighbors can mark the edge of a hidden animal.
Look for shapes that seem out of place in the pattern, such as a curve or angle that doesn't match the repeating design around it.
Try different ways of looking at the picture, like squinting or moving your eyes across it in rows, to spot shapes you might otherwise miss.
Take a short break when you feel stuck, then return with fresh eyes, because the later challenges reward patient observation.
faq: What is the main goal of Kids Flurry Educational Puzzle Game?
The goal is to uncover the animals hidden inside intricate patterns by spotting color variations and unusual shapes.
What skills does this game help build?
The game is designed to sharpen logic and observational skills while you work through its puzzles.

bike-mania-2.intro: Bike Mania 2 is a precision biking game where you ride across varied terrain through 20 levels. Success depends on balance, control, and patience as you get past each obstacle.
tips: Go slowly through the first few levels to learn how your bike responds before trying to move fast.
Watch the terrain ahead so you can adjust your balance before you reach a bump, slope, or obstacle.
Make small, controlled adjustments rather than large movements, since precision matters more than speed here.
If you fall or get stuck, pause to figure out exactly where you lost control, then try that section again.
Treat each level as a chance to improve one section at a time instead of rushing toward the finish.
faq: What is the main goal of Bike Mania 2?
You ride your bike across diverse terrains and get through 20 levels by overcoming obstacles with good balance and control.
What makes Bike Mania 2 challenging?
The game focuses on precision-based biking, so small mistakes with balance can cause problems, especially on tricky terrain and around obstacles.

bullets-master.intro: Bullets Master is a puzzle shooter where you play as an assassin and eliminate enemies with aimed shots. Careful aiming and using the environment are the keys to clearing each situation.
tips: Aim with the mouse and take a moment to plan before you click, since precision is central to the game.
Look for walls you can bounce bullets off, and check the angle of the rebound before firing.
Pay attention to explosive traps in the scene; a single well-placed shot can set them off and take out several enemies at once.
Think about the order of your shots so that one bullet does not get blocked before it reaches its target.
Try a different route or angle if a shot fails, rather than repeating the same aim.
faq: How do I aim and shoot?
Move the mouse to aim and click to fire. Mouse aim and click are the only controls the game uses.
How do I beat a level?
You need to eliminate the enemies in each setup, using bounces and traps where they help you reach them.

obby-parkour-sleeping-brainrots.intro: Obby Parkour: Sleeping Brainrots is an arcade parkour game where you run, avoid sleepers, and escape a huge Brainrot that keeps closing in. Speed, reflexes, and agility decide how far you get.
tips: Keep moving forward rather than stopping to look around, since the huge Brainrot is always approaching and pausing gives it ground.
Use the space bar to jump early before an obstacle reaches you, because a late jump is harder to recover from.
Watch where the sleepers are before you pass them and plan a route that keeps you clear of them.
Adjust the camera with the mouse often so you can see the next jump and landing spot before you commit to it.
Use W, A, S, and D in short, controlled movements near tricky platforms to keep your balance and line up each jump.
faq: What is the goal of Obby Parkour: Sleeping Brainrots?
The goal is to complete challenging levels by running and jumping while avoiding the sleepers and escaping the huge Brainrot that keeps approaching.
How do I move and jump on a computer?
Use W, A, S, and D to move and the space bar to jump, and move the mouse to rotate the camera.

hexasort.intro: HexaSort is a puzzle game about sorting colored hex tiles. Place tiles so that matching colors sit next to each other, and the stacks clear away.
tips: Look at the whole board before you place a tile, and check which colors are already grouped together.
Build up matching colors in one area rather than spreading single tiles across the table, so stacks can merge sooner.
Watch for a tile that would block a color group you are building, and try to place it where it does not split the group.
Use the hints when you get stuck, especially when no move seems to bring two same-colored tiles together.
Pause and plan a few moves ahead when the table starts to fill up, because a poor placement can make the board harder to clear.
faq: What is the goal of HexaSort?
The goal is to place hex tiles on the game table so that tiles of the same color end up next to each other. When they line up, the stacks merge and disappear.
How do I make a stack disappear?
Put tiles of one color next to each other so the stacks join together. Once they merge, they are removed from the table.

noob-saves-a-girl-a-story.intro: Noob Saves a Girl is a rescue story where you play as a hero working to save his love from a villain. You fight through battles and challenges, and the goal is to defeat all the bosses.
tips: Learn the movement controls first. On a computer, use the mouse and keyboard, and on a mobile device, use the joystick, so you can move comfortably before a tough fight starts.
Keep track of which bosses you still need to defeat so you know how far you are from finishing the story.
Treat each battle as a strategic challenge. Watch how a boss moves or attacks for a few seconds before you commit to close-range action.
Move around the scene rather than standing still, which helps you avoid danger and find a better position for your attacks.
If a boss beats you, try the same fight again with a different approach. Repeating the battle while changing your timing often works better than rushing in.
faq: What is the main goal of Noob Saves a Girl?
Your goal is to rescue your love from a cunning villain by defeating all the bosses in the story.
How do I move my character?
On a computer, move with the mouse and keyboard. On mobile devices, use the joystick.

cow-rescue.intro: Cow Rescue is a matching puzzle where you remove same-colored screws and clear wooden boards to free a trapped cow. Each level asks you to plan a path for her to escape.
tips: Before your first tap, look over the whole board and note which screw colors appear, so you know which matches are possible.
Plan a few moves ahead rather than tapping at random, since a careless match can leave you stuck later.
Clear the boards in the order that opens the most room for the cow's path instead of working from one corner.
When a level feels blocked, pause and check whether another match would open a new route before using a helpful tool.
Save the helpful tools for the harder layouts, and try a level on your own first to learn how the boards are arranged.
faq: What is the goal of Cow Rescue?
Your goal is to match and remove screws of the same color, clear the wooden boards in the way, and create a path for the cow to escape. You must do this in every level.
How do I play each move?
Tap two or more screws of the same color to match and remove them. Remove boards carefully so the path stays open.

piano-kids-music-songs.intro: Piano Kids is a music box game where young players tap colorful instruments to make sounds and play songs. It is designed for toddlers and kids who want to explore music on their own.
tips: Start with the piano or xylophone, since their keys are easy to see and tap in order, then move on to the drum kit.
Try each instrument for a few minutes so you can hear how the authentic sounds differ from one another.
Let your child pick the instrument they like best and repeat it, which helps build rhythm and familiarity.
Play along with a parent or older sibling by taking turns tapping, so the session feels like a shared music lesson.
Keep sessions short and fun, and switch instruments when attention drifts so the game stays engaging for little ones.
faq: What is the goal of Piano Kids Music Songs?
There is no fixed goal in the description. The game is a music box where you tap instruments to make sounds, learn to play, and explore songs.
How do I play the instruments?
Tap or click on the instrument you want to play. Each tap produces a sound from that instrument.

masquerades-vs-impostors.intro: Help the red-masked and blue-masked characters escape the spaceship by avoiding the impostors and zombies. Each mask has its own rules for who can be defeated, so plan each move around them.
tips: Before you move, check which impostors are the same color as the mask you are controlling, since only matching colors can be killed by that mask.
Use the double jump to reach higher spots or to get out of a risky position, and plan the second jump before you commit to the first.
Jump on top of an enemy to kill it, but only when your landing is clean, so you do not drop into danger below.
Keep an eye out for zombies as well as impostors, because they are also enemies you can kill and they can threaten you while you focus on escaping.
If you are playing with a friend, decide early who handles which threats so you do not both chase the same enemy.
faq: How do I kill an enemy?
Jump on it to defeat it. Keep in mind that only impostors matching your mask's color can be killed by that mask, and zombies can also be killed.
What does the double jump do?
The double jump lets you jump a second time while in the air. It helps you reach higher places and recover from awkward landings.

schoolboy-escape-from-parents.intro: Schoolboy: Escape from Parents! is a stealth adventure where you sneak out of the house without being seen. Explore rooms, collect items, and solve puzzles to find new routes to freedom across 10 endings.
tips: Look around each room before you act. Notice what objects are there and what they could be used for.
Try combining items and using them in different places. Ordinary things like a light bulb or a stool can open paths you would not expect.
Use the stool to reach higher spots or to change your position. On PC, Q places or picks up the stool, and on mobile it is the chair icon.
Plan your moves ahead of time instead of rushing. Think about where your parents are going next before you move through a room.
Once you have unlocked an ending, replay and try a different approach. Since there are 10 endings, changing your choices is the best way to see more of the game.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You need to escape the house without being seen by your parents. You do this by collecting items, using them wisely, and finding new paths out.
What are the basic controls on PC?
Use A, S, and D to move and W to jump. Press E to interact with objects and Q to place or pick up the stool.

robot-terminator-t-rex.intro: Robot Terminator T-Rex is an arcade battle game where you pilot a robotic T-Rex against robot dinosaurs and zombies. Each fight is fast, so quick reactions matter.
tips: Click or tap steadily rather than rapidly, and watch where enemies are heading before you commit to an action.
Try your different weapons and abilities early on to learn which ones work best against robot dinosaurs and which suit the zombies.
When several enemies move toward you at once, prioritise the ones closest to your T-Rex so they cannot close in and overwhelm you.
Keep moving rather than standing still in one spot, since staying put makes it easier for enemies to surround you.
Pay attention to how each battle develops and adjust your approach from one round to the next instead of repeating the same tactic.
faq: How do I control the T-Rex?
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps, so use a click on desktop or a tap on touch screens to act.
What enemies will I face?
You will battle robot dinosaurs and zombies, so plan your attacks around both types as they appear.

fly-airplane-3d.intro: Fly AirPlane 3D is an arcade game where you steer a plane through a 3D scene. Collect rubies, diamonds, stars and fuel while avoiding clouds that drain your fuel.
tips: Keep an eye on your fuel level and treat it as your most important resource, since running out ends the game.
Plan your path ahead so you can route around clouds instead of reacting at the last moment.
Short, controlled taps or clicks to climb usually give you more precise control than holding the input down.
Pick up fuel when it is available, since staying airborne longer gives you more chances to collect the other items.
Use the flying time to look for groups of rubies, diamonds and stars, which lets you collect more items in fewer moves.
faq: What is the goal of Fly AirPlane 3D?
The goal is to collect rubies, diamonds, stars and fuel. The player who collects the most items is the winner.
What happens when my plane hits a cloud?
Colliding with a cloud reduces your fuel, and if your fuel runs out the game is over.

fnf-fps.intro: FNF FPS is a 3D shooter based on Friday Night Funkin'. You move through the level, shoot enemies, and work toward saving your girlfriend.
tips: Use W, A, S and D to keep moving so enemies have a harder time lining up shots on you.
Hold right mouse button to aim when enemies are at a distance, then fire with left mouse button for more accurate shots.
Save the slow-motion key for tense moments with several enemies nearby, so you can look around and plan your next move.
Reload with R when you have a quiet moment, rather than waiting until your ammo is empty in the middle of a fight.
Use Shift to run between areas and Space to jump over obstacles, and switch the camera with C if you need a better view of the room.
faq: What is the goal of FNF FPS?
The goal is to defeat all the bad guys and save your girlfriend. The description focuses on defeating enemies as the main task.
How do I shoot and aim?
Left mouse button shoots and right mouse button aims. Aiming first and then firing can help you hit enemies more reliably.

bow-or-die.intro: Bow or Die is a fast physics survival archery game. You aim, judge arrow paths, and shoot incoming targets while dodging hazards. Precision and quick reactions decide how long you last.
tips: Make small drag adjustments before you release, since the arrow's path depends on how you pull and aim the bow.
Watch incoming targets and hazards first, then decide where you need to shoot before you start drawing the bow.
Keep your aim steady and release with a clear plan, because rushed shots are the easiest way to miss a target.
On mobile, touch and drag slowly to set your trajectory, then lift your finger only when the aim looks right.
Treat every shot as important, since the game rewards accuracy and high scores come from hitting targets rather than firing quickly.
faq: How do I shoot an arrow on desktop?
Click and drag with the left mouse button to draw the bow and aim, then release the button to fire the arrow.
How do I shoot on a touchscreen?
Touch and drag on the screen to aim your trajectory, then lift your finger to shoot.

daddy-rabbit.intro: Daddy Rabbit is a maze game where you lead a rabbit father through underground tunnels to rescue his bunnies while avoiding zombies. It mixes careful stealth with quick tap-based carrot punches.
tips: Keep your baby bunnies close to Daddy Rabbit, since the description says staying near them helps avoid alerting zombies.
Slow down and plan your route before moving through tight parts of the maze, because stealth matters as much as speed.
Save your quick reflexes for moments when a zombie gets close, rather than reacting to every threat at once.
Use your carrot punches on zombies when they block the way, and tap with a steady rhythm instead of mashing the screen.
Check that every baby bunny is safe before moving on, since the goal is to rescue all of them.
faq: What is the main goal of Daddy Rabbit?
Your goal is to guide Daddy Rabbit through the underground maze and rescue all of his baby bunnies. Keeping every bunny safe is the key objective.
How do the controls work?
The game uses tap controls. Tap to throw carrot punches at zombies.

street-freekick-3d.intro: Street Freekick 3D is a sports game about taking free kicks on the street. Aim for the perfect shot, get past the goalkeeper, and score points with precise kicks.
tips: Watch the goalkeeper's position before you kick, and aim for the side of the goal they are not covering.
Take a moment to line up each shot. Precision earns points, so a careful kick usually beats a rushed one.
Pay attention to the obstacles on each attempt and plan your shot around them rather than trying to force a straight line.
Use early shots to learn how the goalkeeper reacts, then change your approach if the same move keeps getting blocked.
Aim for consistent accurate kicks over risky ones, since clean scoring is how you build up your total points.
faq: What is the main goal in Street Freekick 3D?
Your goal is to score free kicks by outsmarting the goalkeeper and getting past the obstacles in your way. Accurate kicks earn you points.
How do I get more points in Street Freekick 3D?
Focus on precision. Lining up careful, accurate shots that beat the goalkeeper and avoid obstacles is the main way to rack up points.

stick-hero-tower-defense.intro: Stick Hero Tower Defense mixes action and strategy as a stickman defends his ground. You use drag-and-drop combat, gather allies, and face monstrous bosses in battles that reward careful planning.
tips: Gather allies whenever you can, since they boost your power and make the later battles easier to handle.
Pay attention to where enemies come from so you can place your fighters before they reach your defense.
Try different tactics instead of repeating the same setup, because clever positioning often matters more than brute force.
Before a boss fight, review which allies and units you have ready so you are not caught short when the boss arrives.
Stay calm during busy waves and act in order of threat, dealing with the enemies closest to your tower first.
faq: What is the main goal of Stick Hero Tower Defense?
You defend against waves of enemies by using drag-and-drop combat and clever tactics, with the aim of winning the battles, including those against monstrous bosses.
How do allies help me in the game?
