Gathering allies boosts your stickman's power, so collecting them is an important way to become strong enough for tougher enemies and bosses.

ultimate-knockout-race.intro: Ultimate Knockout Race is a physics-based action game where you race against 29 opponents, knock them off the platform and try to win every race to claim the crown. Use WASD or the arrow keys to move and Space to jump.
tips: Stay near the centre of the platform when others are close, since the edges are where players are most likely to fall.
Jump at the right moment to avoid obstacles or to recover your balance after a bump, rather than jumping constantly.
Watch where opponents are heading and push them when they are near the edge, so you eliminate them without risking your own position.
Keep moving rather than standing still, because being stationary makes you an easy target for opponents trying to knock you over.
Pay attention to how the physics react to hits, and learn which movements keep you steady so you can recover faster in later levels.
faq: How do I move my character?
Use W, A, S, and D or the arrow keys to move. Press Space to jump.
What is the goal of the game?
Eliminate other opponents to advance to the next level, win the races, and become the owner of the crown. You must avoid falling off the platform yourself.

one-line-drawling.intro: One Line Drawing is a hypercasual drawing game built around tracing shapes with a single continuous line. It offers both a relaxed mode for unwinding and puzzle-style challenges for a sharper test.
tips: Look at the whole figure before you start moving, and pick a starting point that lets you finish without lifting your line.
Plan the route through tricky corners or crossings in your head first, since a wrong turn can force you to start over.
In the relaxed style, slow down and focus on smooth, steady strokes rather than speed.
When a puzzle feels stuck, try tracing the shape from a different starting point to see if a new path opens up.
Play in short sessions if you want to unwind, and take a break when frustration builds so you come back with a clearer view of the lines.
faq: What is the basic goal of One Line Drawing?
The goal is to draw the shape or pattern using one continuous line. The game offers relaxed drawing and puzzle-type challenges.
Is there a difference between the relaxed and puzzle modes?
The relaxed gameplay is meant to help you unwind and reduce stress, while the puzzle-type gameplay adds a challenge to test your planning.

ticktock-puzzle-challenge.intro: TickTock Puzzle Challenge is a timed puzzle game where you race the clock. You can pick a classic level or a challenge mode, and each puzzle tests quick thinking, logic and creativity.
tips: Look at the whole puzzle for a moment before you click or tap, so you can spot the route or pattern before the clock starts to matter.
If you are new to the game, try a classic level first to learn how the puzzles work before moving on to challenge mode.
Keep an eye on the timer, but do not rush every move. A short pause to plan often saves time compared with trying random paths.
Puzzles that ask for logic often have a clear order of steps, so work through them one at a time instead of guessing.
Since each puzzle is unique, do not assume a solution from the last one will work. Check the details each time.
faq: What is the goal of TickTock Puzzle Challenge?
The goal is to solve each puzzle before the clock runs out. The game rewards quick thinking, logic and creativity.
How do I control the game?
Use a mouse click or a tap to play. The instructions do not list any other controls.

glimmer.intro: Glimmer is an arcade adventure where you guide a small spark through darkness. Relight lanterns, master precise jumps and dashes, and push through four themed chapters.
tips: Hold the jump key for a longer jump when you need extra height, and tap it for shorter hops on narrow ledges.
Plan your dash before you commit. Dashing mid-air can help you reach a platform you could not jump to.
Use checkpoints as soon as you pass them. Fast restarts are quick, so testing a tricky section again is usually better than rushing it.
When you reach a new movement challenge, spend a few attempts practicing it in isolation before trying to combine it with the rest of the stage.
Pause with Esc or P to reset your focus when a section frustrates you. Coming back with a clear head often makes precise jumps easier.
faq: What is the goal of Glimmer?
Your goal is to guide the spark through each chapter by relighting lanterns and clearing the handcrafted stages. The story leads toward the final Sun Lantern.
Which controls do I need to know?
Move with A and D or the Left and Right arrows, jump with Space or W or Up, and dash with X or Shift. Pause with Esc or P.

cannon-shot-online.intro: Cannon Shot Online is a shooting puzzle where you fire balls and move objects to direct them into buckets. Fill every bucket to clear each level and unlock new cannons.
tips: Before you fire, look at the whole level and note where each bucket is and which objects can redirect the balls toward it.
Move objects one at a time and watch the path of the shot, so you can see how each change affects the balls.
Plan for the buckets that are hardest to reach first, since easier ones can often be filled by the same shot later.
If a shot goes wrong, use the next attempt to adjust one object rather than changing everything at once.
Completing levels unlocks new cannons, so replay earlier levels if a different cannon might suit a tricky setup.
faq: What is the goal of Cannon Shot Online?
Your goal is to fill all the buckets with balls to complete each level.
How do I control the balls?
Use your mouse or touch input to move the various objects, which changes the direction of the balls you shoot.

girl-hair-salon-and-dress-up.intro: Girl Hair Salon & Dress Up is a styling game where you create hairstyles, makeup, and outfits for your clients. You earn rewards as you progress and can take photos of your finished looks.
tips: Try a mix of trendy cuts, vibrant colors, and elegant updos on different clients to see which styles suit each look best.
Coordinate hair, makeup, and outfits so the whole look works together rather than choosing each piece in isolation.
Experiment with makeup styles often, since the game offers a wide range of products to test on your clients.
Keep an eye on your rewards and stickers, because unlocking them is how you expand your salon's offerings.
Take a before and after photo of your best work, so you can compare your transformations and share your favorites.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Your goal is to turn your clients into fashion icons by styling their hair, makeup, and outfits. As you progress, you unlock new options for your salon.
How do I earn rewards?
You earn rewards such as stickers as you progress through the game. These rewards unlock new opportunities for your salon and help you improve as a stylist.

locked-in-grandma-s-basement-2-revenge-h.intro: A point-and-click horror escape from a fixed first-person view. You examine objects, gather items, and use them in the right places to solve puzzles and work toward escaping Grandma's basement.
tips: Click on everything in each scene, even objects that look like decoration. The game says every item has a purpose and every detail tells a story.
Read the clues carefully, since cryptic puzzles and grotesque clues often point toward the next step.
Pick up every useful item you find and keep track of what it might be for. Some tools will only make sense once you reach a locked path or puzzle.
When you are stuck, try using your items on different objects in the scene. Thinking logically about what each tool could open or fix often reveals the solution.
Remember that you cannot move freely, so take your time studying the fixed view before clicking. Missing a small detail can block your progress.
faq: How do I move around the game?
You do not move freely. Each scene is viewed from a fixed first-person perspective, and you progress by clicking on objects and items.
What is the goal of the game?
Your goal is to escape by using logic and courage to find tools, unlock hidden paths, and complete a disturbing ritual.

baby-hazel-bathroom-hygiene.intro: Baby Hazel Bathroom Hygiene is a point-and-click game where you help Hazel keep her bathroom clean and learn basic hygiene habits. It is designed as a light, friendly learning activity for young children.
tips: Take each cleaning job one at a time and finish it before moving on, so the bathroom does not feel overwhelming.
Look around the whole room before you start clicking, so you can see which areas need cleaning, such as the sink, tub, or toilet.
Pay attention to the reason behind each task, like scrubbing to prevent germs, so the hygiene lessons stick with you.
If something gets clogged, check the drain area carefully and work on it calmly before trying the next task.
Play at a relaxed pace and use the cheerful visuals as cues to keep going, since there is no need to rush.
faq: What is the main goal of Baby Hazel Bathroom Hygiene?
The goal is to help Hazel clean, unclog, and scrub her bathroom so it stays free of germs. Completing these tasks teaches basic hygiene.
How do I control the game?
You use point-and-click controls, clicking on items and areas in the bathroom to choose what Hazel does next.

funny-rescue-carpenter.intro: Funny Rescue Carpenter is a girls dress-up game where you help Leia, a carpenter, recover from an accident. You treat her injuries and then style her in fashionable outfits.
tips: Start with the injury treatment, since recovery comes first and the dress-up part is the reward for it.
Work through each care step in order and watch Leia's condition change before moving on.
Try a few different outfits before settling on one, since the game is built around both creativity and styling.
Keep an eye on the simulation side of the game, as it is designed to challenge you alongside the dress-up fun.
Take your time with each step rather than rushing, because the game is meant to be enjoyed one step at a time.
faq: What is the goal of Funny Rescue Carpenter?
The goal is to help Leia, a talented carpenter, recover from an accident by treating her injuries and then styling her with fashionable outfits.
Does the game include both care and dress-up?
Yes. The game mixes caring for Leia's injuries with dress-up styling, along with simulation challenges.

evil-granny-city-terror.intro: Evil Granny: City Terror is a shooting adventure where you are trapped in a city. Collect 8 keys to escape while Evil Granny and her puppets hunt you.
tips: Use Right Mouse Button to aim before you fire when enemies are at a distance, since a steadier aim helps you make each shot count.
Keep track of how many keys you have collected, and check each area for items you can pick up with F before moving on.
Press R to reload during a quiet moment rather than in the middle of a fight, so you are not left empty when enemies close in.
Use the Mouse Wheel to switch weapons based on the situation, and save G for grenades when you face a group of enemies.
Use Left Shift to run when you need to get away from danger, but walk with WASD when you need to look around carefully.
faq: What is the main goal of Evil Granny: City Terror?
Your goal is to find and collect 8 keys around the city, then get out. Evil Granny and her puppets are hunting you throughout.
How do I fire and aim my weapon?
Left Mouse Button fires your weapon and Right Mouse Button aims. Use the mouse to look around while you move with W, A, S and D.

bottle-breakshot.intro: Bottle Breakshot is a shooting game where you aim and throw balls to knock down bottles. Each level rewards accurate shots and aims for the best score.
tips: Adjust your aim slightly before each throw and watch where the ball lands, since small changes in angle can change the result a lot.
Test shot power on the first few throws of a level to learn how far each strength sends the ball before you commit to a stronger shot.
Try the different balls to see which look and feel suits your style, then stick with the one that gives you the most consistent results.
Look for bottles that can be knocked down in a chain or with one well-placed hit, and aim for those shots first to clear more bottles.
Replay levels you did not finish with the best score, using what you learned from earlier attempts to improve your accuracy.
faq: What is the goal of Bottle Breakshot?
The goal is to knock down as many bottles as possible in each level and try to complete every level with the best score.
How do I control my throws?
You move the aim to target bottles, then control the shot power to set the strength and distance of each throw.

rapid-apex-rush.intro: Rapid Apex Rush is a formula-style racing game where you steer through tight corners, use speed boosts, and dodge rivals and hazards on high-speed circuits. Use the arrow keys to turn and follow the in-game instructions.
tips: Brake before a corner rather than in it, then get back on the throttle as you exit, so the car stays stable through the turn.
Aim for the apex of each corner, the inside point of the bend, to carry more speed out onto the straight.
Plan your line a few corners ahead so you know where to move before rivals or hazards come into view.
Save speed boosts for straights or the exit of a corner where extra speed will keep you ahead, instead of using them the moment they appear.
Watch the cars around you and leave space when they are close, since a collision can cost you more time than a slightly slower line.
faq: What is the goal of Rapid Apex Rush?
You race around high-speed circuits to finish ahead of the other cars while avoiding rivals and hazards along the way.
How do I steer the car?
Use the arrow keys to turn, and follow any instructions shown in the game for other actions.

final-freeway.intro: Final Freeway is a retro racing game with eight tracks, from deserts to ruins. It offers three modes and variable difficulty, so both new and experienced racers can find a challenge.
tips: Start on a lower difficulty to learn how the controls respond before you push for faster lap times.
Try each of the three modes to see which one suits your style, then return to it when you want a focused session.
Play a track more than once to learn its corners and straights, since the eight tracks each feel different.
Keep your steering smooth. The controls are described as fluid, so gentle inputs usually help you keep speed through turns.
Once you feel comfortable, raise the difficulty a step at a time so each new challenge builds on what you have already learned.
faq: What is the main goal in Final Freeway?
You race across eight tracks in a 16-bit style, pushing your driving to get the best result you can in each race.
How many tracks are there?
There are eight tracks, including desert and ruin settings, each with its own scenery.

dr-psycho-hospital-escape.intro: Dr. Psycho - Hospital Escape is a horror game where you explore a desolate hospital, avoid lurking threats, and collect items to find a way out. You have no weapons, so careful movement matters most.
tips: Move slowly and listen before you enter a new area, since stealth is your main defense.
Check each room for items you might need later, because you must collect key items to unlock your escape.
Keep track of where threats have been, and avoid walking back into areas where you were just spotted.
Plan your route before you commit to a path, since a single wrong step can be fatal.
Do not rush. Staying calm and thinking through each choice is the best way to survive.
faq: What is the goal of Dr. Psycho - Hospital Escape?
Your goal is to escape the desolate hospital by collecting crucial items that unlock the way out. You must avoid the threats that lurk in the building.
Can I fight back against the threats?
No. You have no weapons, so stealth is your only option. Avoiding detection is how you stay alive.

turbo-drive-mode-blitz.intro: Turbo Drive: Mode Blitz is a racing simulation set in an open city. You drive a custom-designed supercar, accept missions such as taking a student to school, and earn rewards for finishing them.
tips: Read each mission before you set off so you know where you are headed and what the task asks for.
Spend a little time driving around the open city first to get a feel for the car's speed and handling before you race.
Keep your speed under control on turns, since the game focuses on speed and driving challenges and losing control can slow your progress.
Finish missions you accept rather than leaving them half done, because completing a task is what earns the reward.
Try short runs and restart if you fall behind, which lets you practise the route and improve your timing.
faq: What is the goal of Turbo Drive: Mode Blitz?
You accept a mission, such as sending a student to school, and complete it while racing your supercar through the city. Finishing the task earns you a reward.
How do I control the car?
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps. Try clicking or tapping early on to see how the car responds before you begin a mission.

zombie-check-survival-shelter.intro: Zombie Check: Survival Shelter is a quarantine inspection game set during a zombie outbreak. You examine arriving survivors, look for symptoms, and decide whether each person goes to camp, quarantine, or liquidation.
tips: Check every body fully with the scanner before deciding, since some symptoms are hidden and only show up on closer inspection.
Watch for symptoms that change over time. A person who looks healthy at arrival may need another look before you send them on.
Keep a steady pace. Each day brings more people and higher risks, so build a routine for inspecting, deciding, and moving on.
Use the teleport keys to move quickly between the inspection zone and quarantine so you spend less time walking and more time checking.
Unlock and equip weapons only when you need them, and use Q to put tools away so your view stays clear during inspections.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Your goal is to inspect each arriving survivor, decide their fate correctly, and keep the camp safe long enough to reach the bunker.
What happens if I make a wrong decision?
A wrong decision can kill an innocent person or infect the entire camp, so accuracy matters more than speed.

cozy-idle-village.intro: Cozy idle village is a calm simulation where you build a village and watch its people live, work and grow old. Your village keeps producing while you are away, so you can return at your own pace.
tips: Start by placing a few houses and a mill or fishing hut, then check which resources your villagers are short of before building more.
Use the Villagers screen to review everyone at once, so you can spot idle people and assign them to jobs in a single tap.
Before you leave, note which buildings are running. Offline production is collected when you return, so a well-staffed village gives you more to gather later.
Check your daily quests each time you log in. They point toward useful unlocks and help you decide what to build next.
Expand your land gradually toward the water and new biomes, and keep an eye on the codex to see which wild animals live near your village.
faq: What is the main goal of Cozy idle village?
There is no fixed finish line. The aim is to grow a warm village over time by building, assigning villagers, unlocking the tech tree and reaching new epochs.
How do I assign villagers to a job?
Tap any building to assign villagers to it, or tap Villagers to manage everyone at once. Assignment takes one tap per villager.

the-adventures-of-big-joe.intro: The Adventures of Big Joe is a humorous pirate adventure about digging up buried treasure on sandy beaches. You move Joe around, dig up the ground, and collect the artifacts hidden beneath the sand.
tips: Stop in one spot for a moment to let Joe dig nearby, then move on once that area is clear.
Work through the level in an orderly way, such as row by row, so you can tell which ground you have already dug up.
Pay attention to the whole map before you start, since you need to dig up all the ground to complete the level.
Use the map controls to look around the level and plan your route before committing to a direction.
Keep your movements steady and deliberate, because the game rewards careful digging rather than rushing.
faq: What is the goal of The Adventures of Big Joe?
Your goal is to dig up all the ground in each level to uncover the buried treasures and artifacts. Completing the digging clears the level.
How do I move Joe and start digging?
Use WASD, the arrow keys, or the on-screen joystick to move Joe. Stop in one place and Joe will start digging the ground nearby.

battalion-commander-1917.intro: Battalion Commander 1917 is a WWI shooter that mixes cartoonish bullet-hell action with strategic choices. You lead your troops, rescue allies, upgrade your arsenal, and push through enemy lines on a battlefield that keeps changing.
tips: Stay alert to incoming fire from the start, since the description says survival depends on quick reflexes. Moving out of danger early is usually better than waiting until you are hit.
Treat rescuing allies as a priority when they are within reach, because the game's goal includes helping them.
Think about which upgrades suit how you are fighting before you spend them, and stick with a direction rather than spreading upgrades thinly.
Expect the battlefield to change as you play. Re-check your position and the enemy layout regularly instead of following a fixed plan.
Use tactical precision by picking your moments to advance, so you push through enemy lines when the path is clearer rather than rushing into crossfire.
faq: What is the main goal in Battalion Commander 1917?
You lead your troops through WWI battlefields, rescue allies, and break through enemy lines. The description says the battlefield keeps evolving as you play.
What skills matter most in this game?
The description highlights quick reflexes and tactical precision. Fast reactions help you avoid bullets, and careful positioning helps you move forward safely.

squishy-sheep.intro: Squishy Sheep is a physics puzzler where you clear platforms at the right moment so the sheep bounces across ledges and gathers every balloon in each level. Each level is designed to be solved in just a few clicks.
tips: Before you click, study the whole level and trace the sheep's likely path, including where it will bounce and where gravity will carry it.
Watch the sheep for a moment after each removal before acting again, so you can see how the physics played out.
If a level feels impossible, try removing a different platform first. Small changes in order can send the sheep somewhere new.
Focus on the balloons you can reach from the start, then plan the route to the harder ones so you do not miss any.
Since levels are solved in few clicks, think through the full sequence before tapping, rather than experimenting with random clicks.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Your goal is to help the sheep collect every balloon in the level. A level is not complete until all of them are gathered.
How do I control the sheep?
You do not steer the sheep directly. Tap or click to remove a platform or obstacle, and the physics takes over from there.

loopix.intro: Loopix is a .io arcade game where you steer a glowing comet, draw loops around groups of creatures, and close them to capture everything inside. Other comets hunt you too, so careful steering matters.
tips: Aim for loops that enclose clusters of creatures, since a bigger loop gives a bigger combo.
Keep your comet's trail away from other comets, because touching any trail ends your run.
Watch for rival comets that are drawing loops and try to trap them inside yours for their points.
Save boost for emergencies, such as escaping a trap or closing a loop at the last second, since boosting costs a little size.
Track your Guardian boss in each world and grow your comet before facing it, so you have size to spare.
faq: How do I capture creatures?
Draw a closed loop with your comet trail around the creatures, and everything inside the loop is caught when you close it.
How do I lose in Loopix?
Your run ends if you touch another comet's trail, so always keep your own trail clear of rivals.

paper-flight-2.intro: Paper Flight 2 is a clicker where you launch a paper plane as far as you can. Each attempt lets you improve your speed and strength while you fly past dangers across different cities.
tips: Use your improvements to balance speed and strength rather than maxing one stat, so you can handle both the distance and the obstacles.
Watch the path ahead on each flight and note where the pollutant gas clouds, toy airplanes, and UFO appear so you can plan your next launch.
Treat each attempt as a test: if a flight ends early, change one thing about your launch and see whether the distance improves.
Pay attention to how the early scenes compare with the later ones, since the danger grows as your adventure goes further.
Use the mouse or touch screen with steady, deliberate inputs, because small differences in how you launch can change how far the plane travels.
faq: What is the goal of Paper Flight 2?
The goal is to launch the paper plane as far as you can and get the best score you can across each attempt.
How do I get better results over time?
Each attempt lets you improve characteristics such as speed and strength, so reinvesting in these between flights helps you travel further.

shaftbound.intro: Shaftbound is a precision platform adventure where you descend underground shafts, using jumps and a grappling hook to swing past hazards across 36 handcrafted stages.
tips: Use the hook to build momentum before you jump, since a swing carries you further than a standing jump.
Pause with Escape or P when a sequence looks complicated, then plan your route before moving again.
Reach each checkpoint before attempting a hard section, so a mistake doesn't send you back too far.
Practice the jump and hook timing on early stages, because the obstacles get more demanding the deeper you go.
If a stage goes badly, restart with R right away instead of pushing through a lost run.
faq: What is the goal of Shaftbound?
Your goal is to descend through the underground shafts, getting past hazards and reaching checkpoints across 36 handcrafted stages.
Which keys control the hook and the jump?
Press Space, W or Up to jump, and use X, Shift or a mouse click to fire the grappling hook.

phone-case-diy.intro: Phone Case DIY is a casual coloring and customization game where you decorate a phone case. You use the mouse or clicks to add color and make the phone look bright and personal.
tips: Choose a color scheme before you start, such as two or three matching colors, so the finished case looks coordinated instead of random.
Work on one section at a time and step back to look at the whole design before moving on, which helps you spot gaps or clashes.
Try a bold color on one part and softer shades on the rest to create contrast that makes the design stand out.
Experiment freely, since this is a creative game with no fixed right answer, and keep a combination you like even if it looks different from your first idea.
faq: What is the goal of Phone Case DIY?
The goal is to customize a phone case by adding color and decorations so your phone looks glamorous and personal.
How do I control the game?
You play with a mouse or by clicking. Click or move the cursor to select, color and place your design elements.

boxing-stars.intro: Boxing Stars is a sports game where you climb from underground fights to championship tournaments. Win matches by knocking out opponents, and train your abilities to earn your way into better events.
tips: Mix up your attacks instead of repeating the same punch, so opponents cannot easily predict your next move.
Use blocking to protect yourself when an opponent is about to attack, then counter when they leave an opening.
Move around the ring to create distance and avoid taking damage from strong opponents.
Spend your rewards on the abilities that suit your fighting style, since better tournaments require stronger skills.
Watch how each opponent fights early in a match and adjust your strategy to their pattern.
faq: What is the main goal of Boxing Stars?
Your goal is to win matches by knocking out your opponents and rise through the ranks to the championship.
How do I get into better tournaments?
Improve your skills by training your abilities and using the rewards you earn from your wins.

dinosaur-game.intro: Dino Dash is an endless runner where you guide a small dinosaur across a prehistoric world. Jump and duck to avoid obstacles, run as far as you can, and beat your best distance.
tips: Watch the ground and the obstacles ahead rather than staring at your dinosaur, so you can start your jump or duck early enough.
Stay calm as the speed rises. Short, controlled reactions usually work better than panicked button mashing.
Use ducking for low barriers and jumping for hazards on the ground, and avoid jumping when a duck would be safer.
Collect coins when you can do so safely, but never take a risky path just to grab them.
Try the Levels and challenges modes when you want a different kind of practice, then return to Endless to chase a higher distance.
faq: What is the goal of Dino Dash?
Run as far as possible while avoiding every obstacle in your path. Each run is a chance to beat your best distance.
How do I control the dinosaur?
Use the arrow keys or swipe to jump or duck. Pick the action that matches the obstacle coming toward you.

master-of-numbers.intro: Master of Numbers is a puzzle race where you type numbers to build the largest total you can while reaching the finish line. You absorb smaller blue numbers and avoid larger red ones along the way.
tips: Before each pickup, compare the blue or red number to your current number so you know whether it helps or costs you a restart.
Plan your route early and pick up blue numbers when you can do so safely, since every one you absorb keeps your number growing.
Watch for red numbers larger than yours, because one contact resets your number and sends you back to the start.
Keep your eyes on the obstacles, such as electric saws, bridges, and ditches, and time your moves so you clear each one without slowing down.
Save some attention for the finish line, where walls must be destroyed, and do not let the final stretch distract you from keeping your number high.
faq: What is the goal of Master of Numbers?
The goal is to reach the finish line while typing the largest number you can. Absorbing smaller blue numbers helps you build it up.
What happens if I touch a red number?
If you encounter a red number larger than yours, you lose your number and have to start over. Check the size of red numbers before you reach them.

runaway-toad.intro: Runaway Toad is an animal game where you guide a toad trying to escape a princess by timing its jumps across tricky terrain. Your main tool is how hard you leap, and eating flies along the way is part of the journey.
tips: Think of jump power as your main decision each turn. Test short and long hops early so you learn how far each one carries the toad.
Before you jump, look at the landscape ahead and pick a landing spot that keeps you moving away from the princess.
Grab flies when they are on your path. They fit naturally into your route, so plan a hop that lets you reach them without slowing your escape.
Treat each terrain type as a new problem. Adjust your jump strength to the ground you are crossing instead of using the same hop everywhere.
Keep playing to unlock new toads. Each one is a fresh chance to try a different approach to the same escape.
faq: What is the goal of Runaway Toad?
The goal is to help the toad escape the relentless princess by jumping across magical terrains toward freedom.
How do I control the toad's jumps?
You control the toad by setting how much leap power to use for each hop, so accurate control of jump strength is the key skill.

gn-ninja-run.intro: GN Ninja Run is an adventure game where you guide a ninja across wooden bridges, collecting coins and avoiding bombs. Your score rises the farther you get.
tips: Time your presses carefully, since the only control is pressing or touching the screen to make the ninja jump.
Keep an eye on the bombs ahead and jump early enough to clear them rather than reacting at the last moment.
Pick up coins when they are on your path, but never risk a bomb just to grab one.
Stay focused on the next bridge gap, because the score depends on distance, so steady progress matters more than quick bursts.
If you fall, restart and try to build a rhythm for the jumps, which tends to help you go farther each run.
faq: How do I control the ninja?
Press or touch the screen to make the ninja jump over the wooden bridges and obstacles.
How is the score calculated?
The score goes up the farther the ninja moves away, so the longer you survive, the higher your score.

foxytruck.intro: FoxyTruck is a 3D driving game where Foxy uses his tractor to help friends in icy, desert and forest settings. Each area has its own task, and you switch the tractor's module to suit the job.
tips: Match the module to the task before you drive: ice for the penguins, cacti for the foxes, rocks for the rabbits.
Learn the stop control early so you can line up your tractor before you commit to a hit.
Switch modules in a clear spot rather than mid-collision, so you keep your steering under control.
Pay attention to each new environment, since the colors and terrain change from one section to the next.
Keep your steering smooth and short; small corrections help you stay on target while the tractor moves.
faq: What is the goal of FoxyTruck?
You help Foxy's friends by completing the task in each section, such as breaking ice for penguins, collecting cacti for foxes, or breaking rocks for rabbits.
How do I steer and stop the tractor?
On a keyboard, use the arrow keys to move, press Ctrl to stop, and press Shift to switch modules. On mobile, swipe to move, tap once to stop, and double-tap to switch modules.

zombie-derby-2.intro: Zombie Derby 2 is a driving game where you run over zombies and try to last as long as you can. Keep your fuel in mind, because running out lets the zombies catch you.
tips: Watch your fuel from the start and avoid wasting it on long stretches with no zombies nearby. Running out is what ends your run.
Save nitro for big groups of zombies so one boost can smash through several at once. It is also useful for clearing hills.
Use the tilt keys to angle your car before a hill, so you land in a better position instead of nose-diving or tipping over.
Use the gun on zombies that are blocking your path or closing in from the side, and keep driving when the road ahead is clear.
Collect upgrades whenever they are safe to grab, and try different cars as you unlock them to find one that suits your driving style.
faq: What is the goal of Zombie Derby 2?
The goal is to survive as long as you can while running over zombies with your car. Your run ends if you run out of fuel and the zombies catch you.
How do I control the car?
Press W or the Up arrow to accelerate, and use Left and Right arrow or A and D to tilt forward and backward. Press Left Shift or N to use nitro.

pull-mermaid-out.intro: Pull Mermaid Out is a 3D puzzle where you help a little mermaid get home by pulling pins in the right order through a fallen ancient city. Each pull changes the layout, so thinking one step ahead is the key.
tips: Before you pull any pin, look at the whole scene and note which pins sit in front of others or block the mermaid's path.
Start with pins that have nothing in their way. Clearing easy pins first often reveals the order for harder ones.
Pay attention to the drainage pipes, since they are the only intact structures and often hint at where the mermaid can go.
If you get stuck, try a different pin order rather than repeating the same move; small changes in sequence can open a new route.
Take your time between taps. Slow, deliberate moves help you avoid pulling a pin that protects the mermaid's safety.
faq: What is the goal of Pull Mermaid Out?
The goal is to help the little mermaid get home by pulling the pins out in the correct order. The pins protect her safety along the way.
How do I control the game?
Tap and slide to play. Use taps and slides to select and move the pins in the scene.

color-tower-2-drop-the-boxes-3d.intro: Color Tower 2 is a 3D arcade game where you stack colorful boxes to build as high a tower as you can. It rewards both planning and fast reactions, and your height can be compared on global leaderboards.
tips: Watch where each box lands before you drop the next one. A slightly off-center box makes the tower harder to balance as it grows.
Think a step ahead. Placing boxes with the next drop in mind usually works better than reacting only to the box in front of you.
Pay attention to the tower's overall balance, not just the top box. Shifting weight to one side can cause a collapse even if the stack looks steady.
Stay focused and keep your timing consistent. Quick reflexes matter, but rushing a drop is a common cause of mistakes.
Play a few rounds to get used to the smooth controls before aiming for high scores. Small improvements in timing add up over time.
faq: What is the goal of Color Tower 2?
The goal is to build a tower as high as possible by dropping colorful boxes on top of each other. Your height is the main measure of how well you did.
What skills does this game test?
It tests strategic thinking and quick reflexes. You need to plan where boxes go while also reacting quickly enough to keep the stack steady.

mathtest22.intro: MathTest22 is a math puzzle game where you solve problems against the clock. The puzzles become more complex as you advance, so it builds both accuracy and speed.
tips: Work on accuracy first. Getting answers right at a steady pace will help you build speed without constant mistakes.
Pay attention to the early puzzles, since later ones grow in complexity and the same habits will carry forward.
Keep your calculations simple by breaking longer problems into smaller steps you can check one at a time.
When you feel rushed, slow down for a moment to read the problem fully before answering. A quick mistake costs more time than a short pause.
Play in short sessions so your focus stays sharp, and notice which types of problems slow you down most.
faq: What is the main goal of MathTest22?
Solve math puzzles correctly while racing the clock. As you advance, the puzzles become more complex.
Does the game get harder as I play?
Yes. The puzzles grow in complexity as you advance through the game.

obby-the-legendary-dragon.intro: Obby The Legendary Dragon mixes obstacle course running with pet catching. You travel through several Roblox worlds, level up your hero, and collect pets through battles, cases, and eggs.
tips: Use the Space key to jump and the AWSD keys to run, and practice short jumps before attempting longer gaps.
Press Tab to show the cursor when you need to click menus, then hide it again to turn with the mouse.
Collect health and upgrade your hero before moving into new worlds, so you are better prepared for the challenges there.
Catch pets in battles and keep the strongest ones, since buying and exchanging pets can help you get better helpers.
Earn money and use it on upgrades for your Obby character, and check your ranks and titles as you progress.
faq: How do I move and jump in Obby The Legendary Dragon?
Use the AWSD keys to run and the Space key to jump. On smartphones, use the joystick to run and the up arrow to jump.
How do I change the camera view?
Move the mouse to turn. If you need the cursor to click something, press Tab to show or hide it.

hard-crash-zombie-rush.intro: Hard Crash: Zombie Rush is a lane-steering action runner where you lead a squad across city bridges, choosing gates to grow your crowd. Build your base between battles to keep your forces strong.
tips: Read each gate before you commit. Blue gates with "+" or "×" grow your squad, while red gates shrink it, so steer toward the bigger gain.
Save golden gate bonuses like air strike, freeze, or shield for tough moments such as bosses or crowded bridges, rather than using them early.
Shoot the targets marked with an arrow to upgrade your weapons, since stronger guns make the later districts much easier to clear.
Keep an eye on each hero's ring and tap their portrait as soon as it is full, so the skill is ready when a fight gets dangerous.
Before you leave the base, upgrade the farm, factory, and HQ, because they collect income while you are offline and fund your next battles.
faq: How do I steer my squad?
Swipe or drag left and right, or use the arrow keys or A and D on a computer. Your soldiers shoot automatically, so your focus can stay on the gates and the path ahead.
What is the difference between blue and red gates?
Blue gates add soldiers with "+" or multiply your squad with "×". Red gates remove soldiers, so you should steer around them unless you have no other option.

wild-wolf-simulator-animal-games.intro: Wild Wolf Simulator Animal Games puts you in the role of a wolf exploring forests, mountains, snowy areas, plains and deserts. Hunt, defend your territory and build a pack to become the Alpha.
tips: Use the Shift key to run when you need to cover ground quickly between hunting spots and missions.
Learn what each special attack key does (R, V, C, X, Z) and save them for tougher fights rather than spending them on easy targets.
Complete level-based challenges to improve your wolf's abilities, since stronger powers are unlocked this way.
Pick a wolf species that suits your playstyle, as the Gray, Black, Timber and Arctic wolves each have different appearances and abilities.
Keep an eye on your den and pack when rival wolves or dangerous predators show up, and be ready to defend before you push further into new terrain.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You play as a wild wolf, hunting animals, defending your territory and completing survival missions to become the Alpha of your pack.
How do I attack and use special moves on desktop?
Press Q to attack and use R, V, C, X or Z for the five special attacks. Press F for action.

niko-and-dino-run.intro: Niko and Dino Run is an endless runner where you dodge obstacles and stay ahead of pursuing dinosaurs. Jumping, dashing, and collecting power-ups are the main ways to keep your lead.
tips: Watch the obstacles early and decide whether to jump or dash before you reach them, rather than reacting at the last moment.
Save your dash for dangerous spots where a jump alone may not be enough to clear the path.
Grab power-ups when they are safe to reach, since they help you maintain your lead on the dinosaurs.
Keep an eye on how close the pursuing dinosaurs are and take a slightly safer route when they are near.
Practice short sessions to build reflexes, because steady timing matters more than speed in an endless run.
faq: What is the main goal of Niko and Dino Run?
The goal is to survive as long as possible by dodging obstacles and staying ahead of the dinosaurs chasing you.
What controls do I use?
The game uses jump, dash, and grab actions, so you need to time these to avoid obstacles and collect power-ups.

ghost-runaway.intro: Ghost Runaway is an arcade platformer where you move through eerie landscapes and race to escape danger. Quick reactions and careful planning both matter on its challenging levels.
tips: Spend your first few moments watching the layout and the lurking dangers before you commit to a route. Knowing where threats appear makes each jump safer.
Take each step with care rather than rushing. The game rewards precision, so a slower, deliberate move often beats a hasty one that ends in a restart.
Try the controls on an early section until they feel natural. Since the game emphasizes intuitive controls, short practice helps you react faster when the pressure rises.
If a level keeps defeating you, pause and look for the pattern in what caused the failure. Adjusting your timing or route on the next attempt is usually more useful than repeating the same move.
Keep your strategic thinking active between dangers, not only during them. Planning your next few moves ahead gives you a better chance to escape when danger closes in.
faq: What is the goal of Ghost Runaway?
The goal is to navigate through intricate levels and escape the impending doom that chases you. You must avoid the lurking dangers along the way.
How do I control the character?
The game is built around intuitive controls, so the best way to learn them is to experiment in the early part of a level. Practice before attempting harder sections.

granny-returns-haunted-house.intro: Granny Returns Haunted House is a 3D horror escape game set in an abandoned asylum. You collect clues, shoot back when needed, and try to get out before the enemies find you.
tips: Keep moving through the asylum rather than standing still, since the description warns that enemies can find you at any moment.
When you need a moment to breathe, duck into a closet and stay quiet, as hiding is the game's main way to avoid being noticed.
Use Left CTRL to crouch or X to go prone when you want to move more quietly past danger.
Save Left Shift for real escapes; running everywhere can make it harder to plan your route.
Check your ammo with R before a tense area, and use Right Mouse Button to aim when you have a clear shot instead of firing wildly.
faq: What is the goal of Granny Returns Haunted House?
You explore an abandoned asylum, complete clues, and survive while avoiding or escaping the enemies.
How do I defend myself against enemies?
Use Left Mouse Button to fire, Right Mouse Button to aim, G to throw grenades, and the Mouse Wheel to switch weapons.

idle-gold-miner.intro: Idle Gold Miner is a mining game where you build a gold-mining operation, manage resources, and automate work so profit keeps coming in. Progress through challenges and unlock bonuses as you go.
tips: Automate your processes early so gold keeps building while you are away from the game.
Check back after time offline to collect your profit and decide what to spend it on next.
Balance your resources rather than spending everything at once, so you can still afford key upgrades.
Look for unlocked bonuses and factor them into your next decisions, since they can speed up progress.
If you want a slower, relaxed session, focus on steady growth; if you want to optimize, compare which improvements give the best return.
faq: What is the main goal of Idle Gold Miner?
Your goal is to build a mining empire that generates gold through efficient management and automation. Progress comes from growing your operation over time.
Does the game keep earning gold when I am not playing?
Yes, the game is designed to produce continuous profit, even offline. Your automated processes keep working while you are away.

downhill-christmas-dash.intro: Downhill Christmas Dash is a festive skiing runner where Santa races down a snowy slope. Steer left and right, grab gift boxes, and dodge the snowmen before you reach the bottom.
tips: Keep Santa moving early and steer in small steps so you can react to snowmen that appear suddenly.
Look a few obstacles ahead rather than only at Santa, which gives you time to change direction calmly.
Grab the winged boots when they are close, since they increase speed and raise gift scores at the same time.
Save the golden star for a tight spot with several snowmen nearby, because it makes Santa invincible for 8 seconds.
Plan your path toward gift boxes without cutting too sharply near snowmen, since one bump ends the run.
faq: How do I control Santa?
Use the left and right arrow keys, or tap the onscreen arrows if you are using touch controls.
What ends the game?
If Santa bumps into a snowman, he falls and the game ends immediately.

evil-granny-must-die-ch1.intro: You have been knocked down inside Evil Granny's bunker and need to escape. Find the 8 books hidden in the bunker and survive the zombies to leave alive.
tips: Press F to pick up items as you find them, and keep count of how many of the 8 books you have so you know how far you are from escaping.
Use the right mouse button to aim before you fire, which helps you make more controlled shots at enemies.
Save grenades (G) for groups of zombies or tough spots instead of spending them on single targets.
Reload (R) during quiet moments rather than in the middle of a fight, so you are not caught with an empty weapon.
Scroll the mouse wheel to try your different weapons and settle on the one that feels best for you, then use Shift to run away when you need to escape a fight.
faq: What is the goal of Evil Granny Must Die Ch1?
You must find 8 books in Evil Granny's bunker before you can leave the place alive.
How do I pick up items in the game?
Walk up to an item and press F to pick it up.

sand-tap-sorting-puzzle.intro: Sand Tap! Sorting Puzzle is a relaxing 3D puzzle where you tap colorful sand from objects and send each color to its matching box above. Each level adds more colors, shapes, and layouts.
tips: Before each tap, check which boxes are open for that color so you don't send sand somewhere it will get stuck.
Use the temporary slots as a holding area for sand you can't place yet, and clear them when a matching box opens up.
Avoid filling the slots too early, since a full slot can block the sand you need for your next move.
When a new color or shape appears, look at the whole layout first to see which sand objects are blocking others.
Save boosters for levels that feel stuck rather than using them right away, so you can still rely on them later.
faq: What is the main goal of Sand Tap! Sorting Puzzle?
Tap and collect sand from the sand objects, then place each color into its matching box above. Finish the sorting in each level to move on.
How do the temporary slots work?
They hold sand temporarily while you plan your moves. Try to keep them from filling up too early so you still have room for the sand you need next.

roller-coaster-simulator.intro: Roller Coaster Simulator is a puzzle strategy game where you ride and control coasters through 3D landscapes. Your goal is to keep twisty tracks balanced and passengers safe through thrilling loops.
tips: Watch how the ride responds before each curve and loop, since balance is the core challenge.
Slow down on tight or twisty sections, where small mistakes are most likely to cause trouble.
Think about passenger safety first; a run that feels thrilling but puts riders at risk is not a good run.
Practice the loops and sharp turns a few times to learn their timing before attempting them under pressure.
Take short breaks between attempts so you can review what went wrong and adjust your approach.
faq: What is the main goal of Roller Coaster Simulator?
The game asks you to control roller coaster rides on twisty tracks while keeping passengers safe. Balance and safety are central to the challenge.
How do I get better at the game?
Focus on learning how the track and ride behave in the tighter sections, and repeat those parts until your timing feels natural. Steady, careful control usually matters more than speed.

wiggle-escape-snake-puzzle.intro: Wiggle Escape is a snake untangling puzzle where you tap snakes in the right order to free a tangled shape. Each level rewards careful planning, and sandbox mode lets you build your own puzzles.
tips: Before tapping anything, look at each snake and check which ones are blocked by others. Only unblocked snakes can move, so start there.
Think a few moves ahead. A tap that looks harmless can trap another snake and stop your progress.
When you get stuck, look for the snake that sits on top of the most others. Freeing that one often opens up several options at once.
Take your time on longer snakes and tighter knots, since later levels are built around them. Slowing down early helps you spot patterns you can reuse.
Use sandbox mode to test how snakes block each other. Building a small shape of your own is a good way to understand the mechanics before tackling harder main levels.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Your goal is to untangle the snake shape completely by tapping the snakes in the correct order. The level is solved once the whole structure is free.
Why can some snakes not be tapped?
Only snakes that are not blocked by other snakes can move. If a snake is held in place by another, you need to free the blocking snake first.

money-fest.intro: Money Fest is a 3D hypercasual runner where you grow your balance by collecting coins and solving quick math operations. Keep your money above zero to stay in the game.
tips: Watch your balance at every step, since a drop below zero ends the run. Check it before you pick up or pass through anything that could cost you money.
Collect coins whenever they are safely on your path, because they are your main way to build money early on.
Before you reach a division or subtraction, decide whether the loss is affordable. Your balance should be comfortably above zero before you take the hit.
Expect discounts, taxes, and other surprise money changes along the way. Adjust your path as soon as you see them rather than reacting late.
Practice doing the math quickly in your head. The game rewards fast calculation, so keeping the numbers simple in your head will help you stay ahead.
faq: What is the goal of Money Fest?
The goal is to keep your balance from dropping below zero while growing your money. You do this by collecting coins and using the math operations you pass along the way.
How do I move my character?
Use your mouse or touchpad, or use the W, A, S, D keys or the arrow keys on a desktop. These are the controls listed for the game.

aqua-sort-water-color-puzzle.intro: Aqua Sort is a color sorting puzzle where you pour liquids between flasks until each flask holds a single color. Plan each pour ahead so you do not block your own flasks.
tips: Look for a flask with a single color on top that matches another flask's top layer, since those pours are usually safe to make first.
Before pouring, check what color sits underneath the top layer of the flask you are emptying, so you do not bury a color you still need to move.
Keep at least one empty flask available when you can, because an empty flask gives you room to set aside a liquid that is in the way.
If you reach a dead end, use the Undo power-up to step back to your last pour and try a different order instead of pushing forward.
Save the Add Flask power-up for a tricky level where you have run out of useful moves, rather than using it early on easy ones.
faq: How do I move a liquid from one flask to another?
Tap the flask you want to take from to pick up its top liquid, then tap the flask you want to pour into. The pour only works if the target flask is empty or its top liquid is the same color.
When does the puzzle count as solved?
A level is complete when every flask contains only one color. Mixed flasks mean you still have more sorting to do.

idle-hotel-empire-tycoon.intro: Idle Hotel Empire Tycoon has you running a small hotel by opening and upgrading rooms, restaurants, leisure areas and cafes. Your job is to grow the business steadily and reinvest profits to multiply earnings.
tips: Reinvest your profits regularly in new rooms and facilities, since each added area raises what every visitor brings in.
Open all rooms and leisure facilities such as halls, cafes and parks, because each one increases your profit per visitor.
Tap the progress bars above each cashier's desk and at reception to speed up service whenever you are waiting on visitors.
Hire staff to service rooms as your hotel fills up, so guests are looked after and the rooms keep earning.
Use the short video bonuses when you want a temporary boost to earnings, especially before a big purchase you have been saving for.
faq: What is the main goal of Idle Hotel Empire Tycoon?
The goal is to grow a small hotel into a larger business by opening and upgrading facilities and reinvesting your earnings. Over time, profits from each visitor rise as you open more of the hotel.
How do I speed up service in the hotel?
Tap the progress bar above each cashier's desk and the one at reception to shorten service time. Doing this helps visitors move through faster.

path-puzzle.intro: Path - Puzzle is a brain-teaser where you guide a rolling ball along a route you build by moving and rotating pieces. The challenges get harder as you progress through its varied levels.
tips: Before moving anything, study the whole layout and trace where the ball needs to end up. Planning the full route first saves many wasted rotations.
Look for the pieces that are fixed in place or that the path clearly depends on, and work around them before adjusting the rest.
Make one change at a time and check how the ball moves after each one, so you can tell which adjustment helped or caused a problem.
If a level stalls, step back and test a different section of the route instead of repeating the same move.
As levels get harder, expect to rethink your approach rather than tweak small details, since later puzzles often need a different overall path.
faq: What is the goal of Path - Puzzle?
Your goal is to guide the rolling ball through each puzzle by building a working path from the pieces provided.
How do I move the pieces?
You maneuver and rotate pieces to create the route the ball follows. The controls are designed to feel smooth, so small adjustments are easy to make.

drive-ahead-sports.intro: Drive Ahead Sports is a pixelated soccer game where you drive vehicles to kick the ball and score against your opponent. Controls are mouse click or tap.
tips: Keep an eye on the ball's position relative to your vehicle so you can line up a kick before it rolls away.
Approach the ball at an angle rather than head-on, which gives you more room to direct it toward the opponent's goal.
Watch where your opponent is heading and use your vehicle to block their path to your goal when they get close.
Try short, controlled taps or clicks to adjust your movement instead of holding steadily, so you don't overshoot the ball.
Play a few matches to learn how each vehicle handles, since the way you steer and kick may feel different from one to the next.
faq: What is the goal of Drive Ahead Sports?
You drive your vehicle in soccer matches, kick the ball, and attack the opponent's goal to win.
How do I control my vehicle?
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps, so use those inputs to drive and kick the ball.

big-donuts-mania.intro: Big Donuts Mania is a puzzle game where you match colorful donuts against the clock. Strategic swaps build sweet combos as you aim for the top of the leaderboard.
tips: Before you swap, check how the donuts you move will look afterward, so the swap helps you form a match rather than just shuffling the board.
Look for swaps that set up a second match, since a chain of matches can build a combo.
Keep an eye on the timer and make your moves steadily, so you do not run short on time near the end.
Notice which colors appear most often on the board and use them as your main options for quick matches.
After each round, compare your result with the leaderboard and try to beat your own best score next time.
faq: What is the goal of Big Donuts Mania?
Match colorful donuts by swapping them, working against the clock, and build up a strong score to climb the leaderboard.
How do swaps work in this game?
You make strategic swaps to line up matching donuts. Choose swaps that create matches and combos rather than random moves.

the-mad-cow.intro: Dasha the cow has gone wild and is running through the city, smashing everything in her path. Your job is to destroy buildings, collect points, and stay ahead of the police.
tips: Button A does double duty for horns and weapons, so check what is in front of you before pressing it. Use it on buildings for close damage and when you are ready to shoot.
The police will keep chasing you, so do not stop in one spot for long. Keep moving and use jumps to change direction and avoid being cornered.
Try switching between ground movement, the car, and the helicopter to reach different targets. Each one gives you a different way to explore the city.

Use the shift button to accelerate when you need to cover ground quickly, such as when escaping pursuit or heading to a new target. On mobile, the joystick handles movement while the pop-up buttons cover the other actions.
Use the T button to pick up objects when you spot one nearby. Keep an eye on your points as you go, since destruction is how you score.
faq: What is the goal of The Mad Cow?
Your task is to destroy everything in the city as Dasha the cow. Destroy buildings with your horns and weapons to earn points while avoiding the police.
Which buttons control movement and combat?
Use the AWSD keys to move and the space bar to jump. Button A is used for attacking with horns and for shooting weapons, and the T button picks up objects.

food-gang-run.intro: Food Gang Run is a running and shooting clicker where a tomato, a banana or a broccoli races through the kitchen, dodging enemies and collecting weapons to get as far as possible.
tips: Watch each enemy's attack style before you commit to a jump, since donuts, sushi, pizza slices and pumpkins each threaten you in a different way.
Pick up the weapons you find along the way, because they are the tools you need to get through each level.
Jump early over obstacles rather than at the last moment, so you have time to correct your position if a new enemy appears.
Try all three characters, since each one is a different choice and you can see which suits your play style best.
Collect the stars you pass, as they add to your progress toward the rewards and the skills you can unlock.
faq: What is the goal of Food Gang Run?
Your group of friends wants to get as far as possible through the kitchen, so the aim is to keep running and improve your score.
How do I move and jump?
On PC, use the arrow keys to move and the spacebar to jump. On mobile and tablet, touch the movement buttons on the screen and use the jump button.

leg-soccer.intro: Leg Soccer is a soccer game where the physics change throughout each match. Your aim is to outscore your opponents and score goals while adapting to the chaos.
tips: Spend the first few moments of a match testing how the ball reacts before committing to a plan, since the physics can shift.
Don't rely on a shot that worked earlier. Watch how the ball behaves in the current match and adjust your aim to match.
Stay flexible. If the physics start to favor a different kind of play, change your approach instead of forcing the same one.
Keep an eye on your opponent's scoring pattern so you can react quickly and not fall too far behind.
After each match, think about which moves worked under the changing conditions so you can repeat them when the physics shift again.
faq: What is the main goal in Leg Soccer?
Your goal is to outscore your opponents by aiming for the goal in each match. Every match plays out with changing physics, so the way you score may differ each time.
How do the changing physics affect play?
The physics change during matches, so the ball may not always behave the same way. Watching how it moves and adjusting your shots is the best way to keep scoring.

dinoz.intro: DinoZ is an adventure shooter where escaped dinosaurs have taken scientists hostage in the forest. Your job is to save the hostages, alone or with a friend in 2 player mode.
tips: Use the wall jump (W for Player 1, UP ARROW for Player 2) to reach higher spots and get around the traps the dinosaurs have set.
Switch weapons with Q (Player 1) or U (Player 2) before you engage, so you are not caught with the wrong tool in a tight spot.
Save bombs for groups or tougher threats, and use the close-range Hit (F or L) for quick, cheap attacks on single enemies.
In 2 player mode, agree on who goes for the hostages and who covers the approach, since you can both move, jump and shoot at the same time.
Watch the ground and surroundings for traps before you move forward, and take a short pause to check your route when the path looks crowded.
faq: What is the goal of DinoZ?
You need to rescue the scientists who have been taken hostage by the escaped dinosaurs in the forest. The game is about saving them from the traps and enemies along the way.
What are the controls for Player 1?
Player 1 moves with W, A, S and D, hits with F, drops bombs with H, jumps with W and switches weapons with Q.

roller-for-brainrots.intro: Roller for Brainrots is an arcade game where you skate around and collect different Brainrots. Use the controls to move across the map and pick up as many Brainrots as you can.
tips: Learn the movement controls first, since WASD on a computer or the on-screen joystick on a phone decides how smoothly you can weave around the map.
Scan the whole map before committing to a direction so you can plan a route that passes several Brainrots in one run.
Keep moving rather than stopping, because the game is built around rollerskating and staying in motion keeps your collecting flowing.
Practice the right mouse button pickup timing on a computer, so you can grab Brainrots without losing speed or position.
Pay attention to where new Brainrots appear and return to busy areas to keep your collection growing.
faq: What is the goal of Roller for Brainrots?
The goal is to collect different Brainrots while rollerskating around the map. Pick up as many as you can while you move.
How do I pick up a Brainrot on a computer?
Move your character with W, A, S, and D, then press the right mouse button to pick up a Brainrot.

infinite-heroes.intro: Infinite Heroes is a card game where you travel a realm, battle foes, and face dangerous terrain. Each card can decide whether you win or lose, so careful choices matter.
tips: Think before each card you play, since the description says every card can decide victory or defeat.
Look at the terrain ahead before committing to a path, because treacherous ground can change the risk of an encounter.
Move through perilous paths with patience rather than rushing, so you can react to what each step brings.
Treat each foe as a separate challenge and plan your approach to it instead of relying on one strategy for every battle.
Pick up treasures when you can do so safely, since they are part of building your heroic legend.
faq: What is the goal of Infinite Heroes?
The description says you traverse a realm, face foes and treacherous terrain, and craft your heroic legend through cunning and courage. Progress comes from navigating paths and winning encounters.
How do battles work in this game?
Battles are strategic card battles, and each card holds the key to victory or defeat. Your card choices directly affect how each encounter turns out.

stickman-bros-in-fruit-island-2.intro: Stickman Bros In Fruit Island 2 is a side-view adventure for up to three players. Control three stickman brothers as they explore Fruitland and collect strawberries and apples.
tips: Agree on a plan before you start, such as who goes first and who waits for the others, so you don't block each other's path.
Keep the brothers close enough to help each other reach higher spots, since a jump that looks too far for one player may work with a teammate's help.
Check your surroundings before each jump so you land on solid ground rather than falling back down.
Grab the nearby strawberries and apples as you move, and don't backtrack more than needed to reach the last few.
Spend a moment learning each player's jump timing, since P1, P2 and P3 each have their own keys and will move differently.
faq: What is the goal of Stickman Bros In Fruit Island 2?
Your task is to collect strawberries and apples while exploring Fruitland with the three brothers.
How do the controls work for each player?
Player 1 moves with A and D and jumps with W. Player 3 moves with J and L and jumps with I. Player 2 has its own move and jump keys as listed in the game.

purrrification.intro: Purrrification is a pixel platformer that starts out simple but grows stranger as you move through its 7 levels. Expect shifting levels, distorted sounds, and a menu that may not be what it seems.
tips: Use the early levels to get comfortable with jumping and moving, since the difficulty increases from level to level.
Pay attention to changes in the environment, sounds, and UI as you play, because the game becomes more distorted over time.
Do not assume the menu is reliable. Look carefully at each option before you select it with x or space.
Explore levels for the hidden easter eggs, and stay alert for intentional glitches that can change how the game plays.
Use the P key to pause when something feels off, then look over the screen before continuing.
faq: What is the goal of Purrrification?
You jump, collect items, and progress through 7 levels with increasing difficulty. The game also mixes in unsettling changes as you advance.
How do I move and jump?
Use WASD to move. You can jump and go down when you are on platforms, and you can click or tap to start playing.

drawing-online.intro: Drawing Online is a fast party game for up to 4 players. You draw a suggested word, and the game tries to guess it, with faster guesses earning more points.
tips: Aim for a clear, simple sketch first. The game guesses faster when the main shape is easy to read, and speed is what earns points.
Start with the most recognizable outline of the object, then add a few key details. Extra lines can slow down the guess.
Watch what other players are drawing when you're stuck. Their sketches can give you ideas for how to approach your own word.
Keep an eye on the clock. You have 5 challenges in 3 minutes, so if a word is hard to draw, skip it rather than spending too long on it.
Even if you don't finish first, you still gain points and experience, so keep playing each round rather than giving up.
faq: What is the goal of Drawing Online?
Draw the word the game suggests so it can guess what you drew. Faster correct guesses earn more points, and the player with the top score takes first place on the podium.
How do I earn points?
Points come from how quickly the game guesses your drawing. The faster it guesses, the more points you earn.

yummy-churros-ice-cream.intro: Yummy Churros Ice Cream is a cooking game where you choose flavors, add toppings to build your dessert, and earn achievements as you move forward. This guide covers simple habits that help you get more from each round.
tips: Try a few different flavor pairings early on so you learn which combinations you like best.
Add toppings one at a time and look at the result before adding the next, so it is easier to see what works.
Keep your recipe simple at first, then add more toppings once you understand how each one changes the dessert.
Check your achievements as you go, since they show what the game rewards and can point you toward new things to try.
Repeat a recipe you enjoyed and adjust one ingredient at a time to see how small changes affect the final result.
faq: What is the main goal of Yummy Churros Ice Cream?
The goal is to create churros ice cream by picking flavors and perfecting your recipe with toppings. Along the way you can unlock achievements as you progress.
How do I make a good churros ice cream?
Start by choosing a flavor you like, then add toppings gradually to see how each one fits. Taking your time with each step usually leads to a better final dessert.

draw-an-obby.intro: Draw an Obby is a drawing-based obstacle course with 30 levels. You move through obstacles and can draw your own shapes to get past them.
tips: Use the right mouse button camera view to look ahead before each jump so you can see the next platform and obstacle.
Take your time on each level. The obstacles are described as crazy, so a slower, careful run is often better than rushing.
Practice your jump timing with the Space Bar on each new obstacle before trying a longer sequence.
Think about what shape you need before you draw it. Look at the obstacle first and decide how your drawing can help you get past it.
If you fall, restart the attempt calmly and focus on the one part that went wrong instead of trying the whole level again at once.
faq: What is the goal of Draw an Obby?
Move through the 30 levels of obstacles and get past each one. Your drawn shapes are a key part of overcoming the obstacles.
How do I move and jump on a computer?
Use WASD to move, the Space Bar to jump, and hold the right mouse button to change the camera view.

slenderman-lost-at-school.intro: Slenderman Lost at School is a horror action game set in an abandoned school. You explore, solve puzzles, and collect items while avoiding Slenderman. Stealth and careful movement are key.
tips: Move carefully and avoid being spotted, since the game is built around stealth tactics.
Listen closely to the sound effects, which are a core part of the atmosphere and can hint at where danger is nearby.
Explore each area thoroughly and pick up items, because you will need them to escape.
Work through puzzles calmly. Solving them unlocks new areas, so stopping to think can be faster than rushing back and forth.
Plan your route before moving on. Keeping track of where you have already searched helps you avoid walking back into Slenderman.
faq: What is the main goal of Slenderman Lost at School?
Your objective is to explore the abandoned school, solve puzzles, and collect items so you can escape Slenderman.
How do I avoid Slenderman?
The game is built around stealth, so use stealth tactics to avoid being caught by him while you explore.

pager-war.intro: Pager War is a casual strategy game where you use energy to summon soldiers and hold back enemy attacks. It offers a level mode and an endless challenge mode, and you play with mouse clicks or taps.
tips: Watch your energy bar closely and avoid spending it all at once, so you always have enough to respond to a sudden enemy push.
Summon soldiers early to build a defensive line before the enemy arrives, rather than reacting only after they reach your base.
Pay attention to which enemies are closing in and choose your summons to match the threat in front of you.
In level mode, take it one stage at a time and learn how the enemy waves come in before pushing your luck.
In endless challenge mode, pace yourself and keep a steady rhythm of summons, since the difficulty is there to test how long you can hold on.
faq: What is the goal of Pager War?
The goal is to use energy to summon soldiers that resist enemy attacks. You play through the level mode or the endless challenge mode.
How do I control the soldiers?
You play with mouse clicks or taps. Click or tap to summon soldiers using the energy you have.

race-on-cars-in-moscow.intro: Race On Cars in Moscow is a driving game where you weave through city traffic on the highway, avoiding crashes to go as far as you can. You can also earn money on the open map and spend it on upgrading your car or buying new ones.
tips: Keep your speed under control in heavy traffic, since a collision ends your run and resets your progress along the highway.
Plan your lane changes a few cars ahead rather than reacting at the last moment, as the game rewards careful, deliberate moves.
Use the turn signals (Q and E on PC) before changing lanes so you can focus on spotting gaps in traffic.
Try parking mode missions early to build up money, then put your earnings into upgrades before buying a new car.
If you are on a phone, test both the on-screen buttons and the on-screen steering wheel in settings to find the one that feels more precise to you.
faq: What is the main goal of the race?
The goal is to get as far along the highway as possible while avoiding crashes into other cars so you can keep driving.
How do I earn money in the game?
Complete missions on the open map in parking mode. The money you earn can be spent on improving your car or buying new cars.

tps-shooting-zombie-apocalypse.intro: Survive a zombie outbreak as a soldier in this third-person shooter. Clear the city of zombies, creatures, and wild animals across its levels, or test your endurance in endless arena waves.
tips: Aim with the mouse before you fire, and keep moving with WASD so you are not an easy target for a group of zombies.
Check the Tab menu regularly so you know your options before a fight starts.
The enemies have different behaviors and abilities, so watch how each type moves and attacks before you commit to a fight.
In arena mode, conserve your position and avoid getting surrounded as the waves get bigger.
If you find a vehicle, press E to get in. It can help you cover ground faster when you need to leave a dangerous area.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Your goal is to get through the infected city and eliminate all the zombies, scary beasts, and creatures you meet. The game also offers arena mode, where you fight endless waves of zombies.
What are the main controls?
Use WASD to walk, the mouse to look around, aim, and shoot, E to enter and exit a vehicle, and Tab to show the menu.

pocketgolf.intro: PocketGolf is a minimalist paper-style golf game where you flick a tiny ball across doodle fairways and bounce it off pencils and erasers. Sink each hole in as few strokes as possible.
tips: Before you release, look at where the ball will travel and adjust your drag so the path clears any obstacles.
Use the walls, pencils and erasers as bounce points. A well-angled rebound can carry the ball closer to the hole than a direct shot.
Plan the whole hole before your first flick. Fewer strokes come from setting up a good second shot, not just hitting hard.
Keep sessions short and focused. Each hole is quick to retry, so reviewing one shot at a time helps you learn the bounces.
Try to beat your own best score rather than comparing across attempts. Track how many strokes each hole takes and aim to shave one off.
faq: How do I aim and shoot the ball?
On desktop, click and drag away from the ball, then release to flick it toward the hole. On mobile, touch and drag away from the ball, then release to shoot.
What is the goal of each hole?
Get the paper ball into the hole in as few strokes as possible.

ghost-sniper.intro: Ghost Sniper is a stealth shooter where you play an elite sniper moving through more than 30 levels. Your aim is to make precise, silent takedowns without being noticed.
tips: Scan each level before you act and locate every position a target could be watching from. Knowing where threats stand makes the first shot much safer.
Use the surroundings to stay hidden, since cover and shadows are central to the stealth approach. Move only when you are sure your path is clear.
Take your time with each shot. Silent takedowns depend on precision, so a rushed shot that alerts others can cost you the level.
Plan your route through the level before committing, and look for an order of takedowns that keeps the rest of the area unaware.
If a level goes wrong, restart your thinking rather than pushing forward. Patience is part of the challenge in a game built around suspense.
faq: What is the goal of Ghost Sniper?
Your goal is to move through each of the more than 30 levels and complete silent takedowns while staying unseen. The game focuses on stealth and precision.
How hard is Ghost Sniper?
The game is built around suspense and careful play, so it rewards patience over speed. Slow, deliberate planning is the best way to handle the harder levels.
