erase-one-part.intro: Erase One Part is a puzzle game where you solve different levels by erasing items as the instructions ask. It has 51 unique levels and a relaxed pace that suits both adults and kids.
tips: Read the instruction for each level before you erase anything, since the goal is to follow it exactly.
Take your time and look over the whole screen first so you can spot every item that might matter.
If you get stuck, pause and reread the instruction, then try a different item rather than repeating the same move.
Play in short sessions. The game is meant to be relaxing, so a few levels at a time can help you stay focused.
Because the game is also described as educational for kids, younger players may enjoy talking through each puzzle out loud as they solve it.
faq: What is the goal of Erase One Part?
Your goal is to solve each puzzle by erasing the items the instruction asks you to erase.
How many levels does the game have?
The game contains 51 unique levels, each with its own puzzle.

business-go.intro: Business Go is a multiplayer board game about rolling the dice, buying properties, and collecting rent. Build your wealth and outplay the other players as you grow your business empire.
tips: Buy properties whenever you can afford them early on, since owning more properties gives you more chances to collect rent.
Keep some cash in reserve so you are not forced to sell properties when you land on a costly space.
Watch what your opponents own and avoid spending everything in a way that leaves you unable to pay rent.
Track your income from rent each turn so you can see which properties are actually paying off.
Look for opportunities to sell or rent out properties when the timing helps your overall wealth, not only when you need cash.
faq: How do you win Business Go?
The game is about building wealth and outplaying the competition, so the player who grows their business empire the most is in the strongest position.
What do I do on my turn?
Roll the dice, then buy properties you land on and collect rent from properties you own or rent out.

bullet-army-run.intro: Bullet Army Run is a casual puzzle game where you lead a growing team of bullets across parkour platforms. You collect bullets to expand your army while steering past obstacles like cutters and hammers.
tips: Watch the obstacles ahead before you commit your army to a path, since a wider team is harder to steer through gaps.
Collect bullets whenever it is safe to do so, because a bigger army gives you more to work with as the course continues.
Keep your timing relaxed and react early rather than late; the game rewards reflexes and planning over rushing.
Pay attention to how your team spreads out on the platforms and steer to keep the group together.
If a run goes badly, try again and notice which obstacle caught you so you can plan a better route the next time.
faq: What is the goal of Bullet Army Run?
You lead your Bullet Army along parkour platforms, collecting bullets to grow your team while avoiding obstacles such as cutters and hammers.
How do I control the game?
You play with a mouse click or a tap. Use your clicks or taps to direct your army as it runs.

chef-tycoon.intro: Chef Tycoon is a restaurant management game where you move your chef around the kitchen, prepare customer orders under time pressure, and spend your earnings on upgrades. Each stage speeds up, so workflow matters more over time.
tips: Keep your chef moving toward the next order rather than waiting at one station, since serving quickly is what keeps customer satisfaction up.
Watch satisfaction levels as well as the order list; a dish served slightly late can still hurt your standing if several customers are waiting.
Spend early coins on upgrades that speed up your kitchen, because a faster workflow helps you handle the quicker pace of later stages.
Aim to finish level goals as you go, since completing them unlocks new recipes and improvements you will need for bigger orders.
If you play with the on-screen joystick, use short, steady drags to change direction so you do not overshoot stations and lose time.
faq: What is the main goal in Chef Tycoon?
Prepare and serve customer orders quickly, keep satisfaction levels up, and complete level goals to earn coins and unlock new recipes and improvements.
How do I move my chef?
On desktop, use the arrow keys to move up, down, left, and right. On the touch screen, drag the on-screen joystick in any direction.

brick-out-candy.intro: Brick Out Candy is an arcade game where you bounce a ball to shatter candy bricks. Keep the ball in play, aim carefully, and score as the levels get harder.
tips: Watch the angle of each bounce before you commit, since precise shots are central to clearing bricks.
Aim for higher bricks when you can, because the description highlights aiming high as a key part of the challenge.
Pick up power-ups when they are safely reachable, but do not chase them if it means losing the ball.
Prioritise keeping the ball alive over grabbing every brick, since the game is built around staying in play.
Expect later levels to be trickier, so use the early levels to get a feel for how the ball reacts.
faq: What is the goal of Brick Out Candy?
Bounce your ball to shatter candy bricks while keeping the ball alive. You score points as you work through increasingly tricky levels.
How do I score points?
Points come from breaking candy bricks. The game also rewards you for keeping the ball in play and collecting power-ups along the way.

urban-military-strike.intro: Urban Military Strike is a tactical shooter set in close-quarters urban battlefields. You move, aim, and coordinate with your squad through multi-level missions where positioning matters.
tips: Use crouch and prone to lower your profile when you enter a new room or area, since staying low makes it harder to be spotted.
Think about where you stand before you fire. Choose cover and angles that let you see the most space while limiting how much of you is exposed.
Keep track of your squad and coordinate before a breach. Waiting a moment to align with your team can be safer than pushing in alone.
Watch for shifting objectives and adjust your plan when they change instead of sticking to the first route you chose.
Scroll the mouse wheel to switch to third-person when you need a wider view of your surroundings, then return to the normal view to aim precisely.
faq: How do I move and aim?
Use W, A, S, and D to move, and use the mouse to aim and click to fire.
How do I crouch or go prone?
Hold Ctrl to crouch and press X to go prone, which helps you stay lower and harder to see.

transport-run.intro: Transport Run is a 3D traffic runner where you steer a colorful vehicle down crowded highways. Dodge oncoming cars and buses, keep your distance growing, and avoid every crash.
tips: Watch the gaps two or three lanes ahead rather than the car right in front of you, so you have time to switch lanes smoothly.
Release the accelerate control early when a gap is closing, since braking in time is often safer than trying to squeeze through.
Use short, controlled swipes to change lanes instead of large sudden steering movements, which can push you into oncoming traffic.
Build a steady rhythm of accelerating and stopping so your timing stays consistent across the run.
Take the careful stops the game offers as chances to upgrade your vehicle, since better performance makes the later stretches of traffic easier to handle.
faq: What is the main goal in Transport Run?
Drive as far as you can without crashing into other vehicles. Your score is based on the distance you cover.
How do I steer and change lanes?
On PC, swipe or hold the left and right arrows or mouse. On mobile, swipe left or right on the screen.

top-shootout.intro: Top Shootout is a Wild West action game about quick reflexes and steady aim. Take down bandits, protect townsfolk, and chase a high score as the action ramps up.
tips: Before you fire, check who is in the line of fire so you never hit a townsperson. Protecting them is part of the challenge.
Keep your aim steady rather than rushing every shot. A missed shot costs time you may need later when the action gets busier.
Stay alert for supplies and grab them when it is safe. They can help you keep going while the pressure builds.
Expect the pace to pick up as you play. Focus on one threat at a time instead of reacting to everything at once.
Play a few rounds to learn the rhythm of the action. Fast reactions come more easily once you recognise where threats usually appear.
faq: What is the main goal of Top Shootout?
Take down the bandits while protecting innocent townsfolk, and gather supplies along the way. The game rewards you for building up a high score.
Does the game get harder as you play?
Yes, the description says the action intensifies, so the pace and pressure increase as you go on. Staying calm and focused helps you keep up.

unno-game.intro: Unno Game is a card game based on the classic UNO format, played solo or with multiple players. Special cards can change how the round unfolds, so timing and planning matter.
tips: Hold special cards until they can change the round the most, such as when an opponent is close to playing out. Using them early often gives rivals an easy recovery.
Keep track of how many cards each opponent has left. The player with the fewest cards is the one you most need to slow down.
Watch which colors and types of cards are being played. This helps you guess which cards your rivals are likely to be missing.
Call "Uno!" as soon as you are down to your last card. Your rivals may try to catch you first, so do not wait.
When playing solo, try different card orders in your head before committing. This helps you see which moves set up your next turn.
faq: What is the main goal of Unno Game?
The goal is to get rid of all your cards before your opponents do. Special cards can be used to change the flow of the game in your favor.
What happens if I forget to shout Uno?
The game description says you should shout "Uno!" before your rivals do. Staying alert to your card count helps you avoid missing it.

agent-j.intro: Agent J is a shooting game where you play as an elite agent facing fierce enemies in dangerous settings. Success depends on agility, cunning, and choosing the right gear for each encounter.
tips: Pick your arsenal with the next fight in mind, since the game asks you to choose your weapons wisely.
Before you move into a new area, take a moment to study where enemies might be and what cover or hazards surround you.
Use agility to reposition instead of standing still, so you can keep control of each battle.
Watch how enemies behave for a few seconds before engaging, then use that information to outwit them rather than rushing in.
If a fight becomes too hard, slow down and reassess your strategy instead of repeating the same approach.
faq: What is the goal of Agent J?
You play as an elite agent who must defeat enemies and uphold justice in a world full of danger. Each encounter tests your strategic thinking.
What controls does Agent J use?
The game page does not list specific controls, so check the in-game instructions or prompts once the game starts.

halloween-makeup-me.intro: Halloween Makeup Me is a dress-up game where you give a girl a Halloween look. You choose from themes like beautiful monsters, lovely witches, and bloody vampires, then play with mouse or tap controls.
tips: Pick a theme before you start and plan the look around it, such as a monster, witch, or vampire, so each choice supports the same style.
Work on one area at a time, like the face, then the hair, then the finishing details, so the look stays balanced and you don't lose track of your changes.
Try a few options in each category before you commit, and compare them against your chosen theme to see which fits best.
Take your photo only after you are happy with the full look, since the game encourages you to capture your finished design.
If you want to enter the "Best Makeup Designs of the Week" contest, focus on a bold, clear design that stands out in a photo.
faq: What is the goal of Halloween Makeup Me?
The goal is to create a Halloween makeup look for your girl using the themes on offer, then take a photo of your finished design. There is no set score or win condition described in the game.
How do I control the game?
Use your mouse to click or tap your way through the options. The game is designed to work with either input.

super-nitro-racing-3.intro: Super Nitro Racing 3 is a top-down racer where the car accelerates on its own. Your job is steering, braking, and picking the right line through 21 tracks, with weather and damage adding pressure.
tips: Since the car never stops accelerating, use braking before corners rather than mid-turn so you keep control of the line.
Save your nitro for a long straight or an exit where speed matters most, since a full burst has to be earned back before you can use it again.
On rain, snow, or fog tracks, ease off your steering and braking inputs early, especially on icy sections where grip is low.
Watch your damage and grab D pods when it is safe to do so, because damage never repairs on its own.
Try Time Attack or Ghost first to learn the track lines before you take on rivals in a full race or the Championship.
faq: How do I steer and brake on desktop?
Use the left and right arrows or A and D to steer, and Space or the down arrow to brake. The N key or up arrow fires nitro, and P or Esc pauses the game.
How does nitro work?
Charge the nitro bar to full, then press the nitro control to fire one long burst of speed. After that, you need to build the bar up again before using it.

real-driving-simulator.intro: Real Driving Simulator is a racing game focused on realistic driving. You unlock different vehicles and drive them through cities and tracks, aiming for a true behind-the-wheel feel.
tips: Try a few different vehicles early on to see how each one handles before settling on a favorite for longer runs.
Ease into turns rather than taking them at full speed, since realistic handling rewards smooth steering.
Pay attention to the road layout in cities so you can anticipate traffic and corners before you reach them.
Start on tracks you find easier, then move to harder courses once you are comfortable with how your car responds.
Keep short practice drives in mind as a way to learn the feel of acceleration and braking before attempting longer races.
faq: How do I control the car?
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps. Use the on-screen options to steer and move, and practice briefly to get comfortable with the response.
What is the goal of the game?
The main goal is to unblock vehicles and drive them through cities and tracks, enjoying the realistic driving experience.

hit-master.intro: Hit Master is an arcade shooter set in the Wild West. You clear waves of outlaws with precise shots, using angles and ricochets while your ammo is limited.
tips: Count your bullets before each shot. Ammo is limited, so take the time to aim rather than firing quickly.
Look for ricochet paths before shooting. A bounced shot can reach targets that are hidden or out of a direct line.
Plan the angle first, then take the shot. Careful aiming is what keeps you alive and raises your score.
Try the different game modes to learn how each one changes the challenge. Each mode asks for a slightly different approach.
Watch the crowd of outlaws as a whole. Prioritize the shots that clear the most threats safely.
faq: What is the main goal of Hit Master?
You aim to survive and conquer hordes of outlaws in the Wild West. Careful, precise shooting is what keeps you going and raises your score.
Why does limited ammo matter so much?
Because you cannot waste bullets, every shot needs a clear plan. Aiming carefully is the key to lasting longer in the game.

counter-craft-zombies.intro: Counter Craft Zombies is a shooting and survival adventure set in blocky pixel worlds. You equip weapons and fight off endless waves of Minecraft-style zombies by staying mobile and making every shot count.
tips: Aim before you fire, since every shot counts against the endless hordes and wasted bullets can leave you short when enemies close in.
Keep moving rather than standing still, so you can avoid being surrounded and keep a clear line of fire.
Try out your arsenal early and notice which weapons work best for close threats and which suit enemies farther away.
Watch how the zombies approach and pick off the nearest threats first to keep pressure from building up around you.
Pace yourself across the run, because the zombie horde keeps coming and survival depends on managing your position as much as your firepower.
faq: What is the main goal of Counter Craft Zombies?
The goal is to survive the zombie apocalypse by shooting the undead and outmaneuvering them across pixel worlds.
Do I need to equip weapons before fighting?
Yes, the game is built around equipping your arsenal before facing the endless blocky hordes.

adventure-time-bullet-jake.intro: Adventure Time: Bullet Jake is an arcade shooter where you launch Jake from a cannon and try to send him as far as possible. Each attempt is a chance to beat your previous distance.
tips: Aim carefully before each shot, since the launch angle sets the path Jake takes through the air.
Collect as many coins as you can during each flight, because they are your only way to buy upgrades.
Use your ammunition while Jake is in the air to keep him moving forward, and do not waste it at the start of the flight.
Spend your coins on upgrades that match your plan, such as more life for longer flights or a rocket backpack to add lift.
Treat each run as a test: note how far you went and what you changed, then adjust your aim or upgrades on the next attempt.
faq: What is the main goal of Bullet Jake?
The goal is to shoot Jake as far as you can, and to improve the distance you reach with each attempt.
How do I aim and shoot?
Use the mouse to aim and shoot. On touch devices, use the on-screen buttons instead.

dungeon-descent.intro: Dungeon Descent is a fast voxel dungeon crawler where you clear rooms, collect loot, and push deeper through harder biomes. Each run ends in a fight with a boss, and the challenge grows with every floor.
tips: Clear each room fully before opening the next door, since enemies are the main threat and loot comes from fights and chests.
Open chests when it is safe, then compare the weapons, armor, upgrades, and artifacts you find before equipping anything.
Dodge incoming attacks instead of standing still, because combat is quick and deadly.
Switch weapons during fights when one is not dealing enough damage or a new enemy type calls for a different approach.
Save artifact powers for the moments when a fight turns against you, rather than using them the first time a room looks tough.
faq: What is the goal of Dungeon Descent?
Your goal is to survive as you descend deeper through the dungeon. Clear rooms, gather loot, and defeat the bosses waiting below.
How do I get stronger during a run?
Open chests and clear rooms to collect weapons, armor, upgrades, and artifacts. Combine these items to build a setup that suits your playstyle.

sports-minibattles.intro: Sports MiniBattles is a 2D sports game with four different sports to play. Face an AI opponent or a friend on split controls, and be the first to score five times in each match.
tips: Watch where the ball or object is heading before you commit to a jump, since the physics affect how it moves after contact.
Use the smash button at the right moment rather than constantly, so you do not waste it when you are out of position.
Keep your character near the middle of the play area so you can reach shots coming from either side.
If you are playing a friend, agree on which keys each player uses before starting so controls do not get mixed up mid-match.
Treat every point as important, since the first player to five wins and a single lost point can shift the match.
faq: How do I win a match?
The first player to score five times in a game wins that match. Stay focused on every point, because each one brings you closer to five.
What are the controls for player 1 and player 2?
Player 1 moves with A and D, jumps with W, and smashes with the space bar. Player 2 moves with the left and right arrow keys, jumps with the up arrow, and smashes with 0 or Enter.

block-blast-jewel-puzzle.intro: Block Blast: Jewel Puzzle is a block puzzle where you drag pieces into a grid and clear them. It offers Classic, Timer and Level modes, plus a global leaderboard.
tips: Before placing a piece, look at which shapes you still have and keep open gaps that fit the awkward ones.
Fill in narrow holes early so that single-cell gaps do not build up and block your later placements.
In Classic Mode there is no clock, so take your time and plan two or three moves ahead.
In Timer Mode, pick quick, obvious placements first and save careful planning for the moments when the clock is not under pressure.
In Level Mode, study the layout of each stage before moving, since the challenges are built around logic and precision.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Drag blocks into the grid and fit them together to clear rows and keep the board from filling up. Your score is shown on the leaderboard.
How do I move the blocks on a computer?
Use your mouse or touchpad to drag a block into the grid and drop it where you want it.

cricket-mania.intro: Cricket Mania is a timing-based batting game where you try to score as many runs as possible before you lose your wickets. Each delivery is a fresh test of your reactions.
tips: Watch the bowler's run-up closely, since their motion gives you an early clue about the delivery before it arrives.
Pay attention to the visual cues that show whether the ball is Straight, Slow, or Fast, and adjust your timing to each type.
Focus on the moment the ball reaches the sweet spot rather than reacting as soon as it appears, because a late press means you're bowled.
Stay calm and consistent, since one mistimed shot ends your innings, so steady timing usually matters more than rushing.
Play a few short sessions to learn the rhythm of the deliveries, which makes it easier to spot the sweet spot on faster balls.
faq: What is the goal of Cricket Mania?
The goal is to score as many runs as possible before you lose all your wickets. Each delivery gives you a chance to add to your total.
How do I hit the ball?
Press Left or Right when the ball reaches the sweet spot. Good timing sends the ball to the boundary, while a late press gets you bowled.

violent-shooter.intro: Violent shooter is a 3D casual shooting game where you fight enemies with a Sniper, a Gatling gun, an RPG, and help from your piggy buddies. Clear levels, collect treasure chests, and take on new stages.
tips: Pick the weapon that fits the situation: the Sniper suits single targets at a distance, while the Gatling gun is better for quick bursts when enemies are close.
Save the RPG for moments when enemies are grouped together, so one shot can cover more than one target.
Watch where enemies come from before you fire, and keep your aim steady so your shots land on target instead of wasting ammunition.
Keep your piggy buddies in mind as extra support when a level gets crowded, rather than relying only on your own weapons.
Look for treasure chests as you move through each stage, since they are part of the reward for clearing levels and make it worth exploring the area.
faq: What is the goal of Violent shooter?
Defeat enemies, collect treasure chests, and work through the levels. The game is built around clearing each stage and moving on to new challenges.
How do I control the game?
Use a mouse click or a tap to play. Click or tap to fire and interact with the game.

subway-surfers-zurich.intro: Subway Surfers Zurich is a browser runner set in the Zurich World Tour edition. You control a runner who keeps going while you dodge obstacles, and the aim is to run as far as you can.
tips: Watch the track ahead rather than your runner, so you can react to obstacles before they reach you.
Use the arrow keys to switch lanes early instead of making last-second moves, which keeps your options open.
Save the space bar for when you need the skateboard, since using it at the right moment helps you get past danger.
Stay calm when the pace rises. Short, steady corrections usually go further than rushed, big movements.
Practice a few runs to learn the rhythm of the obstacles, then try to beat your previous distance.
faq: What is the goal of Subway Surfers Zurich?
The goal is to run as far as possible while overcoming obstacles and dodging danger along the way.
How do I control the runner?
Use the arrow keys to move, and press the space bar to activate the skateboard.

story-of-alcana.intro: Story of Alcana is a Match-3 puzzle adventure with fairy-tale creatures, magical locations and a storyline. You solve puzzles, earn artifacts and recruit allies to help you through each level.
tips: Look for ways to solve the ancient puzzles, since the artifacts you find are meant to help you with Match-3 levels that are harder to clear on your own.
Pay attention to which creatures you upgrade, and favor the ones that fit the level you are stuck on.
Try to make friends with the characters you meet, because the dragon, yeti, time keeper and others take your side and help you complete tasks.
Use the weekly challenges to play on a regular schedule and to earn rewards without rushing through the story.
If you enjoy competition, try the tournaments and PvP matches, and watch how other players build their teams for ideas.
faq: What is the main goal of Story of Alcana?
You move through a story across many locations, such as the Enchanted Forest and Snow Peaks, while restoring magical forests and castles and completing game tasks.
How do artifacts help me in the game?
Each artifact you find by solving ancient puzzles gives you help when you play Match-3 levels.

animal-racing-2.intro: Animal Racing 2 is an arcade racing game where you run against opponents across platforms. You transform into different animals to cross sea, gaps, and steps, while solving puzzles along the way.
tips: Look ahead before each obstacle so you can plan which animal you will need, such as a shark for the sea or an eagle for a gap.
Respond quickly when a transformation is needed, since the game rewards fast reactions on each platform.
Keep an eye on your opponents' positions so you know when a transformation can help you pull ahead.
Treat the puzzles as part of the race and check the path before moving, rather than rushing into the next section.
Practice the transformations on early platforms to learn which animal suits which obstacle before the race gets harder.
faq: How do I play Animal Racing 2?
Use mouse clicks or taps to play. Click or tap to move and to transform into the animal needed for the current platform.
Which animal should I use to cross a gap?
The description gives an eagle as the animal that flies over a gap. Use it when the platform ahead has a gap you cannot run across.

classic-car-driving-game.intro: Classic Car Driving Game is a parking challenge where you guide vintage cars through busy lots, tight spaces and tricky turns into a marked parking spot. Precision and patience matter more than speed.
tips: Use small, steady inputs with W A S D or the arrow keys so you don't overshoot the parking spot.
Plan your route before you move by looking at where the barriers and cones sit relative to the target space.
When a space is tight, reverse slowly and make small steering corrections rather than sharp turns.
Stop and reposition whenever the car is angled wrong, since fixing the angle early is easier than correcting it at the spot.
Check the gaps on both sides of the car before each turn so you avoid clipping obstacles near the end of a run.
faq: What is the goal of Classic Car Driving Game?
Your goal is to drive the vintage car through each parking area and position it correctly in the designated parking spot without hitting obstacles.
How do I control the car?
Use W A S D or the Arrow Keys to drive and steer. You can also reverse to adjust your position in tight spaces.

mixed-world.intro: Mixed World is a tap game about helping blue monsters outsmart red foes across 30 levels. Each level is a physics-based puzzle that rewards clever planning and a high score.
tips: Study the whole level before you act. Notice where the red foes are, where the blue monsters start, and what objects could move or fall.
Try each creature's unique ability on its own first so you learn what it does before you combine them in harder puzzles.
Watch how objects react to gravity and collisions. Physics-based puzzles often reward small, deliberate moves more than rushed ones.
If a level stalls, pause your plan and test a different order of moves. Trying a new approach is often faster than repeating the same one.
Once you finish a level, go back and replay it with a cleaner plan. Chasing the top score can teach you more efficient solutions.
faq: What is the main goal in Mixed World?
Use the blue monsters' abilities and your strategy to outsmart the red foes and solve each of the 30 levels.
How do the creature abilities help?
Each blue monster has a unique ability that can be used to solve the puzzles. Learning what each one does is key to progressing.

donutosaur-2.intro: Donutosaur 2 is a dinosaur puzzle adventure set in odd worlds with fans, portals, and floating donuts. Your goal is to get through 25 levels while collecting hard-to-find stars.
tips: Before acting, look at how each level's fans, portals, and flotation devices are placed, and work out what they could do for you.
Hunt for the stars on each level, since they are described as elusive. Check corners and spots that look out of the way.
If you get stuck, try a different approach rather than repeating the same move. Testing one change at a time makes it easier to see what works.
Go back to earlier levels whenever you want. You can collect stars you missed or try a puzzle again with fresh ideas.
Keep your pace steady. The game rewards patience as much as quick thinking, so take a short break if a puzzle frustrates you.
faq: What is the main goal in Donutosaur 2?
Guide your dinosaur through 25 levels and solve the puzzles in each one. Collecting the stars along the way is part of the challenge.
How do I collect the stars?
Stars are hidden in the levels and are described as elusive, so they take some searching. Explore each level fully and look for places you may have skipped.

demon-killer.intro: Demon Killer is a shooting game where you hold back waves of demons and upgrade a range of weapons to keep the world safe. Quick reactions and smart weapon choices matter most.
tips: Watch each wave closely before you commit, so you can spot which demons are closing in fastest.
Spend your upgrades on weapons that suit your playstyle instead of spreading them thinly across the whole arsenal.
Try different weapons in your arsenal early on to learn which ones handle crowds and which ones work better against tougher targets.
Stay on the move rather than standing still, since waves can overwhelm you quickly when you are boxed in.
Keep your reflexes sharp and take short breaks between waves to reset your focus before the next onslaught.
faq: What is the main goal in Demon Killer?
Survive the waves of demons that keep coming and protect humanity from the hellish invasion. The game is built around holding out against intense waves.
How do I upgrade my weapons?
The game uses strategic weapon upgrades as part of its gameplay. Check the in-game menus and prompts for the exact upgrade options as they appear while you play.

christmas-gift-unlock.intro: Christmas Gift Unlock is a holiday sliding puzzle. Move the red blocks around the grid to clear a path and slide the gift box out. Each level gets harder as you go.
tips: Start by finding which blocks sit directly between the gift box and the exit, since those are the ones you need to move first.
Move each block only as far as you need to open the path. Shifting blocks too far can block a different route.
Before you drag a block, check whether it is blocking another block that you will need to move later.
If you get stuck, try moving blocks that look unrelated to the gift box, as they can open space for the blocks in the way.
Plan two or three moves ahead, especially in later levels, where the puzzles become more challenging.
faq: What is the goal of Christmas Gift Unlock?
Your goal is to slide the gift box out of the puzzle grid by strategically moving the red blocks horizontally or vertically.
How do I move the blocks on desktop?
Click and hold the left mouse button on a red block, then drag it horizontally or vertically to clear the path.

swerve-rush.intro: Swerve Rush is a racing game where you drive down an endless highway, weaving through traffic to score points by passing cars very closely. Each run ends on a crash, and the cash you earn can go toward upgrades and new cars.
tips: Aim for near misses but keep a safety margin, since a single crash ends the run and wipes out your combo progress.
Build your combo steadily by chaining near misses one after another rather than taking risky passes that could end the run early.
Save your nitro for stretches where traffic is dense, because nitro doubles all points and you get the most value when many near misses are happening at once.
Watch your nitro meter fill as you pass cars, and plan to activate it when it is full so you can spend it during a busy stretch of road.
Spend early cash on handling or brakes if you find yourself crashing often, since better control makes tight passes safer, then upgrade the engine for more speed later.
faq: What is the main goal of Swerve Rush?
The goal is to score as many points as possible by passing traffic very closely, building long combos, and beating your high score. The run ends when you crash.
How do I score points?
Each near miss, where you pass a car by inches, adds points, fills your nitro, and grows your combo. Using nitro doubles all points while it is active.

car-crash-test-abandoned-city.intro: Car Crash Test: Abandoned City is a racing and simulation game set in an empty city. You drive, crash, and customize cars with realistic damage, using ramps and crash tools to create your own chaos.
tips: Use B to slow time before a big jump or crash, so you can judge the angle and speed you need.
Press K to repair your car once it is badly damaged, and use R to put it back in service when it is wrecked and you want to keep driving.
Try the same ramp at different speeds and angles to see how the car lands and which parts break off.
Tap Space to brake hard before a corner or collision if you want to keep control of the car and avoid spinning out.
Use C to switch camera views, since a different angle can make it easier to see where the car is heading and how it is damaged.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
There is no fixed goal. The game encourages you to drive, crash, and tune cars however you like in the open world.
Which keys control the car?
Use WASD to steer, Space to brake hard, and Shift to enable nitro. Press N to change car and Tab to open the pause menu.

highway-racers.intro: Highway Racers is a driving game where you weave through traffic on the road. Steer with WASD or the arrow keys, and grab cash and powerups to get to the finish of your track.
tips: Keep your car centered in your lane and look ahead so you have time to change lanes before traffic gets close.
Make small steering adjustments instead of sharp swerves, which can cause you to clip other cars and lose speed.
Aim for cash pickups when it is safe to do so, but do not change lanes into a gap that is about to close.
Save powerups for stretches where traffic is dense, since they are most useful when you need to get through a tough section.
Pay attention to the track ahead rather than only the car directly in front of you, so you can plan your route early.
faq: What is the goal of Highway Racers?
The goal is to race through traffic and finish your track. Collecting cash and powerups along the way helps you reach the end.
How do I control the car?
Use the W, A, S, and D keys or the arrow keys to steer and move your car.

duelers.intro: Duelers is an adventure game where you set out to rescue a princess from villainous captors. You fight with a trusty sword and make your way through the kingdom.
tips: Pick your foes carefully instead of fighting every enemy you meet, since the game rewards strategic choices.
Watch the treacherous obstacles along the way and plan your route before you move forward.
Treat each battle as a chance to learn how enemies fight, so you can handle tougher foes later.
Look for rewarding upgrades and use them to strengthen your sword and your chances in later fights.
Balance skill and strategy: slow, deliberate play often works better than rushing into every duel.
faq: What is the main goal of Duelers?
Your goal is to rescue the princess from her villainous captors by fighting your way through the kingdom. The game combines obstacles, battles, and upgrades along the way.
How do I earn upgrades in Duelers?

The game description says that you earn rewarding upgrades, but it does not explain exactly how they are unlocked. Keep playing, win duels, and pay attention to what the game offers you as you progress.

obby-car-keyboard-parkour.intro: Obby Car Keyboard Parkour is a racing obstacle course where you drive a car through parkour tracks, dodge hazards, and reach the finish line. Progress unlocks new areas, faster cars, and rebirth bonuses.
tips: Use WASD to steer and keep your speed up, but slow down before tricky sections so you can line up your path.
Use Space to jump across gaps and over obstacles, and time jumps so you land on solid ground rather than drifting off the track.
Hold the right mouse button and move the mouse to adjust the camera so you can see upcoming obstacles early.
Press R to return to the start if you fall off or get stuck, which is often quicker than struggling to recover mid-course.
Pay attention to the rewards and boosts you collect, since they help you move faster and make tougher levels easier to reach.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Your goal is to drive your car through each parkour track, avoid dangerous obstacles, and reach the finish line to unlock new areas.
How do I control the car on PC?
Use WASD to drive, Space to jump, and hold the right mouse button while moving the mouse to control the camera.

dinosaur-shifting-run.intro: Dinosaur Shifting Run is a runner where you sprint through a desert as a human and then transform into a dinosaur to smash through the jungle. Each level brings its own challenges, so choosing the right form matters.
tips: Read the environment ahead of you before each obstacle and decide early which form suits it.
Watch for the moment the scenery changes from desert to jungle, since that is when you should be ready to transform.
Pay attention to what each form can handle, and avoid running into obstacles that your current form cannot get through.
Expect the challenges to shift from level to level, so adjust your approach rather than repeating the same timing.
Higher levels are harder, so slow down and focus on one obstacle at a time instead of rushing ahead.
faq: What is the goal of Dinosaur Shifting Run?

You run through each level and transform your character to suit the environment, choosing the right form to become the winner. The description says the desert calls for a human runner and the jungle calls for a dinosaur.
Why does my character keep failing at certain points?
Failing usually means you were in the wrong form for the obstacle in front of you. Look ahead at the environment and switch to the form that fits it.

run-rich-3d.intro: Run Rich 3D is an arcade runner where you race along a track collecting money bills. Your outfit improves as you gather more cash, but grabbing the wrong items can cost you.
tips: Drag gently and keep your movement smooth so you can line up with bills without overcorrecting.
Look ahead on the track rather than only at your character, so you can plan which bills to collect and which to skip.
Bottles and trash cans are the items to avoid, since collecting them makes you poorer.
Treat each bill as a choice: grab the ones you can reach safely and steer clear of clusters of unwanted items.
Watch how your outfit changes as you collect money, since it shows how your run is going.
faq: What is the goal of Run Rich 3D?
Reach the end of the track while collecting as many money bills as you can along the way.
How do I move my character?
Drag your finger or mouse to move. The game is designed to be simple, so the controls are easy to remember.

find-the-vampire.intro: Find the Vampire is a 3D hidden object adventure where you hunt vampires disguised as people, animals and objects across a city. Your goal is to expose and destroy them, save the citizens and defeat the Vampire Lord.
tips: Scan each scene slowly and look for things that seem out of place, such as a figure that doesn't match its surroundings or an object that looks slightly wrong.
Save your detectors for areas where you have a strong suspicion, since they help you expose hidden enemies and you will want them for tougher spots.
Try a new exterminator kit on a suspicious target to see how it reacts before committing to a full attack.
Expect vampires to get more cunning with each level, so keep checking the same kinds of hiding spots such as neighbors, trees and everyday objects.
Finish the story levels in each location in order, since each one reveals part of the story and helps you move toward the Vampire Lord.
faq: What is the main goal of Find the Vampire?
You need to identify and destroy all the vampires disguised among the city's people, animals and objects, rescue the citizens and defeat the Vampire Lord.
What can vampires disguise themselves as?
Vampires can hide as ordinary people, animals and even objects, so anything in the scene could be a threat.

long-drive-to-horizons-sim.intro: Long Drive to Horizons Sim is a desert survival driving game. You build and repair your own off-road vehicle, scavenge supplies from abandoned sites, and race across long dune tracks against rivals.
tips: Scavenge abandoned camps, crashed caravans, and derelict garages early, and grab fuel, parts, and crafting materials before you commit to a long route.
Balance fuel, speed, and durability on every race. Pushing too hard can wear your car down before you reach the finish.
Check your vehicle's condition regularly and swap out worn components before they fail mid-track.
Experiment with different bodies, engines, and wheels to find a combination that suits the terrain you race on most.
Choose which weapon parts and ammunition to carry based on the threats you expect, since your supplies are limited.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You pilot a single vehicle across open desert, racing, repairing, and surviving. Winning races against rivals and staying operational are the core objectives.
How do I improve my car?
Gather parts and resources, then mix and match bodies, engines, and wheels to build your vehicle. You can also unlock performance boosts through maintenance and upgrades.

slice-and-soar.intro: Slice & Soar is a skill game where you swipe or drag to cut objects flying through the air. Score as many points as you can while avoiding obstacles and forbidden items.
tips: Watch the pattern of objects for a few seconds before you start swiping, so you can time your cuts instead of reacting late.
Keep your swipes smooth and deliberate; a rushed swipe is more likely to clip an obstacle next to your target.
Focus on accuracy first. Missing a target or touching a forbidden item costs you, so a slower clean run often beats a fast messy one.
When a level introduces a new obstacle, pause your scoring rhythm and learn where it appears before going for high-value cuts.
Stay relaxed and keep your eyes on the center of the action rather than on one object, which helps you spot the next slice in time.
faq: How do I control the game?
You use touch controls, swiping or dragging across the screen to slice through the objects.
What is the goal of Slice & Soar?
The aim is to collect as many points as possible by cutting objects while avoiding obstacles.

goblin-clan.intro: Goblin Clan is an arcade adventure where you move through a whimsical world, dodge captors, and collect treasure while working toward a showdown with a powerful sorceress. Quick reflexes and planning both matter.
tips: Watch where the captors are moving before you commit to a path, so you can slip past them instead of reacting at the last second.
Collect treasure when it is safe to do so, but do not chase it into danger if a captor is close by.
Treat each challenge as a chance to gain experience, and try to finish stages cleanly so you build toward the rewards.
Plan your route ahead of time rather than moving on instinct alone, since strategic planning is central to this game.
Play in short sessions and take a moment to reset between challenges, which helps keep your reflexes sharp.
faq: What is the main goal in Goblin Clan?
You navigate a whimsical world, dodge captors, and collect treasure while gaining experience. The adventure builds toward outwitting a powerful sorceress.
How do I get better at dodging the captors?
Pay attention to their movement patterns and keep some distance rather than cutting close. Quick reflexes combined with planning your route will help you avoid being caught.

paint-pop-3d.intro: Paint Pop 3D is a one-tap shooting game where you paint every slice on a rotating ring while avoiding obstacles. With over 1000 levels, it offers plenty of practice in timing and precision.
tips: Watch the ring for a few seconds before you start tapping so you can see where the obstacles sit relative to the slices you still need to paint.
Tap with steady timing rather than rushing, since a single hit on an obstacle ends the game.
Try holding your finger down as well as tapping, because the game highlights holding as a way to add more fun, and see how it changes your painting.
Focus on finishing the slices that are hardest to reach first, so you are not left with awkward gaps near the end of a level.
If you get stuck on a level, take a short break and come back with fresh timing, since the game has many challenging missions.
faq: What is the goal of Paint Pop 3D?
Your goal is to paint all the slices on the ring to complete each level. Avoid obstacles along the way, because hitting one ends the game.
How do I control the paint shots?
Tap to paint. The game also mentions holding for more fun, so you can experiment with holding your finger down as well as tapping.

square-hero-bird.intro: Square Hero Bird is an arcade hypercasual game where you guide a bird hero while building an egg tower and getting past barriers. Mouse or touch controls keep the action simple to pick up.
tips: Focus on timing: the description stresses the right timing, so try to act at the moment that keeps your bird and tower steady rather than rushing each move.
Keep your movements smooth. Sudden, jerky inputs are the easiest way to knock your egg tower off balance.
Watch the barriers ahead of you early so you have time to line up your next move instead of reacting at the last second.
Aim for perfect landings on the grass, since the game says three of them help you shoot the obstacles in your way.
Pay attention to the level you are on and adjust your pace to it, as the description notes you need the right level for the challenge.
faq: What is the goal of Square Hero Bird?
The goal is to build your egg tower and pass the barriers while keeping the tower stable. Clearing obstacles along the way is part of getting through each stage.
How do I control the bird?
The game uses mouse or touch input only. Use smooth, well-timed clicks or taps to move the bird and keep the tower balanced.

flappy-alien.intro: Flappy Alien is a one-button obstacle course where you guide a quirky alien through space while dodging asteroids. The game speeds up as you go, so timing matters more with every flap.
tips: Keep your taps small and steady rather than rapid and frantic, since each flap lifts the alien a set amount and overcorrecting is a common way to hit an asteroid.
Watch the gap ahead rather than the alien itself. Aiming for the middle of each opening gives you more room to react to unpredictable placements.
Practice the rhythm early in a run while the speed is still gentle. Building a steady tapping pattern now will help you when the pace increases.
When the speed picks up, slow your reactions down mentally and tap a little earlier than feels natural. Acting a fraction sooner usually keeps you clear of the next obstacle.
If you keep crashing at the same point, pause your thinking about that spot and focus only on the next obstacle. Short, focused attempts often beat long, tense ones.
faq: What is the goal of Flappy Alien?
The goal is to guide the alien through a cosmic obstacle course by staying airborne and dodging asteroids for as long as possible.
What controls does Flappy Alien use?
The game uses simple tap controls, where each tap makes the alien flap upward.

ring-fall-puzzle.intro: Ring Fall Puzzle is a maze puzzle game where you rotate the board to guide circles to their target. Each level adds complexity, so careful planning matters as much as quick reactions.
tips: Before you rotate anything, study the whole maze and trace where each circle needs to go.
Make small, deliberate rotations and watch how the circles move before making the next change.
If you get stuck, step back and look for a route that works backward from the target to the start.
Pay attention to the layout of each new level, since the puzzles grow more complex as you progress.
Stay patient and steady, because precision matters more than speed in this game.
faq: What is the goal of Ring Fall Puzzle?
Your goal is to rotate the maze so that the circles reach their target. Each level presents a new layout to solve.
How do the controls work?
The game uses simple rotation controls to turn the maze. Experiment carefully with each move to see how the circles respond.

dino-simulator-city-attack.intro: Dino Simulator City Attack puts you in control of a dinosaur roaming a 3D city where humans and dinosaurs share the streets. Explore each level, find your mission targets, and finish them before the timer runs out.
tips: Scan the whole map at the start of each level so you know where the targets are before you commit to a route.
Use running with Ctrl to cover large distances quickly, then switch to walking with WASD when you need precise movement near a target.
Check the time you have left regularly and plan your route so you are not chasing a far-off target when the clock is nearly out.
Try a few different dinosaur species to see which one moves and handles best for the kind of missions you enjoy.
Use jumping with the Spacebar to get around obstacles and reach higher spots instead of taking long detours.
faq: What is the main goal in each level?
You need to look for the targets on the map and complete the missions for that level before time runs out.
Which keys control the dinosaur?
Use WASD to move, the Spacebar to jump, Ctrl to run, and F to interact with things in the world.

dogfight.intro: Dogfight is an air combat game where you fly a battle plane through aerial dogfights. Use loops, rolls, and turns to outmaneuver enemies and show off your piloting skills.
tips: Use the sharp turn keys (Q and E) when an enemy is close and you need to change direction quickly, and the normal turns (A and D) for wider adjustments.
Keep an eye on your speed. Speeding up with W helps you chase, while slowing down with S can help you stay behind an enemy long enough to line up a shot.
Use roll (Shift on desktop) to dodge incoming fire and reposition yourself without losing too much height.
Pull up with Space when you need to climb out of a dive or gain height before turning back into the fight.
Reload with R during a quieter moment rather than in the middle of a close engagement, so you are ready when a target appears.
faq: What is the goal of Dogfight?
You fly a battle plane in intense aerial battles and engage in dogfights with enemy aircraft. The description focuses on maneuvering and piloting skill rather than a fixed objective.
How do I shoot and use the sub-weapon?
On desktop, press J to fire and K to use the sub-weapon. On mobile, tap the Fire Button to shoot.

redboy-and-bluegirl.intro: RedBoy and BlueGirl is a two-player puzzle adventure set in a dark maze forest. You guide the red boy and his blue water girl partner through the maze together.
tips: Play with a partner if you can, since the game is built around two characters who have to work together.
Look at the whole maze before you move so you can plan a route for both characters instead of rushing ahead with one.
Move slowly and check where each character is before you commit to a step, because a mistake with one can affect the pair.
If you get stuck, step back and try the other character's path first. Switching your focus often reveals the next move.
Take short breaks between attempts and note which spots gave you trouble, so you can approach them more carefully next time.
faq: How do I move my characters?
The game uses the arrow keys to move, as listed in the instructions.
What is the goal of the game?
You guide the red boy and the blue girl through the dark maze forest by solving the puzzles along the way.

mr-racer-car-racing.intro: MR RACER: Car Racing is a high-speed racing game with supercars and heavy traffic. It has 100 Challenge levels, unlimited Chase Mode levels, and a Career Race Mode to work through.
tips: Tap the brake with S before tight turns rather than braking hard mid-corner, so the car stays under control and you keep your speed.
Try the different camera angles early and pick the one that lets you see traffic ahead most clearly.
Use the horn with H when traffic is directly in your path, and keep an eye on where other cars are heading before you commit to a lane.
Spend the rewards you earn on upgrades when a level starts to feel too hard, since better performance helps you keep pace with rivals.
Use Chase Mode to practise your steering and braking without the pressure of a set level list, then apply what you learn in Challenge Mode.
faq: How do I steer and accelerate?
Press W or the up arrow to accelerate, and A or D (or the left and right arrows) to steer. Press S or the down arrow to brake.
What is the difference between Challenge Mode and Chase Mode?
Challenge Mode has 100 levels to complete in order. Chase Mode has unlimited levels, so you can keep racing your opponents for as long as you want.

superstar-kitty-fashion-award.intro: In this animal makeover game, you style cat clients using a range of treatments and tools across several mini-games. Each cat is meant to leave feeling confident and fabulous.
tips: Try the different treatments and tools on a cat before settling on a look, so you learn what each one does.
Work through each mini-game as a separate step rather than rushing, since each one focuses on a different part of the makeover.
Think about the overall style for each client, so the look you choose matches the cat's personality.
Check your work from more than one angle before you finish, so the final result looks balanced and complete.
Replay a makeover if you want to explore other combinations of treatments and tools.
faq: What is the main goal of Superstar Kitty Fashion Award?
Your goal is to transform cat clients into dazzling divas by choosing treatments and tools that give each one a fabulous style. The game is built around the makeover process.
How do I make progress in the mini-games?
Select the treatments and tools offered in each mini-game and use them to style the cat. Taking each step with care helps you build a complete look.

crazy-knife.intro: Crazy Knife is an arcade game about fast slicing. You chop quickly while avoiding obstacles that can lower your score and dull your knife.
tips: Do not rush every cut. Slow down for a moment when a obstacle is close, then speed up again once the path is clear.
Keep an eye on your knife's sharpness as well as your score, since a dull blade can make later cuts harder.
Build a steady rhythm instead of chopping in bursts. Consistent timing often helps you stay precise over a longer run.
Practice short sessions to learn the obstacle patterns. Recognizing them early gives you more time to react.
If you want to climb the ranks, focus on accuracy first. Clean cuts with fewer mistakes will matter more than raw speed.
faq: What is the main goal in Crazy Knife?
Slice quickly and cleanly to build your score and climb the culinary ranks. Avoid obstacles that threaten your score and knife's sharpness.
How do I balance speed and precision?
Move fast when the way is clear and ease off when obstacles appear. Mistakes can cost you more than a slightly slower cut.

baby-taylor-babysitter-daycare.intro: Help Taylor and her mom look after Taylor's baby cousin while his aunt is at an emergency meeting. You feed and play with the baby, and you keep him comfortable.
tips: Check on the baby's diaper often, since a dirty one needs cleaning right away to stop him from crying.
Keep an eye on the baby's mood and switch between feeding and playing so he stays content.
Clean the diaper as soon as you notice a problem, because waiting makes the baby more uncomfortable.
Pay attention to what the baby seems to need before you move on to another task.
Play at a steady pace so you can handle feeding and diaper changes without falling behind.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You help Taylor and her mom take care of the baby while his aunt is busy. You feed and play with him and keep him from getting upset.
What happens if I don't clean a dirty diaper?
The baby will cry because he feels uncomfortable. Cleaning it immediately prevents this.

circuit-master-2.intro: Circuit Master 2 is a puzzle where you place wires, fans and machines on a grid, then press the power button to see if the current reaches the green light. Each component has a specific spot it needs to go.
tips: Look at each component's properties before placing it, since every piece is meant for a particular position on the grid.
Start with the parts that have the fewest possible spots, such as the green light and the power source, then work outward along the path.
Place a few pieces, press the power button to test, and check where the electricity stops so you know which connection to fix.
Use the hint when you are stuck on one section, then go back and solve the rest yourself to keep the puzzle challenging.
On mobile, drag pieces with a steady finger and double-check placement before tapping the red power button.
faq: What is the goal of Circuit Master 2?
Place all the wires, fans and machines in the correct spots on the grid so that the electricity flows and the green light turns on.
How do I power up the circuit?
Once every component is placed, tap or click the red power button to see the electricity flow through the circuit.

fish-rain-2.intro: Fish Rain 2 is a fishing game with scenic locations, a range of fish, and unique baits. Your aim is to reel in diverse catches and land a legendary fish, either alone or with friends online.
tips: Switch between the unique baits instead of sticking with one, and notice which ones bring in different fish.
Try fishing in different scenic locations, since each one gives you a chance at different species.
Pay attention to the authentic sounds, which can help you tell when something is happening in the water.
Focus on landing a variety of fish before going after the legendary catch, so you learn how the waters behave.
Play with friends online and compare your trophies to keep your sessions interesting and motivating.
faq: What is the main goal of Fish Rain 2?
The goal is to reel in diverse fish across different locations and land a legendary catch using unique baits.
How do baits affect my fishing?
Each bait is meant to help you land fish, so trying different ones is the best way to find out which work for you.

skincare-makeover-makeup-game.intro: Skincare Makeover Makeup Game is a beauty and fashion simulation where you help clients through a full makeover. You move from spa and skincare treatments to makeup, hair, outfits and accessories.
tips: Work through the steps in order: start with the spa and skincare treatments and clean the skin before adding any makeup.
Use the tools by tapping and dragging, and take your time with each application so the result looks even.
Before choosing hairstyles, outfits and accessories, look at how the makeup turned out so the whole look fits together.
Each makeover brings its own challenges, so read the task for each client before you start and focus on what it asks for.
Experiment with different makeup, hair and outfit combinations to see which styles suit each client best.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Your goal is to help each client transform their look by completing the makeover tasks, from skincare and spa care through to makeup, hairstyles, outfits and accessories.
How do I apply makeup and skincare?
Tap and drag to use the beauty tools. Move the tool across the client's skin or face to apply skincare and makeup.

formula-go.intro: Formula Go puts you behind the wheel of a Formula 1 car on detailed tracks modeled after famous circuits. Race against clever AI rivals and aim for a podium finish.
tips: Learn each track before you push hard. Sharp bends reward early braking and a clean line, so take a few laps to find where the corners tighten.
Focus on smooth, controlled inputs rather than rushing. Responsive controls mean small, steady adjustments usually beat sudden changes.
Watch the AI competitors to see how they handle the tricky sections. Their lines can show you where the track opens up for a safe pass.
Fine-tune your vehicle before you go all-out. Check the setup options and try a few adjustments to see which one feels best on the track.
Push your limits gradually. Speeding up in straights is good, but a crash or wide exit through a bend will cost you more time than it saves.
faq: What is the goal of Formula Go?
Your aim is to race against clever AI competitors and secure a top spot on the podium. Focus on driving skill to finish ahead of the field.
How do I control the car?
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps. Use these inputs to drive, and keep your movements steady for better control through bends.

sneaky-draw.intro: Smudge the raccoon wants to prank Mr. Crabtree, and you only get one line to do it. Draw a ramp, bridge, or lever, then let physics send the prank his way.
tips: Before you draw, look at where the prank starts and where Mr. Crabtree stands, then picture the shortest path between them.
Try a simple, short line first. Using less ink is what earns more stars, so a small change often beats a long stroke.
If a try goes wrong, press R to retry quickly instead of tweaking the same line over and over.
Use the ? hint when you feel stuck. It can show you the idea behind the level so you can build your own line.
Play the Daily Prank each day to build your streak and collect stickers, and keep your favourite marker colours in mind as you unlock them.
faq: How do I earn all 3 stars on a level?
Hit Mr. Crabtree with the prank while using as little ink as you can. The less ink you use, the more stars you earn, up to 3 per level.
How do I start the prank after drawing my line?
On desktop, release the mouse button after dragging your line. On mobile, lift your finger after swiping.

fight-trivia.intro: Fight Trivia mixes battles with trivia questions. You pick one of four answers to move forward and duel opponents, and a wrong pick sends you back to the start.
tips: Read all four options before choosing, since the questions are built to be tricky and the first answer that looks right may not be.
Treat every question as important, because a single misstep means starting over.
Save the reward button for tougher moments, since it boosts your odds and is most useful when you are unsure.
If you are stuck between two answers, try to rule out the clearly wrong ones first to improve your chances.
Stay focused between rounds so you can keep your concentration on the questions that decide each duel.
faq: What happens if I pick the wrong answer?
A wrong answer leads to starting over, so it pays to slow down and think before you choose.
How do I move forward in the game?
You answer the questions wisely from the four options, and correct answers let you advance and duel opponents.

none-shall-get-through-save-cappuccina.intro: A physics puzzle built around a gravity gun. Move blocks, open doors, and work your way toward rescuing Cappuccina from the evil AI.
tips: Switch to the gravity gun (key 2) whenever a block is in your way, and use it to move blocks before you try to jump over them.
Use the jump key on boxes to reach higher ledges, and check whether a block you plan to stand on will hold your weight before committing.
Keep an eye on what each door needs. Look for the block or switch that opens it before you spend time elsewhere.
If you get stuck in a position you cannot recover from, use Unstuck to return to the start of the level rather than wasting time.
When a puzzle stops making progress, use Restart to reset the room's puzzles and try a different order of moves.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Use the gravity gun and other tools to move blocks, open doors, and reach Cappuccina to save her from the evil AI.
Which key or button brings up the gravity gun?
On PC press 2, and on mobile tap the 2 button. Use Left Mouse Button on PC or the Pull button on mobile to operate it.

mad-city-matrix.intro: Mad City Matrix is a 3D shooter where you fight incoming agents in a large open city. Defeat them with punches and weapons, and survive each level before the timer runs out.
tips: Keep an eye on the clock from the start, since each level ends when time runs out. Plan your route so you are not stuck in one corner while agents keep arriving.
Use the mouse wheel to switch weapons based on the distance to the next agent. Save your strongest weapon for the moments when several agents are close together.
Reload with R during a lull, not in the middle of a firefight. Running dry while agents are closing in is one of the easiest ways to lose control of a fight.
Hold right mouse button to aim when enemies are at range, and use short bursts of fire instead of holding the trigger. This helps you hit targets more reliably.
Use Space to jump out of the line of fire and T to slow things down when you are surrounded. Pair these with movement using WASD so you are never standing still too long.
faq: What is the main goal in Mad City Matrix?
You need to defeat all the incoming agents and survive each level before the time runs out. Combat and timing both matter.
How do I shoot and aim?
Left mouse button fires your weapon and right mouse button aims. Aim first when you have time, then fire to make each shot count.

snake-2077-glitch-war.intro: Snake 2077: Glitch War is a neon-lit snake battle where you grow by collecting energy pellets and try to outlast rival snakes. Every match is a fight to climb the global leaderboard.
tips: Grow steadily by collecting neon food along safe paths before you look for fights with other snakes.
Boosting burns mass, so use it in short bursts to cut off an opponent instead of holding it down for long stretches.
Aim to cut off rivals from the front so they run into a path they cannot escape, then go after their remains.
Eat the remains of a snake you destroy quickly, since they are worth massive points.
Keep an eye on bots with different personalities, because their movement patterns can help you predict where to cut in.
faq: How do I destroy another snake?
You cut off other snakes so they crash and leave remains behind. Those remains are where you collect the points.
What does boosting cost me?
Boosting consumes mass, so your snake gets shorter while you speed up. Use it when the gain is worth the length you lose.

crashdown-voxel-destruction.intro: CrashDown is a voxel sandbox where you pick a location, grab tools from the arsenal, and bring down the structures around you. Destruction follows physics that aim to feel close to reality.
tips: Open the inventory with I before you start so you know which weapons you have, from the hammer to the bazooka, and which suits the building you want to take down.
Start with a light tool on a single wall or floor to see how the structure collapses, then pick heavier weapons for the parts that hold the most weight.
Use the map with M to plan a route between structures so you can move quickly from one target to the next.
Hold Left Shift to run between targets, and use Space to jump onto higher floors before you start hitting them.
Watch how falling debris lands before you fire again, since collapsing pieces can block your view or your path.
faq: What is the main goal of CrashDown?
The game is a sandbox with no set objective, so your goal is simply to destroy the structures in each location. You can destroy almost anything you see.
Which controls do I need to know first?
Use WASD to move, the mouse to look around, and the left mouse button to shoot or throw. Space jumps, Left Shift runs, and Esc pauses the game.

run-fish-run.intro: Run Fish Run is an endless underwater runner. You guide a punky fish hero through lively scenes, dodging obstacles, timing jumps, and collecting power-ups as the challenges grow.
tips: Watch the obstacles a moment before they reach you so you can react in time rather than at the last second.
Pay attention to the rhythm of the jumps and try to settle into a steady timing pattern.
Grab power-ups when they are safe to reach, since they are there to help you stay alive.
Expect the challenges to get harder over time, so practice staying calm and focused as the pace picks up.
Plan your moves ahead instead of reacting only to what is directly in front of your fish.
faq: What is the main goal in Run Fish Run?
Keep your fish swimming through the endless underwater world by dodging obstacles and staying safe for as long as you can.
How do I get past the obstacles?
Use quick reflexes and good jump timing to avoid them, and pick up power-ups to help you stay safe.

fortress-clash.intro: Fortress Clash is a strategy tower defense game where you build a fort on a cart, pick an army, and send your units to destroy the enemy king. Coins fund your builds and upgrades.
tips: Spend your early coins on blocks that protect your king and the units you plan to rely on, rather than spreading them thin across the cart.
Before pressing Battle, look at how your archers and units will reach the enemy fort, and place your blocks so they are not blocked from firing.
After each win, choose your bonus reward with your next battle in mind, such as a weapon that suits how you want to break the enemy walls.
Use the Upgrade screen to level up the units you use most instead of buying a new weapon you will not place on the cart.
Plan your win around the enemy king: you can knock him off his cart, bury him in rubble, or blast through his walls, so pick the approach your fort can manage.
faq: What is the goal of Fortress Clash?
You win by destroying the enemy king. You can knock him off his cart, bury him in rubble, or blast through his walls.
How do I build my fort?
Pick a block or unit from the bottom tray, then tap the grid to place it on your cart. Each block costs coins.

draw-bridge-puzzle-brain-game.intro: Draw Bridge Puzzle is a physics-style puzzle where you draw a path so a stranded car can cross obstacles and reach its destination. Each attempt is a single drawn line that the car then follows.
tips: Study the whole level before you draw, looking at where the car starts, where it needs to end up, and what stands in the way.
Start your line at the car's position and plan the shape in one smooth drag, since the car runs as soon as you lift your finger.
Make the path high enough to clear obstacles but not so steep that the car cannot keep its footing on the way up.
If the car fails, watch exactly where it stops or falls, then change only the part of the drawing that caused the problem.
Keep your drawings simple and avoid extra loops, which can add weight or distance to the route without helping the car.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Your goal is to draw paths that let the car safely get through the obstacles and reach its destination.
How do I draw a path?
Touch the screen, hold and drag across to form the shape you want, then release your finger so the car starts running.

jungle-bricks-breaker.intro: Jungle Bricks Breaker is a brick-breaking arcade game set in a lush jungle. You smash bricks across vibrant levels by bouncing the ball off your paddle, testing precision and speed.
tips: Watch where the ball is heading before you move the paddle, so you can react early instead of chasing it.
Aim your paddle to change the ball's angle on each bounce, since where it hits the paddle shapes where it goes next.
Plan your shots around the bricks that are hardest to reach, such as those tucked into corners or at the edges.
Stay steady rather than making big, rushed movements, because precise small adjustments usually keep the ball in play longer.
Pay attention to how each level changes, and adjust your paddle habits when new challenges appear.
faq: What is the main goal of Jungle Bricks Breaker?
Your goal is to smash through the bricks in each vibrant level by keeping the ball in play with your paddle.
How can I keep the ball from falling past my paddle?
Track the ball's path early and position the paddle ahead of where it will land, rather than reacting at the last moment.

tile-sort-color-columns.intro: Tile Sort: Color Columns is a logic puzzle where you move colorful tiles between columns until each column holds a single color. There is no timer and no way to lose, so you can plan each move at your own pace.
tips: Before you choose a column, check which tile sits at the bottom of each one. That tile becomes your next move, so pick a column that leads to a useful follow-up.
Think about where each tile will end up before you place it. Putting a tile on top of a column that doesn't match its color can bury other tiles you need later.
If you can't see a solution, try a different sequence of moves rather than repeating the same idea. Stepping back to test another order often reveals a path.
Plan several moves ahead on harder levels, since the tile you take from the bottom decides what you do next. Trace the chain of moves in your head before committing.
Take your time and use the lack of a timer to your advantage. Pausing to study the board is a normal part of solving these puzzles.
faq: How do I win a level?
You win by moving tiles between columns until every column contains tiles of just one color.
What does the tile at the bottom of the screen mean?
It is the tile you need to place next. Choosing a column adds it to the top of that column.

make-a-dress.intro: Make A Dress is a relaxed sewing game where you meet clients, build their dresses step by step, and deliver them to earn stars and gifts. Each dress moves through measuring, cutting, sewing and decorating.
tips: Take your time with the measurements and silhouette choice first, since every later step builds on them.
Pick a fabric that suits the client's chosen style before you start cutting, so the finished dress matches what they asked for.
Lay out the patterns neatly and check them before cutting, because a rough cut can be hard to hide later.
Keep your sewing steady and finish each seam before moving on, so the dress looks clean when you add decorations.
Save bows, flowers and gems for the end and use them lightly, so the finished dress looks balanced and polished.
faq: What is the main goal of Make A Dress?
Your goal is to create a dress for each client by working through every sewing step and then deliver it to earn stars and gifts.
How do I control the game?
Use a mouse or touch. Tap or click to choose a silhouette and fabric, and drag fabrics, decorations and tools onto the dress or sewing area.

combat-zombie-warfare.intro: Combat Zombie Warfare is a multiplayer shooter where you fight zombies, soldiers, and real players. Pick your weapon and map, then work through the campaign levels.
tips: Choose your weapon before you start a map, since the game lets you pick one and you will fight a mix of zombies, soldiers, and other players.
Use SHIFT to run between areas and WASD to keep moving, so you are not standing still when enemies approach.
Use SPACE to jump when you need to change position quickly, but keep your aim steady with the mouse so your shots still land.
Check the menu with TAB when you want to review your options, then return to the action quickly.
Switch guns when a target calls for a different approach, and try the other weapons you have to see which one suits your playstyle.
faq: What is the goal of Combat Zombie Warfare?
Your goal is to finish all the levels of the campaign by shooting enemy zombies, soldiers, and real players.
How do I aim and shoot?
Use the mouse to aim, look around, and shoot. Move with WASD and keep your aim on the target while you move.

real-cod-strike.intro: Real COD Strike is a first-person modern-warfare shooter built around close-quarters firefights, objectives, and squad-based missions. You move with WASD, shoot with the left mouse button, and sprint with Shift.
tips: Move with short bursts instead of running in straight lines, since the game rewards quick reactions when enemies appear from close range.
Use the Shift run and jump controls to reposition between cover points rather than standing still in open areas.
The instructions list the left mouse button for both shooting and zooming, so test which one zooms your weapon before you need it in a firefight.
Before each mission, check your weapon and gear customization, and pick loadouts that suit close-quarters fights if you expect enemies nearby.
Think about the mission goal first, whether it is clearing a base, holding a point, or escaping an ambush, and plan your route around that objective.
faq: What is the main goal of Real COD Strike?
You complete missions such as clearing enemy bases, defending strategic points, and surviving ambushes behind enemy lines. Each mission also asks you to secure objectives.
Which controls do I need to know?

Use WASD to move, the left mouse button to shoot, Shift to run, and the space bar to jump. The instructions also list the left mouse button for zooming, so check which action it performs in your session.

police-car-chase-prison-escape-game.intro: Police Car Chase Prison Escape Game puts you in a police officer's seat to chase criminals, stop prison escapees and complete action-packed missions in 3D.
tips: Use Space to brake before sharp turns so you keep control of the car and stay on the chase.
Save Shift boost for straight stretches where you have room to speed up, rather than using it while cornering.
Press Q for the siren when you are close to a suspect, so you can use it as a signal while you pursue.
Check the controls list with I before a mission so you know which key does what when things get busy.
If you get stuck on a mission, try the Pause key P to reset your thinking and plan your route before continuing.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
