You play as a police officer who chases dangerous criminals, stops prison escapees and completes police missions to protect the city.
What are the main desktop controls?
Use W, A, S and D to move, Space to brake, Shift to boost, F for action and Q for the siren. Press P to pause and I to view the controls.

survev-io.intro: Survev.io Battle Royale is a multiplayer shooter where you fight to be the last character standing on a shrinking island. You start with only your fists and must find weapons and supplies while staying in the safe zone.
tips: Stay inside the safe zone at all times, since the shrinking island will eventually pull you out of position if you linger outside it.
Use the number keys 1 through 4 or the scroll wheel to switch weapons quickly, so you are never stuck with a gun you cannot use at close range.
Press Q to swap back to your previous weapon after a quick switch, which helps when you need to change tools mid-fight.
Reload with R during a lull in combat rather than in the middle of a firefight, so you are not caught with an empty gun.
Pick a mode that suits your style: solo means you rely only on yourself, while duo or squad lets you cover each other and share the fight against up to 50 opponents.
faq: What is the goal of Survev.io?
The goal is to be the last character standing on a shrinking island. You must scavenge for weapons and supplies while staying inside the safe zone.
How do I move and aim?
Use W, A, S and D to move and the mouse to aim. Left-click shoots, and you can use Melee to fight up close.

3d-dots.intro: 3D Dots is a connect-the-dots puzzle set in three-dimensional space. Link the numbered dots with the right lines, and each number tells you how many lines must meet at that dot.
tips: Before drawing a line, check how many connections each dot still needs, since the number is a firm requirement rather than a suggestion.
Rotate the camera often, because some dots sit behind others and a link that looks correct from one angle may be wrong from another.
Zoom in on crowded areas so you can tap the right dot without linking to a neighbour by mistake.
When a line turns red, remove it and reconsider the dots it joined rather than guessing a replacement at random.
Keep the Hint button for when you are truly stuck, and first look for dots that are already green to see what the finished area should look like.
faq: How do I know when a dot is finished?
A dot turns green once the number of lines connected to it matches the number shown inside. Keep working until every dot is green.
What should I do with a red line?
A red line is a wrong connection. Tap it to remove it, then try a different pair of dots.

cavern-run-endless-runner-game.intro: Cavern Run is a side-scrolling endless runner where you race through dark caverns, dodge obstacles, and collect power-ups to stay alive. It rewards quick reactions and steady planning.
tips: Look ahead of your character rather than only at the obstacle right in front of you, so you have time to react to what comes next.
Save power-ups for tough stretches where obstacles are close together, instead of using them as soon as you find them.
Keep your reactions calm and even. Panicking after one mistake often leads to a second one.
Pay attention to how the challenges change over a run, and adjust your approach as the cavern shifts.
Treat early runs as practice for learning how the obstacles appear and how much space you need to get past them.
faq: What is the goal of Cavern Run?
You run through the side-scrolling caverns while evading obstacles and seizing power-ups to survive as long as you can.
What controls does Cavern Run use?
The game's instructions do not list specific controls, so check the on-screen prompts when you start playing.

crazy-motorcycle.intro: Crazy Motorcycle is a racing game where you ride motorcycles through the sky. Use the keyboard or the on-screen touch controls to steer and jump your way through the race.
tips: Learn the jump on Space early, since timing it well is the main skill you need to keep up your speed.
Use small, steady movements with WASD or the arrow keys instead of holding a direction too long, so you stay in control of your bike.
If you play on mobile, get comfortable with the joystick first, then practice the jump button separately so you do not press them in the wrong order.
Watch where you are heading before each jump rather than reacting at the last moment, which helps you keep a straighter line.
Beginners should focus on finishing each race cleanly before chasing speed, and experienced racers can push for faster jumps once the controls feel automatic.
faq: What is the goal of Crazy Motorcycle?
The goal is to race your motorcycle through the sky and get ahead of the competition. The game rewards quick, controlled riding.
What are the controls on desktop?
Use WASD or the arrow keys to move your motorcycle, and press Space to jump. These are the only desktop controls listed for the game.

bus-crash-stunts-2.intro: Bus Crash Stunts 2 is a bus driving and destruction game with races, long jumps and crash stunts across different buses and maps. Drive with WASD and use nitro for speed boosts and bigger jumps.
tips: Use the B key to check behind you before a risky turn or jump so you know where other traffic and obstacles are.
Save nitro for straight stretches and jump takeoffs rather than tight corners, where a burst of speed is more likely to throw you off course.
Switch the camera with C to find the view that helps you judge your landing angle before a long jump.
Try out a few different buses and maps early, since each one handles differently and may suit certain stunts better.
Spend your earnings on new vehicles only after you know which bus fits your style, so your money goes toward something you will actually use.
faq: What is the goal of Bus Crash Stunts 2?
The game focuses on driving your bus through races, long jumps and crashes while performing stunts. You can also earn money and use it to unlock more vehicles.
Which keys control the bus?
Drive with W, A, S and D, use F for nitro, press C to change the camera and hold B to view behind your bus.

burger-bay.intro: Burger Bay is an idle burger shop on the beach. You cook, stack, and serve burgers, spend cash on stations and helpers, and grow your boardwalk while sea-creature bosses bring big orders.
tips: Keep walking between the grill and the counter so food is always moving, since you cook, carry, and serve yourself.
Spend your first cash on the stations or upgrades that speed up cooking, because faster output earns more while you are away.
Hire helpers once your stations are running steadily so you can keep up with customers without stopping to cook everything yourself.
Watch for the sea-monster boss appearing, and clear your path to the right stations before its timer starts, so you can serve its mega order in time.
Use the T key to toss the top item when your stack is off, and press P to pause if you need a moment to plan your next upgrade.
faq: What is the main goal of Burger Bay?
Cook and serve burgers to collect cash, then use that cash to unlock new stations, hire helpers, and grow your boardwalk along the coast to new beaches.
How do I beat a sea-monster boss?
Serve the boss's mega order before its countdown runs out. Bosses can be a Kraken, a giant crab, or a whale, and a successful serve gives a huge payout.

tumble-boat.intro: Tumble Boat is a puzzle game where you remove blocks from under a boat so it can land safely on the ground. Keep the tower balanced, because if the boat falls, the game ends.
tips: Before you remove anything, look at the whole tower and find which blocks carry the most weight. Leave those for later and start with pieces that seem to support less.
Make small, deliberate drags rather than rushing. Watching how the tower shifts after each removal helps you spot trouble before it tips.
Pause to plan the next two or three moves, not just the next one. A block that looks safe now may become the one that drops the boat later.
Each new level brings a different layout, so do not copy a solution from an earlier stage. Study the shape of each new tower first.
If the tower starts to lean, stop removing blocks from that side and work on the other side to rebalance it.
faq: What is the goal of Tumble Boat?
Your goal is to remove blocks one by one until the boat lands safely on the ground. The boat starts on top of a stack of blocks.
How do I remove a block?
On desktop, click and drag to remove a block. On mobile, tap and drag to remove a block.

asmr-pet-treatment.intro: ASMR Pet Treatment is a relaxing game about caring for puppies and kittens. You wash, heal, and dress your furry friends while calming sounds play.
tips: Play with headphones on so you can hear the calming sounds clearly, since the audio is a big part of the experience.
Take your time with each pet instead of rushing, because the game is built around slow, soothing moments.
Try both puppies and kittens to see which feels more relaxing to you.
Cover all three parts of care, washing, healing, and dressing, so each pet gets the full experience.
Keep the session short and calm if you want a quick break, or stay longer if you enjoy the gentle pace.
faq: What is the goal of ASMR Pet Treatment?
The game is about nurturing puppies and kittens through washing, healing, and dressing them in cute outfits. The description focuses on relaxation rather than a set target.
Which pets can I take care of?
You can care for puppies and kittens. Each one can be washed, healed, and dressed up.

idle-island-build-and-survive.intro: Idle Island is a building and survival game where you start on a deserted island with nothing. You gather resources, craft tools, and build up a haven from bare land.
tips: Gather resources steadily before you commit to building, so you have materials ready when you need them.
Craft tools early, since the description ties survival and progress to the tools you make.
Plan your builds in order, starting with what keeps you alive and then expanding your haven.
Treat each challenge as a chance to adjust your plan rather than a setback, as the game's focus is on turning obstacles into opportunities.
Check your progress regularly so you can see which resources or structures are holding you back.
faq: What is the main goal in Idle Island: Build And Survive?
You survive on a deserted island by harvesting resources, crafting tools, and constructing your haven. Over time, the barren land becomes a bustling home base.
How do I play Idle Island: Build And Survive?

The game's instructions do not list specific controls, so learn the basics by watching the on-screen prompts and experimenting with gathering and crafting. Focus on resource collection and building as your core loop.

mr-orange-flappy-jump.intro: Mr. Orange Flappy Jump is an arcade game where you guide Mr. Orange through a colorful world by tapping to fly. The challenge is timing each flap to dodge obstacles and keep soaring.
tips: Tap in short, steady bursts rather than holding your finger down, since each flap gives you a small lift and gravity pulls you back down.
Watch the gap ahead of you before you tap, and plan your next flap while Mr. Orange is still rising from the last one.
Aim for the middle of each gap so you have room to correct a late or early tap.
Try to find a steady rhythm and keep the same tapping pace through the run, which makes the timing easier to repeat.
Stay calm after a mistake and restart right away, because short practice runs are the quickest way to learn the timing.
faq: What is the goal of Mr. Orange Flappy Jump?
The goal is to guide Mr. Orange through the world by tapping to fly while dodging obstacles. Keep flying as long as you can while you learn the timing.
How do I control Mr. Orange?
You control Mr. Orange by tapping to make him fly. Each tap gives him a boost upward, and the rest of the time he falls.

catrobot-idle-td-battle-cat.intro: CatRobot Idle TD Battle Cat is a tower defense game where you protect your tower from waves of magical enemies. You aim and shoot arrows, upgrade your tower and cats, and build a robot to hold off the attackers.
tips: Shoot early and often, since enemies that get close to your tower are much harder to stop. Keep your aim steady and fire at the front of each group.
Spend upgrades on the defenses that have been doing the most work so far, rather than spreading them thinly across everything.
Watch how each wave moves and where it enters, so you can line up your shots before the enemies reach the tower.
Save your progress-related upgrades and new items for the harder levels, where new villains and bosses appear.
Build up your warrior cats and robot steadily between waves, because a stronger defense makes the later levels far more manageable.
faq: How do I aim and shoot in this game?
On PC, move the mouse to aim and left click to shoot the arrows. On mobile and tablet, tap the screen and move to aim, then release to shoot.
What is the main goal of each level?
You must eliminate the multiple enemies that arrive in each level before they reach your tower. Improving your tower helps you do this as the waves get stronger.

shoes-outlet-game.intro: Shoes Outlet Game is a relaxed idle clicker where you grow a shoe store from a mini outlet into a mega one. You manage a mall, hire staff, and make every coin count.
tips: Keep tapping early on to build your first coins, since the game rewards steady clicking as the base of your progress.
Expand from smaller outlets when you can afford it, so your growth keeps pace with your coin income.
Hire staff for the chores that slow you down, such as displaying goods, cleaning fitting rooms, and helping customers check out.
Check your team now and then and balance their work, so no single task falls behind while your outlets grow.
Look for chances to turn problems into opportunities, and spend coins on the choices that help your mall earn the most over time.
faq: What is the main goal of Shoes Outlet Game?
The goal is to grow your shoe outlets from mini to mega by tapping, hiring staff, and making strategic decisions to build a successful mall.
How do I control the game?
Use your mouse to click any button, including the taps that build your business and the buttons used to hire staff and make decisions.

tracoria-draw-color-and-match.intro: Tracoria is a relaxing drawing puzzle where you recreate a reference image on a canvas. You match colors, shapes, and strokes, then check your accuracy to earn stars and unlock new worlds.
tips: Study the reference image before you start drawing, and note the main shapes and where the color changes happen.
Block in large areas with the Bucket Fill first, then go back with the Brush for outlines and small details.
Use the Eyedropper to sample colors from the reference instead of guessing, since close shades can lower your accuracy.
Switch brush sizes often: a large brush for broad areas and a small one for fine lines and edges.
On mobile, tap the Mini-Preview in the top-left to enlarge the reference whenever you need a closer look at details.
faq: What is the goal of Tracoria?
The goal is to recreate the reference image on your canvas as accurately as possible in terms of colors, shapes, and strokes. Higher accuracy earns more stars.
How do I see how well I did?
Click the Check Answer button after you finish drawing. It shows your accuracy score.

escaping-arrows.intro: Escaping Arrows is a minimalist logic puzzle where you clear a tangled field of arrows one by one. Each click sends an arrow flying, so the order you choose decides whether you finish cleanly.
tips: Before clicking anything, trace where each arrow points and check whether its path is clear of other arrows.
Start with arrows that have open space in front of them, since removing them can free up the ones stuck behind.
Work out a sequence of several moves before you commit, because a single blocked path costs one of your three lives.
Look for the arrows that are blocking the most others and consider clearing those routes early.
Take a short break after a hard level, especially the special fifth-level challenges, to come back with a fresh look at the field.
faq: What is the goal of Escaping Arrows?
Your goal is to remove all the arrows on the field one by one. Each level is solved by finding the correct sequence of moves.
What happens if I click an arrow whose path is blocked?
If another arrow blocks the path, you lose one of your three lives. Losing all three ends your attempt.

obby-dumb-or-genius-iq-test.intro: Obby: Dumb or Genius IQ Test is a obstacle-course game where you earn IQ points through mini-games, duels, and challenges. Climb the status ranks and aim for the leaderboard.
tips: Pick up the IQ scattered across the map as you move, since it adds up steadily and is the core way to level up.
Try the mini-games when you can. Winning them gives extra IQ boosts, which can speed up your progress more than collecting alone.
Use the wheel of fortune when it is available, but treat its rewards as random. Don't rely on it as your main source of IQ.
Save your trophies for the pets you want, and check which pets you can get before you spend them on anything else.
Before a PvP duel, take a moment to get comfortable with the controls. Smooth movement and timely jumps matter most when you are under pressure.
faq: How do I move and jump?
On a computer, use the arrow keys or WASD to move and press space to jump. On touch controls, use the left joystick to move and the right button to jump.
How do I interact with objects?
Left-click the object, or move your character into the highlighted circle. On touch controls, tap the object or step into the circle.

retro-speed.intro: Retro Speed is a racing game set in a nostalgic world. Your car speeds up with each coin you collect, so you weave through traffic, pass opponents, and climb the rankings as the pace rises.
tips: Grab coins when you can do so safely, since each one makes your car faster and speed is what drives the race.
Keep your eyes on the traffic ahead so you can start weaving early instead of reacting at the last moment.
Treat the rising speed as the main challenge: as the car gets quicker, give yourself more room to steer around obstacles.
Watch where opponents are heading and look for gaps to pass them rather than forcing your way through crowded lanes.
Stay calm after a mistake and focus on the next stretch of road, because steady reflexes matter more as the pace escalates.
faq: What is the goal of Retro Speed?
Race through the nostalgic world, rise in the rankings, and keep your car moving as the pace escalates.
How does collecting coins affect the race?
Each coin you collect makes your car grow faster, so picking up coins helps you build speed over the course of a run.

truck-factory-for-kids.intro: Truck Factory For Kids is a colorful educational game for young children. It centers on cars and trucks and building-style play, and it is controlled entirely with taps or clicks.
tips: Take your time with each screen and look at all the colorful parts before tapping, since the game is built around learning about trucks.
Tap slowly and deliberately so you can see what each action does before moving on to the next one.
Try the cleaning, collecting, and design parts in your own order to see which trucks you enjoy building the most.
Ask a grown-up or friend to name the trucks and parts with you as you play, which helps the learning stick.
If something does not work the first time, try tapping or clicking again in a different spot on the screen.
faq: How do I control the game?
Everything is done by tapping or clicking. There are no other controls mentioned, so use a single tap or click for each action.
What is the goal of Truck Factory For Kids?
The game is about learning and building with trucks and cars. Follow what each screen asks you to do, and enjoy seeing the trucks come together.

idle-supermarket-tycoon.intro: Idle Supermarket Tycoon is a clicker simulation where you grow a shopping mall by opening shops, upgrading them, and serving customers. Profits and reputation build up over time as you expand your mall.
tips: Reinvest your early profits into new shops and shop interiors, since a bigger mall brings in more customers to serve.
Check your reputation points regularly and distribute them among visitors, as this helps your mall keep growing.
Assign priority customers to each shop so that the shops you have most often serve the customers worth the most to you.
Buy delivery vehicles once you can afford them, because each completed trip adds extra income on top of your regular sales.
Keep an eye on the corridors and watch for clogged trash cans or vending machines, since neglecting them can slow your mall down.
faq: What is the main goal of Idle Supermarket Tycoon?

Your goal is to develop a shopping mall into a large retail empire by acquiring shops, upgrading them, and improving the mall's interior and exterior. Serving customers and growing your reputation are central to that.
How do I earn money in the game?
You earn money by serving customers in your shops and by completing trips with delivery vehicles you purchase. Reinvesting those profits into the mall lets you earn more over time.

fruit-merge-juice-jumble.intro: Fruit Merge: Juice Jumble is a fruit-dropping puzzle where you combine matching fruits to build bigger ones and score as high as you can before the box fills up.
tips: Place larger fruits close to each other so that a matching fruit dropped nearby can set off a chain of merges.
Before you release a fruit, look at where its match already sits in the box and aim for that spot.
Save the side-shift buttons for when they matter, since you only have five shifts per side.
Keep an open area in the middle of the box so that new fruits have room to land and merge rather than stacking up.
Check the fruits near the top of the box often, because the game ends as soon as the box is full.
faq: How do I drop a fruit?
Click and drag the fruit to where you want it, then release it so it falls into the box.
How do fruits combine?
When two of the same fruit touch, they merge into a larger fruit, and you score points for it.

birdy-trip.intro: Birdy Trip is a one-touch arcade flyer about migrating to sunny lands. Collect your bird friends along the way, avoid the dangers, and watch out for eagles.
tips: Learn the rhythm of the one-touch control in a few short runs before you aim for distance, since small timing changes make a big difference.
Pay attention to where the dangers appear and plan your next move early rather than reacting at the last second.
Treat eagles as the main threat and keep your bird clear of their path whenever you spot one.
Try to pick up friends and other birds when it is safe, since catching more birds is part of the journey.
Check your missions before each run and play with them in mind, so each flight has a clear goal.
faq: How do I control my bird?
Use the mouse or touch screen. The game uses one-touch control, so a single click or tap is all you need.
What should I watch out for?
Many dangers can smash your bird during the trip, and eagles are the threat to watch most closely.

wall-kickers.intro: Wall Kickers is a running action game where you control an angry Hulk-style friend and smash every wall in your path. Your mouse controls your speed as you race through more than 50 levels.
tips: Use the mouse to build speed early, since a faster run makes it easier to get through each wall in your way.
Keep an eye on the walls ahead so you can adjust your speed before you reach them rather than reacting at the last second.
Try to keep a steady rhythm with the mouse instead of making sudden, jerky movements, which can cost you control of your pace.
If a level feels hard, replay it to learn how the walls are placed and when to speed up.
Take short breaks between levels so you stay focused, since the game has more than 50 levels to work through.
faq: What is the goal of Wall Kickers?
Your goal is to run and smash every wall in your way. The game encourages you to complete more than 50 levels and become the Smash God.
How do I control my character?
Use the mouse to speed up. The game's instructions only mention this one control, so focus on how you move the mouse to pace your run.

russian-drift-overtaking-in-the-city.intro: Russian Drift: Overtaking in the City is a 3D street racing game where you drift through city traffic and pass rival cars. Steer with the keys or on-screen buttons and work your way past the competition.
tips: Brake gently before a corner rather than mid-turn, so the car keeps its grip and you can enter the drift cleanly.
Use short, steady steering inputs with A and D instead of holding them down, which helps you control how far the car slides.
Pick your overtaking moments on straights and open stretches, where you can pass a rival without risking a crash on a tight bend.
Ease off the gas for a moment when the car starts to spin out, then reapply it once the car is pointing where you want to go.
On a phone, keep your thumbs on the on-screen buttons that match gas, turn and brake so you can react quickly without losing track of the road.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
The goal is to overtake rival cars in city street races and outperform the competition while drifting through the streets.
Which keys control the car?
Press W to accelerate, A and D to turn left and right, and S to brake. On a mobile phone, use the buttons on the screen instead.

drive-zone.intro: Drive Zone is a 3D driving game set across city streets, rally tracks, and off-road terrain. Use the keys to steer, accelerate, brake, and change your camera view as you race.
tips: Ease off the accelerator before sharp turns, then accelerate out of the corner. Carrying too much speed into a bend is the quickest way to lose control.
Learn how each surface handles differently. City streets, rally tracks, and off-road terrain all need different speeds and steering inputs.
Tap steering in short bursts instead of holding it down. Smaller corrections keep the car stable, especially on loose or uneven ground.
Press C to switch camera views and pick the one that shows the road ahead most clearly. A better view helps you spot turns earlier.
Use Esc to pause when you need a moment to reset your focus. Coming back to the wheel with a clear head helps you avoid mistakes.
faq: How do I steer and accelerate?
Use W to accelerate, S to brake or reverse, A to turn left, and D to turn right. On mobile, use the on-screen controls instead.
Can I change the camera view?
Yes. Press C to switch between camera views while you drive.

ninja-clash-heroes.intro: Ninja Clash Heroes is a multiplayer shooter set in an oriental garden. You lead a squad of heroes and defend the Fortune Cat from enemies trying to steal it.
tips: Pick the class whose style suits you, whether that is the stealthy ninja Scout, the armored samurai, the monk or the sniper Geisha, and stick with it long enough to learn its strengths.
Keep an eye on the Fortune Cat so you can respond quickly when enemies move in to steal it.
Collect stars whenever you can, since they open crates with weapons and boosters that can change how you fight.
Use crouch with C and jump with SPACE to change your position, and move with WASD rather than standing still in one spot.
Hold RMB to aim before you take a shot, and press TAB now and then to check the score table and see how your squad is doing.
faq: What is the main goal in Ninja Clash Heroes?
Your squad must protect the Fortune Cat, because enemies are trying to steal it.
How do I get new weapons and boosters?
Collect stars to open crates, which contain weapons and boosters.

epic-mine.intro: Epic Mine is an adventure about digging deep underground to rescue trapped friends. You manage resources, move quickly, and use explosives carefully as you go deeper.
tips: Plan each trip before you dig. Decide what you need to collect and sell so you do not waste time on material you cannot use.
Smelt and sell your treasures at sensible moments rather than carrying everything down with you. Keeping a clear view of your resources helps you avoid running low when it matters.
Spend upgrades on the skills that help you dig and explore faster. Better skills make deeper trips safer and more productive.
Use dynamite with care. Think about where the blast will reach before you light it, since explosive surprises are waiting in the depths.
Move through the shadows slowly enough to spot hidden secrets and dangers ahead. Quick reflexes are most useful when you already know what is coming.
faq: What is the main goal in Epic Mine?
You dig toward the Earth's core to rescue your bearded buddies from disaster. Each trip deeper brings you closer to them.
How do I earn money in Epic Mine?
You earn money by smelting the treasures you find and selling them. Choosing what to sell and when is part of the strategy.

monster-truck-offroad-2.intro: Monster Truck Offroad 2 is a 3D racing game where you drive monster trucks over steep mountain trails and rocky paths. You pick a truck in the garage and race to checkpoints before the timer runs out.
tips: Ease off the accelerator on steep slopes so the truck keeps its grip instead of spinning its wheels.
Check the terrain ahead before committing to a rocky section and pick the line that keeps the truck most stable.
Keep an eye on damage as well as the clock, since a damaged truck can cost you a clean finish.
Use the handbrake sparingly to pivot through tight turns, then accelerate out smoothly to keep your speed.
Watch the checkpoint route early so you can plan your timing and avoid wasting seconds on detours.
faq: What is the main goal in Monster Truck Offroad 2?
Drive your monster truck across off-road mountain stages and reach the checkpoints before time runs out. A clean finish is also part of the aim.
Which controls do I use to drive?
Use W or Up Arrow to accelerate and S or Down Arrow to brake or reverse. A and D or the Left and Right Arrows steer, and Space is the handbrake.

tralala-test.intro: Tralala Test is a trivia game with 20 questions about internet culture and meme knowledge. Expect quirky characters, odd answer choices, and plenty of nonsense humor.
tips: Read every answer option before you pick one, since the silliest-looking choice is sometimes the one that fits the meme.
Go with your first instinct when you recognize a reference, and save extra thought for questions you don't know.
Look for the answer that matches the joke's tone, because the game leans on absurd humor more than strict facts.
Stay relaxed and avoid overthinking, since the game is built around chaotic, playful choices.
Pay attention to the character in each question, as the quirky details often hint at the right direction.
faq: How many questions are in Tralala Test?
The game has 20 questions to answer. Each one tests your knowledge of memes and internet culture.
Do I need to know a lot about memes to play?
Familiarity with internet culture helps, but reading the options closely and trusting the joke's logic can get you through questions you don't recognize.

obby-maker.intro: Obby Maker is an editor for building your own obby and parkour levels, then sharing them so other players can try to beat them. You can also play levels made by others.
tips: Start with a simple parkour course before adding logic or events, so you learn how the platforms and objects behave first.
Test your level after each change you make, rather than building everything and testing at the end. This makes it easier to spot which change caused a problem.
Open the "?" help section in the editor when you are unsure how an object or setting works. It is the quickest way to learn the logic and event options.
Use the Remix button on a level you enjoy and change one part of it, such as the obstacles or the moving platforms. Studying how someone else built it is a good way to pick up techniques.
Before you publish, play through your own course from start to finish and check that it is possible to finish it. Other players will get stuck if a jump or path is not reachable.
faq: What is the goal of Obby Maker?
The goal is to build your own obby and parkour levels with obstacles, platforms, and custom rules, then publish them for other players to beat. You can also play levels that other players have made.
What can I customize in the editor?

You can customize objects, obstacles, and platforms, set how elements behave, program in-game events, and invent your own rules and challenges. The help section behind the "?" button explains these options.

stick-boy-bazooka-ragdoll.intro: Stick Boy: Bazooka Ragdoll is a stickman shooter where you aim bazookas to destroy enemies and bases. Physics and explosions make each level feel like a puzzle.
tips: Aim with a steady hold before releasing, since the shot is only made when you let go. Take a moment to check the angle first.
Pay attention to which weapon and bullet type you pick, because each one has unique bullets that behave differently. Match the choice to the target in front of you.
Watch for hostages before you fire, since destroying them can end your run. Plan shots so explosions stay clear of them.
Keep your Stick out of the line of enemy fire and away from level hazards, because either one can destroy it. Position first, then shoot.
Use the physics to your advantage, since explosions and ragdoll movement can knock over structures and enemies. Look for shots that cause a chain reaction.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You need to destroy all the enemies in the level to win. Bases can be destroyed along the way as part of the fight.
How do I aim and fire?
Hold your finger on the screen, or press and hold the left mouse button, to take aim. Release to fire the shot.

torture-the-trollface.intro: Torture the Trollface is a cartoon action game where you use a range of tools and weapons on a trollface dummy. You can work slowly or finish it quickly, and you collect coins to unlock more weapons.
tips: Collect coins as you go, since they are how you unlock the other weapons in the game.
Try the different tools early, such as knives, machine guns, the shotgun, spikes, bombs and traps, to see which ones you like best before you spend coins on unlocks.
Decide whether you want a slow or a quick session before you start, and pick your tools to match that pace.
Switch between weapon types rather than using only one, so you can see how each one affects the dummy.
Keep an eye on what each tool does to the trollface, so you can plan which ones to use in what order.
faq: What is the goal of Torture the Trollface?
The goal is to use the tools and weapons on the trollface dummy. You can torture it slowly or finish it quickly, depending on how you want to play.
How do I unlock new weapons?
You collect coins during play, and those coins are used to unlock all of the weapons in the game.

blockivo.intro: Blockivo is a block puzzle on an 8×8 board. Place the colorful shapes you are given, clear full rows and columns, and aim for a high score on the leaderboard.
tips: Before placing a shape, check which rows and columns it will complete, and pick the move that clears the most lines.
Keep the empty spaces connected instead of scattering single gaps, since larger open areas make it easier to fit the next shapes.
Look at all three shapes in the current set before you place the first one, so you can plan an order that works for all of them.
Avoid filling the middle of the board early. Keeping edges and corners open gives you more places to put awkward shapes.
Save Line Breaker for when the board is crowded and no good placement remains, rather than using it as soon as the board gets busy.
faq: What is the goal of Blockivo?
Place the shapes on the 8×8 board so that full rows or columns disappear, and try to score as many points as possible. The game ends when none of the available shapes can be placed.
How do I place a shape?
Drag one of the available shapes onto an empty space on the board. After all three shapes are placed, a new set appears.

math-battle.intro: Math Battle pits your dinosaur against rivals in duels. Solving math challenges powers up your beast, so accurate answers are the key to winning each clash.
tips: Take a moment to read each problem fully before you answer, since correct solutions are what keep your dinosaur strong.
Don't rush early rounds. Building steady accuracy at the start makes the later, harder challenges easier to handle.
If a problem looks tricky, work out the numbers step by step rather than guessing, because a single careless answer can cost you.
Pay attention to how the difficulty rises over time and notice which types of problems you find slowest, then practise those.
Keep a calm pace across the whole duel instead of bursts of speed followed by mistakes.
faq: What is the main goal of Math Battle?
Your goal is to power up your dinosaur by solving math challenges so it can win epic duels.
How do my answers affect my dinosaur?
Correct solutions keep your dinosaur mighty, so each answer you choose matters in the duel.

moon-chess.intro: Moon Chess is a cosmic strategy game where you face off against the Half Moon. Connect the lunar phases, from Crescent to Full Moon, to score points and outplay the shifting light and shadow.
tips: Think of the lunar cycle as a sequence. Look for moves that link one phase to the next, since connecting phases is how you score.
Before each move, check how the light and shadow have shifted. A move that looks strong now may leave you exposed to the next change.
Plan a few moves ahead rather than reacting only to the Half Moon's last move. Anticipating its response is central to outwitting it.
Watch for the moment a phase can be completed. Lining up connections in advance gives you more chances to score in a single turn.
Play slowly and review the board after each exchange. Small improvements in timing add up over a full game.
faq: What is the main goal in Moon Chess?
Your goal is to connect the phases of the lunar cycle, from Crescent to Full Moon, and score points while outwitting the Half Moon.
How do I score points?
You score by connecting the lunar phases. Focus on setting up connections that move the cycle forward toward the Full Moon.

hotfoot-baseball.intro: Hotfoot Baseball is a fast-paced baseball game built around one-tap controls. You pick a nation, time your swings, and run the bases in a race for the championship.
tips: Focus on timing, since the game says timing and strategy decide the result. Watch the pitch closely before you tap so your swing lands at the right moment.
Use one-tap controls with a steady rhythm rather than tapping rapidly. Quick, deliberate taps usually give you more control over each swing.
Think about each decision before acting, because every choice moves you closer to the championship. Avoid rushing into a risky move when a safer one is available.
Pay attention to when you break for bases. Committing too early or too late can cost you, so make the run when the situation clearly favors it.
Choose the nation you enjoy playing with and stick with it for a few games. Getting familiar with one team helps you learn the timing faster.
faq: What is the goal of Hotfoot Baseball?
The goal is to win the championship by making good swings and running the bases at the right times. Each decision you make moves you closer to that win.
How do the controls work?
The game uses simple one-tap controls, so you tap to swing and to break for bases. Focus on tapping at the right moment rather than trying to press many buttons.

impossible-jeep-driver.intro: Impossible Jeep Driver is a 3D off-road racing game where you steer a 4x4 jeep over rocky climbs and narrow mountain paths. Your job is to reach each finish line before the timer runs out.
tips: Ease off the throttle before steep rocky climbs so the jeep keeps traction instead of spinning its wheels.
Scout the route ahead and pick the line that keeps you off narrow edges, since the description highlights choosing your route as a key part of the challenge.
Use the handbrake (Space) sparingly to swing the back end around tight corners, and release it quickly to regain control.
Keep your speed steady rather than flooring it everywhere; a controlled pace usually saves more time than a crash-and-recover.
Tap steering inputs in short bursts on uneven ground so the jeep stays level across bumps.
faq: How do I accelerate and steer?
Press W or Up Arrow to accelerate and A or Left Arrow and D or Right Arrow to steer. On touch devices, use the on-screen driving controls instead.
What does the handbrake do?
Holding Space applies the handbrake, which helps you turn sharply on tight sections. Use it carefully so you don't lose control of the jeep.

moscow-metro-simulator.intro: Moscow Metro Simulator puts you in the driver's seat of a Moscow metro train on the Kalininskaya line. You can transport passengers, stop at stations, and walk around them on foot.
tips: Start in Training mode to learn how the speed controller works before you try a full run in Driver mode.
Move the controller between the X and T positions in small steps instead of jumping straight to the highest setting, so each change in speed is easier to manage.
Watch for the doors button to become usable only when you are within 3 meters of the rail at a station, so line up your stop before you try to open them.
Use the camera button and the walking controls to look around the platform and check the train from outside when you stop.
Turn on the informant recording when you want to hear the station announcements, since it is a helpful way to keep track of where you are on the line.
faq: How do I open the doors at a station?
Stop the train at a station so that you are no more than 3 meters from the rail, then press the doors button in the bottom right corner.
How do I get off the train and walk around?
When the train is stopped at a station within 3 meters of the rail, press the "Get off the train" button in the bottom left. Use WASD on desktop or the left joystick on mobile to walk.

war-machine.intro: War Machine puts you in command of a trebuchet, a siege weapon for breaking enemy fortifications. Aim at weak points, pick the right projectile, and clear the enemy from your lands.
tips: Before firing, study the structure and look for its weakest section, since a well-placed hit can bring down more than a hit on the strongest walls.
Try different projectile types on the same kind of target to learn which ones work best against walls, towers, and enemy units.
Use the in-game hints early on, as they are there to help you learn how to activate and aim the weapon.
Watch where each shot lands and adjust your next one, rather than repeating the same aim if it missed the weak point.
Pay attention to how fortifications collapse after a hit, because the damage from one shot can make the next target easier to break.
faq: What is the goal of War Machine?
You command a trebuchet to find and attack weak points of enemy fortifications and destroy the enemy forces to liberate your lands.
How do I fire the trebuchet?
Use the left mouse button on desktop, or the touchpad or touchscreen on touch devices, to activate the weapon.

brawl-simulator-3d.intro: Brawl Simulator 3D is a 3D action fighting game inspired by Brawl Stars. You move, aim, and shoot to destroy enemies, level up, and collect brawlers from boxes.
tips: Move and aim at the same time: on desktop, keep moving with WASD or the arrow keys and use the mouse to line up shots, so you are not standing still while you aim.
On mobile, use the right red joystick to aim before you fire. Release it only when your aim is set, because the shot happens when you let go.
Gain levels by destroying enemies, so stay active in fights rather than hiding. Levelling up is the main way to get stronger as you play.
Try different game modes to see which ones suit your style. Switching modes is a good way to learn how different situations play out.
Open regular boxes, trophy boxes, and Starr Drops as you earn them, and check each brawler's details to see which ones you want to collect.
faq: What is the goal of Brawl Simulator 3D?
You battle against enemies in 3D, destroy them, level up, and collect brawlers through boxes and Starr Drops. The game also offers avatars and skins for customisation.
How do I shoot on desktop?
Move your mouse to aim and press the left mouse button to shoot. Use WASD or the arrow keys to move your player.

kaiten-sushi.intro: Kaiten Sushi is an arcade game where you play a sushi chef. Slice and prepare seafood as it moves along a busy conveyor belt, keeping up with picky customers.
tips: Watch the whole conveyor belt before reacting, so you can plan which seafood to prepare next.
Focus on precision first. Rushing a cut can cost more time than a slightly slower, accurate one.
Keep your attention on the customers' requests so you know which items they want before the belt moves past them.
Stay calm when the pressure builds. Short, steady moves usually help you keep pace better than frantic ones.
Practice a few rounds to learn the rhythm of the belt, since speed becomes easier to manage once you know how quickly items arrive.
faq: What is the main goal in Kaiten Sushi?
You play as a sushi chef who slices and dices seafood on a moving conveyor belt. The aim is to prepare dishes accurately and keep customers satisfied.
What makes the game challenging?
The game combines speed with precision while the conveyor belt keeps moving. Picky customers add extra pressure, so you must stay alert and not miss a beat.

1-grass-cutting-become-stronger.intro: In this grass cutting game, you move through large fields, cut grass to build strength, sell loot for money, and buy better cutters. Reincarnating lets you restart with bonuses and clear the fields faster.
tips: Cut grass steadily in one area before moving on, so you can see how much strength and money each field gives you.
Sell collected loot regularly so you have money ready when a better cutter or stat upgrade becomes available.
Spend early earnings on upgrades that make your cutting faster, since clearing fields quickly is the main goal.
Keep an eye on your progress before reincarnating, and only reset once your current run has stopped growing well.
Use the jump button when obstacles block your path, and rotate the camera to check the area ahead before you move.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Your goal is to become as strong as possible and clear all the fields by cutting grass, collecting loot, and upgrading your stats.
How do I earn money?
You collect loot while cutting grass and then sell it to earn more money for new cutters and upgrades.

shooting-zombie-fps-xtreme-good-vs-bad-b.intro: A first-person shooter pitting you against soldier and zombie AI across several game modes. Play offline through 40 levels or team up with friends for multiplayer matches.
tips: Keep moving rather than standing still, since WASD movement lets you strafe out of enemy sight lines and avoid being an easy target.
Use SHIFT to run when you need to cover ground quickly, then slow down to aim before engaging enemies.
Try different guns with the change gun control and notice which ones suit your playstyle in close and long-range fights.
Use SPACE to jump when you need to clear obstacles or reposition, but avoid jumping blindly into groups of enemies.
If you are new to the offline levels, work through them in order to learn enemy behavior before trying the team-based multiplayer modes.
faq: What is the goal of Shooting Zombie fps Xtreme Good vs Bad Boys?
The game is a shooter where you fight against enemy AI, including soldiers and realistic zombies. Your aim is to shoot your way through the modes and levels.
What are the controls?
Use WASD to move, the mouse to aim, look around and shoot, SPACE to jump, SHIFT to run, and TAB to open the menu.

cats-block-puzzle.intro: Cats Block Puzzle is a shape-fitting puzzle where you drag cats onto a board and try to fill it perfectly. Each puzzle has its own shape, and the challenge grows as you progress.
tips: Look at the whole board before you place anything. Note which gaps are awkward or narrow, since those are the spots that are hardest to fill later.
Start with the cats that have the most distinctive shapes. Placing them early leaves you with more flexible pieces to fit the remaining space.
Work on one area of the board at a time, such as a corner or an edge. Filling small sections completely makes the rest of the puzzle easier to manage.
Check how many cats you have compared with the empty space on the board. Keeping an eye on this helps you spot a fit problem before you run out of options.
Take a moment to reset your thinking when you get stuck. Stepping back and looking at the shape of the remaining gap often reveals the cat that fits.
faq: What is the goal of Cats Block Puzzle?
The goal is to drag the cats onto the puzzle board so that all of them fit perfectly. Solving each puzzle lets you move on to the next level.
How do I place a cat on the board?
You drag a cat from its starting spot and drop it onto the puzzle board. Place it where its shape matches the open space.

baby-hazel-birthday-party.intro: Baby Hazel Birthday Party is a point-and-click game set at Hazel's third birthday. Your job is to keep her happy by fulfilling her playful wishes, with magic shows and a surprise twist along the way.
tips: Click on everything in each scene at least once, since surprises and clues can be hidden in places you might skip.
Pay attention to what Hazel reacts to, and focus on the things that clearly make her smile before trying random options.
Try the magic show and other party activities when they appear, because they tend to be the easiest way to lift her mood.
If Hazel's happiness drops, go back to an activity you have already tried and see whether it helps her recover.
Stay curious and experiment in a different order if you get stuck, since the surprise twist may depend on what you have done earlier.
faq: What is the goal of Baby Hazel Birthday Party?
The goal is to keep Baby Hazel happy during her third birthday party by fulfilling her whimsical desires. Interactive play and a surprise twist are part of the experience.
How do I play the game?
The game uses point-and-click controls. Click on objects, characters, and activities in the party scenes to interact with them and see how Hazel responds.

mahjong-street-cafe.intro: Mahjong Street Cafe combines tile-matching with match-3 style play. You pair free tiles to clear the board, plan your moves, and aim for chain reactions to build a high score.
tips: Before you pick a pair, check which tiles are open and which are covered, so you do not waste moves on tiles that cannot be matched yet.
Look for moves that free up several tiles at once, since opening the board early makes later pairs easier to find.
Save a clear pair for when the board gets crowded, so you always have a safe option if the layout tightens.
Watch for setups that could trigger a chain reaction, because those are the best way to push up your score.
If you get stuck, pause and scan the whole board for matching tiles you may have overlooked rather than rushing your next pick.
faq: What is the main goal of Mahjong Street Cafe?
The goal is to pair free tiles and clear the board. Good planning and chain reactions help you earn higher scores.
How can I get a higher score?
Look for chain reactions, where one clear sets off more matches. Planning a few moves ahead usually earns more than picking pairs at random.

bubble-shooter-pet-match-3.intro: Bubble Fight IO is an online multiplayer bubble shooter. Players take turns shooting down bubbles stacked in the center of the arena, and clearing more bubbles deals more damage to your opponent.
tips: Plan each shot before you take it, since you only get to shoot on your turn. Look for the move that clears the most bubbles at once.
Because more bubbles shot down means more damage, focus on clusters rather than single bubbles where you can.
Keep an eye on the center stack after every turn. Shifts in the pile can open up new targets for your next shot.
Pay attention to your opponent's turns too, so you know which bubbles are left and what they may be setting up.
Stay focused for the whole match, since every turn counts toward the damage you deal.
faq: How do I damage my opponent?
Take turns shooting bubbles down. The more bubbles you shoot down, the more damage you inflict on your opponent.
Who do I play against?
Bubble Fight IO is online multiplayer, so you compete against other players in the arena.

kinder-garden.intro: Kinder Garden puts you in charge of a kindergarten. You change diapers, feed the little ones, and put them to bed to create a warm, caring place for children to grow.
tips: Collect diapers before you start changing babies, so you are not walking back and forth between the diaper spot and the children.
Check which babies need a diaper change, a feeding, or a nap, and handle them in one trip when you can.
Pick up a bottle before heading to a baby who needs feeding, so you can feed them right away.
When putting a baby to bed, take them straight to the crib in one movement to keep the routine moving.
Plan your route with the joystick between the diapers, the babies, and the cribs to avoid wasted steps.
faq: What is my main goal in Kinder Garden?
You act as a kindergarten teacher by changing diapers, feeding the babies, and putting them to bed. The aim is to keep the kindergarten a warm and caring place for the children.
How do I move my teacher?
Use the joystick to move around the kindergarten. You use it to reach diapers, babies, bottles, and cribs.

knots-jam-thread-puzzle-3d.intro: Knots Jam is a 3D thread puzzle where you sort wool spools into groups of three. Each correct match fills part of an embroidered picture on the fabric canvas.
tips: Scan the whole board before you move anything, and look for threads that are already free or nearly free.
Look for sets of three matching threads and check which ones are buried under others before committing to a group.
Plan the order of your moves so that clearing one spool does not block another group you still need to reach.
Work steadily across the canvas rather than in one corner, so each finished match reveals more of the embroidered image.
If you get stuck, step back and reconsider which area of the fabric needs filling next, since the designated spots guide which groups you should aim for.
faq: What is the main goal of Knots Jam?
The goal is to sort the threads into groups of three and place them in the designated areas on the virtual fabric canvas. Doing this clears the board and completes the embroidered image.
How do I make progress in a level?
Focus on untangling threads that are blocking others and then match groups of three. Each correct placement brings the embroidery closer to completion.

monster-truck-dirt-rally.intro: Monster Truck Dirt Rally is an off-road racing game where you drive powerful monster trucks over rugged dirt tracks. Crush obstacles, pull off stunts, and compete in rally events.
tips: Ease off the throttle on steep or bumpy sections so the truck keeps its balance instead of flipping.
Use short taps rather than holding a key down when you need fine control on loose dirt.
Watch the terrain ahead and plan your line early, since the physics reward steady, controlled driving.
Try stunts on flat or open stretches first to learn how the truck responds before attempting them in a race.
Use the time between obstacles to adjust your speed, because hitting things at the wrong angle can slow you down.
faq: How do I drive the monster truck?
Use the W, A, S and D keys to drive. The game is controlled entirely from the keyboard.
What is the goal of the game?
Your aim is to race through the rally events on dirt tracks, crushing obstacles and performing stunts along the way.

doll-queen-designer.intro: Doll Queen Designer is a 3D dress-up runner where you guide a doll along a fashion runway. You dodge obstacles, collect outfits, and build looks to score at the finish line.
tips: Slow down your thinking and focus on timing, since the game rewards good timing more than raw speed.
Keep an eye on obstacles well ahead of your doll so you have time to react calmly.
Treat each outfit you pick up as a piece of the final look, and aim to combine pieces that work well together.
Use the relaxed pace to check what you have collected before you reach the finish line.
Plan your overall look early in the run so you know which outfits to prioritize.
faq: What is the main goal of Doll Queen Designer?
Guide your doll down the runway, dodge obstacles, collect fashionable outfits, and craft a look that scores well at the finish line.
Is speed the most important thing in this game?
No. The game puts timing ahead of speed, so careful, well-timed moves matter more than running fast.

red-and-blue-stickman-rope.intro: Help the brothers Red and Blue reach the key and the door together. Play with a friend in two-player mode, as you work through multiple challenges and move on to new levels.
tips: Agree on a plan with your partner before each level starts, such as who grabs the key and who heads for the door.
Use the double jump to correct your landing when you are close to an edge, instead of committing to a long jump.
Keep both brothers in view at all times, since you need both of them to reach the door.
Try the same challenge a few times and note where you lose your footing, then adjust your timing on the next attempt.
Take turns controlling the brothers if you are sharing a keyboard, so each of you learns the timing for both characters.
faq: How do I move the two characters?
The controls use WASD and the arrow keys, so each player can use a separate set of keys. Double jump is also available.
What is the goal of each level?
Get the key and then bring both brothers to the door to pass to the next level.

dino-hide-n-shoot.intro: Dino Hide N Shoot is a dinosaur-themed shooting game where you play a gunman who must keep moving to dodge attacks while collecting bullets. Use boxes for cover and pick your moment to fire.
tips: Keep moving most of the time, since the description says you need to constantly run to avoid dinosaur attacks.
Grab bullets whenever they are safe to reach so your firepower builds up before a dangerous stretch.
Duck behind a box when a dinosaur is about to attack, then step out to shoot when the threat passes.
Wait for a clear line of fire instead of shooting at every dinosaur you see, so each shot counts.
Scan ahead for where dinosaurs are heading and plan your route before you commit to a move.
faq: How do I control the gunman?
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps, so use a click or tap to make your moves and shots.
What should I focus on to survive longer?
Keep running to avoid attacks, and use boxes as cover whenever a dinosaur is about to strike.

red-stickman-vs-craftmans.intro: Red Stickman vs Craftmans is an action game where you fight blocky monsters in close-range duels across a pixelated world. Each win moves you closer to escape.
tips: Watch how each monster moves and attacks before committing to a full combo, since blocky beasts may follow patterns you can learn.
Treat every fight as a duel: keep track of your health and of the enemy's, and avoid trading hits when you are already low.
Use the early encounters to learn how the combat feels, then take on tougher opponents once your timing is steady.
Stay on the move rather than standing still, so you are not an easy target when several enemies come at once.
Keep your focus on the escape goal: each victory counts, so avoid wasting time on fights you do not need to take.
faq: What is the main goal of Red Stickman vs Craftmans?
You play as the Red Stickman and fight monsters one by one, with each victory bringing you closer to escaping the pixelated world.
How does combat work in this game?
Combat is hand-to-hand, so you need to time your attacks and defence against each monster in a one-on-one duel.

pop-it-plus.intro: POP it Plus is a clicker game built around a pop it fidget toy. You click the bumps to pop them, then match flying balls to the matching large balls at the bottom of the screen.
tips: Pop the bumps steadily from one side to the other so you do not miss any on the board.
Before you click, check which ball type is coming up so you know which large ball at the bottom to match it with.
Watch for balls that need to be picked up quickly, since missing them can cost points or reset pimples you already popped.
Focus on clearing the first level for points before you move on, because the later levels are harder.
Keep your eyes moving across the whole field, as the game is said to train reaction speed and eyesight.
faq: What is the goal of POP it Plus?
Click the pop it to collect points and get through the levels. Later levels add balls that you must pick up by clicking the matching large ball at the bottom of the field.
How do I control the game?
The game uses mouse touch control. Click the pimples on the pop it and click the large balls at the bottom to collect the matching balls.

robby-mini-games.intro: Robby Mini Games is an arcade collection with more than 20 mini-games, a lobby with soccer and a swing, and ways to earn coins and gifts. Try a few modes to learn the controls before you commit to one.
tips: Start in the lobby and try each activity once, such as soccer and the swing, so you learn how your character moves before harder games.
Press E to open the tutorial whenever a mini-game is new to you, since it explains that game's rules.
Use the mouse to look around before you jump, so you can see where you are going and what your rivals are doing.
Mix solo and rival mini-games so you can practice on your own and then test your skills against others.
Save your coins for accessories you like rather than spending them right away, so you can choose what suits your character.
faq: What is the goal of Robby Mini Games?
You play different mini-games, either by yourself or against rivals, to earn coins, collect game gifts, and unlock accessories for your character.
How do I move and jump?
Use W, A, S and D to move, press Space to jump, and move the mouse to change the camera view.

stairs-trivia.intro: Stairs Trivia is a multiplayer quiz game in 3D where you answer questions to climb higher. Build your stairs, race other players, and aim to be the last one standing at the top.
tips: Keep your mouse movements steady so your character stops exactly on a pile when you want to collect it.
Plan your route before you move. Look for piles that take you toward the peak rather than ones that lead you sideways.
Answer each question carefully, since correct answers are what let you climb. A rushed wrong answer can cost you more time than a slow right one.
Pay attention to the other players. Their progress shows how close they are to the peak, so decide whether to push forward or play it safer.
Keep your stairs in mind as you build. Collecting piles is how you construct your path upward, so stay focused on gathering them as you go.
faq: What is the goal of Stairs Trivia?
Your goal is to reach the peak and be the last player standing. You do this by correctly answering questions and building stairs to climb.
How do I control my character?
Use your mouse to move your character around the 3D stage.

air-wars.intro: Air Wars is a Second World War dogfight shooter where you pilot a plane through the skies to outmaneuver enemies. Your guns fire automatically, so your focus stays on flying well.
tips: Since your guns fire automatically, spend your attention on positioning so that enemies stay in front of your plane.
Keep an eye on your fuel and ammo, and plan routes that pass over pickups before either runs low.
Use precise, controlled turns rather than erratic movements, so you can keep an enemy in your line of fire.
When an enemy is closing in, try to break away early instead of waiting until you are cornered.
Practice short sessions to learn how your plane responds, since your reflexes are a major part of staying alive.
faq: What is the main goal in Air Wars?
Survive dogfights against enemy aircraft by outmaneuvering them while keeping your plane flying. Your skills and reflexes decide whether you succeed.
How do I keep my plane flying longer?
Collect fuel and ammo as you fly. Staying supplied is what keeps your flight going through longer fights.

castel-wars.intro: Castel Wars is a two-player retro pixel tower war game. Each player builds bricks, fires a catapult, and fights to defeat the opponent in their tower.
tips: Keep an eye on the sky for the mysterious hero with balloons, since he occasionally drops bonuses that can give you new weapons and bullets.
Use your bricks to block or trap the opponent, and build a way out when your own position starts to feel boxed in.
Aim the catapult from your tower when you want to deal more damage, rather than relying only on basic shots.
Save your sword for when you are stuck, because throwing it with the action button is your way to remove the opponent from a tough spot.
Learn your own key layout early, since Blue uses W, A, S, D and E while Red uses the arrow keys and P, so you can react quickly during the fight.
faq: How do I win Castel Wars?
You win by using your bricks to escape or trap the opponent, dealing damage with your catapult, and removing them with your sword when needed.
What are the controls for each player?
The blue player uses W, A, S, D and E. The red player uses the arrow keys and P.

squid-maze-challenge.intro: Squid Maze Challenge is a 3D adventure where you run through mystery mazes, looking for the Exit Key and then the finish door. Some glass panels break easily and others are very strong, so each step matters.
tips: Look around with the mouse before you move so you can plan a route through the maze instead of running blindly.
Move slowly near glass panels and watch how each one reacts before you commit your weight to it.
If a path looks like a dead end or leads to glass you are unsure about, back off and try another route rather than gambling.
Keep track of where you have already been so you do not waste time circling the same section while searching for the Exit Key.
Use jumps with the Space key when you need to clear gaps, and save them for moments when you are sure of your landing spot.
faq: What is the main goal of Squid Maze Challenge?
You need to find the Exit Key inside the maze and then reach the finish door. Choosing your steps and paths carefully is what keeps you from being eliminated.
How do I move and look around?
Use the WSQD keys to move and the mouse to look around. The Space key makes your character jump.

ragdoll-battle-royale-throw-down-the-ene.intro: Ragdoll Battle Royale is a 3D physics arena where ragdoll fighters push, throw and knock each other off the platform. Your goal is to be the last fighter left standing.
tips: Keep your distance from the edges, since that is where you are most likely to be thrown into the abyss.
Watch your opponents' positions constantly so you can see who is about to push you or who is close to the edge.
Use short, steady movements instead of rushing in, so you can react to collisions as they happen.
Look for chances to push enemies toward the edge when they are already off balance or near the boundary.
Check the online leaderboard after a round to compare your results and see where you can improve.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Push all the ragdoll opponents off the arena and be the last fighter standing.
How do I move my character?
On PC, hold the left mouse button and move the mouse. On mobile, use the virtual joystick by moving your finger across the screen.

smod-sandbox-in-backrooms.intro: SMod: Sandbox in Backrooms is a real-time action game where you shoot monsters that keep spawning in a Backrooms-style sandbox. Your aim is to destroy as many as you can and climb the leaderboard.
tips: Keep moving rather than standing still, since enemies keep spawning in real time and staying in one spot lets them close in around you.
Use the spacebar to jump or fly when you need to reposition quickly or get away from a crowd.
Check the quests and look for weapons in the level, since better weapons can make it easier to clear monsters faster.
Open the monster spawn panel only when you want to test or add enemies, because more monsters means more pressure on you.
Save your points as you go and watch how your score compares on the leaderboard, so you know how many more kills you need to move up.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Your task is to destroy as many monsters as possible and save your points to reach the top of the leaderboard.
How do I shoot and spawn monsters on PC?
Use the left mouse button to shoot, and press Tab to open the monster spawn panel where you can summon enemies.

light-it-rush.intro: Light It Rush is a stickman action game where you swing, jump, flip and slide from one neon shape to the next. Your goal is to light up the colors as you move through the dark world.
tips: Look ahead to the next neon shape before you commit to a move, so you can plan your landing instead of reacting late.
Mix swings, jumps, flips and slides rather than repeating one move, since different shapes may suit different actions.
Keep your timing steady between moves; rushing from shape to shape often leads to missed landings.
Treat each run as practice and pay attention to where you lost your rhythm, then adjust your approach on the next try.
Focus on keeping your stickman moving from one glowing color to the next, because building a steady chain is how you light up the world.
faq: How do I control my stickman?
Use a mouse click or tap to play. The game is built around swinging, jumping, flipping and sliding between neon shapes.
What is the main goal in Light It Rush?
Move your stickman from one neon color shape to another so that the colors glow and the dark world lights up.

lady-pool.intro: Lady Pool is a dress up game where you style a character in comic book inspired outfits. You mix bold colors, prints, hats and accessories to build looks ranging from party pajamas to superhero jumpsuits.
tips: Start with one base outfit, such as a jumpsuit or pajamas, and build the rest of the look around its main color so the result feels intentional.
Try pairing one bold print with a plain piece so the eye has somewhere to rest instead of competing details.
Use hats and accessories last to add personality, since they can change the feel of an outfit more than clothing alone.
Pick a theme before you start, such as a party look or a runway look, and make choices that fit it to keep your designs consistent.
Test a few combinations before settling on a final look, because unexpected color and print mixes are often the most fun to discover.
faq: How do I select items in Lady Pool?
Click with a computer mouse or tap on a touch screen to choose clothing, prints, and accessories. The controls are the same for every choice.
Is there a goal or score in Lady Pool?
The game is open-ended and focused on creativity rather than points. Your aim is to design a look you like and make your character a style icon.

round-rush-jam.intro: Round Rush Jam is a puzzle game where each colored piece slides only in the direction of its arrows. Clear every piece from the hexagonal board before your moves run out.
tips: Before tapping anything, look at which pieces are blocking others. A piece can only leave when its path is clear, so start with the ones that have open routes.
Work backward from the pieces that are stuck. Ask which piece is in the way and whether that blocker can leave first.
Count your remaining moves against the number of pieces left. If a move does not remove a piece or open a route, think twice before using it.
Save boosters for puzzles that stall. If you have tried a few orders without progress, a booster can help you get unstuck.
Pay attention to linked pieces and rotating paths, since they can change which routes are open. Check the board again after each move.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Remove every colored piece from the hexagonal board before the move counter reaches zero.
How do I move a piece?
Tap or left-click a colored piece, and it will travel along the direction shown by its white arrows.

my-ice-cream-shop.intro: My Ice Cream Shop is a strategy puzzle where you run an ice cream truck, serve customers, and build your shop's reputation. Planning ahead and managing your time are central to doing well.
tips: Watch the clock and decide early which orders to prioritize, since time management is a core part of the challenge.
Plan your moves before acting rather than reacting to each customer as they arrive.
Pay attention to what makes each treat unique, and use your creations to keep customers satisfied.
Keep customers happy throughout the round, because satisfied customers are tied to the rewards you earn.
Look for patterns across rounds so your planning improves as the challenges get harder.
faq: What is the main goal of My Ice Cream Shop?
The goal is to run your ice cream truck well by delighting customers with custom frozen treats and overcoming the challenges you face. Doing this boosts your shop's charm and earns rewards.
How do I earn rewards in this game?
Rewards come from keeping customers happy and serving their treats well. Focus on satisfying each customer rather than rushing through orders.

christmas-brain-teasers.intro: Christmas Brain Teasers is a holiday-themed brain game built around puzzles, including pattern spotting and riddles. It can be played alone or with family.
tips: Read each puzzle fully before acting, since patterns and riddles often hide the key detail in the wording.
When a pattern is unclear, look for what repeats or changes from one step to the next and test that idea.
If a riddle stalls you, say the clues out loud or write them down to see them more clearly.
Take a short break when you feel stuck, then return with fresh eyes instead of guessing repeatedly.
For family play, let each person try a puzzle first and share their reasoning, which often helps the group find the answer faster.
faq: What is the goal of Christmas Brain Teasers?
The goal is to solve the holiday-themed puzzles, which include spotting patterns and answering riddles. The game description does not list any other objectives.
Can I play Christmas Brain Teasers with other people?
Yes, the game is described as suitable for solo play or family play. Taking turns on puzzles is one way to enjoy it together.

agent-sniper-city.intro: Agent Sniper City puts you on rooftops as an elite sharpshooter. Your job is to find dangerous criminals across the city and eliminate them with precise shots.
tips: Hold the right mouse button to scope before you shoot so you can check your target clearly.
Use the scroll wheel to zoom out and scan the streets for threats, then zoom in to line up your shot.
Drag the mouse slowly when looking around. Fast swipes can make you lose track of where you were looking.
Keep scanning the city between targets so you spot new threats early instead of reacting late.
Take your time with the left mouse button. The game is built around precision, so a careful shot matters more than a quick one.
faq: What is my goal in Agent Sniper City?
You play as a sharpshooter on tall buildings and must eliminate dangerous criminals with precise shots while keeping watch over the city.
What are the controls?
Hold the right mouse button to scope, scroll the wheel to zoom in and out, drag the mouse to look around, and click the left mouse button to shoot.

parkour-world.intro: Parkour World is a 3D platform game inspired by Minecraft, where you run and jump across levels that get harder as you go. Use WASD to move, Shift to run, and Space to jump.
tips: Hold Shift while moving so you can cover ground quickly before a jump, but ease off before landings so you do not overshoot.
Look ahead to the next platform before you leave the current one, since judging the landing early helps you adjust your jump in time.
Use the first few levels to get a feel for your jump distance and timing, because the description says later obstacles become more demanding.
If you fall, try the same section again with a slower, more deliberate approach rather than rushing back in.
Press ESC to pause when you need a moment to plan the next jump, then resume when you are ready.
faq: What is the goal of Parkour World?
The goal is to move through each level by running and jumping across its obstacles. The levels become more challenging as you progress.
What do the controls do?
WASD moves your character, Shift makes you run, and Space makes you jump. ESC pauses or resumes the game, and E opens a chest.

geo-metric-run.intro: Geo-Metric Run is an action game about dashing through shifting geometric worlds and staying alive as the challenges grow. Quick reactions and careful timing matter more than anything else.
tips: Watch the pattern ahead before you commit to a jump, since the layouts are intricate and the next obstacle often shows its shape early.
Keep your timing steady rather than rushing. Precise jumps are easier to land when you wait for the right moment instead of reacting at the last second.
Plan your swift turns a little in advance so you are not forced into a sharp change of direction at the edge of an obstacle.
Expect the difficulty to climb. Use the early part of a run to learn how each world moves, then carry those habits into harder sections.
Stay calm after a mistake and restart with focus, because the game rewards steady concentration over quick, careless attempts.
faq: What is the goal of Geo-Metric Run?
The goal is to survive as you dash through geometric worlds, getting past intricate patterns and escalating challenges for as long as you can.
Which skills matter most in this game?
Rapid reflexes, precise jumps, swift turns and quick thinking are the main skills the game tests.

animals-battle.intro: Animals Battle is a strategy game where you lead an army of cute animal warriors. Build your forces, conquer islands, and destroy enemy bases to move through the levels.
tips: Watch your food supply before you summon. Your food builds up automatically, so decide which unit to summon based on what you can afford right now.
Destroying enemy bases is what completes a level, so push toward them rather than spending all your time on side fights.
Spend coins between battles on the upgrades that match how you fight, whether that means new units or base stats.
Enemies get stronger with each island you conquer, so do not rush ahead with a weak army. Level up your fighters before moving on.
Collect artifact cards whenever you can, since their permanent bonuses apply in every battle and build up over time.
faq: What is the main goal in Animals Battle?
Your goal is to conquer enemy bases, since destroying them is the key to completing each level. You do this by building an army of animal warriors and commanding them in battle.
Where does the food for my army come from?
Food for your creatures is produced automatically during combat. You use it to summon units into the battle.

hide-and-seek-friends.intro: Hide And Seek Friends! is a real-time multiplayer hide and seek game where you play either the hider or the seeker. Use the different hiding spots and your choice of role to outsmart the other players.
tips: Pick your role with the match in mind: hiders need to stay still and out of sight, while seekers need to scan the whole map carefully.
