As a hider, use the building materials like cars and office desks to make a shelter that blends into the surroundings instead of standing out.
Consider the setting before you settle in: water, the hay pile, the cornfield and the boss office each offer a different kind of cover, so choose one that matches how the seekers are moving.
As a seeker, check the less obvious spots and keep moving so hiders cannot predict where you will look next.
The game asks you to be kind, so when you push other players into the seeker's field of view, do it in a way that keeps the match fun for everyone.
faq: What is the main goal of Hide And Seek Friends!?
Hiders try to stay out of the seekers' sight, and seekers try to find the hiders. You can choose either role at the start.
How do hiders protect themselves?
Hiders can build shelters from cars or office desks and hide in places such as the water, the hay pile, the cornfield or the boss office.

baby-injection.intro: Baby Injection is a puzzle-adventure arcade game where you guide a baby's health journey. Your choices shape the baby's well-being, and each decision brings its own consequences.
tips: Think about how each choice might affect the baby's well-being before you commit to it, since the consequences carry forward.
When a puzzle stalls you, step back and look at what the game has already shown you, as the clues are often there from earlier moments.
Try different decisions on separate playthroughs to see how each path changes the outcome.
Keep track of which choices led to good and bad results so you can repeat the helpful ones and avoid the harmful ones.
Take your time with the intricate puzzles rather than rushing, because a careful look usually reveals the intended solution.
faq: What is the main goal of Baby Injection?
You guide a baby's health journey by making choices that affect its well-being while solving puzzles along the way. Each decision leads to different consequences.
How do my choices affect the game?
Every decision you make influences the baby's well-being and changes what happens next. Because each choice has unique consequences, different decisions can lead to very different results.

real-city-driving-2.intro: Real City Driving 2 is a 3D racing game where you pick a super car and drive it as fast as you can across a city. Use WASD to drive, Space to brake, and C to change the camera.
tips: Try a few different super cars from the selection to see which handling suits your driving style best.
Use Space to brake before sharp turns so you keep control and avoid losing speed on the exit.
Press C to switch camera views and pick the one that shows you the road ahead most clearly.
Ease off the accelerator on tight corners and build speed again on straighter stretches of road.
Practice the same route several times to learn where the turns and straights are, so you can drive faster each run.
faq: What is the goal of Real City Driving 2?
Select a super car and drive it as fast as you can across the city.
Which keys control the car?
Use WASD to drive, Space to brake, and C to change the camera view.

mech-battle-arena.intro: Mech Battle Arena is a real-time robot card duel. Build a deck of 8 robots, drop them onto the field, and destroy the enemy towers before yours fall.
tips: Tap a card before dragging it so you can check its energy cost first.
Keep an eye on your energy and avoid spending it all at once, since it refills over time and you may need it for a sudden threat.
Your robots attack the nearest enemy, so place them where they will meet enemy units before those units reach your towers.
Build your deck of 8 with a mix of robots so you can respond to different situations on the field.
Use the time between fights to upgrade the robots you use most often, and consider the reboot system when you want to start again with bonuses.
faq: How do I win a battle?
You win by destroying the enemy towers before your own towers fall. Your robots walk forward on their own and attack the nearest enemy.
How do I play a robot card?
Pick a robot card from the bottom panel and drag it onto your half of the field. You can drag with the mouse or with your finger.

flip-bird.intro: Flip Bird is an arcade flyer where you guide a bird through gaps between obstacles. Timing and precise taps decide how far you get and how many points you collect.
tips: Tap in small, steady bursts rather than holding in long presses, so you can adjust height as each gap approaches.
Look ahead to the next gap while you are still passing the current one, so your bird is already moving toward the right height.
Aim for the middle of each gap, which leaves the most room for small timing mistakes.
Practice the rhythm of your taps early in a run to build a consistent pattern before the obstacles speed up or get harder.
After a crash, pause for a moment and think about what caused it, such as tapping too early or too late, then adjust your next attempt.
faq: What is the main goal of Flip Bird?
Fly your bird through the gaps between obstacles without crashing, while collecting as many points as you can.
What skills matter most in Flip Bird?
Timing and precision matter most, along with quick reflexes and focus on the path ahead.

squid-sniper-game.intro: Squid Sniper Game is a 3D shooting game where you use a sniper to pick out players who are moving during a Red Light, Green Light round. Aim carefully, because firing at the wrong target costs you points and fails the mission.
tips: Watch for the arrows that highlight moving players, and check them before you fire. Taking a second to confirm your target is worth more than a fast shot.
Use the mouse wheel to zoom in when you need precision, and zoom back out to keep an eye on the wider area.
Right-click to zoom the sniper scope, then line up your shot with a slow, steady mouse movement before you left-click to fire.
Press L to lock or unlock the mouse, so you can keep the sniper steady while you scan the field.
Stay calm and focus on one target at a time. Rushing shots at players who are standing still is the fastest way to lose your score.
faq: How do I know which player to shoot?
Look for the players highlighted with arrows, since these are the ones moving. Shooting a player who is standing still lowers your score and fails the mission.
Which controls do I need to play?
Move the sniper with the mouse, right-click to zoom, left-click to fire, and use the mouse wheel to zoom in and out. Press L to lock or unlock the mouse.

rings-untie.intro: Rings Untie is a colorful ring puzzle game where you rotate circles with your finger to line up the gap with the center target. Each level has a time limit, so plan each move carefully.
tips: Before you touch the screen, check which ring type you are working with, since C lock rings turn easily while D rings only move within a limited range.
Save your flexible rings, such as S rings, for the trickier alignments, and use simpler rotations to set up the rest of the puzzle.
Watch the colors or patterns shown on the circle and confirm they match the center target before making the final move.
Keep an eye on the timer and avoid wrong moves, because a rotation in the wrong direction can cost you time you need later.
Take each level in order, since every successful match unlocks the next, harder puzzle, and the early levels help you learn how each ring behaves.
faq: What is the main goal of Rings Untie?
Rotate the rings by touching the screen so the gap lines up with the center target, and finish each match before the time runs out.
How do I control the rings?
Touch the screen and drag to rotate the circle. Use small, deliberate movements so you can line up the gap precisely.

popit-vs-spinner.intro: Popit vs Spinner is a puzzle game where you clear popits by making matches. When you run out of moves, spinner mode refreshes the board so you can keep going through its three levels.
tips: Before each move, look for every possible match on the board and compare them, so you don't waste a turn on a small clear when a bigger one is available.
Plan a few moves ahead by thinking about which popits will be left after each match, since the board only gets harder to clear as it empties.
Save spinner mode for when you truly have no useful moves left, rather than triggering it early, so you get the most out of the refresh.
After a spinner refresh, scan the new layout carefully for matches before making your first move.
Play each of the three levels at your own pace, and if you get stuck, try a different order of matches to see how the board responds.
faq: What is the goal of Popit vs Spinner?
The goal is to clear popits by creating matches on the board. Clearing them strategically helps you move through the game's three levels.
What should I do when I run out of moves?
Activate spinner mode to refresh the board. This gives you a new set of options so the adventure can continue.

wiggly-worm-snake-puzzle.intro: Wiggly Worm is a cozy snake puzzle set in underwater reefs. Guide your worm through handcrafted mazes to reach the heart, using apples, gates, rocks, buttons, and scissors.
tips: Plan your route before moving, since completing a level in fewer moves earns more stars.
Use Undo freely while you test ideas, because each level gives you 10 free undos.
Before you cut the worm with scissors, check which half needs to reach which gate or button, then use P to switch between the two worms.
Doors that open while a button is held need the worm to stay in place, so plan the other moves that depend on that button first.
If you get stuck, try a Hint before restarting, since you can watch a short video for 2 extra hints.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Guide the worm to the heart at the end of the level. Each level is a maze with its own obstacles to work through.
How do I earn three stars?
Finish the level in fewer moves to earn stars, with three stars as the top result. Undo and restarts are useful for testing, but keep your final route efficient.

grow-empire.intro: Grow Empire is a strategy game where you defend your city or attack enemy cities. You upgrade walls, towers and warriors, then release troops that fight automatically across Europe and Africa.
tips: Spend upgrades on the walls, towers and warriors you need most, since you can strengthen all three to hold off different kinds of attacks.
Release troops at the right moment, because they fight automatically and the timing of each wave can decide the outcome.
Use your abilities against the most dangerous enemies, such as elephants and siege guns, rather than saving them until the fortress is under pressure.
Watch whether you are defending your fortress or attacking, and adjust your troop releases to match the current task.
Conquer enemy cities when you can, since their chests give gems, gold, potions and maps that help you grow stronger.
faq: What is the main goal of Grow Empire?
Your task is either to defend your fortress or to attack, and you defeat enemies by clashing with their warriors. Conquering enemy cities helps you expand your empire.
How do I control my troops?
You release troops to attack or defend, and they fight automatically once released. Your main decisions are when and where to send them.

noob-rocket-punch.intro: Noob Rocket Punch is a boxing-style puzzle game where you draw the path of a punch to knock out monsters on each level. You get three chances per level, so plan each shot before you throw it.
tips: Before you start drawing, study where every monster is and which objects in the level could be used to knock them out.
Touch the fist and draw the trajectory slowly, checking the path against the monsters' positions before you release.
Treat your three chances as a limited resource and avoid rushing shots you have not planned.
Watch how the first attempt plays out, since it shows you how the punch and the level objects react, and adjust your next drawing.
Use the money you earn from completing levels to unlock new gloves and upgrade your fighting abilities as you progress.
faq: How do I aim a punch?
Touch your character's fist and draw the path you want the punch to follow. The punch travels along the line you drew to reach the monsters.
What happens if I run out of chances?
You have three possibilities on each level, so a failed level uses up your attempts. Plan carefully to avoid running out.

build-and-defend-your-base.intro: Build your own base block by block, then hold it against waves of zombies, skeletons, robots, pirates, aliens and demons. Each wave is harder than the last, so every block you place matters.
tips: Use the peaceful building phase to lay out your base before pressing Battle, since you cannot build the same way once enemies arrive.
Combine walls, turrets and traps rather than relying on one type, so enemies that get past one defense still meet another.
Keep your weapon ready during waves and fight near your defenses, because your attacks and your blocks work together.
Check the upgrade menu with U after each wave and spend coins and diamonds on the upgrades that help most against the enemies you face.
Reload with R during quiet moments so you are not caught with an empty weapon when a new group arrives.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Your goal is to keep your base block standing against enemy waves. Survive as many waves as you can to set a new record.
How do I start the enemy waves?
Build your base in peaceful mode first, then press the Battle button to start the waves.

slime-color.intro: Slime Color is a fast arcade game where you run through colorful levels, collecting paint spots to bring a grayscale world back to life while dodging obstacles.
tips: Watch the path ahead rather than the obstacle right in front of you, so you have time to react to what comes next.
Keep an eye out for paint spots as you run, since collecting them is the main way to add color to the world.
Practice the running rhythm in the early levels to get a feel for the speed before the stages get busier.
Treat each level as a fresh run and try to pick up as many paint spots as you can on the way through.
If you fall behind on paint spots, focus on staying safe first, because a single collision can cost you progress.
faq: What is the main goal in Slime Color?
Rush through each level, collect paint spots, and bring color back to the grayscale world while avoiding obstacles.
What should I focus on while playing?
Balance speed with awareness: move quickly through the level, but keep scanning ahead for obstacles and paint spots.

room-45.intro: Room 45 is a horror escape game where you explore a locked room, solve puzzles, and look for clues before time runs out. Nothing is explained up front, so careful observation matters most.
tips: Examine everything you can reach, since the description says every object might be a clue. Items that look like decoration can still be useful.
Keep track of what you have found and where, so you can connect a clue you picked up early with a lock or puzzle later.
Use E or the left mouse button to interact, and X to close whatever you have opened so you can return to the room view.
Watch the clock and avoid spending too long on one puzzle; moving on and coming back later can save time.
Use C to crouch when you need to look at low or hidden areas, such as beneath furniture, that you might miss while standing.
faq: What is the goal of Room 45?
Your goal is to escape the locked room by solving its puzzles and uncovering clues before time runs out.
What controls do I use?
Press E or click the left mouse button to interact, X to close, and C to crouch.

red-stickman-vs-monster-school-2.intro: Red Stickman vs Monster School 2 is a pixel action game with 60 levels, monstrous foes, and bosses like Herobrine. Your goal is to fight through each stage and escape the pixel dungeon.
tips: Think about which weapon fits each enemy before you fight, since your arsenal is what keeps you alive against different foes.
Pay attention to the terrain before you move, because perilous ground can cost you as much as the enemies do.
Collect lucky blocks when they are safe to reach, since they can give you the powerful weapons you need for tougher fights.
Watch how bosses attack for a few moments before committing, so you can time your moves and avoid unnecessary damage.
Treat each level as a chance to learn the layout and enemy patterns, which makes the later stages in the 60 levels easier to handle.
faq: What is the goal of Red Stickman vs Monster School 2?
You battle through 60 levels, defeat monstrous foes and bosses, and try to escape the pixel dungeon.
Who is the hardest enemy in the game?
The game features challenging bosses, including the infamous Herobrine, who is a major test of your weapons and timing.

counter-craft-2-zombies.intro: Counter Craft 2 Zombies is a pixel-style survival shooter where you face waves of undead in changing environments. Waves grow harder, so careful weapon choices and accurate aim matter.
tips: Pick your weapon based on the situation rather than sticking with one option, since the game emphasizes strategic weapon choices.
Aim for the head whenever you can. The description highlights precise headshots as a core part of survival combat.
Watch the early waves closely to learn how zombies approach, so you can plan your position before the next wave arrives.
Use the surroundings. The environments change, so look for cover and openings that let you control where enemies come from.
Stay alert and adjust your approach as each wave gets tougher, rather than repeating the same tactics that worked earlier.
faq: What is the main goal of Counter Craft 2 Zombies?
You survive increasingly difficult waves of zombies in a pixelated world by combining weapon choices with precise aim.
How important are headshots in this game?
Headshots are central to survival combat, so landing precise shots on zombie heads is one of the most useful skills to build.

crazy-driver.intro: Crazy Driver is a 3D voxel car game where you customize your car, smash through walls, collect rewards, and race through chaotic stages. Use the controls to steer, jump, and brake your way through each run.
tips: Use Brake before a tight turn or a wall, not in the middle of a jump. Slowing down early helps you keep control of the car.
Try jumping over obstacles when you can, since the controls include a dedicated jump button for getting past hazards.
Use the camera controls to look ahead before you commit to a turn, so you can spot walls and gaps sooner.
If you get stuck against a wall or obstacle, reverse out instead of pushing forward. Hitting the same spot again wastes time.
Spend your collected rewards on upgrades that suit how you like to play, whether you prefer smashing through walls or racing quickly.
faq: What is the goal of Crazy Driver?
The goal is to smash through massive walls, collect rewards, and race through chaotic stages to become a demolition driver. Each stage tests your driving and wall-breaking skills.
How do I steer and accelerate on desktop?
Use the arrow keys or W, A, S, and D. Up or W accelerates, down or S reverses, and left or right, or A and D, steer the car.

mad-joker.intro: Mad Joker is a 2D action adventure and platformer set in a city ruled by the cops. You fight through original levels with weapons, shooting, and a shield to help you survive.
tips: Use the shield with F on PC or the Shield key on mobile when enemy fire is heavy, then move out of the way once it is up.
Mix shooting and kicks on mobile, since the touch keys give you both attack and kick options.
Keep moving and jumping between shots so you are not a stationary target in the open.
Learn how each weapon feels in the early levels before you rely on it in harder fights.
On mobile, practise the virtual joystick and jump keys together so you can dodge and attack without stopping.
faq: How do I move and jump on PC?
Use the movement keys listed in the instructions for moving and jumping. The mouse is used to attack and shoot.
How do I use the shield?
On PC, press F to activate the shield. On mobile, tap the Shield touch key.

baolings-mystery-dumpling-unbox.intro: Baolings is a 3D mystery toy game where you open dumpling packages, reveal squishy friends, and fill themed display rooms. Each box you open adds to your collection.
tips: Follow the on-screen guides when you drag the wrapper, steamer lid and bag, since moving along the guide keeps each unboxing smooth.
Poke and squeeze each revealed dumpling before moving on, so you get a feel for every collectible in your collection.
Keep opening boxes to finish your collection, because that is how you unlock new themed rooms.
Try Squishy Pop, Squishy Drop and Dumpling Hunt when you want to earn coins and collect new friends alongside unboxing.
If you play Dumpling Hunt, you can use keyboard controls, which may be handy if you prefer them over the mouse or touch.
faq: How do I open a package?
Tap Open box, choose a package, then drag the wrapper, steamer lid and bag along the on-screen guides to reveal the dumpling inside.
How do I find rare characters?
Keep opening boxes to build your collection, since rare characters are among the friends you can reveal as you go.

commando.intro: Commando is a shooting game with 15 levels and several weapons. Your goal is to take out every enemy, using movement, cover, and grenades to stay in control.
tips: Use Tab to pause and look over the layout before you move in. A short pause can help you plan your route.
Hold right mouse button to aim before you fire when you have time, then use left mouse button to shoot. Steady aim matters more than rapid clicking.
Save your grenades for groups of enemies. Press G when several targets are close together so one throw can cover more ground.
Use Ctrl to crouch when you need a smaller target, and Space to jump when you need to move past an obstacle or reposition quickly.
Use Left Shift to run between cover points, then slow down to aim once you are in position. Moving constantly makes it harder to land shots.
faq: What is the goal of Commando?
Your goal is to kill everyone in each level. The game has 15 levels to work through.
How do I move and aim?
Move with WASD or the Arrow keys. Hold the right mouse button to aim and the left mouse button to fire.

wall-painter.intro: Wall Painter is a drawing puzzle where you guide a brush across structures and turn each surface into color. As levels get more complex, careful planning matters as much as speed.
tips: Study the whole structure before you start painting so you can see which surfaces are hard to reach.
Plan your route before each move, since a wrong step can leave a wall you cannot easily return to.
Work carefully near edges and corners, where precision matters most and mistakes are easiest to make.
Leave the trickiest surfaces for later only if you have checked that your path can still reach them.
When a level stalls, pause and think through the order of moves again rather than repeating the same attempt.
faq: What is the goal of Wall Painter?
You paint the surfaces of each structure with your brush until the walls are covered in color. The game asks you to repaint the world one wall at a time.
How do the levels get harder?
The description says levels grow more complex as you progress, which means larger or more intricate structures that need more foresight. Expect each new level to require more planning.

robbie-draw-your-sword.intro: Robbie: Draw your Sword is an arcade adventure where you gather swords, complete challenges, and level up. Movement and camera controls work on both desktop and smartphone.
tips: Learn the camera early by holding the right mouse button and moving the mouse on desktop, or sliding a finger on the right side of the screen on a phone. A clear view makes it easier to see where you are heading.
Use the jump on Spacebar to get past obstacles and reach higher spots, and check the camera before each jump so you know where you will land.
Practice swinging and drawing your sword with the left mouse button or a screen tap until the timing feels natural.
Gather swords as you explore, since collecting them is part of the core progress in the game.
Focus on completing challenges, because levelling up is tied to them and higher levels let you transform your character with new outfits, pets, and abilities.
faq: How do I swing and draw my sword?
On desktop, press the left mouse button. On a smartphone, click or tap anywhere on the screen.
How do I move and rotate the camera?
On desktop, use WASD to move and hold the right mouse button while moving the mouse to rotate the camera. On a smartphone, use the joystick on the left side and finger movements on the right side.

mini-tennis.intro: Mini Tennis is an arcade sports game where you return incoming tennis balls while dodging airborne bottles. One mistake ends the round, so steady focus matters as much as speed.
tips: Watch the ball's path from the moment it leaves the other side, so you can start moving before it gets close.
Keep your position near the centre of the court when nothing is coming, so you can reach either side quickly.
Since balls speed up the longer you last, try to stay calm and avoid rushing your early clicks or taps.
Keep an eye on the bottles as well as the balls, and move away from them early instead of reacting at the last second.
Aim for consistent returns rather than risky ones, since a single misstep ends the game and resets your run.
faq: How do I control my player in Mini Tennis?
You play with mouse clicks or taps, so use those inputs to hit each ball as it reaches you.
What makes the game harder as I play?
The longer you stay on the court, the faster the tennis balls come at you, so timing becomes more demanding over time.

geometry-neon-dash-world-2.intro: Geometry Neon Dash World 2 is a clicking arcade game where you jump, fly, and flip through dark caves and spiky obstacles. Collect stars, unlock new characters, and aim for the best score.
tips: Look ahead rather than at your character. Spotting the next spike or monster early gives you time to time your right click.
Click with a steady rhythm instead of tapping rapidly. Short, controlled presses are easier to time than frantic clicking.
Learn the new levels in small pieces. Replay a tricky section until you can predict where the obstacles appear.
Collect stars when your route allows it, since they help you unlock new characters. Never risk a run-ending hit just to grab one.
After a failed run, pause for a moment before restarting. Your next attempt usually goes better when you have a clear plan for the spot that stopped you.
faq: How do I jump in Geometry Neon Dash World 2?
Use the right mouse click to jump. Timing your clicks to the obstacles is the main skill in the game.
What is the goal of the game?
Move through the caves and obstacles, pick up stars, and make the best score you can. Stars also help you unlock new characters.

slide-the-blocks-build-the-pictures.intro: Slide the Blocks is a logic puzzle where you drag shapes into empty cells to assemble a complete picture. Plan your moves carefully, since blocks cannot pass through one another.
tips: Before moving anything, look at the finished picture and check which blocks sit in the wrong place. Start with the pieces that are closest to their target spot.
Blocks cannot pass through each other, so clear a path first. Move the blocks that are blocking others out of the way before trying to place a key piece.
Try to think a few moves ahead. Sometimes a move that looks helpful creates a jam that takes many steps to undo.
If you get stuck, step back and move a block in the opposite direction to free up space. Working backwards from the finished picture can reveal the right order.
Take breaks between levels. Fresh eyes often spot a sequence of moves that was hard to see after a long stretch of trial and error.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Move the shapes across the board until the whole picture is assembled. Completing the picture clears the level.
Why can't my block move through another one?
Shapes cannot pass through each other in this game. You need to move the blocking piece first to open a route.

nubik-in-the-monster-world.intro: Nubik is back to rescue the kittens from the evil Huggy, now armed with rifles, a grenade launcher, a machine gun, and shotguns. Use your weapons, loot, and radar to find the kittens.
tips: Check the radar often so you always know where the kittens and your route are before you push forward.
Open loot chests whenever you find them and spend what you gain on upgrades before tougher fights.
Try each weapon in a safe moment to learn its strengths, then pick the one that fits the situation ahead.
Keep an eye on TNT blocks before shooting near them, since they blow up and can change your path or hurt you.
Set mouse or swipe sensitivity from the main menu early so aiming feels comfortable from the start.
faq: What is the main goal of Nubik in the Monster World?
Find and rescue the kittens that the evil Huggy has kidnapped to claim the reward of one million coins. Along the way you can also help break Nubik's friend out of prison.
How do I shoot on a phone?
Tap the screen to shoot, or turn on the auto-shoot feature in the settings menu so Nubik fires automatically.

a-long-way-home.intro: A Long Way Home is a survival horror game where you play a lost wanderer trying to find the way back home. Explore an eerie, shifting world, avoid the creatures chasing you, and uncover its mystery.
tips: Use the mouse to look around before you step into a shadowy corridor, so you can see what is ahead and where you can go.
Search odd places and corners for hidden notes, since they expand the story and help you understand what is happening.
Keep a mental or written list of the hidden Foxes you have found so you know which areas still need a closer look.
Move steadily rather than rushing, because the creatures pursuing you are easier to lose when you stay aware of your surroundings.
Revisit earlier areas after you have explored more, since the landscape keeps changing and may reveal something new.
faq: What is the main goal of A Long Way Home?
You play as a lost wanderer trying to find your way back home while uncovering the truth behind your journey. Collecting all the hidden Foxes and finding hidden notes are also part of the experience.
How do I move and look around?
Use the Arrow keys or WASD to move your character. Use your mouse to control the camera and look around the world.

grow-a-garden-3d.intro: Grow a Garden 3D is a calm 3D clicker where you plant seeds, grow unique trees, and expand your garden over time. This guide covers the basics of planting, seasons, and growing a bigger garden.
tips: Plant a wide mix of the 25+ seeds, since each one grows into its own unique tree and you can see which kinds suit your garden.
Keep an eye on the season, because rain is described as helping plants grow faster, so it can be a good time to check on your planted trees.
Watch for Giant trees as you grow, since they have a rare chance to appear, so keep planting and let your trees mature rather than expecting them every time.
Use Tab to open your inventory before planting so you know which seeds you have ready to use.
Follow the in-game tutorial first, since it walks you through the controls and how to buy, sell, and collect items.
faq: What is the main goal of Grow a Garden 3D?
The aim is to plant seeds, grow trees, and watch your garden get bigger and better over time. Earning rewards as your garden grows is part of the progress.
How do I plant a seed on desktop?
Use the left mouse button to plant a seed. Move around with WASD and hold the right or left mouse button while rotating the mouse to look around.

snake-wiggle-master.intro: Snake Wiggle Master! is a snake maze puzzle where you guide your snake through tight corridors against the clock. Choosing the right order of moves is the key to clearing each level.
tips: Before you tap, look at the whole maze and trace a route to the exit. Some paths look safe but close off the rest of the level.
Think about the order of your moves, not just the next step. Going into a dead end early can block the path you need later.
Keep an eye on the timer, but don't rush your first decisions. Pausing briefly to plan usually saves more time than fast, careless taps.
Protect your hearts by avoiding moves you are not sure about. A single wrong move can block the maze completely, so caution pays off.
Once you clear a level, try to notice which early choices mattered. Those patterns will help you plan faster in the next maze.
faq: How do I control the snake?
You move the snake by tapping. Plan each tap so the snake follows a route that keeps the path open.
What makes a level hard?
Some routes look safe at first but can block the maze after one wrong move. The timer adds pressure, so careful planning matters.

car-chase.intro: Car Chase is a 2D racing game where you steer a car, collect points, and avoid police cars. The goal is simple: see how long you can survive on the road.
tips: Watch where police cars are heading before you move, and plan your route a few seconds ahead rather than reacting at the last moment.
Make small, steady joystick movements instead of sharp jerks, which makes it easier to slip between police cars.
Try to collect points while keeping an escape route open, since trapping yourself against the road edge or between cars ends the run quickly.
Don't chase points at any cost. A safe path that picks up a few points is usually better than a risky grab that puts you next to a police car.
Play several short runs to learn how the police cars move, then use that pattern to extend your survival time.
faq: What is the goal of Car Chase?
The goal is to steer your car, collect points, and avoid the police cars for as long as you can. Your score reflects how long you survive and the points you collect.
How do I control the car?
Move the joystick to steer. The game is controlled entirely by this single input.

construction-simulator-lite.intro: Construction Simulator Lite lets you operate excavators, cars, cranes and a robotic arm to finish building tasks. Each job involves digging, handling materials, or filling a foundation.
tips: Try each vehicle at least once so you know how the excavator, car, crane and robotic arm respond before a task depends on them.
Take small, deliberate clicks or taps when working the robotic arm, since the description highlights precise operation.
Before digging, check where the bucket or arm is positioned so you do not overshoot the spot you need.
When handling loads with the crane, move slowly and keep the load steady to avoid dropping or misplacing it.
When filling the foundation, work in steady passes and check how the area looks before moving on to the next section.
faq: How do you control the machines?
The game is played with a mouse click or by tapping the screen. Use single, controlled inputs to move each machine.
What kinds of tasks will I do?
The game includes digging, handling materials, and filling the foundation. These tasks are completed using the machines available to you.

bunny-boy-online.intro: Bunny Boy Online is a multiplayer game where you compete against players worldwide across different maps, weapons, and game modes. You can team up with friends or play solo.
tips: Learn the layout of each map before fighting, since knowing where to move and hide can help you outmaneuver opponents.
Try several weapons to see which ones suit your playstyle, and keep an eye on which ones you have compared to what opponents are using.
Pay attention to the game mode you are in, because the best approach in one mode may not work in another.
Stay on the move and avoid standing still in open spaces, since dodging is central to staying alive.
If you play with friends, agree on roles and coordinate your moves, which can give your team an edge over solo players.
faq: What is the main goal of Bunny Boy Online?
The goal is to dodge and outmaneuver opponents in multiplayer matches while climbing the leaderboards.
Can I play alone or with others?
You can go solo or team up with friends, depending on how you want to play.

snow-drifting-3d-champ-2024.intro: Snow Drifting 3D Champ 2024 is a 3D racing game where you drive a Japanese sports car across snowy hills and an asphalt track. You can practice drifting, change the paint color in the garage, and switch between camera views.
tips: Ease off the throttle before a corner and tap the handbrake with Spacebar to start a slide, then steer to hold it.
Use short handbrake taps rather than holding it down, so you keep control of the car instead of spinning out.
Try the asphalt track first to learn how the car responds, then move to the snowy hills where grip is lower and drifts are easier to start.
Switch camera angles with C to find the view that helps you judge the car's angle through a corner.
Hold E to look back when you need to check the car's position behind you before deciding how to steer out of a drift.
faq: How do I steer the car?
Use the Keyboard Arrow keys to drive, turning left and right and moving forward and back. Combine steering with the handbrake to start a drift.
What does the handbrake do?
Pressing Spacebar engages the handbrake, which helps the rear of the car slide out so you can drift through corners.

alien-wreckage.intro: Alien Wreckage is a fast-paced 2D shooter for one player. You explore abandoned alien wrecks, gather ancient artifacts, and fight through alien threats in a retro pixel-art world.
tips: Check the in-game controls before you start, since the game is played with its own control set and knowing it early helps you react fast.
Because the shooter moves in multiple directions, keep moving rather than standing still so you are harder to hit.
Balance exploration and combat. Pushing deep into a wreck can pay off with treasure, but it also raises your risk, so decide when a risk is worth it.
Pay attention to what is around you inside each wreck before you commit to a path, since the game rewards careful exploration as well as firing.
Play in short focused runs at first to learn how enemies approach, then take on bigger risks once your timing feels reliable.
faq: What is the main goal of Alien Wreckage?
You play as a lonely explorer trying to gather the most ancient artifacts in the universe by searching abandoned alien wrecks and facing the aliens you meet along the way.
What kind of game is Alien Wreckage?
It is a fast-paced 2D multidirectional shooter with a retro pixel-art style, where exploration, combat, and risk-taking are all part of the gameplay.

fruit-drop-3d.intro: Fruit Drop 3D is a physics puzzle where you drop fruits into a container and merge matching pairs into bigger ones. Plan each drop, watch the stack height, and aim for a higher score.
tips: Keep your largest fruits near the bottom of the container, where they can rest steadily and give smaller fruits room to merge above them.
Before each drop, look at which fruit you are holding and whether an identical one is already sitting where it could touch. Setting up matches early saves space.
Use the physics to your advantage: a fruit that rolls or slides into a matching fruit will still merge, so a drop does not have to land exactly on top of its partner.
Avoid stacking fruits in tall columns on one side. Spreading drops across the container keeps the pile low and reduces the risk of reaching the top.
Pause briefly after each drop to watch how the pile settles before choosing your next move. Rushing makes overflow more likely.
faq: How do I move and drop a fruit?
Move the fruit left and right with your mouse or finger, then click or tap to drop it into the container.
How do fruits merge?
When two identical fruits touch, they combine into a larger fruit and add points to your score.

city-car-stunt-4.intro: City Car Stunt 4 is a driving game set on a large Free Driving map. Collect diamonds, catch bonus boxes, and unlock new cars as you explore the city.
tips: Use the blue teleport points when you want to reach the hills faster, then plan your route from there.
Head to the tops of buildings if you want to collect the diamonds placed up high.
Save your Nitro for stretches where you need extra speed or a longer jump, rather than using it all at once.
Use Look Back when you are unsure what is behind you, so you can keep track of diamonds and bonus boxes without losing control.
Press R to restart the level if you get stuck or land somewhere you cannot get out of.
faq: What is the goal of City Car Stunt 4?
Collect diamonds and unlock new cars on the Free Driving map. You can also catch bonus boxes to see surprises.
How do I move my car in Player 1 mode?
Use the arrow keys to drive. Press N for Nitro and B to look back.

sheep-sort.intro: Sheep Sort is a color matching puzzle where you tap sheep and sort them by color. Clear each puzzle to unlock the next, and the levels get harder as you go.
tips: Scan the whole puzzle before you start tapping, so you can see which colors are most common and plan your sorting order.
Pay close attention to similar shades, since sheep that look almost alike are the easiest to match by mistake.
Work on one color group at a time instead of jumping between colors, which keeps your sorting organized.
Save your boosts for the tougher puzzles, where they are most useful for sorting faster and getting past a hard spot.
Take a short pause when a puzzle feels stuck, then look again with fresh eyes to spot the next move.
faq: How do I win a puzzle in Sheep Sort?
You win each puzzle by sorting and matching the sheep correctly by color. Completing a puzzle level unlocks the next one.
What are boosts used for?
Boosts help you sort sheep faster and solve tougher puzzles. Use them when a level becomes difficult.

target-gun-game-fps-shooting.intro: Target Gun Game is a 3D first-person shooter about hitting targets accurately. Each shot counts, so the game rewards patience and careful aim over rapid firing.
tips: Slow down before you shoot. Since every bullet matters, a steady, deliberate shot usually does more for your score than a quick one that misses.
Pay attention to which target you are aiming at before you fire. Setting up a clean shot first helps you avoid wasted bullets.
Try the different challenges instead of repeating just one. Each one can build a different part of your aim and strategy.
Unlock and test different guns to see how each one handles. Note which feels most accurate for you and use it when precision matters most.
Aim for high scores by thinking ahead about your next target while you work through the current one. Planning your order keeps your shots efficient.
faq: What is the main goal of Target Gun Game?
The goal is to eliminate targets and reach high scores by focusing on precision and strategy. Each shot counts toward your result.
How do I get better at this game?
Focus on accuracy first and speed second. Taking time to line up each shot will usually lead to better scores than firing quickly.

basketball-master-2.intro: Basketball Master 2 is a point-and-shoot basketball game where you test your aim and strategy. You take precision shots and bank shots while working around obstacles and defenders.
tips: Study the obstacles and the defenders' positions before you shoot, so you know which path to the hoop is clear.
When a direct line to the basket is blocked, try a bank shot off the backboard instead of forcing a straight throw.
Take a moment to line up each shot. Precision matters more than speed in this game.
Pay attention to how each defender moves, and time your shots for the moments when they are out of the way.
Practice bank shots early on, since they can open up angles that a straight shot cannot reach.
faq: What is the main goal of Basketball Master 2?
Your goal is to score baskets by mastering precision shots and bank shots while overcoming obstacles and dynamic defenders.
What skills does the game test?
The game tests your aim and your strategy, so you need to plan each shot as well as line it up accurately.

merge-rockets-obby.intro: Merge Rockets: Obby is a 3D puzzle-strategy game inspired by 2048. You merge matching rockets into stronger ones and launch them at rival bases in a multiplayer city battle.
tips: Merge identical rockets whenever you can, since a higher-level rocket does more damage when launched at an opponent.
Plan your merges before you attack so you always have a strong rocket ready when a good target appears.
Watch opponents' bases and time your attacks for moments when their defenses look weak.
Keep your shield in mind during rival attacks and activate it at the right moment to block incoming rockets, then strike back while they are exposed.
Use the damage you deal to earn in-game currency, and spend it on upgrades to make later battles easier.
faq: What is the main goal of Merge Rockets: Obby?
Merge matching rockets into stronger ones, launch them at other players' bases, and destroy buildings and ships to win battles.
How do I move my character and jump?
On a computer, use WASD to move and Space to jump. On mobile devices, use the joystick to move.

ninja-hero-cats.intro: Ninja Hero Cats has you lead a squad of agile cat fighters through a magical realm full of demons. Maneuver carefully, dodge projectiles, and strike back to push through enemy territory.
tips: Keep your cats moving rather than standing still, since dodging projectiles is central to surviving the realm.
Watch the incoming projectiles and plan your movement a step ahead instead of reacting only at the last moment.
Collect fish whenever it is safe, because they unlock the upgrades that make your squad stronger.
Pick your attacks with care and look for openings between enemy waves so your strikes land when the squad is in position.
Keep an eye out for the mystical portals, since dashing through one is how you escape enemy territory.
faq: What is the main goal of Ninja Hero Cats?
Lead your squad of hero cats through the demon-filled realm and dash through mystical portals to escape enemy territory.
How do I get stronger during a run?
Gather fish to unlock powerful upgrades for your cats.

truck-cross-country-game.intro: Truck Cross Country is a 3D truck driving game about racing across the map. Drive through every checkpoint, reach the finish line, and collect coins to unlock new truck skins.
tips: Look ahead to the next checkpoint before you reach the current one so you can keep your speed and line up your turns.
Stay on the route that leads to the checkpoints, since heading off course costs time you need to reach the finish line.
Grab coins when they sit close to your path, because they add up to unlock skins in the store.
Keep your truck moving steadily rather than braking hard on every turn, so you cover the course faster.
Play a few runs to learn the layout, then focus on shaving seconds off the sections where you lose the most time.
faq: What is the goal of Truck Cross Country?
Move your truck, cross all the checkpoints, and reach the finish line to complete the challenge.
What are the coins used for?
Coins can be spent in the store to unlock more skins for your truck.

mega-fall-ragdoll-simulator.intro: Mega Fall Ragdoll Simulator is a relaxed physics game where you launch a ragdoll doll off tall buildings and across levels to break as many bones as you can. Click to throw, then use your coins to upgrade and unlock new levels.
tips: Watch how the ragdoll moves after each throw before your next attempt, since the physics respond to where it lands and how it tumbles.
Spend coins on power and fly upgrades first if you want the doll to travel farther, which can open up more of each level.
Try different throw timings and positions to see which setups cause the most damage on a given building.
Look for obstacles in each level and think about how they might change the doll's path, then plan a throw around them.
Put money bonus upgrades early so you earn coins faster and can unlock new levels and skins sooner.
faq: What is the main goal of Mega Fall Ragdoll Simulator?
The goal is to break as many bones as possible on your ragdoll by throwing it off tall buildings and across levels. Breaking more bones and earning coins helps you open new levels.
How do I control the ragdoll?
Click on the screen to throw the ragdoll. Each click sends it into the level, and the physics decide how it falls and tumbles.

demolition-car-rope-and-hook.intro: Demolition Car: Rope and Hook is a physics-based action game where you use a hook and rope to wrap buildings and then pull them down with your car. Aim to bring down whole structures for more points.
tips: Before you pull, move the hook around the building so the rope wraps the main supports, since that is where the structure is most likely to fall.
Check how the rope is wrapped before you press the gas, and adjust the hook if it only catches a small part of the building.
Try a short, controlled pull first to see how the building reacts, then apply more force if it is still standing.
Use the points you earn to upgrade your winch when you can, because a stronger winch helps with bigger structures.
Think about how much force you need so you can bring down the whole building in one go, which the goal of earning more points rewards.
faq: How do I control the hook?
On a phone, move your finger across the screen. On a PC, hold the left mouse button and move the mouse.
What is the main goal of the game?
Destroy abandoned buildings by wrapping them with the hook and rope, then pressing the gas to demolish them.

bridal-race-3d.intro: Bridal Race 3D is a hypercasual runner where you rush down a high runway, collect bridal elements, and build up your outfit. Your controls are a simple slide to move.
tips: Keep your eyes on the path ahead rather than on your character, so you can line up with bridal elements early.
Use small, steady slides instead of large sweeps, which can carry you past items or into obstacles.
Prioritise collecting bridal elements along the way, since building your outfit's look is part of the goal.
Watch your rivals' positions as you go and adjust your lane to overtake them when you have a clear gap.
Stay relaxed and play in short rounds, since the game is light and easy to pick up again.
faq: What is the goal of Bridal Race 3D?
Rush down the high runway, collect as many bridal elements as you can to improve your outfit, and overtake your rivals. The description also mentions meeting a handsome partner along the way.
How do I move my character?
Slide to move. The game's instructions only mention sliding, so use it to steer left and right along the runway.

classic-car-parking-2025.intro: Classic Car Parking 2025 is a precision parking game where you drive vintage cars through tight spaces, narrow lanes, and obstacles. Each level is cleared by parking without crashing. Drive with WASD.
tips: Go slowly when you enter a tight space. Small speed changes make it easier to correct your line before you hit something.
Before you move, look at where the car's corners and back end will sweep, not just the front. Vintage cars can be hard to judge at the edges.
Make a wide, gentle turn to line up with the space early, rather than cutting in sharply at the last moment.
If you get too close to an obstacle, back off and reposition instead of pushing forward. Parking without crashes is the goal, so a slow correction is better than a risky one.
Use short, controlled inputs with WASD and pause to check your position between them. Constant holding of a key often overshoots the spot.
faq: What is the goal of Classic Car Parking 2025?
You complete each parking mission by parking your vintage car in the target space without crashing. Precision matters more than speed.
How do I control the car?
Use the W, A, S, and D keys to drive the car. The game's instructions list only these keys.

juicy-run.intro: Juicy Run is a fast dash through a colorful world where you use shadow powers to slice fruit. Precision and timing help you dodge obstacles and go further.
tips: Watch the path ahead rather than the fruit you are slicing, so you can spot obstacles early enough to react.
Keep a steady rhythm of timing. Hitting fruit and dodging hazards both depend on acting at the right moment, not just quickly.
Pay attention to the soundtrack, since its beat can help you anticipate the pace of the run.
Start each attempt focused on staying alive first. Progress comes from avoiding mistakes that end the run early.
After a failed run, note which obstacle stopped you and plan to approach that spot more carefully next time.
faq: What is the main goal in Juicy Run?
You dash through the world, slice fruits with shadow powers, and dodge obstacles to progress further.
What skills matter most in Juicy Run?
Precision and timing matter most, because you need to slice fruit cleanly while avoiding obstacles at the right moments.

army-truck-simulator-2024.intro: Army Truck Simulator 2024 puts you behind the wheel of a cargo army truck. You drive around army bases, complete the mission in each level, and move soldiers and weapons to their destinations.
tips: Use the brake (Spacebar) before corners and obstacles rather than at the last second, so the heavy truck stays under control.
Check the time you have for each delivery early and plan a route that keeps you moving steadily toward the goal.
Watch the road ahead for hazards and obstacles on the highways, and steer around them when you have room.
Press F when you reach a pickup or drop-off point so passengers and cargo are handled before you head off again.
Keep your speed controlled with WASD so you do not lose cargo or arrive late by taking a wide or rushed turn.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You drive a cargo army truck to complete the mission in each level, which includes picking up passengers, delivering weapons, and reaching your destination on time.
Which keys control the truck?
Use WASD to drive, Spacebar to brake, and F to interact with passengers and cargo at pickup and drop-off points.

fun-sorting-through-the-shelves.intro: Fun Sorting Through The Shelves is a relaxing puzzle where you drag objects onto shelves and group identical items together. Clear each shelf to finish levels and unlock new items as the difficulty rises.
tips: Before placing anything, scan all the shelves to find which items appear most often, so you can plan where each group should go.
Try to keep matching items close together on the same shelf, since three identical objects there form a triplet and free up space.
Avoid scattering single copies of many different items across shelves, because this fills space without creating triplets.
Stop and look for a triplet you can complete before adding a new item, as a small pause often prevents a crowded shelf.
Pay attention to how the difficulty grows with each stage, and take breaks when you feel stuck to keep the experience relaxed.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Your goal is to clear all the shelves in each level by collecting three identical objects on the same shelf to form triplets.
How do I control the items?
Drag and drop each item onto a shelf and place it neatly so it sits with its matching copies.

fidget-spinner-creator.intro: Fidget Spinner Creator lets you design your own spinner, spin it to earn coins, and use those coins to improve how it performs. The game focuses on creativity and experimenting with your builds.
tips: Spin your design often, since coins come from spinning and every session adds to what you can spend on upgrades.
Before buying an upgrade, think about what your current spinner needs most, so your coins go toward the change you will actually use.
Try a few different designs rather than sticking with one, so you can compare how each one spins and decide which direction to develop.
Save some coins for later rather than spending everything at once, in case a better enhancement becomes worth it as your spinner improves.
Make small changes to your design and watch how each one affects performance, so you learn which choices help your spinner most.
faq: What is the main goal of Fidget Spinner Creator?
The main goal is to design your own custom spinner, spin it to earn coins, and use those coins to enhance its performance. The game is about creating the fidget toy you like best.
How do I earn coins?
You earn coins by spinning your spinner. Your earnings can then be spent on enhancements for your design.

tangled-rope-fun.intro: Tangled Rope Fun is a color puzzle where you sort ropes and untangle knots in the correct order. Its 3D graphics and rope challenges are built to hold your focus.
tips: Study the whole knot before you tap anything. Find which rope is involved in the most crossings so you know where to start.
Work on one color at a time. Sorting by color keeps the board readable and stops you from losing track of which rope belongs where.
Rotate your view of the 3D layout if the game allows it, since a rope hidden behind another can look untangled when it is not.
Take a short pause when you get stuck. Coming back with fresh eyes often shows the order you missed.
Check each move as you go instead of rushing. Undoing a wrong step takes longer than planning the next one carefully.
faq: What is the goal of Tangled Rope Fun?
The goal is to sort the ropes and untangle the knots in the correct order. Each puzzle is solved when the ropes are separated and sorted.
How do I play the game?
Tap to play. The instructions only mention tapping, so experiment with taps on the ropes to see how they respond.

mother-simulator-husband-wife-games.intro: Mother Simulator Husband Wife Games is a 3D family life simulator where you play a wife and mom. You care for your family, handle household duties, finish daily tasks, drive around the city, and go shopping.
tips: Use the I key to check the controls list whenever you forget a key, so you can focus on the family tasks instead of guessing.
Save Left Shift for sprinting between tasks in the house and town, and walk when you need precise movement near objects.
Group household chores by location so you spend less time walking back and forth between rooms and the car.
Use the P key to pause when you need to plan your next task, then continue once you know which errand comes first.
Try the N key to skip a level only if you get stuck, since completing tasks yourself helps you learn how the game works.
faq: What is the main goal of Mother Simulator Husband Wife Games?

You take on the role of a wife and mom, looking after your virtual family, managing household responsibilities, and completing daily tasks. Family activities and driving around the city are part of the experience.
How do I move and look around?
On desktop, use W, A, S, and D to move your player and move the mouse to change the camera view. On mobile, use the joystick to move.

tug-of-heads.intro: Tug of Heads is a physics wrestling game for one or two players, where the goal is to keep your character's head safe from danger. Each level changes the conditions, so you will need to adapt as you go.
tips: Watch the conditions at the start of each level before you move, since the rules change from one level to the next.
In two-player matches, keep your character close to your opponent so you can react quickly to their moves.
Use short, controlled movements rather than sudden big ones, because physics-based bodies can overshoot and leave your head exposed.
Pick the number of sets carefully: a shorter match is good for practicing controls, while more sets give you time to learn the level patterns.
Play against the CPU first to learn how each control feels before challenging a friend.
faq: What is the goal of Tug of Heads?
The aim is to protect your character's head from danger during the wrestling match. Keep your head safe while the level conditions keep changing.
What are the controls for Player 1 and Player 2?
Player 1 uses the W, A, and D keys. Player 2 uses the UP, LEFT, and RIGHT arrow keys.

turbo-stunt-racing.intro: Turbo Stunt Racing is a 3D arcade racer where you compete against rivals, perform stunts, and dodge traps across increasingly challenging levels. Use the arrow keys or W, A, S, D to accelerate, brake, and steer.
tips: Slow down slightly before sharp turns, using the Down arrow or S to brake, so you keep control of the car instead of sliding wide.
Watch the ramps before you hit them. Lining up straight on a jump gives you a more stable landing and helps you stay ahead of rivals.
Pay attention to the traps and obstacles ahead of you. Reacting early is usually safer than steering at the last moment.
Try stunts when the road is clear. Landing cleanly matters more than trying a flashy move in the middle of a crowded pack.
Spend your earned cash with care. Compare the characteristics of each car before upgrading or buying a new one, and pick the option that suits how you like to drive.
faq: How do I steer and control my car?
Use the Left and Right arrows (or A and D) to steer, and the Up arrow (or W) to accelerate. The Down arrow (or S) decelerates the car.
How do I earn money in the game?
Money is earned by completing daring stunts and mastering precision driving. You can use this cash to upgrade your current vehicle or buy a new one.

vehicle-stunts-sky-sim.intro: Vehicle Stunts Sky Sim is a 1-player driving game set on high-altitude stunt tracks. You drive cars, bikes, and trucks across gaps and through mid-air loops.
tips: Use WASD to get a feel for how your vehicle accelerates, steers, and handles before you attempt the harder jumps.
Build up enough speed before a gap so you can clear it, but ease off if you feel the vehicle losing control.
Pay attention to your landing angle, since a nose-down or tilted landing is more likely to cause a crash.
Try different vehicles, as cars, bikes, and trucks may feel very different on the same track.
Approach loops with steady, controlled speed and keep your vehicle aligned so you can work through the mid-air section.
faq: What is the goal of Vehicle Stunts Sky Sim?
The goal is to drive your vehicle across sky-high stunt tracks, leaping over gaps and racing through loops in mid-air. The game also includes challenges to complete.
How do I control the vehicle?
Use the W, A, S, and D keys to drive. Combine them to steer and control your vehicle on the stunt map.

battleship-infinity-war.intro: Battleship - Infinity War is a naval battle game played on a 14x14 grid. Place your ships carefully, use special tools like air strikes, and compete against players worldwide.
tips: Spread your ships across the grid rather than clustering them, so one lucky shot from an opponent cannot reveal several at once.
Track where you have already fired and look for patterns in your opponent's placement, since clever foes may try to hide their ships in predictable spots.
Save powerful tools like air strikes for moments when you have a strong read on the board, instead of using them early on guesses.
Use the larger 14x14 grid to your advantage by working outward from confirmed hits to finish off damaged ships before searching elsewhere.
Adapt your approach between matches, because global opponents may use different strategies, and noting what worked against them helps you climb the leaderboards.
faq: What is the goal of Battleship - Infinity War?
The goal is to sink your opponent's ships on the 14x14 grid before they sink yours. Strategic placement and tactical play are key to winning.
How can I improve my chances against clever opponents?
Vary your ship placement and pay attention to how your opponent fires, then adjust your tactics to counter their habits. Adapting during a match is part of the challenge.

ball-run-2048-space.intro: Ball Run 2048 Space is a runner where you steer a ball along a space track, merge matching numbers, and try to reach the finish with the highest value. Each level asks you to balance speed, lane choice, and merging.
tips: Look ahead on the track and pick your lane before you reach spikes or obstacles, rather than swerving at the last second.
Prioritize collecting numbered balls that match your current value so your number grows without stalling your run.
Keep your steering smooth and small, since sharp movements can push you into hazards and break your momentum.
Plan a route across the track instead of chasing every ball, especially when a lane is crowded with obstacles.
Treat each level as a fresh start and watch how the track changes, so you can adjust your lane choices early.
faq: How do I grow my number in Ball Run 2048 Space?
Collect matching numbered balls along the track so they merge with your ball and raise its value. The goal is to reach the finish with the biggest number you can.
How do I steer the ball?
On desktop, move the mouse left and right to steer. On mobile, touch and drag left and right.

brutal-zombies.intro: Brutal Zombies is a single-player 3D shooter where you fight off waves of zombies with guns. Survive long enough and you can unlock new weapons to use against the horde.
tips: Keep moving with WASD so zombies do not surround you, and use Space to jump when you need to change position quickly.
Aim with your mouse and fire with the left mouse button in short bursts instead of holding fire constantly, which helps you avoid wasting ammo.
Press R to reload during a lull in the fighting rather than in the middle of a crowd, so you are not left empty-handed when a group closes in.
Use the P key to pause if you need a moment to plan your route or check your surroundings before pushing forward.
Focus on staying alive rather than clearing everything quickly, since surviving longer is what unlocks the new weapons.
faq: What is the goal of Brutal Zombies?
Shoot the hordes of zombies and survive as long as you can. Surviving is what lets you unlock new weapons.
What are the basic controls?
Use WASD to move, the left mouse button to shoot, R to reload, P to pause, F to use, and Space to jump.

the-unleashed-hunter.intro: The Unleashed Hunter is a shooting game about aiming carefully and acting quickly to collect trophies. You can spend what you earn on weapons and upgrades in the shop.
tips: Focus on precision before speed, since accurate shots are what earn trophies and keep your progress moving.
Check the shop whenever you have enough to buy something, and compare weapons before spending, so your choice fits how you like to shoot.
Use your trophy cabin as a quick progress check to see what you have collected and which goals are still left.
Build up your speed gradually once your aim feels steady, so you do not start missing shots while trying to go faster.
Take short breaks between sessions, because the challenges are endless and it is easy to lose focus over a long run.
faq: What is the main goal of The Unleashed Hunter?
The main goal is to perfect your aim, collect trophies, and unlock weaponry as you move through the challenges.
How can I get better weapons?
Visit the shop to buy powerful upgrades and new weaponry, which you can unlock as you collect trophies.

monster-truck-stunt-game-racing-games.intro: Monster Truck Stunt Game is a racing game where you drive a powerful monster truck through stunt tracks, jumps, and mega ramps. You can also explore the open free car stunts mode.
tips: Start in the open free car stunts mode to get a feel for how your truck handles before you try the tracks.
Move slowly at first so you can see how the truck reacts to each direction before you pick up speed.
Approach each stunt jump at a steady pace, since landing matters as much as launching.
If a track feels too hard, try a different one or go back to the open mode to practice.
Watch the layout of each ramp and obstacle ahead of time so you can plan your route instead of reacting at the last second.
faq: What is the goal of Monster Truck Stunt Game?
The goal is to drive your monster truck through stunt tracks, perform jumps, and get through the obstacles on each course.
How do I control the truck?
Use W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move back, and A/D or the Left/Right Arrows to steer. Use the mouse to click any buttons.

metal-shooter-brother-squad.intro: Metal Shooter Brother Squad is a side-scrolling shooter where you lead a squad of metal soldiers through waves of enemies and powerful bosses. This guide covers the controls and some habits that help you survive longer.
tips: Keep the mouse moving so you can steer the joystick toward enemies before they reach you.
Use SPACE to jump over incoming fire and reposition, rather than standing still while you shoot.
Save your grenades with D for groups of enemies or bosses, since a single throw can cover more ground than gunfire.
Fire with S in short bursts when you are not sure where enemies are coming from, so you can react between shots.
Watch for the moments between waves to unlock weapons and upgrade abilities, since stronger gear makes the later battles easier.
faq: What do I use to move and aim?
You control the joystick with the mouse. Move the mouse to steer and aim your squad.
How do I fire and throw grenades?
Press S to fire your gun and D to throw a grenade. Use grenades when enemies are bunched together.

noob-vs-guys.intro: Noob vs Guys is an action race where you try to outrun experienced opponents in a pixelated world. The goal is to be the last player standing.
tips: Watch the obstacles as they change, and plan your next move before you reach them rather than reacting at the last second.
Since the game rewards quick reflexes, stay alert and keep your attention on the track ahead instead of on the other racers.
The world evolves during play, so adjust your approach each time the layout or obstacles shift instead of repeating the same route.
Think strategically about each decision, such as when to push ahead and when to hold back to avoid a costly mistake.
Stay adaptable: if a run goes badly, notice what caused the setback and change your approach on the next attempt.
faq: What is the main goal in Noob vs Guys?
The goal is to outrun your opponents and be the last one standing in the race for survival.
Does the game reward speed or careful play?
It rewards both: agility and quick reflexes help you move fast, while strategic decisions help you handle changing obstacles.

3d-super-rolling-ball-race.intro: 3D Super Rolling Ball Race is a fast arcade racing game where you guide a rolling ball across tricky 3D platforms. It is played with a single mouse click or tap, so timing matters more than complicated controls.
tips: Watch the path a few seconds ahead rather than the ball itself, so you can plan turns before you reach the edge of a platform.
Keep your clicks or taps steady and deliberate; rushing inputs is the most common way to fall off the course.
Pay attention to gaps and narrow sections, since these are where the game tests your timing the most.
If you play the multiplayer mode, focus on keeping your ball on the platforms first and only then try to pull ahead of the other racers.
Treat each run as practice: notice where you lost speed or fell, and adjust your timing on the next attempt.
faq: What is the goal of 3D Super Rolling Ball Race?
The goal is to race your rolling ball through the 3D platform course without falling off. Staying on the track while moving quickly is the core challenge.
How do I control the ball?
You control the ball with a mouse click or a tap. Because the input is simple, the difficulty comes from timing when you click.

screw-nuts-snap-puzzle.intro: Screw Nuts Snap Puzzle is a colorful matching puzzle. You remove accessible screws from layered glass shapes and sort them into boxes of the same color, planning each move to keep your spare slots open.
tips: Only accessible screws can be removed, so check which ones are uncovered before choosing a move.
Each box holds three screws, so count how many of a color you already have before you pick up another one.
Keep your spare slots as empty as possible, because filling them is what ends the run before the layers are cleared.
When a board feels stuck, look at the extra slots, box swaps, and hammer as tools to reshuffle your options.
In Unscrew mode, select a screw first and then the empty hole you want to move it to, so plan the path before you click.
faq: How do I win a level?
Clear all the layers of screws without filling your spare slots. Match three screws of the same color to fill a collection box.
How many screws go in one box?
Each collection box holds three screws of the same color.

escape-strange-girl-s-house.intro: Escape Strange Girl's House is a dark point-and-click adventure where you wake up locked inside an unfamiliar house and must search for a way out. Explore carefully, because nearly every object may hold a clue or a useful item.
tips: Tap on everything in each room, including furniture, containers and decorations, since hidden items can be tucked away in unexpected places.
Pick up every item you can, even if it seems useless at first, because many objects only reveal their purpose when combined with something else later.
Try combining items in pairs when you get stuck. A simple object can often solve a puzzle when used on a device, lock or door.
Read books and notes you find, as they can reveal clues about the girl and how to get past the obstacles in the house.
Revisit rooms after you unlock new paths or change your perception, because earlier scenes may show details you missed the first time.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Your goal is to escape the house by uncovering clues, collecting items and solving the puzzles that block your way out.
How do I interact with objects?
You explore by tapping on objects in the house. Tapping can reveal secrets, add items to your inventory or open new paths.

extreme-drift-racing.intro: Extreme Drift Racing is a sports game about drifting through tight corners. You balance speed and control, time your moves, and earn coins to customize your cars.
tips: Enter each corner at a speed you can control. Going in too fast often makes the drift harder to hold.
Focus on timing. Start the slide at a consistent point each lap so your line becomes predictable.
Watch how your tires respond on each turn. If they start to lose grip, ease off a little before correcting.
Practice the same corners repeatedly to learn how each one behaves. Small improvements add up over a run.
Spend earned coins on customizing your ride once you know which handling style suits your driving.
faq: What is the main goal of Extreme Drift Racing?
The goal is to master drifting by balancing speed with control through tight corners while perfecting your timing.
How do I earn coins in the game?
The game description says you earn coins as you play, and you can use them to customize your rides.

king-of-mahjong-connecting-tiles.intro: King of Mahjong: Connecting Tiles is a puzzle game where you match pairs of identical character tiles. Each level has a time limit and a limited number of image replacements, so planning your moves matters.
tips: Before you start connecting, scan the whole board for pairs that are easy to reach, and clear the open ones first to free up tiles underneath.
Remember that a connection can use no more than 3 straight lines, so check the path between two matching tiles before you select them.
Keep an eye on the timer and move steadily; the level ends when time runs out, so do not spend too long on a single tricky pair.
Save image replacements for boards where no matching pairs are visible, rather than using them as soon as you are stuck.
Use hints when you have looked at the board carefully and still cannot see a path, since hints are best used as a backup on each level.
faq: What is the goal of King of Mahjong: Connecting Tiles?
Your goal is to connect pairs of identical character tiles on each level before the time runs out.
How many straight lines can a connection have?
A connection between two identical tiles can use no more than 3 straight lines.

riddlemath.intro: RiddleMath is a number puzzle game built around logic and math riddles. Each level asks you to place numbers into the puzzle until the riddle is solved.
tips: Scan the whole puzzle before placing anything, and look for rows or patterns that already have only one possible number left.
Place the numbers you are most sure about first, since each correct placement narrows down the options for the empty spots.
Work through the levels in order so the logic gets easier to follow as you build familiarity with the puzzle style.
If you get stuck, step away for a moment and come back with fresh eyes, as many IQ-style riddles become clearer after a short break.
Check your answer against the puzzle's rules before moving on, so you do not carry a mistake into the next step.
faq: What is the goal of RiddleMath?
The goal is to solve each math riddle by placing the available numbers into the empty spots of the puzzle. Each level is a logical challenge meant to test your thinking.
How do I place a number on PC?
Click one of the available numbers with your mouse, then click an empty spot in the puzzle to place it there.

squid-games-escape.intro: Squid Games Escape is a 2D arcade action game for one player. You help a player escape along a challenging track, where you need to move quickly but carefully.
tips: Read the track ahead before you act. Spotting the next obstacle early gives you more time to respond cleanly.
Balance speed and care. Rushing into a difficult section often costs more time than moving steadily through it.
Use the input method the instructions describe, either left click or touch, and stick with the one that feels most natural to you so your timing stays consistent.
Replay the early part of the track to learn its rhythm. Repeating a section helps you react faster when it matters.
Take short breaks between attempts. A clear head makes it easier to stay careful when the track gets tough.
faq: What is the goal of Squid Games Escape?
The goal is to help the player escape along the track by moving fast while staying careful.
How do I control the player?
The instructions mention left click and touch controls. Try both to see which one feels more comfortable for you.

doctor-teeth.intro: Doctor Teeth puts you in the dentist's chair with a set of tools and fast-paced mini-games. Drive back evil germs and give patients perfect smiles in this sharp puzzle adventure.
tips: Watch each mini-game for a few seconds before acting, so you understand what it wants from you before the pace picks up.
Keep your reflexes ready, since the mini-games are described as fast-paced and slow reactions are likely to cost you.
Try each tool early to learn what it does, so you can switch to the right one quickly when a mini-game calls for it.
Balance your attention between patients and germs so one task does not leave the other neglected.
If you miss a moment, reset your focus on the next action rather than dwelling on the mistake.
faq: What is the main goal in Doctor Teeth?
You play as a dentist who uses tools and mini-games to drive back evil germs and give patients perfect smiles.
Which controls do I need to know?
The game does not list specific controls, so try the first mini-game and see which inputs respond.

ink-streak.intro: Ink Streak is a fast arcade reflex game where you control several running characters and the colorful trails they leave behind. Time each move carefully to keep everyone clear of collisions as the pace picks up.
tips: Watch the whole screen rather than one character, since every runner can cause a collision. Scan ahead for paths that are about to cross.
Click at the right moment rather than as fast as you can. Good timing matters more than rapid clicking.
