Pay attention to the trails. They mark where your characters have already been, so plan routes that do not cross them.
Expect the challenge to grow as speed and character count increase. Stay calm early on so your rhythm carries into harder stages.
Keep your focus steady over longer rounds. Short breaks in attention are often when collisions happen.
faq: How do I control the characters?
Use the mouse and click the screen to make your characters move. Each click is a timing decision that affects where your runners go.
What causes a game to end?
The main risk is a collision between characters. Keeping every runner moving safely is the core goal.

brainrots-dress-up-and-interior-design.intro: Brainrots: Dress Up & Interior Design is a creative game where you style six characters and decorate rooms. You choose outfits, hats and accessories, then furnish spaces to your own taste.
tips: Start with one character and change one piece at a time, so you can see how each hat or accessory changes the overall look.
Try the same outfit on different characters to learn which pieces suit which styles.
Choose a colour mood for a room before you place anything, so furniture, paintings and details feel like they belong together.
Place the larger furniture pieces first, then add paintings and small cozy details around them so the room doesn't feel crowded.
Build a short story for each design, such as who lives there or what they like, to guide your choices.
faq: How many characters can I dress up?
There are six heroes to choose from: Cappuccino Assassino, Ballerina Cappuccina, Bombardiro Crocodilo, Orcalero, Chimpanzini Bananini and Tralalelo Tralalata.
How do I place items in the game?
Use the mouse to select outfits, furniture, paintings and other items and to place them where you want.

multi-surgery-hospital-games.intro: Multi Surgery Hospital Games is an arcade simulation where you work through surgical puzzles and heal patients step by step. There is no timer, so the focus is on getting each procedure right.
tips: Take your time with each step, since there is no timer pressing you to rush through a procedure.
Read each puzzle fully before acting so you understand what the patient needs before you start.
Work in a clear order from one step to the next, and avoid skipping ahead to save effort.
If a step does not go as expected, pause and look over the sequence again rather than repeating the same move.
Keep your attention steady across the whole procedure, because precision matters more than speed here.
faq: Is there a time limit in Multi Surgery Hospital Games?
No. The game has no timers, so you can take as long as you need on each surgical puzzle.
What is the main goal of the game?
Your goal is to heal patients by completing surgical puzzles step by step, with a focus on precision and skill.

archery-hero.intro: Archery Hero is a sports game about precise aiming and timing. Weather changes and targets move, so you need to stay focused as the levels get harder.
tips: Watch how the weather shifts before each shot, since it can change where your arrow travels.
Track the moving target for a moment before you release, and aim where it will be, not where it is.
Focus on timing. A steady, unhurried release usually helps more than a rushed one.
Aim for the bullseye on every shot, but if you miss, note what went wrong so you can adjust on the next try.
Expect the later levels to be tougher, so build your rhythm on the early ones before the challenge grows.
faq: What is the goal of Archery Hero?
Hit the bullseye by aiming and timing your shots as the weather and moving targets make each level harder.
How do the controls work?
The game is built around intuitive controls, so most players can start shooting quickly without a long learning period.

lady-rescue.intro: Lady Rescue is a drawing puzzle game where you draw lines to keep Lady safe from bees, sharks, and crocodiles. Each level asks you to find a line that saves her before time runs out.
tips: Look at every threat on screen before you start drawing, including bees, sharks, and crocodiles, and work out which one reaches Lady first.
You only have 5 seconds, so decide on your line before you touch the screen to avoid wasting time mid-drag.
Use one smooth drag rather than short, stop-start strokes, since you need the line to be in place quickly.
If your first idea does not save Lady, try a different route or angle instead of repeating the same line.
Treat each level as a small brain teaser: notice how the threats move or sit, then use that to find the simplest line that blocks them.
faq: What is the goal of Lady Rescue?
Your goal is to help Lady escape from dangerous things like bees, sharks, and crocodiles by drawing lines, then move on to the next level.
How do I control the game?
Touch the screen and drag your finger to draw a line that protects Lady.

tomb-of-the-dash-game.intro: Tomb Of The Dash is a classic puzzle game set in endless vertical mazes. You explore a tomb, collect coins and three stars, and avoid traps while the clock keeps running.
tips: Watch the clock from the start and plan your route so you are not caught with time running out.
Collect the coins and stars that sit close to your path first, since they are the easiest points to gain.
Learn how each trap behaves before you move near it, and give it enough room to pass safely.
Keep an eye out for power boosts and use them when the path ahead looks crowded with traps.
Because the mazes are generated endlessly, do not expect the same layout twice; stay focused on reading each new screen.
faq: What is the main goal of Tomb Of The Dash?
You move through an endless vertical maze, collecting coins and three stars while avoiding traps. The aim is to keep going while the clock is ticking.
How do I control the character?
Use your mouse or tap the screen to play. The instructions do not list any other controls.

island-puzzle.intro: Island Puzzle is a relaxed match-and-link puzzle game where you guide a curious cat through a colorful island full of challenges. Each puzzle rewards careful thinking and patience.
tips: Scan the whole board before you move, since the puzzles are described as unpredictable and a quick look can reveal links you would otherwise miss.
Look for matching pieces that can be connected in a chain, and plan two or three steps ahead rather than reacting to one match at a time.
If you get stuck, step back and look at which pieces are blocking the paths you need, then focus your next moves on clearing those.
Take breaks between puzzles. The game is designed to be calm, and returning with fresh eyes often makes a tricky layout easier to read.
Pay attention to the rewards and island mysteries as you progress, since they give you a sense of what to work toward in each area.
faq: What is the main goal of Island Puzzle?
You guide a curious cat through island challenges by solving match-and-link puzzles and unlocking island mysteries and rewards along the way.
Is Island Puzzle a fast-paced game?
No, it is described as a relaxing, tranquil game, so you can take your time with each puzzle and think through your moves.

satisdom.intro: Satisdom is a relaxed casual game built around completing tasks at your own pace. You can drag, tap, sort, match, or assemble your way through it, with easy controls for jumping right in.
tips: Try each kind of action the game offers, such as dragging, tapping, sorting, matching, and assembling, so you know what to expect from each task.
Slow down and look over the whole screen before you act, since the game is designed for unwinding rather than rushing.
Notice the small details the game includes. The instructions suggest the fun is in the process, so it can help to pay attention to them as you go.
If a task feels tricky, step away for a moment and come back to it. There is no pressure to finish quickly.
Play with family or friends when you can. The game is described as a good way to spend quality time together, and taking turns can make it more relaxing.
faq: What is the goal of Satisdom?
The goal is to complete tasks by dragging, tapping, sorting, matching, or assembling. The game is more about enjoying the process than reaching a finish line.
Is there a time limit in Satisdom?
The instructions do not mention a time limit. They encourage you to take your time and not rush.

slap-battle-arena-online.intro: Slap Battle: Arena Online is a fast multiplayer slap game with three modes: Arena, Ring, and 67. Your aim is to collect as many slaps as you can by hitting other players.
tips: Hitting more players earns more slaps, so stay active in Arena instead of waiting for openings.
Save your slaps for stronger gloves, since they make you more powerful in battle.
In Ring, keep your footing and watch the edges of the platform so you don't fall off.
In 67, scan the path ahead for the dangerous heads and plan your route before you move.
Try each mode to see which suits your style, then focus your practice on that one.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Collect as many slaps as possible. You earn slaps by hitting other players, and they are the main currency.
What are slaps used for?
You spend slaps to unlock stronger gloves, which make you more powerful in battle.

prado-car-driving.intro: Prado Car Driving is a car racing game with 3D visuals, realistic handling, challenging tracks, and vehicle customization. It also includes offline modes for racing whenever you like.
tips: Spend a few laps on each track before racing hard, so you can learn its corners and straights and how your car responds to them.
Because the handling is described as realistic, ease off the pace going into tight bends rather than braking late and hoping for the best.
Try different vehicle setups and compare how they perform on the same track, so you can see which changes actually help your times.
Pick one track and repeat it until you feel comfortable, then move on to harder courses.
Use the offline modes to practise without pressure, since you can repeat races at your own pace.
faq: What is the goal of Prado Car Driving?

The game is a racing game where you navigate challenging tracks and aim to perform well with your customized vehicle. The description does not spell out specific race rules, so check the in-game menus for details.
How can I improve my performance in the game?
Focus on learning each track and adjusting your vehicle for better performance. Practising in the offline modes can help you build your skills without pressure.

bubble-merge-2048.intro: Bubble Merge 2048 combines 2048-style number merging with bubble shooting. You aim and fire bubbles, combine matching numbers and colours, and clear obstacles to finish each level.
tips: Aim for bubbles that match your number or colour first, since merging them is the fastest way to build higher numbers.
Look at the target number before you shoot so you know which combinations will get you there.
Clear barrels and boxes when they block your path, because removing obstacles opens up more options for merges.
Save boosters like dynamite and rockets for stages that look tricky, rather than using them on early easy shots.
Watch how the bubbles bounce, since physics can move bubbles into new spots and create unexpected matches.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Combine bubbles to create higher numbers and reach the target number shown for the level. Smashing barrels and boxes also helps clear the stage.
How do I aim and shoot?
Swipe to aim and release to fire your ball at matching numbers and colours. Plan each shot so it connects with the bubbles you want to merge.

fire-ring.intro: Fire Ring is a one-touch shooting game where you guide a blazing orb through rotating rings and shifting gaps. One wrong move ends the run, so timing is everything.
tips: Watch the gap for a full rotation before you tap, so you know where the opening will be when your orb reaches it.
Keep your taps light and steady rather than rapid-fire, since each tap sends the orb through the opening and mistimed taps are what end runs.
Expect the gaps to shift, and adjust your timing after each ring instead of repeating the same rhythm.
Practice short sessions to build reflexes, then push for a higher score once you can clear the first few rings consistently.
Aim to beat your previous best score on each attempt, because the game is built around climbing higher with every run.
faq: How do I control the orb in Fire Ring?
You control the orb with a single input: click or tap to jump through the openings in the rings. There are no other controls to learn.
What causes a game over?
Touching the flames or the fiery obstacles ends the run. One wrong move is enough, so careful timing matters more than speed.

cannon-shooter-game.intro: Cannon Shooter Game is a puzzle game where you aim a cannon, launch balls at targets, and smash obstacles across a series of levels. Each level adds new challenges that reward careful aiming.
tips: Before you fire, study the whole level and find the obstacles that block your path to the targets.
Adjust your aim in small steps, since a slight change in angle can send a ball far off target.
Look for shots that knock down several obstacles at once instead of focusing on a single object.
If a level feels stuck, try a different angle rather than repeating the same shot.
Pay attention to what each new level introduces, because the obstacles and challenges change as you progress.
faq: How do I aim and fire the cannon?
Use the mouse to click the buttons and control the cannon. Choose your angle carefully before launching each ball.
What is the goal of each level?
Your goal is to smash the obstacles and reach the targets using the balls you launch. Each level presents a new puzzle to solve.

geometry-vibes-3d.intro: Geometry Vibes 3D is a rhythm-based arcade game in a 3D world, where quick reflexes and timing matter. It supports one player and two-player mode.
tips: Watch the rhythm of the music and jump in time with it rather than reacting only to what is directly in front of you. Anticipating the beat helps you stay ahead.
Keep your eyes on the path ahead, not just your character, so you can plan your next jump before you need it.
Use one steady press for each jump instead of tapping rapidly. Mashing the button often leads to mistimed jumps.
If you are playing two-player mode, agree with your partner on who uses which keys before you start, so you do not press the wrong control at a critical moment.
When you fail a section, restart and focus on the part that caught you out. Short, repeated practice builds reaction speed faster than playing through long stretches while distracted.
faq: What is the basic goal of Geometry Vibes 3D?
You move through a 3D world by timing your jumps with the rhythm of the game. The game is built around reflexes and rhythm-based skills.
What are the controls for Player 1?
Player 1 can press W, left mouse click, or the spacebar. You can also click or tap to start playing.

100-doors-puzzle-box.intro: 100 Doors Puzzle Box is a puzzle and escape room game where each level brings a new room, hidden objects, and doors to unlock. Use the mouse to interact and A and D to move between areas.
tips: Search each room fully before trying to open a door, since the items you need are hidden among the objects.
Pick up items and try combining them, because some objects only become useful when paired with another.
When a puzzle stumps you, step back and look at what clues you have, since some challenges depend on logic and attention to detail.
Try different approaches on tricky brain teasers instead of repeating the same action, as the game rewards creative thinking.
Check the edges and corners of rooms, since hidden secrets can be easy to miss on a first look.
faq: What is the goal of 100 Doors Puzzle Box?
Your goal is to explore rooms, find hidden objects, solve puzzles, and unlock doors to move on to the next level.
How do I interact with objects and doors?
Use your mouse to click on objects and doors. Use the A and D keys to move your character through the room.

4-clues-1-word.intro: A word puzzle where each level shows several images and you must find the one word that connects them all. Type it using the letter tiles, and use hints when a level gets tough.
tips: Look at each image and name it to yourself before looking for a link. Writing down a short label for each picture can make the shared word easier to spot.
Think about more than one meaning for each object or action. Many answers depend on a word that has several meanings, so test each image against different senses of a possible word.
Say the names of the objects out loud, as the game suggests. Hearing a word can help you notice a sound or a phrase you missed while only looking.
Use the Remove Tiles hint early when you are unsure. Clearing letters that cannot be part of the answer makes the remaining options easier to work with.
Save the Expose a Letter hint for when you have a partial idea. A single confirmed letter can help you test a candidate word instead of guessing from scratch.
faq: What is the goal of 4 Clues 1 Word?
Your goal is to find the single word that applies to all the images shown in a level. You then spell it out using the letter tiles.
How do the controls work?
You select letter tiles to type your answer. The game also offers hint options for revealing a letter and removing tiles that are not part of the solution.

brrbrr-patapim.intro: BrrBrr Patapim is a 3D first-person shooter where you explore a map, collect weapons, and throw grenades while fighting the enemy BrrBrr Patapim. The action is fast, so staying alert matters.
tips: Explore the map early to find where weapons are, so you know your options before enemies close in.
Try the weapons you pick up and note which ones work well for you, then keep them ready when a fight starts.
Save grenades for groups or tight spots instead of throwing them at the first target you see.
Keep moving and check your surroundings often, since the pace is fast and standing still makes you an easy target.
Use the first few minutes to learn how clicking or tapping controls your actions before you commit to a long fight.
faq: How do I play BrrBrr Patapim?
The game is played with a mouse click or a tap. Click or tap to start and to take actions while you explore and fight.
What is the goal of the game?
Your aim is to survive the fight against BrrBrr Patapim by exploring the map, collecting powerful weapons, and using grenades.

slalom-ski-simulator.intro: Slalom Ski Simulator is a sports race down a snowy slope. You weave between gates against the clock, avoiding penalties and crashes while choosing your skier and level.
tips: Look ahead to the next gate before you reach the current one, so you can line up your turns early instead of reacting at the last moment.
Take it easy on the first run of a level to learn how the course bends and where the gates sit, then push for a faster time.
Treat each gate as a checkpoint and keep your path tight between them, since wide swings cost time you cannot easily recover.
Watch for penalties and crash risks as you go, because one mistake can cost more time than a clean, steady run saves.
Try different levels once you feel comfortable, and compare your times to see how your approach changes as the course gets harder.
faq: What is the main goal of Slalom Ski Simulator?
You race down the slope through the gates and try to finish before the clock runs out, while avoiding penalties and crashes.
What can cause me to lose time?
Penalties and crashes are the main risks that can slow your run and hurt your final time.

sort-them-cars-sorting-simulator.intro: Sort Them Cars is a relaxed 3D sorting game set in a messy toy store. Pick up scattered toy cars, sort them by category, and fill the shelves until every display is complete.
tips: Pick up a few cars of the same type at once so you can walk straight to their shelf without backtracking.
Spend your coins on the carry capacity upgrade early, since carrying more cars per trip saves a lot of walking across the store.
Try the upgrade that highlights matching shelves when you are unsure where a car belongs, rather than guessing.
Work on one area or shelf group at a time so you can see clearly when a display is filling up toward 100%.
Use Sprint (Shift) to move quickly across open floor, and save normal walking for tight spots between shelves.
faq: What is the main goal of Sort Them Cars?
Collect the toy cars scattered across the store floor, identify each one's category, and place it on the correct shelf. Your aim is to fill every display to 100%.
How do I earn money in the game?
You earn coins for every car you sort correctly, and you can spend them on upgrades.

spa-with-daddy.intro: Spa With Daddy is a beauty salon game where Jessica takes her dad to the spa for her birthday. You help give him a luxurious treatment for his nails, hair, skin and mind.
tips: Take your time with each treatment, since the game is about pampering rather than racing.
Try the nail, hair and skin treatments one at a time so you can see how each one changes the look.
Watch how Dad reacts as you go, because the story is built around him being surprised by the day.
Use single, deliberate clicks or taps so you don't skip past options you want to check.
Play through once without worrying about perfection, then go back and try different choices to see what else you can do.
faq: How do I play Spa With Daddy?
The game is played with a mouse click or by tapping the screen. Click or tap to move through the spa day.
What is the goal of the game?
The goal is to give Dad a luxurious spa day, covering his nails, hair, skin and mind. The description says he is about to get a big surprise, so the day is meant to be a fun reveal.

military-vehicle-driving-simulation.intro: Military Vehicle Driving Simulation puts you behind the wheel of armored trucks, tanks, and tactical vehicles for missions across rough terrain and combat zones. Driving is controlled with WASD.
tips: Start by getting a feel for steering and acceleration with WASD on open ground before you head into harder terrain.
Ease off the throttle on rough or uneven ground, since heavy vehicles can lose control if you push too fast over bumps.
Plan your route before you move. The game rewards precision, so choosing a steady line through a combat zone is usually safer than a quick, wide detour.
Learn how each vehicle handles, since armored trucks, tanks, and tactical vehicles respond differently to turns and speed.
Keep your inputs smooth rather than tapping keys rapidly, which helps you hold a straight line and take corners cleanly.
faq: What is the goal of Military Vehicle Driving Simulation?

The game focuses on completing military missions while driving armored trucks, tanks, and tactical vehicles. Your aim is to reach your objectives through harsh terrain and combat zones with careful driving.
What controls do I use to drive?
Use the W, A, S, and D keys to drive the vehicle. The game's instructions list WASD as the only control mentioned.

merge-2048.intro: Merge 2048 is a puzzle game where you drop numbered blocks and combine matching ones to reach higher values. Try to reach the 2048 block without letting the stack hit the red line.
tips: Before you drop a block, look at where its matching neighbours sit so you can set up a merge rather than stacking it at random.
Keep the middle of the container as open as you can. Filling one side can leave you with no space for the next block.
Save the TNT Block for when you are truly stuck. It is best used to clear tiles that are blocking good merges.
Watch the red line as the stack grows. When it gets close, prioritise moves that free up space over moves that only chase a higher score.
If you are new, play a few runs in Classic 2048 first, then try Shape Mode to see how its different pieces change your planning.
faq: How do I drop a block on desktop?
Click and hold the left mouse button to drag the block, then release the button to drop it where you want.
How do I drop a block on a touch screen?
Drag the block with your finger, and it will drop when you lift your finger off the screen.

dop2-delete-part-in-love-story.intro: DOP2 Delete Part in Love Story is a puzzle adventure about spotting and removing unnecessary details to guide a couple toward romance. It mixes observation with light-hearted humor and surprises.
tips: Study the whole scene before you remove anything, since every level is built around noticing details that do not belong.
Ask yourself what the couple actually needs to move closer together, and treat anything that gets in the way as a candidate for deletion.
Expect twists. If a solution seems too easy, check whether the level has a hidden detail you have not looked at yet.
Pay attention to the humor in each scene, because the funny or odd elements are often the clues that point to what to remove.
If you get stuck, step away for a moment and return with fresh eyes, then look again at objects you have already passed over.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Your goal is to sharpen your observation and delete unnecessary details so the couple can move toward romance.
What kind of challenges should I expect in each level?
Each level brings unexpected twists and light-hearted humor, so solutions may not be obvious at first.

spin-and-collect.intro: Spin & Collect is a clicker game where each spin on the wheel awards coins, gems, and rare items. Your goal is to build up a collection from Common to Legendary rarity.
tips: Use the Basic Wheel for steady progress and save the Premium Wheel for when you want a shot at the bigger jackpots.
Check the Inventory regularly to see which sets you are close to completing, since finishing a set unlocks permanent bonuses and multipliers.
Focus your coins on sets you are nearly finished with so you reach set bonuses sooner.
Because you earn coins while away through AFK rewards, a short check-in at the start of each session is a good habit.
Optional rewarded ads can speed things up, so only watch them when you want faster progress and are happy to pause your normal spinning.
faq: What is the main goal of Spin & Collect?
Your goal is to collect items across all rarities, from Common to Legendary, and complete sets to gain bonuses. Each spin on the wheel brings you closer to that.
What is the difference between the Basic Wheel and the Premium Wheel?

The Basic Wheel gives steady, constant progression, while the Premium Wheel offers the chance at colossal jackpots. Use the Basic Wheel for regular progress and the Premium Wheel when you want bigger rewards.

balloon-smash.intro: Balloon Smash is a casual aim-and-timing game where you launch a thorn ball to pop colorful balloons. Levels get more complex as you go, so precise shots matter more over time.
tips: Before you fire, look at the whole level and plan a route for the thorn ball rather than aiming only at the closest balloon.
Use the walls to your advantage: bouncing the ball off a wall can reach balloons that a straight shot cannot.
Pay attention to timing as well as angle, since the level layout and balloon positions can change how a shot plays out.
Watch how the later levels are built and notice which shots worked, so you can reuse those ideas in harder stages.
If a level becomes frustrating, take a moment to reset your approach and aim more carefully instead of firing quickly.
faq: What is the goal of Balloon Smash?
Your goal is to launch the thorn ball and burst the colorful balloons in each level. The levels become more complex as you progress.
How do I get better at Balloon Smash?
Focus on aim and timing, and practice bouncing shots off the walls to reach hard-to-hit balloons. Planning your shot before you fire usually helps more than rushing.

ammo-rush-master.intro: Ammo Rush Master is an action game where you run a track, pick the right gates to grow your ammo army, and then fire foam darts at walls, targets, and bosses.
tips: Before each gate, check which operation it uses. Multiplying (×) gives the biggest boost, while subtracting (-) or dividing (÷) can cost you a lot of ammo.
Move toward the gates and allies that grow your army, and steer around traps and tricky gates that reduce your numbers.
Keep your army as large as you can by the end of the track, because the shooting section depends on how many bullets you have.
In the shooting section, aim carefully at walls and bosses instead of spraying in every direction, so your darts land where they do the most damage.
Try different blasters as you unlock them and upgrade the ones that suit your play style best.
faq: What is the main goal of Ammo Rush Master?
Run through each track, grow your ammo army by passing through gates and collecting stickman allies, then break through walls and defeat bosses with your blaster.
Which gates should I go through?
Choose gates that add to or multiply your firepower, and avoid gates and traps that reduce your numbers. The gates use +, -, ×, and ÷ operations.

noob-rush-vs-pro-monster.intro: Noob Rush vs Pro Monster is an endless running shooter where you keep the little noob moving while dodging obstacles and shooting enemies. Your goal is to get as far as possible and collect points and gold.
tips: Keep an eye on the enemies coming from the air as well as the ground, since some attack from above and can catch you off guard.
Watch for thrown objects early and move out of their path rather than waiting until they are close.
Use your shots on the most dangerous enemies first, so the ones that could stop your run are removed before they reach you.
Balance your focus between dodging and shooting; eliminating enemies earns points and gold, but getting hit ends the run.
Spend your gold to improve your skills between runs, since the game rewards steady progress over a single lucky attempt.
faq: What is the main goal of Noob Rush vs Pro Monster?
You need to run as far as you can without losing, while eliminating as many enemies as possible to collect points and gold.
How do I move and jump in the game?
Use the arrow keys or WASD to move and the spacebar to jump. On mobile, tap the on-screen buttons to move and shoot.

ramp-car-stunts-impossible.intro: Ramp Car Stunts Impossible is a racing game where you perform car stunts on multiple ramp tracks. You take on challenging missions and long stunt tracks using keyboard controls.
tips: Learn the keyboard controls on a flat part of the track first, so you know how the car responds before you reach a ramp.
Approach each ramp at a steady speed rather than full speed, since a controlled jump is easier to land than a rushed one.
Before attempting a jump, look ahead at the landing area and plan where the car needs to come down.
If you keep falling at the same ramp, slow down your approach and try again, rather than repeating the same run.
Take breaks between long tracks, since the stunt courses are non-stop and concentration drops over time.
faq: What is the main goal of Ramp Car Stunts Impossible?
You perform car stunts on ramp tracks and complete challenging missions across long, impossible courses. The game is built around endless racing and stunts.
How do I control the car?
The game is played with the keyboard, and the controls are designed to be easy and smooth. Practice on the early parts of a track to get comfortable with steering and speed.

staircase-to-heaven.intro: Staircase To Heaven is a climbing adventure where you ascend from the ground toward the skies. There are no checkpoints, so every fall that costs you height matters.
tips: Slow down before each jump and look at where you will land, since a rushed leap is the most common way to lose progress.
Use Shift to run on flat or open stretches, and save careful movement for narrow or uneven parts of the climb.
Keep your camera steady by pressing L to lock the cursor when you need to aim your view, and unlock it when you need to move the mouse freely.
When you feel yourself slipping, react immediately, because the game expects you to catch yourself quickly before you lose ground.
Take short breaks between hard sections so you stay focused, since one lapse with no checkpoint to fall back on can cost a lot of progress.
faq: What is the main goal of Staircase To Heaven?
The goal is to climb from ground level all the way to the summit. Because there are no checkpoints, you need to keep your progress intact as you go.
What happens if I stumble while climbing?
You must quickly catch yourself to avoid losing progress. If you fail to recover, you lose the height you had gained.

happy-orange-glass.intro: Happy Orange Glass is a physics puzzle where you draw a line so the juice flows from its source into the glass. Plan each path before you draw, since the juice follows exactly what you create.
tips: Look at the whole level first and find where the juice starts and where the glass is before you draw anything.
Note the obstacles and trace in your head how the juice would fall along a line before you commit to it.
Keep your line as direct as you can, since a long or looping path gives the juice more chances to hit something.
If a attempt fails, study exactly where the juice went off course and change only that part of your path.
Use the mouse to draw smooth, deliberate strokes so your line lands where you planned.
faq: What is the goal of Happy Orange Glass?
Your goal is to draw a line that guides the juice safely from the juice source into the glass. Each level is completed when the juice reaches the glass.
How do I control the game?
The game is played with the mouse. You draw the path the juice will follow by moving the mouse.

mini-games-calm-and-puzzle.intro: Mini Games: Calm And Puzzle is a collection of eight short minigames that mix relaxing play with brain-testing challenges. Each round is played with mouse clicks or taps.
tips: Start with the games that feel relaxing to get comfortable with how each minigame responds to clicks or taps.
Take a moment to read what each minigame asks before you act, since the puzzle types differ from one another.
When a puzzle stalls you, switch to a different minigame and come back later with fresh eyes.
Slow, deliberate clicks or taps usually work better than rapid ones on the trickier minigames.
Play in short sessions so the calmer minigames stay enjoyable and the harder ones don't feel frustrating.
faq: What is the goal of Mini Games: Calm And Puzzle?
The game is a collection of eight minigames, and you work through them by solving or completing each one. Some are relaxing and others test your brainpower.
How do I control the game?
Use a mouse click or tap to play. Everything in the game is operated this way.

playground-ragdoll-sandbox.intro: Playground Ragdoll Sandbox is an action physics game where you ride cars, blow up buildings, fight enemies and work toward destroying the city with a nuclear bomb. You can follow story missions or explore the sandbox freely.
tips: Try a few story missions first to learn how vehicles, weapons and enemies behave before you plan a route to the nuclear bomb.
Use the F key to get into a vehicle when you need to cover ground quickly, and move on foot when you need to get close to a target.
Experiment with different weapons on the same building or object to see which ones cause the most destruction, then use that knowledge later.
Use the tulgan to build objects when you want to create a path, a platform or a shield before you start blowing things up.
On touch controls, check the on-screen buttons before each fight so you can switch between movement, shooting and vehicles without delay.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Your main goal is to destroy the city using a nuclear bomb. The game leaves it up to you to decide how you will achieve this.
What are the basic controls on a PC?
Use WASD to move, the left mouse button to shoot, and F to get into a vehicle.

princess-ready-for-christmas.intro: Princess Ready For Christmas is a dress-up game where you style Princess Anna and Elsa for a festive castle celebration. You choose hairstyles, dresses, and accessories to get them ready for the holiday party.
tips: Start with the hairstyle, since it sets the overall look. Then pick the dress and accessories so the outfit matches the hair.
Try a coordinated theme for each princess, such as matching colors or a shared holiday style, so the pair looks like they belong at the same celebration.
Change one item at a time and compare the result. This makes it easier to see which choices work well together.
Keep the holiday atmosphere in mind. Choose bright or festive accessories that stand out against the castle setting.
Once you have a look you like, try a different combination for the other princess to explore the many options the game offers.
faq: What is the goal of Princess Ready For Christmas?

The goal is to get Princess Anna and Elsa ready for their Christmas celebration by styling them with hairstyles, dresses, and accessories. There is no set winning condition, so you can finish when you are happy with the look.
Do I style both princesses or just one?
The game lets you style both Anna and Elsa. Each one can have her own hairstyle, dress, and accessories.

rider-2.intro: Rider 2 is a motorcycle clicker where you flip your bike through a never-ending world to earn coins and post high scores. Your goal is to pull off bigger stunts and jumps than your opponents.
tips: Use the mouse or touch screen to control your speed, and ease off when you need to stay steady for a landing.
Build up speed before a big jump so you have enough time in the air to start your flips.
Keep an eye on your coins and save up for a motorcycle you like, since owning a bike you enjoy makes the flipping easier to practice.
Practice the same jump several times to learn how long a flip takes before you land, then try to match your timing on harder jumps.
Check your score after each run and compare it with the opponents' results to see which stunts are worth repeating.
faq: What is the main goal in Rider 2?
You earn coins and build high scores by performing stunts, making jumps, and flipping your motorcycle. Challenging opponents with better scores is another key part of the game.
How do I control my motorcycle?
On PC, use the mouse to drive, accelerate, and stop. On mobile, touch the screen to speed up or stop.

maths-puzzle.intro: Maths Puzzle asks you to fill in missing numbers or operators so that both sides of an equation match. Puzzles get harder as you move through levels, rewarding careful arithmetic and quick thinking.
tips: Check which parts are missing before doing any maths, and decide whether you need a number, an operator, or both.
Work backwards from the side of the equation that already has the most known values, since that often reveals the missing piece quickly.
Test the basic operations one at a time on the blank spot, starting with the ones that most often fit the numbers you can see.
Use hints sparingly if your version offers them, and try a few fresh approaches first so you do not waste moves.
If the game is timed, aim for accuracy first; a fast wrong answer usually costs more time than a slightly slower correct one.
faq: What is the goal of Maths Puzzle?
Your goal is to fill in the missing numbers or operators so that both sides of each equation are equal. Solving a series of puzzles lets you move on to the next level.
What operations do I need to know?
The puzzles use addition, subtraction, multiplication and division. You may need to choose the correct operator as well as the missing numbers.

mergetopia.intro: Mergetopia is a relaxed 2D merge puzzle about sea animals. Combine characters across each Realm to evolve them and discover new Creatures, one bubble pop and one merge at a time.
tips: Take a moment to look over the whole board before you start merging, so you can spot which characters can be combined.
Work on one area at a time instead of spreading your merges across the screen, which keeps the board easier to read.
Pop bubbles as you go, since the goal is built on both bubble pops and merges and progress depends on doing both.
Hold your drag steady on mobile or keep the left mouse button pressed on PC so your merges land where you intend.
Revisit each Realm to see which Creatures you have not discovered yet and aim your next merges toward them.
faq: How do I merge characters in Mergetopia?
On PC, click and drag with the left mouse button to combine characters. On mobile, tap to select, then hold and drag to merge.
What is the goal of Mergetopia?
Your goal is to build and discover the Creatures, one bubble pop and one merge at a time. Each Realm is filled with sea animal characters waiting to be discovered, merged, and evolved.

grapple-grip.intro: Grapple Grip is a puzzle platformer where you climb through levels by attaching your grapple to platforms. Solve each puzzle, find the exit, and use the hint button when you get stuck.
tips: Before you grapple, study the whole level to spot the exit and the platforms that lead toward it.
Make small, controlled moves with A and D or the arrow keys, so you can line up your next grapple before committing to a jump.
If you get stuck or lose track of your route, press R to reset the level rather than continuing from a bad position.
Use the hint button early if a puzzle seems confusing, since a small nudge can save time you would spend retrying the same path.
Pay attention to obstacles above and around you, because a grapple that pulls you into a hazard can undo progress quickly.
faq: What is the goal of Grapple Grip?
Your goal is to climb through each level, solve its puzzles, and reach the exit. Completing every level is the aim of the game.
Which keys do I use to move and grapple?
Use A and D or the left and right arrow keys to move, and W or the up arrow key to grapple. Press R to reset a level and Esc to go back.

slicetall.intro: SlicetAll is an arcade game where you tap to flip a knife and slice through a range of obstacles. Success depends on timing and precision, with the aim of building a higher score.
tips: Watch a few cuts before you commit to a rhythm, so you can spot how quickly each obstacle arrives.
Tap at the moment the knife is in position rather than as soon as an obstacle appears, since early taps are the most common source of misses.
Keep your eyes on the next obstacle instead of the knife itself, which gives you more time to adjust your timing.
Stay relaxed and use short, steady taps. Rushing usually makes your timing less accurate.
After each miss, pause for a moment and think about what went wrong before trying again.
faq: What is the goal of SlicetAll?
The goal is to slice through the obstacles by tapping to flip the knife at the right moments. Each successful cut helps you build a higher score.
What controls does SlicetAll use?
The game is played by tapping to flip the knife. Timing your taps well is the key skill.

weapon-run-3d-gun-shooter.intro: Weapon Run is a fast-paced 3D runner where you sprint through futuristic tracks, clear obstacles, and upgrade your firearms. Your goal is to see how far you can get.
tips: Look ahead along the track so you can plan your moves before obstacles reach you.
Spend upgrades on the firearms that help you clear the obstacles you meet most often.
Keep your reflexes sharp, since the enemies and obstacles come quickly in a fast-paced runner.
Save some strategy for boss encounters, and think about how your weapons match up against them.
Try to beat your previous distance, so each run teaches you where you lost ground.
faq: What is the main goal of Weapon Run?
The game asks how far you can go on each run while you sprint through futuristic tracks and deal with enemies, obstacles, and bosses.
What do I need to upgrade during a run?
You can upgrade your firearms, so improving your weapons is one of the main ways to handle tougher enemies and bosses.

arrow-fever.intro: Arrow Fever is an action game where you use a bow and arrow to defeat foes. Move your character left and right, dodge obstacles, and build up your strength as you play.
tips: Keep your character moving side to side rather than standing still, so you stay clear of obstacles that come your way.
Watch the path ahead and plan your moves a step early, since reacting late is the most common reason to lose a run.
Make a habit of collecting upgrades when it is safe to do so, because they help your character level up.
Balance risk and reward: a small detour for an upgrade is worth it only if you can get back out of danger quickly.
Pay attention to how your skill improves over several attempts, and adjust your timing based on what keeps catching you.
faq: How do I move my character?
Move the character left and right using your mouse or your finger. Keep your movements smooth so you can react quickly.
What should I focus on to do well?
Avoid obstacles and collect upgrades as you go. Rewards in the game come from both skill and strategy, so careful play matters.

storm-dash.intro: Storm Dash is a fast 2D platformer where you run, jump and dash ahead of a deadly storm. Collect coins, upgrade your abilities and push for a new distance record.
tips: Keep moving forward. The storm is always chasing you, so pausing for long periods lets it catch up.
Use the dash when you need to cover ground quickly or clear a gap, and save it for moments when you really need the speed.
Jump early rather than at the last second. A late jump is the most common way to lose momentum in a platformer like this.
Grab coins when they are on your route, but do not take big risks to reach them if the storm is close behind.
Spend coins on upgrades that match how you play, then try a few runs to see how the change affects your distance.
faq: What is the goal of Storm Dash?
Your goal is to escape the storm by running, jumping and dashing as far as you can. Try to beat your distance record on each run.
Which keys control the character?
Use the left and right arrow keys or A and D to move, the up arrow or W to jump, and the down arrow or S to dash. On mobile, use the on-screen buttons.

orbadrone-robot-escape.intro: OrbaDrone is a maze escape game where you pilot an orb-shaped drone through a cave-like structure. You use attract and repel abilities to move objects and navigate dangerous, mysterious areas.
tips: Experiment with attract and repel on nearby objects before relying on them in a tight spot, so you know how each one reacts.
Look at how materials behave around the level before moving them, since each one has unusual properties that affect your route.
Use the drone's movement in short bursts when you are near hazards, which gives you more control over where you end up.
If a level stalls, step back and think about which object you can move to open a new path rather than repeating the same move.
Try the control settings early to find a layout that feels comfortable, whether you play with the joystick and buttons or the keyboard.
faq: What is the goal of OrbaDrone?
Your goal is to escape each maze-like level by using your drone's attract and repel abilities to move through the cave structure. The game includes 50 levels to complete.
How do I control the drone on desktop?
Use the arrow keys to move, press A to attract objects, and press S to repel them.

tall-and-rush.intro: Tall and Rush is an arcade challenge where you grow taller, jump to grab power-ups, and use high-powered kicks against a robot foe. The goal is to climb as high as you can and survive as many rounds as possible.
tips: Treat each jump as a chance to grab a power-up, and plan your route so you can reach one without wasting a leap.
Keep an eye on the robot's position before you commit to a kick, since a well-timed strike matters more than a rushed one.
Watch how your height changes as you grow, and adjust your jumps to match your new reach.
Stay in the air only as long as you need to, so you are ready to land and react when the robot moves.
Play several rounds in a row and notice which moves keep you alive longest, then repeat those habits.
faq: What is the main goal of Tall and Rush?
You try to get as tall as possible and survive as many rounds as you can against the robot foe. The description focuses on height and how long you last.
How do power-ups help you?
You jump to snatch power-ups as you play. The description does not list what each power-up does, so test them to see their effects.

king-simulator.intro: King Simulator is an adventure where you act as a hero defending a village and exploring a fantasy world. You swipe to defend, upgrade buildings, and push back orc attacks.
tips: Keep an eye on the screen for incoming orc attacks so you can start swiping to defend before they reach your village.
Watch your character's defense closely during each attack and adjust your swipes to match where the threat is coming from.
Think about which village buildings matter most to your defense before you upgrade, rather than upgrading at random.
Take each attack as a chance to learn the orc patterns, since staying calm and reacting early usually works better than rushing.
faq: What is the main goal of King Simulator?
Your goal is to defend your village, repel orc attacks, upgrade your buildings, and unlock new territories as you explore the fantasy world.
How do I control my character?
Swipe the screen to control your character's defense. Use the same swipe controls to respond to attacks as they happen.

2-minutes-to-escape.intro: You play as a main character trying to escape a nuclear facility before it explodes. Each room must be cleared in order to move on, and you have only two minutes before the rocket can explode.
tips: Look for the red button first when you enter a room, since it opens the doors you need to leave.
Spend a few seconds studying the layout before you move so you can plan a short route to the button and the exit.
Keep an eye on the clock throughout, because the time limit is short and wandering back and forth can cost you the escape.
Use the arrow keys for steady, controlled movement rather than rushing into corners where you may get stuck.
Move quickly once you have a route in mind, since the game rewards speed and you must be fast to survive.
faq: What is the goal of 2 Minutes to Escape?
Your goal is to escape from each room of the nuclear facility by finding the way out, and to complete every level before the rocket explodes.
How do I open the doors?
Find the red button in each room, as it is the one that opens the doors so you can escape.

getting-over-it.intro: Guide a cat in a flower pot with a hammer up through a tangle of towering junk. Every swing can carry you forward or send you tumbling back to the start, so careful, patient play matters.
tips: Make small, deliberate swings before committing to a big one. Precision usually gets you further than force.
Before each swing, look at where the hammer will land and what it could catch on. Plan the move before you make it.
Expect falls. A tumble back to the start is part of the challenge, so try not to let one frustration push you into rushed swings.
Take short breaks after a bad fall. Coming back with a calm head makes it easier to focus on precise movement.
Rest on stable ground when you can, and use each secure position to plan your next route upward.
faq: What is the goal of Getting Over It?
You guide a cat in a flower pot with a hammer up through a world of towering junk. The description frames it as a climb that rewards precision and patience.
What happens if I fall?
A precarious swing can send you tumbling back to the start. Each fall sets you back, so steady progress matters more than speed.

color-parking-drifter.intro: Color Parking Drifter is a racing game where you drift your car into the parking spaces of the requested color. Precise drifting and careful driving around other cars are the main skills.
tips: Read which color is requested before you start drifting, so you are already lined up for the right space.
Slow your approach before the drift so you have room to stop precisely inside the parking space.
Keep an eye on the edges of the arena and steer back toward the middle before you get close to the boundary.
Watch for passing cars and time your drift so you are not entering a space while another car is moving through.
Practice the controls on keyboard (Z or X) or the left and right sides of a mobile screen until your inputs feel consistent.
faq: What is the goal of Color Parking Drifter?
You drift your car into the parking spaces of the color that is requested. The description asks for precise drifting into the correct spaces.
What should I avoid while playing?
Avoid parking in the wrong color and driving out of the arena. Also be careful of other cars passing by.

shop-cashier-simulator-3d.intro: Shop Cashier Simulator 3D puts you behind the register in a 3D supermarket, where you scan items, take payments and keep customers happy. Accuracy and speed both matter at the checkout.
tips: Slow down slightly on each scan so you do not charge for the wrong item, since mistakes directly reduce your earnings.
Check each payment method before you process it, whether the customer pays with cash or credit, to avoid errors at the till.
Count change carefully and double-check the amount before handing it back, because wrong change upsets customers.
Build a steady rhythm of scan, total, payment and change so you can keep the line moving without rushing into mistakes.
Pay attention to each customer's situation, since every one brings a different challenge at the checkout line.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You work as a cashier, scanning items and processing payments accurately so customers stay happy and your business does well.
What causes customers to become unhappy?
Charging for the wrong item or giving incorrect change can upset customers and affect your earnings.

funny-nose-surgery.intro: Funny Nose Surgery is a light-hearted game where you treat Mia's snotty nose with simple medical tasks, then decorate it with wacky stickers. It is a relaxed way to learn basic healthcare routines.
tips: Take each medical task slowly and watch how Mia's nose responds before moving on, since the game is built around simple, step-by-step care.
Pay attention to the order of the treatment, because working through the routine in a steady sequence makes the process easier to follow.
Try out several different stickers to see how the look changes, rather than settling on the first option you pick.
Save the decorating for after the treatment is done, so you can enjoy the creative part once Mia's nose is cared for.
Replay the game to notice small details you missed the first time, especially the healthcare steps you want to remember.
faq: What is the goal of Funny Nose Surgery?
The goal is to treat Mia's snotty nose by completing light-hearted medical tasks. Once the care is done, you can decorate her nose with wacky stickers.
Does the game include written instructions?
No instructions are provided, so the best approach is to explore the on-screen prompts and interact with the items to learn how each step works.

wild-manager.intro: Wild Manager is a 3D zoo management game where you walk around your park, build and upgrade habitats, look after animals, and grow a small zoo into a busy wildlife destination.
tips: Plan your route before you move. Since upgrades and income are spread across the park, walking to several highlighted areas in one trip saves time.
Collect income regularly so you have funds ready for the next habitat or facility upgrade instead of waiting idle.
Keep your animals cared for alongside building. Expanding quickly while neglecting animal care can slow your progress overall.
Upgrade roads and facilities with the rest of the park in mind, since completion depends on finishing all upgrades rather than a few favorites.
Check the park's overall progress from time to time so you can see which projects are closest to done and focus on those first.
faq: What is the goal of Wild Manager?

The goal is to turn your small zoo into a thriving wildlife destination by building habitats, caring for animals, and completing park projects. Finishing all upgrades brings the park to 100% completion.
How do I move my keeper and interact with the park?
Use WASD or the arrow keys to move the keeper. On mobile, use the on-screen joystick or tap to move, and walk to highlighted areas to build, upgrade, or collect income.

super-sergeant-2.intro: Super Sergeant 2 is a 3D shooter for one player with five levels. Your goal is to find the exit on each level while fighting off waves of enemies with three weapon types.
tips: Before moving on, check which weapon suits the enemies in front of you, and switch with the mouse wheel rather than sticking with one gun.
Reload during a lull in the action so you are not caught with an empty weapon when a horde arrives.
Use the aim button for closer, more precise shots, and fire from a distance when enemies are coming at you in groups.
Keep an eye out for the exit as you move, so you know the route forward even while busy shooting.
Save your grenade for crowds or tight spots where several enemies are grouped together, instead of using it on a single target.
faq: What is the goal of Super Sergeant 2?
Your mission is to find the exit on each of the five levels while shooting the enemies you meet along the way.
How many weapons are available and how do I switch between them?
There are three types of weapons. Use the mouse wheel to change weapons during play.

collect-the-gift.intro: Collect the Gift is a festive puzzle game set in a magical workshop. Your job is to guide each gift safely into Santa's bag using ropes, slingshots, and switches.
tips: Study the whole screen before you act, and note every rope, slingshot, and switch that could affect the gift's path.
Plan the order of your actions. Some moves may change what happens next, so think a step ahead.
Watch where the gift is heading after each action, and adjust your plan if it is moving away from Santa's bag.
If a puzzle feels stuck, try a different tool or sequence instead of repeating the same move.
Play in short sessions so you can keep fresh eyes on tricky layouts.
faq: What is the goal of Collect the Gift?
Guide each gift to Santa's bag by solving the puzzle on each screen.
What tools do I use to move the gifts?
The game uses ropes, slingshots, and switches. Cutting ropes, launching slingshots, and triggering switches help each package reach its destination.

spinning-cat-clicker.intro: Spinning Cat Clicker is a clicker game where you boost a whirling cat's speed and try to beat your own best results. It mixes humor and strategy in a meme-filled challenge.
tips: Build a steady clicking rhythm early instead of clicking in short, frantic bursts, since consistent input is what keeps the cat's speed climbing.
Pay attention to how your speed changes after each action so you can tell which habits help and which slow you down.
Play in short sessions and note your best result, so each attempt has a clear target to beat.
When you feel your focus slipping, take a short break and come back, because a fresh start often helps you spot better timing.
Compare each run to your previous personal best rather than to other players, which keeps the challenge fair and makes progress easier to see.
faq: What is the goal of Spinning Cat Clicker?
The goal is to boost the spinning cat's speed and beat your own personal best results. Each run is a chance to improve on your last one.
How do I get a higher score?
Keep your clicking steady and avoid long pauses, since the cat's speed depends on your continued input. Track what you did in your fastest runs and repeat those habits.

cargo-truck-simulator-2025.intro: Cargo Truck Simulator 2025 is a driving game where you control a powerful truck on challenging roads. Your job is to pick up a stranded car and deliver it safely to its destination.
tips: Use the WASD keys to steer and control speed, and ease off the throttle before sharp turns so the truck stays stable.
Study the terrain ahead before you commit to a route, since uneven ground can tip or slow a heavy vehicle.
Keep the stranded car in mind as cargo: sudden braking and hard cornering put it at risk, so take corners smoothly.
Watch for obstacles early and leave yourself enough distance to steer around them rather than correcting at the last second.
Take each level slowly at first to learn how the truck handles, then increase your pace once you know its limits.
faq: What is the goal of Cargo Truck Simulator 2025?
Pick up the stranded car and deliver it safely to the destination on each level. Completing each level with precision is the main challenge.
Which keys control the truck?
The game is played with the WASD keys. Use them to drive the truck through the course.

coins-rush-run.intro: Coins Rush Run is a 3D game where you guide coins along a moving track to raise their value. You dodge colorful barriers, pick up scattered coins, and aim for big multipliers in a Pachinko-style finale.
tips: Keep an eye on the track ahead so you can react to barriers before they reach your coins.
Collect scattered coins whenever it is safe, since they add to the value you carry toward the finale.
Stay calm and steady rather than making sudden moves, which can cost you more than a slow, careful path.
Save your focus for the Pachinko-style finale, where aiming for multipliers can make the biggest difference to your score.
Think ahead about which route gives you the best mix of safe coin collection and a strong run into the finale.
faq: What is the main goal of Coins Rush Run?
You guide coins along a 3D track to maximize their value while avoiding barriers and collecting scattered coins. The aim is to build a high score.
How do multipliers help my score?
The game encourages you to aim for massive multipliers in the Pachinko-style finale. Reaching them is a key way to push your score higher.

mini-golf-battle.intro: Mini Golf Battle is a casual mini golf game where you aim to sink the ball in the fewest strokes. Levels add slopes, angles, and obstacles that get harder as you go.
tips: Drag a short distance first to test how strong a shot is before committing to a long pull. Strength rises with the length of your drag, so small adjustments make a big difference.
Before each shot, look for a bounce path off walls and corners. Angled rebounds can carry the ball further than a straight line.
Save the Fire Power boost for long straight runs or wide gaps where you need maximum distance in one strike. Using it on short shots often leads to overshooting.

Use Wing / Glide Power when you want distance but still need control, such as lining up a precise approach to the hole. Its lower friction makes the ball travel farther, so account for that in your aim.
Turn to Spring / Bounce Power when barriers, ramps, or platforms block a normal shot. Its extra push helps you cross obstacles that a regular hit cannot reach.
faq: How do I control how hard the ball is hit?
Drag back from the ball and release. The longer you drag, the stronger the shot, so you can fine-tune power with the length of your pull.
What is the goal of each level?
Get the ball into the hole using as few strokes as possible. Fewer shots is the main measure of how well you played the level.

crazy-cone-sweeper.intro: Crazy Cone Sweeper is a racing game where you steer a car around 50 cones and knock them out of the area. Keep the car inside the boundary while you sweep them all.
tips: Keep the car near the middle of the area so you can reach cones in every direction without drifting toward the edge.
Make small, steady steering inputs with Z and X instead of holding a key down, which helps you avoid overshooting the boundary.
Plan a loop around the cones so each hit pushes them toward the outside, rather than chasing single cones across the field.
Watch the edges of the area as you turn, since a sharp slide is the most likely way for the car to leave the playing space.
Use the drifting tag to your advantage: ease off before a tight turn and let the car slide through the cones instead of braking hard.
faq: What is the goal of Crazy Cone Sweeper?
Sweep all 50 cones out of the area by hitting them. You must also keep your car from leaving the area.
What controls do I use to steer?
Use the Z and X keys or the arrow keys on a keyboard. On a touch screen, press the left or right side of the screen to steer.

cat-rescue.intro: Cat Rescue is a drawing puzzle where you protect a cat from bees by sketching shapes on the screen. Each level needs a different approach, so think before you draw.
tips: Before drawing, look at where the bees are coming from and where the cat sits, then find the simplest shape that blocks them.
Keep your drawing small. The instructions say a larger drawing earns fewer stars, so aim for the shortest line that still protects the cat.
Try to get 3 stars on every level by planning a compact solution rather than rushing into a first idea.
If a level stumps you, try a different type of shape, such as a line, a circle, or a star, since each level calls for a different solution.
Use the touch and drag control with short, deliberate strokes so you can place your drawing exactly where it is needed.
faq: What is the goal of Cat Rescue?
Your goal is to protect the cat from the bees by drawing a shape that keeps them away from him in each level.
How do I draw in the game?
Touch the screen and drag your finger or pointer to draw. Your drawing is what stops the bees from stinging the cat.

arsenal-online.intro: Arsenal Online is a 2D shooter where precision and speed matter across several game modes. This guide covers how to use unlockable weapons, the firing range, and solo or cooperative play.
tips: Spend time at the firing range before a tougher mode, so you can learn how each weapon aims, fires, and feels before it counts.
Try different unlockable weapons in each mode instead of sticking with one, since the right weapon can change how a mode plays.
Focus on accuracy first and speed second, because quick shots that miss tend to cost more time than they save.
In cooperative battles, talk with your teammates about who covers which area and who handles which threat.
If a mode is difficult, switch to solo play to practice at your own pace, then return to multiplayer once your aim feels steady.
faq: What is the main goal of Arsenal Online?
The game is a 2D shooter that tests your precision and speed across different modes. Success comes from mastering each mode and using the weapons you unlock.
Which weapons should I unlock first?

The description does not list individual weapons, so the best approach is to try what you can unlock and see which one suits your play style in each mode. The firing range is a good place to compare them.

get-10.intro: Get 10 is a math puzzle played on a 5x5 grid. You combine matching numbered boxes to grow your tiles and try to reach the number 10.
tips: Look at the whole grid before each move, since every turn can change which combinations are possible later.
Combine tiles in a way that keeps the grid open, so you still have room to make new matches.
Plan two or three moves ahead rather than chasing the first match you see.
Track which numbers are building up on the board and work toward 10 with them, instead of letting small numbers get stuck.
If a move looks risky, pause and check whether it blocks your own future matches before you commit.
faq: What is the goal of Get 10?
The goal is to combine matching numbered boxes on the 5x5 grid until you reach the number 10.
How do I make the game more challenging?
Each move requires careful planning, so the challenge comes from thinking ahead and keeping your options open on the board.

traffic-jam-escape-3d.intro: Traffic Jam Escape 3D is a puzzle game where you tap cars and guide them along their arrows to clear city streets. Each stage gets harder as roads narrow and traffic becomes more crowded.
tips: Before tapping anything, look at the whole jam and find which car is blocking the most others. Clearing that one first often frees several cars at once.
Follow the arrows on each car and plan the order of moves, since one wrong move can block the road for good.
Pay attention to large trucks, which take up more room. Plan their exit early so they don't trap smaller cars behind them.
Finish levels quickly if you want more points, but don't rush so much that you cause a crash. A clean, slower solution is better than a fast jam.
Save boosters like rockets or helicopters for the toughest stages, when you have already tried a few plans and still see no clear path.
faq: What is the main goal of each level?
Tap the cars and guide each one along its path out of the traffic jam until the road is clear.
How do I avoid getting stuck?
Think ahead and plan the order of your moves, because a mistake can create a crash that blocks the way.

cube-drop-puzzle-match-color.intro: Cube Drop Puzzle: Match Color is a brain teaser where you guide falling cubes so each cheerful bear reaches its matching hole and jumps into the aqua lake. Puzzles grow harder as you go.
tips: Check the color of each bear before you drop anything, so you know which hole it needs.
Plan a few drops ahead instead of reacting to each cube as it falls, since early placements often decide how later levels play out.
Look at the whole board before you start, and note which holes are hardest to reach so you can clear the path to them first.
Keep your placements neat and avoid stacking cubes in ways that block a hole you still need.
As levels get more complex, slow down and reconsider your plan if a move feels rushed; a short pause often prevents a costly mistake.
faq: What is the goal of Cube Drop Puzzle: Match Color?
Your goal is to match each colorful bear with its corresponding hole so it can jump into the aqua lake. You do this by placing falling cubes carefully.
Does the game get harder as you play?
Yes. The puzzles become more clever and complex over time, so you will need to think strategically to get through the later levels.

halloween-2024-fps-shooter.intro: Halloween 2024 FPS Shooter is a first-person shooter where you fight zombies to unlock new levels. Move with WASD and aim and fire with the mouse.
tips: Keep moving with WASD instead of standing still, so zombies have a harder time closing in on you from several sides.
Use the mouse to line up each shot before you fire, since every bullet counts when ammo is limited.
Watch the ground as you play, because ammo pickups are there to find and you will need them when your bullets run low.
Aim for the zombies that are closest to you first, so the ones that could reach you quickly are dealt with early.
Try to clear enemies in steady rounds rather than rushing ahead, which keeps you from running out of bullets in the middle of a crowd.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Your goal is to shoot as many zombies as possible so you can unlock new levels.
How do I move and shoot?
Use the WASD keys to walk around and the mouse to shoot.

sector-nine-lockdown.intro: Sector Nine: Lockdown is a sci-fi arcade shooter set in a fallen research facility. Fight through three sectors, restore power, and search for hidden rooms.
tips: Look for secret rooms as you go, since uncovering them is part of the game. Pausing to check corners and unusual paths can be worth the time.
Work through the sectors one at a time rather than rushing ahead. Each sector is a separate stage of the same facility, so getting comfortable with one helps with the next.
Keep your clicks or taps deliberate instead of frantic. Short, controlled inputs are easier to aim and react with during fights.
Watch for the power-restoration objectives, because progress through the facility depends on them. Note where you have already been so you do not backtrack without a reason.
If a sector feels hard, take a short break and return with a fresh view of the layout. Small adjustments to how you move and aim can make a big difference.
faq: What is the goal of Sector Nine: Lockdown?
You fight through a fallen research facility, restore power, and survive three sectors of sci-fi action. Uncovering secret rooms is also part of the challenge.
How do I control the game?
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps. There are no other control schemes mentioned in the instructions.

ragdoll-football-online.intro: Ragdoll Football Online is a physics soccer game where every player flops around the pitch. You choose a mode, push your player with drag or keys, and score more goals than the other team.
tips: Use short, controlled drags when you are close to the ball, since a longer drag sends your player much harder and can make you overshoot.
Before you shoot, check where your player will land after the push, because the tumble can carry you away from the ball.
Practice alone first to learn how strength and direction interact before you face bots in 1v1 or 2v2.
In 2v2, keep one player near your goal and send the other forward so you are not both chasing the ball in the same spot.
Watch the replays after a goal or a missed chance to see which push angle worked and which one sent your player off course.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Score more goals than the other team in your chosen mode. Each match is about getting the ball into the opponent's goal.
How do I move my player?
Press on the pitch, drag in the direction you want to move, and release. On a keyboard, hold a WASD or arrow key and release it to push.

archers-io.intro: Archers.io is a multiplayer archery game where you start alone and build an army by recruiting allies. Battles against rival teams test your positioning and timing.
tips: Recruit wandering allies early, since a bigger group gives you more presence on the battlefield before you pick any fights.
Save your power shots for moments when enemies are grouped or when a duel is close, rather than spending them on every target.
Keep your army together instead of spreading out, so you can support each other when rival teams push in.
Watch where rival teams are moving across the battlefield and avoid walking into a larger group without backup.
Pick your PvP duels carefully. Winning a fight you can control is often better than chasing a risky one that drains your army.
faq: What is the main goal of Archers.io?
The goal is to survive and dominate the battlefield by growing your army, using power shots, and winning PvP duels against rival teams.
How do I get stronger during a match?
Recruit wandering allies to add to your army. A larger army helps you hold ground and take on rival teams.

gangsta-duel.intro: Gangsta Duel is a street fighting game where you face a large wave of enemies and a street gangsta. You attack with mouse clicks or taps and use your combat skills to take them all down.
tips: Watch how the enemies approach before you commit to an attack, so you can react to the wave instead of reacting late.
Save your powerful combat skills for tougher moments when several enemies are close together, rather than spending them early.
Keep your clicks or taps steady and deliberate. Rapid, careless input can leave you open to counterattacks.
Focus on clearing the enemies closest to you first, so the crowd does not surround you.
Pay attention to the street gangsta duel itself, since it is the main confrontation the game builds toward.
faq: What is the goal of Gangsta Duel?
The goal is to fight through a large wave of enemies and destroy all of them, including the street gangsta you face off against.
How do I attack in Gangsta Duel?
You play with mouse clicks or taps. Click or tap to attack and to trigger your combat moves.

mommy-pregnant-caring.intro: Mommy Pregnant Caring is a girls game where you look after Sofia on a day she has a hospital appointment. You help her freshen up, go to her examination, and then cook dinner after she gets home.
tips: Work through the steps in the order the game gives them: freshen up first, then the hospital visit, then dinner. Each stage builds on the last.
Pay attention to what Sofia needs before you move on, since the hospital trip comes after getting ready.
Read each on-screen prompt carefully before clicking, because the game is played with mouse clicks or taps and small choices affect the next step.
When it is time to cook, follow each action in sequence rather than rushing, so the dinner comes together smoothly.
Take your time with the makeover and dressing parts; there is no need to hurry through them.
faq: What is the main goal of Mommy Pregnant Caring?
Your goal is to help Sofia freshen up, take her to the hospital for an examination, and then make a delicious dinner after she returns home.
How do I control the game?
Use mouse clicks or taps to play. Follow the on-screen prompts to move through each part of the day.

airport-controller.intro: Airport Controller puts you in charge of a busy airport, where you guide planes, keep them refueled and repaired, and board passengers while the clock runs. Staying calm and organized is the key to keeping traffic moving.
tips: Before you send a plane anywhere, check whether it needs fuel, repairs, or passengers, so it does not stall on the ground later.
Handle landings first when several planes are approaching, since incoming aircraft are the easiest to lose control of.
Keep an eye on the clock and plan your next few moves rather than reacting only to the plane in front of you.
Use the pause key (P) when the screen gets crowded, then review which planes need attention before you resume.
Spread your resources across the airport instead of pouring them into one plane, so that no single flight falls far behind.
faq: What is the main goal of Airport Controller?

You manage the airport by guiding planes to their destinations, keeping them safe, and handling refueling, repairs, and boarding. The aim is to keep everything running smoothly without delays or accidents.
How do I move a plane?
Click and drag a plane with the mouse to the location you want it to go. Dragging is the main way you control every aircraft on the screen.

intergalactic-battleship.intro: Intergalactic Battleship is a space-themed take on the classic board game. Your goal is to outsmart alien forces by locating and destroying their hidden ships before they can be found by you.
tips: Start by firing in a spread-out pattern across the board, such as a checkerboard layout, so you cover more area and find ships faster.
After a hit, focus on the squares next to it, since ships occupy several connected spaces in a line.
Keep a mental note of every shot you have taken so you do not waste turns on squares you already checked.
When a ship is destroyed, look at the remaining open areas and think about where the larger ships could still fit.
Stay patient and methodical instead of guessing at random, because steady, logical shots usually beat rushed ones.
faq: What is the main goal in Intergalactic Battleship?
You must locate and destroy the enemy alien ships hidden on the board. Clearing them out is how you save Earth.
How can I find enemy ships more quickly?
Spread your early shots across the board rather than clustering them together. Once you score a hit, check the squares around it to finish off that ship.

stick-box-ragdoll-slowmo.intro: Stick Box is a physics-based stickman action game where you control a flexible blue ragdoll fighting waves of red stickmen and bosses. Drag his body and arms to move, attack, and pick up weapons as you clear each level.
tips: Drag the body first to reposition your ragdoll before swinging at enemies, since a well-placed body usually makes arm attacks more effective.
