Grab a weapon as soon as one is within reach, because weapons like bats or pistols deal more damage than bare hands.
Look at each level's layout before acting and plan which enemies to handle first, since the description notes strategy matters alongside dexterity.
Use nearby objects as makeshift weapons when you have nothing better, because some items can inflict strong damage on enemies.
Save your approach for bosses by watching how they move before engaging, and keep your ragdoll positioned so you can react quickly.
faq: What is the goal of Stick Box?
Defeat all enemies and bosses to complete each level, then move on to the next one in order.
How do I control my character?
Click and drag the body to move around the level, and drag the arms to attack enemies.

carrom-club.intro: Carrom Club is a browser board game where you flick a striker to pot coins and sink the queen. Build your coin stash as you move from casual games to high-stakes tables.
tips: Line up your striker with the rail before you shoot, since a clean starting position makes each flick easier to control.
Pull back gently for short shots and harder for long ones, and make a few test flicks to learn how the physics carry the striker.
Look for shots that pot a coin and leave your striker in a useful spot for the next turn, not just any shot that scores.
Watch your opponent's last few shots to see which coins they are targeting, and choose a line that blocks or competes with them.
Place your bets carefully, especially early on, so that a losing round does not wipe out the coins you need to move up to bigger tables.
faq: How do I aim and shoot the striker?
Drag the striker left or right along the rail, then pull back to set the power and angle, and release to shoot. Mobile uses the same controls with touch.
How do I win a match?
Pot coins and sink the queen to outplay your opponent. The description does not list specific scoring values, so focus on clean pots and good positioning.

cool-escape-obby-man.intro: Cool Escape Obby Man is a prison escape game where you outwit guards, leap across platforms, dodge traps, and solve riddles to get free. Careful observation matters as much as quick reactions.
tips: Before you jump, study the platforms and traps ahead so you can plan the route instead of reacting at the last second.
Watch how the guards move and react, and look for a moment when they are distracted or out of position.
Search each area for hidden clues, since they often point toward the solution to the next riddle or obstacle.
When you find a makeshift tool, think about which obstacle it could help with before you use it.
If a riddle stalls you, step back and re-read the clues you have collected so far, as the answer is usually already hinted at in them.
faq: What is the main goal of Cool Escape Obby Man?
Your goal is to escape the prison by getting past the guards, traps, and perilous platforms, and by solving the riddles along the way.
How do I get past the guards?
Use your surroundings and any tools you find to outwit them rather than trying to fight your way through. Timing your moves around their positions is often the safest approach.

miner-builder.intro: Miner Builder is a construction game where you drive a bulldozer to collect cubes and use a crane to build a skyscraper. Your goal is to build the tallest one in the world.
tips: Collect cubes with the bulldozer first, since the crane needs cubes to build a house and earn coins.
Watch your coin total and decide what to buy next: a conveyor belt, an assistant, or an equipment upgrade.
Upgrade your construction equipment when you can afford it, so each trip to collect or build goes faster.
Keep an eye on the gauge when boarding a machine, since you have to wait for it to fill before you can get in.
Use the upgrade menu to unlock new cube types as you progress, and check which ones you have available before building.
faq: How do I get into a bulldozer or crane?
Walk up to the machine and wait for the gauge to fill. Once it is full, you will board it.
How do I get out of a machine?
Press the button shown in the game to exit the bulldozer or crane.

signal-survival-block-arena.intro: Signal Survival Block Arena is a 3D arcade survival game where you race across obstacle-filled courses while watching a sentinel. You move when it is safe and must reach the finish before time runs out.
tips: Watch the sentinel closely before every step and only move during the windows when it is safe to do so.
Use short, controlled moves instead of holding a key down, so you can stop quickly if the sentinel changes.
Study each of the five stages early on and note where the obstacles sit so you can plan your route in advance.
Keep an eye on the clock and decide how much time you can afford to wait for a safe moment on each course.
If you are playing on touch, make small, steady joystick movements so you keep control of your character near danger.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Reach the finish of each course before time runs out without getting caught by the sentinel.
How do I move my character?
On desktop, use W A S D or the Arrow Keys. On touch devices, use the on-screen joystick.

dunk-up-basketball.intro: Dunk Up Basketball is an arcade skill game where you climb a tall wall by launching a ball off trampoline nets and sinking shots into hoops. Each clean shot moves you higher.
tips: Treat every shot as a fresh attempt and take a moment to line it up before you launch.
Since one miss sends you tumbling back, prioritise accuracy over speed when you are already high on the wall.
Pay attention to how the trampoline nets bounce the ball, and use that behaviour to plan where your shot will land.
Aim for the hoop with a steady, deliberate approach rather than rushing, because seamless shots are what score big.
If you slip back, use the lower section to rebuild your rhythm before attempting the harder climb again.
faq: What is the main goal of Dunk Up Basketball?
The goal is to climb the towering wall by launching the ball and making shots into hoops. Each successful shot helps you rise higher.
What happens if I miss a shot?
One miss sends you tumbling back down the wall, so every shot matters. Staying accurate is the key to keeping your progress.

bubble-trouble.intro: Bubble Trouble is a retro arcade shooter where you control a devil with a spike gun. Pop bouncing bubbles before they overwhelm the screen, and use quick reflexes to dodge them.
tips: Line up directly under a bubble before you fire, since the description says this gives the best shooting angle.
Pop the largest bubbles first, working down to the smaller ones, so the threats you have to track stay as few as possible.
Keep moving rather than standing still, because bubbles bounce around the screen and can reach you quickly.
Watch the smaller, faster bubbles that appear after each hit and plan your position before they arrive.
If you play with a second player, agree on who handles which bubbles so you do not both chase the same target.
faq: What is the goal of Bubble Trouble?
Pop all the bubbles on each level, starting with the largest and working down to the smallest, to clear the screen.
How do I shoot and move?
Player 1 uses the left and right arrow keys to move and the spacebar to shoot. Player 2 uses A and D to move and Q to shoot.

basket-random.intro: Basket Random is a physics basketball game where each player uses a single key to try to score. Play against the CPU or a friend, and be the first to reach 5 points.
tips: Spend your first few games against the CPU to see how the ball reacts to a single key press before you play for points.
The fields, players and balls change from game to game, so watch the new setup for a moment before you press your key.
Because you only have one key, focus on consistent timing rather than pressing repeatedly and hoping for a score.
In 2 player mode, take turns watching each other's shots, since the first player to 5 points wins and small advantages add up.
If you are on a touch device, practice with a few taps first so you know how the controls respond before a match.
faq: What is the goal of Basket Random?
Score baskets using your single key and be the first player to reach 5 points to win the game.
Which keys do I use?
Player 1 uses the W key and Player 2 uses the Up Arrow key. Touch controls are also available on mobile devices and tablets.

knight-bolts-merge-edition.intro: Knight Bolts: Merge Edition is a puzzle game where you gather knights, merge them into stronger warriors, and defend the kingdom from attacking orcs. Plan your drops carefully to build up power before you unleash your army.
tips: Before dropping a knight, look at where your existing knights sit so you can line up matching warriors for a merge.
Hold off on unleashing until you have built enough power, since the lock is your attack and releasing early can leave your defense weak.
Drop knights with a deliberate drag and release at the spot you want, rather than rushing, so you do not place them somewhere that blocks future merges.
Merge knights whenever you can, because stronger warriors are the main way to handle tougher orc attacks.
Pay attention to how full your side of the screen is, and keep room free so you always have space to place the next knight.
faq: What is the main goal of Knight Bolts: Merge Edition?
Your goal is to defend the kingdom from evil orcs by gathering knights, merging them into stronger warriors, and fighting back.
How do I place a knight on the screen?
Drag your finger or mouse to the position where you want the knight, then release to drop it there.

scary-halloween-adventure.intro: Scary Halloween Adventure is a point-and-click game set in haunted houses, creepy forests, and dark caves. You solve puzzles and try to escape monsters while getting through the night.
tips: Click slowly around each new scene and look at everything, since clues and useful objects can be easy to miss in the dark.
Try items and objects you have collected on different things in the scene before giving up on a puzzle.
Keep moving when you hear or see a monster nearby instead of stopping to explore, because lingering gives it time to reach you.
If you get stuck, return to earlier areas and check them again, as something you skipped may now be useful.
Play in short sessions so you stay focused on the clues and do not rush through the scary parts.
faq: What is the goal of Scary Halloween Adventure?
The goal is to make it through the night by solving puzzles, navigating eerie locations, and escaping the monsters you meet along the way.
How do I control the game?
Use a mouse click or tap to interact with the scene, choose where to go, and select objects or puzzle options.

super-count-masters.intro: Super Count Masters is a casual stickman fight game where you guide your stickman with the mouse on PC or with taps on a touch screen. It is built for quick, fun sessions.
tips: Make small, steady mouse movements on PC so your stickman stays under control instead of overshooting.
On a touch screen, tap deliberately and watch where your stickman lands before tapping again.
Keep your eyes on the action rather than only on your stickman, so you can react to what is happening around you.
Take short play sessions at first to learn how your stickman responds to your input before trying longer runs.
If you get stuck, slow down and reset your focus; casual games like this reward calm, consistent movement over fast, rushed input.
faq: How do I move my stickman on a PC?
Play with the mouse and move the stickman by moving the mouse.
How do I move my stickman on a touch screen?
Tap on the screen to move the stickman.

sustainable.intro: Sustainable is an action game about defending a museum from eco-terrorists who want to vandalize its art. You patrol the galleries, track down suspects, and use your tonfa to stop them before the masterpieces are damaged.
tips: Patrol the galleries steadily instead of rushing to one spot, so you can spot suspicious activity across the whole museum.
Look closely at each suspect before acting, since the game asks you to identify them and not every person you see is the culprit.
Pay attention to the interrogation clues, because the mystery is solved through them and they will help you decide who to catch.
Keep an eye on the time, as the game is a race against the clock and delays can give the vandals a chance to damage the art.
Stay close to the artworks that are most at risk, and act quickly when you see a threat near one of them.
faq: What is the main goal of Sustainable?
Your goal is to catch the culprit behind the vandalism and protect the museum's priceless masterpieces from eco-terrorists.
How do you deal with the suspects?
You identify suspects while patrolling the galleries and use your trusty tonfa to stop them when they try to vandalize art.

hide-n-seek.intro: Hide 'N Seek! is a 3D arcade maze game with two modes. You either run from captors and collect diamonds, or hunt hidden escapees as the captor. Movement is controlled by sliding.
tips: In escape mode, plan your route so you collect diamonds while keeping away from the captors, rather than grabbing the nearest one and getting cornered.
Keep an eye on the clock in escape mode, since you only have a limited time to evade. Stop collecting only when you can still get back out of danger.
As the captor, you cannot see the escapees, so search the maze in a steady pattern instead of revisiting the same corridors.
Use the maze walls to break line of sight when you are escaping, and avoid long dead-end paths where you could be trapped.
Try each mode several times, since learning how the maze is laid out makes it easier to predict where to go next.
faq: What is the goal in escape mode?
You run away from your captors for a limited time and collect diamonds while doing so.
What is the goal as the captor?
You search the maze for escapees who are hiding, even though you cannot see them.

final-christmas-run.intro: Santa has 100 gifts left to deliver before Christmas morning. Fly the sled, drop presents down chimneys, and get them to the kids waiting in the windows.
tips: Use the arrow keys in small adjustments rather than holding them down, so you can line Santa up over a chimney or window before you drop.
Press space bar when the sled is directly above a target, since a present released early or late can miss.
On city levels, use the mouse to aim your throws at the windows, and watch where the previous throw landed before adjusting.
Keep an eye on how many of the 100 gifts you have left so you can judge how much you can afford to miss.
If you are on a touch screen, practice with the on-screen controls first so your movements feel steady before the harder stages.
faq: What is the goal of Final Christmas run?
You fly Santa on his sled and deliver presents to kids in the windows before Christmas morning, starting with 100 gifts to deliver.
How do I drop presents?
Press the space bar to drop a present while flying over a chimney or window. On city levels, you also use the mouse to throw presents.

puzzledom-one-line.intro: Puzzledom: One Line is a casual drawing puzzle where you connect the pieces of each level with lines. It has six ways to play, and each level gets harder to solve.
tips: Study the whole level before you draw anything. Look at where each character starts and where it needs to go so you can plan the route.
Test the easiest-looking path first, but be ready to switch if it blocks another route. Many of these puzzles depend on the order of moves.
Watch for places where paths could cross or where characters could collide. Plan your lines so they keep each character clear of the others.
Try all six ways to play, not just one. Different modes may build different skills, so the one you find hardest may improve your solving in the others.
If you get stuck, step away for a moment and come back with fresh eyes. A new look at the layout often reveals a route you missed.
faq: What is the goal of Puzzledom: One Line?
Your goal is to draw lines that solve each level, such as guiding boys and girls to the correct toilet without them colliding. Each level is a brain teaser that requires you to find the right path.
How do I control the game?
You play with a mouse click or by tapping. Click or tap to draw your lines through each level.

candy-for-capybara.intro: Candy for Capybara is a matching puzzle where you join identical marmalades into bigger candies and use a crane to grab treats for your capybara. It has 36 levels and an endless high-score mode.
tips: Before you drop a candy, look for an identical marmalade it can touch, since matching is how you build bigger candies.
Because candies bounce, stick, and deform when they collide, drop them gently so they settle where you want instead of sliding off the pile.
Plan your crane moves ahead of time. Line the crane up over the treat first, then release, so you don't waste grabs.
Use the early levels to learn how the jelly physics behaves, then move to the harder candy combinations once the drops feel predictable.
Try endless high-score mode when you want practice without a level goal, and compare your best score with friends.
faq: How do I make bigger candies?
Match identical marmalades by moving them next to each other so they combine into a larger candy.
What is the difference between the mouse and keyboard controls?
With the mouse you click and drag candies and release to drop them, while with the keyboard you use the arrow keys to move and Space to drop.

break-the-candy.intro: Break the Candy is an arcade game where you aim and shoot to smash sugary obstacles across a range of levels. Your shots are limited, so each one needs to count.
tips: Before you shoot, look at the whole level and find the obstacles that are linked together. A single well-placed shot can set off a chain reaction that clears more than one.
Pay attention to how many shots you have left and plan your next move before firing. Spending a shot on a small target when a bigger cluster is in reach often costs you points.
Try different angles on the same level to learn how the candy breaks. Noticing which shots create the biggest reactions will help you aim better next time.
If a level stalls, step back and reconsider the layout rather than firing randomly. Targeting the structure that holds other candy in place can open up the rest of the board.
Once you feel comfortable, try a level again to beat your earlier score. You can also challenge a friend on the same level to compare your results.
faq: What is the goal of Break the Candy?
Your goal is to break the sugary obstacles in each level by aiming and shooting. Clearing them well earns you a high score.
How do chain reactions help my score?
When one shot sets off a series of breaks, you can clear more candy with a single shot. Look for setups where one hit can trigger several others.

popular-hair-salon-game.intro: Popular Hair Salon is a quick haircut game where you run a barber shop, serving customers one after another. You wash hair, style it, and then pick outfits to finish each look.
tips: Wash the customer's hair first, since the description says to do this before styling.
Don't linger too long on any one customer, because the waiting guests need help quickly.
Plan the haircut before the clothes so the outfit you pick suits the finished style.
Try a few clothing options before settling, and compare how each one makes the customer stand out.
Keep your pace steady across customers so the shop keeps moving through the day.
faq: What is the goal of Popular Hair Salon?
You serve customers in your barber shop by washing their hair, designing hairstyles, and then matching clothes for them.
What controls do I use?
Use your mouse or tap the screen to make your selections and move through each step.

tall-noob-man.intro: Tall Noob Man is a 3D runner where you steer a blocky hero through number gates to grow taller and wider, then finish each level with a boxing boss fight. Keep your height high and your reactions quick.
tips: Steer early and steadily so you can line up with blue, purple, and green gates well before you reach them.
Before hitting a ram block, read the height written on each one and choose the lower number, since that is the cost you pay.
Treat red gates as obstacles to avoid, and keep an eye on saws, hammers, boxing gloves, and bowling balls as you run.
In the boss fight, watch for the wind-up before his punch and swipe or press A/D to hop back out of range, then punch when you have an opening.
Use the boss's position in the ring to your advantage by knocking him into the pile of crates.
faq: What is the goal of Tall Noob Man?
Run through the level, grow your hero by passing through the right gates, and then defeat the boss in the boxing ring at the finish.
How do I make my character taller or wider?
Run through blue and purple gates to grow taller and green gates to get wider, while avoiding the red gates.

slides-and-climbs.intro: Slides and Climbs is a dice-driven board game based on the English classic that inspired Chutes and Ladders. You roll, move toward the finish, and hope to land on ladders rather than snakes.
tips: Remember that a roll of 6 earns you an extra roll, so keep an eye on how far that bonus can carry your piece.
Since movement depends entirely on the dice, focus on what you can control: check each board square after moving to see whether a snake or a climb is nearby.
When playing with several players, watch the positions of the others, especially anyone close to a snake or a climb that could change their standing.
In a game with up to six players, choose a color that is easy to tell apart on the board so you can track your piece quickly.
Against AI opponents, pay attention to their progress as a benchmark, and stay focused on your own route rather than reacting to every move.
faq: What is the goal of Slides and Climbs?
The goal is to roll the dice, move your piece along the board, and reach the finish line before your opponents.
What happens when I roll a 6?
Rolling a 6 gives you an additional free roll, letting you move again right away.

flames-and-fortune.intro: Flames & Fortune is a card battle game where you work through dungeons that change from run to run. You collect spells and abilities as you go and adapt your plan to each new challenge.
tips: Collect spells and abilities whenever you can, since your options grow over the run and give you more ways to respond to challenges.
Because the dungeons change, avoid locking into one fixed plan. Look at what is in front of you before committing your cards.
Treat each run as a chance to learn. Note which tactics worked against the challenges you faced and try them again when they fit.
Think a few moves ahead in card battles so you can plan how your spells and abilities will work together.
Expect unpredictable challenges and stay flexible. Adjusting your strategy mid-run is often more useful than sticking to your opening choices.
faq: What is the main goal of Flames & Fortune?
The goal is to conquer the dungeons by winning card battles and using the spells and abilities you collect along the way. Each run is a new test of your skill and adaptation.
How can I get better at Flames & Fortune?
Pay attention to how each dungeon and challenge differs, and adjust your tactics to match. Over repeated runs, you will build a better sense of which spells and abilities suit different situations.

hungry-rabbit.intro: Hungry Rabbit is a fast-paced animal game where you help rabbits leap and dash through mini-games to collect carrots. Timing and agility are the keys to getting through each round.
tips: Watch the rabbit's movement for a moment before acting, so you can time your jumps and dashes rather than reacting late.
Since the game is fast-paced, stay focused on what is coming next instead of only on the carrot you are chasing.
Each mini-game may ask for different timing, so pause briefly at the start of a new one to see what it expects.
If you miss a jump or dash, reset your attention quickly and keep your rhythm instead of rushing the next attempt.
Play in short sessions when you are fresh, since quick reactions matter more than long stretches of play.
faq: What is the goal of Hungry Rabbit?
You help the rabbits leap and dash through various mini-games on their quest for carrots.
What controls does the game use?
The game does not list specific controls in its instructions, so check the on-screen prompts when you start playing.

help-tricky-story-a-complicated-story.intro: Help Tricky Story is a point-and-click logic puzzle set in everyday scenarios. You connect, destroy, compose and pull out items to solve riddles and guide the characters to the goal.
tips: Look at every item on screen before you act, since many puzzles depend on objects that seem unrelated at first.
Try a simple, obvious action first, then move on to more unusual combinations if it does not work.
Pay attention to the green dotted line, which marks the final goal, and work backward from it to see what needs to happen first.
When you feel stuck, step back and think about the problem from a different angle, as the game rewards thinking outside the box.
Keep track of which items you have already used so you do not repeat the same moves while searching for the next step.
faq: What is the goal of Help Tricky Story?
Your aim is to solve each logic puzzle and help the characters reach the final goal, which is shown by a green dotted line.
What kinds of actions do I perform in this game?
You control various items to connect, destroy, compose and pull them out in order to solve each puzzle.

cardivo-adventure.intro: Cardivo Adventure is a card-sorting puzzle where you move cards between stacks to group them into themed, colorful sets. Clear every required card before your moves run out.
tips: Before moving anything, scan the whole board to see which cards are hidden and which stacks are already close to complete.
Plan two or three moves ahead, since a move that looks helpful can bury a card you need later.
Clear stacks that only need one or two more cards first, because emptying a space gives you more room to work with.
Save boosters for layouts that stall you after several attempts rather than using them at the start.
If you run out of moves, retry the level and try a different order of moves instead of repeating the same sequence.
faq: What is the goal of Cardivo Adventure?
Sort every card into its matching themed stack to complete the level before you run out of moves.
How do I move cards on desktop?
Use the left mouse button to select a card and move it to another stack.

snowboard-knockout-race-game.intro: Snowboard Knockout is a downhill race where eight riders share one mountain. You steer through gate flags, land tricks for points, and try to finish at or above the place each stage asks for.
tips: Pass through the gate flags before you chase tricks, because a missed gate costs you more than a trick is worth.
Spin only as far as you need on a kicker, and let go early so you land clean. A clean landing keeps your combo going.
Use the grab with Shift while you are in the air to add trick variety when you are already spinning.
Throw a snowball with F at riders who are close in front of you to knock them off balance and open a line past them.
Grab the snowmobile burst when you are behind the placing a stage asks for, and save it for a stretch where you can make up the most ground.
faq: How do I win a stage?
You need to finish at or above the placing the stage asks for, so a clean race matters more than a single big trick. Keep your line through the gate flags and avoid wipeouts.
What does a combo do for my score?
Every trick you land clean adds to a combo, so landing tricks one after another builds your points. A bad landing breaks the chain, so land cleanly before you try a bigger trick.

kitty-jewel-quest.intro: Kitty Jewel Quest is a match 3 puzzle game where you line up kittens of the same type in rows or columns while racing against the clock. Here are some tips to help you beat the levels.
tips: Look for three or more kittens of the same type in a row or column before making a move, since that is what counts as a match.
Keep an eye on the timer from the start, and favor moves that clear several kittens at once so you don't run out of time.
Scan the whole board for matches you can make, rather than always working in the same corner.
Check your missions and special events regularly, because they are the main way to gather coins.
Save your coins for boosters when a level feels too hard, since boosters are there to make levels easier.
faq: What is the basic goal of Kitty Jewel Quest?
Connect at least three kittens of the same type in a row or column to clear them and beat each level. You need to do this before the clock runs out.
How do I earn coins in the game?
Complete missions and special events to gather coins. Coins can then be used to buy boosters.

baby-hazel-at-beach.intro: Baby Hazel at Beach is a casual girls and kids game about a day at the seaside. You help Baby Hazel pack her gear and look after her needs while she enjoys the sand and sea.
tips: Pack the essentials first before you start the fun activities, so Baby Hazel is ready for the beach.
Keep an eye on her needs as the day goes on and attend to them before they pile up.
Try the different beach activities one at a time so you can enjoy each one fully.
Explore the sand, sea, and drink options to see what the game offers before settling on a routine.
Play at a relaxed pace, since the game is built around a calm vacation day with no time pressure mentioned.
faq: What is the goal of Baby Hazel at Beach?
The goal is to help Baby Hazel enjoy a beach vacation by packing her important accessories and gears and taking care of all her needs.
How do I play Baby Hazel at Beach?
Click or tap to play the game and follow the steps as Baby Hazel moves through her beach day.

bushman-bamboo.intro: Bushman Bamboo is an arcade game about bridging gaps with bamboo sticks. You stretch each stick across a gap, and your timing and precision decide whether you make it across.
tips: Before you stretch, look at the width of the gap and the position of the platforms so you know roughly how long the bamboo needs to be.
Spend your first level getting a feel for the controls, since the game is built around intuitive controls and you will rely on them for every jump.
Keep your timing steady rather than rushing. Precision matters more than speed in this game.
Expect each level to get harder as the excitement escalates, so note what worked on earlier levels and reuse those habits.
If you have only a few minutes, play a short session and stop after a level. The game suits both quick sessions and longer play, so you can pick whichever fits your time.
faq: What is the goal of Bushman Bamboo?
Your aim is to stretch bamboo sticks across perilous gaps and get your character through each level. Each level tests your skills more than the one before.
How do the controls work?
The game uses intuitive controls, so most players can pick them up quickly. Spend a few moments on the first level to get comfortable before the gaps get harder.

halloween-merge-mania.intro: Halloween Merge Mania is a spooky puzzle game inspired by Suikagame. Combine creepy characters, starting with pumpkins and bats, to unlock higher-level monsters like Frankenstein and Jack Skellington.
tips: Build your chain from the lower-level characters first, since the higher monsters only appear when you merge the ones below them.
Keep the area you are working in clear so you always have room to place the next character without blocking your own merges.
Look for matching characters before you click, and plan a merge that will set up another one right after it.
Take your time with each click or tap rather than rushing, because a single poor placement can make later merges harder to reach.
Play in short sessions and notice which merges you find easiest, so you can repeat the approach that is working for you.
faq: What is the goal of Halloween Merge Mania?
The goal is to merge Halloween characters into higher-level creatures. You start with pumpkins and bats and work up toward monsters like Frankenstein and Jack Skellington.
How do I play?
You play with a mouse click or a tap. Use your click or tap to place characters and trigger merges.

car-care-repair-dudu-mechanic.intro: Car Care Repair DuDu Mechanic is a casual simulation puzzle where you play as a mechanic fixing clients' cars. You work through problems such as broken windows, cracked doors, flat tires, and motor faults.
tips: Look at each car carefully before you act, since the problem is usually visible, such as a broken window, a cracked door, or a flat tire.
Work out which problem is the main one first, because a car may have more than one issue and fixing the obvious one may reveal the next.
If a repair needs a part you do not have, check whether a missing piece is holding you back and handle that step before moving on.
Take your time with each tap or click, since this is a casual game and rushing can lead to mistakes in the order of your repairs.
Pay attention to the motor and tire problems, as these tend to affect whether the car can be sent back to the client.
faq: What do I do in Car Care Repair DuDu Mechanic?
You act as a mechanic and help clients whose cars have problems like broken windows, cracked doors, flat tires, malfunctioning motors, or missing parts.
How do I control the game?
Use mouse clicks or taps to select tools, parts, and car areas to repair.

stickman-bow-clash.intro: Stickman Bow Clash is a one-player archery duel game where you aim and shoot arrows at rival stickmen using only the mouse. Each clash rewards careful aim, timing, and a bit of planning.
tips: Take your time before each shot. Line up your aim first, since precise aiming is what decides most clashes.
Watch where your arrows land and adjust your next shot based on the last one, rather than firing quickly.
Aim for the spot that will do the most damage to your opponent. A well-placed hit tends to send enemies flying more effectively than a rushed one.
Pay attention to the timing of your shots, not just the position. Shooting at the right moment is part of winning each duel.
Expect the ragdoll physics to make results unpredictable. Keep an eye on how the stickman reacts after each hit and plan your next move from there.
faq: How do I control my bow?
The game is played with the mouse only. Use it to aim your bow and release your arrows.
What decides who wins a clash?
Winning depends on your aim, timing, and strategy. Hitting the right spot on your opponent and knocking them off balance helps you win the duel.

wooden-vest.intro: Wooden Vest is a blocky lumber tycoon where you place axes on stumps, carry wood to the chipper and sawmill, and reinvest your earnings into faster progress. Your island keeps earning while you are away.
tips: Get an axe running on a stump early, since the axes chop wood on their own and that automatic income is what grows everything else.
Keep the chipper and sawmill loop moving by carrying wood from the crate in batches so you are not walking back and forth with small loads.
Spend your money on upgrades that speed up income, such as faster axes or better stumps, before buying decorative or convenience items.
Use the Axe Roulette when you have money to spare, but check what each axe does before placing it so your best spots go to your strongest axes.
Before you log off, make sure your stumps are placed and running, because your island earns while you are away and idle setups pay you back in your absence.
faq: What is the main goal of Wooden Vest?
The goal is to build up your lumber island by turning chopped wood into money at the sawmill and reinvesting it in faster axes, better stumps, new floors and a helper.
How do I get money in the game?
Place an axe on a stump so it chops wood, pick up the wood from the crate, throw it into the chipper, and then step on the green pad to collect your money.

liquid-sort-puzzle.intro: Liquid Sort Puzzle is a color logic game where you pour colored water between glasses until each glass holds only one color. Each level is solved by planning pours so that colors stack cleanly.
tips: Before pouring, look at the top layer of every glass, since only matching top colors can be moved together.
Empty a glass completely when you can, because an empty glass gives you room to separate colors that are buried.
Avoid pouring a color onto a glass that has a different color underneath unless you have a clear plan to clear it later.
Try to keep one glass for each color as you go, so you do not split a color across several glasses.
Your goal includes minimal moves, so think a few steps ahead and avoid pours that just undo a previous one.
faq: How do I pour water from one glass to another?
Tap or click the glass you want to pour from, then tap the glass you want to pour into. The pour only happens if the rules allow it.
When can I not pour between two glasses?
You cannot pour if the top colors do not match or if the receiving glass does not have enough room for the liquid.

mini-stilts.intro: Mini Stilts asks you to guide a green slime across small chambers using stilts while avoiding quirky hazards. Careful balance and well-timed moves are the key to getting through each room.
tips: Slow down at the start of each chamber and look at where the hazards sit before you commit to a stilt move.
Focus on timing rather than speed in normal play; a steady, well-timed step usually beats a rushed one.
Practice keeping your balance steady, since each chamber rewards controlled movement over quick mistakes.
Once you feel comfortable, try speedrun mode to push your reflexes and improve your route through each chamber.
If you fall or fail a room, pay attention to exactly what caught you and adjust your approach on the next attempt.
faq: What is the goal of Mini Stilts?
Your goal is to guide the green slime through small chambers using its stilts while overcoming the hazards in each one.
What does speedrun mode involve?
Speedrun mode is a challenge for players who want to test their reflexes and move through the chambers quickly. It is best tried once you are comfortable with the regular play.

little-pumpkin-online-game.intro: Little Pumpkin is an arcade skill game where you guide a pumpkin on a candy-collecting adventure. You dodge obstacles, manage your resources, and aim for a high score.
tips: Look ahead for obstacles before you commit to a path, so you have time to react rather than correcting at the last moment.
Treat your resources as limited and spend them with a purpose, since running out at the wrong time can cost you a run.
Try to collect candy while staying clear of hazards, because a safe route that picks up most of the candy often beats a risky one that grabs a little more.
Play a few short rounds to learn how the pumpkin responds to your inputs before trying to chase a high score.
Note which mistakes end your run and adjust your approach each time, so every attempt teaches you something new.
faq: What is the goal of Little Pumpkin Online Game?
The goal is to guide your pumpkin through a candy-collecting adventure, avoid obstacles, and manage your resources to reach a high score.
How do I control the pumpkin?
The game describes its controls as intuitive, so the best approach is to try the basic movements at the start and see how the pumpkin responds.

city-car-stunt-3.intro: City Car Stunt 3 is a racing game where you complete six routes before time runs out. Each level unlocks a new car, and you can also practice stunts on a large free driving map.
tips: Watch the clock from the start of each route and keep your speed up, since the timer is the main pressure in this game.
Use nitro in the straight sections where you can hold a steady line, rather than on tight turns where it can throw your car off course.
Approach ramps at a controlled speed and aim them straight on, so your car takes off level and lands with better control.
Use the free driving map to test how your car handles jumps and landings before you attempt them on a timed route.
If a run goes badly, press R to restart the level right away instead of losing more time on a route you already know you cannot finish in time.
faq: What is the goal of City Car Stunt 3?
You need to complete six different routes before time runs out. Each level also unlocks a new car to help you in later levels.
What are the controls for two players?
Player 1 moves with the arrow keys, uses nitro with N, and looks back with B. Player 2 moves with W A S D, uses nitro with T, and looks back with C.

noobcraft-house-escape.intro: Noobcraft House Escape is a pixel-style escape game where you explore a house, find hidden items, and solve puzzles. Your aim is to get out through a magical portal.
tips: Search every room before trying the locked exits, since hidden items often unlock the next step.
Keep track of what you have collected, because an item you pick up early may be needed for a puzzle later.
Look closely at the puzzles and the objects around them, since clues are likely placed near the thing they unlock.
Prioritize finding the golden key and the golden coin, as the description ties both to opening the portal.
If you get stuck, go back over rooms you have already checked, as new options can appear after you find other items.
faq: What is the main goal of Noobcraft House Escape?
You explore the house, uncover hidden items, and solve puzzles. Finding the golden key and coin unlocks a magical portal that lets you escape to a new world.
Are there any scores or timers to worry about?
The game description does not mention scoring or a timer, so focus on exploring carefully and solving each puzzle in turn.

funny-walk-fail-run.intro: Funny Walk Fail Run is an arcade action game where you guide a villain across a shaky road. He falls and bumps often, so your job is to help him get through each step of the challenge.
tips: Watch how the villain is leaning before each tap or click, since his balance shifts constantly and a moment's timing can decide whether he stays upright.
Take the road one step at a time rather than rushing ahead, because each section is a separate challenge to get past.
Expect falls and stumbles and keep your attention on recovering quickly instead of getting frustrated after a bump.
Practice short bursts of input and observe how he reacts before trying longer sequences, so you learn his movement pattern.
If you keep failing at the same spot, slow down and pay closer attention to that section, since the same stumble is likely to happen again.
faq: How do I control the villain?
You play with mouse clicks or taps. Use these inputs to help him move forward along the shaky road.
What is the goal of the game?
Your job is to help the villain navigate each step of the shaky road and get through the challenges.

epic-race-game.intro: Epic Race Game is a racing game where speed and strategy matter on unpredictable tracks. You steer past hazards, look for hidden shortcuts, and build your fleet as you progress.
tips: Slow down a little before sharp turns, since losing control on a bend costs more time than a careful entry.
Scan the track ahead for hazards so you have time to react rather than dodging at the last second.
Keep an eye out for hidden shortcuts on each track, and try the same course more than once to learn where they are.
Use your upgrades and customization on the vehicle that suits how you race, rather than spreading them thinly across every option.
When a new vehicle unlocks, compare it with your current one on a familiar track before switching, so you know whether it helps.
faq: What is the goal of Epic Race Game?
The goal is to win races on tough, changing tracks by combining speed with good strategy. Upgrading your fleet helps you take on harder challenges.
How do I get an edge over other racers?
Find hidden shortcuts, handle sharp turns cleanly, and avoid hazards so you keep your speed. Small gains on each lap add up over a race.

bucket-ball.intro: Bucket Ball is a ball puzzle game where you open the gate, then move or use obstacles to guide the ball into the bucket. Each level brings new challenges as you go higher.
tips: Study the whole level before you act, and trace the ball's likely path from the gate to the bucket.
Test one move at a time and watch how the ball reacts before you commit to a plan.
Use the items you are given for the level where they fit best, rather than spending them early.
If you get stuck, try a different obstacle or approach instead of repeating the same move.
Take your time on harder levels, since a careful plan is more likely to succeed than a rushed one.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Guide the ball into the bucket by moving obstacles out of the way or using them to steer the ball, with the help of the items you are given.
How do I earn points?
Each time you finish a level you earn 1 point, and then you move on to a more challenging level.

bricks-breaker-deluxe.intro: Bricks Breaker Deluxe is a neon arcade game where you launch glowing balls with your mouse to break descending bricks. Collect diamonds for power-ups and try endless mode for long runs.
tips: Before each launch, look at where the bricks are packed most densely and aim there, since a ball that hits a dense group can clear more space at once.
Pay attention to the angle you launch at, because the ball's path after each bounce decides which bricks it reaches next.
Make a habit of going for diamonds when they are reachable without risking a poor shot, since they are the source of power-ups.
Keep your aim steady rather than rushing shots, so you can make the precise launches the game rewards.
If you want longer play, try endless mode, and treat each round as a chance to refine your aim rather than just clearing bricks quickly.
faq: How do I control the ball?
You use your mouse to aim and launch the glowing balls at the bricks.
What are the diamonds for?
Collecting diamonds gives you power-ups, which can help you break bricks more effectively.

bubble-mania.intro: Bubble Mania is an arcade bubble shooter where you fire colored balls at matching bubbles in a spinning ring. Clear every colored bubble to finish each level.
tips: Check the ball in the center before you aim, so you know which color you are about to shoot.
Watch the spinning ring for a moment before tapping, and wait until the arrow lines up with a group of the same color.
Look for groups of matching bubbles that will pop together, since clearing a full cluster removes more of the ring at once.
Save power-ups like Bomb and Colorful Ball for tough clusters that are hard to reach with normal shots.
Keep matching and popping steadily instead of rushing, because you need to clear the whole circle to finish the level.
faq: What is the goal of Bubble Mania?
Shoot colored balls at matching bubbles and keep matching until no colored bubbles are left in the circle. That finishes the level.
How do I aim and shoot?
Aim the arrow and tap when it lines up with a group of the same color. The ball in the center is the color you will shoot next.

mavy-the-fish-mom.intro: Mavy The Fish Mom is an idle cooking simulation where you look after your fish children by cooking for them. Money builds up over time, and you spend it on better gear and new eggs.
tips: Start by upgrading your basic equipment as soon as you can afford it, since better gear is the core of progress in an idle game.
Collect the money coming from the fish regularly so you always have enough to buy your next upgrade.
Buy fish eggs once you can afford them, because the instructions say they drop more valuable coins than your starting setup.
Equip an egg before you place it on the nest, so the hatching step is ready to go.
Give each new child a little time to hatch, and keep checking back so you can keep the nest cycle moving.
faq: What is the goal of Mavy The Fish Mom?
The goal is to care for your fish children by cooking food for them while growing your income through upgrades and eggs.
How do I get more money in the game?
Money is collected from the fish, and better equipment and eggs drop more valuable coins over time.

tung-tung-sahur-lol-face.intro: Tung Tung Sahur LOL Face is a playful face-stretching game where you twist a wooden drummer's face into funny expressions. It is about creativity and humor rather than winning.
tips: Try one feature at a time, such as only the mouth or only the eyes, so you can see how each change affects the overall expression.
Push stretches to the extreme and then ease back slightly, since the most comical shapes often sit just past what looks normal.
Aim for a specific look, like a silly grin or a shocked stare, and work toward it deliberately instead of changing things at random.
Compare pairs of expressions side by side in your head, noticing which combinations feel funniest so you can build on them.
Take breaks between experiments to reset your eye, because a fresh look often helps you spot a stretch that would look better.
faq: What is the goal of Tung Tung Sahur LOL Face?
The game has no set goal. You twist and stretch the drummer's wooden face into different comical expressions and enjoy the results.
Does the game have a score or a way to win?
The description does not mention scoring, levels or a winning condition. The focus is on making funny expressions.

sky-city-riders.intro: Sky City Riders is a racing game where you ride your bike along tracks on top of skyscrapers. Finish each track before the timer runs out, and use NITRO to clear long ramps.
tips: Save your NITRO for the long ramps, since the description calls it out as the way to get across them.
Keep an eye on the clock from the start of each track so you know whether you can afford a slow section.
Try Free Driving mode to get comfortable with your bike and to collect the 30 diamonds needed for the Multi-Color Skin.
Aim to finish races on time consistently, because completing 10 races on time unlocks 10 different bike skins.
If you play with a friend using the 2 PLAYER option, use the separate control sets (arrows and Left Shift for Player 1, WASD and N for Player 2) so you don't mix them up.
faq: What is the goal of Sky City Riders?
Complete the tracks in Sky City with your bike before the time runs out. Finishing races on time also unlocks new bike skins.
How do I use NITRO?
Player 1 uses Left Shift and Player 2 uses N. The description says to use NITRO to pass long ramps.

solitaire-card-sort-puzzle.intro: Solitaire Card Sort Puzzle is a color matching game where you sort cards into neat color order on the board. Each level asks for more careful planning than the one before it.
tips: Look over the whole board before your first move so you can see which colors are buried under others.
Plan two or three moves ahead rather than reacting to the next card, since a quick move can block a color you need later.
Clear out a color that is almost finished before starting a new one, so you have space to work with.
Keep your moves steady and deliberate with tap and drag, and double-check where a card will land before you release it.
When you get stuck, step back and reconsider the order of your moves instead of repeating the same attempts.
faq: What is the goal of Solitaire Card Sort Puzzle?
Your goal is to sort the cards on the board so that each color ends up in perfect order.
How do I move the cards?
Use tap and drag to pick up a card and move it to where you want it.

butterfly-coloring-pages-kids.intro: Butterfly Coloring Pages Kids is a drawing game built around butterfly artworks. You fill in simple outlines using a range of colors and brush textures.
tips: Choose a small set of colors that work together before you start, so the finished butterfly looks cohesive.
Try a few different brush textures on the same wing to see how each one changes the look.
Start with lighter colors and add darker shades on top, which makes the wing patterns easier to build up.
Work on one section at a time, such as a single wing, so the outline stays clear and easy to follow.
Experiment with color combinations on a separate area first if you are unsure, then apply your favorite to the main design.
faq: What is the main goal of Butterfly Coloring Pages Kids?
The goal is to turn simple butterfly outlines into colorful artworks by experimenting with colors and brush textures.
Can I try different brush textures on one picture?
Yes, the game lets you experiment with a range of brush textures, so you can mix them within the same artwork.

cs-command-snipers.intro: CS Command Snipers is a first person shooter about elite snipers working through missions in dynamic combat environments. Precision, teamwork, and tactical thinking are central to how it plays.
tips: Take time to study each area before you fire, since the game rewards precise shots over rushing in. Look for the positions where enemies are most likely to appear.
Think of teamwork as part of the plan: decide who covers which area before the action starts, so you are not reacting to threats alone.
Keep an eye on how the environment changes during a mission, because the terrain can open or close different routes and sightlines.
Try to outsmart foes rather than trade shots with them. Waiting for the right moment or drawing enemies into a position you control is often more effective.
If a mission feels too hard, pause to reassess your approach and try a different position or timing on your next attempt.
faq: What is the main goal in CS Command Snipers?
The game centers on completing challenging missions as an elite sniper. The description focuses on precision, teamwork, and outsmarting enemies rather than listing specific objectives.
How do I control my character?
The description and instructions do not list specific controls. Check any on-screen prompts or in-game menus when you start a mission to see how aiming and firing work.

ball-connect.intro: Ball Connect is a puzzle game where you link matching balls through a tangled grid of paths. Plan each connection so lines never cross and you keep enough open space for the rest.
tips: Look at the whole grid before you draw anything. Note which pairs sit in tight spots, since those are often the ones to connect first.
Avoid routes that wall off empty cells. Leaving open space on each side of a path keeps your other pairs reachable.
Check where each line will pass before you commit. A path that looks fine on its own can block a pair you still need to link.
Work through pairs in a steady order rather than jumping around. This makes it easier to spot which connections are still possible.
Take a short break if you get stuck. Coming back with fresh eyes often reveals a route you missed.
faq: What is the goal of Ball Connect?
The goal is to link every pair of matching balls with paths across the grid. Each connection must be completed without crossing another line.
Can paths cross each other?
No. Lines must not cross, so each route needs to be planned so it does not block another pair.

halloween-dentist-for-kids-2.intro: Monsters visit a Halloween dental clinic in this puzzle game. You pick a patient, figure out what is wrong with their teeth, and clean them up with the right tools.
tips: Use the magnifying glass before you start scrubbing so you can see small stains and problem spots clearly.
Check what the problem is first, then pick the tool that matches it. Using the wrong tool on a tooth can waste time.
Clear the mouth with water and suction after each cleaning step so you can see the next tooth problem more easily.
Try a few different characters, since each one has its own set of teeth to work through.
Work across the mouth in a steady pattern, such as left to right, so you don't miss any spots.
faq: What is the goal of Halloween Dentist For Kids 2?
Your goal is to clean the teeth of each monster patient. You do this by matching the right dental tool to each tooth problem.
How do I zoom in on a tooth?
Select the magnifying glass to get a closer look at the mouth. This helps you spot stains and problems that are hard to see at normal size.

modern-sniper-gun-game-sniper-3d.intro: Sniper Shooting Game puts you on rooftops to take aimed shots at enemies below. Complete missions and challenges, aiming for headshots and perfect shots across each level.
tips: Take a moment to scan the area before you fire, since each level is full of danger and enemies may be spread out.
Aim for headshots whenever you can, as the game rewards precise shots and they are the mark of a skilled sniper.
Use the W, A, S, and D keys to shift your position on the rooftop so you get a clear line of sight before you shoot.
Try to stay calm and avoid rushing, because a careful, well-timed shot is more useful than firing quickly at every target.
Replay levels to get used to the controls and the feel of the rifle, which will help you complete missions with cleaner shots.
faq: What is the goal of Modern Sniper Gun Game Sniper 3D?
You play as a sniper on top of buildings, targeting enemies below and completing missions and challenges with perfect shots. Each level adds its own danger and objectives.
How do I move and aim in the game?
Use W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move back, and A or D (or the Left and Right Arrows) to move sideways. Use the mouse to click any buttons in the game.

merge-plane-tycoon.intro: Merge Plane Tycoon is an idle tycoon game about building an air empire. You combine matching planes into stronger aircraft, unlock new jets, and grow your income over time.
tips: Merge planes of the same type whenever you can, since each merge creates a stronger plane with higher value and performance.
Look for the planes that are closest to matching so you can unlock new plane types sooner.
Use your runway space carefully and keep it clear enough to make new merges as you earn money.
Because your fleet keeps growing while you are offline, check back after a break to see what has changed and plan your next merges.
Upgrades boost your income, so focus your early progress on merges that raise your earnings the most.
faq: How do I merge planes?
Drag one plane and drop it onto another plane of the same type using your mouse or touch controls. When they match, they combine into a stronger plane.
Does my fleet grow when I am not playing?
Yes, your fleet keeps growing automatically while you are offline, so your progress continues between sessions.

zombie-parade-defense-3.intro: Zombie Parade Defense 3 is a wave-based defense shooter where zombies arrive in stronger waves. Your goal is to keep your base standing through 10 waves.
tips: The description recommends 2 or 3 player modes, so bring friends if you can. Splitting up the zombie waves across several players makes the base easier to hold.
If you play alone, avoid hitting the medic characters and stay close to them for support. Their help is what keeps your base alive longer.
Use the spider web defense system early in each wave, before the zombies reach your base. It slows the attack so you have more time to shoot.
Use the mouse to activate weapons and power-ups. Save them for the heaviest zombie groups rather than spending them on small waves.
Keep an eye on how close the zombies are to your base and switch guns as needed. Use the base enter and exit control to move in and out when you need to regroup.
faq: What is the goal of Zombie Parade Defense 3?
Your goal is to survive a total of 10 waves. If you reach that point, you win the game.
How do I shoot and use weapons?
Use the mouse to activate weapons and power-ups. Player movement and gun switching use the keys listed in the game's instructions.

robbery-duel.intro: Robbery Duel is a one-player western shooting duel set in a bank robbery theme. You aim, follow the red laser, and fire at the right moment to take down each opponent.
tips: Watch the red laser before you fire, since it shows where your shot is heading. Adjust your aim until the line runs straight to your opponent.
Take your time on each shot. Firing at the right moment matters as much as aiming at the right spot.
Pay attention to how the physics affect your shot angle. Try a few test shots in a level to learn how your weapon behaves before you commit.
Spend the money you earn on upgrading your character and weapon. Choose upgrades that help the playstyle you find most comfortable.
If you miss, replay the level and study how your opponent is positioned. Small changes to your angle can make a big difference across the 20+ levels.
faq: What is the goal of Robbery Duel?
Your goal is to conquer all of your opponents in each bank robbery themed level. Each level is a duel where you aim, fire, and try to defeat your rival.
How do I aim and shoot?
You control everything with the left mouse button. Follow the red laser to find your angle, then press the trigger at the right moment.

mindblow.intro: Mindblow is a word-guessing puzzle where each picture hides a single word. You work out the word by spotting the clever idea the image is built around.
tips: Look at the whole picture before guessing, and ask what concept the image might be showing rather than what objects you see.
Think about how items, positions, or shapes in the image could stand for a word or sound, since the picture is designed around a hidden idea.
Try a few candidate words in your head and check each one against every part of the image, so a clue that fits only one of them stands out.
Save your coins for levels where you are truly stuck, since you earn them for right guesses and can spend them on hints.
If a level stalls you, step away for a moment and come back with fresh eyes, because the answer often becomes clear after a short break.
faq: What is the goal of Mindblow?
Your goal is to discover the hidden word in each image by understanding the concept the picture is built around. Each level has its own word to find.
How do I earn coins and what are they for?
You earn coins for each right guess. You can use them to buy hints when you are stuck on a level.

blocky-dude-gangster-auto-city.intro: Blocky Dude Gangster Auto City is a blocky sandbox crime game set in Auto City. You play a blocky dude who rises through the underworld by driving, fighting and outsmarting rivals.
tips: Try a few different approaches to each situation, since the game describes outsmarting opponents as well as fighting them.
Use the surroundings on purpose. Objects and the layout of the city can help you more than a direct confrontation.
Pay attention to how risky each action is before you commit. The game is built around balancing thrill and danger, so pushing too far can cost you.
Practice driving and fighting in quiet moments before you take on bigger challenges, so you are not learning the basics under pressure.
Experiment with the sandbox freedom to see what works. Trying new ideas is a good way to learn how the city reacts to you.
faq: What is the main goal of Blocky Dude Gangster Auto City?
The description says you rise through the underworld and assert dominance in Auto City. Progress comes from completing crimes and outmaneuvering others while staying alive.
What are the main actions in this game?
The game focuses on driving, fighting and outsmarting. The page does not list specific controls, so the in-game prompts are the best guide.

shotwildwest.intro: ShotWildWest is a fast action game set in a wild west town. Targets pop up quickly, and you test your reflexes by shooting them while trying to beat your previous score.
tips: Keep your eyes moving across the whole screen so you spot new targets as soon as they appear.
Focus on accuracy before speed. Missed shots cost time, so steady clicks often lead to a higher score than rushed ones.
Play a few rounds and note your score each time, so you know exactly what you need to beat on your next attempt.
Stay relaxed and avoid tensing up. Short, smooth movements tend to keep your reactions quicker over a full round.
Take a short break between attempts to reset your focus, especially after a streak of missed targets.
faq: What is the goal of ShotWildWest?
The goal is to shoot rapidly appearing targets in a wild west setting and get the highest score you can. You can also try to outscore your last attempt.
How do I control the game?
The game is played with mouse clicks. Click to shoot at each target as it appears.

super-car-soccer-arena.intro: Super Car Soccer Arena swaps soccer players for powerful sports cars. Drive, drift and boost to smash the giant ball into the enemy goal before time runs out.
tips: Save Nitrous Boost for key moments, such as a quick attack on the ball or a fast recovery when the enemy is pushing forward.
Use Space to brake before tight turns, then steer through the turn so you come out fast instead of losing speed.
Keep the ball in front of your car as you approach it, so each touch sends it toward the goal rather than to the side.
Press C to switch camera views and find the one that shows the ball and your car best during fast play.
If your car flips or gets stuck, press R right away to reset it so you lose as little time as possible in the match.
faq: How do I win a match?
You win by scoring more goals than the enemy team before time is up. Each goal is made by smashing the giant ball into the opponent's goal.
How do I unlock new cars?
The game says you unlock new cars by scoring goals. Keep playing matches and scoring to expand your garage.

cave-escape.intro: Cave Escape is an adventure game where you guide Rudy upward out of a cave by leaping between falling bricks. Quick reactions and careful timing decide how far he gets.
tips: Watch the bricks for a moment before you jump so you can see how they fall rather than reacting to the first one you spot.
Use falling bricks as stepping stones to climb, but keep an eye on where the next one will land so you are not left stranded.
Grab diamonds when they are safely within reach, since they add to your score, but do not take risks that could cost you a life.
Practice the controls in short bursts to build a feel for Rudy's jump distance before attempting longer climbs.
Stay calm and pause your planning between moves; rushing is the most common reason for falls.
faq: What is the goal of Cave Escape?
Your goal is to help Rudy climb upward and escape the cave by leaping and using the falling bricks to ascend.
How do I earn points?
You earn extra points by snatching diamonds along the way, so collecting them while you climb raises your score.

repo-and-repo.intro: Repo and Repo is a pixel puzzle platformer where you swap between two characters to collect every gem in each level. Each character can reach different spots, so planning the order of switches matters.
tips: Before moving, look at the whole level and note which gems each character can reach on its own.
Use the X key to switch characters only when the current one has nothing more to do or is in a useful position.
Try a level once without rushing to see the route, then replay it with a clear plan for each switch.
Jump with the Up arrow in short bursts when lining up a landing, rather than holding it down, so you keep control of where you land.
If you get stuck, reset your thinking by checking which character can reach the spot you are missing and whether the other character can clear a path for it.
faq: What is the goal of Repo and Repo?
Your goal is to pick up all the gems in each level by switching between the two characters.
How do I switch characters?
Press the X key to switch between characters. Use the arrow keys to move left, move right, and jump.

crazy-car-driving-3d-simulator.intro: Crazy Car Driving 3D Simulator is a sports car game set in an open world city. It focuses on realistic physics, drifting, burnouts, and high-speed driving with no traffic or police to stop you.
tips: Use the open city to learn how the car handles at speed before trying tighter moves, since the physics engine rewards smooth control.
Practice drifting on wide, open stretches first so you can feel how the car slides and recovers.
Because you do not need to brake for traffic or rival cars, keep your speed up and plan your turns ahead of time.
Try burnouts in a few different spots around the city to see how the asphalt and car respond.
Vary your driving routes across the city so you can test drifts and stunts in different conditions.
faq: Do I have to stop for traffic?
No. The description says you do not need to brake because of traffic or rival vehicles, so you can keep driving at full speed.
Will the police chase me?
No. You can run at full speed and perform stunt actions without the police chasing you.

shape-transform-race.intro: Shape Transform Race is a racing game where you change your vehicle to suit each terrain. Race against bots or a friend and reach the finish line first.
tips: Look ahead on the track and switch shape before you reach an obstacle, so you do not lose speed at the moment it appears.
Match the form to the terrain: use a boat for water, a car for road, and an airplane for air sections.
Keep your attention on the upcoming terrain rather than only on your current shape, since late changes are what slow you down.
In 2 player mode, learn the A, S, D and J, K, L keys so you can change vehicles quickly without moving your hand far from the keyboard.
Use the coins you earn from races to unlock new vehicles and characters, and try different ones on tracks that suit their shape.
faq: What is the goal of Shape Transform Race?
The goal is to be the first player to reach the finish line. You do this by changing into the right vehicle for each obstacle so you keep your speed.
How do I change vehicles?
You can use the mouse or touch controls to change vehicles. In 2 player mode, you can also use the A, S, D keys for one player and the J, K, L keys for the other.

blocks-merge.intro: Blocks Merge is a puzzle game where you clear the board before the timer runs out. Same-colored blocks explode when they meet, so placement is the key to success.
tips: Look for color pairs on the board before you move anything, so you can plan which blocks to bring together first.
Drag blocks only to open spaces that bring a matching color closer to its partner.
Avoid stacking blocks of different colors in a way that blocks the path between matching ones.
Keep an eye on the timer and make the moves that clear the most blocks early rather than leaving scattered pieces at the end.
Use the mouse to test a placement and watch how the neighboring blocks react before committing to a bigger rearrangement.
faq: What is the goal of Blocks Merge?
Remove all the blocks on the board before the timer turns off.
How do blocks explode in this game?
Blocks of the same color explode when they come near to each other.

explainable-minesweeper.intro: Explainable Minesweeper is a logic puzzle where every tile can be worked out from the clues on the board. You infer each move step by step, and the Hint button explains the reasoning when you get stuck.
tips: Before revealing a tile, check which numbers touch it and what each one still needs. A tile is safe only when the clues around it force that conclusion.
Work on one number at a time. Count the unrevealed tiles next to it and compare that with the mines it still needs, since a full match or a zero-mine count often settles several tiles at once.
Keep track of the tiles you have already proven as mines or safe, so your reasoning builds on earlier deductions instead of starting over each time.
Use the Hint button to read the explanation, then try the next step yourself. Learning the pattern from the hint helps you solve similar situations without help later.
If no safe move is clear, look for a different area of the board that has clearer clues rather than guessing where the logic is incomplete.
faq: What is the goal of Explainable Minesweeper?
The goal is to uncover every safe tile by using logic and the numbers shown on the board. The game is built so that you never need to guess.
How is this different from the classic Minesweeper?
The description says this version removes the luck-based risks of the classic game, so each move can be deduced from the information already on the board.

funny-pet-haircut.intro: Funny Pet Haircut is a grooming and dress-up game where you clean up messy pets at a hair salon, then restyle them. You work on an alpaca and a cat, choosing colors, patterns and outfits.
tips: Wash and dry your pet first, since a clean base makes the later styling steps easier to see and judge.
Try a color on the pet and look at the result before moving on, so you can compare a few options before settling on one.
Use the pattern options to give your pet a bold look, and keep the overall style consistent so the final result looks cohesive.
Pick the outfit last, once the hair color and pattern are set, so the clothing fits the overall look you are building.
Experiment with both the alpaca and the cat, since each pet gives you a different starting point for styling.
faq: What is the goal of Funny Pet Haircut?
The goal is to take a messy pet to the salon, wash and dry it, then give it a new look with colors, patterns and clothing. Your aim is to turn it into a stylish pet.
How do I control the game on a desktop?
Use your mouse to click items, tools and buttons. Clicking these is how you select and apply each choice.

blockgunner.intro: BlockGunner is a two-player war game with 3 maps and 3 weapons. Players fight each other on the same screen, and the winner takes the match.
tips: Try all 3 weapons in a practice round before a real match so you know how each one feels.
Learn the layout of each of the 3 maps, since knowing where you can move quickly helps you dodge and reposition.
Keep moving rather than standing still, so your opponent has a harder time lining up a shot.
Agree with your partner or opponent on who uses which keys before you start, so you don't mix up the two control sets.
If you are on a touch device, practice the touch controls for a minute first to get comfortable with aiming and moving.
faq: What is the goal of BlockGunner?
The goal is to fight your opponent and be the last one standing. The description says the winner wins the match.
How do the controls work?
Player one uses the WASD keys with the R key, and player two uses the Arrow keys with the O key. Touch controls are also available.

mandala-coloring-book.intro: Mandala Coloring Book is a relaxed drawing game built around intricate mandala designs. You choose the colors and fill in the patterns however you like, with no set goal to reach.
tips: Pick a small set of colors before you start, such as three or four that go well together, so the design looks balanced.
Start with the center of the mandala and work outward, since the inner rings often set the pattern for the rest.
Try bold or unexpected color combinations, because the game encourages experimentation and there is no wrong choice.
Leave some areas blank and come back later, which helps you see how the colors interact across the whole design.
Take breaks between sections if you want to unwind, and focus on one ring or segment at a time rather than rushing the whole piece.
faq: Is there a goal or a score in Mandala Coloring Book?
No. The game has no set goal or scoring. You create the artwork at your own pace and decide when it is finished.
How do I choose what colors to use?
You pick the colors yourself, so the game is about personal taste. Testing different palettes on the same design is a good way to see what you like.

agrarian-magnate.intro: Agrarian Magnate is a farming business simulator where you run the farm, processing, and store yourself. Complete levels and tasks, earn money, and grow your business step by step.
tips: Work through the built-in tutorial first, since it adapts to your progress and shows you how the farm, factory, and store connect.
Check your open tasks before spending money, so you know which upgrades or hires will help you finish them.
Claim your daily bonus each time it is available, because bonuses are given for one round only and can be missed.
Hire salespeople and upgrade your equipment once your income allows, so that your farm, factory, and store can keep up with each other.
Drag the view across the farm, mission selection, or factory to check every area before you make decisions about your business.
faq: What is the main goal of Agrarian Magnate?
The goal is to build your business empire by completing levels and tasks, earning money, and managing your farm, factory, and store.
How do I move around the farm and factory?
On PC, hold left-click and drag to view the field. On mobile, drag the field with your finger. Tap or left-click to select items.

buttocks-time.intro: Buttocks Time is a hypercasual 3D game set in a gym, where you play as a fitness coach working with a team member on challenging tasks. It is built around quick reactions and tapping to play.
tips: Start with a few quiet tries to get a feel for the timing before you focus on finishing tasks.
Keep your eyes on the main action on screen rather than on the edges, since reflex-based games reward steady attention.
Stay relaxed and avoid tapping rapidly out of panic, because controlled, well-timed taps are usually more effective.
If you miss a task, take a short break and return with a clear head, as fatigue tends to slow reactions.
Notice what keeps tripping you up and adjust your timing on the next attempt, rather than repeating the same mistake.
faq: What is the goal of Buttocks Time?
You play as a fitness coach and work with your team member to complete challenging tasks in a gym. The description asks whether you can finish them all.
How do I control the game?
The instructions say to tap to play, so tapping is the main control for starting and interacting with the game.

your-silver-wife.intro: Your Silver Wife is a clicker-style action game about building a bond with a virtual partner through clicks, upgrades, and story moments. Progress keeps going with the Autoclick feature.
tips: Pay attention to the narrative sections, since the description says strategy matters as you move through them.
Check your upgrades regularly and favor the ones that deepen the relationship rather than only raising click output.
Turn on Autoclick when you want steady progress, then return to click manually when you want to focus on the story.
Take breaks between sessions so you can plan your next upgrades instead of spending everything at once.
Try different approaches to see which interactions your partner responds to best, and keep notes if it helps you remember.
faq: What is the main goal of Your Silver Wife?
The game focuses on building a bond with your virtual partner. Clicks drive that progress, and story moments and upgrades help deepen the connection.
How do I play Your Silver Wife?
The core action is clicking. No separate instructions are provided, so learn the basics by watching how your clicks change the relationship and story.

puzzle-match-kit.intro: Puzzle Match Kit is a match-3 puzzle game where you line up three figures of the same color in a row. It has dozens of levels with different structures, and the goal is to earn as many points as you can.
tips: Scan the whole board before each move and look for lines of three matching figures that you can complete, then compare which move leaves the best chances for the next match.
Pay attention to how each level is structured, since the layout changes from level to level and the same move may not work the same way on a different board.
