Try to plan a few moves ahead rather than reacting only to the first match you see, because a careful approach is what separates a good score from a maximum one.
If you are aiming for the highest points, take a short break when you feel your attention slipping, since the game's smooth animation is easier to read with fresh eyes.
Check the achievements and challenges section to see what goals are available, and use them as a guide to try different approaches on levels you have already finished.
faq: What is the main goal in Puzzle Match Kit?
Your goal is to collect three figures of the same color in a row and earn as many points as possible. Each level has its own structure, so you need to adapt your approach to each board.
How do I get started if I am new to match-3 games?
The controls are intuitive, so most players learn the basics within a few minutes. Start with a few simple levels to get a feel for how matches form before moving on to harder layouts.

parking-master-urban-challenges.intro: Parking Master: Urban Challenges is a 3D driving simulation about parking a car in a set area in city settings. You need to park without an accident and finish as quickly as you can.
tips: Follow the arrows to find the parking space before you start steering, so you aren't guessing where to go.
Go slowly when you are close to other vehicles and obstacles, since an accident prevents you from completing the level cleanly.
Use the handbrake with the space bar to stop the car in place when you need to hold a position while you line up your turn.
Try the M key to switch the camera when the default view makes it hard to judge the distance to the parking space or nearby cars.
Before you move on, make sure you complete the current level, because you must pass each level to unlock the next one.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You need to park the car in the marked area without getting into an accident. Finishing faster is also part of the challenge.
How do I control the car?
Use WASD or the arrow keys to move and rotate the car. The space bar works as the handbrake.

starship-troopers.intro: Starship Troopers is a shooting game set on a lunar base, where you fight hostile forces with a range of weapons. Staying alive depends on careful health management and collecting supplies.
tips: Learn what each weapon is good at before a fight, since the arsenal includes flamethrowers and rocket launchers that suit different situations.
Check your health regularly and avoid taking unnecessary damage, because you cannot afford to enter the next fight at low health.
Pick up supplies whenever it is safe to do so, and keep track of what you have so you know when you need to restock.
Stay alert by scanning the area before moving forward, so you can spot enemies before they close in on you.
Save your most powerful weapons for tough encounters and rely on lighter options against weaker threats.
faq: What is the main goal of Starship Troopers?
You play as a trooper fighting hostile forces on a lunar base, and your aim is to survive the combat scenarios while staying supplied.
How should I manage my health in this game?
Keep an eye on your health throughout each encounter and use the supplies you gather to recover before taking on more enemies.

merge-mania.intro: Merge Mania is a number puzzle where you place tiles into columns and combine matching numbers to double their value. Work to score as high as you can before time runs out.
tips: Before each tap, look at which column already has a matching number on top, since placing the tile there can start a merge.
Try to keep the stacks in each column roughly even, so one column does not fill up and push the grid toward overflow.
Merges can chain, so check whether a new merge creates another matching pair before you decide where to place the next tile.
Avoid placing tiles in a column just to fill space if it leaves no matching number nearby, because that can block your later moves.
Stay calm under the time pressure and pick a placement quickly, but take a moment to check the grid when the board is crowded.
faq: What is the main goal in Merge Mania?
Place numbered tiles into columns, merge identical numbers into double their value, and keep the grid from overflowing while you build your score.
How do I place a tile?
Tap the column where you want the tile to go, and it will move upward through that column.

pc-cafe-simulator-3d.intro: PC Cafe Simulator 3D is a tycoon game where you run a gaming club. You build gaming PCs, host gamer clients, repair equipment, and expand your business over day and night cycles.
tips: Learn which components you can assemble into gaming PCs early, so you can get your stations running before clients arrive.
Keep your equipment in good repair. Fixing broken machines helps everyone enjoy their favorite games and keeps the club running smoothly.
Use the day for hosting clients and earning money, and save the night for planning and upgrades.
Expand carefully by adding gaming stations once your current setup runs reliably, rather than adding them all at once.
Check the leaderboard now and then to see how your club compares, and use that as a guide for what to improve next.
faq: What is the main goal of PC Cafe Simulator 3D?
The goal is to grow your gaming club into a well-known business by hosting clients, earning money, and adding more gaming stations. You also climb the leaderboard of club owners.
How do I move and interact in the game on PC?
Use WASD to move and E to interact. Press Space to jump.

archery-king.intro: Archery King is a sports game about precise archery. You aim through shifting winds and changing environments, and you can train solo or challenge friends in duels.
tips: Check how the wind is affecting your arrow before each shot, since unpredictable elements can pull it off target.
Focus on timing as well as aim. A well-timed shot usually matters more than a rushed one.
Use practice rounds to learn how each environment behaves, so you know what to expect when the stakes rise.
Keep your focus steady between shots. Losing concentration after a miss often leads to more misses.
When you duel a friend, watch their shots to learn how conditions are affecting them, then adjust your own aim to match.
faq: What is the main goal in Archery King?
Your goal is to become a skilled archer by hitting your targets with precision, timing, and focus. You can play solo or challenge friends in duels.
How do shifting winds affect the game?
Wind changes the path of your arrow, so you need to balance steady aim with the conditions. Checking the wind before each shot helps you adjust.

fps-shooting-survival-sim.intro: You play a special forces commando fighting evolving zombies across several horrifying settings around the world. Stay mobile, pick your weapons carefully, and eliminate every zombie you find.
tips: Use WASD to keep moving so zombies have a harder time lining up clean shots on you.
Hold Shift with W to run when you need to cover ground fast, such as reaching a new area or getting away from a crowd.
Use Space to jump when you need to change position quickly or get past an obstacle.
Try the different weapons on offer and pick the one that suits the situation, since the game gives you an assortment to choose from.
Keep the mouse steady when you aim and fire, and use look-around often to check your surroundings before you move into a new area.
faq: What is the goal of FPS Shooting Survival Sim?
Your objective is to combat zombies and eliminate all of them to save the world. The game rewards you with combat survival experience as you progress.
How do I aim and shoot?
Use the mouse to aim, shoot, and look around. Combine this with WASD movement so you can track targets while staying on the move.

shawarma-kiosk-anomaly-game.intro: Run a small shawarma kiosk through a night shift where zombies arrive after midnight. Serve burgers, shawarmas, and drinks quickly while keeping your kitchen organized.
tips: Keep your most-ordered items within easy reach so you can serve customers without long walks across the kiosk.
Zombie customers are impatient, so work on one order at a time and avoid starting a new order before the current one is finished.
Check each order carefully before handing it over, since mistakes can be deadly in this game.
Restock and sort your racks whenever you have a quiet moment, because a cluttered kitchen slows you down later in the shift.
Use the E key to interact only when you are close to the item or station you need, which helps you avoid wasted moves.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You run a kiosk during a night shift and prepare food for zombie customers who arrive after midnight. Each order matters because a mistake can cost you your life.
How do I move and look around?
Use W, A, S, and D to move forward, left, backward, and right. Move the mouse to change your camera view, and press E to interact with items and stations.

furious-speed.intro: Furious Speed is a racing game where you dodge, drift, and outrun police while racing against the clock. Unlock sports cars and test your split-second decisions.
tips: Watch the road ahead early so you have time to make a move before a turn or obstacle reaches you.
Use drifts to take sharp corners without losing too much speed, and avoid braking hard unless you need to.
Keep an eye on where the police cars are and choose routes that put space between you and them.
Think about each decision in the moment, since the race rewards quick, committed choices over hesitation.
Try different sports cars as you unlock them and see which handling style suits the way you like to drive.
faq: What is the main goal of Furious Speed?
You race against time and try to outrun law enforcement by dodging, drifting, and making fast decisions.
Can I unlock new cars?
Yes, the game lets you unlock a fleet of high-performance sports cars as you play.

let-me-in.intro: Let Me In is a strategy puzzle about moving city commuters. Fill buses to capacity, time your actions well, and keep everyone moving with limited resources.
tips: Look at the whole queue before acting, so you can see which passengers are waiting and where the crowds are building.
Aim to fill each bus close to capacity rather than sending out partly full ones, since your resources are limited.
Time your moves carefully. Acting too early or too late can leave people stuck, so pause to plan the next step.
Watch for passengers who have been waiting the longest and prioritise them, because the goal is that no one is left behind.
Use your limited resources on the moves that clear the most people, and avoid spending them on small gains early on.
faq: What is the main goal in Let Me In?
The goal is to fill buses to capacity while making sure no one is left waiting. You need to keep the city commute moving smoothly.
Why do I run out of resources so quickly?
Resources are limited, so each action has a cost in effect. Plan a few steps ahead and focus on moves that move the most people at once.

crazy-buggy-demolition-derby.intro: Crazy Buggy Demolition Derby is a 3D racing game where you drive in an arena and try to be the last car standing. Smash the other drivers to take the lead.
tips: Use WASD to drive, and keep moving so the other cars cannot easily box you in.
Start by watching where the other drivers are heading, since they all begin in opposite directions.
Aim for cars that are already damaged or stuck near the walls, because they are often easier to finish off.
Avoid head-on crashes with cars that are still healthy, as a hard collision can cost you as much as it costs them.
Keep an eye on the arena edges and corners, where it is easy to get trapped while you are busy chasing another car.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
The goal is to smash the other cars and be the last car standing in the arena to win the race.
How do I control my car?
Use the W, A, S and D keys to drive. The game is controlled entirely with these keys.

chess-online.intro: Chess Online lets you play against opponents from around the world or practice against AI opponents at several levels. You can pick different time controls, use hints, and check moves with real-time analysis.
tips: Start against a lower AI level to get comfortable with the piece movement before facing tougher opponents.
Pick a longer time control while you are learning, so you have room to think through each move instead of rushing.
Use the hints to check what you may have missed, then try to spot the same tactic yourself in your next game.
Review the real-time analysis after a surprising move to see whether it helped or hurt your position.
Play a few games with a time control you enjoy most, then move to faster ones once your decisions feel steady.
faq: Can I play against real people in Chess Online?
Yes, you can challenge opponents from around the world. You can also practice against AI opponents at different levels.
What do the time controls change?
Time controls set how long each side has to make moves. Shorter controls reward quick decisions, while longer ones give you more time to plan.

american-block-sniper-survival-online.intro: American Block Sniper Survival Online is a first-person action game set in the Minecraft universe. Clear each city level of enemies before the timer runs out, starting with only a rifle and collecting better weapons as you go.
tips: Check the timer regularly so you know how much time is left to clear the remaining enemies in the level.
Pick up weapons as you move between buildings, and switch to whichever one suits the distance to your next target.
Use right mouse button to aim before you fire at distant enemies, since the rifle is your starting weapon and aiming helps you hit targets far away.
Scan the map as you move so you can spot where enemies are positioned throughout the city and plan a route that reaches them without backtracking.
Use the mouse wheel to change weapons quickly during a fight instead of stopping to search for the right one.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Your objective is to eliminate every enemy on the map before the timer runs out. You start each level with only a rifle and must find other weapons along the way.
How do I move and aim?
Use W, A, S and D to walk around the map and move the mouse to look around. Hold the right mouse button to aim and left click to fire.

sky-hop-3d.intro: Sky Hop 3D is a 3D platformer where you jump between floating islands, collect coins, avoid obstacles, and work your way to the top. Each level tests your jumping precision.
tips: Before each jump, pause and check where you will land, since missing a floating island is the most likely way to fall.
Watch the moving obstacles for a few seconds to find a safe gap, then commit to your jump instead of hesitating mid-air.
Grab coins when they are on your route, but do not take risky detours that put you near an edge or obstacle.
Use the level layout to plan a path toward the top before you start, so you know which islands to head for next.
If you keep falling at the same spot, slow down and try shorter, controlled hops until you learn the distance.
faq: How do I move in Sky Hop 3D on a computer?
Use the W, A, S and D keys to move and steer your character across the floating islands.
How do I play on a touch screen?
Tap or click to play, as described in the game's instructions.

terminator-robot-uprising.intro: Play as Mara Vale in this 2D side-scrolling shooter. Fight through 20 missions against robots that have taken over the city, aiming with your mouse and using jumps and an EMP shove to survive.
tips: Keep your aim on approaching machines as early as possible, since waiting for them to close in leaves less room to react.
Save the EMP shove with F for moments when enemies crowd you, rather than spending it on a single target.
Jump over low shots instead of trying to absorb them, and watch the enemy fire pattern before you commit to a jump.
Switch road lanes with W and S (or Up and Down) to get out of a crowded line of fire before you reload or shoot.
Reload with R during quiet moments so you are not caught with an empty weapon when a new group of robots arrives.
faq: What is the main goal of Terminator Robot Uprising?
Your goal is to complete the 20 missions, from the blackout depot to the hospital, foundry and beyond, by shooting down the robots that have seized the city.
How do I aim and fire my weapon?
Move the mouse to aim and left-click to fire. You can also press J to fire.

thorn-and-blast.intro: Thorn and Blast is an action-puzzle game where you aim and launch fruit at colorful thorns. Clear every thorn in a level before you run out of shots to move on.
tips: Count your remaining shots before each launch so you know whether you can afford a risky attempt.
Look for shots that clear several thorns at once rather than picking off single targets.
Take a moment to study the layout before shooting, since the challenge grows with each stage.
Make small aim adjustments and watch where the fruit lands before committing to a full shot.
If a level feels stuck, try a different angle on the thorns you can reach easily to open up the rest.
faq: What is the goal of Thorn and Blast?
Clear all the thorns from each level using the limited number of shots you are given. Each stage gets more challenging as you progress.
How do I aim and shoot on mobile?
Drag your finger to aim, then release to shoot the fruit toward the thorns.

constructor-bricks.intro: Constructor Bricks is a building game where you assemble models block by block, from simple objects to complex architectural designs. Each project comes with step-by-step instructions to follow.
tips: Read each step before you act, so you know which block the instructions call for before you click.
Work through the steps in order, since each block builds on the ones placed before it.
Check the structure against the instructions as you go, so a mistake doesn't carry into later steps.
Start with simpler models to get comfortable with placing and moving blocks before tackling complex architectural designs.
Take your time with the larger models. Patience and careful attention help you finish the build cleanly.
faq: How do I place blocks in Constructor Bricks?
You assemble the set by clicking on the blocks specified in the instructions. Follow the steps shown for each project.
How do I move a block?
Hold your cursor or finger on the block you want to drag, then move it to where it needs to go.

baby-monster-jump.intro: Help a young monster leap through dangerous levels in this arcade jumping game. Time your jumps well, dodge obstacles, and look for hidden power-ups along the way.
tips: Watch the obstacles ahead of the monster and start planning your jump before they reach you, since quick reflexes matter here.
Spend your first few attempts on each level noticing when obstacles appear, so you can time your jumps more confidently later.
Look carefully around each section for hidden power-ups, because they are easy to miss if you rush through.
If a level starts to feel frustrating, pause briefly and reset your focus before trying again.
Replay levels to learn their layouts, which makes the endless challenges feel more manageable over time.
faq: What is the main goal of Baby Monster Jump?
Guide the young monster through each level while jumping over and dodging dangerous obstacles.
How can I get better at dodging obstacles?
Practice timing your jumps and focus on the next obstacle a moment before it reaches the monster. Repeating levels helps you learn their patterns.

save-the-galaxy.intro: Save the Galaxy is an arcade game where you tap alien invaders to destroy them before they overwhelm your realms. Each wave gets more intense, so quick, accurate taps matter.
tips: Scan the whole screen before each tap so you can spot the next threat early instead of reacting late.
Aim for accuracy first. Missed taps cost time, so a steady rhythm usually beats frantic tapping.
Pay attention to the pace of each wave and adjust your speed to match, saving your fastest taps for the most crowded moments.
Use the early waves to build a steady rhythm, since the later waves get more intense and leave less room for mistakes.
Play a few rounds in a row and note where you lose the most invaders, then focus on that area to push your high score higher.
faq: What is the goal of Save the Galaxy?
The goal is to defend the galaxy by tapping alien invaders before they threaten your realms. Survive the increasingly intense waves and try to beat your own high score.
What controls do I use?
You play by tapping the screen to destroy the invaders. Speed and precision are the main skills the game asks for.

plumby.intro: PLUMBY is a pipe-rotation puzzle where you guide water from a tank to flasks, changing it into steam or back along the way. Each level asks for a specific state in each flask.
tips: Before you rotate anything, trace the path from the tank to each flask so you know which flasks need water and which need steam.
Plan the order of state changes: a boiler turns water into steam, and steam melts ice blocks back into water.
Match colors when powering machines. Steam spins fans that open valves of the same color, and water spins generators that power furnaces and freezers of the same color.
Plan your rotations before tapping, since fewer moves earn more stars.
If a level stalls, use a hint, or press R to restart it from the beginning.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Connect the tank to every flask so each one receives the state shown on it, either a water drop or a steam cloud.
How do I earn more stars?
Finish the level in fewer moves, because fewer moves give more stars.

unblock-ball-slide-puzzle-2.intro: Unblock Ball Slide Puzzle 2 is a sliding puzzle where you move blocks to open a path for the ball. Each puzzle asks you to plan several moves ahead so the ball can roll to the end.
tips: Before moving anything, look at the whole board and find the path the ball needs to take to reach the end.
Identify which blocks are standing in that path and work out which direction each one has to move to clear it.
Avoid moving blocks at random. Plan two or three moves ahead so you do not block a route you will need later.
If you get stuck, try moving a block in the opposite direction from your last move to free up different space.
Click or tap slowly and check the result after each move so you can spot mistakes early.
faq: What is the goal of Unblock Ball Slide Puzzle 2?
The goal is to slide the blocks out of the way so the ball can roll smoothly to the end of the channel. Each puzzle is solved once the path is clear.
How do I move the blocks?
Use mouse clicks or taps to slide the blocks on the board. Choose each move carefully, since you cannot make the ball move directly.

tank-push.intro: Tank Push is a puzzle game where you guide a frog across a battlefield by pushing tanks into the right spots. Each level adds new obstacles that reward careful planning.
tips: Look over the whole level before you move, and note where the tanks, gates, traps, and enemy defenses are.
Plan a few moves ahead so you do not push a tank into a corner or position where it blocks your route.
Work out which tank needs to go where before you start, since the correct positions are what unlock the gates.
Use the surroundings on the battlefield to your advantage, as the description suggests the environment can help you.
If you get stuck, reset your thinking and retrace which moves led to the problem, then try a different order of pushes.
faq: What is the goal of Tank Push?
Your goal is to guide the frog through each level by pushing tanks into the correct positions, unlocking gates, and escaping the battlefield.
How do the levels get harder?
Each level brings new obstacles that test your logic, planning, and problem-solving, so later levels usually require more careful thinking.

flag-painting-game.intro: Flag Painting Game is a coloring game where you fill in the flags of different countries. Each level is meant to help you relax, focus, and learn about the countries shown.
tips: Look up the flag's real colors and layout before you start, since each level is built around learning about a different country.
Work one section at a time, such as a stripe or a symbol, so you can keep track of which areas you have already filled.
Use the mouse to click the buttons, and take your time with each stroke to keep the coloring neat.
If a flag has many small parts, zoom in mentally by focusing on one corner at a time to avoid missing spots.
Take short breaks between levels to stay relaxed and make the coloring feel more like a calm activity than a race.
faq: How do I play Flag Painting Game?
Pick a flag, then use the mouse to click the buttons and fill each part of the flag with the colors you choose.
Is there a time limit or score in this game?
The game description does not mention a timer or score, so you can color each flag at your own pace.

johnny-jump-challenge.intro: Johnny Jump Challenge is a hyper casual game about climbing higher with each jump while avoiding unpredictable obstacles. Your aim is to reach greater heights and rise up the leaderboard.
tips: Watch the obstacles for a moment before each jump so you can judge when they will move into your path.
Plan each jump as a step toward your next safe landing spot instead of jumping as fast as you can.
Keep your reflexes ready, since obstacles are unpredictable and a late reaction is the most common cause of a fall.
Play in short sessions and take a breath between attempts to keep your focus sharp.
Treat each fall as practice and notice what caused it, so you can avoid the same mistake on your next climb.
faq: What is the main goal in Johnny Jump Challenge?
The goal is to climb as high as you can by making strategic jumps while dodging obstacles. Higher progress helps you climb the leaderboard.
Why is the game described as easy to learn but tough to master?
The basic idea of jumping and climbing is quick to pick up, but the unpredictable obstacles and the risk of catastrophic falls make consistent high scores hard to reach.

season-wiping-window.intro: Season Wiping Window is a relaxing HTML5 puzzle game where you pick a season and wipe a window clean. It is played with the mouse or by tapping.
tips: Try each season before settling on one, since the window you wipe can look different depending on the choice you make.
Use slow, even strokes across the glass rather than quick scribbles, so you can see which areas you have already cleared.
Work from one edge of the window toward the other so you do not miss patches you have skipped.
Take short breaks between wipes if you are playing for relaxation, since the game has no stated time limit to rush you.
Keep your mouse or finger steady while wiping to avoid leaving streaks on the parts you have already finished.
faq: What is the goal of Season Wiping Window?
The game asks you to choose one of the seasons and wipe the window. The description does not list any other objectives.
How do I control the game?
The game is played with a mouse or by tapping the screen. Use the same input to wipe across the window.

car-stunts-driving.intro: Car Stunts Driving is a 3D racing game where you steer a car along sky-high tracks filled with obstacles. Your goal is to reach the end of each track without falling into the abyss.
tips: Ease off the throttle before rough or narrow sections so the car stays balanced on the track.
Use short taps on W and S instead of holding them down, since the realistic physics can make the car tip or slide.
Use the stop control (Space) to halt the car when you need to correct your position on a narrow stretch.
Study each obstacle before you commit to it, and plan your line so you are not braking or turning in the middle of a jump or gap.
Keep your steering gentle with A and D, because sharp turns at speed are a common way to slide off the edge.
faq: What is the goal of Car Stunts Driving?
Drive your car along each sky track, get past the obstacles, and avoid falling off into the abyss. The game has many levels to work through.
What are the controls on PC?
Use W to go forward, S to go back, A and D to steer left and right, and Space to stop. On mobile, use the on-screen buttons.

offroad-4x4-driving-simulator.intro: OffRoad 4x4 Driving Simulator is an arcade simulation about driving a 4x4 over rugged terrain and steep mountain trails. It focuses on realistic driving physics and off-road adventure.
tips: Start slowly on each new stretch of trail to get a feel for how the vehicle responds to the ground beneath it.
Because the physics are realistic, weight and momentum matter, so avoid sudden speed changes when climbing or descending.
Watch the shape of the terrain ahead and plan your line through rough or uneven sections before you reach them.
Take steep mountain sections at a steady pace rather than rushing, since losing control is more likely at high speed.
Repeat difficult trails a few times to learn where the ground is most challenging and how your vehicle handles it.
faq: What is the main goal of OffRoad 4x4 Driving Simulator?
The goal is to conquer rugged terrain by navigating challenging mountain trails in a 4x4 vehicle. The description does not list any specific objectives beyond that.
How realistic is the driving in this game?

The game is built around realistic driving physics, so the vehicle's behavior on slopes and uneven ground should feel grounded rather than arcade-light. Smooth, careful driving usually works better than fast, sudden inputs.

bowmaster-tower-attack.intro: Defend your tower from waves of attacking enemies by aiming and shooting arrows. Upgrade your weapons between levels to keep up with enemies that grow tougher as you advance.
tips: Take a moment to aim before each shot, since your arrows are your only way to stop the enemies approaching your tower.
Focus on the enemies closest to your tower first, because they are the biggest immediate threat to your defense.
Choose upgrades that match the enemies you struggle with most, rather than spreading your improvements too thinly.
Keep track of how each level changes the enemies, and adjust your aim and upgrade choices to match their increased strength.
Use the mouse on PC or touch the screen on mobile, and keep your movements steady so your aim stays accurate.
faq: What is the main goal of BowMaster Tower Attack?
Your goal is to defend your tower by shooting enemies one by one before they destroy it. Each wave brings a new group of attackers.
How do I aim and shoot?
Use the mouse to aim and shoot on PC, or touch the screen on mobile devices. Your arrows are used to eliminate the enemies.

zombie-killer.intro: Zombie Killer is a post-apocalyptic shooter where you pick a character, use a range of weapons, and fight through waves of zombies. Coins you earn can be spent on gear upgrades.
tips: Aim for the head, since the description highlights headshots as the strategic way to deal with zombie hordes.
Try each weapon in your arsenal early on so you learn which ones suit close fights and which work better at range.
Keep track of your position so zombies do not surround you; moving to keep distance gives you more time to aim.
Save your earned coins for the upgrades that most improve your survival, rather than spending them all at once.
Pick the character that fits your play style, and stay aware of how much pressure the horde is putting on you before you push forward.
faq: What is the main goal in Zombie Killer?
The goal is to survive the zombie hordes by using your weapons, especially headshots, to clear them out. The game describes it as a survival adventure in a post-apocalyptic world.
How do I get stronger between fights?
Earn coins during play and use them to upgrade your gear. Upgrades are meant to increase your chances of surviving the next waves.

king-of-ball.intro: King of Ball is a 2D casual hypercasual game where you play Carter, finishing levels, collecting gold coins, and getting past traps and dangers along the way.
tips: Scan each screen for traps before you move, since the description says dangers are waiting along the route.
Use short, controlled jumps rather than long leaps so you can land safely on the next platform.
Collect the gold coins you pass on the way, but do not risk a dangerous spot just to grab one.
If a jump or move fails, pause and check the timing before trying again so you learn the pattern.
On Android, keep your thumbs on the on-screen buttons for left, right, and jump so you can react quickly.
faq: What is the goal of King of Ball?
You play as Carter, finish each level, and collect gold coins while avoiding the traps and dangers in the adventure.
How do I move Carter?
On PC, use the Left and Right Arrow keys to move and the Up Arrow key to jump. On Android, use the on-screen touch buttons.

real-motor-race-master.intro: Real Motor Race Master is a browser bike racing game set in neon-lit cityscapes. You can customize your ride, use nitro boosts, perform stunts, and unlock new bikes.
tips: Save nitro boosts for straight stretches or moments when you need a burst of speed, rather than using them the moment they become available.
Try stunts during your races to see how they affect your ride, and practice them until you can perform them consistently.
Pay attention to the neon-lit city layout so you can anticipate turns and plan where to use your boosts.
Customize your bike with an eye toward how you race, since your ride setup is part of your overall performance.
Race daily to track your progress and to make the most of the unlocks you earn as you move forward.
faq: What is the main goal of Real Motor Race Master?
The goal is to race through neon-lit cityscapes on a motorbike and compete in daily races. Performing stunts and using nitro boosts help you keep up with rivals.
How do I unlock new bikes?
The game lets you unlock new bikes as you play. Keep racing and competing daily to build up your options.

456-survival-squid-challenge.intro: 456 Survival Squid Challenge is an action game built around short survival challenges, including Green Light, Red Light and the Dalgona Challenge. Each level asks for quick reflexes, careful timing and a clear plan.
tips: Watch each level for a few seconds before you act, so you understand what it is asking of you.
In timing-based challenges like Green Light, Red Light, react on purpose rather than rushing your movements.
Treat precision as the priority in each level, since a small mistake can cost you the attempt.
Plan your next move before you commit, using sharp decision-making instead of guessing under pressure.
If you fail a level, pause to note what went wrong, then adjust your approach on the next try.
faq: What is the goal of 456 Survival Squid Challenge?
The goal is to get through each thrilling level and emerge victorious as a survivor. Each level requires precision and strategy.
Which games are featured in this challenge?
The description highlights Green Light, Red Light and the Dalgona Challenge. Each one tests quick reflexes and sharp decision-making.

football-champ-3d.intro: Football Champ 3D is a sports game about leading your team to victory on a 3D pitch. It focuses on tactics, maneuvers, and building your skills in competitive matches.
tips: Watch where your teammates and opponents are before each move, since the game rewards strategic positioning over rushing forward.
Practice your maneuvers in calm moments so you can use them with better timing when a match gets intense.
Adjust your tactics when the match changes, such as switching approach after the opponent shows a clear pattern.
Pay attention to space on the pitch and move into open areas to create chances for your team.
Stay patient and keep your team organized rather than making rushed decisions under pressure.
faq: What is the main goal of Football Champ 3D?
The goal is to lead your team to victory through strategic play and well-timed football action on the pitch.
Does the game reward quick play or careful strategy?
The game is built around strategic gameplay, so careful positioning and tactical choices are likely to matter more than rushing.

build-a-road.intro: Build Road is an idle clicker where you build your own obby and then play it to earn money. Spend your earnings on blocks, walls, ramps and lava, then upgrade your plot to build bigger courses.
tips: Play your obby regularly, since playing it is how you earn money. Earnings from one run can fund your next purchase.
Spend money in small, steady steps rather than saving everything, so your obby grows as you earn.
Test your course by playing through it after each change. This shows you quickly whether a new section works as intended.
Mix block types like walls, ramps and lava so each stretch of the course feels different to play.
Save up for plot upgrades once your current space starts to feel full. A bigger plot lets you build a longer obby.
faq: How do I earn money in Build a Road?
You earn money by playing your obby. Run through the course you have built to collect your earnings.
How do I move my character?
Use the W, A, S and D keys to move. On a touch device, use the joystick instead.

tung-tung-super-sahur.intro: Tung Tung Super Sahur is a platform adventure where you guide a little hero through a fantasy world to rescue the princess. Travel through many levels, collect coins, and reach every castle.
tips: Collect the coins you pass on the way, since they are part of each level's main route and are worth grabbing before you move on.
Save power-ups for moments when enemies or obstacles are hard to handle, rather than using them the moment you find them.
Look at each enemy's movement for a few seconds before you approach so you can time your jumps and avoid unnecessary hits.
Study each obstacle before you commit to a jump, and if a section feels unfair, try a different approach or pause to plan the next move.
Aim to reach every castle rather than rushing past them, since the game is built around progressing through each one in turn.
faq: What is the goal of Tung Tung Super Sahur?
Your goal is to help the little hero rescue the princess by travelling through the fantasy world, clearing levels, and reaching every castle.
How do I control the hero?
The game uses keyboard controls, and the instructions list them. Check the controls section on the game page before you start so you know the keys before the first level.

career-rush.intro: Career Rush is a 3D arcade game where you guide a girl through levels, collecting green money bags and dodging red ones while choosing a career. Slide your finger or mouse to move her.
tips: Keep your eyes on the path ahead so you can spot red money bags early and move out of their way in time.
Use small, steady slides rather than large sudden ones, which can carry the girl into a red bag by mistake.
Plan your route a few bags ahead so you collect green money bags without drifting into danger.
Stay calm when the pace picks up; the game rewards steady, patient movement more than rushing.
If you lose a run, replay the level and focus on the spots where you were caught to improve your timing.
faq: What is the goal of Career Rush?
Help the girl collect green money bags and choose a career while avoiding the red money bags in each level.
How do I control the girl?
Slide to move her. The game is controlled by sliding across the screen.

run-the-electricity.intro: Run The Electricity is a calm puzzle where you turn lines to close a circuit and light up the lamps. There is no timer, so you can work through each stage at your own pace.
tips: Before you tap anything, trace the path from each energy source to the nearest lamp so you can see which lines need to connect.
Start with the parts of the circuit that are already close to lined up, then work outward to the pieces that are farther apart.
Remember that you only need at least one lamp and a wire connected to light up, so you do not have to finish every branch to see progress.
If you get stuck, step away for a moment and come back. Since the levels have no time limit, a short break can help you spot the missing connection.
Pay attention to how the tasks change from stage to stage, since later puzzles are more varied and reward noticing patterns in earlier ones.
faq: What is the goal of Run The Electricity?
Your goal is to turn the lines until you form a closed electrical circuit that lights up at least one lamp.
How do I control the pieces?
Tap on the lines to turn them. Keep tapping until the pieces connect into a closed circuit.

zumba-quest.intro: Zumba Quest is a marble-matching puzzle set in a jungle world. You aim and shoot marbles to clear chains of matching colors while working against a time limit.
tips: Look for chances to connect three or more marbles of the same color before you shoot. A shot that completes a group clears more of the board.
Keep an eye on the timer in timed challenges and decide early whether you can clear the board in time or need to speed up.
Pay attention to the special types of marbles. Using them at the right moment can open up a board that seems stuck.
Save your boosters for levels where you are stuck rather than using them right away, so you have help when you need it most.
Replay earlier levels once you unlock a new marble shooter to see how it changes your aim and shot choices.
faq: How do I complete a level?
Aim and shoot to connect three or more marbles of the same color. Match all the marbles that appear, or finish the level before the time limit runs out.
What should I do when the board gets crowded?
Focus on the color groups that are easiest to reach and clear them first. Clearing a path lets you reach the rest of the marbles more easily.

obby-football-soccer-3d.intro: Obby Football Soccer 3D is a multiplayer soccer game with real-time matches, penalties, and obstacle challenges. Play against friends or random opponents and grow your player from rookie to champion.
tips: Hold the kick button for a longer time when you need more power, and tap it briefly for short, controlled passes.
Use Q to protect the ball when an opponent is close, so you keep possession while you look for a pass or shot.
Save E for sliding tackles when you are near the ball and the timing is right, since a poorly timed slide can leave you out of position.
Spend your upgrade points based on how you play: choose Kick force for shooting, Speed for covering the field, or Endurance if you tend to tire in long matches.
Practice the obby challenges to sharpen your reaction and speed before you enter real matches against other players.
faq: How do I score more goals in a match?
Aim your kicks carefully and use the kick button's hold time to adjust power. Keep the ball under control with Q when defenders are near so you can make a clean shot.
What should I upgrade first after matches?
Kick force, Speed, and Endurance all help in different ways, so pick the one that matches your playing style. Improving Kick force is useful if you rely on scoring from distance.

dino-funny-digging.intro: Dino Funny Digging is an archaeology game where you dig up dinosaur fossils and rebuild complete skeletons. You can explore several locations and collect a range of ancient creatures.
tips: Work slowly when extracting bones, since the game stresses careful excavation and rushing can damage the fossil.
Use your tools on each dig site before moving on so you do not leave bones behind.
Pick one dinosaur at a time and gather all its pieces, which makes it easier to see what is still missing for the skeleton.
Try different locations, because each one offers a variety of fossils and creatures to collect.
Compare the bones you have with the skeleton outline as you assemble, and check each piece before placing it.
faq: What is the goal of Dino Funny Digging?
Your goal is to extract dinosaur bones from the ground and assemble them into complete dinosaur skeletons.
How do I get the bones out?
Use the tools in the game to carefully extract each bone from the dig site.

tom-runner.intro: Tom Runner is an action game where you guide Tom, a nimble raccoon, through a busy city while police chase him. Your aim is to dodge pursuers, grab coins, and keep running as the chase grows harder.
tips: Pay attention to where the police are coming from before you move, so you can react early instead of at the last second.
Use your touch controls with small, steady movements rather than rushed ones, which helps you stay in control at high speed.
Collect coins whenever they are safe to reach, but don't let chasing them put you in the path of an officer.
Watch for power-ups and think about when to use them most effectively, especially when pursuits start to intensify.
Expect the chase to get harder over time, so use the early part of each run to learn the layout and pace of the city.
faq: What is the main goal of Tom Runner?
You play as Tom the raccoon and try to survive as long as possible while escaping persistent police pursuit through the city. The game gets more intense the longer you last.
How do I control Tom?
The game uses touch controls to move Tom through the city. Use them to dodge obstacles and officers as you run.

3-warrior-team-force.intro: 3 Warrior Team Force is a team-based adventure where you lead a band of warriors across dangerous lands to free the kingdom from evil. You control one hero at a time and can switch between them as you go.
tips: Switch heroes with C when the current warrior is in trouble or when another one suits the danger ahead, since your whole team is your main resource.
Save the Space special for tougher moments rather than using it early, so it is ready when a fight really needs it.
Mix Z attacks with careful movement using WASD or the arrow keys instead of standing still and trading hits.
Pay attention to which hero is active before you attack, so you do not waste a moment fighting with a warrior who is not suited to the situation.
faq: What is the goal of 3 Warrior Team Force?
The goal is to travel across dangers and free the kingdom from evil dominion with your band of warriors. The game is built around fighting together as a team.
Which keys do I use to move and attack?
Use WASD or the arrow keys to move. Press Z to attack and Space to use your special move.

lucky-dice.intro: Lucky Dice is a physics merge puzzle where you launch dice like a slingshot. Matching dice combine into the next number and set off chain reactions across the board.
tips: Before each throw, look for pairs of matching dice that a single shot could bring together. Setting up a merge that feeds into other matches often creates the biggest cascades.
Keep your throws count in mind. Since each level gives you a limited number of throws, avoid spending shots on small merges when a bigger chain is possible.
Pay attention to where a merged die will fly next. The new number seeks its own twin, so think about which matching dice are in its path.
Use short, gentle pulls when you want precise placement and longer pulls when you need to reach distant dice. Small aim changes can send a die far off target.
Check your target score against what the board can realistically give you. Aim for the cascade that gets you closest to the goal, and clear the board when you can.
faq: How do I aim and launch a die?
Drag back on the die to pull it like a slingshot, then release to launch it in the direction you aimed.
What happens when two dice merge?
When two matching dice touch, they combine into the next number. The new die then flies off to find a matching die, which can start a chain reaction.

water-sort-master-color-puzzle.intro: Water Sort Master is a color puzzle where you pour liquids between bottles until each bottle holds a single color. Each level tests your planning, so think a few moves ahead before you tap.
tips: Before you pour, check the color on top of both bottles, since you can only pour onto the same color or into an empty bottle. Pouring the wrong color can block a bottle you need later.
Look for a color that is spread across several bottles and find the bottle where it is most exposed, so you can gather it in one place.
Save empty bottles for the moves that really need them. Using one too early can leave you with no space to untangle the rest.
Work out the order of your moves on paper or in your head before you start tapping, because each pour can change what is possible next.
If you get stuck, step back and look for any bottle whose top layer can move onto a matching color. Small, clear moves often open up the rest of the level.
faq: What is the goal of Water Sort Master?
The goal is to sort every bottle so that each one contains only one color. You finish a level when all the bottles are sorted.
How do I pour water between bottles?
Tap one bottle to select it, then tap another bottle to pour. You can only pour onto the same color or into an empty bottle.

save-the-pets.intro: Save the Pets is a puzzle game where you draw a protective line to block bees that are trying to sting a dog. Keep the dog safe for 10 seconds while avoiding lava, water, spikes, and bombs.
tips: Study the bees and the dog before you start dragging, so you can see where the threats are coming from.
Aim for a short line, since the shorter your line, the more stars you earn.
Draw your line in one smooth touch-and-drag so you can block the bees without wasting time.
Keep an eye on the hazards around the dog, not just the bees, because lava, water, spikes, and bombs also put him at risk.
Track the 10-second timer in your head and stay focused until the dog has been safe for the full time.
faq: What is the goal of Save the Pets?
Your goal is to draw a protective line that blocks the bees and keeps the dog safe for at least 10 seconds.
How do I earn more stars?
The shorter the line you draw, the more stars you earn, so try to protect the dog with as little line as possible.

drifting-car-master.intro: Drifting Car Master is an arcade racing game about sliding through sharp turns on open tracks while staying ahead of police patrols. Your skill with timing and balanced drifts decides how far you get.
tips: Ease off the gas before a sharp corner rather than braking hard in the middle of it, so the car keeps its balance and slides smoothly.
Use short taps on the turn keys instead of holding them down, which helps you control how wide the drift becomes.
Brake with S only when you need to slow the car for a corner, since braking too late can throw you out of a drift.
Pay attention to where police patrols appear on the highway and streets, and lower your speed in those areas to avoid triggering a chase.
Try different cars and their upgrades to find a setup that matches how you like to drift, then stick with it until you feel comfortable.
faq: What is the goal of Drifting Car Master?
You race against other drifters on open tracks and try to win by keeping control through every turn. Police chases add a second challenge where you must escape or be caught.
How do I steer and control the car?
Press W to accelerate, A and D to turn the car, and S to brake. On a mobile phone, use the on-screen buttons instead.

monster-heroes-of-myths.intro: Monster Heroes Of Myths is an arcade battle game where you summon soldiers to fight evil enemies. You build your army and explore a mysterious map. Play with mouse clicks or taps.
tips: Summon soldiers early so you have a force ready before enemies become tougher.
Look at the map before moving on, so you know where threats and paths are.
Keep your army together rather than sending units off alone, so they can support each other in battle.
Pay attention to which enemies appear and adjust the soldiers you summon to match them.
Take short breaks between battles to plan your next move and avoid rushed clicks.
faq: What is the goal of Monster Heroes Of Myths?
You summon soldiers to battle evil enemies, form your army, and explore the mysterious map.
How do I control the game?
Use mouse clicks or taps to play. Click or tap to summon soldiers and make your moves.

tarantula-clicker.intro: Tarantula Clicker is a clicker game where each click grows your fortune. Strategic upgrades boost your earnings, and you can unlock stylish skins as you progress.
tips: Focus on steady clicking early on, since every click adds to your fortune and builds the money you need for upgrades.
Compare upgrades before you buy. Pick the one that boosts your earnings the most for the cost, rather than buying whatever is cheapest.
Check your earnings after each purchase to see how much an upgrade actually changed your income.
Try to avoid spending everything at once. Keeping a small reserve lets you buy the next upgrade as soon as you can afford it.
Keep an eye on the skins you can unlock so you know what to aim for as your fortune grows.
faq: What is the main goal in Tarantula Clicker?
The goal is to grow your fortune by clicking and using upgrades to increase your earnings over time.
How do upgrades help?
Upgrades enhance your earnings, so each click or income cycle can bring in more money than before.

dont-be-angry-with-match-man.intro: Don't Be Angry With Match Man is a single-player stickman game where you move through levels full of hidden traps. Your controls are forward, backward, and jump, and patience is the key to getting through each stage.
tips: Move slowly at the start of each level and watch how the ground, gaps, and obstacles are arranged before you commit to a jump.
Test a suspicious spot with a short step first, so you learn what happens before you move farther into the level.
If you fall into a trap, restart with a clear plan instead of rushing the same section again.
Use small, controlled jumps rather than big leaps, since overshooting a platform is an easy way to lose progress.
Take short breaks between levels so you stay focused on spotting traps rather than making careless mistakes.
faq: What is the goal of Don't Be Angry With Match Man?
The goal is to get through each level by avoiding the traps placed along the way. The game asks you to learn each layout by playing through it.
Which controls do I need to play?
You only need to move forward, move backward, and jump. Keeping your movements precise matters more than using many inputs.

red-and-blue-cat.intro: Red and Blue Cat is a space adventure where two feline characters explore a dangerous spaceship. You solve puzzles, avoid monsters and traps, and work your way to the key that opens the exit.
tips: Look at the whole room before you move, and spot where the monsters and traps are placed so you can plan a safe route.
Treat each puzzle as a step toward the key. Figure out what the room needs before you start moving pieces around.
Collect the precious stones when you can do so safely, but do not let them pull you into danger near the exit.
Because you control two characters, think about where each one should stand so that one does not block the other's path.
If you play co-op, agree on a plan first, such as who handles which section, so you both act with the same goal in mind.
faq: What is the main goal in Red and Blue Cat?
Your goal is to secure the key and escape each level. You do this by navigating the spaceship, solving puzzles, and avoiding monsters and traps.
Can I play Red and Blue Cat alone?
Yes, the game can be played solo or in co-op mode. In either case, you use dual character control to move through each level.

time-stop.intro: TIME STOP is a first-person arena shooter built around freezing time. Stop it, grab enemy bullets, throw them back, or line up clean shots while the world is still.
tips: Use time stop when several enemy bullets are coming at once, so you can catch or redirect them instead of dodging blindly.
Approach riot-shield soldiers from the side or behind, since their shields block fire from the front.
Deal with kamikaze bombers at range before they close in, and keep your distance when they are near.
Save time stop for dangerous moments rather than spending it early, because it lasts only a few seconds and needs time to recharge.
Pick perks that support the way you fight, and check your modifiers at the start of each arena, such as Darkness or Jammed Guns, before you commit to a plan.
faq: What is the main goal of TIME STOP?
Survive as long as you can by clearing every wave in each arena, choosing a perk, and moving through the exit to the next one. Points from kills and combos push you up the leaderboard.
How do I use time stop and bullets in combat?

Press F or the right mouse button to stop time, then use the left mouse button to shoot or throw. Bullets freeze in the air, so you can grab them with E and throw them back with Q or use the held item.

sniper-shooter-3d.intro: Sniper Shooter 3D puts you in the role of an elite marksman taking positions on city rooftops to track down dangerous criminals. Each mission rewards careful aiming over quick action.
tips: Use the scroll wheel to zoom in before you fire, so you can see your target clearly and place your shot precisely.
Aim with the mouse and take your time before pressing left click. Careful aiming matters more here than rapid shooting.
Press R to reload when you have a moment of calm, rather than waiting until you are empty during a tense moment.
Scan the rooftops and surroundings before you commit to a shot, so you know where your target is and what is nearby.
If a level is stopping your progress, press N to skip it, and come back to it later with a fresh approach.
faq: What is the goal of Sniper Shooter 3D?
Your goal is to complete sniper missions across the city by locating dangerous criminals from rooftop positions and taking them out with careful aim.
How do I aim and fire my sniper rifle?
Move the mouse to aim and press the left mouse button to fire. Use the scroll wheel to zoom the camera in or out for a better view of your target.

tank-craft-2.intro: Tank Craft 2 is a 2D side-scrolling tank battle game where you build your own tank from many parts and fight waves of corrupted tanks and demonic bosses. Your build is the key to progressing through each level.
tips: Balance your tank for firepower, armor, and speed rather than maxing out one stat, since a lopsided build can fall apart against tougher waves.
After each battle, check the parts you looted from defeated foes and compare them with your current build before swapping anything in.
Experiment with small part tweaks between levels so you can see how each change affects how your tank handles in combat.
Keep moving left and right with A and D (or the arrow keys) to avoid incoming fire in the lava-filled arenas instead of holding still.
Clear all enemies and bosses in a stage before advancing, since the level only progresses once every threat on the battlefield is gone.
faq: What is the main goal of Tank Craft 2?
Progress through levels by defeating all enemies and bosses in each stage, gathering resources to craft stronger tanks, and stopping the hellish invasion.
How do I move my tank?
Use A or the Left Arrow to move left, and D or the Right Arrow to move right.

pull-the-thread-puzzle.intro: Pull the Thread is a puzzle game with thirty levels. You guide a thread around key nodes, and each level asks you to plan your route carefully before you wind.
tips: Look at the whole level before you move the thread, so you can spot which nodes are key and which paths lead to dead ends.
Plan your route a few steps ahead instead of reacting one move at a time, since a single wrong turn can make the rest of the level harder.
If you get stuck, step back and try a different order for winding around the nodes rather than repeating the same path.
Take a short break after a tough level. Coming back with fresh eyes often makes the pattern easier to see.
Start each new level by checking how the thread needs to end, then work backward to find a route that gets you there.
faq: What is the main goal of each level?
You navigate your thread and wind it around the key nodes in the level. The game is built around planning this route carefully.
How does the difficulty change as I play?
The game has thirty levels with intricate layouts, so later levels generally ask for more careful planning. The controls are simple, so most of the challenge comes from working out the solution.

drop-dunks.intro: Drop Dunks is a basketball game where you control a platform to deflect balls into baskets. Three dispensers release balls, and you score points by keeping them in play and on target.
tips: Track all three dispensers before you move, since each one can release balls at a different time. Knowing where the next ball will come from keeps you from reacting too late.
Move your platform early rather than at the last second. Precise deflections are easier when you are already in position as the ball arrives.
When you unlock an upgrade, think about which dispenser gives you the most trouble and choose the new ball or cannon that helps with it.
Focus on accuracy over speed. Sending a ball cleanly into a basket is usually worth more than rushing several shots that miss.
Stay calm when the screen gets busy. Pick the ball that is closest to a basket and deal with it first, then move to the next one.
faq: What is the goal of Drop Dunks?
You score points by deflecting balls with your platform so they land in the baskets. The game rewards quick thinking and precision.
How do I get better at scoring?
Watch the dispensers so you can anticipate where balls will come from. Aim for clean shots rather than trying to hit everything at once.

archery-shooting.intro: Archery Shooting is a simple one-player shooting game where you aim arrows at a target. Closer hits to the center earn more points, and centre hits can also reward bonus arrows.
tips: Focus on the center of the target, since the closer your arrow lands to the middle, the more points you score.
Take your time with each shot. Accuracy matters more than speed when the goal is to land near the bullseye.
Watch for the bonus arrows you earn by hitting the middle of the target, and use them to keep your score climbing.
Pay attention to where your previous arrows landed and adjust your aim for the next shot instead of repeating the same mistake.
Treat each round as a short practice session, and try to beat your own best score on your next play.
faq: What is the goal of Archery Shooting?
The goal is to shoot arrows into the center of the target. The closer your arrow lands to the middle, the more points you get.
How do I earn bonus arrows?
Each time you hit right in the middle of the target, you receive bonus arrows.

quarantine-rush.intro: Quarantine Rush is an arcade action game about stopping a virus. You save people, send them home, cure the infected, and use coins to unlock items that help you save more people.
tips: Keep an eye out for infected people and deal with them early, since curing them is central to the game.
Use power-ups to cure infected people quickly, especially when several are around at once.
Collect coins whenever it's safe to do so, because they unlock new items that can help you save more people.
Send healthy people home as you go so they stay protected, rather than letting the virus spread through the crowd.
Click or tap steadily rather than rushing, so you don't miss infected people or waste power-ups.
faq: What is the main goal of Quarantine Rush?
Your goal is to save as many people as you can by sending them home and curing the infected. Power-ups and coins help you do this more effectively.
How do I control the game?
Click or touch the screen to play. The game uses only this simple input, so focus on timing your clicks or taps.

hotel-manager-simulator.intro: Hotel Manager Simulator is a management game where you run a small hotel, keep guests happy, and grow your business. Your aim is to build up from a single small hotel into a much bigger one.
tips: Check guests in as soon as you have an empty room so no rooms sit idle while guests are waiting.
Keep food and drinks flowing before guests start asking for them, since serving them is how you earn likes.
Clean rooms promptly after each checkout so the next guest can move in without delay.
Watch the guests' demands closely and prioritize the ones that are about to leave unhappy.
Save boosters for difficult moments when your service is falling behind, rather than using them early.
faq: What is the main goal of Hotel Manager Simulator?
The goal is to grow a small new hotel into the biggest hotel in the world by serving guests well. Good service brings you likes, which help your business grow.
How do I earn likes?
You collect likes by giving guests food, drinks, and shelter. Keeping their needs met is the main way to earn them.

aidol-k-pop-adventure.intro: Aidol K-pop Adventure is a girls' dress-up game about guiding a K-pop group toward stardom. You style your idols with outfits, makeup, and choreography, then show them off on stage.
tips: Try several outfit and makeup combinations before settling on a look, since the game encourages experimenting with fashion.
Pay attention to how each look suits your group's stage performance so the style and the choreography work together.
Keep an eye out for newly unlocked looks and check them against your existing styles to see what new combinations they open up.
Focus on a consistent theme for your group, such as bold or soft styling, so each member's look feels like part of one act.
Watch how your pop idols perform on stage after each change, so you can see which styling choices bring out their charisma.
faq: What is the goal of Aidol K-pop Adventure?
The goal is to guide your group to stardom by perfecting their style, choreography, and stage presence. Each performance is a chance to show off your idols' charisma.
What can I customize in this game?
You can customize your idols' outfits, makeup, and overall style. The game also focuses on choreography, so the look and the performance both matter.

lost-bus.intro: Lost Bus is a shooting survival game set after a nuclear war, where you defend your modified school bus against mutated zombies, some of them enormous. Your goal is to keep going as long as you can.
tips: Open the start menu first and read the control section so you know how to aim, shoot, and move before the zombies arrive.
Keep an eye out for military help, since the description says it sometimes appears. Use it when it comes rather than waiting for a better moment.
Pay attention to the bus modifications you have access to and use them to handle the biggest threats, especially the oversized zombies.
Expect some luck to play a part, so do not panic if a run goes badly. Each attempt is a chance to learn which threats come first and how to respond.
Keep your companion Sasha in mind as you play, and make sure your attention stays on the bus and the zombies closest to it.
faq: What is the main goal of Lost Bus?
The goal is to survive against waves of mutated zombies while defending your modernized school bus. The description does not list a fixed win condition, so play until you are overwhelmed.
Where can I find the controls?
The controls are listed in the control section of the start menu. The game supports both desktop and mobile controls, so check the instructions for the device you are using.

combine-pickaxes.intro: Combine Pickaxes is a hypercasual game about upgrading basic tools into stronger ones. You combine and enhance your pickaxes to break through obstacles and clear each level.
tips: Start by looking at the tools you already have before you combine anything, so you know which upgrades you are working toward.
Plan your combinations ahead rather than merging pickaxes as soon as you can, since a stronger tool may help more in later levels.
Pay attention to the obstacles in each level and pick the pickaxe that will clear them most effectively.
Keep an eye on your profits, because the game rewards you for clearing obstacles efficiently and you can use that progress to strengthen your arsenal.
If a level feels hard, step back and reconsider your current setup instead of repeating the same approach.
faq: What is the main goal of Combine Pickaxes?
The goal is to upgrade your pickaxes by combining and enhancing them so you can destroy obstacles, earn profits, and conquer each level.
How can I make my pickaxes stronger?
You make them stronger by combining and enhancing your tools, so planning which pickaxes to merge is the key to building a more powerful arsenal.

car-mechanic-simulator-2025.intro: Car Mechanic Simulator 2025 is a restoration game where you bring rusted, abandoned vehicles back to life. You work through engines, hunt for rare parts, and finish with careful paintwork.
tips: Look over each vehicle fully before you start, so you know which parts need the most work and can plan the order of your restoration.
Take your time with engine restoration, since a car that runs well is a stronger base for the rest of the project.
Keep an eye out for rare parts as you explore, because a missing piece may be the difference between a finished car and one that stays incomplete.
Save painting for last, once the mechanical work is done, so you don't have to repaint areas that get dirty or damaged later.
Pay attention to small details, such as trim and finishing touches, because the game rewards a complete, polished result.
faq: What is the main goal of Car Mechanic Simulator 2025?
Your goal is to take forgotten, rusted vehicles and restore them into well-finished cars. You do this by fixing engines, finding parts, and painting with care.
How do I find rare parts?
The description says rare parts are something you hunt for, so exploring and checking every find is the main way to gather them. Keep track of which parts you still need for each car.

anime-girl-fashion-make-up.intro: Anime Girl Fashion Make Up is a dress-up game that moves from a spa session to makeup and then to outfits. It is built around mixing and matching anime-style looks.
tips: Follow the order the game gives you: start with the spa step so the character is ready before you apply makeup.
Pick a makeup style first, then choose clothes that fit it, so the final look feels consistent.
Try a few different combinations before settling on one, since mixing and matching is the main point of the game.
Compare your finished look with a few alternatives by switching items back and forth to see which pieces work best together.
Keep your color choices limited to two or three main shades so the outfit and makeup look coordinated.
faq: What is the main goal of Anime Girl Fashion Make Up?
The goal is to create stylish anime-inspired looks by going through a spa session, applying makeup, and choosing high-fashion outfits. There is no fixed score to beat.
How do I get a good result in this game?
Focus on making the makeup and outfit match each other in color and style. Testing several combinations will help you find the look you like best.

ludo-classic.intro: Ludo Classic is a board game for two players, based on the classic Ludo board. It is played with the mouse and suits both family and friends.
tips: Before each move, check where your opponent's pieces are so you can see which moves might put you at risk.
Take a moment to compare your options before clicking, since a quick click on the wrong piece can cost you the turn's advantage.
Keep track of how far each of your pieces has travelled and try to advance the ones closest to finishing.
If you are playing a friend, take turns slowly at first to learn how the board and pieces respond to your mouse clicks.
Try to balance your moves so that no single piece falls too far behind the others.
faq: How do I control the game?
Ludo Classic is controlled with the mouse. Click on the options shown on the board to make your moves.
How many people can play?
The game is tagged for 2 players, so it is designed for a match between two people.

gas-station-stick-simulator.intro: Gas Station - Stick Simulator puts you in charge of a small highway gas station. Service cars, earn coins, and grow your station into a larger business with extra services.
tips: Put your early coins into upgrades that let you service more cars, since more customers is the main source of profit.
Check your station regularly, because it keeps earning while you are offline and you can use those coins to keep expanding.
Add the store, restroom, and cafe as your customer flow grows, so each new building has enough visitors to be worth the cost.
Hire employees once your station is busy enough that keeping everything running smoothly takes more time than you have.
Balance spending between equipment, buildings, and staff, rather than putting all your money into one area at once.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
The goal is to start with a small gas station and grow it into a profitable empire by servicing cars, upgrading equipment, and adding new buildings and services.
How do I make money?
You earn coins by filling up and servicing cars, and more customers bring in more profit. Adding a store, restroom, cafe, and hot dog delivery also helps your income grow.

blade-and-bedlam.intro: Blade & Bedlam is a top-down medieval melee action game about surviving waves of enemies with a sword and shield. Buy upgrades between rounds and dodge roll out of trouble.
tips: Spend time in the shop between rounds on upgrades that fit how you fight, since your gear carries your knight through the waves.
Keep your character moving with WASD instead of standing still, so you can reposition before enemies close in.
Use the dodge roll to escape danger, but time it before an attack lands rather than after, so you avoid damage cleanly.
Watch incoming projectiles and block them with your weapon when a dodge would put you in a worse spot.
Save your special items for tough moments, such as a crowd of enemies or a boss, instead of using them on small groups.
faq: What is the main goal of Blade & Bedlam?
Survive for as long as you can by dodging attacks, quickly killing enemies, and buying items between rounds. The game also includes bosses to defeat.
How do I attack and move?
Use the mouse to swing your weapon and the W, A, S, and D keys to move your character.

catch-cats.intro: Catch Cats is an action game where you tap to catch quick-moving kittens and build a high score. It tests your reflexes and speed across endless rounds.
tips: Keep your eyes moving across the whole screen so you spot kittens as soon as they appear, before they have a chance to get away.
Watch the direction each kitten is moving and tap where it is heading, not where it is right now, since the fast ones cover ground quickly.
Stay relaxed and avoid rushing every tap, because steady, accurate taps usually build a higher score than frantic clicking.
Play in short sessions and take a breather when your reflexes start to slip, since endless challenges reward focus over stamina.
Use the friendly competition to measure progress by trying to beat your own previous high score each time you play.
faq: What is the main goal of Catch Cats?
Your goal is to tap your way to a high score by catching kittens. The game is built around reflexes and speed.
How does scoring work in Catch Cats?
The game is built around getting a high score, and it rewards you for catching kittens as they move. Focus on accuracy so each catch counts.

run-giant-3d.intro: Run Giant 3D is a running and fighting game where you collect matching-color items to grow your hero before facing an opponent at the finish line. Steer by sliding to move.
tips: Stay on the items that match your hero's color, since those are the ones that add to your collection.
Slide left and right early to line up with the largest group of matching items rather than chasing single pickups.
Keep your collection growing as you run, because a bigger hero is what gives you the strength to win the final fight.
Watch the path ahead so you can adjust before reaching obstacles or groups of the wrong color, which can cost you time and size.
Think of the finish line as the point where your growth pays off, so focus on building size all the way through the run.
faq: What is the goal of Run Giant 3D?
The goal is to collect as many same-color items as you can, grow your hero, and then hit and defeat the opponent standing at the finish line.
How do I control my hero?
You slide to move. Slide left or right to steer your hero along the path and collect items.

ultimate-car-parking-sim.intro: Ultimate Car Parking Sim is a driving game focused on precise parking in tight spaces and busy parking areas. You steer sports cars and luxury vehicles through challenging driving courses.
tips: Go slowly when you enter a tight space. Small speed changes make it much easier to line up the car without clipping the sides.
Check the angle of your car before you commit to a turn. Straightening the wheels early often saves you from having to reverse and correct.
Use short taps of the drive keys instead of holding them down. This gives finer control over the car in narrow gaps.
Pay attention to busy parking areas and plan your route around moving obstacles before you start maneuvering.
Practice each course a few times. Learning where the tight corners are makes later runs smoother and more precise.
faq: What is the goal of Ultimate Car Parking Sim?
The goal is to park perfectly and complete the challenging parking missions and driving courses in the game.
How do I control the car?
Use W, A, S, D or the Arrow Keys to drive and steer the car.

battle-simulator-police-prison.intro: Battle Simulator - Police Prison is an action game where you lead a police squad through escape missions in tricky prisons. Each scenario rewards careful planning and smart use of your officers.
tips: Before you move anyone, look at the whole layout and the positions of the inmates, since each scenario is built like a puzzle.
Learn what each officer is good at and assign them tasks that match those unique skills instead of using everyone the same way.
Keep your squad in a tight formation when you move through open or dangerous areas so no one is left exposed.
Watch how the cunning inmates react to your moves and adjust your plan rather than repeating the same approach.
Plan two or three steps ahead, and if a plan fails, pause to rethink the formation before pushing forward.
faq: What is the goal of Battle Simulator - Police Prison?
You lead a police squad through intricate prisons on escape missions, using each officer's skills and outsmarting the inmates along the way.
How should I approach the puzzle-like scenarios?
Study the layout and enemy positions first, then plan each officer's moves in order before you act, because the scenarios reward strategy over speed.

number-quest.intro: Number Quest is a puzzle game where you move through levels of number problems that test quick thinking and problem-solving. Puzzles get harder as you progress, so it's a good way to practice math.
tips: Read each puzzle fully before you move any numbers, so you know what the level is asking for.
Select a number first, then decide where it belongs. Making one clear move at a time helps you avoid mistakes.
Work through the easier puzzles at the start carefully, since the later ones build on the same kinds of thinking.
If you get stuck, step back and check which numbers you have not used yet. Looking at the remaining pieces often reveals the next move.
Try to solve each puzzle in your head before dragging or swiping. Quick mental checks help build the speed the game rewards.
faq: What is the goal of Number Quest?
You move through levels, each with a set of number puzzles, and solve them using quick thinking and problem-solving. Each level presents its own problems to work through.
How do I move the numbers in the game?
