On a computer, click to select a number and drag it to where you want it. On touch devices, tap to select and swipe to move it.

glow-halloween-nails-game.intro: Glow Halloween Nails is a manicure game where you turn out the lights and create glow in the dark nail designs for Halloween. Pick a skin tone, shape your nails, and build a costume-themed look.
tips: Start by choosing a skin color and clipping your nails to a length you like, since these choices set the base for the rest of the design.
Shine your nails before adding decorations so the polish and glow effects look smoother on the nail surface.
Think about your costume first, such as a pink castle princess or a green haunted witch, and pick polish colors that match that theme.
Try out several polish colors and decorations on the same design to see which combinations glow and look best together.
Use the many unlocked free items to experiment with different styles, then keep a design you like as a reference for future looks.
faq: What is the goal of Glow Halloween Nails?
The goal is to create a Halloween nail design that matches your costume, using glowing polish and decorations. The game is about nail art rather than winning or losing.
How do I make my nails glow?
Turn out the lights in the game and apply the glowing nail polish and decorations. The glow effect shows best in the dark.

music-note.intro: Music Note is a platform game where you control a musical note hopping between platforms. Each bounce spreads color through a black-and-white world, and you win by reaching the Piano at the end.
tips: Take a moment to study the next platform before each jump, since a missed landing is the most likely reason to restart.
Jump with a steady rhythm rather than rapidly tapping, so you can judge where each bounce will take you.
Pay attention to how the color spreads after each bounce, which can help you see which parts of the world you have already covered.
If you fall or get stuck early on, press R to restart right away instead of trying to recover a bad position.
Use Space or the click control, whichever feels more comfortable, and stick with it so your timing stays consistent across the whole level.
faq: What is the goal of Music Note?
Your goal is to guide the music note across the platforms and reach the end part, the Piano, to win.
How do I jump in Music Note?
Click on the screen or press the Space key to jump.

bike-mania-3-on-ice.intro: Bike Mania 3 On Ice is a sports game with 20 icy courses. Precision and balance matter on slippery terrain, and each course has its own challenges.
tips: Use small, gentle arrow key presses instead of holding keys down, since ice makes the bike slide and overcorrect easily.
Watch how the bike reacts after each input on the first few meters of a course before you commit to speed.
Treat each level as a new course and spend a few attempts learning its layout before trying to go fast.
Slow down before tricky sections and let the bike settle, rather than fixing a wobble with a hard correction.
If you keep losing balance in the same spot, change your approach there instead of repeating the same move.
faq: What is the main goal of Bike Mania 3 On Ice?
Your aim is to get through each of the 20 icy levels by controlling the bike across slippery terrain. Each course is uniquely challenging.
How do you control the bike?
The game uses the arrow keys. Smooth, measured presses help you keep balance on the ice.

car-crash-tricks-simulator-crazy-stunts.intro: Car Crash Tricks Simulator is a driving game built around high-speed stunts and vehicle destruction. You steer, accelerate and brake through obstacles, ramps and loops while the physics do the rest.
tips: Build speed on the straight sections before a ramp, since a faster approach usually gives a bigger launch.
Use the handbrake with Space to tighten a turn or slide the car around when you need to change direction quickly.
Watch your landing angle on jumps and loops, because a car that lands flat tends to stay in control longer.
Try different approaches to the same obstacle to see how each vehicle reacts to impacts from the side and from the front.
Pause with Esc whenever you need to check the options or collect your thoughts before the next run.
faq: What is the goal of Car Crash Tricks Simulator?
The game has no fixed goal beyond driving fast, performing stunts and causing as much destruction as you can. Smash obstacles, launch off ramps and create big crashes.
How do I control the car?
Use W or the Up Arrow to accelerate and S or the Down Arrow to brake. Steer with A and D or the Left and Right Arrows, and press Space for the handbrake.

air-space-shooter.intro: Air Space Shooter is an arcade game where you pilot a spaceship to defend the galaxy from alien invaders. You move and fire with a single tap-and-drag control, and you can upgrade your ship and weapons as you fight.
tips: Keep your finger moving rather than holding still, so your ship stays out of enemy fire while it keeps shooting.
Start each run by getting comfortable with the tap-and-drag control, since moving and shooting happen through the same input.
Use your upgrades to strengthen your weapons and ship as soon as you can, because stronger attacks make the later air battles more manageable.
Watch the incoming enemies and prioritize the ones that threaten you most, rather than firing at random.
Pay attention to where your ship is relative to the enemies so you can dodge while you fire.
faq: How do I move and shoot?
Tap and drag on the screen to move your ship, and your ship fires as you play.
What is the goal of the game?
Your goal is to defend the galaxy by blasting alien invaders in intense air battles.

my-dentist.intro: My Dentist is a surgery game where you treat virtual patients. You learn various dental tools while working through unique challenges with colorful graphics.
tips: Try each dental tool on a patient before moving to harder challenges, so you know what it does.
Take your time with each patient instead of rushing, since the game rewards careful treatment.
If a challenge feels hard, pause and look at what the patient needs before choosing your next step.
Pay attention to how each challenge is different, and use what you learned from earlier ones.
Replay challenges you found tricky to build confidence with the tools.
faq: What is the goal of My Dentist?
The goal is to treat virtual patients and master the dental tools while handling a range of challenges. The game is designed to teach basic oral health in a fun way.
What kinds of challenges will I face?
The description mentions unique challenges that test your dental skills. Each one asks you to apply the tools you have learned.

spray-paint-coloring-games.intro: Spray Paint is a coloring puzzle where you pick a tool and fill in highlighted areas layer by layer to reveal a hidden picture. Each layer must be fully covered before the final artwork appears.
tips: Before you start a layer, look at the shape and size of the highlighted area and choose the tool that fits it best.
Use the spray paint for small or detailed spots and save the paint roller for large, open areas to cover them faster.
Stay inside the target outline, since going past it is not part of the goal and can make the layer harder to finish neatly.
Work through the layers in order and finish one completely before moving on, so you can see how the picture is building up.
Take your time on the edges of each shape, because precision there matters more than speed when you want a clean final image.
faq: What is the goal of Spray Paint?
The goal is to color every highlighted area layer by layer until the hidden picture is fully revealed and the level is complete.
How do I choose a painting tool?
You can pick spray paint, a paint roller, or a spray gun. Choose the one that suits the shape and size of the area you need to cover.

clean-the-garden.intro: Clean The Garden is a cozy arcade game where you clear leaves from a property one patch at a time. You gather leaves, carry them to compost bins, and spend the coins they become on upgrades.
tips: Upgrade movement and carrying capacity early, since carrying more leaves per trip cuts down on walking back to the compost bins.
Use the highlight control (H on keyboard, or the on-screen button on touch) when you lose track of leaves, rather than searching each patch by eye.
Switch tools with 1-4, Q, or the mouse wheel as you move between areas so you always have the right tool ready.
Follow the current objective before opening a new gate, so you finish each area fully and avoid backtracking later.
On replay, decide whether to keep or reset your upgrades before starting, since that choice changes how quickly you can clean the early areas.
faq: How do I earn coins?
Gather leaves, carry them to a compost bin, and they turn into coins. You then spend those coins on upgrades.
Where do I improve my tools?
Each tool is improved at its own station, and you can open the upgrade menu with B on keyboard or the upgrade button on touch.

time-of-adventure-ice-king.intro: Time of Adventure: Ice King is an arcade platform adventure set in a snowy land patrolled by the Ice King's soldiers. Collect crystals and push through 15 chapters to reach the end.
tips: Learn the movement keys early in the first chapter, using WASD or the arrow keys, so you can react quickly when soldiers appear.
Keep an eye on where the Ice King's soldiers are before you move forward, since they are spread across the snowy levels.
Pick up crystals as you go rather than skipping them, because they are part of what you need to collect on the way to the end.
Try the Shift key in safe moments to see what it does before you need it during a dangerous stretch.
Treat each of the 15 chapters as a separate challenge, and if you get stuck, slow down and replay the section with a clearer plan.
faq: What is the goal of Time of Adventure: Ice King?
Your goal is to get through the snowy land, collect crystals, and reach the end of the game across its 15 challenging chapters.
Which keys control the character?
You can use WASD or the arrow keys to move, and the Shift key is also part of the controls listed in the game's instructions.

obby-space-challenge-starships.intro: Obby Space Challenge: Starships is a space obby where you fly starships, collect energy capsules, and earn trophies for each flight. You can also unlock new ships, companions, and locations as you progress.
tips: Collect as much energy as you can on every flight, since the more energy you gather, the more trophies you receive afterward.
Spend your trophies on pets and spaceships that speed up energy gathering, so each flight becomes more productive.
Use the right mouse button to look ahead before you jump, so you can line up your next move on the course.
Check your rewards regularly, because they are based on time spent in the game and refresh daily.
Keep the music on for atmosphere if you like, but know that it is not needed to play well.
faq: What is the main goal of Obby Space Challenge: Starships?
Your main goal is to collect energy capsules while flying a spaceship, which earns you trophy points. Trophies can then be used to buy pets and ships.
How do I move and jump on PC?
Use WASD to move your character and the Space bar to jump. Hold the right mouse button to control the camera.

stickboys-hook.intro: StickBoys Hook is a one-player arcade game where you help Stickboys swing, jump, and web his way to the finish line across 20 levels. Falling from the sky ends the run.
tips: Watch where each swing will carry Stickboys before you release the rope, since a bad release is the most common way to fall.
Use launch ramps to build height and distance, and plan your jump so you land on solid ground rather than in the gap.
Shoot webs toward the next anchor point early instead of waiting until you are already falling, because timing matters more than speed.
Keep your clicks or taps short and steady so you can adjust mid-swing rather than making one large, risky move.
Because you must complete every level, slow down on the tougher stages and practice the same jump until you can repeat it reliably.
faq: What is the goal of StickBoys Hook?
Your goal is to guide Stickboys to the finish line on each level by swinging, jumping from launch ramps, and shooting webs. You must complete all 20 levels.
What happens if Stickboys falls?
If Stickboys falls from the sky, you lose the game. Stay focused on your swing and landing points to avoid this.

sorting-nuts-and-bolts-by-color-home-rep.intro: Sort colorful nuts onto bolts to build color chains and clear the board. Tap a bolt to pick up a nut, then tap another bolt to move it. Each level is a calm puzzle with no time limit.
tips: Before each move, look at the top nut on every bolt so you can see which colors are close to being grouped.
Avoid filling a bolt with a mixed color early on, since burying a nut makes it harder to reach later.
Keep one bolt with enough free space available so you can shift nuts around when a color is split up.
Use undo when a move leaves you stuck, rather than restarting the whole level, to save your progress on the rest of the board.
Treat nuts under question marks as unknown and plan around the visible colors first, then deal with the hidden ones as they appear.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
The goal is to clear the board by sorting all the nuts so that each bolt holds nuts of one color.
How do I move a nut?
Click the bolt you want to take a nut from, then click another bolt to move it there. Make sure the destination bolt has enough room.

pin-puzzle-love-story.intro: Pin Puzzle Love Story is a logic puzzle game where you pull pins in the correct order to help couples reunite. Each level presents a new puzzle to solve by choosing the right latch.
tips: Look at the whole level before pulling anything, and note which pins or latches are blocking others.
Work out the order first. Pulling the wrong pin early can make a level harder to finish, so think a few steps ahead.
If you get stuck, try a different pin to see how the scene reacts; watching what changes often reveals the next step.
Take a short break when a level stops making sense. Coming back with fresh eyes often shows the solution quickly.
Play one level at a time and focus on the logic rather than speed, since each puzzle has only one correct sequence of moves.
faq: What is the goal of Pin Puzzle Love Story?
Your goal is to solve each logic puzzle by pulling the right pins in the right order to help the couples reunite.
How do I control the game?
Use a mouse click to pull pins and select latches. The game is played by clicking or tapping.

city-bus-parking.intro: City Bus Parking is a bus driving and parking simulator. You steer city and coach buses along busy roads, mountain routes, and bridges, then park safely in designated spaces.
tips: Go slowly at the start and get a feel for how the bus turns, since larger vehicles swing wider than a car.
Watch the road and traffic ahead rather than the bus alone, so you can plan turns and avoid obstacles early.
On winding mountain routes, ease off before corners and keep steering smooth instead of making sharp inputs.
When parking, line up with the designated space well before you reach it, then make small, slow adjustments.
Replay levels that give you trouble, focusing on one skill at a time such as steering, braking, or parking.
faq: What is the goal of City Bus Parking?
The goal is to drive your bus along the route through city, countryside, and mountain roads, avoiding obstacles and following traffic, and then park it safely in the designated space.
How do I control the bus?
Use W A S D or the Arrow Keys to drive and steer the bus.

tac-tac-way.intro: Tac Tac Way is an arcade skill game where you guide a nimble ball through colorful puzzle landscapes. You change its trajectory to avoid edges and fiery pits, either solo or in multiplayer challenges.
tips: Look ahead along the path before you commit to a direction, since a late change leaves little room to avoid edges and pits.
Stay calm when the route gets crowded, and pick the safest line instead of the fastest one.
Treat each landscape as a puzzle: scan for the gaps and safe spots first, then plan a route through them.
Practice the early stages to learn how your ball responds to direction changes before you attempt harder sections.
If you try multiplayer challenges, watch how other players handle the same obstacles to pick up new routes.
faq: What is the main goal of Tac Tac Way?
You guide a ball through colorful landscapes while avoiding perilous edges and fiery pits. The game rewards careful planning and steady decisions.
How do I control the ball?
The game's instructions do not list specific controls, so check any on-screen prompts when you start playing. Changing the ball's trajectory is the core action.

broom.intro: Broom is an endless highway racer where speed and quick reflexes are tested as obstacles grow harder over a track with no end. Race solo or challenge friends in multiplayer.
tips: Expect obstacles to get harder the longer you last, so use your early runs to get a feel for their timing and spacing.
Keep your reflexes sharp by reacting early rather than at the last moment, since the track never ends and small mistakes add up.
Play a few solo rounds before challenging friends, so you know how the speed builds before you compete against others.
Note your best score after each run and try to beat it in short, focused sessions instead of playing until you tire.
Take short breaks between races, because steady concentration tends to matter more than long stretches of play in a game that rewards reflexes.
faq: What is the goal of Broom?
The goal is to race down a limitless track while avoiding increasing obstacles and reach the highest score you can.
Can I play Broom with friends?
Yes, the game includes a multiplayer mode where you can challenge friends, as well as a solo mode.

endless-siege.intro: Endless Siege is a strategy puzzle where you defend your kingdom from invaders that keep coming in waves. You place and upgrade defenses on maps that change daily, aiming for a high score.
tips: Look at the day's map before spending anything, and plan where your first defenses will go so you are not rebuilding your layout mid-wave.
Balance your resources between new placements and upgrades, since the waves never stop and running out of either can end your run.
Upgrade defenses that are already in strong positions instead of spreading resources across many weak spots.
Treat each attempt as a test: note which waves caused the most trouble and change your placements the next time you play.
Pace yourself, because endurance matters more than a fast start when the waves keep growing.
faq: What is the main goal in Endless Siege?
Your goal is to defend your kingdom against continuous waves of invaders for as long as possible while building up a high score.
Do the maps stay the same from one play to the next?
No, the maps change daily, so the layout you planned on one day may need to be adjusted on another.

kitten-connections.intro: Kitten Connections is a puzzle game where you draw paths to join matching kittens across a board. Each level unlocks new kittens, backgrounds, and surprises as you go.
tips: Scan the whole board before drawing anything. Find every pair of identical kittens first so you can see which connections might get in each other's way.
Start with the pairs that look easiest to reach. Clearing them opens up space and makes the harder connections simpler to plan.
Think of your paths as a plan rather than a single drag. If a route blocks another pair, try rerouting it before you commit.
Take short breaks between levels if a board feels stuck. Coming back with fresh eyes often shows a path you missed.
Play with the mouse or on a touch screen, whichever feels steadier for you. Smooth, slow drawing helps you avoid accidental wrong connections.
faq: What is the goal of Kitten Connections?
Your goal is to connect each pair of identical kittens by drawing paths across the board. Solving the puzzles lets you move on through the levels.
How do I play Kitten Connections?
Use your mouse or touch screen to draw a path between two matching kittens. Repeat this until every kitten on the board has a match.

fantasy-star-pinball.intro: Fantasy Star Pinball is a ball game where you use the flippers to keep a ball in play, score points, and uncover hidden scenarios across enchanted tables.
tips: Focus on timing your flipper presses rather than mashing them, since a well-timed hit keeps the ball moving upward.
Pay attention to where the ball is heading before you commit to a flipper, and try to catch it near the flipper's tip for more control.
Use the nudge or tilt-free moves sparingly; keeping the table steady helps you avoid losing the ball early.
Aim for the targets and features on each table first, since building up points is the main way to advance your score.
Play a few rounds on each table to learn how its bumpers and ramps bounce the ball, so you can plan shots around them.
faq: What is the main goal in Fantasy Star Pinball?
The main goal is to rack up as many points as you can by keeping the ball in play with the flippers. Hidden realms and secret scenarios are also part of the journey.
How do I control the flippers?
The game does not list specific controls in its instructions, so check the on-screen prompts or the game's controls menu when you start. Practice a few rounds to get a feel for the timing.

masha-and-the-bear-jigsaw-puzzles-for-ki.intro: Masha and the Bear Jigsaw is a puzzle game for kids based on the cartoon characters. You complete colorful picture puzzles by tapping or clicking to place the pieces.
tips: Look at the whole picture first so you know which characters and scenery you are putting together.
Start with the pieces that have straight edges or clearly match a part of the scene, such as the sky or the ground.
Group pieces by color, like the bear's brown fur, green grass, or blue sky, and work on one group at a time.
Take a short break when you feel stuck, then come back and look at the pieces with fresh eyes.
Work on one area of the picture at a time instead of jumping around, so the puzzle grows in a steady way.
faq: What is the goal of Masha and the Bear Jigsaw?
The goal is to put the jigsaw pieces together to complete each picture of Masha and the Bear's adventures.
How do I control the game?
You use tap or click to pick up and place the puzzle pieces.

basketball-school.intro: Basketball School is a sports arcade game where you shoot baskets across three modes: Arcade, Time Attack, and Distance. Aim by dragging with the left mouse button and release to shoot.
tips: In Arcade mode you only have 10 balls, so avoid wasting shots on rushed or low-percentage throws early on.
Use a consistent drag length and release point so you learn how far each shot travels before you try harder shots.
In Time Attack, you have unlimited balls, so focus on quick, accurate shots rather than taking time to line up every throw.
In Distance mode, stand back only after you have made a shot comfortably, since each basket increases the distance you must hit.
Watch the trajectory of each shot and adjust your next drag based on whether the ball fell short or flew past the hoop.
faq: What is the goal of Basketball School?
Your goal is to score as many baskets as you can in whichever mode you choose: Arcade, Time Attack, or Distance.
How do I aim and shoot?
Drag with the left mouse button to aim, then release the button to shoot the ball.

vlinder-girl-fashion-story.intro: Vlinder Girl Fashion Story is a dress-up game where you style characters for different scenarios. You build full looks from clothes, hair, makeup and accessories, then take a photo of the result.
tips: Pick a scenario first and think about what suits it before choosing any items. A look that fits the occasion is easier to finish well.
Start with the outfit, then choose hair, makeup and accessories so the pieces match one another instead of clashing.
Keep your palette limited to two or three colors so the look feels coordinated.
Try headwear, necklaces and earrings last, and test a few options before settling, since small pieces can change the whole style.
Before taking the final photo, check the full look from top to bottom to make sure nothing has been missed.
faq: What is the goal of Vlinder Girl Fashion Story?
The goal is to dress up characters for different scenarios and create stylish looks that match each one. You finish by taking a photo of the finished style.
How do I play?
Use mouse clicks or taps to choose clothes, hairstyles, makeup and accessories for your character. Work through each part of the look until you are happy with it.

traigon.intro: Traigon is a pixel-style platformer where you move through challenging terrain, time precise jumps, and dodge obstacles across levels that grow harder over time.
tips: Watch the obstacles for a few seconds before you move so you can spot their timing and pattern.
Aim for precise landings rather than rushed jumps, since a small miss can send you back to the start of a hazard.
Take each level in small sections and practice the tricky jumps until they feel consistent before moving on.
Stay patient when you fail. Each attempt shows you where the danger is, so use that to adjust your next run.
Expect the later levels to demand more care, so slow down and plan your route rather than racing through.
faq: What is the main goal in Traigon?
You navigate challenging terrain, dodge deadly obstacles, and conquer progressively tougher levels by mastering precise jumps.
What skills matter most in Traigon?
The game rewards strategic finesse and patience, so careful timing and calm, deliberate play tend to matter more than speed.

crown-and-crafts.intro: Crown & Crafts is a medieval village strategy game where you design the systems your villagers rely on. Build production chains, connect them with roads and porters, and defend the village from bandits and rival lords.
tips: Read the objectives at the top left before each build, then work backward from them. Check which goods each objective needs and build the chain that produces them.
Finish each production chain before starting a new one. Ore needs a mine, a smelter, a smith and a recruit, and a missing step leaves the others idle.
Remember that goods only reach your people once a porter carries them to their door. Make sure homes sit on a road that porters can use, or food will stay in the storehouse.
Use pause (Space) to plan roads and placements while nothing is moving, then raise the speed with keys 1 to 3 once the layout works.
Place soldiers and watchtowers before bandits arrive, and keep an eye on your company so you can send it to attack or hold a position when needed.
faq: What is the goal of a mission?
Each mission has objectives shown at the top left, and you complete them by building a working village with roads, homes, food and production chains, and soldiers to hold off bandits.
How do I move soldiers and select buildings?

Left click selects and builds, and right click sends selected soldiers to move, attack bandits, or man a watchtower. On touch screens, tap to select and double tap the ground or a target to send your company.

swarm-picnic.intro: Swarm Picnic is a calm puzzle about matching colors and planning order. Pick boxes from queues and send ants to clear the picture one color at a time.
tips: Before you tap, check which colors will be uncovered next in each queue, not just the front box.
Keep at least one work slot free for a color that will appear soon, so you always have a valid move.
Avoid filling every slot with boxes that cannot move, since that is how you run out of moves.
Save boosters for moments when the box you need is buried deep in a queue, rather than using them early.
Look at which cubes each group of ants can reach before committing, because they collect every matching cube they can get to.
faq: How do I finish a level?
Clear the whole picture by collecting every cube. Each box's ants remove the matching cubes they can reach.
What causes a loss in Swarm Picnic?
If all work slots hold boxes that cannot move, you run out of moves and the level ends.

emoji-guess-master.intro: Emoji Guess Master is a puzzle game where you match two emojis to a given word. It tests your creativity, quick thinking, and intuition across a range of difficulty levels.
tips: Think about what the two emojis could mean together, such as an object and an action, before picking any. Pairing ideas often leads to the word faster than testing single emojis.
Start with the most literal meaning of each emoji, then consider metaphors, sounds, or everyday phrases if nothing fits.
Say the word out loud or picture a short scene using both emojis. Hearing or imagining the combination can make the answer click.
If you get stuck, step away for a moment and come back with fresh eyes. Quick breaks often help intuition work better than pushing on.
Use short sessions when you want a quick puzzle, and save longer sessions for harder difficulty levels where more thinking is needed.
faq: What is the goal of Emoji Guess Master?
Your goal is to match two emojis to a given word. Each puzzle asks you to find the connection between the emojis and the word.
How do I select emojis on mobile and PC?
On mobile, tap your screen to select emojis and interact with the interface. On PC, use the left mouse button to click emojis and UI elements.

join-clash-3d.intro: Join Clash 3D is an arcade game that mixes avoiding, shooting, and collecting. You start with one soldier, gather more by blowing up barrels, and build up enough troops to face the monsters at the end.
tips: Shoot barrels early to grow your squad before the harder parts arrive, since you need enough soldiers for the final monster rush.
Keep an eye on the path ahead and move aside from obstacles, because hitting them costs you soldiers.
Balance shooting and dodging: aim at barrels to collect more soldiers, but leave room to slide out of the way when something dangerous is coming.
Spend your upgrades on the soldiers' power as soon as you can, so each soldier does more damage against the monsters.
Watch for the caves at the end of the level, since that is where the monsters will come from, and make sure your group is as large as possible before you reach them.
faq: How do I control my soldiers?
Slide your finger or mouse across the screen to move, shoot, and avoid obstacles. Sliding handles both aiming and dodging.
How do I get more soldiers?
Blow up the barrels along the way to collect more soldiers. Each one you gather adds to your group.

frogtress.intro: Frogtress is an action survival game where your frog attacks bugs on its own while you choose mutations and fuse them into combos. Survive the waves, beat the bosses, and purify the ponds.
tips: After each wave, read all three mutation choices before picking, and aim to collect 4 that work together so you can unlock a fusion.
Your frog attacks automatically, so spend your clicks or taps on bugs that are getting close rather than trying to hit everything.
Save CROAK for a moment when it matters most, such as a crowded wave, instead of using it as soon as the belly is full.
Use P to pause when a wave gets busy so you can check your mutations and plan your next pick.
Plan toward wave 30, where the boss must be beaten to purify the pond, and keep your mutation build focused on surviving until then.
faq: What is the main goal of Frogtress?
Survive the waves of bugs, beat the boss at wave 30 to purify the pond, and then go deeper into the waters.
How do I attack the bugs?
Your frog attacks on its own, but you can click or tap a bug to lick it right away. When the belly is full, press CROAK or Space for a big blast.

tide-and-powder.intro: Tide & Powder is a 3D pirate sailing roguelike where you command a small warship. Read the wind, sail past islands, fight enemy ships and build a stronger vessel through upgrades and harbour visits.
tips: Turn your ship so the broadside you want faces the target before you fire, since firing arcs decide which guns can reach.
Time your volleys around each gun bank's reload instead of firing the moment it is ready, so you keep firing steadily.
Use the sail settings to control your speed and approach, and keep islands in mind so they do not block your line of fire.
Collect gold from wrecks soon after a fight, and save enough gold for harbour repairs before your hull gets low.
When choosing upgrades, favour the category that fixes your current weak point, such as hull for survival or weapons for damage, because enemies get tougher as your ship improves.
faq: How do I win an operation?
Complete the operation objectives, then destroy the pirate island's defensive batteries and its central powder magazine. After that you begin another voyage.
Which keys fire the cannons?
Q fires the port broadside and E fires the starboard broadside. W fires the bow guns and S fires the stern guns.

gt-championship-arcade.intro: GT Championship Arcade is a high-speed racing game set on neon-lit tracks. You drive futuristic GT cars, practice smooth drifting, and race against rivals that adapt to you.
tips: Learn the layout of each track before pushing for top speed, since the tracks are intricate and a missed turn costs more time than a slower entry.
Focus on smooth drifting rather than sharp, jerky corrections, because steady cornering keeps your speed up through the bends.
Because rivals adapt, avoid repeating the exact same line every lap. Vary your approach when you notice a rival closing in on your racing line.
Watch for the dynamic challenges that appear during races and adjust your pace rather than holding one speed the whole way.
Use the races you finish to unlock new tracks and cars, and pick the car that suits the track you are about to race.
faq: What is the main goal of GT Championship Arcade?
The goal is to win races against adaptive rivals on neon-lit tracks. Finishing races well also helps you unlock new tracks and cars.
How do I get new tracks and cars?
The game says you unlock new tracks and cars as you race. Keep completing races to open more of them.

super-huggie-bros.intro: Super Huggie Bros is a 2D platformer where you guide Huggy Wuggy through a fiery escape. The character runs on its own, so timing your jumps and dodging hazards is the main challenge.
tips: Watch the flames behind you, since they keep advancing and you need to stay ahead of them.
Use the double jump to clear gaps and obstacles, and time the second jump so you land safely.
Scan the path ahead for hazards early so you have time to react before you reach them.
Pick up coins when it is safe to do so, because they unlock stylish transformations.
Practice short stretches of the level first, since keen timing matters more than speed.
faq: What is the goal of Super Huggie Bros?
The goal is to escape the fire by guiding Huggy Wuggy through the level while avoiding hazards and staying ahead of the advancing flames.
How does the double jump work?
The double jump lets Huggy Wuggy jump a second time in mid-air, which helps with precise movement over hazards and gaps.

balls-vs-lasers.intro: Balls Vs Lasers is a fast arcade game where you steer two balls to dodge incoming lasers. Quick reactions and steady control of both balls are the keys to lasting longer.
tips: Watch both balls at once rather than focusing on only one, since lasers can approach from either side.
Keep your clicks or taps short and deliberate so each ball moves where you intend instead of overcorrecting.
Match each ball to the laser of the same color, because the game asks you to place balls of the same color against the corresponding laser.
Stay near the middle of the play area when nothing is coming, so you have room to react in either direction.
Practice in short sessions to build reaction speed, since the game rewards fast, precise movement.
faq: What is the goal of Balls Vs Lasers?
The goal is to control two balls and avoid the incoming lasers for as long as you can. Each ball must also be placed against the laser of its matching color.
How do I control the balls?
You play with mouse clicks or taps. Use them to move the balls and dodge the oncoming laser attacks.

flow-blast-shooter.intro: Flow Blast Shooter is a fast puzzle shooter where you place shooters on a conveyor of moving blocks and fire at the right moment. Timing and color control decide how long you can keep the flow moving.
tips: Before you fire, check the color and number on each unit so you know exactly which segment it will fill or clear.
Watch the flow for a few seconds before acting. Spotting the pattern of incoming blocks helps you plan your next shot.
Aim with a steady rhythm instead of rushing. Firing at the right moment matters more than firing quickly.
Think a step ahead about tricky color combinations, since placing a shooter in the wrong spot can make the next block harder to clear.
Save your boosters for difficult moments, such as a fast flow or a tough block pattern, rather than using them early.
faq: What is the goal of Flow Blast Shooter?
You control colored units marked with numbers to fill or clear colored segments on a closed track. Keep the blocks flowing and clear the track as the levels get harder.
How do I get better at timing my shots?
Practice watching the flow and firing when the block lines up with your aim. Shorter sessions can help you learn the rhythm without getting frustrated.

click-and-idle-slimes.intro: Click & Idle - Slimes! is a clicker game where you tap a squishy slime to earn income and grow your empire. You can unlock skills, collect slimes, and shape your own progression.
tips: Tap the slime steadily from the start, since clicking is how you generate the income that pays for everything else.
Check which skills give instant rewards and which give long-term advantages, and spend early on the ones that fit how you want to progress.
Compare skills by their perks rather than only by click boosts, because some skills do more than raise your tapping power.
Explore the menus between sessions to see what upgrades and options are available before you spend your income.
Since the adventure is endless, aim for steady, balanced growth instead of spending everything at once.
faq: How do I earn income in Click & Idle - Slimes!?
Tap the squishy slime to generate income. Your income is what you use to expand your empire and unlock upgrades.
What do skills do?
Skills are unlocked and enhanced over time, and each one offers a unique perk. Some grant instant rewards, while others provide long-term advantages.

lumina-robot.intro: Lumina Robot is a platformer puzzle game where you guide a robot through dark levels, using the light on its head to see the way forward. Collect card keys, unlock doors, and reach the trophy.
tips: Use the light on your robot's head to scout ahead before each jump, since the levels are dark and it's easy to misjudge distances.
Collect the card keys you pass on the way, because you need them to open doors that block your path.
Before moving, look at the whole stage and plan the order you will take the keys and doors, especially when the layout gets more complex.
Keep clear of the torches, since touching one sends you back to the start of the level and costs progress.
Stay patient and take short, careful jumps; the game tests reflexes, so slowing down near tricky ledges often works better than rushing.
faq: What is the goal of Lumina Robot?
Your aim is to guide your robot through each level and reach the trophy. Collecting card keys to unlock doors helps you move forward.
What controls do I use to move and jump?
Use W, A, S, D or the arrow keys to move your robot. Press Space to jump.

clicker-knights-vs-dragons.intro: Clicker Knights vs Dragons is an idle clicker RPG where you tap the screen to deal damage while your heroes auto-attack skeletons and dragons. You build your team, upgrade your heroes, and push through fantasy stages and boss fights.
tips: Keep tapping while you play, since your taps add Hero Tap DMG on top of what your heroes deal automatically.
Watch your Total DPS on the stage screen and use it to judge whether your upgrades are actually helping.
Put upgrades into Striker DPS early, because the game is built around exponential scaling and that stat compounds as you progress.
Hire and level up heroes steadily rather than spending everything on one, so your team keeps pace as stages get harder.
Check your offline rewards each time you return, and before a boss raid, make sure your team is upgraded enough to handle the fight.
faq: What is the main goal of Clicker Knights vs Dragons?

The goal is to advance through progressive fantasy stages and worlds by defeating skeletons, dragons and bosses. You do this by building a team of pixel-art heroes and steadily increasing your damage.
How do I deal damage to enemies?
On desktop, click the left mouse button anywhere on the screen. On mobile, tap anywhere on the screen. Your taps deal Hero Tap DMG and attack enemies, while your heroes also attack automatically.

stunt-extreme.intro: Stunt Extreme is a side-scrolling motocross racing game where you perform tricks, handle challenging tracks, and try to outrace your rivals. Speed and precision both matter.
tips: Keep your speed up through the jumps, since a faster approach usually gives you more air time for tricks.
Land your bike level and steady after each jump, because a bad landing can cost you the lead.
Try your tricks on the smoother stretches first so you learn their timing before you need them on a tough section.
Watch where your rivals are on screen and decide when to push for a pass and when to hold your line.
Learn each track's layout over a few runs, paying attention to where the big jumps and rough patches come up.
faq: What is the goal of Stunt Extreme?
You race on dirt bike tracks against rivals, aiming to outrace them while showing off stunts. Winning races and performing tricks with precision are the main focus.
Does the game list its controls?
The game's description does not list specific controls, so check any in-game prompts or instructions when you start a race to see how tricks and steering work.

steal-meme-and-go.intro: Steal Meme And Go is a heist game where you sneak into homes while the owners are away and grab valuable assets. Other NPCs are also trying to steal from your house, so you need to both raid and defend.
tips: Go for the most valuable items first, since the goal is to grab them before the other NPCs do.
Keep an eye on what the rivals are taking so you can switch targets before the best items are gone.
Balance your time between stealing and protecting your own property, because a house left unguarded can be robbed.
Watch how the other characters move and act, and use that to pick the moment when a home is safest to enter.
Plan each heist as a quick, focused trip rather than lingering, so you get out with your loot before anyone catches you.
faq: What is the main goal of Steal Meme And Go?
Your goal is to steal valuable assets to make your property richer. You also need to outsmart the other NPCs who are trying to steal from you.
How do I win a round?
Win by grabbing the most valuable items before anyone else does. Protecting your own property is just as important as stealing.

tractor-simulator-farming-game.intro: Tractor Simulator Farming Game is a farming sim where you cultivate and harvest crops, then trade them and craft products like tomato ketchup and dairy treats. Each level opens new ways to earn currency.
tips: Look for chances to both sell raw crops and turn them into crafted products, since the game names both trading and crafting as ways to build up your earnings.
Check each new level for fresh opportunities to earn currency before you start working, so you know which activities are worth your time.
Focus on one crop cycle at a time, moving from cultivating to harvesting to trading, so your progress stays easy to follow.
Pay attention to which products bring in the most value, such as tomato ketchup or dairy treats, and plan your farm around them.
Take time to enjoy the fields as you drive between tasks, since the game is built around a relaxed pace of growth.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
The goal is to grow a successful farm by cultivating and harvesting crops, trading them, and crafting products to earn currency. Each level offers new ways to do this.
How do I earn currency?
You earn currency by trading crops and by crafting products such as tomato ketchup and dairy treats. New levels also bring new opportunities to earn more.

drifting-mania.intro: Drifting Mania is an endless racing game about drifting through sharp turns on a colorful road. Tap, hold and release to stay on the asphalt and build up your drifting skills.
tips: Practice the tap, hold and release rhythm on straight sections first so you learn how long to hold before letting go.
Watch the road ahead rather than your car, since sharp turns come up quickly and you need time to react.
Drift on purpose to earn money, because that money is what you use to unlock and customize your car.
Try different cars from the 13 options to see which one suits your style of drifting.
Work toward the 30 achievements over several runs, focusing on one or two at a time instead of chasing them all at once.
faq: How do I earn money in Drifting Mania?
You earn money by drifting. Use the money to unlock and customize your car.
What are the controls?
Tap, hold and release to stay on the road while you drift through turns.

stickman-jailbreak-story.intro: Stickman: Jailbreak Story is a puzzle escape game where you guide an innocent stickman out of jail. You select items and interact with objects to solve puzzles and slip past guards.
tips: Look around each room before you act. Note every object and item, since most of them are likely part of a solution.
Pick up items you might need later and keep track of what you carry, so you can combine or use them at the right moment.
Watch guard movements for a moment before you move. Timing your steps around them helps you avoid being caught.
Make quick decisions, but do not rush. If you are stuck, step back and recheck the objects in the room for something you missed.
Try different options when a choice fails. The game rewards choosing the correct option, so trying another approach is often faster than repeating the same one.
faq: What is the goal of Stickman: Jailbreak Story?
Your goal is to help the trapped stickman solve puzzles, outsmart the guards, and reach freedom.
How do I control the game?
Use your mouse or tap the screen to select items, interact with objects, and choose options.

doomsday-shooter.intro: Doomsday Shooter throws you into a monster invasion with a range of weapons, 3D battles, and large arenas to fight through. Collect coins to upgrade and keep fighting until the end.
tips: Keep moving during fights, since the game makes constant movement as important as aim.
Try out your different weapons early so you learn which ones suit close and long-range fights.
Spend time learning the layout of each arena so you know where to run when monsters close in.
Pick up coins whenever it is safe to do so, because they fund the upgrades that help you survive longer.
Aim carefully rather than firing wildly, since steady aim is one of the main keys to staying alive.
faq: What is the goal of Doomsday Shooter?
The goal is to survive an invasion of relentless monsters and keep fighting through the chaos for as long as you can.
What are coins used for?
Coins are collected during battles and used to buy upgrades that strengthen you for the fights ahead.

shape-defense.intro: Shape Defense is a puzzle game where you guard your treasure from waves of geometric invaders. Each shape behaves differently, and the challenge grows as the rounds go on.
tips: Watch how each new shape moves before deciding where to focus your defense, since every invader type poses a different challenge.
Save your coins for upgrades that suit the threats you are facing rather than spending them as soon as you collect them.
Stay alert at the start of each round, because the description says new surprises appear every round.
Pay attention to which waves cause the most trouble and adjust your approach early instead of reacting after the treasure takes damage.
Expect the pace to increase over time, so practice calm, steady choices early when the waves are still manageable.
faq: What is the goal of Shape Defense?
The goal is to guard your treasure against waves of geometric invaders that attack in each round.
How do I earn upgrades in Shape Defense?
You collect coins during play and use them to buy powerful upgrades that help you defend against the invaders.

hole-eats-all-eat-them-all.intro: Hole Eats All is a 3D arcade game where you steer a hungry hole around colorful levels, eating objects to grow. Each level must be cleared before the timer runs out.
tips: Begin each level by eating the smaller objects nearby, since growing gives you access to the bigger ones.
Keep an eye on the timer and pick a route that passes through groups of objects rather than wandering around the map.
Check whether a larger object is within reach before moving toward it, so you do not waste time chasing something you cannot eat yet.
If a level feels too hard, try the boosters and upgrades you have unlocked, as the game suggests they are meant for difficult stages.
Replay earlier levels when you feel stuck, because the size you gain there can make the later, harder levels easier to clear.
faq: What is the goal of Hole Eats All?
Your goal is to eat the required objects in each level and finish before the timer runs out.
How do I move the hole?
On desktop, use the WASD or arrow keys. On mobile, drag the on-screen joystick in any direction.

drago-warrior-tower-defense.intro: Drago Warrior Tower Defense is a strategy game where you protect your kingdom from waves of dark monsters and giant dragons. You place towers, summon heroes, and use skills to stop enemies before they reach your base.
tips: Spread your towers so they cover the same stretch of the enemy route, which keeps targets under fire for longer.
Save hero spells for tough moments, such as when a large group arrives or a boss appears, instead of using them as soon as they are ready.
Use manual targeting on dangerous enemies that are close to your base, and let your towers handle the weaker ones.
Watch how each wave moves before you spend upgrades, so you can invest in the towers that are doing the most work.
Use fast-forward during early waves when the threat is low, and slow down when a new enemy type or boss shows up.
faq: How do I win a level?
You win by surviving all the waves without enemies reaching your base. Earning upgrades along the way makes it easier to hold out against the later waves.
How do I target a specific enemy?
Click or tap an enemy to focus your towers on it. Use this for threats that are getting close to your base.

zaruvane-the-amber-oasis.intro: Zaruvane: The Amber Oasis is a desert survival and building game where you explore, gather resources, and turn an empty patch of sand into a thriving oasis. Manage food and water while caring for your animal companions through changing days and sandstorms.
tips: Explore the desert before committing to a spot, so you know where resources are and can plan your oasis around them.
Check your food and water often rather than waiting until one runs low, since you can drink with F and eat with G whenever you need to.
Press P to pause when you want to think through your next steps, such as which resources to collect first or what to build.
Keep your animal companions in mind as days change, and look after them before sandstorms make travel harder.
If you play on mobile, hold your device in landscape and get used to the left joystick for movement before you try to gather resources in a hurry.
faq: How do I drink and eat in Zaruvane?
Press F to drink and G to eat. Keeping both topped up is central to surviving in the desert.
What does the E key do?
E is used to interact with things in the game world. Use it when you want to take part in an action in front of you.

monster-live.intro: Monster Live is an action game set in an apocalyptic world, where you fight real-time waves of undead. Choose whether to survive alone or team up with other players.
tips: Pick your skill upgrades with the next few levels in mind, not just the immediate fight. The challenges escalate, so a build that works early may fall short later.
Watch how the hordes move before committing to a fight. Staying mobile and reacting quickly helps you avoid being surrounded.
If you play with others, agree on roles early so you are not all drawing enemies at once. Coordinating who handles which threats keeps the team alive longer.
Do not rush into the thickest crowds. Pick off the threats closest to you and fall back when your position becomes unsafe.
Treat each level as a chance to adjust your character. Reviewing which upgrades helped most will guide your choices in the next run.
faq: What is the main goal in Monster Live?
The goal is to survive the undead hordes in a real-time apocalyptic setting. The game keeps getting harder as you progress.
How do upgrades work?
You upgrade your skills tactically as you move through each level. Choosing upgrades that match your playstyle helps you handle later challenges.

sportbike-drive.intro: Sportbike Drive is a motorcycle simulator where you pick from three bikes, ride across two locations, and test your driving skills with stunts. You can explore freely and try whatever you like.
tips: Try all three motorcycles before settling on one, since each handles differently and you can switch bikes from the main menu.
Use the rear brake (X) to slow down in a controlled way when you need to take a turn tightly or stay steady.
Build up speed with the accelerate control (2) gradually, so you keep control of the bike instead of losing balance at the start of a ride.
Practice in both locations, as the different surroundings give you different room to experiment with driving and stunts.
If a stunt goes wrong or you want a fresh start, press R to restart quickly instead of returning to the menu.
faq: Is there a specific goal in Sportbike Drive?
The game is open-ended and focuses on freedom, so there is no set objective listed. Choose a bike, ride around, and try stunts at your own pace.
What controls do I use to drive?
Use WASD or the arrow keys to steer and move the bike. Press 2 to accelerate, X for the rear brake, R to restart, and Esc or Tab to return to the main menu.

draw-bridge-brain-game.intro: Draw Bridge is a physics-based drawing puzzle where you draw roads to help a stranded car reach its destination. Each level can be solved in more than one way.
tips: Look at the whole level before you start drawing, including where the car begins and where it needs to end up.
Remember that the car only moves after you release your finger, so plan the full shape of your path before you lift off.
Draw slowly and smoothly with a steady hold, so the shape you make matches the path you had in mind.
Try a different approach if a shape fails, since the game supports creative, non-linear solutions and several routes can work.
Watch how the car moves after each attempt and use what you see to adjust the height, slope, or length of your next path.
faq: What is the goal of Draw Bridge?
Your goal is to draw paths that let the car safely get past obstacles and reach its destination.
How do I control the drawing?
Touch the screen to start drawing, hold and drag to make the shape you want, then release to let the car run.

squad-assembler-red-vs-blue.intro: Squad Assembler - Red vs Blue is a strategy puzzler where you build a team, equip your fighters, and battle rival squads in isometric arenas. Planning ahead matters more than rushing into fights.
tips: Think about how your squad fits together before you commit resources, since the goal is a team that works as a unit.
Spend your funds with a plan. Decide which fighters or gear matter most for the arena in front of you.
Try merging gear to create upgrades, and compare the result against what you already have before combining more pieces.
Pay attention to the layout of each arena and where your fighters stand, because positioning is central to winning skirmishes.
If a battle goes badly, adjust your squad and approach rather than repeating the same setup, since tactical precision is what the game rewards.
faq: What is the main goal of Squad Assembler - Red vs Blue?
You build a battle squad, equip and fund it, and lead your fighters to win skirmishes against rival squads across arenas.
How does merging gear help?
Merging gear creates powerful upgrades for your fighters, so it is worth keeping track of which pieces combine well.

panda-lu-treehouse.intro: Panda Lu Treehouse is a relaxed simulator where you look after a panda named Lu. You build his treehouse, keep him happy, and grow his home over time.
tips: Start by checking on Panda Lu's wellbeing before spending on anything else, since the game asks you to make sure he is well taken care of first.
Offer him a variety of entertainments in the treehouse rather than relying on just one, so you can see which ones keep him happiest.
Expand the treehouse once the basics are in place, so Panda Lu has new rooms and areas to explore.
Take part in the fun activities with Panda Lu as you progress, since they are part of how the adventure moves forward.
Use mouse clicks or taps deliberately and slowly, especially when placing items or choosing activities, so you do not waste moves.
faq: What is the main goal in Panda Lu Treehouse?
Your goal is to build a cozy tree house for Panda Lu and keep him happy by caring for him and giving him things to enjoy.
How do I control the game?
You play with mouse clicks or taps only. Click or tap to select, build, and interact with the treehouse and Panda Lu.

uncle-hit-punch-the-dummy.intro: Uncle Hit: Punch the Dummy is a casual arcade game where you control a floating boxing glove and punch dummies and objects out of each scene. Each level has a new setup, and clearing every target lets you move on.
tips: Before swinging, look at how the dummies are grouped, since one well-aimed punch can knock several of them aside at once.
Physics can send knocked objects into other targets, so a quick hit on the right one may clear the scene faster than hitting each target directly.
Remember that you need to knock out other objects in the scene too, not only the dummies, so scan the whole screen before you finish a level.
There is no timer, so take a moment to line up your glove before each swing instead of rushing.
On levels that need more timing, try a few different angles if a target is hard to reach rather than repeating the same swing.
faq: What do I need to do to finish a level?
Knock out every dummy and the other objects in the scene. Once all of them are down, you can move to the next level.
Does the game get harder as I progress?
There is no strict difficulty curve. Some levels are very simple, while others require more precise timing.

sorty-bolty.intro: SORTY BOLTY is a color sorting puzzle where you move colored nuts onto matching bolts. Each game gets harder as the moves demand more planning ahead.
tips: Before each move, check which bolts already hold a single color, since those are the easiest places to build a clean stack.
Avoid moving a nut onto a bolt with mixed colors unless it clears a path to a color you need.
Look a few moves ahead: a move that looks helpful now can block a color you will need later.
Use the Cancel move hint as soon as you realize a step has trapped a nut, rather than working around a mistake.
Save the Extra bolt hint for a stuck position where no safe move remains, because it opens space for nuts you cannot otherwise place.
faq: What is the goal of SORTY BOLTY?
You sort the colored nuts so that each bolt ends up holding nuts of one matching color. The puzzle is solved when the nuts are organized this way.
How do I move a nut?
Tap or click a bolt to select a nut, then tap or click another bolt that has the same color or is empty. The nut moves to that bolt.

mutant-mash-merge-garden.intro: Drop fruit-animal hybrids, merge matching pairs into bigger and weirder ones, and keep the pile below the top line. Each round lasts a few minutes, and your Mega Mutant plant grows a little more every day.
tips: Aim before you release, since you can move your finger or mouse until the moment you drop. Careful aiming keeps the pile flat and spreads your fruits where you want them.
Look for matching fruits on the pile before dropping new ones. Setting up a pair so it can touch and merge helps you keep building upward without crowding the top.
Save your one Swap for a moment when the fruit you are holding would block a merge or push the pile too high. You only get one swap per round, so pick the right time.
Watch the top line as the pile grows. If it gets close, focus on merging what is already there before adding more fruit.
If you play with the keyboard, use the arrow keys to move, Space to drop, and P to pause when you need a moment to plan.
faq: What is the goal of Mutant Mash: Merge Garden?
Drop and merge matching fruit-animal hybrids to create bigger ones, and avoid letting the pile reach the top line. Each merge can also mutate into a Golden, Rainbow or Glitch version.
How do I drop and merge fruits?
Move your finger or mouse to aim, then release to drop. Touch two matching fruits to merge them.

capybara-hexasort.intro: Capybara-HexaSort is a calm color-sorting puzzle. You place hex tile stacks on a board, merge matching top colors, and reach each level goal before you run out of free cells.
tips: Before each placement, check which top colors are showing and where a matching stack could touch it, so the merge happens by design.
Keep some empty cells open. Filling the board too early is the most common reason a level is lost.
Avoid placing a stack where it blocks the only route to a color you will need soon. Look a move or two ahead.
Look at the level goal first and work toward it, rather than merging whatever is easiest in the moment.
If you get stuck, try the in-game boosters, and use pause or settings to take a break when you need a clear head.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Clear the tiles and complete the level goal shown for that level before the board has no room left for another stack.
How do I place a stack?
On desktop, click and drag a stack from the bottom tray with the left mouse button and release it over an empty board cell. On mobile, tap or drag the stack and release it over an empty cell.

kofi-adventure.intro: Kofi Adventure is a platformer where you guide Kofi through enchanted forests and mysterious caves in Dreamland. Timing, puzzles, and your choices all shape how the quest unfolds.
tips: Watch the moving obstacles and magical creatures for a few seconds before you commit to a jump. Patterns become easier to read once you have seen them repeat.
When you reach a puzzle, pause and look at the whole area first. Note which objects or paths stand out before you start testing.
Treat each section as a chance to experiment with different approaches. Clever strategies often work better than rushing through.
Pay attention to the choices you make along the way, since each one can lead to a different ending. If you want to see another ending, try a different path on your next run.
Explore the vibrant landscapes slowly. Hidden secrets in Dreamland are more likely to appear when you look around instead of racing ahead.
faq: What is the main goal in Kofi Adventure?
You guide Kofi through enchanted forests and mysterious caves while uncovering the secrets of Dreamland. Your choices lead to one of several endings.
How do I get a different ending?
Each choice you make can lead to a new ending in the quest. Replaying and choosing different paths is the way to explore the other outcomes.

suger-rush.intro: Sugar Rush is a physics puzzle where you cut candy ropes so the candy reaches the hungry rabbit. Plan each cut before you act, since one mistake can end the run.
tips: Before cutting, follow the rope and the path the candy will take, so you can see where it will land.
Aim for the rabbit's position rather than cutting as soon as the candy looks close, because timing decides whether it reaches him.
Watch how the candy swings after a cut and wait for it to settle into a predictable line before making your next move.
If a candy is about to fall away from the rabbit, consider that the level may already be lost and focus on learning the angle for the next attempt.
Keep your touches or clicks deliberate and calm, since the controls are simple and quick, careless taps are the most common cause of a missed feed.
faq: What is the goal of Sugar Rush?
You cut the candy rope at the right moment so the candy falls to the rabbit and he can eat it.
How do I cut the rope?
On Android, tap the on-screen rope to cut it, and on PC, use a left mouse click.

ping-pong-3d.intro: Ping Pong 3D is a sports game about table tennis rallies, where timing and paddle control decide each point. Its realistic physics reward careful play over rushing.
tips: Watch where the ball is heading before you move, since realistic physics means spin and angle affect how it bounces back.
Use the paddle's movement to change the angle of your return rather than just hitting the ball back the same way.
Keep your paddle near the center of your play area between shots so you can react quickly to the next ball.
Pay attention to how your opponent positions themselves and send the ball to the side they are not covering.
Try different varied modes to learn how each one changes the pace, and stick with the one that suits your reflexes.
faq: What is the goal of Ping Pong 3D?
The goal is to outplay your opponent in table tennis rallies and win the match. The description focuses on precision, skill, and strategy.
How do the controls work?
The game uses sleek controls that let you make dynamic paddle movements. Practice them in a few rallies to get a feel for how the paddle responds.

falling-blocks-2048-2d.intro: Falling Blocks 2048 - 2D combines Tetris-style falling pieces with the number merging of 2048. Your aim is to merge numbers on the grid until you reach 2048.
tips: Keep the bottom of the grid as open as you can, since stacking blocks high leaves less room to maneuver.
Before each drop, check which numbers can merge next to each other and place blocks so matching values sit together.
Plan a few moves ahead rather than reacting to each falling block, so your merges build toward larger numbers.
Try to keep one area of the grid clear for incoming blocks, which gives you room to fix mistakes.
Play in short sessions at first to get a feel for how the blocks fall and merge before attempting longer runs.
faq: What is the goal of Falling Blocks 2048 - 2D?
The goal is to merge numbers on the grid by maneuvering falling blocks until you reach 2048.
How is this game different from regular 2048?
It adds falling blocks like Tetris, so you need to place pieces as they drop while still merging numbers toward 2048.

owl-block.intro: Owl Block is a platform adventure built around quick reflexes, careful block movement, and precise timing across more than 100 levels. Each stage tests how well you can read and avoid obstacles.
tips: Watch the obstacles for a few seconds before you move so you can spot their pattern and timing.
Practice precise timing on early levels, since small mistakes in jump or move timing are the most common cause of failure.
Plan your block movements a step ahead rather than reacting only to what is directly in front of you.
If you keep failing the same section, pause your attempts and try again with a slower, more deliberate approach.
Treat each level as a short test of agility; resetting your focus between attempts often helps more than rushing.
faq: What is the main goal in Owl Block?
You move through platform levels while avoiding intricate obstacles, using quick reflexes and strategic block movements to get through each stage.
How many levels does Owl Block have?
The game offers over 100 levels, so you can keep progressing through a long run of platform challenges.

oddly-sorted-color-sort.intro: Oddly Sorted: Color Sort is a puzzle where you sort colorful blocks into matching boxes to reveal pixel-art portraits. Plan the order of the front boxes and manage your slots carefully.
tips: Before tapping anything, look at which front box is next in line and which blocks of that color can be reached. Choosing the box order is the core of the puzzle.
Keep your slots free for blocks you still need to move. Do not fill every slot, because the portrait only needs to be cleared, not packed.
Use Undo freely when a move closes off a path you needed. Undo is free, so testing a different order costs you nothing.
Try Hints when you are stuck, and use Shuffle when the current layout has no good moves left. Both are free, so there is no penalty for using them.

Extra slots are free, so add them when your slots are crowded instead of rushing to empty them. On desktop, pressing the queue number is a quick way to collect a color once you have planned the order.
faq: How do I collect blocks in Oddly Sorted: Color Sort?
Tap or click a front box to collect the reachable blocks of its color. On desktop, you can press the queue number for that box instead.
Do I have to fill all my slots to finish a portrait?
No. The goal is to clear the portrait without filling every slot, so keep some room open as you work.

rich-mom-family-simulator-luxury-life.intro: Rich Mom Family Simulator Luxury Life is an adventure game where you play a billionaire mother running a business and looking after her family. You move around a city, take on missions, and enjoy a wealthy lifestyle.
tips: Use the mouse to swing the camera before you move so you can see where missions and objects are before you walk into them.
Hold Left Shift to sprint when you have a long walk between locations, then ease off to avoid overshooting your target.
Press P to pause when you need a moment to check your surroundings or think about what to do next.
Work through one mission at a time and finish it before starting another so you do not lose track of what you are trying to achieve.
If a mission is stuck, try a different route or move to another area of the city and come back, rather than repeating the same steps.
faq: How do I move my character?
On desktop, use W, A, S and D to move and the mouse to move the camera. On mobile, use the joystick to move the player.
What does the F key do?
F is the action key for interacting with things in the game. Stand close to what you want to use before pressing it.

noob-city-the-gangster.intro: Noob City The Gangster is a 3D action game set in an open world where other criminals try to eliminate you. Each level brings tougher foes, so you'll need to plan your moves.
tips: Use the mouse to look around before you move, so you always know where rivals might be waiting in the open world.
Keep an eye on the enemies you pass. Learn how they approach so you can react before they reach you.
Use the handbrake with Space when you need to stop or turn sharply in a vehicle, rather than crashing into obstacles.
Press F to get out of a vehicle when it is safer on foot, especially if you are being chased.
Take your time in the early levels to learn the controls, since the later levels bring more dangerous foes.
faq: What is the goal of Noob City The Gangster?
You play as a gangster in an open world and must complete the game's levels while eliminating or getting past criminals who try to stop you. Each level features more dangerous foes.
What are the controls?
Use the mouse to look around, W, A, S and D to drive, Space to use the handbrake, and F to exit a vehicle.

bubble-rush.intro: Bubble Rush is a one-player bubble shooter puzzle. You aim from the center, shoot colorful bubbles, and clear the board by matching bubbles of the same color.
tips: Before each shot, look at the whole board and pick a color group you can pop, rather than shooting at the first bubble you see.
Aim to join your bubble to a matching group so that more than the bubble you hit gets cleared.
Keep an eye on which colors are left in small numbers, since clearing them early can open up the rest of the board.
Take a moment to plan your next shot before clicking or tapping, because quick shots often leave stray bubbles behind.
If you are running low on options, use the bonus choices offered in the game to refill or continue rather than rushing a poor shot.
faq: What is the goal of Bubble Rush?
The goal is to clear the board by popping bubbles. You do this by matching bubbles of the same color.
How do I aim and shoot?
On a computer, move the mouse to aim and click to shoot. On mobile, use touch controls to aim and shoot.

hook-master-mafia-city.intro: Hook Master: Mafia City is a puzzle escape game set in a dangerous city. You solve puzzles, collect items, and use a grappling hook to swing away from enemies.
tips: Look at the whole scene before you act. Note where enemies are, where you can swing to, and which objects might help you solve the puzzle.
Use the grappling hook to get out of danger quickly, but plan your swing first so you do not land near an enemy.
Mix your moves. Dodge when an enemy is about to reach you, then strike or swing away once you have space.
Keep track of items you collect, since they may be needed for a puzzle later on.
If you get stuck, step back and check your surroundings again. Puzzle solving often depends on noticing a detail you missed.
faq: What is the goal of Hook Master Mafia City?
Your goal is to solve puzzles and escape the enemy hunt in the city. You use your smart thinking and grappling hook skills to get away.
How do I control the character?
Use a mouse click or a tap to play. Clicks or taps control the grappling hook, swings, dodges, and strikes.

block-master-gem-puzzle.intro: Block Master Gem Puzzle is an 8x8 block puzzle where you drag pieces onto the board and clear full rows or columns. It offers three modes: Classic, Diamond Quest, and Clear the Board.
tips: Keep the board as open as possible by placing pieces in a way that leaves flat, empty areas for future blocks.
Avoid filling isolated single gaps early, since they are hard to use later and can block your progress.
In Clear the Board, count your remaining moves before each placement and plan two or three steps ahead.
In Diamond Quest, look at where the diamonds are first and clear the rows or columns that reach them most directly.
In Classic mode, aim to clear several lines in one move when possible, since clearing more at once helps you build a higher score.
faq: What is the goal of the game?

The goal depends on the mode: in Classic you play endlessly to beat your high score, in Diamond Quest you collect all diamonds to finish a level, and in Clear the Board you remove every block within a limited number of moves.
How do I clear blocks?
Drag and place blocks onto the 8x8 board, and complete a full row or column to clear it and earn points.

triangle-run.intro: Triangle Run is an arcade skill game where you steer a triangle through a rotating world. You tap to change direction and work through each level's obstacles using timing and reflexes.
tips: Watch the rotation for a moment before you move. Learning the pattern of the twists helps you time your taps more accurately.
Tap with small, deliberate timing rather than rapidly. Precision matters more than speed when the world keeps turning.
Expect each level to have its own obstacles. Pay attention to how they behave in the first attempt and adjust your approach on the next one.
If you keep failing at the same spot, slow down and reset your rhythm. Patience usually gets you further than pushing through quickly.
Keep your focus on the triangle rather than the edges of the screen, so you can react to unpredictable turns as they happen.
faq: What is the goal of Triangle Run?
The goal is to steer your triangle through the rotating world and get past each level's obstacles. The description focuses on reflexes, timing, and precision.
How do I control the triangle?
You tap to change the triangle's direction. Timing each tap is the main skill in the game.

idle-chicken-farm.intro: Idle Chicken Farm is an idle merge game about growing one chicken into a working egg business. This guide covers how to choose between selling and incubating eggs, and how to get the most from merging and upgrades.
tips: Sell eggs when you need steady income, since selling gives a guaranteed profit. Save incubation for when you can afford to wait for a possible reward.
Merge chickens as soon as you can to reach stronger breeds, because better chickens are the main way your farm grows.
Spend earnings on upgrades to your coop and production line first, since those raise your output for the rest of the game.
Use click-and-drag or tap-and-drag to collect and sell several eggs in one motion instead of tapping each egg separately.
Expand into new facilities once your current setup is running smoothly, so you are not spreading your money too thin.
faq: What is the goal of Idle Chicken Farm?
You start with a single chicken and build a thriving egg production business by selling eggs, merging chickens, and upgrading your farm.
How do I earn money in the game?
You earn money by selling eggs. Incubating eggs can also give you new chickens and bonus rewards.

glowit-two-players.intro: Glowit - Two Players is a head-to-head arcade game where two friends take turns competing in short, randomly chosen mini-games. Each round shows you the instructions before you start.
tips: Read the instructions shown at the start of each round before you act, since every mini-game has different challenges.
Use the drag control with the left mouse button in a steady, controlled way rather than rushing, because the game is built on physics.
Watch your opponent's turn closely, as it can show you how the current mini-game works and what to avoid.
Stay relaxed between rounds and keep track of which mini-games you handle well, so you can build on your strengths against your friend.
Expect variety, since the game picks a new random mini-game each round, so do not get stuck on one approach.
faq: What is the goal of Glowit - Two Players?

You and a friend compete against each other across short mini-games, with each round giving a new challenge and instructions. The description does not list a specific scoring rule, so check the on-screen instructions each round.
How do I control my character?
Drag with the left mouse button to play. Use smooth, deliberate drags to get the result you want.

mike-and-mia-1st-day-school.intro: Mike and Mia are getting ready for their first day of school. You clean their room, pack a snack box, and dress them in cute outfits before enjoying the day with playful activities.
tips: Work through the room cleaning first so the space feels tidy before you move on to the snack box.
When making the snack box, try different items and see which combinations look the most appealing before you finish.
Browse the clothing options carefully, since you can mix and match outfits for each character.
Take your time with each activity instead of rushing, so you can notice all the small interactions the game offers.
Click or tap items to interact with them, and try each tool on different objects to see what responds.
