faq: What is the goal of Mike and Mia 1st Day School?
The goal is to help Mike and Mia get ready for school by cleaning their room, making a snack box, dressing them up, and joining in the day's activities.
How do I play on a computer?
Click items, tools, and buttons with your mouse to interact with the game.

pro-obunga-vs-creepender.intro: Pro Obunga vs CreepEnder is a monster escape game where you run from a relentless pursuer, jump through dangerous levels, and try to reach the portal first. Collect coins to upgrade your character along the way.
tips: Plan each jump before you commit, since the game rewards strategic movement over rushing.
Watch how close Obunga is at all times and avoid moves that leave you cornered with no way forward.
Collect coins whenever you can do so safely, because they are the way to upgrade your character for harder levels.
Keep your route to the portal in mind from the start so that you do not waste time on detours.
If cooperative play is available to you, coordinate with your partner so that you can cover different parts of the level and move quickly together.
faq: What is the main goal of Pro Obunga vs CreepEnder?
The goal is to reach the portal before Obunga catches you. Each level is a chase, so steady progress matters more than speed alone.
What are coins used for in this game?
Coins let you upgrade your character. Gathering them on the way can help you handle the tougher levels that follow.

knock-and-run-100-doors-escape.intro: Knock and Run is a stickman running game set in hotel corridors. You race to the end of each level while pulling pranks on residents without getting caught.
tips: Keep moving at all times, since the character always runs and pausing gives residents a chance to catch you.
Watch the corridor ahead for doors and residents before you reach them, so you can plan your prank timing.
Expect different reactions from each door, and adjust your route after a resident gets angry or scared.
Stay on the move after each prank instead of lingering at the door, which keeps the distance between you and anyone chasing you.
Practice your movement early in the level so that sharp turns and quick dodges feel natural when danger appears.
faq: What is the main goal of Knock and Run?
Reach the end of each level while pulling pranks on residents and avoiding capture. The run to the finish line is what wins the level.
How do I control my character?
You can use touch, the cursor, or the WASD keys to move. The character always runs, so you steer the direction rather than starting and stopping.

angela-real-dentist-doctor-surgery-game.intro: Angela Real Dentist puts you in charge of a pet dental clinic. You treat animals whose teeth hurt from eating too many sweets, using tools to clean, straighten, operate, and fill teeth.
tips: Look at each animal's teeth before picking a tool, so you can tell whether it needs cleaning, straightening, an operation, or a filling.
Work through the problems in a simple order, such as removing plaque first and then dealing with cavities, so you do not miss a step.
Try each instrument, such as the tongs, scalpels, and burs, to see which one works best for each job.
Take your time with delicate treatments, since rushing a procedure is more likely to lead to mistakes.
Use tap or click controls steadily and calmly, especially during detailed work on small areas of the teeth.
faq: What is the goal of Angela Real Dentist?
You treat the teeth of pets in a dental office at an animal hospital. Your tasks include cleaning plaque, straightening teeth, doing operations, and removing and filling cavities.
How do I control the game?
The game is played by tapping or clicking. Use taps or clicks to select tools and make treatment choices.

deep-worm.intro: Deep Worm is an action game where you control a hungry worm that feeds on the surface while staying out of reach of armed humans. Timing your trips up and down is the key to staying alive.
tips: Stay underground as your default position and only surface when you have a clear opening to feed.
Watch the surface before you emerge so you know where the armed humans are standing.
Plan a quick exit route before each feeding run so you can dive back to safety without hesitating.
Expect threats to grow over time, so adjust your pace and do not linger on the surface as the game goes on.
Take short, controlled feeding trips rather than long ones, since staying above ground for too long is where most danger comes from.
faq: What is the main goal of Deep Worm?
Your goal is to survive by devouring things on the surface while avoiding the armed humans who try to stop you. The longer you last against growing threats, the better.
When should I come up to the surface?
Surface when the area around you looks clear and you can reach food quickly. Dive back down as soon as enemies get close.

baby-dino-planet.intro: Baby Dino Planet is an adventure game where you guide a baby dino through colorful levels full of obstacles. You jump and dodge your way through, collect dino eggs and power-ups, and complete missions.
tips: Use the arrow keys to move and jump, and practice until the timing feels natural before you tackle harder obstacles.
Watch the obstacles ahead of you so you can plan your jumps and dodges instead of reacting at the last second.
Pick up dino eggs and power-ups when they are safe to reach, since they help you progress through the level.
Finish missions as you go, because completing them is how you unlock new baby dinos with different abilities.
If a level feels hard, try a different approach on the next attempt, such as slowing down near rivers or lava.
faq: How do I control my baby dino?
Use the keyboard arrow keys to move and jump. Jumping and dodging are the main actions you need to get past obstacles.
What should I collect in each level?
Collect dino eggs and power-ups as you travel. They are part of the levels' surprises and can help you keep going.

warrior-bee-apocalypse.intro: Warrior Bee Apocalypse is an action and upgrade game where you lead a warrior bee through hordes of enemy insects. Clear each level and gather gems to make your bee stronger.
tips: Keep moving toward enemies you can handle, since the bee attacks automatically once it gets close. Staying near a group of foes keeps your damage output steady.
Collect gems whenever it is safe, because they are what you need to upgrade the bee's items and skills. Picking up a few extra on the way can make a later upgrade possible.
Save your special items for crowded moments when many insects are closing in at once. Using them on a single weak enemy wastes their value.
Use the WASD or arrow keys to slip out of the path of a large group rather than standing still. Moving around the edges of a horde gives you room to keep attacking.
On mobile, drag gently across the screen to steer the bee and avoid overcorrecting. Tap the special items in the lower right corner only when you need them most.
faq: What is the main goal of Warrior Bee Apocalypse?
Your goal is to eliminate hordes of enemy insects to complete the levels. Along the way, you collect gems to upgrade the warrior bee.
How do I attack enemies?
You do not press an attack button. Move the bee close to an enemy and it attacks automatically.

open-city-suv-car-stunts.intro: Open City SUV is a driving game where you jump ramps and perform stunts in a large city, or deliver illegal packages while staying ahead of the police. Use the arrow keys or WASD to drive.
tips: Use Free Ride Mode to learn how your SUV handles jumps before you attempt a delivery. Practice landing at different speeds so you know how much throttle you need.
Press Space for the handbrake when you need to turn sharply, such as at a corner or after landing. Tap it briefly rather than holding it, so you keep control of the car.
Before a risky delivery, plan a route that avoids main roads where police are likely to spot you. Taking side streets gives you more room to escape if a chase starts.
When police are chasing you, keep moving and look for places to hide rather than driving in a straight line. Breaking line of sight with the cops is your best chance to escape.
Explore the city in your spare time to find hidden locations and new spots to jump. Knowing the layout ahead of a delivery makes it easier to choose quick escape routes.
faq: What is the main goal of Open City SUV?
Your main mission is to deliver illegal packages across the city without getting caught. You also need to avoid police chases and escape before the cops catch you.
How do I brake and turn in the game?
Use S or the Down Arrow to brake, and A or D (or the Left and Right Arrows) to steer. W or the Up Arrow accelerates the SUV.

wedding-beauty-makeup-salon-indian-desig.intro: Wedding Beauty Makeup Salon is a styling game set around Indian weddings. You prepare a couple for their special day by applying makeup and styling their looks with a wide range of colors and designs.
tips: Try a few different color combinations on the same look before settling on one, since the game is built around experimenting.
Think about the overall feel of the wedding, such as bright and festive or softer and elegant, and let that guide your color and style choices.
Keep the makeup and the styling in harmony so the couple's look feels complete rather than focusing on one detail alone.
Take your time with the more intricate techniques, because careful, detailed work is what makes a finished look stand out.
Save looks you like and compare them side by side to see which colors and styles work best together.
faq: What is the goal of Wedding Beauty Makeup Salon?
Your goal is to prepare a couple for their wedding day by mastering makeup and styling techniques. The game focuses on creating memorable looks.
Is there a single correct look I need to create?
No fixed look is required. The game encourages you to experiment freely with colors and styles to create your own designs.

stickman-crowd-runner-3d.intro: Stickman Crowd Runner 3D is a lane-steering runner where you grow a crowd of stickmen through math gates, dodge hazards, and tackle a boss at the end of each world. Your squad size decides how far you get.
tips: Prioritize multiplication (×) and addition (+) gates, since they grow your crowd fastest, and steer away from red subtraction (-) and division (÷) gates even if they look close.
Check flip-gates before you commit to a lane, because their values can change as you approach them.
Keep your crowd together and avoid spreading it thin, since you need enough runners alive to reach the finish line.
Plan ahead for hazards like pendulums, spikes, and smashers by starting your steering early rather than reacting at the last moment.
During the boss fight, use short, steady rapid taps to keep the rally going, and spend coins in the shop on Tackle Power if you find boss fights difficult.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Grow your crowd of stickmen by passing through positive gates, avoid hazards and rival squads, and reach the finish line of each world. Then defeat the boss at the end.
How do I steer the crowd on desktop?
Use the A and D keys or the Left and Right Arrow keys, or hold and drag with the left mouse button for smoother steering.

moms-diary-cooking-games.intro: Moms Diary: Cooking Games is a time management cooking game where you tap to make recipes and serve customers while working through levels. Your aim is to keep orders moving and meet each level's targets.
tips: Keep an eye on the customers waiting for food and start the dishes they have ordered first, since waiting customers are the main time pressure.
Work on a few recipes at a time rather than one dish at a stretch, so cooking steps overlap and your kitchen stays busy.
Check the level target before you start and plan which dishes will earn you the most toward it.
Serve each dish as soon as it is ready so customers do not leave unhappy and you do not lose progress toward the target.
If a level feels too hard, pause to reset your order priorities rather than tapping randomly, because steady, deliberate taps usually beat frantic ones.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You make recipes, serve customers, and complete the levels by meeting the targets set for each one.
How do I play?
Tap to make a recipe, then serve it to the customers who ordered it.

zombie-shooter-3d.intro: Zombie Shooter 3D is a 3D zombie shooter built around holding the trigger. You fight the undead, aim for headshots, and try to save the last survivor, with an online PvP doom battle mode also included.
tips: Aim for headshots, since the game highlights them as the way to take zombies down cleanly.
Keep the trigger held so you can fire continuously when zombies rush in, rather than tapping and losing rhythm.
Stand your ground instead of running when the dead start rising, because the game pushes you to face them with your guns.
Split your attention between shooting and finding a way to protect the survivor, since the goal is about saving sas as well as killing zombies.
If you try the multiplayer PvP doom battle mode, learn the single-player pace first so you are comfortable with the trigger before facing other players.
faq: What is the main goal of Zombie Shooter 3D?
You fight the unkilled zombies across a doom dead zone, and you also need to find a way to save the last sas. Shooting zombies is only part of the job.
How do I shoot in this game?
The game is built around holding the trigger and not releasing it, so you keep firing as zombies approach. Aim carefully, because headshots are the emphasized way to kill them.

idle-influencer-simulator.intro: Idle Influencer Simulator is a simulation game about building a digital brand. You craft videos, follow trending topics, and invest in equipment to grow your reach while your stats climb.
tips: Check which topics are trending before you pick what to make, since the game is built around following trends.
Save up for better equipment early, because the game says upgrades boost your reach with minimal input.
Keep your brand growing steadily rather than spending everything at once, so you always have something to build on.
Because the game is designed to run with little input, check back regularly to see how your stats have changed.
Pay attention to how your stats respond to different choices, and repeat the approaches that help your reach most.
faq: What is the goal of Idle Influencer Simulator?
The goal is to grow your brand into influencer stardom by crafting videos, following trends, and raising your stats over time.
Do I need to keep playing constantly to progress?
No. The game is described as idle with minimal input, so your progress builds with less direct action than most arcade games.

laser-nodes.intro: Laser Nodes is a physics puzzle where you drag laser shooters so their beams pass through every node. Mirrors can bend the beams, which makes later levels much harder to solve.
tips: Before dragging anything, trace each laser's path in your head and note which nodes it needs to hit.
Start with the nodes that can only be reached from one direction, since they narrow down where the shooter must sit.
Move one laser at a time and check how it changes the paths of the others, rather than adjusting everything at once.
When using mirrors, follow the beam through each bounce on paper or in your mind to confirm it lands on the intended node.
If you get stuck, step back and look at the level as a whole for a shooter position you have not tried yet.
faq: What is the goal of Laser Nodes?
The goal is to line up all the lasers so they pass through the nodes, which completes the level.
How do I move the lasers?
Drag the laser shooters to change where their beams point.

destructive-car-crash-simulator.intro: Destructive Car Crash Simulator is a driving game where every car can be dented, deformed and destroyed. You can start police chases, run crash tests, and smash into a range of props and maps.
tips: Use the crash test mode to compare how different cars deform, then pick the one whose damage pattern you find most interesting to watch.
Press C to change the camera between impacts so you can see how the dents and deformation spread across the body.
Hit a police car on purpose if you want a chase, and plan a route through the map so you have room to keep moving.
Build speed with Shift (nitro) before reaching a prop like a catapult or press, since a faster approach makes for a bigger impact.
Use R to reset a car after a wreck, or K to restore it, so you can run the same crash again under the same conditions.
faq: How do I start a police chase?
Hit a police car and it will start hunting you. Keep driving to stay ahead of it.
What is the difference between R and K?
R resets your car, while K restores it. Use whichever fits what you want to do next.

joyful-ball.intro: Joyful Ball is a physics puzzle where you balance blocks so the ball can reach and break glass bottles. Keep the ball rolling, because if it falls the game ends.
tips: Watch how the blocks tilt before you move them, and make small adjustments rather than large ones.
Keep the ball's path in mind early so you can shift the blocks ahead of it instead of reacting once it starts to slide.
Use short, steady presses on the controls, since holding a direction too long can tip the structure more than you expect.
If the blocks start to lean in one direction, try to bring them back to a level position before the ball reaches the unstable section.
Take a moment to study each setup before you begin, especially when the bottles are placed in awkward spots.
faq: What is the goal of Joyful Ball?
Your goal is to balance the blocks so the ball reaches the glass bottles and breaks them. The round ends if the ball falls.
How do I control the blocks on PC?
Press the Left Arrow key to move the blocks left and the Right Arrow key to move them right.

octobeer.intro: Octobeer is a shooting game where you serve beer to flying festival guests. Charge, aim and release your throws to earn coins and pay the rent before each deadline.
tips: Every throw uses one beer, so take a moment to line up your arc before you release. Wasted throws bring the end of the Run closer.
Chain serves together to build combos, since a steady rhythm of hits is the best way to grow your coin total.
Check your coin total against the rent as each five-wave block approaches so you know early whether you are on track.
Use the Run skills you pick to suit your play style, and think about which skill helps most with the challenge you keep facing.
Keep an eye out for boss guests in later Runs and plan your beer supply for them, because they can drain your stock quickly.
faq: How do I aim and throw a beer?
Hold the mouse button or your finger to charge, slide left or right to aim, then release to throw. Each guest you serve pays you coins.
How does a Run end?
A Run ends when you pay the rent late, which happens if you do not earn enough coins before it is due, or when your beer runs dry. Each Run lasts five waves.

funny-kitty-care.intro: Funny Kitty Care is a dress-up game about caring for a stray kitten. You heal it, groom it, and style it into the cutest version of itself.
tips: Begin with healing so your kitten is in good shape before you move on to grooming and dressing.
Groom the kitten thoroughly first, since a clean coat gives you a better base for outfits.
Try several outfit combinations before settling on one, because the game rewards creative choices.
Take your time with each step instead of rushing, so the care feels like a calm, gentle routine.
Experiment freely; because the controls are intuitive, testing options is the quickest way to learn what each one does.
faq: What is the main goal of Funny Kitty Care?
The goal is to nurse a stray kitten back to health, then groom it and dress it up. The game focuses on transforming your kitty into its cutest look.
How do I control the kitten?
The game is built around intuitive controls, so try the options on screen and see how each one responds. No separate instructions are provided.

road-race-3d.intro: Road Race 3D is a racing game set on a challenging 3D track that mixes racing with parkour. Quick reactions and flexible control are the keys to winning each run.
tips: Watch the track ahead rather than only the vehicle, so you can react to turns and obstacles before you reach them.
Keep your clicks or taps timed to the moment you need to change direction instead of tapping constantly.
Pay attention to the vehicle that appears for you at the start, since each run begins with a randomly drawn vehicle and you should adapt your approach to it.
Practice short stretches of the track first to learn how quickly the vehicle responds to your input.
If a run goes badly, restart and focus on the sections where you lost ground rather than trying to recover everything at once.
faq: How do I control the vehicle?
Use mouse clicks or taps to play. The game is built around flexible operation and quick reactions, so timing your inputs matters more than holding them.
Does the vehicle change between runs?
Yes. A vehicle appears randomly for you at the start, so the car or vehicle you get can differ from one run to the next.

loose-change-cashier-simulator.intro: Loose Change: Cashier Simulator is a relaxing coin sorting puzzle. You drag coins into open slots and group them by year and value until the board is clear.
tips: Before each drag, look at which coins can reach an open slot and which groups are closest to being complete. Planning two moves ahead saves moves later.
Finish groups that are almost done before starting new ones, so the board does not fill up with half-sorted coins.
Keep an eye on your remaining moves. Finishing with more moves and boosters left is the goal, so avoid moves that do not bring a group closer to completion.
Save boosters for moments when you are truly stuck rather than using them early, since you want to finish with as many left as possible.
Each run is a chance to beat your previous best score. Note which moves cost you the most and try a different order next time.
faq: What is the goal of Loose Change: Cashier Simulator?
The goal is to sort coins by matching their year and value, clear completed groups from the board, and finish the puzzle.
How do I move a coin?
Drag a coin into an available slot on the board. Only coins moved into open slots can be placed.

super-ball-blast.intro: Super Ball Blast is an arcade action game where you shoot the balls on screen and upgrade your cannon. The challenge is to survive as long as you can.
tips: Scan the whole screen before each shot so you know which balls are closest to becoming a threat.
Use your upgrades early to make your cannon more effective, since a stronger cannon clears balls faster.
Keep your cursor or finger ready at all times so you can respond quickly when new balls appear.
Watch where the balls are moving and aim ahead of their path rather than at their current position.
Stay calm and avoid rushing; steady, accurate shots usually last longer than frantic clicking.
faq: What is the goal of Super Ball Blast?
Shoot the balls you can see, upgrade your cannon, and survive for as long as possible.
How do I control the cannon?
The game uses mouse or touch controls, so you aim and shoot with whichever input you are using.

boxing-hero-2077.intro: Boxing Hero 2077 is a 3D cyber boxing game where you start as a rookie and build your fighter through training, upgrades, and tougher opponents. Expect a playtime of about 60 to 80 minutes.
tips: Check your upgrade options after each fight so you can spend what you earn on the attacks and abilities that suit your style.
Try out the abilities you unlock rather than saving them, since you will learn how each one fits into a round.
Take on the quests as you go, because they point you toward new enemies, locations, and upgrades you might otherwise miss.
Pay attention to how each new opponent fights and adjust your punches and timing instead of using the same approach every time.
Use WASD for movement and the mouse for aiming and punching, and get comfortable with both before you face the harder opponents.
faq: What is the goal of Boxing Hero 2077?
You play as a rookie boxer who trains your fighter, upgrades your punches and abilities, and works your way up to face stronger opponents in the ring.
How do I control my boxer?
Use WASD or the mouse to move and fight. The game is designed to be simple and intuitive, so most players pick up the controls quickly.

catch-the-cat.intro: Catch the Cat is a cozy line-drawing puzzle where you draw a safe route for a kid to reach a kitten and bring it home. Each level adds new hazards to plan around.
tips: Look at the whole level before you start drawing, and note where the cars, dogs, holes and fences sit along the likely route.
Plan your path as one clear line from the kid to the kitten, then from the kitten back home, so you do not have to backtrack.
Pick up the food when the kitten is hungry, since keeping it fed is part of bringing it home safely.
If a route fails, try a wider detour rather than cutting close to a hazard, because small mistakes end the attempt quickly.
Spend collected coins on the kitten's wardrobe and mood items after you finish a session, so your pet stays happy between levels.
faq: What is the goal of Catch the Cat?
Draw a line that takes the kid to the kitten and brings it safely back home without touching any obstacles.
What controls do I use?
You use the mouse or a single finger to draw the path, so the controls are simple.

tic-tac-toe-html5.intro: Tic Tac Toe HTML5 is a classic line-up game played on 3x3, 5x5, or 7x7 grids. You can challenge a friend or the computer in quick strategic duels.
tips: Start by claiming the middle of the board, since a central piece can take part in more rows, columns, and diagonals.
Check every turn whether your opponent has a line about to complete, and block it before building your own.
On the bigger grids, try to set up two possible lines at once so your opponent cannot block both.
Keep track of the open lines on the board, not just the ones near your last move, to spot threats early.
If you are playing a friend, vary your opening moves so you learn how different starts tend to develop.
faq: How do I win a round?
You win by lining up your pieces in a row on the grid. The game is played until one player completes a line or the board is full.
Does the grid size change how the game plays?
Yes. The 3x3, 5x5, and 7x7 grids give different amounts of space, so larger boards make duels longer and reward careful blocking.

the-rooms-escape-challenge.intro: The Rooms-Escape Challenge is a point-and-solve adventure built around a set of connected rooms. Your task is to look closely at each space, find hidden keys and mechanisms, and work out how to get out.
tips: Examine every object in a room before moving on, since the description says any detail could be the key to leaving.
Keep a mental or written note of items you have found and where you saw unusual markings, codes, or mechanisms, so you can match them up later.
When a puzzle seems stuck, step back and check rooms you have already left, because an item or clue there may be what you need.
Interact with objects more than once, as a change in one part of a room can reveal something new in another.
Work through puzzles one at a time instead of switching between several, which makes it easier to spot patterns and connections.
faq: What is the goal of The Rooms-Escape Challenge?
The goal is to escape the connected rooms by finding hidden keys and working out the mechanisms that open the way forward.
How do I progress through the game?
You progress by interacting with objects, observing details in each environment, and solving the puzzles that stand between you and the next room.

key-and-shield-2.intro: Key & Shield 2 is a monster-themed arcade adventure set on Gorlik Island. You work through tricky levels, rescue friends from cages, and try to lift a curse over the island.
tips: Take a moment to study each level's layout before moving, since the levels are described as tricky and mistakes can cost progress.
Experiment with the clever mechanics early in a level to learn how they work before you commit to a risky route.
Keep track of where the caged friends are, and plan your path so you can reach them as you go rather than backtracking later.
If you get stuck, step back and look for a different approach instead of repeating the same move.
Play in short sessions and focus on one level at a time, which makes it easier to notice patterns and solve puzzles.
faq: What is the main goal of Key & Shield 2?
Your goal is to conquer the tricky levels on Gorlik Island, rescue your friends from their cages, and lift the curse on the island.
How difficult are the levels?
The levels are described as tricky, so expect puzzles that take some thought. Looking at the layout first and trying different routes can help you progress.

sumo-fury.intro: Sumo Fury is a wrestling fighter where you collect wrestlers with different stats, battle rivals, and earn in-game currency to unlock stronger fighters. Learn the three main actions early and use defense well.
tips: Use Defend (C) when you see an incoming attack, then counter with a punch (Z) or kick (X) once the opening appears.
Mix up your attacks instead of spamming one button, since rivals are likely to adjust to repeated moves.
Use Jump (Spacebar) to reposition yourself, but be careful, because landing in front of an opponent can leave you open.
Pay attention to the stats of each wrestler before you pick one, and choose a fighter whose strengths suit how you like to fight.
Save your earnings from victories for stronger fighters rather than spending them as soon as you have enough, so your progress keeps building.
faq: What is the goal of Sumo Fury?
Your goal is to win matches against rivals, show your skill in combat, and dominate the arena. Each victory earns in-game currency you can use to unlock stronger fighters.
How do I move and attack my wrestler?
Use the arrow keys to move, Z to punch, X to kick, C to defend, and the Spacebar to jump. On mobile, use the virtual joystick to move and tap the matching action buttons.

my-new-poodle-friend.intro: My New Poodle Friend is a girls' game about getting ready for a new pet poodle. You help Sofia repair and decorate the pet house in her yard before the poodle arrives.
tips: Start with the repairs before you decorate, since the old pet house needs fixing first.
Look over the whole house before choosing decorations so your style choices fit together.
Take your time with each step, because the game is built around getting the house ready rather than racing a clock.
Try different decoration combinations to see which ones you like best for the poodle's new home.
faq: What is the goal of My New Poodle Friend?
The goal is to repair the old pet house and decorate it for the poodle Sofia is receiving as a birthday gift.
How do I play the game?
Use mouse clicks or taps to select items, make repairs, and place decorations on the house.

esther-the-penguin-return-to-antartica.intro: Esther the Penguin - Return to Antartica is a puzzle adventure where you guide Esther back to her icy home. Solve puzzles and dodge frosty obstacles as the challenges grow.
tips: Take your time with each puzzle before moving Esther, since the game rewards patience and careful thinking.
Study the layout of each icy area first and look for the route that keeps Esther clear of obstacles.
Expect the challenges to increase, so try to understand how the earlier puzzles work before moving on.
If you get stuck, step back and look at the scene from a different angle to spot clues you may have missed.
Play in short sessions if you want to stay focused, since the journey is designed to hold your attention for a long time.
faq: What is the goal of Esther the Penguin - Return to Antartica?
The goal is to guide Esther the Penguin back to Antarctica by solving puzzles and dodging frosty obstacles along the way.
Does the game get harder as I progress?
Yes, the description says the challenges increase as you move through the journey, so earlier puzzles help prepare you for later ones.

delivery-now.intro: Delivery Now is a fast-paced racing game where you deliver packages against the clock through busy city traffic. You choose your own route across an open world that keeps going.
tips: Keep an eye on the timer from the start, since every delivery is a race against time.
Pick your own route through the city rather than following the same path each run, and look for the one that avoids the heaviest traffic.
Watch the highway traffic closely and leave yourself room to change lanes or slow down before you reach a crowded stretch.
Treat each delivery as a fresh start and try to beat your previous time on the same kind of route.
Play in short sessions at first to learn how the mouse click or tap controls respond before you attempt faster runs.
faq: What is the main goal in Delivery Now?
You race against time to deliver packages across an open city while making your way through highway traffic.
How do I control the car?
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps, so you steer and act by clicking or tapping the screen.

fever-cubes-drop-number-2048.intro: Fever Cubes is a 3D number puzzle where you drop cubes, merge matching numbers, and aim for chain reactions. Each cube follows realistic physics, so placement matters.
tips: Line up your aim before you drop. Move the cube over the target cube first, then release, so the merge lands where you planned.
Look for matching numbers on the board before each drop. Dropping onto a cube of the same grade is what creates the next grade.
Pay attention to what happens after a merge. Chain reactions can start from one merge, so a single drop may clear more space or create more merges.
Keep in mind that every cube obeys physics. Cubes can shift or roll after a drop, so consider where the surrounding cubes will end up.
Take your time with each drop. Slow, deliberate aiming usually works better than rushing, since a poorly placed cube can block future merges.
faq: How do I merge cubes?
Drop a cube onto another cube with the same number to create a cube of the next grade. Matching numbers are the key to every merge.
How do I control the cube?
Swipe with your finger or move your mouse to position the cube and aim it. Then release to drop it onto the board.

smash-yard.intro: Smash Yard is a clicker where you break apart a range of vehicles in a yard to earn cash. You can buy upgrades and try Endless, timed, or Boss Rush modes.
tips: Use the cash you earn to buy upgrades early, since faster smashing makes every later vehicle quicker to clear.
Practice the charge timing on easier vehicles so you learn where the green zone sits before you need a Super Smash on a tougher target.
Build a rhythm of smashing parts steadily rather than only charging, so your hit count keeps climbing toward the 20-hit Super Smash.
If you are playing Boss Rush, focus on one heavyweight at a time and save your Super Smash for the moments you can land it cleanly.
Use pause with P or Esc when you need a moment to plan your next charge, especially during timed runs.
faq: What is the main goal of Smash Yard?
The goal is to demolish vehicles by ripping off parts and smashing them. Along the way you collect cash to buy upgrades and take on tougher targets.
How do I get a Super Smash?
Hold E on desktop or hold CHARGE SMASH on mobile, then release while your timing lands in the green zone. A successful release leads to a 20-hit Super Smash.

rollance-going-balls.intro: Rollance Going Balls is a casual arcade platformer where you guide a colorful ball across platforms by timing jumps and rolls. It is played with a single click or tap.
tips: Watch the moving hammers for a few seconds before you commit to a jump so you can see their rhythm.
Time your click or tap for the moment a gap or platform edge is in the right position, rather than tapping quickly.
Make shorter, controlled jumps when the next platform is close, since overshooting is a common way to fall.
Use the pause between hammer swings to line up your next move instead of rushing ahead.
Keep your play steady and calm; the game rewards precise timing more than fast repeated tapping.
faq: What is the goal of Rollance Going Balls?
You control a ball and roll it across a series of platforms by jumping and rolling, while avoiding the moving hammers.
How do I control the ball?
Use a mouse click or a tap to make the ball jump and roll. There are no other controls.

tractor-farming-farmer-life-game.intro: Tractor Farming Farmer Life Game is a farming simulator where you drive tractors, work fields across four crop modes, and complete missions to earn rewards. This guide covers habits that help you progress through the missions.
tips: Pick one crop mode first, such as Corn or Wheat, and finish its missions before switching. Each mode has its own missions and harvesting challenges, so learning one at a time keeps things clear.
Work through the farming steps in order: plough, sow, irrigate, fertilize, then harvest. Skipping a step may make the crop harder to finish well, so follow the sequence the game asks for.
Harvest at the right moment rather than as soon as possible. The game mentions harvesting at the perfect time, so check the crop before you start cutting.
Use the brake before tight turns and when you are near the edge of a field. Smooth driving keeps your tractor steady, which is useful when you are towing a trailer.
Save your rewards for new tractors, trailers, and equipment. Better machines unlock as you move into the more challenging levels, so spending wisely helps you keep up.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You complete farming missions by ploughing, sowing, watering, fertilizing, and harvesting crops, then transport your produce to earn rewards. Rewards help you unlock new tractors and equipment.
How do I move my tractor on desktop?
Use the A, W, S, and D keys to move your player, and use the mouse to move the camera. Press F for actions and Shift to sprint.

army-block-squad.intro: Army Block Squad is a strategy action game where you command a battalion, build your own army, and move carefully to survive a war. You play with the mouse or touch controls.
tips: Plan each move before you make it, since strategic movement is the core of the game.
Build your army with a purpose rather than spending everything at once, so your forces suit the situation you face.
Check the battlefield between moves to see where danger is coming from before you commit units.
Keep part of your battalion in reserve so that one mistake does not end your chances of survival.
Take your time with each click or tap so you do not move units by accident.
faq: What is the main goal of Army Block Squad?
The goal is to survive the war by building your own army and moving your battalion strategically.
How do I control the game?
You play with the mouse or with touch input, so use whichever works for your device.

bricks-buster.intro: Bricks Buster is an arcade game where you aim and shoot balls to break bricks before they reach the bottom. Clear each level by planning your shots and using power-ups well.
tips: Watch the number on each brick, since it shows how many hits it needs. Focus on the lower-number bricks first to clear space quickly.
Bounce your shots off the walls to reach bricks that are hard to hit directly and to set up combos.
Save power-ups for tougher levels where the bricks are packed close to the bottom.
Before each release, check where the bricks are closest to the bottom and aim to break those first so you do not lose the level.
Keep your aim steady and plan a few shots ahead rather than firing quickly, since high scores come from smart aiming.
faq: How do I aim and shoot?
Swipe to aim, then release to shoot the balls. The aim line shows where your shot will go before you let go.
How do I end a level?
A level ends when all the bricks are cleared or when bricks reach the bottom of the screen.

drivers-washing-clean.intro: Drivers Washing Clean is an arcade car wash game. You drive to the wash, then clean, polish, and detail cars before the next wave arrives. Click or tap to play.
tips: Check each car's condition first and plan the order of your steps, so you do not have to backtrack across the car.
Spend early earnings on equipment upgrades that speed up your work, since faster washing helps you keep up with the next wave.
Hire helpers as soon as you can afford them, because more hands make it easier to handle several cars at once.
Unlock new cleaning tools as they become available and use the one that suits the dirt or finish a car needs.
Keep an eye on customer satisfaction and do the detailing steps fully, rather than rushing, so you keep your reputation up.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You drive to the car wash and clean, polish, and detail each car before the next wave of vehicles arrives. Satisfying customers helps you progress.
How do I control the game?
Use mouse clicks or taps to play. The game is controlled entirely with these inputs.

crash-skill-racing.intro: Crash Skill Racing is a street racing game set on busy Japanese highways. You weave through traffic, perform stunts, and upgrade your car as you work toward faster times and cleaner driving.
tips: Keep your speed under control in dense traffic, since the game rewards precise steering more than raw speed. Small, early steering corrections are easier to manage than sharp last-second turns.
Save Nitro (N on keyboard, A or X on gamepad) for straights with clear road ahead so you can get the most out of each boost.
Use the Handbrake (Space, or B or Circle on gamepad) to tighten turns when you need to change direction quickly in traffic.
Try the Reset Car key (R, or Y or Triangle on gamepad) to recover quickly after a bad crash instead of driving on in a damaged position. The Car Fix key (F) is there if you need to repair.
Switch camera views with V (or R3 on gamepad) to find the one that gives you the clearest view of traffic ahead. Choose whichever helps you judge gaps best.
faq: What is the main goal of Crash Skill Racing?
The game focuses on high-speed highway driving, dodging traffic, and completing stunt skill tests while chasing speed, style, and mastery behind the wheel.
How do I steer and control the car?
Use WASD or the Arrow Keys to move, with Q and E for left and right turn signals. On gamepad, the Left Stick steers, RT or R2 accelerates, and LT or L2 brakes.

bananacat-clicker.intro: BananaCAT Clicker is an action clicker where you tap the screen to collect bananas, unlock feline friends, and take on challenges. The game gives no written instructions, so these tips focus on steady progress.
tips: Tap in short, steady bursts rather than one long session, so you can notice when your banana total is climbing and when it slows down.
Spend your bananas on character upgrades as soon as you can afford them, since stronger characters help you collect faster over time.
Compare the upgrades you can afford before buying, and favour the ones that boost your collection rate the most.
Check your banana count after each challenge or unlock, so you know whether to keep collecting or to save for a bigger purchase.
Take a short break now and then to keep your tapping accurate, especially during challenges where timing or focus may matter.
faq: What is the main goal of BananaCAT Clicker?
The main goal is to collect bananas by tapping the screen, use them to unlock feline friends, and complete the game's challenges.
How do I get more bananas faster?
Tap consistently and invest in character upgrades, since they are the game's main way to build up your collection over time.

obby-save-the-brainrots-online.intro: Obby: Save the Brainrots Online is a fast reaction game where a tsunami is closing in. Grab brainrots, carry them to the safe zone, and save as many rare ones as you can before the water arrives.
tips: Move quickly from the start, since the description says you only have seconds before the wave reaches you.
Use Space to jump over obstacles on your route so you keep your speed while carrying a brainrot.
Keep an eye on the advancing wave and plan your path to the safe zone before you pick anything up.
Aim for rarer brainrots when you can, because the faster you act, the more likely you are to find the rarest meme characters.
If you play with friends, split up: one player can grab brainrots while another focuses on delivering them, or compete to bring the most valuable finds.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Grab brainrots, carry them away from the advancing wave, and deliver them to the safe zone before the water covers everything.
What do the controls do?
Use WASD to move your character, Space to jump, and E for actions. On a phone, use the buttons shown on the screen.

room-makeover-design-and-aesthetic.intro: Room Makeover is a relaxed decorating puzzle where you unpack boxes of furniture and decor and place each piece in its correct spot. There are no timers, so you can take your time with each room.
tips: Before you start dragging, look at the whole room and note its color palette and style, since that makes the right spot for each item easier to spot.
Place large furniture pieces first, such as beds, sofas, or tables, because they set the layout that smaller decor items need to fit around.
Check the highlighted spots before dropping an item, and if a piece does not seem to fit, move on to another box and come back to it.
Group similar items together in your mind, such as soft pastel accents or modern pieces, so the room feels consistent as you go.
Since rooms get more complex as you progress, keep an eye on which boxes are still unpacked so you do not miss any items before the level ends.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Your goal is to turn an empty room into a cozy, stylish space by placing every furniture and decor item in its correct spot. The level is complete once all items are placed correctly.
How do I move items in the room?
Drag and drop each furniture or decoration piece onto the highlighted spot in the room. Each item has only one correct place.

fill-line-cover-every-cell.intro: Fill Line is a calm one-stroke puzzle. Start from the marked cell and draw a single continuous line through every block, moving only up, down, left or right without visiting any cell twice.
tips: Before drawing, look for cells with only one open neighbor. A dead end like that has to be the last cell of your line, so plan to finish there.
Work through the awkward parts of the board first, such as isolated corners and edge cells, and leave the open middle for last.
Pay attention to the special cells early. Rings, bridges and arrows each restrict how the line can pass, so check them before you commit to a long route.
If you go wrong, drag back a few cells instead of restarting, since you only need to undo the part that caused the problem.
Use Hint only after you have tried a few routes yourself, so you still get the satisfaction of solving the logic.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Your line must start at the marked cell and fill every block on the board in one continuous path. You cannot cross your own line except where a bridge or ring allows it.
How do I fix a mistake?
Drag the line back to undo steps, or tap any cell on the line to continue from that point. The Undo button removes your last step, and Restart begins the level again.

red-and-blue-stickman-spy-puzzles-2.intro: Red And Blue Stickman Spy Puzzles 2 is a puzzle game where you play as a blue stickman using archery to defeat red monsters across its levels. Aim carefully, since each shot depends on the angle and distance you choose.
tips: Before you shoot, look at where the red monster is and how far away it stands, then judge the angle you need.
Adjust your shot in small steps when you can, so you learn how much a change in angle moves the arrow.
Watch the enemies for a moment before acting, and use your agility to dodge threats instead of rushing in.
If a shot misses, note whether it fell short or flew too far and correct that on your next attempt.
Take each level calmly; puzzle-style play rewards thinking through the layout rather than clicking quickly.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You play as a blue stickman and defeat the red monsters in each level using archery. Clearing the enemies in each level is the core objective.
How do I control my shots?
Use mouse clicks or taps to play. Aim by adjusting the angle and distance of your archery shot before you release it.

red-and-green-3.intro: Red and Green 3 is a two-player adventure about the friendship between the red man and the green man. Across 10 chapters, you collect candies, earn points, and avoid lasers.
tips: Agree on a plan with your partner before each move, since both characters need to get through the same chapter together.
Watch where the lasers are firing before you step forward, and wait for a safe gap instead of rushing.
Grab candies when they are on your route, but do not take risky detours near lasers just to collect them.
Split your attention: keep one eye on your own character and one on your partner so neither of you gets caught off guard.
Pay attention to the layout of each new chapter early, so you can plan the path before the pressure builds.
faq: How many people can play Red and Green 3?
It is a two-player game, so you play with a partner who controls the second character.
What do I need to avoid while playing?
Watch out for lasers, which are the main hazard throughout the game.

magic-story-of-solitaire.intro: Magic Story of Solitaire is a card puzzle set in a fantasy adventure, where you clear the playing field using classic solitaire-style matching. Work through varied layouts and challenges as your fairy helper guides you.
tips: Before each move, check which cards are one value higher or lower than the card you have drawn, so you can spot every legal removal.
Prioritise removals that clear cards blocking other cards, since uncovering new options usually matters more than clearing an easy card in the open.
Keep an eye on your remaining supply, because you lose if you run out before the field is empty; avoid draws that don't help you progress.
Look at the whole layout at the start of each level and plan a route through it rather than acting on the first match you see.
Save your fairy helper's magical powers for tight spots where you have no obvious move, instead of using them early.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You need to remove every card from the playing field before you run out of cards in your supply. Clearing the field completes the level.
How do I remove a card from the field?
Select a card that is one higher or one lower in value than the card you have drawn. Matching cards are removed from the playing field.

retro-sniper.intro: Retro Sniper is a fast 2D sniper shooter with retro arcade visuals. You take precision shots across 42 levels, from city streets to deep ocean and outer space.
tips: Use right click or hold to zoom before you fire, so you can check who is in the scope before you shoot.
Watch for mermaids, hostages, and bystanders before every shot. Hitting them carries heavy penalties, so take a moment to confirm each target.
Use WASD to pan the view and look around the level before you commit to a shot. Knowing where enemies are early helps you plan your next move.
Reload with R between shots when it is safe, so you are ready when a new enemy appears.
Save grenades (G) and nukes (N) for crowded moments when enemies bring helicopters, jets, tanks, or UFOs, rather than spending them early.
faq: What is the goal of Retro Sniper?
You complete precision elimination missions by taking out enemies across levels set in urban, jungle, tundra, ocean, space, and underwater environments. Protecting civilians is part of the challenge.
How do I aim and fire?
Move the mouse or touch to aim through the scope, then left click or tap to fire. On mobile and tablet, touch to fire and the game auto aims for you.

animal-pair-card-match.intro: Animal Pair Card Match is a matching puzzle where you open two cards at a time to find pairs of the same animal. Each match helps you collect target animals and clear the board.
tips: Pay attention to where each animal appears as you open cards, so you can find its partner later without reopening everything.
Before opening new cards, check the board for pairs you already know about and clear those first.
Focus on the target animals, since matching them moves you toward clearing the board.
Save your tools for when the board gets tricky instead of using them at the start, so you have help available when you are stuck.
Take your time and plan each pair of clicks, since the game is designed to be relaxing rather than rushed.
faq: How do I play Animal Pair Card Match?
Click and drag to open cards, two at a time, and try to match cards that show the same animal.
How do I win the game?
You win by matching animal pairs, collecting the target animals, and clearing the board.

asmr-beauty-japanese-spa.intro: ASMR Beauty Japanese Spa is a relaxing spa game built around calming treatments, from massages to facials, with soothing ASMR sounds. You finish by dressing your client in an elegant yukata.
tips: Use headphones if you can, since the ASMR sounds are a big part of the calming effect and are easy to miss through small speakers.
Take each ritual slowly rather than rushing through them, so the mood of the spa builds up before you move on.
Pay attention to the sounds during massages and facials, as they can help you judge when a treatment feels complete.
Treat the yukata dressing as the final step and give it the same care as the treatments, since it closes the spa journey.
If you want a calmer session, play in a quiet room with few distractions so you can fully enjoy the atmosphere.
faq: What is the main goal of ASMR Beauty Japanese Spa?
The goal is to move your client through a peaceful spa journey of calming rituals, including massages and facials, and end by dressing them in a yukata.
Do the ASMR sounds affect how I play?
The sounds are part of the relaxing atmosphere and are meant to be enjoyed as you go through each treatment. Listening closely can help you stay focused on each step.

mummy-land.intro: Mummy Land is an arcade platformer where you guide a mummy through pyramid levels full of traps and puzzles. Collect treasures and power-ups to help you survive the labyrinth.
tips: Study each trap before you move past it, since the game's traps are the main threat. Watching their timing for a few seconds often shows a safe moment to pass.
Treat every puzzle as a chance to slow down and look at the whole room. Many puzzles are easier to solve once you know what each part of the room does.
Grab treasures and power-ups when they are safe to reach, because they help your survival. Do not take risky detours that could cost you the run.
Expect the challenges to get harder as you go, so use early levels to learn the layout of traps and platforms. Calm, steady play tends to hold up better than rushing.
If you lose a run, think about which trap or puzzle caused it and try a different approach next time. Small changes in order and timing add up quickly.
faq: What is the goal of Mummy Land?
Your goal is to guide the mummy through the pyramid levels and find a way out of the ancient labyrinth alive. Each level is filled with traps and puzzles that stand in your way.
What should I collect in the game?
Collect treasures and power-ups along the way, since they help boost your survival. Pick them up when it is safe to do so.

o-m-i-n-o.intro: O.M.I.N.O is an arcade game where you fly a human through an alien-invaded pixel universe. You dodge hostile spaceships, collect coins, and rely on quick tapping to survive.
tips: Watch the spaceships' paths before you commit to a move, since the game rewards reading the screen over reacting late.
Keep your taps light and steady rather than frantic, so you can make small corrections as the challenge builds.
Treat coins as a secondary goal: only go after them when the route is clear, so a risky grab doesn't cost you the run.
Play a few short rounds to learn the timing of the enemies before trying to push for a longer run.
Expect the pace to rise over time, so stay calm early on and save your focus for the faster sections.
faq: What is the goal of O.M.I.N.O?
You fly through an alien-invaded pixelated universe, dodging hostile spaceships and collecting coins for as long as you can survive.
How do you control the ship?
The game uses simple controls based on tapping, and the description says tapping is how you stay alive.

bouncy-motors.intro: Bouncy Motors is a racing game where you drive a car that bounces like jelly to reach the finish line. Watch for red zones and icy patches, which can make the ride much harder.
tips: Ease off the throttle when you approach a bounce so you can control the landing instead of being thrown around.
Use the rotate keys (A and D, or the left and right arrows) early in a jump to keep the car level before it lands.
Treat red zones as the main hazard: slow down and steer around them, since wheels fall off on impact.
On ice, make small, gentle inputs with forward and backward movement, because sudden moves are more likely to send the car spinning.
Replay sections where you lost a wheel and note where the bounces were strongest, so you can plan a safer line next time.
faq: What is the goal of Bouncy Motors?
The goal is to get your bouncy car to the finish line. Avoid red zones and be careful on ice along the way.
How do I steer and move the car?
Use W or the up arrow to drive forward and S or the down arrow to drive backward. Press A or the left arrow to rotate counterclockwise and D or the right arrow to rotate clockwise.

run-clicker-tap-muscle-up.intro: Run Clicker: Tap Muscle Up is a clicker game where you tap to sprint, earn cash from running, and spend it on upgrades to race faster against rival runners. Your progress builds through training, races, and unlocking new clothes.
tips: Keep running between races, since the game lets you earn money while you train, and that cash pays for your next upgrades.
Spend your first earnings on stamina and speed upgrades, because the description says these let you run faster and farther with each tap.
Pay attention to race results, since winning races is how you earn keys for unlocking clothes with bonuses.
Check the unlocked clothes after each win and compare their bonuses against what you need for upcoming races.
Balance your spending so you do not run out of cash for the upgrade that matters most before a tough opponent.
faq: What is the main goal of Run Clicker: Tap Muscle Up?
The goal is to sprint ahead of rival runners, win races, and cross the finish line first. Upgrading your stats helps you do that.
How do I control the runner?
Rapidly tap the screen to build speed and move ahead of your rivals. Each tap helps your sprint.

bricks-balls-breaker.intro: Bricks Balls Breaker is a skill game where you aim and shoot balls to break bricks before they reach the bottom. There are no time limits, so you can play at your own pace.
tips: Hold your finger on the screen and move slowly to line up your shot before you release, rather than rushing each aim.
Look for angles that bounce the ball through several bricks at once, since smashing many bricks in a single shot helps you earn stars, gems, and power-ups.
Check the durability shown on each brick and focus on the tougher ones when they are getting low on the board, so you do not let them drop.
Keep an eye on the bricks closest to the bottom first, because a single row reaching the bottom ends the game.
Use the lack of a time limit to think through each puzzle; taking a moment to plan the angle usually beats a quick, careless shot.
faq: What is the goal of Bricks Balls Breaker?
Your goal is to break all the bricks on the screen by aiming and shooting balls at them. A brick is destroyed when its durability reaches 0.
How do I aim and shoot?
Hold the screen with your finger and move to aim, then release to shoot. Find the best position and angle to hit as many bricks as possible.

cookie-maker-for-kids.intro: Cookie Maker for Kids is a relaxed baking game where you roll dough, shape cookies, bake them, and add colorful decorations. It suits young players who enjoy being creative in the kitchen.
tips: Follow the steps in order: roll the dough, shape the cookies, bake them, then decorate. Each step builds on the one before it.
Take your time with the shaping step, since the shape you choose sets up the final cookie.
Try a few different shapes and decorations rather than repeating the same design, so you can see what combinations you like best.
Keep decorations simple at first, then add more colors and details once you feel comfortable with the controls.
Because the controls are simple, practice each step a few times to get a feel for how it works before trying a complete batch.
faq: What is the goal of Cookie Maker for Kids?
The goal is to make cookies from start to finish: roll the dough, shape it, bake it, and then decorate it however you like.
How do the controls work?
The game uses simple controls, so you can learn them quickly by working through each baking step one at a time.

sorting-ball-puzzle.intro: Sorting Ball Puzzle is a color sorting game where you move balls between bottles until each bottle holds only one color. Each move matters, so plan ahead before you tap.
tips: Before moving anything, scan the top ball of every bottle and look for colors that appear on top in more than one place. Those are the moves that can open up space.
Try to empty a bottle that has only a few balls, since an empty bottle gives you a spare place to park a ball you need to move out of the way.
Avoid stacking a different color on top of a color that is still buried. Covering a ball you will need later is the most common way to get stuck.
Use Undo as soon as a move looks like a mistake, rather than pushing forward and hoping it works out. Going back a few steps is often quicker than restarting.
If you reach a point where no good move is left, add an extra bottle or restart the level. Restarting is a clean way to test a different plan from the beginning.
faq: What is the goal of Sorting Ball Puzzle?
The goal is to move balls so that every bottle contains balls of only one color. You win when all balls of the same color are sorted into a single bottle.
How do I move a ball?
Tap a bottle to pick up its top ball, then tap another bottle to place it there. You can only place it on a top ball of the same color, and only if the bottle has room.

nitro-kick.intro: Nitro Kick is a car football game where you drive, jump and boost to smash a giant ball into the opponent's goal. Pick 1v1, 2v2 or 3v3 and face bots at three difficulty levels.
tips: Use boost in short bursts and keep some in reserve for recovering position or chasing the ball when it rolls away from you.
Press jump twice quickly to dodge, which is useful for avoiding a rival's hit or lining up a shot in a tight spot.
Switch to the ball cam with C (or BALL on mobile) when you need to read where the ball is heading before committing to a run.
Use the arena walls to reach the ball from an unexpected angle, especially when a bot is guarding the middle of the pitch.
Watch the 6-minute timer: if the score is level late in the match, stay calm, since the next goal wins in overtime.
faq: What is the goal of Nitro Kick?
Score more goals than the other team before the 6-minute timer runs out. If the match is tied, it goes to overtime and the next goal wins.
What are the basic keyboard controls?
Use W, A, S and D to drive, Space to jump (press twice to dodge), and Shift to boost. Press C to toggle the ball cam and Esc to pause.

demolition-derby-racing.intro: Demolition Derby Racing is a sports game about high-speed vehicle combat in arenas. You upgrade and customize your car, then fight other drivers to be the last one still running.
tips: Spend your upgrades on the parts that help you survive longer, since staying in the fight matters most in a demolition derby.
Pay attention to the arena layout early on and note where the hazards are so you can avoid getting trapped near them.
Watch your opponents before you commit to a hit. Choosing the right moment to strike is often more useful than charging in.
Stay mobile instead of sitting still. A damaged car that keeps moving can still outlast competitors who stop to fight.
In multiplayer matches, try to keep track of who is weakened and focus on them when you have the chance.
faq: What is the main goal of Demolition Derby Racing?
The goal is to survive the battle and be the last vehicle still standing against your competitors.
How should I approach upgrading my vehicle?
Think about what keeps your car in the fight longest, then build your upgrades around that strength instead of spreading them thinly.

stunt-boxes.intro: Stunt Boxes is an arcade flying game where you pilot a box through each level, collecting stars and passing through hoops while keeping your fuel and your craft intact. Levels get harder as you go, so expect to replay them.
tips: Look at the whole level before you commit to a route, so you can plan where the stars and hoops are before your fuel starts to run down.
Treat fuel as a limited resource and avoid spending it on movement you do not need, since it can run out before you reach the stars.
Keep an eye out for fuel barrels and plan your path so you can reach them before your fuel gets low.
Go for the stars and hoops in an order that keeps you away from obstacles, rather than chasing whatever is closest.
Expect the difficulty to climb, and use replays to learn where you crashed or ran short on fuel so you can adjust your approach next time.
faq: What is the goal of Stunt Boxes?
Your goal is to collect all the stars in each level while flying through hoops and avoiding crashes. Completing every star in a level is how you move through the stages.
How do I control the box?
The game is played with a mouse click or a tap. Use your click or tap to steer your flight through each level.

slap-king.intro: Slap King is a 3D action game about slapping opponents out of the ring. You control every slap with the left mouse button, and the harder you throw, the better your chances of winning.
tips: Focus on landing the strongest slap you can rather than rushing many weak ones, since the description says harder throws give you a better chance of knocking your opponent out of the ring.
Watch your opponent before you commit, so you can pick the moment when a strong slap is most likely to connect.
Keep your clicks deliberate. Every slap is controlled by the left mouse button, so steady, careful clicks usually work better than frantic clicking.
Use each match to learn how your opponents move and react, then adjust how you approach the next slap.
Treat each round as a chance to improve, because the game is built around becoming the best slapper.
faq: What is the goal of Slap King?
Your goal is to challenge opponents and throw them out of the ring with your slaps. The game is built around becoming the best slapper.
How do I control my slaps?
All actions use the left mouse button. Click to throw your slap.

snake-simple-retro-game.intro: Snake Simple Retro Game is a classic arcade game where you steer a snake that grows longer each time it eats. The challenge comes from avoiding your own body as the snake gets bigger.
tips: Plan each turn a few squares ahead so you do not box yourself into a corner as the snake grows.
Keep a wide open area in the middle of the play space, since a longer snake needs more room to turn safely.
Avoid tight loops that cut back across your own body, because one wrong turn can end the run.
Go after food in a steady path rather than making sudden sharp moves, which tend to trap the snake.
Stay calm and take short, deliberate moves, since every decision matters more as the snake grows.
faq: What is the goal of Snake Simple Retro Game?
Guide the snake to its next meal, growing longer with each bite while avoiding running into your own body.
Why does the game get harder over time?
As the snake grows, its body fills more of the play area, leaving less space to turn and move around.

cat-vs-granny-cat-simulator.intro: Cat vs Granny is a first-person simulation where you play a mischievous cat causing chaos in grandma's house. Your job is to finish all the tasks while wearing down her patience.
tips: Look around each room before you act, so you can plan a sequence of pranks rather than reacting to whatever is nearest.
Use E to pick up and put down objects, and F to interact with things in the room. Knowing which key does which saves time.
Use LMB to throw items. Try throwing at different objects to see how the room responds and which pranks get the biggest reaction from grandma.
Hold Shift to run between rooms when you need to move quickly, and save walking for tight spots.
On mobile, use a right swipe to check the room layout and then move with the left joystick. Getting your bearings first makes it easier to find tasks.
faq: What is the goal of Cat vs Granny?
The goal is to complete all the tasks while annoying Granny. Her patience drops with each of your pranks.
Which keys do I use to pick up and interact with objects?
Press E to put or take an object and F to interact. Press LMB to throw or shoot.

hole-and-fill-collect-master.intro: Hole And Fill Collect Master is an adventure game where you control a magical hole that grows by swallowing food items in the scene. Click or tap to move and keep collecting to get bigger and stronger.
tips: Aim for bigger items first, since the description says larger food helps you upgrade faster.
Keep moving so you can reach new food before other areas of the scene are cleared.
Look across the whole scene for clusters of food such as cakes, meat, and donuts, and plan a route that passes several of them.
Grow steadily rather than chasing a single item, because each meal adds to your overall power.
Check the scene often so you do not get stuck in a corner with nothing nearby to collect.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
The goal is to collect as much food as possible in the scene, such as cakes, meat, and donuts, to fill yourself up and become more powerful.
How do I control the hole?
Use a mouse click or tap to play. The game is controlled entirely with clicks or taps.

car-modding-contest.intro: Build a car from the parts on offer, then race head-to-head against rivals. Your look matters as much as your ride, so each change should make your car stand out on the asphalt.
tips: Start with the big visual parts, such as rims and overall style, since they change the look most. Fine details can come after you have a direction.
Pick one theme before you start clicking, like a clean street look or a bold race style, so your choices stay consistent.
Try a modification, then look at the whole car before adding the next one. This helps you spot when a detail clashes with the rest of the build.
Keep an eye on what your rivals show off and aim for a build that is clearly different from theirs, since the goal is to out-style the competition.
Adjust small details last. Fine-tuning is where a build goes from good to memorable, so give it time rather than rushing through.
faq: How do I change my car?
Click on a modification to select it, as shown in the game's instructions. Your selected parts are applied to the car as you go.
What is the goal of the game?
You build your car and then compete head-to-head on the track. The description says the aim is to out-style the competition and claim victory.

panda-hair-do.intro: Panda Hair-do is a hair salon game where you wash, style, and accessorize a panda-loving girl. Each session can produce a different look, so experimenting is the main draw.
tips: Work through the three main stages (washing, styling, accessorizing) in order, so each choice builds on the last.
Try a few different combinations before settling on a final look, since the game is built around many makeover options.
Keep a mental note of which hairstyles and accessories you like best, so you can recreate or refine them in later sessions.
Experiment with accessories that match the panda theme to see how they change the overall feel of a look.
Don't rush a single session; comparing several looks side by side can help you judge which one works best.
faq: What is the goal of Panda Hair-do?
The goal is to create stylish looks for the girl by washing, styling, and accessorizing her. The game is focused on creative makeovers rather than a set target.
Is there a score or a winning condition?
The description does not mention scoring or a win state, so the game appears to be about exploring looks rather than reaching a finish point.

jelly-block-puzzle.intro: Jelly Block Puzzle is a color-matching puzzle with an unlimited number of levels. Connect jellies of the same color to meet each level's required color combinations.
tips: Before you connect anything, look at which colors are still left on the board. Plan your merges so you do not run out of a color you need.
Start with the jellies that are easiest to connect. Clearing open space early can make the harder groups easier to reach later.
Save your power-ups for moments when the board is stuck. Use the destroy power-up on a jelly that is blocking a useful group, and use swap when two jellies sit in the wrong places.
If a level becomes hard, step back and check which color combinations are still missing. Focus on the one you are furthest from completing.
Take a short break when your moves stop working. Coming back with fresh eyes often shows a connection you missed.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Connect jellies of the same color until you reach the required number of color combinations for that level.
What are the power-ups used for?
You can use two power-ups: one destroys a selected jelly, and the other swaps jellies.

3d-triple-match.intro: 3D Triple Match is a puzzle game where you find and collect three identical 3D items from a messy pile. Clear the target items before the timer runs out.
tips: Before you tap, scan the whole pile for matching shapes and colors so you can pick the set that is easiest to reach.
Keep an eye on the tray as you play. Every mismatched item you add takes up a slot that you need for later matches.
Look at the target items at the top of the screen first, so you know which objects to prioritize.
When a match is available, take it quickly to free up tray space and keep the countdown from becoming a problem.
If the tray is getting crowded and no match is in sight, focus on the items that are closest to completing a set rather than grabbing new ones at random.
faq: What is the goal of 3D Triple Match?
Clear all the target items listed at the top of the screen before the countdown timer reaches zero.
How do I clear items?
Tap three identical 3D items from the pile to move them into the bottom tray. Once three matching items are in the tray, they merge and disappear automatically.

knife-battle.intro: Knife Battle mixes merging and throwing. You combine matching knives to upgrade them, then throw them at enemies while avoiding your own earlier throws.
tips: Merge knives of the same type as soon as you can, since stronger knives are the main way to get through tougher enemies.
Before each throw, check where your earlier knife is stuck or still in flight so you do not aim into it.
Tap at a steady pace rather than rapidly, which gives you time to line up each throw.
Keep an eye on bosses and plan your knife upgrades around them, since defeating all bosses is the goal.
faq: How do I create a new knife?
Drag one knife onto another knife of the same type to combine them into a new one.
How do I throw a knife?
Tap the screen to throw the knife toward the enemy.

car-real-simulator.intro: Car Real Simulator is a driving game built around realistic physics and handling. You can cruise through open-world cities, try drifting, tackle parking tasks, and drive over varied terrain.
tips: Start with city cruising to learn how the car responds to steering and speed before moving on to harder challenges.
Because the physics are realistic, avoid sudden inputs. Smooth, gradual steering and braking usually keep the car more stable.
Spend time in the garage to compare vehicles, since each car may handle differently on the road and off it.
For parking tasks, slow down and take your time. Precision matters more than speed, so check your position before each move.
When you try drifting or rougher terrain, expect the car to behave differently from normal road driving. Build up gradually and adjust your approach as you learn how it reacts.
faq: Does the game have a clear goal or set of missions?
The description focuses on open-world exploration, city cruising, drifting challenges, parking tasks, and diverse terrains. Players can choose what to try and move between these activities.
How important is the car's handling?

The game is built around genuine car physics and lifelike handling, so how you steer, brake, and accelerate affects how the car behaves. Gentle, controlled driving is a practical way to get used to it.

car-transform-mania-merger-tycoon.intro: Car Transform Mania Merger Tycoon is an action game about merging cars to unlock new models and grow your automotive empire. Combine cars strategically, boost your earnings, and set up your track for passive profits.
tips: Plan each merge before you make it, since the game rewards strategic combinations over random ones.
Watch for new models as you merge, and aim to unlock them, because they are a core part of growing your empire.
Keep an eye on your earnings and look for changes that boost them, so your money keeps building.
Set up your track with passive profits in mind, and give it time to earn while you focus on your next move.
Be patient. The game is built around steady progress, so rushing usually works against your long-term financial success.
faq: What is the main goal of Car Transform Mania Merger Tycoon?
The goal is to grow your automotive empire by merging cars, unlocking new models, and boosting your earnings over time.
How do I make progress in the game?
Progress comes from combining cars strategically, which unlocks new models and helps increase your income.

3d-darts.intro: 3D Darts is a sports game about accurate throws and good timing. You can challenge friends or work through hundreds of levels while aiming for high scores.
tips: Focus on timing as much as aim, since the description highlights timing as a key part of scoring big.
Play each throw with a steady routine so your timing stays consistent from one throw to the next.
Take your time on early levels to learn how the throws behave before you try to push for higher scores.
When playing against friends, watch how they throw and use that to plan your own shots and outwit them.
If a level feels hard, step back and repeat a few throws to build the precision you need for the next one.
faq: What is the main goal of 3D Darts?
The goal is to throw accurately, score big, and get through hundreds of levels. Challenging friends is another way to play.
What makes this game hard to master?
Precision and timing both matter, so small mistakes in either can cost you points. Practice helps you improve both.
