find-capybara-valley-of-monsters.intro: Find Capybara: Valley of Monsters is an adventure game where you explore a large map to find and collect every hidden capybara. Monsters guard the territories, so you will need to stun them and keep moving.
tips: Look in unexpected places. Capybaras can hide high up or in out-of-the-way corners, so check edges, platforms and gaps as you go.
Use the trampolines together with the Space bar for super jumps. This is the main way to reach the highest platforms.
Save power-ups for spots you cannot reach on foot. The magic carpet helps with flying routes, the speed spring for fast dashes, and the jump spring for inaccessible places.
When a monster gets close, use a slap to stun it, then move on right away rather than staying to fight.
Keep track of which areas you have already explored so you do not waste time backtracking across the large map.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Your goal is to explore the map and find and collect all the hidden capybaras.
How do I move and jump?
Move with the W, A, S and D keys and jump with the Space bar. Combine jumping with trampolines to get higher.

block-ice-puzzle.intro: Block Ice Puzzle is a logic game played on a frosty 6x6 grid. You slide blocks around the board to free the blue ice block, with endless levels to work through.
tips: Before you move anything, look at the path between the blue ice block and the exit or open space. Clear the blocks in its way first.
Move blocks one step at a time and check the board after each slide, so you can undo a bad idea in your head before it costs you time.
Avoid pushing blocks into corners or tight spots where they can only move back and forth, since that can block the route you need later.
If you get stuck, try moving a block that seems unrelated to the blue block. Freeing space elsewhere often opens a new route.
Take a short break when your moves start repeating. A fresh look at the grid usually shows a solution you missed.
faq: What is the goal of Block Ice Puzzle?
Your goal is to slide and maneuver the blocks on the 6x6 grid so the blue ice block can get free.
How do the controls work?
You move the blocks by sliding them across the grid. The game is described as having smooth controls, so each slide should feel responsive.

cricket-smash-3d.intro: Cricket Smash 3D is a fast-paced 3D cricket game with short 2-over matches, tournaments and leagues. You choose your team, play multiple cricket formats, and can challenge friends.
tips: Start with a 2-over match to learn how the leg side and off side hits feel before moving on to longer formats.
Decide early which side the ball is heading toward, so you can press A or D in time instead of reacting late.
Use the on-screen buttons at the bottom corners if you prefer tapping to using the keyboard, and stick with the one that feels most comfortable.
Try a few different team choices to see which one suits your style of play before entering a tournament or league.
Move up to league or multi-format matches once you feel consistent, since these add more challenge over a longer run.
faq: What do the A and D keys do?
Press A to hit the ball on the leg side and D to hit it on the off side. The bottom-left and bottom-right buttons on screen do the same thing.
How long are the matches?
The game offers short 2-over matches as well as longer formats, so you can pick a quick game or a bigger tournament.

limo-city-taxi-driver.intro: Limo City Taxi Driver puts you behind the wheel of a city limousine for taxi missions. You pick up passengers, follow the city route and drive them to their destinations in a 3D city.
tips: Before each trip, check where the passenger is waiting and plan a route that keeps you moving toward them.
Brake early before turns and corners so you can steer smoothly instead of sliding wide through the streets.
Keep an eye on the route while driving so you can spot the next turn well before you reach it.
Use the accelerate and brake controls gently in traffic; stopping and starting suddenly makes the limo harder to control.
Finish one trip at a time and focus on delivering each passenger to their destination before worrying about the next pickup.
faq: What is the goal of Limo City Taxi Driver?
Your goal is to complete each taxi mission by picking up passengers and driving them to their destinations through the city.
How do I control the limousine?
Use the on-screen driving controls to accelerate, brake and steer your car through the streets.

sheep-escape-farm-sorting-challenge.intro: Sheep Escape is a casual puzzle about guiding tangled sheep out of their pen and into the barn. Each level adds more sheep and trickier layouts to untangle.
tips: Before tapping anything, scan the whole field and look for sheep whose path in a straight line is already clear.
Look at which sheep are blocking others, since removing a blocker often frees several sheep at once.
Plan two or three moves ahead so you do not trap a sheep behind one that you still need to move.
When a level gets crowded, work through one side of the field at a time to keep track of which sheep have already escaped.
If you get stuck, pause and check the directions each sheep can travel, because most solutions come from spotting the right order.
faq: How do I know which sheep I can tap?
Only sheep with a clear straight-line path out of the pen can be moved. Tap those first, then look again at what has opened up.
What should I do when every sheep seems blocked?
Look for the sheep that sits in front of the most others and find the order that clears it first. Trying a different starting sheep often reveals the solution.

handless-millionaire.intro: Handless Millionaire is an action game about grabbing cash from under a guillotine. The blade speeds up each round, so timing and nerve matter more as you go.
tips: Watch the blade for a round or two before reaching for the cash, so you learn its rhythm and speed.
Since the guillotine gets faster each round, expect the timing window to shrink as you progress and adjust your pace early.
Balance greed with caution: a slightly smaller grab that you survive is usually better than a risky one that ends the run.
Stay calm and focused rather than rushing, because quick reflexes work best when you are not reacting in panic.
Use each round's speed as a checkpoint to decide whether you should keep pushing or take a safer approach.
faq: What is the goal of Handless Millionaire?
The goal is to snatch cash from beneath a guillotine without getting caught by the blade. Each successful grab is a risk you have to weigh.
Why does the game get harder over time?
The guillotine gains speed with each round, which leaves you less time to react. Staying sharp and cautious helps you keep up as the speed rises.

hidden-basketball.intro: Hidden Basketball is a basketball simulator built around shooting. You can practise your shots in training, play friendly matches, and work through tournaments.
tips: Start in training to get a feel for your shooting before you face any opponents.
Pay attention to your timing and aim on each shot, since precision is central to this game.
Play friendly matches to test what you learned in training against a live opponent.
Think strategically before each tournament game rather than shooting on instinct every time.
Replay training when a shot keeps missing, so you can spot what is going wrong before the next match.
faq: What is the main goal of Hidden Basketball?
The game focuses on mastering your shooting skills and dominating tournaments. Progress comes from training, friendly matches, and tournament play.
Does the game include a training mode?
Yes. The game lets you master your shooting skills in training before you move on to matches.

basketball-park.intro: Basketball Park is a 3D basketball game where you drag and release to shoot. You start with 10 balls, and clean shots that avoid the rim can earn you more.
tips: You start with only 10 balls, so line up each shot before you release instead of rushing through them.
Aim for shots that stay clear of the rim, since clean scores are what earn you extra balls.
Try to keep your shooting steady and consistent, because a run of clean baskets keeps your ball count growing.
Work toward higher scores early, since reaching them is how you unlock helpful creatures.
Check the leaderboard now and then to see how your scores compare with the top players and set a target to beat.
faq: How do I shoot the ball?
Drag your finger or mouse back and release to shoot. Each release sends one ball toward the hoop.
How do I earn extra balls?
Score without touching the rim. Each clean basket you make this way can add balls to your supply.

fruit-madness.intro: Fruit Madness is a puzzle where you drop fruits onto the board, and matching fruits merge into a tastier new one. Use your boosters well to keep the board clear and build a high score.
tips: Aim before you release. Take a moment to line up each fruit, since where it lands decides which fruits it can touch.
Look for identical fruits that can meet. Dropping a fruit next to its match is the quickest way to merge and clear space.
Don't hoard your boosters. You get 4 at the start of each round, so use them when the board starts to feel crowded rather than waiting.
Use the clear-cluster booster when a group of fruits blocks the way. Shrinking fruits can also help when you need room for the next drop.
Keep an eye on your score. Each 500 points earns you another random booster, so steady merges also give you more tools.
faq: What is the goal of Fruit Madness?
The goal is to merge identical fruits into new ones and chase a high score. Each merge helps you build bigger, tastier fruits on the board.
How do I aim and drop a fruit?
Aim with your finger or mouse, check that you have your target, then release to let the fruit drop onto the board.

realistic-lion-hunting-animal-2024.intro: Realistic Lion Hunting Animal 2024 puts you in control of a lion roaming a dense forest. Hunt animals to survive and move through increasingly challenging levels.
tips: Walk with WASD when you are near prey, and save running for long stretches of open ground. Running costs you control, so it is easy to overshoot a target.
Use the right mouse button to stop running as soon as you spot an animal. This lets you line up your approach before you commit.
Track your prey through the forest before you attack. Watching where an animal moves gives you a better chance of catching it.
Attack with a left mouse click only when you are close enough to make it count. Rushing in from far away gives the animal time to get away.
Explore different parts of the wilderness rather than staying in one spot. Finding a variety of animals is the surest way to keep progressing.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You play as a lion hunting various animals in the forest to survive. Successful hunts let you advance through the game's challenging levels.
How do I move my lion?
Use the W, A, S, and D keys to walk. Hold Left Shift to run.

hopeless-island-survival-hero.intro: Hopeless Island Survival Hero is an action game where you fight monstrous creatures with swords and guns while trying to escape a dangerous island. Every choice matters as you work to survive.
tips: Before each fight, check whether you need to win it or whether you can avoid it and keep moving toward escape.
Watch your supplies closely and avoid spending resources on small threats you could have dodged.
Pay attention to your instincts and how the creatures move, since reacting early usually costs less than recovering late.
Pick a weapon based on the threat in front of you, and do not rely on one approach for every enemy.
Plan your next few decisions instead of reacting only to what is directly in front of you, because one bad choice can make the island harder to escape.
faq: What is the main goal of Hopeless Island Survival Hero?
Your goal is to overcome the threats on the island and escape its relentless peril. The game asks whether you can survive.
How important is resource management in this game?
The description says each decision is vital, so managing your resources wisely can decide whether you keep going or fall behind. Save what you need for the most dangerous moments.

robby-build-bridge-to-brainrots.intro: Robby is a 3D management game about gathering wood, building bridges to reach brainrots, and growing your base as you move to new islands. Your progress depends on how well you collect and store wood.
tips: Upgrade wood collection early, since more wood gathered means faster bridge building to reach new areas.
Improve wood storage before your stockpile fills up, so you do not lose progress while you keep collecting.
Use the camera rotation control to check where bridges and brainrots sit before you commit to a route.
Place caught brainrots on the base as you go, so your collection stays organized and easy to manage.
Use the throw-away control on brainrots you do not need, so your base space stays free for better ones.
faq: What is the main goal of Robby: Build Bridge To Brainrots?
Collect wood, build a bridge to reach brainrots, and move on to new islands to gather more brainrots. Improving wood collection and storage helps you go further.
What do the controls do?
WASD moves Robby, Space jumps, the rotate camera control turns the view, E picks up or places a brainrot, and F throws one away.

jump-in-rhythm-to-the-hit-cat-disco.intro: Jump in Rhythm to the Hit! Cat Disco! is a music game where you guide a cat across tiles in time with pop songs. Reach the end of each level without falling to unlock more tracks and cats.
tips: Listen for the beat before you move, and try to time each jump to the music rather than reacting to the tiles alone.
Keep your eyes a little ahead of your cat so you can see the next tiles and plan the path before you reach them.
Watch for gaps in the tile path, since missing tiles are what send your cat off the level, and slow down when a stretch looks uneven.
Replay levels you find tricky to get the rhythm down, because clearing more levels is how you unlock all the songs.
Save up your coins for the cats and tracks you like most, since coins are what unlock new cats and popular tunes.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Reach the end of each level by jumping on the tiles without falling. Each level is played to the beat of the music.
How do I move my cat?
On a touchscreen, move your finger across the screen left and right. On a computer, move the mouse with the left button pressed.

do-not-feed-the-monkeys.intro: Do Not Feed the Monkeys is a simulation arcade game about watching strangers through hidden cameras. Your choices center on how much you observe and how much you hold back.
tips: Watch the cameras for a while before drawing conclusions, since the secrets and dilemmas are revealed over time.
Resist the urge to interfere early on, because the game suggests that meddling can tip the balance.
Pay attention to small details in each person's situation, as they often hint at what they are facing.
Think about what you would gain or lose by stepping in before you act, and treat each decision as a test of restraint.
If you find yourself repeatedly tempted to interfere, pause and reconsider whether observing alone is the better path.
faq: What is the main goal of Do Not Feed the Monkeys?
The game asks you to monitor strangers through hidden cameras, uncover their secrets and dilemmas, and avoid interfering with them.
What happens if I interfere with the people I am watching?
The game warns that meddling might tip the balance of the situation, so interfering can change what unfolds.

sticker-book-puzzle-color-by-number.intro: Sticker Book Puzzle: Color By Number combines color by number artwork with sticker matching. Place each sticker in its matching area to build up the full picture.
tips: Match the number on each sticker to the same number in the picture before you drag it. This keeps your placements accurate.
Start with the areas that have the most matching stickers or the clearest numbers. Filling these first makes the rest of the picture easier to read.
Work on one section at a time instead of jumping around. Finishing a small area gives you a clear sense of progress.
If a sticker does not seem to fit, check the numbers in nearby areas before trying again. The brain-teasing puzzles are designed to be solved by careful matching.
Take short breaks between sections if you want a calmer pace. The game is meant to be relaxing, so there is no need to rush.
faq: How do I place a sticker in the picture?
Click a sticker picture at the bottom of the screen and drag it to the matching area of the picture. Keep going until the whole picture is complete.
How do I know which area a sticker belongs to?
Each sticker has a number that matches the numbers in the picture. Find the area with the same number to know where it goes.

fireline-merge-defense.intro: FireLine: Merge Defense is a clicker where you unlock different guns and combine them to upgrade your cannon. You hold a tactical position and defend against waves of cubes and bosses that grow stronger over time.
tips: Merge guns early to build a stronger cannon before the waves start getting harder.
Keep your cannon in a position that lets it cover the lanes where cubes arrive most often.
Watch for boss waves and prepare by upgrading your cannon before they appear.
Use the mouse to aim and click with steady, deliberate timing rather than rapid clicking alone.
Try different gun combinations to find which setup handles the cube waves you struggle with most.
faq: How do I control the cannon?
You play with the mouse only. Use it to aim and click to fire.
How do I get stronger?
Unlock new guns and combine them to upgrade your cannon. A stronger cannon helps you handle later waves.

shadow-duel.intro: Shadow Duel is a one-on-one ninja fight where reading your rival matters more than button speed. Guard after each attack, look for the counter, and pick one of 13 ninjas with their own weapons.
tips: Guard after every attack your rival lands, since the game is built around defending first and striking back second.
Tap S just before a hit connects to parry, then attack straight away while your rival is still open.
Try the Training mode and combo trials to learn the timing of your ninja's kick and ki technique before you face the AI on harder settings.
If your sword is knocked away, switch to fists and kicks, and watch the floor so you know when you can flick your blade back up.
Use the arena's walls, props and slippery floors to your advantage, and keep an eye on the hazards that can change how the fight plays out.
faq: How do I win a duel?
You win by reading your opponent, guarding after their attacks, and then striking back when they leave an opening.
What does the parry do?
Tapping S just before a hit lands counts as a parry, and a good run of defence triggers your ninja's counter cinematic that ends in a finishing strike.

stickman-epic.intro: Stickman Epic is a battle game where you pick one of three stickman heroes, upgrade their armor, and fight bosses across 15 levels. Success depends on choosing the right hero and planning each fight.
tips: Try each of the three characters early to see which special ability suits your play style before committing to one.
Spend armor upgrades on the defenses you struggle with most, since a sturdier hero lasts longer in tough fights.
Study each boss's pattern for a few moments before attacking, because cunning bosses often reward patience over rushing.
Save your special abilities for dangerous moments rather than using them right away, so they make the biggest difference.
If a level becomes too hard, go back and reconsider your character and armor choices instead of repeating the same approach.
faq: What is the goal of Stickman Epic?
Your goal is to progress through 15 levels by defeating enemies and bosses with your chosen stickman hero. The game description does not list further win conditions.
How many characters can I choose from?
You can choose from three unique characters, each with its own special abilities. Pick the one whose abilities fit how you like to fight.

starpoly.intro: Starpoly is a board trading game for PC that you can play against the AI or with family and friends. It features property draws, loans, and a Starbridge, all controlled with mouse clicks.
tips: Before you buy or upgrade anything, check which draws and loans are on offer, since they can change your cash position quickly.
Think carefully before accepting a loan. Make sure you can cover the repayment before you commit to it.
Upgrade properties you already own when you have spare cash, but keep enough money in reserve to handle a bad turn.
Use the downgrade or sell options when you are short of funds, rather than waiting until you run out of money.
When playing with family or friends, take turns deciding on loans and property moves together so everyone understands the current position.
faq: What is the goal of Starpoly?
The description does not state a specific winning condition, so play with the rules shown in the game. Focus on managing your properties and money to stay in a strong position.
How do I manage my properties?
Click the corresponding site or slot on the board to settle amounts, upgrade, downgrade, or sell a property. You can also use the site management options.

glauron-dragon-tales.intro: Glauron: Dragon Tales puts you in control of a wrathful dragon that attacks archers, arrows, and villages from the air. It is quick to pick up but takes practice to play well.
tips: Keep your eyes moving across the sky so you can spot archers and arrows before they reach you.
Plan each attack around the two-click control so you can respond quickly when a new target appears.
Watch which threats are closest to you and deal with them first, since arrows can reach you fast.
Stay aggressive and keep the pressure on, because the game rewards relentless attacks over waiting.
faq: What is the main goal of Glauron: Dragon Tales?
You play as a dragon raining fire on archers, incinerating their arrows, and setting villages ablaze from the air.
How do the controls work?
The game is played with two clicks, so the controls are simple to learn and the challenge comes from timing and reactions.

connect-pipe-color-puzzle-game.intro: Connect Pipe! is a colorful puzzle game where you link pipes of the same color without letting them cross. Levels get harder as you go, and some puzzles are timed.
tips: Start with the pipe pairs that have the fewest open routes, since they are the easiest to place without blocking others.
Plan the paths of longer pipes before connecting shorter ones, so you do not trap a pair you still need to finish.
Check that no two pipes cross before you move on. A crossing usually means you need to reroute one of them.
If a level has a time limit, aim for accuracy first. Fixing a wrong connection often costs more time than thinking carefully at the start.
Try the Daily Puzzle to build a steady habit of solving a new layout each day and sharpen your planning.
faq: What is the goal of Connect Pipe!?
Connect every pair of pipes that share a color, making sure no pipes cross each other. Each level must be solved completely.
How do I connect pipes?
Use a left-click with the mouse, or drag with touch controls, to link pipes of the same color. The controls are designed to feel smooth and easy.

basketball-arcade.intro: Basketball Arcade is a timed free-throw shooting game. You pick up a ball, aim with the mouse, and try to score as many points as you can with your 20 balls before time runs out.
tips: Watch the force indicator on the right while holding the mouse button, and release once it reaches the strength that matches the shot's distance.
Because each free throw comes from a different angle and distance, take a moment to read the position before you aim rather than shooting right away.
Keep an eye on the clock. Spend less time on shots that look difficult and move on to the next ball when time is short.
Use WASD to reposition yourself and Space to jump so you can line up a better angle for the shot.
Try a quick test shot early on to learn how much force a given distance needs, then apply that lesson to the rest of your 20 balls.
faq: How do I control the shot strength?
Press and hold the left mouse button while shooting to build up force. The force level appears on the indicator on the right, so release when it matches the shot you need.
How many balls do I get?
You have a total of 20 balls to use during the round. Make each one count, since the timer also limits how long you can play.

fast-and-wild-in-sky.intro: Fast and Wild in Sky is a racing game set in the skies, where one mistake can send you into the clouds. Race past unpredictable obstacles and unlock and upgrade your vehicles.
tips: Keep your eyes on the path ahead so you can react to obstacles before they reach you. Reacting early gives you more room to steer clear.
Because a single mistake sends you into the clouds, avoid risky moves when you are not sure of the route. Playing it safe often beats a fast but reckless line.
Practice your movements in a relaxed run before tackling high-stakes races. Getting a feel for how your vehicle responds will make precise steering easier.
Spend your progress on the vehicle upgrades that suit your style. Choosing carefully helps you handle the demanding races better.
Stay calm after a close call and reset your focus. Quick thinking works best when you are not rushing your inputs.
faq: What is the goal of Fast and Wild in Sky?
Your goal is to race through the skies, avoiding unpredictable obstacles while staying in the air. Winning high-stakes races is the main challenge.
How do I control my vehicle on PC?
Use the W, A, S and D keys to control your vehicle. On a phone, use the matching buttons on the screen.

fall-beans-game.intro: Fall Beans Game is a fast racing game where you compete against a crowd of opponents to reach the finish line first. Each run comes down to timing your moves around obstacles and picking the quickest route.
tips: Watch the obstacles for a moment before you commit, and time your moves so you pass them without losing speed.
Keep an eye on the whole crowd, not just the bean directly in front of you, so you can spot openings and avoid getting boxed in.
Pick the quickest path early rather than switching lanes at the last second, since sudden changes often cost time.
Use short, controlled clicks or taps instead of holding steadily, so your timing stays precise around hazards.
Restart quickly after a bad run and focus on one section of the course at a time to learn where the tricky spots are.
faq: What is the goal of Fall Beans Game?
The goal is to reach the finish line before your opponents. You race against a large crowd in battle-royale style gameplay.
How do I control my bean?
Use mouse clicks or taps to play. Timing your clicks or taps is the main skill in the game.

gorbo-the-orc-crown-quest.intro: Gorbo the Orc is a side-scrolling platform adventure where you fight through six worlds to win back the Tusk Clan's golden crown. Learn the moves early, then use them to handle each world's new monsters and tricks.
tips: Use the early levels to practice running, jumping and the 3-hit cleaver combo, since most later challenges depend on those moves.
Hold the jump button to reach higher platforms, and tap it for shorter hops when you need precise landings near hazards like fire jets or slippery ice.
Deal with ranged enemies such as archers and wizards by knocking their arrows out of the air with your cleaver, rather than running straight into fire.
Stomp monsters when you can and use your thrown axe to hit enemies from a distance, which can help when shield bearers or charging bears are in the way.
Keep an eye on your hearts and save your potions for when they run low, and spend coins at the merchant when you have enough to spare.
faq: How do I attack in Gorbo the Orc?
Press X or J to swing your cleaver, and tap quickly to chain a 3-hit combo. Press C or L to throw your axe, which travels like a boomerang.
What should I do when my hearts are running low?
Press E to drink a potion. You can also spend your coins at the merchant, and your progress is saved so you can return to the quest later.

super-friday-squid-challenge.intro: Super Friday Squid Challenge is a rhythm game where you dance through songs across different weeks. Hit the arrows in time across 12 levels to reach the prize.
tips: Keep your eyes on the arrows rather than the background, since the game asks you not to miss any of them.
Stay with the beat and keep moving through each song instead of stopping to react to a missed arrow.
Try to stay calm and keep your rhythm steady from the start, because each week builds on the songs before it.
On a desktop, rest your fingers lightly on the arrow keys so you can respond quickly without looking down.
On a touch screen, tap the areas of the game steadily and keep your timing consistent rather than rushing.
faq: What is the goal of Super Friday Squid Challenge?
You help the characters complete all the songs in each week to win the prize. There are 12 levels to finish.
Which controls do I use on a desktop?
Use the arrow keys to play. Press the arrows as they come up in the song.

midnight-taxi-hustle.intro: Midnight Taxi Hustle is an arcade driving game set on neon-lit city streets. You pick up passengers, beat the clock through heavy traffic, and upgrade your taxi before dawn.
tips: Use the arrow keys to keep your speed steady through traffic instead of making sharp, sudden turns, since heavy gridlock slows you down quickly.
Tap the space bar to brake early before tight corners or stopped cars, so you can keep control of the taxi and avoid collisions.
Click the horn to call passengers when you need a fare, and watch the street for them before you commit to a route.
Keep an eye on the clock as you drive, and plan routes that let you reach pickups and drop-offs without wasting time in jams.
Spend your earnings on upgrades when you can, since a better ride makes it easier to dodge city chaos and keep your run going.
faq: What is the main goal of Midnight Taxi Hustle?
Your goal is to pick up eccentric passengers and beat the clock while navigating busy city streets. Over time you can also upgrade your ride to handle the traffic better.
How do I call passengers to my taxi?
Click the horn to call passengers to your taxi. Make sure you are in a spot where they can reach you before you try.

geometry-maze-maps-v2.intro: Geometry Maze Maps V2 is a fast platformer where your cube moves forward on its own and you control only the jumps. You work through six mazes filled with spikes and moving platforms.
tips: Watch the spikes and moving platforms for a moment before you commit, and find the rhythm of the obstacles before trying to pass them.
Time each jump to land on the next safe surface, since the cube keeps moving forward and you cannot slow it down.
Use the yellow boosters when a spot is too high to reach with a normal jump, and line up your jump with the booster before you reach it.
Stay calm after a failed attempt and review where you were hit, because repeated runs through the same section build your reaction time.
Keep your jump input steady rather than tapping or pressing wildly, so each jump is deliberate and timed to the obstacle ahead.
faq: How do I jump in Geometry Maze Maps V2?
Press the Spacebar on desktop, or tap the screen on a touch device. Your cube jumps each time you use the input.
Why is the game so hard to win?
The cube moves forward at a fast speed that you cannot control, so you have less time to react to spikes and moving platforms. The game is designed to test your reflexes.

cricket-hero.intro: Cricket Hero is a batting game where you smash balls into the stands while dodging eggs and bombs. It rewards quick reflexes and steady focus.
tips: Watch each ball closely from the moment it is released so you can judge its path before you swing.
Keep an eye out for eggs and bombs at all times, since a mistake with an obstacle can cost you the run of hits.
Stay calm between deliveries instead of swinging early; a short pause can help you reset your timing.
Aim for consistent contact before going for big hits, then push for stand-clearing shots once your timing feels reliable.
Play in short sessions so your reflexes stay sharp and you can notice patterns in how the balls and obstacles appear.
faq: What is the main goal of Cricket Hero?
You bat well enough to smash balls into the stands. The game is about clean hits and staying clear of the obstacles.
What should I avoid while batting?
Watch out for eggs and bombs, which are the obstacles the game sends your way. Dodging them is as important as hitting the ball.

spider-robot-transformation.intro: Spider Robot Transformation is a robot shooting game where you control a police spider robot in battle. You move the spider with the keys listed below and take on enemies in the fight.
tips: Use the movement keys in short bursts so you can adjust your position quickly instead of running in one straight line.
Keep the spider moving around the battle area so you are harder to pin down during the fight.
Pay attention to where threats are coming from before you commit to a direction, so you do not move into danger.
Try a few different paths or positions early on to learn how the spider responds to each key before the battle gets busy.
If you keep losing the same way, pause and change your approach rather than repeating the same moves.
faq: How do I move the spider?
Use the WASD keys or the arrow keys to move the spider around.
What kind of game is this?
It is a shooting game about spider robots battling in a robot fight, with the description highlighting a robot transformation theme.

the-biggest-number.intro: The Biggest Number is a 3D runner where you grow a number by collecting values and choosing math gates. Reach the finish with the largest number you can and smash through the walls along the way.
tips: Only collect numbers equal to or smaller than yours, since larger red numbers will stop your run. Check the size before you commit to a path.
Compare gates before you reach them. Addition and multiplication raise your number, while subtraction and division lower it, so pick the route that keeps your value climbing.
Save your shield for dangerous moments such as spinning saws, gaps, or traps, rather than using it early on safe stretches.
Let the magnet work for you by steering near useful numbers, so it can pull them toward you.
Spend coins on your starting number and income upgrades between runs, since they help you progress faster in later attempts.
faq: What is the goal of The Biggest Number?
Reach the finish with the biggest number possible and smash through as many walls as you can along the way.
How do I lose a run?
Running into a larger red number stops your run, and traps, gaps, and spinning saws also put you in danger.

power-crusher.intro: Power Crusher is a clicker where every tap smashes minerals with bursts of visual spectacle. Upgrade your crusher's power and speed to see how mighty your machine can become.
tips: Focus on steady tapping early on, since every tap is what turns minerals into shatters.
Spend upgrades with a plan: power helps each smash hit harder, while speed helps you smash more often.
Try switching your upgrade focus when one side starts to feel slow, so neither power nor speed falls far behind.
Pay attention to how each upgrade changes the visuals and rhythm of your smashes, so you know what is working.
Take short breaks between sessions so you can come back and plan your next upgrades with a clear head.
faq: What is the goal of Power Crusher?
The goal is to smash minerals and keep upgrading your crusher's power and speed as you progress. The game is about strategic progression toward a stronger machine.
How do I play Power Crusher?
You play by tapping, since each tap is a smash of your crusher. Use your progress to upgrade power and speed over time.

hexa-block-puzzle.intro: Hexa Block Puzzle asks you to fit hexagonal pieces into a grid. Pieces cannot be rotated, so you need to plan each placement carefully. There is no time limit, so you can take your time.
tips: Since pieces cannot be rotated, check the shape of each one as it is before deciding where it goes.
Look for awkward gaps on the board first and think about which pieces could fill them.
With no time limit, pause to study the board before each move instead of rushing.
If you get stuck, use the hint rather than guessing, then look at how the hint's placement fits the shape.
Expect the challenge to grow as you play, so practice on easier boards to build your habits.
faq: Can I rotate the hexagon pieces?
No, the pieces cannot be rotated. You need to find a spot where each piece fits in its current orientation.
Is there a time limit?
No, the game has no time limits, so you can think through each move at your own pace.

paperly-paper-plane-adventure.intro: Paperly is a 3D single-player adventure about flying a paper plane through physics-driven flight. You learn how the plane handles, learn from your mistakes, and work toward reaching your destination.
tips: Make small, gentle inputs with WASD at first, since a physics-driven plane can overreact to sharp changes in direction.
Use Shift for boost in short bursts to gain speed or push through a tricky stretch, rather than holding it the whole time, so you keep control of the plane.
After each crash or missed target, pause and think about what the plane did, then adjust your next attempt instead of repeating the same move.
Watch how your speed and angle affect the plane's glide before committing to a turn, because the game is built around learning flight mechanics.
On mobile, get comfortable with the joystick before you try to fly fast, and use the buttons for boost in the same calm, controlled way.
faq: What is the main goal in Paperly?
Your goal is to fly your paper plane and reach your destination. The game focuses on learning how flight works and improving from mistakes along the way.
How do I control the paper plane on PC?
Use WASD to move the plane and hold Shift to boost. Try small adjustments first to see how the plane responds.

dark-world.intro: Dark World is a platformer battle game with 30 levels. You fight foes with a sword and arrows while exploring winding paths and searching for hidden treasure.
tips: Take each level slowly at first and watch how enemies move before you commit to an attack.
Use your sword for enemies that come close and your arrows for foes you can hit from a distance.
Explore the mysterious paths carefully, since treasure is often tucked away from the obvious route.
Keep track of where you have already been so you do not waste time backtracking through dangerous areas.
If a level feels too hard, pause to plan your route and timing rather than rushing through the peril.
faq: What is the main goal of Dark World?
You move through 30 levels of a treacherous platformer, defeating cunning foes and surviving the peril along the way. Finding hidden treasure is also part of the adventure.
What weapons do I have to fight with?
You fight with a sword and arrows. Choose the weapon that suits the foe in front of you.

bus-and-subway-rush.intro: Bus & Subway Rush is a fast-paced runner where you race through a busy city along a bus and subway route. Dodge obstacles, switch lanes, and collect rewards while you keep moving.
tips: Look ahead rather than at your character, so you can start changing lanes before an obstacle is directly in front of you.
Make lane changes early and in small steps, since switching late can leave you no room to avoid the next obstacle.
Grab rewards when they are safe to reach, but never swerve into a new obstacle just to collect one.
Settle into a steady rhythm with the controls instead of making rapid, panicked movements, which often cause collisions.
If you play on a touchscreen, use short, clear swipes so the game registers each lane change reliably.
faq: What is the main goal in Bus & Subway Rush?
The goal is to keep moving through the busy city by dodging obstacles, switching lanes, and collecting rewards as you go.
Which controls do I use to move and steer?
Use the W, A, S, and D keys or the arrow keys on a keyboard. On touch devices, swipe to move and steer.

e-rickshaw-simulator.intro: E-Rickshaw Simulator is a driving game where you carry passengers around a busy city. You follow the map to pick them up and drop them off safely at homes, schools, hospitals, and other locations.
tips: Check the mini-map and distance indicator before each turn so you can plan your route instead of reacting at the last second.
Ease off the accelerator before corners and busy intersections, since steering hard at speed makes it harder to avoid pedestrians and vehicles.
Watch for pedestrians and traffic near pickup and drop-off points, where people may be moving into your path.
Keep an eye on your health during longer missions, and slow down in heavy traffic when it drops, because crashes can make a mission fail.
Use the reverse control carefully in tight spaces, and make sure the passenger is safely dropped off before you move on.
faq: What happens if my e-rickshaw crashes?
Crashes can reduce your health or cause the mission to fail, so avoid hitting pedestrians, vehicles, and obstacles.
How do I earn money in the game?
You earn money by completing pickup and drop-off missions, and you can spend it to unlock new e-rickshaws in the shop.

weapon-run-battle.intro: Weapon Run Battle is a fast hypercasual game that mixes parkour dashing and leaping with shooting. Collect cash, upgrade your arsenal, and pick weapons that suit each enemy.
tips: Grab cash whenever it is safe to do so, since it is what you use to upgrade your arsenal.
Before a fight, think about which weapon fits the enemies ahead rather than sticking with one for everything.
Use dashes and leaps to keep moving between threats instead of standing still while you shoot.
If a level becomes hard, try a different weapon or upgrade order on your next run and compare results.
Replay levels to practice timing your jumps and shots, since the description emphasizes refining your tactics.
faq: What is the goal of Weapon Run Battle?
Dash, leap, and blast your way through each level by defeating enemies while collecting cash along the way. The description highlights strategic weapon choices as central to success.
How do I upgrade my weapons?
Collect cash during your run and use it to upgrade your arsenal. Check the in-game menus for the exact upgrade options available.

stand-on-the-right-color-robby.intro: Stand on the Right Color, Robby! is an arcade race to the finish line. You jump onto colored tiles while the colors change at random, and you must react fast to stay on the road.
tips: Watch the tiles ahead rather than the ones under your feet, so you can start moving before a color changes.
Keep your character near the center of the path where possible, since you have limited time at each stage and a short step can save a fall.
Jump only when you are sure of the next tile's color; a rushed jump is one of the easiest ways to fall behind rivals.
Use the camera controls to check the upcoming part of the course, especially when you are racing close to other players.
Spend in-game currency on skins, items, or effects only for variety; they do not change how the tiles work, so focus your attention on reaction and accuracy.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Your goal is to reach the finish line by jumping on colored tiles before the time at each stage runs out. Staying ahead of your rivals matters too.
How do I control Robby on a computer?
Use W, A, S, and D to move, Space or the left mouse button to jump, and the mouse to move the camera. The right mouse button also controls the character.

baseball-for-clowns.intro: Help Henk, a legendary baseball player, win back his glory by outsmarting and eliminating mischievous jesters across zany, action-packed levels. Each stage asks you to use your baseball skills.
tips: Watch how each jester moves before you act, since the game rewards outsmarting them rather than rushing in.
Treat each level as a puzzle: look for the jesters' pattern and time your moves around it.
Keep your focus on the jesters you can eliminate first, so the field gets easier to manage.
If a level feels chaotic, pause your attempts mentally and reset your approach instead of repeating the same move.
Play each level again after a loss to learn where the jesters tend to show up and how they respond.
faq: What is the goal of Baseball for Clowns?
Your goal is to help Henk use his baseball skills to outsmart and eliminate the jesters, reclaiming his glory in each action-packed level.
How should I approach the jesters?
Focus on outsmarting them rather than charging in. Observing their movements first will help you choose the right moment to act.

survival-wave-zombie-multiplayer.intro: Survival Wave Zombie Multiplayer is a shooter where you face AI soldiers and zombies alone or with friends. It includes several modes, including gun game, survival, team deathmatch and deathmatch.
tips: Learn the controls early: WASD to move, the mouse to aim and shoot, and SHIFT to run so you can reposition quickly when enemies close in.
Use SPACE to jump over low obstacles and to dodge zombies that are closing in on you.
Open the menu with TAB to check your gun options and attachments before a round, so you start with a setup that suits your playstyle.
Switch between guns as you go instead of sticking to one weapon, especially in gun game where weapons change as you progress.
Play with friends when you can, since splitting up to cover more ground helps in team modes and survival waves.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
The goal is to survive against waves of AI soldiers and zombies in survival, or to win the round in modes like team deathmatch and deathmatch. The specific objective depends on the mode you choose.
How do I aim and shoot?
Use the mouse to aim and look around, and click to shoot. Use the mouse to track moving enemies as you fire.

battleship-war-multiplayer.intro: Battleship War Multiplayer is a strategy game about placing your fleet, firing torpedoes at rival ships, and using points to buy power-ups during ocean battles against other players.
tips: Think about where you place your ships before the battle starts, since a well-spread layout makes it harder for opponents to find them.
Watch the pattern of your opponent's shots and look for gaps in their coverage so you can predict where their fleet might be.
Save points when you can and spend them on power-ups at the moment they will matter most, rather than using them early without a plan.
Track where you have already fired so you do not waste torpedoes on the same spots and can focus on unexplored areas of the ocean.
Keep an eye on which enemy ships are still afloat and adjust your strategy to the threats that remain.
faq: What is the goal of Battleship War Multiplayer?
The goal is to outsmart your opponents by finding and sinking their ships with torpedoes while protecting your own fleet.
How do I earn power-ups?
You earn points during play, and you can use those points to acquire power-ups that give you an advantage in battle.

swat-and-greens-vs-zombies.intro: SWAT and GREENS vs Zombies is a tower defense strategy game where you upgrade SWAT squad members and plants to hold back waves of advancing zombies. Your squad's placement and timing decide how long each battle lasts.
tips: Place each SWAT member where their unique weapon suits the lane or area they are covering, rather than grouping everyone in one spot.
Keep track of each plant's cooldown and save its power for the moments when waves are hardest to handle.
Upgrade the members and plants you use most often, so your strongest defenders are ready when the waves grow tougher.
Try to keep losses low during each battle, since the level completion reward is tied to how few you lose.
Unlock new squad members as you progress, and test how they combine with your existing plants before committing to a full lineup.
faq: How do I place SWAT members and plants on the battlefield?
Hold down the left mouse button or touch the screen, then drag the member or plant onto the field.
What does a plant's cooldown mean?
After a plant uses its power, it needs time to recharge before it can be used again, so timing matters.

zombie-invasion.intro: Zombie Invasion is a 3D action game where you survive an apocalypse by picking Rick or Kate and fighting off waves of undead. You dodge danger, protect survivors, and collect power-ups along the way.
tips: Keep moving rather than standing still, since the game focuses on dodging danger as well as shooting.
Track where the survivors are so you can protect them, because keeping them safe is part of the core challenge.
Grab power-ups when it is safe to do so, and notice what changes on screen after each pickup so you learn which ones help you most.
Try both Rick and Kate early on to see which character's style suits how you like to play.
Stay alert for the tougher zombie threats, and save your shooting for moments when you have a clear line on them.
faq: What is the main goal of Zombie Invasion?
Survive the zombie apocalypse by battling the undead hordes, dodging danger, and protecting survivors. The description does not list a specific win condition.
Should I choose Rick or Kate?
The description does not explain how the two characters differ. Try each one to see which feels better to you.

gt-flying-car-racing.intro: GT Flying Car Racing is a one-player arcade racer where you drive fast GT cars that can switch between land and air. You race on challenging tracks, avoid obstacles, and compete against rivals.
tips: Use the mouse to steer and control your car, and keep your movements smooth so you don't overcorrect on fast turns.
Watch the track ahead for obstacles early, so you have time to change your line before you reach them.
Pay attention to when a switch between driving and flying gives you an advantage, such as a shortcut or a difficult section.
Practice aerial maneuvers in calm stretches of track so you know how your car responds before you need them in a close race.
Keep an eye on your rivals' positions and push harder when you are close to them, rather than racing at full speed the whole time.
faq: What is the goal of GT Flying Car Racing?
Your goal is to race through challenging tracks, avoid obstacles, and beat your rivals to become the champion. Mastering both land and air racing helps you do this.
How do I control the car?
This game is played with the mouse only, so all steering and actions are controlled that way.

slinky-color-sort.intro: Slinky Color Sort is a relaxing puzzle across multiple levels. You sort colorful slinky rings by moving them onto matching colors until each color sits in its own single stack.
tips: Before you move anything, scan the whole level to see which colors are on top of others. Clearing the top rings first usually opens up the most options.
Only rings of the same color can stack together, so focus on one color at a time and finish its stack before switching to another.
Keep each color in a single stack. Splitting a color across two places can make later moves harder to plan.
If you get stuck, look for a ring that is blocking a color you need and see whether it can be moved onto a matching ring first.
Take your time and look at the colors closely. Slow, deliberate moves help you avoid placing a ring in the wrong spot.
faq: What is the goal of Slinky Color Sort?
The goal is to sort the colorful slinky rings so that every ring of the same color is gathered into a single stack.
How do I move a ring?
Drag and drop a ring by tapping it, then place it onto another ring. You can only move a ring onto another ring that is the same color.

weapons-merge-hero.intro: Weapons Merge Hero is a 2D puzzle game where you combine matching knives and throw them at planet-shaped enemies until they explode. Your merges decide how hard you hit as the enemies get tougher.
tips: Merge early and often. Each merge of two same-level weapons makes a stronger knife, so combining them as soon as you can keeps your damage rising.
Check your weapon row before every merge. Only two weapons of the same level can combine, so plan which pairs to join to avoid getting stuck.
Pay attention to timing when you throw. The game says timing matters, so aim for steady hits rather than wasting knives on misses.
Keep hitting the same enemy until it explodes. Focusing your throws on one target clears it faster than spreading your knives around.
Expect harder enemies to test your upgrades. As the enemies toughen, the strongest merged knives are the ones that keep you going, so prioritise building them.
faq: What is the goal of Weapons Merge Hero?
Your goal is to destroy round, planet-shaped enemies by throwing knives at them until they explode. Each successful hit brings you closer to victory.
How do I make a stronger knife?
Drag one weapon onto another weapon of the same level to combine them. Each merge increases knife damage and effectiveness.

catchfish-fishing-master.intro: CatchFish is an arcade shooter where you fire cannons at schools of fish and huge bosses to earn gold. Spend that gold to upgrade from a single barrel to multi-shot weapons across 100 levels.
tips: Hold your aim on a school of fish and keep firing, since hitting several fish at once earns more gold than chasing single targets.
Spend gold on cannon upgrades early so your shots cover more ground before the levels get harder.
Pay attention to which fish species give the best rewards and focus your fire there when you can.
Try to keep your hits coming without long gaps to build up combo streak bonuses.
Save your gold for boss fights when possible, because bosses offer huge gold bonuses.
faq: How do I fire my cannon?
Tap or click anywhere to fire at that spot. Hold to fire rapidly, and drag to keep aiming while you shoot.
How do I earn gold?
Hit fish to earn gold. You then spend that gold on cannon upgrades.

draw-the-path-puzzle.intro: Draw The Path is a line-drawing puzzle where you guide a ball into a basket through a series of challenges with different obstacles. Plan each route before you start drawing.
tips: Study the whole level before drawing anything, and note where the ball starts, where the basket is, and which obstacles it has to pass.
Look for the simplest route first. A short, direct line often works better than a long one that adds more places for the ball to go wrong.
Pay attention to how the ball will move once it is released. Think about its path, not just where your line ends.
If a route fails, look at exactly where the ball went off course and adjust only that part of your line instead of starting over.
Take your time with precision. Small changes in the angle or length of a line can decide whether the ball reaches the basket.
faq: What is the goal of Draw The Path?
Your goal is to draw a path that guides the ball into the basket while avoiding or working around the obstacles in each challenge.
How do I get better at solving the puzzles?
Watch how the ball reacts to your lines and use each failed attempt to learn what the obstacles do. Test small changes before committing to a completely new route.

fun-summer-holiday.intro: Fun Summer Holiday is a dress-up game where you go on summer trips with Ashleigh and her friends. You spin a wheel to pick a destination, choose outfits, and collect photos to revisit later.
tips: Spin the wheel for a destination first, then pick outfits that suit the place you landed on. Matching the look to the setting keeps each trip feeling distinct.
Try different outfit combinations for the same destination, since each trip is a fresh chance to experiment with fashion.
Take time to capture the moments on each trip, because those photos are what you will look back on later.
Check the photo gallery after a few trips to compare your memories and see which outfits and places you liked most.
Keep jetting off to new destinations to see more of what the game offers, since the adventures are meant to keep going.
faq: How does the destination wheel work?
You spin the wheel to discover where your next summer holiday will take you. Each spin sets up a new trip with Ashleigh and her friends.
Can I look back at my trips?
Yes, the photo gallery lets you relive your vacations by viewing the moments you captured along the way.

super-tank-hero.intro: Super Tank Hero is a shooting game where you drive a tank across the battlefield, fighting enemies and dodging obstacles. Collect soldiers before battle to strengthen your team.
tips: Gather soldiers whenever you can before a fight, since they join your team and help you battle.
Keep moving rather than standing still so you are harder for enemies to target.
Watch the obstacles on the battlefield and use them as cover when enemies are firing at you.
Plan your shots around the enemies nearest to your tank first, then move on to the rest.
Use mouse clicks or taps deliberately, since the game is controlled entirely by clicking or tapping.
faq: What is the goal of Super Tank Hero?
The goal is to drive your tank, shoot and fight on the battlefield against enemies and obstacles. Collecting soldiers before battle helps your team fight.
How do I control the tank?
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps. Use clicks to aim, fire and move your tank as the battle unfolds.

water-me-please.intro: Water Me Please! is a puzzle game where you guide water to thirsty plants by arranging pieces. With over 600 levels, it offers a calm Relax Mode and a harder Challenge Mode.
tips: Before placing any pieces, trace the route the water needs to take from its source to each plant. Planning the whole path first saves wasted moves.
Start in Relax Mode to learn how the pieces connect, then move to Challenge Mode when you feel comfortable with the basics.
If a level feels stuck, look at the plants and the water source again to check whether a piece is blocking a route you had not considered.
Work through levels in short sessions. Taking a break can help you spot the solution with fresh eyes.
Pay attention to the characters and their reactions, since they make each watered plant easy to recognise as progress.
faq: What is the goal of Water Me Please!?
Your goal is to guide water to the thirsty plants by arranging the puzzle pieces correctly. Each level is solved once every plant has its water.
What is the difference between Relax Mode and Challenge Mode?
Relax Mode offers a serene, unhurried way to play through the levels. Challenge Mode presents tougher trials for players who want a greater test.

nuts-and-bolts-game-wood-puzzle.intro: Nuts & Bolts Game: Wood Puzzle is a logic puzzle where you remove nuts and bolts so wooden plates fall from the board. Each move affects what happens next, so planning ahead is key.
tips: Study the whole board before your first tap, and note which plates are held by which nuts and bolts.
Think about what will happen after each removal, since falling plates can affect the pieces below or beside them.
Start with pieces that look like they will free up the most space or open the next step, rather than tapping at random.
If a move leads to a dead end, try the puzzle again with a different order rather than forcing the same approach.
Take a moment to plan each move in your head, because the instructions note that every move can decide success or failure.
faq: What is the goal of Nuts & Bolts Game: Wood Puzzle?
The goal is to unscrew all the nuts and bolts in each puzzle so the wooden plates fall in a way that clears the board. You win by completing each puzzle.
How do I control the game?
Tap on the nuts and bolts to remove them. Each tap causes the wooden plates pinned to the board to fall.

ash-hidden-objects.intro: Help Ash and Pikachu find hidden objects before time runs out. The names of the items you need are listed on the left side of the screen.
tips: Read the item names on the left before you start searching, so you know exactly what shape and colour to look for.
Scan the scene in a set pattern, such as left to right or top to bottom, so you don't miss items in the corners.
Keep an eye on the timer from the start, and move on from a tricky item if you are running low on time.
Look for items that are partly covered or blend into the background, since these are often the ones players miss.
If you want three stars, aim to finish each level quickly and cleanly, and try to beat your own points score on replays.
faq: What is the goal of Ash Hidden Objects?
Your goal is to find all the hidden objects listed on the left side of the screen before the timer runs out. If time runs out, the game is over.
How do I play the game?
Click with your mouse or tap the screen to find the objects. The item names are shown on the left, so check them as you go.

cat-chaos-simulator.intro: Cat Chaos Simulator is a 3D arcade game where you play a mischievous cat causing mayhem across scenes like houses and parks. Knock things over, mess with people, and build up your mess value.
tips: Start in the Room Naughty scene to get comfortable with jumping and knocking items off surfaces before moving on to other areas.
Plan a route through the room so you reach high surfaces like tables without wasting time wandering.
Target items that create the biggest disturbance, such as cups and computers, to build your mess value faster.
Keep an eye on your mess value as you go and see how far you can push it before the scene runs out of things to destroy.
Try different scenes such as houses and parks, since each one offers different objects and ways to cause chaos.
faq: How do I play Cat Chaos Simulator?
Use mouse clicks or taps to control your cat, jump onto objects, and knock things over. Keep causing chaos to raise your mess value.
What is the goal of the game?
The goal is to keep destroying furniture and messing with humans to see how far you can take your mess value.

lovely-virtual-cat-at-restaurant.intro: Lovely Virtual Cat At Restaurant is a cooking game where you help a cat run a busy restaurant. You take orders, prepare dishes for the animal customers, and explore the fun extras in the restaurant.
tips: Focus on picking up orders and preparing dishes first, since these are the core jobs of the restaurant.
Keep an eye on which animals are waiting so no customer has to wait too long for their food.
Try feeding the lobster and watching it grow, since this is one of the game's unique features.
Experiment with the table decorations and change them to match the mood you want for the restaurant.
Touch the animals to hear their cute sounds, and explore the other features as you go to find all the fun parts of the game.
faq: What is the main goal of Lovely Virtual Cat At Restaurant?
Your main job is to help the lovely cat manage his restaurant by picking up orders and preparing dishes for the animal customers.
How do I play the game?
You play with the mouse or by tapping the screen. Click or tap to take orders, prepare dishes, and interact with the animals and decorations.

money-maker.intro: Money Maker is a merge game where you run a banknote machine. Drop pins, merge them into higher tiers, and upgrade your machine to grow your earnings over time.
tips: Merge pins as soon as you have two of the same tier, since higher-tier pins are what raise your profits.
Place power-up chips in the spots that let every bounce count, and check where new chip slots open up as you progress.
Spend upgrades on the Money Machine when you can, because a higher base banknote value lifts everything you earn afterward.
Keep the board from filling up with low-value pins so you always have room to drop and merge new ones.
Check back often to collect and reinvest your earnings, since the game rewards steady growth more than one long session.
faq: How do I increase my profits?
Drag pins onto the board and merge them into higher-tier pins, and upgrade the Money Machine to raise the base banknote value.
What does merging do?
Dragging one pin onto another merges them into a higher-tier pin, which helps your income grow.

mini-games-puzzle-collection.intro: Mini Games: Puzzle Collection gathers three popular puzzle games in one place. You help a dog reach its bones with a limited number of wooden planks, and you guide donuts to the dog by drawing lines.
tips: Before placing any wooden plank, look at the whole gap and the path to the bones so you know where the bridge must reach.
Since your planks are limited, aim for the shortest bridge that still gets the dog across rather than testing long, wasteful designs.
If a plank placement doesn't work, study why it failed before trying again, so you don't spend your limited planks on guesses.
For the donut puzzle, plan the full route of your line first, keeping it clear of obstacles so the donuts can reach the dog.
Switch your focus between the three puzzles if one feels stuck, since a fresh look at a different puzzle can help you spot a new approach.
faq: What is the goal of the bridge puzzle?
Use the limited wooden planks to build a bridge that helps the dog reach the bones on the other side of the river.
How do I control the games?
Use a mouse click or tap to play. Everything in the collection is controlled this way.

ninja-escape-2.intro: Ninja Escape 2 is a platformer where you run, jump, slide, and fly past spikes. Work through the levels, follow the master, and unlock endless mode to chase high scores.
tips: Watch the spikes ahead before you commit to a jump or a slide. Most deaths come from acting too late, so react early.
Use the slide and fly moves as well as jumping. Each one can get you past a hazard that a jump alone would not clear.
Treat the early levels as practice for your timing. Completing all levels unlocks endless mode, so it is worth going through them carefully.
Keep your clicks or taps deliberate. Since the game uses only mouse clicks or touch, a steady rhythm helps you avoid mistimed inputs.
Once you have unlocked endless mode, use it to work on consistency. Playing it repeatedly lets you learn the patterns that help you beat your best scores.
faq: What is the main goal of Ninja Escape 2?
Your goal is to run, jump, slide, and fly through the levels while avoiding all the spikes. Completing all the levels unlocks endless mode.
How do I control the ninja?
The game is played with mouse clicks or touch. Use your input to run, jump, slide, and fly through each level.

tcg-shop-dino-adventure.intro: TCG Shop: Dino Adventure is a prehistoric card game where you battle league rivals in 3v3 fights, earn coins, open packs, and build your binder. Your progress depends on winning battles and choosing which cards to keep.
tips: Since a card's power serves as both its attack and its health, favor cards with higher power when building your battle deck, because they can deal and absorb more damage.
Keep your coin balance in mind before buying packs, since packs cost coins and winning battles is what earns them back.
Before swiping a pulled card, check whether it would strengthen your battle deck or fill a gap in your binder. Keep the cards you need and sell the ones you don't.
Use your binder to track which cards you already have, so you don't sell or sleeve duplicates without thinking about it.
Climb the league ladder steadily rather than rushing. Each win adds coins that help you buy better packs and grow a stronger deck for the next promotion.
faq: What is the main goal of TCG Shop: Dino Adventure?
Your goal is to battle league rivals, earn coins, open packs, and build a prehistoric card collection. You climb the league ladder while filling your binder with rare finds.
How do I play a battle?
Each battle is a 3v3 fight against a league opponent. You can control it with your cursor or your finger.

fashion-sewing-clothes.intro: Fashion Sewing Clothes is a dress-up and design game where you create costumes for two guests, Elisa and Alice. You listen to what each girl asks for and build outfits to match their requests.
tips: Listen to each guest's requirements before you start, since the costume should match what she asks for.
Work through the steps in order so the outfit comes together cleanly rather than jumping ahead.
Take your time with the decorating choices, because the game's aim is to make the most beautiful costumes.
Compare your finished costume with the guest's request before you move on, so you catch anything that does not fit.
Use the mouse or tap controls slowly and carefully to place each piece exactly where you want it.
faq: What is the goal of Fashion Sewing Clothes?
The goal is to make beautiful costumes that meet the requirements of the two guests, Elisa and Alice.
How do I control the game?
You play with mouse clicks or taps, so click or tap to select, place and decorate each part of the costume.

princess-kawaii-swimwear.intro: Princess Kawaii Swimwear is a dress-up game where you style princesses in pastel swimsuits for a beach look. Mix, match, and accessorize to create outfits that suit each princess.
tips: Start by choosing a swimsuit for the princess, then build the rest of the look around it so the pieces suit each other.
Try a few pastel colour combinations before settling on one, since the pastel tones are what give the game its soft, kawaii feel.
Pick accessories last and use them to finish the look, adding one or two at a time so the outfit does not become cluttered.
Compare your outfit with the princess's overall style to check that the colours and accessories work together.
Experiment with different combinations on each princess, because each one can look different with the same pieces.
faq: What is the goal of Princess Kawaii Swimwear?
The goal is to style princesses in vibrant, pastel swimsuits and create a beach look that makes each princess shine. The game is about creativity rather than winning.
How do I create a good beach look?
Mix and match swimsuits with accessories until the outfit feels balanced. Keep the pastel tones in mind so the final look stays consistent.

half-life-2-beat-em-up.intro: Half-Life 2: Beat Em Up is a 2D arcade fighter set across five locations from the Half-Life 2 world. You fight your way from City 17 through to the Citadel, using mouse clicks or taps to play.
tips: Learn how the controls respond by trying a few clicks or taps before you move into harder fights, since the game is played entirely with mouse clicks or taps.
Take the locations in order, from City 17 through Route Kanal, Ravenholm and Nova Prospekt, so you build familiarity before reaching the Citadel.
Watch the screen for a moment before each action so you can see where enemies are coming from rather than reacting too late.
Stay calm in tight spots and avoid rushing every click, since steady, deliberate inputs usually work better than frantic tapping.
If a location feels difficult, take a short break and return with fresh focus instead of pushing through while tired.
faq: What is the goal of Half-Life 2: Beat Em Up?
The goal is to fight through City 17, Route Kanal, Ravenholm, Nova Prospekt and the Citadel. Each location leads to the next one.
How do I control the game?
You play by mouse click or tap. There are no other controls listed in the game's instructions.

gun-and-guys.intro: Gun and Guys is a two-player duel game where you move fast, shoot accurately, and outplay your opponent across colorful battlefields. Speed and precision decide each match.
tips: Keep moving rather than standing still, since a stationary target is an easy one to hit.
Use jumps to dodge incoming shots and to reposition quickly, timing them so you land somewhere useful.
Take a moment to aim before firing, because precise shots tend to matter more than rapid ones.
Try different weapons and pick upgrades that suit your style, then notice which ones help you win exchanges against your opponent.
Watch your opponent's movement patterns and try to predict where they will go, so you can strike when they are exposed.
faq: What is the main goal of Gun and Guys?
You face another player in a duel and try to defeat them through quick movement, dodging, and accurate shooting. Victory depends on speed and precision.
How important are weapons and upgrades?
The game offers a variety of weapons and upgrades, so choosing the right ones can change how you approach each duel. Experiment to find the setup that feels most effective for you.

cat-pet-doctor-dentist.intro: Cat Pet Doctor Dentist lets you play as a vet caring for kittens. You use a set of treatment tools, including an X-ray machine and a magnifying glass, to check and help each cat.
tips: Use the X-ray machine when you suspect a problem with a cat's bones, and save the magnifying glass for skin problems. Matching the tool to the issue keeps your checks focused.
Take your time with the magnifying glass and look over the whole area before you decide what is wrong. Rushing can make you miss small skin problems.
Check the X-ray results carefully before you move on to treatment. Knowing what is happening under the surface helps you choose the right care.
Work at a steady pace with single clicks or taps, since each action is a deliberate step in treating the cat. Slow, careful input is easier to control than quick tapping.
Try each instrument on a kitten to see what it reveals, so you learn how the tools work before you rely on them.
faq: What is the goal of Cat Pet Doctor Dentist?
You play as a veterinarian who examines and treats kittens. The game is about caring for the cats using the instruments provided.
How do I play the game?
Use a mouse click or tap to interact with the game and its tools. Everything in the game is controlled this way.

switch-colors.intro: Switch Colors is a ball game where you guide a color-changing ball through rotating hoops. Matching colors, timing your moves, and keeping your focus all help you climb the high score.
tips: Watch the ball's current color before each hoop reaches it, so you can plan whether to pass through or wait.
Track the rotation pattern of the hoops for a few seconds before acting, since the timing gap between them is what keeps you alive.
Stay calm during fast stretches. Reacting to the next hoop is usually better than rushing a move you have not read yet.
Try to remember which colors came up recently, because the challenge is built around focus and memory as the pattern shifts.
Play in short sessions and notice where you lose points. Repeating the same mistake is the fastest way to stall your score.
faq: What is the main goal of Switch Colors?
Guide the color-changing ball through rotating hoops by matching colors and timing your moves well. The aim is to reach a high score.
What makes the game harder as you go?
The description says the challenges keep shifting, so you need to stay alert and adjust your timing and memory as the pattern changes.

rabbit-samurai.intro: Rabbit Samurai is an adventure game about swinging through landscapes to rescue mice, collect treasure, and get past wolves. Success depends on timing your swings and choosing the right angles.
tips: Watch the arc of each swing before you commit, since the release point decides where you travel next.
Plan your route ahead of time by looking for the next grappling point or rope before you leave the current one.
Make small, controlled swings first to learn how far your momentum carries you before attempting longer jumps.
Keep an eye out for wolves and move past their positions early rather than waiting near them.
Scan each landscape for treasures and mice on the way, so you can build a route that picks them up without backtracking.
faq: What is the main goal of Rabbit Samurai?
You swing through each landscape to rescue mice, collect treasures, and outsmart the wolves along the way.
What skill matters most in this game?
Precise swinging is the core skill, since the angle and timing of each swing determine where you land and whether you can reach the next target.

obby-click-and-grow.intro: Obby: Click and Grow is a 3D clicker where you grow your blocky character with every click while tackling parkour trials. Pets, rebirths, and leaderboards give you ways to speed up your progress.
tips: Keep clicking whenever you are idle, since each click adds to your character's size and builds the progress that everything else depends on.
Collect Obby pets and check how much each one increases size per click, then focus on the ones that help your growth the most.
Consider rebirthing once growth slows down, because the rebirth system doubles your trophies and speeds up growth from that point.
Claim your daily free gifts and bonuses every time you log in, as they add up over time and help you move up the leaderboard.
Practice the parkour trials with the controls before rushing, and use the camera rotation on mobile to check your path before each jump.
faq: What is the main goal of Obby: Click and Grow?

The goal is to become the biggest and strongest character by upgrading its size through clicks and completing parkour trials. Unlocking achievements and climbing the leaderboard are also part of the progression.
How do I move and jump on a computer?
Use WASD to move your character and the Space bar to jump. On mobile, use the joystick to move and the button in the lower right corner to jump.

halloween-mania.intro: Halloween Mania is a Match 3 puzzle game set in a castle full of scared monsters. Clear 60 levels, each with its own goal, and try to earn three stars on every one.
tips: Read the goal at the start of each level before you move, since the targets differ from level to level and a plan for one may not work for another.
Look for matches of four or more monsters of the same color, because they create powerful tiles that explode the area around them.
Save powerful tiles for moments when they can clear a crowded part of the board or help reach the level goal.
Aim for three stars on each level rather than just finishing it, since the stars show how well you played.
Keep an eye on points as you play, and replay a level if you finished it with fewer stars than you wanted.
faq: What is the main goal of Halloween Mania?
Match at least three monsters of the same color to remove them from the field. Each level has its own goal you need to reach to finish it.
How do I create a powerful tile?
Make a combination of four or more monsters of the same color. These powerful tiles explode the areas around them on the board.

physics-box-2.intro: Physics Box 2 is a puzzle game where you guide a cube to the finish line using momentum. Watch out for lasers, moving platforms, and spikes along the way.
tips: Watch the cube's movement for a moment before you act, since momentum keeps it moving after you start it.
Study moving platforms and time your clicks or taps so the cube lands where you want rather than reacting late.
Approach lasers and spikes slowly at first, and note where they sit so you can plan the next move ahead of time.
If a run goes wrong, restart and try a different approach instead of repeating the same mistake.
Keep your tapping steady and deliberate, because rushing usually leads to overshooting the path.
faq: What is the goal of Physics Box 2?
Your goal is to guide the cube to the finish line while avoiding obstacles like lasers, moving platforms, and spikes.
How do I control the cube?
You play with mouse clicks or taps, so use those inputs to move the cube along its path.
