grazing-giraffe.intro: Grazing Giraffe is a sliding puzzle where your giraffe keeps moving until something stops it, and its growing neck fills the tiles behind it. The goal is to eat every leaf by covering the whole board in one path.
tips: Before each swipe, check which tiles are still empty and where the giraffe can actually stop, since it only halts at walls, trees, ponds or its own neck.
Look for dead ends early. A small unfilled pocket that you cannot reach later is the most common reason a level gets stuck.
Plan the route backwards from the last leaves you need to eat. Working out the finish first often reveals which opening move is required.
Use rewind freely while learning a layout. Trying a line of moves, rewinding, and trying another is a fast way to map a level.
Expect new mechanics as you move through the chapters, so reread the board for unfamiliar tiles before you commit to a plan.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Fill every tile of the trail so the giraffe eats all the leaves and completes the level. Each swipe sends the giraffe sliding until it hits something.
How do I control the giraffe?
On touch screens, swipe in the direction you want. On a keyboard, use the arrow keys or WASD, and with a mouse, click and drag.

obby-swing-for-brainrots-steal.intro: Obby Swing for Brainrots Steal is a fast movement game where you swing and fly across the map with a harpoon. You reach Brainrots, steal them, and upgrade your base over time.
tips: Aim before you fire. Pick your next hook point ahead of time so you can keep moving instead of stopping mid-swing.
Focus on timing. Launch and release at the right moment to carry your speed from one point to the next.
Use the swings and jumps together. Chaining them keeps your momentum high and makes the map easier to cross.
Steal Brainrots whenever a safe route opens up. Collecting them is how you grow your base, so do not ignore them while traveling.
Spend upgrades on what helps your movement and collection most. Progress is long-term, so steady choices add up more than rushed ones.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Swing across the map with your harpoon, steal Brainrots, and upgrade your base to build a large Brainrot empire.
How does the harpoon work?
You aim, hook onto a point, and fly toward it. Each grapple lets you move from one point to the next across the level.

street-food-cooking-game.intro: Street Food - Cooking Game puts you in charge of a food truck, where you craft street snacks like hot dogs and nachos. Your aim is to keep a busy kitchen running and customers happy.
tips: Read each order carefully before you start cooking so you make the snack the customer actually wants.
Experiment with the creative toppings to see which combinations look good and keep customers satisfied.
Focus on presentation as well as flavor, since the game puts emphasis on visually appealing snacks.
Keep your workflow steady during busy periods so no customer has to wait too long and your kitchen stays on track.
Treat the chef-level challenges as practice for the basics, and go back to simpler snacks if a harder one starts to slow you down.
faq: What is the main goal of Street Food - Cooking Game?
The goal is to run a food truck kitchen by crafting tasty, good-looking street snacks and keeping customers satisfied.
Which snacks can I make in the game?
The description mentions hot dogs and nachos as examples of the street snacks you prepare, along with other creative snack options.

nullify-merge-math.intro: Nullify is a relaxing merge puzzle where you clear the screen by combining numbers and math symbols. Drag pieces together to work through handcrafted levels or endless generated ones.
tips: Look at the whole board before you move anything, so you can spot which pairs of numbers and symbols can merge into something useful.
Plan two or three merges ahead rather than reacting to each one, since a merge can create a piece that makes the next step easier or harder.
Keep the board tidy by clearing out pieces that are close to each other first, which helps you see what remains.
If you get stuck on a handcrafted level, step back and try a different merge order instead of repeating the same moves.
Use the infinite modes to practice once you have finished the main levels, since generated boards let you sharpen quick number sense.
faq: What is the goal of Nullify?
The goal is to clear everything from the screen by merging numbers and math symbols together. A level is complete when no pieces are left.
How do I move and merge pieces?
Click and drag a symbol or number to move it, then drop it onto another piece to merge them. The controls are simple and use only dragging.

coin-hunt.intro: Coin Hunt is a car game where you drive through shifting landscapes, collect hidden coins, and use power-ups to speed up. Customize your car and climb the global leaderboards.
tips: Scan each course for secret paths before you commit to the main route, since treasure is often tucked away off the obvious line.
Use ramps with care. Judge your approach speed so you land cleanly and keep your momentum instead of losing control.
Save power-ups for stretches where a speed boost helps most, such as long straights or sections where you can grab several coins in a row.
Plan your route around the coins rather than chasing them at the last second, which often causes wide turns and lost time.
Try different car customizations to find one whose handling suits your driving style, then stick with it while you learn the courses.
faq: What is the main goal of Coin Hunt?
Collect the hidden treasures on each course while racing through the landscape. Your results also count toward the global leaderboards.
How do power-ups help me?
Power-ups boost your speed, which can help you reach more coins and move faster through the course. Use them strategically rather than the moment you get them.

gt-formula-championship.intro: GT Formula Championship is a high-speed Formula racing game for one player. You drive powerful open-wheel cars against elite racers on world-class tracks, with realistic physics and detailed track surfaces.
tips: Use the arrow keys smoothly rather than making sudden jerky inputs, since the realistic physics can punish abrupt steering.
Ease off before corners and accelerate out of them, keeping the car stable as you rotate through the turn.
Pay attention to the track surface, because grip changes can affect how the car responds to your inputs.
If you start to drift, make small steering corrections instead of overcorrecting, which often causes a spin.
Learn each track by running a few laps at a comfortable pace before pushing for speed against the other racers.
faq: How do I control the car?
Use the arrow keys to move the car. Smooth, gradual inputs usually give you better control than sudden changes.
Is this a single-player game?
Yes, it is tagged for one player, so you race against the computer-controlled elite racers on your own.

my-gym-manager-idle-tycoon.intro: Run your own gym by checking in members, assigning them to workout zones, and collecting cash as they finish. Keep the floor clean and invest your earnings to grow the business.
tips: Collect cash piles regularly, since they build up as members finish their workouts and you want to avoid a backlog.
Watch for angry emoji faces above members and send them to a free station quickly, because impatient gym-goers wait less willingly the longer they stand.
Sweep up trash as soon as you see it, since sweaty workouts leave litter that lowers gym hygiene.
Hire personal trainers early to repair broken machines and refill locker room supplies so your workouts keep running while you focus elsewhere.
Spend earnings on upgrades that speed up workout times or increase locker room capacity, since faster sessions bring in cash more quickly.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Your goal is to grow your gym by welcoming members, keeping them on the floor, collecting their payments, and expanding into new rooms and equipment areas.
How do I get more money?
Members pay you when they finish their training sessions, and the cash appears in piles you can walk over to collect. Happy members pay extra, and VIP members pay the most.

battleships-pirates.intro: Battleships Pirates is a turn-based guessing game on a grid. Hide your ships, call out targets, and be the first to sink all of your opponent's ships.
tips: Place your ships in spread-out positions rather than clustered together, so one lucky shot is less likely to reveal several at once.
Try the random placement option if you want a quick setup, but compare its layout with your own logic when you have time to think.
After a hit, check the cells next to it before guessing elsewhere, since a ship usually extends in a straight line.
Keep a mental or written record of misses so you do not repeat guesses and can narrow down where the remaining ships could be.
Use the grid pattern as a guide: systematic sweeps across rows or columns can find ships more reliably than random guesses.
faq: What is the goal of Battleships Pirates?
The goal is to be the first player to sink all of the opposing player's ships. Each turn you guess a grid position to try to find them.
How do I make a move?
On desktop, click to select a grid cell and apply your choice. On touch screens, tap the cell to select and apply it.

froggy-tower.intro: Froggy Tower is a pixel art stacking game where you time your leaps to keep your frog climbing higher. Precision and rhythm matter as the tower grows endlessly skyward.
tips: Watch the rhythm of the extending blocks before you leap, since a steady pattern makes the timing easier to read.
Focus on landing near the center of each block, because a precise landing gives your stack the most room to keep growing.
Pick up coins when they are safely within reach, since the game says they boost your survival.
Stay calm and avoid rushing a jump after a missed timing, as the game rewards patience and a steady rhythm.
Practice a few short climbs to learn how the blocks move before you try for a longer run.
faq: What is the goal of Froggy Tower?
Leap and stack blocks to keep your frog hopping higher in an endless climb up the tower.
How do I stay alive longer?
Collect coins, which the game describes as a way to boost your survival, and keep your timing accurate with each leap.

draw-and-escape.intro: Draw And Escape is a puzzle game where you draw lines to help a yellow car reach the finish line. It mixes drawing puzzles with parking-style challenges, and you play with mouse clicks or taps.
tips: Look at the whole area before you start drawing so you can spot the route the yellow car needs.
Plan your line on paper in your head first, since a poorly placed line can block the car's path.
Keep your lines simple and direct where possible, as a shorter line leaves less room for mistakes.
If a puzzle isn't working, try a different angle or shape rather than repeating the same line.
Pay attention to how the car moves once the line is drawn, so you can adjust your next attempt.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Your goal is to draw a line across the defined area so the yellow car can reach the finish line.
How do I control the drawing?
Use mouse clicks or taps to draw your line and play each puzzle.

cube-drop-puzzle.intro: Cube Drop Puzzle is a logic game where you drag furniture-shaped blocks and holes around the board so each piece lands in the matching color spot. Each level gets harder as the space gets tighter.
tips: Before you move anything, look at the whole board and find which color hole is hardest to reach. Plan the route for that piece first.
Check whether a move will block another piece's path before you make it. Blocking a route is the most common way to get stuck.
Make small test moves and watch how the pieces settle. This shows you how the drop behaves before you commit to a longer sequence.
Work through the level one step at a time instead of trying to solve it all at once. Finish the easiest matches first to clear space for the rest.
If a level stops making progress, step back and rethink the order of your moves. Sometimes undoing a placement opens a better path.
faq: What is the main goal of Cube Drop Puzzle?
The goal is to match each cube to its correct color block hole. You finish the level once every piece has dropped into the right place.
How do I move pieces?
You drag and drop the blocks and holes across the board. The controls are meant to be simple, so most of the challenge comes from planning the order of your moves.

impossible-car-stunt-mega-ramp-3d.intro: Impossible Car Stunt Mega Ramp 3D is a racing game set on sky roads with zigzag ramps, where you drive, drift, and jump your car across tall, narrow tracks. Keyboard controls are used throughout.
tips: Check your landing before you commit to a jump, since the tracks are built on high ramps and a bad landing can end your run.
Ease off the speed before tight zigzag turns so the car stays on the track instead of sliding off the edge.
Practice drifts on the wider parts of the track first, then use them to keep your speed through corners.
Try to keep the car steady in the air when you attempt a mid-air flip, so you come down facing the right way.
Pay attention to the rival racers so you can judge when to push your speed and when to play it safe.
faq: What is the goal of Impossible Car Stunt Mega Ramp 3D?
The goal is to drive across the sky road tracks, perform stunts on the ramps, and beat the rival racers. Staying on the track while you jump and drift is a key part of doing well.
How do I control the car?
The game uses keyboard control. Use the keys listed in the game's instructions to steer, accelerate, and brake.

wizard-santa-jump.intro: Wizard Santa Jump is an arcade game where you guide Wizard Santa through dangerous holiday levels. Time your leaps carefully and race the clock to finish each stage.
tips: Watch the obstacles for a moment before you jump so you can judge the gap and the landing spot.
Use momentum to carry you further, since the game rewards keeping your movement flowing rather than stopping on every platform.
Keep an eye on the timer and pace yourself, so you do not rush into a risky jump with little time left.
If you fall, try the same section again and focus on one small change, such as jumping a fraction earlier or later.
Be patient with the early levels, because learning the jump timing there will make the harder stages much easier.
faq: What is the goal of Wizard Santa Jump?
Your goal is to complete each stage by navigating past deadly obstacles before time runs out.
What are the controls?
The game does not list specific controls, so try a jump and see how Wizard Santa responds before attempting tougher sections.

super-shark-world.intro: Super Shark World is an underwater action game where you steer a shark through a submarine full of obstacles. You can play 15 levels or try endless mode, and fight three boss characters.
tips: Use the dash (L) to get past obstacles quickly when you are caught in a tight spot, rather than trying to steer around them slowly.
Combine shooting (K) with movement so you can clear threats ahead while you keep moving through the level.
Pay attention to the layout of each area before you commit to a direction, since the submarine is full of obstacles.
Learn how each boss moves and attacks before you focus on destroying it, so you can avoid damage while you shoot.
Try endless mode after you are comfortable with the levels to practice your movement and timing without a fixed end point.
faq: How do I move the shark?
Use W, A, S, D or the arrow keys to move in any direction through the submarine.
What do the shoot and dash buttons do?
Press K to shoot and L to dash. Dash is useful for quick bursts of movement when you need to get out of danger fast.

good-and-evil-dressup.intro: Good and Evil DressUp is a fashion game where you style a sorceress at a magical academy. You mix good and evil looks using items like shiny leather and elegant satin, then save your result as a PNG image.
tips: Try pairing a bright, light-toned outfit with a darker accessory to see how the good and evil themes blend.
Compare materials such as shiny leather and elegant satin side by side, since the game highlights these fabric styles.
Change one piece at a time so you can tell which item makes the biggest difference to the overall look.
Check the full outfit from different angles before saving, so the final image shows the style you want.
Save your favourite combinations as PNG images so you can compare them later and keep track of ideas you like.
faq: What is the goal of Good and Evil DressUp?
The goal is to create striking outfits for a sorceress that blend good and evil styles. There is no score, so success is about the look you create.
How do I control the game?
On a computer, click with the mouse. On a touchscreen, tap with your finger to select and change items.

yummy-cupcake.intro: Yummy Cupcake is a puzzle game about baking, decorating, and serving cupcakes to customers. Your goal is to keep customers happy with what you create.
tips: Work through the steps in order: bake first, then decorate, then serve. Each stage builds on the one before it.
Try a few different toppings and cup colors to see which combinations look best together.
Before serving, look at what the customer is likely to want and make a cupcake that suits them.
Experiment with your decorating choices instead of repeating the same design, since the game offers many toppings and cups to try.
Pay attention to how customers react after each serving, and use that feedback to guide your next creations.
faq: What is the main goal of Yummy Cupcake?
The goal is to bake, decorate, and serve cupcakes so that your customers become happy with what you make.
How do I earn points or progress in the game?
The game description focuses on earning customers' happiness through the cupcakes you serve, so progress comes from making creations they enjoy.

apocalypse-rush.intro: Apocalypse Rush is a fast-paced survival shooter where you defend your trailer from endless waves of enemies. It supports two players and gets harder the longer you last.
tips: Pick up coins whenever it is safe, since they are used for upgrades that can make the rest of your run easier.
Save your special attack for moments when enemies are crowding the trailer, rather than spending it on the first wave.
Keep moving rather than standing still, so you can keep shooting at incoming enemies from more than one direction.
In two-player mode, split the work: one player can focus on clearing enemies while the other watches for threats near the trailer.
Expect the difficulty to climb over time, so use the calmer moments between attacks to check your position and plan your next move.
faq: What is the goal of Apocalypse Rush?
Your goal is to defend your trailer against endless waves of enemies and survive as long as possible. The longer you last, the harder the game becomes.
What are the controls for Player 1 and Player 2?
Player 1 moves with the arrow keys, shoots with K, and uses a special attack with L. Player 2 moves with W, A, S, and D, shoots with C, and uses a special attack with V.

siren-head-3-game.intro: Siren Head 3 Game is a 3D horror shooter where you and a companion use an ax and other items you find to fight a creature with a siren head. Read the controls before you enter the woods.
tips: Learn the weapon switch with the Mouse Wheel and keep your ax ready for close encounters, since you can switch to other items when you need them.
Use Right Mouse Button to aim before firing with Left Mouse Button so your shots are more accurate.
Press F to interact with things you find, and check your surroundings for items that could help you fight back.
Save G for grenades and use Left CTRL to crouch or X to go prone when you need to stay low and out of sight.
Reload with R during a quiet moment rather than in the middle of a fight, so you are not caught with an empty weapon.
faq: What is the goal of Siren Head 3 Game?
You and a companion must use an ax and anything else you can find to defeat a creature with a siren head.
How do I change weapons?
Scroll the Mouse Wheel to switch between your weapons.

block-puzzle-king.intro: Block Puzzle King is a block elimination puzzle where you drag pieces onto the board to fill gaps and clear lines. Clear every block on the board to pass each level.
tips: Look at all the pieces at the bottom before you move, so you can plan which shape fits where.
Try to fill gaps in a way that completes a horizontal or vertical line, since completed lines are what clear blocks.
Avoid leaving isolated single holes on the board, because they make it harder to fit larger pieces later.
Work from the middle of the board outward to keep space open for awkward shapes.
If a level gets difficult, pause and check which blocks remain so you can focus on the last few gaps needed to clear the board.
faq: How do I play Block Puzzle King?
Drag the blocks from the bottom of the screen onto the board to fill the gaps. Complete a horizontal or vertical line to clear those blocks.
What do I need to do to pass a level?
You need to clear all of the blocks on the board to pass the level.

obby-escape-from-lava-and-survive.intro: Obby: Escape from Lava and Survive is a run-and-jump game where you chase animals along a path while staying ahead of rising lava. Rebirths and upgrades help you go further each run.
tips: Keep moving forward rather than stopping to collect targets, since the lava keeps rising and standing still lets it catch up.
Watch the lava level as you go and plan your route so you always have a clear escape path ahead.
Practise your jumps early on, because your jump height is part of what helps you get past obstacles and reach targets.
Spend your earnings on upgrading your brainrots when you can, as this is the main way to build up money faster.
Consider rebirthing once you are comfortable with the basics, since each rebirth makes your character stronger, faster and more resilient for the runs that follow.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You run along the path, catch animals as you go, and stay ahead of the rising lava. Every second you survive helps you keep moving forward.
How do I control my character on PC?
Use the WASD keys to move, hold the right mouse button to rotate the view, and use the mouse wheel to zoom the camera in and out.

pirates-tiles-challenge.intro: Clear treasure-filled pirate boards by matching identical icons with paths of at most 3 straight lines. Each level is cleared by finding every pair before the board stands in your way.
tips: Before clicking, scan the whole board for icons that have a clear route to their twin, especially along the edges where paths are often open.
Start with tiles that sit on the outside of the grid, since clearing them opens up routes for the tiles inside.
Count the turns in a path before committing: if it needs more than 3 straight lines, look for a different partner for that icon.
Use the lightbulb hint when you are stuck, but first check the rows and columns near the blocked tiles, because the path you need is often one tile away.
Watch how the board changes after each match, and keep a mental note of which icon types are running low so you do not leave a single unmatched tile.
faq: What is the goal of Pirates Tiles Challenge?
The goal is to match every pair of identical pirate icons on the board. Once all tiles are cleared, the level is complete.
How do I connect two matching tiles?
Click or tap the first tile, then click or tap its identical partner. The game links them automatically if a valid path with at most 3 straight lines exists.

sword-hunter.intro: Sword Hunter is a 2D beat-em-up arcade game where you control a sword girl who fights off incoming enemies. Click or tap to play.
tips: Watch the enemies as they approach and time your attacks for when they are in range, rather than swinging at empty space.
Keep an eye on your own position so you are not caught by several enemies at the same time.
Learn how each enemy moves before committing to a close fight, since some attacks are easier to avoid when you see them coming.
Take short breaks between waves to reset your focus, especially if the enemies start arriving faster.
Practice with the click or tap controls early on so your timing feels natural before the pace picks up.
faq: What is the goal of Sword Hunter?
Your character upholds justice by eliminating the incoming enemies. Stay in the fight as long as you can while defeating them.
How do I control the sword girl?
Use mouse clicks or taps to play. The game is controlled entirely with these inputs.

noob-s-great-escape.intro: Noob's Great Escape is a platformer with 100 designed levels. You guide Noob to freedom by solving puzzles, reacting quickly, and handling unexpected twists.
tips: Before you move, look at the whole level and find the exit or the goal. Knowing where you are headed makes the puzzles easier to read.
When a level feels stuck, pause and check what has changed compared with earlier attempts. Twists often hide the key to the next step.
Try a few different approaches to a puzzle instead of repeating the same move. Many levels reward trying something new.
Keep your reflexes sharp during the tricky sections. Slow, steady timing usually works better than rushing through a hazard.
Expect surprises in later levels and stay alert even after an easy stretch. Staying calm helps you spot the unusual solution.
faq: What is the main goal of Noob's Great Escape?
Your goal is to guide Noob to freedom by getting through each of the 100 levels. Each level is a puzzle with its own challenges.
What skills matter most in this game?
Both wits and reflexes matter. Puzzles test your thinking, while the trickier moments test how quickly you can react.

monster-versus-human.intro: Monster Versus Human is a shadowy arcade battle where you pick a side: human survivors with flashlights and firearms, or monsters hunting in the dark. Movement uses WASD or the arrow keys.
tips: Pick a side first and learn its strengths: humans rely on flashlights and firearms, while monsters see well in the dark.
As a human, keep your flashlight in mind and use its light to spot threats before they reach you.
As a monster, stay in the shadows and hunt prey carefully so you can collect the power-boosting vials.
Use the power boosts from collected vials to press your advantage when the other team is weakened.
Move steadily with WASD or the arrow keys rather than rushing, since the battle rewards careful positioning and patience.
faq: What is the goal of Monster Versus Human?
The goal is to eradicate the opposing team. You win by defeating everyone on the other side.
How do I move my character?
Use the WASD keys or the arrow keys to move.

gt-ghost-racing.intro: GT Ghost Racing pits vintage and futuristic cars against legendary specters on changing tracks. Win races by mastering curves and surfaces while collecting stars along the way.
tips: Study each track's curves before you commit to speed, since the description highlights mastering every curve as a key skill.
Pay attention to the surface you are driving on and adjust your pace when it changes.
Use each race to learn the layout of a track, then apply that knowledge the next time you race on it.
Plan your line so you can reach stars without losing too much ground in a tense race.
Try different tracks across the various landscapes and seasons to find the ones where your driving feels strongest.
faq: What is the main goal of GT Ghost Racing?
You race against legendary specters on dynamic tracks and collect stars to secure your place as a racing champion.
How do stars factor into racing?
Collecting stars is part of how you progress through the game, so keep an eye out for them as you race.

cube-sort.intro: Cube Sort is a 3D tap-and-sort puzzle where you clear floating tile sculptures by matching tiles to open buckets. Plan your taps carefully so the tray never fills up.
tips: Rotate and zoom the sculpture before tapping anything, so you can see tiles on every side and spot which ones are hidden underneath.
Look for tiles that match the open bucket first, since they fly in right away and free up tray space.
Be careful with the order you clear tiles in, because a tile you tap early can open up a path to others or block one you need later.
Clear the tiles next to a "?" tile to reveal its pattern before you decide what to do with it.
Gray riveted tiles cannot be removed, so work around them by clearing the tiles that surround them first.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Fill every bucket to clear the level. When one bucket is full, the next one opens and matching tray tiles fly in automatically.
What happens if the tray fills up?
The level fails when the tray is full. Tiles that do not match an open bucket wait in the tray, so keep the tray clear by tapping only tiles you can place.

bounce-dunk-basketball.intro: Bounce Dunk Basketball is an arcade game where you control a bouncing ball and tap to set its angle and strength. Your aim is to bounce the ball cleanly into the basket and build a high score.
tips: Focus on the angle before the strength, since the direction of the bounce decides whether the ball has a chance of reaching the basket.
Make small taps to test how strong a bounce is, then adjust your next tap based on where the ball landed.
Watch the first few bounces closely so you can learn how the ball reacts before you try for a higher-scoring shot.
Keep your attention on the basket and the ball's path, and avoid rushing your taps when a shot looks close.
If enemies or coins appear on screen, decide whether a detour is worth the risk before you commit to a bounce.
faq: How do I control the ball?
Click or tap the screen to set the angle and strength of the ball's bounce. Each tap decides how the ball moves toward the basket.
What is the main goal of the game?
The goal is to bounce the ball perfectly into the basket and get a high score. Clean, accurate shots are the core of play.

train-artillery-adventure.intro: Train Artillery Adventure is a shooting game where you command an armored artillery train against waves of zombies. You merge weapons, collect resources, and upgrade your train across intense levels.
tips: Check which weapons you can merge before you spend resources, so each upgrade builds toward a setup that works for you.
Use a mix of different guns rather than relying on one, since the game offers diverse weapons for different threats.
Save resources for upgrades that boost firepower where you are struggling, instead of spreading them evenly across everything.
Pay attention to how the zombie hordes approach and focus fire on the groups that pose the biggest threat to your train.
Treat each level as a test of both quick reactions and planning, and adjust your train's setup if a level is proving too hard.
faq: What is the main goal of Train Artillery Adventure?
You command an artillery train and fight back relentless zombie hordes across intense levels. The description focuses on defeating enemies with precise firepower.
How do I make my train stronger?
Collect resources and use them to customize your train and enhance its firepower. You can also merge weapons to create stronger options.

words-story.intro: Words Story is a word adventure where you help a framed man work toward his freedom. Type the correct word to clear each level and move his story forward.
tips: Read each word prompt slowly before typing, since a single wrong letter means the level isn't cleared.
Play in short sessions. With no time limit, stepping away between levels can help you keep your focus on spelling.
Collect tools whenever you can, then think about which upgrades will speed up your progress most.
If you get stuck on a word, try a different approach, such as sounding it out letter by letter, rather than guessing quickly.
Because the 2000 levels never repeat, build your vocabulary as you go by noticing word patterns and common endings.
faq: What is the goal of Words Story?
Your goal is to help the man in the story work toward his freedom by typing the correct word to win each level.
How do I win a level?
Type the correct word for the level. Once it is right, you win that level and move on.

prison-architect-cage-break-tycoon.intro: Prison Architect: Cage Break Tycoon puts you in charge of an empty prison that can't yet hold ordinary prisoners. You build, hire and upgrade your way through several prisons, each lasting about 10 days.
tips: Fortify before the first escape. Prisoners get out at the end of each day, so spend your early resources on doors and cameras rather than extras.
Hire guards early, then keep them stocked. Personnel help you stop escapes, so add them as your prison grows instead of waiting until a day gets hard.
Spread your upgrades between your overseer and your prison. Making the chief overseer faster or stronger helps you chase prisoners, while better doors and cameras reduce how many get out.
Prepare for Bosses before they appear. Bosses are described as especially dangerous, so have your overseer's weapons and your security in good shape before a new day brings one in.
Walk to each activity to interact with it. Your character must stand on a building or upgrade spot to use it, so plan routes that let you upgrade quickly between escape attempts.
faq: How do I move my character?
On PC, use WASD or the arrow keys, or hold the left mouse button and drag in the direction you want. On mobile, press and drag your finger on the screen.
Do I have to aim my shots?
No. The hero shoots automatically, so your focus can stay on moving and positioning.

hungry-cats.intro: Hungry Cats is a casual puzzle game where you guide a group of cats through small worlds to their food. You control every cat at once, so each move and rotation affects them all.
tips: Before each move, check where every cat will end up, since they all move together. A move that helps one cat can leave another stuck.
Use the rotate controls to change the whole level when a cat is blocked. Rotating can line up a path that moving alone cannot.
Plan a few moves ahead instead of testing at random. Working out the route for all cats first saves you from repeated resets.
Get each cat to its snack safely before you focus on the rest. Keeping the group together can make the last steps easier.
On mobile, use the Down icon to interact with items when a cat needs them to reach its food.
faq: What is the goal of Hungry Cats?
Guide all the cats through each tiny world until every one of them reaches its food. The cats should get there before they curl up for a nap.
How do I rotate the level?
On desktop, press Q to rotate the platform left and E to rotate it right. On mobile, use the Rotate Left and Rotate Right icons.

i-want-ice-cream.intro: I Want Ice Cream is a puzzle platformer where you guide a penguin through the icy landscape of Antarctica. Dodge obstacles and search for the hidden ice cream treats.
tips: Take a moment to scan the whole screen before you move, so you can spot where the ice cream might be hidden.
Move the penguin in short steps at first, and watch how obstacles travel or repeat before you commit to a path.
Plan your route backwards from the ice cream when you can, which helps you see which paths are blocked.
If you get stuck, try a different route rather than repeating the same move, since the layout often offers more than one way forward.
Keep your pace steady; rushing into obstacles is the most common way to lose progress.
faq: What is the goal of I Want Ice Cream?
You control a penguin and need to get it to the ice cream while dodging obstacles in the icy landscape.
Which keys control the penguin?
Use the arrow keys to move the penguin around the screen.

red-light-green-light-io.intro: Red Light Green Light.io is a multiplayer action race inspired by the Squid Game game. You compete with players from around the world to finish first, moving on green light and stopping on red.
tips: Move in short bursts rather than holding a key down, so you can stop quickly when the light changes.
Watch the signal closely before each move and react to it right away instead of guessing when it will change.
Keep your progress steady. Racing ahead and then being caught stopped costs more time than a slower, controlled pace.
Use the control you find most comfortable, whether that is WASD, the arrow keys, or the mouse or touchpad, and stick with it so your reactions stay consistent.
Pay attention to other players' positions so you know when to push harder and when to hold back to stay accurate.
faq: What is the goal of Red Light Green Light.io?
The goal is to complete the course before the other players who are playing at the same time. You need to be both fast and careful to finish first.
What do I do on red light and green light?
When the signal says red light, you must stop. When it says green light, you must take action and move forward.

world-cricket-champ.intro: World Cricket Champ is a sports game where you lead your nation through cricket matches. It mixes strategic management with fast reflexes as you compete on the world stage.
tips: Think about the match situation before each action, since the game rewards clever tactics over rushed moves.
Balance your quick reflexes with planning so that fast decisions still fit your overall strategy.
Pay attention to how each match is developing and adjust your approach when the pace changes.
Keep track of what worked in earlier matches and repeat those habits when the challenge looks similar.
Take a short moment to reset between challenges so you stay focused during the faster stretches.
faq: What is the main goal of World Cricket Champ?
The goal is to lead your nation and secure international cricket glory by competing globally. Success depends on both strategic management and quick reflexes.
What controls does the game use?
The game's description does not list specific controls, so follow the on-screen prompts and instructions as you play.

mouth-shift-3d.intro: Mouth Shift 3D is a hypercasual arcade game where you customize a hungry mouth, travel through colorful 3D worlds, and gobble up food while avoiding obstacles. Steer with simple slide controls.
tips: Keep your eyes a little ahead of your mouth so you can line up with food and spot obstacles before you reach them.
Make small, steady slides rather than sudden large movements, which makes it easier to stay clear of hazards.
Watch for patterns in how the challenge changes, since the game keeps shifting, and adjust your focus when new obstacles appear.
Prioritize the foods that keep your run going and avoid detours that take you into danger.
Take short breaks between sessions so you can come back with fresh reactions, especially when the challenge speeds up.
faq: What is the goal of Mouth Shift 3D?
You gobble various foods while dodging obstacles across colorful 3D worlds, and the game asks how much you can devour.
How do you control the mouth?
You move it with simple slide controls, so the main skill is sliding to line up with food and avoid obstacles.

fire-hose.intro: Fire Hose is a firefighting game where you aim and spray water to put out every fire before your water runs out. Each level adds more flames and trickier layouts, so every drop counts.
tips: Aim before you spray. Line up the hose on the base of a flame first, then click or press the button, so you do not waste water on empty space.
Keep moving between fires instead of holding the spray in one spot. Short bursts on each fire help you cover the whole screen.
Check how many fires remain before you start a new spray. Finishing the last few quickly keeps your water from running low.
If you use the desktop version, press Q to toggle mouse lock so your aim stays steady while you focus on the flames.
Spend your upgrades on water deposits when you can. A bigger supply lets you spray longer on the harder stages.
faq: What is the goal of Fire Hose?
Put out as many fires on the screen as you can before your water runs out. Each level adds more flames and trickier layouts.
How do I move and spray on desktop?
Use the mouse to aim and click to release the water. Press Q to toggle mouse lock if you want to control the aim more steadily.

secret-parkour.intro: Secret Parkour is an obby-style platformer where you climb a tower by jumping across platforms and avoiding lava. Regions get harder as you go, and hidden areas reward careful exploration.
tips: Watch the lava and the gaps before you jump, and check where you will land so you do not fall back down the tower.
Use the F dash to cover wide gaps, but pause for a moment first so you can aim the dash in a straight line.
Keep an eye out for hidden shortcuts and secret platforms, especially near the edges of the tower, since they can save a lot of climbing time.
In the City Skyscrapers area, time your moves around the rotating obstacles and move in short steps rather than rushing through.
Use the TAB key to pause and reset your focus when a section feels frustrating, then return to it with a clear plan.
faq: What is the goal of Secret Parkour?
The goal is to get to the end by jumping, running, and climbing through each region of the tower.
What do the controls do?
Use WASD to move and the Space bar to jump. F dashes, Shift switches cursor, TAB pauses, and the mouse wheel zooms in and out.

moon-clash-heroes.intro: Moon Clash Heroes is a multiplayer shooter set in an abandoned lunar base. You can play as a spy, a Terminator, a special forces soldier, or a strike bot, and fight rivals across the base and deep space views.
tips: Try each role before settling on one, since the spy, Terminator, soldier and strike bot all fight in very different ways.
Use C to crouch and keep your profile low when you approach a rival, especially if you are playing the spy.
Press RMB to aim before you fire so your shots land more reliably at range.
Save your G grenades for groups of enemies or for rivals hiding in corners of the base you cannot reach directly.
Tap TAB often to check the score table and see where your rivals are gathering.
faq: What is the goal of Moon Clash Heroes?
The goal is to defeat your rivals in the space squad while you explore the abandoned lunar base. The description focuses on combat against other players.
Which controls do I need to know first?
Use WASD to move, SPACE to jump, C to crouch, RMB to aim, G to throw a grenade, and TAB to view the score table.

kids-good-habits.intro: Kids Good Habits is an educational game with four short mini-games about everyday habits. You help a panda brush its teeth and take a bath, feed a puppy, and judge whether a lamb's and giraffe's behavior is correct.
tips: Work through all four parts, since each one teaches a different everyday habit. Trying every mini-game gives you a fuller picture of the habits the game covers.
Think about why each action matters while you play, such as why teeth need brushing or why a pet needs feeding. Connecting the action to a real routine makes the habit easier to remember.
Take your time with the judging part. Look closely at what the lamb and giraffe are doing before you decide whether their behavior is correct.
Use simple, deliberate clicks or taps so you do not rush past the details in each scene. The game rewards careful interaction with its animations.
Pay attention to the animations after each action. They show how the characters respond, which helps you see whether you did the right thing.
faq: What is the goal of Kids Good Habits?
The goal is to help the panda, the puppy, and the lamb and giraffe through small activities that teach good habits. Each of the four parts focuses on a different daily routine.
How do I control the game?
You play with a mouse click or by tapping the screen. Click or tap on the objects and characters in each scene to take action.

extreme-formula-racing.intro: Extreme Formula Racing is a fast-paced 3D arcade racer where you drive a formula car, overtake rival racers and try to beat your best score. Each run gets you faster and helps you earn coins for new cars.
tips: Ease off the throttle and brake early before tight sections, since precision matters as much as speed.
Watch the rival cars around you and look for safe gaps to overtake rather than forcing your way through traffic.
Keep your steering smooth. Small, steady inputs usually keep the car more stable at high speed than sharp corrections.
Pay attention to obstacles on the track so you have time to steer around them without losing much speed.
Explore the different maps and environments, then return to the ones you know well to push your best score higher.
faq: What is the main goal of Extreme Formula Racing?
Drive as fast as possible, overtake rival racers and beat your own high score. You can also explore the environments and unlock new formula cars.
How do I control the car?
Use the arrow keys or WASD to accelerate, brake and steer. Steering and braking are the main skills to practise early on.

21-rush-ultimate-card-game.intro: 21 Rush is a fast card game that mixes Blackjack totals with Solitaire-style planning. You play cards into four lanes, aiming to build stacks that add up to exactly 21 while avoiding busts.
tips: Before each move, check which lanes are close to 21 and which are near going over. Choose the lane that keeps you safest.
Use the TRASH button when the next card would push a critical lane over 21. Skipping a dangerous card is often better than busting a lane.
Keep an eye on your bust count. Three busts end the game, so protect your lanes when you have only a few busts left.
Plan for combos and streak bonuses by thinking one or two cards ahead, not just about the current card.
Watch the clock as you go. Finishing the deck before time runs out earns a time bonus, so steady decisions usually beat slow ones.
faq: What is the goal of 21 Rush?
Build card stacks in the lanes that add up to exactly 21 to score points. Avoid going over 21, which busts the lane.
How does the game end?
The game ends when you collect three busts. You can also finish the deck before time runs out to earn a time bonus.

raccoon-retail.intro: Raccoon Retail is a cleaning game where you play a raccoon tidying a busy store. You deal with spills, trash, and mischievous customers while upgrading your gear as the aisles grow.
tips: Deal with spills quickly before they spread into the aisles you have not reached yet.
Collect trash as you go instead of letting it pile up in one corner of the store.
Keep an eye on the customers, since the messiest ones can make your cleaning work harder.
When the aisles expand, look over the bigger space first and plan a route that covers it without doubling back.
Spend upgrades on the gear that fixes the mess you see most often, so your progress feels more useful.
faq: What is the main goal of Raccoon Retail?
You clean a bustling store full of spills and trash while dealing with mischievous customers. The challenge is to out-clean the messy critters around you.
Does the store change as you play?
Yes, the aisles expand as you go, so the area you need to clean gets bigger.

wedding-artist2.intro: Wedding Artist is a click-to-play planning game where you help Jennifer prepare for her wedding in one month. Work through her to-do list and design the look for the bride you choose.
tips: Scan Jennifer's to-do list before you start so you can see which wedding tasks are waiting and plan your order.
Choose the girl whose style you like best, since you will be designing her look throughout the game.
Take your time with each design choice and compare options before committing, so the final result feels like the dream wedding you want.
Use short, steady clicks rather than rushing, which helps you avoid mistakes when placing or selecting items.
Keep the one-month deadline in mind and focus on finishing one task at a time instead of jumping between many unfinished ones.
faq: What is the goal of Wedding Artist?
Your goal is to help Jennifer get ready for her dream wedding by working through her wedding planning tasks. The game is set one month before the ceremony.
How do I control the game?
The game is played with a mouse or by clicking, so you simply click to make your selections and move through each step.

the-matrix-merge.intro: Matrix Merge is a puzzle game where you swipe to combine faces and build larger mega-characters. Each level brings its own challenges and objectives while you work toward high scores.
tips: Look for matching faces that sit next to each other before making a move, so each merge builds toward a bigger character.
Plan a few moves ahead. Clearing a crowded area early can open space for later merges.
Keep an eye on each level's objective and shape your merges around it, rather than only chasing points.
Save your power-ups like the Personality Blender, Bomb, and Double Points for levels or moments where the board gets tight.
Try a level again after a loss to test a different order of merges. The controls are simple, so most of the learning comes from the layout.
faq: How do I control the game?
Use your mouse or touch input to swipe between faces. Swiping combines matching faces into a larger character.
What is the goal of each level?
Each level has its own challenges and objectives. Merge faces to reach the goal and build high scores.

fall-race-season-2.intro: Fall Race: Season 2 is a 3D racing action game for one player. Use the arrow keys to move and the space key to jump as you race through the new season.
tips: Spend your first few runs learning how the arrow keys steer and how far the space key makes you jump before you try to race hard.
Time your jumps rather than pressing space constantly, so you keep your speed and stay in control.
Keep your eyes looking a little ahead of your character so you can react to what is coming instead of what is already under you.
Make small, steady movements with the arrow keys, since sharp over-corrections can throw you off your line.
Replay the game after a fall to notice patterns in where you lose ground, then adjust your timing on the next attempt.
faq: What is the goal of Fall Race: Season 2?
The game is a racing game, so the aim is to get through the course as quickly and smoothly as you can. Focus on staying in the race rather than only on speed.
Which keys do I need to play?
Use the arrow keys to move and the space key to jump. Those are the only controls listed for this game.

farm-nubik-vs-zombies.intro: Nubik is stuck and needs to escape through a portal. Gather resources, upgrade your base, Nubik and his weapons, and use mercenaries to push through zombie-filled zones.
tips: Spend resources on base upgrades early so you have a stable place to build up before taking on bigger threats.
Upgrade Nubik and his weapons together rather than focusing on only one, so your damage keeps pace with the zombies you face.
Use mercenaries to help clear zombies, especially when you are about to open a new zone.
Before entering a bigger zone, make sure your base and weapons are strong enough, since larger zones bring more zombies.
Keep an eye on the leaderboard as a goal to aim for, but play at a relaxed pace since the game is meant to be meditative.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
The main goal is to find the portal and escape. You do this by gathering resources, upgrading, and opening new zones along the way.
Why are bigger zones harder?
The game says the bigger the zone, the more zombies there will be. Upgrade your base and Nubik before moving into larger areas.

crystalia.intro: Crystalia is a block puzzle where you place colored blocks so that three or more of the same color line up. Clear matches, build long chains, and use boosters when space runs short to climb the leaderboard.
tips: Before dropping a block, check which neighboring blocks share its color so you can set up a match of three or more.
Keep open lanes across the board instead of filling every gap, since long chains need room to form.
Save the Bomb for a block surrounded by mixed colors, because it clears that block and all its neighbors at once.
Use the Laser when a single row or column is crowded and you need to free up space quickly.
Use Shuffle when the remaining blocks are awkwardly placed and no good match is available.
faq: How do I make a match?
Place a block so that three or more blocks of the same color touch each other horizontally or vertically. Diagonal blocks do not count.
What does the Laser booster do?
It clears an entire row or column of the board. It is useful when you need to open space quickly.

woods-of-nevia-forest-survival.intro: Woods of Nevia is a survival adventure in the wild. You fight off wolves, chop wood, build shelter, and search for resources and hidden chests while managing hunger and health.
tips: Check your hunger and health regularly, since both affect how long you can keep exploring. Address whichever one is getting low before you head into a fight.
Gather wood early so you have materials ready when you need to build shelter. Having a shelter gives you a safe base to return to.
Keep your axe ready as you explore, because wolves can appear while you are looking for resources. Deal with threats one at a time rather than running into several at once.
Look for hidden chests while you explore, since they can hold resources you need. Note where you have already searched so you do not waste time going back over the same ground.

Pick level-up upgrades that match how you are playing, such as focusing on combat if wolves are your main problem. Growing dangers get harder over time, so plan your upgrades around what you expect to face next.
faq: What is the main goal of Woods of Nevia?
The goal is to battle and survive in the forest while the dangers grow. You do this by fighting wolves, gathering resources, building shelter, and managing hunger and health.
What do the controls look like?
Use the left mouse button to move or interact with the game interface, and use WASD or the arrow keys to move. Hold the right mouse button to rotate the camera.

ancient-aztec-coloring.intro: Ancient Aztec Coloring is a puzzle game where you color eight different pictures as quickly as you can. Your speed and choice of colors affect the score you finish with.
tips: Look over the whole picture before you start so you can plan which areas to fill first.
Work through one color at a time, filling every area that uses it, to avoid switching colors back and forth.
Pick from the 23 available colors deliberately, grouping similar shades so you can move quickly between areas.
Keep an eye on the clock while coloring; speed is what earns a higher score, so avoid stopping to admire small details.
If you want to keep a finished picture, use the save option before moving on.
faq: What is the goal of Ancient Aztec Coloring?
The goal is to color all eight pictures as fast as you can to get a great score at the end of the game.
How many colors can I use?
You have 23 different colors to choose from while you color each picture.

scp-173-foundation-escape.intro: You play as SCP-173 and try to escape the Foundation by moving only when no one is watching you. Stay hidden, read the patrols, and time every dash through the dark corridors.
tips: Watch where the security forces are looking before every step, since you can only move when nobody sees you. Treat each pause as a chance to plan your next move.
Plan your full route before you start moving. Knowing which corridors are dark and where you can stop to hide helps you avoid being caught mid-dash.
Use shadows and cover whenever you are close to a guard's line of sight. Staying in darkness keeps you safer while you wait for the right moment.
Save your dashes for the moments when patrols have turned away. A single bad move starts a chase, so one rushed step can undo a lot of progress.
Spend your upgrades on stealth abilities, since those directly help you stay unseen. Touch controls work by tapping where you want to go, so choose your taps carefully when you are close to danger.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Your goal is to break free from the Foundation's control by moving through dark corridors without being spotted. You must avoid patrols and reach your escape while staying out of sight.
When am I allowed to move?
You can move only when no one is looking at you. If a security guard sees you, you freeze in place until they look away.

nitro-speed-car-racing.intro: Nitro Speed Car Racing is a reaction-based racing game. You stop a moving pointer on a dial at the right moment to earn nitro and push your car toward the finish line.
tips: Watch the pointer's pattern for a few sweeps before you try to stop it, so you can predict where it will be.
Focus on the center of the dial and keep your eyes steady instead of following the pointer with your whole head.
Use one consistent input, either a mouse click or a tap, and press it with the same light motion every time to keep your timing stable.
Spend your collected coins on upgrades to your engine and nitro, since both help your car rush to the finish line.
Take short breaks between runs when your reactions start to slip, because this game is a test of quick reflexes and fatigue hurts timing.
faq: What is the main goal of Nitro Speed Car Racing?
The goal is to stop the pointer on the dial at the right moment to get nitro, which helps your car reach the finish line quickly.
How do I control the car?
You control the game with a mouse click or a tap. Timing your click on the dial is how you collect nitro.

lamborghiniparking3.intro: Park your luxury car in the designated space with precise control. The game offers single, double, and three-player modes, and you must avoid touching anything else.
tips: Ease off the throttle well before you reach the parking space, since slow, controlled approaches are easier to line up than fast ones.
Use the brake early and in short taps rather than holding it, so you can make small corrections without overshooting the space.
Before you move, check where your car sits relative to the marked space and any nearby objects, because touching anything else is a failure.
In multiplayer, learn your own control set first (W, S, A, D for P1; arrow keys and keypad 1 for P2; I, K, J, L for P3) so you don't press the wrong keys under pressure.
Take each turn at a steady pace and reset your attention between attempts, since the game rewards smooth, careful driving over speed.
faq: What is the goal of LamborghiniParking3?
The goal is to park your luxury car in the designated position smoothly. You also need to avoid touching anything else on the way.
How do I control the car in single player?
Use W, S, A and D to move the vehicle, and press the space bar to brake.

noob-vs-pro-drift-tag.intro: Noob vs Pro: Drift Tag is a 3D car game where you pass a bomb to rivals before the timer runs out. Drift, jump, and read the track to stay out of the explosion.
tips: Keep an eye on the timer from the moment you receive the bomb, and plan your pass early rather than waiting until the last second.
Use drifting to take tight corners without losing too much speed, so you can reach an opponent quickly.
Try jumping with E over obstacles or off ramps to cut across the arena and close the distance on a rival.
Watch where other drivers are heading and aim your pass at a car that is not about to be caught in a crowd of others.
Experiment with the different cars to find one whose handling suits your drifting style.
faq: What is the goal of Noob vs Pro: Drift Tag?
The goal is to avoid being caught holding the bomb. You must pass it to another player before the timer runs out, and the last driver still in the race wins.
What happens if I am holding the bomb when the timer runs out?
Your car explodes and you are eliminated from the round.

dye-it-right-color-picker.intro: Dye It Right: Color Picker is a casual puzzle game for kids and the young at heart, where you work through colorful challenges. You play by clicking or tapping with your mouse or touchscreen.
tips: Look closely at each color before you choose, since puzzles like this often depend on telling similar shades apart.
Take your time with each challenge rather than clicking quickly, because a careful look is usually more useful than a fast guess.
If you get stuck, step back and compare the options side by side to see which one fits best.
Keep your clicks or taps deliberate so you do not select the wrong color by accident.
Play in short sessions so you can keep your focus fresh while you work through the challenges.
faq: How do I play Dye It Right: Color Picker?
You play by mouse click or tap. Choose colors in the game to complete each challenge.
Does the game show a score?
The game page does not describe a scoring system, so the best approach is to focus on finishing each challenge accurately.

galaxy-bricks.intro: Galaxy Bricks is a neon-lit brick-breaker arcade game. You move a paddle, break glowing blocks, and use power-ups as each level gets harder.
tips: Keep your paddle positioned under the ball's path before it arrives, since staying in position matters more than rushing to move.
Watch how each level's block layout is arranged so you can spot the patterns early and plan where the ball will go.
Use power-ups strategically rather than grabbing them at random, and save them for levels or moments where they will help most.
Expect the challenge to rise as you progress, so stay relaxed and avoid panic moves when a new level introduces unfamiliar patterns.
Focus on clearing the blocks that are blocking your route to the rest of the layout first, so the ball can keep moving freely.
faq: What is the main goal of Galaxy Bricks?
The goal is to break the glowing blocks by bouncing the ball off your paddle, working through each level as the challenges escalate.
How do power-ups help in Galaxy Bricks?
Power-ups are meant to be used strategically, so they can help you handle tougher blocks and changing patterns when used at the right moment.

highway-of-the-dead.intro: Highway of the Dead is an auto-battler RPG where your survivor fights on his own along a zombie-filled road. Your job is to manage gear, training, and bosses as you push forward.
tips: Decide quickly on each piece of gear that drops. Equip upgrades right away and sell pieces you won't use, since gold is needed for training at the Tavern.
Save gold for Tavern training so your hero keeps pace with the sections you are pushing into rather than spending it all at once.
Keep an eye out for the ability bar. Tapping it when it appears lands a power strike, so try to be ready for it during tough fights.
Think carefully before choosing good or evil when you meet lost souls, because that choice determines which faction bosses you can call.
Use PvP Raid to attack rival shelters for trophies. Trophies unlock new maps with stronger loot, so raiding is a good way to plan your longer-term progress.
faq: How do I equip or sell gear?
Swipe a gear card right to equip it or left to sell it for gold. On desktop, drag the card with the mouse in the same direction.
What is the main goal of the game?
You walk the highway from section to section, building up your survivor with gear and training. Winning trophies in PvP Raid unlocks new maps with stronger loot.

drill-the-snake.intro: Snake Drill is an arcade defense game where you swing a pendulum drill to break giant segmented snakes before their heads reach the surface. Each run plays out differently, so adapt as you go.
tips: Watch the swing before you tap. Wait until the drill is passing over the snake's body rather than firing on instinct, so each strike lands where it counts.
Work through the body from the nearest segment first. Clearing segments in order keeps the threat manageable as the head moves up the tunnel.
Keep an eye on how close the head is to the surface. When it gets near, shift your focus to the head and time your strikes to stop it.
Pick card upgrades with your current weakness in mind. Since the card system changes every run, choose the option that helps you handle the snakes you are facing now.
Stay patient and keep your timing steady. The game rewards precise strikes more than frantic tapping, so one well-timed hit beats several rushed ones.
faq: How do I win a round?
You win by shattering every segment of the snake before its head breaks through to the surface. If the head reaches the top first, the snake gets through.
What controls do I use?
Tap the screen or press the spacebar to launch a drill attack. The game uses this single button for every action.

happy-obby-land.intro: Happy Obby Land is a bright obstacle course made for the youngest players. Move your character carefully and work your way up toward the highest peaks.
tips: Use W, A, S and D in short, steady moves so you can see where your character is heading before each step.
Press SHIFT to toggle mouse lock when you need to aim the camera, then press it again to return to normal control.
Take a moment to look at the path ahead before moving, especially near edges or gaps, so you do not rush into a fall.
Open the settings menu with ESC if you want to check options or adjust things before you continue.
Keep your progress in mind as you climb: slow, careful progress is usually safer than rushing toward the top.
faq: What is the goal of Happy Obby Land?
The goal is to climb through the course and conquer the highest peaks, as described in the game.
How do I move my character?
Use W to move forward, A to move left, S to move backward and D to move right.

asmr-beauty-superstar.intro: ASMR Beauty Superstar is a calm clinic game where you give a superstar skin and foot treatments, then customize her hairstyle and makeup. The focus is on relaxing care and fashion-led styling.
tips: Finish the skin and foot treatments before you start styling, so the look you build is on a fully cared-for base.
Try a few hairstyles before committing to makeup, so you can pick a hair look first and then choose makeup that suits it.
Keep the overall ensemble in mind as you go, aiming for pieces that work together rather than picking each option in isolation.
Take your time with each step. The game is built around a soothing pace, so rushing through treatments will take away from the experience.
Revisit your choices at the end and compare the hair and makeup side by side to check that the final look feels cohesive.
faq: What is the main goal of ASMR Beauty Superstar?
The goal is to care for a superstar in a serene clinic by offering soothing skin and foot treatments, then creating a stunning look with hairstyles and makeup.
What can I customize on the superstar?
You can customize her look using an array of hairstyles and makeup options to build a complete ensemble.

coloring-book-for-kids-game.intro: Coloring Book For Kids is a drawing and painting game for young children, with several modes to try. It is played with a mouse or by tapping the screen.
tips: Start with the color by numbers or paint by numbers modes if your child likes having a guide, since each area shows which color to use.
Try the doodling mode when your child wants to draw freely without following a picture.
Let younger players, such as toddlers, spend time with one coloring book at a time so the choices stay simple and manageable.
Switch between the different coloring books and modes to keep the activity fresh across several play sessions.
Use the drawing and painting tools to experiment with shapes and colors, and talk about what your child made once they finish.
faq: How do I play Coloring Book For Kids Game?
Use a mouse or tap the screen to pick colors and fill in the pictures or draw freely. Choose a mode and a coloring book to begin.
What modes are available in this game?
The game includes paint by numbers, color by numbers, doodling modes, and free coloring books of several types.

rpg-idle-clicker.intro: RPG Idle Clicker is a clicker where you tap monsters to deal damage and earn gold. You can upgrade your swords and recruit heroes who keep fighting for you, even while you are away.
tips: Tap enemies yourself early on, since your clicks are the main source of damage until you have heroes working for you.
Spend gold on sword upgrades to raise your click damage, which speeds up every enemy you face.
Recruit auto-attacking heroes when you can afford them, because they keep dealing damage every second and make your progress steadier.
Check the UI buttons often for new upgrades, heroes, and equipment, since the game offers many options beyond clicking.
When you return after being offline, look at your gold and progress first, then decide which upgrades to buy next.
faq: What is the main goal of RPG Idle Clicker?
Your goal is to slay monsters by tapping them, earning gold, and getting stronger so you can face tougher enemies and bosses.
Do heroes keep working when I am not playing?
Yes, the auto-attacking heroes keep battling monsters even while you are offline.

dunkin-beanz.intro: Dunkin Beanz is a fast-paced basketball game focused on dunking. You move around the court, throw or pass, and can compete against players worldwide.
tips: Learn the movement controls first, since you can use WASD, the arrow keys, or dragging with the left mouse button.
Practice releasing your drag or key at different moments to see how your throws and passes behave before you play a live match.
Stay on the move during fast-paced matches so you keep options open for a dunk or a pass.
Check the leaderboards and achievements to see what goals to aim for as you improve.
Play several matches in a row to get comfortable with the timing, since the game rewards practice in its competitive multiplayer matches.
faq: What is the goal of Dunkin Beanz?
The goal is to score by dunking and to compete against other players, with the aim of climbing the leaderboards and unlocking achievements.
How do I move and shoot?
Use WASD, the arrow keys, or drag with the left mouse button to move. Release the button to throw or pass.

super-war.intro: Super War is a 3D arcade defense game where you build a base and fortify it against waves of enemies. Click or tap to place your defenses and hold your ground.
tips: Build a mix of fortification types rather than repeating one, since different defenses handle different threats better.
Place your strongest defenses where enemies approach most directly so every attack meets resistance.
Spend early resources on defenses that protect your base core before expanding outward.
Watch which direction attacks come from each round and shift your fortifications to cover those gaps.
Keep your clicks deliberate; placing defenses in a rush can leave weak spots that enemies exploit.
faq: What is the goal of Super War?
You build a base and defend it against enemy attacks by placing fortifications that repel every assault. Surviving each attack is the core objective.
How do I control the game?
Use mouse clicks on desktop or taps on touchscreens for all actions. There are no other controls mentioned in the instructions.

tenkyu-ball.intro: TENKYU BALL is a 3D ball-rolling puzzle where you tilt each stage to guide the ball to its goal. Tilting faster means faster rolling, but going too far sends the ball off the edge.
tips: Make small, short swipes rather than large ones, since a little tilt goes a long way once the ball has picked up speed.
Before a turn or a gap, ease the stage back toward level so the ball slows down enough to take the corner cleanly.
Use the stage's straight sections to build a steady rhythm instead of tilting constantly.
When a gap is ahead, reduce speed first so you can line up the ball before it reaches the edge.
If a stage keeps ending in a fall, restart and focus on the one section that caused the failure rather than replaying the whole route.
faq: What is the goal of TENKYU BALL?
Guide the ball across each tilting stage to reach the goal point or exit without it falling off the edge.
How do I control the ball?
Swipe or drag on the screen to tilt the surface. The direction of the tilt decides where the ball rolls.

ladder-master.intro: Ladder Master is an arcade running game where you climb ladders, dodge obstacles and enemies, and collect parts and power-ups to reach new heights. Here are some tips to help you climb higher.
tips: Use the keyboard (A and D, or the arrow keys) or swipes to switch lanes early, so you are not forced into a last-second move near an obstacle.
Keep your eyes on the path ahead rather than your character, so you can spot obstacles and enemies before they reach you.
Grab coins and power-ups when you can do so safely, but do not steer into danger just to collect them.
Focus on reaching the top of each ladder, since that is what advances you to the next level.
Practise the controls on early levels, because difficulty increases over time and smooth movement matters more as you climb.
faq: How do I move my character?
Swipe left or right on the screen, or press A or the left and right arrow keys on your keyboard.
What is the main goal of the game?
Run, collect ladder parts, and climb to the top of the ladder to advance to the next level and eventually reach the moon.

idle-desert-life.intro: Idle Desert Life is a building game about surviving a barren world. You construct rafts, rescue other survivors, and lead your team to explore new lands and rebuild.
tips: Spend your resources on rafts and shipbuilding early, since the game centers on building the vessels you need to move forward.
Keep track of what each resource is used for before spending it, because strategic resource management is a core part of the game.
Rescue fellow survivors when you can, since your team is what lets you explore new lands and keep rebuilding.
Pace your progress by checking back regularly, as an idle game rewards steady growth more than rushing a single goal.
Explore the different cultures you encounter, and plan your next steps around the lands and people that help your civilization grow.
faq: What is the main goal of Idle Desert Life?
The main goal is to survive in the desert, build rafts and ships, rescue survivors, and lead your team to explore new lands and rebuild civilization.
Do I need to manage resources carefully?
Yes, the description highlights strategic resource management as a central part of the game, so spending resources wisely matters.

street-legends.intro: Street Legends is a fast bike racer where you weave through city traffic and dodge vehicles and obstacles to build the highest score. Steering is simple, so the challenge comes from reacting quickly.
tips: Look a few lanes ahead rather than at your bike, so you can start steering before a vehicle is directly in your path.
Make small, quick steering moves instead of big swings, since overcorrecting can push you into traffic.
Pick a lane with open space and stay near it until you see a clear gap to move into.
Keep your taps or key presses light and steady, which helps you respond faster when obstacles appear suddenly.
Stay calm when the pace picks up; if you feel rushed, slow your decisions and focus on one obstacle at a time.
faq: What is the goal of Street Legends?
Your goal is to weave through traffic, dodge vehicles, and get past obstacles to achieve the highest score possible.
How do I steer my bike?
Tap the right side of the screen or press the right arrow key to steer right, and tap the left side or press the left arrow key to steer left.

corner-bakery.intro: Corner Bakery is a cozy merge puzzle about making pastries and drinks for your neighbors. Combine matching items, fill orders, and slowly restore the bakery and the street around it.
tips: Look at the open orders before you merge. Making the items people are asking for earns rewards faster than building items you don't need yet.
Merge early and often so the board doesn't fill up. A crowded board makes it harder to spot matching pairs.
Use the store slots when you have spare items you can't use right away. Clearing space keeps your kitchen producers easy to work with.
Save your coins for the improvements and locations you care about most. Think about which upgrade will help your next few orders before you spend.
Pace your energy. It refills over time, so plan longer merging sessions around it instead of rushing through every chapter at once.
faq: How do I merge two items?
Drag one identical item onto the other, or select an item first and then click or tap its matching partner. Each merge creates the next recipe in the chain.
What do I need to do to earn coins?
Complete your neighbors' orders with the requested items. Each completed order gives you coins and experience.

zombie-parade-defense.intro: Zombie Parade Defense is a tower defense shooter where you protect a building from waves of zombies. You can play alone or with a friend, and you win by surviving 10 waves.
tips: Spend time on upgrades between waves, since the zombies get stronger with each wave and your weapons need to keep up.
Grab Power-ups when they appear, especially when waves get harder, so you are not caught with weak weapons.
Keep an eye on the building at all times, because the goal is to keep zombies away from it rather than simply clearing them.
In 2 Player mode, split the work: one player can focus on defending the building while the other handles shooting and weapon switching.
Use the Switch Gun key often so you always have the weapon that suits the zombies coming at you.
faq: What is the goal of Zombie Parade Defense?
The goal is to keep the zombies away from the building. If you survive a total of 10 waves, you win.
How do the controls work for Player 1 and Player 2?
Player 1 moves with W, A, S, and D, and Player 2 moves with the arrow keys. Weapons and Power-ups are activated with the mouse.

kaido.intro: Kaido is an adventure game where you guide a robot through dangerous terrain, dodging spinning blades and hat-wearing enemies while collecting orange ice cream bars. Eight levels grow harder as you go.
tips: Watch the spinning blades for a few seconds before moving so you can spot the gap in their rhythm.
Practice your double jump on the easier early levels until the timing feels automatic before the harder stages arrive.
Plan each jump before you take off, since precise timing matters more than speed here.
Go for the orange ice cream bars when the path is clear, but do not risk a fall or a hit just to grab one.
If you keep losing at the same spot, slow down and study the enemy movement pattern there before trying again.
faq: What is the goal of Kaido?
Your goal is to guide the robot through eight levels while collecting orange ice cream bars. Avoid spinning blades and enemies along the way.
What makes Kaido difficult?
The levels become more challenging as you progress, and success depends on precise navigation and well-timed jumps. Spinning blades and hat-wearing foes are the main threats.

combat-strike-zombie-survival-multiplaye.intro: Combat Strike is a zombie survival shooter with soldier AI, several multiplayer modes, and 40 offline levels. Move with WASD, aim and shoot with the mouse, and use SHIFT to run.
tips: Use SHIFT to run between cover and objectives, and switch back to walking when you need to aim accurately.
Learn which guns you can unlock by rank, and save XP for the characters you want to buy rather than spreading it thin.
In survival, keep moving rather than standing still, since zombies and soldiers will converge on a stationary player.
Use SPACE to jump over low obstacles and reposition quickly when you are pressed from one side.
Try the 40 offline levels first to learn enemy patterns before you join multiplayer matches against other players.
faq: How do I aim and shoot?
