Move the mouse to look around and aim, then click to shoot. Use the mouse to change your aim as enemies move.
What modes can I play?
The game has five settings, including survival, team deathmatch (TDM), and deathmatch (DM). You can also play with friends or offline across 40 levels.

guard-the-baby.intro: Guard The Baby is a fast-paced hypercasual game where you play as a brave young boy. You gobble fruit while fending off animal attacks and aim for record-breaking scores.
tips: Keep your attention on both the fruit and the incoming animals at once, since the game rewards players who handle both threats together.
Think before each move. The description highlights decision-making, so pause for a moment to judge whether a fruit or a foe is the better priority.
Treat balance as your main goal. Overcommitting to one side of the action can leave you open to attacks.
Practice to sharpen your reflexes. Faster reactions help you respond to animals before they reach you.
Try to beat your own best score each run. Small improvements in timing and choices add up over repeated attempts.
faq: What is the main goal of Guard The Baby?
Gobble up fruits and fend off animal attacks while keeping your balance. The game encourages you to aim for record-breaking scores.
What skills matter most in this game?
Quick reflexes and good decision-making are central to the challenge. Balancing your focus between fruit and foes is key.

sustainable-3.intro: You play as a museum guard who must patrol the galleries, find clues, and identify eco-terrorists before they can sabotage the priceless art. Stay alert and act with care.
tips: Patrol the galleries fully before acting, since clues are spread across the museum and rushing can make you miss them.
Gather evidence before you confront anyone, so you have a clear picture of who is responsible.
Treat each interrogation as a chance to learn more, and pay close attention to what suspects say and how they react.
Strike decisively only once you are confident you have the right culprit, because acting on a wrong guess can leave the real threat free.
Stay calm under pressure, as the game's tense moments reward careful thinking over hasty moves.
faq: What is the main goal of Sustainable 3?
Your goal is to protect the museum's priceless art by finding the eco-terrorists and stopping their sabotage before disaster strikes.
How do I figure out who the culprits are?
Patrol the galleries and uncover clues, then use what you find to narrow down the suspects. Confronting suspects is part of identifying the right person.

liquid-sort.intro: Liquid Sort is a calm puzzle where you pour colorful liquids so that every bottle ends up holding only one color. Each level adds new challenges that test your planning and attention to detail.
tips: Before each pour, check which color sits on top of every bottle, since that is the liquid you will move.
Think two or three moves ahead. A pour that looks helpful now can block a color you need later.
Look for bottles that already hold a single color and avoid mixing new liquid into them.
If you get stuck, stop and look at the whole board again instead of making random pours, because a fresh view often reveals the next step.
There are no time limits, so take your time and focus on one level at a time.
faq: What is the goal of Liquid Sort?
Pour the liquids so that each color is grouped into its matching bottle, and every bottle holds only one color.
Is there a time limit in Liquid Sort?
No. The game has no time limits, so you can play at your own pace and think through each move.

hot-rods-arena-stars.intro: Hot Rods Arena Stars is a car battle game where you drive an armed Hot Rod against many opponents. Collect stars, use your weapons, and outscore your rivals before one mistake turns your car into scrap.
tips: Keep your car moving. Standing still makes you an easy target for rivals with loaded weapons.
Grab stars when you can do it safely, but don't chase them into open fights you can't win.
Trap enemies and then move on instead of chasing them, so they can't strike back while you collect stars.
Put upgrades into armor if you keep taking hits, or into top speed if rivals keep getting to the stars first.
Use the first moments of each new arena to learn its layout and where the stars appear before you take big risks.
faq: How do I win a match?
You win by collecting more stars than your rivals while blowing up enemies and keeping your own car in one piece. The description says the match is about outscoring opponents.
How do I steer my car?
On desktop, use W, A, S, and D to drive. On mobile, use the left stick to move up, down, left, and right.

save-the-stick-draw-line.intro: Save The Stick Draw Line is a puzzle game where you help a stickman character by drawing lines. You can pick between two modes, Save Stickman and Love Story, and test your brain with each one.
tips: Look at the whole screen before you draw anything, so you know what the stickman needs to reach.
Try a simple line first and watch what happens. This shows you how the game responds before you commit to a longer plan.
If you get stuck, pause and think about a different angle or direction instead of repeating the same line.
Try both modes. Save Stickman and Love Story may ask you to think about the same drawing idea in different ways.
Use mouse clicks or taps in short, deliberate steps so you can control where each line goes.
faq: What is the goal of Save The Stick Draw Line?
You help the stickman character by drawing lines to solve each puzzle. The game is designed to test your brain.
How do I play?
Use mouse clicks or taps to draw your lines. Plan each line carefully before you place it.

pets-and-paints-logic-puzzle.intro: Pets and Paints is a logic puzzle where you place animals and colors on a board using clue blocks. Work through hundreds of puzzles across six forest trails at your own pace.
tips: Before dragging a block, check which animal-color pairs are already used so you do not repeat one.
Try a placement, then use undo if a later clue contradicts it, instead of trying to fix the board by hand.
Combine two or more clues that share an animal or a color, since their overlap often reveals the missing details.
Use the arrows to revisit earlier clues when you feel stuck, because a clue you skipped may now narrow things down.
Use the cross tool to clear a single cell when only one piece is wrong, rather than restarting the whole puzzle.
faq: How do I know when a puzzle is solved?
A puzzle is solved when every clue is satisfied and each animal-color pair appears only once on the board.
Is there a time limit?
No. The game has no timer or rush, so you can take as long as you need on each puzzle.

cube-island-3d.intro: Cube Island 3D is a survival and building game where you play as Steve, starting from nothing on an uninhabited island. Your aim is to turn it into a thriving paradise through tasks, construction and exploration.
tips: Check your task list often, since completing tasks is central to how the island develops.
Gather resources early so you have materials ready before you start constructing buildings.
Plan your layout before placing structures, because building and infrastructure work best when they support each other.
Explore the island in stages and keep an eye out for new territories you can discover.
Use swipes or left mouse clicks deliberately and keep a steady pace so you do not waste time on small moves.
faq: What is the main goal of Cube Island 3D?
The goal is to turn a desert island into a prosperous paradise by completing tasks, constructing buildings, collecting resources and discovering new territories.
How do I move around the island?
Use swipe gestures or the left mouse button to interact with the island, as the game's controls are based on these inputs.

99-nights-in-the-forest.intro: 99 Nights In The Forest is a survival horror game where you must last through 99 nights while a monstrous deer hunts you. Your main job is keeping the fire lit, gathering supplies by day, and surviving each harder night.
tips: Gather wood during the day before night falls, since the fire is your only protection from the deer and you cannot rebuild it in the dark.
Check the fire regularly during the night and keep it fed, because it is the only thing that keeps the creature away.
Carry food and useful items with you when you head out, and use F to eat when your health starts to drop.
Crouch with C when you want to move more quietly, and save Shift for short bursts of running when you need to get away.
Pay attention to the sounds around you, since the tense audio is one of the clearest signs that the monster is close.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Your goal is to survive all 99 nights in the forest. Each night gets harder as the temperature drops and the monster becomes more aggressive.
How do I keep the monster away?
Keep the fire burning, since it is the only thing that scares the deer away. Gather wood during the day so you have enough fuel for the night.

funny-rescue-pet.intro: Funny Rescue Pet is a girls game about rescuing two cats, Lica and Purry, from a burning house and a wet accident, then giving them a makeover. You play by clicking or tapping items, tools, and buttons to act on each step.
tips: Start by looking at the whole scene before you act, so you can see what needs rescuing first.
Work through the rescue steps in order, since the cats need help right away before any makeover begins.
Try each tool on the items around you to learn what it does before committing to a choice.
Once the cats are safe, take your time with the makeover options and compare choices before applying them.
If a step does not seem to respond, tap or click the item again and check that the button you need is highlighted.
faq: What is the goal of Funny Rescue Pet?
The goal is to rescue Lica and Purry from the fire and the wet accident, then give them a makeover. Each step is completed by selecting items and tools.
How do I play on a desktop computer?
Use the mouse to click items, tools, and buttons to interact with the scene. Each click applies your choice to the game.

formula-car-racing-games-real.intro: Formula Car Racing Games Real puts you behind the wheel of fast formula cars on demanding tracks. You race against tough competition in both online and offline play.
tips: Treat every lap as practice for precision. Aim for smooth, consistent driving rather than sudden changes in direction.
Pay attention to the track ahead so you can plan each corner before you reach it.
Think about strategy, not just speed. Holding back in the right places can matter as much as pushing hard.
Try offline play first to learn how the cars handle, then take that experience into online races against other drivers.
Start a race, see how the car responds, and adjust your approach on each lap instead of repeating the same mistakes.
faq: What is the goal of Formula Car Racing Games Real?
The goal is to race fast formula cars around intense tracks and finish ahead of your competition. Precision driving and strategy are central to doing well.
Can I play against other people?
Yes. The game can be played both online and offline, so you can race against others or play on your own.

fall-germ.intro: Fall Germ is an arcade skill game where you dodge and remove falling germs before they cause an outbreak. Quick reactions and careful movement help you keep each level under control.
tips: Watch the pattern of the falling germs for a few seconds before you move, so you can plan where you will be next.
Dodge early rather than at the last moment, since rapid reactions work best when you have time to position yourself.
Save power-ups for busy moments when several germs are coming down at once, instead of using them the moment you find them.
Keep an eye on the whole screen, not just the germs closest to the bottom, so a sudden cluster does not catch you off guard.
If you want a high spot on the leaderboard, practice the levels you find hardest until your movements feel consistent.
faq: What is the main goal in Fall Germ?
You need to dodge and eliminate the descending germs while keeping an outbreak from happening. Each level asks you to stay ahead of the falling pattern.
How can I get a higher score?
Focus on clean, quick reactions and smart movement so you do not waste time reacting to germs that are already close. Competing on the leaderboard rewards players who stay steady under pressure.

bounce-ball-timer.intro: Bounce Ball Timer is an arcade game where you guide a bouncing ball to collect three stars while dodging obstacles. Each completed level moves you on to the next challenge.
tips: Plan your route before each bounce by checking where the stars and obstacles are, so you are not reacting too late.
Collect the stars in an order that keeps your ball away from obstacles, rather than chasing the closest star first.
Watch the timing of your bounces closely, since a slightly early or late move can send you into an obstacle.
Keep your movements small and controlled, especially near tight gaps, to avoid overcorrecting.
If you keep losing at the same spot, slow down and replay that part with a fixed plan rather than rushing through it again.
faq: What is the goal of Bounce Ball Timer?
Collect the three stars in each level while avoiding the obstacles, then move on to the next level.
What controls does the game use?
You can play with touch or with the keyboard, so use whichever input you prefer.

criatures-defense.intro: Criatures Defense is a shooting game where you hold off waves of enemy units to protect your fortress. Use your primary gun, let the automatic system help, and call in special weapons from the bottom panel when waves get heavy.
tips: Keep your primary gun firing at the front of each wave, since it is your main source of damage.
Save the weapons on the bottom panel for large or dangerous groups instead of spending them on single enemies.
Watch which enemies are closest to your fortress and prioritise those, because a leak can end the run quickly.
Finish each level with a clear idea of what to upgrade, and spend upgrades on the areas where you struggled most.
Stay calm between waves and check your fortress condition before the next group arrives.
faq: What is the goal of Criatures Defense?
Your goal is to stop the waves of enemy units before they destroy your fortress. Completing levels lets you keep defending and upgrading.
How do I control the game?
Play with the mouse or by touch. Aim and shoot with your primary gun, and tap or click the weapons on the bottom panel to launch a targeted strike.

angry-checkers.intro: Angry Checkers is a twist on classic checkers where you knock enemy pieces off the board. You can play against the AI, a random online opponent, or a friend on the same device.
tips: Start in Single Player to get a feel for how hits and board edges work before you face real people.
Keep an eye on your pieces near the board edge, since they are the easiest to lose.
Look for moves that hit an enemy piece toward the edge while your own pieces stay safely away from it.
Try Multiplayer when you are comfortable, because random opponents play in very different styles.
In Hot Seat, take turns calmly and plan each move before you touch the board so you do not hit by accident.
faq: What is the goal of Angry Checkers?
Your aim is to beat the enemy checkers off the board. The game is built around hitting opposing pieces out of play.
How do I control the game?
The game uses touch or mouse input. Tap or click to select and move your pieces.

slpoing-path.intro: Slpoing Path is a casual puzzle where you draw lines so a ball can roll to the target block. Gravity is always pulling the ball down, so every line you draw needs to guide it along the way.
tips: Look at where the ball starts and where the target block sits before you draw anything. Plan a rough route from the ball to the target first.
Use the pull of gravity to your advantage. Lines that slope downward help the ball gain speed and carry it forward.
Start with simple, short lines and see how the ball reacts. Small test lines make it easier to learn how the ball moves.
If the ball rolls past the target or gets stuck, rethink the angle of your line rather than adding more lines in the same spot.
Keep your lines clean and placed with a single click or tap. Drawing only what you need helps you spot mistakes faster.
faq: What is the goal of Slpoing Path?
The goal is to draw lines that let the ball roll to the target block. Each attempt is about finding a path the ball can follow to reach it.
How do I draw a line?
Use a mouse click or tap to draw your line. The game is played entirely with this one input.

block-match-3d.intro: Block Match 3D asks you to take apart a large cube one block at a time, sending matching icons to the goals at the top. Plan each tap so the storage bar at the bottom does not overflow before the timer ends.
tips: Only blocks with an open face can be tapped, so look at the outside of the cube first and work your way inward.
Before each tap, check which goal chips are showing at the top and prefer blocks that match them.
Keep the storage bar in mind: every non-matching block you take takes up space, so avoid collecting blocks you cannot use yet.
When a goal chip completes, the next category slides in and stored blocks of that category fly over, so keep some of that category in storage if you can.
Save boosters for tough moments: use Hint when you cannot find a match, Shuffle when the icons are hard to reach, and Undo if a tap was a mistake.
faq: What is the main goal of Block Match 3D?
Clear all the categories by sending matching blocks to the goal chips before the timer runs out.
What happens when the storage bar overflows?
You lose the level, so avoid taking blocks that do not match the active goals unless you need them.

pill-soccer.intro: Pill Soccer is a soccer game where you face many opponents or play head to head with a friend in 2 Player mode. This guide covers the controls and some habits that help in matches.
tips: Learn the kick and jump keys for your side before the first match, since timing both affects your shots and your defense.
In 2 Player mode, agree with your friend on who covers the ball near each goal so you do not both chase it at the same time.
Use the left and right movement keys in short bursts to stay in control of the ball rather than running at full speed past it.
Save the Super Bonus key K for a moment when you have a clear chance, instead of pressing it as soon as it is available.
Watch where your opponent is moving before you kick, so you can aim away from the defender and toward open space.
faq: What is the goal of Pill Soccer?

You play soccer matches against the computer opponents or a friend and try to score more goals than your opponent. The description notes that the matches are challenging, so focus on controlling the ball.
What are the controls in 2 Player mode?

Player 1 uses the Up Arrow to jump, the Left and Right Arrows to move, and P or the Down Arrow to kick. Player 2 uses W to jump, A and D to move, and S to kick. Player 1 also has the K key for the Super Bonus.

digit-shooter-1.intro: Digit Shooter 1 is a vertical arcade shooter where you launch green numbers at numbered walls and green targets to grow your number. Aim carefully, avoid red walls, and use your shots well as you head for the finish line.
tips: Shoot green numbers and numbered walls you can beat to keep your number growing.
Steer clear of red walls, since shooting them wastes bullets and time.
Collect numbers as you move so your value climbs before you reach harder walls.
Near the finish line, focus your fire on one line at a time to earn the extra rewards.
Keep an eye on your remaining bullets and spend them only on targets that help you.
faq: What is the goal of Digit Shooter 1?
Grow your number by shooting and collecting green numbers and numbered walls, and reach the finish line.
How do I control the game?
Use mouse clicks or taps to launch your numbers at targets.

paper-craft-wars.intro: Paper Craft Wars blends real-time strategy with RPG elements. You pick a race, fight for control of the map, and defend your kingdom in a paper-crafted world.
tips: Choose your race early and plan your strategy around its strengths before committing your forces.
Balance attacks with defense. Capturing enemy bases helps, but leaving your own kingdom open can cost you the match.
Save your magical skills for key fights, such as breaking a defense or holding a base you just captured.
Try different tactical approaches in each battle to learn how your race and the enemy respond.
Keep an eye on the achievements, since they can point you toward mechanics you might otherwise overlook.
faq: What is the main goal in Paper Craft Wars?
The game centers on leading your chosen race to victory by capturing enemy bases and defending your own kingdom.
How do I win a battle?
Win by capturing enemy bases while keeping your kingdom protected. Pressure the enemy in ways that let you take ground without leaving your own territory exposed.

darling-doll-diy-paper-doll.intro: Darling Doll is a dress-up game where you style a paper doll using clothes, hairstyles, expressions, skin tones, and accessories. You can build a custom anime-style avatar or dress a famous princess character.
tips: Pick a base character first, then plan your outfit around their look so the pieces feel cohesive.
Try the hairstyle before committing to clothes, since hair can change how the whole outfit reads.
Test a few expressions and skin tones on your character, as these can shift the mood of the final look.
Add accessories last and use them to finish the outfit, rather than letting them crowd the main pieces.
Save your design once it feels finished so you can share it on social media with friends and family.
faq: What is the goal of Darling Doll?
The goal is to dress and accessorize your chosen princess or anime-style character until you are happy with the result. Once finished, you can save and share your design.
How do I move items onto my character?
Choose clothing, hairstyles, and accessories from the wardrobe, then use touch and drag controls to apply them to your figure.

don-t-touch-the-red.intro: Don't Touch the Red is a reflex challenge where the goal is to tap only the green tiles and avoid the red ones. It offers different modes, and the difficulty increases as you play.
tips: Scan the whole board before you tap so you can spot every green tile and every red tile first.
Keep your pace steady rather than rushing, since a single tap on red is the main mistake to avoid.
Try the different modes to find the one that suits your reflexes best before pushing harder.
Expect the difficulty to climb, so use early rounds to settle into a rhythm you can keep up with.
If you make a mistake, pause for a moment and reset your focus instead of tapping quickly to recover.
faq: What is the main goal of Don't Touch the Red?
The goal is to tap only the green tiles. Tapping a red tile is the mistake you need to avoid.
How does the difficulty change as I play?
The game gets harder over time, so the challenge increases the longer you keep going. Early rounds are a good time to learn the pattern.

superhero-fighting-game.intro: Superhero Fighting Game is an action brawler where you battle across arenas using kung fu, karate, and boxing. Each fight gives you a chance to sharpen your combat skills.
tips: Watch how your opponent moves before committing to an attack. Waiting for a clear opening usually works better than rushing in.
Mix up your attacks instead of repeating the same move. Varied combinations make it harder for an opponent to predict and block you.
Pay attention to your own health and stamina as the fight goes on. Playing more carefully when you are low can keep you in the match longer.
Try different fighting styles to see which suits you best. Learning the strengths of kung fu, karate, and boxing can help you adapt to different opponents.
Learn from each clash by noting which moves landed and which were blocked. Small adjustments between rounds add up over time.
faq: What is the goal of Superhero Fighting Game?
The goal is to win fights against opponents in arenas and grow your martial arts skills. The description encourages you to become a champion through repeated battles.
Which fighting styles are included?
The game features kung fu, karate, and boxing. Each style is part of the combat you use while fighting.

mergemaster-dragonets.intro: MergeMaster: Dragonets is a merge puzzle where you connect identical dragonets in bubbles while keeping the field from overfilling. Choose where each bubble falls and use bonuses to keep the board clear.
tips: Before you drop a bubble, look at the whole board and check where identical dragonets sit next to each other so you can connect them.
Aim each drop to join a matching group instead of placing it in an open spot, since isolated bubbles are what fill the field.
Keep the top of the board as clear as you can, because overfilling the field is what ends the round.
Save bonuses for moments when the board is getting crowded rather than using them right away, so they help most when you need space.
Your points per connection rise as your level goes up, so focus on steady, clean merges early to build progress over time.
faq: What is the main goal of MergeMaster: Dragonets?
The goal is to connect as many identical dragonets in bubbles as possible without overfilling the field. Each connection earns you points.
How do I control where a bubble lands?
Specify the point on the board where the bubble will fall. Choose a spot that lets it join a matching dragonet.

drakkar-strike.intro: Drakkar Strike is an action game where you sail a Viking longship and fire spears like a slingshot to sink enemy vikings. Aim carefully, since every launch counts.
tips: Use the drag-and-release aim to get a feel for how far and how hard your spear travels before you try to finish off tougher targets.
Watch the positions of enemy ships before you fire, and pick the one that threatens your drakkar most to take out first.
Take a moment to line up each shot instead of rushing, because a wasted spear means you have to wait to reposition.
Track which enemy vikings are left so you can plan your shots and clear the map efficiently.
If a shot misses, adjust your angle slightly on the next attempt rather than changing everything at once.
faq: What is the goal of Drakkar Strike?
Hit enemy vikings and sink their ships. You win by clearing all foes from the sea.
How do I aim and fire my spear?
Drag to aim your spear, then release to launch it like a slingshot.

ticktock-egg-run.intro: Ticktock Egg Run is an arcade obstacle game where you guide a little egg through a series of levels while dodging monsters. Your only input is a mouse click or tap, so timing is the key skill.
tips: Watch the obstacles a few moments ahead of the egg so you can time your click or tap before the obstacle arrives.
Keep your clicks steady rather than rapid-fire, since each input should respond to a specific obstacle or monster.
Pay attention to how the monsters move and wait for a clear gap before committing the egg to a risky section.
If you keep losing at the same spot, slow down and focus on that section until your timing feels consistent.
Take short breaks between runs to reset your focus, as quick reactions are important in an arcade game like this.
faq: What is the goal of Ticktock Egg Run?
You help a brave little egg get through obstacles and levels in adventure mode while avoiding monsters.
How do I control the egg?
Use a mouse click or tap to play. The game uses this single input for all of the egg's movement.

obby-prison-craft-escape.intro: Obby Prison: Craft Escape is a block-style survival adventure about breaking out of a prison full of guards, other prisoners, and traps. You move through a complex layout, avoiding police and working out how to get free.
tips: Use the mouse to look around before you commit to a jump, so you can judge gaps and platform heights from a distance.
Practice your SPACE jump timing on safer sections first, since you will need precise jumps to get past traps.
Press P to pause when a section gets crowded, and use the moment to plan your route instead of rushing ahead.
Watch how police guards move for a few seconds before you act, and keep your distance from them rather than cutting close.
Remember the layout you have already explored, so you can backtrack quickly if a route turns out to be blocked by a trap.
faq: What do the controls do?
Use WASD to move, SPACE to jump, and the mouse to look around. Press P to pause the game.
How do I avoid getting caught by the police?
Watch the guards' movement before you go forward, and keep a safe distance rather than passing right next to them.

king-of-sumo.intro: King of Sumo puts you in the ring as Takeshi, where each bout mixes strength with strategy. Winning matches moves you toward the championship while a story about a vanished legend unfolds.
tips: Watch how your opponent moves before committing to an attack, since clashes are described as unpredictable.
Pick your attacks with a plan rather than button-mashing, because the game rewards strategic play.
Treat each bout as a read on your rival: notice patterns in their stance and timing and adjust.
Keep your focus steady between matches so you can spot clues about the vanished legend as the story develops.
faq: What is the goal of King of Sumo?
Your goal is to win sumo bouts as Takeshi and keep advancing toward the championship. Each victory brings you closer to the final title.
Does the game rely on strength or strategy?
Both matter, since every bout is described as a battle of strength and intellect. Planning your attacks is as important as raw power.

ice-cream-vendor.intro: Ice Cream Vendor is a fast-paced click game where you run an ice cream stand. You build each customer's order by choosing a cone, flavors, chocolates and toppings before the line gets too impatient.
tips: Read the whole order before you click anything, so you know which cone and flavors you need from the start.
Build the cone first, then add flavors, then chocolates and toppings, so you do not have to backtrack.
Keep your clicks steady and avoid rushing a wrong click, since fixing a mistake costs time you need for the next customer.
As levels get harder and customers move faster, focus on the orders in front of you rather than thinking ahead to the next one.
Stay calm during busy stretches; a simple, consistent routine will usually beat frantic clicking.
faq: What is the goal of Ice Cream Vendor?
The goal is to get as many customer orders right as you can before the rush becomes too much. Each order must match what the customer asked for.
How do I play?
Just click the buttons to pick a cone, add flavors, and place chocolates and toppings for each customer.

skibronx-runner.intro: Skibronx Runner is a 2D endless runner where you run through the streets, dodge challenges, and try to get as far as you can. You can also play a level mode that ends at the grocery store.
tips: Learn the jump and double jump timing early, since you can press Up Arrow again in the air to double jump.
Hold Up Arrow after your double jump to fly, and use it to reach higher spots or stay out of trouble longer.
Use the Arrow Down key to slide when an obstacle is low and jumping would not get you past it safely.
Press E to shoot the water gun or to bump, and use it when a challenge is close enough to deal with it rather than running into it.
In level mode, keep your focus on reaching the grocery store without losing, and in endless mode, play for distance by staying calm and avoiding unnecessary risks.
faq: What is the goal of Skibronx Runner?
In level mode, your goal is to reach the grocery store without losing. In endless mode, your goal is to get as far as possible without losing.
How do I jump and double jump?
Press the Up Arrow key to jump, then press it again in the air to double jump.

squid-glass-bridge.intro: Squid Glass Bridge is a 3D action game based on the glass bridge challenge from Squid Game. Pick a difficulty on the main menu, then find the safe glass panels and cross the bridge without stepping on the fake one.
tips: Choose a difficulty on the main menu that matches your reflexes before you start, since the challenge changes with the level you pick.
Move the mouse to look ahead along the bridge before each step, so you can spot which glass looks different before you commit to it.
Use the Space bar to jump over windows instead of walking onto them when you are unsure, and keep your movements short and controlled.
Keep your eyes peeled on the panels just ahead of your character rather than the ones far away, so you can react in time.
Take your time on each step. The fake glass breaks as soon as you stand on it, so a careful pause to check the next panel is worth more than speed.
faq: What is the goal of Squid Glass Bridge?
Your goal is to find the right glass and cross the whole bridge. Stepping on the fake glass breaks it and you fall.
How do I move and jump?
Use W, A, S, D or the arrow keys to move, and press Space to jump. Move the mouse to look around the surroundings.

shadow-samurai-ninja.intro: Shadow Samurai Ninja is an action game where you move through mystical terrain, avoid traps, and fight tough foes. Quick reflexes and smart combat help you earn upgrades along the way.
tips: Watch the terrain and traps before you move, since the game rewards careful reading of each area over rushing ahead.
Pay attention to how enemies attack and react, then time your own moves to respond rather than attacking blindly.
Mix quick reflexes with planned combat: strike when an opening appears and back off when you are under pressure.
Spend upgrades on the abilities that match how you actually play, so your strengths carry you further.
If you keep losing to the same obstacle or foe, slow down and change your approach instead of repeating the same mistake.
faq: What is the main goal of Shadow Samurai Ninja?
You move through mystical terrain, outsmart traps, and defeat formidable foes on your way to victory. Along the path you can unlock powerful upgrades.
How do upgrades help in this game?
Upgrades make your samurai stronger for the challenges ahead. Choosing upgrades that suit your play style can make combat and navigation easier.

idle-magic-academy-tycoon.intro: Idle Magic Academy Tycoon is a management game where you build classrooms, recruit Magisters, and grow your academy of sorcery. This guide covers how to spend your resources and keep your academy growing.
tips: Spend your gold coins on the upgrades that raise your profit first, since that income funds everything else you buy.
Check each room's cost in its purchase window before buying, so you don't run short on gold for the upgrades that matter most.
Use diamonds on construction only when a build is holding up progress, because gold is what you'll use for most upgrades.
Open your free hourly chests and claim your daily rewards whenever you log in, since they can give you mages or currency.
Work through daily quests and achievements as you go, as they give you clear goals while you plan your next upgrades.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You build and upgrade academy facilities, train students, and generate profit that you reinvest into further upgrades. Your aim is to grow the academy into a legendary center of magic.
How do I buy or upgrade a room?
Click the area where the room is located. A window opens showing the cost and a purchase button, and once a room is owned, a management window lets you choose items and press the Upgrade button.

456-impostor.intro: Play as astronaut 456, who must survive in space by jumping on the men in red suits to crush them. Clear the levels to reach the final stage, with an endless run every 10 levels.
tips: Land on top of each red-suited enemy to crush it, since that is the only way to destroy them. Plan your jumps so you come down on their heads rather than their sides.
Watch the enemies for a moment before you jump. Their movement patterns will help you time your landing.
Keep your movements short and controlled. Overshooting a jump can leave you in a bad position for the next enemy.
Treat the endless run levels, which come every 10 levels, as a separate challenge. Stay calm and keep your rhythm, because the enemies keep coming.
Use WASD on a keyboard, or the touch controls on a mobile device, and practice the jump timing in the early levels before moving on.
faq: What is the goal of 456 Impostor?
Your goal is to survive as astronaut 456 by destroying the men in red suits and reaching the final level.
How do I destroy the enemies?
You destroy them by jumping on them and crushing them from above.

baby-taylor-bubble-tea-maker.intro: Baby Taylor Bubble Tea Maker is a cooking game where you help Taylor's mother make a bubble tea drink step by step. It is aimed at young players and works with simple mouse clicks or taps.
tips: Read each prompt before you tap, since the game moves you through the drink-making steps in order.
Take your time with each ingredient so the drink is prepared carefully from start to finish.
Watch what the characters are doing or asking for, because the next step often follows from it.
Try making the drink more than once to get comfortable with the order of the steps.
Go slowly and enjoy the cute details, since there is no rush to finish quickly.
faq: What is the goal of Baby Taylor Bubble Tea Maker?
The goal is to help Taylor's mother prepare and make a bubble tea drink. You complete it by following the steps in the game.
How do I control the game?
You play by clicking or tapping with your mouse or touchscreen. Use single clicks or taps to choose items and move through each step.

vampire-survival.intro: Vampire Survival is a multiplayer game set in a mythical vampire world. You build up your vampiric skills, avoid hunters, and outlast rival players in tense battles.
tips: Keep track of where the hunters are before you commit to a fight, so you are not caught in the open.
Use flight as an escape route when a battle turns against you, rather than waiting until your health is critical.
Collect gold steadily from the start, since it is what you use to strengthen your powers for later rounds.
Think about which power upgrades will help you survive longest, and avoid spending gold on upgrades you won't use.
Watch your rivals as well as the hunters, because a competitor who is busy fighting can be an opening for you.
faq: What is the main goal of Vampire Survival?
The goal is to outlast your competitors in a dark, multiplayer world full of battles and hunters. Staying alive longer than the other players is the main objective.
How does gold help me in the game?
You accumulate gold during play and use it to enhance your vampire powers. Stronger powers can help you survive battles and evade hunters more effectively.

pop-the-balloons-bounce.intro: Pop the Balloons Bounce is a ball game where you use a thorn ball to pop balloons. Each level rewards careful planning of angles and power, and chain reactions can clear more balloons at once.
tips: Before each shot, look at the whole level and find the balloons that a single bounce could reach.
Set your angle first, then adjust the power, so you can check the path before you commit.
Try to set up chain reactions, where one popped balloon sets off others nearby.
Watch how the ball rebounds off walls and surfaces, and plan your shots around those bounces.
If a level feels stuck, rethink the angle rather than only adding more power.
faq: What is the main goal of Pop the Balloons Bounce?
Your goal is to pop the balloons on each level using the thorn ball. Levels are built around precision, timing, and bouncing tactics.
How do I get better at aiming the thorn ball?
Practice calculating angles and power on early levels, where small mistakes are easy to notice. Pay attention to where the ball goes after each bounce to learn how the shots behave.

airport-security-3d.intro: Airport Security 3D is a cartoon airport checkpoint simulation. You check passengers at the counter and their baggage at the security checkpoint, approving civilians and arresting criminals.
tips: At the counter, compare the passenger's name with the name on the ID card before you approve them. A mismatch is a sign of a fake ID.
Look at each ID closely instead of skimming it, since fake IDs are one of the things you need to catch.
At the checkpoint, scan the baggage carefully for weapons before letting a passenger continue. Don't rush through bags just to keep the line moving.
Use the questioning step on suspicious passengers before deciding. It can help you tell a criminal from a civilian.
Keep a steady pace and clear each step fully, since the counter and checkpoint checks both need your attention.
faq: What is my main goal in Airport Security 3D?
Your mission is to arrest criminals who carry fake IDs or weapons while approving the civilians who pass your checks.
How do I play the game?
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps. You use them to check IDs at the counter, inspect baggage at the checkpoint, and question suspects.

merge-grabber-race-to-2048.intro: Merge Grabber: Race to 2048 is a 2048-style arcade game where you race through dynamic lanes, merge characters, and avoid zombies. It rewards quick thinking and fast reactions.
tips: Plan your merges a step ahead, since the game combines strategy with speed and rushing usually leads to poor merges.
Keep an eye on the lanes as they change, and move toward the merges you can actually reach before the zombies do.
Watch where the zombies are coming from and prioritize staying out of their path over chasing a small merge.
Aim for merges that build toward higher characters rather than many small ones, so your progress keeps pace with the increasing challenge.
Practice a few runs to build reflexes, and treat each run as a chance to learn how the lanes behave.
faq: What is the main goal of Merge Grabber: Race to 2048?
The description says the game is a race where you merge characters and outsmart zombies, with the aim of being the quickest thinker and boldest runner to triumph.
Does the game reward speed or planning more?
The description presents it as a mix of strategy and speed, so the best results likely come from balancing quick reactions with thoughtful merges.

boys-battle-for-the-district.intro: Boys - Battle for the District is an idle clicker where you tap to fight rival gangs and take over city districts. Each enemy you defeat earns currency for upgrading your character.
tips: Spend your currency on damage upgrades early, since hitting harder means enemies fall faster and you earn currency more quickly.
Check your upgrade options after each defeat rather than saving up without a plan, so your growth keeps pace with the next enemy.
Keep your taps steady and focused on the current enemy, because the game is built around one-tap combat with no other controls to manage.
Use the prestige system when your progress slows down, since each restart is meant to let you come back stronger.
Track your position on the leaderboards over time to see whether your incremental power gains are actually paying off.
faq: What is the goal of Boys - Battle for the District?
Your goal is to defeat rival gangs, claim districts, and grow your power so you can expand your district empire. Progress comes from steady defeats and upgrades.
How do I attack enemies?
You tap the screen to hit your enemy. The game uses simple one-tap combat, so no complex controls are needed.

battle-area.intro: Battle Area is a 3D first person shooter set on Mars. You play an elite soldier who must eliminate the enemies holding a mineral mine and take it back.
tips: Keep moving rather than standing still, since staying in one spot makes you an easier target. Use the movement keys or joystick to shift position between shots.
Use the mouse on desktop, or a drag on the right side of the screen on mobile, to keep your aim steady and turn quickly toward threats.
Clear enemies one group at a time instead of rushing into the open. Check each area before you advance so you are not caught from two directions.
Fire in short bursts when targets are at a distance, and save longer firing for when enemies are close and in your sights.
Watch the area around the mine as you move, and pay attention to where enemies appear so you can turn to them early.
faq: What is the goal of Battle Area?
Your mission is to eliminate all the enemies and reconquer the mineral mine on Mars. Clearing the enemies is the core objective of the game.
How do I move and aim on desktop?
Use the arrow keys or W, A, S and D to move your character. Move the mouse to turn and aim, then click to shoot.

zombie-city-polygon-survival.intro: Zombie City Polygon Survival is a shooter set in a post-apocalyptic city overrun by zombies. You fight through waves of enemies with guns, using quick reflexes and tactical thinking to clear each area.
tips: Keep moving with WASD instead of standing still, since staying in one spot makes it easier for waves of zombies to surround you.
Use the mouse to aim before you fire, and avoid spraying shots at distant targets that may waste ammunition.
Clear enemies in a steady order rather than rushing into the open, so you always know where the next threat is coming from.
Watch the edges of your screen as you move, because the minimalist graphics make it easier to spot approaching zombies early.
Pay attention to how each wave arrives and adjust your position between waves to prepare for the next group.
faq: How do I move and shoot?
Use the WASD keys to move around the city and the mouse to aim and fire your gun.
What is the main goal of the game?
Your goal is to survive the waves of zombies and clear each area of enemies.

masterpiece-unharmed.intro: Restore damaged paintings by matching colors and filling gaps before the inspector's timer runs out. Work carefully, check your results, and then compare your restoration with the original.
tips: Zoom in with the mouse wheel or side slider to check edges and small details before you start painting.
Use the pipette to sample the exact color from the nearby paint instead of guessing from the palette.
Adjust the brush size to fit the gap: a thick brush for large areas and a small one for edges and fine lines.
Undo or use the eraser right away when a stroke goes wrong, so you do not have to fix several mistakes at the end.
Keep an eye on the timer and leave enough time to click Check, since later levels give you less time.
faq: What is the goal of Masterpiece Unharmed?
Your goal is to fill in the damaged areas of each painting with matching colors and details before the timer ends. Then you click Check to show the result to the inspector.
How do I pick the right color?
You can select a color with the pipette or choose one from the palette. The pipette is useful when you want to match an existing shade in the painting exactly.

clean-up-mini-games.intro: Clean Up Mini Games is a calm collection of tidying tasks where you sort, clean, pack, and arrange everyday items. Levels are short and use soft visuals and gentle sounds to help you unwind.
tips: Look at the visual hints at the start of each level to see what the finished arrangement should look like before you begin moving things.
Tap, hold, and drag items one at a time so each object lands in its spot cleanly rather than rushing several at once.
Work through a space in an order that makes sense, such as clearing loose items first and then arranging what remains.
Use a simple swipe for items that need to be pushed or cleared quickly, saving slower dragging for pieces that need precise placement.
If a level feels stuck, check the hint again and look for items that belong together, like cosmetics or food supplies, to narrow down where things go.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Each level asks you to sort, clean, pack, arrange, or organize a set of items until everything is in its correct place. The visual hints show what a finished level looks like.
What controls do I use?
Tap, hold, and drag items to move and sort them, and use a simple swipe to organize things across the screen. The controls are designed to be easy for players of all ages.

medieval-battle-2p.intro: Medieval Battle 2P is a 3D battle simulator where you place soldiers and plan strategies on Medieval battlefields. You can play alone or with a second player.
tips: Before you start a battle, use the camera to look over the whole field so you can see where your soldiers will face the enemy.
Place soldiers carefully rather than all at once, since their starting positions shape how the battle unfolds.
Use the remove key on soldiers that are badly placed and try again, instead of accepting a weak setup.
If you are playing two player, agree on which side each player controls and discuss your plan before placing any soldiers.
Rotate and move the camera often to check how the fight is going from different angles, so you can react to gaps in the enemy line.
faq: What is the goal of Medieval Battle 2P?
The game is a battle simulator focused on soldiers, battles and strategy in Medieval-period fights. Your aim is to set up your army and see how the battle plays out.
How do I move the camera and place soldiers?
Use W, A, S and D to move around, hold CTRL to rotate the camera, and hold right-click to move the camera. Use the mouse and left-click to place soldiers, and press X to remove them.

mafia-billiard-tricks.intro: Mafia Billiard Tricks is a billiards game where you face a series of increasingly clever opponents. Each match tests your precision and strategy, building up to a tense final showdown with the mob boss.
tips: Take your time before each shot and focus on accuracy, since the game rewards precision.
Plan a few shots ahead rather than only thinking about the ball you are hitting now.
Pay attention to how each opponent plays, because later rivals are described as more cunning and will need a different approach.
Treat early matches as practice to sharpen your timing and judgment before the harder games.
Stay patient during the mob boss match, where a single careless shot can cost you the game.
faq: What is the main goal of Mafia Billiard Tricks?
Your goal is to win billiards matches against a series of opponents, each more cunning than the last, and earn the respect of the mob figures. The challenge ends with a match against the mob boss.
How does the difficulty change as I play?
Each game is described as pushing your skills against more cunning opponents, so the challenge increases as you progress. Strong precision and planning become more important the further you go.

dirt-bike-trail-rider.intro: Dirt Bike Trail Rider is a 3D off-road racing game where you guide a motocross bike over rough terrain, bumps and jumps through a series of stages. Your goal is to reach the finish while keeping the bike under control.
tips: Ease off the throttle before rough patches so the bike does not bounce out of control.
Approach jumps at a steady speed and keep the bike level in the air rather than tilting too far forward or back.
Use the brake before tight corners instead of braking mid-turn, which can make the bike slide.
Watch the path ahead and pick a line through the bumps early so you are not reacting at the last second.
If the bike tips over, stop and recover it before pushing on, since a fall costs more time than a short pause.
faq: What is the goal of Dirt Bike Trail Rider?
Your goal is to race across each off-road trail and reach the finish line while keeping your bike upright. You complete a series of motocross stages to progress.
How do I control the bike?
Use the on-screen driving controls to accelerate, brake and steer. Steering is key for staying balanced over bumps and jumps.

alphabet-writing-for-kids.intro: Alphabet Writing for Kids is a puzzle-style game where young children trace letters with on-screen guidance. Pronunciation, music, and animations make learning each letter feel like play.
tips: Have your child listen to the letter's pronunciation before tracing it, so the sound and shape are learned together.
Encourage your child to say the letter aloud while tracing to reinforce what they hear and see.
Focus on one letter at a time and follow the interactive guidance closely before moving on.
Keep sessions short and playful so your child stays interested in the animations, tunes, and stickers.
Praise your child for careful tracing, not only for finishing, to build confidence with letter shapes.
faq: What does my child do in this game?
Your child traces letters on the screen while following interactive guidance. The game is designed to help them learn how each letter is written.
How does the game help with letter sounds?
Each letter is paired with phonetic pronunciation, so children hear how it sounds as they practice writing it.

zombie-royale-io.intro: Zombie Royale io is a survival arcade game where you lead cartoon survivors, rescue more people, and shoot down zombies. Stronger zombies arrive as time passes, so staying alive matters.
tips: Rescue survivors early in each round, since a bigger group gives you more firepower when the tougher zombies show up.
Keep moving rather than standing still, because zombies chase the last survivors and a cornered group is easy to lose.
Save your summons for moments when the zombie pressure spikes instead of using them the moment they become available.
Use bombs when a crowd of zombies is clustered together so one blast can clear several at once.
Spend gold coins after each round on the upgrades that help your group survive longest, rather than spreading them thinly.
faq: How do I control my survivors?
You play with mouse clicks or taps. Click or tap to direct your group and fire at zombies.
Why do zombies keep getting harder?
As time goes on, stronger zombies appear and chase the last survivors at random, so the difficulty rises the longer you last in a round.

it-clicker.intro: IT Clicker is a clicking game where each click moves you forward. Buy ClickBoost upgrades to work faster and build steady growth over time.
tips: Spend your progress on ClickBoost upgrades early, since faster clicking pays off for the rest of the session.
Compare what each upgrade adds before you buy, and favor the ones that improve your efficiency the most.
Keep a steady, rhythmic clicking pace rather than bursts followed by long pauses, so your progress builds consistently.
Check your progress regularly and plan your next upgrade so you are not saving resources you could already be using.
Take short breaks when you feel stuck, then return with a fresh plan for which upgrade to pursue next.
faq: What is the main goal of IT Clicker?
The goal is to keep clicking to make progress, using upgrades to increase your efficiency and speed up your growth.
How do ClickBoost upgrades help?
ClickBoost upgrades improve your efficiency, so each stretch of play moves your progress along faster.

silent-fear.intro: Silent Fear is a first-person zombie survival shooter where you keep moving and fight back with a saw and a gun barrel. Run ahead, use your weapons when needed, and stay alive as long as you can.
tips: Keep moving most of the time, since the description says the zombies cannot be stopped and standing still gives them time to reach you.
Use the W, A, S and D keys to change direction smoothly so you can slip past groups instead of running into them head on.
Save the gun barrel for threats you cannot avoid, and rely on the saw for close encounters when you need a quicker response.
Watch for the animals mentioned in the description, since they may come to your aid, and be ready to use the moments they create to get further ahead.
On mobile, use the dynamic joystick to steer and keep one thumb free to tap the weapon, so you can attack without stopping your run.
faq: What is the main goal in Silent Fear?
You play as the last human in this world and must survive by running away from zombies. The game is about staying alive as long as possible while you move forward.
How do I move and attack on a PC?
Use the W, A, S and D keys to run, and click the mouse on the weapon to attack. Keeping your movement steady helps you avoid being caught.

freddys-return-village-escape.intro: Freddys Return Village Escape is a 3D action horror game set in a snowy, forgotten city on New Years Eve. Explore the map, stay out of Freddy's reach, and try to survive as long as you can.
tips: Start with the escape mode to learn the layout before you face Freddy in the second mode.
Explore the whole map so you know where the exits and hiding spots are before you need them.
Snow slows escape, so plan your route in advance and avoid wasting time on wrong paths.
Use F to hide and T to come out again, and stay still in hiding until the danger has passed.
If you bring weapons into the second mode, use them to slow down Freddy and his snowman minions rather than trying to fight every enemy.
faq: What is the goal of Freddys Return Village Escape?
The goal is to get out of the forgotten city and stay alive for as long as possible while exploring the whole map.
How do I hide from Freddy?
Press F near a hiding spot to hide, and press T to come out again. Hiding is useful when enemies are close and you need a moment to stay unseen.

mister-bullet-arcade-shooter.intro: Mister Bullet is an arcade shooter where you play as a special agent clearing enemy bases of Balloon Villains. Pick your weapons, choose a stealthy or loud approach, and eliminate every opponent on each level.
tips: Use the mouse on PC or your finger on mobile to scan the area before you move in. Knowing where enemies stand lets you plan your route.
Shooting is automatic once your sight is on an enemy, so focus on aiming and positioning rather than tapping to fire.
Try staying in the shadows when you can. Sneaking up on enemies gives you more control over the fight than charging in.
Switch to heavier weapons like shotguns or grenade launchers when enemies gather in groups. Save lighter weapons for single targets.
Keep track of which enemies are left, since you must eliminate all opponents to finish a level. Do not leave a few hidden enemies behind.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You need to eliminate all opponents on the level to win. The game does not say what happens if you fail, so keep moving forward and clear the area.
How do I aim and shoot?
On PC, use the mouse to control the camera. On mobile, use your finger. Shooting is automatic when your sight is aimed at an enemy.

find-the-dog.intro: Find The Dog is a relaxed hidden object game set in black-and-white scenes. Your job is to spot the pups tucked into parks, streets, and other settings.
tips: Scan each scene in sections, such as one corner or edge at a time, so you can tell which areas you have already checked.
Zoom in with the scroll wheel on busy areas, since small dogs can blend into patterns and details.
Because the scenes are black and white, look for shapes, ears, and tails rather than colors.
Pan slowly by holding left click and dragging, and avoid rushing past the edges of the image.
If you are stuck, take a short break and come back with fresh eyes before using the hint button at the bottom left.
faq: How do I mark a dog I have found?
Move your cursor over the dog and left-click on it. Clicking on the dog is how you find it.
How do I get a closer look at a scene?
Use the scroll wheel to zoom in and out. Zoomed in views are useful for spotting small details.

balls-bricks-breaker.intro: Balls Bricks Breaker is a ball and brick game where you bounce a ball through levels, break obstacles, and collect hidden power-ups. Each level adds new challenges and strategy.
tips: Watch the angle of each bounce before you act, since every rebound changes where the ball goes next.
Look for hidden power-ups early in a level, as they can change the outcome when the game gets harder.
Clear the obstacles that are most likely to block your path first so the ball has more room to work.
Pay attention to how each level is laid out, because the challenges and strategic elements often reward a plan over quick moves.
If a level feels hard, slow down and think about the next few bounces rather than reacting to only the current one.
faq: What is the main goal in Balls Bricks Breaker?
The goal is to break bricks and shatter obstacles in each level by bouncing the ball through the playing area. Clearing the level is how you move on to the next challenge.
How do power-ups help me?
Hidden power-ups can turn the tide of a level and help you shatter obstacles more efficiently. Finding them is part of the strategy in each stage.

sky-islands-obby.intro: Sky Islands Obby is a 3D obstacle course across seven floating islands with 70 stages to climb. Reach each flag to save your progress, and use pets from eggs to help you jump higher, run faster and gather more.
tips: Watch moving platforms, lifts and crumbling pads for a few cycles before you jump, so you can time your landing instead of guessing.
Reach the flag at the end of each stage before you push further, since it saves your progress as a checkpoint.
Pick pets based on the stage ahead: a higher jump helps with long gaps, while a glide or a rescue from a fall can save you on tricky sections.
Use the tutorial at the start to learn the controls, and try sprinting only on straight paths where you can keep your balance.
Look off the main path for bonus gems, and use your pets' boosts to reach areas that are hard to get to on foot.
faq: What is the main goal of Sky Islands Obby?
Your goal is to move through the 70 stages across the seven floating islands and reach the flag at the end of each one. Each flag saves your progress.
How do pets help me in the game?

You open eggs at each island's shop to hatch pets, and you can bring up to three along. Each pet gives a boost, such as higher jumps, more speed, gliding, a coin magnet, extra coins or a rescue from a fall.

car-stunt-race-trial.intro: Car Stunt Race Trial is a racing game about driving and performing stunts over difficult tracks. Use WASD to drive and the pause button to take a break. Physics-based cars and endless racing keep each run different.
tips: Start by learning how the car responds to WASD inputs on a flat section before you attempt stunts. Knowing how much each input moves the car makes landings easier.
Focus on car control and stability rather than speed. A car that stays balanced will usually finish a track faster than one that flips and has to recover.
Pay attention to the physics when you go over bumps and jumps. Small corrections in the air or on landing help keep the car upright.
Try the different cars and airplanes if the game offers them, and notice which handles best for you. Each vehicle reacts to the physics in its own way.
Use the pause button to reset your focus when a track gets crowded with obstacles. Stepping back for a moment can help you plan the next section.
faq: What is the goal of Car Stunt Race Trial?
The goal is to race and perform stunts over impossible tracks while keeping your car under control. The game offers endless rally car racing, so you keep going as long as you can handle the course.
Which keys do I use to play?
Use the W, A, S and D keys to drive. Press the pause button to pause the game.

jewel-garden-story.intro: Jewel Garden Story is a match-3 puzzle game where you connect three or more jewels of the same type to clear levels. It offers many puzzles, six boosters, and competitive rankings for players who want to chase high scores.
tips: Look for moves that create the biggest chain of matches, since clearing more jewels at once is the most direct way to climb the scores.
Save your boosters for harder puzzles where progress has stalled instead of using them on easy levels early on.
Log in every day so you don't miss the daily login rewards, which add up over time.
Check Garden Expeditions regularly, because they are one of the listed ways to earn rewards alongside daily logins.
If you are aiming for a top ranking, focus on consistent scoring across many puzzles rather than relying on one lucky board.
faq: What is the main goal of Jewel Garden Story?
The goal is to connect three or more jewels of the same type to clear each level. You can keep playing through the game's many puzzles.
How many boosters are there, and how should I use them?
The game features six unique boosters that help you progress faster. Use them when a level is difficult rather than spending them early.

evolution-survival.intro: Evolution: Survival starts you as a tiny cell and asks you to grow stronger by eating food, defeating enemies, and choosing mutations. Each evolution changes the world and the threats you face.
tips: Build your mutations before taking on tough enemies. Early fights go better when you have a few evolutions behind you.
Pick mutations that fit your play style, then combine them over time. Combinations are how you reach the secret forms.
Watch for enemy drops such as healing, magnet, shield, and explosion. Grab them when your health is low or when a crowd is gathering.
Hunt the rare golden stars across the map. They give you currency for permanent upgrades that carry over into later runs.
Learn your ability buttons early and use them with intent. Dash, acid spit, death cloud, traps, and cover each work best in different situations, so practice switching between them.
faq: How do I move my creature?
Steer with the mouse or your finger, or use WASD or the arrow keys on a computer. Spacebar triggers a dash once you have unlocked it.
How do I trigger an evolution?
Collect DNA by consuming food and defeating enemies. Once enough DNA is gathered, you can choose your next mutation from speed, attack, defense, poison, regeneration, or intelligence.

shadow-adventure.intro: Shadow Adventure is a reflex-based platform challenge set in the shadowy realm of the dead. You dodge moving obstacles, time your jumps, and cross deadly chasms as each level grows harder.
tips: Watch how an obstacle moves for a few seconds before you commit to a route, since its pattern is what you need to read.
Plan each jump before you make it. A calculated jump is safer than a rushed one, especially near a chasm.
Scan ahead for the next gap or hazard so you can prepare your position instead of reacting at the last moment.
Expect each level to be harder than the last, so focus on keeping calm and steady rather than moving as fast as possible.
After a mistake, pause briefly and reset your rhythm before trying the section again.
faq: What is the main goal of Shadow Adventure?
You move through the shadowy realm of the dead, dodging obstacles, making jumps, and getting past chasms while each level becomes more challenging.
What makes the later levels harder?
Each level intensifies and offers new challenges that test both your reflexes and your planning, so the later stages demand more precise timing.

bridge-builder-3d.intro: Bridge Builder 3D is a physics puzzle where you design bridges from different materials so vehicles can cross safely. Each level asks you to plan a structure that carries the weight of the vehicle without collapsing.
tips: Before placing anything, look at the vehicle and the gap it needs to cross, then decide where the load will be carried.
Start with a simple shape like a triangle or a straight deck with supports, since triangles resist bending and spread weight well.
Test your bridge early and often so you can see which joints or beams fail and fix only those parts.
Try different materials on the same design to learn how each one handles weight, and choose the one that suits the section you are building.
Use the built-in hint system when you are stuck, then apply the idea to the next puzzle so your design skills keep growing.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Your goal is to build a structure that can support the weight of the vehicle so it can cross from one side to the other.
How do I build a bridge on desktop?
Use your mouse or touchpad to place and connect the building pieces. On mobile, use the touchscreen and on-screen controls instead.

satisroom-perfectly-organized.intro: Satisroom is a calm arcade game about sorting, cleaning, packing and organizing items. Each level asks you to put things in perfect order, with a relaxed sound atmosphere throughout.
tips: Read the hint shown at the start of each level first, since it explains what the mini-game is asking you to do.
Work through one group of items at a time, such as all cosmetics or all furniture, so the screen stays easy to scan.
Try a single swipe to sort items before dragging them one by one, because a swipe can organize several things at once.
When you're unsure where something belongs, pause and look at how the other items in the scene are arranged to find the pattern.
Since new levels are added every week, revisit earlier levels occasionally to practice your organizing skill at a relaxed pace.
faq: What is the goal of Satisroom?
Your goal is to put things in perfect order in each level, whether that means sorting cosmetics, arranging furniture, packing, or cooking tasks.
How do I move objects in the game?
Touch the screen to select an object and drag it to where it belongs. You can also sort and organize items with one swipe of your finger.

fashion-foot-shop.intro: Fashion Foot Shop is a makeover game where you run a foot shop, treat customers' feet and then design nail styles to suit each person. Play with the mouse or by tapping.
tips: Fix the foot problems first, such as long or dirty nails and wounds, before moving on to decoration. A clean base makes the final design look better.
Look at each customer's characteristics before choosing a nail style, since the game asks you to design nails that match them.
Work through each step in order so you do not skip treatment or have to undo finished work.
Try a few different colour and style combinations on each customer to see which one looks best with their look.
Take your time with small tasks like shaping and polishing, because careful work is what makes the final result look polished.
faq: What is the goal of Fashion Foot Shop?
Your goal is to treat each customer's feet, dealing with problems like long nails, dirty nails and wounds, and then design nails that suit them.
What controls does the game use?
You play with the mouse or by tapping the screen, so you click or tap to pick tools, colours and styles.

tank-stars-battle-arena.intro: Tank Stars Battle Arena is a tank design strategy game where you build tanks to defeat every enemy tank across 14 levels. Your goal is to take out the enemy pilot to win each battle.
tips: Focus on the enemy pilot, since defeating that pilot is what wins the battle, not just clearing tanks.
Experiment with where each part sits on your tank, because every part has a different function and moving it can change how your tank performs.
Save your designs as you go, but remember you can only keep 3 tank design projects at once, so keep your best builds.
Spend diamonds on chests in the Shop when you have enough, since they give you tank parts to improve your designs.
Use the mouse click or tap controls to test your tank in each level, then adjust the design if you miss the target.
faq: What is the goal of Tank Stars Battle Arena?
You build tanks to defeat all enemy tanks in each of the 14 levels. Defeating the enemy pilot is what wins the battle.
How do I play the game?
You play by mouse click or tap. Use these to build and control your tank during each battle.

block-puzzle-chuzzle-classic.intro: Block Puzzle Chuzzle Classic is an endless arcade puzzle where colorful blocks fall and you line them up to clear rows. Shapes and speeds change, so you need to stay focused.
tips: Keep the surface as flat as you can, because uneven stacks leave gaps that are hard to fill later.
Look at the shape of each falling block before deciding where to place it, so you can plan the next few moves.
Clear lines whenever you can instead of waiting, since fewer stacked rows give you more room before blocks reach the top.
Pay attention to speed changes and slow down your decisions when blocks fall faster, rather than rushing placement.
Watch the height of your stack closely and place blocks away from the top edge, especially when a difficult shape appears.
faq: What is the goal of Block Puzzle Chuzzle Classic?
The goal is to align the falling blocks and clear lines before the stack touches the top of the playing area. Because the game is endless, you keep playing for as long as you can manage the stack.
Does the difficulty change during play?
Yes, the blocks come in varying shapes and speeds, so the challenge can change as you go. Staying calm when the pace picks up helps you keep your stack under control.

underwater-2d.intro: Underwater 2D is a browser shooter set in an alien ocean. You move through the depths, collect the fish you need to finish the dive, and keep your oxygen topped up while avoiding dangerous fish and seaweed-like plants.
tips: Check your oxygen often and plan routes that pass through refill zones before your air gets low.
Move in short, controlled bursts with W, A, S and D so you can stop and change direction around hazards.
Scan the path ahead for dangerous fish and seaweed-like plants, since a single touch ends the mission.
Use Space or Left Click to deploy the hook only when you have a clear line to a fish you need, so you don't waste time.
Collect the required fish in an order that keeps you close to a refill zone, rather than wandering far from air.
faq: What is the goal of Underwater 2D?
Collect the required fish to complete the dive while keeping your oxygen above zero and avoiding hazards. Finishing the dive is how you win.
What happens if I touch a dangerous fish or plant?
One wrong touch ends your mission, so keep a safe distance from hazardous fish and seaweed-like plants at all times.

moutain-jeep-drive.intro: Mountain Jeep Drive is an offroad driving game where you steer powerful 4x4 jeeps over rugged terrain and race through mountain landscapes. It rewards careful control as much as speed.
tips: Ease off the speed before rough patches so the jeep stays steady instead of bouncing out of control.
Watch the terrain ahead and plan your line early, since rocks, slopes, and bumps are easier to handle when you see them coming.
Spend a few minutes getting a feel for how the 4x4 handles on different surfaces before pushing for a fast run.
After a bump or a tilt, give the jeep a moment to settle before accelerating again.
Replay a stretch you struggled with and focus on one thing at a time, such as braking earlier or steering more gently.
faq: What is the main goal of Mountain Jeep Drive?
You drive a 4x4 jeep across rugged offroad terrain and race through mountain landscapes. Staying in control while you move forward is the core challenge.
What makes driving in this game difficult?
The uneven terrain, bumps, and steep sections make it hard to keep the jeep balanced. Slowing down at the right moments helps you avoid losing control.

zombie-raid.intro: Zombie Raid is an action survival game where you fight waves of zombies across different city missions. You move with A and D, choose weapons, and upgrade your gear as the threat grows.
tips: Match your weapon to the mission type before you start. Melee weapons suit enemies that reach you quickly, while ranged weapons help when zombies are still far away.
Keep moving left and right with A and D so enemies do not surround you. Being pinned in one spot is a common way to lose a run.
Spend your gold on upgrades to weapons you already use rather than spreading it across many items. A stronger weapon you rely on will carry you further.
Save crystals for the upgrades or characters that matter most to you, since gold and crystals are separate currencies with different uses.
Expect harder enemies in each new mission. If a mission is getting difficult, return to earlier missions to earn resources before pushing forward.
faq: What is the goal of Zombie Raid?
You survive waves of zombies, complete missions such as survival, cleanup, running and clown hunting, and upgrade your equipment as you go.
How do I move my character?
Use the A key to move left and the D key to move right.

paint-with-diamonds.intro: Paint with Diamonds is a drawing game where you build artwork one diamond at a time. It mixes careful painting with typing, and you can take it at your own pace.
tips: Go slowly on each diamond, since the game rewards precision more than speed.
Pick a theme you enjoy, such as Titanic or Tigers, and keep to one picture at a time so your progress stays clear.
Take short breaks between sections to keep your eye fresh for fine details.
Check your earlier work as you go, so small mistakes don't build up across the whole picture.
Treat the typing part as a steady rhythm rather than a race, which helps keep the session relaxing.
faq: What is the main goal of Paint with Diamonds?
The goal is to create a finished artwork by filling in its diamonds with careful, precise work. Each diamond should reflect your attention to detail.
Does the game have a time limit?
The game is designed to be played at a pace that suits you, so there is no need to rush. Take your time to keep the artwork neat.

cup-quest.intro: Cup Quest is a puzzle adventure where a cat hero uses bouncing balls to land shots in cups. Across more than 200 levels, you'll face spinning platforms, explosives, and enemy swarms.
tips: Before you release a shot, watch how the ball bounces off the walls and platforms so you can plan a route into the cup.
Time your shots around spinning platforms, since their position changes and the same aim can miss at a different moment.
Treat explosives and traps as part of the puzzle. Look for a shot that uses them to your advantage instead of avoiding them completely.
When enemy swarms appear, prioritize the threats that could stop your hero first, then return to the cup shot.
Use the mouse carefully on buttons and powerups too, and check the level layout first so you know when a powerup will help most.
faq: What is the main goal of Cup Quest?
Guide the balls dropping from the cup so they land in the target cup while you work through obstacles and enemies. Each level tests your aim, timing, and strategy.
How do I control the balls?
Use the mouse to guide the balls as they drop from the cup. The mouse also handles all buttons and powerups on screen.

stick-duel-the-war.intro: Stick Duel: The War is a two-player fighting game where you face the CPU or a friend. Win five rounds across 20 maps, using weapons and avoiding fire pools and traps.
tips: Learn each weapon's strengths and weaknesses early, since the description notes that every weapon has both advantages and disadvantages. Pick one that suits how you like to fight.
Before you start a fight, look at the map layout. Note where the fire pools and traps are so you can keep your distance from them.
Use double jump to reposition quickly, especially when an opponent is closing in or when you need to escape a dangerous spot.
Keep count of your rounds. The first player to take five rounds wins, so avoid risky moves when you are close to the win or need to stay alive.
If you are new, play a few rounds against the CPU to get used to the new physics before facing a friend.
faq: What is the goal of Stick Duel: The War?
The goal is to win the game by taking 5 rounds against the CPU or your friend. Each round is a fight on one of the 20 maps.
What are the controls for Player 1 and Player 2?
