Player 1 moves with the arrow keys, double jumps by pressing UP twice, and hits with L. Player 2 moves with W, A, S and D, double jumps by pressing W twice, and hits with F.

tap-gallery.intro: Tap Gallery is a puzzle game where you tap arrow blocks to move them and uncover a hidden image. Each puzzle is a brain teaser that asks you to plan your taps before you act.
tips: Before you tap, look at where each arrow points and think about which block should move first.
Plan a few taps ahead instead of clearing blocks at random, since the goal is to clear the board as efficiently as possible.
Save boosters for puzzles where you feel stuck, because each one removes multiple blocks at once.
If you get stuck, step back and look for a block that opens up space for others to move.
Replay earlier puzzles to sharpen your approach, since the game says your skills improve the more you play.
faq: What is the goal of Tap Gallery?
Clear the blocks by tapping them so the hidden image is uncovered. Each puzzle is solved when the board is cleared.
How do I move the blocks?
Tap on a block with an arrow on it to move it. Your taps should be planned carefully to clear the board efficiently.

cut-it-voxel-crusher.intro: Cut it: Voxel Crusher is an arcade puzzle where you steer a robotic chainsaw arm to grind down blocky voxel structures. Your fuel bar is the main limit, so planning each cut matters.
tips: Watch the fuel bar before every move, since the saw uses fuel whenever it travels. Long, wandering passes will drain it faster than short, purposeful ones.
Start by cutting the outer edges or the top of a structure so pieces can fall away cleanly instead of getting stuck under the rest of the model.
Collect the coins that drop from destroyed voxels, because they are your only way to buy upgrades in the main menu.
Spend early coins on Fuel Capacity if you tend to run dry, or on Arm Range if you find yourself unable to reach parts of a larger model.
Use simple drag-and-swipe motions anywhere on the screen rather than tiny corrections, which keeps the saw moving efficiently.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You grind the saw against the voxel structure to take it apart block by block. Completing the challenge means destroying the model.
How do I move the saw?
Drag or swipe anywhere on the screen to guide the robotic saw. The saw follows your movement.

clucknrun.intro: CluckNRun is a 3D endless runner where you drive through farm countryside to bring lost chickens home. Collect chickens and gasoline while steering around the barrels on the road.
tips: Look ahead rather than at your truck, so you can line up your lane change before a barrel is close.
Make small, early steering adjustments with A and D instead of sharp turns, which helps you stay in control at speed.
Try the mouse control if you find keyboard steering slow to react, since it can feel more direct on the curves.
Plan your route so you pick up chickens and gasoline on the way without swerving into hazards to reach them.
Keep your steering calm and steady during long straight stretches, since over-correcting is a common reason to clip a barrel.
faq: What is the goal of CluckNRun?
Your mission is to return the lost chickens to their farm home. Along the way you collect chickens and gasoline while avoiding barrels.
Which controls should I use to steer?
Use the A and D keys for left and right movement, or move your mouse to steer for a smoother feel.

suck-it-all.intro: Suck It All is a cozy cleaning game where you steer a vacuum hose and nozzle to break junk and collect coins. Rounds are short, so quick, steady aim matters.
tips: Keep the nozzle moving over clusters of junk rather than chasing single items, since short rounds reward covering the most ground.
Spend your early coins on upgrades that speed up collecting, such as a wider nozzle or stronger suction, before buying extras.
Look for plastic bags and use them to set off chain explosions, which can clear several pieces of junk at once.
Save batteries for moments when the room is crowded, because they overload the nozzle and let you pick up more at once.
Each round gets tougher, so check your upgrade tree between rounds and buy something that fits the mess you are facing.
faq: What is the main goal of each round?
You steer the vacuum's hose and nozzle onto junk to break it and suck it up for coins. Rounds are short, so the aim is to collect as much as you can before time runs out.
How do I steer the nozzle with a mouse?
Just move the mouse to steer the nozzle. No clicking is needed.

stickman-the-flash.intro: Stickman The Flash is a 2D fighting RPG where you survive in Survival Mode by dodging red danger zones and defeating incoming stickman enemies. Everything is played with mouse clicks or taps.
tips: Scan for the red areas before you click on an enemy, since staying out of them is what keeps you alive in Survival Mode.
Look at which enemies are coming and deal with them in a steady order so you are not caught between two threats.
Pick up the weapons that drop when you defeat enemies, and notice which ones you are getting so you can use them when they matter most.
Save your gems for the Equipment Store when you have enough, since equipment raises your overall abilities for later runs.
Stay calm during busy moments, because rushing clicks often leads to walking into a red area.
faq: What is the goal of Stickman The Flash?
The goal in Survival Mode is to last as long as you can by dodging red areas and killing the enemies that come at you.
How do I control the game?
You play by clicking the mouse or tapping the screen.

brazil-cup-2014.intro: Brazil Cup 2014 mixes soccer with pinball. You move through qualifiers and knockout rounds while several balls are in play at once, so quick reflexes matter.
tips: Keep your eyes moving across the whole field rather than fixing on one ball, since several can be in play at the same time.
Deal first with the ball that is closest to going out of play, and only then turn to the others.
Use the qualifier rounds to get comfortable with how the balls move before the tougher knockout rounds begin.
Stay calm when the field gets busy. Quick, steady reactions usually work better than rushed ones.
Think of each round as a chance to build up your reflexes, so you are ready for the pressure of the knockouts.
faq: What is the goal of Brazil Cup 2014?
Get through the qualifiers and knockout rounds to win the tournament and make your name in football history.
What makes the game hard to play?
Multiple balls can be on the field at once, so you need to track several of them and react quickly.

bricks-breaker.intro: Bricks Breaker is a puzzle game where you aim and launch balls to knock down rows of bricks. Clear every brick in a level before the bricks reach the bottom of the screen.
tips: Before each shot, look at the whole layout and choose an aim angle that can hit several bricks, since the goal is to break as many as possible.
Bricks are removed when their score reaches 0, so focus your shots on the lowest-numbered bricks first to clear them faster.
Pay attention to the bottom of the screen and clear the rows closest to it first, because bricks that reach the bottom end the run.
Use the slider when you want finer control over the launch direction, and click directly when a clear straight line is available.
With over 3000 levels, take a short break between sessions and come back fresh, as careful aiming is easier when you are relaxed.
faq: What is the main goal of Bricks Breaker?
Your goal is to clear all the bricks in each level by launching balls at them. You must remove every brick before they reach the bottom of the screen.
How do I aim and launch the balls?
Click in the direction you want the balls to travel, or use the slider to set the angle. Each launch sends the balls out along that path.

feed-them-all.intro: Feed Them All! is a fast arcade shooter where you run around an arena, fire fruit at hungry monsters, and dodge attacks. Each level ends with a boss fight you need to survive.
tips: Keep moving rather than standing still, since enemies attack from different directions and staying in one place makes you an easy target.
Dodge incoming attacks first and aim second, so you stay alive long enough to land your fruit shots.
Use the joystick smoothly, whether with WASD or arrow keys on desktop or a touch drag on mobile, so you can change direction quickly when a threat appears.
Before a boss fight, look at where it moves and fires from, then pick a path around the arena that keeps you out of its line of attack.
Clear the smaller monsters in each level as you go, so you are not overwhelmed when the boss arrives.
faq: What is the goal of Feed Them All!?
Shoot fruit to feed the hungry monsters, defeat all enemies, and survive the boss fights to finish each level.
How do I move my character?
On desktop, use WASD or the arrow keys, or use the on-screen joystick with the mouse. On mobile, touch and drag the on-screen joystick.

blob-man-run.intro: Blob Man Run is a hypercasual runner where you swipe to move your blob through levels. Collect diamonds and pick the right doors to grow stronger before facing the boss.
tips: Grab diamonds whenever you can do it without a risky detour, since they are part of your path to becoming stronger.
Pay attention to the numbers on the doors before you pass through them, and choose the one that helps your blob grow more.
Keep your swipes smooth and early so you can switch lanes or sides ahead of obstacles instead of reacting at the last second.
Build your strength steadily through each level, because the description links a stronger blob to an easier boss fight.
If a level gets hard, replay it and focus on learning where the obstacles and doors appear so you can plan your route.
faq: What is the goal of Blob Man Run?
Get through each level by collecting diamonds and choosing the right doors, then beat the boss at the end.
How do I control my blob?
Swipe to move. The game uses swipe controls only, as stated in the instructions.

muscle-run-io.intro: Muscle Run io is a sports race where you compete against quirky opponents. Bulking up is central to the game, so building your strength is part of getting to the finish line.
tips: Collect gains whenever you can, since building muscle is central to how you race.
Keep an eye on the obstacles ahead so you can plan your route rather than running into them at full speed.
Watch how your opponents are moving and adjust your pace to stay competitive for the whole race.
Think of your muscle power as your steering margin: the stronger you are, the smoother you can push through the course.
Pace your strength instead of spending it all early, so you still have power left for the final stretch to the finish line.
faq: What is the goal of Muscle Run io?
Your goal is to race against your opponents and reach the finish line first. Bulking up and collecting gains help you storm toward victory.
How do I get stronger during a race?
Collect gains along the course to build up your muscles. The game describes muscle power as the key to a smooth race.

ocean-pop.intro: Ocean Pop is a bubble-popping puzzle game set underwater. Match colored bubbles with your mouse to reach each level's target.
tips: Look for groups of same-colored bubbles that touch each other, since popping a larger cluster clears more of the board in one move.
Pay attention to how the bubbles drift and bounce before you shoot, because the cluster you aim at may move out of position.
Watch for chain reactions after each pop, and aim so that one shot can set off several groups in a row.
Save your powerups for moments when the board is crowded or the target is hard to reach, rather than using them right away.
Check the level target before each shot so you can decide whether to clear the board or focus on the goal.
faq: What is the goal of Ocean Pop?
Your goal is to reach the target shown for each level by popping matched colored bubbles with the mouse.
How do I pop bubbles?
Click or aim with the mouse to pop groups of bubbles that share the same color.

sky-golf.intro: Sky Golf is a physics puzzle where you rotate a structure of flat platforms so gravity rolls a golf ball to the hole. Each level requires a specific sequence of rotations to reach the goal.
tips: Before you rotate, picture which way gravity will pull the ball and where it will roll next.
Hold the rotation control in short presses and watch the ball's response before adding more rotation.
Plan the whole route before moving, since a rotation that helps at one gap may send the ball off course later.
Use rotations to build speed on a downhill section, then tilt the platforms back to slow or redirect the ball before a gap or obstacle.
If the ball rolls into a dead end, think about which earlier rotation put it there and reverse that move rather than guessing.
faq: What is the goal in Sky Golf?
Guide the golf ball from the starting point to the hole by rotating the platforms so the ball rolls across them and drops into the goal.
How do I move the ball?
You do not move the ball directly. Rotate the whole platform structure clockwise or anti-clockwise, and gravity makes the ball roll.

reckless-roller-fun-park.intro: Reckless Roller Fun Park is a driving action game where you steer a roller that carries people to their destinations. Speed control and careful driving are key to finishing each trip without crashing.
tips: Ease off the speed before sharp turns or dips, since going too fast is the most likely way to crash.
Build up speed only on straight, clear stretches so you can slow down quickly if something ahead looks dangerous.
Use the camera view changes to check the path ahead before you commit to a fast section.
Keep an eye on your passengers' goal and plan your route toward the destination rather than rushing in a straight line.
Practice adjusting your speed in small steps, because large sudden changes make the roller harder to control.
faq: What is the main goal in Reckless Roller Fun Park?
Your job is to carry people to their destination with your roller. You need to get them there without crashing.
How do I control the roller's speed?
Use the mouse to add speed. To slow down, reduce your speed so you can take turns and avoid crashes safely.

millionaire-factory.intro: Millionaire Factory is a clicker game where you tap a large Metal button, turn Metal into Money, and grow a factory empire with upgrades, robots and extra factories.
tips: Keep tapping the Metal button early on, since Metal is your main income and everything else depends on it.
Convert Metals to Money regularly so you have cash ready for upgrades and automation systems.
Buy upgrades that increase Metal per tap first, because they make every later tap more valuable.
Add automation such as the Basic Auto Robot early, since it produces passive income every 5 seconds while you do other things.
Use your factories to build passive income, and remember you can add up to three more to the one you start with.
faq: What is the main goal of Millionaire Factory?
The goal is to grow your fortune by collecting Metal, converting it into Money, and investing in upgrades to build a factory empire.
How do I earn money in the game?
Tap the giant Metal button to gather Metal, then convert the Metal into Money at the rate shown, such as 10 Metals for 1 Money.

space-craft-ship-war.intro: Space Craft: Ship War is a 3D space battle game where you pilot a cubic ship, add modules, and destroy enemy ships. Your ship grows stronger as you collect parts and upgrade between levels.
tips: Grab modules and weapons early, since your ship's strength depends on what you add to it. Pick up anything you pass near in the opening levels.
Mix melee and ranged weapons so you can handle both close and distant enemies instead of relying on one style.
Spend your upgrades on the stats that match your current build, and check them after each level before choosing.
Keep moving with WASD or swipes rather than sitting still, because enemies also grow stronger and waiting makes fights harder.
Try different module and weapon combinations across runs to see which builds suit your play style best.
faq: What is the goal of Space Craft: Ship War?
The goal is to destroy enemy ships by collecting modules, upgrading your ship, and surviving longer than the other ships.
How do I control my ship?
On PC, use the WASD keys to move. On mobile devices, use swipes to control movement.

unreal-descent-2-race.intro: Unreal Descent 2: Race is a high-speed arcade racing game where you compete through extreme downhill descents. Steer, brake, and use nitro to be the first to reach the finish line.
tips: Ease off the gas and tap brake before tight turns, since staying in control matters more than top speed.
Save nitro for stretches where you can keep a straight line, so the boost is not wasted in a bend.
Press F to change the camera view and pick whichever angle lets you read the track ahead best.
Watch the road several turns ahead rather than just the next bend, so you can react early.
On a phone, get used to the on-screen steering wheel and buttons, and check the game settings if you need to switch the control mode.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Your goal is to reach the finish line first in each descent. Speed and reaction decide the winner.
Which keys control the car on PC?
Use W or the up arrow to gas, S or the down arrow to brake, A or the left arrow to turn left, and D or the right arrow to turn right.

mountain-bike-challenge.intro: Mountain Bike Challenge is a physics-driven biking game where you ride rugged mountain trails against the clock. Success depends on balancing speed with precision over changing terrain.
tips: Start each run by testing how the bike responds to the terrain before pushing for top speed. Learning the handling early makes later obstacles easier to read.
Ease off before rough or steep sections instead of arriving at full speed. Keeping control matters more than a fast entry.
Use your ride to focus on one technique at a time, such as clean landings or smooth turns. Small improvements add up when you are racing the clock.
Watch how the terrain changes ahead and plan your line a few obstacles in advance. Reacting late is the most common cause of crashes.
Replay a trail after a failed attempt and note exactly where you lost time or balance. Targeting that single spot often gives the biggest gain on the next run.
faq: What is the main goal in Mountain Bike Challenge?
You ride down rugged mountain trails, overcoming obstacles while racing the clock. The aim is to finish each course as well as you can.
How does the physics affect my ride?
The game is physics-driven, so your bike's momentum, balance and landings all affect how it moves. Controlling speed carefully helps you stay upright.

hazard-pay.intro: Hazard Pay is a trap-filled platformer in a dangerous factory, where floors vanish and spikes appear right where you land. Pick one of three workers and clear 60 shifts.
tips: Pick the worker whose ability fits the level's problem: Cinder for walls, Pip for extra height in mid-air, or Rivet when you need to spot hidden traps.
Do not trust ground that looks safe. The game warns that the safest-looking route is often the trap, so check where you are heading before committing.
Use the hold-to-jump control to adjust your height precisely, since a short tap and a full jump can land you in very different spots.
Use Down or S to drop through thin platforms when a route calls for it instead of jumping into an unknown space.
Press R to restart quickly after a trap catches you, and use Esc to pause if you need a moment to plan your next move.
faq: How do I get through a thin platform?
Press Down or S to drop through thin platforms.
What does holding the jump button do?
Holding Space, W, Up or Z makes you jump higher than a quick tap.

pawky.intro: Pawky is a fast platform challenge where you guide an energetic creature through changing landscapes. Timing and quick reactions matter as platforms shift and obstacles appear.
tips: Watch the platforms for a moment before you commit, since they shift unpredictably and a short pause can show you the pattern.
Focus on timing rather than speed alone. Moving too early or too late is the most common way to miss a landing.
Scan a few steps ahead of your creature so you can spot obstacles early and plan a route around them.
Stay calm after a mistake and reset your focus quickly, because the game rewards steady, quick thinking over rushed moves.
Practice the rhythm of each new landscape, as learning how the platforms move will make later sections feel more manageable.
faq: What is the main goal in Pawky?
You guide an energetic creature across platforms while dodging obstacles, using timing and quick thinking to keep moving through the landscapes.
What makes Pawky challenging?
The platforms shift unpredictably, so you need sharp reflexes and good timing to navigate safely through each section.

boom-stick-bazooka-2-puzzles.intro: Boom Stick Bazooka 2 is a shooting game where you aim a bazooka at towers holding black stickmen. You have three shots per level to clear the enemies before they hit back.
tips: Look for barrels near the towers before you fire, since an explosion next to a tower can take out enemies faster than a direct hit.
Shoot early rather than waiting, because enemies in some towers will fire at you if you delay and you only have 3 lives.
Plan your first shot carefully, since each level gives you only 3 shots and a wasted one can make the level harder to finish.
Use heavy objects in the scene to knock stickmen down when a direct line of fire is blocked.
Spend coins on a new weapon or skin only after you have a sense of which weapon handles the towers you struggle with most.
faq: What is the goal of Boom Stick Bazooka 2?
The goal is to eliminate all enemies in each level by destroying the towers and hitting the stickmen, using the 3 shots your bazooka gives you.
How do I aim and shoot?
Use the mouse to aim and click to shoot. Watch your aim closely, because each level only gives you three attempts.

ice-and-fire-twins.intro: Ice And Fire Twins is a 3D arcade shooter where you use ice and fire skills to defeat opponents. The game uses a tap-and-slide control scheme and an elimination shooting mode.
tips: Start by learning how the tap-and-slide controls respond before you focus on enemies. Small, steady movements usually give you more control than fast swipes.
Try both your ice and fire skills early on to see how each one feels against different opponents. Knowing their strengths will help you choose faster in a fight.
Keep moving rather than standing still, since the elimination shooting mode is built around freely going after enemies. Staying in one spot makes you an easier target.
Watch where your shots land and adjust your aim after each attempt. Paying attention to the shooting feel will help you get more eliminations over time.
Take short breaks if the action gets hectic. Coming back with a clear head makes it easier to plan your next move.
faq: What is the goal of Ice And Fire Twins?
The goal is to defeat your opponents using your special ice and fire skills. The elimination shooting mode lets you take out enemies as you play.
How do I control the game?
Tap and slide to play. Tapping and sliding are the only controls listed for this game.

camel-destroyer.intro: Camel Destroyer is an open city sandbox where you play as a camel looking for adventures. You can explore, chat with people, find animals, and cause chaos with weapons and vehicles.
tips: Use the Shift key to accelerate when you are driving, so you can cover the city faster.
Press E to pick up items, and look for hidden machines, guns, cannons, and grenades before you start causing destruction.
Jump with Space to get around the city and reach places on foot before you try a vehicle.
Try different animals and vehicles, such as the turtle, cow, cars, and helicopter, to see how each one changes the way you explore.
On mobile, get comfortable with the joystick for movement before you use the pop-up buttons for attacks and actions.
faq: How do I shoot a weapon?
Press the F key on desktop, which is used for both attacking and shooting a weapon.
How do I pick up an item?
Stand near the item and press E to pick it up.

drift-king-racing-multiplayer.intro: Drift King Racing Multiplayer is a drift racing game where you use the arrow keys to slide through sharp corners on neon-lit tracks. You compete in real-time against players around the world and earn points for perfect drifts.
tips: Treat every sharp corner as a chance to score, since points come from perfect drifts rather than just finishing first. Slow down enough to keep your slide controlled.
Take time to learn each city's tracks, because corner shapes change from one to the next. Knowing where the sharp bends are helps you plan your drifts before you reach them.
Upgrade and customize your car as you progress, and pick a setup that suits how you like to drift. Street cars and pro-tuned machines handle differently, so try a few before settling on one.
Keep your speed up between corners so you can enter each drift with momentum. A smooth, steady line usually scores better than rushing and losing control.
Challenge friends and check the leaderboard regularly to see where your scores stand. Comparing your results with others shows which parts of your drifting need work.
faq: How do I win in Drift King Racing Multiplayer?
Victory depends on precision, style, and speed, and you earn points for perfect drifts. Climbing the leaderboard is how you measure your progress against other players.
What controls do I use to drive?
Use the arrow keys to move your car. Practice steering through corners on different tracks to get a feel for how your car slides.

crazy-supercars-stunt-2022.intro: Crazy SuperCars Stunt 2022 is a driving and parking game with realistic handling, several vehicle types, and large city maps. You control your car with the WASD keys.
tips: Try the inside view early on so you can judge distances and gaps around the car more accurately.
Watch the parking sensors and signs closely before each manoeuvre, since they are there to help you park.
Test a few different vehicles, from hatchbacks and sedans to SUVs and supercars, to find which one feels easiest for you to control.
Drive slowly and carefully through traffic and the parking garage to avoid collisions.
Use the real sound effects as an extra cue, and keep your inputs smooth with WASD rather than tapping hard.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
The game focuses on parking your car well, as the description puts it, to show that you are a Parking Master. Park carefully in each situation and avoid accidents in traffic and the garage.
Which keys control the car?
You drive by pressing the W, A, S and D keys.

save-king.intro: Save King is a pull-the-pin rescue puzzle where you protect the King and his royal family. Each level is a single tricky situation that you solve by pulling pins in the right order.
tips: Study the full puzzle before pulling anything. Note where the King, Queen, Princess, enemies, treasure, and traps are so you know what each pin protects.
Plan the order of pins before you act. Ask which pin needs to come out first to create a safe path, since one wrong pull can ruin the level.
Deal with the danger closest to the royal family first. Enemies and traps near the King are the most urgent threats to stop.
Before each pull, think about what the pin will release. Moving slowly and thinking through each step is safer than guessing.
Collect treasure when it does not put the King at risk. Rewards from finished levels are what you use to rebuild and upgrade your castle.
faq: What is the main goal in Save King?
Your main job is to pull the pins in the correct order to create a safe path for the King and stop the danger around him.
What happens if I pull the wrong pin?
One wrong pin can ruin the level, so it pays to check each pin's effect before pulling it.

swarmfront.intro: Swarmfront is an arcade crowd-runner where you lead a growing medieval army through changing biomes. Steer your squad through recruitment gates, dodge hazards, and pick upgrades to face bosses.
tips: Aim for recruitment gates when your squad is still small, since each gate adds to your forces and makes it easier to absorb later hits.
Look ahead before each obstacle and start steering early so you are not forced into a last-second move that splits your army.
Choose upgrades based on what you are struggling with, such as surviving hazards or handling a boss, rather than picking the same option every time.
Expect a boss every fifth level and treat it as a checkpoint: enter it with your strongest squad and the abilities you have unlocked.
Between encounters, take a moment to review your options before committing, because the upgrade you pick now shapes how the next biome feels.
faq: What is the main goal in Swarmfront?
Your goal is to lead your army through five biomes, grow your forces, and survive the escalating campaign, including the bosses that appear every fifth level.
How do I steer my army?
On desktop, use the mouse or the directional controls shown in the game to move left and right. On mobile, swipe left or right to steer.

astro-digger.intro: Astro Digger is a space adventure about digging through an alien landscape to collect gold and minerals. You use teleportation and bombs to reach your treasure while dealing with distractions.
tips: Look at the whole landscape before you start digging so you can plan a route to the gold and minerals that avoids unnecessary detours.
Think about where you place each bomb before you use it, since a well-placed bomb can open a path or clear an obstacle while a poorly placed one can block your way.
Save teleportation for moments when it gets you to a valuable spot or out of a tricky area, rather than using it on short trips you could walk.
Keep an eye on distractions and move with purpose, so that a single detour does not pull you away from your main targets.
Replay the early parts of the level to learn how the terrain is laid out, which will help you spot shortcuts and safe digging paths on later attempts.
faq: What is the main goal in Astro Digger?
Your goal is to collect gold and minerals across the alien landscape while getting past the distractions in your way.
How do bombs help me play better?
Bombs can be placed strategically to open paths or deal with obstacles, so think about their position before you set them off.

jelly-run-in-2048.intro: Jelly Run in 2048 mixes the 2048 number-merging puzzle with a parkour course. You steer a flexible jelly block through animated terrain, merging identical tiles while avoiding spines and maces.
tips: Plan your swipes a few moves ahead so the tiles you merge also keep your jelly block clear of the spines and maces.
Merge identical tiles early and often, since building up the board is what drives you toward 2048.
Watch the terrain before each move, because the hazards are the biggest threat to your run.
Keep your reactions quick when a hazard appears, but avoid rushed swipes that leave tiles in awkward spots.
Pay attention to which quirky blocks you unlock, and experiment with them to see how they change your approach.
faq: What is the goal of Jelly Run in 2048?
The goal is to reach 2048 by merging identical tiles while getting your jelly block through each vibrant level.
How do I move in the game?
You control the jelly block with strategic swipes, so plan each swipe based on both the tiles and the terrain ahead.

hide-heist.intro: Hide Heist is a stealth action game where you switch between a smart thief and a strong thief to sneak into offices and banks, complete the heist, and get out unseen. Plan each move before you act.
tips: Use the smart character for locks and hacking systems, and the strong character for guards and obstacles. Think about which one fits each obstacle before you move.
Scout the room before acting. Note where guards are and how they move so you can pick a safe moment to advance.
Try to keep both characters working together. Clear the path with one, then bring the other through while the area is quiet.
Stay out of sight as much as you can. Being spotted is the main way to lose a run, so slow down when a guard is near.
Plan your escape route early. Know where you need to end up so you are not forced to improvise under pressure.
faq: What is the main goal of Hide Heist?
Sneak into a secure office or bank, complete the heist, and escape without being detected.
How do I control the characters?
Use the A, S, D and W keys on a keyboard, or left click with a mouse. On a touch screen, touch and drag.

break-the-car-completely.intro: Break The Car Completely is a crash test driving game where you try to reach the finish line along a highway littered with obstacles. Any collision destroys your car, so careful, precise driving is essential.
tips: Treat every obstacle as a hazard, since even a small bump ends the run. Ease off and line up your path before you get close to anything.
Make small, steady steering adjustments instead of sharp turns. Sudden movements are the fastest way to hit something.
Watch the road ahead rather than your car alone. Spotting obstacles early gives you more time to plan a safe route.
Pay attention to how your car responds to the realistic physics. Learning how it drifts and reacts will help you keep control.
If your car falls apart, don't get discouraged. Restart the route and use what you learned from the previous attempt to go a little farther.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Your goal is to drive along the highway and reach the finish line, getting as far as possible without crashing.
What ends a run?
Any collision, even a small one, instantly destroys your car and ends the attempt.

cosplay-gamer-girls.intro: Cosplay Gamer Girls is a dress-up game where you help two best friends build complete video game cosplay looks for a summer festival. You style makeup, hair, clothing and accessories to match their favorite game heroes and princesses.
tips: Start with the hair or wig, since it sets the overall character silhouette before you choose the rest of the look.
Pick makeup that matches the character's theme, then keep the outfit colors in the same palette so the look feels coordinated.
Choose shoes and accessories last to finish the costume and check that they suit the outfit's style.
Try a few different combinations before deciding, because changing one item at a time makes it easier to see what works best.
When you are happy with the look, save it as a PNG image so you can keep a copy of your final cosplay.
faq: What is the goal of Cosplay Gamer Girls?
Your goal is to create a complete cosplay look based on a computer game, covering makeup, hairstyle or wig, clothing, shoes, accessories and jewelry.
How do I control the game?
On a computer, use the mouse to click items and options. On a touchscreen, simply tap to make your choices.

heroes-of-arena.intro: Heroes of Arena is an action game where you build a hero, fight in the arena, and team up with friends in a guild. Your aim is to become the strongest fighter and lead your guild through boss raids.
tips: Pick one way of developing your character early and focus your skill and ability upgrades on it, so your hero stays strong in both arena fights and raids.
Join or form a guild quickly. Raids on bosses are easier when several players coordinate, and your guild is also part of clan wars.
Get a pet and bring it along on adventures and exploration. Pets are there to help you in battles, so use them as part of your regular routine.
Work through the story chapters alongside arena fights. Chapter progress and arena results both help you grow stronger, so balance your time between them.
Play with friends when you can. The game is built around teams, so tackling tough enemies together is usually more rewarding than going solo.
faq: What is the main goal of Heroes of Arena?
Your goal is to become the strongest fighter in the arena, build a strong guild, and lead it into raids on bosses. You can also explore with a pet and move through the chapters.
How do I get stronger in the game?
Pump up your character and improve your skills and abilities. Choosing a consistent development path helps you get the most out of each upgrade.

a-day-with-masha-and-the-bear-fun-togeth.intro: Spend a full day with Masha and her friends in this cute girls' adventure. You can try more than 20 activities, from riding a bike and fishing to making cakes and practicing letters.
tips: Try a few different activities to find the ones you enjoy most, since the game offers more than 20 to explore.
When you play the time-telling or adding activities, take your time and check your answer before moving on.
For tracing letters, go slowly and follow the lines carefully to get the most practice from it.
Mix the fun activities, like riding a bike or looking for animals, with the learning ones so each session stays varied.
Use the recycling and checkers activities as a chance to think about what you are doing before you tap or click.
faq: How do I play this game?
Tap or click on the activities and follow what each one shows you. The instructions for this game are simply to tap or click.
What kinds of activities are included?
You can ride a bike, look for animals, go fishing, play checkers, and make cakes. There are also learning activities for telling time, adding, tracing letters, and recycling.

pizza-maker-food-cooking-games.intro: Pizza Maker is a cooking game where you build pizzas in a busy kitchen. You pick ingredients to match each customer's preferences and serve orders quickly to earn high scores.
tips: Read each customer's preferences before you start adding toppings, so you do not have to remove ingredients later.
Use drag-and-drop to place ingredients one at a time, and check the pizza against the order before you serve it.
Work steadily rather than rushing. Speed matters for serving, but a wrong pizza will cost you more time than a careful one.
Notice which ingredients come up again and again in orders, and keep them in mind when you choose toppings.
Pay attention to the dynamic challenges as they appear, and adjust your order handling to match them.
faq: What is the main goal of Pizza Maker?
Your goal is to craft pizzas that match customer preferences, serve them quickly, and earn top scores.
How do I add ingredients to a pizza?
Select ingredients and drag them onto the pizza. The game is built around drag-and-drop mechanics.

ninja-platformer-rage.intro: Ninja Platformer Rage is a fast arcade platformer with 50 short, trap-filled levels. Use your shadow throws and teleports to get through each course, and race for your best time.
tips: Throw your shadow before a risky jump so you have a landing point to teleport to if you need to recover.
Treat each death as information. Note exactly where you were hit and change your timing or route on the next attempt.
Practice the double-jump timing on a safe stretch before trying it over traps, since small timing errors are the most common cause of falls.
Once you can clear a level safely, go back and focus on a cleaner route to improve your best time.
Keep your inputs calm and short. Rushing with repeated presses often causes missed jumps in precise sections.
faq: What is the goal of Ninja Platformer Rage?
Get through each of the 50 levels by surviving the traps and platforming challenges. You can also race for a faster best time on each one.
How do I throw my shadow and teleport?
On PC, press Shift to throw your shadow and double-press Shift to teleport to it. On mobile, use the Shadow button to throw and the Dash button to teleport.

weapon-survivor.intro: Weapon Survivor is an arcade shooter where you are trapped on a battlefield full of enemies. You fight your way out by shooting and merging weapons to build stronger attacks.
tips: Start by shooting steadily to see which weapons you can combine, since merging is the core way to get stronger.
Pay attention to which weapon combinations give you the most bullets on screen, as this helps you clear groups of enemies faster.
Keep moving and do not stay in one place for too long, so enemies have a harder time surrounding you.
Focus on the enemies closest to you first, because they are the most immediate threat to your survival.
Play in short sessions at first to learn the rhythm of the waves and get a feel for which weapon mixes work best for you.
faq: How do I play Weapon Survivor?
Use mouse clicks or taps to shoot and play. Your goal is to survive the battlefield by merging weapons to enhance your combat abilities.
How do I get stronger during a run?
Merge different weapons together to improve your combat abilities. Stronger weapons create more powerful bulletstorms against enemies.

master-craft.intro: Master Craft is a 3D action game set in an endless, blocky world. You survive in the landscape and build structures out of blocks.
tips: Start by moving around and looking at your surroundings before you commit to a build, so you can pick a spot that suits your plans.
Use WASD to move steadily and the mouse to aim, and practice both until they feel natural before you try to build or survive longer.
Plan simple shapes like a small house or wall first, then add detail once you are comfortable placing blocks.
Since the world is endless, pick a direction and explore it in stages so you always know how to find your way back to your builds.
Take breaks to look over what you have made, and adjust your next build to keep the structures balanced and easy to read.
faq: What is the main goal of Master Craft?
The game asks you to survive in an endless blocky world and build buildings with blocks. There is no fixed finish line, so you play at your own pace.
Which controls do I need to know?
Use the mouse to look around and WASD keys to move. These are the only controls listed for the game.

fallingman-io.intro: Fallingman.io is a multiplayer race to the ground, where you steer through obstacle courses at high speed while rivals try to get there first. Expect quick, unpredictable rounds.
tips: Watch the obstacles ahead rather than only the one directly below you, so you have time to adjust your path.
Keep your movements small and steady. The controls are described as simple, so precise, calm inputs usually work better than frantic ones.
Keep an eye on nearby rivals and move away from crowded areas when a collision could slow you down.
Expect the course to change unpredictably, and stay ready to adapt your route instead of sticking to one plan.
Play a few rounds to learn how your character responds to speed before aiming for the fastest finish.
faq: What is the goal of Fallingman.io?
The goal is to reach the ground before other players in a race through obstacle courses.
How do I control my falling character?
The game uses simple controls, so the best approach is to test them in a few early rounds until your movements feel natural.

slime-planet-eater.intro: Roll a translucent slime across a planet and swallow everything in your path, growing bigger until even the skyscrapers become snacks. Nothing can fail, so you can play at your own pace.
tips: Start with the small things near you, like grass and flowers. Each bite adds mass, and more mass lets you reach bigger objects.
Watch the larger objects around you. When something is still too big, steer around it and come back once you have grown.
Plan a path that clears a section in one sweep. Circling back and forth leaves small items behind that you could have eaten on the way.
Use the camera pull-back as a signal. When the view zooms out, the edge of what you can eat has moved outward, so look for new targets.
If you want to see your progress, change your hats, trails or skins in the wardrobe under the gear button. They do not affect how you play.
faq: How do I steer my slime?
On a computer, hold the left mouse button and drag toward where you want to go, or use WASD or the arrow keys. On a touchscreen, touch and drag, and the slime will follow your finger.
Can I lose in this game?
No. There are no timers, enemies or currency, and large objects simply push you aside rather than stopping you.

food-run-and-battle.intro: Food: Run and Battle is a 3D runner where you guide your team along colorful tracks, gathering food to grow stronger before the final clash. Plan your route carefully to keep your supplies high until the finish.
tips: Look ahead before each stretch of track so you can pick the safest lane before you reach a trap or obstacle.
Grab food when it is on your path, but do not steer into danger just to collect a few extra portions.
Keep your team's strength in mind: a bigger reserve gives you more to work with in the finish-line battle.
Make small, steady moves rather than sharp swerves, so you stay in control when several things come at once.
Save your focus for the final clash, since defeating rivals there is needed to complete the level.
faq: What is the main goal of Food: Run and Battle?

Guide your characters along the track, collect food to increase your team's strength, avoid traps, and reach the finish with the largest reserve possible. Then defeat your rivals in the final clash to complete the level.
How do I move my characters on desktop?
Use WASD or the arrow keys. You can also hold the left mouse button and move the pointer in the direction you want to go.

stalker-2033-the-path-of-the-survivor.intro: Stalker 2033 is a first-person action shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world where a mysterious phenomenon has turned people into the living dead. You explore large locations, gather weapons and resources, and piece together the story bit by bit.
tips: Search areas thoroughly for resources, since you need them to create equipment that helps you survive.
Keep your movement in mind: use running with LSHIFT to cover ground quickly, then slow down with WASD when you need more control in a fight.
Pick your battles carefully, because the enemies vary and you should not assume every encounter is the same.
Talk to the few survivors you meet, as they can help you learn more about what is happening in this world.
Collect information as you go, since the story is revealed gradually and connecting clues is how you learn the nature of the disaster.
faq: What is the main goal of Stalker 2033?
You need to survive in a dangerous new world while also uncovering the secrets behind the catastrophe. Collecting information step by step is how the story moves forward.
How do I move and jump?
Use WASD to move, hold LSHIFT to switch to running, and press SPACE to jump. The left mouse button is also part of the controls.

top-shootout-the-pirate-ship.intro: Top Shootout: The Pirate Ship is a 3D arcade shooter where you fire a cannon at pirates on a ship in the Caribbean Sea. Your aim is to defeat the pirates and build up as high a score as you can.
tips: Wait for your cannon to recharge before each shot so you are never caught with an empty cannon when a new pirate appears.
Use the recharge time to watch where pirates are moving so you can pick your next target more carefully.
Focus on the pirates first, since defeating them is the main way the game is played and scored.
Try short, steady play sessions and note which shots worked well, so you can build a routine that keeps your score climbing.
If you are chasing a high score, keep your rhythm consistent rather than rushing, since tapping too early just leaves you waiting on the recharge.
faq: How do I shoot in Top Shootout: The Pirate Ship?
Click or tap to fire the cannon. The same click or tap is used to recharge the cannon after each shot.
What is the goal of the game?
Your goal is to defeat all the pirates on the ship and get as many points as you can.

stacky-bird.intro: Stacky Bird is an animal stacking game where you guide a bird that builds egg towers while soaring over hurdles. Timing and skill decide how high your stack can climb.
tips: Watch the gap ahead before each tap, since your timing matters more than speed. Small, steady taps are easier to control than rapid ones.
Pay attention to how each tap changes your height, and adjust before you reach a hurdle rather than after. Early corrections keep the tower steadier.
Use the landscape and birdhouse scenery as visual markers for where your bird is in the level. This helps you judge distance to the next obstacle.
Take short breaks between attempts to reset your focus. Many missed hurdles come from rushing the next run.
Aim to beat your own previous height instead of chasing a perfect run. Steady progress is a good way to learn the timing.
faq: What is the main goal in Stacky Bird?
Guide the bird while it builds an egg tower and soars over hurdles to get as high as possible. The game asks how high you can go.
How do I control the bird?
Each tap fuels the bird's ascent, so tapping at the right moments keeps it moving upward. Timing your taps is the key skill.

bounce-dunk-frvr.intro: Bounce Dunk Frvr is a basketball game built around a physics-based bounce and dunking. You control the action with mouse clicks or taps while dodging obstacles and sharing the court with other dribblers.
tips: Watch how the ball bounces before each move, since the physics engine makes the rebound feel real and timing matters.
Keep an eye on the other players dribbling on the court so you can plan a route that doesn't run into them.
Treat the obstacles in the middle as things to avoid or clear, because breaking them does not raise your score.
Focus on your dunk attempts instead of chasing obstacles, since dunking is the main fun of the game.
Make short, deliberate clicks or taps rather than rapid ones, so you stay in control of each bounce.
faq: What is the goal of Bounce Dunk Frvr?
The goal is to bounce your basketball and dunk it while avoiding getting blocked by the obstacles and other players on the court.
How do I control the game?
You play with mouse clicks or taps only, so there are no other controls to learn.

team-men.intro: Team Men is a co-op runner where you steer a character along roads, gathering teammates of the same color to build a larger army. Reach the finish line with the strongest army and the highest score you can.
tips: Pick your route early by scanning the road ahead for teammates that match your color, so you can steer toward them before you run past them.
Keep your army the same color when you can, since the goal is to gather teammates of one color rather than a mix.
Make small, steady left and right movements instead of sharp swings, which makes it easier to collect several teammates in a row.
Spend the points you earn to strengthen your army, and choose upgrades that help you keep collecting as the road gets longer.
Plan for the finish line by checking how large your army is partway through, so you still have time to adjust your position for the best score.
faq: What is the main goal of Team Men?
Gather teammates of the same color on the roads, build a larger army, and reach the finish line with the highest score you can. Points can be used to strengthen your army.
How do I move my character?
On a computer, move the mouse left and right to steer. On a phone, use touch control to move left and right.

wormpocalypse.intro: Wormpocalypse is a retro platformer set in a post-apocalyptic world. You explore, fight mutated enemies, and uncover the story's dark secrets using a range of weapons.
tips: Watch how enemies move for a few seconds before engaging, since the game rewards quick reflexes and planned attacks over rushing in.
Try your different weapons on the same enemy to learn which ones work best, and switch to the one that suits the situation.
Treat each area as a puzzle of routes and hazards. Scan the layout before moving so you can plan a safe path.
Keep some resources in reserve for tougher challenges instead of spending everything on the first fights you meet.
Pay attention to the pixel art and sound cues, which can hint at danger ahead or at areas worth exploring.
faq: What is the goal of Wormpocalypse?
The description says you navigate a post-apocalyptic realm, survive, confront mutated adversaries, and uncover dark secrets as you work through the challenges.
Are there any instructions for the controls?
No separate instructions are provided for this game, so check any on-screen prompts or the start screen to learn the controls.

killer-io.intro: Killer.io is a multiplayer murder game set at a Halloween party. Move around the party, try to eliminate as many people as you can, and avoid getting caught.
tips: Move with the arrow keys or taps and keep an eye on who is nearby before you act. Staying aware of your surroundings helps you pick the right moment.
Hide bodies quickly after each kill so other guests are less likely to notice what happened. Do not linger near the scene.
Avoid repeating the same pattern in the same area, since this can draw attention to you. Vary where and when you strike.
Watch the other players' movements to spot anyone who seems to be following or watching you. Changing direction can help you lose them.
Focus on quality over speed: a careful kill that stays unseen is worth more than a rushed one that gets you caught.
faq: What is the main goal of Killer.io?
The goal is to kill as many people at the Halloween party as possible while trying not to get caught. Each kill should be followed by hiding the body.
How do I move my character?
Use the arrow keys on a keyboard, or tap the screen on touch devices. Movement is the only control listed for the game.

sky-ball-adventure-3d.intro: Sky Ball 3D is a fast 3D rolling game where you race a ball along floating sky tracks. Steer, jump gaps, dodge obstacles and reach the finish line.
tips: Use the brake (slow down) before sharp turns so you keep control of the ball instead of sliding off the track.
Save your jumps for gaps and obstacles. Jumping too early can leave you short of the next platform.
Watch the moving platforms for a few seconds to learn their rhythm before you commit to crossing them.
Aim for Boost Pads when you can, but keep an eye on what comes after them, since speed makes it harder to stop.
Pick up coins when it is safe to do so, since they help you unlock new balls and skins.
faq: What is the goal of Sky Ball 3D?
Race your ball through each sky track, avoid obstacles and traps, and reach the finish line.
How do I control the ball?
Use the left and right arrows to move, the up arrow to jump, and the down arrow to slow down or brake.

my-golf.intro: My Golf is a pixel-style golf game where precise aiming matters most. You play through varied landscapes, each with its own hole layout to master.
tips: Take a moment to study the whole hole before you swing, since aiming precisely is the key skill in this game.
Pay attention to how each landscape is shaped, because the terrain changes from hole to hole and should affect how you plan your shot.
Collect the stars you pass along the way, since they unlock new courses and golf balls.
Think about your strategy on every hole rather than swinging on instinct, as each hole is designed to reward a planned approach.
Stick with the simple controls and practice your aim on early holes so the timing and direction feel natural before you move on to harder ones.
faq: What is the main goal in My Golf?
Your goal is to get the ball into the hole on each course by aiming with precision and planning your strategy for every hole.
How do I unlock new courses?
You unlock new courses by gathering stars during play. Stars also unlock new golf balls.

walkers-attack.intro: Walkers Attack is a zombie survival shooter where you move through dangerous places, gather resources, and fight hordes. Completing missions unlocks new themed levels, each harder than the last.
tips: Since fire is automatic, spend your attention on movement. Choose where you stand so zombies approach from fewer directions.
Gather resources whenever it is safe to do so, since they are part of surviving the journey.
Watch for hordes building up and move before you get surrounded, rather than waiting to see how much damage you take.
Finish missions to unlock new levels, but try to understand the current level's pattern first, because the challenge rises quickly.
Think of each level as a new test. Experiment with your movement early so you know what works before the harder levels arrive.
faq: How is Walkers Attack played?
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps. Fire is automatic, so your main focus is strategic movement through each level.
How do I unlock new levels?
Complete missions to unlock new themed levels, which range from sci-fi to medieval and urban settings.

scary-granny-horror-maze-escape.intro: Scary Granny: Horror Maze Escape is a horror arcade game where you explore a creepy, twisting maze and look for the exit before Granny catches you. Move carefully and stay alert the whole time.
tips: Use the mouse to look around before you step into a new corridor, so you can spot a dead end or a turn ahead of time.
Keep your movement slow and steady while you explore, and save running for when you actually need to get away.
Pay attention to which paths you have already tried, since the maze is full of confusing routes that can loop you back.
When you hear or see signs that Granny is close, change direction early instead of waiting until she is nearby.
Take a moment to scan each corner before turning it, because the game is built around surprises hiding in tight spaces.
faq: What is the goal of Scary Granny: Horror Maze Escape?
Your goal is to find the exit of the haunted maze and escape before Granny finds you. You need to explore the corridors while avoiding her.
How do I move and look around?
Use W, A, S, D or the Arrow Keys to move, and use the mouse to look around. Hold Shift to run.

obby-mine-crasher.intro: Obby: Mine Crasher is an idle obby game where you hit anvils with a hammer, grow stronger, and smash stone walls. Each broken block earns cups you can spend on pets that make your hits hit harder.
tips: Keep hitting the anvil early on, since your strength is what raises your attack power and makes walls break faster.
Save your cups for pets once you have enough, because stronger pets speed up wall breaking and help you get further through the obby levels.
Check in on the daily rewards and the wheel of fortune regularly, as they are listed as ways to gain extra progress.
Keep an eye on the wall difficulty, since each broken wall gets tougher, so upgrading your power before pushing ahead can save time.
Use the jump and movement keys to get across the obby sections quickly, and keep moving forward as you progress.
faq: What is the main goal of Obby: Mine Crasher?
The goal is to hit the anvils, raise your strength, and break stone walls to go further through the obby levels. You also aim to earn cups, pets, and power along the way.
What do I get for breaking walls?
Each destroyed block gives you cups, which act as trophies. You can spend them on pets, which increase the impact of your hits on the anvils.

dentist-doctor-teeth-surgery-hospital.intro: Dentist Doctor Teeth Surgery Hospital is a colorful dental game where you run your own clinic, treat patients carefully, and grow your practice and reputation.
tips: Treat each patient with care and precision rather than rushing, since the game rewards a smooth, satisfying experience.
Keep an eye on several tasks at once, and focus first on whichever patient or job is closest to becoming a problem.
Use early patients to learn how the treatments play out, so you can work faster and more accurately later on.
Prioritize the patients and tasks that protect your reputation, because a good reputation is central to growing your practice.
Reinvest in your clinic as your practice expands so you can keep up with a growing number of patients.
faq: What is the goal of Dentist Doctor Teeth Surgery Hospital?
The goal is to manage your own dental clinic, treat patients well, and grow your practice while boosting your reputation.
How do I do well in this game?
Focus on careful, precise treatment and keep juggling your tasks so patients get a smooth experience. Protecting your reputation helps your clinic grow.

besties-chinese-new-year-celebration.intro: Help two best friends get ready for Chinese New Year by dressing them in traditional outfits, modern looks, and festive accessories. It is a relaxed dress-up game about color, tradition, and friendship.
tips: Try a traditional outfit and a modern look on the same friend to see which style suits the celebration best.
Choose the main outfit first, then add accessories that match its colors so the whole look feels coordinated.
Give both friends a related theme, such as matching colors or a shared style, to make their pair look connected.
Check each friend's full look before moving on, since changing one piece can change how the whole outfit fits together.
Explore every category of clothing and accessories, because the festive details are where the Lunar New Year theme comes through most.
faq: How do I play Besties Chinese New Year Celebration?
Use the left mouse button to click, or tap on a touchscreen, to choose outfits and accessories for the two friends. The game is built around dressing them up for the celebration.
What kinds of outfits can I choose?
You can pick beautiful traditional outfits, elegant modern looks, and festive accessories inspired by Chinese New Year celebrations.

clean-kitty.intro: Clean Kitty is a cozy physics puzzle about drawing lines to guide water from a tap into a tub. Each short level asks you to fill the tub using as little ink as possible.
tips: Before drawing, look at where the tap and tub are and picture the water's path. Your first line should set up the flow rather than fix a mistake later.
Remember that rubber ducks, soap bars, pipes and the tub start falling as soon as you finish a line. Draw with that movement in mind so nothing shifts out of place.
Use short, deliberate lines. Since ink is limited, one well-placed funnel or ramp often does more than several long strokes.
Keep an eye on the glowing red plates, since water touching them turns to steam. Shape your line so the water flows around them.
If a level has two taps, check that your lines can catch water from both before you start. Use the Hint button only after you have tried a plan yourself.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Fill the tub until the gauge beside it is full. The level is complete once the gauge is full.
How do I earn three stars?
Finish the level with as much ink left as you can. The more ink you have remaining, the more stars you receive, up to three.

brick-breaker-classic-arcade-fun.intro: Brick Breaker Classic Arcade Fun is a paddle-and-ball game where you bounce a ball to smash bricks across a series of levels. Each stage gets more exciting as you work toward clearing them all.
tips: Aim with the edge of your paddle rather than its center, since where the ball hits the paddle is the main way to control its angle.
Watch for power-ups as they fall and catch the ones you can reach without losing your paddle position.
Pay attention to the layout of bricks before each shot and look for gaps where the ball can bounce behind a wall of bricks.
Keep your paddle moving smoothly rather than in sudden jerks so you can react to the ball's path early.
Take your time on tricky spots and plan a few bounces ahead, because precision matters more than speed in later levels.
faq: What is the goal of Brick Breaker Classic Arcade Fun?
Your goal is to bounce the ball with your paddle and break all the bricks in each level. The game gets more exciting as the levels progress.
How do I control the paddle?
Move your paddle left and right to keep the ball in play and direct where it bounces. Check the in-game controls on screen for any additional options.

ambulance-driving-simulator.intro: Drive an ambulance through busy city streets in a race against time. Find the fastest route, weave through traffic, and keep control while you speed toward your next emergency.
tips: Scan the road several blocks ahead so you can pick a route before you need to turn.
Slow down before sharp corners and crowded intersections, then build speed again once the road opens up.
Keep an eye on traffic patterns and choose lanes that are moving, rather than sticking to one path.
Avoid sudden, large steering moves when you are fast, since small corrections keep the vehicle steady.
Treat each run as a chance to learn the city layout, so you can take shortcuts more confidently next time.
faq: What is the main goal in Ambulance Driving Simulator?
You race against time through city streets to get to emergencies, looking for the fastest route while staying in control.
How do I balance speed and control?
Push your speed on clear stretches, then ease off in traffic and on turns so you do not lose control of the vehicle.

car-racing.intro: Car Racing is a browser driving game where you weave through traffic on tracks that get faster as you go. Dodging collisions and keeping your speed up are the core challenges.
tips: Look a few car lengths ahead rather than just at your own car, so you can start steering around slower traffic early.
Make small, smooth steering moves instead of sharp swerves, which are easier to control at higher speeds.
Pay attention to gaps in traffic and try to move into them before you reach the car in front of you.
If you crash, restart the level and focus on the spot where you lost control, since later stages get harder.
Balance speed and caution: going faster helps only if you can still react to sudden changes in traffic.
faq: What is the goal of Car Racing?
Your goal is to weave through traffic and avoid collisions while progressing through increasingly challenging stages. Speed and strategy both matter.
What happens if I crash?
You can restart the level after a collision. Use the retry to learn the tricky part of the track before trying again.

pixzombies.intro: PixZombies is a fast arcade game where you tap to fend off waves of zombies that charge from every direction. Earn stars as the challenges escalate.
tips: Scan all sides of the screen before each wave arrives, since zombies can come from any direction.
Keep your taps quick and steady early on so you stay ahead of the horde instead of reacting late.
Watch where the next zombies are gathering and prioritize the closest threats first to avoid being overwhelmed.
Stay calm as the challenges escalate. Short breaks in your rhythm can help you keep accuracy high when the pace picks up.
Track how many stars you earn in each run and try to beat your own score next time to build steady improvement.
faq: What is the goal of PixZombies?
Your goal is to smash waves of zombies by tapping quickly and earn stars as you go. The challenges get harder as the undead charge from all directions.
How do the controls work?
The game is played by tapping. Tap swiftly to fend off the zombies as they approach.

block-blast-mania.intro: Block Blast Mania is a block-placing puzzle game where you fill rows and columns on the board to clear them. You can play an endless classic mode or work through level objectives.
tips: Before placing a block, check which rows and columns are almost full, so you can aim for the spots that will complete them.
Since you can't rotate blocks, look at each shape's exact outline and decide where it fits before you drag it onto the grid.
Try to clear several lines with one placement, because the more rows you destroy at once, the more points you earn.
Avoid leaving small isolated gaps scattered across the board, since they make it harder to fit the next shapes.
In level-based mode, keep your objective, such as collecting pigs, in mind and save your boosters for levels where they will help most.
faq: What is the goal of Block Blast Mania?
Place colorful blocks on the board so that complete rows or columns with no gaps are formed. Those lines disappear and make room for new blocks.
How do I place a block?
Drag a block from the bottom of the screen onto the grid. You cannot rotate blocks, but you can place them in any spot and in any order you like.

doctor-teeth-2.intro: Doctor Teeth 2 is a 2D puzzle adventure where you treat quirky patients with unusual tooth problems. You work through dental procedures using a variety of tools in short mini-game challenges.
tips: Look at each patient's problem before acting, since the tools and steps needed can change from one case to the next.
Take each mini-game slowly and focus on precision, because the game rewards careful work over speed.
Think of each appointment as a sequence of steps and finish one stage before moving on to the next.
If you miss a three-star result, replay the appointment and note which step cost you points, then adjust your approach there.
Enjoy the humor in the patient stories; keeping a relaxed pace helps you spot details in the puzzles more easily.
faq: What is the main goal of Doctor Teeth 2?
You treat quirky patients with bizarre tooth troubles and aim to complete perfect appointments. The description says the goal is to earn three stars for each one.
How do the mini-game challenges work?
Each procedure uses dental tools in playful mini-games. Focus on precision in each one, since accuracy is what the game is built around.

magical-unicorn-grooming-world-pony-care.intro: Magical Unicorn Grooming World is a pony care game where you look after a unicorn. You clean her stable, bathe her, change her horseshoe, and then dress her up.
tips: Work through the care tasks in the order the game presents them, with stable cleaning and bathing first and dress-up last, so each step builds on the one before.
Finish the stable before moving on, since a clean space makes the rest of the grooming feel easier to follow.
Take your time during the horseshoe change and check that each part is done before you continue.
Save the dress-up step for last so you can see the unicorn fully cared for before you choose her look.
Since everything is controlled by tapping or clicking, slow and deliberate taps help you avoid skipping steps.
faq: What is the goal of Magical Unicorn Grooming World?
The goal is to care for a unicorn by cleaning her stable, bathing her, and changing her horseshoe. Once those tasks are done, you can dress her up as your magical unicorn.
How do I play the game?
The game is played by tapping or clicking. Use taps or clicks to carry out each grooming and dress-up action.

rabbit-shooter.intro: Rabbit Shooter is a 3D shooting game where you play a rabbit hunter. You aim, shoot, and switch weapons to take down rabbits in a test of your hunting skill.
tips: Hold the right mouse button to aim before you fire, since a steadier view makes it easier to line up a clean shot.
Press R to reload when no rabbit is close by, so you are not caught with an empty weapon at a bad moment.
Scroll the mouse wheel to try each weapon you have and learn which one suits the distance and movement of your target.
Take your time with each shot instead of firing quickly, because a well-aimed shot is more useful than a rushed one.
Keep track of how many shots you have left in your current weapon so you can plan when to reload or switch.
faq: How do I shoot in Rabbit Shooter?
Press the left mouse button to shoot. Use the right mouse button to aim first if you want more accuracy.
How do I change weapons?
Scroll the mouse wheel to change weapons. Test each one to see which works best for your style of play.

fall-cars-hexagon.intro: Fall Cars: Hexagon is a 3D car game where you drive on a hexagon and try not to fall off. You can play alone or with a friend in two-player mode.
tips: Keep your car near the middle of the hexagon, where there is the most room to move, and only steer toward the edges when you need to.
Use short, gentle key presses instead of holding a direction, since big steering moves are more likely to send you off the edge.
Watch where your car is heading before you turn, so you can correct early instead of reacting at the last second.
In two-player mode, agree with your friend on who covers which side of the hexagon so you do not both drift toward the same edge.
Spend a few minutes learning the controls before you aim for a long run, because the car responds differently to each key.
faq: What is the goal of Fall Cars: Hexagon?
Your goal is to drive your car on the hexagon without falling off the edge. The game is about staying on the surface for as long as you can.
What are the controls?
Player 1 uses the arrow keys, and Player 2 uses the W, A, S, and D keys in two-player mode. Use the keys for your player to steer your car.

stick-bros-leave-prison.intro: Stick Bros Leave Prison is an adventure game where you control two stickmen at once. Find the colored keys, get both characters to the exit, and stay ahead of the guards.
tips: Before moving far, look at where both characters are and which key matches which door, so you don't waste time backtracking.
Switch between the two characters often and keep the one you're not controlling out of the guards' path.
Pick up the scattered money as you go, since it's what unlocks better skins. Grab it when it's safe rather than risking a guard catching you.
Watch the guards' movement for a moment before you commit to a route, and time your leaps and dodges around their patterns.
Get each character to the exit with the timing in mind, since the goal is to reach the door before the guards catch up.
faq: What is the main goal of Stick Bros Leave Prison?
You need to find the correct colored keys to open doors and get both stickmen to the exit at the end of each level. Staying one step ahead of the guards is essential.
How do I switch between the two characters?
Find the key that changes characters, then use it to move between the two stickmen so you can guide each one toward the exit.

magnet-master-3d.intro: Magnet Master 3D is a clicker-style simulation where you drive an industrial magnet around a scrap yard, collect metal, sell it, and upgrade your machine. Each upgrade helps you lift heavier objects and earn more from every load.
tips: Fill your magnet with a load, then drive to the SELL zone to turn it into cash before collecting more.
Spend your earnings on upgrades early, since stronger power and capacity let you pick up more scrap per trip.
Balance your upgrades across power, range, capacity and value instead of maxing only one stat.
Focus on Power when heavier objects are out of reach, and on Capacity when your magnet keeps filling up too quickly.
Unlock new areas as soon as you can afford them, because they are where the more valuable scrap is found.
faq: What is the main goal of Magnet Master 3D?
Your goal is to clean up the yard by collecting metal scrap, selling it, and upgrading your magnet until nothing is too heavy to lift.
How do I move the magnet?
On desktop, use WASD or the Arrow Keys. On mobile, use the virtual joystick.

my-dogy-virtual-pet.intro: Take care of Dogy, a cute puppy, by feeding him, bathing him, playing with him, and tucking him in for rest. He reacts to how well you look after him.
tips: Check the need icons at the top of the screen often so you can spot which need is dropping before it gets low.
Keep the bars full in each room, since the needs are tracked room by room and a low bar in one room can be easy to miss.
Feed Dogy as soon as he seems hungry, then give him a bath to keep him clean so his care stays balanced.
Put him to bed when he looks tired, because a rested puppy is easier to keep happy during play time.
Mix play with his other care tasks so he stays happy overall, and watch how he reacts as a sign of how well you are doing.
faq: What is the main goal of My Dogy Virtual Pet?
Your goal is to keep Dogy happy and cared for by feeding him, bathing him, playing with him, and putting him to bed when he is tired. He will react to how well you take care of him.
How do I know what Dogy needs?
The icons at the top of the screen show his needs. Keep the bars full by attending to his needs in each room.

stickman-escape-plane-and-ship.intro: Stickman Escape - Plane and Ship puts you in control of Stick, who must find the successful ways out of a plane and a ship. Choose items and actions carefully as you face enemies and monsters.
tips: Before acting, look at the items and options on screen and think about which one fits the danger in front of you.
When an attempt fails, note what caused it so you can avoid repeating the same choice.
Pay attention to where enemies and monsters are before you move, since timing often decides whether an escape works.
Try different combinations of items and actions instead of settling on the first route that seems to work.
Use a steady click or a firm tap with a stylus or finger so your choices register exactly where you intend.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Your goal is to find all the successful ways to escape from the plane and the ship. Each escape path you discover is a step toward that goal.
How do I control Stick?
On a computer, use the mouse. On a mobile device, use a stylus or your finger to make your choices.

sprint-club-nitro.intro: Sprint Club Nitro is a sports racing game where you start at the back of the field and work your way to first place. You compete against 19 rivals across diverse tracks.
tips: Treat the early laps as a chance to learn each track's layout, since you start last and need to pass rivals safely to climb the field.
Save your nitro boosts for moments when you have a clear path ahead, so the speed gain helps you overtake instead of getting stuck behind slower cars.
Pay attention to how each track is shaped, and adjust your racing line for its corners and straights rather than using the same approach everywhere.
After each race, think about which part of your run lost the most ground, then focus on improving that section in your next attempt.
Spend your cash rewards on upgrades that match your racing style, so your car improves in the areas where you are losing time.
faq: What is the main goal in Sprint Club Nitro?
You start from last place and race to finish first against 19 rivals. Every position you gain brings you closer to winning.
How do nitro boosts help during a race?
Nitro boosts give your car a burst of speed that helps you pass rivals. Use them strategically, when a boost will help you gain a position or hold one.

time-travel-tower-rush-td.intro: Time Travel: Tower Rush is an idle tower defense game where you build and upgrade a tower floor by floor while fighting waves of enemies across different eras. Gold from defeated enemies pays for your upgrades and weapons.
tips: Gold comes from defeating enemies and collecting what they drop, so keep your tower firing to build up your funds between purchases.
Check which part of your tower is struggling. If enemies reach it, prioritize durability; if they survive too long, put gold into damage or firing speed.
Try different gun types early, since each one has its own advantages. Then look for combinations that work well together.
Use manual target selection with the left mouse button when elite enemies or bosses appear, because they are the main threats that benefit from priority attacks.
Pay attention to synergy effects when you add new weapons or upgrades, as pairing the right parts can increase your damage more than buying them separately.
faq: How do I earn gold in Time Travel: Tower Rush?
You earn gold by defeating monsters, and enemies also drop gold that you need to collect. The more enemies you defeat, the more gold you gain.
When should I use manual targeting?
