Use the left mouse button to pick a target when you are facing elite enemies or bosses. This lets you direct priority attacks at the enemies that matter most.

delivery-chaos.intro: Delivery Chaos is a 3D city driving game where explosions make every delivery harder. Collect waypoints to earn coins and score, and keep your car in one piece as you race through the mayhem.
tips: Plan your route between waypoints before you reach them, so you spend less time turning and more time moving toward the next pickup.
Use the handbrake with Spacebar (or Triangle on a controller) to take sharp corners without losing too much speed.
Keep an eye on the explosions around you and steer away from them early rather than reacting at the last second.
Collect coins on the way to your waypoints when you can, since they add to your score.
Press V to unlock the cursor when you need to click on menu options, and Tab to return to the menu.
faq: What is the goal of Delivery Chaos?
You drive through a city collecting waypoints to rack up coins and boost your score while avoiding explosive destruction. The game also lets you unlock new vehicles and map areas.
What are the basic driving controls?
Use WASD or the arrow keys to drive, and the left stick or triggers on a controller. Spacebar works as the handbrake on keyboard.

snowtail-peaks-3d-bubble-pop-adventure.intro: SnowTail Peaks is a 3D bubble shooter where you aim with a glowing guide line, bounce shots off the side rails, and match colors to clear the board before your shots run out.
tips: Before each shot, check the glowing guide line for rail bounces, since a bank shot can often reach a bubble that a straight shot cannot.
Look for shots that knock out a large group at once. Popping a cluster makes the unconnected bubbles fall away, which can clear much more of the board than you aimed at.
Count your remaining shots as you go. If the board has many bubbles left and few shots, prioritize moves that remove whole clusters over single pops.
Use the tap-to-swap option on the launcher when your current bubble color does not fit a good target, and plan the next shot before you swap.
Save Bomb, Rainbow, and Lift for tight spots where normal shots cannot reach or clear the board. They are most useful when the stage starts to get crowded.
faq: What is the goal of each stage?
Clear every bubble from the board to win the stage. If you run out of shots first, the level ends.
How do I pop bubbles?
Drag to aim, release to shoot, and match three or more bubbles of the same color. Bubbles that are no longer connected to the top will then fall away.

sort-puzzle.intro: Sort Puzzle is a relaxing puzzle game built around short mini-puzzles, from sorting to arranging school items, with obstacles along the way. Each level offers a different challenge to work through at your own pace.
tips: Scan the whole board before your first move so you can spot which items belong together.
Look for obstacles early and plan around them, since clearing a blocked path first often makes the rest of the level easier.
Use taps, drags, and connections deliberately; a wrong drag can put an item out of place, so slow down on tricky mini-puzzles.
Take a short break when a mini-puzzle stalls, then return with fresh eyes to notice the pattern you missed.
Pay attention to how each level's mini-game differs, and adjust your approach rather than repeating the same method everywhere.
faq: What is the goal of Sort Puzzle?
Solve each mini-puzzle by sorting or arranging items, including school items, while working around obstacles to move through the adventure.
Which controls do I use?
You play with simple taps, drags, and connections to select and move items and link pieces together.

taxi-simulator-3d.intro: Taxi Simulator 3D puts you behind the wheel of a taxi to pick up and deliver passengers across ten levels. Your goal is to finish each transport mission before time runs out.
tips: Use WASD to get a feel for how the taxi steers and accelerates before you start chasing the clock.
Check your destination first and plan a route before you leave, so you are not guessing at turns while the timer runs.
Keep an eye on the time for each mission and decide early whether a shortcut or a longer, clearer road is the safer choice.
Take the early levels slowly to learn how the car handles, then speed up once you are comfortable with the controls.
If you fall behind schedule, focus on the next delivery rather than worrying about the one you missed, so you can recover on the rest of the level.
faq: What is the goal of Taxi Simulator 3D?
You drive a taxi to deliver passengers to their destinations, completing each transport mission on time across all ten levels.
How do I control the taxi?
Use the W, A, S and D keys to move the taxi around the map.

warriors-vs-evil-spirits.intro: Warriors VS Evil Spirits is an arcade battle against undead hordes. You fight as a lone warrior, choosing weapons and moving tactically to survive skirmishes and build up your arsenal.
tips: Pick your weapons with the enemy type in mind, since the game rewards strategic weapon choices over button mashing.
Keep moving rather than standing still in the middle of a zombie horde, so you are not surrounded.
Use the rewards you collect to upgrade your arsenal early, because stronger weapons make later skirmishes easier to survive.
Watch how the zombies approach and plan your position before each fight, so you can handle one group at a time.
When a skirmish turns intense, step back and reposition instead of pushing forward into the largest crowd.
faq: What is the goal of Warriors VS Evil Spirits?
You play as a lone warrior fighting through zombie hordes and evil spirits. The aim is to survive the skirmishes and stop the spirits from taking over the world.
How do I get stronger during a run?
Collect the rewards you find and use them to upgrade your arsenal. Better weapons help you handle tougher waves.

hill-climb-truck-transform-adventure.intro: Hill Climb Truck Transform Adventure is a 2D balance stunt game where you drive trucks over hills, ramps and rough terrain. Keep your vehicle steady, transform to suit each stretch, and collect repair plates when you crash.
tips: Focus on keeping the vehicle balanced before you think about speed, since a tipped vehicle is what usually ends a run.
Approach ramps at a steady pace so you can keep the vehicle level as it leaves the ground.
Try each of the three vehicles on the terrain to learn which transformation handles uneven ground best for you.
Grab repair plates when you can, because they are your recovery after hitting obstacles or terrain.
Spend upgrades on the acceleration abilities when harder levels start to feel too slow to clear.
faq: What is the goal of Hill Climb Truck Transform Adventure?
The goal is to get your truck across different terrains, ramps and obstacles while keeping the vehicle balanced.
How do I control the truck?
You play with mouse clicks or taps, so use clicks to drive and transform as the game requires.

slow-mo-blade-rush.intro: Slow Mo: Blade Rush is a physics-based throwing game where you fling a knife at groups of wobbly red goofballs and towers in slow motion. Aim carefully, use the bonus gates, and work your way up to the giant blue boss.
tips: Before you throw, watch where the goofballs and towers sit, since a well-placed hit can knock down several at once. Take a moment to line up each shot.
When a crowd is too large to handle, look for the ×3 gate and send your blade through it to turn one throw into a fan of blades.
Slow motion lets you follow the tumble, so watch how the goofballs and towers fall to learn which angles knock the most targets over.
Missed throws are not a setback, so keep your focus on the next shot rather than the last one.
When the giant blue boss appears, consider switching to the fiery, frosty, or lightning weapons, since each one changes how your hits play out.
faq: What is the main goal of Slow Mo: Blade Rush?
Your goal is to knock down the red goofballs and wobbly enemy towers with well-aimed knife throws. After that, you take on the giant blue boss.
How do I throw my weapon?
Tap or click to fling your weapon at the red goofballs. Lining up your shot before you throw helps you hit more targets.

bus-rush.intro: Bus Rush is an endless arcade action game where you pull off stunts and tricks on a skateboard. Move your mouse to control your run and keep the action going.
tips: Since the game is endless, focus on staying in play rather than chasing one big score at the start.
Keep an eye out for power-ups and try to collect them, since they give you a boost.
Try the different skateboard models available to see which one feels best for your style of play.
Move the mouse smoothly instead of making sudden jerky motions, so you can react in time to what comes next.
Practice showing off different stunts and tricks, and build a rhythm you can repeat when the pace picks up.
faq: How do I control the game?
You control the game with the mouse. Move the mouse to play.
What do the power-ups do?
Power-ups give you a boost, so grabbing them can help you keep moving forward with more momentum.

merge-cubes.intro: Merge Cubes is a 3D puzzle where you combine matching numbered cubes to build higher values on a changing grid. It rewards strategy and quick thinking as you chase a high score.
tips: Before each merge, check which matching cubes sit next to each other and whether the move leaves room for future merges.
Because the grid evolves, look at the board again after every change instead of relying on your earlier plan.
Avoid filling up the grid with unmatched cubes, since crowded boards make it harder to create higher values.
Think a few moves ahead so you can set up a bigger merge rather than making small ones that block later options.
Take short breaks when you feel stuck, then look at the grid fresh to spot merges you may have missed.
faq: What is the goal of Merge Cubes?
Merge matching numbered cubes to create higher values and aim for the highest score you can reach on the grid.
How can I get a higher score?
Plan merges ahead, keep the grid from getting too crowded, and re-check the board after each move as it changes.

wingy-wheels.intro: Wingy Wheels is a cozy hill-sliding game where you dive down slopes, launch off hilltops, and glide through the sky. Build speed, chain clean landings, and reach new islands before the sunset.
tips: Dive on the downhill side and release near the top of a hill, so you launch with more speed and glide farther.
Land on downward slopes rather than steep uphill ones, since landing on a steep climb can end the run.
Before you climb a hill, check that you still have enough speed. If you're slow, dive a little earlier to build it back.
Try to string several perfect slides together, because a row of them starts Fever mode and boosts your run.
Keep an eye on the sunset and aim for the next island in time, since reaching it gives you extra daylight.
faq: What is the main goal of Wingy Wheels?
Keep your car moving across the hills and reach new islands before night falls. Each island you reach before sunset gives you extra time.
How do I control my car?
Hold the mouse button, tap and hold the screen, or hold Space to dive down a hill. Release to fly off the hilltop and glide.

battalion-commander-2.intro: Battalion Commander 2 is a 2D top-down shooter where you lead a lone soldier across a snowy battlefield. Free captured comrades, collect upgrades, and dodge enemy fire.
tips: Keep moving rather than standing still, since the description stresses constant enemy fire and incoming bullets.
Look for captured comrades early and free them when it is safe, as the game centers on rescuing your squad.
Pick up upgrades whenever you can reach them safely, and think about which ones suit how you are playing.
Scan the snowy battlefield before you advance so you know where enemies are coming from and where cover might be.
Treat each move as a decision: the game rewards strategy over reckless charging into enemy lines.
faq: What is the main goal in Battalion Commander 2?
You lead a lone soldier through enemy lines, freeing captured comrades and collecting upgrades along the way.
How do upgrades help in this game?
Upgrades are collected during play and can strengthen your soldier, so grabbing them when it is safe is worth the effort.

kitten-s-way-home-word-associations.intro: Kitten's Way Home: Word Associations is a word duel where you guess words linked to a theme. You can take turns with a friend on one screen or race a bot against the clock.
tips: Think about the theme first and list related words in your head before you guess. Associations often come from everyday connections, so start with the most obvious ones.
Points for each word are random, so do not spend too long on one hard guess. Keeping a steady pace usually gives you more chances to score.
In Player vs. Player mode, pay attention to the words your opponent has already guessed. Avoid repeating ideas that are already taken and look for new angles on the theme.
In Player vs. Bot mode, the clock is your main pressure. Give quick answers to easy associations and save a little time for the trickier ones.
Play a few rounds to get a feel for the kinds of themes that come up. Recognising patterns makes it easier to guess associations quickly.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
The goal is to earn more points than your opponent by guessing words associated with the theme. The player with the most points at the end wins.
How do points work?
You earn a random number of points for each word you guess. Because the amount changes, every correct guess is worth trying for.

far-orion-new-worlds.intro: Far Orion: New Worlds is an action strategy game where you lead a team of heroes and a deck of cards through missions, bosses, and a tower. This guide covers how to build your squad and earn gold.
tips: Pair heroes whose abilities support each other, such as a healer alongside a tank, so your squad holds up better in long fights.
Check each boss's attack types and HP before a battle, and bring cards and heroes that suit the threat instead of using the same squad every time.
Choose cards that either strengthen your heroes or provide basic healing and damage, so every card in your deck has a clear job.
Spend gold on upgrading the heroes and cards you use most often, rather than spreading it across many unused options.
Log in for daily quests and play missions and tower runs regularly, since these are the main ways to earn the gold you need for upgrades.
faq: What is the goal of Far Orion: New Worlds?
You complete missions and fight enemies across the storyline, using a squad of heroes and a deck of cards to win each battle. Bosses appear throughout the story and are the main challenges to beat.
How do I earn gold in the game?
You earn gold by completing missions, finishing daily quests, and fighting in the tower and the arena. Gold is then used to upgrade heroes and cards and to buy hero cards.

gravity-shift-sky-racers-gt.intro: Gravity Shift: Sky Racers GT is a racing game where you pilot GT machines across the ground and through the air. Use the mouse to steer and manage both ground drifts and airborne moves.
tips: Use the mouse with smooth, small movements, since the same left and right control handles both the ground and the air.
Practice drifting on the ground first so you learn how the car responds before you rely on it at higher speeds.
Pay attention to when you leave the ground, because your control in the air matters as much as your handling on the track.
Learn how futuristic cities, floating highways, and high-altitude circuits feel differently, and adjust your line for each one.
Keep an eye on rivals around you, since the race is a battle for dominance and a well-timed position change can matter more than a single fast section.
faq: How do I steer the car?
Move the mouse left and right to steer the car. The same movement also controls the car when it is airborne.
How is flying different from driving on the ground?
On the ground you drift around the track, while in the air you use aerial maneuvers to keep control of the car. Plan for the moment you transition between the two.

crazy-golf-iii.intro: Crazy Golf III is a one-player golf game set on hills, with 23 levels that look simple at first. Every level is different, and the settings button in the upper left gives help when you need it.
tips: Look over the whole hole before your first shot, since the layout of the hills matters more than it seems at a glance.
Do not assume a level will play like the one before it, because every level is different.
Start with gentle, controlled shots to learn how the ball reacts on the slopes before trying anything bold.
If you get stuck, open the settings button in the upper left for help instead of guessing repeatedly.
Take your time with each click or tap, since the easy look of the levels can hide tricky angles.
faq: What is the goal of Crazy Golf III?
Your goal is to get the ball into the hole on each of the 23 levels, which are set on hills.
How do I play the game?
Use mouse clicks or taps to play, following the on-screen prompts for each shot.

knife-storm.intro: Knife Storm is a knife-throwing and fruit-slicing game with three modes: Classic, Shoot, and Ninja. You can play solo or with a friend in two-player mode.
tips: In Classic mode, plan each throw around the knives already stuck in the target, since a new knife must not hit the others.
In Shoot mode, track the remaining time and avoid bombs, because a wasted throw costs you time you may need later.
In Ninja mode, try to slice several fruits at the same moment to build combo points instead of cutting them one at a time.
Always watch for bombs in Ninja mode, because slicing one ends the game immediately, so slow down when the screen gets crowded.
Try each mode a few times to see which one suits your timing, then use the same focus on the bombs and the target in the others.
faq: What is the goal of Classic mode?
You need to throw all of your knives successfully onto the rotating table or the fruits. Knives cannot hit each other, so a throw that touches another knife does not count.
How do I lose in Ninja mode?
Slicing a bomb ends the game right away. Keep slicing fruit, but leave bombs alone.

build-your-dream-car.intro: Build Your Dream Car is a racing game where you upgrade your car's engine and nitro, then compete in drag races. Shifting at the right moment is the key skill for winning.
tips: Shift gears at the right moment rather than waiting for the engine to redline, since timing decides who pulls ahead in a drag race.
Upgrade your engine and nitro before tackling tougher races, so you have the power to keep up with stronger opponents.
Watch your rev or speed readings after each race to see when you shifted too early or too late, and adjust next time.
Use the upgrade screen to balance engine and nitro improvements rather than putting all your effort into one part.
Keep your inputs smooth on the controls, whether arrow keys and mouse on PC or a steady slide on mobile, to avoid losing control during a race.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Your goal is to build and upgrade your dream car so you can win drag races and dominate the streets.
How do I control the car on PC?
Use the arrow keys and mouse to control your car, and shift gears at the right moment during a race.

car-games-car-racing-game.intro: Car Games: Car Racing Game is a fast-paced city racing game with night-time competitions, several racing modes, and 3D visuals. This guide offers practical habits to help you race more effectively.
tips: Spend your first few races getting a feel for how your car handles before pushing for top speed.
Try the different racing modes to find the one that suits your style, then return to the ones that challenge you most.
Night races can make it harder to see road ahead, so keep your eyes further down the track rather than fixed on the car directly in front.
Take corners at a controlled pace, since losing control in a busy city street costs more time than a slightly slower entry.
Between races, take a moment to review how your last run went so you can improve one specific thing next time.
faq: What is the main goal of Car Games: Car Racing Game?
The goal is to win fast-paced races through lively city streets, including night-time competitions. The game rewards skilled driving across its racing modes.
Are there specific controls I need to know?
The game does not list detailed controls in its instructions, so check the on-screen prompts or help menu once you start playing.

wood-bolts-nuts-screw-pin-puzzle.intro: Wood Bolts Nuts Screw Pin Puzzle is a brain game where you tap screw holes to release metal plates in the right order. Each of its over 100 stages adds new layouts to solve.
tips: Before tapping anything, look at the whole product and note which plates are stuck behind which screws. Working out the order first saves wasted moves.
Start by thinking about which screw, if removed, would let a plate fall into a clear path. Planning the sequence in your head often works better than tapping at random.
If a stage stalls, step away for a moment and come back with fresh eyes. Many layouts become clearer once you have tried a different approach.
Use the hint button when you have truly run out of ideas, rather than guessing repeatedly. Seeing one clue can unlock the rest of the stage.
Keep track of what you have already tried. Remembering which sequences failed helps you avoid repeating the same mistakes.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You tap the screw holes on the product to unlock them so the metal plates fall in the correct sequence. Each stage is solved once the plates are cleared.
What do I do if I get completely stuck?
Use the hint feature or the option to remove random screws to move forward. Both are built into the game for when a stage gets too difficult.

mydream-universe.intro: myDream Universe is a sandbox flight game where you start as a small asteroid and grow by absorbing celestial bodies. You navigate a changing universe, plan against larger threats, and shape a cosmic domain of your own.
tips: Begin by absorbing the smallest bodies around you, since they help you grow without putting your asteroid at risk early on.
Keep an eye on the larger threats in the universe and plan your route to avoid them until you are big enough to deal with them.
Grow steadily rather than rushing toward the biggest objects, so each new size gives you a stronger position.
Watch how your size changes after each absorption so you can judge when you are ready to take on something larger.
If you want to evolve into a black hole, focus on consistent growth over time, because that path is built on steady absorption rather than one big move.
faq: What is the main goal of myDream Universe?
Your goal is to grow from a humble asteroid into an immense entity and craft a universe that is truly your own. The game also asks whether you will evolve into a powerful black hole.
What should I absorb first?
Start with smaller celestial bodies so you can grow safely. Save bigger targets until your size gives you a clear advantage.

99-nights-in-the-forest-survival-simulat.intro: Head out on outings through three forest locations, gather food and resources, and fight monsters while searching for the missing children. This guide covers the basic controls and how to get the most from each trip.
tips: Pick your location with care, since the three areas hold both peaceful and hostile creatures. Try a location where you can gather food and resources safely before moving to tougher ones.
For attacks, watch the triangle as it moves along the attack bar and click when it sits over the center. Timing matters more than speed, so take a moment to line it up.
For defense, hold to stop the heart and release to send it the other way. Practice a few short holds to learn how far it travels before a fight gets hard.
Open chests and collect resources whenever you pass them. Their contents can support your next outing.
Check your achievements regularly, because each one you earn rewards you with diamonds. Diamonds can be used to buy upgrades at the skin merchant's store.
faq: What is the main goal of 99 Nights In The Forest?
Your goal is to go on outings, collect food and resources, fight monsters, and find the missing children. Saving children also involves destroying secret bosses.
How do I start an outing?
Click on Hike and then select one of the three locations. Your trip begins from there.

blob-twist-color-puzzle.intro: Blob Twist is a colorful puzzle game where you move and twist a blob past obstacles to reach the finish point. Timing and careful planning help you clear each level.
tips: Look at the whole level before you move so you can spot hazards and the route to the finish point.
Move in small steps at first to learn how the blob responds to the Arrow Keys or WASD.
Pause your planning before tricky sections, since the game rewards careful moves over rushed ones.
If you keep hitting the same hazard, try a different path or timing rather than repeating the same move.
Practice a level again after failing it, because the timing of each obstacle becomes easier to read with repetition.
faq: What is the goal of Blob Twist?
Your goal is to move and twist the blob past obstacles and reach the finish point to complete each level.
How do I control the blob?
Use the Arrow Keys or WASD to move and twist your blob.

pumper-crazy-defence.intro: Pumper Crazy Defense is a top-down defense shooter where you fight off waves of enemies that keep coming at you. You earn money during the fight and spend it on character upgrades.
tips: Keep moving with WASD or the arrow keys so enemies don't get a clear line at you. Staying still for long makes you an easy target.
Use Auto Fire (T to turn on, Y to turn it off) when enemies are coming in a steady stream, and switch it off when you need to pick your shots.
Spend your earned money on upgrades that help you survive longer first, such as health, before buying offensive boosts.
Compare the damage and bullet upgrades before buying them. Doubling your damage or bullets can change how quickly you clear each wave.
Aim with the mouse and keep your cursor near the enemies you are fighting, since your aim follows the mouse position.
faq: What is the goal of Pumper Crazy Defense?
Your goal is to destroy the enemies that constantly come toward you while you defend your position. Earning money and upgrading your character helps you last longer.
How do I shoot and aim?
Aim with the mouse and fire with a left click. Your aim follows the mouse position as you move.

guns-n-glory-heroes.intro: Guns n Glory Heroes is a medieval defense game where you lead a trio of heroes against waves of enemies. It mixes varied hero abilities, traps, and a touch of classic tower defense.
tips: Learn what each of your three heroes does before a wave starts, since their abilities differ and work best in different situations.
Set your traps along the path enemies take toward your kingdom so they trigger before enemies reach your heroes.
Save a hero's strongest ability for a dangerous push rather than spending it on small early groups.
Watch which enemies get through your first line and adjust your hero positions and traps to cover that gap.
Strengthen your forces steadily between challenges instead of putting everything into one area of the defense.
faq: What is the goal of Guns n Glory Heroes?
You protect your kingdom from evil by repelling enemy onslaughts with your trio of heroes. Each wave you hold back brings you closer to keeping the kingdom safe.
How many heroes do I command?
You command a trio of heroes, and each one has its own set of abilities to use in battle.

hidden-sniper-camo-hunter-3d.intro: Hidden Sniper: Camo Hunter 3D is a shooting game where you search detailed 3D scenes for camouflaged targets. You zoom in with a sniper scope and take precise shots to clear each level.
tips: Scan the whole scene with a slow look-around before you open the scope, so you know where the likely hiding spots are.
Check edges, shadows, and areas that look slightly out of place, since camouflaged targets blend into their surroundings.
Open the scope only when you think you have spotted a target, then move carefully to line up your aim.
Keep your movements smooth while scoped, because the shot fires only when you release the button and a rushed aim can miss.
Track which targets you have already found so you can focus your search on the ones still left in the level.
faq: How do I take a shot?
On desktop, hold the Left Mouse Button on the scope button, aim, then release the button to fire. On mobile, press and hold the Scope Button, aim by swiping, then release it to fire.
How do I complete a level?
Find and shoot all of the required camouflaged targets in the scene. Each level is finished once you have successfully hit them.

100-doors-escape-mysteries.intro: 100 Doors Escape Mysteries is a room-escape puzzle game where you work through a series of rooms by solving puzzles and finding the key that opens each door. Controls are a simple click or tap.
tips: Look at every item and corner of the room before clicking anything, since the clue or key you need is often hidden in plain sight.
Pick up objects and keep them in mind, because a item you find early may be the answer to a lock much later.
When a puzzle stalls, step back and check the room again for patterns, numbers, or symbols you may have overlooked.
Try one idea at a time and watch what changes after each click, so you can tell which actions are actually useful.
Stay calm and work through the logic step by step; rushing through clicks tends to make the puzzles harder to follow.
faq: What is the goal of 100 Doors Escape Mysteries?
The goal is to get through one room after another by solving puzzles, using logic to find the key that lets you escape each room.
How do I control the game?
You play with mouse clicks or taps. Click or tap on objects, doors, and items to interact with the room.

constella-single-line-puzzle.intro: Constella is a calm single-line puzzle where you connect stars with one continuous path to reveal constellations. Each solved board shows a new shape.
tips: Plan the whole route before you drag. A single unbroken line has to pass through every star, so a short-cut early on can leave stars stranded later.
Look for stars that have only a few possible neighbours. Those are often the ones to visit first or last, since they are easy to miss otherwise.
Use Undo freely when a path dead-ends. Backing up a step is usually quicker than starting the board over.
Save Hints for boards that stall you. Trying a few routes on your own first helps you learn the patterns that come back in later puzzles.
Move the mouse around the board to see the layout from different angles before committing to a line. Taking a short break between boards can also help you spot the route more easily.
faq: What is the goal of Constella?
Your goal is to draw one continuous line that connects all the stars on a board. Completing the path reveals a constellation.
How do I draw a line between stars?
Hold the left mouse button and drag to trace a line from one star to the next. Mouse movement lets you navigate around the board.

lucky-clash.intro: Lucky Clash is a 3D tower defense game where you summon monsters, merge units, and hold off waves of enemies. Build a strong team and use smart combinations to survive each clash.
tips: Think about your team before each clash, since the right mix of monsters matters more than any single unit.
Pay attention to elemental synergies when choosing which monsters to keep and merge, as matching elements can make your team stronger.
Use merging to upgrade your units rather than spreading your resources too thin across weak monsters.
Collect and check relics whenever you can, because they can change how your team performs in later rounds.
Watch how each wave arrives and adjust your choices and timing to suit the enemies you are facing.
faq: What is the main goal in Lucky Clash?
Your objective is to defeat your opponents before they defeat you, surviving each round and collecting rewards along the way.
How do I get stronger during a run?
Summon monsters, merge units, and collect rewards and relics to improve your team as you progress through the game.

money-chaser-parkour-game.intro: Money Chaser Parkour is an endless running game where you collect coins, dodge traps, and knock out rivals on your way. Coins also become your ammunition for a boss fight.
tips: Keep an eye on the path ahead rather than the coins right in front of you, so you have time to jump over traps before you reach them.
Use the slide to knock out enemies directly in front of you instead of trying to jump over them, since the slide is your main way to clear rivals.
Grab coins whenever it is safe to do so, because they both keep your run going and build the stock you need for the boss fight.
Before you challenge the boss, check that you have collected enough coins, since the coins are your only weapon and more shots give you a better chance.
On a touch screen, practice tapping the right and left sides quickly so you can jump and slide without losing track of your position.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Keep running as long as you can while collecting coins, avoiding traps, and knocking out enemies. Once you have enough money, you can take on the boss.
How do I defeat enemies on my way?
You can knock out an enemy in front of you by using the slide. Jumping and avoiding traps are the other ways to stay ahead.

granny-the-game.intro: Granny has locked you in her house, and your goal is to get out within 5 days. Move carefully and quietly, because she can hear almost everything you do.
tips: Treat every movement as noisy. Dropping anything on the floor brings Granny running, so plan your route before you start moving around.
Know your hiding spots before she shows up. Wardrobes and beds are your cover, so keep track of which ones are closest to where you are.
When you hear her approaching, get into hiding right away instead of trying to keep moving. Waiting it out is safer than being caught in the open.
Use the full 5 days to learn the layout. Each attempt is a chance to memorize where you can hide and where the noisy objects are.
Play with a steady touch on the pad. Quick, careless taps can lead to mistakes, so slow, deliberate moves help you stay quiet.
faq: What is the goal of Granny the Game?
You are trapped in Granny's house and must find a way out before your 5 days run out.
What makes Granny come after you?
She hears everything, and dropping an item on the floor is a sound that will make her come running.

speed-rush-simulator.intro: Speed Rush Simulator is a 3D running game where you train your speed, race through themed areas, and build a team of pets. This guide covers the main habits and controls that help you progress.
tips: Reach checkpoints during races, since they are how you earn rewards. Plan your route so you hit each one.
Build your pet team early, because pets boost your training. Keep checking your team as you hatch new ones.
Use Space to jump over obstacles during races. Running is automatic, so your timing with jumps matters most.
Open eggs with E when you want to hatch them normally, or press R to open three eggs at once by watching a rewarded ad.
On mobile, hold the left joystick and tap the right jump button together to run and jump at the same time.
faq: How do I earn rewards in Speed Rush Simulator?
Race through the areas, jump over obstacles, and reach checkpoints to earn rewards.
What do pets do in this game?
Pets boost your training, so building a pet team helps you progress faster.

scary-math.intro: Scary Math is a monster-themed math game where you solve equations as they grow harder across levels. It tests both your speed and your accuracy.
tips: Focus on getting answers right first. Speed tends to follow once your accuracy is steady.
Work the early levels carefully so you can spot the patterns in the simpler equations before the harder ones arrive.
Practice mental math for common operations like addition, multiplication, and small fractions, since quick recall helps when the timer pressure builds.
When an equation looks difficult, break it into smaller steps instead of trying to solve the whole thing at once.
If you get stuck, take a short breath and reread the problem. Rushing often causes careless mistakes.
faq: What is the goal of Scary Math?
You solve math problems set in a spooky, monster-themed world while moving through levels. The game tests how quickly and accurately you can work through them.
How does the difficulty change as you play?
The equations become increasingly challenging as you progress. Each new level asks more of your mental agility.

flag-puzzle-jam-collect-flags.intro: Flag Puzzle Jam is a tap-based puzzle where you match banner pieces to complete national flags. Each finished flag unlocks a symbol for your collection in the Avenue of Flags.
tips: Before each tap, check which slots are still open and whether the piece you are about to move really belongs there, since wrong placements can cost you the level.
Look for flag sections with distinctive colors or shapes first, because they make it easier to tell where a piece fits.
Keep track of which pieces you have already placed so you do not waste slots or lose track of what is left on the board.
If a level starts to feel crowded with mismatched pieces, slow down and focus on one flag at a time rather than rushing through the board.
Take your time with the animations, since the game is designed as a relaxing experience and rushing rarely helps with planning.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Your goal is to complete each flag by matching all the correct banner pieces to their right spots and clearing the board.
How do I move a piece?
Tap a banner piece and it will move automatically to its correct spot on the board.

glow-halloween-nails-polish-and-color.intro: Glow Halloween Nails is a nail salon game where you trim, polish and decorate nails with glowing decals and glitter stickers for a spooky Halloween look. Work through each step to build a manicure for a Halloween party.
tips: Finish the basic steps first, such as trimming and polishing, before adding decals and stickers so your later choices sit on a clean base.
Pick a color scheme that fits a Halloween theme, like dark or glowing shades, and keep it consistent across your nails.
Try a few different glitter stickers and decals on a single nail before committing, so you can see how they look together.
Use a light hand with the stickers so the glowing and glitter effects stand out instead of crowding the nail.
Check each nail one at a time at the end to make sure the design matches across all your fingers.
faq: How do I play Glow Halloween Nails?
Tap or click on the tools and options on the screen to trim, polish, decorate and shine your nails. Follow the steps in order to complete the makeover.
Can I change my design after I add a decoration?
The game lets you keep working on your nails, so you can experiment with different decals and stickers to adjust your look.

nightmare-2d-shooters.intro: Nightmare 2D Shooters is a side-scrolling arcade shooter where a constructor fires a minigun at a swarm of alien monsters while defending a red monster truck. Use the keyboard to move, jump, and shoot.
tips: Use J to fire straight ahead and I to shoot upward, so you can handle enemies coming from above as well as from the side.
Keep moving with A and D instead of standing still, since the swarm and bullet-hell patterns punish players who stay in one spot.
Use Space to jump over incoming threats and reposition quickly when a wave closes in on you.
Keep the red monster truck in mind as the thing you are protecting, and prioritize enemies that are closest to it.
Pick up power-ups when it is safe to do so, and save your jumps for moments when the screen gets crowded.
faq: What is the main goal of Nightmare 2D Shooters?
You defend the red monster truck from a relentless swarm of monstrous creatures for as long as you can. The challenge is survival under constant pressure.
Which keys do I use to shoot?
Press J to shoot forward and I to shoot up. Use A and D or the left and right arrow keys to move, and Space to jump.

bridge-fun-race.intro: Bridge Fun Race is a knockout arcade battle game with cute 3D characters and AI opponents. You play through racing and survival levels, and only the top three finishers move on to the next battle.
tips: Since only the first three places advance, think about your finish position in every level rather than just staying alive.
In racing levels, grab items along the way, since they are part of the course and can help you get ahead.
When pushing obstacles toward the finish line, keep an eye on where the other players are so you do not clear a path for them.
In survival levels, keep your snowballs rolling and watch the platform edges, because opponents are easier to knock off when they are close to the edge.
Keep an eye on the time limit in survival levels and avoid standing still, so you always have a chance to launch another snowball.
faq: What is the goal of Bridge Fun Race?
Your goal is to beat the AI opponents in each battle. Only the first three players to finish or survive move on to the next battle.
How do I control my character?
Use mouse clicks or taps to play. The game is controlled entirely by clicking or tapping.

funny-cubes-2048.intro: Funny Cubes 2048 is a physics-based take on the 2048 merging puzzle. You throw cubes onto the pile, combine matching face values, and try to build the largest cube you can before the container overflows.
tips: Only throw a cube onto another cube with the same face value, since matching values are the only ones that merge and double.
Watch the container as you play. Mismatched cubes pile up and can overflow it, so keep an eye on how full it is before each throw.
Try to collect several cubes at a time, because that is how you earn boosters for clearing out unassembled cubes.
Save boosters for crowded moments when the pile is full of mismatched cubes and you need to clear space quickly.
Aim your throws with the physics in mind. Cubes can bounce and shift, so plan where a cube will land before you release it.
faq: What is the main goal of Funny Cubes 2048?
The goal is to collect as large a cube as possible by merging matching cubes. Each merge doubles the face value.
What happens when I throw a cube with a different face value onto another cube?
Nothing merges. The cubes stay separate and begin to accumulate, which can overflow the container and end the game.

world-flags-color-puzzle.intro: World Flags: Color Puzzle asks you to paint each country's flag correctly, then fly across a world map to unlock new countries. It is a relaxed geography puzzle that suits curious players of all ages.
tips: Read the country's name carefully before you start painting, since the colors you choose must match the flag of that specific country.
If you are unsure of a flag, work out the main colors and layout first, then fill in smaller details such as stripes or emblems last.
Check each flag against what you remember of its design before moving on, so mistakes do not carry into later challenges.
Use the airplane button to travel to new areas of the map, and try flags from different regions to build your knowledge of the world.
Play in short sessions and return to countries you found tricky, since repeating them is a simple way to remember their colors.
faq: What is the main goal of World Flags: Color Puzzle?
The goal is to paint each flag correctly based on the country's name. Completing flags helps you fly across the world map and unlock more countries.
How do I paint a flag?
Tap a color to select it, then tap the parts of the flag you want to fill. The colors should match the real flag of the country shown.

blocky-gun-paintball-3.intro: Blocky Gun Paintball 3 is a pixel-style paintball shooter with multiplayer and single player play. You can face AI opponents and zombies across team vs team, free for all, and gun game modes.
tips: Learn the movement and aim controls first: WASD to move, the mouse to look around and fire, and Space to jump. Good aim is the core skill in this game.
Use the Tab menu to check your options before you start a match so you know what is available in the mode you picked.
In team vs team, stay near your teammates instead of running off alone, since spreading out makes it easier for enemies to pick you off.
In gun game, do not get too attached to one weapon, because you need to keep moving through the weapon order to progress.
Jump to change your height and dodge shots, but keep your aim steady so a jump does not throw off your next shot.
faq: What is the goal of Blocky Gun Paintball 3?

The goal is to test your shooting skill against enemies, which include AI opponents, zombies, and other players, depending on the mode you choose. Scoring details are not described in the game's instructions.
What controls do I use to play?
Use WASD to move, the mouse to look around and fire, Tab to open the menu, and Space to jump.

mini-springs.intro: Mini Springs is an arcade puzzle game where you guide a purple slime through compact levels. Use color-coded springs to bounce your way to the goal flag while avoiding enemies and spikes.
tips: Study each level before you move. Work out which springs you need and in what order, since the levels are built around puzzles.
Pay attention to the color of each spring. Match your bounces to the springs that will carry the slime toward the next safe platform.
Watch enemy movement for a few moments before you commit to a jump. Timing your bounce for a gap in their path is often safer than rushing.
Treat spikes as fixed hazards and plan landings well away from them. A short pause to line up a jump can prevent a costly mistake.
Because the controls are limited, focus on precision rather than speed. Retrying a tricky section calmly is usually faster than pushing through with a rushed jump.
faq: What is the goal of Mini Springs?
Lead the purple slime through each level and reach the goal flag. Each stage is a compact puzzle built around bouncing and timing.
How do the color-coded springs work?
Springs launch the slime when it lands on them, so the colors help you plan a route. Choose which spring to use based on where you need to go next.

extra-hot-chili-3d.intro: Extra Hot Chili 3D is a fast hypercasual challenge where you move through spicy dishes from around the world as the heat keeps rising. It rewards quick reflexes and planning ahead.
tips: Expect the heat to climb as you go, so pace yourself early instead of rushing through the easiest moments.
Watch for each new challenge before you commit, since reading the situation first helps you react more calmly.
Blend quick reactions with a little planning: act fast when the moment calls for it, but think one step ahead when you can.
Stay relaxed under pressure. Mistakes often come from panicking when the heat spikes, so take a breath and refocus on the next move.
Play a few rounds in a row to learn the rhythm of the escalating challenges, and note which parts give you the most trouble.
faq: What is the main goal of Extra Hot Chili 3D?
You try to endure the fiery challenges as you move through a series of spicy dishes inspired by different parts of the world. The game tests how long you can keep your cool as the heat increases.
What skills matter most in this game?
Quick reflexes and strategic thinking are the key skills the game asks for. Reacting fast when needed and planning a little ahead will help you handle the rising difficulty.

onet-animals.intro: Onet Animals is a puzzle game about matching pairs of similar animal tiles. Clear every pair to finish each level and enjoy the cute animal artwork as you go.
tips: Scan the whole board before you start tapping, so you can spot every matching pair of animals.
Keep track of which animals you have already cleared and which ones still appear, so you know where the remaining pairs are.
Look for pairs that sit close together or are easy to reach first, since clearing them can make the rest of the board easier to read.
If you get stuck, step back and look at the board from a fresh angle instead of repeating the same moves.
Play in short sessions, especially on harder levels, to stay focused and avoid missing pairs.
faq: What is the goal of Onet Animals?
The goal is to match similar animal tiles in pairs. Completing pairs lets you finish each level.
How can I get better at finishing levels?
Scan the board carefully before each move, keep track of the animals that are left, and start with the pairs that are easiest to spot.

dino-robot-fighting-war.intro: Dino Robot Fighting War is an arcade action game where you build and customize dinosaur robots and battle others. Pick a dino warrior, shape it to your liking, and enter the clash of giants.
tips: Try each dino warrior, such as the T-Rex, Triceratops, or Stegosaurus, to see how they feel before settling on one.
Spend time customizing your robot before a fight, since your build is what you bring into every battle.
Watch how your opponent moves and reacts in the first moments so you can respond instead of simply reacting late.
Use short, deliberate clicks or taps rather than rapid spamming, so each action you take is intentional.
After each fight, adjust your build based on what worked and what didn't, and keep refining it over time.
faq: What is the main goal of Dino Robot Fighting War?
The goal is to build and customize your dinosaur robot and then fight against many other dinosaur robots. Your build and your fighting choices decide how well you do.
How do I control my dino robot?
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps. Use clicks or taps to make your choices and actions during play.

rooftop-shooters.intro: Rooftop Shooters is a shooting game where you try to knock your opponent off the rooftop. You can play online multiplayer, local two player, or local practice, and winning matches unlocks new skins.
tips: Start in local practice mode to learn how the W, E, O and P keys shoot and jump before you face a real opponent.
Pay attention to where you stand on the rooftop, since the goal is to push your opponent off the edge.
Practice switching between shooting and jumping so you can react quickly when your opponent fires at you.
If you are playing local two player, agree on which keys each person uses so you do not press the wrong ones mid-match.
Win a few matches in a row to unlock new skins, and keep track of your progress as you play more rounds.
faq: What is the goal of Rooftop Shooters?
The goal is to shoot your opponent off the rooftop. Win matches to unlock new skins.
Which keys control the game?
The instructions list the W, E, O and P keys for shooting and jumping. Check the controls shown in the game to see which key does which action.

marvelous-girl-skate.intro: Marvelous Girl Skate is an arcade skating game where you guide a superheroine on high-tech blades through tricks, obstacles, and colorful races. Collect boosts and unlock upgrades as you go.
tips: Watch the track ahead so you can react to obstacles before you reach them.
Grab boosts whenever you can, since they are one of the main resources the game asks you to collect.
Try the tricks during stretches where you have a clear path, so a missed landing does not cost you a run.
Spend upgrades on the improvements that help the way you already play, rather than trying to unlock everything at once.
Replay races you find tricky, paying attention to where you lose speed or hit obstacles, and adjust your approach each time.
faq: What is the goal of Marvelous Girl Skate?
You skate through races and obstacle courses, perform tricks, collect boosts, and unlock upgrades to become a skating champion.
How do I control the skater?
The instructions only say to click to interact, so follow the on-screen prompts in the game for the exact actions.

hills-of-steel.intro: Hills of Steel is a tank battle shooter where you drive a steel tank across battlefields, destroy enemies with powerful shots, and upgrade your vehicle as you progress.
tips: Keep moving with A and D or the arrows, since staying still makes you an easy target for enemy fire.
Spend gold on armor and weapon upgrades early so your tank survives longer in harder battles.
Save your booster with the X key for tough moments, such as a boss fight or when enemies are closing in from several sides.
Expect bosses at the end of a level: they have more HP and are larger, so plan your shots and keep your health up before reaching them.
Claim your free case every 24 hours, since it is an easy way to gain rewards without spending diamonds.
faq: What is the goal of Hills of Steel?
You win battles by destroying enemy tanks, collecting rewards from defeated opponents, and progressing through increasingly dangerous opponents and locations.
How do I control my tank on a computer?
Use the A and D keys or the arrow keys to move, press Space to fire, and press X to use the booster.

lone-sniper.intro: Lone Sniper is a fast shooting game where you have 50 seconds to take out all the enemies. Click or tap to shoot, and use cover to stay safe from return fire.
tips: Scan the whole screen before your first shot so you know where every enemy is and can plan a route through them.
Take a shot, then duck behind cover right away so you are not caught during the reload or the moment after firing.
Do not rush every shot. Missing wastes precious seconds, so aim steadily when you have a clear view.
Keep an eye on the timer and pick the enemies that are closest or easiest to reach first to keep your pace up.
Practice a few rounds to learn the rhythm of shooting and hiding, since quick, repeated cycles of both are what clear the level in time.
faq: What is the goal of Lone Sniper?
You have 50 seconds to destroy all the enemies on screen. Clearing them all before time runs out is the aim.
How do I control the game?
Use mouse clicks or taps to play. Click or tap to take a shot and to act within the game.

category-match-puzzle.intro: Category Match Puzzle is a sorting game where you study scrambled picture tiles and drag each one into the right category. Clear the board to finish the level and give your brain a relaxed workout.
tips: Read the theme labels, such as Toys, Food, and Weather, before you start dragging anything. Knowing the categories first makes every move faster.
Scan the whole board before picking up a tile. Spotting the easiest matches first clears space and makes the harder tiles easier to place.
Look closely at each picture and ask what it is used for or where you would normally find it. This helps when a picture could seem to fit more than one category.
Save your boosters for tiles you truly cannot place. Use a hint when you have tried a few options and are stuck.
Take a short pause if you feel rushed. Sorting carefully is more important than sorting quickly, since every item needs to be in the correct group to clear the level.
faq: How do I win a level?
You win by grouping all of the items correctly until the board is clear. Every tile must be placed in its matching category.
How do I move the picture tiles?
Drag each tile from the board and drop it into the category it belongs to. Scan the picture tiles first to find the ones you can place right away.

speed-per-click-obby.intro: Speed per Click: Obby mixes a clicker with obby parkour. Earn speed by clicking, then use it to clear jumping tracks and push through new locations.
tips: Keep clicking whenever you are not on a track, since your speed per click builds your progress over time.
Spend what you earn on pets that raise your speed per click before you attempt harder parkour sections.
Practice tricky jumps on a track before rushing, because a missed jump can cost you time.
Check your upgrades and unlocked locations regularly so you know which skill or area to improve next.
Consider performing a rebirth once your progress slows down, since it gives bonuses that help you speed up again.
faq: What is the main goal of Speed per Click: Obby?
The goal is to build your speed by clicking, then use that speed to beat parkour tracks faster and unlock new locations. Collecting wins and upgrading your skills helps you move forward.
How do I move and jump in the game on a computer?
Use WASD to move your character and press Space to jump. Jump timing matters on the tricky obstacles, so take your time with the harder tracks.

tangle-master-3d.intro: Tangle Master 3D is a 3D puzzle game where you untangle wires by moving the plug. Your goal is to free every wire across all the levels.
tips: Study the whole tangle before you drag anything, and look for which wire crosses over or under which other wire.
Start by moving the plug on the right toward the left, since that is the basic move the game is built around.
Make small, careful drags and watch how the wires respond, so you do not pull a knot tighter by accident.
Expect the early levels to be simple and the later levels to be much harder, so take your time as the puzzles get more complicated.
If you get stuck, step back and try a different route through the wires rather than repeating the same move.
faq: How do I play Tangle Master 3D?
Drag to move the plug, which is the basic action for untying the wires. The aim is to loosen every tangled wire on the screen.
What is the main goal of each level?
Each level is complete when all the wires entangled in it have been untied. You move from one level to the next as you finish them.

draw-bridge-puzzle-challenge.intro: Draw Bridge is a physics puzzle where you draw a single line to create a path for a motorcycle and get it to the flag. Plan your line before you start, since you only get one attempt at drawing it.
tips: Look at the whole level before drawing. Note where the gaps are, where the flag sits, and whether the ground rises or falls between them.
Keep your line as simple as possible. A short, direct span with supports at the right points is usually more stable than a long, wobbly one.
Think about balance. Ragdoll physics means the bridge and the rider can tip or collapse under weight, so avoid sharp angles that create weak points.
Aim for the flag rather than just reaching the far side. You have to touch the flag to win, so make sure your path carries the vehicle all the way to it.
If a design fails, study exactly where it broke. Change only that part of the line on your next attempt so you can learn what works.
faq: Can I redraw my line if I make a mistake?
No. The game only lets you draw the line once per level, so planning before you draw is important. Use the first look at each level to choose your approach.
What counts as winning a level?
You win by touching the flag with your vehicle. Simply getting close to it is not enough.

dark-boy.intro: Dark Boy is a side-scrolling adventure set in greyscale levels, where you fight dark monsters and reach the end line. Using slow-motion time control is central to getting through each stage.
tips: Read each level's objectives before moving, since you must complete them as well as reach the end line to finish the level.
Use bullet time (W on desktop) before entering dangerous areas with several monsters so you can line up your attacks and jumps more carefully.
Switch between the boys with Q when one character is better placed for a section, and keep track of which one you are controlling.
Pause to scan the layout ahead, since the greyscale levels can make platforms and enemies harder to read at a glance.
On mobile, tap the on-screen buttons deliberately rather than rapidly, so your jumps and attacks land where you intend.
faq: What is the goal of Dark Boy?
Complete the given objectives in each level and reach the end line to finish it.
How do I attack and jump?
On desktop, press A to attack and the Up Arrow or Space key to jump. On mobile, tap the on-screen buttons for these actions.

bear-adventure-online-game.intro: Bear Adventure is an adventure game set in lush forests, where you search for bear companions. Each new level brings its own challenges, and exploring well is the way to find what's hidden.
tips: Explore each area fully before moving on, since the game says exploration reveals hidden surprises.
Spend a few moments testing the controls at the start so your movement feels natural when challenges get harder.
Treat each new level as a fresh challenge and look at what has changed before rushing ahead.
Take your time in the forests and look around carefully, as the search for bear companions rewards patience.
Stay focused during the suspenseful parts of the quest, because staying calm makes it easier to react to threats.
faq: What is the main goal of Bear Adventure?
You journey through lush forests seeking bear companions while progressing through levels with unique challenges. Exploring the world helps you uncover hidden surprises along the way.
How does difficulty change as I play?
Each new level offers different challenges, so the game becomes a new test as you advance. Pay attention to what is different in every level and adjust your approach.

kick-the-ball-and-shoot.intro: Kick the ball and shoot is a sports arcade game where you guide your character's head to bounce a ball through an obstacle-filled course. Collect weapons to clear your path and work through stages that get harder.
tips: Watch the obstacle pattern for a few bounces before committing, since the game rewards players who adapt to how the course is laid out.
Treat each stage as a learning run: note where the hardest obstacles appear so you can prepare your timing before reaching them.
Save collected weapons for the obstacles that are hardest to pass, rather than using them as soon as you get them.
Keep your reflexes sharp by playing in short sessions, which helps you react quickly when stages become more challenging.
Check the achievements list as you play, and aim for them on stages you have already cleared to earn rewards without rushing.
faq: What is the main goal of Kick the ball and shoot?
You navigate an obstacle-filled course by bouncing a ball with your character's head, using collected weapons to clear your path through each stage.
How do I get past the tougher obstacles?
Use the weapons you collect at the right moment, and pay attention to the patterns of the obstacles so you can time your bounces to avoid them.

doors-awakening.intro: Doors Awakening is a challenging puzzle game set in handcrafted 3D levels with detailed visuals and a realistic atmosphere. You solve puzzles by clicking or tapping through each scene.
tips: Look around each level before you click anything, since the handcrafted scenes are built to be explored.
Use the camera controls to view the room from different angles, because a clue may be easy to miss from the first view.
Click objects one at a time and watch what changes, so you can tell which interactions move you toward a solution.
Pay attention to the visual effects and lighting, as they can highlight important details in the scene.
If you get stuck, step away for a while and come back with fresh eyes, then revisit the parts of the scene you have not checked yet.
faq: How do I interact with the game?
You play by mouse click or tap. Click on objects in the scene to interact with them and work through each puzzle.
How do I move the camera around the scene?
The game uses natural camera controls, so move your view around the level to look at it from different positions. Checking every angle is useful when a solution is not obvious.

laser-survivor.intro: Laser Survivor is a cyberpunk roguelike survival action game. You pick one of five heroes, drop into a randomized map, and fight waves of demons with whatever weapons and passives you find.
tips: Each run starts with randomized weapons and passives, so take a moment to read what you have before moving. Build around the combinations that work together instead of collecting everything.
Pick a hero whose base ability suits your style. Blaze's homing bullets help if you struggle to aim, while Hunter's explosive traps reward players who plan where enemies will go.
Keep moving. Survival runs are about staying out of trouble as much as dealing damage, so avoid getting pinned between groups of demons.
Watch for collectibles while you explore. They reveal the lore behind the rift, which can add context to the story as you progress.
Earn permanent upgrades through missions and use them to make later runs easier. Try different heroes to see which upgrade paths suit you best.
faq: What is the goal of a run?
You survive waves of demons across randomized maps, using the weapons and passive abilities you find along the way. Each run tests how well you adapt.
How do I move my character?
Use the arrow keys or WASD on a keyboard, or move with the mouse. On touch devices, use the touch controls to move.

paper-fighter-3d.intro: Paper Fighter 3D is a retro paper-style fighting game for one or two players. Each match is a short best-of-three battle, and you control your fighter with punches, kicks, and a special strike.
tips: Win a round by taking the fight to your opponent at the right moments, since timing matters more than button mashing.
Use punches and kicks in turns instead of repeating one attack, so your opponent has a harder time predicting you.
Keep an eye on your power bar and save your special strike for when it is full, rather than spending it early.
You only need two round wins, so if you lose the first round, stay calm and focus on taking the next two.
In two-player matches, learn your own key layout well so you can move and attack without looking down at the keyboard.
faq: How do I win a match?
You need to win two of the three rounds. The first fighter to take two rounds wins the match.
When can I use the special strike?
The special strike is ready when your power bar is full. Press your special attack key, R for Player 1 or O for Player 2, to use it.

football-tricks.intro: Football Tricks puts you in charge as team captain, where you attempt trick shots and aim for goals from difficult angles. The goal is to build your skills and lead your team to victory.
tips: Before you try a difficult trick shot, take a moment to read the angle and position of the goal. Shots from hard angles are the main challenge, so choose them when you have a clear view.
Practice the same type of shot several times before moving on. Repeating a move helps you learn how the ball responds to your timing.
Watch how each attempt ends and note what worked. Small changes in your approach can make a big difference in the next shot.
Stay patient and avoid rushing every attempt. Trick shots are hard to land, so steady, focused tries usually beat quick, careless ones.
Pay attention to the match as a whole, not only the shot in front of you. Leading your team means knowing when a bold trick is worth the risk.
faq: What is the goal of Football Tricks?
You play as the team captain and try to score goals using trick shots from challenging angles. Your aim is to lead your team to victory.
What kind of shots should I focus on?
Focus on trick shots that score from difficult angles, since that is the core of the game. Mastering these shots builds your finesse over time.

dream-room.intro: Dream Room is a decorating game with six rooms to style, from a cozy bedroom to a sunny balcony. You choose the walls, floors, furniture, and décor, then save your design.
tips: Pick a mood before you shop, such as cozy, magical, or bright, and stick to it so your room feels cohesive.
Choose wallpaper and flooring first, since they set the base colors that your furniture and décor will sit on.
Try different window views, like the sea, mountains, or an enchanted garden, to see which one fits the room's style best.
Repaint items to match a color palette instead of keeping their default colors, which helps a room look planned.
Complete challenges to earn coins and rewards, then spend them on the pieces you want most, and save your design often.
faq: How do I place an item in a room?
Open a category at the bottom of the screen, tap an item in the catalog, then tap anywhere in the room. You can drag it to any spot you like.
How do I earn coins?
Save your design to earn coins for new items, and complete themed challenges for additional rewards.

egg-hill-climb.intro: Egg Hill Climb is a two-player adventure where you and a partner escape a bank with stolen money. You control one car each and must stay close together while collecting coins.
tips: Agree on a pace with your partner before you start, since you must stay near each other and falling too far behind can slow the whole team down.
Keep your eyes on your partner's car as well as your own so you can wait or adjust speed when one of you drifts ahead.
Grab the coins along the way rather than rushing to the end, because you need to collect all of them before the level can be finished.
Save the red and blue money boxes for the end of the level, and make sure both of you reach them so you can fill both safes.
Split the controls clearly: one player uses WASD for the red car and the other uses the arrow keys for the blue car, so you never fight over the same keys.
faq: What is the main goal of Egg Hill Climb?
Your team must get the money safes full of stolen cash and reach the finish line together. You need to collect all the coins and take both money boxes at the end to complete the level.
How do I control the two cars?
Press the WASD keys to move the red car and the arrow keys to move the blue car. Each player controls one car during the same run.

organizer-master.intro: Organizer Master is a 3D puzzle game built around spatial thinking. You find matching pairs of objects and slot them into place across many levels, with the challenge growing as you clear each layer.
tips: Scan the whole arrangement before you start moving anything, so you can spot which objects form pairs.
Look for objects that share a clear visual feature, such as shape, color, or pattern, and set those aside as candidates.
If the view allows it, check objects from more than one angle, since a match may be hidden from the first view.
Clear each layer fully before moving on, because the difficulty ramps up and loose leftover pieces can make the next layer harder.
Slow down as the levels get harder and place each pair deliberately rather than rushing to fill slots.
faq: What is the goal of Organizer Master?
Your goal is to find pairs of objects and slot them perfectly into place. Each level is a 3D arrangement that you work through layer by layer.
Does the game get harder as I play?
Yes. The description says that with each layer you conquer, the difficulty ramps up, so later levels are more challenging than early ones.

tank-arena-steel-battle.intro: Tank Arena Steel Battle is an arcade shooter where you drive a tank into a battle arena and fight enemies. It tests skill, strategy, and quick reflexes.
tips: Keep moving rather than staying in one spot, since standing still makes your tank an easy target in the arena.
Watch where enemies are before you commit to a shot, and try to predict where they will be next.
Learn the arena layout early so you know where to retreat and where you have room to maneuver.
Stay calm during the faster moments, because quick reflexes matter more than rushing your clicks or taps.
Play a few short rounds to get a feel for your timing before trying longer battles.
faq: What is the goal of Tank Arena Steel Battle?
Your goal is to drive your tank into the arena and fight the enemies you encounter. The game rewards skill, strategy, and quick reflexes.
How do I control the tank?
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps. Use these inputs to act during the battle.

gears-of-war-beat-em-up.intro: A fan-made arcade beat em up inspired by Gears of War, where you fight through five chapters using melee combos, a chainsaw, Lancer fire, and active reloads. Controls are mouse click or tap.
tips: Learn which enemies you can finish fast in melee and which need ranged fire, so you do not waste time on the wrong approach.
Use active reloads whenever you get the chance, since a well-timed reload helps you keep your weapon ready during busy fights.
Mix melee combos with Lancer fire to control the pace of a fight rather than rushing into a crowd.
Save the chainsaw for moments when you are close to an enemy and can commit to it safely.
Play each chapter a few times to learn its enemy layout and where danger usually comes from.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
You fight your way through five chapters, using melee, ranged fire, and special moves to get past enemies in each one.
How do I control the character?
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps, which you use to trigger attacks, fire the Lancer, and perform actions.

obby-upgrade-your-lucky-machine.intro: Obby: Upgrade Your Lucky Machine! is an idle clicker where you earn coins and upgrade your own spin machine. You build it up over time, then challenge a bot to see who collects more winnings.
tips: Spend your early coins on upgrades that speed up your spins, since faster spins earn more over time.
Add reels gradually and check that each new reel pays off before buying the next one.
Symbol bonuses add coins to every matching symbol, so they are worth prioritising once your reel count is up.
Before a battle, make sure your machine is well upgraded, because the loser gets nothing and the winner takes all winnings from both machines.
Keep your spending balanced between speed, reels and bonuses instead of putting everything into one upgrade.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
The goal is to earn coins, buy upgrades and build a machine strong enough to out-collect the bot in battles.
How do battles against the bot work?
You and the bot each collect winnings, and the player who collects more wins. The winner takes all winnings from both machines, and the loser gets nothing.

roots-and-wheels.intro: Drive the military Ural through muddy tracks, steep climbs and broken bridges, delivering as many boxes as you can. Use your driving skill and problem-solving to reach the finish line.
tips: Move gently on the controls, since sudden throttle changes can make the truck slip in mud or lose grip on steep climbs.
Look ahead at the terrain before committing to a route, and pick the path that keeps your wheels on firmer ground.
Spend your earnings on the engine, suspension or wheels first if you keep getting stuck, because those upgrades are aimed at handling tough terrain.
Carry as many boxes as you can safely manage, since every box delivered counts toward your result.
Try a different approach when a section defeats you, such as backing up and taking another line, instead of forcing the same move again.
faq: How do I control the truck on a computer?
Press D to drive forward and A to drive backward. The controls are the same for every terrain you cross.
How do I control the truck on a mobile device?
Use the touch pedals: the right pedal moves the truck forward and the left pedal moves it backward.

mahjong-master-tile-sort-and-match.intro: Mahjong Master is a tile-matching puzzle where you pair identical mahjong tiles to clear the board. Levels get progressively more challenging, with Japanese-style scenery and power-ups to help you along.
tips: Before each move, scan the whole board for identical pairs, and check which tiles you can select right now.
Save hints for when you are truly stuck, so you still have them for harder levels later.
Use shuffle when no obvious pairs remain, rather than guessing, since it can reveal new options.
If a move closes off a route you still need, undo it straight away and try another pairing.
Play in short sessions and take a breath between levels, which helps you spot matches more easily.
faq: What is the goal of Mahjong Master?
Match identical mahjong tiles in pairs until the board is cleared. Each level is a new layout to solve.
How do I play?
Click or tap the tiles to select them and match two identical ones. The game is played entirely with a mouse or touch input.

racing-destruction-and-chase.intro: Racing: Destruction and Chase is a 3D car game where you race, escape police, or explore an open world while your car takes realistic damage. You control the car with WASD, Space, and Shift.
tips: Use the slow motion key (B) when a turn or jump gets tricky, then return to normal speed once you have lined up your line.
Use the repair key (K) as soon as your car is badly damaged, so you can keep driving instead of losing time in a messy crash.
If your car ends up upside down after a crash, press R to flip it back over quickly.
Save Shift for straight sections where you can control the car, since a boost into a corner can easily send you into a wall.
Try the camera angle key (C) to find the view that helps you judge distances and spot police cars or bots coming toward you.
faq: How do I get my car back on its wheels?
Press R to flip the car. This is useful after a crash or a jump lands you upside down.
How do I repair my car during play?
Press K to repair the car instantly. Repairs are quick, so you can keep going without a long pause.

last-to-leave-circle-obby.intro: Last to Leave Circle Obby is a fast-paced survival game where the circle shrinks as you play. You need to dodge traps, handle changing challenges, and outlast your rivals.
tips: Watch the edge of the circle at all times so you can react before the space gets too tight.
Stay alert for traps and move early rather than waiting until the danger is right on top of you.
Pay attention to how competitors move, since their positions can show you where it is safer to go.
Plan a few steps ahead instead of reacting only to what is directly in front of you.
Stay calm when the circle tightens quickly, because rushed moves are the most common way to fall out.
faq: What is the main goal of Last to Leave Circle Obby?
The goal is to be the last player still in the circle. You need to outlast your competitors while the play area keeps shrinking.
What makes the game harder as you go?
The circle tightens with every move, leaving less room to work with. Dynamic challenges and traps also demand quicker reactions.

serial-cheaters.intro: Serial Cheaters is a fast, lighthearted chase where you pursue an elusive cheater through zany obstacles. Each level gets harder, so quick reflexes matter from the start.
tips: Watch the obstacles a moment before you reach them so you can react in time rather than at the last second.
Keep your eyes on the cheater's direction and speed, since the chase depends on staying close to them.
Try a few short runs at the start to get a feel for the controls, which are designed to be intuitive.
Expect each level to be harder than the last, so stay relaxed and avoid tensing up when the action speeds up.
If you fall behind, reset your focus on the next obstacle instead of dwelling on the mistake.
faq: What is the goal of Serial Cheaters?
You chase the elusive cheater through a series of zany obstacles and try to keep up as the action gets more challenging.
How difficult does the game get?
Each level is described as more challenging than the one before, so the difficulty rises as you progress.

party-games-mini-shooter-battle.intro: Party Games: Mini Shooter Battle is a cartoon battle-royale shooter where you fight other players across four modes. Earn coins and gems by getting kills and staying alive.
