tips: Stay aware of where enemies are, since your character aims at the closest target automatically and your main job is to fire and dodge.
Focus on dodging incoming bullets rather than chasing fights, because fewer deaths lead to more coin and gem rewards.
Pick fights that you can finish quickly so you collect kills without taking unnecessary damage.
Check the Shop between rounds to compare roles and guns, and spend your earnings on options that suit how you like to fight.
Try each of the four modes to see which one fits your style, since the rewards depend on how well you perform in whichever mode you play.
faq: How do I control my character?
Use mouse click or tap to play. Your character aims at the closest target automatically, so you mainly need to fire and dodge.
How do I earn coins and gems?
You earn scores for coins and gems by shooting other players. More kills and fewer deaths lead to bigger rewards.

catch-the-snowmen.intro: Catch the Snowmen! is a winter game where you grow a crowd of snowmen by collecting gifts and fighting your way through levels. Each finished level rewards you with upgrades and a New Year's toy for your tree.
tips: Collect gifts steadily to recruit new snowmen, since a bigger crowd is what raises your place in the player ranking.
Check each enemy's level before engaging. Attack the ones below yours and retreat from any that are higher.
Use the New Year's toy you earn at the end of a level to decorate your Christmas tree, and make it part of your routine after each run.
Spend the upgrades you gain from completed levels on your snowmen's abilities, and bring in new heroes to strengthen your team.
Pick up magical items along the way, because they unlock unique abilities you will need before facing the Giant and Evil Santa boss.
faq: How do I grow my snowman crowd?
Recruit new snowmen by collecting gifts during a level. The more snowmen you have, the higher your place in the player ranking.
What should I do when an enemy is stronger than me?
Run away from any enemy that is higher than your level. You can only attack enemies below your level.

squicky.intro: Squicky is a platformer where you guide a clever mouse past large cats, grab coins, and get through levels full of obstacles. Quick reflexes and careful jumps are the keys to success.
tips: Watch the cats for a moment before moving, so you can see their pattern and pick a safe gap to pass.
Plan each jump before you make it, since the game is built around every jump counting.
Collect coins when they sit on your safe route, but do not risk a fall or a cat encounter just to reach one.
Study each new obstacle layout early in a level and note where the safe ground is before you rush ahead.
If you keep losing at the same spot, slow down and retry that section with a steadier, more deliberate rhythm.
faq: What is the main goal in Squicky?
You play as a mouse trying to gather coins and stay safe while avoiding the cats and obstacles in each level.
How do I avoid getting caught by the cats?
Use your reflexes and cunning: watch how the cats move, time your jumps carefully, and stay out of their reach.

sigma-boy-musical-clicker.intro: Sigma Boy: Musical Clicker is a rhythm-themed clicker where you tap to earn points, spend them on upgrades, and guide Sigma Boy from desert landscapes out to space. This guide covers how to plan your upgrades and keep progress steady.
tips: Tap steadily from the start, since every tap adds to the points you need for upgrades.
Spend points on upgrades as soon as you can afford them, because upgraded skills make later tapping and challenges easier.
Save a small reserve of points before you buy something big, so you are not stuck waiting when a new challenge appears.
Pay attention to the rhythm and the scenery changes, since each new landscape brings its own challenges and may call for a different approach.
Check your upgrades after each new area, and favor the ones that help with the challenges you are struggling with most.
faq: What is the goal of Sigma Boy: Musical Clicker?

The goal is to guide Sigma Boy through a series of landscapes, from deserts to space, by earning points and using them to improve his skills. Each area presents challenges that you work through as you progress.
How do I earn points?
You earn points by tapping or clicking on Sigma Boy. Each tap adds to your total points.

fnf-music-3d.intro: FNF Music 3D is a rhythm game where you battle through levels called weeks, each with three songs. You play by pressing WASD or the Arrow Keys in time with the music.
tips: Listen for the beat and press keys on it, rather than reacting only to what you see on screen.
Pick either WASD or the Arrow Keys and stick with it so your hands learn where each key is.
Each week has three songs, so take a short break between them if your focus starts to drop.
Work through the early weeks first to get used to the timing before moving on to harder ones.
Keep your fingers resting close to the keys so you can respond quickly without large hand movements.
faq: What is the goal of FNF Music 3D?
You pass multiple levels called weeks, and each week contains three songs. You progress by pressing the right keys in time with the music.
Which keys do I use to play?
You use WASD or the Arrow Keys, pressing them in time with the music.

sniper-king-2d-the-dark-city.intro: Sniper King 2D: The Dark City is a stealth shooter where you take out targets from a first-person view. Each mission rewards careful aiming and limited use of your ammo.
tips: Scan the whole area before you take a shot so you know where every target is and where guards or obstacles sit.
Wait for a clear moment instead of rushing. Patience usually matters more than speed in this game.
Treat every bullet as valuable. Only fire when you are confident the shot will hit, since ammo is limited.
Plan your order of targets so you can eliminate the most dangerous ones first without drawing attention to your position.
Stay calm when the mission gets tense. Slow, steady breathing and small adjustments to your aim help keep your shots accurate.
faq: What is the main goal of Sniper King 2D: The Dark City?
You complete strategic sniping missions by scanning, aiming, and executing your targets. Each shot should count.
How do I avoid running out of ammo?
Conserve your shots by checking the area carefully first and firing only when you have a clear, accurate line on a target.

hair-do-design.intro: Hair Do Design is a hair salon game with three stages: a spa treatment, hairstyling, and a makeup makeover. Work through them in order to transform your character from start to finish.
tips: Treat the spa stage as the foundation, since the hair you style later is shaped by how well you prepare it.
Pick a hairstyle that suits the character before adding colour, so the look feels planned rather than random.
Keep your colour choices consistent with each other so the hair and makeup look like one complete style.
Use the makeover stage to balance the look: if the hair is bold, keep the makeup softer, and the reverse.
Check the finished character from a few angles before moving on, so you can fix any mismatched details.
faq: What is the goal of Hair Do Design?
The goal is to take a character through a spa treatment, a hairstyling session, and a makeup makeover. The game is about creating a finished, colourful look.
What order should I follow in the game?

The description presents the stages in a clear order: spa treatment first, then styling with vibrant hairstyles, and finally the makeup makeover. Following that sequence keeps each step building on the last.

my-little-farm.intro: My Little Farm is a casual clicker where you move around with an on-screen joystick, gather wood, stone, and water, and build up a farm. Its idle-style pace suits short, relaxed sessions.
tips: Start by chopping nearby trees and rocks to build up wood and stone, since those materials are what you need to construct buildings.
Before heading toward a building, check how many resources you have so you can stop gathering once you have enough.
Dig your well early so you have water available as you expand, rather than waiting until a project is blocked.
Breed animals to collect fertilizer while you work on other tasks, so your plants are ready when you need them.
Plan a loop that passes several resource spots in a row, such as trees, rocks, and water, to save walking time.
faq: What is the main goal of My Little Farm?
The goal is to gather resources and use them to build your farm, including a mill and other buildings. Progress comes from collecting materials and constructing buildings as you go.
How do I move and collect resources?
Move with the on-screen joystick. Approach a tree to cut it down for wood, approach water to extract it, and chop rocks to get stone.

cyber-arrows-brain-puzzle-game.intro: Cyber Arrows is an arrow-based logic puzzle set on neon pathways. Each level asks you to work out the right order to clear the arrows without leaving blocked paths behind.
tips: Before your first swipe, check which arrows point to open space and which are boxed in. Start with the ones that have a clear way out.
Think of each arrow as a path that could block another. Clearing an arrow that sits in front of others often opens the board.
Trace the route an arrow will take before you swipe it, so you do not create an obstacle for a later move.
If a level stops making progress, step back and look at the whole board again. Small details in the arrow directions are easy to miss on a first look.
Expect the levels to get harder. Use the logic you built on earlier levels to spot patterns in the new layouts faster.
faq: How do I move an arrow?
Swipe in the direction you want the arrow to go. Each swipe is one move, so plan the sequence before you start.
What is the main goal of each level?
Clear all the arrows on the board by choosing the correct order. Avoid blocked paths and tricky situations that would stop you from finishing.

road-gunner-3d.intro: Road Gunner 3D is an arcade driving and shooting game where you merge parts, upgrade your vehicle, and fight through dangerous roads. Earn coins to unlock new rides and survive each run to reach the finish.
tips: Merge matching parts early so your vehicle gets stronger before the roads get harder.
Spend coins on upgrades that help the most in your current run rather than saving everything for a later vehicle.
Keep your finger or mouse held down to fire, and drag left or right to keep your aim on the nearest threats.
Save your rockets for groups of enemies or blocked stretches of road so they clear the path when you need it most.
If a run goes badly, try again with a different merge combination to see which parts suit your play style.
faq: What is the goal of Road Gunner 3D?
Survive each run by blasting enemies on the road and reach the finish line. Coins you earn help you unlock new rides.
How do I fire my weapon?
Hold your mouse button or finger down to fire, and drag left or right to aim.

noob-vs-choo-choo-charles.intro: Noob VS. Choo-Choo Charles is an endless runner where you keep Noob alive while outrunning relentless enemies. Collect coins, unlock characters, and see how long you can survive the chase.
tips: Keep your attention on the path ahead rather than on the enemy behind you, since most danger comes from obstacles you have not reached yet.
Treat every run as a chance to learn the pattern of the challenges, and use what you notice to plan your next move.
Grab coins when they are safely within reach, but do not take risks that could end your run, because survival matters more than any single pickup.
Spend your coins with a plan in mind, and compare characters before unlocking so you choose one that suits how you like to play.
Take short breaks between runs if the suspense starts to affect your focus, since clear decisions matter in a fast endless runner.
faq: What is the main goal of Noob VS. Choo-Choo Charles?
The goal is to keep Noob alive by outrunning terrifying foes through an endless chase. Your run continues for as long as you can avoid being caught.
What can I collect during a run?
You can collect coins while you run. Coins can help you unlock unique characters.

blend-it-perfect.intro: Blend It Perfect is a relaxed 3D juicing game with a range of levels. Slide to play and enjoy the process of making juice at your own pace.
tips: Use smooth, steady slides rather than fast, jerky movements, since the game is built around relaxed play.
Take short breaks between levels so your fingers can rest, as the game itself suggests being careful not to hurt them.
Try each level at a calm pace first to learn how your slides affect the juicing before you aim for a better result.
Watch how the levels get more challenging and adjust your slide size or speed to match them.
If you get stuck on a level, pause and look at the layout again before sliding, instead of repeating the same move.
faq: What is the goal of Blend It Perfect?
The goal is to make juice by completing each level of this 3D juicing game. The levels become more challenging as you progress.
How do I control the game?
You play by sliding on the screen. Slide gently and steadily to keep your movements controlled.

plug-man-race.intro: Plug Man Race is a collecting racer where you gather red battery items to get past switches and finish ahead of the other racers. Click or tap to play.
tips: Focus on collecting red battery items on each platform, since you need many of them to pass the current switch.
Use the batteries you gather right away on the switch so you keep moving toward the finish line.
If the other racers are stronger than you, avoid them and concentrate on picking up red batteries instead.
Watch your position as you go, because you must cross the finish line in first place to win the level.
Save your gold coins for skins you like once you have enough, rather than spending them early.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You need to cross the finish line in first place to win the level. Collecting battery items and passing switches helps you get there.
How do I get past a switch?
Each platform requires a lot of red battery items. Collect them and use them to pass the current switch.

ninja-bamboo-assassin.intro: Ninja: Bamboo Assassin is an arcade stealth game set in treacherous bamboo forests. You play as a ninja who must move through levels full of enemies, obstacles, and traps to eliminate targets silently.
tips: Scout each area before you move in, and note where enemies are and how they patrol so you can plan a route.
Favor stealth over direct fights. Staying unseen lets you pick off targets quietly and keeps your options open.
Watch for obstacles and traps early in each level and time your movement around them rather than rushing through.
Stay patient between bursts of action. The game rewards strategic planning, so a short pause to think can save a risky dash.
Practice your timing and reflexes. Fast-paced combat is easier to handle once you learn the rhythm of enemy movements.
faq: What is the main goal of Ninja: Bamboo Assassin?
You play as a ninja on a stealth mission, navigating bamboo forest levels to eliminate targets silently while avoiding enemies, obstacles, and traps.
How can I avoid getting caught by enemies?
Use your stealth and move carefully, keeping an eye on enemy positions so you can outmaneuver them rather than engaging them head-on.

squid-games-red-light.intro: Squid Games Red Light is an arcade challenge where you complete tasks before each one's time period ends. Failing a task eliminates you, so timing and quick decisions matter.
tips: Check how much time each task gives you as soon as it starts, and plan your route before you move.
Use left mouse clicks to run and move in the direction you want, keeping your movements steady rather than rushing into mistakes.
Treat every task as harder than it looks, and expect the first few attempts to teach you how each challenge behaves.
Stay focused on the current task, since a single failed task eliminates you and you cannot take part in any later tasks.
If a task is slipping away, keep moving toward the finish instead of stopping, because the period is what decides whether you survive.
faq: What is the main goal of Squid Games Red Light?
Your goal is to complete each task before its time period runs out. Players who fail a task are eliminated and cannot perform another task.
How do I control my player?
Use your mouse. Click the left mouse button to run, and use the mouse to move in the direction you want to go.

save-the-baby-home-rush.intro: Save the Baby: Home Rush is an arcade puzzle where you guide a lost baby home by drawing paths around dangerous obstacles. Each level is more complex than the last, so careful planning matters.
tips: Study the whole level before you draw anything. Spot the obstacles and the route home first, then decide on a path.
Plan around the most dangerous obstacles first, since they are the hardest to avoid when you are already on the move.
Look for a clear route that keeps the baby well away from hazards rather than one that just gets close to the goal.
Early levels are good for learning how the obstacles behave. Watch closely and use what you learn in later levels.
If a level goes wrong, pause and rethink the whole route instead of making small changes. A fresh plan often works better than patching a failed one.
faq: What is the goal of Save the Baby: Home Rush?
Your goal is to guide the lost baby safely home by drawing paths that steer it around perilous obstacles.
How do the levels change as you play?
The levels become increasingly complex, with more obstacles and challenges that test your problem-solving skills.

funny-gummy-characters.intro: Funny Gummy Characters is a playful mouse-controlled game where you stretch, pull, squash, and twist wobbly characters into silly shapes. Their faces and bodies bounce and jiggle like jelly.
tips: Try pulling on different parts of a character, such as an arm, a face, or the body, to see how each part reacts differently.
Squash a character gently before stretching it hard, so you can compare how the shape changes in both directions.
Combine stretching and twisting in one character to create more unusual shapes than either move makes on its own.
Watch how the wobble continues after you let go, and wait for it to settle before making your next change.
Switch between characters often, since each one may react to the same movement in its own way.
faq: What is the goal of Funny Gummy Characters?
The description does not list a specific goal or score. The game is about playing freely and making funny gummy shapes.
How do I control the characters?
You play with the mouse. Use it to stretch, pull, squash, and twist the characters.

misland-online.intro: Misland is a management game where you start on a deserted island with bare hands and grow it into a thriving paradise. Gather resources, upgrade your tools, and build a team of assistants to keep things running.
tips: Start by picking apples with your bare hands, then focus on earning enough resources to buy your first tool upgrades.
Use ships to trade resources when you have a surplus, since trading is the main way to grow your wealth.
Once you can afford them, assign assistants to repetitive jobs like apple harvesting, tree felling, and quarrying so resources keep coming in while you explore.
Keep an eye out for invading monsters, which try to steal your resources, and use your sword to drive them off before they take much.
Move around with WASD or click and drag with the mouse, and explore the island early to find resources that you have not yet discovered.
faq: What is the main goal of Misland?
The goal is to turn a deserted island into a prosperous paradise by gathering resources, upgrading your skills and tools, and building up your wealth.
How do I move around the island?
Use the WASD keys or click and drag with the mouse to move. Exploring helps you discover new resources.

crossy-rails.intro: Crossy Rails is a logic puzzle where you arrange rail blocks into one continuous track so the train can reach its destination. Each level gets a little harder as you go.
tips: Before you move anything, look at where the train starts and where it needs to end, and picture the simplest route between them.
Check which rail pieces have openings on which sides, so you know which neighbours each piece must connect to.
Work backwards from the destination when a level feels stuck, placing the final pieces first so the route is easier to see.
Make sure every gap is closed before you expect the train to move, since a single unconnected section will stop the whole track.
Try a different arrangement if you get stuck, and keep track of your earlier moves so you do not repeat the same layout.
faq: What is the goal of Crossy Rails?

Your goal is to move and arrange the rail blocks so they form a complete track from the starting point to the destination. Once the track is ready, the train travels across it and the level is complete.
How do I move the rail pieces?
Use the controls to move each rail block left, right, up, or down. Rotate or reposition pieces until every section connects properly.

slap-kings-fun-and-run-3d-game.intro: Slap Kings is a relaxing 3D reflection game where you hit other people and beat them before they beat you. Tap or click to play and see how quickly you can react.
tips: Focus on reacting quickly, since this is a reflection game and speed matters more than rushing in.
Watch your opponent closely for the moment to act instead of tapping or clicking randomly.
Stay calm and relaxed; hasty inputs are more likely to cause misses.
If a fight feels too hard, upgrade your abilities before trying again rather than repeating the same approach.
Pay attention to what changes after each attempt so you can adjust your timing next time.
faq: How do I play Slap Kings?
Use tap or click to hit other people and beat them before they beat you. The game is built around quick reactions.
What should I do if I keep losing?
Upgrade your abilities and try again, as the game suggests when winning feels difficult. Each retry is a chance to apply what you noticed.

sink-or-float.intro: Sink or Float is a physics prediction game where you decide whether objects will sink or float when dropped into water. Each correct answer earns points.
tips: Before you choose, picture the object in water and ask whether it feels heavy for its size. That quick check helps you decide between sinking and floating.
Think about what the object is made of, since materials like wood and metal behave very differently in water. Using that habit across rounds makes your answers more consistent.
Take a moment with each object instead of clicking quickly. Each correct answer earns points, so accuracy matters more than speed.
Notice which objects you get wrong and think about why they surprised you. Spotting those patterns will improve your predictions over time.
Keep your selection steady with a mouse or a finger so you do not pick the wrong answer by accident.
faq: What is the goal of Sink or Float?
The goal is to predict whether each object will sink or float when it is dropped into water. Every correct prediction earns you points.
How do I play Sink or Float?
Use your mouse or your finger to select an object. Then decide whether it will sink or float when submerged in water.

blue-and-red-impostor.intro: Blue and Red Impostor is a two-player adventure where both characters must finish each of the 15 parts before the rising water catches up. Speed and teamwork decide how far you get.
tips: Watch the water from the first second, since it is the timer for every part. Start moving toward the exit right away instead of waiting.
Look at the layout before you commit to a route, so you can plan the fastest path for both characters.
Split the controls clearly: one player uses WASD and the other uses the arrow keys, so you never fight over the same keys.
Keep both characters moving in the same direction when possible, so neither one falls behind and slows the team down.
If you are playing on touch controls, keep your movements short and steady so you can react quickly when the water rises.
faq: What is the goal of Blue and Red Impostor?
Both characters need to complete each part of the episode before the water rises. You have to be fast to survive.
How many parts does the game have?
The game has 15 parts, and each one must be passed before the water rises.

noob-legends-dungeon-adventures.intro: Noob Legends Dungeon Adventures is a 2D arcade adventure where you fight zombies and drones, upgrade your weapons, and complete missions to rescue friends. Exploring can also uncover hidden secrets.
tips: Check your mission goal before you start fighting, so you know whether you need to clear enemies, reach a place, or collect something.
Spend upgrades on the weapons you use most often, since the game lets you enhance them and a stronger weapon makes every later fight easier.
Deal with the most dangerous threats first when several zombies and drones are on screen, so you do not get overwhelmed.
Take a moment to explore once an area is safe, because the game rewards curious players with secrets.
Keep track of your friends' missions as you play, so you can switch between combat and progress without losing the main objective.
faq: What is the main goal of Noob Legends Dungeon Adventures?
The main goal is to complete missions to save your friends while fighting zombies and drones. Exploring the dungeon can also reveal secrets.
How do I get stronger during a run?
You can enhance your weapons as you play, so improving the ones you rely on is the most direct way to get stronger.

basketball-master-kids.intro: Basketball Master Kids is a street basketball shooter set on an outdoor court. You aim and shoot your way past obstacles and defenders, and the game rewards careful, precise play.
tips: Before each throw, look at where the defenders are standing and plan a route for the ball that avoids them.
Take a moment to line up your aim instead of rushing. Precision matters more than speed in this game.
Pay attention to the obstacles on the court and try to find a shot angle that gets around them.
If a shot misses, watch where the ball lands and adjust your next aim. Small changes in angle can make a big difference.
Keep your practice short and focused. Repeating the same shot type helps you learn how your aim responds.
faq: What is the main goal in Basketball Master Kids?
You aim and shoot the ball on an outdoor street court while getting past obstacles and defenders. Success depends on precise aiming and smart planning.
Does the game require complicated controls?
The game uses intuitive controls, so the basic aim and shoot actions should feel natural. Spending a few shots getting comfortable with them helps before you try harder situations.

squid-sugar-cooking.intro: Squid Sugar Cooking is a cooking game inspired by the Squid Sugar Challenge. You gather a few ingredients to make the sugar shape from the game and unlock more shapes as you go.
tips: Gather all the ingredients before you start, so you are not hunting for them in the middle of a step.
Work through each step calmly with your mouse or tap controls rather than rushing, since the shape you make depends on following the process.
Try to match the sugar shape shown in the game before moving on, so you understand each step of the recipe.
Once you have a shape working, experiment with the other shapes you can unlock to see how each one differs.
Remember that this is only a game. The description warns against trying the sugar challenge in real life, so keep the cooking inside the game.
faq: What is the goal of Squid Sugar Cooking?
The goal is to make the Squid Sugar shown in the game using a few ingredients. You can also unlock many other beautiful shapes.
How do I control the game?
You play with your mouse or by tapping the screen.

rage-maze-master.intro: Rage Maze Master is a puzzle game where you move a fighter through mazes, paint every tile in your color, and defeat the enemies in your way. Each level is complete only when the whole field is painted and all enemies are gone.
tips: Plan your route before you start moving, since you need to cover every tile and defeat every enemy in the same level.
Look at the layout first and note any tiles that are awkward to reach, so you don't end up stranded with unpainted areas left behind.
Check where enemies are standing and decide the order you will deal with them, so they don't block the paths you still need.
Keep an eye on the unpainted tiles as you go and fill in small gaps before moving on to larger sections.
Use the arrow keys for short, precise moves on desktop, or short swipes on mobile, so you stay in control of each step.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You must paint the entire playing field and defeat all enemies before the level is complete.
How do I move my fighter?
On desktop, use the arrow keys to move up, down, left, or right. On mobile, swipe in the direction you want to go.

tictoc-urban-outfits.intro: Dress up four fashionable TicToc friends in urban fashion trends. This one-player game is about styling looks and trying out the latest outfits for girls.
tips: Work through all four characters rather than focusing on one, since each is presented with her own hottest looks.
Try mixing pieces from different categories to see which urban combinations look best together.
Take your time comparing options before settling on a look, because the fun is in exploring the trends.
Check each finished outfit from start to finish so the look feels complete and balanced.
Use mouse clicks or taps steadily and calmly, so you can make clear choices at your own pace.
faq: How do I play this game?
Use mouse clicks or taps to choose items and dress up the characters. There is one player and no special controls are described.
How many characters can I dress up?
The game features four of the TicToc stars, described as the most fashionable BFFs in the collection.

animal-shape-puzzle.intro: Animal Shape Puzzle is a casual matching game for kids. You match small pieces to form simple animal shapes, and you can play with friends or classmates.
tips: Look for the outline of the animal first, then find the pieces that fill its edges before working on the middle.
Start with the pieces that have the most distinctive edges, such as corners or curved parts, since they are easiest to place correctly.
Check the shape of the whole animal before placing a piece so you do not have to move it again later.
If you are stuck, try a piece in a different spot instead of forcing it, because a wrong fit often looks almost right.
When playing with friends, take turns and call out which shape you are working on so you do not both go for the same piece.
faq: How do I play Animal Shape Puzzle?
Use your mouse or tap the screen to pick up and move the pieces. Match each piece to its place so the animal shape is complete.
Is there a way to compete with other players?
The description says you can call schoolmates and friends to battle. Agree on the rules with them before you start so everyone knows how to win.

red-hide-ball.intro: Red Hide Ball is a logic puzzle where you hide good balls from monsters by placing them behind safe zones and obstacles. Each board asks you to plan moves ahead and reach a secure position.
tips: Before you move anything, look at where each monster can travel and which paths it can reach. This tells you which spots are actually safe.
Use blockers and obstacles between a monster and your good ball, rather than relying on distance alone.
Aim for the fewest moves that achieve the goal. Wasted taps and swipes make it harder to keep track of the board.
If a level stalls, undo your thinking: trace the outcome of each move one step ahead before committing to it.
Try to predict where monsters will go after each of your moves, and check that the good ball stays hidden in that new position too.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Hide the good ball from the monsters by placing it behind safe zones or obstacles. Once it is secure or the level goal is reached, you move on to the next puzzle.
How do I move the pieces?
You tap or swipe objects on the board, often dragging them. Use the smallest number of moves needed to reach the solution.

pixel-hero-survivor.intro: Pixel Hero Survivor is a survival game where you fight off endless waves of monsters with one of three heroes. Pick upgrades between waves and use your hero's exclusive skill to hold back the horde.
tips: Keep moving rather than standing still, since the monsters keep coming in endless waves and staying in one place lets them surround you.
Try each of the three heroes before settling on one, and learn how each hero's exclusive skill works so you know when to cast it.
Save your skill for crowded moments when many enemies are close together, instead of using it the moment it becomes available.
Read each upgrade choice carefully after an attack wave and pick the ones that support your hero's strengths and the way you play.
Practice your movement on the controls you use most, WASD or mouse on PC and the virtual joystick on touch screens, so steering feels automatic during busy fights.
faq: What is the goal of Pixel Hero Survivor?
The goal is to survive endless waves of incoming monsters for as long as you can. Each wave gets you closer to the next upgrade choice.
How do I move my hero?
On PC, use the WASD keys or the mouse. On touch screens, use the virtual joystick on the screen.

rune-reactor.intro: Rune Reactor is a spell-building auto-battler where you draft runes, combine them into spells, and survive enemy waves. Your wizard attacks on its own, so your choices in rune drafting and spending decide how far you get.
tips: Pick elemental runes and modifier runes that work together, since combining them is how you discover new spells.
Spend gold between waves on health when your wizard is taking heavy damage, rather than saving everything for runes.
Click dropped gold and Arcane Dust quickly, because both disappear if you wait too long.
Keep an eye on the bonus wheel and use it whenever it becomes available, as it can give you a boost at no cost to your run.
Save Arcane Dust for permanent upgrades after each run, so every attempt leaves you stronger for the next one.
faq: What is the main goal of Rune Reactor?
Survive as many waves as possible while defeating bosses along the way. Each run ends when your wizard falls.
Do I need to aim my wizard's spells?
No, your wizard automatically attacks nearby enemies. Your job is to choose and combine runes and manage gold between waves.

jumpero.intro: Jumpero is an arcade jumping game where timing and momentum decide whether you clear towering walls. Each well-timed leap pushes you further into its physics-defying world.
tips: Watch the wall ahead before you commit, and plan your jump around its height rather than reacting at the last moment.
Build momentum with your approach, since a steady run-up tends to carry you higher than a standing start.
Practice the rhythm of your jumps in short attempts, and pay attention to how each jump feels so you can repeat the good ones.
If a jump fails, stop and reset your timing instead of rushing back in, because most missed leaps come from jumping too early or too late.
Focus on consistency over speed; a series of clean, controlled jumps will get you further than a few risky ones.
faq: What is the main goal of Jumpero?
The goal is to jump over towering walls by using good timing and momentum. Each successful leap lets you keep exploring the game.
What skills matter most in Jumpero?
Timing and momentum are the core skills the game is built around. Reading the height of each wall and judging when to jump are the key parts of playing well.

bus-simulator-3d-bus-coach.intro: Take the driver's seat in this 3D bus simulator. Drive through busy city streets and rougher off-road routes while picking up and dropping off passengers safely.
tips: Slow down before each stop so passengers can board and leave without rushing.
Watch the road ahead in busy city traffic and leave extra space before turns and lane changes.
Take off-road sections at a gentler pace so the bus stays under control on uneven ground.
Learn how the bus responds to clicks or taps early on, so you can steer smoothly when routes get tricky.
Focus on safe driving over speed, since the game is built around realistic bus handling.
faq: What is the main goal of Bus Simulator 3D Bus Coach?
You drive a bus on city streets and off-road routes, picking up and dropping off passengers safely while handling the bus realistically.
How do I control the bus?
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps, and the instructions do not list any other controls.

stick-new-year-in-prison.intro: Stick New Year in Prison is a point-and-click escape game where a Stickman character is locked in a cell on New Year's Eve. Your job is to find three successful ways out using objects around the prison.
tips: Click on everything in the cell and in each new location, since most of the clues and escape items are hidden in plain sight.
Pay attention to the ten items that appear in the Christmas Day package and think about which ones could realistically help with a break-out.
When you get stuck, look at objects you have already collected and try combining or using them on different parts of the scene.
Note down any clues or odd details you notice, because some problems may depend on something you saw earlier in the game.
Explore the New Year's Eve themed locations fully, as each one may hold the next problem you need to solve.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Your goal is to find three successful ways to escape from the prison. Clicking the right objects and solving the problems you face will get you there.
How do I control the game?
Use a computer mouse to click on objects. On a mobile device, you can use a stylus or your finger instead.

spider-solitaire-pro.intro: Spider Solitaire Pro is a single-player card puzzle built on two decks. You win by stacking cards in descending order until every stack is cleared.
tips: Before moving anything, look for hidden cards you can uncover, since revealing new cards gives you more options.
Build descending runs in the tableau even when suits do not match, but try to keep cards of the same suit together when you can, because a complete run is what clears a stack.
Avoid burying low cards under high ones early on, as this can block the sequences you need later.
Only click the stock when you have no useful moves left, because each click adds a new row of cards and can make the layout harder to manage.
Think ahead about which stack each card should end up on, so you do not run out of moves before you can eliminate a full stack.
faq: What is the goal of Spider Solitaire Pro?
The goal is to stack cards in descending order in the tableau until you eliminate all of the stacks.
Do I need to match suits?
No, suits do not need to be sorted, though matching suits can make it easier to build complete runs.

fruit-fusion.intro: Fruit Fusion is a merge puzzle where you drop fruits onto a board and combine matching pairs into bigger fruits. Score as many points as you can before the board fills up.
tips: Before each drop, check where the matching fruits are on the board so you can line up the next merge.
Try to keep the space near the top of the board open, since a crowded top is what ends the round.
Look for chances to chain merges, because one merge can create a fruit that sets off another.
If you have a choice, place a fruit where it will touch its identical match rather than in an isolated spot.
Watch for fruits that are hard to fit in, and avoid stacking them in a way that leaves gaps you cannot use.
faq: How does the game end?
The round ends when the board fills up with fruit and there is no room left to drop more.
How do I score points?
You earn points by merging identical fruits, and bigger merges and combos help you build a higher score.

night-silk-dark-city-fashionistas.intro: Night Silk Dark City Fashionistas is a dress-up game set in a gloomy city, where two friends prepare for a Gothic ball in an old mansion. You create holiday looks in a noir palette of black, graphite, blood red and silver.
tips: Pick a base palette of deep black and graphite first, then add blood red or silver as accents so the look stays cohesive with the noir theme.
Use silver sparingly for highlights, since the description calls it dazzling and it can easily overpower a darker outfit.
Work on the two friends' looks one at a time so you can compare them and make sure they feel like a matched pair for the ball.
Try a few combinations before settling on a final image, since each click or tap brings a new look to life and it is easy to experiment.
Keep the Gothic mansion setting in mind when choosing details, aiming for dramatic, mysterious styles rather than everyday ones.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
The goal is to help the two friends create perfect holiday images for their Gothic ball in the old mansion. Each finished look should fit the noir style.
How do I control the game?
Click with the mouse or touch the screen to bring each image to life. The controls are simple, so you can focus on styling.

blue-chameleon.intro: Blue Chameleon is a platformer where you dodge one-eyed monsters, gather gold coins, and collect hearts to boost your health across stages.
tips: Watch the one-eyed monsters for a moment before moving so you can see their pattern and avoid rushing into them.
Pick up hearts when your health is getting low, since they are your way to recover before a risky stretch.
Grab gold coins when they are safe to reach, but do not let chasing them pull you into danger.
Take each stage slowly at first to learn where the hazards appear, then move faster once you know the layout.
If you lose health, pause to regroup and plan the next section rather than pushing forward on low health.
faq: What is the main goal in Blue Chameleon?
You try to survive and get as far as you can through the stages while dodging monsters and collecting gold coins and hearts.
How do hearts help during a run?
Hearts boost your health, which gives you more room to make mistakes when you face the one-eyed monsters.

monster-trucks-kids-racing.intro: Monster Trucks Kids Racing is an adventure driving game for kids. You steer big monster machines along a course, crushing cars and collecting stars, with fireworks and balloon popping at the end of each level.
tips: Look ahead along the course so you can spot cars to crush and stars to collect before you reach them.
Try the jump button at different points on the track to see where it helps your truck cover more ground.
Use the horn when you want to get a feel for how the sounds work, then switch the music track to find one you enjoy.
Keep your attention on the course rather than the buttons so you do not miss stars or cars along the way.
Play each level through to the end to see the fireworks and balloon popping that close it out.
faq: What is the main goal of Monster Trucks Kids Racing?
Drive your monster truck along the course, crush the cars you pass, and collect stars. Each level ends with fireworks and balloon popping.
How do I control the monster truck?
Tap or click the big buttons on screen. They let you jump, beep the horn, and change the music track.

god-of-entropy.intro: God Of Entropy is a falling-sand game with a story mode and a sandbox mode. You place and mix elements to reach each level's goal or to build and break whatever you like.
tips: Before starting a story level, read the goal and note which elements seem most useful for it, then test them in small amounts.
Use the brush size control for broad areas and fine detail; a large brush fills space quickly, while a small one lets you shape edges carefully.
Shift plus click and drag draws a straight line, which is handy for walls, floors, and channels that guide falling elements.
Try chain reactions on a small scale first so you can see how one element affects its neighbors before building something larger.
In sandbox mode, save your experiments as you go and try changing one variable at a time to learn how each element behaves.
faq: What is the goal of Story Mode?
Each level has a goal that you complete by using the elements available to you. Finishing it lets you progress through the story.
How do I choose an element to place?
Click an icon in the left toolbar, then left click and drag on the scene to draw with it.

who-says-pigs-can-t-fly.intro: Who Says Pigs Can't Fly is a physics-based slingshot puzzler where you launch a piggy at pirates across whimsical levels. Careful aiming and planning your shots are the keys to progress.
tips: Before each launch, watch how the piggy moves on its first few steps so you can judge the physics and adjust your next shot.
Look over the whole level before firing. Spotting which pirates are easiest to reach first can save shots for harder targets.
Make small aim changes and compare the results rather than swinging wildly, so you learn how the launch power and angle affect the flight.
If a level stalls, try a different order of targets. Puzzles in this game often reward a new approach over repeated identical shots.
Take a moment to think through the path of the piggy, including bounces and falls, before you pull back the slingshot.
faq: What is the goal of Who Says Pigs Can't Fly?
You use a slingshot to launch a piggy at wily pirates and work through whimsical levels filled with puzzles. The game focuses on aiming well and planning your shots.
How should I approach the harder levels?
Study the layout first and think about which shot will set up the next one. Testing small variations in aim usually helps more than repeating the same launch.

rescue-skibd-rope-cut-puzzle.intro: Rescue Skibd Rope Cut Puzzle is a 3D puzzle where you cut a rope at the right moment and place to help a man avoid danger. You play by clicking or tapping on the screen.
tips: Study the whole scene before you make a cut, paying attention to which rope is holding the man and what is below him.
Think about what will happen after the rope is cut, such as whether he will swing, fall, or land somewhere safe.
Try to plan your cut instead of tapping quickly, since one wrong cut can end the attempt.
If a level does not work out, note what went wrong and try a different cut point on your next attempt.
Take breaks between harder levels so you can come back with a fresh look at the layout.
faq: How do I play Rescue Skibd Rope Cut Puzzle?
Use a mouse click or a tap to cut the rope in the right place so the man avoids danger.
What is the goal of each level?
Your goal is to cut the rope at the right spot to help the man get out of his desperate situation.

gun-shooter.intro: Gun Shooter is an action shooting game built around reflexes and precision. You can play solo missions or challenge friends in multiplayer, with several difficulty levels to choose from.
tips: Start on an easier difficulty level to get a feel for how quickly targets move before you raise the challenge.
Focus on tracking a moving target and leading your shot rather than aiming at where it currently is.
Pay attention to the dynamic environment around you, since it can affect where targets appear and how you line up your shots.
Use solo missions to practice your timing and precision before you take on friends in multiplayer.
Take short breaks between rounds so your reflexes stay sharp and your aim does not drift from tiredness.
faq: What is the main goal of Gun Shooter?
The game tests your reflexes and precision by asking you to hit ever-moving targets across dynamic environments. Success comes from accurate, quick shooting.
Can I play with other people?
Yes, you can challenge friends in multiplayer as well as play solo missions. Multiplayer adds a competitive element for sharpshooters who want to test their skills against others.

tricky-puzzle-brain-test.intro: Tricky Puzzle - Brain Test is a casual logic game where each puzzle asks you to think sideways. Solutions often come from physical actions like shaking, tilting, or rotating your device.
tips: Look at the whole screen before acting, since the clue is often in a small detail like a background object or a character's position.
When you feel stuck, try an action you would not normally expect, such as shaking or rotating the device, instead of tapping the same spot again.
Test one idea at a time so you can tell which action caused the change.
Keep track of what each puzzle asks for, such as saving aliens, counting bees, or opening doors, so you do not overlook a simple goal.
If a puzzle seems unsolvable, step away for a moment and come back with a fresh look, which often helps with out-of-the-box thinking.
faq: What is the goal of each puzzle?
Each puzzle asks you to solve a task such as saving aliens, counting bees, petting a dog, or opening a door. The task is shown on screen.
How do I solve the puzzles?
Shake, twist, or flip your phone as well as tapping the screen. Many answers depend on using the device in an unexpected way.

color-lines.intro: Color Lines is a block puzzle where you arrange colorful blocks on a grid. Your aim is to complete lines to clear space as the challenge gradually rises.
tips: Look a few moves ahead before each placement so you do not fill the grid in a way that leaves no room to work.
Group blocks of similar color where you can, since this helps you complete lines sooner and frees up space.
Keep some open space clear in the middle of the grid, because it gives you room to place blocks when the pressure builds.
Pay attention to how the challenge changes as you play, and slow down when the board starts to feel crowded.
Plan your moves rather than reacting to the next block alone, since each move adds complexity to the board.
faq: What is the main goal in Color Lines?
The goal is to arrange the colorful blocks on the grid and complete lines to clear space on the board.
How can I last longer before the board fills up?
Keep the grid tidy, avoid scattering blocks across many areas, and clear lines whenever you have the chance to free up room.

war-v-path-of-the-survivor.intro: A story-driven first-person zombie shooter set in a world hit by a man-made virus. You fight through hordes of zombies, buy weapons, and add modules to them as you progress.
tips: Use right mouse button to aim when enemies are at range, since steadier shots help you conserve ammo in a long fight.
Reload with R during quiet moments rather than in the middle of a crowd, so you are not left empty when zombies close in.
Use LSHIFT to run between areas and to reposition, but walk when you need precise aim, because sprinting leaves you less controlled.
Press T to inspect your weapons regularly so you know their condition and can judge which one suits the situation.
Spend your progress on weapon modules that match how you play, and keep an eye on your leveling system to plan upgrades ahead of tougher zombie types.
faq: How do I move and sprint?
Use WASD to move, and hold LSHIFT to switch to running. Press SPACEBAR to jump.
How do I shoot and aim?
Left mouse button fires your weapon and right mouse button aims. Aiming before you fire helps you make more accurate shots.

clock-head.intro: Clock Head is a rhythm-based arcade game where you keep your clock face intact by timing your taps. Hit the glowing orbs in sync with the clock arm while your head keeps shrinking.
tips: Watch the clock arm's movement before you tap, so you can predict when it will reach each glowing orb.
Focus on keeping a steady rhythm rather than reacting to each orb on its own.
Stay calm under pressure, since the shrinking head adds urgency and rushed taps are more likely to miss.
Practice short stretches of play to get a feel for the timing before trying to keep your clock face intact for longer.
faq: What is the goal of Clock Head?
Keep your unique clock face intact by timing your taps well while your head relentlessly shrinks.
What do I need to tap?
Tap to hit the glowing orbs, timing each tap so it lines up with the clock arm.

truck-space-2.intro: Truck Space 2 is a 3D driving game where you steer a large truck with a trailer and park it in a marked spot. Road signs show where and in which direction the trailer should go.
tips: Read the road signs before you start turning, since they tell you which spot to aim for and which way to back the trailer in.
Drive slowly at first so you can see how the trailer swings when you turn, especially on tight corners.
Use the camera controls to check the gap between the trailer and the parking lines from more than one angle before you finish the manoeuvre.
Make small steering adjustments rather than large ones, because the trailer reacts more to big turns and can drift off line.
If you lose your bearings, zoom out to see the whole parking area and the position of the trailer relative to the marked spot.
faq: What is the goal of Truck Space 2?
The goal is to drive the truck with its trailer and park it in the marked parking spot. Road signs show where and in which direction to park.
How do I drive the truck on desktop?
Use the arrow keys or the W, A, S and D keys to drive. Use the mouse to zoom and rotate the camera.

frog-byte.intro: Frog Byte is an arcade game where you play a hungry toad. Tap to catch insects, avoid the bombs, and try to climb the leaderboard.
tips: Keep your eyes moving across the whole swamp instead of fixing on one spot, so you spot both insects and bombs early.
Before each tap, check where the bombs are, since a quick catch is only worth it if the path is clear.
Stay calm as the challenges escalate. Reacting smoothly usually works better than tapping rapidly.
Pay attention to patterns in how the insects and bombs appear, and use them to plan your next few moves.
Play short sessions to practice your reflexes, then compare your best run with your friends on the leaderboard.
faq: What is the main goal in Frog Byte?
Catch as many delicious insects as you can while dodging the tricky bombs. Your score rises with each successful catch.
How do I control the toad?
You play by tapping, using simple gestures to catch insects. There are no complicated controls to learn.

zodiac-runner.intro: Zodiac Runner is a vertical arcade runner with 3D platforms and zodiac items. You start with one of two zodiac signs, then collect matching items to upgrade your suit as you climb.
tips: Choose your starting zodiac with care, since it decides which items you will be collecting from the start.
Focus on items that match your current zodiac sign, because collecting them is what upgrades your suit.
Keep your drags short and steady so you stay on the 3D platforms instead of overcorrecting.
Look ahead toward the upper part of the screen to plan your route, since the game is played vertically.
Stay calm when your suit changes automatically and keep collecting, rather than changing direction suddenly.
faq: What is the goal of Zodiac Runner?
Your goal is to complete the level by collecting the zodiac items that correspond to your current sign.
How do I move my character?
Drag to move. The game uses drag controls only, so keep your movements smooth.

escape-from-the-toys-factory.intro: Escape From The Toys Factory is a click-based game where you pop all the Poppy pop it toys to get out of the factory. Your goal is to finish as fast as you can.
tips: Scan the whole screen before you start clicking so you know where every pop it toy is.
Work through the toys in one consistent pattern, such as left to right, so you do not miss any.
Keep your clicks steady and precise rather than rushing, since misses can slow you down.
Try a few runs and aim to beat your own time, focusing on the parts where you lost the most seconds.
faq: What is the goal of Escape From The Toys Factory?
You need to complete all the Poppy pop it toys to escape the factory. The game encourages you to do it as fast as you can.
How do I play the game?
Use your mouse or click the screen to interact with the toys. Clicking is the only control the game asks for.

draw-dance-battle.intro: Draw Dance Battle mixes drawing and rhythm. You draw lines on the screen to shape your dancer's moves and compete in a dance-off on stage.
tips: Keep your drawn lines simple and clear so the dancer can follow them smoothly during the performance.
Watch the rhythm of the beat before you start drawing, so your moves match the music rather than fighting it.
Try a few different line shapes early on to see which ones make your dancer look most lively on stage.
Draw with steady, deliberate strokes instead of rushing, since quick messy lines can make the moves harder to read.
Play several rounds in a row to build a feel for how the beat and your drawings work together.
faq: How do I control my dancer?
You do not move the dancer directly. Click or tap and draw lines on the screen, and the lines become the moves your dancer performs.
What is the goal of the game?
The goal is to create dance moves that fit the rhythm and win the dance-off on stage. The description focuses on creative design and fun rather than a fixed scoring system.

throw-fast.intro: Throw Fast is an arcade game about timing and precision. You throw knives at rotating targets while avoiding obstacles, and the challenge grows as you play.
tips: Watch the rotation for a few seconds before you throw. Learning the target's speed and pattern makes it easier to time your shot.
Focus on accuracy over speed early on. Clean hits set you up better for the harder stages than rushed throws that miss.
Keep an eye on obstacles as well as the target. Plan your throw so you can still dodge what is coming without losing your aim.
Pay attention to how the difficulty changes. Adjust your timing as the targets speed up or the obstacles become harder to avoid.
Take short breaks between attempts if your timing starts to slip. Coming back with a clear head often helps you line up shots again.
faq: What is the goal of Throw Fast?
Throw knives at rotating targets and hit the mark while dodging obstacles. The description focuses on precision and timing.
The game has no written instructions. How do I know what to do?
Start playing and watch how the targets and obstacles move. Pay attention to any on-screen prompts so you can learn how throwing works.

slap-master-3d.intro: Slap Master 3D is a hypercasual action game where you face opponents in an arena and slap them until they fly out. The core idea is simple: time your hits well and keep the pressure on.
tips: Watch your opponent's movement before each slap so you can land your hit at the right moment rather than swinging randomly.
Keep hitting consistently instead of pausing, since steady pressure is what pushes opponents toward the edge of the arena.
Pay attention to where the arena edge is and try to position your slaps so the opponent is pushed closer to it.
Start each match by learning the rhythm of the tap controls, then speed up once you feel comfortable with the timing.
If an opponent keeps recovering, try a different timing rather than repeating the same tap pattern.
faq: What is the goal of Slap Master 3D?
Your goal is to hit your opponent until they fly out of the arena and get knocked out.
How do I control the character?
The game is played with taps, so tap to slap and focus on hitting at the right moment.

kingdom-defense.intro: Kingdom Defense is a tower defense battle game where you protect your castle while using in-game coins to recruit soldiers and attack the enemy castle. Keep your defenses strong and your army growing.
tips: Spend your coins steadily rather than all at once, so you always have a reserve for emergencies.
Watch which direction enemies are coming from and place your soldiers where they can reach that path first.
Keep an eye on your own castle's health, and switch to defense if enemies start breaking through.
Build up a balanced group of soldiers so you can both hold the line and push toward the enemy castle.
Use spells at key moments, such as when a large group of enemies is close to your castle.
faq: What is the main goal of Kingdom Defense?
Stop enemies from destroying your castle while you destroy the enemy castle by buying soldiers with in-game coins.
How do I get more soldiers?
You buy soldiers using the in-game coins you have earned during play.

galaxy-bricks-breaker.intro: Galaxy Bricks Breaker is a fast arcade game where you clear the screen by forming chains of same-colored bricks. The challenge grows with every match, so quick thinking pays off.
tips: Scan the whole screen before each move and find the color that appears most often, since clearing the bricks of one color is the core of the game.
Plan a few moves ahead rather than reacting only to the bricks in front of you, because the game is built around strategy as well as speed.
Stay focused as the pace picks up, since the challenge escalates with every match and a slow reaction can cost you the chain you were building.
Keep your attention on the colors that are easiest to group together, as this keeps your chains going and the screen clearing steadily.
Take a short mental break between rounds to reset your focus, so you can start the next screen with a clear plan.
faq: What is the goal of Galaxy Bricks Breaker?
Your goal is to clear the screen by forming chains of same-colored bricks.
Does the game get harder as I play?
Yes. The challenge escalates with every match you make, so the game becomes more demanding the longer you play.

cube-rivals.intro: Cube Rivals is a fast arena shooter with four modes, three maps and a wide choice of weapons and gadgets. Movement is central, so learning to run, jump, dash and slide well will help you win fights.
tips: Keep your momentum by sliding between cover instead of stopping, since the slide keeps your speed going.
Aim for the head, because headshots deal extra damage and can end fights faster than body shots.
Use the dash to dodge incoming fire, and try to dash again only once its short cooldown has finished.
Stay out of enemy fire for a few seconds so your health can regenerate before you push into the next fight.
Throw your gadget at groups of rivals rather than single targets, and use cover when you reload or reposition.
faq: How do I win a match in Cube Rivals?
Each mode has its own goal: Team Deathmatch ends when a team reaches 50, and Free For All ends when a player reaches 25. Eliminating rivals is how you score.
How do I switch weapons quickly?
Press 1, 2 or 3 on desktop to switch weapons, and press Q to return to your last weapon. On mobile, use the weapon swap button.

geometry-vibes-monster.intro: Geometry Vibes Monster is a reaction-based arcade game where you steer a spaceship through obstacles and spikes while facing a range of monsters. Your goal is to travel as far as you can without getting hit.
tips: Watch the spikes and obstacles a little ahead of your ship rather than only the spot directly in front of it, so you have time to adjust.
Learn each monster's attack pattern before reacting to it. Spend the first few moments of a fight watching how it attacks.
Use short, controlled taps of the mouse or spacebar for small height changes instead of holding for long stretches, which can carry you into danger.
Release the button early when you see a gap coming, since your ship needs time to dive down after you let go.
If you are playing the 2, 3, or 4 player race mode, keep an eye on the other ships as well as the obstacles so you do not fall behind or crash while trying to overtake.
faq: What is the main goal of Geometry Vibes Monster?
Your main goal is to fly your spaceship as far as possible while avoiding obstacles, spikes, and monster attacks.
How do I make my spaceship go up and down?
Click and hold the mouse or press and hold the spacebar to ascend, and release it to dive downward.

leap-and-avoid-2.intro: Leap and Avoid 2 is an arcade platformer where you guide a white ball through caves and laboratory levels. Jump on white platforms, dodge black ones, and hunt for hidden coins along secret paths.
tips: Look for the exit before you commit to a jump, since some routes require moving left instead of always pushing right.
Scan each level for secret passages, because coins are often tucked along paths that are easy to miss on a first pass.
Grab coins when they are safe to reach, since they give you a speed boost or a shield that absorbs one hazard touch.
Save a shield for a risky stretch of black platforms rather than spending it on an easy section.
Use the R key to restart quickly when a mistake costs you a lot of progress, and the ESC key to pause and plan your next moves.
faq: What is the main goal of Leap and Avoid 2?
Get through all the hazards in each level to reach the exit. You jump on white platforms, avoid black platforms, and sometimes move left to reach the exit or hidden paths.
How do coins help me in the game?
Collecting coins gives bonuses: a speed boost for the ball and a shield that protects you from one touch with a hazard. Coins also raise your place on the leaderboard.

crab-shooter.intro: Crab Shooter is a top-down shooter where you fight waves of aquatic enemies, including rival crabs and crafty humans. Fast reflexes and precise aim are key as you work through challenging levels.
tips: Keep your aim steady and fire in short, controlled bursts rather than wildly, since precision matters as much as speed.
Watch the enemy waves before reacting, and note which types come from which direction so you can prepare for them.
Stay mobile during fights instead of standing still, which makes you a harder target for incoming enemies.
Pay attention to the layout of each level, since knowing where enemies tend to appear helps you plan your route.
Take a short break after a hard stage, then return with fresh reflexes, because the game rewards focus when you unlock new stages.
faq: What is the main goal in Crab Shooter?
Your goal is to battle through waves of enemies, including rival crabs and crafty humans, and clear the challenging levels. Clearing levels unlocks new stages.
How difficult is Crab Shooter?

The game is built around challenging levels and relentless waves, so expect the difficulty to rise as you progress. Practicing your aim and reflexes on earlier stages helps you prepare for harder ones.

obby-1-to-spaceflight-altitude.intro: Obby: +1 to Spaceflight Altitude is a space game where you collect stars, charge a slingshot or rocket, and climb in altitude. Use the keys to run, jump, and manage your hero, pets, and bonuses.
tips: Collect stars whenever you can, since they are one of the main ways to build up energy for your launches.
Use your pets to gain more energy by hatching them from cases and eggs, and keep an eye on which ones help you most.
Spend your earned money on ranks to upgrade your hero, so your progress carries over into later rounds.
Check the tasks panel (key 4) regularly so you know which goals are worth pursuing next.
Claim the daily bonus (key 5) and try the wheel of fortunes (key 6) each time they are available to boost your resources.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
The game is built around climbing in spaceflight altitude by gathering energy and launching with a slingshot, dynamite, or rocket. Progress comes from building up your hero and pets over time.
How do I get more energy for my launches?
Collect stars and hatch pets from cases and eggs, since the instructions say both give you more energy. Pets are opened with key 3.

my-perfect-halloween-costume.intro: My Perfect Halloween Costume is a dress-up game where you mix and match outfits and accessories to build a Halloween look for the BFF Girls. It is a good pick for anyone who enjoys styling characters.
tips: Choose a costume idea first, such as a spooky, cute, or funny theme, and then pick pieces that fit it. This keeps your outfit from looking random.
Try a base outfit and swap one piece at a time so you can see how each change affects the overall look.
Match colors across the outfit and accessories. Repeating one or two shades often makes a costume look more polished.
Save accessories like hats, jewelry, or bags for last, since they can complete or completely change a costume.
Experiment with unexpected combinations, because the game encourages creativity and some of the most fun looks come from mixing styles.
faq: What is the goal of My Perfect Halloween Costume?
The goal is to mix and match outfits and accessories to craft a Halloween costume you like for the BFF Girls. There is no fixed score, so the result is your own creative choice.
Are the controls difficult to learn?
The game uses simple controls, so you can start styling right away. Spend a few minutes clicking through the options to see how each piece changes the look.

1945-air-force-airplane.intro: 1945 Air Force: Airplane is an arcade shooter where you fight aerial battles against enemy planes. You upgrade your aircraft as you defeat enemies and work your way through the sky.
tips: Learn how your click or tap input responds in the first few battles before enemies start coming in larger numbers.
Upgrade your plane whenever you can, since a stronger aircraft makes the later aerial battles much easier to survive.
Pay attention to where enemies appear and deal with the most dangerous ones first rather than chasing easy targets.
Stay calm during busy moments. Rushing your inputs during intense fights often leads to avoidable losses.
Treat each victory as progress and build your strategy around what keeps your plane alive longest.
faq: How do I play 1945 Air Force: Airplane?
You play by mouse click or tap. Use your input to take part in the shooting battles and fight the enemies that appear in the sky.
How do I get stronger in the game?
You upgrade your plane as you defeat enemies. Taking down enemies steadily is the main way to build up your aircraft for harder battles.

superhero-adventure.intro: Superhero Adventure lets you create your own hero or villain and take part in fast-paced battles across the world. Success depends on using your powers strategically and building your skills over time.
tips: Decide early whether you want to play as a protagonist or an antagonist, and think about how that choice shapes the battles you take on.
Combat is fast-paced, so pay attention to the opponent's moves before committing your powers.
Save strategic powers for the moments when they will have the most impact instead of using them all at once.
Work on one or two skills at a time so your progress feels focused and your hero develops a clear strength.
Watch how opponents respond to your tactics and change your approach, since the game world is described as constantly evolving.
faq: What is the main goal in Superhero Adventure?
The description says you take part in intense global battles and try to outwit and overpower your opponents. The game does not list specific objectives beyond that.
Can I choose what kind of character I play?
Yes, the description says you can craft your own protagonist or antagonist. The exact customization options are not listed in the description.

last-day-on-earth-survival.intro: Last Day on Earth: Survival is a 2D survival simulation set in a large ruined city with 51 locations to discover. Your aim is to outlast 50 days while exploring every place you can reach.
tips: Collect wood and metal whenever you find them, since both are needed to make weapons at the Workbench.
Use your daytime hours to explore new places, and try to visit a location you have never been to before each day.
Level up by gaining experience, then check your Attribute screen and decide whether HP, ATK, Speed, or Search will help you most.
If you are short on survival, put upgrades into HP first so you can keep going through longer stretches between finds.
Keep a rough list of which of the 51 locations you have already visited so you can plan trips toward the ones you have not seen.
faq: What is the main goal of Last Day on Earth: Survival?
The goal is to survive 50 days and explore all 51 locations in the ruined city.
How do I control the game?
You play with mouse clicks or taps, so every action is made by clicking or tapping on the screen.

fruit-samurai.intro: Fruit Samurai is an action game about slicing fruit with your mouse. Move the cursor across the fruit to cut it and keep your swipes quick and clean.
tips: Use short, quick mouse swipes across the fruit rather than slow drags, so each slice registers cleanly.
Keep the cursor moving through the air instead of stopping over the fruit, since you need to be cutting, not hovering.
Watch where fruit is launched from and move toward that area early so you are ready before it reaches the top of the screen.
Aim for fruit in the middle of the screen where it is easiest to reach, and avoid chasing items that are far off to the edges.
Play a few short rounds first to get a feel for how the mouse movement works before trying to cut as much fruit as possible.
faq: What is the goal of Fruit Samurai?
The goal is to cut the fruit that appears on screen using your mouse. The description focuses on cutting sweet, delicious fruit as the core activity.
How do I control the game?
You control everything with the mouse. Move the cursor across the fruit to slice it.

ballon-race-3d.intro: Ballon Race 3D is a multiplayer race where you collect balloons to lift off the ground and fly toward the finish line. Outmaneuver the other players and be the first across.
tips: Start by collecting balloons right away, since they are what lift you off the ground and get you flying.
Remember that more balloons mean you soar higher and faster, so grabbing a steady stream early can give you a lead.
Keep an eye on your rivals' positions and adjust your path to stay close to them or pull ahead.
Check where the finish line is as you climb, so you can plan your final push to cross it first.
Collect the coins you pass along the way, since they unlock new skins to customize your character.
faq: What is the goal of Ballon Race 3D?
The goal is to be the first player to cross the finish line after collecting balloons to fly toward it. Your rivals are racing for the same finish.
How do I control my character?
You play with a mouse click or a tap. The game is built around clicking or tapping to collect balloons and keep moving.

alchemy-elixir-of-life.intro: Alchemy: Elixir of Life is a logic puzzle about combining elements to discover new ones. Start with the basic elements and work toward the Elixir of Life.
tips: Try obvious pairs first, such as Fire and Water, to build up your list of elements before attempting harder combinations.
Keep a mental or written note of combinations that failed, so you do not repeat them and can focus on new pairings.
Combine newly discovered elements with the basic ones as well as with each other, since many results come from mixing across the whole list.
If you are stuck, think about what the result should logically be, such as combining materials found in nature, and test that idea.
Remember that the same result can often be reached in more than one way, so if one route stalls, look for another path to the same element.
faq: How do I create a new element?
Choose one element, then select a second element to add to it. If the game has a combination for that pair, a new element appears and is added to your list.
What happens if two elements do not combine?
Nothing new is created. Try a different pair, since some combinations need experimentation with other discovered elements first.

idle-crafting-empire-tycoon.intro: Idle Crafting Empire Tycoon is a clicker and tycoon game where you rule an island, explore it, and craft resources into goods. You grow your empire by upgrading factories, hiring helpers, and filling production orders.
tips: Finish the introductory training first, since it explains how production, region unlocks, and resource discovery work.
Keep your factories producing and sell finished goods regularly, because profit only comes after production is complete.
Spend resources on factory upgrades when you can, so each production cycle brings in more profit.
Watch the balance between raw production and finished goods so you don't build up more of one than you can use.
Save the resources and goods you need for expeditions, since you must invest them to open new regions of the island.
faq: How do I earn money in this game?
Produce resources at your factories, then sell the finished products once production is complete. Upgrading factories lets you produce more and earn more profit.
How do I open new areas of the island?
You equip and send expeditions by investing the required resources and goods. Each expedition helps open up new regions of the island.

bunge-jungle.intro: Bunge Jungle is an arcade-style game about climbing vertical jungle landscapes by tilting your device to leap between platforms. The challenge is to keep moving while dodging obstacles.
tips: Make small, steady tilts instead of sharp ones so your jumps stay predictable and you can judge where you will land.
Before each leap, look at the next platform and the obstacles near it, and pick your timing from that view rather than reacting at the last second.
Platforms are described as unpredictable, so do not assume the next one will behave like the last. Stay ready to adjust your tilt mid-jump.
Since the challenges are endless, focus on staying calm and consistent rather than rushing. A steady pace usually lasts longer than rapid, careless movement.
Pay attention to how gravity pulls you after each jump, and use that feel to plan your next move before you start tilting again.
faq: What is the main goal in Bunge Jungle?
You move upward through vertical jungle landscapes by tilting your device to leap between platforms. Along the way you need to dodge obstacles and keep going.
How do you control the character?
You control movement by tilting your device, which uses gravity to guide your leaps. The game does not list any other controls.

pin-puzzle-save-the-sheep.intro: Pin Puzzle: Save The Sheep is a pin-pulling puzzle where you help sheep and a dog reach their food while avoiding hazards. Each level asks you to think through the order of pin pulls before you act.
tips: Before pulling any pin, look at the whole level and trace where the food will fall, so you can see what each pin releases.
Pay close attention to the bombs and lava on the screen and check whether a pin will send an object toward them before you pull it.
If a level does not go the way you planned, try a different pin order instead of repeating the same move.
Watch what the dog and the sheep need, since some tasks involve getting food to the dog rather than the sheep.
Work through levels one at a time and take a moment to plan, because the puzzles are built around careful thinking rather than speed.
faq: What is the goal of Pin Puzzle: Save The Sheep?
Your goal is to make the sheep eat food and save them from their predicament. Some levels also ask you to pull pins so the dog eats the food.
How do you control the game?
You play with a mouse click or a tap. Click or tap the pins to pull them and watch what happens.

flashcolor.intro: FlashColor tests your memory and color perception. You watch a flashed sequence of colors, then rebuild it from a palette, with points awarded for accuracy.
tips: Look at the whole flash before you start. Try to take in the full order of colors, not just the first few, since the sequence is what you need to recreate.
