Name each color to yourself as it appears, such as warm red or cool blue. Verbal labels make it easier to remember the sequence than trying to hold the exact shades in mind.
Because points are based on precision, aim for the closest match rather than rushing. A near miss on a shade can cost you more than a slightly slower pick.
Work through the palette in a consistent way, such as scanning the same direction each time. A repeatable routine helps you find colors quickly and reduces mistakes.
Pay attention to similar shades that sit close together. Those are the easiest to mix up, so double-check them before you lock in an answer.
faq: What is the goal of FlashColor?
The goal is to recreate the sequence of colors you saw flashed, using the palette. You score points based on how precisely you match them.
How are points earned in FlashColor?
Points are awarded for precision, so the closer your colors are to the flashed sequence, the more points you earn.

save-the-noob.intro: Save the Noob is a puzzle game where you draw a magical line to rescue Noob from threats. Plan each line carefully, since it must stay inside the area and cannot cross itself.
tips: Before you draw, study where the enemies and Noob are and imagine where the line will fall. Think about the whole route first.
Keep your line away from Noob. Touching Noob while the line falls ends the attempt, so leave a clear gap around them.
Remember that the line cannot intersect itself. Plan a single path that reaches every enemy without crossing over its own drawing.
Stay well inside the boundaries of the selected area. A line that goes beyond the edge will not work, so leave a small margin.
Make sure your line covers all enemies, not just the nearest ones. Check each enemy's position before you release the line.
faq: What is the goal of Save the Noob?
Your goal is to destroy all the enemies on the screen while keeping the line away from Noob. Each level is a new layout to solve.
What happens after I finish drawing my line?
The line falls on its own once you finish drawing it. Watch closely as it moves, since it needs to destroy all enemies without touching Noob.

squid-escape-game-2player.intro: Squid Escape Game 2Player is a two-player arcade adventure where both blue players must escape an iron-covered labyrinth prison. You control one player with WASD and the other with the arrow keys.
tips: Keep both players close together, since the game is lost if you lose each other.
Before heading for the door, collect all the geometric shapes in the level, because the level requires them.
Find both keys first, then run to the door, so you do not have to backtrack through the maze.
Watch the ground for thorny obstacles and steer around them carefully, especially when moving quickly.
Plan your route with a partner in mind: move one player at a time and pause the other nearby so neither gets separated.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Both blue players must collect all the geometric shapes, find both keys, and reach the door safely to complete the level.
How do I control the two players?
Use the WASD keys for one player and the Arrow keys for the other.

somewhere.intro: Somewhere is a minimalist adventure set in a 1-bit world with no enemies. You work through seven levels of obstacles that test your timing and patience.
tips: Read each level fully before moving, so you can plan a route past the obstacles rather than reacting to them.
Take your time with timing-based sections. Pausing to watch the pattern before you commit usually beats rushing.
If a level stalls you, step back and try a different approach instead of repeating the same mistake.
Keep an eye out for hidden secrets as you go, since they are part of the game's design and often sit off the most obvious path.
Focus on precision over speed. The game rewards careful execution more than quick reflexes.
faq: What is the goal of Somewhere?
Your goal is to get through all seven levels, navigating intricate obstacles while staying alive in a world with no enemies.
Does the game have enemies I need to avoid?
No. The challenge comes from the obstacles and the timing needed to get past them, not from enemies.

the-rings.intro: The Rings is a puzzle game where you test your logic and strategy by placing and arranging rings in the correct positions. Each level is complete once every ring is in the right place.
tips: Study the layout before you click anything. Work out where each ring needs to end up so you are not guessing as you go.
Look for rings that are already in the right position and be careful not to move them out of place while you work on the rest.
Plan a few moves ahead instead of reacting to each one. Thinking through the order of moves often prevents you from blocking your own progress.
Make one change at a time and check the result before the next move. This makes it easier to see which move helped and which did not.
If you get stuck, step away for a moment and come back with fresh eyes. Looking at the puzzle again often reveals an approach you missed.
faq: What is the goal of The Rings?
Your goal is to place and arrange the rings in the correct positions to complete each level. A level is finished when the rings are where they need to be.
How do I control the game?
Use your mouse to click any button in the game. All interaction is done with clicks.

horror-sniper-clown-ghost.intro: Horror Sniper Clown Ghost is a first-person shooter where you play Sam, a sniper lost in a nightmarish forest. Track your targets, aim carefully, and use every shot to work toward escape.
tips: Take your time before each shot, since the game rewards precision and every bullet matters.
Track a creature's movement for a moment before firing so you can predict where it will be.
Plan your route through the forest rather than rushing ahead, because staying alive depends on strategy as much as aim.
Watch for the chains you need to saw through and keep your focus on them when they come into view.
If you miss, reset your aim calmly instead of firing rapidly, which tends to waste shots.
faq: What is the goal of Horror Sniper Clown Ghost?
The goal is to survive in the forest and escape by tracking, aiming, and shooting at threats while sawing through chains.
How important is accuracy in this game?
Accuracy is central, because the game is built around precision and every shot counts toward your escape.

novahelm-tactical-strike.intro: Novahelm is a third-person 4v4 team shooter set in a maze of shipping containers and loading bays. Your squad pushes the enemy base, holds the site, and tries to outscore a four-soldier enemy squad.
tips: Learn how each of the six weapons recoils and practice controlling it, since the spray pattern differs from gun to gun.
Use aim-down-sights for accurate shots at range, and fire from hip position when enemies are close.
Because sprint and crouch are toggles, check whether you are still sprinting or crouched before you take a fight.
Use grenades when enemies are holding cover or a narrow passage, rather than throwing them at open ground.
Play with your squad to hold the site together, since a lone push through the containers leaves you exposed.
faq: What is the goal of Novahelm?
Your team of four fights a four-soldier enemy squad until one side reaches the score limit. You earn a point for every enemy you eliminate.
How do I unlock the sniper rifle, machine gun and grenade launcher?
Play matches to unlock them. The SMG and rifle can also be unlocked by watching a rewarded ad from the loadout screen.

lifecode.intro: LifeCode is a survival horror game set in an abandoned laboratory, where you play a creature exporting memory data for the A.R.C.H core while avoiding hungry monsters. Each day has a strict deadline, so planning your time matters.
tips: Spend a little extra care on the antenna angle at the start of each day, since a more accurate alignment gives you more memory during the export.
Use the time while an M3N is running to gather supplies from crates, but keep an eye on how far you are from the exit.
Set a personal reminder to head for the exit well before midnight, because staying inside after 12:00 AM means losing your character, items, and stored memory.
Treat the 11:00 PM siren as your final warning and stop collecting anything once it sounds.
Watch for monsters in the corridors, since they are driven only by hunger and see you as food; avoid lingering in open areas where they can reach you.
faq: How do I earn N-Neutrons?

Starting an M3N memory export grants between 3N and 8N on Normal difficulty. Completing the export and activating Phase Two rewards between 50N and 65N, and activating Control Core functions gives higher rewards.
What happens if I stay in the laboratory after midnight?
If you remain inside after 12:00 AM, your character dies and all collected items and stored memory are lost. You must leave the laboratory before midnight.

fashion-girl-cosplay-sailor-challenge.intro: Fashion Girl Cosplay Sailor Challenge is a dress-up and hidden-object game where you help Zoe and Iris find the outfits they want for their sailor cosplay party. You then use those clothes to style them.
tips: Read the clothing request before you start searching so you know which items to look for.
Scan the whole pile of clothes first, then check the details like colors and accessories that match the sailor theme.
Work on one girl at a time to keep track of which outfit pieces you have already placed.
Match the clothes as a complete look, checking that tops, bottoms and accessories fit together before moving on.
Take your time with each stage, since the game rewards careful searching more than speed.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Find the clothes that Zoe and Iris want for the sailor cosplay party, then help them match the outfits.
How do I play?
Use mouse click or tap to select items and place them on the girls as the game asks.

pet-card-sort.intro: Pet Card Sort is a relaxing matching puzzle where you tap cards to place them on a double-sided board. Clear sets of three identical pets to finish every level.
tips: Before you tap a card, check whether you already have another copy of it on the board or in your selection, so you can aim for a set of three.
Watch your empty slots closely, since the instructions say they are limited. Filling the last few slots with unmatched cards can stall the level.
Keep an eye on both sides of the board. Clearing cards on one side may open up options you can use on the other.
Avoid placing a single card of a pet type in a slot unless you have a clear plan to complete its set soon.
If you get stuck, look at which pets have the most copies left on the board and focus on finishing those sets first.
faq: What is the goal of Pet Card Sort?
Clear all cards from both sides of the board to complete each level. You do this by matching three identical pet cards at a time.
How do I select and place cards?
Tap a card at the bottom of the screen to select it, then tap an empty slot on the game board to place it.

monster-wheels-turbo-rush.intro: Monster Wheels Turbo Rush is a 2D arcade racer where you drive monster trucks over ramps, loops and rough terrain. Balance your truck in the air, use nitro wisely, and upgrade between races in the Workshop.
tips: Use the tilt controls while airborne to keep the truck level, so you land on all four wheels instead of bouncing or flipping.
Tilt slightly backwards to pull wheelies on takeoff, and tilt forwards to stick nose landings when you need a cleaner touchdown.
Save your nitro boost for flat or straight stretches where you can use the full speed burst, rather than spending it on a jump.
Flatten road wrecks on your route when it costs you little speed, since they give bonus cash you can use in the Workshop.
Try different trucks and check how each part changes top speed, acceleration and handling, then pick upgrades that suit the biome you are racing in.
faq: What is the goal of Monster Wheels Turbo Rush?
You race your monster truck through levels to beat your rivals across 48 levels in 6 biomes. Balancing mid-air and using nitro help you get ahead.
How do I balance my truck in the air?
On desktop, press A or Left Arrow to tilt backwards and D or Right Arrow to tilt forwards. On touchscreen, use the Left and Right Tilt Buttons while airborne.

the-upside-down.intro: Eddie Sinclair must search a snowy ghost town during the 1984 winter solstice to rescue his dog Buddy. Plan each move carefully, because every action takes time and cannot be cancelled once started.
tips: Stay near home until you have upgraded your stats, since the outskirts become much more dangerous the farther you go.
Keep an eye on the Gloometer and head back toward home before the danger rises too high.
Search city buildings for better slingshots and spells, and use them to improve your chances on the way to the bottom-right corner.
Think about which fighting tool to use before you commit, since each action takes time and you cannot change your mind mid-action.
Save potions for when your health is low, and drink them after returning home if you need a full recovery before pushing outward again.
faq: What is the main goal of The Upside Down?
Reach the bottom-right corner of the map for the final showdown and rescue your dog, Buddy.
Where do I heal and upgrade Eddie?
Return to your home in the top-left corner. There you can upgrade your stats and heal by drinking potions you have found.

hole-3d-color-block-game.intro: Hole 3D Color Block is an arcade puzzle where you steer a hole across 3D levels, swallowing cubes and spheres while steering clear of colored obstacles. Its 200+ levels mix relaxed play with rising challenge.
tips: Focus on the white blocks first, since collecting all of them is what unlocks the next level.
Before you move, check which colored obstacles sit on your path and plan a route that swings around them.
Grow your hole steadily by eating the smaller objects nearby before going after bigger ones, so you can fit through tight gaps later.
Keep your finger or mouse moving in small, controlled steps rather than sudden large swipes, which makes it easier to avoid obstacles.
Replay levels you already cleared to chase higher scores, and use the coins you earn to unlock new hole skins.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Move the hole to collect all the 3D cubes and spheres, including the white blocks, to complete the level. Collecting all the white blocks is what lets you advance.
How do I control the hole?
Drag with one finger or move the mouse to steer the hole around the level. Keep the hole moving to gather objects and dodge obstacles.

epic-join-crowd.intro: Epic Join Crowd is a hypercasual game about growing a team of warriors. You rescue prisoners, avoid obstacles, and build a strong crowd to defeat the boss at the end of each level.
tips: Steer your crowd toward prisons to rescue warriors, since your team needs to be strong enough before the boss fight.
Keep an eye on obstacles ahead and move early so you do not lose warriors from your group.
Plan your route before you reach a split or a cluster of obstacles, and pick the path that passes the most prisons safely.
Use the mouse or the W A S D or arrow keys to make small, steady adjustments rather than sharp swerves that can clip hazards.
Before reaching the boss, check how many warriors you have, and if you are short, prioritize rescuing prisoners on the way.
faq: What is the goal of Epic Join Crowd?
Your goal is to save the prison warriors and recruit them to your team, then build a strong enough crowd to destroy the boss monster at the end of the level.
How do I recruit more warriors?
Recruit warriors by avoiding deadly obstacles and approaching prisons to rescue the warriors held inside.

survival-for-100-dollars.intro: You start with 100 dollars and must stretch it while keeping your character alive. Manage your budget, find work around the settlement, and watch your hunger, health, and mood.
tips: Check your hunger, health, and mood before spending, since a problem in one can make the others harder to fix.
Treat your budget as the main puzzle: decide early whether a purchase is a necessity or a luxury before you commit your money.
Look at the different jobs available, from unloading train cars to the dubious errands, and compare how each affects your money and condition.
Keep your character's health well above zero at all times, because a health drop to 0 ends the run.
Click your abilities deliberately rather than rapidly, so each action is a choice you can justify against your current resources.
faq: What is the main goal of Survival for 100 dollars?
You try to survive with only your starting 100 dollars by managing your budget and keeping the character's health above 0.
How do I control the game?
Use standard mouse controls: left-click the abilities you want to use.

prison-escape-online.intro: Prison Escape Online is a clicker game where you guide a stickman out of a prison cell. Use the mouse, or tap on mobile, to work your way toward freedom.
tips: Look at everything in the cell before you act, since the game says nothing is off limits and any object may be useful.
Be deliberate with each click or tap, because some escape routes are dangerous and a rushed choice can set you back.
If an attempt fails, pause and think about what else you could try instead of repeating the same action.
Keep your clicks steady and watch the results of each step so you can judge which approach is working.
faq: What is the goal of Prison Escape Online?
The goal is to help the stickman escape from the prison cell he has been thrown into. You do this by using your skills and trying different ways out.
How do I control the stickman?
On a computer, use the mouse to play. On mobile devices, tap on the screen.

space-blast.intro: Space Blast is a 2D arcade shooter where you pilot a spaceship through waves of meteors and enemy aircraft. Steer carefully, fire at threats, and upgrade your weapon to protect the galaxy.
tips: Keep your ship moving with small, steady finger slides rather than large jerky ones, so you stay in control when meteors come in from several directions.
Watch the incoming waves and pick out the meteors that are headed straight for you first, since those are the most urgent to deal with.
Prioritize enemy aircraft that can shoot back, and keep your fire aimed at them while you dodge the rocks around you.
Upgrade your weapon as soon as you can, because a stronger weapon makes it easier to clear waves before they reach your ship.
Think a few moves ahead about where you want to be when the next wave arrives, instead of reacting only to the threat right in front of you.
faq: What is the goal of Space Blast?
Your goal is to protect the galaxy by surviving waves of meteors and shooting down incoming enemy aircraft with your spaceship.
How do I move my spaceship?
Slide your finger to move the spacecraft. On a computer, the game is also played with the mouse.

pop-it-bubble-game.intro: Pop It Bubble Game is a relaxing arcade game where you pop 3D bubbles on boards of different shapes. It is a calm, simple game meant for a few minutes of stress-free fun.
tips: Tap to play and take your time; there is no need to rush, since the game is designed to be relaxing.
Try popping bubbles in a steady rhythm rather than randomly, which keeps the experience calm and enjoyable.
Pay attention to the shape of each board, as different shapes are part of what the game offers to explore.
Aim to work through a board fully before moving on, so you can see how the bubble pattern changes as you pop.
Play in short sessions when you need a break, since the game works well as a quick way to release pressure.
faq: How do I start playing Pop It Bubble Game?
Tap the screen to start the game and begin popping bubbles on the board.
What is the goal of the game?
The goal is to pop the 3D bubbles on each board and enjoy the relaxing process of popping them one by one.

treasure-quest.intro: Treasure Quest is a casual puzzle game where Prince Arthur searches for treasure for his father. Match each coloured treasure to the bowl of the same colour by pulling the right pin.
tips: Before you pull any pin, check which colour treasure is being released and find the bowl of that same colour.
Take your time with each pull. A wrong pin sends the treasure to the wrong bowl and restarts the game, so a careful pull matters more than a fast one.
On Android, touch the pin directly and make a steady, deliberate motion. On PC, use a single careful mouse click on the pin.
Keep your eyes on the treasure's path to the bowl so you can tell right away whether the pin you chose was correct.
If the game restarts, go back to the start and focus on the colour matching step again rather than rushing through the pins.
faq: What is the main goal of Treasure Quest?
The main goal is to get the treasure into the bowl of the same colour. Pulling the right pin for each treasure earns the reward.
How do I release the treasure?
You pull off the correct pin so the treasure drops into the bowl matching its colour. On Android, touch the pin; on PC, click the pin with the mouse.

hamster-escape-prison.intro: Hamster Escape: Prison is a 2D adventure where you help a hamster break out of prison by solving puzzles and passing reaction tests. The goal is to get him back to his family.
tips: Start with the built-in tutorial, since it explains how the game works before the harder tasks begin.
Look carefully at each room before acting, because puzzle solutions are usually based on objects and details you can see around you.
Try a few different ideas on a puzzle instead of repeating the same move, and note what each attempt changed.
For reaction tests, stay focused on the screen and avoid rushing; a calm, steady approach usually works better than fast, careless input.
If you get stuck, pause and re-check what you have already tried, since many escape steps depend on earlier actions.
faq: What is the goal of Hamster Escape: Prison?
Your goal is to help the hamster escape from prison by solving puzzles and completing skill tasks so he can return to his family.
What kinds of challenges will I face?
You will solve puzzles and pass reaction tests, which require both thinking and quick response.

zombie-world.intro: Zombie World is a first-person shooter where you survive waves of zombies in a post-apocalyptic setting. You have limited ammo, power-ups to collect, and hordes to avoid while you try to last as long as possible.
tips: Treat your ammo as limited from the start. Fire in short, controlled bursts instead of emptying your weapon at distant targets.
Use power-ups when you are under pressure, not just when they appear, so they help you survive a dangerous moment.
Keep moving rather than standing still. Staying in one spot lets hordes surround you quickly.
Watch how zombies approach and pick routes that keep them in front of you instead of around you.
Pay attention to how many enemies are left in each wave so you can save ammo for the bigger groups.
faq: What is the goal of Zombie World?
The goal is to survive as long as you can against relentless waves of zombies. The game asks how long you can withstand the undead.
How does ammo work in Zombie World?
Your ammo is limited, so you need to plan your shots. Spend it on threats that are closest or most dangerous.

shark-rampage.intro: Shark Rampage puts you in control of an apex predator that tears through the coastline. Smash boats, chase swimmers, and build your combo as you go.
tips: Use Space for run attacks when you are lined up with a wooden boat or swimmer, since the attack is your main way to take targets down.
Keep moving with WASD or the arrow keys between targets so you don't stall and lose the rhythm of your combo meter.
Clear nearby swimmers and boats in one pass before turning back, so your combo keeps building in one area.
Pay attention to where targets gather along the coast and approach from the open water to hit several at once.
Spend what you earn on upgrades for your sharp jaws as soon as you can, because stronger jaws make every later attack more useful.
faq: What is the goal of Shark Rampage?
You play as a shark that causes destruction along the coastline by smashing wooden boats and devouring swimmers. The game rewards you for keeping the chaos going.
What are the controls?
Use WASD or the arrow keys to move your shark. Press Space to perform a run attack.

capture-flag.intro: Capture Flag is a fast-paced adventure of strategic battles where speed and caution both matter. You assemble weapons, race for rival flags, and defend your own while working toward victory.
tips: Balance speed with caution. Rushing for a rival flag can leave your own flag open, so keep an eye on what your side is protecting.
Assemble your weapons early so you are ready for battles when they start rather than scrambling mid-fight.
Plan a route to the rival flag before you move. Taking a steady path can be safer than charging straight in.
Use solo missions to learn how the field works and how fights tend to go before you face tougher situations.
Check the state of your own flag regularly, especially after a successful grab, since defending it is part of winning.
faq: What is the main goal in Capture Flag?
You race to snag rival flags while protecting your own, with the aim of claiming victory on the field.
Is there a single-player option?
Yes. The game includes intense solo missions where you work to dominate the field and claim victory.

finger-soccer-tournament.intro: Finger Soccer Tournament is a sports game where you pick a team and try to outscore your opponent. You can play alone or with a friend.
tips: Touch and hold the screen to keep your paddle moving where you need it, so you are ready to block shots before they reach your goal.
Keep your paddle between the ball and your goal, and watch the ball's direction rather than chasing it across the pitch.
Spend time defending first; a solid goal keeps your opponent from scoring while you look for a chance to attack.
When playing with a friend, take turns observing how they position their paddle and use the same habits to read the ball faster.
Play a few short matches to learn how the ball bounces off the paddle, since small timing differences can change where it goes.
faq: What is the goal of Finger Soccer Tournament?
The goal is to make more goals than your opponent. You win by outscoring them.
How do I move my paddle?
Touch and hold the screen to move the paddle. Release when you want to stop controlling it.

rule-out-the-dangerous-circle.intro: Rule out - The Dangerous Circle is an arcade game where you stay alive in a descending world full of obstacles. You need quick reflexes, changing direction, and staying ahead of a deadly trap.
tips: Watch the path a few moments ahead instead of reacting only to what is directly in front of you, so you have time to change direction.
Make small, early direction changes rather than sharp last-second ones, since rapid shifts are easier to control when you start them sooner.
Keep track of where the trap is at all times, and avoid moving into areas that would leave you with no room to escape.
Stay calm when the screen gets busy. Pausing your reactions for a moment to pick the safest gap often works better than rushing.
Play several short rounds to learn how the obstacles appear, since the world is meant to be unpredictable and patterns help you prepare.
faq: What is the goal of Rule out - The Dangerous Circle?
The goal is to survive as long as possible while navigating a world that keeps descending and avoiding obstacles and the deadly trap.
What skills does this game test?
The game challenges quick reflexes, agility, and strategy, especially your ability to shift directions quickly when obstacles appear.

garden-snakes.intro: Garden Snakes is a calm logic puzzle where you drag snakes across the board to fill every empty tile. Each of its 115 levels adds obstacles and new mechanics to think through.
tips: Before you move, look at the whole board and note which empty tiles are hard to reach, such as corners and narrow gaps. Plan a route that covers them first.
Trace a route on paper or in your head before dragging, because a snake that cuts through the middle can block tiles you still need.
Pay attention to obstacles and special tiles as soon as they appear, since each new mechanic usually changes how you should route your snakes.
Use Undo freely to test a plan. Taking back a move costs nothing, so you can explore different routes without fear.
Use Hint only after you have tried a level for a while. It is most useful when you are stuck on one specific section of the board.
faq: What is the goal of Garden Snakes?
Drag the snakes' heads through every empty tile so the board is full, and use all of each snake's remaining moves to finish the level.
How do I move a snake?
Use your mouse or touch screen to drag a snake's head through empty cells. You can use Undo to take back a move or Restart to begin the level again.

huskeydoku.intro: Huskeydoku is a cozy logic puzzle that mixes classic Sudoku with husky symbols. Fill each grid so no symbol repeats in any row, column, or colored region.
tips: Start with the rows, columns, or colored regions that already have the most symbols filled in, since they leave the fewest options.
For each empty cell, check its row, column, and colored region together. A cell can only take a husky that none of those three already contain.
If a cell has only one husky that fits, place it right away. Each placement can unlock several more easy moves.
Tap a cell again to remove a husky you placed by mistake. Keeping the grid clean makes it easier to spot conflicts.
Save the hint button for a spot where you are truly stuck. Working through a few cells on your own keeps the puzzle satisfying.
faq: What is the goal of Huskeydoku?
The goal is to fill the whole grid so that no husky symbol repeats in any row, column, or colored region.
How do I place or remove a husky?
Tap or click an empty cell to place a husky. Tap the same cell again to remove it.

hill-climber.intro: Hill Climber is a physics-based driving game where you try to drive as far as possible without crashing or running out of fuel. Its simple controls make balancing speed and braking the main skill.
tips: Ease off the accelerator as you approach a steep hill so the car stays stable instead of launching over the top.
Use short taps on the gas and brake rather than holding a single key, which gives you finer control over speed.
Ease off the gas when you come down a slope so the car does not pick up too much speed before the next bump.
Watch how the car sits on each slope and adjust before it starts to tilt, since a small correction early is easier than a big one later.
Keep your fuel use in mind by avoiding unnecessary acceleration on flat ground, so you have enough left for the longer hills ahead.
faq: What is the goal of Hill Climber?
The goal is to drive as far as possible without having an accident or running out of fuel.
How do I control the car on desktop?
Use the arrow keys to accelerate and apply the brake.

monster-truck-crush.intro: Monster Truck Crush is a racing arcade game where you beat an AI opponent to the finish line. Balance your 3D monster truck on each platform to keep your speed up.
tips: Watch the truck's body angle before each platform and aim to land it level, since a balanced landing lets you speed up right away.
Use the mouse click or tap timing to keep the truck steady rather than pressing constantly, so you do not tip the body too far.
If the truck starts to lean, ease off on the next input to stop it rolling, because a roll costs you speed.
The AI opponent is strong at managing its speed, so do not rely on it slipping up; focus on keeping your own speed steady across the whole track.
Practice a few runs to learn how the platforms sit, so you can anticipate balance changes before you reach them.
faq: How do I control the truck?
You play with mouse clicks or taps. Use them to control the body angle so the truck stays balanced.
How do I win the race?
Arrive at the finish line in first place, ahead of the AI opponent.

heart-box.intro: Heart Box is a physics puzzle game where you help the robot Robby reach the charging station by popping, destroying, or moving objects in Professor Rat's rooms.
tips: Before you act, look at the whole room and note where Robby starts and where the red charging station is. Plan the path between them first.
Try the objects you can move or pop one at a time. Watching how each one falls or shifts helps you learn the physics before you commit to a plan.
If a level stalls, reset your thinking and look for a different object to affect instead of repeating the same move.
Realistic physics means small nudges can have large effects, so use gentle, precise moves when you need Robby to stay in a specific spot.
Once you finish a few levels, try the Level Editor to build your own puzzle. Designing one shows you how objects can be arranged to create a challenge.
faq: What is the goal of Heart Box?
Your goal is to guide the robot Robby into the red charging station in each level. Doing so completes the level and frees him from the charger.
How do I interact with objects?
On PC, use the left mouse button. On mobile, use your finger. You can pop, destroy, or move game objects to clear a path for Robby.

a-deadly-car-crash.intro: A deadly car crash is an open-ended action driving game built around realistic crashes. You can steer, crash, race, and customize cars in a large open world and crash test areas.
tips: Use B to slow time before a jump or a likely collision, so you have more room to steer and brake with WASD and Space.
Try your crashes from different angles by pressing C to switch the camera, since the same impact can look very different from another view.
Press K to repair the car when it has taken heavy damage, so you can keep driving and testing crashes without restarting.
Save Shift nitro for straight stretches of road, and use Space for hard braking before corners to keep control of the car.
Press R to put the car back in service after a wreck, and use N to switch to a different car when you want to try another build.
faq: What is the goal of A deadly car crash?
The game has no fixed goal. The aim is to drive, crash, and tune your cars however you like.
How do I steer and brake?
Use WASD to steer the car and Space to brake hard.

3d-formula-racing.intro: Pick a Formula One car, set new records, and unlock more cars and tracks as you go. This guide covers the controls and habits that help you build your score.
tips: Learn the controls first: W, A, S, D or the arrow keys move the car, and Space brakes. Practice until steering and braking feel automatic.
Use Space to slow down before a tight turn rather than braking in the middle of it. Easing off early keeps the car steadier through the bend.
Make small steering corrections instead of sharp jerks. Smooth inputs help you keep speed and stay on the track.
Replay a track to learn its layout. Knowing where the turns come is what helps you set a new record.
Chase your best time one run at a time. Focus on one section you lost time in, then retry it, since unlocking new cars and tracks depends on setting records.
faq: How do I move the car?
Use W, A, S, D or the arrow keys to drive. Space is the brake.
How do I unlock new cars and tracks?
You unlock them by setting new records as you play. Each new record moves you forward in the game.

ballerina-cappuccina-loves-tung-tung-sah.intro: Ballerina Cappuccina Loves Tung Tung Sahur is a physics puzzle where you remove blocks so Ballerina Cappuccina can dance into Tung Tung Sahur's embrace. Each stage is set against a cozy twilight backdrop.
tips: Before removing anything, look at how the blocks support each other and where the ballerina needs to end up. Blocks that hold up the rest of the structure are usually the ones to leave for last.
Try removing blocks that sit on the outside or at the top first, and watch how the structure shifts. This shows you how the physics responds before you commit to a key block.
If a stage feels stuck, step back and try a different removal order instead of repeating the same move. Small changes in order can change which blocks fall.
Pay attention to the path between the ballerina and Tung Tung Sahur. Clearing blocks that block that path directly is often the goal, but a block removed too early can cause a collapse.
Take your time with each stage. The puzzles reward careful observation more than quick moves.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
The goal is to remove blocks in a way that lets Ballerina Cappuccina dance over to Tung Tung Sahur. Each stage is a physics puzzle built around that path.
How do I remove blocks?

The game description and instructions do not list specific controls, so follow the on-screen prompts when you start playing. Watch how the blocks react after each removal to learn how the physics works.

crush-yard-tycoon.intro: Crush Yard Tycoon is a 3D clicker about running your own junkyard. You smash cars with a hydraulic press, earn cash, and spend it on upgrades to grow your scrapyard.
tips: Decide early whether Power, Speed or Value suits your playstyle, and spend most of your cash on that path first.
Check which upgrade gives you the most benefit for the cash you have, rather than buying whatever is cheapest.
Keep crushing steadily, since every new car brings bigger rewards and your cash grows faster the longer you play.
Save up for expanding your scrapyard when you can afford it, so you have room to keep growing your business.
Try new vehicles as you unlock them, because each one can change which upgrades are worth buying next.
faq: What is the main goal of Crush Yard Tycoon?
Your goal is to grow your junkyard into a larger recycling empire by crushing cars, earning cash, and upgrading your Power, Speed and Value.
How do I play Crush Yard Tycoon?
Use your mouse to click or tap to operate the hydraulic press and crush cars.

football-kickoff.intro: Football Kickoff is a field goal kicking game where you swipe to send the ball through the uprights. Wind and shifting perspectives make each kick a test of precision and power.
tips: Pay attention to the wind before you swipe, since it can push the ball off its path.
Watch how the view changes between kicks and adjust your aim to match the new perspective.
Try a few gentle test swipes to learn how much power and angle each swipe produces.
Focus on consistency first, because steady accurate kicks build up higher scores than risky long shots.
Stay calm after a missed kick and reset your timing so each new attempt gets your full attention.
faq: How do I control the ball in Football Kickoff?
You control the kick by swiping. The direction and motion of your swipe decide where and how hard the ball is sent.
What is the goal of the game?
Your goal is to send the ball through the uprights and rack up high scores. Each successful kick moves you closer to gridiron glory.

mosquito-fight-number-battle.intro: Mosquito Fight: Number Battle is a fast .io arena where you collect energy dots to grow your number, then outmaneuver rivals to climb the leaderboard. Stay sharp, because one bad move can cost you your progress.
tips: Collect dots steadily early on so your number grows before you take on bigger rivals.
Keep an eye on the mosquitoes around you and avoid head-on collisions with stronger ones.
Save your speed boost for key moments, such as escaping a dangerous spot or cutting off a rival who is carrying valuable energy.
Circle around opponents rather than charging straight at them, so you can force a crash or steal energy with less risk.
Stay near the safer parts of the arena when you are small, and move into busier areas once your number is high enough to hold your ground.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Your goal is to grow your number by collecting energy, survive collisions, and rise to the top of the leaderboard.
How do I move my mosquito?
Use your mouse or touch controls to guide your mosquito around the arena.

fighter-tank.intro: Fighter Tank is a tank battle game where you outmaneuver rivals across varied terrain and make quick decisions to survive and win against players from around the world.
tips: Watch the terrain before you move, since different ground can offer cover or open you up to fire.
Avoid staying in one spot for long. Repositioning often keeps you harder to target.
Make your decisions quickly when an opening appears, but avoid rushing into a fight without a clear plan.
Pay attention to where enemies are coming from so you can turn your position to your advantage.
Focus on staying alive first. A tank that survives longer usually gets more chances to win.
faq: What is the main goal in Fighter Tank?
The goal is to dominate the battlefield, survive the fighting, and claim victory against opponents.
What skills matter most in this game?
Quick reflexes and sound strategy matter most, especially when you have to make split-second decisions in combat.

block-puzzle-cats.intro: Block Puzzle Cats is a single-player puzzle game where you drag cat pieces onto a board and fit them all together. Each solved challenge unlocks new cats to collect.
tips: Look at the whole board before placing anything. Note the gaps and odd-shaped spaces so you can see which pieces are likely to fit where.
Start with the largest or most awkward pieces first. Small pieces are easier to slot into leftover gaps later.
Fill in corners and edges early, since these areas are hard to reach once the middle of the board is crowded.
If a piece does not fit in one spot, try rotating or flipping it before moving on. Many shapes only work in a different orientation.
Pay attention to the challenge's unique shape each time, because the layouts change and a strategy that worked before may not carry over.
faq: How do I move a cat piece?
Click or tap a piece and drag it onto the board. Release it where you want it to sit.
Does the game have a set number of puzzles?
The description says the challenges keep changing, so each new puzzle presents a different shape to solve. Beating each one lets you collect a new cat.

the-pirate-sea-the-smuggler-s-way.intro: The Pirate Sea. The Smuggler's Way is an adventure where you play a smuggler sailing the seas. You search for treasure, take on tasks, fight enemy ships, capture islands and upgrade your vessel.
tips: Keep an eye on your food, because it is used up while you sail. Plan your route so you can restock before it runs low.
Use the map to set your course before you travel. Click the compass icon near a location to plot the route there.
Use the left and right shooting keys based on where enemy ships are positioned, since your cannons fire from each side of the ship.
Save acceleration for longer trips or chases. It helps you cover ground faster, but it also uses up your food supply.
Check the leaderboard to track your gold as you go, and use the gold you earn to upgrade your ship for tougher encounters.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
You play as a smuggler who aims to become the most famous smuggler by searching for treasure, completing tasks, destroying enemy ships and capturing islands.
How do I shoot on PC?
Press the D key to shoot from the right side of your ship and the A key to shoot from the left side.

elastic-car-3d.intro: Elastic Car 3D is an arcade racing game where you change lanes, pass the cars ahead, and chase high scores at super-fast speeds. It is played with tap or click.
tips: Switch lanes early so you have room to pass the cars ahead instead of reacting at the last moment.
Watch the road for the yellow cars, since collecting them gives you a speed boost and a short spell of invincibility.
Save the rocket-like acceleration props for stretches where you are boxed in by traffic, so the boost helps you get past several cars at once.
Keep your attention on the lanes ahead rather than only on your own car, so you can plan each lane change before you need it.
Try a few runs to learn how quickly the speed builds, then aim to keep your pace steady rather than rushing into crowded lanes.
faq: How do you control the car?
The game is played with tap or click. Use your input to change lanes and move past the cars in front of you.
What do the yellow cars do?
Collecting a yellow car gives you faster speed and a little invincible time. Use that window to push ahead through traffic.

make-the-glass-happy.intro: Make the Glass Happy is a physics puzzle where you draw lines to guide water into a glass. Each level asks you to use logic and creativity to fill the glass and make it happy.
tips: Look at where the water starts and where the glass sits before you draw anything. Plan a route that connects the two.
Begin with one simple line and watch how the water moves. Adjust your next shape based on what actually happens.
Use angled lines like ramps to change the water's direction, since a steep or gentle slope can decide whether the water lands in the glass.
Think about the shape of the path, not just its destination. Keeping the water flowing smoothly helps it reach the glass without spilling away.
Try a few different ideas on the same level if your first one fails. Creative solutions are often the quickest way through.
faq: What is the goal of Make the Glass Happy?
Your goal is to draw lines that guide the water and fill the glass in each level. Solving the level is how you make the glass happy.
How do I draw on the game?
On a computer, press and hold the left mouse button to draw a shape. On mobile devices, draw by tapping on the screen.

barber-shop-hair-salon-sim.intro: Barber Shop Hair Salon Sim is a hair salon game where you style hair, design unique looks, and upgrade your salon while serving customers with quirky requests.
tips: Read each customer's request before you start styling, so you know what look to aim for and avoid redoing work.
Work efficiently: finish requests in a steady order rather than perfecting one client while others wait.
Experiment with different designs early on, since learning what works for different requests will help you as the requests get more varied.
When you have a choice between upgrades, think about which one will help you serve customers faster or more reliably.
Keep an eye on your progress from novice to skilled stylist, and focus on building consistent results rather than chasing one perfect look.
faq: What is the main goal of Barber Shop Hair Salon Sim?
The goal is to grow from a novice hairstylist into a successful salon owner by styling hair, designing looks, and upgrading your salon. You do this by satisfying customer requests.
How do I get better at matching customer requests?
Pay close attention to what each customer asks for and compare it with the styles you have already practiced. Taking your time on the first few requests helps you learn what each design needs.

obby-sword-hero-adventure.intro: Obby: Sword Hero Adventure is an obby where you build up your sword skills, collect stronger swords, and recruit companions to help you defeat enemies and bosses across the game worlds.
tips: Spend time on the obstacle course between fights so you can keep your jumps accurate before you reach harder areas.
Check your collected trophies and skill points regularly and put them into upgrades that suit how you like to fight.
Try swords you have collected before deciding which one to keep, since rarer swords are meant to be a key part of your progress.
Recruit companions early and keep a few in your collection so you have help against enemies that are tougher than you expected.
Before fighting a boss, defeat the smaller enemies nearby to build up your strength and avoid taking unnecessary damage.
faq: What is the main goal of Obby: Sword Hero Adventure?
Your goal is to master your sword skills by increasing your attack power, collecting rare swords, and unlocking all the game worlds.
How do I attack and move on PC?
Use WASD to move, Space to jump, the left mouse button to attack, and the right mouse button to control the camera.

elemental-friends-adventure.intro: Elemental Friends Adventure is a platform game with levels and a survival element. You move and jump through an adventure world inspired by Disney-style enchantment.
tips: Get comfortable with the jump before anything else. Short taps and held jumps give you different distances, so test them on the early ground to learn the timing.
Move in short bursts rather than holding a direction the whole time. This makes it easier to stop on a platform edge and react to what is ahead.
Because the game has a survival tag, keep an eye on your health or safety while you travel. Slow down near unfamiliar areas instead of rushing forward.
Pause briefly before a difficult jump to check the landing spot. A quick look often prevents a fall and a restart.
If you play on touch, keep your thumbs on the on-screen move and jump buttons in a steady position so you can react without losing track of the platforms.
faq: How do I move and jump on desktop?
Use the W, A, S and D keys to move, and use the jump control described in the game's instructions to leap between platforms.
How do I control the character on a touch screen?
Use the on-screen buttons to move left and right and to jump. Keep a steady grip so you can press them quickly during tricky sections.

juicyjong.intro: JuicyJong is a color puzzle based on Mahjong. Swipe tiles around the board and line up three or more identical symbols in a row to clear them.
tips: Click a tile once to see which tiles are underneath it, then plan which moves will free up useful matches.
Click and hold a tile for one second to preview where it will land before you commit to a swipe.
Before each move, check whether swiping one tile creates a row of three and also sets up the next match.
Save your special bonuses for the hardest levels, where they can help you most.
When you can, aim for a match of more than three tiles, since those earn additional bonuses.
faq: What is the goal of JuicyJong?
Move tiles around the board and collect three or more identical symbols in a row. Special bonuses can help you get through tougher levels.
How do I move a tile?
Swipe a tile in any direction to move it. Click a tile once to see what is below it, and click and hold for one second to see where it will land.

hockey-brawl.intro: Hockey Brawl is a physics-driven hockey game where movement is your only control. Play solo through three leagues or challenge a friend in local two-player matches.
tips: Since movement is your only input, focus on positioning and timing your approach rather than trying to press extra buttons.
Keep an eye on the random modifier at the start of each match, because it changes the rules and may call for a different approach.
Try to line up body checks when your opponent is near the boards or off balance, since physics often makes those hits more effective.
In two-player matches, call out your plans to your partner or opponent before the puck drops so you both know what to expect from each other's movement.
Play a few matches in each league before moving on, so you learn how the physics respond and can adapt as the game gets more chaotic.
faq: What is the goal of Hockey Brawl?
Move your player, use physics to your advantage, and try to win the match. Climbing the three leagues unlocks new arenas and cosmetics.
What controls do I use?
Player 1 uses WASD and Player 2 uses the Arrow Keys in local two-player mode. Movement is the only input in the game.

truck-parking-game.intro: Truck Parking Game is a 3D parking challenge where you steer a heavy cargo truck into position using the arrow keys. It is built around careful, slow maneuvering rather than speed.
tips: Move slowly and make small steering corrections. Heavy trucks turn wide, so large steering inputs often push you past your target spot.
Before you reverse, stop completely and shift into reverse with T. Then press Up Arrow to back up, which avoids jerky starts.
Check your angle early. It is easier to fix a misaligned truck on the first approach than after you have already turned in tight.
Pull forward past the spot, then back in with short taps of the controls. Repeated small adjustments are usually more accurate than one long move.
Practice the forward and reverse switch a few times before a serious attempt so you know exactly how the truck responds to each key.
faq: How do I move the truck forward and backward?
Press Up Arrow to drive forward. To reverse, press T to shift into reverse gear, then press Up Arrow.
How do I steer the truck?
Use the Left Arrow and Right Arrow keys to turn. The game can also be played with a mouse click or tap, as stated in its instructions.

flip-shoot-control.intro: Flip Shoot Control is a fast 3D arcade action game where you take control of a powerful gun and face waves of relentless enemies. You play with mouse clicks or taps.
tips: Watch where enemies come from before each wave arrives, so you can start aiming early instead of reacting late.
Pace your clicks or taps. Firing in short, deliberate bursts usually helps you hit targets more often than rapid, random shooting.
Keep your attention on the enemies that pose the biggest threat, rather than spreading your focus across the whole screen.
Practice your aim in the first waves to get a feel for how the gun responds to your input before the foes get tougher.
If you are struggling, slow down and reset your focus between waves. Calm, steady shots tend to beat panicked ones against relentless enemies.
faq: What is the goal of Flip Shoot Control?
You take control of a powerful gun and survive waves of formidable foes by shooting them down. The game is built around sharp, action-packed gunplay.
How do I control the game?
Use a mouse click or a tap to play. There are no other controls mentioned in the instructions.

low-poly-smash-cars.intro: Low Poly Smash Cars is a 3D demolition derby where you pick a Super Car and smash your way through a twisted arena. Last car standing advances to the next level.
tips: Stay mobile and keep your car moving, since the goal is to be the last car standing and sitting still makes you an easy target.
Use the handbrake with SPACEBAR for sharp turns when you need to change direction quickly during a crash.
Pick the car you're most comfortable steering, because smooth driving is what keeps you in control during collisions.
Hit the opponents that are already damaged or slowed when you can, so you can eliminate them before they become a threat.
Watch the edges of the arena and avoid getting cornered between cars, which makes it hard to escape the next impact.
faq: What is the goal of Low Poly Smash Cars?
The goal is to be the last man standing in the derby by damaging and crushing the other cars. Winning the round lets you advance to the next level.
How do I drive my car?
Use the ARROW KEYS to drive and the SPACEBAR to apply the handbrake. Use the left mouse button to navigate the menus.

stickman-gun-rush.intro: Stickman Gun Rush is a runner where you swipe left and right to collect stickmen and gun parts, building a bigger weapon as you race to the finish line. Pick up cash along the way to upgrade your gun.
tips: Collect stickmen and gun parts early in each track, since a larger weapon makes the later sections and enemies easier to handle.
Watch for obstacles that reduce your weapon's size or power, and start swiping away from them well before you reach them.
Pick up cash bundles whenever they are safely in reach, because the coins fund your damage, fire rate, and income upgrades.
Check how big your weapon is before the finish line, since you need the strongest gun possible to defeat the final enemy.
Put some early coins into income upgrades so you earn more cash for the stronger upgrades you will need in harder levels.
faq: How do I move my character?
Swipe left and right to move your character along the track.
What do I need to do to complete a level?
Reach the finish line with the strongest gun you can build, then defeat the final enemy to complete the level and earn rewards.

fighting-vehicles-arena.intro: Fighting Vehicles Arena mixes vehicle building with battles. You assemble a car from cartoon blocks, then fight an opponent using the weapons and parts you chose.
tips: Before the battle starts, add body parts, wheels, and weapons so your vehicle has a balanced build.
Do not spend all your attention on offense. The description says both defense and offense parts are necessary, so include protective pieces too.
Keep an eye on your weapon parts during the fight. Losing all of them before your opponent means you lose the battle.
Try the manual control first to learn how your vehicle responds, then switch to auto fight when you want the battle to run on its own.
Compare how your build performs across a few rounds and change one part at a time so you can see what actually helps.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Build your vehicle before the battle and win by keeping at least one weapon part alive after your opponent has lost all of theirs.
How do I control my vehicle?
Use mouse clicks or taps to play. You can control the battle yourself or select auto fight.

basketball-strike.intro: Basketball Strike is a 3D basketball game built around driving to the hoop and finishing with dunks. It is played with the mouse only.
tips: Use the mouse to get the ball and move toward the lane before deciding on a shot, since the game centres on driving the lane.
Dribble with purpose rather than running in a straight line, so you can keep control of the ball as defenders close in.
Look for openings near the rim, because the game rewards dunks and close finishes.
Watch the rim and the angle of your approach, and adjust your path if your first attempt does not connect.
Try different routes to the basket across your games to find the approach that suits your timing with the mouse.
faq: What is the goal of Basketball Strike?
The goal is to dribble, dunk, and score your way toward winning and becoming MVP. Each successful score moves you closer to that aim.
What controls does Basketball Strike use?
The game is played with the mouse only, so all actions such as grabbing the ball, dribbling, and shooting are done with mouse input.

squid-candy-game.intro: Squid Candy Game is a mouse-controlled puzzle based on the Dalgona Challenge. You carefully break toffee candy around a preset shape while racing a limited timer.
tips: Study the preset shape before you start moving, so you can plan the route around its outline.
Work slowly and steadily near the edges, since a single rough move can break the whole candy.
Keep an eye on the timer, but don't rush the delicate parts, because a broken candy ends the attempt.
Start with the easier, open sections of the shape and save the tight corners and thin lines for later.
Make small, controlled mouse movements instead of big sweeping ones to keep your path precise.
faq: What is the goal of Squid Candy Game?
You need to break the toffee candy around the preset shape without breaking the whole thing before time runs out.
What controls does the game use?
The game is played with the mouse only.

viaducts.intro: Viaducts is a calm logic puzzle where you rotate bridge blocks to build paths for trains and objects. You have a limited number of attempts, so plan each move before you commit to it.
tips: Before rotating anything, zoom out and pan around the whole scene to see where every track piece and object needs to go.
Trace the path from the start point to the destination in your head, and note which blocks are already in the right place so you do not move them.
Work on one connection at a time, and check how it lines up with the next block before you rotate the one after it.
Because your attempts are limited, avoid random clicking. Rotate a block only when you have a clear reason for the new direction.
If you get stuck, zoom in on the part of the layout that is causing trouble and look closely at the edges of each block to see where the path breaks.
faq: What is the goal of Viaducts?
You build seamless paths so that trains and objects can travel across the scene. You do this by rotating the bridge blocks into the right positions.
How do I rotate the blocks?
On desktop, click a block to rotate it. On phone or tablet, tap the block instead.

car-cargo-ship-simulator-game.intro: Car Cargo Ship Simulator is a driving and boat game where you load cars onto cargo ships and deliver them across ports and islands. Your driving, parking, and ship handling are all tested.
tips: Learn the movement controls on an open area first, so you know how the car responds before you reach a tight parking spot.
Take parking slowly and line up the vehicle before you commit, since parking skill is one of the main things the game tests.
Watch the clock and plan your route so you can finish deliveries on time, because time management is part of the challenge.
When guiding a ship, make gentle, steady movements rather than sharp turns, so the vehicles stay safely in place on deck.
Use the mouse to click the on-screen buttons whenever you need to select options or move between screens.
faq: How do I move my vehicle?
Use W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move back, and A/D or the Left and Right Arrows to steer left and right.
Which skills matter most in this game?
The game tests driving, parking, loading, ship navigation, and time management, so practice all of them rather than focusing on just one.

advance-car-parking-driver-simulator.intro: Advance Car Parking Driver Simulator is a racing game focused on parking and driving in parking lots and city areas. It emphasizes precise steering and realistic gear handling, with practice as the main way to improve.
tips: Practice the same parking spot several times before moving on, since the game is built around learning how to park by repetition.
Use the swipe gestures to find a camera angle that shows your car's position relative to the parking lines before each manoeuvre.
Double touch to zoom in when you need a close view of tight gaps, and zoom out to check your surroundings.
Take steering slowly and make small corrections, because the game rewards precision in handling the wheel.
Pay attention to your gear choices as you approach a space, since the game models gear box behaviour at a fairly realistic level.
faq: How do I change the camera view?
Swipe up, down, left or right on the screen to set the camera angle. Double touch to zoom in and out.
What controls does the game use?
The instructions list keyboard controls, but the specific keys are not described in the game details, so check the in-game controls before you start.

color-roll-3d.intro: Color Roll 3D is a color puzzle where you copy a shown image by unrolling colored rolls and placing them so the overlaps line up. Each level asks for careful placement rather than speed.
tips: Study the target image before your first tap and note which colors sit on top of others, since the overlaps are what make the picture match.
Work out the direction of each roll before you tap it, because a roll unrolled the wrong way will change the final image.
Place the largest or most spread-out roll first so the smaller rolls have a clear reference to line up against.
Compare your partial result with the sample after each roll, and fix a misplaced roll early rather than building on top of it.
Pay attention to fine details at the edges of shapes, since a small shift in position is enough to make the whole picture look different.
faq: What is the goal of Color Roll 3D?
Your goal is to recreate the sample image shown for each level by unrolling the colored rolls and overlapping them in the correct positions.
How do I move the rolls?
Tap each roll to start it unrolling, and it will move across the screen and overlay onto the puzzle area.

king-of-crabs.intro: King of Crabs is a crab battle game where you find a shell, grow by eating fish, and fight your way up against other crabs. Use mouse clicks or taps to move your crab.
tips: Find a shell early, since it's the first step before you can grow and fight effectively.
Collect and eat the fish on the ground to get bigger, then look for weaker opponents to attack.
Check the Shell Gallery to compare each role's armor, speed, skill, and pelt, and pick the one that suits how you like to fight.
Visit the Equipment shop to choose from its claws, bodies, and legs, and claim extra claw coins in the Sign and Spin to help afford them.
Try the Quick Match when you want a quick fight, since it pits you against 24 players in total.
faq: How do I control my crab?
You play with mouse clicks or taps, and the game is designed to be easy to operate.
How does my crab get stronger?
Collect and eat fish lying on the ground to grow, and upgrade your gear from the Equipment shop.

pga3-survival.intro: PGA3 Survival is a pixel-style shooter set on a jungle map. You can play through campaign missions or try the other game modes, alone or with friends online.
tips: Check the difficulty before starting a campaign, since each one has its own difficulty and map. Pick one that matches your current skill.
Use SHIFT to run when you need to reposition quickly, and go back to WASD for careful movement when enemies are close.
Keep your aim steady with the mouse and avoid spinning around, so you can react faster when a threat appears.
Use SPACE to jump over obstacles or to shift your position, and keep moving rather than standing still in one spot.
If you play with friends, press Enter to open chat and share call-outs about threats or positions so you can cover each other.
faq: What is the goal of PGA3 Survival?
The game is a survival shooter where you fight through campaign missions and other game modes. Each mode and campaign has its own challenge to work through.
How do I move and aim?
Use WASD to move and the mouse to aim and look around. SHIFT lets you run and SPACE makes you jump.

bubble-tea-cocktail-maker-mix-drinks.intro: Bubble Tea Cocktail Maker Mix Drinks is a relaxed mixing game where you pour ingredients to create your own cocktails at a virtual bar. Experimenting with different combinations is the main way to play.
tips: Try one new ingredient at a time so you can see how each addition changes the drink's taste and look.
Since the game sets the proportions for you, spend your effort on choosing which ingredients go together rather than worrying about amounts.
Keep track of combinations that worked well so you can repeat them when a client wants something similar.
Experiment with unusual pairings to find original drinks, since the game is built around creating unique cocktails.
Use the simple buttons to add each ingredient in turn, and take a moment to check the drink before you serve it.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
The goal is to create delicious and original cocktails by combining different ingredients and serving them to your clients.
Do I need to measure the ingredients myself?
No, the game says all ingredients are already well proportioned, so you can focus on choosing the right mix.

jumping-bottle-3d.intro: Jumping Bottle 3D is a bottle-flipping game where you throw a bottle over obstacles across more than 200 levels. Your goal is to keep the bottle off the floor while you progress.
tips: Watch the bottle's rotation before each tap so you can time your jump to land it upright on the next surface.
Use a single tap for a standard jump and turn, and save the double tap for moments when you need extra height or faster spin.
Look at the obstacles ahead of time and plan your jump path rather than reacting only when the bottle is already in the air.
Collect gold caps when they are within reach, since they help you unlock new bottle skins.
If a level keeps ending the same way, pause your rhythm and try a slightly different tap timing instead of repeating the same attempt.
faq: What is the main goal of Jumping Bottle 3D?
Your goal is to complete levels by throwing the bottle over obstacles without letting it touch the floor.
What do the controls do?
A single tap makes the bottle jump and turn over, and a double tap makes the bottle taller and spin faster.

junkyard-keeper.intro: Junkyard Keeper puts you in charge of a junkyard where you collect abandoned vehicles and parts, then combine them into new machinery. It is a creative simulation driven by collecting and transporting.
tips: Drive around the junkyard early and note which parts are available before you plan what to build.
Bring several old parts back to your base in one trip when you can, so each drive around the yard counts for more.
Think about which machines you want to assemble and collect the parts they need first, rather than grabbing items at random.
Check the layout of the yard regularly so you know where vehicles and parts are sitting when you need them.
Keep your base clear and organized so you can see what you have and what you still need for your next build.
faq: How do I play Junkyard Keeper?
Use mouse clicks or taps to drive vehicles around the junkyard, collect old parts, and transport them back to your base.
What is the main goal of the game?
Your goal is to assemble new mechanical equipment by combining the recycled items and parts you collect.

holey-battle-royale.intro: Holey Battle Royale is an arcade fighting game where you control a hole that grows by swallowing items and smaller opponents. The arena keeps shrinking until only one hole is left standing.
tips: Start by swallowing small items and opponents, since each one makes your hole bigger and stronger for later fights.
Keep an eye on larger holes nearby and avoid them until you have grown enough to take them on.
Because the map keeps shrinking, move toward the middle of the arena early rather than waiting for the walls to close in.
Pay attention to where the shrinking boundary is, so you do not get pushed into a crowded spot with bigger opponents.
Take quick, steady clicks or taps rather than rushing, so you stay in control of where your hole is heading.
faq: What is the goal of Holey Battle Royale?
The goal is to be the last hole standing in the arena. You do this by consuming items and smaller opponents while the map shrinks around you.
How do I play the game?
You play with a mouse click or by tapping the screen. Use your clicks or taps to guide your hole toward items and smaller opponents.

pushplush.intro: PushPlush is a match-3 puzzle game where you slide whole rows and columns of colorful creatures to line up three or more of the same color. You can play through 50 levels, solve picture puzzles, or relax in endless Zen mode.
tips: Before you drag, check which row or column will bring three matching creatures together, since the whole line moves at once.
Watch what the rest of the line does when you slide it, because moving a full row or column can also shift creatures you did not plan to move.
Use Puzzle mode to practice planning moves, since you can focus on one target picture and work out the slides needed to recreate it.
If you feel stuck in a level, step back and look for a different row or column to slide rather than repeating the same move.
Try Zen mode when you want to play without pressure and get comfortable with how the slides and matches work.
faq: How do I make a match?
Drag a fluffy with your mouse or finger to slide its entire row or column, then release when three or more creatures of the same color line up.
What is the goal in Puzzle mode?
You slide rows and columns to recreate the target picture shown for the level.

moto-bike-extra.intro: Moto Bike Extra is a motorcycle racing game where you can drift, perform acrobatics, and choose from career, free ride, battle arena, hot chase, and two player modes.
tips: Try a few laps in free ride first to learn how the bike handles before you move into career or races.
Use the handbrake with Space bar to help you drift into corners, and release it at the right moment to keep control.
Save Nitro for straights or after you have set up a clean exit from a turn, so the boost does more for your speed.
Press C to try different camera views and pick the one that lets you see upcoming turns and obstacles most clearly.
If you play two player, agree with your partner on which keys each of you uses so you do not press the same controls by accident.
faq: What is the main goal of Moto Bike Extra?
The game is built around riding a motorcycle, drifting, and doing acrobatics across its modes, including career, free ride, battle arena, hot chase, and two player.
Which keys control the bike for Player 1?
Player 1 drives with the arrow keys or WASD, uses N for Nitro-Shift, C to change the camera view, and the Space bar for the handbrake.

epic-basketball.intro: Epic Basketball is a sports arcade game built around throwing the ball with realistic physics. You aim by dragging and launch by releasing, and the goal is to climb the world ranking.
tips: Make small changes to your drag between throws so you can see how each adjustment affects where the ball lands.
Pay attention to the angle of your drag as well as its direction, since your aim is what unlocks new players.
Try the different characters, as each one has different animations and different things to throw, and choose the one that suits your style.
Stay focused through the whole run, because the game is meant to be played to the end once you start it.
Use each miss to adjust your next throw instead of rushing, which helps you climb the world ranking over time.
faq: How do I aim and throw the ball?
Press and hold the left mouse button, drag to aim, then release to launch the ball.
How do I unlock more players?
You need to tune your aim to unlock the 20 players in the game.

runner-coaster-race.intro: Runner Coaster Race mixes fast roller coaster arcade action with free-running parkour moves. You collect passengers and money along a ring road while dodging bombs and other obstacles.
tips: Watch the track ahead rather than the obstacle right in front of you, so you have time to react before a bomb or hazard reaches you.
Pick up passengers and money whenever it is safe, but do not chase a pickup if it takes you into an obstacle.
Learn the rhythm of the clicks or taps early on, since a single input controls your timing for jumps and moves.
Stay calm on the faster sections of the track, because rushing usually leads to missed inputs and collisions.
Try short runs at first to get comfortable with the timing, then push further as you get more consistent.
faq: What is the goal of Runner Coaster Race?
Collect passengers and money on the ring road while avoiding obstacles such as bombs. The game describes your aim as pushing your limits to become the king of the track.
How do I control the runner?
You play with mouse clicks or taps. Timing your clicks or taps is the main skill the game asks for.

skebob-gun.intro: Skebob Gun is an open-world shooter where you can play as a hero, a villain, or just have fun. You can fight with friends or other players online across large maps.
tips: Learn the core keys first: WASD to move, Space to jump, left mouse button to shoot, R to reload, and G for grenades. Reloading before a fight starts keeps you ready.
Try several weapons from blasters to rocket launchers to find what suits your style. Switching to the right weapon for the distance you are fighting at often matters more than raw firepower.
Use jumping and flipping to move around the map. Staying on the move makes you a harder target than standing still and shooting.
Pick a mode that matches your goal. Duels are good for practicing aim against one opponent, while survival tests how long you can last.
Use the C key to change your camera when you want a better view of the area around you, especially when exploring or driving a car.
faq: What is the main goal of Skebob Gun?
The game lets you decide your own role, whether hero, villain, or just having fun. You explore open maps, fight other players, and take part in modes such as duels, survival, and minigames.
How do I shoot and reload?
Use the left mouse button to shoot and the R key to reload. On mobile, controls are handled by touch and swipe.

summer-fashion-makeover.intro: Lily wants to go to the beach this summer, but her look needs a complete makeover after a long time without much care. Help her become pretty and neat again.
tips: Look at Lily's current appearance carefully before you start changing anything, so you can see what needs the most work.
Aim for a neat result, since the goal is to make Lily look pretty and well cared for again for summer.
On desktop, use the mouse slowly and steadily so your choices and movements are precise.
On mobile, tap the screen to start and keep your taps deliberate so you do not skip past steps you meant to make.
Take your time with each change and compare the look as you go, so the final result feels balanced and fresh.
faq: What is the goal of Summer Fashion Makeover?
The goal is to give Lily a makeover so she looks pretty and neat again, ready to go to the beach when summer comes.
How do I control the game on a computer?
Use the mouse to play the game easily on desktop.

car-collision-master.intro: Car Collision Master is a head-to-head car battle set on looping desert tracks. You drive a blue jeep, aim to knock rival drivers out, and be the first to five knockouts.
tips: Since physics decide your direction and flips, get a feel for how your car lands after a loop before you commit to an attack. Small test runs early in a round help more than rushing in.
Release the gas before a jump or a steep section so you can control your landing angle. Holding full speed through every bump often sends you off line.
Watch your rival's approach and try to hit them from the side or behind, where your timing gives you the most control. Head-on crashes can leave you just as damaged.
Stay clear of the hazards mentioned in the arena, since a bad hit from them can end your run before you reach an opponent. Keep an eye on the track ahead as well as your target.
Use the loops to set up a hit rather than only to show off. Lining up your jeep as you come out of a flip can give you a clean collision.
faq: How do I win a round?
You score a point by colliding into your opponent's vehicle to knock the driver's helmet off. The first player to reach 5 points wins the match.
How do I control my car's speed?
On desktop, hold the Spacebar to accelerate and release it to slow down. On mobile, hold the gas pedal in the bottom right corner.

ben-10-run.intro: Ben 10 Run is a 3D endless action game where you run, jump and smash your way past enemies, obstacles and supervillains. It uses mouse or keyboard controls.
tips: Keep your eyes moving ahead of Ben so you can spot obstacles early and react in time.
Watch how enemies approach before you commit to a smash, so your attacks land on the right target.
Use short practice runs to learn how the 3D track and jumps feel before trying to go as far as possible.
Stay calm when a supervillain appears, since a steady rhythm of jumping and smashing usually works better than rushing.
Pick one control scheme, mouse or keyboard, and stick with it so your timing stays consistent from run to run.
faq: What is the goal of Ben 10 Run?
You run through the level, jumping and smashing your way past enemies, obstacles and supervillains. Because it is an endless game, the aim is to keep going as far as you can.
Which controls does Ben 10 Run use?
The game is played with a mouse or a keyboard, as listed in its instructions. Check the in-game prompts for the exact actions each input performs.
