golf-invaders.intro: Golf Invaders is an arcade shooter where you use golf shots to clear troublemakers from a course. Each level has a limited number of balls, so every shot matters.
tips: Before you release a shot, check how the ball is pulled by the wind and adjust your aim to compensate for it.
Since each level has a limited number of balls, avoid taking shots at single invaders when a group is close together.
Save explosive power shots for clusters of enemies, where one hit can clear several invaders at once.
Watch how each type of invader moves or behaves before you commit to a shot, and aim for the ones that threaten you most.
Take a moment to plan each shot instead of firing quickly, because a wasted ball can leave you short on the remaining invaders.
faq: How do I aim and fire the golf ball?
Drag to aim your shot, then release to fire. Use the direction and strength of your drag to control where the ball goes.
Why does my ball keep missing its target?
Wind changes the path of the ball in flight, so a shot that looks correct can drift off target. Try adjusting your aim to account for the wind direction.

erase-the-extra-element.intro: Erase the extra element is a puzzle game about spotting what does not belong in each scene. You clear away the wrong parts to reveal the hidden truth behind each puzzle.
tips: Study the whole scene before you start erasing, so you can tell which details look out of place.
Look for small inconsistencies such as an odd color, a misplaced object, or a shape that does not match its surroundings.
Erase in small, deliberate taps or clicks rather than rushing, so you do not remove parts that belong in the scene.
If you get stuck, scan the scene slowly from one edge to the other instead of focusing on one spot.
Take a moment to compare similar objects side by side, since the extra element is often a near-copy with one difference.
faq: What is the goal of Erase the extra element?
The goal is to erase the wrong parts of each scene so the hidden truth behind the puzzle is revealed.
How do I erase parts of a scene?
On a computer, click the left mouse button over the part you want to erase. On a mobile device, tap that part of the screen.

space-break.intro: Space Break is a pixel space shooter where you pick a ship, upgrade it, and fight through waves of aliens and boss battles across different galaxies. Your score rises the further you get.
tips: Choose a ship type you like before you start, then spend your upgrades on it so it grows stronger as you go.
Keep your finger or mouse steady and move side to side early in each wave, so you are never caught out of position when enemies arrive.
Each level has randomly generated waves, so do not memorize patterns. Stay alert and react to what appears on screen.
Save some focus for the boss at the end of each level, since it is the main test before you move on.
Since levels never end, aim for a steady pace rather than rushing. Your record grows the further you pass, so survival matters more than speed.
faq: What is the goal of Space Break?
Pass through waves of enemies in each level and defeat the boss at the end of it. Keep going to get further and raise your record.
How do I control my ship?
On a phone, move your finger from side to side. On a PC, hold down the left mouse button and move the mouse to steer the ship.

3d-air-racer.intro: Fly your airplane through the rings to complete each level in 3D Air Racer. Unlock new planes as you progress, and work through all 20 levels to prove your piloting skills.
tips: Aim your plane toward the next ring early and make small, steady turns so you don't overcorrect and lose track of the course.
Use the A and D keys for rudder control when you need to adjust your heading without turning sharply.
Try the tricks on the 1, 2 and 3 keys in safe moments, so you learn how each one affects your flight before you need it.
Keep an eye on the route ahead rather than the plane itself, since looking forward helps you line up the rings sooner.
When you unlock a new airplane, spend a few flights getting used to how it handles before attempting the harder levels.
faq: What is the goal of 3D Air Racer?
Your goal is to complete each level by flying your airplane through the rings. Finishing all 20 levels is the full challenge.
How do I steer the airplane?
Use the mouse or the arrow keys to turn. The A and D keys act as the rudder for finer control.

limited-defense.intro: Limited Defense is a tower defense strategy game where you place bandits, archers, and explosive towers to stop waves of slimes, orcs, and bosses. Upgrade your defenses and unlock legendary heroes as you go.
tips: Place your characters where they can cover the path enemies take, since the goal is to stop them before they get through.
Tap a character to open its sub menu, and check the upgrade option before you spend on new placements.
Use a mix of bandits, archers, and explosive towers so you can handle different enemy types in each wave.
Sell a character that is in a poor spot and place it somewhere more useful, rather than leaving weak defenses in place.
Watch how each wave plays out, then adjust your layout and upgrades before the next one arrives.
faq: What is the goal of Limited Defense?
You defend your position by placing characters that stop waves of slimes, orcs, and bosses from getting through.
How do I place a character?
Drag the character onto the designated spot on the map.

blue-tractor.intro: Blue Tractor is a relaxed 3D driving game where you deliver goods, collect lost animals and find treasure across a sunny countryside. Follow the arrow to each villager and earn coins to upgrade your tractor.
tips: Check the fuel bar before starting a new delivery, and top up at the shop when it gets low so you are not stuck mid-route.
Choose quests that lie close together so you can chain several deliveries in one trip and save fuel.
Spend your first coins on upgrades that help your current driving most, such as the engine or mud tyres if you spend time on muddy paths.
Steer around deep water, since it is the main hazard on the map and can cost you time and wheel repairs.
Use the pause menu to check your longest ride and longest time on the farm, then try to beat those records on your next session.
faq: What is the main goal of Blue Tractor?
Follow the arrow to each character, complete their delivery or collect quests, and earn coins. You use those coins to upgrade your tractor in the garage.
What happens if my fuel tank runs empty?
The farmers will refill it for you after a short stop, so you can keep going without starting over. Buying fuel in the shop is still the faster option.

reel-and-slash-ii-beach-legends.intro: Reel & Slash II: Beach Legends is a 3D beach fishing game where you cast from the shore, wait for a bite, and reel in fish that fight back. Bigger catches pull harder and pay more coins.
tips: Hold SPACE for a longer time when you cast if you want to reach deeper water, since holding longer throws further.
When a fish is on the line, hold the action button to keep it tight, and release when the tension meter fills rather than holding on the whole time.
Spend your coins on better rods and lures first, since these help you land the bigger fish that pay the most.
Use the number keys 1, 2 and 3 to switch between rod, sword and bow quickly so you are ready for the strike and finish.
If you take the jetski out to sea, go for the golden multiplier rings, because they multiply everything you collect.
faq: How do I catch a fish?
Cast into the water, wait for the bite, then hold the action button to keep the line tight. Release when the tension meter fills, then finish the fish with your sword.
How do I get more coins?

Catch fish, which pay more coins the bigger they are, and drive your car along the sand to smash through the floating coins. Jetski trips at sea can also add to your total through the multiplier rings.

ramp-rider-mega-bike-racing.intro: Ramp Rider Mega Bike Racing is a 3D motorcycle stunt racer where you ride powerful bikes over giant ramps and obstacles to reach the finish line. Controls are simple, so most of your progress comes from timing and balance.
tips: Hold the accelerate key (W) steadily on straights to build speed before you reach a ramp, since a faster approach gives you more height on jumps.
Tap the brake (S) before tight turns rather than braking mid-corner, so you keep control of the bike as you steer.
Use the left and right keys in small adjustments when landing, so the bike stays level and you do not drift off the track.
Before each jump, look ahead at the obstacles on the next section so you can line up your approach and avoid hitting them.
Practice the stunt tracks in short bursts, focusing on one ramp or obstacle at a time, to get a feel for how your bike responds.
faq: What is the goal of Ramp Rider Mega Bike Racing?
The goal is to race across the 3D stunt tracks, get past the ramps and obstacles, and reach the finish line.
Which keys control the bike?
Use the Left and Right arrow keys, or A and D, to turn. Press W to accelerate and S to brake or slow down.

merge-number-cube-3d-run-game.intro: Merge Number Cube 3D Run Game is a 3D running game where you lead a group of cubes across platforms, collect more cubes, and pick gates to upgrade your team. Click or tap to play.
tips: Look ahead along the platforms before each move so you can react to obstacles early instead of at the last second.
Pay close attention to large pendulums, spikes, and cutters, since these are the hazards the game asks you to avoid.
When you reach a gate, compare the options before you pass through and choose the one that best helps your team member grow.
Keep your cube group moving past obstacles rather than stopping, so you stay on the run and keep collecting cubes.
Try a few runs to learn the timing of each obstacle, then focus on passing the hardest sections more carefully.
faq: How do I control the cube?
You play with mouse clicks or taps. Use them to move through the run and respond to obstacles as they come up.
How do I make my team stronger?
Collect more cubes along the way and choose the right gate at each merge point to raise your team member.

shape-transform.intro: Shape Transform is a one-touch racing game where you switch between car, boat, and plane to match the terrain. Timing your taps and avoiding obstacles are the keys to finishing first.
tips: Look ahead to the next stretch of land, water, or air before you tap, so your shape change is ready when the terrain arrives.
Tap with a steady rhythm rather than in bursts. Good timing usually matters more than tapping quickly.
Watch for obstacles early and decide on your shape change before you reach them, instead of reacting at the last second.
Keep an eye on your rivals' positions so you know when you need to push for the lead near the finish.
Use short races to practice reading the tracks, then try longer sessions once your timing feels consistent.
faq: What is the goal of Shape Transform?
Race through each track by matching your vehicle to the terrain, and finish ahead of your rivals to win.
How do I change my shape?
Tap the screen to switch between car, boat, and plane. Each tap changes your shape so you can match the terrain.

flick-n-goal.intro: Flick n Goal is a soccer game where you pick a national team, set up your players and formation, and compete in international matches. You control everything with the mouse.
tips: Before kickoff, check where your players are placed and adjust the formation to suit the team you are facing.
Practice short drags first to see how the ball and players respond before you try longer shots.
Use a small, controlled drag when you need to pass to a nearby teammate, and save bigger drags for shots on goal.
Move players into open space before you pass, so your teammate has room to receive the ball.
Pay attention to the flow of the match and change your tactics if one approach is not working.
faq: How do I hit the ball?
Click and drag with the mouse, then release to hit the ball. Your drag and release decide how the ball moves.
How do I move my players?
Use the same drag and release action with the mouse to move your players around the pitch.

monster-truck-driving-stunt-game-sim.intro: Monster Truck Driving Stunt Game Sim is a driving game with challenging mountain tracks and stunt jumps. You steer a monster truck with WASD and can switch views with C.
tips: Make small, steady steering changes with A and D on steep climbs so the truck keeps its grip.
Before a jump, check the landing ramp and line up the truck straight, since a sideways landing is harder to recover from.
Press C to switch cameras and pick the view that shows the track ahead best on each section.
Take the first run of a track slowly to learn where the drops and bumps are before trying to go faster.
Keep the truck balanced on uneven ground by easing off the throttle when the front starts to lift.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
You drive a monster truck over challenging tracks, including mountain climbs, and perform stunts while staying in control of the vehicle.
Which keys control the truck?
Use WASD to drive the truck and the C key to change the camera view.

fix-the-hoof.intro: Fix The Hoof is a calm 3D game about cleaning, polishing and painting the hooves of animals such as horses, goats and cows. Earned money can be used to improve your farm.
tips: Take one hoof at a time and finish it before moving on, so you can see the full difference each cleaning, polishing and painting step makes.
Give each hoof a thorough clean first, since the polishing and painting steps will look better on a clear surface.
Try different animals, such as horses, goats and cows, to see how their hooves differ and which ones you find most satisfying to work on.
Spend your earnings with a plan in mind, and think about which farm upgrades will help you keep playing for longer.
Play in short sessions when you want to unwind, since the slow, steady pace works best as a relaxing break.
faq: What is the main goal of Fix The Hoof?
The goal is to care for animal hooves by cleaning, polishing and painting them. Doing this earns money that you can use to improve your farm.
Which animals can I work on?
The game mentions horses and goats, and the instructions also include cows. You work on the hooves of these animals.

solitaire-stars.intro: Solitaire Stars brings the Yukon Solitaire card game to your browser. Build each suit from Ace to King while stacking cards in alternating colors.
tips: Since every card is dealt face-up, scan the whole layout before your first move and look for cards that can free up others.
Check which cards are buried under others. Clearing a column that holds several face-down-style blockers in your plan can open up more options.
Use group moves when they help. A run of cards in descending order with alternating colors can be shifted together to uncover a useful card underneath.
Keep Aces and low cards in mind for the foundations. Getting an Ace out early lets you start building its suit right away.
Avoid moves that bury a card you will need soon. Before each move, ask whether it opens a column or a foundation step, or just shuffles cards around.
faq: What is the goal of Yukon Solitaire in this game?
The goal is to move all the cards to the foundation piles, with each pile built by suit from Ace up to King.
How do I stack cards in the tableau?
Stack cards in descending order from King to Ace and alternate colors, so a red Queen can go on a black King.

racing-crash-jigsaw.intro: Racing Crash Jigsaw is a jigsaw puzzle game built around pictures of supercars after crashes. You rebuild each picture from its pieces, with 12 images ranging from easy to hard.
tips: Start with the easier pictures to learn how the pieces fit before moving to the harder ones.
Begin by sorting out the edge pieces first, then work inward so the frame of the picture takes shape.
Group pieces by colour and by the car's parts, such as paint, wheels, or background, so you can find matches faster.
Focus on one section of the picture at a time instead of scanning the whole board, which keeps you from getting overwhelmed.
Use mouse or tap controls steadily and place each piece carefully, since a rushed placement can slow you down later.
faq: What is the goal of Racing Crash Jigsaw?
The goal is to put together each car crash picture by fitting its pieces into the correct places. There are 12 pictures to work through.
How many pictures are in the game and how does difficulty change?
The game has 12 car crash pictures that range from easy to hard. Harder pictures are the ones to tackle once you feel comfortable with the easier ones.

taxi-driver-las-vegas.intro: Taxi Driver Las Vegas is a 3D driving game where you pick up passengers and take them to their destinations. You can follow the directions in stages or explore the open map freely.
tips: Use free exploration early on to learn where the main streets and addresses are before you start taking fares.
Keep an eye on your destination directions and plan your route ahead of time so you spend less time lost.
Try both the taxi and open modes to practice driving and navigation in different ways.
Use the camera controls (click to move the camera, C to switch views) to check surroundings at intersections before you turn.
When you reach a passenger or destination, press F to interact, and get out and walk with Ctrl to run when you need to move quickly on foot.
faq: What is the goal of Taxi Driver Las Vegas?
Your goal is to pick up passengers and drive them to their destinations while following directions. You can also explore the maps to learn the streets and addresses.
Which keys do I use to drive?
Use WASD to move, click to move the camera, and C to change the camera view. Press Esc to open the menu.

merge-the-coins-ussr.intro: Merge the Coins: USSR! is a puzzle game where falling coins combine when they match. Build bigger coins to score points and climb the leaderboard.
tips: Keep matching coins close together so they can merge into bigger ones before the play area fills up.
Start with the early game in mind, since the instructions say it gets harder as more coins appear.
Plan a few moves ahead by checking which coins are likely to fall next to a matching one.
Aim to create the biggest coin possible, because it disappears and gives the most points.
Play in short sessions and look at your score after each one to see whether your approach is working.
faq: What is the goal of Merge the Coins: USSR!?
Your goal is to connect as many matching coins as possible, build the biggest coin you can, and collect points to reach the top of the leaderboard.
How do coins combine?
Coins that are the same connect when they touch, forming a larger coin of the next value.

l-y-eggs.intro: Lay Eggs is a skill game where you guide a bird home along a road full of obstacles. Your aim is to get the bird there safely.
tips: Watch the obstacles ahead before you commit to a move, since the goal is to reach home without running into them.
Move at a steady pace rather than rushing, so you have time to react when a new obstacle appears.
Pay attention to the gaps between obstacles and pick the route that keeps the bird clear of danger the longest.
If you make a mistake, restart with a clear plan for the first few obstacles so you don't repeat the same error.
Practice the early part of the road until you understand how the obstacles are spaced, then focus on the harder sections.
faq: What is the goal of Lay Eggs?
Help the bird get home safely by getting it past the obstacles on the road.
What controls does the game use?
The game's instructions do not list specific controls, so check the on-screen prompts when you start playing.

parkour-runner-3d.intro: Parkour Runner 3D is an arcade running game where you sprint, jump, slide and dodge through obstacle courses across rooftops and platforms. Good timing and clean movement are the keys to going further.
tips: Keep your moves short and deliberate. Jump and slide only when you can see the obstacle clearly, rather than reacting late.
Watch the path ahead, not just the character. Spotting the next platform or trap early gives you time to line up your move.
Use the Space bar boosts with purpose. A single tap triggers the Head Booster and a double tap activates the Hover Board, so save them for gaps or traps that are hard to clear on foot.
Practice switching between left, right, jump and slide without pausing. Smooth transitions between moves matter more than any single jump.
Replay levels you find difficult to learn their rhythm. Repeating a course helps you memorize where the traps and gaps appear.
faq: What is the main goal of Parkour Runner 3D?
You run through obstacle courses by sprinting, jumping, sliding and flipping while dodging traps and crossing platforms. Each run tests your reflexes and timing.
How do I move my character?
Use W, A, S and D or the arrow keys. W or Up Arrow jumps, A or Left Arrow moves left, D or Right Arrow moves right, and S or Down Arrow slides.

dinos-rush.intro: Dinos Rush is a 2D platform runner where you move, jump, and attack through obstacle-filled worlds. Collect coins, upgrade your dinosaur, and see how far you can get.
tips: Spend coins on speed and jump upgrades early, since faster movement and higher jumps make tricky platforms and gaps much easier to handle.
Watch the pattern of obstacles before each jump instead of reacting at the last second, especially when several hazards come one after another.
Attack enemies when they are in your path, but avoid stopping to fight when a clean jump will get you past them and keep your momentum.
Use boosters like Golden Magnet and Coin Fever when you are planning to collect a lot of coins, so they are worth more in that run.
Check your daily rewards and challenges each time you play, and try to beat your own best times on levels you have already cleared.
faq: What is the goal of Dinos Rush?
Run, jump, and fight through each level while collecting coins and avoiding obstacles and enemies. Levels keep getting harder, so the aim is to get as far as you can and beat your best times.
How do I move and jump on desktop?
Use the Left and Right arrow keys to move your dinosaur. Click or press the on-screen Jump button to jump, and use the on-screen Attack button to attack enemies.

sweet-supermarket-simulator.intro: Sweet Supermarket Simulator is a management game where you collect ingredients, stock shelves, and earn money to grow your store. Move with W, A, S, D keys or with mouse or touch.
tips: Collect ingredients first so you always have stock ready to put on the shelves.
Keep shelves filled before you spend money on new ones, since stocked products are what earn your income.
Use your earnings to hire new staff early, because extra help frees you up to restock while you collect ingredients.
Upgrade your character when you can afford it, since a faster or stronger character makes every trip around the store more productive.
Save up for new shelves with products and new supermarkets once your current store runs smoothly.
faq: What is the main goal of Sweet Supermarket Simulator?
The goal is to collect ingredients, stock shelves, and earn money so you can unlock new shelves, hire staff, and open new supermarkets.
How do I move my character?
Use the W, A, S, D keys to move, or use your mouse or touch input as an alternative.

bike-stunt-racing-legend.intro: Bike Stunt Racing Legend mixes motorcycle racing with stunt riding in a 3D world. Your aim is to reach the finish line first while keeping your speed up.
tips: Keep your speed high from the start, since the AI opponents are known to make mistakes when you stay fast.
Do not hesitate on rolling ramps; committing to them is part of the stunt side of the game.
Aim for the green arrows, which help you gain speed more easily.
Stay calm during jumps and turns instead of braking hard, so you can keep accelerating.
Watch the rivals and use their errors to pull ahead rather than racing only against the clock.
faq: What is the goal of Bike Stunt Racing Legend?
You need to ride your motorbike to the finish line in first place. Staying ahead of the AI opponents is the main objective.
How do I control the bike?
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps. Use these inputs to steer the bike and keep the throttle on.

badlands-hero.intro: Badlands Hero is an action survival game where you complete levels, earn experience and gold, and defeat bosses. Move through each stage carefully and use your rewards to grow stronger.
tips: Move constantly rather than standing still, since danger can appear around any corner.
Spend gold on upgrades for your characters and weapons instead of saving it, so each run starts stronger.
Pay attention to where your experience points come from, because they unlock new characters you can try.
Try different weapon types as you unlock them to find which one suits your playstyle best.
Before each boss fight, look at how it moves and attacks, and keep your distance until you understand its pattern.
faq: How do I move my character?
On a PC, use the W, A, S and D keys or left mouse click. On a touchscreen, tap and drag on the screen to move.
How do I unlock new characters?
Earn experience points during play, and they will unlock new characters for you to choose from.

chaos-road-combat-car-racing.intro: Chaos Road: Combat Car Racing is a shoot-em-up car arcade game. You drive a 3D vehicle along the ground, collect upgrades, and work toward defeating the final boss.
tips: Your vehicle fires automatically, so focus on staying in position and watching what is coming at you.
Use the magnet to pull in items from a distance, since it makes collecting upgrades much easier.
Pick up upgrade items whenever you can, because they help you handle the tougher vehicles and the boss later.
Shoot down the ground vehicles that come your way to build your strength before the boss fight.
When the boss appears, watch its bullet pattern closely and avoid them while your automatic fire keeps damaging it.
faq: What is the goal of Chaos Road: Combat Car Racing?
Your mission is to defeat the final boss by collecting upgrade items and shooting down vehicles on the ground.
How do I play the game?
Play by clicking or tapping. Your vehicle keeps shooting automatically, so you mainly need to stay alert and avoid danger.

twist-and-tug.intro: Twist and Tug is a rope puzzle where you drag and connect ropes to recreate a target shape. Each level asks you to position nodes carefully while keeping ropes from overlapping.
tips: Study the target shape before you move anything. Notice where each rope starts, ends, and crosses so you know what the final layout needs.
Place nodes one at a time and check after each move whether any rope now overlaps another. Catching a crossing early is easier than untangling several at once.
Begin with the parts of the pattern that are easiest to lock into place, then work toward the more tangled sections.
If you get stuck, move a single node and watch how the rope responds. Small, deliberate changes make it easier to understand the layout.
Expect the puzzles to get harder as you progress. Use the logic and observation you built on earlier levels rather than guessing.
faq: What is the goal of Twist and Tug?
Your goal is to drag, connect, and arrange the ropes so they match the target shape shown for each level. Completing the match finishes the level.
How do I control the ropes?
You play with the mouse. Drag the nodes and ropes to position them, and connect them to build the target pattern.

crumb-bandit.intro: Crumb Bandit is a stealth heist game where you play a hungry raccoon sneaking through homes, shops and a manor to steal snacks without being spotted. Each job asks you to grab a treat and get out unseen.
tips: Watch the colored vision cones before every step and wait for a guard or camera to turn away before you cross open floor.
Use tables and curtains as hiding spots when someone looks your way, and move out only once their gaze has passed.
Tiptoe near sleeping guard dogs and robot vacuums, since running makes it easier to be noticed.
Plan your route before grabbing the snack, especially for big snacks, which are slow and only fit through the door.
Aim for the four medals on each heist by replaying jobs unseen, grabbing the bonus snack and beating the par time.
faq: What is the goal of each heist?
Grab the snack and carry it out through the pet flap or the door without being seen by anyone.
How do I avoid getting caught?
Stay out of the colored vision cones and hide under tables or behind curtains when someone looks your way.

escape-from-school-3d.intro: Escape from School 3D is a blox-style action game where you fight through teachers, bullies, and bosses to find the elevator and break out of a crazy high school. Use weapons you find along the way to survive.
tips: Use the weapons you pick up on purpose. Bats, bricks, and slingshots each suit different situations, so switch to whichever gives you the best chance against the enemy in front of you.
Dodge before you swing. Enemies can be dangerous up close, so move out of the way first and then attack when you have an opening.
Keep an eye out for the elevator on each level. Finding it is how you move on, so it is worth checking the layout as you explore instead of only fighting.
Collect money as you go. You can use it to buy new escape heroes, so picking up cash during runs helps you build up for later.
Explore the different zones, such as classrooms, hallways, gyms, and rooftops. Each area has its own layout, so learn how they connect to find your route faster.
faq: How do I move and attack on PC?
Use the WASD keys to move your character and the left mouse button to use your weapon.
How do I play on mobile?
Use the virtual joystick on screen to move your character. Attacks and other controls are handled through the on-screen interface.

groomy-island.intro: Groomy Island is a first-person horror-survival game set on a large island. Your goal is to survive while collecting all 10 Grimace Shakes and avoiding the Grimace.
tips: Check the MiniMap often so you always know where you are and which areas you have already searched.
Explore the island in an organized way, sweeping one area fully before moving on, so you don't miss hidden collectibles.
Stay quiet and out of sight when the Grimace is nearby, since the game centers on evading it while you search.
Use Shift to run when you need to get away quickly, and save it for real danger so you can keep moving when it matters.
Follow the instructions to keep drinking, and keep track of how many of the 10 Grimace Shakes you have collected.
faq: What is the main goal in Groomy Island?
Your main objective is to survive and collect all 10 Grimace Shakes hidden around the island. You need to avoid the Grimace while you search.
How do I move and run?
Use W, A, S, and D to move, and hold Shift to run. Press Space to jump or start the game.

bubble-crash.intro: Bubble Crash is a bubble shooter with a Halloween theme. You aim and fire bubbles to match colors and build up your score.
tips: Aim before you release the click, and check where the bubble will land so it joins a group of matching colors.
Try to hit groups of three or more of the same color, since that is how bubbles are cleared.
Look at the bubbles around the edges of a cluster first, because clearing them can drop loose bubbles that were attached to them.
Keep an eye on the color of the next bubble before you fire so you can plan your shot ahead.
Aim for shots that clear several bubbles at once rather than single pops, since the game rewards a high score.
faq: How do I play Bubble Crash?
Use a left click to aim and shoot. Match three or more balls of the same color to clear them.
What controls does the game use?
All controls use a left mouse click. There are no other keys or buttons mentioned in the instructions.

baggage-out.intro: Baggage Out! is a puzzle game where you load baggage onto a bus before it leaves. You drag each piece into its correct space and finish the task to complete the level.
tips: Look over all the baggage and the open spaces before you start moving anything, so you can plan which piece goes where.
Place the pieces one at a time and check each one before moving on, so you don't have to rearrange later.
Use tap to select an object first if you want to check it before you move it.
Keep an eye on the bus. You need to finish before it leaves, so don't spend too long on one piece.
If a piece seems to fit more than one space, compare the spaces side by side and choose the one that leaves the rest of the layout easiest to complete.
faq: What is the goal of Baggage Out!?
The goal is to arrange all the baggage correctly so the level is complete, and you must get everything ready before the bus leaves.
How do I move the baggage?
Use your mouse or touch to drag each piece and drop it into the correct position.

figher-stick-hero.intro: Figher Stick Hero is a 2D stickman fighting game for one player, with arcade and survival modes. You battle opponents, pick weapons, and customize your stickman's look.
tips: Keep your stickman moving during fights, since the game rewards attacking while on the move.
Try a few weapons early on to see which range and timing suit your style before committing to one.
Pay attention to your opponent's position so you can strike first when they come into reach.
Defeating other stickmen raises your score, so focus on finishing fights cleanly rather than avoiding them.
Try both arcade and survival modes, since they may call for different approaches to staying alive and scoring.
faq: How do I control my stickman?
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps. Use clicks to attack and move as the game prompts during each fight.
How do I earn a higher score?
You earn higher scores by defeating other stickmen. Attacking while moving is also recommended as a way to gain an advantage.

robot-chopter-online.intro: Robot Chopter is an arcade maze game where you steer a small flying character up through a labyrinth of paths. Enemies and dangerous obstacles stand in the way, so careful movement matters.
tips: Before you commit to a path, look at where the enemies and obstacles sit so you can judge whether the route is safe.
Move in short, controlled steps with the arrow keys rather than holding a direction, so you can react when something appears.
Use spacebar to shoot threats that you can clear, and dodge the ones you cannot destroy.
Avoid collisions, since touching an enemy or obstacle destroys your character, so give walls and hazards a little extra space.
If a path becomes crowded with danger, back out and try a different route rather than pushing through under pressure.
faq: What is the goal of Robot Chopter?
Your goal is to guide the flying character through the maze of paths until it reaches the top of the map.
How do I control the character?
Use the arrow keys on your keyboard to move, and press the spacebar to shoot.

little-big-fighters.intro: Little Big Fighters is an action survival game where you defeat opponents, grow stronger with each win, and collect resources to build your power. Movement and fighting both use the mouse.
tips: Collect resources whenever it is safe, since they help you grow stronger for later fights.
Win smaller battles first to build up your strength before you take on a boss.
Keep an eye on your position while you move with the left mouse button so you can react to opponents quickly.
Pick your moment to click and fight a boss rather than rushing in, especially if you are still getting stronger.
If your mouse gets stuck in the game window, press L to unlock it.
faq: How do I move my fighter?
Hold or use the left mouse button to move around the arena.
How do I fight a boss?
Click the left mouse button when you are in position to fight a boss.

mole-dig-clicker.intro: Mole Dig Clicker is an idle game where you tap dirt to dig deeper toward the center of the world. Spend the dirt you collect on upgrades that speed up your digging and keep it going on its own.
tips: Tap the dirt steadily early on, since every chunk you break is the dirt you need for your first upgrades.
Buy stronger taps first to raise the amount you earn per click while your passive income is still small.
Pick up auto-dig once you can afford it, because it keeps mining running while you do other things.
Come back regularly and claim your dirt, since mining continues while you are away and your progress builds up.
Check the upgrades at the bottom of the screen after each return so you can spend your dirt on the next step.
faq: How do I earn dirt?
Click or tap the dirt to dig, and each tap breaks off a chunk that adds to your total.
What do the upgrades do?
You can buy stronger taps, auto-dig, and a bigger cart, all paid for with dirt collected from digging.

mini-farm.intro: Mini Farm is a 3D arcade farming game where you plant crops, look after them, and harvest them while growing a set of animals. You control everything with the mouse.
tips: Plant crops first and keep them watered, since the game asks you to sow, water, and harvest in turn.
Check your fruit trees regularly and collect fruit once it is ripe.
Use the time between harvests to plan your layout so your farm grows in a tidy, easy-to-manage way.
Look after your animals as you unlock them, since they add new farming activities to your farm.
Move the camera around your farm often to spot crops that need attention before they are missed.
faq: What is the goal of Mini Farm?
You play as a farmer who builds and manages your own farm. Grow crops, care for animals, and collect fruit to expand your farm.
How do I control the game?
Everything is done with the mouse. Use it to sow seeds, water plants, harvest crops, and collect fruit from trees.

looper-fruit-hit.intro: Looper Fruit Hit is an archery shooting game where you fire arrows at rotating fruits. Tap the screen at the right moment to hit targets and move through harder levels.
tips: Watch the rotation for a few seconds before you shoot, so you can learn the pattern and predict where the fruit will be.
Shoot on a steady rhythm rather than rapidly tapping, since each arrow needs the right timing to land.
Treat each arrow as a single chance and wait for a clear opening instead of firing when the fruit is moving away from the line of your shot.
If you miss a shot, pause briefly and reset your focus before the next one, as it is easy to make hasty mistakes under pressure.
Pay attention to how the levels get harder and adjust your timing gradually rather than expecting the same approach to work throughout.
faq: What is the goal of Looper Fruit Hit?
Your goal is to hit the rotating fruits with your arrows and clear each level successfully. As levels progress, the challenge increases.
How do I shoot my arrow?
Tap the screen to release your arrow. The timing of your tap is what determines whether it hits the fruit.

baby-hazel-bed-time.intro: Baby Hazel is ready for bed, but first she needs a few bedtime activities done. This game is a gentle, click-or-tap bedtime routine for Hazel.
tips: Follow the bedtime order in the story: brush teeth, then take a shower, then make the bed. Working in sequence keeps the routine easy to follow.
Finish the early activities before moving on, so Hazel is clean and settled before you start the later steps.
Make the bed before the stories, so Hazel has a ready place to rest when the routine winds down.
Keep an eye on Hazel during the night. If a bad dream scares her, switch to comforting her with kisses and lullabies.
Take your time with each activity. Clicking or tapping steadily is enough to move through the routine without rushing.
faq: What is the goal of Baby Hazel Bed Time?
The goal is to help Baby Hazel get ready for bed by brushing her teeth, taking a shower, and making her bed. You also tell her stories and comfort her if she has a bad dream.
How do I control the game?
You play by clicking or tapping on the screen. Use the same method to choose activities and carry out each step of Hazel's bedtime routine.

circle-car.intro: Guide a queue of cars into a busy roundabout by tapping at the right moment. Merge every car into an open gap without a crash to clear each level and move on to faster traffic.
tips: Watch the loop for a few cycles before your first tap so you can learn the speed and rhythm of the cars already circling.
Only launch a car when you can see a clear gap that it can fit into, rather than tapping as soon as the queue allows.
Use mouse drag to orbit the 3D camera and scroll to zoom, so you can judge the spacing between cars more easily.
Stay calm after each successful merge, since one mistimed tap can cause a pile-up that ends the level.
Plan ahead for the next car in the queue as the pace picks up, because the later levels bring faster traffic and tighter timing gaps.
faq: What is the goal of Circle Car?
Your goal is to send every car in the queue onto the roundabout track without any collisions. Clearing the queue wins the level.
What happens if two cars crash?
A single collision causes a traffic pile-up and the level fails. You can retry the level from the start.

jelly-path.intro: Jelly Path is a calm puzzle game where you guide a squishy jelly across a grid to its cushion. Every step leaves a solid trail, so you need to plan your route before you move.
tips: Look at the whole level before your first move and find the path to the cushion. Then work backward from the goal to see which turns you need.
Keep track of your own trail as you go. Since you cannot cross it, avoid running into a dead end where every direction is blocked.
Try to keep open space around you. Moving into a narrow corridor early can trap the jelly before it reaches the cushion.
Collect the stars on the way if you want a higher score, but check that the detour does not leave you boxed in. Reaching the goal comes first.
If you get stuck, restart the level and try a different route. Taking a few seconds to plan each move usually beats rushing.
faq: What is the main goal in Jelly Path?
Guide the jelly along the grid to reach its cushion. Along the way, you can collect stars to improve your score.
What happens if I cross my own trail?
You cannot cross your trail at all, so any move that would run into it is not allowed. Plan routes that leave you room to keep moving.

ragdoll-football.intro: Ragdoll Football is a zero-gravity arcade soccer game where you float and tumble to smash the ball into the opponent's goal. Each match lasts 60 seconds, with surprise modifiers that change the action.
tips: Use short drags to steer rather than long ones, since in zero-g your ragdoll keeps drifting after you let go and overshooting is the most common mistake.
Save Dash-Strike for when the ball is close to you and the rival is nearby, because the dash both kicks the ball and knocks the opponent away.
Hold Brake & Trap to stop quickly and catch the ball when you are about to lose control of it, instead of chasing it across the arena.
Watch for modifiers like the giant ball, bouncy ball, huge goals or currents, and adjust your approach each time one appears, since the same move can behave very differently.
Build your Special meter steadily and fire it when a clear shot on goal is available, as the signature strike is most useful when it can finish a play.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Score by smashing the ball into the opponent's goal before the 60-second match timer runs out.
How do I move my player?
Drag on the screen to fly in any direction, or use WASD or the arrow keys on a PC.

category-match.intro: Category Match is a relaxing sorting puzzle where you place memoji cards into the correct category groups. Observe each card closely and plan a few moves ahead to clear every level.
tips: Before you move anything, scan the whole board and note which cards share a category. This gives you a clear picture of the groups you need to build.
Pay attention to the character style of each memoji, since small visual details often show which category a card belongs to.
Be careful with empty space in levels with limited room. Avoid placing a card in a spot that blocks a group you still need to finish.
Think before each placement, because a wrong move can stop your next match. If a move feels unclear, look for a card that fits a group you have already started.
Work on one category at a time when the board gets crowded. Finishing a group early can free up space for the cards that remain.
faq: What is the goal of Category Match?
The goal is to tap and move each memoji card into its correct category group. You clear the level once every group is complete.
How do I move the cards?
Tap a card and move it to the group it belongs to. The game uses simple tap-and-move controls.

open-rings.intro: Open Rings is a calm puzzle about freeing gems from tangles of rings, sliding bars and locks. Turn, pull and slip each piece off the board without anything colliding.
tips: Study the whole tangle before moving anything. Use the zoom buttons to see how the rings and bars overlap.
Clear the pieces that block others first. Locks only open once the pieces they depend on are gone.
Keep an eye on bombs. They blast everything around them, so plan your moves so pieces are not caught in the blast.
Double-tap a ring to return it if a move leads nowhere. If the board gets too messy, hold still for 1 second to put every ring back.
Save your boosters for levels that stall. Collect diamonds to earn gems, and use your free daily gift of 5 of each booster when you get stuck.
faq: How do I finish a level?
Slip every piece off the board without letting any of them collide. Turn rings, pull sliding bars and clear locks in the right order.
How do I undo a move?
Double-tap a ring to put it back. Holding still for 1 second puts every ring back at once.

flex-escape.intro: Flex Escape is a 3D hypercasual game where you stay on a mat and stretch to dodge furniture and appliances. Move left or right to get past each obstacle and reach the end.
tips: Watch the incoming objects early and start moving before they reach you, since your body needs time to bend out of the way.
Make small, steady movements instead of large swings, which helps you stay balanced and react to the next obstacle.
Keep your attention on the upcoming path rather than the object right in front of you, so you can plan your next dodge.
Collect gems when you can without risking a hit, because they help unlock new objects for the game.
If you hit an obstacle, take a breath and refocus on the timing of the next one instead of rushing your inputs.
faq: What is the goal of Flex Escape?
The goal is to reach the end of the course without hitting any of the obstacles thrown at you.
How do I control my character?
Click or tap to play, then move left or right with the simple controls to stretch and dodge.

drift-city-racing-3d.intro: Drift City Racing 3D is a single-player browser racer set across eight environments. You race smart AI cars, drift through corners, use nitro, and earn XP to upgrade your car.
tips: Save nitro for straights and open stretches where you can use it fully. Using it while you are still turning often sends you wide into walls or traffic.
Practice drifting on the early roads before you commit to hard races. Learning how far your car slides helps you keep speed through corners.
Watch for obstacles such as fences, rubble, traffic, and walls. Choose a clean line early instead of correcting at the last second.
Pay attention to police and rival teams as you move through each area. Staying in front of them keeps your race position steady.
Spend XP on upgrades that match how you drive, and buy a new powerful car only when your current one is holding you back in races.
faq: What is the main goal of Drift City Racing 3D?
You race against smart AI cars across eight environments, aiming to be the best driver in each race. Winning races earns XP that you can use to upgrade your car.
How do I earn XP in the game?
XP is gained by taking part in and winning races. You can then spend it to upgrade your car, buy colors, or unlock new powerful cars.

annoying-cousins-punch-game.intro: Annoying Cousins Punch Game is a fast, cartoonish arcade game about punching your goofy cousins away. You tap at the right moment, dodge their sneaky attacks, and work through harder battles as the levels climb.
tips: Watch your cousin before you tap, since the punch needs to land at the right moment rather than just as fast as possible.
Use the swipe or dodge move to avoid sneaky attacks before you start throwing punches, so you are not left open.
Focus on timing over speed; precise taps give more powerful punches than rapid, messy tapping.
Expect the cousins to get faster and louder as levels increase, so slow your pace in your head and keep your attention on their movements.
Play in short sessions and beat each level before moving on, because harder and funnier cousin battles unlock as you progress.
faq: What is the goal of Annoying Cousins Punch Game?
Your goal is to knock your annoying cousins away by punching them at the right moment. As you beat levels, harder cousin battles unlock.
How do the controls work?
Tap to punch and time your taps to hit your cousin at the perfect moment. Swipe or dodge to avoid their attacks.

stacky-hero-master-game.intro: Stacky Hero Master Game is a maze puzzle where you move through colorful mazes, collect blocks, and build stacks while searching for the correct path to the finish line. Each level presents a new puzzle.
tips: Study the whole maze before you move so you can spot the route to the finish line and any dead ends.
Think about the path first and only collect blocks that help you reach the goal, since a tall stack is not useful if it leads you the wrong way.
Do not reuse the route from the previous level, because every level brings a new puzzle that needs fresh planning.
Use the mouse deliberately when clicking buttons, and pause to check your position after each move so you do not overshoot the correct path.
If you get stuck, step back and re-read the maze layout rather than repeating the same moves, which often leads to the same dead end.
faq: What is the goal of Stacky Hero Master Game?
Your goal is to move through each maze, collect blocks, build stacks, and find the correct path to reach the finish line.
How do I control the game?
The controls are easy and you use the mouse to click any button in the game.

tsunami-steal-an-egg.intro: Tsunami Steal An Egg is an obby where you sneak past guards, steal eggs from nests, and hatch pets that earn you cash. Build your base, train your speed, and climb the ranks.
tips: Watch the guards before you move in, and time your grab so you are not spotted near a nest.
Once you steal an egg, run straight back to your base before the guards can catch you.
Keep an eye out for the giant wave, since it can interrupt a run, so plan your route with it in mind.
Sell your haul regularly so your cash keeps building, and use it to upgrade your progress.
Train speed on the treadmill to reach new lands, and remember that rarer eggs hatch stronger pets.
faq: What is the main goal of Tsunami Steal An Egg?
Steal eggs from guarded nests, hatch pets, earn cash, and grow your base while climbing the global ranks.
How do I steal an egg from a guard?
Move close to the guard and hold the action key until the egg is yours, then run back to your base.

sneaker-factory.intro: Sneaker Factory is a tycoon game where you run your own shoe factory. You fill orders, sort stock, drive delivery trucks, and climb the city leaderboard.
tips: Earn reputation from several sources at once: building improvements, sorting, order fulfillment, and shipping. Since your level depends on reputation, a mix of activities keeps you moving forward.
When filling an order, check the requested colors and labels before you pack the batch so you don't have to redo work.
In the warehouse, put identical sneakers on the same shelves. Keeping stock grouped makes sorting faster and easier to manage as your output grows.
In truck delivery, use the brake or reverse early when an obstacle is ahead. Going slower near obstacles usually costs less than a collision.
Check the leaderboard now and then to see where your factory stands, and use that as a guide for which activity to focus on next.
faq: How do I level up in Sneaker Factory?
Your level depends on your reputation. You earn reputation by building improvements, sorting, fulfilling orders, and shipping goods.
What are the controls for the truck delivery part?
On PC, use the Left and Right Arrow keys to brake or reverse and to gas, and the Space Bar to jump. On mobile, use the matching Left, Right, and Up arrow buttons on screen.

rally-point-3.intro: Rally Point 3 is a 3D racing game where you compete to finish first and leave your opponents behind. Win races to unlock new missions and better cars.
tips: Your goal in every race is to finish in first place, so focus on the road ahead and the cars around you rather than just staying on pace.
Keep an eye on your engine. Pushing too hard in the heat of the moment can make it overheat, and that will end your race, so ease off when you need to.
Your first three races use the starting cars ForceZ, Vulcan and Bison. Use these races to learn how each car handles before you move on.
Win each race to unlock the next mission. Finishing the first three races is what opens up the better cars for the rest of the game.
Use the arrow keys with smooth, steady inputs so you keep control of your car through corners and avoid losing speed.
faq: What is the goal of Rally Point 3?
The goal is to win the race by coming in first place ahead of your opponents. Winning races also unlocks new missions.
How do I control the car?
You steer and drive using the arrow keys on your keyboard.

biking-extreme-3d.intro: Biking Extreme 3D is a racing game where you ride a mountain bike on multiplayer mountain tracks. Stay clear of trees and rocks, collect coins, and use them to upgrade your bike.
tips: Keep your eyes on the track ahead rather than on other riders, so you can spot trees and rocks early enough to steer around them.
Leave a safe gap between your bike and any obstacle, because touching one ends the game straight away.
Save your coins for bike upgrades when you have collected enough to make a clear difference, rather than spending them as soon as you get them.
Try the other characters to see which one suits your riding style, since the game offers five to choose from.
Remember that crashing into other riders sends them flying into the sky, so you can use collisions to pull ahead of the pack.
faq: What ends the game?
Getting too close to obstacles such as trees and rocks ends the game immediately. You need to keep a safe distance from them at all times.
How do I control the bike?
You play with mouse clicks or taps. The game uses only this single input method.

card-quest.intro: Card Quest is a card battle game built on Triple Triad rules. You move across a campaign map, facing enemies with their own battle rules and card decks while working to complete a collection book of fairy monsters.
tips: Before each match, read the enemy's battle rules, since every opponent plays with different ones and a move that works in one fight may fail in another.
When placing a card, compare the numbers on each edge that touches an opponent's card, because bigger numbers win and turn the card over.
Look for placements that flip several opponent cards at once, since combos can sweep the board and swing the match quickly.
Be careful where you place your strongest cards, because opponents can turn your cards and steal them if they have a stronger edge next to them.
Keep track of which cards you still need for the collection book so you can choose matches and cards that help you fill the gaps.
faq: What is the main goal of Card Quest?
Your goal is to beat every enemy on the campaign map and collect all cards to complete the collection book of fairy monsters.
How do I play a card?
Click or tap a card to select it, then click or tap a space on the board to place it. Bigger numbers on the card beat and turn over the cards they touch.

fire-truck-rescue-driving.intro: Fire Truck Rescue Driving puts you behind the wheel of a fire engine as you race to fire scenes for emergency rescues. Your job is to drive fast while staying careful around other vehicles.
tips: Watch the road ahead early so you have time to steer around other vehicles rather than reacting at the last moment.
Balance speed and caution: going faster helps you reach the fire sooner, but a crash on the way costs you time.
Use mouse clicks or taps steadily instead of rapid, random presses so your truck stays under control.
Keep your attention on the traffic in front of you when you approach a fire scene, since the urgency can make it easy to rush into collisions.
If a run starts going badly, focus on finishing the drive safely rather than trying to recover every second of lost time.
faq: What is the goal of Fire Truck Rescue Driving?
You drive a fire engine quickly to the scene of a fire to carry out an emergency rescue. Getting there fast while avoiding other vehicles is the core challenge.
How do I control the fire truck?
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps. Use them to steer and move the truck as you drive toward the fire.

rope-push-game.intro: Rope Push Game is a puzzle where you control a rope and push your opponent toward the edge of the arena. Timing and balance decide each round, and opponents get harder as you go.
tips: Click or tap at the moment you want to pull or push, rather than rapidly clicking, since timing is central to the game.
Watch your balance during each exchange and avoid moves that leave you off-center, because that makes it easier for your opponent to gain the advantage.
Look for openings when your opponent commits to a move, and respond with a push or pull that uses their momentum against them.
Stay patient in early rounds to learn how each opponent reacts, then adjust your timing to match their pattern.
As opponents become more challenging, focus on one smart move at a time instead of trying to win the round with a single big push.
faq: What is the goal of Rope Push Game?
Your goal is to push your opponent toward the edge of the arena and reach the winning point. Each round is decided by controlling the rope and your opponent's position.
How do I control the rope?
You play with mouse clicks or taps. Click or tap at the right moment to pull or push.

cyber-city-driver.intro: Cyber City Driver is a racing game set in a future city. You can race the clock through six routes or challenge a friend in two-player mode.
tips: Watch the timer closely on each route, since the run ends when time runs out. Keep a steady pace rather than crashing into obstacles that cost you seconds.
Use nitro in stretches where the road is straight and clear, so the boost is not wasted on turns.
Use the ramps to reach building roofs and find shortcuts. Check whether a ramp leads somewhere faster before committing to it.
Each new level unlocks a more powerful car. Pay attention to how each car handles and adjust your braking and turning to suit it.
Try Free Driving first to learn the layout of the city and how your car handles, then return to the timed routes with that knowledge.
faq: What is the goal of Cyber City Driver?
Complete all six different routes before time runs out. Each new level brings a more powerful car.
How do I play against a friend?
Choose 2 Player mode. Player 1 uses the arrow keys with N for nitro and B to look back. Player 2 uses W, A, S, D with T for nitro and C to look back.

hex-triple-match.intro: Hex Triple Match is a one-player puzzle game built around matching and merging items on a hexagonal board. Click or tap to place pieces and clear them faster by thinking ahead.
tips: Before placing a piece, look at which colours are already on the board so you can line up matches instead of scattering them.
Think about where each piece sits relative to the others, since the description stresses that placement decides how fast items get eliminated.
Try to group similar colours near each other so that a single placement can complete a set of three.
Take your time on early moves; a few quick, careless clicks can leave isolated items that are harder to match later.
If a move seems to block your options, step back and look for a different spot that keeps more matches possible.
faq: What is the goal of Hex Triple Match?
The goal is to match and merge items of the same colour so they are eliminated from the board. Each colour represents a different item.
How do I play?
Use a mouse click or tap to place pieces on the board. There are no other controls mentioned.

muscle-rush-3d.intro: Muscle Rush 3D is a fast-paced runner where each choice makes your hero stronger or weaker. Race through colorful tracks, pick the right gates, and finish with a hammer swing.
tips: Compare the multiplier gates before you reach them, since the gate you pick decides how much your strength grows.
Grab protein along the track and steer around junk food, because every pickup affects your hero's strength.
Stop at gym stations and lift weights when you can, so you enter fights and the finish line stronger.
Keep an eye on obstacles ahead and steer early rather than correcting at the last second.
Before the finish, think about your strength level, since a stronger hero will do better at the hammer swing and the high striker.
faq: How do I steer my hero?
Hold and drag on mobile, or use the mouse drag or the Left and Right arrow keys (or A and D) on desktop.
What do I tap or click for?
Tap or click (or press Space or Enter) to punch during fights and to swing the hammer at the finish line.

baby-taylor-puppy-daycare.intro: Baby Taylor Puppy Daycare is a simulation game about caring for a puppy that has returned home dusty and hurt. You clean him, tend his wounds, and then help him recover, dress him, feed him, and make him a home.
tips: Start with cleaning and disinfecting the puppy, since his wounds need attention before anything else. Working in that order keeps the rest of the care steps simple.
Give the puppy time to recover before moving on to dressing, feeding, or building his doghouse. The game is built around this waiting step.
Try each activity once, such as clothes, food, and the doghouse, so you know what each one does before you focus on a favorite.
If you want the puppy to look his best, save the manicure for last so his clothes and look come together at the end.
Use single mouse clicks or taps to move through each step, and take your time so you don't miss a stage.
faq: What is the main goal of Baby Taylor Puppy Daycare?
Your goal is to help Taylor's puppy come back to health after he returns dusty and hurt. You clean him, care for his wounds, and then dress him, feed him, and build him a doghouse.
How do I control the game?
Use a mouse click or tap to play. Click or tap on the items and actions on screen to move through each care step.

power-ball-soccer.intro: Power Ball Soccer is a top-down soccer game where you use special powers and score goals to beat a series of rivals across 32 levels. Each opponent is stronger than the last.
tips: Test the movement keys for a minute before a match. The game's directional mapping (W up, S left, D right, A down) is unusual, so it pays to learn it early.
Save your special ability with E for moments when a goal or a defensive stop is on the line, rather than using it the moment it is ready.
Because each opponent is stronger than the previous one, play the early levels carefully and pay attention to how the rivals move before you push forward.
Keep playing to unlock new characters, and try a few different ones to see which movement and power style suits how you like to play.
When you feel ready, switch to Challenge Mode for tougher matches, and expect to adjust your approach from the normal mode.
faq: What is the goal of Power Ball Soccer?
Score goals and beat your rivals across the 32 levels. Each opponent is stronger than the previous one.
How do I use special abilities?
On desktop, press E to activate your special ability. On mobile, tap the special ability button on screen.

police-stunt-cars.intro: Police Stunt Cars is a 3D racing game where you drive several police cars and perform stunts. You steer with the WASD keys.
tips: Learn how each car handles before attempting stunts, since the cars can feel different from one another.
Ease off the throttle before sharp turns so the car keeps its grip and does not spin out.
Plan your stunt runs from a straight stretch of road, giving yourself room to land safely.
Practice short movements with W, A, S and D rather than holding keys down, so you can make small corrections in the air and on landing.
Try a stunt a few times in a calm spot before repeating it in more crowded areas.
faq: What is the goal of Police Stunt Cars?
The description says you drive multiple police cars and perform stunts. Focus on driving smoothly while trying out different stunt moves.
How do I control the car?
Use the WASD keys to drive. W, A, S and D are the only controls listed for this game.

hit-and-knock-down.intro: Hit & Knock Down is a casual arcade shooting game where you throw balls at targets. Clear each stage by reaching the required score or completing its objectives.
tips: Drag or swipe to aim, and pay attention to the angle before you release, since a small change in direction can move the ball well away from the target.
Start each stage by testing your aim on the easiest targets to get a feel for how far the ball travels.
Try different balls on the same target to see which one knocks it down or makes it explode most reliably.
Check the stage objective before you start throwing so you know whether to focus on points or on specific targets.
Look for targets that are close together, since one well-placed throw can sometimes take out more than one at a time.
faq: What is the goal of Hit & Knock Down?
Your goal is to clear each stage by reaching the required score or meeting the stage objectives, then move on to the next challenge.
How do I throw the ball?
Drag or swipe on the screen to aim toward a target, then release your touch to throw the ball.

popdify.intro: Popdify is a fast-paced skill game about precision. Hold to release popcorn and aim to fill the cup without dropping a single kernel outside it.
tips: Start with short holds to see how much popcorn each press releases before you commit to a longer one.
Keep your eyes on the cup and the stream of kernels together, since a kernel that misses even slightly ends the game.
Adjust your aim in small steps rather than big moves, so you can correct without overshooting the cup.
Pause briefly between holds to let the popcorn settle, which makes it easier to judge where the next kernels will land.
Play in short sessions and focus on steady, controlled releases, because rushing is the most common cause of a mistake.
faq: What is the goal of Popdify?
The goal is to fill the cup with popcorn perfectly. Your aim is to keep every kernel inside the cup.
How do I release popcorn?
Hold to release popcorn into the cup. Letting go stops the flow.

fun-race-car-3d.intro: Fun Race Car 3D is a car stunt racing arcade game where you race against two other drivers to reach the finish line first. Tap to move and aim for a clean run through each level.
tips: Finishing first among the three drivers matters most, so keep your pace up rather than slowing down to play it safe.
Earn all three yellow stars by completing a level without crashing. Take each obstacle slowly at first until you learn its timing.
When you crash, you restart from the beginning of the current obstacle, not the start of the level. Focus on clearing one obstacle at a time.
Watch the obstacles ahead before each tap so you can time your moves instead of reacting late.
Replay a level you finished with crashes to go for the three-star result. A cleaner run is often faster as well.
faq: What is the goal of Fun Race Car 3D?
Your goal is to reach the finish line before the other two drivers and win the championship. Completing levels without crashing also earns you three yellow stars.
What happens if I crash into an obstacle?
You respawn at the start of the current obstacle rather than the beginning of the whole level. You can then try that section again.

bombaman-3d.intro: BOMBAMAN 3D is a maze game where you place bombs to clear paths, defeat enemies, and find the secret exit. You can play alone or with others, and each level has a 99-second timer.
tips: Place bombs next to walls and boxes so the blast opens a route, rather than dropping them in open space where they clear nothing useful.
Bombs placed side by side set off each other, so you can line up a chain to clear a wider area at once.
Keep an eye on the timer. Break boxes that drop clocks when you need more time, but don't spend too long searching a level.
Collect power-ups early in each level. More bombs and a longer blast range make it much easier to clear paths and handle enemies.
Against the boss, plan your bomb placements ahead of time, since you need three bomb hits to defeat it and it can be hard to dodge the blasts in a tight space.
faq: What is the goal of BOMBAMAN 3D?
Clear your way through each maze, defeat enemies and bosses, and find the secret exit to move on. Each level has a 99-second time limit.
How do I move and place bombs?
Use W, A, S, D or the arrow keys to move, and press the Spacebar to place a bomb. Bombs explode after 3 seconds.

all-golf.intro: All Golf! is an arcade golf game where you aim your shots across challenging courses and go for a hole-in-one. You play with a mouse click or a tap, and you can also compete with friends.
tips: Take a moment to line up each shot before you click or tap, since the course layout rewards careful aiming.
Try for a hole-in-one on early courses to learn how your swings behave before you move on to harder layouts.
Play solo challenges to build your skills, then test the same approach when competing against friends.
Keep track of which courses you have unlocked and which ones you still need to beat, so you know what to work toward next.
Experiment with your equipment options to see which setup suits your swing style, rather than sticking with the default.
faq: What is the goal of All Golf!?
The goal is to get your ball into the hole, with a hole-in-one as the big target on challenging courses. Aim carefully on each shot to make it count.
How do I play All Golf!?
Use a mouse click or a tap to play. The controls are meant to be intuitive, so the focus is on your timing and aim.

obby-king-of-the-hill.intro: Obby: King of the Hill is a multiplayer obstacle course where players race up a mountain to reach the top and try to hold the crown. Climb, jump past obstacles, and knock rivals off the hill.
tips: Use Space to jump early before obstacles reach you, since a late jump is the most common way to fall.
Keep moving rather than standing still near the top, because players who hold position are the ones rivals try to knock off.
Use the club attack (LMB on PC, the attack button on mobile) when a rival is close to an edge, so the bump sends them off the mountain.
Rotate the camera with RMB and mouse movement on PC to check what is ahead before you commit to a jump.
Spend time in matches to earn experience, since the description says your character becomes stronger and more stable the more you play.
faq: What is the goal of Obby: King of the Hill?
Race up the mountain to reach the top, then stay there in King of the Hill mode. Knocking rivals off the mountain helps you keep your position.
How do I move and jump?
On PC, use W, A, S and D to move and Space to jump. On mobile, use the joystick to move and the jump button to jump.

cool-tuning-paint-the-car.intro: Cool Tuning: Paint the Car is a customization game where you buy cars, decorate them with paint, stickers and film, and sell them at auction. This guide covers the tools and habits that help you grow your collection.
tips: Use the brush for detail work and the spray can for covering large areas, so each tool has a clear job on the car.
Add stickers and film after the base paint is done, so you can see how the finished design fits together.
Check the store regularly for new colors, films and stickers, since they give you more ways to make each car stand out.
Plan each car's look before you start, so your choices stay consistent from paint to stickers.
After you sell a finished car at auction, use the money to buy your next car and keep building your collection.
faq: What is the main goal of Cool Tuning: Paint the Car?
The goal is to buy cars, tune them with paint, stickers and film, and sell them at auction to earn money. You then use that money to buy new cars and grow.
Which tools do you have for decorating a car?
You have a brush, a spray can, stickers and film. Each one lets you customize the car in a different way.

real-mtb-downhill-3d.intro: Real MTB Downhill 3D is a mountain biking adventure where you ride down five different mountain roads before time runs out. You face changing weather and rough terrain while you race to the finish.
tips: Keep an eye on the clock from the start, since you must finish each of the five roads before time runs out.
Adjust your speed for the terrain ahead, and ease off when the ground gets rough so you keep control of the bike.
Weather changes how the ride feels, so stay alert and expect the bike to handle differently in rain or other tough conditions.
Try the controls on an early road to learn what Space, C and V do before you reach the harder roads.
Use the rewards you earn to change your bike's color and unlock new riding clothes if you want to customize your rider.
faq: What is the goal of Real MTB Downhill 3D?
Your goal is to complete all five mountain roads before the time runs out. Each road tests your riding across different terrain and weather.
Which keys do I use to play?
Use the arrow keys to ride, and use Space, C and V for the other actions listed in the game's instructions.

build-levels-earn-money.intro: Build levels – earn money! is a clicker game where you tap to release balls toward holes in each round. Upgrades bought in the store between rounds help you progress further.
tips: Tap anywhere on the screen to release balls, and pay attention to how each ball lands so you can adjust your timing on later rounds.
Visit the store after every round and compare what is on offer before spending, since upgrades can change how the next level plays.
Save your diamonds for permanent upgrades that carry across runs rather than spending them all at once on small boosts.
Aim to finish each level cleanly, because the game rewards you more the further you go.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Release balls into the holes in each round, then use store purchases to get through the next level. Completing levels earns diamonds.
What are diamonds used for?
Diamonds can be spent on permanent upgrades that help you level up faster over time.

hex-block-puzzle-master.intro: Hex Block Puzzle Master is a relaxed puzzle where you drag colorful hexagonal blocks onto a grid and fill every open space. Each layout gets harder as you move forward.
tips: Look at the empty cells before you place anything. Find spots that only one block shape can fill, and place those first.
Remember that blocks cannot be rotated. Check which way each block faces before you drag it, so you do not have to work around a wrong fit later.
Start with the edges and corners of the grid. Pieces placed there are often the hardest to fit later, so solving them early keeps options open.
Avoid leaving small isolated gaps. If a single empty cell is surrounded, it may be impossible to fill with the blocks you have left.
There are no timers, so take your time. If you get stuck, step back and scan the whole board for the next clear placement.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Your goal is to place the hexagonal blocks into the grid so that every available space is filled. Completing the grid solves the puzzle and unlocks the next level.
Can I rotate the blocks?
No. Blocks cannot be rotated, so you need to plan each move with the shape as it is shown.

drawer-sort.intro: Drawer Sort is a puzzle about tidying cluttered drawers by placing each item in its right spot. Each brain training task asks you to fit objects neatly, so careful planning pays off.
tips: Look over the whole drawer and every item before you click anything, so you can see which pieces are most awkward to fit.
Place the larger or more unusual items first, then fill the gaps with smaller ones so nothing gets stuck in the wrong spot.
Aim for snug fits. A piece that is slightly off can block space for the others, so take a moment to line it up before placing it.
If a placement makes the drawer harder to finish, consider whether the item could go somewhere that leaves more room for the rest.
Use mouse clicks or taps slowly and deliberately, since precision matters more than speed in this game.
faq: What is the goal of Drawer Sort?
The goal is to place the various items in their right places within each drawer, so everything fits snugly and the space is tidy.
Why does my drawer end up messy even when I try to tidy it?
Placing items without planning ahead can leave awkward gaps or misplaced pieces. Thinking about the full layout before you start each task helps prevent this.

lovely-virtual-cat.intro: Lovely Virtual Cat lets you look after Bubbu, a virtual pet cat, through everyday activities like eating, selfies, visiting friends and dancing. It is a relaxed game built around exploring his home and discovering his secrets.
tips: Try every activity at least once, since the description mentions feeding, selfies, visiting friends and dancing, and each one may reveal something different about Bubbu.
Explore all areas of Bubbu's home, because the game highlights finding out secrets about his life and some surprises may only show up when you look around.
Tap or click slowly on objects and characters to see how Bubbu reacts, which helps you learn what he enjoys.
Keep an eye on Bubbu's mood and take a break from one activity when he seems to want to switch to another.
Come back to the game later and check what has changed, since the game is meant to surprise you over time.
faq: What is the goal of Lovely Virtual Cat?
There is no fixed goal stated in the description. The game is about spending time with Bubbu, caring for him and discovering the secrets of his life.
How do I control the game?
You play by tapping or clicking on the things you want to interact with, such as food, friends, the camera or the dance activity.

ancient-dragons-princess.intro: Ancient Dragons Princess is a dress-up adventure where you style Princess Rennie and her dragon. You tap characters to pick outfits, hairstyles, and jewelry as you follow her journey.
tips: Try a few outfits before settling on one, since the game offers everything from velvet gowns to dragon-riding outfits. Comparing them side by side helps you find the look that suits the adventure.
Pick an outfit for the activity Rennie is about to do. A dragon-riding outfit fits the journey, while a velvet gown suits a more formal scene.
Give your dragon a custom look early, then keep it consistent across scenes so your styling feels planned. Matching colors between the dragon and Rennie's outfit can make the whole set look cohesive.
