Do not overlook hair and jewelry. These small choices can change the overall feel of Rennie's look more than you might expect.
Tap each character to check their options before moving on, so you do not miss a piece of styling you wanted to add.
faq: How do I change Rennie's outfit?
Tap on Rennie or the other characters to choose new outfits for them. You can keep trying different combinations until you are happy with the look.
Can I customize the dragon as well?
Yes, you can customize a unique dragon for Rennie. You can style it alongside her outfit and jewelry to build a matching pair.

colorful-greedy-snake.intro: Colorful Greedy Snake is a casual snake game that mixes quick reactions with strategy. You steer your snake using the mouse or touch controls and try to outplay the competition.
tips: Look a few steps ahead instead of only reacting to the snake's head, so you can plan a safe route before you reach a turn.
Keep open space near you. Turning into a tight corner or a dead end is the most common way to lose a run.
Make small, steady movements with the mouse or touch input rather than sharp, jerky ones, which can overshoot your intended direction.
Pay attention to where your snake's body is as it grows, and avoid boxing yourself in between your own segments.
If a run starts going badly, stay calm and focus on getting free of the danger first before trying to recover your position.
faq: How do I control the snake?
You steer the snake with mouse or touch input, so you point or move in the direction you want it to travel.
What is the main goal of the game?
The game rewards both quick hand speed and good strategy, so the aim is to keep your snake moving well while staying ahead of the competition.

cubegate.intro: CubeGate is a puzzle-platformer where you carry glowing cubes onto pressure plates to power gates, doors, bridges and elevators. Each short room asks you to work out the right order of actions before you reach the exit.
tips: Before picking up a cube, look at the whole room and note which plates need power and which gate they control. Planning the full route first saves a lot of retries.
If one cube does not seem to be enough, check whether another gate or plate in the room also needs power. Some rooms are built around using more than one cube.
Pay attention to order. Some rooms only work if you act in a specific sequence, so try moving a cube or jumping up before powering a gate.
Use the floor markings and highlights as guides for where a cube belongs. Following the energy lines and cables often shows the path you need.
When a jump feels too far, sprint to build speed and jump from the edge of the platform. Practise precise jumps in a safe spot before carrying a cube across a gap.
faq: What is the main goal in CubeGate?
Your goal is to place cubes on the marked pressure plates, power the logic gates, and open the doors to reach the exit of each chamber.
How do I pick up and place a cube?
Use the Left Mouse Button to pick up or put down a cube. Carry it to the marked plate before you try to power the gate.

puzzle-box-brain-fun.intro: Puzzle Box - Brain Fun is a one-player brain game with several modes and difficulty levels to unlock. You play by clicking or tapping, so it suits short, focused sessions.
tips: Start on the easiest level you can reach so you learn how the puzzles work before moving up.
Take a moment to look over the whole puzzle before you click, since rushing tends to cause mistakes.
Try each mode at least once, because the different modes ask for different kinds of thinking.
Unlock new levels in order and do not skip ahead too fast, so the difficulty increases at a pace you can handle.
If you get stuck, step away for a moment and return with fresh eyes, which often makes the next move easier to spot.
faq: How do I play Puzzle Box - Brain Fun?
Use a mouse click or a tap to interact with the puzzles. Choose a mode and level, then work through the puzzle on screen.
How do I unlock new levels?
The game has different levels of difficulty and gameplay that unlock as you play. Keep progressing to reach the harder ones.

war-groups.intro: War Groups is a strategy game set in the Zone, where you pick a group, capture sectors, and fight enemies and rival factions. Your aim is to become the master of the entire Zone.
tips: Pick a group early and plan your strategy around its strengths, since the game offers more than 10 groups to choose from.
Collect artifacts whenever you can, because they are the way to strengthen your army.
Explore the map before committing to a big fight, as the 15+ sectors contain anomalies, mutants and enemies that can slow you down.
Use trading to fill gaps in your equipment and artifacts rather than relying only on what you find yourself.
Think carefully before starting a war, and consider forming alliances first to make your position stronger.
faq: What is the main goal of War Groups?
Your goal is to capture the entire Zone by destroying enemies and rival factions. You do this by taking over sectors and becoming the sole master of the Zone.
How do I get stronger in the game?
Collect artifacts to strengthen your army, and trade equipment and artifacts with other players. Growing your army is central to progressing.

crazy-downhill-ragdoll-fall-down.intro: Crazy Downhill! is an arcade race where a ragdoll hero rolls, tumbles and crashes down a slope toward the finish line. Steer around obstacles and keep your fall under control to get there first.
tips: Look ahead to spot obstacles early, so you have time to change direction before you reach them.
Make small, steady direction changes instead of sharp swerves, since big turns can send your hero into a worse crash.
Expect falls and tumbles: the hero gets up again, so keep moving toward the finish line rather than stopping to react.
Use the same control method every time you play, so your timing and steering become consistent.
Try a few runs to learn how the hero reacts to the slope, then aim for a faster route on the next attempt to climb the leaderboard.
faq: What is the goal of Crazy Downhill!?
Your goal is to roll your ragdoll hero to the finish line while dodging obstacles along the way.
How do I steer the hero?
On mobile, swipe left or right to change the direction of movement. On PC, use the arrow keys or the mouse.

strike-force-action-platformer.intro: Strike Force is a side-scrolling action platformer where you run, jump, and shoot through colorful levels packed with enemies. Keep moving, watch every direction, and use your ammo and upgrades wisely.
tips: Keep moving along the route rather than standing still, since enemies come at you from several directions at once.
Save your grenades for groups of enemies or those firing from cover, where regular shots are harder to land.
Track your ammo as you go and grab pickups when it is safe, so you do not run dry in the middle of a tough fight.
Shoot down enemy drones whenever you can, because they are the source of the weapon upgrades that make later fights easier.
Learn to jump between shots and bullets, watching for incoming fire so you can dodge before you return fire.
faq: How do I get stronger weapons?
Blast the enemy drones you see in the levels. They drop powerful weapon upgrades that you can use in the fight.
What are the desktop controls?
Move with W, A, S, D or the arrow keys, jump with the spacebar, shoot with J, and throw a grenade with K.

hook-pin-jam.intro: Hook Pin Jam is a logic puzzle where you tap hooks to release them and untangle the board. Each level is a new puzzle, and clearing them earns in-game currency.
tips: Before you tap, scan the board for the hooks that seem to block the most others, since untangling those first can open up the rest.
The goal is to finish in the fewest moves, so plan a short sequence rather than tapping hooks at random.
Some levels have special challenges that give extra rewards, so check what the challenge asks for before you start tapping.
Puzzles get more complex as you progress, so take a moment to study each new layout instead of rushing.
You have a limited number of lives, so slow down and think through a move before committing to it.
faq: What is the goal of Hook Pin Jam?
The goal is to untie the hooks and clear the board, untangling all hooks in as few moves as possible.
How do I play each move?
Tap on a hook to release it. Each tap counts as one move, so choose carefully.

children-doctor-dentist-2-surgery-game.intro: Children Doctor Dentist 2 is a dental clinic game where you treat funny animal patients whose teeth hurt. You use modern medical tools to care for each one. Controls are tap or click.
tips: Look at each animal patient first to see where the problem is before you pick up a tool.
Work through the treatment in a steady order rather than jumping between tools, so each patient is handled cleanly.
Use the tools carefully and avoid rushing, since each patient needs to accept the care you give.
Keep your taps or clicks deliberate, so you do not select the wrong tool or item by accident.
Pay attention to how each animal reacts and adjust your approach if a patient seems uncomfortable.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Your goal is to manage a dental hospital and help the animal patients whose teeth hurt by providing the medical care they need.
How do I control the game?
The game is played by tapping or clicking on the screen to choose tools and interact with your patients.

12-minutes-to-survive.intro: Play as a mage who must survive 12 minutes of waves of enemies. Level up mid-battle, collect souls from defeated foes, and use your growing power to hold out until the end.
tips: Collect souls from defeated enemies whenever you can, since they are how you upgrade your mage's power.
Pay attention to level-ups during the fight and choose skills and abilities that fit how you are playing.
Keep moving rather than standing still, so you can stay away from crowds of enemies while you gather souls.
Watch the clock. The challenge increases with every passing minute, so plan for stronger waves in the later part of the run.
Stay aware of your surroundings and avoid getting trapped in corners, because the waves keep coming for the full 12 minutes.
faq: What is the goal of 12 Minutes to Survive?
Your goal is to survive the full 12 minutes while battling waves of enemies that get harder as time passes.
How do I move my mage?
On desktop, use the arrow keys on your keyboard. On mobile, use the touch virtual buttons on screen.

baby-panda-train-driver.intro: Baby Panda Train Driver is a girls' game about building a train and getting it ready for a trip. You assemble the engine and carriages, check passengers, load cargo, and then drive off on an adventure with baby panda.
tips: Build the front of the train first, then add the long carriages and cargo boxes, so each piece has a clear place to attach.
Check each suitcase carefully for dangerous items before the passenger moves on, since that is one of the main jobs of the babies.
Get passengers lined up before you check tickets, which keeps the boarding area from getting crowded and mixed up.
Load all the cargo onto the train before you start the machine, so nothing is left behind when the journey begins.
Take your time with each click or tap, because the game is played only with the mouse or touch, and rushing can lead to missed items.
faq: What is the goal of Baby Panda Train Driver?
The goal is to build the train, check passengers and their suitcases, load the cargo, and then drive the train on a new journey with baby panda.
How do I control the game?
You play by clicking the mouse or tapping the screen. Use single clicks or taps to pick items, move things, and carry out each step.

bird-sort-puzzles.intro: Bird Sort Puzzles asks you to sort colorful birds into the nests that match their colors. Each level is a logic puzzle that rewards planning ahead before you move.
tips: Before moving anything, look at which bird is on top of each nest so you know what you can reach first.
Try to empty a nest or branch early, since a free space gives you more room to rearrange the other birds.
Avoid stacking a different-colored bird on top of a group you are still building, because it will block that color.
When a level feels stuck, use the extra branches the game offers on harder levels to set birds aside temporarily.
Take short breaks between levels; the puzzle is easier to solve when you look at the board with fresh eyes.
faq: How do I move a bird?
Click or tap a bird to select it, then click or tap the nest or branch where you want it to go.
What is the goal of each level?
The goal is to sort every bird into a nest that matches its color so that each nest holds only one color.

planet-blast-rockets.intro: Planet Blast: Rockets is a physics-based action game where you design rockets and launch them at cities, continents, and planets. Each strike is a chance to tune fuel, mass, and blast power for a bigger impact.
tips: After every launch, look closely at the result before changing anything, so you can tell which parameter caused the weak spot.
Change one rocket parameter at a time when testing. This makes it easier to see how fuel, mass, or blast power affects the strike.
Treat fuel, mass, and blast power as a balance rather than maxing one out. The game is built around finding the right combination.
Spend upgrades on the modules that match your current weakest result, so each upgrade addresses a real problem.
Choose your impact point with the rocket design in mind, since the same rocket can produce very different craters on different targets.
faq: What is the main goal in Planet Blast: Rockets?
Your goal is to tune a rocket, pick an impact point, and destroy cities, continents, and planets. Along the way you upgrade modules and unlock new targets across the galaxy.
How do I aim and launch a rocket on desktop?
Press and hold the left mouse button to adjust rocket parameters, choose a target, and launch. Mobile uses taps and finger gestures for the same actions.

chess-free.intro: Chess free is a browser chess board where you can play against a computer engine at 18 difficulty levels, play a friend on the same screen, or face live players online. Click or tap to move.
tips: Select a piece and check the highlighted squares before you commit, so you can see every move that piece can make.
Start at a level where you can finish games with some confidence, then move up one level at a time as your results improve.
Use the interactive tips during play to spot ideas you might miss, and try to work out the reason behind each tip.
Cancel a move if you notice a mistake right away, but use this sparingly so you build the habit of checking before you move.
After each game, open the analysis to see which moves were mistakes, then use the replay feature from the right point to test a better line.
faq: How do I move a piece?
Click or tap a piece to select it, then click or tap the square where you want it to go. The possible moves for that piece are shown when you select it.
Can I take back a move?
Yes. The cancel move option lets you go back if you made a move you did not intend. It is worth checking your moves first so you rely on it less.

color-hole.intro: Color Hole is a casual game where you steer a hole across the screen to swallow white objects while steering clear of colorful ones. Levels get harder as obstacles become more complex.
tips: Swipe in small, steady moves so you can keep the hole centered on the white objects without overshooting into colored ones.
Before each move, check where the colored objects are and plan a route that reaches the white ones without crossing them.
Clear the easier white objects near the edges first, so the middle of the level is less crowded when the trickier parts come up.
Watch the path ahead rather than only the hole itself, since obstacles get more complex as you advance and reacting late is the most common mistake.
If you keep bumping into colored objects, slow down and replay the level with a clearer plan instead of rushing through it.
faq: What is the goal of Color Hole?
Your goal is to guide the hole so it eats all the white objects on each level. You must avoid the objects of other colors while doing so.
How do I move the hole?
Swipe across the screen to move the hole. The hole follows your swipes, so smaller swipes give you more precise control.

paint-the-keyboard.intro: Paint the Keyboard is a clicker where you run across the keys, paint them with a roller, and earn money for each press. You use that money to buy upgrades, hire workers, and open new areas of the keyboard.
tips: Keep an eye on your paint supply and head to the paint tank to refill the roller before it runs out.
Put your early earnings into upgrades that boost your speed or widen the roller, since both help you cover more keys per trip.
Hire workers as soon as you can afford them, because they press keys alongside you and add to your earnings.
Open new areas of the keyboard when you have the money, so you have more keys to paint and more presses to earn from.
Check what a new round of development offers before you start one, so you know what you are gaining from it.
faq: How do I earn money?
You earn money for each key press while you paint the keys with your roller. Hired workers also press keys with you.
How do I move around the keyboard?
On a computer, use WASD to move and hold the right mouse button while moving the mouse to rotate the camera. On mobile, use the joystick to move and swipe the screen to rotate the camera.

tornado-fury-of-the-elements.intro: You play a tornado lord who tears through a city, building whirlwinds and destroying buildings while steering clear of defenses and obstacles. Use WASD on PC or the on-screen joystick on mobile.
tips: Learn the movement first by making small, slow turns, so you can keep your tornado under control before you go after bigger targets.
Scan the streets ahead for defenses and obstacles and plan a route around them instead of reacting at the last moment.
Aim for clusters of buildings and infrastructure in one pass, since a single well-placed run can cause more destruction than several scattered ones.
Spend your upgrades on the skill that is causing you the most trouble, whether that is steering or destructive power.
Stay calm when the city gets crowded. Slowing down for a moment often helps you avoid a collision that would end your run.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?

You play as a tornado lord and cause as much destruction in the city as you can. This means creating whirlwinds, destroying buildings and infrastructure, and avoiding collisions with defenses and other obstacles.
How do I control the tornado?
On PC, use W to go forward, A to go left, S to go backwards, and D to go right. On mobile devices, use the joystick on the screen.

stackitaire.intro: Stackitaire is a solitaire card-sorting puzzle where you move cards between stacks to build complete suits. Each level has a new layout, and locked and hidden cards make later levels harder.
tips: Keep one stack empty for as long as you can. It gives you a spot to move cards out of the way while you rearrange a blocked stack.
Before you place a card, look at which cards sit beneath the stacks you plan to use. Moving a card that covers a useful card can leave you stuck.
When you are stuck, try Undo first and check whether your last move caused the block. Save Hint for a position you truly cannot untangle.
Focus on finishing one suit at a time. A stack only counts as complete when the full suit is sorted from bottom to top, so partial stacks do not help you clear the level.
When a stack is sealed, consider using a Key early if its hidden cards might unlock the moves you need. Hidden cards can change which options you have.
faq: What is the goal of Stackitaire?
Sort the mixed cards into complete suits, with one suit per stack. You clear the level once all stacks are done.
Where can I place a card?
You can only place a card onto another card of the same suit or into an empty stack. Tap a stack to pick up its top card, then tap another stack to place it.

bullet-man-3d-online.intro: Bullet Man 3D Online is a 3D arcade shooter where you aim a gun at enemies and try to hit them before they get away. Enemies keep moving, so timing and aim both matter.
tips: Watch an enemy for a moment before you fire so you can see which direction it is moving.
Aim slightly ahead of a moving target, since a straight shot at its current spot may miss once it shifts.
Pay attention to the path a bullet will travel and check whether the enemy can step out of it.
Take your time with each shot rather than firing rapidly, because a missed bullet gives the enemy a chance to dodge the next one.
Keep your eyes on the enemy's position at all times so you can react as soon as it changes direction.
faq: What is the goal of Bullet Man 3D Online?
Your goal is to aim your gun at each enemy and destroy them by hitting them with a bullet. The enemies do not stay still, so you need to predict where they will be.
How do I control the game?
The instructions say to tap to play. Tap to aim and fire at the enemy in the 3D scene.

offroad-truck-animal-transporter.intro: Offroad Truck Animal Transporter is a driving game set in a realistic forest. You haul farm animals to their destinations across ten levels of rough terrain, changing weather, and obstacles.
tips: Take the rough terrain slowly at first so you can learn how your truck handles each surface before you speed up.
Press C to switch camera views and check the ground and obstacles around your truck before you commit to a route.
Click the screen and look around when you need a wider view of the path ahead, especially before tight or uneven sections.
Expect the weather to change and adjust your speed and steering to match the conditions on screen.
Replay a level if you struggle with precision, since each level is built to test your driving control and accuracy.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Transport the farm animals to their destinations while driving through each forest level. The game has 10 levels in total.
What are the basic controls?
Use W, A, S and D to drive the truck. Press C to change the camera, and click on the screen to look around.

paint-tiles-puzzle.intro: Paint Tiles Puzzle is a relaxing puzzle game where you fill a tile grid with the correct colors. Each level has its own pattern and color mix, and the challenge grows as you move forward.
tips: Before you start painting, study the whole grid and look for patterns that repeat across rows or columns.
Work out which tiles are certain first, and fill those before guessing on harder spaces.
Pay attention to the color combinations in each level, since matching them is the main way to know where a color belongs.
If you get stuck, step back and look at the grid from a different angle rather than trying the same move again.
Take short breaks between harder levels so you can come back with fresh eyes on the pattern.
faq: What is the goal of Paint Tiles Puzzle?
Your goal is to fill the empty spaces in each tile grid with the right colors. Each level presents a new pattern to solve.
How do I paint the tiles?
Use a mouse click or tap to pick up the brush and paint tiles. The brush paints the same colors as the level requires.

rift-of-hell-demons-war.intro: Rift of Hell - Demons War is a fast-paced first-person shooter set in a hellish world. You fight waves of demons, collect gold, and upgrade your gear and abilities to survive.
tips: Pick up gold whenever it is safe, since it is what you need to upgrade your abilities between tough moments.
Think about how you spend gold instead of buying everything at once. Focus on the upgrades that help you survive the waves you struggle with most.
Equip the weapons that suit your playstyle, and switch to a stronger option when you have the chance rather than sticking with weak gear.
Do not rush into the middle of a crowd of demons. Keep your distance where you can so you have time to react as new waves arrive.
Keep an eye on your health and resources during each battle, because intense waves can wear you down quickly.
faq: What is the main goal of Rift of Hell - Demons War?
Your goal is to survive waves of demons in a hellish setting and conquer the darkness. Each wave gets you closer to surviving the intense battles.
How do I get stronger during the game?
Collect gold during battles and use it to upgrade your abilities. You can also equip more powerful weapons to handle tougher demons.

hard-puzzle.intro: Hard Puzzle asks you to assemble a square from bright geometric figures across a large number of levels. It is built for daily brain training, with a hint available whenever you get stuck.
tips: Start by looking at the shapes and their edges before placing anything. Matching straight sides and corners often shows which piece goes where.
Place the pieces with the clearest fit first, such as corner or flat-edge pieces, so the remaining space gets smaller and easier to read.
Work on one area of the square at a time instead of trying to fill it all at once. This keeps the picture from feeling overwhelming.
If you feel stuck, step away for a moment and come back with fresh eyes. Then try the hint only after you have made a real attempt.
Play a little each day rather than long sessions. The levels get harder as you open new ones, so steady practice builds the skill.
faq: What is the goal of Hard Puzzle?
Your goal is to assemble a square from the bright geometric figures on each level. Completing the square lets you move on to the next level.
How does the hint work?
If you get stuck, you can use a hint to get help with the current level. Try the puzzle on your own first so you still get practice from it.

bump-bandit.intro: Bump Bandit is a top-down puzzle game where you guide a quirky thief to collect every diamond in the city. Each move matters, so plan your route before you step.
tips: Look at the whole screen before moving, since you need to collect all gems to finish the level.
Use Undo (Z) freely when a move leaves you stuck, rather than restarting the whole level.
Use Restart (R) when you have clearly blocked your own path and undoing would take too many steps.
Test small routes first, for example one or two moves, to see how the thief reacts before committing to a longer plan.
On mobile, make your swipes clear and deliberate so the thief moves in the direction you intended.
faq: What is the goal of Bump Bandit?
Collect all the gems on each level to complete it. The story follows the thief through the heist.
What controls do I use on desktop?
Use the Arrow keys or W, A, S, D to move. Press R to restart a level and Z to undo your last move.

mx-offroad-mountain-bike.intro: MX OffRoad Mountain Bike is a downhill riding game where you race down rough terrain, over high ramps and past cliff edges. Reach the checkpoints to complete each level, alone or with a second rider.
tips: Keep your speed under control on steep slopes, since the terrain is rough and a fast crash can leave the bike stuck.
Look ahead for the next checkpoint and line up your route early, especially when fog hides what is coming.
Approach high ramps with steady speed rather than full throttle, so you land with the bike balanced.
If the bike gets stuck, use the re-spawn button right away instead of trying to force it free, which saves time.
In two-player mode, agree with your partner on a pace so one rider does not leave the other behind at checkpoints.
faq: What is the goal of MX OffRoad Mountain Bike?
Your goal is to ride down the course and reach the checkpoints to complete each level. The game is built around extreme downhill riding.
What are the controls for Player 1 and Player 2?
Player 1 uses the W, A, S and D keys. Player 2 uses the arrow keys.

bullet-loop.intro: Bullet Loop is an action shooter where your hero retreats toward a bunker while holding off waves of enemies. Each run earns coins that you spend on upgrades to push further through the zones.
tips: Focus on aiming for headshots, since precise shots are the main way to make your hero's fire count during a wave.
Collect coins during every run, because they feed the upgrades for damage, fire rate, and income that carry over to later attempts.
Balance your upgrades instead of stacking only one. If enemies are lasting too long, damage helps most, while fire rate helps when waves overwhelm you.
Use the restart option after a run ends to try again quickly and test whether your new upgrades help you get further.
Keep your drag aim steady and watch where enemies are closing in on the bunker, so you can aim at the threats that matter most.
faq: What is the goal of Bullet Loop?
Hold off waves of enemies as your hero retreats toward the bunker, and push as far as you can through the 10 themed zones.
How do I aim and shoot?
Hold the left mouse button and drag to aim. Shooting and movement are automatic, so your main job is aiming.

drift-idle-drift-earn-upgrade.intro: Drift Idle is a relaxed clicker where your car drives on its own and you steer the drifts. Build combos, spend your cash on upgrades, and work up to faster cars.
tips: Focus on steering through corners at a sharp angle, since harder angles pay out more per drift.
Flip sides without ending the drift to raise your combo multiplier toward the 10x cap.
Hold a drift for longer when you can, because the end-of-drift bonus grows with how long you keep it going.
Spread your upgrade spending across Income, Speed, and Drift rather than maxing one lane early, so every part of your earnings grows together.
Check the garage when you have enough cash, since each new car drifts harder and pays out more than the one before.
faq: What is the goal of Drift Idle?
Your goal is to earn money by drifting, then spend it on upgrades and better cars. Each car you unlock drifts harder and pays out more.
How do I steer the car?
Drag the steering wheel at the bottom of the screen left or right. The car drifts based on the angle you hold.

jixora-jigsaw-solitaire-puzzle.intro: Jixora is a calm jigsaw solitaire where you drag pieces into place to complete a piece of artwork before the timer runs out. You can work through 100 levels or replay favorites in Free Play.
tips: Start by grouping pieces that clearly belong together, such as edge pieces or ones with matching colors, then join the groups together.
Pieces snap and lock when they belong next to each other, so build connected sections and check that each join looks right before moving on.
Save Peek for when you are stuck on a section, since it shows the completed image for only a few seconds and you need to memorize what you see.
Use Freeze when the clock is getting tight and you still have many pieces to place, because it pauses the timer for 10 seconds.
If a particular level feels too hard, try Free Play with a smaller grid size to practice placing pieces before returning to the main levels.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You must piece together the full image before the timer runs out. Earning stars depends on racing the clock.
How do I know when pieces are correct?
Adjacent pieces that belong together snap and lock into place. Locked pieces stay where they are, so you can focus on the remaining ones.

team-loyalty.intro: Team Loyalty is an arcade game where you grow an army by running your units through gates. You steer the group by swiping left and right, with your mouse on desktop or your finger on mobile.
tips: Watch the gates ahead and line up your group so you pass through the ones that add units to your army.
Keep your steering smooth and small so you can react to obstacles and stay on track.
Start by focusing on building numbers early, since a larger group gives you more strength when challenges appear.
Pay attention to how each challenge changes your group size and adjust your path before you reach it.
If your army shrinks, slow down your swipes and reposition carefully to recover your numbers.
faq: What is the goal of Team Loyalty?
The goal is to grow your army from a single unit by passing through gates, then use your strength in numbers to overcome challenges and defeat foes.
How do I control my characters?
On desktop, swipe left and right with your mouse. On mobile, swipe right and left with your finger to move the characters.

asmr-obby-slicer.intro: Slice colorful, paint-filled pinatas and robots through five-level chapters, each ending in a boss. Move around the arena, upgrade your hero, and pick up new swords between levels.
tips: Your hero attacks automatically, so spend your attention on movement. Keep moving and let the attacks land while you dodge.
Step out of the orange danger circles as soon as you see them. Staying inside one is the quickest way to lose health.
Take out healers first, before they can patch up the rest of the enemies. Leaving them alive makes every fight longer.
Approach shieldbearers from the side rather than the front, since their shields block frontal hits. Circle around them to get damage in.
Spend your coins between levels on upgrades and new swords rather than saving them. Pick a sword whose special ability suits how you like to fight.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Defeat every enemy in the arena to clear the level. A boss waits on every fifth level.
How do I move on desktop and on mobile?
On desktop, use WASD or the arrow keys. On mobile, drag anywhere on the screen to use the joystick.

tank-arena.intro: Tank Arena is a shooting action game where you pilot a super tank against high tech alien tanks in an arena. The game is played entirely with the mouse.
tips: Keep your mouse movements smooth so you can aim and reposition quickly during a fight.
Stay on the move rather than sitting still, since a stationary tank is an easy target for enemy fire.
Watch where the enemy tanks are heading and try to predict their next position before you shoot.
Use the arena layout to your advantage by staying out of open lines of fire when you can.
Pick your moments to attack instead of firing constantly, so you conserve focus for the openings that matter.
faq: What is the goal of Tank Arena?
The goal is to battle high tech alien tanks in the arena with your super tank. Stay in the fight and outmaneuver your opponents.
How do I control my tank?
Tank Arena is controlled entirely with the mouse. Use it to aim and move your tank during battles.

chicken-escape.intro: Chicken Escape is a 3D stealth puzzle set on a colorful farm. You guide a clever chicken past patrolling dogs using a cardboard box disguise, collecting golden corn to unlock the gate to freedom.
tips: Before you move, watch the glowing vision cones and note where each dog is looking. Wait for a safe window instead of walking straight into view.
Learn each dog's patrol route on the first pass through a yard. Most of the planning in this game comes from knowing where the guards will be next.
Put the box on close to a guard, but remember that staying still is what keeps the disguise working. If you need to move, step out of the cone first.
Use fences and haystacks as cover between patrols, and make your dashes during the gaps when a dog is facing away.

Collect all the golden corn grains before heading for the green beacon, since the gate stays locked until you have them. If a level's 3-star rating matters to you, plan a route that gathers the corn without extra detours.
faq: What is the main goal of each level?
Collect all the golden corn grains to unlock the gate, then run to the green beacon of freedom. Getting caught by a dog's vision cone ends your attempt.
How does the box disguise work?
Press Space or E to put the box on, and a guard will only see a harmless crate. Stay still while a dog can see you, because moving will blow your cover.

family-squid-challenge.intro: Family Squid Challenge is a two-player arcade game where you and a friend team up to run past masked enemies and collect keys to finish each level. Both players must survive to get through.
tips: Keep an eye on both characters at once, since the level only goes on while both of you are alive.
Use the WASD and Arrow keys split between you and your partner so each player has their own controls without overlap.
Jump on enemies to defeat them rather than running into them from the side, which is the safer way to clear a path.
Collect the blue and red keys as you go, and plan your route so you are not stuck far from a key when enemies close in.
Stay cautious around the black and red masked men, and run away from them when you cannot jump on them safely.
faq: What is the goal of Family Squid Challenge?
The goal is to collect the keys and complete the level. You and your friend both need to survive while you do it.
How do I move and defeat enemies?
Use the WASD keys or the Arrow keys to move. Jump on enemies to defeat them.

snake-tangle.intro: Snake Tangle is a puzzle game where you guide a snake through a tangled maze to reach its prey. Levels get harder with narrower paths and new challenges.
tips: Before each move, look at where the snake will stop, since it only travels in a straight line until it hits an obstacle or the boundary. Plan the stopping point first.
Keep the snake's current length in mind when choosing a path, because a longer snake takes up more space in narrow passages.
Avoid routes that lead into dead ends, where the snake could become trapped with no way out.
In later levels, watch for moving barriers and plan around where they will be, not where they are now.
When swipes are limited, think through the full route to the prey before making your first move so you don't waste one.
faq: How does the snake move?
The snake moves in a straight line and keeps going until it hits an obstacle or the edge of the maze. You need to choose each move with its stopping point in mind.
What makes the later levels harder?
New levels bring more complex obstacles and narrower paths, and later stages add moving barriers, time limits, and limited swipes.

stickman-clicker.intro: Stickman Clicker is a clicker game where you tap a stickman to earn money and spend it on upgrades, accessories, and achievements. The aim is to build up a fortune as quickly as you can.
tips: Keep tapping the stickman early on, since the money you earn by clicking is what pays for your first upgrades.
Check the upgrade options regularly and buy the ones that increase your earnings the most before spending on cosmetic items.
Let your empire earn while you are away, then come back and spend what has built up so you can keep buying upgrades.
Look at the achievements list now and then to see which milestones are close, and aim for them as clear goals.
Customize your stickman with the accessories you unlock once you have spare money, as they are a fun reward after strong upgrade purchases.
faq: What is the main goal in Stickman Clicker?
The goal is to help your stickman become a billionaire by earning as much money as possible through clicking, upgrades, and idle income.
How do I earn money faster?
Click the stickman to earn money, then invest in upgrades that boost your income so each purchase helps you earn more over time.

blocky-challenges.intro: Blocky Challenges is an arcade game about a red block with funny eyes who must get past a series of obstacles. You help him by building blocks underneath him so he can rise high enough to clear each one.
tips: Look at how high each obstacle is before you click, so you can judge how many blocks the hero needs.
Build only the number of blocks you need for the current obstacle, since the goal is to reach the required height and move on.
Click or tap with steady, measured presses rather than rapid bursts, so you can see how each block changes his height.
If you get stuck, pause and reassess the height of the next bump, since even a small obstacle can be hard to clear without the right amount of blocks.
Use the friends mentioned in the game's story if you can call them, as they are there to help the hero when he needs it.
faq: What is the goal of Blocky Challenges?
Your goal is to help the red block with funny eyes get past the obstacles on his journey by building blocks under him to reach the height he needs.
How do I control the hero?
You play with a mouse click or a tap. Each click forms a block under the hero to raise him.

helifight.intro: Helifight is a two-player pixel arcade battle where each player flies a helicopter and tries to hit the other with rockets. The first player to score five hits wins.
tips: Keep an eye on the air for rocket symbols, since collecting them is how you get the rockets you need to fire at your opponent.
Do not waste shots by firing when your helicopter is not lined up with the enemy, because you only have a limited supply to reach five hits.
Watch your opponent's movement and fire when they are likely to fly into your line of fire rather than chasing them directly.
Pick up rockets when they are safe to reach, but do not fly into open danger just to grab one if your opponent is positioned to fire at you.
Track how many hits each of you has so you know when to play aggressively near the finish and when to stay cautious.
faq: What is the goal of Helifight?
The goal is to hit the enemy helicopter with rocket fire five times before your friend does. The first player to five shots wins the game.
How do I get rockets to fire?
Collect the rocket symbols that appear in the air. Each one lets you fire at the opposing helicopter.

battledudes-io.intro: BattleDudes.io is a multiplayer 2D shooter with a destructible map. You fight other players and teams across several maps and game modes, unlocking weapons as you earn XP.
tips: Switch weapons early in a match to find one that suits how you like to fight, since the game offers over 20 to unlock.
Use the mouse wheel or number keys 1 to 4 to change weapons quickly rather than stopping to find the right one.
Reload with R during a quiet moment instead of in the middle of a firefight, so you are not caught with an empty weapon.
Keep an eye on the destructible terrain, because walls and cover can be broken and may open new lines of fire for enemies.
Try different map and game mode combinations to learn which layouts you handle best, then play those more often to build XP steadily.
faq: How do I win a match in BattleDudes.io?
The goal is to fight other teams and players for victory. Your results depend on the game mode you choose, so check the mode before you start.
How do I unlock new weapons?
Weapons unlock as you play and gain XP points. Playing more matches is the way to reach new weapons.

traffic-jam-escape-car-puzzle.intro: Traffic Jam Escape: Car Puzzle is a 3D puzzle where you plan your moves to get cars out of crowded roads without collisions. Each move matters, so think before you tap.
tips: Before tapping, scan the whole jam and find which car is blocking the most others. Moving that one first often opens up the most options.
Look for cars that can exit the road with a single move, and clear those early to free up space for the rest.
Avoid moving a car into a spot where it will later trap another car. Try to picture the path ahead before you commit.
If you get stuck, step back and check which cars you have not moved yet. A different order can solve a jam that looked impossible.
Keep your taps deliberate rather than rushed. The game rewards planning, so slowing down usually saves time overall.
faq: What is the goal of Traffic Jam Escape?
Your aim is to clear the traffic so every car can escape the jammed roads without hitting other cars.
How do I control the cars?
The game is played by tapping. Tap the cars to move them through the roads.

dress-up-anime-girl.intro: Dress Up Anime Girl is a styling game where you build an anime princess from outfits, hairstyles, and makeup. You can then save a screenshot of your character to use as your avatar.
tips: Pick a base look first, such as a hairstyle, then add outfits and makeup around it so the pieces match instead of clashing.
Try the random button to get ideas, then keep the parts you like and change the rest.
Look through the unusual items on purpose, since they are easy to skip but can give your princess a more unique style.
Check your character from the full view before you take a screenshot, because the screenshot is what becomes your avatar.
Look for the cute cats in the scene and try a few different outfit combinations to see how the look changes around them.
faq: What is the goal of Dress Up Anime Girl?
The goal is to create your own anime princess by combining outfits, hairstyles, and makeup. There is no score or win condition mentioned in the instructions.
How do I use my character as an avatar?
Use the screenshot button to capture your finished princess, and the screenshot can then be used as your avatar.

block-team-deathmatch.intro: Block Team Deathmatch is a first-person shooter built from pixel blocks, with a 4v4 team mode, an individual mode, and a sniper mode. You aim and fire with mouse clicks or taps.
tips: Start with Team Mode, as the description suggests, since it is the recommended way to earn better equipment before trying the other modes.
If you are new to shooters, an auto-rifle is a good choice because it lets you fight at any distance.
Shoot first. Fire as soon as an enemy is in your sights rather than waiting, since the game rewards quick reactions.
Keep calm during fights. Stay steady and aim before you click instead of firing wildly.
Move on to Individual Mode or Sniper Mode once your rank levels up, so you can test your skills in a different style of play.
faq: What is the goal of Block Team Deathmatch?
The game is a first-person shooter where you fight opponents in pixel block scenes. You can choose between 4v4 Team Mode, Individual Mode, and Sniper Mode.
How do I control my character?
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps. Click to shoot and use the on-screen controls to move and aim as the game shows.

paint-quest-kiddo.intro: Paint Quest Kiddo is a relaxing coloring game where you pick colors and fill in black-and-white pictures of cars, animals, and other cartoon scenes. You control it with the mouse.
tips: Choose a small set of colors you like before you start, so your picture ends up with a consistent look.
Work on one area at a time and finish it before moving on, which keeps the page from looking messy.
Try mixing bright and soft shades on different parts of a picture, such as bright wheels on a car and pale sky behind it.
Start with the large background areas and then add small details like faces or wheels, so you do not paint over them by accident.
Take breaks between pictures and compare how you colored each one to see which combinations you enjoy most.
faq: How do I play Paint Quest Kiddo?
Use your mouse to pick a color and click on the areas of the black-and-white drawing you want to fill in. There is no set goal, so you can color as you like.
Is there a score or a way to win?
The description does not mention scoring or winning. The game is focused on creative coloring rather than competition.

mag-roller.intro: Mag Roller is an arcade ball game where you steer a magnetic sphere that gathers cubes into orbit around it. Roll through chaotic levels, crush obstacles, and clear each stage.
tips: Move steadily rather than constantly changing direction, so cubes you collect stay in orbit around the sphere.
Pick up cubes early in a level, since a bigger block armor gives you more to work with when you hit obstacles.
Look ahead for obstacles you can crush and plan your path so you hit them with your armor rather than avoiding them entirely.
Pay attention to how the layout of each level funnels you, and use those openings to keep your momentum up.
If a level feels chaotic, slow down for a moment to see where the nearby cubes are before pushing ahead.
faq: What is the goal of Mag Roller?
Your goal is to clear every stage by rolling through each level, crushing obstacles, and using the magnetic force of your sphere along the way.
How do I control the sphere?
Use the WASD keys or the arrow keys to move Mag-Roller around the level.

african-cheetah-hunting-simulator.intro: In this cheetah hunting game, you play as a cheetah on an African savanna, hunting zebras across many levels. Each level asks for a specific number of animals to hunt.
tips: Check the target number at the start of each level so you know exactly how many animals you need to hunt before you move on.
Use WASD to get close to a zebra before you commit to an attack, since a rushed approach gives the zebra more time to escape.
Keep an eye on large animals such as rhinoceroses and steer clear of them, because they are described as dangerous.
Use the on-screen run, jump, and attack buttons in short, deliberate bursts rather than holding them, so you can react to what happens around you.
Use the trees and tall grass of the savanna to plan your route, moving in a way that keeps your target in view until you reach it.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Each level has a specific number of animals you need to hunt, and completing that count is how you finish the level.
How do I move and attack the cheetah?
Use the WASD keys to move the cheetah. The on-screen buttons let you run, jump, and attack.

draw-tattoo.intro: Draw Tattoo is a relaxed hypercasual drawing game where you aim a needle to fill in shapes and watch your artwork turn into tattoos. It rewards steady, careful work.
tips: Move slowly and steadily, since precision matters more than speed when you fill in a shape.
Work through one section at a time instead of jumping around, so you can keep track of which areas are already filled.
Before you start filling, look at the whole shape and plan your path so you do not have to backtrack over the same lines.
Take short breaks if your aim starts to slip. Relaxed hands tend to produce cleaner lines.
Pay extra attention to edges and corners, where small aiming mistakes are easiest to make.
faq: What is the main goal of Draw Tattoo?
Your goal is to point and aim the needle to fill in the shapes, turning your artwork into a finished tattoo.
Does speed matter in Draw Tattoo?
The game focuses on precision, so it is better to take your time and aim carefully than to rush through the shapes.

santa-stunt-racer-christmas-delivery.intro: Santa Stunt Racer: Christmas Delivery is a snowy driving game where you steer Santa's car over ramps and obstacles, collect gifts, and bring them to the kids at the finish line. Speed and clean driving both affect your delivery score.
tips: Look ahead along the track before each jump so you can line up your car for the landing instead of reacting at the last moment.
Take the gifts placed along the ramps when it is safe to do so, since collecting them is part of completing the delivery.
Slow down slightly before tight or obstacle-heavy sections, then build speed again on straighter parts, because the score rewards both speed and clean driving.
Use short, controlled key presses with WASD or the arrow keys on rough sections rather than holding a direction, which can help you avoid spinning out.
Try different unlocked Santa vehicles on earlier tracks to see how their speed and handling feel, then pick the one that suits the harder levels.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Reach the finish line while collecting the Christmas gifts placed along the ramps, then deliver them to the kids waiting for Santa.
How is my score decided?
The faster and cleaner you complete the track, the better your delivery score, so aim for both speed and controlled driving.

supercar-stunts-2023.intro: SuperCar Stunts 2023 is a ramp stunt racing game where you choose a car and drive over big ramps. You steer with WASD, or use the on-screen buttons on mobile.
tips: Try a few different cars from the range before settling on one, since each vehicle handles differently on ramp jumps.
Before a jump, slow down or line up your car straight on the ramp so you land with better control.
Keep your inputs gentle while in the air, because sudden steering can send your car off balance when you come down.
If you are playing on mobile, get comfortable with the on-screen buttons first so you can react quickly during a stunt.
Watch how your car lands after each jump and adjust your speed next time, rather than repeating the same run.
faq: How do I drive the car?
Use the W, A, S and D keys to drive. On mobile, use the buttons shown in the game.
How do I unlock Mega Ramp Car?
According to the game's description, Mega Ramp Car can only be played through Big Ramp Car, so you need to access it that way.

moto-traffic-rider.intro: Moto Traffic Rider is a first-person motorbike racer where you weave through busy highways and city streets. Build speed, steer carefully, and use your earnings to unlock faster bikes.
tips: Hold the throttle to build speed, but release it early when a dense group of cars is ahead so you have room to react.
Use the brakes before tight bends and in heavy traffic rather than after you have already entered them.
Save nitro for open stretches of road where you can use the burst without running into a stream of cars.
Overtaking cars closely pays extra points and money, so aim for close passes only when you still have full control of the bike.
Lean gently and early when changing lanes; small, smooth movements keep you upright better than sharp steering.
faq: What is the goal of Moto Traffic Rider?
You ride through highways and city streets, complete missions, and earn money to unlock new motorcycles as you move through the career mode.
How do I steer the motorcycle?
Lean the bike left or right to steer, avoid traffic, and take corners smoothly.

scale-kid-run-and-jump-up.intro: Scale Kid Run And Jump Up is an endless run where you guide Scale Man through obstacles and puzzles. Use his size adjustment power to fit through tight spaces and keep moving.
tips: Look ahead before each obstacle so you can decide early whether to jump, walk around, or change size.
Use size adjustment when a gap or passage looks too narrow, rather than rushing forward and getting stuck.
Save shields for dangerous obstacles you cannot avoid, and don't spend them on small hazards you could dodge.
Grab speed boosts when the path ahead is clear, since moving faster can make it harder to react to sudden obstacles.
When you reach a puzzle, slow down and work out which size change solves it before you commit to a move.
faq: What is the goal of Scale Kid Run And Jump Up?
The goal is to keep Scale Man running through an endless course of obstacles and puzzles. Each challenge needs precision, agility, and quick thinking to get past.
How do I move and jump?
Use the W, A, S, and D keys to walk and the SPACE bar to jump. Move the mouse to look around and click as needed during play.

monsters-wheels-special.intro: Monsters' Wheels Special is a physics racing game where you drive big trucks over hills, precipices and obstacles. Races and demolition derby rounds let you ram rivals while you earn money to upgrade your vehicle.
tips: Use the balance keys in the air after a jump so your truck lands nose-first or level instead of tipping over.
Save nitro for the straights or for a short burst to get over a steep hill, rather than spending it all at the start.
Ease off the gas briefly on steep downhill sections to keep the truck from flipping as you hit the bottom.
Spend money on engine power and durability first if you struggle to finish races, since a stronger truck survives more crashes.
In demolition derby rounds, ram opponents from the side or rear when they are slowed down by terrain, which is safer for your truck.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Finish races ahead of strong opponents and win demolition derby rounds by ramming and crushing rivals. Earning money along the way lets you unlock new cars.
How do I control the truck?
Use the up arrow for gas and the down arrow for brake. Use the left and right arrows to balance the truck, and press Space for nitro.

slow-time-ninja.intro: Slow Time Ninja is a stealth action game where you throw your weapon at enemies while time moves slowly. Plan each throw carefully, because the mission ends once every enemy is defeated.
tips: Use the slow-time window before you swipe. Study where each enemy stands and which path your weapon will take before you release it.
Remember that time returns to normal the moment you throw. Only commit to a swipe once you are sure of the target and the route.
Do not judge enemies by their appearance. Some may be faster, stronger, or craftier than they look, so watch how each one moves before you act.
Look at the surroundings for chances to use the environment. Objects in the level can help you reach enemies while you stay hidden.
Keep a stealthy approach by avoiding unnecessary risks. Clear the foes that are easiest to reach first, then plan the harder ones with the time you have.
faq: What is the goal of Slow Time Ninja?
The goal is to defeat all enemies on the battlefield. The mission ends once every enemy has been defeated.
How do I attack enemies?
Swipe to throw your weapon at an enemy. Time slows down while you hold the weapon, and it returns to normal speed once you throw it.

warlock-king-castle-defense.intro: Warlock King is a tower defense game where you protect your castle from waves of enemies. You can destroy foes one at a time or use spells to take out large groups at once.
tips: Swipe enemies one by one when only a few are approaching, so you save spells for bigger groups.
Save your spells for crowds of enemies, where a single cast can clear many targets at once.
Build towers early so your castle has defense in place before the stronger waves arrive.
Spend upgrades on the spells you use most often, so your strongest tool gets better over time.
Before casting a spell, pick the spot where enemies are bunched together to get the most value from it.
faq: How do I damage an enemy?
Swipe across an enemy to cause damage to it. You can also use this to clear single targets as they approach.
How do I use a spell?
Click the ability you want first, then click the place on the screen where you want to apply it.

hide-the-monster-choose-pose.intro: Help cute monsters hide from an invisible enemy by matching each one to the right hiding pose. Each level gets harder and the time limit gets shorter.
tips: Before you move anything, compare the monster's shape with the shape of the cover. A pose that looks close may not fit the gap.
Click the monster to cycle through its poses one at a time, so you can check each option against the cover before dragging.
Keep an eye on the timer from the start. It shows how long until the monster becomes dangerous, so don't spend too long on one pose.
Work through the easier-looking monsters first to build up a rhythm, since later levels shorten the time you have.
If you get stuck, step back and look at the whole crowd of shelters and shapes. Spotting the matching outline is often faster than testing poses one by one.
faq: How do I save a monster?
Click the monster to change its pose, then drag the shape onto the matching cover shape. Once the pose matches, the monster is saved.
What happens when the timer runs out?
The timer shows how long it will take for the monster to become dangerous. Finish matching the pose before that time runs out to keep the monster safe.

relaxing-games-30-in-1.intro: Relaxing Games: 30 in 1 is a collection of 30 calm mini-games for short breaks or long trips. Pick any game to start, and there is no scoring to worry about.
tips: Try a few different games from the collection to find the style you enjoy most, since each one plays differently.
If a level feels frustrating or stops being fun, skip it and move on to another game instead of pushing through.
Use it for short breaks by choosing a quick game you can pick up and put down at any time.
Since there are no points or ratings, focus on how relaxed you feel rather than trying to beat your previous result.
Read the simple rules at the start of a game before you play, as they are usually enough to get going without any training.
faq: Is there a score or goal to reach?
No, the collection has no ratings or points. Each mini-game is simply meant to be played for relaxation and enjoyment.
How do I get started?
After the game loads, choose one of the 30 mini-games from the list to begin playing.

pig-bros-adventure.intro: Pig Bros Adventure is a 2D adventure where two pig brothers explore the countryside and collect gems. Work through the terrain together and gather as many gems as you can.
tips: Use jumps with care. Pause before each jump to check your landing spot so you don't lose progress or miss a gem.
Collect gems as you go instead of rushing ahead. Scanning the area ahead helps you spot gems that are easy to miss.
If you are playing with a friend, decide early who goes first and who follows. Taking turns to move through tricky spots keeps you both safe.
Keep your movement steady rather than tapping randomly. Short, controlled moves are easier to correct than long jumps you cannot stop.
Watch the position of your partner on screen. Waiting for them at ledges helps you both reach the same areas.
faq: What is the goal of Pig Bros Adventure?
The goal is to explore the countryside with the pig brothers and collect the gems you find along the way.
How many players can play at once?
The game supports 2 players, and the instructions list controls for three player slots: P1, P2, and P3.

hungry-snail.intro: Hungry Snail is a logic puzzle where you help a cute snail get home. Rearrange ground tiles to build a safe path, dodge obstacles, and gather stars along the way.
tips: Before you move anything, look at the whole level and trace a route from the snail to its home. Planning the full path first saves wasted moves.
Pay attention to where the stars are and try to collect them on the way, not as an afterthought. Some stars may only be reachable if you shape the path around them.
Watch the obstacles closely and think about where the snail will be after each tile change. Check that the path you build does not lead it into trouble.
Experiment in your head before clicking. Work out the order of your tile moves so you do not have to undo many steps.
Expect later levels to be harder. Use the same approach each time: study the layout, plan a route, then carry it out one step at a time.
faq: How do I control the snail?
You play with the mouse. Use it to move the ground tiles and build a path that guides the snail home.
What is the goal of each level?
Get the hungry snail safely home while avoiding obstacles. Collecting as many stars as you can along the way is part of the challenge.

cosmic-dash.intro: Cosmic Dash is an endless space runner where you dodge debris, collect tokens, and smash asteroids while travelling as far as you can. This guide covers the controls and habits that help you go further.
tips: Watch the obstacles ahead and decide early whether to jump, shrink, or boost, rather than reacting at the last moment.
Save SHRINK for tight gaps and space junk that you cannot clear by jumping, so you are ready when a narrow passage appears.
Use BOOST only when a glowing asteroid is directly in your path, since it is the tool for clearing the way.
Position yourself with LEFT and RIGHT before a cluster of tokens so you can line up and collect them efficiently.
Aim for big tokens, because they pull in the smaller ones around them and can build up your score quickly.
faq: What is the goal of Cosmic Dash?
Your aim is to travel as far as possible across the solar system while collecting tokens and avoiding or destroying obstacles. The further you go, the more challenging and rewarding it becomes.
How do I jump, shrink, and boost on a keyboard?
Press UP to jump, DOWN to shrink through tight gaps, and SPACE to boost and smash asteroids. Use LEFT and RIGHT to change your position.

dop-puzzle-erase-master.intro: Dop Puzzle Erase Master is a one-player brain puzzle where you use an eraser on a picture to reveal a hidden object or scene. Each level asks you to decide what to erase to move on.
tips: Look at the whole picture before you erase anything, and note which parts seem out of place or overlap with others.
Think about the final goal of the level first, such as the hidden object, then work backward to decide which part to remove.
Erase in small steps when you can, so you can see how each change affects the picture before committing to the next one.
If you get stuck, try erasing a different area instead of repeating the same move, since the solution often comes from a new angle.
Take a short break when a level feels confusing, then return with fresh eyes to spot what you missed.
faq: What is the main goal of each level?
You use the eraser to remove part of the picture so that a hidden object or scene becomes visible. You must do this to pass the level.
How do I control the game?
Use mouse clicks or taps to erase parts of the picture. There are no other controls mentioned.

zombie-incursion-world.intro: Zombie Incursion World is a first-person shooter where you fight zombies as a survivor and an elite sniper hunter. Your goal is to stop the zombie apocalypse and save the frontier.
tips: Use the L key to lock or unlock the cursor when you need to control your aim more steadily.
Save the G key bomb throw for groups of zombies, since one well-placed bomb can cover more targets than single shots.
Crouch with the C key when you are under fire or lining up a long shot, which can make you a smaller target.
Keep moving with WASD or the arrow keys between shots so zombies have a harder time closing in on you.
Jump with Space to get past obstacles or change your position quickly during a fight.
faq: What is the main goal of Zombie Incursion World?
Your goal is to stop the zombie apocalypse by fighting off the monster zombies on the battlefield. The game describes this as a lethal battlefield war with one target.
How do I shoot in this game?
Press the left mouse button to fire your weapon. Aim with your mouse and keep the cursor locked when you need steady control.

yummy-hotdog.intro: Yummy Hotdog is a cooking game where you build a hotdog from scratch, starting with gathering ingredients and mixing the batter, then finishing with sauce and toppings. Click or tap items, tools, and buttons to make each step.
tips: Gather every ingredient and material before you start mixing, so you do not have to stop partway through the batter.
Work through the steps in order: prepare the batter first, then handle the hotdog, then add sauce, then toppings.
Check each topping choice before you apply it, since sauce and toppings change the final look and flavor of the hotdog.
Use a light hand with garnishes so the sauce and toppings support the hotdog rather than covering it up.
Once you finish a hotdog, look back at what you did to unlock achievements, and try a different topping combination on your next attempt.
faq: What is the goal of Yummy Hotdog?
The goal is to make a hotdog from scratch, from gathering ingredients and mixing the batter to garnishing it with sauce and toppings. Finishing a perfect hotdog also unlocks the game's achievements.
How do I control the game on a computer?
Click items, tools, and buttons with your mouse to interact with the kitchen and make each choice.

fruit-mahjong.intro: Fruit Mahjong is a timed mahjong solitaire played on a rotating 3D board of fruit tiles. Clear all the pairs on each level to add time to your clock and build a scoring combo.
tips: Before picking a tile, rotate the board to check its left, right, front and back sides, since tiles boxed in on both sides of an axis cannot be taken yet.
Look for matches on the far side of the stack, because the pair you need may be hidden from the default view.
Keep your picks quick and steady, since the next pair must land within about two seconds to keep the combo alive and scores climb with each pair in the chain.
Save your hint for a moment when you are truly stuck, and use shuffle only when the remaining tiles offer no open pairs.
Watch the clock closely on later levels, because each cleared board adds only 10 seconds to a run that started with 6:00.
faq: How do I know which tiles I can pick?

A tile can be taken only if it has a clear side, meaning nothing blocks it on the left or right, or on the front or back. Tiles hemmed in on both sides of either pair are locked until you clear the tiles around them.
What happens if I pick two tiles that do not match?
Both tiles wobble and stay in place, and your combo is broken, which resets the multiplier.

sausage-life.intro: Sausage Life is an arcade parkour and survival game where you guide a sausage through obstacle-filled stages and try to be the last one standing. Drag your mouse to move and unlock new looks as you play.
tips: Watch the layout of each stage before you commit to a path, so you can spot obstacles early.
Make small, steady mouse drags rather than large sweeping ones, which makes it easier to stay in control.
Focus on surviving each stage first, since progress in the game comes from getting through levels.
Keep an eye on the money you collect, because it can be spent on skins, hats, and weapons for your character.
Turn on the music if you enjoy atmosphere, but know that the game is playable without sound.
faq: What is the goal of Sausage Life?
You play as a sausage and must overcome obstacles on different stages to be the last sausage standing and win.
How do I move my sausage?
Drag your mouse to move, and use the mouse to navigate through the game.

ragdoll-duel-2p.intro: Ragdoll Duel is a funny shooting duel for one or two players. Time your shots carefully to take down your opponent.
tips: Wait for a clean moment before you fire, since timing matters more than shooting fast.
In 1 Player mode, collect coins so you can raise your health bar and weapon power.
Spend your early coins on the upgrade that fits your style, whether that is staying alive longer or hitting harder.
In 2 Player mode, use the W key for Player 1 and the UP ARROW key for Player 2, and keep an eye on each other's position.
If you play solo, try the mouse controls to see which feels more precise for lining up your shots.
faq: What is the goal of Ragdoll Duel?
The goal is to shoot down your opponent in a duel. You win by timing your shots well.
How do I earn upgrades?
You earn coins in 1 Player mode, and you can use them to increase your health bar and weapon power.

where-is-my-cat-the-adventure.intro: Where is My Cat: The Adventure is a relaxed hidden object puzzle set across five worlds. Search each scene for hidden cats and missing items, and take your time.
tips: Scan each screen in sections, moving from one corner to the next, so you do not miss cats tucked at the edges.
Slide the game screen to check areas beyond the current view, since some hiding spots may be off screen.
Look behind and under larger objects, such as sandcastles on the beach, where cats often blend in.
Use the inventory as a checklist: when you find an item, drag it from the inventory onto the scene only when it is needed for a puzzle.
There are no timers or penalties, so pause and zoom in on suspicious shapes instead of rushing through a level.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Your goal is to find the hidden cats and missing items within the scene. Each level is a hidden object puzzle set in one of the five worlds.
How do I select and move items?
Tap or click an item on the game screen to select it. To move an item from the inventory to the game screen, drag or slide it into place.

bike-rivals.intro: Bike Rivals is a racing game where you weave through traffic, overtake opponents and push toward the finish. Hold to speed up, steer to dodge, and use your coins to improve your bike.
tips: Ease off the throttle a moment before a crowded stretch so you have room to steer around cars and obstacles.
Release acceleration briefly when you need to line up a gap, rather than steering hard at full speed.
Overtake opponents on open lanes where you can keep your speed, instead of squeezing between vehicles.
Spend the coins you earn on upgrades for the bike you use most, since that's the one you'll race with most often.
Plan your steering early: small, steady movements keep you more stable than sharp swerves at the last second.
faq: How do I accelerate and steer?
Hold the screen or left mouse button to accelerate and drag left or right to steer. On keyboard, hold Space or Enter and use A/D or the arrow keys.
How do I slow down?
Release the accelerate input to slow down. Slowing down is useful for dodging traffic and keeping control through tight spots.

moto-3d-racing-challenge.intro: Moto 3D Racing Challenge is a 3D motorbike stunt racing game where you race along a track, collect gold coins, and aim for a better rank to earn more.
tips: Use slide to keep your bike in a clear line so you can see the track ahead and grab coins without swerving.
Tap to speed up on straight stretches, then ease off before sharp turns so you do not lose control.
Try stunt taps when the bike is in the air, since a well-timed stunt can help you keep momentum for the next section.
Plan your route to pass over the gold coins where you can, because collecting them is a direct way to increase your earnings.
Focus on a steady, clean race rather than rushing, since a better rank is what gives you the chance to win more coins.
faq: What is the main goal of Moto 3D Racing Challenge?
The goal is to race on the track, collect gold coins, and finish with a better rank to win more coins.
How do I control the bike?
Tap to speed up or perform stunt actions, and slide to move the bike.

tower-platformer-3d.intro: Tower Platformer 3D is a 3D platform game where you climb a large ruined tower standing in the middle of the sea. You jump between platforms, avoid monsters, and collect coins on the way up.
tips: Look at the next platform before you jump so you can judge the distance and land safely.
Pay attention to where monsters move and time your jumps to pass them when they are not in your path.
Grab coins when they are close to your route, but do not risk a fall just to reach them.
Remember where each portal checkpoint is, since reaching one keeps your progress as you climb higher.
Take short, controlled jumps when you are unsure, because a single bad landing can send you back down the tower.
faq: What is the goal of Tower Platformer 3D?
The goal is to climb the huge ruined tower by jumping across platforms, avoiding monsters, and reaching the top as you progress.
How do I control the character?
You play with mouse clicks or taps, which is the only control listed for this game.

dop-fun-delete-one-part.intro: DOP Fun: Delete One Part is a puzzle game where you study a picture, spot the hidden problem, and erase the one part that solves it. Solutions often need logic, creativity, or a sense of humor.
tips: Look at the whole picture before you touch anything, and ask yourself what seems out of place.
Try to name the problem in one sentence first, such as what looks wrong or unusual, so you know what you are searching for.
Pay attention to small details like shadows, objects, or labels, since the wrong part is often something easy to overlook.
Drag slowly and in small strokes over the part you suspect, so you can see what lies behind it before erasing more.
If an obvious answer does not work, consider a playful or unexpected explanation, because many solutions depend on humor.
faq: What is the goal of DOP Fun: Delete One Part?
Your goal is to find the hidden problem in each picture and erase just the correct part to solve it.
How do I erase part of the drawing?
Touch or click the screen and drag your finger or cursor over the area you want to erase to reveal what is behind it.

crazy-breakout-mobile.intro: Crazy Breakout Mobile is an updated mobile version of the earlier Crazy Breakout. It uses simple touch controls that take some practice to master, and the aim is to beat the high score and make the list.
tips: Use the touch or mouse control gently and steadily, since small, controlled movements are easier to manage than fast, jerky ones.
Spend your first few rounds just learning how the ball responds to your input before you try to push for a high score.
Keep an eye on where the ball is heading next rather than reacting only when it is close to you.
Stay calm after a missed ball. Short, focused runs usually lead to better results than rushing back in angry.
Try to beat your own previous score one step at a time, which makes progress toward the high score list easier to track.
faq: How do I control the paddle in Crazy Breakout Mobile?
You control the game with touch or a mouse. Move your finger or cursor to guide the paddle and keep the ball in play.
What is the goal of Crazy Breakout Mobile?
The goal is to score as high as you can and beat the high score to get onto the list.

plugjoy.intro: PlugJoy is a colorful cable puzzle where you drag cables along tricky paths to join every plug to its matching socket before the timer runs out. It rewards careful planning and includes hints when you get stuck.
tips: Before you drag anything, trace each cable from its plug to its socket and look for the paths that other cables could block.
Connect the cables that have the fewest possible routes first, so you do not run out of space for the harder ones later.
Watch the clock, but do not rush your first move; a short pause to plan usually saves time overall.
If a level stalls, use a hint to see the next step rather than guessing, then try the rest of the puzzle on your own.
Try the daily challenge to practice planning on fresh puzzles, and use the coins you earn to unlock avatars as a reward for progress.
faq: What is the goal of PlugJoy?
Drag each colorful cable along its path so every plug connects to its matching socket before time runs out.
How do the controls work?
You drag cables with simple mouse or touch controls, and the same drag action works on both mobile and desktop.

tennis-hero.intro: Tennis Hero is a one-button sports game where you pick a hero and face three opponents in a tennis event. Your goal is to earn a Gold Medal against every opponent.
tips: Watch the ball closely and wait for it to reach the right moment before you swing, since timing decides how well each shot lands.
When serving, release the power bar before it reaches the top, because overpowering the serve can make it go out.
Pay attention to how each opponent returns the ball so you can anticipate where your next shot needs to go.
Keep your timing steady across rallies instead of rushing every swing, which tends to cause missed returns.
If you lose a point, reset your focus on the next serve rather than repeating the same swing pattern.
faq: What is the goal of Tennis Hero?
Win a Gold Medal across all three opponents in the Tennis event by playing well against each one.
How do I control my player?
Tap, click, or use the cursor keys to swing at the ball. The game uses one button, so all the skill is in timing.

brain-find-can-you-find-it-2.intro: Brain Find: Can You Find It 2 is a puzzle game where you look for a target item by thinking in unexpected ways. Levels reward creative, lateral thinking more than speed alone.
tips: Read the whole screen before you click. The target item is often hidden in something that looks like background or decoration.
If a level seems stuck, try reverse thinking: ask what the goal item could be hiding inside, behind, or disguised as.
Try the obvious objects first, then move to odd ones. Many levels pass through a surprising choice rather than a hard search.
Keep a short mental note of what you have already tried so you do not repeat the same click over and over.
