Take a short break when you are stuck. Coming back with fresh eyes often shows the answer you missed.
faq: How do you play Brain Find: Can You Find It 2?
Use mouse clicks or taps to interact with the screen and find the final target item in each level. Think about the scene in unusual ways rather than searching only for the obvious.
What is the main goal of each level?
Your goal is to locate the final target item. The game encourages reverse thinking and creative solutions to get there.

woof-foow.intro: Woof Foow is an idle merge game where you combine pups to unlock new dog breeds and grow your pack. Progress comes from merging, and rewards keep building while you are away.
tips: Look for matching numbers on your dogs before you drag, since only dogs with the same number can merge.
Merge whenever a match appears so your pack keeps evolving instead of filling up with unmatched dogs.
Hold the Space Bar when you want dogs to generate faster, and ease off when you need time to plan your merges.
Check your rewards after returning to the game, since they collect even while you are offline.
Pay attention to which breeds you have unlocked, because each new evolution makes your pack stronger.
faq: How do I merge dogs in Woof Foow?
Drag one dog onto another dog that has the same number. Merging is how you evolve your pups and unlock new breeds.
How can I make new dogs appear faster?
Press the Space Bar to speed up dog generation. You can use it whenever you want to build your pack more quickly.

spooky-vending-machine-2.intro: Spooky Vending Machine 2 is a Halloween puzzle game where you pick a treat, enter its code, and pay to collect it. You can explore different machines filled with monster toys, candy, and creepy snacks.
tips: Browse the shelves before you start typing so you know which item you want and its code.
Check the code on the keypad before you press ENTER, since you need to confirm your choice.
Look at the displayed price first, then click or tap the coins that match it.
Try the different machines to see the full range of items on offer.
Remember to click or tap the pickup hatch after paying, or your item will not be collected.
faq: What is the goal of Spooky Vending Machine 2?
The goal is to collect Halloween treats by finding each item, entering its code, and paying the displayed price. Your items are collected from the pickup hatch.
How do I control the game?
Use your mouse or touchscreen. Click or tap the keypad to enter a code, press ENTER, click or tap the coins to pay, and then click or tap the pickup hatch.

zombie-parade-defense-2.intro: Zombie Parade Defense 2 is a shooting and tower defense game for 1 to 3 players. Zombies grow stronger each wave, and your job is to keep them away from the building until you survive 10 waves.
tips: Spend your early waves learning how the zombies approach, so you can place turret towers and mines where they will pass first.
Keep an eye on the building as well as the zombies, since the goal is to stop them from reaching it.
Save your shield for the waves where zombies are hitting hardest rather than using it at the start.
Switch guns when the zombie type in front of you changes, so your current weapon is not wasted on enemies it handles poorly.
In a 2 or 3 player game, split roles, with one player covering the front line and another handling defenses near the building.
faq: How do I win Zombie Parade Defense 2?
You win by surviving a total of 10 waves while keeping the zombies away from the building.
How many players can play at once?
The game can be played by 1 player or by 2 to 3 players, with each player using their own set of controls.

war-robots-battle-mech-arena.intro: Pilot powerful robots through challenging arenas in this arcade battle game. Mix strategy with fast, high-speed action across its Qualifying and Boss modes.
tips: Start with Qualifying to learn how the arenas and robots respond before you take on tougher challenges.
Pause to read the arena layout before committing to a move, since the strategy side of the game rewards planning over rushing.
Balance quick reactions with patience: when the action speeds up, avoid chasing targets and keep your focus on your next move.
Treat each battle as a learning round and note which approaches work in different arenas so you can repeat them.
Save your fastest play for moments when you have a clear opening, and slow down when the odds look uncertain.
faq: What is the goal of War Robots Battle: Mech Arena?
You pilot powerful robots and fight in challenging arenas. The game combines strategy with high-speed action in each battle.
What controls do I use to play?
You play with a mouse click or by tapping the screen. Clicking or tapping is the only input listed for this game.

mergemma.intro: MergeMMA is a merge and idle fighting game where you combine matching boxers to create stronger fighters. Build your gym, grow your earnings, and take on tougher opponents in animated battles.
tips: Merge fighters as soon as you have two of the same level, since stronger boxers are the main way to get ready for harder battles.
Spend your earnings on gym upgrades for speed and income early, so your money grows faster while you keep merging.
Check your team's strength before each battle and merge up any weak fighters you can, rather than waiting until a fight is already hard.
Keep an eye on the next opponent's power and aim to have a stronger team before you challenge them.
Because the game is idle, check back regularly to collect earnings and buy new fighters while your gym keeps working.
faq: What is the main goal of MergeMMA?
Your goal is to merge boxers into stronger fighters, improve your gym, and build a team strong enough to win each battle. Winning battles unlocks stronger boxers.
How do I merge two boxers?
Drag one boxer onto another boxer of the same level. On desktop use the mouse, and on mobile drag with one finger.

bubble-foxy.intro: Bubble Foxy is a colorful bubble shooter where you guide a fox through magical worlds. Match bubbles of the same color, rescue animals, and clear each level.
tips: Drag to aim and check the angle before you release, since every shot should be planned rather than rushed.
Look for bounce shots off the walls when a bubble is hard to reach directly.
Aim for matches of three or more in a single shot, and try to set up shots that cause chain reactions for bigger combos.
Save your boosters for tricky spots, where a single shot is not enough to clear the board.
Before shooting, scan the board for the color you have most of and for bubbles that hold up others, so you clear the right ones first.
faq: What is the main goal of Bubble Foxy?
Clear every level by matching three or more bubbles of the same color, rescuing the cute animals, and completing each level's objective. Finishing levels unlocks new magical worlds.
How do I aim and shoot the bubbles?
Drag your finger across the screen to aim, then release to shoot the bubble. The controls are one-touch and easy to learn.

pin-rescue.intro: Pin Rescue is an arcade game where you help a trapped friend escape a dangerous room. You must avoid hazards such as dangerous animals and hidden devices while working toward the exit.
tips: Watch the room carefully before you act, since animals and hidden devices can appear in places that are easy to miss.
Take your time with each move rather than rushing, because a single mistake can end the attempt.
Keep your attention on the path to your friend, so you always know which route leads toward the escape.
Play in short, calm sessions and reset your focus after each escape to avoid careless errors.
Start the game by tapping to play, then pause mentally between moves to plan your next step.
faq: What is the goal of Pin Rescue?
The goal is to help your trapped friend escape from the dangerous room without getting hurt. You need to reach your friend and get both of you out.
What should I avoid in Pin Rescue?
Avoid dangerous animals and hidden devices, since touching them will hurt you. Staying clear of these hazards is the key to surviving each room.

makeover-mayhem.intro: Makeover Mayhem is a head-to-head cleaning race against a rival. You clear five grimy items stage by stage, aiming to finish before your opponent or before the 4-minute timer ends.
tips: Work with the tool you have in the order it unlocks: scraper, foam spray, scrub brush, then squeegee. Each stage builds on the last, so keep moving forward.
Stop once the grime is mostly gone. A stage finishes on its own at about 90% clean, so you do not need to chase every last speck.
Choose a steady drag pattern and cover the whole item evenly rather than scrubbing one small area. This helps you reach the 90% mark faster.
Keep an eye on your rival's progress and the timer. If time may run out, focus on finishing as many items as you can, since a timeout is decided by items finished or overall progress.
Plan your pace across all five items instead of spending most of your time on one. Finishing items steadily gives you a clearer path to beating your rival.
faq: What is the goal of Makeover Mayhem?
Clean all five items, which are the rug, sneaker, trophy, teapot, and watch, before your rival does. Each item must be cleaned through all four stages.
How do I move on to the next stage?
Clear about 90% of the grime on the current item and the stage finishes automatically. The next tool then unlocks for that item.

sushi-bros.intro: Sushi Bros is a physics puzzle where you guide little sushi pieces safely onto customers' plates through obstacles. Each run tests how well you time your input and read the path ahead.
tips: Watch the whole path before your first click or tap so you know where the obstacles sit.
Make small, deliberate inputs instead of rapid clicking, since physics makes the sushi's movement hard to undo.
If a run goes wrong, restart quickly and try the same section again while paying attention to where you lost control.
Pay attention to how the sushi bounces and slides, and plan your next move around that momentum.
Stay calm under pressure; the challenge comes from difficult circumstances, so steady timing usually beats speed.
faq: What is the goal of Sushi Bros?
Guide the sushi safely through obstacles so it lands on the plates of the happy customers at the hibachi.
How do I control the sushi?
Use mouse clicks or taps to play; the game is controlled entirely by clicking or tapping.

logo-quiz-master.intro: Logo Quiz Master tests how well you recognize famous brands, companies, and symbols. Pick the right logo from the options to clear each level.
tips: Look at the shape, colors, and any letters first, since those details often point straight to the brand.
If you are unsure, compare the remaining options by checking which one matches the logo's overall style and layout.
Try to notice which categories you find easiest and which you find hardest, so you know where to focus your attention.
Take a moment to think before tapping, because the level is won only when you select the correct logo.
Recall the company's name or industry out loud or in your head, which can help you link a symbol to the right brand.
faq: What is the goal of Logo Quiz Master?
Your goal is to guess the correct logo from the options shown in each level. Completing all levels lets you become the logo quiz master.
How do I select an answer?
Use your mouse or finger to click or tap the logo you think is correct. Choosing the right one wins the level.

gears-of-war-platformer.intro: Gears Of War Platformer is a side-scrolling action game where you fight through five devastated districts using a Lancer, a shotgun, grenades and active reloads. Mouse clicks or taps control the action.
tips: Use the shotgun at close range, where its damage is most useful, and switch to the Lancer when enemies are farther away.
Save grenades for groups of enemies or spots where you cannot easily reach them with bullets.
Practice active reloads early so the timing feels natural before the fights get harder.
Keep moving between cover and platforms instead of standing still, since staying in one place makes you an easy target.
Learn the layout of each district as you progress so you can plan your route and find your footing faster.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
You fight through five devastated districts, defeating enemies as you move across each one.
How do I play?
Click or tap with your mouse to play. The instructions do not list any other controls.

noob-saves-the-village.intro: Noob Saves the Village is an adventure game where monsters attack your village and you fight back with your own combat skills. Move with the keyboard and attack with the left mouse button.
tips: Keep moving rather than standing still, since staying in one spot makes it easier for enemies to surround you.
Watch how each enemy approaches before you commit to an attack, so you can time your strikes better.
Pick your fights carefully when several monsters are close together, and deal with one at a time when you can.
Stay near the village as you play so you always know where the threats are coming from.
If you are struggling, step back for a moment to reset your position instead of rushing in with low health.
faq: What is the goal of Noob Saves the Village?
Your goal is to defeat the dangerous monsters that have attacked the village and protect the people living there.
How do I move and attack on a computer?
Move around using the keyboard, and attack by pressing the left mouse button.

fun-with-flags-ultimate-quiz-game.intro: Fun With Flags is a flag quiz where each level shows one country flag and four answer options, with only one correct choice. Your job is to identify the country and move on to new levels.
tips: Look at the overall layout first: stripes, colors, and central symbols are often the fastest clues to narrow down the country.
Eliminate options you are certain are wrong before choosing, so you are weighing only two or three possibilities.
Save the Hint button for flags you truly cannot place, since it is there to help when you are stuck rather than as a first step.
Note which flags you miss and review them again later, since working through the levels in order builds up familiarity with flags from each continent.
Take your time on each question instead of rushing, because a wrong answer can slow your progress through the levels.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Each level shows a country flag, and you need to pick the correct country from four options. Answering correctly keeps you moving through the levels.
How do I unlock new levels?
Keep answering correctly to unlock new levels. The game is built around mastering flags from every continent.

pop-puzzle.intro: Pop Puzzle is a block matching puzzle game with colorful visuals. Tap groups of same-colored blocks to clear the screen and move through levels that get harder as you go.
tips: Scan the whole screen before you tap anything, so you can see which colors are spread out and which are already grouped together.
Look for blocks of one color that sit close to each other, and plan which group to clear first so you do not leave a single block of a color stranded.
Work out a few moves ahead on harder levels, since the challenge comes from spotting patterns rather than from speed.
If a level stalls, check for colors that have only one block left, because a lone block cannot be matched and will block your goal of clearing everything.
Take your time on each level. The gameplay is simple, so most of the difficulty comes from careful thinking about the order of your taps.
faq: What is the goal of Pop Puzzle?
Your goal is to clear all the blocks on the screen to finish each level.
How do I make blocks pop?
Tap a group of two or more blocks that share the same color, and the group will pop.

motorcycle-stunts-drive.intro: Motorcycle Stunts Drive is a 3D stunt racing game where you ride a superbike against rivals, tackling ramps and tricks on the way to the top rider spot. Use WASD to drive and C to change the camera.
tips: Watch the track ahead for ramps and stunt setups so you can plan your approach before you reach them.
You don't need to stay in high gear the whole time. Ease off before tricks that call for extra care.
Keep checking on your competitors, since they will try to pass you during the race.
Try the different modes, not just multiplayer, because playing them is how you unlock more superbikes.
Use the C key to switch camera views and pick the one that gives you the clearest look at the road and jumps.
faq: How do I win a race?
Finish ahead of your competitors and earn the top bike rider honors. Staying in control of your bike while watching rivals is key.
How do I unlock new superbikes?
Try the variety of modes in the game. Playing them is how you unlock the superbikes.

poppytile.intro: PoppyTile mixes match-3 and mahjong puzzles across a village map. Tap sets of three identical tiles to clear the board, and follow Poppy through levels that grow harder.
tips: Before you tap, check which tiles are underneath others. Tapping a covered tile releases the tiles beneath it, so clearing blockers opens up more choices.
Pick matches that free up the most tiles rather than the first set you spot. This keeps your options open later in the level.
Save the Cancel the last action booster for a wrong pick. It is most useful right after a mistake, before you build on it.
Use the Use an idea booster when you are stuck instead of guessing. It helps you find a path forward without making random picks.
Try Mix tiles on the board when the layout no longer offers matches. Shuffling can open up new combinations for the rest of the level.
faq: How do I complete a level?
Clear the whole board by matching three identical tiles at a time. Each match removes those tiles and releases any tiles underneath them.
What do the boosters do?
Add an extra slot gives you more room to hold tiles, Cancel the last action undoes your previous move, Mix tiles on the board rearranges the tiles, and Use an idea helps when you are stuck.

max-the-secret-of-grandpa-s-letter.intro: Max: The Secret of Grandpa's Letter is a treasure hunt where a young wolf follows his late grandfather's riddles and clues to find a hidden treasure. This guide covers how to move, look around, and keep your quest on track.
tips: Read the letter, map, and notebook clues carefully before moving on, since each one points toward the next task.
Complete the tasks in the order the instructions suggest, because the treasure can only be reached by following the trail step by step.
Use the right mouse button to rotate the camera and the mouse wheel to adjust the camera distance so you can spot paths and objects around Max.
Use the jump key when a gap, ledge, or obstacle blocks your way, and look ahead before jumping so you land where you intend.
Take a moment to explore each area fully, since small details can help you solve the riddles and find what you need.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
The goal is to find your grandfather's treasure. You do this by completing tasks and following the instructions given along the way.
How do I move Max and jump?
Use the A, S, W, and D keys to move, and press the space bar to jump. On a phone, use the mobile joystick instead.

cat-escape.intro: Cat Escape is a 3D casual arcade game where a cat has to get out of a stranger's home without being spotted by the security guards searching the rooms. You control the cat by dragging.
tips: Watch where the security guards are searching before you move, and plan your route around their line of sight.
Move in short, deliberate drags rather than long ones, so you can stop quickly if a guard turns toward you.
Treat the room decoration as cover: keep to spots that block the guards' view of the cat.
Do not rush. The guards are the main threat, so a slow, careful escape usually works better than a fast one.
If you get spotted, reset your plan and look for a new path out instead of repeating the same route.
faq: What is the goal of Cat Escape?
The goal is to get the cat out of the bad person's home without letting the security guards see it.
How do I control the cat?
You drag on the screen to move the cat around the room.

crazy-sheep.intro: Crazy Sheep is a puzzle-platformer where you help a clumsy sheep reach the other side by building a bridge from objects. Physics and careful placement decide whether each crossing works.
tips: Look at the gap and the sheep's path before you build, so you can plan the whole bridge rather than adding pieces at random.
Keep the surface as level as you can, since the sheep cannot cross even small bumps in the bridge.
Take your time with each placement and avoid rushing, because the challenge rewards patience.
If the bridge collapses or stops working, study exactly where it failed and change that part instead of starting over from scratch.
Stay relaxed between attempts; short breaks help you spot uneven spots you might have missed.
faq: What is the goal of Crazy Sheep?
Your goal is to help the clumsy sheep get to the other side by building a bridge from the objects you have.
Why does the sheep keep failing to cross?
Any unevenness in the bridge stops the sheep from passing, so even a small bump can cause a failed attempt.

formula-1-driver.intro: Formula 1 Driver is a racing game where you customize a car and steer it to first place. You compete against AI cars across 30 levels.
tips: Use the arrow keys with small, steady inputs so the car stays under control instead of sliding off the track.
Ease off before sharp bends and accelerate again once the car is pointed out of the corner.
Watch the AI cars around you and pick a moment to pass when there is clear space ahead.
Pay attention to how your car handles after each customization, and keep the setup that gives you the most control.
If you fall behind early, focus on a clean lap rather than risky moves, since mistakes cost more time than they gain.
faq: What is the goal of Formula 1 Driver?
Your goal is to control your customized car and reach first place against the AI cars. Finishing all 30 levels is the main challenge.
How do I control the car?
Use the arrow keys to steer and drive the car. Smooth inputs usually work better than sudden direction changes.

garage-boss.intro: Garage Boss is an idle tycoon where you start with one repair bay and expand into a garage, supermarket, and gas station. Your staff keep earning while you tap cars, collect money, and buy upgrades.
tips: Tap cars to repair them early on, since active work is the fastest way to build the cash you need for your first upgrades.
Walk up to workers regularly to collect their earnings so money does not sit idle and you can spend it on the next step.
Check the phone menu after each batch of earnings and prioritise hiring staff or upgrades that grow the business you can afford.
Spread your spending across the garage, supermarket, and gas station rather than pouring everything into one area, since they all sit in the same connected world.
Use WASD on desktop or the on-screen joystick on touch screens to move quickly between workers, cars, and the phone menu.
faq: What is the main goal of Garage Boss?
Grow your single repair bay into a full garage, supermarket, and gas station by hiring workers and buying upgrades. Your mini empire keeps running while you play.
How do I earn money in Garage Boss?
Tap cars to repair them and walk up to workers to collect their earnings. Staff also generate income on their own over time.

stickman-team-return.intro: Stickman Team Return is a two-player action shooter where three stick figures team up to stop a gang of robbers threatening Detroit. Each playable character has its own weapons and abilities.
tips: Try all three characters early to learn which weapon and special ability suits your style before committing to one.
Use the special move on a button press only when enemies are clustered, so its effect hits as many targets as possible.
Keep moving rather than standing still, since staying in one spot makes it easier for enemies to surround you.
If you are playing with a friend, agree on who covers which area so you do not both chase the same enemy.
Switch characters when the one you are using is struggling against a particular group, because each one is built for a different role.
faq: What is the goal of Stickman Team Return?
You play as one of three stick figures working together to stop a gang of robbers threatening Detroit by shooting enemy stickmen.
How do I use the special ability?
Player 1 presses E and Player 2 presses K to use the special move of the character they are controlling.

tankcraft-war-tank-battles.intro: TankCraft - War Tank Battles lets you design your own war machine and lead it into battle. Here are some habits to help you get more out of each run.
tips: Start by looking at how your tank is put together before you head into a battle, since the design is the core of the game.
Try a few different designs rather than settling on the first one, so you can see how each build handles the fights.
Keep your clicks or taps steady and deliberate, because every action you make with the mouse or touchscreen controls your tank.
Watch how your tank responds after each change and note which parts of the design suit your style of play.
Experiment between battles to learn what works, and treat each fight as a chance to test a new idea.
faq: What is the goal of TankCraft - War Tank Battles?
You design your own powerful war tank and lead it into battles as a tank crafter and commander. The game focuses on building and commanding your machine.
How do I control the tank?
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps. Use single, controlled clicks or taps to interact with the game.

sneaky-fits.intro: Sneaky Fits is a one-player puzzle game where you match your character's pose to wall cut-outs while guards patrol with flashlights. You must fit into each gap before the light sweeps over you.
tips: Study the shape of the wall cut-out before you start moving, so you know which body parts need to bend or stretch.
Click to change the character's position, then use short adjustments rather than large changes to stay in control.
Hold click to drag the character when a large move is needed, and release once the body lines up with the opening.
Watch the guard's flashlight path and plan your pose so you are already in place before the beam reaches you.
Keep your reactions quick on each level, since the timing of the sweep is what makes the later levels hard.
faq: What is the goal of Sneaky Fits?
Your goal is to strike a pose that fits inside the wall cut-out and stay hidden before the patrolling guard's flashlight sweeps over your character.
How do I move my character?
Click to change the character's position, and hold click to drag the character into place.

beep-out.intro: BEEP OUT is a single-player puzzle about untangling a colorful toy-town traffic jam. Send each car along its roof arrow, match vehicles with passengers, and manage limited parking across 30 levels.
tips: Before you tap anything, scan the whole board and find which car is blocking the most others. Clearing that one first often opens several lanes at once.
Check where each car's roof arrow points before moving it. A car that looks free may still have a blocked path ahead.
Watch the parking spaces closely. Filling them too early can leave no room for a car that needs to park later.
Think about passenger matches before you move. Sending a car to the wrong spot can make it harder to pair the right vehicle with its passenger.
Use Undo freely to test an order of moves, and save Hint for when you have truly run out of ideas. Restart is there if a level gets too tangled.
faq: How do I move a car in BEEP OUT?
Click or tap a vehicle to send it along the direction of its roof arrow. On a keyboard, use the arrow keys to select a car and press Enter to send it.
What should I do when I get stuck?
You can press Undo to take back your last move, use Hint for a suggestion, or press Restart to begin the level again.

ball-attack.intro: Ball Attack is an arcade shooter where you slide your cannon left and right to fire at waves of numbered balls. Survive as long as you can while the waves get tougher.
tips: Keep your cannon moving so you can line up shots and stay clear of balls at the same time. Standing still makes it easy to get trapped.
Pay attention to the numbers on the balls and focus fire on the ones that will reach zero soonest. Clearing smaller targets quickly keeps the screen from filling up.
Since the cannon fires on its own, spend most of your attention on positioning. Watch where the balls and obstacles are heading before you move.
Spend coins with a plan. Decide whether firepower, speed, or a special ability will help you most, and stick with that choice for a run.
Expect the difficulty to climb with each wave. Stay calm early on and build a habit of checking the edges of the screen for incoming threats.
faq: What is the goal of Ball Attack?
The goal is to survive as long as possible. You blast through waves of bouncing balls and avoid touching them, because contact ends the game.
How do I control the cannon?
Slide your finger or mouse left and right to move the cannon. It fires continuously, so your main job is aiming through movement and dodging.

pizza-delivery-drive-and-deliver-hot.intro: Pizza Delivery: Drive and Deliver Hot puts you on a scooter as a city delivery rider. You pick up packages, follow routes through busy streets, and deliver them before time runs out.
tips: Keep an eye on both the timer and your fuel from the start, since the game asks you to manage both on every mission.
Once you collect the package and place it in the storage box, check the route to the destination before you pull away.
Use the brake before tight turns and busy intersections so you keep control of the scooter and avoid losing time.
Deliver quickly, because faster deliveries earn more coins for unlocking scooters and buying upgrades.
Spend coins on upgrades that suit how you ride, and try a new scooter when you can afford one to see how it handles.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Complete pickup and drop-off missions on your scooter by delivering each package to the customer before time runs out.
How do I move the scooter on desktop?
Use W to accelerate or move forward, S to reverse, and A or D to steer. Press Space to brake and use the mouse to move the camera.

drifty-master.intro: Drifty Master is a 3D roadster racing game about drifting through tracks of different difficulty across 200 levels. Upgrade your car and unlock new ones as you go.
tips: Use short, steady steering inputs with A/D or the arrow keys instead of holding one direction, so the car stays controlled through each turn.
Spend time on the early levels to learn how your car responds before you move on to harder tracks and difficulties.
Pay attention to which tracks give you the most trouble, and focus your practice on the turns where you keep losing control.
Upgrade your current car when you feel it limits your driving, and try newly unlocked cars to see which handles better for your style.
On mobile, tap the buttons in small, controlled bursts rather than rapidly, which helps you hold a line through corners.
faq: What is the goal of Drifty Master?
You race through different tracks and difficulties across 200 levels, aiming to drive well and progress through the game.
How do I steer the car?
On PC, use the A and D keys or the arrow keys. On mobile, tap the on-screen buttons.

buddy-and-friends-hill-climb.intro: Buddy and Friends Hill Climb is a racing game where you drive a jeep up a series of hills. Use WASD to steer your way up the track and stay in control on every climb.
tips: Learn the WASD keys with a short practice run before you aim for a difficult stretch, so your inputs feel automatic.
Ease off and make small adjustments on steep slopes, since pressing too hard can make the jeep hard to control.
Use the jump tag as a cue to watch the landing: plan your next move before you leave the ground.
Keep an eye on what is ahead on the track so you can react early rather than correcting at the last second.
If a run goes badly, restart and focus on one section at a time instead of trying to finish the whole course on the first attempt.
faq: What is the goal of Buddy and Friends Hill Climb?
The goal is to take on the hills and get through the track as a driver. The description focuses on climbing and making it to the top of each challenge.
How do I control the jeep?
Use the W, A, S and D keys to move the jeep around the track.

sprinter-heroes.intro: Sprinter Heroes is a 3D running race where you compete in a worldwide tournament across seven continents. You can race alone against other runners or team up with a friend in two-player mode.
tips: Alternate your inputs steadily between the left and right arrows and the A and D keys, rather than tapping one side over and over. Keeping a smooth rhythm is the core of running in this game.
Try to keep a consistent pace from the start instead of sprinting hard at the beginning and running out of speed later.
Each new level gets harder, so use the earlier races to practice your rhythm and get comfortable with the controls.
If you play with a friend, use the race against them to test different rhythms and see which one keeps you moving fastest.
Save your best effort for the final race, which is described as the toughest, and avoid burning out in the races before it.
faq: How do I run in Sprinter Heroes?
Tap the left and right arrow keys and the A and D keys by turns. Alternating between them is what makes your runner move forward.
Can I play Sprinter Heroes with a friend?
Yes. The game supports two players, and you can race both against your friend and against other runners.

hexa-sort-3d.intro: Hexa Sort 3D is a puzzle game about sorting, stacking and merging hexagonal tiles. Each level asks you to match and combine tiles with clear, logical moves.
tips: Study the whole board before your first click, so you can spot which tiles can be matched or merged right away.
Plan two or three moves ahead instead of reacting to each tile, since a quick move can block a better merge later.
Keep your sorted groups tidy and close together so that new tiles have an obvious place to go.
Take a short break when you feel stuck, then look at the board again with fresh eyes.
Pay attention to how levels progress, since later stages usually need more planning than the early ones.
faq: What is the goal of Hexa Sort 3D?
You sort, stack and merge hexagonal tiles to solve each level's puzzle. The game describes it as a test of clever puzzle-solving and logical moves.
How do I control the game?
Click with a mouse or tap the screen to make your selections. There are no other controls mentioned in the instructions.

shoot-your-nightmare-double-trouble.intro: Shoot Your Nightmare - Double Trouble is a first-person horror shooter where you explore dark locations and fight enemies to wake up. Each area brings new threats, so careful movement and smart weapon use matter.
tips: Use the right mouse button to aim before firing at distant enemies, which helps you hit more shots.
Scroll the mouse wheel to switch weapons based on the situation, so you are not stuck with a weapon that does not suit the threat.
Save grenades with G for groups of enemies or tight spots, rather than spending them on single targets.
Reload with R during quiet moments rather than in the middle of a fight, so you are not caught with an empty gun.
Crouch with Left CTRL or go prone with X when you need to slow down and steady your aim, and use melee with V to save ammo on close enemies.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
You must explore the woods, city block and sewers and defeat two nightmares to wake up. A bonus level is also included.
Which keys should I use to move and look around?
Use W, A, S and D to walk and the mouse to look around. Left Shift lets you run, and Space lets you jump.

word-chef.intro: Word Chef is a word puzzle where you connect letters to form valid words hidden in a scramble. It has six difficulty levels and more than 500 levels to work through.
tips: Start by spotting short words first, then look for longer ones that build on the letters you have already found.
Scan the grid for common endings like -ing, -ed, or -er, since these often combine with letters nearby.
Drag across letters in a steady, straight line so you do not accidentally pick up a neighboring letter.
Take a short break when you get stuck and come back with fresh eyes, as new letter patterns often jump out.
Move up a difficulty only when you can comfortably find most words, because later levels use harder or longer words.
faq: What is the goal of Word Chef?
Your goal is to find all the valid words hidden in the letter scramble to complete each level.
How do I form a word?
Click and hold the left mouse button, then drag across letters in sequence. If the word is valid, it is accepted and added to your list and score.

sheepdoku.intro: Sheepdoku is a logic puzzle where you place one sheep in each colored area of the board. Sheep must keep their own space, so every placement limits where the next one can go.
tips: Start with regions that have the fewest open cells, since they leave you the least room to make a mistake.
Remember that sheep cannot share a row or column, so once a sheep is placed, cross off that entire row and column in your head.
Check the eight squares around each sheep, including diagonals, because those cells are off limits for other sheep.
When a row or column has only one possible spot left for a sheep in a region, place it there and update the board.
Take a moment to scan the whole board before each move, and avoid guessing, since a wrong placement can make the rest of the puzzle harder to fix.
faq: What is the goal of Sheepdoku?
Place exactly one sheep in every colored area of the board without breaking any rules. The board is complete when every area has a correctly placed sheep.
Where are sheep not allowed to be placed?
Sheep cannot share a row or a column with another sheep, and they cannot touch each other, even diagonally.

mordecai-and-rigby-easter-holiday.intro: Mordecai and Rigby Easter Holiday is a two-player 2D adventure. Players collect Easter eggs, reach the door, and work through 10 chapters together.
tips: Split the work between both players, with one focusing on nearby eggs while the other keeps an eye on the door's location.
Collect the Easter eggs before heading to the door, since reaching the door is the step that moves you forward.
Check the whole route in each chapter before rushing ahead, so you know where the eggs are and how to reach the door.
Finish one chapter at a time rather than rushing through, so the layout and jumps become familiar before the next one.
Agree on a plan with your partner before each jump, so you do not move in different directions and lose track of each other.
faq: What is the goal of each chapter?
Collect the special Easter eggs in the chapter, then reach the door and jump through it to complete the chapter.
How many chapters are there, and how do I control my character?
There are 10 chapters to complete. Player one uses the WASD keys and player two uses the arrow keys, with R and O also listed in the instructions.

poligon-war-zombie-apocalypse.intro: Poligon War Zombie Apocalypse is a shooting action game set in a blocky, pixel-style world. You move with WASD, aim and shoot with the mouse, and clear each level of enemies to get through the apocalypse.
tips: Keep moving with WASD instead of standing still, since zombies will close in on you if you stay in one spot.
Use the mouse to aim before you fire, and release the trigger in short bursts so your shots stay on target.
Save your grenade on G for groups of enemies or for moments when you are surrounded, rather than using it on a single target.
Check the in-game controls screen early, because the description only lists the basic keys and the rest are shown in the game.
Clear each level fully before moving on, since you need to knock out all enemies to finish it.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Your mission is to knock out all enemies and finish all levels to win the apocalypse.
Which keys control the player?
WASD moves your character, the mouse looks around and shoots, and G throws a grenade.

click-kitty-idle.intro: Click Kitty Idle is a fast cat clicker where you have 32 seconds to earn coins, spend them on cat food, and climb the leaderboard. Speed and timing matter as much as raw clicks.
tips: Spend your early coins on upgrades that raise your Click Value, since every click then earns more for the rest of the round.
Keep an eye on the food prices. Each purchase costs more than the last, so buying a little at a time may not be the best use of coins.
Save your boosters, Auto Click, Time Extension, and Massive Click Power, for the moments when they will help most rather than using them the instant you get them.
Watch the clock as the 32 seconds run down. Make sure your last purchases happen before time runs out.
Play several rounds to learn which food and upgrade order gives you the best coin total, then aim to beat your own high score on the leaderboard.
faq: What is the goal of Click Kitty Idle?
You have 32 seconds to earn coins by clicking, then use those coins to buy cat food before time runs out. Your score comes from how well you use that time.
How do I play with the mouse?
Use the left mouse button to interact with the in-game buttons and upgrades. Clicking on your kitty earns the coins you need for food and upgrades.

chain-cube-2048-3d-merge-game.intro: Chain Cube 2048 is a merging puzzle where you combine number cubes to build bigger values. Each cube you fail to merge bounces away, so careful placement matters from the start.
tips: Look for matching number cubes before every click or tap, and make sure they can meet each other before you commit to a move.
Avoid placing a cube where it blocks a future merge, since cubes that fail to combine will bounce off and clutter the board.
Work toward one main area for your largest numbers instead of spreading them out, which keeps the rest of the board flexible.
Take a short pause to check which merges are possible on each turn, because rushing is the most common reason puzzles go wrong.
Keep the bigger goal in mind, since the game rewards patience and steady planning more than fast clicking.
faq: What is the goal of Chain Cube 2048?
The goal is to merge number cubes together to create larger values and keep building toward higher numbers like 2048.
What happens when two cubes do not merge?
If you fail to merge the cube number blocks, they bounce off each other, so you need to plan where each block lands.

checkmate.intro: Checkmate is a chess-style puzzle where you play Black and must trap the White king. Each of its 500 maps has its own setup, so you start by reading the board before you move.
tips: Read the setup before your first move, since each of the 500 maps can need a different approach.
Remember that Black moves from bottom to top, so plan your pawn advances in that direction.
Check whether a Black king is on the board, because that changes how much you need to protect your own position.
Look for moves that restrict the White king's escape squares, as a checkmate is often built one limited square at a time.
Try a few maps from different starting positions to learn patterns, then use them on harder boards and the 24 achievements.
faq: What is my goal in Checkmate?
You play as Black and must checkmate the White king, meaning it is under attack and cannot escape.
Do the normal chess rules still apply?
Yes, standard chess rules apply, with the exceptions that you are Black, the Black king may or may not be present, and Black moves upward while White moves downward.

easter-funny-makeup.intro: Easter Funny Makeup is a dress-up style game where you decorate a character's face with spring symbols. Pick your favorite designs, mix them together, and save your finished artwork as a PNG.
tips: Start by picking one main symbol, such as bunnies or Easter eggs, and build the rest of the look around it so the design feels balanced.
Mix in a few smaller accents like butterflies or flowers instead of covering the whole face, which keeps the artwork readable.
Try a rainbow or bright color-focused element for a cheerful spring feel, and balance it with simpler pieces elsewhere on the face.
Test a few combinations before settling on one, since you can mix and match symbols freely to find the look you like best.
Once you are happy with the design, check the full face before saving, so the PNG shows the artwork exactly how you want it.
faq: What is the goal of Easter Funny Makeup?
The goal is to create a bright, festive Easter face design using the decorations provided. There is no set target; you decide when your artwork is finished.
Which decorations can I use?
You can use Easter eggs, bunnies, flowers, butterflies, and rainbows, and you can mix and match them to make a unique design.

save-her-tour.intro: Save Her Tour is a puzzle game where each level presents a scenario that you solve with clever thinking. Mistakes can lead to a bad outcome for the heroine, so careful choices matter.
tips: Read the whole scene before acting. Look for every object and detail, since the answer often comes from something small in the setup.
Test one idea at a time. If an action goes wrong, note what happened so you do not repeat the same mistake on the next attempt.
Think about cause and effect. Ask what each action will change before you commit to it, especially when a wrong move could harm the girl.
Stay calm and patient. The description calls the game relaxing, so take your time rather than rushing through each challenge.
Use the mouse click or tap control to explore each option carefully. Small, deliberate clicks help you avoid accidental moves.
faq: What is the goal of Save Her Tour?
Your goal is to solve each level's puzzle and protect the girl from harm. Each scenario requires you to use your ingenuity to find the right solution.
What happens if I make a wrong move?
The game states that mistakes will not end well for the heroine, so a wrong choice can lead to a bad outcome. You can try the level again to find a better solution.

obby-weapon-rush.intro: Obby Weapon Rush mixes a jumping obstacle course with idle upgrades. You run, jump over obstacles, and hit targets while building up your weapons and rewards over time.
tips: Tap to jump and time it early, since the course speeds up as you move forward. Holding the click or tap makes you jump automatically, which can help when the timing gets tight.
Spend coins on weapon upgrades that raise your DPS, because stronger hits make it easier to clear targets quickly.
Check your quests regularly. Completing them is a direct way to earn extra rewards while you keep playing.
Pick perks that match how you play, and improve your rewards when you can, so each run pays off more.
Use prestige bonuses once you have progressed far enough, since they carry over and make every later run stronger.
faq: How do I jump in Obby Weapon Rush?
Click or tap to jump. Hold the click or tap to jump automatically. Use the mouse or touch to interact with menus and buttons.
How do I get stronger between runs?
Upgrade your weapons to raise DPS, collect perks, and use prestige bonuses. Each run builds on what you have unlocked before.

obby-royal-races-in-flight.intro: Obby: Royal Races in Flight is a lava racing game where you upgrade your Obby character, buy cars, and get through difficult parkour courses. Collect stars and gear up to move faster across the tracks.
tips: Collect stars as you go, since they feed the energy you need for slingshots, dynamite, and rockets.
Save your energy-based boosts for the tougher parts of a course rather than using them on easy stretches.
Hatch pets from cases and eggs whenever you can, because the description says they give you more energy.
Spend the money you earn on upgrades for your character and ranks so each run gets a little easier.
Learn the controls first: W, A, S, D to run, Space to jump, and the mouse to turn, so you can focus on the course layout.
faq: How do I move and jump in the game?
On PC, use A, W, S, and D to run, Space to jump, and the mouse to turn. On smartphones, use the joystick to run and the Up arrow to jump.
How do I get more energy?
Hatch pets from cases and eggs, which the game says will give you more energy. Collecting stars also helps you build energy for your boosts.

realistic-tanks-poopy-war.intro: Realistic Tanks Poopy War is a tank shooter where you drive a customized war machine through offline campaign stages and mazes, raining rockets on enemy armies. Upgrades, talents, and experience shape how you fight.
tips: Try different weapon and tank builds on early stages, then keep the setup that handles each set of objectives best.
Use the Tab menu to check your upgrades and talents before each battle so your build matches the mission.
Mines and crafts must be finished on every level, so track those objectives alongside the main targets rather than leaving them for last.
Use the scroll wheel to zoom the camera out when enemy swarms come from several directions, and zoom in when you need precise aim.
Spend upgrades on what helps you most in the stage you are facing, since stronger firepower makes swarms of enemy tanks easier to handle.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You must rain rockets down on an armada of opposing tanks while completing the objectives of each campaign level. Finishing mines and crafts is also required on every level.
How do I control my tank?
Use WASD to drive, move the mouse to aim, and click to fire. Scroll the mouse wheel to zoom the camera, and press Tab to open the menu.

woody-block-puzzles.intro: Woody Block Puzzles is a simple block puzzle for kids where you drag pieces onto matching slots. It is built around quick, easy-to-learn placement play.
tips: Look at the shape of each block before you pick it up, and find a spot where it fits the empty slot exactly.
Start by placing the blocks that have fewer possible spots first, so the board does not get crowded with awkward pieces.
Keep the open slots in mind as you go and avoid filling areas that would leave gaps no piece can reach.
Try to place each block with a clear purpose rather than dropping it wherever it lands, since a wrong spot can make the next move harder.
If you get stuck, pause and scan the whole board for a slot you have not checked yet.
faq: How do I move the blocks?
Use drag and drop: click and hold a block, move it over the matching slot, then release it to place it.
What is the goal of the game?
The goal is to place each block on the perfect slot, which the game describes as simple and fun to play.

zombie-mission-5.intro: Zombie Mission 5 is a shooting action game where you rescue hostages from zombies. Collect coins to buy upgrades, pick a difficulty, and defeat the boss in the final level to finish the mission. It supports two players.
tips: Spend coins on weapons and extra lives in the UPGRADES section only when you can afford a clear benefit, since coins are your only way to improve your gear.
Try Normal difficulty first to learn the levels and the zombie patterns before moving up to Hard or Extreme.
Use grenades for groups of zombies and save regular shots for single targets, so you do not waste ammo on enemies you can handle one at a time.
Use the switch weapon key often so you always have the weapon that fits the situation in front of you.
In two-player mode, agree on who covers which area and use the wall walking and jump controls to reach hostages that are hard to get to from the ground.
faq: What is the goal of Zombie Mission 5?
Your goal is to save all the hostages and complete the mission by defeating the BOSS in the last level.
How do I get new weapons and extra lives?
Collect coins during play, then open the UPGRADES section to buy new weapons and extra lives.

world-war-camp-company.intro: World War Camp Company is an idle clicker where you build up your blue troops and lead them against the red camp. Upgrade your forces between battles, then push through each location to capture the enemy flag.
tips: Send your troops with the BATTLE button as soon as you have a group ready, since allied units move out on their own to find enemies. Waiting too long before attacking can slow your progress.

Spend your gold and silver helmets on the upgrades that help most in your current fight, such as troop stats or the equipment you rely on. Check the base upgrades regularly so helmets are not left unused.
Keep your hero moving rather than standing still, because your character shoots automatically and staying in one spot can leave you exposed to incoming fire.
Prepare before each boss, which appears every few levels and is much tougher than regular enemies. Build up your army and equipment beforehand so you are not caught short at the end of a level cycle.
Clear the enemies on the level first and then head for the enemy flag, since you need to destroy all opponents before you can win the level.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You need to destroy all enemies on the level and capture the enemy flag. Clearing the enemies first makes the flag the final step.
How do I control my character?
On PC you can use WASD, the arrow keys, or hold the left mouse button and drag in the direction you want to go. Your hero shoots automatically, so you only need to focus on movement.

king-of-fishing.intro: King of Fishing is a top-down arcade game where you fire fishing nets at colorful fish, rare sea creatures, and ocean bosses. Catch fish, earn coins, and upgrade your gear to reach new ocean zones.
tips: Spend your early coins on upgrades that improve your chances of catching bigger fish, since those are where the greater rewards are.
Watch where each fish is heading before you tap, because timing and aim decide whether your net lands.
Save some coins rather than spending them all at once so you can afford the upgrades that matter most.
Pay attention to rarer fish and ocean bosses, which pay out more, and try to target them when your gear is ready.
Move on to new ocean areas as you climb the ranks, since each zone has its own species and challenges.
faq: How do I shoot my net?
Tap or click on a fish to shoot your net at it. Each successful catch earns coins.
What are coins used for?
Coins can be spent to upgrade your fishing power, which improves your chances of catching bigger and rarer sea creatures.

drawer-and-race.intro: Drawer And Race is a fast drawing game where you sketch a word or phrase against the clock. Mouse clicks or taps are all you need to draw and play.
tips: Pick the most recognizable version of your word before you start, since clarity matters as much as speed.
Use simple, bold shapes first, then add a small detail only if you have time left.
Think about the word's most famous feature, such as a key outline or shape, and draw that first.
Practice quick sketches of common everyday objects and animals to build up your speed.
Don't stop to erase too often; a clear rough drawing usually beats a neat one that arrives late.
faq: What is the goal of Drawer And Race?
You race against the clock to draw a given word or phrase clearly enough to convey it. The emphasis is on both speed and clarity.
How do I control the drawing?
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps. Use these inputs to make your sketch.

a-mimicry-of-life.intro: A Mimicry of Life is a top-down pixel puzzle game set in 2057, where a team of scientists investigates a strange asteroid at the North Pole. Use the arrow keys to move and Z or Enter to interact with people and objects.
tips: Talk to and examine everyone you meet, since the game's questions about strange behavior and missing blood are likely clues to what is happening.
Pay attention to small details in each area, because puzzles in a mystery like this often depend on noticing something that seems out of place.
Keep a mental note of what each character says and does, especially when their behavior seems odd, so you can compare it later.
Use Shift to sprint only when you are sure of where you need to go, so you can move quickly without missing important things along the way.
Press X to pause whenever you feel stuck or want to think through what you have learned before continuing.
faq: What is the main goal of A Mimicry of Life?

The game centers on finding out why some people are behaving strangely, why there is no blood, and why you cannot remember much from before the expedition. Solving these questions is the core of the puzzles.
What are the controls?
Use the arrow keys to move, Shift to sprint, Z or Enter to interact, and X to pause.

diy-joystick-game.intro: Diy Joystick is a design game where you are an artist who repaints customers' worn-out joysticks. You spray colors, add stickers, and create a new look for each one.
tips: Read each customer's style request before you start, so you know whether to follow their taste or design freely.
Pick a color scheme first and stick to it across the joystick, so the final design looks coordinated rather than random.
Try different production methods on the same joystick to see which one gives the most interesting finish.
Place stickers with a plan, keeping the main design balanced so the joystick does not look crowded.
When you design for yourself, experiment with bold color combinations, since you have a wide palette to work with.
faq: What is the goal of Diy Joystick?
Your goal is to restyle the ugly joysticks that customers bring to your shop. You do this by spraying colors, adding stickers, and choosing production methods.
Can I design joysticks however I want?
Yes. You can design a joystick to match a customer's requested style, or you can follow your own creative ideas.

ink-shop-dress-and-tattoo-games.intro: Ink Shop: Dress & Tattoo is a creative game where you design tattoos for characters and then dress them in fashionable outfits and accessories. It suits players who enjoy both art and style.
tips: Pick a theme for each character before you start, such as a bold look or a soft, delicate one, so that the tattoo and outfit choices fit together.
Work on the tattoo first, then choose clothing that does not hide your design. This helps the finished look feel complete.
Try a few different accessories on the same outfit to see which combination works best before you settle on a final look.
Take your time with intricate tattoo designs, since fine details are where your artistic work will stand out most.
Compare the trending outfit options against the character's style so each makeover feels intentional rather than random.
faq: What is the main goal of Ink Shop: Dress & Tattoo?
The goal is to create tattoo designs for characters and give each one a full makeover with outfits and accessories. You decide how the final look comes together.
Can I both tattoo and dress up the same character?
Yes. The game lets you design ink tattoos and then choose stylish outfits and accessories for the same character.

survival-rush.intro: Survival Rush is a 3D action game where you face waves of enemies on a platform. You attack, defend, and use your skills to survive and destroy them.
tips: Keep moving around the platform rather than standing still, so enemies have a harder time closing in on you.
Scan the platform often to spot where enemies are coming from before they reach you.
Decide whether to attack or defend based on how close the enemies are, rather than using skills at random.
Use your skills on the enemies that pose the biggest immediate threat first.
Take a moment to reposition between clicks or taps when a wave gets crowded, so you are not trapped in one spot.
faq: What is the goal of Survival Rush?
You survive waves of enemies on the platform by using your attack, defense, and survival skills to destroy them.
How do I control the game?
You play with mouse clicks or taps. Clicking or tapping is the only input the game lists.

knifeblades.intro: KnifeBlades is a 2D online action game where you collect knives, wrap them around yourself, and fight other players in the arena. You can switch between offensive and defensive modes to outplay your enemies.
tips: Pick up knives early so you have a larger blade ring around you before other players get strong.
Use offensive mode when an enemy is close and exposed, and switch to defensive mode when several opponents approach at once.
Watch how other players move and wait for a clear opening instead of charging straight in.
Stay near the edges of the arena only when you need space; moving into open areas can make it easier for others to surround you.
Keep track of which knives you have collected so you know when your defense is strong enough to press an attack.
faq: What is the main goal of KnifeBlades?
The goal is to defeat your enemies in the arena by collecting knives and using them around yourself to fight. Outlasting and outplaying other players is how you win.
How do offensive and defensive modes differ?

The game describes offensive and defensive modes as two ways to fight, one for attacking and one for protecting yourself. Choosing the right mode for each situation is key to defeating enemies smartly.

jenny-s-math-puzzle.intro: Jenny's Math Puzzle asks you to drag number tiles onto a grid so every equation is correct. It mixes arithmetic practice with logic, and the challenge grows gradually as you play.
tips: Check each equation both horizontally and vertically before you move on, since every row and column that forms an equation must be valid.
Start with the spots where only one tile seems to fit, then use those placements to narrow down the rest of the grid.
Remember that you win only when the whole grid is filled correctly with no mismatches, so a single wrong tile still blocks the win.
If you get stuck, drag a tile back to the pool rather than forcing it into a slot, which keeps the board easier to fix.
Pause to test a placement against the equations it affects before dropping the tile, especially as the puzzles get harder.
faq: What is the goal of Jenny's Math Puzzle?
The goal is to complete all the mathematical equations on the board by placing number tiles from the pool into the empty slots. You win once the entire grid is filled correctly.
How do I move the number tiles?
Use the mouse to drag and drop tiles into the slots. On touch screens, you can drag tiles with your finger instead.

stickboy-epic-swordsman.intro: Stickboy Epic Swordsman is an action game where you fight through challenges, defeat powerful bosses, and collect armor and swords. This guide covers the controls and how to get the most from your fights.
tips: Learn the WAD keys and the E punch key before a tough fight, so your moves feel automatic when enemies close in.
Explore the world before pushing forward, since exclusive gear and unique swords can make a real difference in combat.
Try different armor and swords to find a setup that suits your style instead of sticking with the first gear you find.
Before challenging a powerful boss, watch how it moves for a few seconds and look for openings rather than attacking nonstop.
Use the punch as a backup when you are out of position, and switch back to your sword when you have space to attack.
faq: What is the goal of Stickboy Epic Swordsman?
Your aim is to rise through the ranks by facing challenges, defeating powerful bosses, and testing your skills against others. Gathering better gear helps you progress.
How do I control my character?
Use the WAD keys on a computer to control your character, and press the E key to punch. On smartphones and tablets, use the virtual buttons on screen instead.

rings-and-dot.intro: Rings and Dot! is a color-matching puzzle played on a 3×3 grid like tic-tac-toe. Line up three matching colors to clear them, and keep going until the board fills up.
tips: Ignore ring size when you plan a line, since only the color needs to match. A small ring and a big ring of the same color count the same.
Before placing a piece, check which cells it fits. A piece only goes where its rings have room, so some cells may not take it at all.
Look for moves that set up a second line. Clearing more than one line at once multiplies your score, so a placement that completes two lines is worth more.
Keep some open cells free. The run ends when the board fills, so avoid filling the grid in a way that leaves no room for future pieces.
Save the discard or eraser tool for when you have no good moves. Using it early can waste space you might need later.
faq: What counts as a match in Rings and Dot!?
You need three pieces of the same color in a row, column, or diagonal. Ring size and whether it is the center dot do not matter.
Why can't I place a piece in some cells?
A piece only fits where its rings have room. Check the open cells against the rings on the piece before you drag or tap it onto the board.

bubble-shooter-classic-online.intro: Bubble Shooter Classic Online is a colorful puzzle game where you blast balloons and use strategy and logic to clear each board. You play with a mouse click or a tap.
tips: Before each shot, look at the whole board and pick a target that will let you clear the most balloons at once.
Plan one shot ahead by checking which colors are left and where they sit, so you know what to aim for next.
Pay attention to balloons that are hard to reach, since clearing them early can open up the rest of the board.
Take your time with each aim. A slower, more careful shot often beats a quick one that leaves a mess behind.
If a puzzle feels stuck, step back and look for a different group of balloons to work on instead of forcing the same spot.
faq: What is the goal of Bubble Shooter Classic Online?
The goal is to blast the colorful balloons on the board by using your shots and logic. Clearing them is how you solve each puzzle.
How do I control the game?
Click with your mouse or tap the screen to play. Aim and fire by using the same click or tap action.

pocket-drift.intro: Pocket Drift is a racing game built around sliding your car through turns. You pick from 5 cars and race across 5 tracks, earning points for how far and how stylishly you drift.
tips: Steer in short, deliberate taps rather than holding the key, so you can control how far the car slides through each corner.
Start drifts a little earlier than feels natural, since a longer slide through a turn gives you more distance for points.
Ease off the steering as the car straightens out, otherwise you will lose traction and spin away the speed you built.
Try each of the 5 cars on an early track before committing to one, because cars handle differently and you should find the one that slides most predictably for you.
Learn each track's corner layout before pushing for high scores, since knowing where the tight turns come lets you plan your drifts ahead of time.
faq: How do I steer my car?
Use the A and D keys or the Left and Right arrow keys to steer. Steering is the only control listed for this game.
How do you score points in Pocket Drift?
Points are earned for the distance and style of your drifts. Longer, smoother slides through turns are the main way to build a higher score.

cuddle-crane.intro: Cuddle Crane is a cozy 3D claw machine game where you steer a claw over pastel plushies, grab your favorite, and carry it to the chute. Six themed machines and 48 plushies are waiting to be collected.
tips: Watch the soft marker before you click GRAB!, since it shows where the claw will land. Move the claw until the marker sits directly over the plushie you want.
Use the eye button to swing the camera to the side when you are unsure about depth. A side view helps you judge how far forward or back the claw needs to go.
Use the arrow buttons for small adjustments once you are close. Fine moves are often more accurate than dragging over a long distance.
Keep track of the luck meter. Each miss fills it, and when it is full, the golden Lucky Claw is guaranteed to grab the plushie under it.
Match the special claw to the prize. The Hook suits keychains, the Magnet suits bell collars, and the Suction Cup suits capsules and gift boxes.
faq: What is the goal of Cuddle Crane?
Your goal is to grab plushies with the claw, carry them to the chute, and fill your album. Completing album pages unlocks new decor for your Plushie Room.
How do I control the claw?
Drag on the machine with the mouse or your finger to move the claw. Click or tap the arrows for fine moves, then click or tap GRAB! to drop it.

city-taxi-driving-simulator.intro: Drive a yellow taxi through busy city streets, follow checkpoints, and deliver passengers before time runs out. This guide covers the controls and habits that help you finish routes on time.
tips: Steer smoothly with A and D or the arrow keys. Small corrections keep your speed up better than sharp turns.
Brake early with S or Down Arrow before corners and traffic, so you don't have to stop hard and lose momentum.
Save nitro with Shift for straight stretches where you can use it without risking a crash near traffic.
Use the handbrake on Space only for tight turns, and release it quickly so you can keep accelerating.
Press C to switch camera views and pick the one that shows you upcoming traffic and checkpoints best.
faq: What is the main goal in City Taxi Driving Simulator?
Follow the checkpoints, pick up passengers, and deliver them safely before the timer expires. Completing routes also lets you unlock new driving missions.
How do I control the taxi?
Use W or Up Arrow to accelerate, S or Down Arrow to brake and reverse, and A/D or Left/Right Arrow to steer. Space is the handbrake and Shift activates nitro.

car-dealership.intro: Car Dealership is a management game where you start with a small lot, buy affordable cars, and grow your business. Your success depends on inspecting vehicles and pricing them correctly.
tips: Inspect each car carefully before you buy it, since the condition you find shapes what you can sell it for.
Compare the neighborhood's prices with the wider car market before setting a value, so you do not overprice or underprice a vehicle.
Start with affordable vehicles while your funds are limited, and save the bigger purchases for after you have built up profits.
Reinvest your earnings in two areas: adding cars to your inventory and improving your showroom.
Balance inventory and showroom upgrades so that you always have enough stock to sell while your lot keeps growing.
faq: What is the main goal of Car Dealership?
The goal is to grow a small car dealership by buying vehicles, determining their market value, and earning profits. You use those profits to expand your inventory and improve your showroom.
How do I decide what a car is worth?
Use both the neighborhood and the car market to determine a vehicle's market value. Inspect the car carefully first, because its condition is part of the value.

arcade-thief-runner.intro: Arcade Thief Runner is an endless runner where you play a thief fleeing through city streets. Jump obstacles, dodge security, and grab loot to push your score as the speed rises.
tips: Keep your attention on the upcoming obstacles and security rather than only on the loot, since a single collision ends the run.
Grab loot when it is safe to do so, because every item you collect adds to your score.
Settle into a steady rhythm early, since the speed and difficulty increase the longer you survive.
Try the WASD and space controls for digging early on so you know how they work before the game gets fast.
Use the characters, power-ups, and special abilities you unlock to test which combination suits your play style best.
faq: What is the goal of Arcade Thief Runner?
The goal is to survive as long as you can while collecting loot to raise your score. The game gets faster and harder the longer you last.
How do I play?
Use a mouse click or tap to play. Use W, A, S, D and the space bar to dig, as listed in the game's instructions.

princess-dressing-up-game.intro: Help a lovely princess choose beautiful clothes and makeup in this dress-up game for kids. Use your mouse or tap to pick each style and enjoy the happy time.
tips: Start with the outfit, since clothes set the mood for the rest of the look. Once you like the dress, pick makeup that fits its colors.
Try a few options in each category before deciding. Swapping items back and forth helps you see which combinations look best together.
Keep the colors in the princess's look coordinated, such as matching a soft dress with lighter makeup. A simple color theme often looks more polished than mixing many bright shades.
Take your time with each choice instead of rushing through. Playing slowly lets you notice small details and enjoy the process more.
If you want a different result, you can go back and change a choice before finishing. Experimenting with new styles is a good way to explore what you like.
faq: What is the goal of this game?
Your goal is to help the princess by choosing beautiful clothes and makeup for her. You get to decide how her look turns out.
How do I play?
Use your mouse or tap the screen to select the clothes and makeup you want. Click or tap on each option to try it on the princess.

funny-dentist-surgery.intro: Leah has eaten too many candies and now has several teeth problems. Your job is to treat them and then finish her smile with funny stickers.
tips: Look over each tooth before you pick a tool, so you know what the problem is before you act.
Try different items and tools on a problem to see how each one responds, rather than rushing through the first option you see.
Work through the teeth one at a time so you don't lose track of which problems you have already fixed.
Save the stickers for the end, once the treatment is complete, so you can see the full result before decorating.
Keep your clicks or taps deliberate, since each choice you apply is what moves Leah's treatment forward.
faq: What is the goal of Funny Dentist Surgery?
The goal is to fix Leah's teeth problems caused by eating lots of candy. Once her teeth are treated, you can decorate them with funny stickers.
How do I use the tools and items?
On desktop, click items, tools, and buttons to interact with them. On touch screens, tap to select a tool or item and then tap to apply it.

katana-upgrade.intro: Katana Upgrade is an arcade game about pushing your sword as high as you can go. Each upgrade is a gamble, and one failure can wipe out your progress.
tips: Decide on a target level before you start, so you know when you are happy with your progress and when to keep pushing.
Remember that a single failed upgrade can destroy your sword, so the higher your level, the more you have to lose on each click.
Play in short sessions and avoid rushing clicks, since each upgrade is a separate decision you can take your time over.
Track your results across several runs to get a feel for how often upgrades fail at different levels, and adjust how far you push based on that.
faq: What is the goal of Katana Upgrade?
The goal is to strengthen your katana by upgrading it as many times as possible and reach the highest level you can. Each successful upgrade raises the level.
What happens when an upgrade fails?
A failed upgrade can destroy your sword, which ends your progress on that katana. This is the main risk in the game.

traffic-craft-rider.intro: Traffic Craft Rider is a 3D motorbike racer where you weave through blocky city traffic, collect coins, and try to go as far as you can. Your score grows the farther you ride.
tips: Watch two or three vehicles ahead rather than only the one directly in front, so you can plan your lane change early.
Make small, steady left and right moves instead of sharp swerves, which can push you into the next vehicle.
Grab coins when it is safe to do so, but never swerve into a risky lane just to pick one up.
Spend coins on the upgrade that addresses your weakness: speed if you are too slow to get past traffic, handling if you struggle to dodge, or power if you lose ground after crashes.
Keep your runs short at first to learn traffic patterns, then push for longer runs once you can react consistently.
faq: What is the main goal of Traffic Craft Rider?
Survive as long as possible while riding through traffic, since the farther you ride, the higher your score. Try to beat your best distance.
How do I control the motorcycle?
Move left and right to dodge cars, trucks, and other bikes on the road.

spartan-fruits.intro: Spartan Fruits is an arcade platformer where you guide a Spartan fruit through obstacles, opening chests for coins and collecting gems. Use the sword to hang and swing your way forward.
tips: Look for chests as you move through each area, since they hold the coins that unlock rewards.
Get comfortable with hanging and swinging early, because the sword lets you reach areas that jumping alone may not.
Use the hang controls to go up and down while swinging so you can line up your next jump before letting go.
Pick up gems whenever you can, since they are needed to unlock new types of fruit.
Use a quick tap of G for attacks and hold G when you want to throw the sword forward at a distance.
faq: What is the goal of Spartan Fruits?
Overcome obstacles, find chests with coins to unlock rewards, and advance to the next stages. Collecting gems also unlocks new types of fruit.
How do I move and jump?
Use A and D or the Left and Right arrow keys to move, and W or the Up arrow key to jump.

emilys-hotel-solitaire.intro: Emily's Hotel Solitaire is a tropical-themed solitaire puzzle. Each win moves Emily closer to building her grandfather's dream hotel. Click or tap to play.
tips: Scan the whole board before your first move so you can spot which cards are blocked and which ones open up new options.
Prioritize moves that reveal hidden cards, since uncovering more of the board gives you more choices.
Do not rush. The game is described as challenging, so think a step ahead before committing to a move.
If you get stuck, step back and look for a different order of moves rather than repeating the same approach.
Play in short sessions and take breaks, so you can come back with a fresh look at the layout.
faq: What is the goal of Emilys Hotel Solitaire?
The goal is to win games of Solitaire. Every victory brings Emily closer to building the best hotel in the world.
How do I play?
Use a mouse click or a tap to make your moves. The instructions say the game is played entirely with clicks or taps.

brain-challenge.intro: Brain Challenge is a puzzle game with 250 levels that rewards out-of-the-box thinking. Each level asks you to find an unexpected answer using click and drag-and-drop controls.
tips: Read each level fully before you move anything, since the clue may point to an answer that is not the obvious one.
If you are stuck, try a different approach instead of repeating the same move, because many levels reward a fresh angle.
Test one idea at a time so you can tell which action caused a result and avoid confusing yourself with many changes at once.
Take a short break after a hard level and come back with fresh eyes, as a new perspective often makes the answer clearer.
Play the levels in order, since the early puzzles build the kind of lateral thinking the later ones expect.
faq: What is the goal of Brain Challenge?
Your goal is to solve each of the 250 puzzle levels by finding the answer the level is asking for. The puzzles are built around thinking outside the box.
How do I control the puzzles?
