You play by clicking, dragging, and dropping items on the screen. Use these actions to try out your answer for each level.

obby-vs-noob-driver.intro: Obby vs Noob Driver is a two-player car race where you and a friend share one car on a rough, obstacle-filled track. You steer the red car with WASD and the blue car with the arrow keys, and you must reach the finish line together.
tips: Agree on a plan before you start, since both players need to move the car together rather than pulling in different directions.
Keep the car balanced as you drive, because the instructions say balance is affected by how each player steers.
Slow down before rough patches and obstacles so the car stays intact, which the game requires to reach the finish.
Take small, steady inputs instead of holding keys down, which makes it easier to correct the car after a bump.
If you are playing on mobile, check the on-screen controls first so both players can respond quickly on their side of the car.
faq: What is the goal of Obby vs Noob Driver?
Drive the car with your partner along the track and reach the finish line, where Obby and Noob must reach the flag. The car must stay intact the whole way.
Which keys control each car?
Press WASD to move the red car and the arrow keys to move the blue car. Both players control the same vehicle together.

shot-trigger.intro: Shot Trigger is a shooting skill game where you help a hero rescue civilians from the underworld. Take your time, watch the action, and aim for clean, well-timed shots.
tips: Focus on the civilians first, since rescuing them is the whole goal of the game.
Take a moment to read the screen before each shot so you know where your hero and the civilians are.
Pay attention to timing, because this is a skill game and a well-timed shot tends to work better than a rushed one.
Keep your attention steady rather than reacting to every movement, which helps you avoid wasting shots.
Play a few rounds to learn how the action moves, then try to improve a little each time you play.
faq: What is the goal of Shot Trigger?
Your hero must rescue the civilians from the underworld. The game's description focuses on helping him complete this rescue.
What controls does Shot Trigger use?
The description and instructions do not list specific controls, so check the on-screen prompts when you start playing to see how to aim and shoot.

edgefire-2.intro: EdgeFire 2 is a first-person shooter built around competitive matches, tactical depth, and team play. It mixes old-school shooter feel with fast, dynamic action.
tips: Aim before you shoot. Each shot counts, so line up your crosshair on the target first instead of firing at everything that moves.
Use R to recharge at safe moments, such as when no enemy is in sight, so you are not caught with an empty weapon during a fight.
Keep your movement measured. Use WASD to reposition between shots rather than running in a straight line, which makes you an easy target.
Think before you push. Watch the arena and plan your route and timing, since strategy matters as much as raw reflexes.
If you are playing with a team, stay close enough to support each other and coordinate your moves, because team synergy is a core part of the game.
faq: What is the main goal in EdgeFire 2?
The goal is to win competitive battles by dominating each encounter. Destroying opponents is important, but skilled, deliberate play matters just as much.
How do I move and shoot?
Use W, A, S and D to move around. Press the left mouse button to shoot, and press R to recharge your weapon.

eat-to-evolve-2.intro: Eat To Evolve 2 is an arcade-style adventure where you start as a small worm and grow stronger by eating what is in your path. Click or tap to play and keep eating to evolve.
tips: Keep eating small food like grubs early on, since growing steadily is what lets you evolve.
Look ahead before you move so you can line up food items instead of wandering into danger.
Pay attention to what you eat, since fruits, mushrooms and grubs are all part of the path to evolving.
Avoid rushing into fights you have not prepared for; the game is tagged with battle and survival, so stay alert to threats.
Take short breaks to plan your route, since steady, careful clicks often work better than fast, random ones.
faq: What is the main goal in Eat To Evolve 2?
Your goal is to grow stronger by eating food in your path so you can keep evolving. The more you eat, the further you progress.
How do I control the worm?
You play by clicking the mouse or tapping the screen. Use your clicks or taps to move through the level and reach food.

geometry-vibes-x-ball.intro: Geometry Vibes X-Ball is an arcade game where you steer through levels by flying up and diving down while avoiding obstacles, traps, and gears. It includes new levels, a challenge section, and a store in X-Ball mode.
tips: Use short, steady presses of the mouse or up arrow to make small height changes. Holding too long can push you into a ceiling or trap.
Before each jump, look ahead to the next gap or gear. Plan your rise and dive so you are already in position when the obstacle arrives.
Release the button early when you see a drop coming. Diving down quickly is often the safest way to clear a low hazard.
Try the challenge section after you feel comfortable with the regular levels. It is a good way to practise timing under pressure.
In 2, 3, or 4 player modes, agree on who uses UP ARROW, H, and L before you start. Clear roles help you avoid collisions with other players.
faq: What is the goal of Geometry Vibes X-Ball?
You move through each level while avoiding obstacles, traps, and gears. Reaching the end of a level without touching a hazard is the main aim.
How do I control my character?
Click the left mouse button or hold the up arrow to fly up. Release the button to dive down.

fish-eat-grow-mega.intro: Fish Eat Grow Mega is an action simulation where you pick a fish and swim through a huge ocean to grow as large as you can. You can play alone or team up with a friend in two-player mode.
tips: Pick a fish before you start and learn how it moves, since the new fish types in this chapter may handle differently.
Stay near the safer parts of the ocean while you are small, and move into the more dangerous areas once you have grown.
Test the boost key for a few seconds in open water to see how it changes your speed and turning before you need it in a tight spot.
In two-player mode, agree on a split of roles, such as one player scouting ahead and the other watching the area behind.
Keep moving rather than sitting still, so you can spot food and threats early and keep your growth going.
faq: What is the goal of Fish Eat Grow Mega?
Your goal is to grow as much as you can and become the king fish of the ocean. Growing bigger is the main way to progress.
What are the controls for Player 1?
Player 1 moves with W, A, S and D, and uses C to boost.

dig-and-flow-save-water.intro: Dig & Flow is a physics puzzle where you dig through sand to guide water, lava, and steam through labyrinths. Your aim is to collect every star in each level by routing the streams correctly.
tips: Before you dig, trace the route from each element's source to the stars so you know where the channel needs to go.
Start with the simplest path you can see. Each new level adds more logic, so a clear first channel makes the rest easier to plan.
Pay attention to what each mechanism needs, since streams can activate them and open new paths further through the level.
Learn how water, lava, and steam each behave, because the same channel can work differently for each element.
Dig steadily and watch the flow as you go, so you can adjust the path before the element moves too far in the wrong direction.
faq: What is the goal of Dig & Flow?
Collect all the stars on each level by digging through the sand and guiding the streams along the correct path.
How do I control the elements?
Hold the left mouse button and drag to dig through the sand, or drag your finger across the screen on touch controls to create paths.

block-puzzle-tropical-story.intro: Block Puzzle Tropical Story is a relaxing block puzzle set across tropical islands. You drag blocks into place, complete level tasks, and earn stars to unlock new locations.
tips: Look at the whole board before you move anything, so you can see which spaces are hard to fill later.
Hold the left mouse button on a block and drag it to the spot you want, then release to place it.
Use the booster system when a level feels stuck rather than forcing blocks into poor positions.
Finish the level tasks first, since stars earned from completing them are what open new locations.
If you are new to block puzzles, start by placing the blocks that fit into gaps with the fewest options.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Each level asks you to complete tasks, and finishing them rewards you with stars and opens new tropical locations.
How do I move the blocks?
Hold and drag the left mouse button to drag a block, then release it to drop it in place.

kids-transport.intro: Kids Transport is an educational racing game for early preschool children. It helps young players learn vehicle names and sounds while they play with the mouse or by tapping.
tips: Listen closely to each vehicle's sound and say its name out loud, which links the sound and the word together.
Take your time with each vehicle rather than rushing, so the names and sounds have a chance to stick.
Use whichever control feels most comfortable for your child, either the mouse or tapping, since both work for play.
Replay the game often, as repetition helps young learners recognise vehicles and their sounds more easily.
Ask your child to point to or name a vehicle after hearing its sound to check what they have learned.
faq: What is the goal of Kids Transport?
The game is designed to help early preschool children learn vehicle names and sounds while they play.
How do I control the game?
You play with the mouse or by tapping the screen, depending on which device you are using.

super-santa-adventures.intro: Super Santa Adventures is a holiday run game where you guide Santa through traffic while he distributes all the gifts. Keep your speed under control and avoid other vehicles as you go.
tips: Build up speed gradually rather than rushing, since the game recommends accelerating slowly.
Watch the traffic ahead of you early so you have time to adjust before you reach it.
Treat every collision as a costly mistake, because hitting other traffic is one of the main things to avoid.
Keep your attention on the road between gift stops so you don't lose track of your route.
Replay a level once you understand where the traffic tends to come from, so each run gets steadier.
faq: What is the goal of Super Santa Adventures?
Run through the level while Santa distributes all the gifts. Finishing the delivery is the main objective.
How should I control my speed?
The game advises accelerating slowly rather than speeding up quickly. A gentler pace gives you more room to react to traffic.

shape-transform-shifting-rush.intro: Shape Transform: Shifting Rush is a racing run where you control a character that can change shape while you race through a parkour course. Use mouse clicks or taps to play.
tips: Keep your eyes on the path ahead rather than on your character, so you can react to what is coming before you reach it.
Pay attention to when and how your character changes shape, and learn which shape suits each part of the run.
Try out shape changes early in a run to see how they affect your movement before you rely on them in tight spots.
Stay calm and steady with your clicks or taps, since rushing your inputs can make it harder to keep up your speed.
If you fall behind, restart with a clear plan for the first few obstacles so your early moves are more consistent.
faq: What is the goal of Shape Transform: Shifting Rush?
You race forward through a shape-shifting parkour course, keeping your character moving as fast as you can. The description focuses on speed and changing shape along the way.
How do I control the character?
Use mouse clicks or taps to play. The instructions do not list any other controls.

monster-truck-extreme-racing.intro: Monster Truck Extreme Racing is a desert racing game where you drive powerful monster trucks against rivals. Finish in the top 3 to win prizes, or perform stunts on the open Free Drive map.
tips: Aim for a top 3 finish in each race, since that is what earns prizes.
Use the Free Drive map to practice driving and attempt stunt shows, which can also earn prizes.
Save your Nitro for the straights or the final stretch, rather than spending it early in a race.
Use the Look Back key when you want to check where rivals are before making a move.
Visit the Garage between races to buy new Monster Trucks, which you need to win the next races.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Finish races in the top 3 places to win prizes, and perform stunt shows on the Free Drive map to earn more.
What are the controls for Player 1?
Use the arrow keys to move, N for Nitro, and B to look back. Press R to restart the level.

arklet.intro: Arklet is a calm sorting puzzle where you place arriving animals into cabins so each one feels safe and content. Plan room pairings carefully, since every animal has its own likes and dislikes.
tips: Start by finding the animals that dislike others, such as a large elephant and a small mouse, and separate them before filling anything else.
Look for animals that enjoy company, like meerkats and raccoons, and place them together to keep them satisfied.
Give solitary animals, like bears and porcupines, a room away from crowded neighbors so they stay comfortable.
Check each animal's special request, such as a view of the lighthouse or nearness to food supplies, before deciding where it goes.
Because there are no timers, rearrange cabins freely whenever a placement looks wrong, and compare a few layouts before committing.
faq: What is the main goal of Arklet?
Your goal is to satisfy as many animals as possible on the floor by pairing each one with suitable neighbors. A level is completed perfectly when every animal feels safe and comfortable.
How do I move animals between cabins?
Use mouse or touch drag and drop to sort the animals into cabins. You can keep moving them until the arrangement works.

bs-simulator.intro: BS Simulator is a multiplayer game built around unlocking and upgrading Brawlers, climbing the Trophy Road, and completing the Brawl Pass. This guide covers habits and priorities that help you progress faster.
tips: Log in every day so you do not miss the daily bonuses, since they stack up over time and cost nothing to claim.
Spend your coins and gems on upgrades for Brawlers you actually use rather than spreading them across many characters.
Finish daily quests early in the day, because the tokens they give go toward completing the Brawl Pass.
Check the shop when you log in, since special offers are updated several times a week and may be worth a look.
Try the mini-games for a change of pace and extra rewards, especially when you are waiting to earn more trophies.
faq: What is the main goal of BS Simulator?

The main goal is to unlock and upgrade Brawlers while collecting trophies to advance along the Trophy Road and into new leagues. Completing the Brawl Pass and daily quests also helps you earn rewards.
How do I earn trophies?
You earn trophies by playing matches and winning them, and they move you forward on the Trophy Road. Reaching new leagues unlocks further rewards.

city-delivery-rider-simulator.intro: Ride a motorcycle through a busy city as a delivery courier. Carry parcels, follow checkpoints, and reach customers before time runs out.
tips: Keep an eye on your fuel gauge while you plan routes, so you are not caught with an empty tank far from a customer.
Use Space to brake before tight corners and busy junctions rather than braking late in the middle of a turn.
Use the Shift keys to adjust your balance when the bike feels unsteady, especially at speed.
Switch the camera with C to find the view that lets you see traffic and upcoming checkpoints most clearly.
If you get stuck or tipped over, press R to reset the motorcycle quickly instead of losing time struggling to recover.
faq: What is the goal of City Delivery Rider Simulator?
You deliver parcels by following checkpoints and reaching each customer before time runs out. The routes become more challenging as you progress.
How do I steer and control the motorcycle?
Use W or Up Arrow to accelerate and S or Down Arrow to reverse. Steer with A and D or the Left and Right Arrow keys, and press Space to brake.

tankhit.intro: TankHit is a 3D tank battle where you face a CPU opponent or a friend in labyrinths and arenas. The first tank to land 5 hits wins the match.
tips: Your tank magazine holds 5 shots, so count your ammo before firing. Shooting when you are empty leaves you exposed while you wait.
Pick up power-ups whenever the route allows, since the game says they can give you an advantage in the fight.
Use the labyrinth walls to break your opponent's line of fire. Moving out of a straight line with them makes their shots harder to land.
Keep moving rather than sitting still, especially in the open arena, so your opponent cannot line up a clean shot on you.
Watch the opponent's shots and reposition after they fire, since they will need time to reload their magazine.
faq: What is the goal of TankHit?
The goal is to make 5 hits on your opponent before they make 5 hits on you. The first player to reach 5 hits wins.
What are the controls for Player 1?
Player 1 moves with W, A, S and D, and shoots with T.

nutcracker-new-years-adventures.intro: Dress two princesses for a series of winter holidays in this New Year dress-up game. Pick outfits inspired by a fairy tale ballet, from elegant evening dresses to playful costumes.
tips: Try a few different fashion trends on each princess before settling on a final look, since the game encourages experimenting.
Think about the occasion first: an elegant evening dress and a playful costume call for very different colors and details.
Pay attention to the shiny fabrics and small details, because they are a big part of what makes each dress stand out.
Give each princess her own style so the two outfits feel unique rather than matching.
Use a steady click or tap for each choice so you can move through the options without mistakes.
faq: How do I control the game?
Use a computer mouse click on a computer, or a simple touch on a touch screen. The same action works for picking items and options.
Is there a goal to reach or a score to beat?
The game is about creating a New Year outfit for each princess and developing your sense of style. There is no score mentioned in the description, so focus on making each dress look the way you like.

hexfall-io.intro: HexFall.io is a survival game where hex tiles break under your feet with every step. Plan each move ahead so you stay above the void longer than the other players and become the last one standing.
tips: Think a few steps ahead before you move, since every step breaks the tile you leave behind.
Avoid running into corners or narrow strips of tiles, because they can cut off your escape routes.
Keep track of where the solid tiles are around you and head toward the areas that are still intact.
Watch where your rivals are moving, and avoid following them into the same shrinking area.
On mobile, make small, steady joystick movements so you keep control of exactly where you land.
faq: What is the goal of HexFall.io?
Stay above the void for as long as possible, survive longer than everyone else, and be the last player standing.
How do I move my character?
On PC, use the arrow keys or WASD. On mobile, use the on-screen joystick.

obbie-zombie-land.intro: Obbie Zombie Land is a 2D adventure where you fight hordes of zombies while moving through obstacles and jumping across platforms. The game has 12 pre-designed levels to work through.
tips: Learn the jump before you fight. Practise leaping across a few platforms with W and D so you can judge distance before enemies are added.
Use Space to attack foes that stand in your path rather than trying to run past them, especially when they block a narrow gap.
Look ahead at each obstacle and platform before you commit to a jump, so you do not drop into a spot you cannot leave easily.
Play the levels in order, since the 12 levels are designed to build on each other as your journey continues.
Take short, steady moves with A and D near enemies, and stop to reset your position if a group of zombies gets close.
faq: How many levels does the game have?
The game includes 12 pre-designed levels that you can work through as your adventure progresses.
What are the basic controls?
Use A to move left, D to move right, W to jump, and Space to attack.

melodys-adventure-2.intro: Melodys Adventure 2 is a platforming game with 32 larger levels. You guide Melody across wide landscapes, overcoming new challenges and outwitting foes along the way.
tips: Look at the whole layout before moving, since the levels are larger than in the first game and the route forward may not be obvious at first.
Learn how Melody moves and lands early on, so you can judge jumps across the vast terrain with confidence.
Watch the enemies for a few seconds to find their pattern before you try to pass them.
Expect new challenges and surprises in each stage, and slow down when the layout changes so you can react instead of rushing into danger.
If you get stuck, go back over the area you just crossed and check for spots you may have skipped.
faq: What is the goal of Melodys Adventure 2?
Your goal is to guide Melody through its 32 levels by platforming across each landscape and outwitting the foes you meet along the way.
Which keys control Melody?
The game uses the arrow keys or the W, A and D keys, as listed in the instructions.

fill-the-lines.intro: Fill The Lines is a relaxed puzzle game where you drag colorful blocks into a shape until no blank spots remain. There is no timer and no way to lose, so you can work through the levels at your own pace.
tips: Look for the blank spots that are hardest to reach, such as narrow corners or dead ends. Fill those first, because only a few blocks will fit there.
Before you drag a block, check whether its outline matches a gap in the shape. Placing a block that fits exactly is easier to plan than trying pieces at random.
Watch for small leftover gaps that a block could no longer reach. Avoiding these early saves you from having to undo moves later.
Since there is no time limit, step back and look at the whole shape when you get stuck. A fresh look often shows which block belongs where.
Work on one area of the shape at a time. Finishing a section makes the remaining blank spots easier to count and plan around.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Place the colorful blocks into the puzzle shape so that every blank spot is covered and no gaps are left.
Can I lose a level?
No. The game has no losing condition and no time limit, so you can take as long as you need on each puzzle.

zombie-vacation.intro: You are a special forces soldier stranded on a tropical island overrun with zombies. Use your sub-machine gun to shoot your way through waves and survive each one.
tips: Keep moving with WASD instead of standing still, so zombies approaching from several sides don't surround you.
Reload with R during quieter moments, not in the middle of a crowd, so you don't run out of ammo when enemies are closest.
Use Space to jump when you need to reposition quickly out of a tight group of zombies.
Aim your shots with the mouse and hold LMB to keep firing at the nearest threats first.
Press P to pause if you need a moment to plan your route before the next wave arrives.
faq: What is the goal of Zombie Vacation?
Shoot the zombies on the tropical island and survive each wave to win.
Which keys control the soldier?
Use WASD to move, LMB to shoot, R to reload, Space to jump, and P to pause.

stair-race-3d.intro: Stair Race 3D is a hypercasual race where you collect planks, build stairs across gaps, and reach the next platform before your rivals. Bumping into enemies can swing the round in either direction.
tips: Pick up planks whenever you can, since you need them to build the stairs that carry you forward.
Keep an eye on how many planks each enemy is carrying before you run into them, because a rival with more planks can knock you over and take yours.
Aim for enemies carrying fewer planks than you, since colliding with them can knock them over and let you gain their advantage.
Plan your route so you always have enough planks to finish the next stair section rather than running out mid-build.
Winning rounds unlocks new skins for your character and planks, so it is worth playing a few rounds to see what you can earn.
faq: What is the goal of Stair Race 3D?
The goal is to be the best stair builder in the arena by collecting planks, building stairs, and reaching the next platform ahead of your enemies.
What happens when an enemy knocks me over?
If an enemy with more planks than you runs into you, you lose all the planks you have collected.

merge-sesame.intro: Merge Sesame is a fruit puzzle game where you combine objects to build combos and raise your score. There are no time limits or penalties, so you can play at a relaxed pace.
tips: Take your time before each move, since there are no time limits or penalties to rush you.
Look for chances to chain merges together, because consecutive combos are what make your score climb fastest.
Save a high combo for when you can line up several merges, as a high combo with an object boosts your score the most.
Pay attention to the sound effects and visual feedback, which show when a combo is building up.
Keep your play steady rather than clicking quickly, so you do not miss a merge that could extend your combo.
faq: How do I play Merge Sesame?
Click or tap to play. Combine objects to complete consecutive combos and build your score.
How does scoring work?
Hitting a high combo with an object makes your score soar, so chaining merges is the key to a higher score.

billiards-3d-russian-pyramid.intro: Billiards 3D: Russian Pyramid is a pool game against computer opponents. You can set their skill level and play on tables of different sizes. This guide covers aiming, striking, and spin.
tips: Use the precision aim wheel on the right side of the screen for small adjustments before you shoot, rather than rotating the cue with broad movements.
Set your force by pulling the cue back and watch the strength before releasing, since a gentle stroke is often easier to control than a hard one.
Check the screw setting before a shot that needs spin, and confirm the impact point with the green button so you know exactly where the cue ball will strike.
Practise the cue tilt control on a few shots so you know how the angle changes your stroke before you rely on it in a real game.
Choose an AI skill level that matches your current ability, and move up gradually as your aim and force control improve.
faq: How do I aim my shot?
Click anywhere on the table to rotate the cue. For finer control, use the precision aim wheel on the right side of the screen, or hold Shift while aiming on a PC.
How do I add spin to the cue ball?
Click the ball icon with a dot in the upper right part of the screen, move the impact point, and confirm it with the green button. On a PC, you can hold X while aiming to move the point of impact.

fish-shooting-fish-hunter.intro: Fish Shooting - Fish Hunter is a relaxed arcade game where you aim and fire at fish to catch them. It is played with a mouse click or a tap.
tips: Watch the movement of the fish for a moment before you fire, so you can aim where they are heading rather than where they are now.
Keep your clicks steady and avoid rapid firing when a target is far away, since quick reflexes matter more than constant shooting.
Try to catch fish that are close together in one area, which makes it easier to keep your focus and react quickly.
Take short breaks between rounds to keep your reactions sharp, especially since the game is designed as a laid-back experience.
Pay attention to the different kinds of fish on screen and notice which ones appear most often, so you know where to focus your aim.
faq: What is the goal of Fish Shooting - Fish Hunter?
The goal is to use your skills and quick reflexes to catch as many different fish as you can. The game is built around a relaxed fishing experience.
How do I control the game?
You play by clicking the mouse or tapping the screen. Click or tap to aim and shoot at the fish.

maze-bomber-game.intro: Maze Bomber is an adventure game where you work through obstacle-filled mazes, placing bombs to open a path to the goal. Each level is complete once you reach the exit.
tips: Look at the whole maze before you act, and plan a route to the goal so your bombs go where they will help most.
Think about where a blast will reach before you place a bomb, and keep yourself out of that area.
Break through blocks only when they clearly open a useful path, since a wrong break can leave you with a dead end.
Move slowly through tight spaces and check each step, because a single careless move can put you in danger.
If you get stuck, pause and trace the possible routes again from the start instead of repeating the same moves.
faq: What is the goal of Maze Bomber?
Your goal is to move through each maze, clear a path with bombs, and reach the goal to complete the level.
How do I control the game?
You play with mouse clicks or taps, so click or tap to move and place bombs as the game asks.

jelly-drop-merge-and-sell.intro: Jelly Drop: Merge & Sell is a puzzle game about dropping jellies into a jar, merging identical ones into more valuable forms, and selling them for points. It suits short, relaxed sessions.
tips: Watch where new jellies land, since identical jellies must touch to merge. Placing them next to matching jellies gives you more merges.
Higher jelly levels are worth more points, so aim to merge up rather than letting many low-level jellies fill the jar.
Keep an eye on the fill level and sell when the jar is nearly full. Waiting too long can leave less room for new jellies to merge.
Spend upgrades on the stat that fits your play. Jar capacity helps you hold more merges before selling, while sale income raises what each sale earns.
Check your upgrades after each new jelly tier unlocks, since higher tiers often change which upgrades will pay off most.
faq: What is the main goal of Jelly Drop: Merge & Sell?
The goal is to merge identical jellies into more valuable forms, fill the jar, and sell the contents to grow your score. Each sale earns more as your jellies reach higher levels.
How do I merge jellies?
Jellies fall into the jar from the top, and when two identical jellies touch, they merge into a more advanced version. Simple drops and touches are all the controls you need.

brain-line-connect.intro: Brain Line Connect is a logic puzzle where you draw one unbroken line through every dot on the screen. Obstacle lines make each level a test of planning ahead.
tips: Before you touch the screen, scan the whole level and note which dots are hard to reach, such as those near obstacle lines or in corners.
Plan your route from the most awkward dot first, then build the rest of the line around it.
Keep your path a safe distance from obstacle lines, since touching one counts as a wrong try.
Look for dead ends early. If a dot could only be reached from one direction, plan to visit it at the right moment in your route.
There is no time limit, so take a moment to trace the route with your eyes before you start drawing.
faq: What is the goal of Brain Line Connect?
Your goal is to draw one continuous line that connects every dot on the screen. When all dots are connected correctly, the level is complete.
Why does a try count as wrong?
A try is wrong if your drawn line touches an obstacle line. Keep your path clear of those lines to avoid a failed attempt.

dungeon-master-cult-and-craft.intro: Dungeon Master - Cult & Craft is a 3D idle clicker where you act as a dungeon keeper. You send stickmen to mine ore, grow your Cult, and expand your underground base.
tips: Send followers out for ore and minerals regularly, since resource extraction feeds everything else you build.
Keep Cult loyalty high. The game ties your power to it, so check it before you spend on expansion.
Spend your resources on dungeon upgrades that build, improve, and strengthen your base, rather than spreading them thin across small purchases.
Use the economic side of the game deliberately: decide how spoils are distributed, because that choice affects your wealth and your followers' loyalty.
Use the controls that suit you: WASD or arrow keys with the mouse on desktop, or the joystick and taps on mobile, to move around your base and select upgrades quickly.
faq: How do I move around and pick upgrades?

On desktop, use WASD or the arrow keys, or drag with the left mouse button to move. Use the left mouse button or E to select an upgrade. On mobile, use the in-game joystick to move and tap to select an upgrade.
How do I make progress in the game?

Progress comes from mining ore and minerals with your followers, managing your resources, and upgrading your base. The description does not list a specific win condition, so focus on steady growth of your Cult and dungeon.

catwalk-beauty.intro: Catwalk Beauty is a 3D puzzle dressing game where you style a model with clothes and jewelry. Your picks decide whether she wins the judges' favor in the competition.
tips: Look at the full outfit before you commit, since clothes and jewelry need to work together as one look.
Pick the main outfit first, then choose jewelry that complements it rather than competing with it.
Take your time with each choice, because one wrong fashion mix means the model loses her chance on the catwalk.
If a combination looks off in the 3D view, try a different piece before moving on.
Treat each selection as a puzzle step and check how the pieces fit before you finish the look.
faq: How do I start playing Catwalk Beauty?
Tap to play, then start choosing clothes and jewelry for the model.
What is the goal of the game?
Your goal is to make the model win more of the judges' favor in the competition by choosing the right looks.

dino-huntress.intro: Dino Huntress is a 2D side-scrolling adventure where you guide her through eight levels, collecting coins and eggs while avoiding enemies. Two big bosses wait at the end of the journey.
tips: Jump on birds to eliminate them, but steer clear of the dinos, since those cannot be jumped on.
Use your weapon with the SPACE bar when an enemy is in your path, so you can deal with threats from a distance.
Hold the jump button for a higher jump, and press jump twice for a double jump when you need to reach a platform or clear a gap.
Collect the coins and eggs as you go, but keep your eye on the finish area so you do not lose track of where you need to end up.
Pick up and use bonuses when you find them, since they can help you get through tricky sections safely.
faq: What is the goal of Dino Huntress?
Your goal is to collect all the coins and eggs along the way, avoid enemies, and reach the finish area of each level safely.
Which enemies can I defeat by jumping on them?
You can jump on birds to eliminate them, but not all enemies can be jumped on. The dinos, for example, cannot be defeated that way.

wood-nuts-master-screw-puzzle.intro: Wood Nuts Master: Screw Puzzle is a physics-based puzzle where you place screws and nuts to topple wooden blocks. Good planning matters because the empty holes you can use are limited.
tips: Study the whole layout before placing anything. Look at which blocks are supported and where a single release could bring the most blocks down.
Choose your holes carefully, since the number of empty holes is limited. Using one early can leave you short for a harder block later.
Remember that releasing a block can cover some holes. Check which holes will be blocked before you act, so you do not lose a spot you still need.
Work out the order of your moves ahead of time. Starting with the piece that sets off the most falling blocks can make the rest of the puzzle easier.
If a attempt leaves you stuck, restart and try a different placement sequence. Small changes in where you start can open up very different solutions.
faq: What is the goal of Wood Nuts Master: Screw Puzzle?
Your goal is to strategically place screws and nuts so that all the wooden blocks fall.
How do I decide where to place screws?
Look for the best empty holes that will knock over blocks effectively. Think about the physics of how each block will fall before you commit.

big-wild-bucks-voxel-buck-hunter.intro: Big Wild Bucks is a first-person voxel hunting shooter played against the clock. Bag enough bucks to clear each trek, and avoid shooting does, which bust your run.
tips: Check the target before you fire, since shooting a doe ends the run. Take a moment to confirm you are aiming at a buck every time.
Use the scope on distant shots, because those pay more than close ones. Hold the scope button steady so your aim settles before you shoot.
Chain bucks together to build combos, which add to your score. Keep your shots clean so one miss does not break your rhythm.
Spend the cash you earn in the shop on better rifles and ammo. Stronger gear makes the later treks easier to clear.
Shoot critters for bonus points when they are safe to target, since they carry no penalty. Use them to add to your score without risking the run.
faq: What is the main goal of Big Wild Bucks?
Bag enough bucks to clear each trek. Shooting a doe ends your run, so you need to be selective with every shot.
How do I aim and shoot on desktop?
Move the mouse to aim, then use left click or Space to shoot. Hold right click or Shift to scope in, and press R to reload.

kung-fu-little-animals.intro: Kung Fu Little Animals is a clicker game where you act as assistant to a great master. Your job is to train funny, dexterous animals into martial artists using simple clicks.
tips: Use a steady, comfortable click or tap rhythm rather than rushing, since every click is part of the training.
Keep an eye on your progress so you can see which animals and locations you are unlocking as you go.
Play in short sessions and take breaks, which helps you stay focused and enjoy the funny characters.
Try the game on the device you find most comfortable, using a mouse click on a computer or a touch on a touchscreen.
faq: What is the goal of Kung Fu Little Animals?
Your goal is to train the funniest and most dexterous kung fu animals to become martial artists. You do this with simple clicks as the master's assistant.
How do I control the game?
On a computer you use a mouse click, and on a touch screen you use a simple touch. The same click or touch is used for all training.

impossible-car-stunt-game.intro: Impossible Car Stunt Game is a racing challenge with stunts, ramps, and tricky tracks. Steer your car through obstacles and traps to reach the finish line in each level.
tips: Use W or the Up Arrow to move forward and S or the Down Arrow to move back, and ease off before obstacles so you keep control of the car.
Use A and D (or the Left and Right Arrows) for small steering corrections rather than sharp swings, especially on narrow tracks.
Before a jump over a ramp, check where you will land and adjust your position so the car comes down straight.
Watch for dangerous traps ahead and slow down early enough to react, instead of trying to correct at the last moment.
Replay a level if you keep failing at the same spot, and focus on that one section until you can pass it consistently.
faq: What is the goal of Impossible Car Stunt Game?
Your goal is to drive across each track, avoid dangerous traps, and reach the finish line to complete the level.
How do I control the car?
Use W, A, S, and D or the Arrow keys to move forward, left, back, and right. Use the mouse to click any buttons on screen.

mr-reckless-car-chase-simulator.intro: Mr.Reckless is a fast-paced driving game set in a low-poly city, where you race to stay free from police and traffic. Keep moving, use your power-ups well, and see how long you can last.
tips: Keep your car moving at all times, since the game's one rule is to never stop. Hesitating even briefly gives police and traffic time to close in.
Use the Spacebar handbrake for sharp corners so you can turn without losing too much speed. Tap it rather than holding it down so you can accelerate out of the turn.
Save Nitro for straight stretches or moments when you need a burst of speed to pull away from pursuers. Using it in a tight spot can put you into traffic.
Treat Slow-Mo and Freeze as emergency tools for crowded intersections or sudden blockages. Waiting until you are already trapped often means they come too late to help.
Scan ahead for gaps between traffic and plan your route a few moves in advance. Reacting only to what is directly in front of you makes crashes more likely.
faq: What is the goal of Mr.Reckless Car Chase Simulator?
The goal is to keep your car moving and avoid being caught while dodging police, traffic, and obstacles. The game asks how long you can stay free.
How do I control the car?
Use the WASD keys or the Arrow Keys to move your vehicle. Press the Spacebar to engage the handbrake for sharp turns or emergency stops.

magic-block-sort.intro: Magic Block Sort is a sorting puzzle where you move 3D blocks between tubes until each tube holds only one matching color or symbol. Levels grow with more blocks, hidden mystery symbols, and extra tubes.
tips: Look at the top block of every tube before you move, and find which blocks are buried under others. Planning two or three moves ahead usually prevents getting stuck.
Empty a tube when you can, because a completely empty tube lets you place any block in it. Extra empty space gives you more options later.
Avoid stacking a block on a tube where it will bury a block you need soon. Keep the tubes that are close to matching sorted first.
If you hit a dead end, try Undo before restarting. Undo lets you step back one move at a time, so you keep the progress you have already made.
There is no timer, so take a moment to study the board before each move. Slowing down often saves more moves than rushing.
faq: What is the goal of Magic Block Sort?
Sort all the magic blocks so that each tube ends up holding only one matching color or symbol.
How do I move a block?
Tap a tube to lift its top block, then tap another tube to drop the block into it.

fruitsland-escape-from-the-amusement-par.intro: Fruitsland is an adventure about escaping a flooded-with-danger underground park by solving puzzles, finding items, and avoiding fruit monsters. Move with WASD, crouch with C, and jump with Space.
tips: Pick up and keep useful items, since the instructions say to use them to your advantage. Try items on puzzles and obstacles when you are stuck.
Read the scientists' journals and other remnants you find. They reveal how the experiments worked and can hint at how to solve the puzzles ahead.
Watch how the blind apple moves before you commit to a route. It roams aimlessly, so waiting for a clear gap is often safer than rushing past.
Against the pomegranate's roaming eyes, keep moving and do not stay in open areas where they can chase you across the room. Find cover and plan your next step before you move.
Choose your path carefully at each junction. Some routes lead to traps or monsters, so backtrack and try another way if a section feels too dangerous.
faq: What is the main goal of Fruitsland?
Your goal is to escape the underground part of the park by solving puzzles and finding a way out. Each section adds new challenges along the way.
Which controls do I need to know?
Use WASD to move, C to crouch, and Space to jump. Crouching and jumping can help you get past obstacles and avoid danger.

diamond-sort-picture-puzzle.intro: Diamond Sort: Picture Puzzle is a relaxing sorting game where you move colorful gems into matching groups to clear the board and reveal artwork. Each level is solved by sorting every active gem and emptying the buffer.
tips: Look for gems that are already in the right place before moving anything, since correctly placed gems stay fixed and can serve as anchors for the rest of the board.
Before selecting a group, check that there is an empty area of the matching color ready to receive it, so you do not waste a move on a dead end.
Use the buffer slots as a temporary holding area when a group is blocking another color, but try to empty them as soon as a matching spot opens up.
Work on one color at a time where possible, which keeps the board easier to read and reduces the chance of putting a gem in the wrong place.
If you get stuck, scan the whole board again from the start, since a small rearrangement elsewhere often opens the path you need.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Sort every active gem into its matching color and empty the buffer. Completing this clears the level and reveals the artwork.
How do I move a gem group?
Tap a group of misplaced gems to select it, then tap an empty matching-color area on the board or an available buffer slot. Touch works on mobile and the mouse works on desktop.

battle-of-tank-steel.intro: Battle of Tank Steel is an arcade shooter where you drive tanks into battles on a challenging battlefield. You play by clicking or tapping, and you can unlock several tank types with different weapons.
tips: Try each tank type you unlock, since they have different capabilities and weapons. Find the one that suits your style of play.
Spend a moment reading the battlefield before you fire. Notice where threats are coming from and where you have cover.
Plan your moves instead of only reacting. The game rewards strategy as well as shooting, so keep your position in mind.
Keep your attention on the action because the battles are continuous. Short breaks can leave you unprepared for the next wave of danger.
Use each battle to learn how your tank handles. Practice with clicks or taps until your aim and timing feel natural.
faq: How do I control my tank?
You play with mouse clicks or taps. Use these inputs to move and shoot as the battle unfolds.
Can I change to a different tank?
Yes, you can unlock various types of tanks. Each one has its own capabilities and weapons, so you can switch to the one that fits your play.

color-ball-escape.intro: Color Ball Escape is a colour-matching puzzle where you slide holes under falling marbles. Each hole only catches its own colour, so the order you clear marbles in decides how the board opens up.
tips: Before moving any hole, look for marbles that are blocking others. Clearing the outer pieces first often frees up the marbles underneath.
Scan the board for the colour that appears most often and plan around it, since a hole in the wrong colour can leave the board jammed.
Save power-ups for tight spots. Magnet is most useful when loose balls are scattered, and Claw suits a single marble that is stuck in the wrong place.
When an obstacle is in the way, check what it needs first. Ice needs a hole filled under it, crates need hammers, and locks need a matching key.
On layered marbles, work from the inner ring outward only when you have a clear route. Peeling the wrong layer early can make the next colour harder to reach.
faq: What is the main goal of each level?
Clear every marble from the board to finish the level. Each hole only catches marbles of its own colour, so you need to plan the order carefully.
How do I move a hole?
Click and drag the hole with the mouse on desktop, or tap and drag on touch. Line it up under the marbles you want to collect.

hexa-two.intro: Hexa Two is a 3D running and jumping game for one or two players. Keep moving across a floor of hexagon tiles, which fall away once anyone touches them. You can play online against many characters or share a split screen with a friend.
tips: Keep moving forward rather than standing still, since the tiles you stand on are the ones that can fall.
Watch where other characters are running and steer away from their path, because touching a tile can make it fall for everyone.
Use the jump button in good time when you need to clear a tile that is about to drop, rather than waiting until the last moment.
In two-player split screen, keep your eyes on your own screen and check the tiles ahead before you commit to a direction.
Plan a route a few tiles ahead, so you always have solid ground to switch to when the one under you starts to fall.
faq: What is the goal of Hexa Two?
Your goal is to keep running on the hexagon ground for as long as you can. The ground falls away once somebody touches a tile.
Which keys do I use to run and jump?
Run with the Arrow keys or WASD. Jump with Space or Q.

cute-princess-dress-up.intro: Cute Princess Dress Up is a casual styling game where you care for a princess through spa treatments, hair, makeup and outfits. Your aim is to help her look her best for the final battle.
tips: Start with the spa step so the princess has the white skin effect before you move on to the other stages.
Work through the hair salon, makeup and outfit steps in an order that keeps the look coordinated rather than picking items at random.
Try different clothing styles before settling on one, since the game offers a wide range of outfits to match.
Pick makeup that suits the outfit you chose, because the look is judged as a whole when the princess goes into battle.
Use the battle stage as a check: if the princess looks off, go back and adjust the hair, makeup or clothes before continuing.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Your goal is to act as the princess's stylist and help her match a beautiful outfit so she can win the PK battle.
How do I control the game?
Use mouse clicks or taps to choose items and move through each stage.

hair-dye.intro: Hair Dye is a girls' cartoon styling game where you dye and decorate hair for salon customers. Pick a hairstyle, choose a color, and add decorations to finish each look.
tips: Choose the hairstyle first, since the color and decorations look best once the shape is set.
Try bold color combinations on different styles to see which pairings look most striking.
Use decorations sparingly so the hairstyle and color stay easy to see.
Keep an eye on the waiting customers and work through them steadily rather than spending too long on one look.
Experiment with a few different hair dyes on the same style to learn how each color changes the final result.
faq: How do I play Hair Dye?
Use your mouse or tap the screen to pick a hairstyle, hair color, and hair dye, then add decorations to each customer's hair.
What is the goal of the game?
Your goal is to style the hair of every customer waiting at the salon with unique hairstyles, colors, and decorations.

funny-snake-2.intro: Funny Snake 2 is an arcade game where you steer a snake to collect apples, avoid fire obstacles, and melt big ice to free a key and open the door ahead. You control it with the mouse, taps, or the left and right arrow keys.
tips: Plan your route before each turn so you can reach apples without running into fire obstacles.
Keep an eye on the ice blocks and make sure your snake reaches the fire needed to break them, since the key is behind the ice.
Once you free the key, head straight for the door so you do not lose momentum on the way.
Use small, steady turns with the left and right controls instead of rapid zigzags, which make it easier to crash.
If you keep hitting the same obstacle, slow down and watch its pattern before moving again.
faq: What is the goal of Funny Snake 2?
Collect apples, avoid fire obstacles, break the big ice with fire to free the key, and then open the door to move on.
How do I control the snake?
Use your mouse, tap the screen, or press the left and right arrow keys on your keyboard.

army-commando.intro: Army Commando is a first-person shooter where you infiltrate a terrorist headquarters and take down enemies one by one while completing your objectives. Movement, aiming, shooting and grenades are all handled with the keyboard and mouse.
tips: Use right mouse button to aim before engaging distant targets, since aiming gives you a more controlled shot than firing from the hip.
Move with WASD rather than standing still, so you are harder to hit while you pick off enemies.
Save your grenades with G for groups of enemies or spots you cannot clear safely with bullets alone.
Take enemies out one at a time where you can, instead of rushing into open areas where several can fire at you at once.
Check your current objective often and plan your route through the headquarters around it, so you do not waste time in areas that do not help you progress.
faq: What is the goal of Army Commando?
Infiltrate the terrorists' secret headquarters, take them down one by one, and meet each of your objectives.
Which keys control shooting and aiming?
Left mouse button shoots and right mouse button aims. Use WASD to move, G to throw a grenade, and Tab to pause.

capi-bar.intro: Capi Bar is a relaxing idle business game where you merge fruits, make juice, and grow your bar with the help of Capybara. Income keeps building while you are away.
tips: Merge fruits whenever you have a chance, since combining watermelons, oranges, coconuts and other fruits drives your progress.
Spend your earnings on equipment upgrades first, because they improve the bar's output for everything that follows.
Check your bar regularly so you can use the income from idle time, since it accumulates even when you are not playing.
Save up for new bars, counters and interior elements once your current setup is running smoothly, as each expansion adds to your business.
Take short, calm sessions rather than rushing, because the game is designed for slow progress and steady improvement.
faq: What is the main goal of Capi Bar?
Your goal is to grow your bar into a thriving business by merging fruits, saving juice and upgrading your equipment and interior over time.
How does the idle income work?
Income keeps accumulating even when you are not in the game, so you return to find your bar has been earning while you were away.

bus-color-jam.intro: Bus Color Jam is a color puzzle where you match passengers to the bus with the same color. Levels get harder as you go, so planning each tap matters.
tips: Before tapping, check which bus each passenger matches and whether a waiting spot is free for anyone who has to wait.
Keep your empty tiles open for as long as possible, since a full waiting area is what causes a level to fail.
Look for passengers whose color matches a bus that is about to be ready, and send them first to free up space.
If a mismatched passenger has no empty tile to wait in, the level is lost, so think a few moves ahead when the board gets crowded.
Clear the easiest matches early to keep the board calm, then work through the harder colors once you have room to maneuver.
faq: What is the goal of Bus Color Jam?
You need to board every passenger on the bus that matches their color to finish the level. Successful completion rewards you with coins.
What happens when a passenger does not match the bus?
The passenger waits in an empty tile provided. If you run out of empty tiles and a mismatched passenger arrives, the level is failed.

phone-case-diy-2.intro: Phone Case DIY 2 is a design game where you create a phone case for a girl going to her sister's party. You pick colors, stickers, and a phone case model, then decorate it your way.
tips: Choose your phone case model first, then plan your colors around its shape so the design fits well.
Try each making process at least once to see which one suits your style: Stencil art for spraying patterns, or Pop it for a playful look.
Spray a base color before adding patterns or stickers, so the later details stand out clearly.
Use stickers sparingly and place them with some empty space around them, so the case does not look crowded.
Experiment freely with colors, since the game is designed so that any combination comes out looking pretty.
faq: What is the goal of Phone Case DIY 2?
Your goal is to design the latest phone case for the girl so she can wear it to her sister's party. You decide the colors, stickers, and case model.
How do I control the game?
You play with a mouse or by tapping the screen.

color-fall.intro: Color Fall is a color puzzle game where you slide pins to open paths for liquid that matches each truck. Keep black liquid away from colored liquid across all 30 levels.
tips: Before you move any pin, trace where each colored liquid will flow so you can see which path it will take.
Check where black liquid is coming from and plan its route first, since it must stay separate from the colored liquids.
When a level gets harder, slow down and test one pin at a time rather than opening several paths at once.
If a plan fails, look at the exact spot where the colors mixed and adjust the pin that controls that section.
Work through the 30 levels in order, since each one builds on the same ideas about routing liquid safely.
faq: What is the goal of Color Fall?
Open paths so each liquid reaches the truck that matches its color. Complete all 30 levels to finish the game.
What happens if black liquid mixes with a colored liquid?
The colored liquid will evaporate, so you need to keep black liquid out of colored paths.

word-puzzle-connect-words-and-letters.intro: Word Puzzle Connect Words and Letters asks you to link letter bubbles into words that match a theme. It suits quick brain breaks and longer relaxed sessions alike.
tips: Scan the whole grid for common letter pairs and short words before you start dragging, since a word you spot early can clear space for others.
Check the theme first so you know what kind of words to look for, such as nature or technology terms.
Only connect bubbles that sit next to each other, so plan your path before you drag to avoid starting over.
Work on the easier-looking words first, because clearing bubbles can reveal new letters to build longer words.
Save the hint for when you are truly stuck on a level rather than using it right away, so you keep your own word-finding practice going.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Find all the words that match the theme shown in the level. Completing them all finishes the level.
How do I form a word?
Tap and drag across adjacent letter bubbles to spell a word, then submit it to earn points and clear those bubbles.

offroad-jeep-game-2026.intro: Offroad Jeep Game 2026 is a racing and driving game where you steer a 4x4 jeep over mountains, rocky trails, mud and steep hills. Your goal is to keep the vehicle balanced and reach the destination.
tips: Use gentle, short key presses instead of holding the forward or side keys, so the jeep does not tip or slide on steep slopes.
Look ahead at the rocks and hills before you reach them, and choose the line that keeps the jeep level.
Slow down on muddy and rocky sections, since speed makes the jeep harder to control there.
When the jeep starts to lean, ease off the movement key and steer back toward flatter ground to recover balance.
Try a route a few times to learn where the bumps and obstacles are, then use that knowledge to drive more smoothly.
faq: What is the goal of Offroad Jeep Game 2026?
The goal is to carefully control your 4x4 jeep over rough terrain and reach the destination while keeping the vehicle balanced.
Which keys control the jeep?
Use W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move back, and A or D (or the Left and Right Arrows) to move left and right. Use the mouse to click any buttons on screen.

kaku-shikaku-logic-puzzle.intro: Kaku is a logic puzzle based on Shikaku. Split the grid into rectangles so each one holds exactly one number that matches its cell count. It has 2,000 levels across four difficulties.
tips: Look for a 1 first. A number 1 can only be a single cell, so that cell is settled right away.
Check how many open cells surround each number. A number is only satisfied by one rectangle of exactly that size, so tight spaces often leave just one option.
Work on one area at a time instead of scanning the whole board. This is especially helpful on the 13×13 Expert boards.
Tap a rectangle to remove it if you spot a mistake, rather than trying to fix the layout around it.
Save hints for when you are truly stuck. Each hint reveals one correct rectangle, which can unlock the rest of the board.
faq: How do I clear a stage?
Draw rectangles so the whole board is filled with no gaps or overlaps. Each rectangle must contain exactly one number, and that number must equal its number of cells.
How do I remove a rectangle I placed by mistake?
Tap the placed rectangle and it will be removed. You can then draw a new one in its place.

christmas-gift-jump.intro: Christmas Gift Jump is a festive arcade game where you help Santa climb by jumping between platforms. Collect gifts for points, avoid obstacles, and aim for the highest score you can reach.
tips: Time each click or tap to land on the next platform, since a badly timed jump is the most common way to fall.
Before you jump, look at where you want to land so you can judge the timing instead of reacting at the last moment.
Pick up gifts when they sit on your path, but don't risk a fall or an obstacle just to grab one.
Watch for obstacles and plan your next jump around them rather than reacting after they appear.
Play in short rounds to get a feel for the jump timing, then try to beat your own highest score or challenge a friend to climb higher.
faq: What is the goal of Christmas Gift Jump?
Your goal is to help Santa jump from platform to platform, collect gifts, and reach the highest score possible.
How do I control Santa?
On desktop, click on the screen to make the character jump. On mobile devices, tap the screen to make the character jump.

mahjong-pirate-plunder-quest.intro: Mahjong Pirate Plunder Quest is a tile-matching solitaire game with a pirate treasure theme. Match identical free tiles to clear the board and earn up to three stars on each level.
tips: Before each move, scan the whole board for every free tile and note which ones share a matching icon, so you can plan a sequence instead of picking at random.
Prioritize free tiles that are covering other tiles, since removing them can open up new pairs underneath.
Try to clear a level without using hints first, because finishing without hints earns the second star and builds your sense of which pairs are hidden.
Keep an eye on the timer, since beating the time limit is what earns the third star; a few quick, confident matches usually help more than rushing.
If you get stuck, use the on-screen hint tool and then look at the newly revealed tiles, which often shows you the pattern you missed.
faq: What is the main goal of each level?
Remove all tiles from the board by matching pairs of identical free tiles. Each level is complete when the board is empty.
How do I select and match tiles?
On desktop, left-click a free tile and then click an identical free tile to match them. On mobile, tap a free tile and then tap an identical one.

arrow-rescue.intro: Arrow Rescue is a puzzle game where you free trapped animals by pulling arrows in the right order. Each maze gets harder as you plan your route to safety.
tips: Before you pull anything, trace the path from each animal to the exit and note which arrows block it.
Look for the arrow that clears the most obstacles at once, but check that it does not close off the only escape route.
Work out the order of moves on paper or in your head before tapping, since the wrong order can make a level harder to solve.
If you get stuck, step back and look at the whole maze again rather than repeating the same moves.
Rescue animals one level at a time and focus on the new challenge each puzzle introduces, since the same planning habits apply throughout.
faq: What is the goal of Arrow Rescue?
Your goal is to guide every trapped animal to safety by pulling arrows to remove obstacles and open a safe route.
How do I move the arrows?
Tap and pull arrows to change the maze. Think about the order first, because removing obstacles in the correct sequence is key.

zombie-last-guard.intro: Zombie Last Guard is a defense shooter where you hold off waves of zombies to protect three main servers. You can play alone or with a friend on the same keyboard.
tips: Activate and upgrade your Defense Turrets early so they can cover your servers while you handle zombies nearby.
Spend coins on the Market with a purpose: weapon upgrades help you clear waves faster, while health upgrades help you survive longer.
Save your grenades for crowds of zombies closing in on a server instead of using them on single enemies.
Use the switch gun key to change weapons when the zombies in front of you change, rather than waiting until you are overwhelmed.
In two player mode, split the work: one player can focus on moving and shooting while the other manages turrets and the Market upgrades.
faq: What is the main goal of Zombie Last Guard?
Stop the waves of zombies from reaching your three main servers. Defending the servers is what the game is built around.
How do I move and shoot?
Player 1 uses W, A, S and D to move and F to shoot. Player 2 uses the arrow keys to move and L to shoot.

island-monster-offroad.intro: Island Monster Offroad is a monster truck racing game set across mountains, coasts and nature. You can drive alone or race a friend in split screen.
tips: Learn the W, A, S, D keys first and drive slowly on flat ground until you feel how the truck responds before you tackle the hills.
Approach the special ramps at a steady speed, since the realistic physics will affect how the truck lands and how it behaves in the air.
When climbing hills, ease off and steer carefully so the truck keeps its grip instead of tipping or sliding back.
In two player mode, keep each driver's controls in mind: Player 1 uses W, A, S, D with N for power, and Player 2 uses the arrow keys with L for power.
Try the terrain more than once. Mountains, coasts and nature tracks each handle differently, so repeated runs help you learn the best line through each one.
faq: How do I control the monster truck?
Player 1 drives with W, A, S and D and uses N for power. Player 2 drives with the arrow keys and uses L for power.
Can I play with a friend on the same screen?
Yes. The game supports 2 player split screen, so you and a friend can race on the same computer at the same time.

monster-truck-stunt-racer.intro: Monster Truck Stunt Racer is a 3D off-road racing game where you pick a truck, race across varied terrains and weather, and earn money to upgrade your vehicle. Three bonuses can help you win.
tips: Save your bonuses for the sections of the track where you need them most, since each one is a limited help you can use at the right moment.
Earn money in early races and spend it on upgrades for your truck before trying harder maps, so you are better equipped for tougher terrain.
Learn how each map handles, since daytime, nighttime, forest, desert, and snow tracks can feel very different to drive on.
Pay attention to the weather, because changing conditions can affect how your truck handles and when you should use each bonus.
Try all 8 vehicles to find one whose handling suits your driving style, then focus your upgrades on that truck.
faq: How do I steer my monster truck?
Use the A and D keys or the left and right arrow keys to move.
Which keys activate the bonuses?
Press K for magnet, L for four-wheel drive, and J for nitro.

euro-truck-driving-game.intro: Euro Truck Driving Game puts you behind the wheel of heavy European trucks to carry cargo along realistic roads. Each delivery brings its own challenge, so steady driving matters as much as speed.
tips: Use W and S or the arrow keys to control forward and reverse, and keep your movements gentle so the heavy truck stays stable on turns.
Take corners at a slower pace than you think you need, since a loaded truck takes longer to slow down and change direction.
Look ahead down the road rather than at the truck itself, so you can start adjusting your steering early on bends and in traffic.
Read each mission's details before setting off and plan a steady route, especially on longer deliveries where pacing yourself helps you finish.
Use the mouse to click the on-screen buttons when you need to interact with menus or mission options, and keep your hands on the keyboard while driving.
faq: What is the goal of Euro Truck Driving Game?
The goal is to transport valuable cargo across European roads by completing missions. Each delivery is a new challenge to finish.
Which keys control the truck?
W or the Up arrow moves the truck forward, S or the Down arrow moves it back, A or the Left arrow moves left, and D or the Right arrow moves right. Buttons are clicked with the mouse.

basketball-life-3d.intro: Basketball Life 3D is a sports game that tests your timing and shooting skills. Work through levels that range from classic hoop challenges to trick shots, all played with a mouse click or tap.
tips: Pay attention to your timing before each shot, since the game is built around it. Waiting a moment to line up your release often matters more than shooting quickly.
Start each level by getting a feel for the classic hoop challenges before attempting trick shots. Learning the rhythm early makes the harder levels easier to handle.
Take a short look at the layout of each level before you shoot. Noticing where the hoop sits in the 3D space helps you judge the angle.
If you miss, think about whether your timing or your aim was off, and adjust only that part on the next try. Changing too many things at once makes it hard to improve.
Keep your clicks or taps steady and deliberate rather than rapid. Calm, controlled input tends to be more consistent across levels.
faq: What is the goal of Basketball Life 3D?
The goal is to complete the levels by making your shots, which range from classic hoop challenges to trick shots. Each level is designed to test your skill and timing.
How do I control the basketball?
You play by clicking the mouse or tapping the screen. The same input is used for every shot in the game.

gangster-crime-car-simulator-1.intro: Gangster Crime Car Simulator is a driving game where you pick up gangster passengers in a city and get them to a secret location before time runs out. Police cars are chasing you while you race the clock.
tips: Check the map or your phone for the next pickup before you need it, so you can plan your route through the city instead of reacting at the last second.
Keep your speed under control near busy oncoming traffic, because a crash damages your car and costs you the fare.
Use the time you have to take the fastest safe route, and avoid long detours that will cost you the clock.
Complete several pickups in a row, since the game says multiple pickups unlock better sports cars to drive.
Try both keyboard and touch or tilt controls if available, and pick the one that gives you the steadiest steering at high speed.
faq: What is the goal of Gangster Crime Car Simulator?
Drive to each gangster's location, pick them up, and get them to the next secret location on time. Collect fares as you complete each trip.
What happens if I crash into traffic?
Crashing into busy oncoming traffic damages your crime car and you lose your fare for that passenger.

formula-rush-online.intro: Formula Rush Online is a 3D formula car racing simulation with twenty racers on each map. Steer with WASD or the arrow keys and aim to finish in the top three over five laps.
tips: Watch the field early on, since there are twenty racers and staying out of trouble in the crowd matters as much as speed.
Slow down when you are going into a wheel-spin, because the game specifically warns against holding speed through it.
Ease off the throttle before corners and get back on it once the car is pointing where you want to go.
Pace yourself across all five laps rather than burning out early, so you still have grip and control at the finish.
Treat each map as a chance to learn its layout, since you need a top-three finish there to unlock new maps.
faq: How do I unlock new maps?
You need to finish in the first three places over five laps on the current map. Winning a top-three finish is the requirement stated for unlocking the next map.
What keys do I use to drive?
You can use either the WASD keys or the arrow keys to control the car.

the-warlock-s-prisoner.intro: The Warlock's Prisoner is a dark adventure where you wake up trapped in a warlock's lair. You must explore corridors, collect items, solve puzzles, and survive zombie attacks to escape.
tips: Search every area carefully and pick up items you find, since you will need them later to solve puzzles.
Open your inventory with the TAB key on desktop regularly so you remember what you are carrying and which items might fit a puzzle.
Gather clues before trying a puzzle, and note any symbols or details you spot in the environment.
If you get stuck, press H on desktop to use the hint feature rather than wandering the same corridors.
Keep an eye on your surroundings in dark areas, and rotate your view often so zombies do not catch you off guard.
faq: What is the goal of The Warlock's Prisoner?
Your goal is to escape the warlock's lair by exploring, finding items, solving puzzles, and surviving encounters with zombies.
How do I interact with objects on desktop?
Use the E key or the left mouse button to interact with items. On mobile, tap the icon in the center of the screen.

magic-tri-peaks-solitaire.intro: Magic Tri Peaks Solitaire is a card puzzle where you remove board cards one value higher or lower than your drawn card. Levels change in layout and card placement, and boosters add extra ways to clear the board.
tips: Before each move, check which board cards are one value above or below the card you drew, and look for the move that opens up more playable cards.
Plan a few moves ahead, since the board and layout change between levels and a quick pick can leave you stuck later.
Save boosters for difficult boards rather than using them on easy starts, so you have them when you run out of options.
Use the Eye to check the top card of the deck before committing to a move, which helps you choose a path that avoids running out of cards.
Use the Hammer when many hidden cards are blocking your options, since flipping a group of them can open new choices quickly.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You need to remove all the cards from the playing field without running out of cards from your supply.
How do I remove a card from the board?
Select a card that is exactly one higher or one lower in value than the card you drew from the deck.

ultimate-stunt-car-challenge.intro: Ultimate Stunt Car Challenge is a 3D car racing game with single player and 2 player modes. You drive over challenging tracks, perform stunts, and try to stay balanced with the arrow keys.
tips: Use the LEFT and RIGHT ARROW keys to keep the car balanced, especially when you are in the air or on a steep section.
Hold the UP ARROW to build speed, but ease off before jumps so the car does not land nose-first.
Use the DOWN ARROW to slow down or reverse when you need to correct your position on a difficult stretch.
Learn each track's layout in single player mode before you try to race against a friend in 2 player mode.
Try small balance corrections rather than large swings, since overcorrecting can throw the car off its line.
faq: How do I control the car?
Use the UP ARROW to go forward and the DOWN ARROW to go back. The LEFT and RIGHT ARROW keys help you keep the car balanced.
What are the two game modes?
You can play alone in single player mode or race a friend in 2 player mode. The game describes the 2 player mode as real-time competition.

lift-defender-zombie-carnage.intro: Lift Defender Zombie Carnage puts you in charge of an elevator guard post in a skyscraper shelter after a zombie outbreak. Stop the monsters from moving between floors and keep the survivors safe.
tips: Watch each floor before you open the elevator path, since the goal is to stop monsters from reaching the floors above and below.
Spend the money you earn on new weapons as soon as you can afford them, so you are better equipped for harder levels.
Try different weapons from the selection to find the ones that feel most effective against the zombies you face most often.
Rescue people when the chance comes up, because saving survivors is one of the core objectives alongside clearing floors.
Take a short break between levels to plan which weapon to unlock next, rather than rushing through the shop.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You guard the elevators of a skyscraper shelter and must stop emerging zombies from getting from floor to floor. Clearing floors and saving people are the main objectives.
How do you earn money and what do you use it for?
You earn money during play, and you can use it to unlock new weapons. Choosing which weapons to unlock first is an important part of your progress.

zombie-vs-gorilla.intro: Zombies vs Gorillas is a lane defense game where you protect a banana garden from waves of zombies and mythical monsters. You grab falling bananas for ammo and fire banana throws down each lane.
tips: Grab falling bananas as soon as they appear, since your ammo comes from them and running out leaves a lane undefended.
Watch which lane has the most incoming enemies and send your shots there first before they reach your defense line on the left.
Use the (+) button above a gorilla when a lane is under pressure, so its attack power rises during the fight.
Collect gold coins whenever you see them, because they fund permanent shop upgrades and recruiting allies like Bora, Mira, and Kaya.
Use the 1x and 2x speed buttons to slow down or speed up the action once you are comfortable with the lane rhythm.
faq: How do I win a level?
You must clear all enemy waves and defeat the final boss. Stopping any enemies from breaching your defense line on the left keeps the level going.
What are gold coins used for?
Gold coins let you buy permanent shop upgrades and recruit allies such as Bora, Mira, and Kaya to strengthen your defense.

tri-peaks-emerland-solitaire.intro: Tri Peaks Emerland Solitaire is a card puzzle set in a fantasy land of forests and bluffs. You clear the playing field by matching cards one value above or below the card you draw.
tips: Before each move, check which cards on the field are one higher or one lower than your drawn card, so you can see your options at a glance.
Watch your supply as well as the field. You lose if you run out of cards before the layout is clear, so avoid moves that waste your draws.
When you have more than one valid match, pick the one that opens up cards underneath, since clearing a card can free up others.
Save wild cards for tricky spots where no normal match is available, rather than using them early when you have other choices.
Earn stars by playing with skill, so think ahead about each move instead of clearing cards at random.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Remove every card from the playing field before you run out of cards in your supply.
How do I remove a card from the field?
Select a card that is one higher or one lower in value than your drawn card.

growwars-io.intro: GrowWars.io is an arena battle game where superhero fighters evolve as you slash opponents. It can be played alone or with a friend on the same keyboard.
