tips: Earn coins in each battle so you can save up for new equipment or heroes in the shop.
Use Dash to get out of trouble or close distance quickly, rather than only attacking head-on.
Keep an eye on your opponent's position and attack when they are close enough to hit, instead of swinging at empty space.
In two player mode, agree with your friend on who handles which role in the arena so you do not get in each other's way.
Spend your first coins on equipment or a hero that suits how you like to fight, then build from there.
faq: What is the goal of GrowWars.io?
Step into the arena, slash your opponents, and earn coins to buy new equipment or heroes in the shop.
What are the controls for Player 1?
Use W, A, S, and D to move, F to attack, and G to dash.

hydro-racing-3d.intro: Hydro Racing 3D is a boat racing game with single and two-player modes. You can race, drive freely around the water parkour, or work through the career mode chapters.
tips: Save nitrous for the straights and the stretches after corners, since it gives the biggest speed boost when you have room to use it.
Use the camera view switch to pick the angle that lets you read the water ahead best, especially before tight turns.
If you get stuck or drift off course in the parkour, use the restart key early rather than losing time trying to recover.
In free driving mode, try the different parts of the map to learn how your boat handles on turns before entering a race.
In two-player mode, each player uses their own key set, so agree on who takes which side of the keyboard before starting to avoid mix-ups.
faq: What is the goal of Hydro Racing 3D?
The main goal is to race your boat through the water course and beat your opponent or the race. You can also drive freely or progress through the career mode chapters.
How do I control the boat in Player 1 mode?
Use W, A, S and D to move the boat. Press L-SHIFT to use nitrous for a speed boost.

city-husle.intro: City Hustle is a 3D arcade driving game where you deliver packages, earn cash, and build your reputation while staying ahead of the police in a colorful city.
tips: Keep your eyes on the blue route so you always know where the next delivery is. Glancing at it often helps you avoid wrong turns that cost time.
Use WSAD for smooth steering and speed control rather than sudden changes. Gentle inputs help you stay in control in busy streets.
Save your cash for unlocking new cars when you can. A better car may make deliveries and police escapes easier.
Watch for police cars and change your route early instead of waiting until they are close. Avoiding contact is the easiest way to keep your run going.
Check the on-screen controls at the start so you know all the options before you begin. Knowing them in advance keeps you focused on the road.
faq: What is the main goal of City Hustle?
Your goal is to complete deliveries, earn cash, and build your reputation while staying away from the police. Following the blue route is the main way to progress.
How do I move and drive?
Use the W, A, S, and D keys to move and drive. You can also use the on-screen controls if you prefer.

unboxing-brainrots.intro: Unboxing Brainrots is an arcade game about opening cases to find Italian animals, then upgrading weapons, breeding pets, and building a base. This guide covers controls and habits that help you collect more.
tips: Hit boxes steadily rather than rushing, since every case holds a surprise and you can keep going at your own pace.
Keep an eye on which rare animals you already have so you can spot new combinations when you breed pets.
Upgrade your weapons before taking on harder challenges so you are better prepared for them.
Mine resources regularly and spend them on building your base, so your progress keeps growing between case openings.
Try different pets in your team to see which combinations unlock new creatures.
faq: How do I open a case on PC?
Move with W, A, S, and D, then left-click to hit the box. Use mouse movement to move the camera.
How do I open a case on a phone?
Use the joystick on the left side of the screen to move, drag on the right side to control the camera, and tap the screen to hit the box.

crazy-bar-brawl.intro: Crazy Bar Brawl is a physics-based action game where you throw objects at rowdy bar patrons. Aim, throw, and smash your way through chaotic bars and wild enemies.
tips: Aim before you throw, since accuracy decides whether your object reaches the target or the enemies you want to hit.
Try different throwables, because each item behaves differently and can create different results in the same fight.
Spend upgrades on throwing strength or accuracy early, so later bars with tougher enemies are easier to handle.
Watch how enemies stumble, fall, and crash into walls, and look for objects in the environment that can knock over several targets at once.
Unlock new bars and levels to see new enemies and layouts, and adjust your approach to each one's setup.
faq: What is the basic goal of Crazy Bar Brawl?
Smash everything in your path by throwing objects at enemies and the bar around them. Each fight is built around chaotic, physics-driven hits.
How do I aim and throw?
Use your mouse or touch controls to aim at a target, then press the Throw button to launch your object.

block-puzzle-prize-mania.intro: Block Puzzle: Prize Mania combines a classic block-drop grid with a collection of items you bring into each match. Plan your loadout and piece placement together to clear more lines per move.
tips: Choose a loadout of up to three items that support each other, such as one for score, one for clearing blocks, and one that changes board rules.
Before placing a piece, look at all three shapes at the bottom and think about which order keeps the grid open for the next move.
Aim for moves that clear several rows or columns at once, since bigger combos earn better rewards.
Keep gaps in the grid narrow and avoid isolated holes, because the match ends as soon as no remaining piece can fit.
Learn how your active items work before you need them, so you can use bombs, lightning, or undo at the right moment.
faq: What is the goal of Block Puzzle: Prize Mania?
Drag the three shapes onto the grid to fill complete rows or columns. The match ends when none of your remaining pieces can fit on the board.
How do items affect a match?
Before each match you pick up to three items. Some trigger automatically, while others can be activated manually for effects like bombs, lightning strikes, or an undo move.

angry-sharks.intro: Angry Sharks is a hypercasual game where you control a mutated shark that eats fish to grow. Your goal is to eat safely while avoiding bigger fish, spiky fish, and the dangers in the sea.
tips: Start by eating the smaller fish near you, since growing gives you a safer position for the bigger threats later.
Before you move toward a fish, check whether it is bigger than you or spiky, and steer away from it if it is.
Keep an eye on barrels, mines, and spears as you swim, and plan your route a little ahead so you are not forced into them.
Move in smooth, steady motions with the mouse or your finger rather than sudden jerks, which makes it easier to dodge obstacles.
Look at the whole screen between grabs instead of focusing only on one fish, so you can spot incoming hazards early.
faq: How do I control the shark?
You can steer the shark with the mouse cursor or by moving your finger across the screen.
How does the shark grow?
Eat the fish that swim toward you. The more fish you eat, the bigger the shark becomes.

yummy-waffle-ice-cream.intro: Yummy Waffle Ice Cream is a cooking and decorating game where you make a waffle and top it with ice cream, fruit and syrup. You select items and tools with a mouse click or a tap.
tips: Pick your base and toppings first, then decorate, so you can see how each layer looks before adding more.
Mix fruit and syrup for balance, since a few bright toppings often look better than covering the whole waffle.
Place ice cream on the waffle before adding fruit so the fruit sits on top and stays visible.
Try different fruit and syrup combinations to find flavors you enjoy, since the game allows any kind of fruit and syrup.
Use the tools and buttons one at a time and check the result after each step, so you can undo or adjust before moving on.
faq: What is the goal of Yummy Waffle Ice Cream?
The goal is to make a waffle and decorate it with ice cream, fruits and syrups. You are the waffle maker.
How do I choose items and tools?
On desktop, click items, tools and buttons to interact with them. On mobile, touch the screen to select and apply your choices.

halloween-stickman-2.intro: Halloween Stickman 2 is a spooky stickman game where you watch a story animation and choose how to get back at your trickster friend, Stickman. Each choice shapes the fun of the festive chaos.
tips: Watch the story animation through before you choose anything, since the setup often shows what Stickman has been up to.
Click every punishment button at least once before deciding, so you know all your options and can pick the one that suits your mood.
Pay attention to the details in each punishment scene, because the Halloween and ghost themes are where the game's humor comes through.
If you want to see something different, go back and try another punishment instead of settling on your first pick.
Play with a mouse for the most precise clicks, or use a stylus or finger if you are on a mobile device and take your time with each button.
faq: What is the goal of Halloween Stickman 2?
Your goal is to outsmart your friend Stickman and get revenge by choosing a punishment for him. The game is built around the story and his tricks.
How do I control the game?
Use a computer mouse to click. On a mobile device, you can use a stylus or your finger instead.

world-of-alice-footprints.intro: World of Alice Footprints is a puzzle game for children that teaches animal footprints. You match each footprint to the animal that made it by clicking the correct animal.
tips: Look closely at the shape of the footprint before you choose. Notice the number of toes and whether the prints have claws, pads, or hooves.
Compare the footprint to the animals on screen one by one, rather than guessing from the first animal you see.
If you are unsure, say the animal's name out loud and think about where it lives or how it moves. This can help you recall its footprint.
Play at a relaxed pace. Taking a moment to study each print usually works better than clicking quickly.
Try to remember the footprints you get wrong, then look for them again in later rounds to strengthen what you have learned.
faq: What is the goal of World of Alice Footprints?
The goal is to learn different animal footprints by clicking the animal that matches each footprint shown.
How do I play?
Click on the animal that matches the footprint displayed on the screen.

chubby-finn.intro: Chubby Finn is a Sokoban-style puzzle where you guide a chubby seal to push balls onto their target spots. Each level is a logic challenge, so planning moves before you act is the key skill.
tips: Look at the whole level before your first move, and note which balls are closest to a target and which ones are in awkward spots.
Remember that balls can only be pushed, never pulled, so avoid shoving a ball into a corner or against a wall where it cannot be moved again.
Think a few steps ahead: before pushing a ball, check that Finn can reach the square behind it to push it where you want.
If you get stuck, undo your last few moves rather than continuing, since a single wrong push can make a level unsolvable.
Solve the easier-looking balls first only if doing so does not block the path to the remaining targets.
faq: How do I move Finn?
Use the arrow buttons to move Finn up, down, left, or right, one square at a time.
What is the goal of each level?
Push every ball into its correct target position to solve the level.

hoop-kings.intro: Hoop Kings is a basketball puzzle game where you score points by solving challenges. This guide covers the controls and some habits that can help you score more.
tips: Before each move, check where the ball needs to go to score, and pick the direction that gets it closer to the goal.
Use short, deliberate swipes or single arrow key presses so you don't overshoot your target.
Plan a few moves ahead rather than reacting only to the ball's current position.
If a challenge isn't working, stop and try a different route instead of repeating the same moves.
Play in shorter sessions at first to get comfortable with how the ball responds to each direction.
faq: What is the goal of Hoop Kings?
The goal is to score points by solving basketball-themed challenges. Each challenge is a puzzle that you work through by moving the ball.
How do I move the basketball?
On a keyboard, use the arrow keys to move the ball left, right, up, or down. On a touch screen, swipe in the same four directions.

rocket-rush.intro: Rocket Rush is a 3D arcade flying challenge where you steer a rocket through 20 handcrafted levels to reach a target before your fuel runs out. Earn stars by finishing faster and unlock new rockets and equipment.
tips: Keep an eye on your fuel gauge from the start and plan your route so you do not run dry before reaching the target.
Grab fuel cans when they are on or near your path, since they keep you in the air for the rest of the run.
Use boost in short bursts on straight stretches rather than holding it constantly, so you still have fuel for tight sections.
Replay earlier levels to improve your completion time, because faster runs earn more stars.
Spend your earned credits on rockets and equipment that suit the route you struggle with, such as a parachute for longer descents.
faq: What is the goal of Rocket Rush?
Your goal is to guide your rocket to the target in each level before you run out of fuel. Avoiding obstacles and finishing quickly both matter.
How do I earn more stars?
Stars are earned by improving your completion time on a level. Replaying levels and flying cleaner, faster routes will earn you more.

demolition-tycoon-3d.intro: Demolition Tycoon 3D is a clicker where you hold to strike buildings, earn coins, and grow a demolition fleet across districts. Each hit makes you stronger, so steady progress comes from spending coins wisely.
tips: Hold your strike steadily rather than tapping rapidly, since the game is built around holding to attack.
Spend early coins on power and profit upgrades first, because they make every later hit and every later contract pay off faster.
Check speed and critical hit upgrades before buying a bigger machine, so you know which investment is actually raising your income.
Pay attention to the material of each building, since wood, brick, concrete, metal and glass all react differently to impacts.
Save for a new machine once your current setup feels slow, and keep an eye on which contracts you can finish with it.
faq: What is the main goal of Demolition Tycoon 3D?
Break buildings apart, earn coins, and complete the 80 contracts across the seven districts. Later you can continue into tougher contracts after the campaign.
How do I attack a building?
Hold the mouse or touch on the demolition button or building, or hold Space on the keyboard. Holding is how you keep striking.

archer-defense.intro: Archer Defense is an arcade tower defense game where you protect your castle from endless waves of monsters. Shoot enemies, earn gold, and upgrade your archer to last longer.
tips: Spend your early gold on upgrades that help you kill enemies faster, since clearing each wave quickly leaves you more time to prepare for the next one.
Let your archers handle nearby enemies automatically and save your own aiming for targets that are farther away or harder to reach.
Try to clear every enemy in a wave before the next one arrives, because monsters left on the field make later waves harder to manage.
Keep an eye on which upgrades you are buying. Balancing damage, speed, and abilities usually works better than putting all your gold into one area.
Since your score rises the longer you survive, focus on steady defense rather than risky shots that could leave your castle exposed.
faq: What is the main goal of Archer Defense?
Your goal is to defend your castle from endless waves of monsters. Survive as long as you can to get the highest score.
How do I shoot arrows?
Use the mouse or tap the screen to aim and shoot. Your archers also attack nearby enemies automatically.

squidly-game-123-stop.intro: Squidly Game: 123, Stop is a 3D hypercasual challenge inspired by the Squid Game show. You knock down competitors while following the on-screen instructions and staying in the game.
tips: Read the instructions before each round starts, since the game says to follow them closely.
Watch the timing carefully, because the game warns that being late means you are out.
Use the mouse and keyboard together so you can react quickly during the challenge.
Focus on staying in the game rather than only knocking down rivals, since avoiding elimination is what earns prizes.
Stay calm and keep an eye on your competitors' positions so you can time your moves.
faq: What is the main goal of Squidly Game: 123, Stop?
Your goal is to knock down your competitors while following the instructions. The game says that avoiding elimination is what lets you earn prizes.
What happens if I am late?
The game says that being late means you are dead, so you are eliminated from the challenge.

tetradice-merge-and-blast-blocks.intro: TetraDice is a puzzle game that mixes Tetris-style placement with dice-based shapes. You build combinations on the field, clear lines, and try to earn as many points as you can.
tips: Before placing a figure, look at the whole field and think about where the next few pieces could fit, not just the current one.
Rotate a figure with a click or tap before you commit to a spot, so you can check how it fits the gaps around it.
Aim for combinations that match the provided figures, since more matches earn more points.
In adventure mode, read the assigned tasks for each level first and plan your placements around completing them.
In classic mode, keep the field open and avoid burying gaps, because the game ends when you can no longer place figures.
faq: What is the goal of TetraDice?
Your goal is to create combinations using the provided figures. You earn points for successful combinations and special tasks, and more matches give more points.
How do I move and rotate figures on PC?
Use the left mouse button to select a figure, rotate it, and move it across the playing field.

ninja-obby-speed-run.intro: Ninja Obby Speed Run is a 3D obstacle course racer where you move through courses quickly, using jumps, sprints, and bonuses. This guide covers the controls and habits that help you get through runs faster.
tips: Learn the double jump early by tapping the jump key twice, since it can help you reach higher ledges and gaps.
Hold the forward key to sprint on long straight sections, then ease off before tricky jumps so you land with control.
Use checkpoints to reset your pace: smashing the glass doors with your ninja power is a good moment to check your path ahead.
When you get a speed boost, giant mode, or flight, plan your route around its effect instead of using it at random.
During flight, aim for the golden rings in the sky to collect coins, which you can spend on items in the shop.
faq: How do I move and jump in Ninja Obby Speed Run?
Player 1 uses WASD to move and SPACE to jump. Player 2 uses the Arrow Keys to move and L to jump.
How do I do a double jump?
Double-tap the jump button to perform a double jump. Use it to reach platforms that a single jump cannot clear.

bonk-islands.intro: Bonk Islands is a physics battle game where four fighters knock each other off floating islands above rising lava. You aim, fire unusual weapons, and try to be the last fighter standing.
tips: Before each shot, check where the lava is and how close it has risen to your island so you know how much room you have.
Use the optional jump before firing when you need extra height or distance, but remember you can still land in danger.
Aim for the edge of an opponent's island rather than their center, since a push toward the drop-off sends them flying more often.
Watch how the terrain crumbles after each hit, because a weakened island can give way under you or your rivals.
Some weapons need you to pick a spot on the map instead of aiming, so take a moment to choose a target that keeps you on solid ground.
faq: What is the goal of Bonk Islands?
The goal is to knock your rivals off the islands and stay out of the lava. The last fighter standing wins the battle.
How do I aim and fire a weapon?
Choose a weapon, drag back to aim, and release to shoot. Press GO to launch your attack.

king-boxing-2024.intro: King Boxing 2024 is a boxing game where you pick one of 8 boxers and fight your way through the arena against tougher opponents. Use WASD to move, Z to attack, and C to defend.
tips: Don't attack non-stop. Throw a few strikes, then press C to defend so you don't take a string of hits.
Watch your opponent's movements before you commit. If they're setting up a punch, defending first can open a window for your own attack.
Use WASD to reposition after each exchange so you're not standing still in front of a strong opponent.
Pick the boxer whose style suits you, since your choice affects how you approach each fight.
Pace yourself across the arena. Opponents get harder with each win, so save your energy for the tougher fights.
faq: What is the goal of King Boxing 2024?
Your goal is to win fights one after another, facing harder opponents each time, until you become champion.
What do the controls do?
WASD moves your boxer, Z attacks, and C defends. Balancing attacks and defense is the core of the game.

craft-the-war.intro: Craft the War is a fast first-person shooter set on compact industrial battlefields. Join or create a multiplayer room, pick your loadout, and fight rival soldiers in team or free-for-all matches.
tips: Choose your loadout before the match starts, and pick a weapon type that suits how you like to fight at close or long range.
Use Tab to check the scoreboard often so you know where enemies are gathering and how your team is doing against the match score.
Because the battlefields are compact, keep moving and use Crouch and Sprint to change position rather than staying in one spot.
Reload with R during quieter moments instead of in the middle of a firefight, and use the number keys or mouse wheel to switch to a backup weapon when needed.
In team modes, focus on the match objective as well as kills, since helping your team reach the score is what decides the match.
faq: What is the goal of Craft the War?
In team modes, you and your team try to reach the match score or objective before the other side does. In free-for-all modes, the aim is to earn the highest score before time runs out.
How do I move and aim?
Use WASD to move and the mouse to look and aim. Hold the right mouse button to aim down sights and press the left mouse button to fire.

cowboy-survival-zombie.intro: Cowboy Survival Zombie is a 2D shooter where you play a cowboy in an old west world overrun by zombies. You farm, gather resources, build a shelter, and fight to last as many days as you can.
tips: Plant and harvest early, since food keeps you going while zombies press in. Eating regularly is part of staying alive.
Gather resources before you need them, so you can repair or expand your shelter when the attacks get heavier.
Use W to jump and climb ladders, and S to climb back down. Getting up and down quickly helps you escape zombies and reach higher ground.
Left-click to shoot and right-click to switch figure build. Save your shots for the zombies that are closest to you, and keep moving between shots.
The world can be destroyed, so check your walls and structures after each fight. Fix weak spots before the next wave arrives.
faq: What is the main goal of Cowboy Survival Zombie?
Your goal is to survive as many days as possible and kill as many zombies as you can. Balancing farming, building, and shooting is the key to lasting longer.
Which keys control movement in the game?
Use A and D to move left and right, W to jump or climb a ladder, and S to climb down a ladder. Left-click shoots and right-click changes figure build.

angry-grandmother-run.intro: Angry Grandmother Run is an endless 3D runner where you play as a nimble granny sprinting through the streets of sunny Miami. Dodge obstacles and collect gold coins as you go.
tips: Watch the road ahead rather than your character, so you can react early to cars, surfboards and airships.
Use jump for low obstacles like cars and surfboards, and slide for airships, so you learn which move each obstacle needs.
Use the turn keys early to line up with a clear lane before an obstacle reaches you, instead of turning at the last second.
Keep moving between the lanes to pick up gold coins, but do not turn so much that you lose track of the next obstacle.
Practice reading the pattern of obstacles, since the run keeps going and staying calm helps you make the right move each time.
faq: What is the goal of Angry Grandmother Run?
The goal is to keep running as far as you can while dodging obstacles and collecting as many gold coins as possible.
How do I jump and slide?
Press the Up Arrow to jump and the Down Arrow to slide. Jump over cars and surfboards, and slide under airships.

pirate-cannon-a-mega-battle.intro: Pirate Cannon A Mega Battle is a bubble shooter where you fire numbered cannonballs at enemy pirate boats. Match the numbers on the boats to sink them and clear every ship before your cannonballs run out.
tips: Check the number on your cannonball before you aim, so you know which boats it can hit.
Look for a boat with a matching number that sits at the edge of a cluster, since shots there are easier to land.
Count your remaining cannonballs regularly so you can decide whether a safe shot or a bigger, riskier one makes more sense.
Aim carefully and take a moment before releasing, because each shot uses one of your limited cannonballs.
Work through the cluster gradually rather than targeting random boats, so each shot opens a clear path to the next match.
faq: What is the goal of Pirate Cannon A Mega Battle?
Your goal is to sink all the enemy pirate ships floating above the water by matching their numbers with your cannonballs. You win by clearing every ship before you run out of cannonballs.
How do I aim and fire the cannon?
On desktop, drag with the mouse to aim the cannon and release to fire. On touch controls, drag to aim and release to fire the same way.

dreamblox.intro: DreamBlox is a multiplayer game about collecting coins, buying pets and accessories, and training your pets in tricks at a special school. You explore the world to find new places and activities.
tips: Collect coins before spending them, since you need them for both pets and accessories.
Browse the shops before buying so you can compare what each one offers.
Decide whether a new pet or an accessory is the better purchase before you spend your coins.
Take a pet to the special school once you have one you want to train, so your coins go toward tricks you will actually use.
Explore all the locations early, because the game points to new entertainment opportunities in each one.
faq: What is the main goal of DreamBlox?
The game is about collecting coins, buying pets and accessories, and training your pets in tricks at the special school. Exploring the world and discovering new entertainment is part of the fun.
How do I earn coins?
You collect coins as you explore the world. The coins you earn are used to buy pets and accessories in the shops.

kalulu-tanhulu-asmr-mukbang.intro: Kalulu Tanhulu: ASMR Mukbang is a cooking and streaming game where you prepare desserts and drinks, then go live so Kalulu can eat them for your viewers. Your aim is to grow your audience and collect donations.
tips: Start with Tanghulu, since it is the main dish in the game and a good way to learn the cooking steps.
Try different fruits such as strawberries and grapes to see which combinations look best on your skewers.
Unlock Boba Tea early so you have more variety to show on stream, since viewers are drawn to different foods.
Keep an eye on viewer requests during your streams and fulfill them when you can, as this is how you receive donations.
Use the shop for ready-made food when you are short on time, and save your own cooking for dishes you want to show off.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Your main goal is to host live streams, eat delicious food, and attract as many viewers as possible. The more entertaining your stream, the more popular you become.
How do viewers grow in number?
The more diverse food you try on stream, the more viewers will join you. Trying a wider range of dishes is the key to growing your audience.

ice-cream-inc.intro: Ice Cream Inc. is a hypercasual game where you build an ice cream that matches the reference picture shown at the top of the screen. You make each ice cream by pressing number keys or tapping the screen.
tips: Look at the target picture at the top before you start, and note the order of the layers or toppings you need.
Work through the steps one at a time and check the ice cream against the picture after each press.
If you press a number by mistake, compare your result with the picture to decide whether to keep going or adjust.
Keep your eyes on the picture rather than the number keys, so you can spot small differences in color and shape.
Once your ice cream matches the picture, press the number button to finish it and enjoy the treat.
faq: What is the goal of Ice Cream Inc.?
The goal is to make an ice cream that looks the same as the picture shown at the top of the screen.
How do I control the game?
Press the number keys on your keyboard or tap the number buttons on the screen.

moto-stunts-driving-racing.intro: Moto Stunts Driving & Racing is a side-scrolling motorcycle race with 2D cartoon riders. You steer with WASD or the arrow keys, aiming to finish fast while keeping your rider alive.
tips: Watch the track ahead for traps and gaps before you commit to speed, since crashing into a trap ends the run.
Treat your starting bike as a way to finish the course, not a way to set fast times. Save coins to buy a better motorcycle if you want to push your records.
Keep an eye on your rider's body parts as you land and recover, because falling to the ground with them loses the game.
Try both Racing Mode and Level Mode, since the same skills carry over but the challenge in each is different.
Check the Lottery and Tasks regularly for extra coins, which helps you afford the bikes you want sooner.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You need to reach the finish line as fast as you can on each side-scrolling track while keeping your rider alive. Racing Mode and Level Mode both use this goal.
How do I lose a run?
You lose if you crash into any traps or fall to the ground with your rider's body parts. Staying clear of both is the key to finishing.

crash-tower-3d.intro: Crash Tower 3D is a physics destruction arcade game where you launch a vehicle at walls, towers and houses. Time your boost well, earn coins from each impact, and use them to upgrade and repair your vehicles across 30 structures.
tips: Watch the boost marker closely and press Use Boost, or Space, when it reaches the gold zone, since timing decides how hard you hit.
Treat every impact as a source of coins, so aim for the parts of each structure that bring down the most material.
Upgrade each of your three vehicles separately, and pick the one whose strengths suit the structure you are facing.
Check your vehicle's condition before a run and repair it in the garage if it is damaged.
If a structure survives, don't get discouraged. Adjust your launch and boost timing and try again.
faq: How do I start a launch?
Click or tap Start Engine, or press Space, to launch your vehicle.
When should I use the boost?
Use Boost when the marker reaches the gold zone, as the timing of the boost is what you need to focus on.

flippee-ball.intro: Flippee Ball mixes pinball and basketball. Use your flippers to bounce the ball into the basket, either against the computer or a friend on the same device.
tips: Start on the default Easy difficulty with Aim Assist on to learn how the ball travels before raising the challenge.
Since one button flips all five of your flippers at once, focus on timing your presses so the ball is hit when it reaches the flippers rather than mashing the button.
When you feel comfortable, move to Professional speed and then turn Aim Assist off to practise your shot accuracy without help.
In the Flippee Academy, count your touches on each level, since every level only allows a set number, and plan your shots before you start flipping.
Watch your opponent's flippers in the Academy, because you must score before the ball reaches them, so aim for a quick, direct route to the basket.
faq: What is the goal of Flippee Ball?
Use your flippers to hit the ball into the basket. You can play against the computer or another player on the same device.
How do I control the flippers?
You control one set of flippers, either red or blue. A single button flips all five of your flippers at the same time.

knife-vs-fruits.intro: Knife vs Fruits: Just Shoot It is a skill game where you tap to throw knives at rotating fruits, vegetables, and desserts on the kitchen floor. Hit the targets and collect coins to unlock new blades from the shop.
tips: Watch the rotation for a few seconds before you throw. The fruits can spin clockwise or anticlockwise and their speed keeps changing, so timing your tap matters more than tapping quickly.
Aim for the coins that surround each fruit. The instructions say these are how you progress toward hitting all the targets, so collecting them is part of the goal.
Pay attention to the speed changes within a level. If a target has just sped up, wait for it to settle into a steadier rhythm before you commit to a throw.
Save up coins for the shop. Knives, swords, and daggers are available to buy, so earning coins steadily helps you upgrade your throwing options over time.
Prepare for the crazy boss challenge that appears every few levels. Since it is described as tough, take a few steady throws to get used to the pattern before going for big rewards.
faq: What is the goal of Knife vs Fruits?
The goal is to hit and stab all the rotating targets on the kitchen floor and become the greatest knife-throwing maniac. Coins surrounding the fruits are also part of how you progress.
How do I throw a knife?
Just tap on the screen to fling the knife. Each tap throws one knife toward the targets.

dunkers-fight.intro: Dunkers Fight is a two-player basketball game where you and a friend race to grab the ball and score in the pot. Each player has their own keys for moving and shooting.
tips: Watch the countdown closely and be ready to move the moment it ends, since grabbing the ball first is the start of the match.
Stay near the ball when it is loose so you can grab it before your opponent does.
If your opponent takes the ball from your hand, try to take it back quickly rather than waiting, because the pot is at risk.
Stay between the pot and your opponent when you can, so you are in position to protect it.
Learn both shoot controls well so you can switch quickly between moving and throwing without losing your rhythm.
faq: What is the goal of Dunkers Fight?
Grab the ball before your opponent, throw it toward the pot, and stop your opponent from grabbing the ball from your hand and protecting the pot.
Which keys does each player use?
Player 1 moves with the A-D keys and shoots with the W-S keys. Player 2 moves with the Left and Right Arrow keys and shoots with the Up and Down Arrow keys.

obby-upgrade-your-speed.intro: Obby Upgrade Your Speed is a clicker where tapping earns Run Points that make your character run faster. Unlock pets to boost your progress and push for new speed records.
tips: Tap consistently, since every tap earns Run Points and more points mean more speed.
Unlock pets as soon as you can, because they affect how many points each tap gives you, from 2 up to 3.
Compare which pet gives you 3 points per tap and focus your progress on getting it.
Practice moving with WASD or the arrow keys and using Space to jump, so you can keep your run steady while you go faster.
Try to beat your own records by checking your top speed after each session and aiming to exceed it.
faq: How do I get faster in this game?
Tap to earn Run Points, and the more points you have, the faster your character runs.
How do pets help?
Pets boost your progress and change how many points you get per tap, which is either 2 or 3 depending on the pet.

pool-8.intro: Pool 8 is a puzzle game played on a pool table. You pot the balls in the correct order to move through increasingly difficult challenges, starting with the easy rookie level.
tips: Before your first shot, look at the whole table and plan the full sequence of pots, not just the next one.
Check which balls block the path to others, and clear those first so later shots stay open.
Remember that movement is limited to up, down, left, and right, so plan lines that work along those directions.
If you get stuck, use the bonus round's extra retries at the end of a difficulty level to keep your progress going.
Start with the rookie level to learn how the ball order works before moving on to harder layouts.
faq: What is the goal of Pool 8?
Pot the balls in the correct order to clear each table and progress to the next challenge.
Can the balls move diagonally?
No. The balls can only move up, down, left, and right, so there are no diagonal shots.

turbo-racer-extreme.intro: Turbo Racer Extreme is a traffic racing game where you weave between cars to build your score. Pick a mode, stage, and difficulty, then see how far you can go without getting hit.
tips: Score comes from getting close to other cars, so aim to pass near them without touching them. Staying in control at close range pays off more than playing cautiously far away.
Use Space to brake before a tight gap rather than trying to correct at full speed. Slowing down early gives you more room to steer around traffic.
Try time attack when you want to focus on top speed, and one way or two way when you want more traffic to weave through. Each mode asks for a different approach.
Switch between sunny, night, and rainy stages to practice how each one feels. Your reactions may need adjusting when visibility changes.
Start on an easier difficulty to learn the gaps between cars, then raise it once you can avoid bumps consistently. Higher difficulty is a better test once your steering is steady.
faq: How do I steer and brake?
Use WASD or the Left, Right, Up, and Down arrow keys to move. Press Space to brake.
How do I earn points?
You gain points by driving close to other cars. Avoid getting hit or bumped, since that is what keeps your run going.

christmas-sledge-rider-3d.intro: Christmas Sledge Rider 3D is a racing game where you steer a sledge down snowy, icy hills while dodging obstacles. This guide covers how to steer and what to focus on to keep your run going.
tips: Look ahead rather than at your sledge, since spotting obstacles early gives you more time to move left or right.
Make small, steady steering adjustments instead of sharp swerves, which can push you into the path of something else.
Pick a line early on each hill and keep to it, so you are not correcting at the last second.
Keep your attention on the lane you are heading toward rather than the one you just left.
On mobile, keep your finger moving gently with the slide so you can respond quickly without overcorrecting.
faq: How do I steer the sledge?
On desktop, use the A and D keys or the left and right arrow keys. On mobile, hold your finger on the screen and slide left or right.
What is the goal of the game?
You race down icy hills through snowy landscapes while dodging obstacles, and the game is built around sledding your way to victory.

assassin-commando-car-driving.intro: Assassin Commando Car Driving is a vertical car battle arcade game where you drive a 3D cartoon vehicle and fight enemy cars. You use crashes, arm punches, and a machine gun to take them down.
tips: Upgrade the baffle first, as the game recommends, since it helps your car survive the collisions you will be making.
Aim for the backside of enemy vehicles when crashing, because the game notes it is easier than hitting them from the side.
Use the side punch from the mechanic arm when an enemy is next to you, and keep your car close enough for the arm to reach.
Watch the machine gun skill indicator and save your shots for when it is ready instead of firing at random.
Control the car with mouse clicks or taps, and keep moving so you are not an easy target for enemies coming from different directions.
faq: What is the main goal of Assassin Commando Car Driving?
The goal is to battle enemy vehicles by crashing into them, punching them from the side, and shooting them with the machine gun once its skill is ready.
Which upgrade should I get first?
The game suggests upgrading the baffle first. It is the recommended first upgrade before you spend on other parts of your car.

cube-shooter.intro: Cube Shooter is a 3D battle shooter where you loot weapons and eliminate enemies to be the last player standing in fast-paced PvP matches. Move with WASD and shoot with the left mouse button.
tips: Pick up weapons early in each match so you are not caught with only a starting weapon when enemies close in.
Keep moving rather than standing still, since staying in one place makes you an easy target in a PvP fight.
Use the cube-shaped arena layout to break line of sight, stepping out only to shoot and then ducking back out of view.
Watch where enemies are coming from and aim for them before they line up shots on you, because fights in this game are fast.
Focus on surviving first: avoiding unnecessary fights helps you stay in the match until only one player remains.
faq: What is the goal of Cube Shooter?
The goal is to eliminate enemies and be the last player standing in each PvP match.
How do I move and shoot?
Use W, A, S and D to move, and click the left mouse button to shoot.

blind-boat-shooting-master.intro: Blind Boat Shooting Master is a turn-based shooting battle game where you craft a raft, aim, and fire at pirates, thieves, and raft fighters across different lands. Use the slide control to play.
tips: Pay attention to each opponent's position before you fire, since battles are turn-based and you get a clear moment to plan each shot.
Use your early battles to learn how far and how hard your shots travel, then adjust your aim for the tougher foes you meet later.
Gather riches whenever the opportunity appears, because they are part of the goal and can help you progress through new territories.
Try different raft setups and compare how they perform in battle, so you can find one that suits your style.
Study the different characters in the roster, since each opponent may call for a different approach.
faq: What is the main goal of Blind Boat Shooting Master?
You craft your raft, navigate the colorful world, and take aim to defeat foes and gather riches as you explore new territories.
How do battles work?
Battles are turn-based, so you take your shot, then your opponent responds, and you keep alternating until one side is defeated.

catch-the-bear.intro: Catch the Bear is a cozy block-sliding puzzle where you slide blocks to guide bears into holes that match their colors. Levels start simple and add obstacles, routes, and time limits as you go.
tips: Before you move anything, look at where each bear needs to end up and which blocks stand in its way. Working backward from the target color often shows the order of moves.
Watch for blockers early. Clear the paths that lead to the most tangled bears first so you do not trap yourself later.
Try moves in your head before sliding. Since blocks slide freely, a single wrong move can leave a bear stuck behind another block.
If a level becomes tangled, reset your thinking by checking each bear's route one at a time instead of trying to solve everything at once.
Take your time on early levels to learn how the blocks behave. If you enjoy a challenge, try the time limits once you feel comfortable with the planning.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You must place every bear into the hole of its matching color to complete the level.
How do the blocks move?
You slide blocks across the board, and you can move them freely to clear routes for the bears.

supa-tic-tac-toe.intro: Supa Tic Tac Toe, also called Tic-Tac-Deck, is a grid puzzle where you place markers and play cards from your hand. The goal is to get 5 markers in a row before your enemy does.
tips: Each card works only once, so save powerful cards for turns when they can change the outcome instead of spending them on small gains.
Before every move, check whether the enemy has four markers in a line that could become five, and block that line first.
Look for lines of five that have open space at both ends, since a line blocked on one side has fewer ways to finish.
Read the card's sub-screen carefully before committing, so you know exactly which tiles or effects it will affect.
Aim to build a position where you threaten two lines at once, because the enemy may not be able to stop both with one move.
faq: What is the goal of Supa Tic Tac Toe?
Beat the enemy by placing 5 markers horizontally, vertically or diagonally on the grid. The first player to complete a line of five wins.
How do I place a marker on the board?
Click on a free grid tile to place your tic-tac-toe marker. Tiles that are already taken cannot be used.

mtb-downhill-extreme.intro: MTB DownHill Extreme is a mountain biking racing game with four different mountain bikes and both 1 player and 2 player modes. You control your rider with the keyboard, using brakes and a camera switch to get down the course.
tips: Try all four bikes early on to see how each one handles before you settle on a favorite for longer runs.
Use the front brake with SPACE for controlled stops, and save the rear brake for adjusting your line through turns.
Press the camera switch (C for Player 1, O for Player 2) now and then to check the track ahead and plan your next move.
If you fall behind or end up in a bad position, use the restart key (R for Player 1, P for Player 2) to reset quickly and try again.
In 2 player mode, keep an eye on your opponent's line, since the two riders can use the same course at the same time.
faq: How do I control the bike in MTB DownHill Extreme?
Player 1 moves with W, A, S and D, while Player 2 uses the arrow keys. Brakes and the camera switch are on separate keys for each player, as listed in the controls.
What is the difference between the front brake and the rear brake?

The front brake is on SPACE for Player 1 and R-SHIFT for Player 2, and the rear brake is on S for Player 1 and the down arrow for Player 2. Test both on a quiet stretch of track to learn how each one slows your bike.

draw-pixels-heroes-face.intro: Draw Pixels Heroes Face is an action game where you copy a pixel image shown below. Using only your mouse, you place each color in the right spot until your drawing matches the example.
tips: Compare your canvas with the reference image after every few moves, so small mistakes don't pile up.
Work one color at a time: finish all the spots that share a color before switching, which keeps you from mixing them up.
Start with the large areas like the background or hair, then fill in smaller details such as eyes and outlines.
Check the exact row and column of each pixel against the reference before clicking, since a single misplaced pixel is easy to miss.
Move your mouse slowly and steadily when placing pixels near edges, so you don't accidentally color the wrong square.
faq: What is the goal of Draw Pixels Heroes Face?
The goal is to draw the same image as the one shown below, putting the right color in the right place. Your drawing should match the example.
How do I control the game?
The game uses only the mouse. Click to select colors and place pixels on the drawing area.

car-escape-parking.intro: Car Escape Parking is a sliding puzzle where you clear a crowded lot so a trapped car can get out. Each level adds more cars and tighter spaces, so planning ahead matters.
tips: Before you drag anything, look at which car is blocking the exit and which cars are blocking that car. Solve the chain from the outside in.
Move cars one step at a time and check the board after each move. A small shift can open a path that a big move would close.
Avoid pushing cars into spots where they will trap another car later. Parking a car in a dead end often costs more moves to undo.
If you get stuck, step back to an earlier position rather than forcing more moves. Undoing a bad idea is usually faster than fixing it.
Keep the trapped car's route in mind from the start, and move other cars out of its lane first so you do not have to reshuffle them later.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Clear the parking lot by moving cars in the right order so the trapped car has a safe path out.
How do I move a car?
Drag a car to slide it forward or backward along its lane. Cars can only move in the direction they are set up to travel.

halloween-stickman.intro: Halloween Stickman is a spooky story game where you get revenge on a tricky friend by rewinding time. Your choices shape how the story unfolds, so each decision matters.
tips: Watch the full story animation before you choose anything, since it sets up the situation you need to respond to.
Click every punishment button to see all the options before you commit, because each one reveals a different outcome.
Think about what each punishment says about your goal, since your choices influence how the story ends.
After using time rewinding, try a different punishment to compare how the story changes.
Tap or click deliberately on a phone or tablet so you do not select a punishment by accident.
faq: How do I control the game?
Use a computer mouse to click. On a mobile device, use a stylus or your finger.
What is the goal of Halloween Stickman?
You take revenge on your tricky friend, the Stickman, by choosing a way to punish them and rewinding time to shape the outcome.

chips-bakery-simulator.intro: Chips Bakery Simulator is a cooking game where you run a potato chip factory. You wash, slice, fry, season, and bag the chips, then sell them to customers. Play with mouse clicks or taps.
tips: Work through the steps in order: wash the potatoes, slice them, fry them, season them, then bag them. Skipping a step usually means you have less to sell.
Keep an eye on each stage so nothing sits too long. Move on when a batch is ready instead of waiting for the next step to start on its own.
Aim for a good golden colour when frying, since the game describes the goal as golden perfection. Pull the batch at the right moment rather than letting it overcook.
Try different seasonings to see how each one changes your product. Use the flavours that suit the batch you are making.
Bag finished chips promptly and sell them while customers are waiting. Keeping your stock moving helps your sales keep growing.
faq: What is the goal of Chips Bakery Simulator?
The goal is to run a full potato chip factory and sell your bagged chips to customers. Each part of the process, from washing to selling, feeds into that goal.
How do I control the game?
Use mouse clicks or taps to perform each action. There are no other controls mentioned in the instructions.

join-clash-epic-battle.intro: Join Clash Epic Battle is an arcade running game where you grow your group of followers before the battle starts. You steer through obstacles and then face the enemy to win.
tips: Drag gently and early so you can react to obstacles before they reach your group.
Focus on bringing more people into your ranks, since a bigger group gives you more to work with when the clash begins.
Watch the path ahead rather than only the obstacle right in front of you, so you can line up your next move in time.
Avoid rushing into fatal obstacles; a small detour is usually safer than a risky straight run.
Keep your attention on the enemy stage at the end, and save your strength for the final clash.
faq: What is the goal of Join Clash Epic Battle?
Expand your ranks by bringing your own people into the group, avoid the fatal obstacles along the way, and then defeat the enemy to win the battle.
How do I control my character?
You play by dragging on the screen, and dragging is the only control listed for this game.

baby-taylor-tea-party-day.intro: Baby Taylor Tea Party Day is a cooking and decorating game where you help prepare tea, snacks and desserts for Taylor's friends. You also look after the children during the party.
tips: Finish the tea preparation first so the drinks are ready before the guests need them.
Work through the cooking steps in order, since the dessert and Petit Fours depend on each other.
Arrange the tea time desserts on the tray with care, keeping the setup neat and balanced.
Keep an eye on the little kids during the party and respond to their needs quickly to keep them happy.
Watch the instructions on screen before each step so you know what the game expects from you.
faq: What is the goal of Baby Taylor Tea Party Day?
The goal is to help Taylor and her mom get ready for the tea party by making tea, arranging desserts on a tray, and keeping the guests happy.
How do I play the game?
Use mouse clicks or taps to play. Click or tap on the items and actions shown on screen to move through each step.

happy-unicorn-magic-leaps.intro: Happy Unicorn: Magic Leaps is an arcade platformer where you guide a little unicorn through leaps and flips to reach the other unicorn waiting on the far side. Timing and aim decide whether each jump lands safely.
tips: Before you press down, look at where the obstacles sit and plan the landing spot first, then set your power to match.
Make small aim and power adjustments while holding the button, since you can see the jump path change before you release.
Start each level by testing a short jump to learn how far the unicorn travels at different power levels.
If a leap goes wrong, try a different angle or lower power rather than repeating the same jump, since each attempt teaches you the spacing.
Take your time on tricky sections; releasing the button at the right moment matters more than speed.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Guide the little unicorn through each level, avoiding obstacles, until it reaches the other unicorn on the far side.
How do I control the unicorn?
Click and hold the left mouse button, drag to aim and set jump power, then release to leap. On touch screens, tap and hold, swipe to aim, then release.

box-press-puzzle.intro: Box Press Puzzle is a logic game where you click pistons in the right order to push cyan cubes into a central drop zone. Each layout gets more complex as you go.
tips: Before clicking anything, trace which piston will push which cube and where that cube will travel. Thinking a few moves ahead prevents most mistakes.
Look for cubes that are blocking a path for other cubes. Clear those first so the rest of the layout stays open.
Try to avoid pushing a cube into a position where it gets stuck or cannot reach the drop zone. If a move looks risky, pause and check the route again.
If a layout feels stuck, try a different order of pistons rather than repeating the same sequence. Small changes in timing often open a new path.
Work through the layout one cube at a time and confirm each one reaches the drop zone before moving on. This keeps the puzzle manageable as it grows harder.
faq: What is the goal of Box Press Puzzle?
The goal is to push all the cyan cubes into the central drop zone by activating pistons in the correct sequence. Completing this in each layout solves the puzzle.
How do I control the pistons?
You use the mouse to click on pistons. The order you click them in determines how the cubes move.

car-evolution-driving.intro: Car Evolution Driving is a running arcade game where you collect parts to upgrade your car. Gather enough parts for a target car and it drives itself to the show platform.
tips: Keep an eye on how many parts your target car still needs, so you know how close you are to the show platform.
Focus on collecting parts that belong to the car you are building rather than grabbing everything you pass.
Use the click or tap control steadily, since it is the only input the game uses to play.
Stay on the path where parts are most common, as the game rewards collecting over simply surviving the run.
Once you have enough parts, let the car drive to the show platform on its own and enjoy watching your upgraded vehicle.
faq: What is the goal of Car Evolution Driving?
The goal is to collect enough parts of a target car so that it can be driven to the show platform. Each part helps make your car more advanced.
How do I control the car?
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps. There are no other controls listed in the instructions.

math-meteors.intro: Math Meteors is a typing-based mental math game. Solve each problem on the meteor, type the answer on the keypad, and press the check mark before the meteor reaches the planet.
tips: Start in a mode you can handle, such as Times tables or addition and subtraction, and move up to multiplication, division or brackets once your answers come quickly.
Read each problem once and work out the answer before you type. Typing a wrong guess costs time, and you cannot take it back.
Focus on the meteors closest to the surface first, since those are the ones that cost a life. Keep an eye on the meteors that are splitting.
Save your gold for the trap that suits the moment: ice when the sky is crowded, reverse when meteors are stacked near each other, and blast when the field is full.
When a boss appears, solve its chain of problems in order. Each correct answer breaks one of its parts, so a steady pace matters more than speed.
faq: How do I score more points?
Each meteor you destroy adds to your score, and the multiplier rises as the round goes on, up to x16. Choosing a harder difficulty also multiplies your points.
What happens if a meteor reaches the planet?
You lose one of your three lives. When all three are gone, the round ends, though you can sometimes watch an ad to continue.

scary-house-clown-evil.intro: Scary House Clown Evil is a 3D horror escape game set in a creepy mansion. You must sneak through rooms, find each room's key, and avoid a suspicious clown killer.
tips: Move slowly and sneak whenever you can, since the game is built around stealth rather than speed.
Save Left Shift for short bursts, because sprinting may be noticed by the clown who is always watching for intruders.
Explore each room carefully and look for its key before moving on, so you are not forced to backtrack near the killer.
Keep checking where the clown is, and back away from his area before he gets close to you.
If you play on a touch screen, use the virtual joystick to move and drag across the screen to look around, so you can scan corners before stepping into them.
faq: What is the main goal in Scary House Clown Evil?
You need to explore the mansion, find the key for each room, and escape while avoiding the clown murderer.
How do I move and sprint?
Use W, S, Q and D to move, and hold Left Shift to sprint. On touch screens, use the virtual joystick to move.

cute-shapes.intro: Cute Shapes is a casual observation puzzle where you spot the one shape that differs from the rest. Read each task at the top of the screen, then find the odd one out.
tips: Read the task at the top of the screen before you look at the shapes, so you know what kind of difference to search for.
Scan the whole group first and compare shapes side by side, checking form, size, and emotion one feature at a time.
Check small details such as eyes and expression, since the difference may be subtle rather than obvious at a glance.
If you are stuck, look away briefly and then look again with fresh eyes, which often makes the odd shape stand out.
Tap or click the shape you choose only after you are confident, so you move on to the next level with the right answer.
faq: What is the goal of Cute Shapes?
The goal is to spot the one shape that is different from the others and select it to move on to the next level.
What kinds of differences can I look for?
The different shape may vary in its form, size, emotion, sound, or another feature, so check each of these when you compare.

ultimate-pk.intro: Ultimate PK is a penalty kick soccer game for one or two players. You climb the rankings over a season by beating stronger teams, scoring while you also defend the goal.
tips: Watch the goalkeeper's position before you shoot and aim for the side he is leaning away from.
Vary where you aim instead of repeating the same spot, since a predictable pattern makes saves easier for the keeper.
When defending, pay attention to the shooter's body angle and approach so you can react before the ball is struck.
Use short, controlled swipes when you need accuracy, and save bigger swipes for moments when power matters more.
If you play with a friend on the same device, take turns watching each other's shots to learn how they tend to aim.
faq: What is the goal of Ultimate PK?
The goal is to rise up the rankings during the year by defeating the best teams. You do this by scoring goals and defending against opposing teams.
How do I shoot the ball?
Swipe to shoot. Your swipe is the input that sends the ball toward the goal.

parking-boom.intro: Parking Boom is a physics game where you launch your car toward a parking spot, smashing through other vehicles on the way. Your aim is to land inside the highlighted zone.
tips: Make small adjustments to angle and power before you release, since a slight change can shift where the car lands.
Watch which vehicles sit along your flight path and plan a line that clears the ones you do not need to hit.
Use the destruction to your advantage: a well-placed collision can redirect your car toward the parking zone.
Pay attention to each level's obstacles, because they change the best launch angle from stage to stage.
Try to land accurately rather than just fast; a clean park within the highlighted zone is the main goal.
faq: How do I aim my car?
Adjust the angle, direction and power using the mouse or by touching the screen. Once you are happy with the aim, release to launch.
What counts as a successful park?
You need to land your car inside the highlighted parking zone. Landing accurately is the main goal of each level.

diamond-painting-by-number.intro: Diamond Painting by Number is a coloring game where you fill in drawings by matching numbers to colored diamonds. You pick and place elements with a single click or tap.
tips: Work on one color at a time so you can scan the picture for every cell with that number and fill them in one pass.
Start with the outer edges or a clear section of the picture so the shape guides the rest of your placements.
Check the numbers carefully before each placement, since the drawings are built entirely around matching numbers to colors.
Take short breaks and look at the whole picture now and then to spot any missed areas you may have skipped.
On mobile, tap slowly and precisely on each element, as the touch screen makes it easy to hit a neighboring cell by mistake.
faq: How do I control the game?
On desktop, use a left mouse click. On a mobile device, touch the game elements on the screen.
What is the goal of Diamond Painting by Number?
The goal is to color and complete diamond drawings by matching the numbers in the coloring books.

adventure-home.intro: Adventure Home is a 2D running, jumping, and treasure-collecting game with simple controls and quests to follow. This guide covers the basics of moving, jumping, and getting started.
tips: Spend a minute practising movement before you chase treasure. The controls are simple, so a short warm-up helps you judge how far each jump carries you.
On PC, use the Left and Right Arrow keys to move and the Up Arrow to jump. Try short, controlled movements instead of holding keys down the whole time.
On Android, get comfortable with the on-screen touch buttons first. Keep your thumbs on the controls so you can respond quickly while running.
Read your quests as you go and keep an eye on what they ask for. Following them gives you a clear direction through the game.
If you lose progress or get stuck, slow down and look ahead before you jump. Careful timing usually works better than rushing.
faq: What is the goal of Adventure Home?
The game is about running, jumping, and collecting treasure while completing quests. The description focuses on this journey rather than a fixed finish point.
How do I control the player on PC?
Use the Left Arrow and Right Arrow keys to move, and the Up Arrow key to jump.

avatar-make-up.intro: Avatar Make Up is a girls makeover game where you choose makeup shades and try out different techniques on your avatar. Use your mouse on desktop or tap on mobile to play.
tips: Try a few eyeshadow shades on the same look before settling on one, so you can compare how each colour sits with the rest of the design.
Pair a bold lipstick hue with softer eye makeup, or the reverse, to see which balance you like best.
Test different makeup techniques one at a time so you can tell which change made the biggest difference to the final look.
Work in a consistent order, such as base first and details last, to keep your avatar's makeover tidy and easy to adjust.
Take a moment to step back and look at the whole avatar between changes, which helps you spot anything that needs fixing.
faq: How do I play Avatar Make Up?
Use your mouse on a desktop computer, or tap the screen on a mobile device. Pick colours from the palette and apply them to your avatar.
What kinds of makeup can I try?
The game lets you experiment with eyeshadow shades, lipstick hues and different makeup techniques. Mixing these choices is the main way to explore your creative side.

highway-car-shooting-3d-action-game-2025.intro: Highway Car Shooting puts you in the backseat of a car on endless highways, where you aim and fire at enemy cars chasing you. Shoot fast, stay alert, and use your unlocked weapons to clear the road.
tips: Tap to fire only when your aim is on a target, since quick, controlled shots tend to hit more often than rapid firing at nothing.
Keep an eye on the enemy cars closest to you, because they are the ones most likely to hit your vehicle first.
Spend upgrades on the weapons you use most so your firepower improves where you already feel comfortable.
Try a few different guns as you unlock them and notice which ones work best against the chasing cars.
Pay attention to changes between highways, cities, and deserts, and adjust your aim and timing to suit each setting.
faq: What is the main goal of Highway Car Shooting?
Your goal is to destroy the enemy cars that chase you while you race along the highway. Staying in the fight and taking down chasers as they come is the core of the game.
How do the controls work?
The game uses simple tap and aim controls. You tap to shoot and aim at the enemy cars around you.

escape-from-squid-island.intro: Escape from Squid Island is a 3D shooter where you fight enemies while trying to flee a dangerous island. You move with WASD, aim with the mouse, and shoot to survive.
tips: Right-click to aim before you fire at distant enemies, since aiming steadies your shots for more accurate hits.
Press R to recharge when no enemies are close by, so you are not stuck reloading in the middle of a fight.
Use WASD to keep moving rather than standing still, which makes it harder for enemies to line up shots on you.
Rotate the mouse often to check your surroundings, so you can spot enemies coming from the side or behind before they reach you.
Pay attention to the different environments as you go, and use their layout to find cover and plan your route off the island.
faq: What is the goal of Escape From Squid Island?
Your goal is to flee the dangerous island filled with enemies and fight for your freedom. You progress by surviving battles and moving through the island.
How do I shoot and aim?
Click the left mouse button to shoot and hold the right mouse button to aim. Aiming before you shoot can help you land more accurate hits.

sweet-solve.intro: Sweet Solve is a physics puzzle where you clear blocks to open a path and guide strawberries into the bucket. Plan each move carefully, since losing a strawberry ends the level.
tips: Study the whole level before you touch anything. Look at where the strawberries sit and where the bucket is, then work out which blocks are in the way.
Destroy blocks in an order that keeps strawberries supported. Removing the wrong block can make a strawberry fall and end the level.
Pay attention to what happens to each block before you remove it. Physics can carry objects in directions you might not expect.
Try to pick up the stars on your way through the level rather than leaving them for last. Collecting them is part of completing the challenge.
If a level goes wrong, restart and test your plan with a slower, more deliberate sequence of taps or clicks.
faq: What is the goal of Sweet Solve?
Your goal is to collect the strawberries in each level by clearing a route to the bucket. You also need to collect the stars.
What ends a level early?
Dropping a strawberry or destroying one will end the game. Think about each action before you make it.

clickdom.intro: Clickdom is a clicker where you tap villagers for coins, scratch lottery tickets for scrolls and buildings, and grow your kingdom. Automated buildings help the progress run while you keep playing.
tips: Tap wandering villagers steadily early on, since coins pay for your first lottery tickets in the shop.
Scratch every ticket you buy, because the prizes are where scrolls and new buildings come from.
Save scrolls for the upgrade menu only when an upgrade clearly strengthens what you are already doing.
Place the Tower, Bell Tower and Laboratory as soon as you can, since they keep working for you between clicks.
Check back on the Laboratory's coin output regularly, and spend those coins on more tickets to keep the cycle going.
faq: What is the main goal in Clickdom?
Your goal is to unlock every upgrade and expand the kingdom to its maximum size. Clicking, scratching and building all move you toward that.
How do I earn coins?
Tap the wandering villagers in your realm. Coins from tapping are what you spend in the shop on lottery tickets.

princess-eye-art-salon.intro: Princess Eye Art Salon is a makeup game where you help Ariel create eye makeup designs. You play by clicking or tapping, and the goal is to finish each eye look she draws.
tips: Look at Ariel's eye design first before you start, so you know what the finished makeup should look like.
Work on one eye area at a time to keep the design neat and easier to follow.
Use the colors and patterns that match the style Ariel is aiming for, since her designs are meant to be creative but cohesive.
Take your time with small details, because they are often what make the final eye look stand out.
Check the finished result against the original design before moving on to the next look.
faq: How do I play Princess Eye Art Salon?
Click or tap to play. Follow what Ariel shows you and complete each eye makeup look step by step.
What is the goal of the game?
The goal is to help Ariel finish a beautiful, imaginative eye makeup design. Each look is completed by following her lead.

witchy.intro: Witchy is a retro Halloween shoot 'em up where you fly with Witchy and her black cat through four magical worlds. Defeat monster waves and bosses to recover 10 stolen amulets.
tips: Use your magic bombs when a monster wave or boss starts to overwhelm you, since they clear danger quickly.
Keep moving rather than staying in one spot, so you can dodge incoming attacks while you fire.
Learn the boss patterns in each world, because bosses are the toughest part of the run.
Put your spell upgrades into the style of shooting that suits you best instead of spreading them thin.
If you are on desktop, pick either Arrow or WASD in Options so your hands stay in one comfortable position.
faq: What is the goal of Witchy?
Fly through the four magical worlds, defeat the monster waves and bosses, and recover the 10 stolen amulets to save Halloween.
Which keys fire and use bombs on desktop?
Hold Z or Space to fire and press X to use a bomb. The A key fires only when Arrow mode is selected in Options.

sword-play-chop-enemies-to-pieces.intro: Sword Play: Chop enemies to pieces! is an action game about slicing ninja foes in half. Swipe through each enemy to win fights and get past waves of attackers across its levels.
tips: Watch enemies before they strike, since they can either hit you or throw weapons at you. Start reacting as soon as you see a throw.
When flying bullets approach, use the slow-down of time to line up your cut and chop them out of the air.
Keep an eye on barrels of explosives near enemies. Cutting them in half can help you deal with a crowd at once.
Stay ready for giant shurikens coming from your enemies and beat them off rather than waiting for them to reach you.
Use short, clean swipes on the screen or with the mouse so each slice lands precisely on the enemy you are aiming for.
faq: How do I finish a level?
You win a level by defeating all the enemies on it. Clear them one by one while watching for incoming attacks.
How do I attack in this game?
Swipe your finger across the screen or move the mouse cursor to slice enemies into halves. The same swipe is used to block and chop incoming threats.

slope-city.intro: Slope City is an endless running game where you guide a ball down a chain of connected slopes. The ball keeps speeding up, so quick reactions are key to staying on course.
tips: Make small, short steering taps with A and D or the arrow keys instead of holding a key down, since big swings can push the ball off the slope.
Look ahead to where the slopes are heading rather than only watching the ball, so you have time to react before you reach a turn.
Expect the ball to get faster as you go, and loosen your steering a little as speed builds so you do not overcorrect.
Stay calm after a small mistake and correct it right away instead of reacting sharply, which often causes a bigger miss.
Practice a few runs to get a feel for how the ball responds to your inputs before trying to go as far as possible.
faq: How do I steer the ball in Slope City?
Press A or the left arrow key to steer left, and press D or the right arrow key to steer right.
Why does the game get harder the longer I play?
The ball keeps accelerating as it moves through the slopes, so you have less time to react and need to keep your steering precise.

slap-master.intro: Slap Master is a light-hearted arcade chase where you slap pedestrians as you run and then escape before you get caught. Swipe left or right to steer and keep the chaos going.
tips: Swipe toward pedestrians to slap them, but keep an eye on where you will be heading next so you don't run into a dead end.
Build the frenzy by slapping several people in a row before you try to get away, since that is the core of the scoring idea in the description.
Watch for obstacles and enemies early and make small left or right swipes to avoid them rather than big late turns that cost speed.
Don't stay in one area too long after a slap. Keep moving so pursuers have less chance to close in on you.
Practice short runs first to learn how close you can get to pedestrians before a slap happens, then push for longer chains.
faq: How do I slap a pedestrian?
Swipe into a pedestrian or come near one, and your character will slap them. Pedestrians you pass without contact are not slapped.
What do I need to do after slapping?
After a slap, you need to escape while avoiding obstacles and enemies without getting caught. Keeping your speed up makes this easier.

hair-challenge-online.intro: Hair Challenge Online is an arcade runner where you walk a runway with a long, majestic hair while avoiding sharp obstacles. Collect hair pieces and dyes, and use the hair shop to unlock new looks.
tips: Follow the game tutorials first, since they explain how to play before the runway gets harder.
Keep an eye on the scissors, blades, and other sharp obstacles ahead so you can react before your hair is cut.
Pick up the weaves and hair dyes along the runway to build your look as you go.
If your hair gets cut, head to the hair salon at the shop to recover and carry on.
Spend what you earn in the hair shop on characters, hair dyes, and accessories to unlock new options for your next run.
faq: What is the goal of Hair Challenge Online?
You run down the runway with your long hair and try to keep it from being cut by scissors, blades, and other sharp obstacles.
How do I control my character?
The game tutorials show you the controls, so follow them before you start your first run.

draw-the-car-path.intro: Draw The Car Path is a puzzle game where you draw a route for each car so it reaches its parking spot. Swipe across the screen to trace the path.
tips: Before you swipe, look at the whole board and find where each car needs to end up. Planning the route first saves retries.
Trace the path in one clear motion where you can, so the line stays easy to follow from start to finish.
Check the spaces around the parking spot before you draw. Make sure your path does not run into obstacles or other cars along the way.
If a path does not work, try a different route rather than repeating the same line. Small changes in direction often solve the puzzle.
Start with the car that has the simplest route to clear space, then work on the trickier ones once the board is less crowded.
faq: What is the goal of Draw The Car Path?
The goal is to draw a path for each car so it drives into its parking spot. You complete the level by parking every car.
How do I control the cars?
You swipe across the screen to draw a path. The car follows the line you draw.

nut-and-bolt.intro: Nut and Bolt is a color-matching puzzle where you sort bolts into the correct nuts. Each level adds more colors and asks for more planning before you finish.
tips: Look over the whole level before you move anything so you can see which colors appear most and where they sit.
Match each bolt to the nut with the same color, and finish one color at a time so the board stays easier to read.
Before placing a bolt, check whether it is blocking a bolt you need to reach next.
When a level gets harder, slow down and plan two or three moves ahead instead of guessing.
If you get stuck, step back and look at the nuts you have already filled to spot any bolts placed in the wrong spot.
faq: What is the goal of Nut and Bolt?
The goal is to place every bolt into the nut that matches its color. A level is complete once all bolts of the same color are set in their nuts.
How do levels get harder?
As you progress, the levels bring more colors of bolts and need more focus and strategy to solve. Early levels are a good place to practice your sorting habits.

terminal-nine.intro: Terminal Nine is a third-person stealth game set across three industrial districts. You move through nine operations, avoiding patrols and reaching extraction without being detected.
