tips: Spend a few minutes in the practice yard before your first operation so the crouch, camera and decoy controls feel natural under pressure.
Use physical cover and crouching together. Stay low behind cover when a patrol is close, and move between cover points rather than across open ground.
Throw a decoy to pull a patrol's attention away from your route, then move past while they investigate. Plan the throw before you are spotted.
Watch patrol routes for a few seconds before you move. Timing your steps between guards is usually safer than rushing.
Save your credits for the upgrades that help your current playstyle most, and use checkpoints between missions to reset your approach before the next operation.
faq: How do I move quietly through an operation?
Hold C to crouch and use WASD or the arrow keys to move slowly between cover. Sprinting with Shift is faster but makes it harder to stay undetected.
How do I complete an operation?
Finish the objectives in each operation, then hold E near the extraction point to get out. Reaching extraction is the goal of every operation.

snake-train-zone.intro: Snake Train Zone is a shooting game in an arena where you collect colored balls to grow a train of soldiers that follow you. Use your mouse or tap to play.
tips: Collect colored balls steadily, since each one fills the number bar that adds a new soldier to your train.
Keep an eye on the number bar so you know how close you are to adding the next soldier.
Think about where you move before you commit, because a longer train takes up more space and can be harder to steer through tight spots.
Use the shooting and breaking-through moments to clear your path rather than charging straight into dense groups.
Upgrade whenever the chance comes up, as the game rewards building up your group over time.
faq: What is the goal of Snake Train Zone?
Enter the arena, collect colored balls, and fill the number bar to add soldiers that follow you. Build a strong group as you play.
How do I control my character?
Play with a mouse click or tap. The instructions do not list other controls, so use the click or tap input to move and act.

tank-stormy.intro: Tank Stormy is a tank battle game for two players sharing one keyboard, or for one player facing AI in Survival mode. Use labyrinth walls for cover and grab map bonuses to gain an edge.
tips: Stay near labyrinth walls when you need cover, since they are your main defense against incoming fire.
Keep an eye on the map for bonuses and move toward them when the path is clear, because they can help you destroy opponents faster.
In 2 Player mode, coordinate with your friend so you do not block each other's paths in narrow corridors.
In Survival mode, avoid staying in open areas for long, and move between wall sections so the AI has fewer clear angles on you.
Learn both control sets early, since Player 1 uses W, A, S, D and Q while Player 2 uses the arrow keys and SPACE.
faq: What are the two game modes in Tank Stormy?
You can play 2 Player mode against a friend or Survival mode against AI. Both modes use the same lablabyrinth battlefield.
How do I control my tank?
Player 1 uses W, A, S, and D along with Q. Player 2 uses the arrow keys and SPACE.

dream-supermarket-3d-shop.intro: Dream Supermarket: 3D Shop is a 3D simulation where you run a supermarket, working the checkout as a cashier and also keeping shelves stocked and the store tidy. Your job is to keep customers happy and the store running smoothly.
tips: Keep an eye on the checkout line and deal with customers quickly so the queue keeps moving.
Count out change carefully at the register, since the game expects you to give accurate change to each customer.
Restock shelves before items run out so customers can find what they came for.
Arrange the store layout so popular items are easy to reach and the aisles stay clear of crowding.
Switch between the cashier role and store upkeep regularly so neither the lines nor the shelves fall behind.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You aim to become a top-notch store manager by serving customers, restocking shelves, and keeping the store lively and well prepared.
What do I do as a cashier?
You scan items, handle cash, and give accurate change, while keeping lines moving and making sure each customer leaves content.

arrow-escape-3d.intro: Arrow Escape 3D is a calm puzzle played on the surface of a cube. Each colorful arrow must slide off the edge, but only when its path is completely clear.
tips: Drag to rotate the cube and check all six faces before you tap anything. Arrows on the back faces are easy to miss and can block others.
Before each tap, follow the arrow's direction with your eyes and check that nothing sits in its path. A blocked tap costs a heart, so a quick check saves lives.
Start by looking for arrows whose paths are already open, then work toward the ones stuck behind other arrows. Clearing the front blockers first often frees the rest.
When an arrow is boxed in, look at what is blocking it and find out which arrow is in the way. Then remove that blocker first.
Keep an eye on your hearts as the cube gets crowded. Slow down near the end of a level, when several arrows point at each other.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Clear every arrow from the cube so that none remain on any face. The level is finished once the whole cube is empty.
What happens when I tap an arrow that is blocked?
The arrow will not escape, and you lose one heart. Check the path first and remove blockers before tapping.

gun-craft-and-fight.intro: Gun Craft and Fight is a first-person shooter where you battle enemies, gather resources, and craft or upgrade weapons to finish combat missions. This guide covers how to use your arsenal well as the enemies get tougher.
tips: Collect resources and useful items as you explore, since you need them to craft and upgrade your gear.
Pick the weapon that fits each situation instead of relying on one gun for every fight.
Check your surroundings often, because enemies can attack from different directions.
Move and aim before you shoot. Accurate shots help you clear levels faster and move forward sooner.
When enemies become more dangerous, spend your upgrades on stronger weapons rather than waiting until you are in trouble.
faq: What is the main goal of each level?
Your main goal is to survive, defeat all enemies, and complete the mission. Clearing the level is how you move forward.
How do I get stronger over time?
Defeat enemies, collect resources, then craft or upgrade your weapons. Unlocking new options also adds to your arsenal.

draw-the-railball-physics.intro: Draw the RailBall Physics is a relaxed puzzle where you build a track of rails and pipes to roll a ball to its goal. Place planks, springs, accelerators and bumpers, then launch the ball and watch the physics play out.
tips: Before you launch, follow the ball's path from start to goal in your head and check where it could fall off the track.
Place a few props, then tap start to test. Watching one short run shows you quickly which piece needs adjusting.
Use drag to reposition props rather than deleting them when a run is close, since small nudges often fix a near miss.
Delete props that are not doing anything useful, so the track stays simple and easier to read.
Since there is no time limit, take your time planning each layout and try a few different routes to the goal.
faq: What is the goal of Draw the RailBall Physics?
Your goal is to draw rails and pipes that guide the rolling ball to the goal using the props available.
How do I place and move props?
Drag a prop from the panel onto the scene to place it. Drag a placed prop to move it, and tap delete to remove it.

snake-color-race.intro: Snake Color Race is a 3D racing game where you steer a colorful snake through an arena, collecting matching balls to grow. Bigger snakes face tougher challenges, including a bridge section where you shoot blocks.
tips: Only collect balls that match your snake's color, since those are the ones that help you grow.
Keep your steering smooth with the mouse so you can line up with matching balls without overshooting them.
Watch rivals around you and avoid getting boxed in when your snake is long, because a bigger body leaves less room to turn.
Before the bridge challenge, think about which blocks you can break with the balls you have collected so your shots count.
Plan your route a few balls ahead instead of chasing the nearest one, which helps you grow faster and stay clear of rivals.
faq: What is the goal of Snake Color Race?
Your aim is to eat balls that match your snake's color so you grow bigger and become the most dominant snake in the arena, outsmarting other players in real time.
How do I control my snake?
Use the mouse to change the direction your snake moves.

ball-jump-switch-the-colors.intro: Ball Jump Switch The Colors is an arcade game where you tap to bounce a ball upward through rotating obstacles. Match its color to the barriers or slip through the gaps to climb as high as you can.
tips: Watch the obstacle sections ahead of the ball, not just the one it is currently passing, so you have time to plan your color.
Collect stars to change the ball's color before you reach a barrier that does not match it.
Keep your taps steady and rhythmic rather than rapid, since each tap sends the ball higher and timing decides whether it clears a gap.
When the ball's color does not match a section, aim for the gaps between the mismatched parts instead of the solid color areas.
Play in short runs at first to learn how the rotating barriers move, then aim to beat your own high score.
faq: What is the goal of Ball Jump Switch The Colors?
The goal is to climb as high as possible through the endless obstacles without crashing. Your score builds the higher the ball gets.
How do I control the ball?
On desktop, click the mouse or press the spacebar. On mobile, tap the screen. Each input makes the ball bounce higher.

jeep-drive-prisoner-transport-sim.intro: Jeep Drive Prisoner Transport Sim puts you behind the wheel of an army prisoner vehicle for a US Army transfer. The game relies on realistic physics, so how you handle the truck matters.
tips: Take it slow at the start to learn how the vehicle responds, since the physics affect weight, balance, and grip.
Ease off the controls before turns instead of cutting sharply, because a heavy military truck can lose stability quickly.
Watch how the vehicle reacts after bumps and uneven ground, and adjust your speed to keep it steady.
Treat each run as training: repeat tricky sections to build the feel of the truck rather than rushing through.
Use the controls that suit your device, with the on-screen mobile buttons on a phone or the keyboard on a computer, and practice until your inputs feel smooth.
faq: What is the goal of Jeep Drive Prisoner Transport Sim?
You drive an army prisoner transport vehicle as part of your training with the United States Army's transport units. The goal is to operate the truck safely and complete the transfer.
What controls does the game use?
You can use the mobile buttons on a phone or tablet, or the keyboard on a PC. Pick the input that feels most comfortable and practice with it.

stickman-night-survive.intro: Stickman Night Survive is a Halloween shooter where a white stickman fights monsters that rise from underground on different platforms. Aim carefully and time each shot to keep the monsters from overwhelming him.
tips: Watch which platform each monster appears on before you aim, so you can move your attention there early.
Wait for the monster to line up with your aim instead of firing at its old position.
Keep your aim steady when you drag on a touch screen, since small jumps can cause missed shots.
Pay attention to the timing of the monsters' movements and fire at the moment they are in your sights.
Stay calm and focus on one monster at a time rather than shooting wildly at everything at once.
faq: What is the goal of Stickman Night Survive?
The goal is to help the stickman shoot the monsters that come out of their underground lairs on Halloween night. The game is about surviving the monster attacks.
How do I aim and shoot?
On a computer, use the mouse to aim and shoot. On a touch screen, touch and drag to aim.

angela-all-season-fashion.intro: Help Skyler, Sunny, Ruby, and Violet, four Rainbow high school girls, get ready for a summer picnic before they head out. Everything is done with the left mouse button.
tips: Work through the girls one at a time so you don't lose track of who is already ready.
Keep the summer picnic in mind when you choose each look, since that is the outing they are dressing for.
Click slowly and check each choice before moving on, because every step is made with a single left mouse click.
Try different combinations for each girl to see how her style changes, and compare the results.
Finish one girl completely before switching, so the group is clearly ready to head out together.
faq: What is the goal of this game?
The goal is to help Skyler, Sunny, Ruby, and Violet get ready so they can head out to their summer picnic.
How do I control the game?
You use only the left mouse button. Click to make your choices as you help each girl get ready.

snow-plow-inc.intro: Snow Plow Inc. is a relaxing game about driving an orange plow truck through snow and ice. Fill your truck bed, sell your load in the yard, and upgrade your rig across 15 levels.
tips: Make a few trips to the yard before pushing hard on a new level, so you know how full your truck bed gets and when it is worth heading back to sell.
Spend early coins on capacity or earnings first, since they help every trip that follows.
Harder snow slows you down, so save upgrades like plow power and plow teeth for the tougher levels from powder to packed snow and ice.
Plan your route to clear the field in an order that keeps you near the yard, which cuts down on wasted driving between loads.
Look for 3 stars on levels you have already cleared, since a full clear is what earns the top rating and helps you get the most out of the game.
faq: How do I sell the snow I collect?
Drive your truck onto a pad in the yard to sell your load for coins.
How do I earn stars on a level?
Clear the field to earn up to 3 stars, and clearing a level unlocks the next one.

axe-run.intro: Axe Run is a construction game where you chop through barriers, collect wood, and build a city. Swipe to steer your character, use gates to gain speed, and upgrade as you move through the levels.
tips: Aim for gates when you can, since passing through them is how you gain speed.
Keep your swipes smooth and steady so your character stays on course while you chop through barriers.
Collect wood as you go, because it is what you need to build your city.
Spend your upgrades early on the abilities that help you most, then use them to handle harder levels.
Try each level a few times to learn where the barriers and gates sit before you aim for a faster run.
faq: What is the goal of Axe Run?
You chop through barriers, collect wood, and use it to build a city across the levels. Upgrading your character helps you progress.
How do I move my character?
On desktop, hold the right mouse button and swipe. On mobile, hold your finger on the screen and swipe to move.

match-them-up.intro: Match Them Up! is a 3D puzzle where you search a room for pairs of identical objects. Clear every pair to finish the level, and try to beat your best time.
tips: Scan the room in sections, such as left to right or near to far, so you don't miss objects you have already passed.
Rotate and zoom in on objects that look similar, since small differences in angle or detail can tell you whether two items are really identical.
Use the camera to look behind and around objects, because some items may be partly hidden from your starting view.
Match the pairs you are confident about first, which shrinks the number of objects left to check and keeps your pace steady.
Keep camera movements purposeful, because a lot of spinning around can slow you down when you are working toward a best time.
faq: What is the goal of Match Them Up!?
Find and match all the pairs of identical objects scattered around the room to clear the level. Finishing faster than before helps you beat your best time.
How do I select objects?
Select an item by clicking it with the right mouse button. Use the same button on its matching partner to make the match.

ugi-bugi.intro: Ugi Bugi is a cute 2D arcade adventure where a blue plush teddy bear must reach the flag while avoiding obstacles and collecting gold. It is played alone and controlled with WASD or touch.
tips: Look at the path ahead before you move so you can spot obstacles early and time your jumps or steps.
Collect the gold on the way when it is safe to do so, since it is part of the goal alongside reaching the flag.
Move in short, controlled bursts instead of holding a direction, which makes it easier to stop before a hazard.
If you keep falling at the same spot, slow down there and study the layout before trying again.
On touch screens, keep your thumb steady on the controls so your movements stay accurate near tricky sections.
faq: What is the goal of Ugi Bugi?
Help Ugi Bugi reach the flag at the end of the course. Collecting gold along the way is also part of the challenge.
How do I control the teddy bear?
Use the W, A, S and D keys on a computer, or use touch controls on a touch screen device.

robot-police-iron-panther.intro: Robot Police Iron Panther puts you in charge of a police robot defending Earth from invading monster aliens. You build your own Iron Panther and then take on the monsters in a fight.
tips: Read each choice on screen before you select it, since the game is driven entirely by clicking or tapping buttons.
Take your time when building your Iron Panther, because the fighting comes after that step and you will be stuck with those choices in the battle.
Try different options on separate runs to see how each one changes the fight, rather than settling on the first build you make.
Keep your clicks or taps steady and deliberate so you do not select the wrong option by accident during a fight.
Remember the game is still unfinished, so some parts may change or be missing, and it is worth checking back later.
faq: What is the main goal of Robot Police Iron Panther?
Your goal is to protect Earth from monster aliens by building your own Iron Panther robot and fighting the monsters.
How do I control the robot in the game?
On desktop you click buttons to interact, and on touch screens you tap to select choices.

funny-bone-surgery.intro: Funny Bone Surgery is a hospital game where you treat Leah after she was hit by a car while playing on her stakeboard. You fix her broken arm and foot by picking tools and applying them to her injuries.
tips: Look over Leah's arm and foot first so you know which injuries need work before you pick up any tools.
Try each tool on a spot before moving on, so you can see what it does and avoid wasting steps.
Work through one injury at a time instead of switching back and forth, which keeps the treatment easier to follow.
Use the buttons on screen to move between steps, and check the results after each choice before continuing.
If you make a wrong choice, look at how Leah reacts to find out what went wrong and adjust your next move.
faq: What is the goal of Funny Bone Surgery?
The goal is to help Leah by fixing her broken arm and foot. You do this by choosing the right tools and treatments for each injury.
How do I play on a desktop computer?
Click items, tools, and buttons with your mouse to interact with the game and apply your choices to Leah.

bffs-golden-hour.intro: BFFs Golden Hour is a single-player dress-up game where you style characters in outfits inspired by different places around the world. You use your mouse on desktop or tap on mobile to pick and combine looks.
tips: Start by picking one location, such as New York or Japan, and build a full outfit around its style before moving on, so your looks feel coherent.
Try mixing pieces from different inspirations to see which combinations work best together, since the game encourages mixing and matching.
Keep the Fall Aesthetics theme in mind when choosing colors and layers, as the game is built around that look.
Take time to compare several options for each item rather than settling on the first one you see, because there are many choices to explore.
Play in short sessions and return to earlier outfits later with fresh eyes to decide if they still look right.
faq: What is the goal of BFFs Golden Hour?
The goal is to dress up the stylish crew with outfits inspired by places like New York, Tuscany, Japan, and Scotland. Creating looks you like is the main focus.
How do I control the game?
On a desktop, use your mouse to select and place items. On mobile, tap the screen to do the same.

neon-square-rush.intro: Neon Square Rush is a fast endless runner where you guide a neon square across a geometric landscape full of obstacles. A single mouse click makes it jump, so timing is everything.
tips: Look ahead rather than at your square. Spotting obstacles early gives you more time to decide when to jump.
Keep your clicks steady and rhythmic. Jumping at the same point each time helps you build a reliable pattern.
Don't click too early. Wait until the obstacle is close enough that you can clear it, then press once.
Watch for the neon lighting effects and color changes around you, since they can make the landscape harder to read at speed.
If you miss an obstacle, reset your focus right away instead of reacting to the last mistake. Staying calm keeps your timing consistent.
faq: What is the goal of Neon Square Rush?
You run through an endless geometric landscape with your neon square and avoid the obstacles and challenges that appear along the way.
How do I control the square?
Click the mouse to make the square jump over obstacles. Jumping is the only control listed for this game.

gun-blast.intro: Gun Blast is a fast arcade shooter where you fight other guns in an arena. Every shot adds recoil that moves you around, so firing and moving happen together. Last gun standing wins.
tips: Treat each shot as movement, since recoil pushes you around the arena. Before you fire, check where that push will take you.
Try bouncing your shots off walls to hit enemies you cannot reach directly.
Learn how the SMG and the shotgun feel differently, and switch weapons based on whether enemies are close or spread out.
Save rockets for groups of enemies, since their shots are explosive. Keep shields in mind for moments when you are under heavy fire.
Avoid firing wildly. Chaining precise shots keeps you in control and makes it easier to stay alive.
faq: How do you win a round?
You win by shooting down the other guns in the arena. The last gun standing takes the win.
How does recoil work?
Each shot you take adds recoil to your gun, which moves you around the space. Your firing is also how you get around the arena.

intercity-bus-driver-3d.intro: Intercity Bus Driver 3D is a racing game where you drive a coach bus along long freeways. You pick up waiting passengers and carry them to bus stations in different cities.
tips: Keep an eye on the route to the pick-up spot so you can reach it quickly, since passengers are waiting anxiously.
Use the WASD or arrow keys to steer smoothly rather than making sharp turns, which can slow your bus down.
Plan your path to the destination bus station before you leave the pick-up point to avoid losing time looking for it.
Use the mouse when you need to interact with the game, and keep your attention on the road between interactions.
Take the long freeway stretches at a steady, fast pace, and ease off when traffic gets heavy so you stay in control.
faq: What is the goal of Intercity Bus Driver 3D?
Your goal is to drive to each pick-up spot quickly and then take your passengers to the bus station of a different city.
Which keys control the bus?
Use the WASD keys or the arrow keys to drive, and use the mouse to interact with the game.

melodys-adventure.intro: Melody's Adventure is a platform game where you guide Melody through 32 levels full of landscapes, obstacles, and enemies. Use WASD or the arrow keys to move and jump your way through each stage.
tips: Take a moment to look at each new level before moving, so you can spot obstacles and enemies ahead of time.
Collect power-ups when they are safe to reach, since they can help you on the trickier parts of the journey.
Watch how enemies move before you try to get past them, and time your steps to avoid them.
Practise your jumps on simple sections first so you know how far Melody travels in the air before attempting harder gaps.
If you get stuck on a level, slow down and check the path again rather than rushing, as careful movement usually works better.
faq: What is the goal of Melody's Adventure?
The goal is to guide Melody through 32 levels, collecting power-ups and getting past obstacles and foes along the way.
How do I control Melody?
Use the WASD keys or the arrow keys to move Melody around each level.

fidget-trading-card-toy.intro: Fidget Trading Card Toy is a short hypercasual game about flipping and slapping cards in trading duels against opponents. Your aim is to build a big collection and win rare cards along the way.
tips: Watch how each card lands before you act, so you can judge which trades are worth making.
Use the slap feature at moments when a duel is close, since it can decide the outcome.
Focus on collecting rare cards first, because they give you the biggest gains in trading.
Keep playing with short, steady clicks or taps rather than rushing, so each flip stays under control.
Track which cards you already own so you do not waste trades on duplicates you do not need.
faq: How do I play Fidget Trading Card Toy?
Click or tap to flip cards against your opponent and use the slap feature to start a trading duel.
What is the main goal of the game?
Your goal is to collect as many rare cards as possible and grow your card collection to gain more advantages in trading.

gungame-paintball-wars.intro: GunGame Paintball Wars is a shooter with multiplayer and campaign play, plus several modes including team vs team, free for all, gungame, and zombie survival. Use WASD to move and the mouse to look and fire.
tips: Start by practicing movement with WASD, mouse look, and space to jump so you are comfortable before you join a match with other players.
Open the menu with Tab to check options between rounds rather than searching for them during a fight.
Try a few different modes, such as team vs team and free for all, to see which style of play suits you best.
In the survival wave zombie mode, coordinate with friends so you can cover different directions as waves come in.
When playing as a zombie, focus on destroying soldiers, and use jumps and movement to keep moving and avoid being caught in one place.
faq: What is the main goal of GunGame Paintball Wars?
The goal is to test your skill across several modes, from team battles and free for all to zombie survival and campaign levels. The description says you can complete all levels in the game.
Which keys control the game?
Use W, A, S, and D to move, the mouse to look around and fire, Tab to open the menu, and Space to jump.

2048-checkers.intro: 2048 Checkers combines the number-merging idea of 2048 with checkers-style captures. Your checkers can only take pieces that show the same number, and each successful capture doubles your checker's value.
tips: Before each move, scan the board for pairs of matching numbers so you can plan captures ahead instead of reacting to them.
Watch for numbers that appear only once, since a lone piece may have no partner left to capture and can end up stuck.
Save coins for moments when the board is locked, because shuffling the board can open new capture options when you have no good moves.
Use the option to remove a piece when one checker is blocking a useful capture or leaving you without any matching targets.
Spend coins to double a checker only when it has a matching partner nearby, so the bigger number can actually be used in the next capture.
faq: What is the goal of 2048 Checkers?
The goal is to reach the 2048 checker. Reaching it gives you victory and can place you at the top of the player leaderboard.
Which pieces can a checker capture?
A checker can only capture another piece that has the same number. After a successful capture, your checker's number doubles.

fun-town-parking.intro: Fun Town Parking is a parking simulation where you steer through tricky paths, reach open parking spots, and avoid obstacles. The challenge grows as you advance, so careful control matters.
tips: Move slowly when you are close to a parking spot or an obstacle, since small steering mistakes add up quickly at the end of a maneuver.
Check the camera view with C before you commit to a turn, and switch views if you cannot judge the gap to a wall or obstacle.
Use the gear shift to reverse when you overshoot a spot instead of forcing the car around in a wide arc.
Pause with P when you need a moment to plan your route, then continue once you know the path ahead.
Press R to reset the game when you get stuck in a bad position, rather than trying to recover from a messy angle.
faq: What is the goal of Fun Town Parking?
Your goal is to maneuver through tricky paths, secure parking spots, and dodge obstacles along the way. You need to park your car in the spot.
How do I control the car?
Use W, A, S, D or the arrow keys to move. Use the Shift key to change gear so you can move forward or backward.

my-phone-store.intro: My Phone Store is a casual clicker and tycoon game about building and selling smartphones, laptops, and tablets. Start small, improve your production, and grow your shop into a successful electronics business.
tips: Try all three device types early on so you can see which ones earn money fastest for you.
Spend your earnings on production improvements first, since making devices faster lets you earn more over time.
Check your store upgrades regularly and expand once your current setup is running smoothly.
Keep the game moving with short, steady sessions, since the idle side of the game keeps progress going between clicks.
Use WASD or the mouse on a computer, or your finger on a phone, to keep your actions quick and consistent.
faq: What is the main goal of My Phone Store?
The goal is to build and sell tech devices, grow your shop, and turn a small store into a successful electronics business. Earnings from sales let you improve and expand.
Which devices can I create?
You can create smartphones, laptops, and tablets. Each one lets you sell to customers and earn money.

ricochet-paint-aim.intro: Ricochet Paint Aim is an arcade puzzle where you bounce a ball through peg mazes to splatter paint on targets. Aim carefully, since every shot depends on the angle and the bounces that follow.
tips: Hold the mouse button to aim and watch the path before you let go, so you can plan the bounces ahead of time.
Look for the angle that sends the ball off a peg toward your target, rather than aiming straight at it.
Before each shot, check which targets are hardest to reach and try to clear the easier ones first to keep your shots focused.
Take a moment to study the layout of the maze when a new one starts, since pegs placed near each other can change where the ball goes.
If a shot misses, pay attention to where the ball bounced and adjust your aim by a small amount rather than changing direction completely.
faq: How do I shoot the ball?
Hold the mouse button down to aim, then release it to launch the ball.
What is the goal of each level?
Use bounces off the pegs to get the ball through the maze and splatter the targets with paint.

pocket-universe.intro: Pocket Universe is a cozy adventure where you gather resources, unlock new lands, and slowly grow a small world into something much bigger. Each step opens up new biomes and new challenges to face.
tips: Mine a bit of everything early on (wood, stone, metal, and crystals) so you are never stuck waiting for one material before you can act.
Spend resources on tool upgrades before expanding too far, since better tools are what let you harvest the rarer materials.
Before unlocking a new hex, check how much of each resource you have so you can afford both the unlock and a tool upgrade.
Watch enemies for a moment before engaging, especially the monsters and golems guarding unexplored areas, and fight them when you feel ready.
Explore one biome at a time and come back to your base to spend what you gathered, rather than running low on supplies far from home.
faq: How do I move my character?
Use the joystick to move your character around the world.
What do I collect and what is it for?
You mine rocks, trees, and crystals to gather wood, stone, metal, and crystals. You spend these to upgrade tools, unlock new hexes, and explore biomes.

home-rush.intro: Home Rush is a relaxed drawing puzzle where you connect each parent to their child and guide them home safely. Draw clear routes that avoid obstacles and keep every family on track.
tips: Before you draw, look at the whole board and find the walls, dogs, cars and thieves that sit between each parent and child.
Choose the route that is clear and direct rather than the first path that comes to mind, since picking the best route is key to reaching each baby.
Make sure each line joins a parent to the child of the same color, so you don't waste a route on the wrong pair.
Plan the order of your lines so that parents don't run into each other as they move toward their children.
If a route gets blocked, step back and rethink the whole layout instead of forcing a line through danger.
faq: How do I start drawing a line?
Click on mom or dad first, then draw a line from that parent to the baby of the same color.
What should I avoid while drawing?
Keep your lines away from walls, dogs, cars and thieves, since these are the obstacles that can stop a family from getting home.

aqua-fish-dental-care.intro: Aqua Fish Dental Care is a hypercasual game where you play a dental expert treating underwater species. Each level features different fish, and you use the equipment to finish each treatment.
tips: Look at each species before you start, since every level introduces different fish and their treatment may vary.
Try the equipment on a case to see how it works before you rely on it, so you know which tool to reach for next time.
Finish each step fully before moving on to the next one, so you don't have to redo work on the same patient.
Use a steady, unhurried click or tap rhythm, because the game rewards careful treatment more than speed.
If a level feels tricky, replay it and focus on one species at a time to build a routine you can repeat.
faq: What is the goal of Aqua Fish Dental Care?
Your goal is to treat each underwater species as a dental expert. Each level has different species, and you use the equipment to complete the treatment.
How do I play the game?
Use a left mouse button click or tap to play. Each action you take moves the treatment forward.

obby-way.intro: Obby Way is a 3D obby where the levels break their own rules. Floors collapse, platforms move at bad moments, and the obvious finish may be a trap. Learn from each attempt to find the real path to the finish door.
tips: Treat the obvious finish with suspicion, since the description warns it may be a trap. Look for the real route before committing to a jump.
Hold right-click and rotate the camera to check the layout around you before moving. This helps you spot walls and platforms that block familiar routes.
Pay attention to hint eggs, which warn you about traps. Stopping to find them can save you several attempts.
Collect coins along the way, since they unlock new levels. Grabbing them safely is worth a little extra care.
After a failed attempt, note where the trap caught you and what triggered it. Use that memory to time your jumps differently next run.
faq: What is the goal of Obby Way?
Survive each level and reach the real finish door. The obvious finish may be a trap, so watch the environment carefully.
How do I unlock new levels?
Collect coins to unlock new levels. Coins are gathered as you run, jump, and climb through each course.

sling-chicken.intro: Sling Chicken is a climbing skill game where you fling a chicken from peg to peg up an endless barn track. Each 90-second match is a race to gain more height than a rival chicken.
tips: Practice your pull on the early rungs before the hazards appear, so you learn how far each launch carries the chicken.
Before you release, look at where the next peg sits and where the saws or boards are along that flight path.
Aim for a landing spot on the peg rather than rushing, since a clean stop lets you set up the next launch with control.
Watch the rival's progress and push harder when you are behind, but avoid risky launches when you are already ahead.
Grab golden eggs when they sit on your flight path, but never take a dangerous route just to collect one.
faq: What is the goal of Sling Chicken?
Climb as high as you can in meters during a 90-second match. You win by finishing with more meters than the simulated rival chicken.
How do I launch the chicken?
Drag backward from the chicken to stretch its wings, then release to fling it toward the next peg above.

mr-tung-shoot-zombie.intro: Mr. Tung Shoot Zombie is an archery game where you aim arrows at zombies to save Ballerina Cappuccino, who is in prison. Each arrow is aimed by clicking or tapping a direction or a zombie.
tips: Aim before you fire, since the game asks for precise shots. Take a moment to line up each arrow instead of firing quickly.
Keep an eye on Ballerina Cappuccino at all times, because zombies can eat him at any time. Deal with the zombies closest to him first.
Pay attention to the direction of each zombie before you shoot. Choosing the right target keeps the threats under control.
Use the tap or click on the zombie itself when it is a clear target, and use a direction when you want to cover a wider area.
Stay calm and focused, because a single careless shot can leave a dangerous zombie free to reach the prisoner.
faq: What is the goal of Mr. Tung Shoot Zombie?
Your goal is to shoot and destroy all the zombies so that Ballerina Cappuccino is saved from prison.
How do I shoot an arrow on PC?
Click on the direction or the zombie you want to hit with your mouse to fire an arrow.

game-of-warrior.intro: Game of Warrior is a tower defense strategy game where you defend your fortress, then attack enemy territories to turn them into your colonies. Your troops fight on their own, so your choices focus on when to send them and how to upgrade them.
tips: Watch the field before you release troops. Since your units fight automatically, timing and placement decide the outcome more than micromanagement.
Spend coins on warriors and structures steadily rather than all at once. Balanced upgrades help you hold defenses and push attacks at the same time.
Prepare for the boss army that appears every 10 waves. Bosses are tougher than regular units, so save abilities and strong upgrades for those fights.
Conquered colonies keep producing coins for you, so taking territories early can speed up your later upgrades.
Use your abilities when enemies cluster or when your own line is under pressure. Good timing of abilities can matter more than adding more units.
faq: What is the main goal of Game of Warrior?
You either defend your fortress against incoming waves or attack enemy territories to conquer them. Conquered territories become your colonies.
How do I get coins to upgrade faster?
Earn coins by defeating enemies and by collecting coins from the colonies you have conquered. Use those coins to level up your warriors and structures.

off-road-overdrive.intro: Off Road Overdrive is a side-scrolling racing game where you drive a cartoon car across 2D terrain. You keep the vehicle steady on the platform using two buttons while you try to set a strong record in Challenge mode.
tips: Use short, gentle presses on the two buttons rather than holding them down, so the car stays balanced on uneven ground.
Watch the car's tilt before each bump or slope and correct early, since small corrections are easier than recovering from a big lean.
Try each terrain in Challenge mode, including Snow, Beachwear, Field, Desert, and Dark Night, and note which one gives you the most trouble.
Replay the terrain you find hardest several times to learn how the car responds to its surface and slopes.
Keep your focus on the road ahead rather than the car itself, so you can prepare for the next dip or hill before you reach it.
faq: What is the goal of Off Road Overdrive?
The goal is to drive your cartoon car across the 2D platform while keeping it steady. In Challenge mode, you aim to build a strong record by playing the terrains again and again.
How do I control the car?
You operate the vehicle with two buttons. Use them to keep the car balanced as it moves along the terrain.

square-bird.intro: Square Bird is an adventure game where you guide a square bird through obstacles and traps to reach the destination. Collect coins along the way to unlock new skins for your bird.
tips: Use the click or tap control with steady timing rather than rapid, random presses, so you can react to each obstacle as it comes.
Take a moment to study a new level before you commit to moving, so you can spot the traps and the safest route to the destination.
Keep an eye out for coins as you go, since collecting them is how you unlock new skins.
If a level keeps defeating you, step back and try again with a different approach. The game notes that some levels are hard and that persistence pays off.
Play in short sessions and take breaks between tough levels, so you stay focused on spotting mistakes you can fix on the next attempt.
faq: What is the goal of Square Bird?
Your goal is to break through obstacles and traps to reach the destination in each level. Reaching the destination successfully is how you move forward.
How do I control the square bird?
Use a mouse click or tap the screen to play. There are no other controls mentioned in the instructions.

hungry-crab.intro: Hungry Crab is a casual puzzle game where you cut ropes so the candy drops into the crab's mouth. Along the way, you can collect stars while you solve each level.
tips: Before you cut anything, look at where the candy hangs and which way it will swing or fall. Plan the cut order so the candy travels toward the crab rather than away from it.
Cut ropes one at a time and watch what each cut does before making the next one. This makes it easier to spot a better sequence.
Keep an eye on the stars on each screen. Trying to collect them while still getting the candy to the crab is part of the challenge.
If the candy drifts off course, pay attention to the path it takes so you can adjust your plan on the next attempt.
On Android, use a light, quick swipe across the rope. On PC, a left-click cut works the same way, so aim your cut precisely at the rope.
faq: What is the goal of Hungry Crab?
The goal is to guide the candy into the crab's mouth by cutting the right ropes. Collecting the stars along the way is also part of playing.
How do I cut the ropes?
On Android, touch and swipe across the rope on screen. On PC, hold the left mouse button and drag across the rope to cut it.

obby-parkour-crazy-descent.intro: Obby Parkour: Crazy Descent is a fast 3D parkour game where you drop through generated platforms, dodge moving obstacles, and try to get as low as you can. Your speed builds as you go, so quick reactions matter.
tips: Look ahead before you jump. Use the camera controls to scan the next platforms and spot obstacle timing early, rather than reacting only when you are already on top of them.
Watch how the moving obstacles repeat. Waiting a moment before each jump often works better than rushing in, especially as your speed rises.
Keep your movements small and steady. Sudden direction changes at high speed make it easy to overshoot a platform and fall.
Pick up gold coins only when the path is clear. A coin is not worth a fall, so take the safe line first and grab coins along the way.
Expect the pace to change. Each platform you pass makes the game faster, so practice staying calm and controlled as the rush builds.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Your main goal is to descend through the generated platforms as low as possible while dodging moving obstacles. One wrong move sends you falling into the abyss.
How does the speed change during a run?
Your speed increases with every platform you pass, so the game gets faster the lower you fall.

math-playground.intro: Math Playground is an educational game for kids that practices basic math. It covers addition and subtraction, multiplication and division, and geometry through a variety of challenges.
tips: Start by thinking about which topic you want to practice, such as addition and subtraction, multiplication and division, or geometry, so you know what to focus on.
Work slowly and check your answers before moving on, since accuracy helps build the skills the game is designed to teach.
If a challenge feels hard, try a different activity for a while and come back to it later, so practice stays enjoyable.
Try to notice which types of problems take you longer, and spend a few extra rounds on those to improve.
Practice in short sessions regularly rather than one long session, which makes it easier to remember what you learned.
faq: What is the goal of Math Playground?
The goal is to help kids learn and practice basic math concepts, including addition and subtraction, multiplication and division, and geometry. Playing through the challenges builds these skills.
How do I start playing?
Tap to play to begin. From there you can move through the challenges and activities the game offers.

wood-builder-tycoon.intro: Wood Builder Tycoon is an idle management game where you chop trees, upgrade sawmills, and move timber along conveyor belts. Your aim is to grow your lumber operation into a large forestry business.
tips: Keep your cursor moving between tasks, since the game is played entirely by pointing and clicking.
Collect the golden cash regularly so you always have funds ready for your next purchase.
Prioritise upgrades that raise your timber output, because growing production is the core goal of the game.
Set up your conveyor belts early so that timber keeps moving while you focus on other parts of your empire.
Hire workers once your income is steady, since they help you scale production further.
faq: How do I play Wood Builder Tycoon?
Use point and click to chop trees, upgrade your sawmills, and manage the flow of timber along the conveyor belts.
How do I earn money in the game?
Golden cash is the main source of funds, so collect it as it appears to keep your expansion moving.

fishtopia.intro: Fishtopia is a match-style adventure where you swap and match items to clear levels, rescue fish, and unlock new aquariums. It suits puzzle fans who want a relaxed pace with steadily harder stages.
tips: Before each swap, look for moves that clear more than one match, since planning ahead helps you finish levels in fewer turns.
Save your power-ups for levels that look hard or are close to their goal, rather than using them on the first easy stages.
Pay attention to what each level asks you to collect and focus your matches on those items first.
Check the daily events and challenges regularly, because they offer extra rewards you can earn alongside normal progress.
Aim for higher scores on levels you have already cleared when you want more rewards, instead of rushing through them.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You match and collect items to meet the level's objective, which also lets you save fish and unlock new aquariums.
How do I make a move?
Use your mouse or touch screen to swap, click, and match items on the board.

racing-island.intro: Racing Island is a 3D racing game where you drive unique vehicles across an island in race, freeride and stand modes. You steer and accelerate with the keyboard and can use nitro to boost your speed.
tips: Start with the race mode to learn how each vehicle handles before trying the freeride areas, since every vehicle drives differently.
Use the brake before tight turns and then accelerate out of them, so you keep control instead of sliding wide.
Save nitro for straight stretches or the final push of a race, where the speed boost will help you most.
Try freeride mode to explore the island and find shortcuts and jumps you can use later in races.
Switch between the WASD keys and arrow keys to find the layout that feels most comfortable for your hands.
faq: What is the goal of Racing Island?
The game is built around racing, exploring and showing your driving skills in race, freeride and stand modes. Each level brings new vehicles and things to discover.
Which keys control the car?
Use W or the up arrow to speed up, S or the down arrow to brake, and A/D or the left and right arrows to steer. The Shift key activates nitro.

bucket-sort-3d.intro: Bucket Sort 3D is a color-sorting puzzle where you clear a sand art piece by sending matching trucks to the loading zone. Each tap removes sand, so your order of moves decides how smoothly the puzzle comes apart.
tips: Always check the bottom layer of the sand art before you tap, since that is the color you can actually reach next.
Look across the whole fleet of trucks before choosing one, so you know which colors are available and which are still waiting.
Keep an eye on trucks that are close to full, because a full truck drives away and frees a space for the next one.
Plan a few moves ahead when several layers share a color, so you do not leave a single sand color stuck under another.
Work steadily from top to bottom of the sand art rather than rushing, since mistakes are easier to avoid when you read each layer first.
faq: What is the goal of Bucket Sort 3D?
Your goal is to empty the entire sand art canvas by tapping the trucks in the right order. Each truck you send to the loading zone removes sand that matches its color.
How do I choose which truck to tap?
Look at the bottom layer of the sand art and tap the truck that matches that color. This sends the sand to the loading zone.

fun-draw-race-3d.intro: Fun Draw Race 3D is an arcade racing game where you draw legs for your robot to help it win each race. Each track has different obstacles, so your leg shapes need to suit the challenge ahead.
tips: Look at the obstacles on the track before you draw, so you can plan a leg shape that suits what is coming.
Keep your drawing simple and smooth, since you slide your finger to draw and quick strokes are easier to control.
Use the chance to change your legs while the robot is running if you notice a different obstacle ahead.
Try different shapes on the same track to see which one helps your robot move forward the fastest.
Stay focused on the start of each race, because a good first set of legs can make the rest of the run easier.
faq: What is the goal of Fun Draw Race 3D?
The goal is to win each race by drawing legs that carry your robot across the track. Each track has its own obstacles to get past.
How do I draw the legs for my robot?
Slide your finger or mouse across the screen to draw the shape you want for the robot's legs. The instructions say to slide to draw.

the-depth-of-the-limbo.intro: The Depth of the Limbo is a top-view platform game where a girl must clear 13 levels to wake up. The camera rotates around her, so directions can get confusing.
tips: Before moving, look at where the path leads and ignore which way feels familiar, since the camera may have changed the orientation.
Pause for a moment after each camera rotation to re-map left, right, up and down to the screen before you press anything.
Plan the route in short segments rather than trying to see the whole level at once, which helps when the layout keeps turning.
Keep an eye on the one-minute timer in each level and avoid wasting time on wrong turns by checking your direction early.
If you get lost, reset your thinking to the goal of reaching the end of the route, and move steadily instead of rushing.
faq: What is the goal of The Depth of the Limbo?
Complete each of the 13 levels from beginning to end to wake up. Each level is a one-minute test cycle.
Why do the directions feel confusing?
The camera rotates around the character and changes the orientation of the space, so a route that looks familiar can point a different way than expected.

special-strike-zombies.intro: Special Strike Zombies is a 3D shooter where you play a special forces soldier fighting hordes of zombies and mercenaries. Pick the right weapon for each wave to survive and clear every level.
tips: Match your weapon to the enemy wave in front of you, since the description stresses choosing a suitable weapon for each wave.
Switch weapons with the mouse wheel before a wave arrives rather than mid-fight, so you are not caught reloading the wrong gun.
Press R to reload during a lull in the action, not while enemies are closing in on you.
Use WASD to keep moving and avoid standing still in one spot where a horde can surround you.
Use crouch (C) and jump (Space) to change your position and line up shots when enemies approach from different directions.
faq: What is the goal of Special Strike Zombies?
Use your arsenal to shoot zombies and mercenaries, choosing a suitable weapon for each wave, so you can survive and complete each level.
Which keys control the soldier?
WASD moves, the left mouse button shoots, the mouse wheel changes weapons, R reloads, Space jumps, C crouches, and P pauses the game.

sky-slash-ninja-rise.intro: Sky Slash: Ninja Rise is a one-tap arcade climber where you leap between walls, slash flying enemies, and race the rising mist. Chain combos, beat bosses, and see how high you can climb.
tips: Keep an eye on the mist below, since it rises faster the higher you go. Don't linger on one wall for too long.
Plan your leaps ahead so you land near the next enemy. Each leap through an enemy is a chance to extend your combo.
Use the extra tap in mid-air to flip when you need to change direction quickly instead of committing to a risky jump.
Watch bosses closely and only leap into them when they are open. Attacking at the wrong moment wastes your opening.
Collect coins whenever they are safe to reach, since they unlock new ninjas with their own powers. Try different ninjas to see which suits your climbing style.
faq: What is the goal of Sky Slash: Ninja Rise?
Climb as high as you can by leaping between walls, slashing enemies, and beating bosses across 9 worlds. The mist below rises faster the higher you go, so the run ends if it catches you.
What controls do I use?
Tap, click, or press SPACE to leap to the other wall, and tap again in the air to flip. You can pause with the pause button or Esc on desktop.

percys-froggy-frenzy.intro: Percys Froggy Frenzy is a fast-paced platformer where you guide a frog named Percy through levels while he auto-fires bouncing bubble shots at falling bubbles. Collect coins to power him up as you go.
tips: Keep Percy moving left and right with A and D or the arrow keys so he stays out of the path of falling bubbles while he keeps firing.
Plan your jumps before you leap across platforms, since the levels are built around timing your landing spots.
Pay attention to where coins are placed, because they are worth going out of your way for. Each coin can boost Percy's shooting speed, power, or health.
Aim your attention on health when hits start to pile up, since taking damage can force a level restart.
Treat each run as a chance to learn the level layout, because the varied challenges reward players who notice patterns and adjust as they progress.
faq: What is the goal of Percys Froggy Frenzy?

The goal is to guide Percy through platforming levels, pop falling bubbles with his automatic bubble shots, and collect coins along the way. The game offers endless progression with varied challenges.
What controls do I use to play?
Use the A and D keys or the left and right arrow keys to move Percy left and right. Percy fires his bubble shots automatically, so you focus on movement and jumping.

mine-master.intro: Mine Master is a merge and digging puzzle where you combine matching shovels to build stronger tools and dig deeper underground. Each level asks you to collect coins and finish specific goals.
tips: Merge shovels early so you have stronger digging tools before the layers below get harder to clear.
Before each dig, check which shovels you have and whether a matching pair is available to combine first.
Keep an eye on the level objectives and plan your digs around them rather than collecting coins at random.
Upgrade your tools steadily instead of saving them up, since better shovels make deeper layers much easier to get through.
If you get stuck, look at your board for a merge you can make before digging further down.
faq: How do I merge shovels?
Tap two matching shovels and they will combine into a higher-level shovel.
How do I dig through blocks?
Select a shovel and tap the Down option to dig through the blocks below it.

farm-defenders.intro: Farm Defenders mixes farming and survival. You grow crops by day to fund weapons and defenses, then hold a fence against endless night waves. Your run ends when the fence falls.
tips: Before you start a wave, use the calm time to plant, water, and harvest so your coins keep coming in for the fights ahead.
Since nothing moves until you start a wave, check your fence and defenses first and only begin when your setup is ready.
Your character fires on its own, so focus on where you stand. Move toward the gate that is breaking and keep enemies from settling near your fence.
Read the upcoming wave before choosing your free boost. Pick damage, fence strength, or fire rate based on what you expect the horde to do.
Save the revive for when your fence is nearly gone. It is your last chance to keep the run going, so don't waste it early.
faq: How do I end a run?
A run ends when the fence falls. Keep the horde away from it by positioning your character and defending the gate under the most pressure.
Do I need to aim my weapons?
No. Your character aims and fires automatically, so your main job is moving to the right place at the right time.

cat-puzzle-draw-to-kitten.intro: Cat Puzzle: Draw to Kitten is a casual puzzle game where you draw safe paths that lead each cat to its kittens. The challenge grows as you move through levels with more enemies and obstacles.
tips: Plan the whole route before you start drawing, looking at where enemies and obstacles sit between each cat and its kittens.
Check how the lines will cross before you finish one, since cats that collide become dizzy and you lose.
Start with the cat that has the clearest path so you can see how the other routes need to fit around it.
Give extra attention to the enemies and obstacles early in each level, because they are the main risk to a safe route.
When a level gets harder, slow down and redraw your plan rather than rushing, since the difficulty increases steadily.
faq: What is the goal of Cat Puzzle: Draw to Kitten?
Your goal is to draw a safe line for each cat to reach its kittens so that every cat gets home safely.
What happens if two cats collide?
If the cats collide, they become dizzy and you lose the level, so keep the routes apart from each other.

steal-my-egg.intro: Steal My Egg is a fast 3D action game where you sneak into wild worlds, grab rare eggs from giant guardians, and race home before you get caught. Each run tests your timing and your escape route.
tips: Before you grab an egg, look around and plan your route home so you are not running blind once the guardian notices you.
Keep the guardian in view while you move, since staying aware of where it is will help you pick the safest path.
Use the bat swing when rival thieves get close, rather than letting them slow you down on the way home.
Pay attention to giant eggs, because they are described as worth a fortune and can be a better target than common ones.
On mobile, use the joystick to move and tap the steal and jump buttons with clear timing so you do not waste a grab.
faq: What is the goal of Steal My Egg?
Sneak in, grab the egg, and run home before the giant guardian catches you. Getting the egg back to your home is what counts.
How do I bring the egg home?
Press H on PC to go home. Make sure you have the egg before you try to reach home.

hard-flap.intro: Hard Flap is a puzzle skill game where you guide a bouncing ball along the ground while dodging moving obstacles. You jump between obstacles and must avoid touching any of them.
tips: Watch several obstacles before your first jump, since they move at different speeds and the timing changes from one to the next.
Plan your jumps ahead rather than reacting to the closest obstacle, because you only get a limited number of jumps in a row.
Do not waste jumps on small hops. Save them for the moments when you really need to clear an obstacle.
Practice reading the rhythm of the obstacles in the early part of the game so you can time your jumps more consistently.
If you are playing on a touchscreen, tap at a steady pace and avoid rushing, since a mistimed tap can cost you the run.
faq: What is the goal of Hard Flap?
Keep the bouncing ball moving along the ground by jumping between obstacles without touching any of them.
How do I control the ball?
Use your mouse to click, or tap the screen on a touch device, to make the ball jump.

crazy-merge-room.intro: Crazy Merge Room is a fast-paced merging puzzle where you combine identical items into stronger versions before the room overflows. It is played with the mouse only.
tips: Look for identical items on the board before doing anything else, and merge pairs early so the room does not fill up.
Keep your open space organized by grouping similar items together, so you always see which matches are ready to combine.
Since items spawn faster over time, avoid leaving single items scattered around; each one you leave behind takes up room you will need later.
Plan a merge chain before you make it. Think about what the stronger version will need next to continue combining.
Save your boosters for tight moments when the room is close to overflowing, rather than using them the moment they become available.
faq: What is the main goal of Crazy Merge Room?
Merge identical items into stronger, crazier versions and clear the room before it overflows. Each successful merge helps you move on to new levels.
Does the spawn rate change during play?
Yes, the room keeps spawning items faster and faster, so the pressure increases as the game goes on. Staying organized early makes the later stages easier to manage.

yoga-master-flex-running.intro: Yoga Master is a 3D running game where you adjust your character's pose to dodge furniture and collect money along the way. Watch out, because some stacks of cash are traps.
tips: Watch the obstacles ahead rather than your character alone, so you can start changing the pose early enough to clear each piece of furniture.
Make small, quick swipes to shift lanes or adjust your pose; large, late swipes are more likely to leave you in the wrong place.
Before you grab a stack of money, check whether it sits near an obstacle or in an awkward spot, since some cash is a trap.
Stay calm and keep your focus on the next obstacle instead of the one you just passed, because a single hit ends your run.
Practice the early levels to learn how quickly each obstacle appears, then carry that timing into the harder levels that challenge fast reflexes.
faq: What is the goal of Yoga Master?
Run through each level by changing your pose and moving your character to avoid the furniture. Do not let anything hit you until you reach the end.
How do I control the character?
Tap or swipe to begin a level, then swipe to move the character. Swipe again to adjust the pose when you need to dodge furniture.

planet-404-episode-1.intro: Planet 404 Episode 1 is a puzzle platformer in which Alice explores a mysterious planet. You solve puzzles and overcome obstacles to move forward and uncover its secrets.
tips: Study each new landscape before rushing ahead, since the puzzles and obstacles are what open the path forward.
Test your jumps on safe ground first so you learn how far Alice can reach before you attempt a difficult gap.
If you get stuck, go back and look over the area again, because the solution is usually visible in the surroundings.
Keep an eye out for changes in the scenery, as new chapters of Alice's adventure appear as you progress.
On a phone or tablet, use the on-screen arrows with short, steady taps so you can control Alice's movement precisely.
faq: What is the main goal of Planet 404 Episode 1?
Your goal is to solve the puzzles and overcome the obstacles on the mysterious planet. Each solution moves you forward and reveals a new part of Alice's story.
How do I move and jump on a computer?
Press D or the right arrow to run right, and A or the left arrow to run left. Press the space bar or the up arrow to jump.

tall-grass.intro: Tall Grass is a turn-based arcade game about clearing hidden fields one step at a time. Each cut tile reveals clues, and you decide when to leave with your loot or push deeper.
tips: Read the numbers before you step. A number counts the monsters in the eight tiles around it, so a 0 area is usually safer to clear next.
Use the gate as a decision point. Once it opens, weigh the shards and upgrades you already have against the risk of going deeper.
Check the morning weather before you start. Mist shortens how far you can read, and dusk cuts the light, so plan your early moves more carefully on those days.
Take your time. Nothing happens until you move, so you can study the field between steps instead of rushing.
Look for the hidden thing in every field. Scan the grass closely before committing to a path, since a careful eye is what finds it.
faq: How do I move through the field?
Use the arrow keys or WASD, or tap or swipe on a touchscreen. Stepping into tall grass cuts it, and stepping into a woken monster strikes it.
What do the numbers on cleared tiles mean?
A number tells you how many hidden monsters are in the eight tiles surrounding that tile. Use these counts to decide where it is safe to step next.

tiny-zomby-the-barricade.intro: Tiny Zomby The Barricade is a shooting game where you defend a fence from a watchtower. You aim, shoot, and spend coins to keep the zombies from breaking through.
tips: Watch the barricade's condition before each wave and prioritize zombies closest to it, since a fallen fence ends your defense.
Drag slowly to line up your aim before tapping, so you spend fewer shots on zombies that are already moving past your target.
Pick up coins as soon as they drop, because you need them to save up for the shotgun.
Place mines on the paths zombies keep walking, so one mine can catch several of them before they reach the fence.
Save your coins for the shotgun early rather than spending them on small upgrades, so you have a stronger weapon for the boss at the end of each stage.
faq: What is the goal of Tiny Zomby The Barricade?
Keep the wooden barricade standing through six stages of six waves each. Each stage ends with a boss.
How do I aim and shoot?
Drag to aim and tap to shoot. Aim carefully before firing so your shots count.

chaos-arena.intro: Chaos Arena is an arcade game where you drag back on your spinner, aim, and release to fling it into the arena. Knock out every opponent, bounce off walls, and beat the bosses.
tips: Watch the walls before you launch. Bounces can carry your spinner into enemies you could not reach by a straight shot.
Pull back only as far as you need. A shorter drag gives you more control over where you end up, while a longer drag sends you further but is harder to aim.
Pay attention to where your spinner stops after each launch. Plan your next swipe from that spot so you are not starting from scratch every time.
Try different builds when you adjust yours. Notice which setups help you smash enemies the most, and keep the ones that work for you.
Take boss fights one launch at a time. Study how the boss moves and reacts before you commit to a big swing.
faq: What is the goal of Chaos Arena?
Your goal is to knock out every opponent in the arena to claim victory. Bosses are tougher challenges you need to beat along the way.
How do I control my spinner?
Drag back with one finger, aim, and let go. Each launch sends your spinner flying across the arena.

cake-stack.intro: Cake Stack is a one-touch arcade game where you guide a yellow character along a track, stacking cake layers while dodging obstacles. Build the tallest tower you can and chase a new high score.
tips: Watch the track ahead rather than the tower, so you can react to obstacles before they reach your character.
Keep your taps steady and avoid rapid tapping, since one touch controls the whole run.
Collect golden coins when they are on your path, but do not risk a crash to reach one that is out of the way.
Coins can be spent in the shop on unlockable characters and skins, so it is worth saving some for them.
Treat each run as practice: notice which obstacles caught you and adjust your timing on the next attempt.
faq: What is the goal of Cake Stack?
Guide your yellow character along the track, dodge obstacles, collect golden coins and build the cake tower as high as you can. The aim is to set a new high score.
What controls does the game use?
Use a mouse click or tap to play. The controls are one-touch, so the whole game is played with a single input.

dino-egg-shooter.intro: Dino Egg Shooter is a bubble-style puzzle game with 100 levels set in a prehistoric world. Aim, shoot, and clear the board of colorful dino eggs as the levels get harder.
tips: Before each shot, look for matching groups of eggs you can clear in one move. Clearing a bigger group usually opens up the board more.
Pay attention to the shape of the formation. Shooting at the edges or supports of a cluster can bring down more eggs than hitting the middle.
Because some levels limit your shots, avoid wasting them on single eggs when a better shot is coming up. Think about the next one before you fire.
Take a moment to study tricky formations before aiming. Plan a route that clears an area you can reach easily, then work toward the harder parts.
Use the left and right aim to test angles carefully. Small adjustments can make a big difference when eggs are packed closely together.
faq: How do I aim and shoot?
Aim left and right to shoot. Line up your shot with the eggs you want to clear.
What is the goal of each level?
Your goal is to clear the board of dino eggs. Each level has its own challenge, such as a tricky formation or a limited number of shots.

van-rush.intro: Van Rush! is a driving game where you drive a van, solve a loading puzzle, and deliver packages to earn money. This guide covers the basic route from pickup to drop-off.
tips: Turn on fullscreen before you start, since the instructions recommend it for this game.
Press C to switch between the cursor and driving when you need to pick an order, then press C again to get back to the van.
After you reach the orange platform and wait 3 seconds, the loading puzzle opens. Take your time with it, because the deliveries only appear after you press Finish.
Check the big map with M once you accept a delivery so you can follow the green circle to the drop-off point.
Use Space to brake when you need to slow down, and keep an eye on the Tab deliveries menu to see which jobs are waiting.
faq: How do I start a delivery?
Drive the van to the orange platform and wait 3 seconds for the loading puzzle. Once you finish the puzzle and press Finish, open the deliveries menu with Tab and click a delivery to take it.
What does the green circle on the map mean?
The green circle marks the place where you need to deliver the package. Use the big map (M) to check its location.

offroad-muddy-trucks.intro: Offroad Muddy Trucks is a monster truck racing game with huge tires and bodies. You can play career mode alone or with a friend on a large open map full of muddy grounds.
tips: Use the Restart key (R for Player 1, M for Player 2) if your truck gets stuck or flipped, so you can get back on track quickly instead of struggling in the mud.
Save your NOS boost for muddy or uphill stretches where your truck is slowing down, rather than using it on the first open ground you reach.
Try different grounds on the map as the description suggests, and notice how each surface changes the way your truck handles so you can pick the right approach for each one.
In two-player mode, keep an eye on your friend's position on the map and plan your routes so you are not blocking each other on narrow sections.
Stop briefly to check the terrain ahead before committing to a steep or muddy path, since a short pause can prevent a costly stall.
faq: What is the goal of Offroad Muddy Trucks?
The main goal is to drive your monster truck across the muddy terrain in career mode, whether you play alone or with a friend. You can also explore the free map and try out its different grounds.
How do I switch cars in the game?
Get near the vehicle you want, then press F as Player 1 or N as Player 2. Use the same switch key while you are close to the car.

worm-path.intro: Worm Path is a logic puzzle where you steer a worm through tricky mazes to reach the exit. Each level adds new layouts and harder obstacles that reward careful planning.
tips: Before you move, trace the whole route to the exit in your head so you don't walk into a dead end.
Pushing blocks can open a path but can also trap you, so check where a block will end up before you push it.
If you get stuck, restart the level rather than trying to force your way out, since many positions cannot be recovered.
Test small moves first to learn how obstacles behave, then commit to a longer sequence once you understand the layout.
Use the early levels to learn the rules, since later levels build on the same ideas with new layouts.
faq: How do I move the worm?
Use the W, A, S, D keys or the arrow buttons to move the worm across the tiles.
What is the goal of each level?
Guide the worm through the maze to reach the exit while avoiding obstacles and not getting stuck.

ping-pong-battle-table-tennis.intro: Ping Pong Battle - Table Tennis is an arcade sports game where you compete against opponents in fast table tennis matches. You hit the ball back and forth using your paddle, aiming to win each rally.
tips: Pay attention to where the ball is coming from before you move, so you can position your paddle early instead of reacting at the last second.
Keep your paddle near the middle of the table between shots so you can reach both sides quickly.
Watch your opponent's paddle angle, since it often shows where the ball is likely to go.
Take short breaks between points to reset your focus, especially in longer matches against tough opponents.
Try different timing with your clicks or taps to see how the paddle reacts, and adjust based on how the ball returns.
faq: How do I control the paddle?
Use mouse clicks or taps to play, as the instructions describe. Pay attention to how each click affects your return shot.
What makes a rally hard to win?
Fast, well-placed shots that push your paddle to the edge of its reach are the hardest to return. Staying centered helps you respond to them.

flag-coloring-puzzle.intro: Flag Coloring Puzzle asks you to fill in national flags by matching each country name shown at the top with the right colors from the palette. It is a light puzzle that tests both memory and geography knowledge.
tips: Read the country name at the top before you pick any color, so you know which flag you are building.
Work through the flag one blank area at a time rather than jumping around, which makes it easier to check each section.
Pay attention to which colors appear on the flag and where they sit, since the layout is part of getting it right.
If you are unsure of a flag, recall its main colors first, then fill in the largest areas before the small details.
Finish each flag accurately rather than rushing, because the instructions say completing it correctly is what levels you up.
faq: What is the goal of Flag Coloring Puzzle?
The goal is to color each national flag correctly by matching the country name shown at the top. Completing a flag accurately levels you up.
How do I color a flag?
Select a color from the palette below the flag, then tap the blank area you want to fill. Repeat until every section is colored.

gunner-pursuit.intro: Gunner Pursuit is a fast-paced action shooter where you fire from a moving vehicle while dodging and taking on enemies. Upgrading your gear helps you get through each challenging stage.
tips: Use the L key early to get comfortable with the cursor. Being able to lock and unlock it quickly makes it easier to switch between aiming and moving around.
Keep your mouse moving to look around while the vehicle is in motion. Scanning ahead helps you spot enemies before they close in.
Fire in short bursts instead of holding the button down. This keeps your aim steady and makes your shots more accurate against moving targets.
Focus on the enemies closest to you first. Eliminating immediate threats keeps you from being overwhelmed during an intense pursuit.
Pay attention to how each stage plays out and adjust your approach. Stages are challenging, so learning their patterns will help you survive longer.
faq: What is the goal of Gunner Pursuit?
Your goal is to shoot from your fast-moving vehicle while navigating enemies and surviving each challenging stage. Enhancing your gear helps you keep going.
How do I aim and shoot?
Move the mouse to look around and left-click to shoot. Press L to lock or unlock the cursor if you need to change how you control the view.

roll-sky-ball-3d.intro: Roll Sky Ball 3D is a fast arcade game where you guide a ball along winding 3D tracks full of obstacles. The goal is to reach the end of each track without falling off or hitting hazards.
tips: Keep your eyes on the track a few steps ahead of the ball rather than on the ball itself, so you can react before obstacles arrive.
Make small, gentle slides instead of big sweeping ones, since overcorrecting is a common reason the ball leaves the path.
Expect the layout to change unexpectedly, and slow your reactions slightly at turns and gaps so you do not commit to a move too early.
If you fall or miss a section, try the same part again with a calmer pace rather than rushing, because speed is what makes the tracks harder to control.
Watch for the ball's momentum on slopes and bends, and ease off before a sharp turn to keep it on the surface.
faq: How do I move the ball?
Slide your finger or mouse across the screen to steer the ball along the track.
What is the goal of each track?
The goal is to reach the end of each track, so focus on staying on the path and avoiding obstacles.

ben-10-alien.intro: Ben 10 Alien is a jump-and-run adventure where you play as Ben, transforming into different aliens to jump, run, fight and swim through obstacle-filled levels. Collecting coins and finding hidden blocks and levels are part of the challenge.
tips: Watch for falling bricks and time your jumps so you pass them without stopping in their path.
Transform into the alien that fits the situation, since each form is suited to different obstacles and enemies.
