Use your shooting and fighting when enemies block the path, but save your moves for dangerous spots where you have no other way forward.
Keep an eye out for hidden blocks and levels, as they are easy to miss when you are focused on running ahead.
When you reach the sea sections, slow down and plan your route, because the water is dangerous and sharks are present.
faq: What is the main goal of Ben 10 Alien?
You move through jump-and-run levels, defeat enemies and get past traps and obstacles to complete the platformer.
How do I transform into different aliens?
The description says Ben transforms into several aliens using the Omnitrix, but it does not list the exact controls, so check the in-game instructions.

money-cutter-idle.intro: Money Cutter Idle is a clicker where you merge bills, unlock higher-value money, and grow your income row by row. Your earnings keep coming in even when you stop tapping.
tips: Spend your early earnings on upgrades for your rows, since each upgrade pushes your income further.
Merge identical bills whenever you can, because combining them creates more valuable currency and raises your overall profit.
Tap the screen often in the early stage to speed up production, then rely more on idle earnings as your system grows.
Expand your income system before buying every available upgrade, so new rows add to your earnings over time.
Check back regularly to collect progress and decide on your next upgrade, since your money keeps building while you are away.
faq: What is the main goal of Money Cutter Idle?
The goal is to grow your cash flow from basic bills into a large fortune by merging money, unlocking higher bills, and expanding your earnings.
How do I make my money grow faster?
Combine identical bills to create more valuable currency, and keep upgrading your rows and income system to increase your profit.

clownfish-pin-out.intro: Clownfish Pin Out is a puzzle game where you help a small fish escape a dangerous place. Tap the pins to guide the waterfall to the fish while keeping it away from lava.
tips: Look at the whole screen before you tap, and trace where the water will flow before you move any pin.
Keep the lava in mind at all times and check which paths it could reach as the level changes.
Take your time on each move, since the description warns that a rushed move can cost you the level.
If a level stops making sense, try a different pin first to see how the water reacts, then plan your next moves.
Focus on getting the fish to safety with the fewest moves you can, rather than tapping pins at random.
faq: What is the goal of Clownfish Pin Out?
The goal is to help the little fish escape from a dangerous place by directing the waterfall to reach it. You must avoid the lava along the way.
How do I control the game?
You play by tapping the pins on the screen. Each tap changes how the waterfall moves.

light-stream.intro: Light Stream is a puzzle game where you reflect a laser beam off mirrors to light the path to a gate. Each level asks you to aim the beam correctly so the door unlocks.
tips: Before you touch anything, trace the beam's path in your head from the source to the gate so you know which mirrors matter.
Rotate one mirror at a time and watch where the beam goes after each change, rather than moving several at once.
Look for a level's three stars by testing small variations of a working setup, since the star goals are part of the challenge.
If you get stuck, reset your mirror angles and start from the beam source again to avoid working from a messy layout.
On Android, tap the on-screen controls with steady, deliberate touches; on PC, use single left clicks so each mirror turn is easy to track.
faq: What is the goal of Light Stream?
Your goal is to reflect the laser beam with the mirrors so it reaches the gate and unlocks the door for the next level.
How do I control the mirrors?
On Android, use the on-screen touch controls to change the mirror direction. On PC, use the left mouse button to change it.

from-zombie-to-glam-a-spooky.intro: From Zombie to Glam is a Halloween makeover game where you help Ellie move from her undead look to a glamorous everyday style. You work through cleaning, makeup, nails, and dress-up.
tips: Work through the steps in the order the game presents them, since cleaning comes before makeup and dress-up.
Clean up each area fully before moving on, so the later makeover steps look their best.
Try a few different makeup and nail combinations before settling on a final look to see which suits Ellie most.
Mix and match clothing and accessories in the dress-up stage to find a spooky-chic style you like.
Take your time with each click and interaction, because the transformation is built up gradually.
faq: What is the goal of From Zombie to Glam?
The goal is to transform Ellie from a zombie into a glam, ordinary girl through a series of makeover levels. Each level focuses on a different part of the look.
How do I play the game?
Click and interact with the items and areas on screen to clean, apply makeup, decorate nails, and choose clothes. Each action moves Ellie closer to her new look.

taxi-driver-simulator.intro: Taxi Driver Simulator is a 3D city driving game where you pick up passengers and deliver them across town. Work Mode has 80 levels to complete, and Free mode lets you keep driving without advancing.
tips: Follow the blue direction indicators closely so you always know where the next pickup or drop-off is.
Slow down before you steer. Braking early through turns is usually faster than correcting a skid after you enter them.
Obey red lights. Running them can cost you time, so plan your approach to intersections ahead of time.
Save up for the other cars in the garage. Each one you buy gives you another option to try in the game.
In Free mode, keep an eye on your fuel and stop at gas stations to pay for fuel before you run low.
faq: What is the main goal in Work Mode?
Complete the 80 levels and earn 3 yellow stars to become an eligible taxi driver. Pick up passengers and deliver them to their destinations efficiently.
How do I earn money?
You earn money by serving customers. Use the money you earn to buy the other 9 cars in the garage.

tug-pull-crash-challenge.intro: Tug Pull Crash Challenge is a 3D racing arena where customized cars pull against each other toward dangerous crushers. Manage engine heat, upgrade your car, and stay clear of explosive hazards.
tips: Hold the pull control in short bursts when you need to build a steady tug, and ease off before your engine gets too hot.
Release the pull input to cool the engine, so you can keep pulling hard later in the match.
Pay attention to where the crushers and explosive hazards are before you commit to a long pull.
Spend upgrades on wheels and body parts that match how you like to play, since both affect your car on the track.
Try new worlds once you unlock them to learn how the arena layout changes your pulling strategy.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You win by using your car to pull your rival toward the dangerous crushers while keeping your own car out of trouble.
Which controls do I use to pull?
Hold Space, W, Up Arrow, or Right Arrow, or hold the left mouse button anywhere on the game area. Release the key or button to ease the engine.

pinata-color-smash.intro: Pinata Color Smash is a casual color puzzle where you break piñatas by picking the bat that matches their color. Bats are chosen from the top and the ones beneath them are revealed as you play.
tips: Before tapping, check the color of the piñata you want to break and find the matching bat at the top of the screen.
Pick top bats in an order that reveals the bats you will need next, rather than choosing at random.
Save your five tile slots for harder piñatas so you are not stuck without a helpful extra bat when it matters.
If you run low on options, look at which bats are still hidden and plan around the colors you have not yet seen.
Take your time with each choice; this is a relaxed puzzle, so careful matching usually beats rushing.
faq: How do I break a piñata?
Select a bat at the top of the screen that matches the color of the piñata you want to break.
What happens when I choose a top bat?
The matching bat at the bottom of the screen is revealed, which can give you new options to work with.

zen-garden-match.intro: Zen Garden Match is a calm match-3 puzzle where you clear flower tiles by matching sets of three. The goal is to clear the board without letting the dock area fill up.
tips: Before each move, check which flowers appear in groups and look for the ones you can collect together.
Send a tile to the dock only when it helps you complete a set of three, since the dock has limited room.
Pick up tiles that are easy to reach first, and leave buried tiles for later once the board opens up.
If the dock is getting crowded, look for a match you can finish right away to free up space.
Take your time. The game has no stated time pressure, so a slow, careful approach suits it well.
faq: How do I play Zen Garden Match?
Click or use the mouse to select cubes and send them to the dock area. Match three of the same flower to clear them from the board.
What happens if the dock area fills up?
The game is lost if the dock area fills up before you clear the board. Keep the dock clear by only sending tiles that you can match.

funny-hair-salon.intro: Help George fix his hair at the salon. You will treat his scalp and then plant new hair so he can show off his inner beauty.
tips: Deal with the scalp problem before you plant new hair, since the scalp is the base for everything that follows.
Pick one tool at a time and check how it changes George's scalp before moving on, so you can tell which step helped.
Look over the whole scene first to see which items, tools, and buttons are available before you start clicking or tapping.
If a choice does not seem to work, try a different tool or item instead of repeating the same action.
Take your time with the hair planting step, and check the result carefully before you finish.
faq: What is the goal of Funny Hair Salon?
Your goal is to cure George's scalp and plant new hair on his head so he can look his best.
How do I play on desktop?
Use your mouse to click items, tools, and buttons to interact with the salon and with George.

coin-sort-puzzle.intro: Coin Sort Puzzle is a grid-based arcade puzzle where you sort and merge coins by denomination to clear the board. Speed, precision, and planning all matter as the coin flow keeps growing.
tips: Look at the whole board before each move so you can see which coins belong in which line.
Keep each line sorted by denomination, because a mixed line makes later merges harder.
Plan a few moves ahead rather than reacting to each new coin, since the flow of coins keeps growing.
Work on accuracy first and build speed afterward, as a wrong placement can cost you more time than a slower move.
Earn as many coins as you can on each level, since they help you progress as you unlock new levels.
faq: What is the goal of Coin Sort Puzzle?
Your goal is to organize the flow of coins into their matching lines by denomination and merge them to clear the board. Clearing the board lets you unlock new levels.
What skills does this game test?
The game tests your decision-making, reflexes, and strategy. Good planning and quick, precise placement both help you keep up with the growing coin flow.

bird-game-clicker.intro: Bird Game Clicker is a clicker about hesitation. You tap to collect feathers, upgrade a flock of doubtful birds, and work toward a full collection of uncertain creatures.
tips: Spend feathers on regular upgrades early, since they drive your progression and help you earn faster.
Save grain for the unique improvements and special bonuses it unlocks, because it is the rarer currency.
Read each upgrade's description before buying, as some have unexpected effects that may not help the way you expect.
Keep an eye on the birds you have not unlocked yet, and check which upgrades help you reach them.
Check the leaderboards now and then to see how far you are from the top positions and what your progress looks like against others.
faq: What is the main goal of Bird Game Clicker?
Tap the screen to collect feathers, upgrade your flock, and unlock new birds until you complete the full collection.
What is the difference between feathers and grain?
Feathers are used for regular upgrades and faster progression, while grain is a rare currency for unique improvements and special bonuses.

hobo-speedster.intro: Hobo Speedster is a 2D cartoon motorcycle platform game where you race toward the finish line while keeping your bike balanced. Earn coins and diamonds to upgrade bikes and unlock riders.
tips: Keep your bike balanced before pushing for speed, since a tipped bike will slow you down or end your run.
Use the forward and back controls in short bursts on steep or uneven ground instead of holding one direction the whole time.
Spend your early coins and diamonds on upgrading the bike you already use at the motorcycle settlement, so each run gets easier to control.
Try the different maps to learn how their terrain changes, and adjust your riding style for each one.
Check your task list regularly and aim for the tasks that are close to done, since they give extra rewards.
faq: What is the goal of Hobo Speedster?
Your goal is to keep the motorcycle balanced and reach the finish line on each map.
How do I control the bike on PC?
Press A or the Left arrow to move back and D or the Right arrow to move forward.

zombie-mission-6.intro: Zombie Mission 6 is a two-player action game set in the desert, where you and a friend work together to rescue kidnapped prisoners and defeat bosses. Player 1 and Player 2 each have their own control set.
tips: Agree on roles with your partner before you start, such as who handles close attacks and who covers from range, so you do not waste hits on the same target.
Spend coins on upgrades at the market between levels, focusing first on the stat that is struggling most, whether that is your weapons or your health bar.
Save grenades for groups of enemies or for the mini and mega bosses, rather than using them on single weak zombies.
Use the wall-walk and jump controls to reach higher ground and get around enemies, instead of standing still in open ground where you can be surrounded.
Switch weapons with your switch key when the situation changes, and keep an eye on your health bar so you can retreat or regroup with your partner before it runs low.
faq: How do I move and attack in Zombie Mission 6?
Player 1 moves with W, A, S and D, attacks with F and throws grenades with G. Player 2 moves with the arrow keys, attacks with L and throws grenades with K.
How do I make my character stronger?
Collect coins during the game, then click the market icon between levels to see what you can improve, such as your weapons and health bar.

dronner-3d.intro: Dronner 3D is a racing game where your car can switch into a quadcopter to fly over tracks. Collect points and battery charges while managing damage and battery levels.
tips: Keep an eye on your battery and damage indicators throughout each level, not just when they run low.
Pick up battery charges whenever you can, since they help you keep moving through the track.
Be extra careful before switching to quadcopter mode, because collisions are especially dangerous while flying.
Plan your transformations around the track layout so you switch modes at the right moments rather than mid-danger.
Use the statistics table at the end of each level to see which parts of your run cost you the most points or damage, then adjust your approach.
faq: How do I switch between car and quadcopter mode?
Press the Spacebar to transform the machine into a quadcopter, and press it again to change back to car mode.
How do I move up and down while flying?
In quadcopter mode, use Q to move upward and E to move downward, and use the arrow keys or WASD to move in other directions.

hill-climb-2022.intro: Hill Climb 2022 is a 2D physics-based racing game where you guide a car up hills across a wide range of courses. This guide covers the controls and some habits that help you climb further.
tips: Use A and D for left and right, and practice short presses so you can see how the car responds to each change in direction.
Pay attention to the terrain ahead, since the physics means the car reacts to slopes and bumps, and small adjustments can keep it stable.
Try different courses to learn how each environment changes the feel of the climb, from the early hills to more unusual settings.
Experiment with different cars and their handling to find one that suits your style, since the game offers many options.
Take a break between runs to think about what caused a crash or stall, then adjust your approach on the next attempt.
faq: What is the goal of Hill Climb 2022?
The goal is to race your way up the hill and keep climbing as far as you can across the courses. The game is built around physics, so careful driving matters.
Which keys control the car?
The instructions say to use A and D for left and right. Practice these keys to get comfortable with how the car moves on different slopes.

happy-fluffy-cubes.intro: Happy Fluffy Cubes is an arcade runner where you steer a fluffy cube through dangerous levels using one finger. Dodge the hazards, collect coins, and hatch new Fluffies to build your collection.
tips: Keep your finger steady and make small, early moves up or down so your Fluffy never has to swerve at the last second.
Look ahead for fire, ice, lasers, and spinning saws, and start adjusting before a hazard reaches your cube.
Grab coins when your path is clear, since you need them to buy chests, but don't chase them into danger.
Save coins for chests when you can, because each chest may contain an egg that hatches a new Fluffy.
Put some of your coins toward upgrading the incubator, since higher levels hatch Fluffies faster.
faq: What is the goal of Happy Fluffy Cubes?
Fly your Fluffy through each level while avoiding fire, ice, lasers, and spinning saws. Along the way, collect coins and eggs to grow your collection.
How do I control my Fluffy?
Hold the screen and move your finger up or down to guide the cube. Keep your finger down, because lifting it is one of the ways to lose.

space-rolling-balls-race.intro: Space Rolling Balls Race is a 3D arcade runner where you steer a rolling ball along cosmic tracks full of obstacles, traps, jumps and moving platforms. Stay on the path and keep your reflexes sharp to go as far as you can.
tips: Look ahead rather than at your ball. Spotting traps and gaps early gives you time to adjust your line before you reach them.
Use small, steady swipes or drags to steer. Large sudden movements can push the ball off the path on the narrow sections.
Listen to the background music and try to match your moves to its beat, since the rhythm helps guide your timing for jumps and platforms.
Collect power-ups when they are safe to reach. They boost your score and help you progress faster, but never sacrifice your footing to grab one.
Track your best distance and try to beat it in short sessions. Focusing on one section at a time helps improve your reaction speed.
faq: What is the goal of Space Rolling Balls Race?
Your aim is to roll your ball through the space tracks, dodging obstacles and traps, and get as far as possible. Falling off the path ends the run.
How do I move the ball?
Swipe or drag your finger on the screen to steer the ball along the track.

gorilgo-fps-online-shooter.intro: GORILGO FPS is a fast 3D first person shooter where you can switch between human form with guns and a gorilla form built for close combat. Learn when to use each form to outplay your opponents.
tips: Stay on the move with WASD so enemies find it harder to line up clean shots on you.
Use human form for precise shooting at range, and save your gorilla transformation for close-quarters fights where melee damage matters most.
Press F at a moment when enemies are not expecting it, since surprise is a big part of how the gorilla form pays off.
Use Space to jump when you need to reposition quickly or get out of a bad spot during a chaotic battle.
Before each fight, check which weapon you are holding and get comfortable switching between ranged and melee play so you are never stuck in the wrong form.
faq: What is the main goal of GORILGO FPS?
The description says the aim is to defeat rivals and control the battlefield by mastering both shooting and gorilla power. Focus on picking fights that build your advantage.
How do I transform into a gorilla?
Press F at any moment during play to switch from human form into gorilla form. Gorilla form gives you stronger close combat and brutal melee attacks.

blocks-move-n-hit.intro: Blocks Move n HIT is a single-player action puzzle where you guide a block through a maze of stone blocks that bounce you off course. Plan each move around the rebounds to reach the target.
tips: Before you move, look at where each bump will send you, since every collision changes your direction.
Watch for angles: a hit at 45 degrees sends you diagonally, while a hit at 90 degrees makes a full turn, so plan which one you need.
Think of the path as a chain of rebounds and work backward from the target to find a route that lands you there.
The path can shift as you go, so re-check the layout after each move instead of relying on your first plan.
If a route stops working, try a different first hit rather than repeating the same move.
faq: What is the goal of Blocks Move n HIT?
Your goal is to move and hit your way to the target by guiding your block through the maze.
How do the stone blocks affect movement?
The immovable stone blocks bounce you off course with every bump, so each collision changes where you go next.

bus-jam-sort.intro: Bus Jam Sort is a color-sorting puzzle where you sort waiting passengers onto their matching buses. Shuffle passengers, make triple matches, and get the VIPs out on time.
tips: Scan the whole waiting area before you move, so you can spot which colors appear most often and plan around them.
Give VIP passengers priority, since they need to be released on time and delays can cost you.
Look for chances to make triple matches, because lining up three of the same color is the core way to clear passengers.
Use the shuffle to break up stuck arrangements instead of making random moves that could block other colors.
Take short breaks between sessions so you can return with a clearer view of the color patterns.
faq: What is the goal of Bus Jam Sort?
Sort the passengers by color so they board the buses that match them, and release the VIPs on time.
What makes a VIP passenger different?
VIPs must be released on time, so they add urgency and you need to plan your moves to get them out before they are held up.

icing-on-doll-cake-creative-bakery.intro: Icing On Doll Cake is a relaxed decorating game where you frost a spinning cake-shaped dress in different colors. Tap or click to add icing and build a stylish design.
tips: Plan your color order before you start, so the dress looks balanced as it spins.
Work slowly and in small sections, since the dress keeps turning and each tap lands where the icing meets the surface.
Mix bold and soft colors to see which combinations look most stylish to you.
Step back and look at the whole dress between layers to check for gaps or uneven coverage.
Treat it as a calm practice session, and try a few different designs to build your own style.
faq: What is the goal of Icing On Doll Cake?
The goal is to frost the outside of the spinning dress with different colors and create a stylish, beautiful design.
How do I control the game?
Tap or click to apply the icing to the dress while it spins.

pop-the-ball.intro: Pop The Ball is a physics puzzle where you pop balloons into smaller ones and guide them through matching holes. Plan each pop so every balloon fits and lands in the basket.
tips: Before you click, check which holes each balloon must pass through, and pop only the balloons that will fit.
Think through the whole level first. A balloon you pop early can change the path of the others.
Pop a balloon only when its smaller pieces have a clear route to a matching hole.
Look for multiplier windows on the way to the basket and aim balls through them to increase their amount.
If a level stalls, reset your plan and check which balloons are blocking the path to the basket.
faq: What is the goal of Pop The Ball?
Fill the basket with balloons to complete each level. Every balloon needs to fit through its matching hole and land in the basket.
How do I pop a balloon?
Click on a balloon to pop it into smaller ones. Choose which balloons to pop based on where the smaller ones will go.

mortal-brothers-survival-friends.intro: Scorpion and Subzero must work together to solve puzzles and reach the portals in each level. Both must make it out alive, so every move should consider both characters.
tips: Before you move, look at where each character's flame is and which fire is dangerous for them. Plan the route for both characters before you start moving.
Use the space bar to switch characters often, so you can check whether the other character needs to move first to open a path.
Test the E key on the platforms early in a level to see how they move, then decide when to use it so a character can reach a higher spot.
Do not be afraid to experiment. You can restart the level as many times as you want, so trying a route and starting over is a useful way to learn the layout.
Keep your eyes on the fire on the ground. Touching the wrong fire ends the attempt immediately, so slow down near any hazard.
faq: What is the goal of Mortal Brothers Survival Friends?
The goal is to solve the puzzle in each level and get both Scorpion and Subzero to the portals so they can leave the level alive.
What happens if a character touches the wrong fire?
That character loses right away and the level must be restarted. You can restart as many times as you need.

offroad-driving-truck-transport.intro: Offroad Driving Truck Transport is a driving game where you haul heavy cargo over rugged terrain, muddy paths, and steep hills. It is played with the WASD keys across several levels in forest settings.
tips: Spend a few moments driving on open ground to learn how the WASD keys respond before you reach steep hills or mud.
Approach steep slopes slowly and steadily, since rushing up a hill is more likely to leave your truck stuck.
Look ahead at the path and choose the firmer ground over muddy stretches when there is a choice.
Take turns gently when carrying heavy cargo so the load stays under control on uneven ground.
If you get stuck, stop, check the terrain around your wheels, and try a slower, straighter approach instead of repeated quick attempts.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Your goal is to transport heavy cargo across challenging off-road landscapes while overcoming the obstacles on the way.
Which keys control the truck?
You steer and drive the truck using the W, A, S and D keys.

movie-star-daily-routine.intro: Movie Star Daily Routine follows a famous actress through a full day, from morning skin care to the red carpet. You control each step with a click or tap and can save your final look as a PNG image.
tips: Work through the routine in order, since each stage (skin care, gym, makeup, screen test, red carpet) builds toward the final look.
Before the gym, pack the bag fully with water, the yoga mat and the other accessories so nothing is missing when you move on.
Take your time choosing the tracksuit, because the game asks you to dress the star stylishly even for the gym.
During the screen test, try on the different heroine images to see which styles suit the character before you move on.
Save the clutch items for the red carpet and pick the most original outfit you can put together, then save the result as a PNG if you want to keep it.
faq: What is the goal of Movie Star Daily Routine?
The goal is to get the movie star ready for her day, from skin care and the gym to the screen test and finally a red carpet appearance. The game ends with an outfit meant to impress everyone.
How do I control the game?
Use a mouse click on a computer or a simple touch on a touchscreen. The same action works for every step of the routine.

wild-west-gun-game.intro: Wild West Gun Game is a single-player 3D shooter where you fight off waves of incoming enemies. Shoot quickly and clear them out to unlock new weapons.
tips: Keep moving with WASD so enemies have a harder time lining up clean shots on you.
Reload with R during a lull rather than in the middle of a fight, so you are not caught with an empty weapon.
Use the mouse wheel to switch weapons based on the situation, since each gun is useful in different moments.
Use Space to jump when you need to reposition quickly or dodge incoming fire.
Press P to pause when you need a moment to plan your next move, then resume when you are ready.
faq: What is the main goal of Wild West Gun Game?
Shoot as fast as you can to kill all the incoming enemies. Clearing them out lets you unlock new weapons.
How do I shoot and change weapons?
Left mouse button fires your weapon, and the mouse wheel switches between weapons. Use R to reload when your ammo runs low.

madness-driver-vertigo-city.intro: Madness Driver Vertigo City is a 3D racing game set in a busy city full of races, ramps and gem collecting. You can play alone or challenge a friend in two player mode.
tips: Use the free drive activities to learn how your car handles turns and jumps before you enter a timed race.
Hit ramps at a steady speed so you land in a controlled way and keep moving forward instead of drifting off course.
Save Nitro for straight stretches or the moments when you need a burst of speed, rather than using it on every corner.
Pick up gems on your way along the route when they do not force you into a bad line, since they add to your fun and are part of the city's activities.
If you get stuck or fall off the route, use the restart key right away instead of driving around to recover.
faq: What is the main goal of Madness Driver Vertigo City?
The goal is to race through the vertigo city, fly over ramps, collect gems and take part in races and amusement park activities.
How do I control my car in single player?
Use W, A, S, D or the arrow keys to move, L-SHIFT for Nitro, R to restart and T to look back.

fruit-lane-cafe.intro: Fruit Lane Cafe is a card-sorting puzzle where you slide cards through lanes to match sets and fill customer orders before the timer runs out. Plan each move with the cards you can see coming next.
tips: Before each tap, check which card will come out of the lane and into the bottom slot, then ask whether that card helps or blocks your next match.
Treat the multicolored spare card as a priority. Move it out of a lane early so that lane is not stuck when you are close to clearing it.
Look for lanes that are nearly matched and work on those first, since clearing a full set is what completes a customer's order.
Keep an eye on the timer and the number of open orders, and avoid spending moves on lanes that do not bring you closer to a finished order.
Use boosters when a level gets tight rather than early on, so you save them for the moments when a single extra move makes the difference.
faq: What is the main goal in Fruit Lane Cafe?
Clear full matching sets in the lanes to complete every customer order before the timer runs out.
How do I move cards?
Click or tap a lane to slide its bottom card in, and the outgoing card moves into the bottom slot. On desktop use the left mouse button, and on mobile tap the screen.

angry-pets-3d-boom.intro: Angry Pets: 3D Boom! is a physics demolition game where you launch pets from a slingshot, place charges on a building, and detonate them to bring it down before your shots run out.
tips: Rotate the camera around the building before your first shot to find its supports, since a blast there can bring down more of the structure.
Keep an eye on the health bar at the top and your remaining shots at the bottom so you know how much room you have to try again.
Pets stick where they land, so place your charges in a planned pattern first and then detonate them all at once with the lightning button.
If a building stays standing after a blast, change your angle instead of repeating the same shot, because a different side may expose a weaker point.
Use TNT from the bottom panel when you need extra force, and save coins between levels for pet upgrades that suit how you like to play.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You need to demolish the building before you run out of charges. The health bar at the top shows how close you are to finishing.
How do I aim my shots?
On a computer, hold the left mouse button and drag sideways to rotate the camera, then left-click a spot on the structure to launch a pet.

dancing-road.intro: Dancing Road is a rhythm runner where you steer a glowing ball along a neon track, matching colors to the beat. Each run is short, so quick reactions and steady lane choices matter most.
tips: Look ahead rather than reacting only to the ball in front of you, so you have time to slide into the right lane before a gate or group of balls arrives.
Pay attention to the music. The challenges are synced to the beat, so watching for the rhythm helps you anticipate when obstacles and gates come.
When a color gate is coming, move toward the lane that matches your ball's color early instead of making a last-second swerve.
Keep your drag movements small and smooth. Large, sudden swipes are easier to overshoot, especially on touch screens.
Try different music tracks once you have unlocked them, since each one may feel different and some runs may suit you better than others.
faq: What is the goal of Dancing Road?
Guide your ball into balls of the same color, avoid mismatched colors, and reach the end of the track while improving your score.
How do I control the ball?
Hold the left mouse button and drag left or right on desktop, or touch and drag horizontally on mobile. No keyboard is needed.

halloween-merge.intro: Halloween Merge is a puzzle game where you combine spooky items to complete levels, reveal secrets, and transform a haunted mansion. Drag matching items together to see what new pieces you can unlock.
tips: Before you merge, look at the whole board and decide which items you need for the level goal. Merging without a plan can use up pieces you need later.
Start with the items that combine into something new quickly, since they open up space and options on the board.
Pay attention to the secrets and treasures you reveal, because the items you unlock often feed into the next steps of a level.
If you get stuck, step back and check which items you have not merged yet. Sometimes a different combination opens the path forward.
Come back each day to claim the daily rewards, which can help you progress without rushing through levels.
faq: How do I merge two items?
On desktop, click an item, hold the left mouse button, and drag it onto the target item. On touch screens, tap and hold an item, drag it, and drop it onto the other item.
What is the goal of each level?
Each level asks you to match and merge items to complete it, and merging also reveals secrets along the way.

ragdoll-teleport-arena.intro: Ragdoll Teleport Arena is an arcade action game where you fire a projectile at enemies and can teleport to it mid-flight. Aim carefully, then use teleports to reposition quickly.
tips: Aim before you fire, since a well-placed shot is the main way to deal damage to enemies.
Watch your projectile after you shoot and tap again while it is in the air if you want to jump to its spot.
Use teleports to get out of danger or into a better angle, not just to close distance.
Plan your next move as you land, so you can keep shooting without stopping.
Stay mobile and vary your position so opponents have a harder time predicting where you will be.
faq: What is the goal of Ragdoll Teleport Arena?
You shoot a projectile to hit enemies and deal damage while outmaneuvering them. The game is about blending precise aiming with quick repositioning.
How do I control my character?
Use mouse clicks or taps. Click once to fire the projectile, then click again mid-flight to teleport to where it is.

mermaid-coloring-book-glitter.intro: Mermaid Coloring Book Glitter is a coloring game with many mermaid pages and sparkly painting. You can play with a mouse or by tapping the screen.
tips: Look over the pages before you start and choose the one you like best, so you have a clear idea of what you want to finish.
Work on one section at a time, such as the tail or the hair, so the page stays neat and easy to follow.
Try a few different pages to see which mermaid designs suit your style, since each one has its own shapes and details.
Use the sparkly effect on a few small areas first to see how it looks before adding more across the whole picture.
Take breaks between pages and come back with fresh eyes, which helps you notice spots you may want to touch up.
faq: What is the goal of Mermaid Coloring Book Glitter?
The goal is to color and decorate the mermaid pages in the book, adding sparkly glitter to make them shine.
How do I play the game?
You play with a mouse or by tapping the screen, depending on your device.

words-with-prof-wisely.intro: Words with Prof. Wisely is a word puzzle where you connect suggested letters to form hidden words and fill the empty cells on each level. Difficulty rises as you progress, and bonus words earn extra rewards.
tips: Scan the whole letter set first and look for common endings like -ing, -ed, or -er, which often unlock several words at once.
Start with the longest words you can spot, since they fill more cells and make the remaining letters easier to place.
Keep your finger on the screen and drag in one smooth line, so you do not have to restart a word that you almost made.
When a level stalls, try a different starting letter rather than repeating the same word attempts, as this often reveals a new pattern.
Use the hint option only after you have tried a few different combinations, so you save rubies for the levels that are truly difficult.
faq: How do I complete a level?
Fill every empty cell on the field by finding the hidden words, and the level is completed once the field is full.
What happens if I find a word that is not in the task list?
It is added to the bonus words, and you receive additional rubies for it.

ragdoll-fury.intro: Ragdoll Fury puts you in control of a weapon instead of a hero. Swing blades and fire guns to send waves of dummies and robots flying across the arena.
tips: Swing faster for harder hits, since the speed of your drag decides how far enemies fly. Short, quick swings often do more than slow, heavy ones.
Use melee when enemies are close and move your aim toward distant targets for ranged fire. Switching between the two keeps you hitting enemies no matter where they stand.
Pick upgrades that build toward one element or effect, such as burn, freeze or chain explosions. Focused builds set up combos more reliably than a mix of unrelated bonuses.
Watch for the glowing special button and use it as soon as it charges, since waves with armored robots, shield bots or bosses can be easier to handle with a special move ready.
Between waves, use run coins to reroll your options or banish a weak card when none of the three upgrades fit your build. Save coins for moments when a single bad choice would hurt your run.
faq: How do I make enemies fly farther?
Swing the weapon faster. The speed of your drag sets how hard you hit, and a harder hit sends enemies farther across the arena.
When can I trigger my weapon's EVOLUTION?
EVOLUTION becomes available from wave 10 onward. Chain your elemental combos before then so your build is ready when it unlocks.

legions-way-of-war.intro: Legions: Way of War is a real-time strategy game about positioning troops and using heroes to win battles. You build your army and unlock archers, cavalry, infantry, artillery and heroes as you go.
tips: Arrange your squads before you commit them, since the game asks you to place and connect them correctly to win.
Match troop types to the situation: use infantry to hold ground, archers to hit from range, cavalry for fast flanking, and artillery to break defenses.
Keep your heroes close to the squads that need support rather than leaving them alone at the edge of the fight.
Develop your army steadily instead of spending everything at once, so you always have a reserve of new troop types available.
Work through the tests in order, because passing them is how you progress and unlock the rest of the game.
faq: What is the main goal of Legions: Way of War?
You win by arranging and connecting your squads correctly, using your troops and heroes to defeat the opposing army.
Which troop types can I get in the game?
The instructions mention archers, cavalry, infantry, artillery and heroes as the types you can develop and unlock.

plane-crash-ragdoll-simulator.intro: Plane Crash Ragdoll Simulator is an action game where you pilot aircraft through skies filled with incoming rockets. You can switch between planes and helicopters and try three different game modes.
tips: Use the joystick's gas press and control movement in small, steady amounts rather than sharp swings, since the physics make abrupt turns easy to lose control of.
Watch where rockets are coming from before you commit to a direction, and keep moving so you are not an easy target.
Try the different aircraft to see which one suits you best, as planes and helicopters likely handle differently.
In Low Fuel Landing, keep an eye on your descent and approach slowly so you have a better chance of a controlled landing.
Work through the modes one at a time to learn how each one's goal changes what you should focus on.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Survive the rockets aimed at your aircraft, and in other modes destroy enemies or land with low fuel. The mode you pick sets the specific goal.
How do I control my aircraft?
Press the joystick to add gas and move the joystick to steer the aircraft.

cube-quiz.intro: CubeQuiz is a relaxing 3D puzzle where you decide which sandy voxel blocks slide together into a solid box. It rewards careful rotation and close reading of each shape.
tips: Rotate each block fully before you answer, since a shape can look like a match from one angle and differ from another.
Compare the outlines of the two blocks first, then check the inner corners and edges to confirm whether they lock together.
Since there are no timers, take your time on harder puzzles and use the drag rotation to build a clear picture in your head.
In Challenge mode, slow down on every question, because one wrong answer ends the run. Accuracy matters more than speed there.
Work through the four packs in order, clearing 10 puzzles in each to unlock the next, so your skills build up gradually.
faq: What is the goal of CubeQuiz?
The goal is to decide which blocks fit together to form a solid box, using rotation and shape reading. Each mode asks you to find, match, or check fits in a different way.
How do I rotate the blocks?
Drag any block to rotate it and inspect it from every angle. You can turn it as much as you need before answering.

canyon-drifter.intro: Canyon Drifter is a 2D moto-trial where you balance a dirt bike over steep climbs and jumps. Tune your bike in the garage and race the clock for a top spot on the leaderboard.
tips: Use small lean inputs on steep climbs. Leaning back lifts the front wheel, so tapping it keeps the bike balanced instead of flipping you over.
Before a jump, plan your nose position. Leaning forward on landing helps the front wheel touch down first and keeps the bike stable.
If a track keeps stopping you, go to the garage and change your build for the terrain before trying again. A different setup can make the same section much easier.
Keep throttle steady rather than pinning it. Quick, controlled bursts give you more grip and control on loose dirt and uphill sections.
Restart with R as soon as a run goes wrong. Short, repeated attempts help you learn the track faster than pushing through a bad run.
faq: What is the goal of Canyon Drifter?
Get your bike across each tough track and aim for the best time you can. Faster times move you up the leaderboard.
How do I keep my balance on steep climbs?
Use the lean back and lean forward keys in small taps rather than holding them down. This keeps the front wheel under control as the bike tilts.

help-me-tricky-puzzle-games.intro: Help Me: Tricky Puzzle Games is a logic puzzle with funny, bizarre scenarios. You solve each one by interacting with characters and objects to find unexpected ways to rescue them.
tips: Read the prompt at the top of the screen before you touch anything, since it tells you the goal of each puzzle.
Look for the green targets first, because they show you exactly which objects can be tapped, dragged, or pulled.
Try the most unusual option early. The solutions often rely on creative thinking rather than the obvious action.
If you get stuck, step back and list what each object on screen could do, then test them one at a time.
Pay attention to how the characters react after each action, as their responses can hint at whether you are on the right track.
faq: What is the goal of each puzzle?
The goal is to rescue the character from the trouble shown in the prompt at the top of the screen. You do this by finding a working solution to the scenario.
How do I interact with objects?
Tap, drag, or pull on the green targets to act on objects and characters. Each action can change how the scene plays out.

jig-snap-puzzles.intro: Jig Snap Puzzles is a jigsaw game with themed picture packs, from landmarks and animals to food and space. You start with small 3x3 boards and work up to 5x5 as you earn stars.
tips: Begin with the corner and edge pieces, since their outer sides tell you where they belong and give you a frame to build from.
Sort the loose pieces by color and pattern first, so you can quickly find the right area for each piece instead of searching the whole board.
Pieces that match up next to each other will merge automatically, so build small correct sections and let them lock together.
If a piece is in the wrong spot, drop it onto another piece to swap them rather than dragging everything around.
Save hints for the trickiest parts, because they cost coins or are limited per level. Finishing earlier packs also helps you reach the harder puzzles.
faq: How do I earn stars in Jig Snap Puzzles?
You earn stars the first time you complete each level. Collecting enough stars unlocks new themed packs.
What happens when two pieces fit together?
When two correct pieces sit next to each other, they merge into one group automatically. This makes larger sections easier to move and keep track of.

fruit-names.intro: Fruit Names is a children's educational clicker game where you learn different fruits and their names. Read the fruit name, then click the picture that matches it.
tips: Read the fruit name carefully before you look at the pictures, so you know exactly what to find.
Say the fruit name out loud as you click, which helps it stick in memory.
Take your time with fruits that look alike, and compare their shapes and colors before choosing.
If you pick the wrong picture, pause and note which fruit it was so you can recognize it next time.
Play in short sessions and come back to the game often, since repetition is how the names become familiar.
faq: What is the goal of Fruit Names?
The goal is to learn the different fruits and their names. You do this by clicking the image that matches the fruit name shown.
How do you play Fruit Names?
Click on the image that corresponds to the name of the fruit. Each round asks you to match a name to the correct picture.

twisty-roads.intro: Twisty Roads is a racing game where you follow a winding road, pass checkpoints for points, and collect coins to buy new vehicles. The road gets harder the further you go.
tips: Keep your attention on the road ahead so you can react before the bends get tighter.
Pass every checkpoint you can, since they are your main source of points.
Pick up coins whenever you can do so safely, because they let you buy vehicles to try.
Try different vehicles to see which one handles best for you, and save your coins for the one you like most.
Expect the journey to get harder over time, so take a short break when you feel your focus slipping.
faq: What is the goal of Twisty Roads?
Your goal is to keep following the road, pass checkpoints to earn points, and get as far as you can on an endless journey.
How do I earn points?
You earn points by passing checkpoints along the road. Collecting coins helps you buy vehicles rather than adding to your points.

happy-jelly.intro: Happy Jelly is a match-three puzzle game where you move jelly candies to line up rows of three or more. Clearing as many candies as you can is the main goal.
tips: Look for moves that line up three or more candies of the same kind, since those are what get destroyed.
Scan the whole board before each move so you can spot the best option instead of picking the first match you see.
Try to set up matches where clearing one row leaves candies in place for another match to form.
Pay attention to which candies are near the edges and corners, because clearing them can open up new possibilities below.
Play in short sessions and take a moment to check the board when you feel rushed, as steady moves usually score more than hasty ones.
faq: What is the goal of Happy Jelly?
The goal is to move candies so they form a row of three or more, which destroys them. You try to destroy as many candies as possible.
How do I make a match?
Move a candy so that it builds a row of at least three candies of the same type. Matched candies are then removed from the board.

world-of-alice-images-and-words.intro: World of Alice Images and Words is a puzzle game for children that teaches words through pictures. You complete each puzzle by matching an image to the word shown.
tips: Read the word out loud before you look at the pictures. Saying it helps you remember how it sounds and what it looks like.
Look at every image before you drag one. Choosing too quickly can lead you to the wrong picture.
If you are unsure, think about what the word describes, such as an animal, object, or action, and check which picture fits that idea.
Go back over words you matched incorrectly. Repeating them is the best way to make them stick.
Play in short sessions and try to name the objects around you using the same words you practiced in the game.
faq: What is the goal of World of Alice Images and Words?
The goal is to learn words through images by dragging the picture that matches each word to complete the puzzle.
How do I play?
Drag the image that corresponds to the word into the correct place to finish the puzzle.

cut-it-all-3d.intro: Cut It All 3D is a skill game where you slice objects into pieces by following the rules of each task. It rewards logical thinking and good spatial planning.
tips: Read the rule for each task before you cut, since the goal changes from level to level.
Look at the object's shape and plan where the pieces will fall before making your first slice.
Start with the easier levels to learn how each slicing method behaves, then move to the harder ones.
Try different object types and slicing styles to see which combinations you find easiest to control.
If a task feels stuck, reset your plan and try a different cutting route rather than repeating the same slice.
faq: What is the goal of Cut It All 3D?
Your goal is to cut objects into pieces while following the rules given for each task. Each puzzle asks you to solve a logical problem through your cuts.
How do I make a cut?
Left-click or tap the screen to start cutting. On a phone, tap the screen in the same way.

transport-army-vehicle-truck-driving.intro: Transport Army is a driving action game where you carry vital supplies over rough ground and through enemy territory. You complete missions, avoid roadblocks, and upgrade your truck as you go.
tips: Use WASD to keep your speed steady on uneven ground, since sudden turns and heavy throttle can tip or stall your truck on rough terrain.
Look ahead for roadblocks and steer around them early instead of braking at the last moment.
Spend upgrades on armor first if you are taking hits from enemy territory, and on speed if you are losing time on long routes.
Try a mission a second time to learn the layout, where the hazards sit, and the safest route through each stretch.
Keep your convoy's goal in mind: arriving with the supplies intact matters more than finishing quickly.
faq: What is the goal of Transport Army?
You drive army trucks to deliver vital supplies across rugged terrain while completing missions and avoiding enemy threats. Reaching the destination safely is the main objective.
How do I control the truck?
Use the W, A, S, and D keys to drive the vehicle. These are the only controls listed for the game.

doodle-halloween-momo-cat-sea-magic.intro: Help Momo, a magical cat, clear ghosts from the deep sea by drawing the symbols shown above each one. Draw quickly and accurately before the ghosts reach her.
tips: Read the symbol above each ghost as soon as it appears, so you can start drawing before it gets close to Momo.
Keep your drawings simple and clean. A clear shape is more reliable than a rushed one, since accuracy matters as much as speed.
Watch for sequences of symbols. Some ghosts need more than one shape in order, so take them one at a time without losing track.
Expect more ghosts and faster approaches in later levels. Build a steady rhythm early so you have room to react when the pace picks up.
Save your focus for the boss ghost at the end of a stage. It may need a long chain or repeated spells, so stay calm and work through each part.
faq: How do I cast a spell?
Draw the symbol shown above the ghost using your mouse or your finger on a touchscreen. A correct drawing casts the spell and defeats that ghost.
What makes the game harder as I go on?
Ghosts come faster and in greater numbers in each level, and the deeper zones are more challenging. You need both speed and accuracy to keep up.

tsunami-race.intro: Tsunami Race is an arcade game where you run ahead of a rising wave while dodging obstacles. Pick a character, then keep moving to stay clear of the water.
tips: Hold your finger on the screen to move your character, and release when you need to stop or change direction.
Watch the obstacles several steps ahead so you have time to adjust before reaching them.
Try each game mode to see which one suits you, since the fruit dodging and water slide races ask for different timing.
Keep short, steady holds instead of long continuous presses so you can react quickly when something appears.
Pick the character that feels best to you before starting, and stick with it for a few rounds to learn how it handles.
faq: How do I move my character?
Tap and hold on the screen to move your character. The game is controlled entirely by touch and holding.
What is the goal of Tsunami Race?
You race against a looming tsunami while navigating obstacles. Staying ahead of the wave and avoiding hazards keeps you in the game.

supercars-zombie-driving.intro: Supercars Zombie Driving is a single-player 3D racing game where you pick a supercar and smash zombies along the way to win. Use WASD to drive and F to enter a vehicle.
tips: Before each run, try the different supercars to find one whose handling suits you, since the cars are the main choice you make in this game.
Keep an eye on the road ahead so you can steer toward zombies and clear them without losing control of your car.
Use the C key to switch camera angles and pick the view that gives you the clearest look at the zombies and the road around you.
Press P to pause when you need a moment to plan your route or check your position, then resume and continue driving.
Use F to enter a vehicle as soon as you are near one, so you do not waste time getting back on track.
faq: What is the goal of Supercars Zombie Driving?
The goal is to drive supercars and smash all the zombies you meet on your way in order to win.
How do I control the car?
Use the WASD keys to move. Press F to enter a vehicle and C to change the camera view.

feeding-a-black-hole.intro: Feeding A Black Hole is a clicker where you move your cursor or finger to destroy asteroids and grow your black hole. Spend coins and skill points on upgrades, then prestige to speed up later runs.
tips: Put your early coins into more damage, since faster asteroid destruction feeds the rest of your progress.
Coins and skill points are separate. Check which one you need before buying, so you don't leave points unspent.
Level-up rewards are random, with 3 choices each time. Pick the one that fits the upgrades you're already building toward.
When progress slows, prestige. It resets everything, so wait until your run has clearly stalled before using it.
Each prestige adds a permanent bonus to asteroid value, so use the early part of your next run to rebuild quickly.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Your goal is to grow your black hole by destroying asteroids and collecting resources. As you progress, you unlock upgrades and more powerful abilities.
What does prestige do?
Prestige resets all of your progress, but it gives you a permanent bonus to asteroid value. Your next run should move faster because of that bonus.

basketball-street.intro: Basketball Street is a free-throw shooting game in the Sports category. You pick one of three players, then try to sink as many shots as you can in one minute.
tips: You have 25 shots in total, so take each one with a clear aim rather than rushing through them.
Striped balls are worth 2 points instead of 1, so watch for them and focus your attention on those shots.
Keep an eye on the clock as well as your shot count, since the round lasts one minute and time can run out before your shots do.
Try all three players to see which one suits your shooting style and timing best.
faq: What is the goal of Basketball Street?
The goal is to get as many balls as possible into the basket within one minute, using up to 25 shots.
How do I earn extra points?
Striped balls are worth 2 points each instead of 1, so sinking those special balls gives you a higher score.

fish-and-trip.intro: Fish & Trip is a clicker-style survival game where you steer a small fish toward the deep sea, gathering seedlings and new friends while avoiding predators. Each attempt is a chance to beat your score.
tips: Keep your movements smooth and steady rather than jerky, so you can react quickly when a predator or dangerous object comes into view.
Watch for predators and hazards before you commit to a path, and steer around them early instead of at the last moment.
Pick up seedlings whenever they are safely in reach, since they are the main thing to collect on each run.
Guide your recruited friends carefully through the ocean, because the path you choose affects how well they keep up with you.
Collect coins on every attempt, even short ones, so you can unlock new skins for your fish over time.
faq: How do I move the fish on a PC?
Use the mouse to move the character around the screen. The fish follows your pointer's direction.
How do I move the fish on a touch device?
Touch the screen and slide your finger to move the character.

mr-noob-jailbreak.intro: Mr noob Jailbreak is a running and shooting game where a little noob escapes prison by running across rooftops. Your goal is to go as far as possible while building up the best score.
tips: Watch the guards ahead and decide early whether to jump over them, slide under obstacles, or shoot them. Reacting early leaves you more time to choose.
Use the slowmotion key when a tricky guard or weapon is close. It gives you more time to line up your shots.
Don't spend too long aiming at one enemy. If a guard is out of reach, keep moving so you don't get caught.
Practise switching between jump (W) and slide (S) so you can respond quickly when obstacles come in a row.
Pay attention to the distance you cover. Consistent movement and clean dodges usually matter more than one risky stretch.
faq: What is the goal of Mr noob Jailbreak?
Escape from the prison guards by running across the rooftops and go as far as possible to get the best score.
Which keys do I use to jump, slide and shoot?
Press W to jump, S to slide, and right click to shoot. Use the spacebar to activate slowmotion.

sky-track-racing.intro: Sky Track Racing is a 3D driving game where you steer a Jeep along sky platform tracks and aim to reach the final area of each level. Use the arrow keys to move and Space to brake.
tips: Learn how the Jeep responds to the arrow keys on the first level before you try to go fast.
Tap or hold Space to brake before sharp turns or gaps so you keep control of the car.
Watch the track ahead rather than the car itself, so you can plan your line through each section.
If you fall off the track, restart the level and take the same route more carefully rather than rushing.
Try each level a few times; the route to the final area becomes easier to read once you know where the track bends.
faq: What is the goal of Sky Track Racing?
Drive your Jeep to the final area of each level. The game describes it as a car driving and stunt simulation across 3D sky platform tracks.
Which keys control the Jeep?
The arrow keys move the car and the Space bar brakes.

world-of-alice-occupations.intro: World of Alice Occupations is an educational puzzle where young players learn different professions and the tools each one uses. You match each tool to the job it belongs to by clicking the right profession.
tips: Look closely at the tool first and think about what kind of work would need it before you look at the professions.
Ask yourself where you would usually see that tool, such as at a hospital, a farm, or a kitchen, to narrow down the choices.
Take your time with unfamiliar tools and say the tool's name out loud, which can help it stick in memory.
If you are unsure, pick the answer you think is most likely, then notice the result and use it to learn for the next tool.
Play with a young child by taking turns guessing, so you can talk about each profession together as you go.
faq: What is the goal of World of Alice Occupations?
The goal is to learn different professions and their tools by clicking the profession that matches each tool. It is designed as an educational game for children.
What do I need to do to play?
Click on the profession that corresponds to the tools shown. Work through the tools one at a time and think about which job uses each one.

shadow-stick-lightning-ninja.intro: Shadow Stick - Lightning Ninja is a 2D fighting game with RPG elements, spread across more than 120 levels with tough bosses. This guide covers the controls and habits that help you get through the fights.
tips: Save the B special skill for boss fights, since it gives a 30% boost to attack and defense for 15 seconds.
Use the F dragon summon when you are in trouble rather than at the start of a fight, so it can help you when you need it most.
Pick your skill branches with your playstyle in mind, because the Z, X and C skills change depending on which branch you chose. Stick with one approach so you learn its timing well.
Rely on the V normal attack for steady damage and keep your jumps and movement under control so you are not stuck in one spot during a boss attack.
On mobile, use the slider in the bottom left corner for movement and keep an eye on the on-screen buttons for your attacks and skills.
faq: What is the goal of Shadow Stick - Lightning Ninja?
You move through more than 120 levels and defeat tough bosses. Customizing your character and unlocking legendary gear help you keep up as the fights get harder.
Which key gives a temporary boost in attack and defense?
The B key activates a special skill that increases your attack and defense by 30% for 15 seconds. It is most useful when a fight becomes difficult.

snake-of-balls.intro: Snake of Balls is a fast reflex game where you hunt a snake that looks easy to catch at first. It speeds up and moves in chaotic patterns, so you need to stay alert.
tips: Don't judge the snake by its first few moves, because it can speed up and change direction without warning.
Keep your attention on the snake's path rather than fixing on one spot, so you can react when its trajectory shifts.
Pay attention to every error you make, since each mistake feeds the snake and makes it harder to catch.
Stay calm when the chaos builds up. Quick, small corrections usually work better than panicked moves.
Play several rounds in a row to get used to how the snake accelerates, which helps your reflexes improve over time.
faq: What is the goal of Snake of Balls?
Your goal is to hunt the snake, which seems like easy prey at first. It accelerates and follows a chaotic trajectory, so catching it takes skill.
Why is the snake so hard to catch?
It speeds up over time and moves unpredictably, so it is hard to predict where it will go next.

police-drift-escape.intro: Police Drift Escape is a top-down chase where you play a getaway driver. Drift around open space, make the police crash into each other, and collect cash while you stay ahead of them.
tips: Use your turning advantage: police cars are faster but cannot turn as sharply as you, so tight drifts are your best way to make them miss.
Lure police cars into following you, then turn at the right moment so they run into each other. Each police crash adds to your score.
Treat survival as the first priority. Grab cash when it is safe, and leave bundles that would pull you into a tight spot with police closing in.
Save golden cash for when you have room to spare, since it gives bigger rewards but is still worth the risk only if you can reach it safely.
Expect the chase to get harder the longer you last. Start building good habits early, like keeping space between your car and the nearest police car.
faq: What is the main goal of Police Drift Escape?
Your goal is to survive as long as possible while avoiding police, collecting cash, and making police cars crash into each other.
Do I need weapons to make progress?
No. The game says your driving skill is your best weapon, so focus on drifting, dodging, and baiting police cars.

emoji-skill-puzzles.intro: Emoji Skill Puzzles is a brain-teaser game built entirely from popular emojis. It offers six puzzle types that test your problem-solving skills, played with mouse clicks or taps.
tips: Identify the puzzle type first, since link, memory, word quiz, related, shadow, and crop puzzles each need a different approach.
For memory puzzles, try to remember where emojis appear as you go rather than trying to memorize everything at once.
In word quiz puzzles, think about what the emojis mean together, not just what each one shows on its own.
For shadow and crop puzzles, look closely at the outline or cropped section and compare it against the emoji details before choosing.
Take a short pause when you get stuck and look at the puzzle from a different angle, which often reveals the link you missed.
faq: What is the goal of Emoji Skill Puzzles?
The goal is to solve each emoji-based puzzle by using logic, memory, and observation. The game is designed for players who enjoy brain teasers.
How do I control the game?
You play by clicking the mouse or tapping the screen. The instructions do not list any other controls.

draw-to-smash.intro: Draw To Smash! is a logic puzzle where you sketch shapes that fall and destroy the bad eggs while keeping the good eggs safe. Plan each drawing before you release it.
tips: Look at where the bad eggs and good eggs sit before you draw, so you know which spots your shape must reach and which to avoid.
Remember that your drawing drops as soon as you lift your touch, so think about the full path of the shape before you start.
Aim to cover the bad eggs in a single drop when you can, since fewer drawings means less chance of accidentally hitting a good egg.
Keep your lines simple and short at first; a small, precise shape is often easier to control than a long, tangled one.
If a level goes wrong, restart your thinking rather than repeating the same drawing, because the challenges change as you progress.
faq: What is the goal of Draw To Smash!?
Your aim is to destroy all the evil eggs by dropping your drawings onto them. You also need to protect the good eggs along the way.
How do I make a drawing fall?
Touch and draw inside the box, then release your touch. Once you release, the drawing drops onto the eggs below.

my-cute-virtual-pet.intro: Adopt a virtual pet and keep it fed, clean, and happy. Watch its Needs meters and use the care items and mini-games to keep every bar full.
tips: Check the Hunger, Hygiene, Sleep, and Happiness meters often so you can spot the lowest one before it drops too far.
Drag food onto your pet as soon as Hunger starts to fall, since a full belly helps keep the other meters steady.
Clean your pet with the Bath category when it gets messy, then use the bubbly soap to keep Hygiene high.
Play the arcade mini-games regularly, because they earn rewards and are one of the main ways to boost Happiness.
On desktop, click and hold an item before dragging it onto your pet. On touchscreens, tap a category first, then drag with your finger.
faq: What is the main goal of My Cute Virtual Pet?
Your goal is to keep all of your pet's Needs meters, including Hunger, Hygiene, Sleep, and Happiness, completely full. This keeps your pet healthy and joyful.
How do I feed or clean my pet?
Open the Food or Bath category at the bottom of the screen, then drag the item onto your pet. On mobile, tap the category button first and then drag the item with your finger.

driverz-ed.intro: Driverz Ed is an open-world driving adventure set on instructor Ed's island. You can take on challenges or simply explore and hunt for hidden Puzzle Pieces and unlockable cars.
tips: Open the missions list with M early on to see what challenges are available and which records you can beat.
Use G to fast travel to the start of races when you want to get to a challenge quickly instead of driving the whole way.
Drive slowly around unfamiliar areas and look closely at edges, corners and high spots, since Puzzle Pieces are hidden.
Keep track of which Puzzle Pieces you have found so you can focus your searching on areas you have not yet covered.
Use the camera with the mouse to look around while driving, which helps you spot hidden details off the main roads.
faq: What is the main goal of Driverz Ed?
Explore Ed's island, complete challenges, find all the hidden Puzzle Pieces, and unlock every car.
How do I move my car?
Use WASD or the arrow keys to drive, and move the mouse to control the camera.

baby-sitter-merge-2.intro: Help a young mother keep her restless baby calm by connecting matching tiles. Each connection lets you decorate the nursery in this colorful puzzle.
tips: Scan the board for identical tiles that have a clear route between them before you start clicking.
Remember that a path is built one cell at a time, moving to an adjacent cell in the same row or the same column.
Use the space outside the playing field. A path can run past the edge, so tiles near the border may still connect.
Watch for tiles that sit between a matching pair. Removing a blocking tile first can open up a connection.
Click the first tile and then the second one, and check that the route is free before you commit to a pair.
faq: How do I connect two tiles?
Click one identical tile, then click the second one. They connect if there is an unobstructed path between them.
What blocks a connection?
Any cell that contains a tile blocks the path. Tiles can only be connected when there are no obstacles along their route.

the-dye-diy.intro: The Dye DIY is a hypercasual dress-up and design game where you tie and dye clothes and beach accessories to fill client requests. Each piece is customized to your own taste using simple tap or click actions.
tips: Read the client request carefully before you start so you know what the finished item should look like.
Tie the fabric first, as the description suggests, since the tie-then-dye order is central to how the designs turn out.
Experiment with different items such as T-shirts, bikinis and beach bags to see which ones suit your style.
Take your time with the customizing step, because small changes to your design can make a big difference to the final look.
Keep a steady pace so you can work through client requests one after another without leaving pieces unfinished.
faq: What is the goal of The Dye DIY?
The goal is to complete client requests by dyeing and customizing clothes and beach accessories to match what each client wants.
How do I control the game?
You use tap or click to make your choices and actions throughout each step of the dyeing and design process.

holecraft-io.intro: Holecraft.io puts you in control of a hungry black hole. Swallow blocks, objects, and structures to grow, and race the clock to become the biggest hole on the map.
tips: Begin with the small items closest to you. Growing early makes it easier to reach larger objects later.
Keep an eye on the clock from the start, since the game is a race against time as well as a test of size.
As you grow, bigger blocks become available, so move on to larger targets once they are within reach instead of clearing tiny pieces.
Plan your route across the map so that you are rarely far from the next thing to swallow. Moving with purpose helps you collect more.
Clear areas that are packed with blocks and structures first, since each swallow adds to your total and your growth.
faq: What is the main goal of Holecraft.io?
Your goal is to grow as large as possible by swallowing blocks, objects, and structures. You also need to collect as much as you can before time runs out.
How do I control the black hole?
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps. Use these inputs to move your black hole around the map.

don-t-open-that-door-seriosly.intro: You play a plush teddy bear with a small suitcase, stuck in a strange hotel where every door leads to something more absurd. Explore the rooms and interact with the odd world around you.
tips: Hold the right mouse button to turn the camera before you walk through a new doorway, so you can see what is waiting in the room.
Use the left mouse button to kick when you want to interact with objects or things nearby, and test what reacts.
Use Space to jump when you need to get past obstacles or reach higher spots, and keep an eye on where you land.
Read any pop-up buttons carefully when they appear, since they are part of how the game presents its choices and interactions.
Take your time in each room, because the hotel's oddities are the main fun, and rushing may cause you to miss details.
faq: What is the goal of Don't Open That Door...Seriosly!?
The description does not state a clear objective, so the game is best approached as exploration. Move through the rooms, interact with the world, and see how the hotel changes around you.
How do I move and look around?
Use W, A, S and D to move forward, left, backward and right. Hold the right mouse button and move the mouse to rotate the camera.

blocks-move-hit-pro.intro: Blocks: Move HIT PRO is a puzzle game where you guide a block through a maze of immovable stone blocks. Each bump changes your direction, so you need to plan the route to reach the target.
tips: Before you move, trace the likely bounce path in your head to see where you will end up after each impact.
Pay attention to whether a hit sends you at a 45-degree angle or a full 90-degree turn, since the two lead to very different routes.
Look for the target first, then work backward to find the bounces that would lead you there.
If a route ends in a dead end or a wrong bounce, reset your plan instead of repeating the same move.
Take your time on the harder stages, because the path changes and rushing usually leads to missed hits.
faq: What is the goal of Blocks: Move HIT PRO?
Find a path and hit the target to win each puzzle. You guide your block through the maze until it reaches the destination.
How do the bounces work?
Every time your block bumps into a stone block, its direction changes. Some hits send you diagonally at 45 degrees, while others make a full 90-degree turn.

ski-challenge-3d.intro: Ski Challenge 3D is an arcade skiing race down a snowy mountain. You slide to steer your skier, dodge rolling snowballs and sudden wooden stakes, and aim for the top rank.
tips: Watch the slope ahead rather than your skier, so you can spot snowballs and wooden stakes early enough to change direction.
Make small, steady slides instead of large sudden ones, which helps you keep control when you need to avoid an obstacle.
Since the stakes appear suddenly, stay ready to react at all times rather than settling into one line down the mountain.
Use your speed control with care: going faster can earn ground, but it also leaves less time to react to danger.
Keep playing several runs in a row to learn the patterns of the snowballs and where the stakes tend to show up.
faq: What is the main goal of Ski Challenge 3D?
The goal is to reach the Top 1 rank in the ski match and to get the No. 1 position as many times as you can.
What are the obstacles I need to avoid?
You need to avoid snowballs rolling down the mountain and wooden stakes that suddenly appear on the slope.

pinball-boy-adventure.intro: Pinball Boy Adventure is a 3D pinball game where you collect pinballs, use bombs and rockets, and work through levels using physics and puzzles. Steady aim and careful launches matter most.
tips: Before each launch, drag the wheel to get your position right, then swipe to set your aim. Taking a moment to line up the shot usually beats a rushed one.
Keep an eye on where the pinballs are before you fire. Collecting them is part of the goal, so plan shots that pass near them.
Save bombs and rockets for targets that are hard to reach or cluster together. Spending them on easy shots can leave you short when a level gets tougher.
Try different tactics on the same level if one approach is not working. The game lets you choose your tactics, so changing your plan is a good habit.
Spend upgrades on the skills that match how you like to play, such as accuracy if you struggle with precision. Consistent aim often helps more than raw power.
faq: How do I aim and launch the ball?
Drag the wheel to move into position, swipe to aim, and release to launch. Take your time with the aim before releasing.
What are bombs and rockets used for?
They are tools for causing destruction and clearing targets during a level. Use them when a shot is hard to make with a regular launch.

escape-police-for-brainrots.intro: Escape Police for Brainrots is a running game where you flee from the police, collect Brainrots, and build up your speed. Your aim is to keep running as far as you can without getting caught.
tips: Watch for obstacles early and plan your route a few steps ahead, so you can keep your speed instead of slowing down to dodge at the last moment.
Spend your upgrades on speed first, since running faster gives you more room to escape the police and cover more ground.
Collect Brainrots whenever they are safe to reach, but do not chase them into a dead end where the police can corner you.
