Keep moving across the map rather than stopping, because the game rewards distance and your progress grows the farther you run.
Check your Brainrot base and unlocks as your run goes on, since new possibilities open up and can help you survive longer.
faq: What is the main goal of Escape Police for Brainrots?
The main goal is to run from the police and survive as long as possible, going as far across the map as you can. The farther you run, the higher your progress becomes.
How do I get better Brainrots?
Better Brainrots come from running farther. Keep going and your collected Brainrots will improve as your run continues.

capybas.intro: Capybas is a cozy logic puzzle where you find hidden capybaras using clues from colors, rows, columns, and adjacency. It mixes Minesweeper-style deduction with Sudoku-style rules across Easy, Medium, and Hard boards.
tips: Start with color regions that have only a few open squares, since each region hides exactly one capybara and those spots are easiest to narrow down.
Mark an X on squares you have ruled out as soon as you are sure, so the board stays readable and you can spot the remaining options quickly.
Remember that a capybara blocks its eight neighboring squares, including diagonals, so use that to eliminate spots around each one you place.
When a row or column already has its one capybara, mark every other square in that line with an X to avoid wasting lives.
Double tap only when the logic is certain, because you need to find every capybara before you run out of lives.
faq: What is the goal of Capybas?
Your goal is to find all the hidden capybaras on the board before you run out of lives. You do this by using clues from colors, rows, columns, and adjacency rules.
How many capybaras are in each color region?
Each color region hides exactly one capybara. Each row and column can also contain only one capybara.

rescue-my-love.intro: Rescue My Love is a brain puzzle game with simple picture-style visuals. Each level is easy to start but asks you to find a different way through.
tips: Read each new level fully before you act, since the way to pass changes from one level to the next.
Do not repeat a method that failed. Pause and look for a different approach instead.
Watch what each element on screen does before committing to a move, so you learn how the level responds.
If you get stuck, step back and try a few small experiments rather than one big guess.
Keep your focus on the goal of each level, since the simple visuals can make it easy to miss a useful detail.
faq: What is the goal of Rescue My Love?
The goal is to pass each level by using your brain to work out the way through. The game describes the levels as challenging but easy to break through with thinking.
Do the levels get harder as you go?
Each level is described as different, and the way to pass each one changes. Expect new methods rather than the same solution repeated.

mech-frontline-last-stand.intro: Mech Frontline: Last Stand is a roguelike turret game where you build a mech, choose equipment, and hold off enemies across each run. Base building and gacha mechanics add variety to every attempt.
tips: Pay attention to enemy pressure during each run and adjust your setup to match what is coming at you, rather than sticking to one plan.
Look closely at how each turret and set works before committing, since several come with unique effects that can change your whole strategy.
Use your upgrade choices to build toward a clear direction, such as a focus on certain turrets or equipment, instead of spreading picks thinly.
Treat each run as a learning attempt and note which choices held up well, so your next run starts from a stronger plan.
Play in landscape mode, as the game recommends it for the best view of your base and battlefield.
faq: What is the main goal of each run?
You build up your mech, select equipment, and respond to enemy pressure to survive each battle. The description also highlights a roguelike structure, so every run plays out differently.
How do I control the game?
Use your mouse or touch input to navigate menus, create your character, choose upgrades, and enter battle. The game is designed for landscape mode.

bubble-merge-2d.intro: Bubble Merge 2D is a physics puzzle where you launch bubbles and merge identical ones into higher-level items. Each level asks you to create specific items before you run out of moves.
tips: Before every shot, look at the items shown at the top of the screen and aim for merges that bring you closer to them.
Merge two identical bubbles whenever you can, since each merge creates a higher-level item that may be one of your targets.
Count your remaining moves early in a level so you do not spend them on shots that do not help any objective.
Use the drag aim to test angles carefully, because a small change in launch direction can send a bubble somewhere very different.
Save power-ups for harder moments when your normal shots cannot reach a useful merge or when you are close to running out of moves.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You must create all the items shown at the top of the screen to complete the level. You need to finish every objective before your moves run out.
How do I launch a bubble?
Tap and drag a bubble to aim, then release to launch it. The drag direction controls where the bubble goes.

zombie-rage-merge-3d.intro: Zombie Rage: Merge 3D is a shooter puzzle where Grandpa fights zombie pursuers across many locations, from hot deserts to sea battles. You build your own gun from parts and battle through the world.
tips: Try different barrel, butt, handle, sight, and silencer or compensator combinations to find a gun that suits how you like to play.
Keep an eye on which enemy types are chasing you, since motorcyclists, shooters, Giants, and vehicle-based zombies may need different approaches.
Reload between fights when you have a moment, so you are not caught with an empty weapon when a new group arrives.
Use the sight to take careful aim at dangerous targets, and rely on automatic fire for crowds on mobile.
Switch between your weapons with keys 1 to 4 on PC so you can match the right gun to each threat quickly.
faq: What is the goal of Zombie Rage: Merge 3D?
The goal is to destroy your pursuers. Keep fighting through the locations and bosses to win.
How do I aim and shoot on PC?
Use the left mouse button to shoot and the right mouse button to bring up the sight. Move the mouse to control the sight.

wordeck-associations.intro: WorDeck: Associations is a calm word puzzle that mixes solitaire-style card play with word association. Group the words on the board by shared meaning to clear it, one set at a time.
tips: Scan the whole board before selecting anything, and look for words that could belong to a theme, object type, or property.
Start with the most obvious connections to shrink the board, since each cleared group leaves fewer words that could be confused.
Consider less literal meanings too, such as a word's common uses or the things it is often paired with, because later levels rely on less obvious links.
Pay attention to whether a level limits mistakes, and slow down when it does by checking each group's logic before you commit.
When a combination fails, note which words you tried together and rule that pairing out, so you can focus on other possibilities.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Clear the board by selecting cards that share a common meaning or association. Each correct group is removed from the board.
What happens if I pick the wrong words?
The cards return to their original positions so you can try a different combination. Some levels limit how many mistakes you can make.

world-of-alice-daily-routine.intro: World of Alice Daily Routine is an educational puzzle game for children. It teaches everyday routines and tasks in a playful way, set in Alice's world.
tips: Think about your own day from morning to night before you start, so you can match each task to a real routine.
Ask yourself what happens at that time of day, such as waking up, eating, or going to bed, before you choose a task.
Say each routine out loud as you go. Hearing the words can help you remember which activity belongs to which part of the day.
If you pick a wrong task, take a moment to compare it with the other options and find the one that fits the schedule better.
Play several rounds in a row to build the habit of linking tasks with the order of a daily schedule.
faq: What is the goal of World of Alice Daily Routine?
The goal is to learn daily routines and tasks by clicking the task that matches your schedule. The game is designed to teach these habits in a fun way.
How do I play?
Click on the task that corresponds to your schedule. The instructions do not describe any other controls.

truck-driving-construction-transport.intro: Truck Driving Construction Transport is a driving simulator where you haul construction materials and equipment across varied terrain to a job site. Use WASD to steer and drive your truck while managing traffic, hazards and delivery deadlines.
tips: Before you move, look at the route and the delivery deadline so you know how much time you can spare for each section.
Take corners and uneven ground slowly, since a fast turn can throw off your load or cost you time.
Keep an eye on traffic ahead and leave room between your truck and other vehicles so you can react to sudden stops.
Plan your path around known hazards early instead of braking hard at the last second.
Build a steady rhythm with WASD: short, controlled inputs usually keep the truck more stable than holding keys down the whole way.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You load construction materials and equipment onto your truck, drive them through different terrains, and deliver them to the designated construction site on time.
What controls do I use to drive?
Use the WASD keys to drive your truck. Steer and control speed with these keys as you move along the route.

squadz.intro: SquadZ is a fast, hyper-casual 3D shooter built around short levels and quick missions. You can unlock heroes, collect weapons, and take down enemies in short sessions or longer ones.
tips: Use short sessions to your advantage: a single quick mission is enough to make progress, so play when you only have a minute or two.
Keep your character moving with W, A, S, D or the Arrow Keys on PC, or with the on-screen joystick on mobile, so you are not an easy target.
Pick up weapons as you go and stay alert for ones that look more powerful, since stronger weapons help you clear enemies faster.
If you are chasing a high score, focus on clearing enemies quickly and keeping your movement smooth rather than rushing into every fight.
Try different heroes once you unlock them to see which playstyle suits you best.
faq: What is the main goal in SquadZ?
Take down enemies in each bite-sized level and complete quick missions. You can also aim for a high score if you want a bigger challenge.
How do I move my character?
On PC, use W, A, S, D or the Arrow Keys. On mobile, touch and drag the on-screen joystick to move through the environment.

railroad-magnate.intro: Railroad Magnate is a clicker tycoon where you grow a small station into a large rail network. You earn passenger income, then spend it on upgrades for stations, trains, and routes.
tips: Spend early income on upgrades that raise earnings, since a faster income rate makes every later purchase quicker.
Check which upgrade costs the least relative to its benefit before buying, and save bigger purchases for when you have a surplus.
Watch for capacity limits on your stations and routes, and expand them before they slow down your income.
Unlock new buildings and platforms as soon as you can afford them, because the map grows with your railroad and new areas add more earning potential.
Return to the game regularly to collect income and buy the next upgrade, which keeps progress steady without needing constant tapping.
faq: What is the main goal of Railroad Magnate?
Your goal is to build a growing railroad network from a small station into a large transport empire. You do this by earning money and reinvesting it.
How do I earn money in the game?
Income comes from passengers and trains as your railroad runs. Collect it and use it to buy upgrades that increase your profits.

blondie-in-the-real-world.intro: Help Blondie leave her perfect doll world behind in this girls' dress-up game. You will do her makeup, bake a cake, tidy her new apartment and choose a party outfit.
tips: Start with the apartment so the room is tidy before you move on to the other tasks.
Bake the cake for the guests as one step of the day, and follow each stage in order so nothing gets skipped.
Use Blondie's favorite colors, pink, gold and white, as a guide when you choose her party outfit and makeup, so the look feels consistent.
Try a few outfit and makeup combinations before you settle on one, since you can change your choices until the look feels right.
Save your finished look as a PNG image once you are happy with the result, so you can keep it.
faq: What is the goal of Blondie in the Real World?
Your goal is to help Blondie adjust to real life by doing her makeup, baking a cake for guests, cleaning her new apartment and dressing her for a party.
Which colors should I use for Blondie's party look?
The description says her favorite colors are pink, gold and white, so these are good choices when you pick her outfit and styling.

save-the-kingdom.intro: Save The Kingdom is a castle defense game where you hold off waves of wizards, ghosts, demons and other monsters. You place castles by dragging them into position and use the points you earn to upgrade your defenses across 50 levels.
tips: Place your first castle with care, since the position you choose sets up the rest of your defense for the level.
Save some money between waves instead of spending everything at once, so you can respond when a tougher group of monsters arrives.
Spread your upgrades across your four general skills early, then focus on the ones that help you most in the levels where you keep losing ground.
Build new castles as you earn points so your defense covers more of the kingdom rather than one weak spot.
Keep playing through levels without stopping, because each level builds on the castles and upgrades you already have.
faq: What is the goal of Save The Kingdom?
The goal is to defend your kingdom from wizards, ghosts, demons and other monsters. You do this by building castles, upgrading your skills and destroying enemies across 50 levels.
How do I place a castle?
Drag the castle with your mouse or finger to the area where you want it, then drop it there.

gas-station-24-simulator.intro: Gas Station 24: Simulator is a management game where you run your own fuel station. Refuel cars quickly, keep customers happy, and grow a small station into a modern one.
tips: Check each vehicle for the correct fuel type before you refuel it, since the instructions make matching the fuel a core part of serving customers.
Keep an eye on the queue and clear cars before drivers start waiting too long, because long waits make customers less happy.
Spend early earnings on service speed upgrades first, since faster service brings in more customers and more profit over time.
Reinvest your profits in new equipment and expansion steadily instead of saving everything, so your station can handle a growing flow of cars.
Serve customers in a steady rhythm rather than rushing in bursts, which helps you keep the queue moving without mistakes.
faq: What is the main goal of Gas Station 24: Simulator?
Your goal is to serve as many customers as possible, earn money, and grow your gas station into a modern one. The faster and better your service, the more profit you make.
How do I earn money in the game?
You earn money by refueling each vehicle with the correct type of fuel and collecting payment. Happier customers and quicker service lead to higher profits.

awesome-tanks-3-game.intro: Awesome Tanks 3 is a top-down 2D tank shooter where you destroy monsters and enemy tanks, uncover hidden areas, and spend collected money on better weapons and tank upgrades.
tips: Spend money on upgrades early, but save some for better weapons when you have a clear idea of which enemies are giving you trouble.
Explore the map fully to find the hidden areas, since they can contain extra money and routes you would otherwise miss.
Keep moving rather than standing still, using WASD or the arrow keys to stay out of enemy fire while you aim and shoot.
Use the physics engine to your advantage by pushing or crushing enemy tanks and objects, which can clear paths and save ammunition.
If you want to practise a layout or a challenge, try building a small level with the Level Editor to learn how the terrain and enemy placement affect combat.
faq: What is the goal of Awesome Tanks 3?
Your aim is to destroy monsters and crush opposing tanks while exploring the game's hidden areas. Money you collect can be used to buy weapons and improve your tank.
How do I move and shoot?
Move with the WASD keys or the arrow keys, and click to shoot. On touch devices, use the on-screen game buttons instead.

angry-bird-2-friends-angry.intro: Angry Birds 2 is a slingshot game where you choose a bird, launch it at pigs, and clear multi-stage levels. Use the mouse to aim and fire your birds.
tips: Pick the bird for each shot based on the structure you are trying to break, since each bird is different and the description says to choose with strategy.
On multi-stage levels, finish each stage before moving on, and watch for Boss Pigs, which take more effort to defeat.
Level up your characters with feathers when you can, because it raises their scoring power.
Complete daily challenges when you have a short session, since they give quick rewards with little time commitment.
If you want coins for the Mighty Eagle's shop, try his Bootcamp challenges, which are the source of those coins.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Launch birds from the slingshot to defeat the pigs and clear each level, including every stage of multi-stage levels.
How do I aim my shots?
Use the mouse to aim and launch your birds from the slingshot.

cubble-on-top.intro: Cubble on Top is a one-player jumping arcade game where you climb cliff walls to reach the top and the finish. The game is built around patience, so careful jumps matter more than speed.
tips: Before each jump, look at the next cliff wall and pick a landing spot you can reach. Rushing usually leads to a fall.
Use short, controlled drag and drop movements to test how far your cube travels before committing to a bigger jump.
If you miss a landing, take a moment to reset your aim rather than making several quick jumps in a row.
Plan your route up the walls in steps, focusing on one section at a time instead of thinking about the finish the whole way.
faq: What is the goal of Cubble on Top?
Your goal is to jump onto the cliff walls, climb to the top, and reach the finish.
How do I jump in Cubble on Top?
Use drag and drop to make your cubble jump. The game's instructions list drag and drop as the main control.

sniper-silent-ridge.intro: Sniper: Silent Ridge is a first person shooting game where you take out every hostile with carefully aimed shots. Use the scope and the environment to stay unnoticed and finish each target.
tips: Check the small scope pip before each shot, since it shows the predicted wind and bullet drop at the displayed range. Adjust your aim to match it.
Aim for the head when you can, because a headshot earns a bonus.
Crouch and wait when guards seem alert, since waiting reduces alert and gives you a calmer moment to take your shot.
Look for fuel drums near groups of guards. Shooting them damages the guards nearby, which can help you clear an area.
Use Space, a click, or a tap on Skip to shorten the bullet camera, so you can move on to your next target sooner.
faq: What is the goal of Sniper: Silent Ridge?
Your goal is to eliminate every hostile in the area. Plan each shot so you can clear the whole scene.
How do I play the game?
Click or tap to play. Use the mouse or touch input to aim and fire, and watch the scope pip for wind and bullet drop.

jigsaw-puzzle-anime.intro: Jigsaw Puzzle - Anime is a relaxing puzzle game where you rebuild classic anime-themed pictures by dragging scattered pieces into place. You can pick from free and premium puzzles or make your own from family photos.
tips: Start by sorting pieces into groups, such as edge pieces, pieces with a similar color, and pieces showing the same part of the picture.
Work on the border first so you have a clear frame to build the inside of the image against.
Check the reference image often so you know which area each piece belongs to before you drag it.
Build small sections of the picture and then connect them, rather than trying to place every piece in one area at once.
Hold a piece and move it slowly toward its spot, then release it only when the edges line up with its neighbors.
faq: How do I move a puzzle piece?
Tap or click and hold a piece, drag it to the spot you want on the board, then release your finger or mouse button to drop it in place.
What is the goal of the game?
Your goal is to arrange the scattered pieces so they form the complete anime image.

city-tuk-tuk-simulator-racing-game-3d.intro: City Tuk Tuk Simulator 3D is a racing game where you drive a colorful three-wheeler through busy city streets. You pick up passengers, dodge traffic, and drift through tight corners using the arrow keys.
tips: Ease off the up arrow before tight corners so the three-wheeler stays stable instead of tipping into a slide.
Use short taps of the left and right arrows to steer through traffic rather than holding them down, which keeps your line controlled.
Plan your route around passenger pickups so you are not forced to reverse or make sudden turns to reach them.
Spend your earned rewards on upgrades when you find a section that feels too hard to control, since a better Tuk Tuk makes routes easier to handle.
Practice drifting on quieter streets first, then bring the same habit into busy areas once you can predict how the vehicle reacts.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?

You race through city streets, pick up passengers, and complete challenging routes while dodging obstacles and traffic. Finishing routes also earns rewards you can use to upgrade your Tuk Tuk and unlock new levels.
Which keys control the Tuk Tuk?
The left and right arrow keys move you left and right, the up arrow drives forward, and the down arrow reverses. Smooth, small inputs are recommended for better control.

super-goin-up.intro: Super Goin Up is a vertical jump game where you climb as high as you can. Stomp and slay enemies along the way to upgrade your stats.
tips: Watch where you land before each jump, since the climb is all about staying on your feet and moving upward.
Stomp enemies whenever you can, because defeating them is how you upgrade your stats.
Pay attention to which stats you are improving, and keep the ones that help you climb higher.
Keep your steps steady rather than rushing, so you have time to react to enemies above you.
If you get knocked back, reposition quickly instead of panicking, since a calm recovery usually keeps your height.
faq: What is the goal of Super Goin Up?
The goal is to jump as high as you can in this vertical jump game. Stomping and slaying enemies helps you upgrade your stats along the way.
How do I control the character?
You can use the arrow keys or touch controls to move and jump.

legends-arena.intro: Legends Arena is a team shooter where you and a partner face a rival duo, or join larger 3v3 and 5v5 team deathmatches. Pick a mode and fight for your side in the arena.
tips: Stay close to your teammate in duo matches so you can cover each other when the rival pair pushes in.
Keep an eye on your ammo and reload with R during quiet moments rather than in the middle of a firefight.
Use the 1 to 4 keys or the mouse wheel to swap weapons quickly, so you always have the right gun for close or long range.
Crouch with C when you take cover or aim at a distant target to present a smaller target to your rivals.
Sprint with Left Shift to reposition across the arena, then slow down before engaging so your aim stays steady.
faq: What is the goal of Legends Arena?
You team up and fight against opposing players in the arena. The description focuses on team battles, so working with your partner is central to the game.
Which battle modes can I choose?
You can play a duo match against a rival pair, or pick 3v3 or 5v5 team deathmatches for more action. The mode you pick is up to you.

cat-escape-hide-and-seek.intro: Cat Escape: Hide and Seek is a casual arcade game where you help a cat sneak past a Great Dane to reach a sweet cake. It has several levels of difficulty and an Endless mode.
tips: Check where the Great Dane is before each move, since staying unnoticed is the core of the game.
Plan your route toward the cake in short stretches and pause your run when the dog is close.
Try the different levels in order so you learn how the difficulty changes before aiming for harder runs.
In Endless mode, focus on staying calm and consistent rather than rushing, because a single mistake can end a run.
Replay a level after a failed attempt and notice where you were spotted so you can change your path next time.
faq: What is the main goal of Cat Escape: Hide and Seek?
Help the cat escape, hide from the Great Dane, and get to the sweet cake. Run straight toward the cat's favorite food while staying unnoticed.
What should I watch out for most while playing?
Keep an eye on the dog at all times. Staying out of its sight is what keeps the cat safe on the way to the cake.

shortcut-run.intro: Shortcut Run is a simple arcade race where you collect track boards and decide whether to use them to pave a shortcut or save them for a final score bonus. The controls are a slide-to-play motion.
tips: Watch the route ahead and plan where a shortcut would save you the most distance before you commit your boards.
Collect boards early so you have enough to pave a path when you reach a gap or a longer detour.
Decide early whether to spend boards on the road or keep them for the final bonus, and stick to that plan for the run.
Pay attention to your position in the race, since the description says only the player in first place can keep playing the following games.
Use short slide inputs and check the result after each move so you do not overshoot your path.
faq: What is the main goal of Shortcut Run?
The goal is to win the race by taking the best route, using shortcuts that you build with the track boards you collect.
How do I control the game?
The game is played by sliding, as shown in the instructions. Practice small slides to get a feel for the response.

2048-3d-merge-cubes.intro: Drop number blocks into place, merge matching values, and clear stones with boosters before the stack reaches the top. Work through the levels or chase a high score in endless mode.
tips: Before you release a block, check the stack height first. Keep the tallest columns low so you have room to maneuver.
Plan merges one step ahead. Place a block next to its match so the pair combines, which keeps the field open.
Save boosters for trouble. Use the Bomb when stones block a key area, and use Flash when stones are spread across the field.
Use X2 on a block that is already high in value, since doubling a larger number gains you more points.
If blocks reach the top boundary, act immediately. You have only three seconds before the game ends, so clear or merge something right away.
faq: How do I move and drop a block?
Swipe left or right on an empty part of the screen, or drag with the left mouse button held down, to position the block. Release your finger or the mouse button to drop it.
What do stones do, and how do I get rid of them?
Stones cannot be merged with other blocks. Use the Bomb to destroy the blocks around a stone, or use Flash to remove all stones from the field.

dressup-wheel.intro: Dressup Wheel is a casual dress-up game where you spin a wheel to answer style questions and then build outfits for your fashion doll. It is played with a mouse click or a tap.
tips: Pay attention to each style question before you commit, since the answers guide which pieces suit the look you are building.
Plan the look for each event before you start dressing the doll, so the outfit, jewelry and accessories all fit the same theme.
Try to match jewelry and accessories to the outfit's colors and style rather than choosing them at random.
Work through the four outfits one at a time so you can compare them and keep each one clearly distinct.
Use the spin as a prompt for creativity: if the result pushes you toward an unfamiliar style, try it once to see how the combination looks.
faq: What is the goal of Dressup Wheel?
The goal is to spin the wheel, answer the style questions, and create four unique outfits with matching jewelry and accessories for your fashion doll.
How do I play Dressup Wheel?
Use a mouse click or a tap to spin the wheel and make your selections.

idle-tower-defense.intro: Idle Tower Defense asks you to hold off endless waves of enemies with your tower. You collect meat during fights for temporary boosts and spend coins between battles on lasting upgrades.
tips: Keep an eye out for meat during each battle and grab it when it's safe, since the temporary upgrades it gives can turn a difficult wave around.
Treat the time between battles as your planning phase. Spend coins on the permanent improvements that help your defense most, rather than buying whatever is cheapest.
Look at which new features you can unlock and plan toward them early, because they can change how you approach later waves.
Use the merge strategy deliberately. Think about how combining pieces will affect your tower's strength before you commit.
Check your progress after each wave and adjust your upgrade choices to fit the enemies you are facing most often.
faq: What is the goal of Idle Tower Defense?
Your goal is to protect your tower from endless waves of enemies for as long as you can. The game keeps sending new waves, so survival depends on steady improvement.
How do I collect meat during a battle?
Meat is collected during combat with a Left Mouse Button click or a touch. Collecting it activates temporary battle upgrades.

point-to-merge.intro: Point to Merge is a puzzle game where you aim arrows to join numbered blocks, doubling them up a sequence from 2. Work through 50 levels that get harder as you go.
tips: Before you point any arrow, trace the whole chain of merges in your head so you know where each block needs to end up.
Plan the path for the blocks that are farthest apart first, since they are the most likely to cross a wrong line or leave the level.
Make small, deliberate moves and check each one before committing, because a single wrong move restarts the puzzle.
Keep your arrows well inside the level boundary, since pointing outside it also resets the puzzle.
If a level keeps restarting, step back and look for a different merge order rather than repeating the same approach.
faq: What is the goal of Point to Merge?
Your goal is to merge numbered blocks by pointing arrows so each block moves toward its match, building the highest value possible. The sequence runs 2, 4, 8, 16 and so on.
What happens if I make a mistake?
One wrong move or pointing an arrow outside the level restarts the puzzle. Careful, precise aiming matters more than speed.

ultraman-monster-island-adventure-2.intro: Ultraman Monster Island Adventure 2 is a two-player 2D adventure set on a Pacific island rich in sapphires, where Ultraman Altman sets out to explore the monster-filled road. The guide below covers the controls and how to approach the run.
tips: Learn the Player 1 keys (A, D and W) first and practise moving before you head into anything dangerous.
The instructions also list P2, P3, J, L and I. Check the in-game prompts to see which keys belong to which player before a two-player session starts.
Because the island has many sapphires, keep an eye out for them as you move, but do not let collecting them distract you from watching for monsters.
If you are playing with a friend, agree on who handles which keys at the start so you do not both press the same controls at the same moment.
faq: What is the goal of Ultraman Monster Island Adventure 2?

The story describes an adventure to the monster island, where villagers have gone missing and Altman sets out to explore. Work through the level and look for the sapphires that make the island valuable.
Which keys control the game?
Player 1 uses A, D and W. The instructions also list P2, P3, J, L and I for the other player controls, so check the in-game prompts to confirm each key's job.

dragon-block-blast.intro: Dragon Block Blast is a block puzzle with 100 solo levels on an 8×8 grid. Hit each score target, and your dragon egg hatches and grows as you advance.
tips: Keep the grid as open as you can, since the quest has no timer but a filled grid is what ends a run. Place pieces where they help clear rows or columns rather than leaving scattered gaps.
Clear lines whenever you can, because each cleared row or column earns bonus points toward the level's score target.
Plan for combos by setting up a nearly full row or column so one well-placed piece can trigger several clears in a row.
Take your time on each move, since there is no clock in solo mode. Look at all three pieces in the tray before deciding where to drag one.
Save your coins for hints when a level gets tight, and only watch the short ad for fresh blocks when you have no valid moves left.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Each level has a score target that rises as you go further, and you must reach it to clear the level. Your score comes mainly from clearing full rows and columns.
How many pieces can I use at once?
You always have 3 pieces in the tray. When all three are placed, a fresh set appears.

my-puppy-daycare-salon.intro: In this caring dress-up game, you rescue a stray puppy, treat its wounds, bathe it, and get it ready with a cozy nest and a stylish outfit. Work through each stage in order to finish the rescue.
tips: Clean all of the puppy's wounds before moving on to the bath, so you don't miss any spots during treatment.
Give the puppy a warm bath and then wait for its fur to dry fully before choosing clothes, since the outfit is meant to keep it from catching a cold.
Take your time when building the nest, because the description highlights stylized, unique designs, so try a few combinations before settling on one.
Browse through the accessories before deciding on an outfit, as there are more than 30 options to compare.
Use click and drag with your mouse on PC or your finger on mobile to move items, and keep your movements steady to avoid dropping things in the wrong place.
faq: What is the main goal of My Puppy Daycare Salon?
The goal is to rescue a stray puppy by cleaning its wounds, giving it a bath, building it a nest, and dressing it in a suitable outfit.
Why does the puppy need to dry before getting dressed?
The game says the outfit helps prevent the puppy from catching a cold, so the fur should be dry before you choose clothing.

paper-fold.intro: Paper Fold is a puzzle game where you fold paper to create pictures. You only need to tap and fold, using the left mouse button.
tips: Look at the whole sheet before your first fold so you can plan which folds will shape the picture you want.
Make small, deliberate folds rather than rushing, since each fold changes the shape you have to work with.
If a fold leaves the paper in an awkward shape, think about how the earlier folds led there and try a different order next time.
Take short breaks between sessions to keep your attention on the shapes and patterns rather than on speed.
faq: What is the goal of Paper Fold?
The goal is to fold the paper so that it creates a picture. The game is built around shaping the paper step by step.
What controls do I use?
You use the left mouse button to tap and fold. There are no other controls mentioned in the instructions.

princess-escape-2021.intro: Princess Escape is a browser game where you guide a princess trying to get out of an evil castle. You move her with WASD or the arrow keys.
tips: Learn how the princess moves with WASD or the arrow keys before you go far, so you can react quickly when danger appears.
Move in short, steady steps instead of holding a key down, which makes it easier to stop and change direction near obstacles.
Take a moment to look around each new area before moving, so you can spot a safe route out.
If you get caught or stuck, slow down and retry the section with a plan rather than rushing the same path again.
faq: How do I control the princess?
Use the WASD keys or the arrow keys to move her. The game is played entirely with these keys.
What is the goal of Princess Escape?
The goal is to help the princess escape from the evil castle. Guide her through the castle and get her out.

city-tuk-tuk-rickshaw-game-auto-games.intro: City Tuk Tuk Rickshaw Game is a driving sim built around pick and drop missions in an open city. You choose from 10 rickshaws, each with its own feel on the road.
tips: Spend a few minutes driving around the open city before starting a mission so you get a feel for how the rickshaw turns and accelerates.
Try different rickshaws from the 10 available to find the one whose handling suits you best.
Use short, steady key presses for turns rather than holding a direction too long, so the rickshaw doesn't swing wide.
Plan your route to each pickup and drop-off point before you move, since missions are about getting to the right spot.
Use the mouse to click menu buttons, and keep your hands on W, A, S, and D for driving.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
The main goal is to complete pick and drop missions by driving your rickshaw to the right locations in the city.
Which keys control the rickshaw?
Use W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move back, A or the Left Arrow to move left, and D or the Right Arrow to move right.

hero-sheep.intro: Hero Sheep is a pin puzzle game where you rescue a sheep from danger. Each level presents a new puzzle, and you win by pulling the pins in the right order.
tips: Before you tap anything, look at the whole level to see where the sheep is and which hazards are nearby.
Think about what each pin controls before pulling it, since a wrong pull can cost the sheep.
Watch how water and lava move once a pin is released, and plan which hazard should reach the monsters.
If a level goes wrong, restart and try a different order rather than repeating the same pulls.
Take your time on each new puzzle; the game rewards careful thinking more than speed.
faq: What is the goal of Hero Sheep?
Your goal is to help the sheep escape danger by pulling the correct pins in the right order on each level.
How do I control the game?
Tap the screen to pull a pin. Each tap is one move, so think about your choice before you tap.

beach-volleyball-3d.intro: Beach volleyball 3D is a sports game where you control one player on a two-person team. Each match is played to three goals, and your opponents are tough to beat.
tips: Since a match ends at three goals, every point matters, so avoid careless mistakes early on.
Watch the ball closely from the moment it is served and keep your eyes on where it is heading.
Stay ready to move between points rather than waiting in one spot, so you can reach shots quickly.
Pay attention to how the opponents play, and notice patterns in where they send the ball.
Play with a steady rhythm instead of rushing each shot, because the opponents are not easy to beat.
faq: How do I win a match?
You win by being the first to score three goals before your opponents do.
How do I control my player?
Use a mouse click or tap to play, and keep your focus on your one player, since the team's result depends on that player.

darts-pro.intro: Darts Pro is a precision darts game where you aim with your mouse or touch screen and throw by clicking or tapping. Score points by landing close to the center of the target.
tips: Settle into a steady, consistent aim before each throw rather than rushing, since precision is what the game rewards.
Aim for the bullseye when you are working on accuracy, but do not ignore the ring just around it if your throws keep drifting.
Watch the board for bonus symbols and plan your throws so you can reach them when they appear.
Use short practice rounds to learn how your aim moves between throws, then adjust your timing or grip to compensate.
Keep your attention on the target at the moment you click or tap, because small hand movements make a big difference at this level of precision.
faq: What is the main goal in Darts Pro?
Your goal is to land your darts as close to the center of the target as you can. Bonus symbols can also boost your points.
Can I play Darts Pro with a touch screen?
Yes. You can aim with your mouse or a touch screen, then click or tap to throw.

football-leauge.intro: Football League is a fast-paced soccer game where you pick your players, plan your tactics, and score goals to climb the ranks and win the championship. The controls are simple enough to learn in a few passes.
tips: Pass the ball early instead of holding it, since a quick throw to a teammate with space often creates a better chance than a solo run.
Watch where your other players are positioned before each throw so you always know who is free to receive the ball.
Keep your choice of players in mind when you set up your team, and pick the mix that suits how you like to attack.
Practice throwing in short sessions so the timing of your taps feels natural before you face tougher matches.
Look for openings near the goal and throw to the player who is in the best position to score, rather than the closest one.
faq: How do I pass the ball to another player on desktop?
Tap the right mouse button to throw the ball to another player.
How do I pass the ball on a touchscreen device?
Tap the screen to throw the ball to another player.

dental-care-game.intro: Dental Care Game is a dentist simulation where you diagnose and treat patients with lively, expressive reactions. You play by clicking with the mouse or tapping the screen.
tips: Look at each patient before you start treating. Their expression and reactions can hint at what kind of problem they have.
Work through one step at a time instead of rushing. Finishing each part of a treatment in order keeps the process clear.
Pay attention to how the patient reacts while you work. Laughing or crying can show whether you are being gentle enough.
Try different patients to see how the treatments vary. Getting comfortable with each type of case makes the next one easier.
Use short, steady clicks or taps rather than fast repeated ones. Careful, controlled actions are the easiest way to get through a session.
faq: What is the goal of Dental Care Game?
The goal is to diagnose and cure different patients as a dentist. You work through each case from start to finish.
How do I control the game?
You play with the mouse or by tapping the screen. Click or tap to select tools and carry out each step.

monster-spaceship-shooter.intro: Monster SpaceShip Shooter is a fast arcade bullet-hell game where you dodge laser trails and projectiles while battling a fiery boss in a glowing space arena. Quick reflexes and precise movement decide how long you last.
tips: Start each run by watching where the projectiles come from and how the laser trails move, rather than rushing in. Learning the boss's patterns early makes the first minute much less chaotic.
Keep your ship near the middle of the arena when you can. Staying central gives you room to move left, right, or back out of a trap in either direction.
Make small, precise movements instead of large sweeping ones. Razor-thin evasions are easier to manage when you only move as far as you need to clear a projectile.
Commit to a dodge as soon as you see a threat, since reacting late is the most common way to get hit. Early, deliberate reactions tend to hold up better than last-second saves.
If a run goes badly, stop and reset your focus before the next attempt. Short, calm retries usually beat frustrated ones in a game that depends so heavily on reflexes.
faq: What is the goal of Monster SpaceShip Shooter?
Your goal is to survive the chaotic space arena while battling the fiery boss. You do this by dodging laser trails and relentless projectiles.
How do I control my ship?
You play by clicking the mouse or tapping the screen. Precise movement is the key skill for slipping past incoming fire.

happy-birthday-party-game.intro: Happy Birthday Party is a cooking and decorating game where you prepare cakes and desserts for the red panda's birthday. You make choices at each step and finish with a birthday song and candles.
tips: Work through the steps in order, from the tablecloth to the plate and the snacks, so nothing is missed before the candles.
Pick a cake style first, such as fruit cake or rainbow cake, and then choose the other items to match it.
Check the table before moving on so you do not forget any cake, since the game asks you to finish all of them.
Take your time with the snack choices, like popcorn, French fries, or cookies, because they are part of the final spread.
Save the candles and the birthday song for last, once everything else is set, so the finish feels complete.
faq: What is the goal of Happy Birthday Party?
The goal is to prepare the cakes and desserts for the red panda's birthday, finish all of them, and then light the candles and sing the birthday song.
How do I control the game?
You play with the mouse or by tapping the screen, clicking or tapping to make each choice.

drift-rider.intro: Drift Rider is a 3D drifting game where you earn points through skillful driving to unlock new cars and customize them. You can drive through city streets or along open highways.
tips: Use the Space key to brake before a corner, then steer to start a drift, since controlled sliding is what earns points.
Try drifting on both the city streets and the highway to see which setting suits your driving style better.
Press the C key to switch camera views and pick the one that gives you the clearest view of the road ahead while drifting.
If your car ends up stuck or facing the wrong way, press the R key to reset it quickly instead of losing time.
Press the P key to enlarge the screen when you want a closer look at the car's movement during tricky maneuvers.
faq: How do I earn points in Drift Rider?
You earn points through skillful maneuvers and strategic driving, with drifting being the main way to build your score. Points are used to unlock new cars and customization options.
Which keys control the car?
Use either the WASD keys or the Arrow keys to steer and move. Press the Space key to brake.

obby-survival-island.intro: You start shipwrecked and must cross rising water, lava paths, broken bridges and traps to reach the rescue point. Each stage is harder than the last, and a single fall sends you back to the start.
tips: Slow down before each jump and check where you will land, since one mistake returns you to the start of the stage.
Keep an eye on the rising water and move forward steadily rather than waiting, so you stay ahead of it.
Collect resources whenever it is safe to do so, then craft useful items before attempting the hardest obstacles.
Watch how the traps move for a few seconds before you go, and time your steps to pass between their cycles.
Help other players when you can, since the game rewards cooperation alongside survival.
faq: What is the goal of Obby: Survival Island?
Reach the end of each level without falling or getting eliminated. Completing every stage lets you escape the island.
How do I move my character?
On PC, use the Arrow Keys or W A S D. On mobile, use the on-screen joystick.

patagonians.intro: Patagonians is a horror adventure where you search for your missing daughter through eerie caves and mansions. You will fight monsters, solve puzzles, and avoid deadly traps along the way.
tips: Use SHIFT to run between safe areas and save your jumps for crossing gaps or dodging traps.
Slide with S or the Down arrow to pass under low obstacles without wasting time going around them.
Use E to interact with objects and puzzles, and check your surroundings carefully before moving on.
Keep your primary attack (LMB) for close enemies and save the secondary weapon (RMB) for tougher monsters.
Pause with TAB when you feel overwhelmed to look around and plan your next move before continuing.
faq: What is the goal of Patagonians?
Your goal is to search for your missing daughter while surviving monsters, traps, and puzzles in caves and mansions. The story unfolds as you explore.
How do I attack and defend against monsters?
Use the left mouse button (LMB) to attack and the right mouse button (RMB) to use your secondary weapon. Moving away from danger with WASD and jumping with SPACE can also help you avoid hits.

merge-guns.intro: Merge Guns combines tower defense with merging on one grid. Buy guns, combine matching tiers into stronger weapons, and stop alien waves from crossing the line.
tips: Merge guns of the same tier early so your strongest weapons are in place before the waves get heavy. Think about which tiles each merged gun will occupy.
Before pressing START WAVE, check that your guns cover the lane enemies come from on the right, since every enemy that crosses the line is a problem.
Use the move, swap, and recycle options to reshape your layout between waves instead of leaving guns in awkward spots.
Save Airstrike for heavy waves where many enemies arrive at once, rather than using it on small early waves.
Spend your earned cores and Salvage on permanent upgrades between runs, and pick upgrades that support the way you like to build your grid.
faq: What is the goal of Merge Guns?
Stop the alien waves from crossing the line by placing and merging guns on the grid. Each run is a new layout puzzle.
How do I merge two guns?
Drag one gun onto another gun of the same tier to merge them into a stronger weapon. Only identical tiers can be combined.

match-3d-puzzle-mania.intro: Match 3D Puzzle Mania brings match-3 puzzling into 3D, with matching objects to clear levels and collect coins. Each level has three difficulties and four abilities to help you get past tougher boards.
tips: Scan the whole board before each move so you can spot matches that are easy to miss in 3D.
Save your coins for the abilities you need most, rather than spending them as soon as you have them.
Try a level on an easier difficulty first to learn how the objects behave before moving to harder versions.
Complete your daily quests every day, since they are the main way to earn the bonus rewards.
Check the rotating events regularly, because they offer extra rewards you can miss if you only play the standard levels.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You clear the level by matching objects, and you progress by completing each level in turn.
What are the abilities used for?
The four abilities are there to help you overcome challenges that are hard to solve by matching alone. Use them when a board seems stuck rather than early on.

battleground-chicken-winner.intro: Battleground Chicken Winner is a shooting game built around teaming up. Room cards and clan modes make it easier to keep playing with friends whenever you have time.
tips: Get comfortable with the touch pad controls before you join a match, so your aiming and movement feel natural when the action starts.
Team up with friends before you begin so you can coordinate and stay together during play.
Use room cards to keep your group together, so you spend less time looking for teammates and more time playing.
Try clan modes with a regular group of friends, since playing with the same people makes it easier to build good teamwork.
Keep track of where your teammates are and communicate early, so you are not caught alone in a shooting fight.
faq: What is the goal of Battleground Chicken Winner?
The game is a shooting game focused on teaming up with friends. Playing together in rooms or clans is a central part of the experience.
How do I control the game?
The game is played with the touch pad, as listed in its instructions. Check the on-screen prompts when you start for the exact layout.

grand-city-driving-2.intro: Grand City Driving 2 is a 3D racing game where you drive detailed supercars through a busy city full of pedestrians. Explore the streets and smash everyone you pass on the way.
tips: Use Space to brake before sharp corners so you keep control of the supercar instead of sliding into buildings.
Press C to switch camera views and pick the one that shows the road and crowds ahead most clearly.
Spend a few minutes driving around the city before trying anything else, so you learn how each car steers and accelerates.
Keep a steady line through the streets rather than making sudden jerky inputs with WASD, which helps you stay on course in traffic.
Try different supercars in the game to see which handling style you enjoy most for exploring and smashing.
faq: What is the goal of Grand City Driving 2?
The game asks you to explore the grand city and smash the pedestrians you drive past. There is no set finish line described, so you can play it as an open drive.
Which keys control the car?
Use WASD to drive, Space to brake, and C to change the camera view.

fix-pizza-food-sorting.intro: Fix Pizza: Food Sorting is a relaxing puzzle where you find extra toppings on each pizza and sort them onto matching plates. Study the recipe first, then remove everything it doesn't list.
tips: Read the recipe sheet before tapping anything, and keep it in mind as you scan the pizza.
Check each ingredient against the recipe before you tap it, since a wrong tap uses up one of your limited mistake markers.
Look at the plate's required item and count first, then search the pizza for that item so you collect in a focused way.
Save Highlight for when you are stuck, because it reveals suitable ingredients and is most useful once the pizza gets busier.
Use Shuffle when the remaining items are hard to spot, and use Mistakes to clear markers if you have used some on an earlier wrong choice.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Remove every ingredient that is not in the recipe by filling the matching plates. Once every plate is full and only recipe ingredients remain, the level is complete.
What happens if I tap the wrong ingredient?
A wrong choice fills one mistake marker. If all available markers are used, you will need to restart the level.

stellar-style-spectacle-fashion.intro: Stellar Style Spectacle Fashion is a dress-up game where you get four friends ready for a futuristic red carpet event. You pick outfits, hairstyles, makeup and accessories using simple clicks.
tips: Work through the categories in a set order, such as outfit, hair, makeup, then accessories, so you do not lose track of what is still missing.
Try a few holographic gowns with different metallic accessories before settling on a look, since pairing matters as much as the single piece.
Use the gravity-defying hairstyles to set the mood of a character, then match the makeup so the whole look feels coordinated.
Experiment with the avant-garde accessories on each friend, because each of the four besties can end up with a very different style.
Click slowly and check each choice before moving on, since the instructions say the left mouse click handles both navigation and task completion.
faq: What is the goal of Stellar Style Spectacle Fashion?
Your goal is to prepare four besties for a futuristic red carpet bash by choosing outfits, hairstyles, makeup and accessories that make a statement.
How do I control the game?
Use the left mouse click for navigation and to complete each task. The same click is used to pick items from the wardrobe.

wasteland-hunter-puzzle-rpg.intro: Wasteland Hunter mixes Tetris-style block placement with turn-based battles in a post-apocalyptic world. You fill your block grid with equipment like bullets, health packs, shields and grenades to build combat combinations against enemies.
tips: Look at the shape of the enemy you are facing before placing blocks, and choose a formation that suits that enemy type.
Keep an eye on how your blocks fit together, since good placement lets you combine equipment into stronger combinations.
Balance offense and defense: fill some of your grid with shields or health packs so a single rough turn does not end the fight.
Explore the map carefully, because you will meet new situations and escalating difficulty that call for different block layouts.
Use what you gain beyond battle, such as rescued NPCs and blueprints for combat figures, to strengthen your camp and prepare for harder fights.
faq: What is the main goal of Wasteland Hunter?
You fight turn-based battles using Tetris blocks loaded with equipment, while exploring the map and rebuilding a survivor camp. Winning fights and growing your camp move you forward.
How do I control the game on PC?
Use the mouse buttons to play. Click and use the mouse to place blocks and take actions during battles.

hair-salon-3d.intro: Hair Salon 3D is a hair salon simulator where you cut and dye clients' hair to match the requested style. Your stars and tips depend on how closely the result matches the request.
tips: Open the client's card and check the 3D preview before you touch the hair, so you know the target shape and length.
Start with the rough cut using scissors for precise shaping, then switch to clippers when you need an even trim across a section.
Save the razor for detailing edges and finishing lines, since small adjustments matter most near the end.
Rotate the camera often to check both sides and the back of the head, because uneven sections are easy to miss from one angle.
Spend your earned currency on new tools and dyes when a request needs them, and look at daily challenges for extra practice on different styles.
faq: How do I get more stars on a client?
The rating is based on how accurately you recreate the requested hairstyle, so compare your result with the preview before tapping Done.
What is the difference between the tools?
Scissors are for precise cutting, clippers are for even trimming, and the razor is for detailing. The game also includes a color brush for dyeing hair.

town-builder-inc.intro: Town Builder Inc. is an arcade tycoon game where you walk around a stickman town, collect cash, and grow a small street operation into a bigger financial empire. Move with WASD or the arrow keys.
tips: Collect cash steadily at the start, since your earnings fund every upgrade and hire that follows.
Upgrade your capacity before you expand, so your stacked earnings don't go to waste while you work.
Hire workers as soon as you can afford them, because they help your businesses keep earning.
Unlock new town businesses one step at a time rather than rushing, so each new income source is supported before you add the next.
Keep moving between your collection points and businesses in short loops to avoid long gaps with no income.
faq: What is the goal of Town Builder Inc.?
The goal is to grow a small street operation into a larger money-making town empire by collecting cash, unlocking businesses, and expanding step-by-step.
How do I move my character?
Use the WASD keys or the arrow keys to move around the town.

lift-the-girl.intro: Lift The Girl is a 2D puzzle game about guiding a character through levels full of traps. You drag weights into place and move the character while keeping the little sister safe.
tips: Before you drag anything, look at the whole level and find where the traps are. Plan the order of your moves first.
Drop each weight slowly and check where it lands before you let go. A weight in the wrong spot can block your route or set off a trap.
Move the character one step at a time and watch how the sister reacts. If a move puts her in danger, undo your thinking and try a different route.
Because a hurt sister means starting the level over, play carefully rather than quickly. Slow, deliberate moves usually save time overall.
Each level has different traps, so do not reuse the same solution everywhere. Study each new layout as if it were the first one.
faq: What is the goal of Lift The Girl?
Your goal is to get the character through each level while keeping the little sister from being hurt. If she is hurt, you must start the level again.
How do I control the game?
Use the left mouse button to drag and drop the weights. Click on the character to move it.

hook-wars.intro: Hook Wars is a 3D action game about hooking opponents across a river while dodging their hooks. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, and hook with left-click or the space key.
tips: Watch the opponents' hook throws before you move, so you can step out of the line of the hook instead of reacting late.
Keep your aim steady before you fire. Accuracy decides the fight, so a slower, careful hook usually beats a rushed one.
Stay mobile along your side of the river rather than standing still, which makes you an easy target.
Try to beat your own previous score on each run by focusing on one improvement at a time, such as dodging better or hooking more accurately.
faq: What is the main goal of Hook Wars?
The goal is to dodge hooks thrown by opponents across the river while hooking them toward your side.
Which controls do I use to move and hook?
Use WASD or the arrow keys to move, and left-click or the space key to hook.

uber-sim-transport-2020.intro: Uber Sim Transport 2020 is a driving action game where you play as a ride driver. Passengers are waiting, so you need to get to them quickly. The game includes a career mode.
tips: Passengers are waiting, so keep moving toward your next pickup instead of taking slow detours.
Use W, A, S and D together to steer smoothly, since sharp corrections can cost you time.
Plan your route before each trip so you spend less time driving in the wrong direction.
Work through the career mode in order and watch how each stage changes the pace of your drives.
If you fall behind, focus on getting the next passenger first rather than trying to make up time in one run.
faq: What is the goal of Uber Sim Transport 2020?
The goal is to pick up waiting passengers and get them where they need to go, as the title suggests. The game rewards speed, so keep your drives moving.
How do I control the car?
Use the W, A, S and D keys to drive. W, A, S and D are the only controls listed for this game.

mars-colony.intro: Mars Colony is an idle simulation where you guide Rob the Robot through mining, processing, and building to prepare Mars for human settlement. Move Rob around the map to start each activity.
tips: Send Rob to resources first so mining runs while you work on other areas. Since this is an idle game, steady progress comes from keeping production going.
When Rob reaches a production facility, watch for the acceleration panel and click it quickly to speed up processing. Make this a habit each time a facility starts.
Stop by construction zones to invest resources in buildings. Check which resources you have stored before heading there so Rob is not left waiting.
Use warehouses to manage how resources move. Open the resource movement panel when you need to shift materials to where they are used.
Use the transport assistant control zone to set up automated help with moving resources. Checking it now and then keeps your colony supplied.
faq: What is the main goal of Mars Colony?
Your goal is to prepare Mars for human settlement by mining resources, building factories, and recycling materials. Rob carries out each step as you move him around the map.
How do I move Rob around?
Use the on-screen joystick, or the WASD or arrow keys if you are on a keyboard. Move Rob onto a resource, facility, construction zone, warehouse, or transport control zone to start that activity.

parkout-traffic-escape.intro: ParkOut: Traffic Escape is a 3D sliding puzzle where you clear a gridlocked parking lot. Swipe cars out of the way so every vehicle can reach the exit.
tips: Before moving anything, look at the cars nearest the exit and find which ones block their path. Those blockers usually need to move first.
Remember that each car only moves in a straight line, so check which direction a car can travel before you plan around it.
Test a few moves and watch where each car stops. Use the result to work out which cars are tangled together.
Take your time. There are no timers or penalties, so it is worth planning two or three moves ahead instead of rushing.
Avoid crashing into other cars, walls, or obstacles. Keep the path clear as you go so you don't have to undo your progress.
faq: How do I win a level?
You win by guiding every single car out of the parking lot. The level is not finished until the whole lot is clear.
How do I move a car?
Tap and swipe a car to move it forward or backward. Cars can only travel in a straight line along their direction.

deepglow.intro: Deepglow is a pixel-art clicker set in a glowing night world. You harvest resources against a timer, then spend them on an upgrade tree to grow stronger and reach new biomes.
tips: Keep hunger and thirst topped up before each phase, since hunger weakens your hits and thirst halves the materials you collect.
Spend your resources on upgrades that raise yields or sharpen your tools early, so every later phase pays out more.
Use the time between phases to plan your upgrade path rather than buying whatever is closest to affordable.
Tap the richest resources first in each phase so you collect the most before the timer runs out.
Since there is no game over, treat a weak phase as a setup for the next one and keep building toward new biomes.
faq: What is the goal of Deepglow?
Your aim is to travel through six biomes and reach the heart of the Deepglow. Each phase moves you forward, and upgrades help you get there.
How do I harvest resources?
On desktop, click a resource or use Arrows or WASD and Space to move and harvest. On mobile, tap the resources you want to gather.

sea-legends-match-3.intro: Sea Legends - Match 3 is a match-3 puzzle where you clear blocks from the board, collect marine creatures, and uncover secrets from shipwrecks and ocean treasures across new stages.
tips: Look for larger block combinations when you can, since the bigger the underwater combination, the more powerful the booster it creates.
Save boosters for harder moments. Activate them when a level goal is out of reach so they help you finish faster.
Try pairing two boosters together, because combining them is a way to clear tougher boards more efficiently.
Keep an eye on your level objectives at all times, and plan moves that clear blocks and collect creatures at the same time.
Move on to new stages once you feel comfortable, since each one adds more ocean mysteries to uncover.
faq: What is the main goal of each level?
You need to complete the level objectives, which involve clearing blocks from the board and collecting marine creatures.
How do boosters work in this game?
Boosters are earned by making bigger underwater block combinations. Once you activate one, it helps you complete level goals faster.

doggydoku.intro: DoggyDoku is a head-to-head sudoku-style logic duel. You and a rival race to place one dog in every row, column, and colored region before the five-minute timer runs out.
tips: Before placing anything, scan each colored region for a row or column where it is confined to one line, since that narrows where its dog can go.
When you place a dog, mark every tile it rules out with an X, including the eight tiles touching it diagonally, so you can see forced moves faster.
Work through rows, columns, and regions one at a time instead of jumping around, which helps you spot the single remaining empty tile.
With only five minutes on the clock, move on to another area if a section stalls rather than spending a long time on one tile.
Save hints for moments when you are truly stuck, since each one costs 50 coins and reveals one forced dog.
faq: How do I win a DoggyDoku match?
You win by solving more boards than your rival before the five-minute timer ends. Each board is a separate grid you race to complete.
What are the placement rules?
Each row, column, and colored region needs exactly one dog, and no two dogs can touch, even diagonally. Illegal placements are rejected, so you will know right away if a dog breaks a rule.

superhero-dentist-surgery-game-for-kids.intro: Step into a superhero dentist clinic where your patients are crime-fighting heroes. Treat them with mouth spray, dental tweezers, and braces, and use taps or clicks to get each job done.
tips: Look at each superhero patient before choosing a tool, so you can match the treatment to what they need.
Try each tool at least once, such as the mouth spray, dental tweezers, and braces, so you learn what each one does before you rely on it.
Work through one patient fully before moving to the next, which keeps the clinic from feeling rushed and makes it easier to spot problems.
Tap or click slowly and deliberately, since precise taps are more useful than fast, random ones when handling small tools.
faq: What is the goal of this game?
You run a clinic for superhero patients and treat their teeth using tools like mouth spray, dental tweezers, and braces.
How do I control the game?
You play by tapping or clicking. The instructions do not list any other controls.

obby-rpg-slasher-blade-loot.intro: Obby: RPG Slasher Blade Loot mixes obstacle-course stages with close-combat fights and gear upgrades. You move through levels, collect weapons and armor, and get stronger as you go.
tips: Compare the stats on each weapon and armor piece before equipping it, since every item changes attack, defense, and health.
Spend upgrades on the gear you use most, so your strongest stats grow in the style you prefer.
Save your ability for tough enemies or tricky moments rather than using it on every small foe.
Before pushing into a new area, make sure your health and defense are up to the challenge of the enemies there.
Pay attention to the obby trials between fights, and take your time with jumps so you do not lose progress.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You progress through levels, unlock new areas, and defeat increasingly dangerous enemies while growing your hero's power.
How do I attack and use abilities?
On PC, left mouse button attacks and the 1 key uses your ability. On mobile, use the attack and ability buttons on screen.

impossible-bus-stunt-3d.intro: Impossible Bus Stunt 3D is a racing and stunt game where you drive buses at full speed over mega ramps. Complete tricky challenges to unlock bigger vehicles.
tips: Use the arrow keys or WASD, whichever feels more comfortable, and stick with one so your steering stays consistent on the ramps.
Pay attention to the angle of each ramp before you accelerate, since the launch determines whether your bus lands safely.
Try a few runs at a moderate speed first to learn how each bus handles in the air before going full speed.
Treat the challenges as practice: repeating a stunt helps you judge timing and balance better than rushing through.
Keep track of which challenges you have already finished, so you can focus on the ones that bring you closer to unlocking the next vehicle.
faq: What is the main goal of Impossible Bus Stunt 3D?
Your goal is to drive your chosen bus over mega ramps and complete the tricky challenges. Finishing them unlocks the larger vehicles.
Which controls do I use to drive?
Use the arrow keys or WASD to control your bus.

my-sweetstreet-shop.intro: My SweetStreet Shop is a shop management game where you run a candy and pastry store. You move around the shop, serve customers, and spend your earnings to grow the business.
tips: Keep customers moving through the shop, since serving them is the main way money comes in.
Pick up sweets and deliver them to the right counters before checking on other tasks, so no customer waits too long.
Save up for the first upgrades that speed up your movement or collection, because they make every later round easier.
Spend money on new stations and products once your current setup is running smoothly, so you are not short on cash for basic restocks.
Hire helpers when your shop gets busy so you can keep up with customers while you handle deliveries yourself.
faq: What is the goal of My SweetStreet Shop?
The goal is to run a successful sweet business by serving customers, collecting money, and expanding your shop. Keep serving customers to grow the store.
How do I move around the shop?
On PC, use WASD or the arrow keys. On mobile, use the floating joystick that appears on screen.

call-of-bravery-shooter.intro: Call of Bravery Shooter is a 5v5 team shooter set on the Catania or Venado maps. Your team wins by being the first to reach 50 points, so smart weapon choices and steady aim matter from the start.
tips: Pick a map and learn its layout before you push forward, so you know where enemies can reach you from.
Keep your primary, secondary, and utility weapons ready to switch between, using keys 1 to 4 on PC, so you can react as the fight changes.
Aim for headshots whenever you can, since the game encourages quick, clean kills over spraying bullets.
Reload with R on PC when you are out of cover or between fights, not in the middle of a firefight.
Move with purpose instead of running in a straight line, and stay aware of your teammates so your team works together toward 50 points.
faq: What is the goal of Call of Bravery Shooter?
Your team wins by being the first to score 50 points in a 5v5 match. Staying focused and working with your team is the main way to get there.
How do I move and aim on PC?
Use WASD to move and the mouse to aim and fire. Press R to reload and keys 1 to 4 to change weapons.

matching-tiles-3d.intro: Matching Tiles 3D is a relaxing puzzle where you find and select pairs of 3D tiles with the same image. Clear every tile from the board to win.
tips: Drag to rotate the cubes before you pick, so you can check every side of a tile for a matching image.
Scan the whole board first and look for pairs you can spot quickly, then work through the harder ones.
Pay attention to where each image appears as you reveal it, since remembering positions helps you find the match later.
Take your time on each move. The game rewards focus more than speed, so a short pause to compare tiles often saves mistakes.
Expect the board to get harder as you go, so keep your memory sharp by checking tiles you have already seen before choosing new ones.
faq: What is the goal of Matching Tiles 3D?
Your goal is to find and select two tiles with the same image and clear them from the board. Keep matching until no tiles are left.
How do I select tiles and rotate the cubes?
On mobile, touch a tile to select it and drag to rotate the cubes. On PC, click to select a tile and drag with the mouse to rotate the cubes.

mega-ramp-car-stunts-gt-racing.intro: Drive powerful sports cars across sky tracks, massive ramps, zigzag roads, and stunt courses. Your goal is to reach the finish line without falling off the track.
tips: Tap the movement keys in short bursts on zigzag roads so you can correct your line before the car drifts toward an edge.
Use Shift for boost mainly on straight stretches, so you keep control when the track turns or you approach a ramp.
Before each jump, check the car's angle and speed, and try to take off roughly level so you have a better chance of landing on the track.
Keep Space ready for sharp obstacles or sudden drops, since braking early is often safer than reacting late.
If a level keeps going wrong, press P to pause and study the next section, then try again with a plan for the hardest jump.
faq: What is the main goal of Mega Ramp Car Stunts GT Racing?
Reach the finish line of each track while staying on the road and avoiding dangerous obstacles. Falling off the track ends your attempt.
Which keys control the car on desktop?
Use A, W, S, and D for movement, Space to brake, and Shift for boost. P pauses the game and N skips the current level.

strategy-of-war-tanks-and-helicopters.intro: War Strategy: Tanks and Helicopters is a browser strategy game where you lead ground and air forces to capture enemy strongholds. Your success depends on choosing where to send your troops and when.
tips: Click a base once to send half its troops, which is useful when you want to probe or pressure an enemy without giving up your whole force.
Click twice to send all troops from a base when you need a decisive attack on a stronghold.
Before moving units between a ground base and an air base, remember it costs double the troops, so plan those transfers early.
Keep some troops at your own bases so enemy attacks cannot take them easily while your main force is advancing.
Watch which enemy strongholds are weakly defended and target them first, since capturing them quickly gives you more options.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You lead your forces to seize enemy strongholds using tanks and helicopters. Winning means taking control of the enemy's bases.
How do I move troops or attack?
Select the base you want to use, then click the target base. One click sends half the troops, and two clicks sends all of them.

push-the-frog.intro: Push The Frog is a logic puzzle where you guide a small frog to eat every mosquito. You need to plan your route and use the length of the tongue to reach each target.
tips: Before you move, look at the whole screen and find every mosquito. Plan an order that lets you reach them all without getting stuck.
Work out where the frog needs to stand before you fire the tongue. Position matters more than speed.
Use WASD or the arrow keys to make small, careful moves. Small adjustments often save you from a wasted tongue shot.
Press Spacebar only when you are sure of the distance. Think about how far the tongue will reach from your current spot.
If you get stuck, step back and rethink the route from the start rather than repeating the same moves.
faq: What is the goal of Push The Frog?
The goal is to control the frog so it eats all the mosquitoes on the screen. You do this by positioning the frog and using its tongue.
How do I control the frog?
Use WASD or the arrow keys to move the frog. Press Spacebar to pop out the frog's tongue and catch a mosquito.

city-chase-escape-police.intro: City Chase: Escape Police is a racing survival game where you drive through the city, dodge cops, and try to last as long as possible. Your goal is to beat your best time before the police catch you.
tips: Keep the car moving in short steering bursts rather than holding a direction for long, so you can react when a police car cuts in front of you.
Use the Ram Bar when police cars are close around you, since smashing them clears the way ahead and reduces the pressure.
Pay attention to HP boosts and collect them when you have room to spare, so you have some protection as Wanted Levels climb.
On mobile, try releasing the screen to straighten up between turns, because the car keeps accelerating on its own and you do not need to hold the gas.
If your car gets stuck against a wall or a car, use the Reset button or R key straight away rather than waiting, since it frees the car without ending your run.
faq: What is the goal of City Chase: Escape Police?
Survive the police chase for as long as you can to get the highest score. Each run ends when the cops finally bust you.
How do I steer on a computer?
