Use the Left and Right Arrow keys or A and D to steer, and the Down Arrow or S key to reverse. The car accelerates on its own by default.

bow-brawls.intro: Bow Brawls is a top-down archery survival game where you pull back a drag joystick to aim and release to fire. Survive endless waves, beat bosses, and climb the global leaderboards with your score.
tips: Pull the aim joystick away from your target and release when the line feels right, since practicing this timing is the core skill of the game.
Keep moving rather than standing still, because enemies attack from all directions, including melee fighters and ranged shooters.
Watch for the boss's special moves, such as dashing, jumping over you, or launching projectiles, and step out of the way before you shoot.
Protect your health bar early in each run, because you only get one life and a single mistake can end it.
Defeat bosses to earn gems, then use them to unlock new bows and armors with different abilities, and try a few setups to find a style you like.
faq: How do I aim and shoot?
Pull the on-screen joystick in the opposite direction of your target, then release to shoot an arrow. On PC, use WASD to move.
How is my score calculated?
Your score is based on enemy kills, and each enemy type rewards a different number of points. Defeating more enemies is the main way to climb the leaderboards.

melon-maker-fruit-game.intro: Melon Maker is a stacking puzzle where you drop fruits into a box and merge matching ones to grow toward a large melon. Your fruit must stay inside the box, or the round is lost.
tips: Drop fruits near the middle of the box and build outward, so the pile stays level and matching fruits have room to meet.
Before each tap, check where the fruit will land, since it falls straight down from the spot you choose.
Keep the top of the box clear. A fruit that rises out of the box ends your round, so stop stacking high in one spot.
Plan around pairs of matching fruits. Place a fruit next to its match so they can merge into the next size.
Avoid rushing your taps. Taking a moment between drops gives you time to spot gaps and keep the pile balanced.
faq: What is the goal of Melon Maker?
The goal is to merge matching fruits repeatedly until you make the biggest melon you can. You are competing with other players around the world to reach the largest melon.
How do I control the game?
Tap the screen to drop a fruit into the box. Each tap releases one fruit at the position you choose.

super-stickman-duelist.intro: Super Stickman Duelist is a 2D arcade duel game where you rotate your stickman and weapon to attack and defeat enemies on each level. Drag to play and aim your swings carefully.
tips: Watch how your weapon rotates before you commit, since timing the swing matters more than speed.
Pay attention to the enemy's position and attack from angles where your weapon reaches them first.
Keep an eye out for weapons dropped by enemies or lying on platforms, and switch to them when they look stronger.
Test a new weapon for a few moves to learn its reach and swing before relying on it in a tough fight.
Take a short moment to plan each drag so your movement stays controlled instead of rushed.
faq: How do I control my stickman?
Drag to play. The description says you rotate your character and weapon by dragging, so use smooth drags to aim each attack.
How do I defeat enemies?
Rotate your stickman and weapon so the blade reaches the enemy. Landing a clean hit at the right angle is how you kill them on each level.

rolling-ball-halloween-escape.intro: Rolling Ball Halloween Escape is an arcade game where you roll a ball through a spooky sky and haunted landscape, dodging obstacles to get away. Click or tap to play.
tips: Watch the swinging pendulums and time your moves so you pass them at the right moment rather than rushing into them.
Keep an eye on the shattering boxes ahead, since they can appear in your path, so plan your route a few obstacles in advance.
Use speed changes deliberately: speed up when the path is clear and slow down or back up when a hazard is close.
Try short, controlled inputs instead of holding your click or tap for long stretches, so you can react to what is coming next.
If you keep getting caught by the same obstacle, pause mentally, study how it moves, and retry with a different timing.
faq: How do I control the ball?
Use a mouse click or a tap to play. The game lets you speed the ball up or back it up to get through obstacles.
What should I focus on to avoid getting hit?
Pay close attention to the swinging pendulums and the shattering boxes, since these are the main obstacles mentioned in the game.

only-up-or-lava.intro: Only Up Or Lava is a single-player adventure where you climb through levels while avoiding obstacles and rising lava. Precise jumps and steady movement matter more than speed.
tips: Use Shift to walk when you are near a ledge or an edge, so you can control where you land instead of overshooting.
Before each jump, look at where you will land and make sure the spot is solid ground rather than a gap you might fall into.
Keep moving upward and do not stop for too long, since the lava is the main threat and waiting gives it time to catch you.
Use the R key to pause when a level feels overwhelming, then return to it with a clear head before attempting the hard jumps again.
Practice the climbing and jumping controls on early levels so that the harder sections feel familiar when the challenges increase.
faq: What is the goal of Only Up Or Lava?
Your goal is to conquer each level by climbing, jumping over obstacles and avoiding the molten lava. If the lava reaches you, you are engulfed.
How do I move and jump?
Use W, A, S and D to move, and press Space to jump or climb. Hold Shift to walk, which is useful for controlled landings near ledges.

baby-taylor-easter-fun.intro: Help Baby Taylor get ready for an Easter rally with her friends. You will make a decorated Easter goody basket and colorful Easter eggs, all controlled with mouse clicks or taps.
tips: Finish the Easter goody basket first, since the game describes it as the step she wants to complete before getting ready for the rally.
Work through the activities in the order they come up so you do not miss a step on the way to the rally.
Take your time when decorating the eggs and basket, because the game asks for colorful, beautiful results.
Use short, deliberate clicks or taps so you can react to each prompt without accidentally skipping ahead.
Stay with Taylor through each part of the day, since the game is built around following her plans from start to finish.
faq: What is the goal of Baby Taylor Easter Fun?
The goal is to help Baby Taylor make an Easter goody basket with colorful eggs and then get ready for the Easter rally with her friends.
How do I play the game?
You play by clicking the mouse or tapping the screen. The instructions do not describe any other controls.

mega-car-stunts.intro: Mega Car Stunts is a physics-based driving game where you tackle stunt tracks full of jumps, ramps, and obstacles. Success depends on control and timing as much as speed.
tips: Slow down before big jumps and ramps, since a faster approach does not always mean a better landing.
Study each track on your first run and note where the hazards and jump points are so you can plan later runs.
Keep your car level in the air when possible, because a tilted landing is a common cause of physics-based crashes.
Use your earnings to unlock new cars once the current ones start to feel limiting on harder events.
Aim for a clean run over a fast one; keeping control under pressure is what the courses reward.
faq: What is the goal of Mega Car Stunts?
Drive through each stunt track, avoid hazards, perform jumps, and reach the finish while keeping your car under control.
How do I earn money in the game?
You earn money by completing events and challenges, and you can spend it to unlock new vehicles.

world-of-alice-animal-habitat.intro: World of Alice Animal Habitat is an educational puzzle for children. You learn what different habitats are and which animals live in each one by matching animals to their homes.
tips: Look closely at the animal before you click. Its body features, such as fur, feathers, or fins, can hint at the environment it needs.
Think about where the animal would find food and shelter. This often narrows the choice to one habitat.
Rule out habitats that clearly do not suit the animal, then choose from what remains.
Say the habitat name out loud as you click it. Repeating the connection helps you remember it for next time.
Pay attention to animals you find tricky and think about why their habitat fits. Understanding the reason is more useful than memorizing one answer.
faq: What is the goal of World of Alice Animal Habitat?
The goal is to learn which habitats exist and which animals live in each one. You do this by matching animals to their habitats.
How do I play?
Click on the habitat where the animal shown lives. Each animal you match teaches you where it belongs.

line-color-2d.intro: Line Color 2D is a relaxed but challenging puzzle where you guide a colored line along a flat circuit, painting the full route until you reach the finish. Use the arrow keys to move.
tips: Plan your path before you move. Look at the whole circuit first so you do not paint yourself into a dead end.
Watch the moving obstacles and time your moves around them rather than reacting at the last second.
Keep your route tidy. Each section you paint shapes what options remain, so avoid choices that box you in.
If a run goes wrong, restart with a clear plan rather than pushing on with a messy path.
Take short breaks between attempts. Steady, deliberate moves usually beat fast, careless ones in this puzzle.
faq: What is the goal of Line Color 2D?
You need to paint the whole route on the flat circuit and cross the finish line while avoiding the moving obstacles.
How do I move the line?
Use the arrow keys to move the colored line around the circuit.

super-zombie-driving.intro: Super Zombie Driving puts you behind the wheel in a city overrun by zombies. Choose a vehicle, smash through the undead, and complete missions before time runs out.
tips: Check the target number of zombies at the start of each level so you know how much smashing you need before the timer ends.
Keep your speed up and aim for groups of zombies rather than chasing single ones across the street.
Use the brake with Space to steer through tight spots and line up your next hit instead of crashing into wrecks you can avoid.
Turn the view with the mouse often so you can spot zombies and wrecked cars ahead before you reach them.
If a run goes badly or you are running out of time, press R to restart and try the level again with a cleaner route.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Each level asks you to smash a specific number of zombies before time runs out. Completing the mission clears the streets and earns rewards.
What do the controls do?
Use WASD to drive and Space to brake. Move the mouse to rotate the view, and press R to restart.

madness-ward-number-6.intro: Madness: Ward number 6 is an adventure-RPG where you play as a patient in a psychiatric hospital. You level up by fighting other patients and bosses, then spend points to build your character.
tips: Fight regularly, since you only gain a new level after several battles and each level brings points to spend on upgrades.
Think about which stat you put points into, because the power of your critical hits depends on your Madness characteristic.
Critical damage is random, so do not rely on it every fight; treat it as a bonus and keep your basic damage useful.
Check the weapons, skins and pets in the shop before spending, and compare what each one offers for the fights you plan to take on.
Try your luck in the rat race when you want a change of pace, but avoid spending resources on it if you need them for upgrades.
faq: How do I level up my character?
Win battles against other patients and bosses by tapping or clicking the fight buttons. After several battles you reach a new level and receive points to upgrade your character.
What does the Madness stat do?
Madness controls how powerful your critical damage is in battle. Critical hits happen at random, so the stat affects how hard they hit when they land.

orbit-pals.intro: Orbit Pals is a cozy sorting puzzle where you move groups of alien pals between planets. Each planet holds only four pals, so every move needs a plan.
tips: Before you move, check which pals sit at the edge of each planet, since only that group can be lifted.
Look for planets with a single species on top, and keep them intact so you can send matching pals onto them.
Use the empty planet button when you run out of room, but do not fill new planets without a clear purpose.
Try a move, and if it blocks a species, press undo right away instead of working around the mistake.
Save the hint button for when you are truly stuck, and play the Daily Puzzle to build a streak.
faq: How do I move pals?
Tap or click a planet to lift the group at its edge, then tap another planet or drag to send them there. Pals can only land on their own kind or on an empty planet.
What does the four-pal limit mean?
Each planet fits only four pals, so a planet that is already full cannot take more. Plan your moves so a species fits neatly into one flock.

gang-fall-party.intro: Gang Fall Party is a fighting game set on high platforms, where you win by punching opponents off the edge. You can play alone, in a 1vs1 match with a friend, or in online matches with many players.
tips: Keep an eye on where you stand relative to the edge, since every fight takes place on a high place and falling is how you win.
Use the run key to close distance quickly, then punch, rather than standing still and trading slow hits near the edge.
In online games with 16 or 17 players, watch the crowd for a moment before engaging so you know who is near the edge.
Practice movement in single player mode first to get comfortable with the controls before facing a friend or the Vs All mode.
In 1vs1, try to stay on the side of the arena that keeps your opponent with their back to the edge.
faq: What is the goal of Gang Fall Party?
Your goal is to make your opponents fall off the high places you are fighting on, using your punches.
What are the controls for Player 1 and Player 2?
Player 1 moves with W A S D, runs with C, and punches with V. Player 2 moves with the arrow keys, runs with O, and punches with P.

chu-choo-cake.intro: Chu Choo Cake puts you in charge of Chef Piggo, who must bring his cakes safely to the bottom of each level while greedy mice try to stop him. Move with WASD and use SPACE to act.
tips: Plan your route before you move, since you must save every cake before the level can be completed.
Stand on a cake to drop it toward the bottom, so position yourself directly on top of each cake you want to save.
Keep an eye on the mice at all times and change your path early rather than running into them.
Because the game mixes Pac-Man and Donkey Kong ideas, expect to move carefully around obstacles and enemies rather than rushing through the level.
If you get stuck, pause to study the layout of the cakes and mice, then choose the safest next move.
faq: What is the goal of Chu Choo Cake?
Help Chef Piggo save his cakes from the hungry mice by dropping each cake to the bottom of the level. You must save every cake to complete a level.
How do I move the chef and drop the cakes?
On desktop, use WASD to move and SPACE for action or select. To drop a cake, stand on it so it moves to the bottom.

advanced-air-combat-simulator.intro: Advanced Air Combat Simulator is a shooting game where you pilot a fighter jet and destroy enemy jets in aerial dogfights. Use WASD to fly, the mouse to aim and look around, and left-click to fire.
tips: Use WASD for smooth, steady flight changes rather than sharp, repeated inputs, so you keep control of your jet while turning toward a target.
Move the mouse to aim and look around at the same time, and check your surroundings often so an enemy does not get behind you unnoticed.
Press C to change the camera view when you need a better sense of where enemies are relative to your aircraft.
Fire in short bursts when your aim is on target instead of holding left-click continuously, which helps you avoid wasting shots.
Press TAB to open the menu whenever you need to recheck the controls during a battle.
faq: What is the goal of Advanced Air Combat Simulator?
Your goal is to destroy enemy jet fighters and come out victorious in intense aerial battles.
How do I control my jet?
Use the WASD keys to navigate and fly your fighter. The mouse controls aiming and looking around.

launch-jack.intro: Launch Jack is a physics-based puzzle game where you catapult a pumpkin through haunted landscapes to destroy every zombie head in each level. Click or tap to play.
tips: Study the whole level before your first shot so you can see where the zombie heads are and which obstacles stand in the way.
Plan your shots around breakable obstacles, since clearing a path can make the rest of the level much easier.
Look for chances to set up combos, because chaining hits together is a key way to clear levels.
Save your power-ups for harder levels where the layout is tricky, rather than using them early on.
Pay attention to how Jack flies after each launch, so you can adjust your next shot rather than repeating a miss.
faq: What is the goal of Launch Jack?
Your goal is to destroy all the zombie heads in each level by launching Jack at them. Clearing every head moves you forward.
How do I control Jack?
Use a mouse click or tap to play. The game is controlled entirely by clicking or tapping.

color-dash-chameleon-runner.intro: Color Dash - Chameleon Runner is an arcade endless runner where you change your chameleon's color to match the world around you. Speed rises as you go, so quick timing matters.
tips: Watch the obstacles before you switch colors, since they are designed to match the environment. Change color just before you reach a hazard, not long before it.
Keep your eyes on the path ahead rather than on your character. Spotting platforms early gives you more time to time your jumps and color changes.
Collect coins along the way, because they add to your score. If you want the bonus reward, plan your route so you can pick up as many coins as possible before the finish line.
Expect the pace to pick up as the level goes on. Practice the early sections until your reactions feel steady, then try to keep that same rhythm when speed increases.
Use the same steady rhythm in each new world, such as the jungle, neon city, or crystal cave. Each theme changes how the colors look, so learn its patterns before pushing for a high score.
faq: What is the main goal of Color Dash - Chameleon Runner?
Run forward, switch colors to match the world, and avoid obstacles and enemies. Reach the finish line to complete each level.
How do I change my chameleon's color?
Tap to change colors so your chameleon matches the world around it. Timing the switch correctly is the key skill in this game.

rolling-balancer-ball.intro: Rolling Balancer Ball is a 3D balance game where you guide a ball across narrow wooden bridges over water to reach a boat at the end of each level. Small, careful swipes matter, since one wrong move can send the ball into the water.
tips: Make small swipes left or right rather than large ones, because the ball reacts to physics and can overcorrect quickly.
Control your forward speed by how you drag. Going slower gives you more time to react on narrow sections.
When you see a trap, slow down and line the ball up straight before you cross it.
Correct drifting early. A small sideways lean is easy to fix, but a large one near the edge of a bridge often ends in the water.
Keep your eyes on the path ahead rather than only on the ball, so you can plan your moves before you reach a narrow stretch.
faq: What is the goal of Rolling Balancer Ball?
Your goal is to guide the rolling ball across the narrow wooden bridges and safely reach the boat at the end of each level.
How do I move the ball?
Swipe left or right to move the ball sideways, and drag forward to roll it ahead. Dragging differently changes how fast it goes.

guardians-of-tower.intro: Guardians of Tower is a tower defense and shooting strategy game where you defend your castle against waves of enemies. You deploy soldiers and towers, earn coins, and upgrade your forces to push back the enemy fortress.
tips: Spend your coins on upgrades that match the enemies you are facing, since each upgrade makes your forces stronger.
Keep sending reinforcements steadily rather than waiting, so your castle is never left with nothing on the field.
Check which enemies are arriving in each wave and place towers where they will reach them first.
Save a little coin for emergencies, so you can respond quickly when a wave breaks through.
Use the on-screen buttons to manage your army between waves, and compare your options before committing coins.
faq: How do I deploy soldiers and towers?
Use the left mouse button to deploy soldiers, build or upgrade towers, and use abilities. All actions are done by clicking the on-screen buttons.
How do I earn coins?
You earn coins from every victory. Use them to upgrade your army and defenses.

endless-z-survivor.intro: Endless Z Survivor is a zombie shooter where waves of hungry zombies keep coming. You kill zombies to earn gold, buy new weapons, and push further each run.
tips: Keep moving rather than standing still, since the waves never stop and staying in one spot lets zombies surround you.
Reload during a quiet moment instead of waiting until your magazine is empty in the middle of a crowd.
Switch between your two weapons with keys 1 and 2 depending on how close the zombies are, and use whichever fits the situation.
Spend gold on weapon upgrades you will actually use rather than buying everything at once.
Each death makes you stronger for the next attempt, so treat early runs as a way to learn wave patterns and where your gold comes from.
faq: What is the goal of Endless Z Survivor?
The goal is to survive as long as you can against endless waves of zombies. Each zombie you kill gives you gold, which you can use to buy new weapons.
How do I move and shoot?
Move with the W, A, S and D keys and shoot with the left mouse button. Press R to reload your weapon.

stick-archer-champion.intro: Stick Archer Champion is a stickman archery game where you defeat other stick figures using bows, arrows, quivers and shields. Coins from completed levels pay for upgrades.
tips: Use the A and D keys to move side to side, lining up your shot before you fire. Small position changes can matter more than rushing to shoot.
Keep moving while you aim so you can dodge incoming enemy arrows. Staying still makes you an easier target.
Spend the coins you collect on upgrades for your arrows rather than only cosmetics. Stronger arrows make later enemies easier to handle.
Try different bows, arrows, quivers and shields to find a setup that suits your play style. Check what each option offers before buying it.
Unlock new talents and effects as you go, and pick ones that fit how you like to fight. Revisit your loadout after each level to see what changed.
faq: How do I move and aim my archer?
Move side to side with the A and D keys to line up your aim with the enemy. Use the mouse to select options in menus.
What do I do with the coins I collect?
Coins from each completed level can be used to improve your arrows and unlock new skins and powers. Save up for upgrades that help your current playstyle.

archer-clash.intro: Archer Clash is a fast-paced io battle where you guide a lone hero across a rolling arena, recruiting allies and fighting for control. Quick reflexes and smart choices both shape how each match goes.
tips: Move with WASD, the arrow keys, or the mouse, and keep your hero moving so enemy armies that spawn at random have a harder time pinning you down.
Pick up speed bursts and protective shields when they are nearby, especially before you head into a fight, since they can give you an edge.
Watch where enemy armies are gathering across the terrain and steer around the largest groups until you have allies or boosters to support you.
Recruit allies early when the opportunity appears, then adjust your tactics as the challenges shift during the match.
Treat each encounter as a decision about whether to fight or move on, because your path to victory depends on choosing the right battles.
faq: What is the goal of Archer Clash?
You fight for control of the battlefield by recruiting allies, adapting your tactics, and outlasting enemy armies that appear across the arena.
How do I move my hero?
Use the WASD keys, the arrow keys, or the mouse to move across the hill-like battle arena.

2-3-4-player-games.intro: 2,3,4 Player Games is a hypercasual party game for two to four players sharing one keyboard. It offers 21 different mini-games, each with its own scenario and a goal of scoring or reaching the finish line first.
tips: Learn your keys before the first round starts: Player 1 uses W A S D, Player 2 uses the arrow keys, Player 3 uses I J K L, and Player 4 uses T F G H.
Pay attention to the goal shown at the start of each mini-game, since the scoring rule or finish line can change how you should play.
Move early rather than waiting, because the description stresses speed and the first player to the finish line or scorer often wins.
Watch what your opponents are doing and use their mistakes, such as stumbling or getting in the wrong position, to get ahead.
Keep an eye on your own position in the scene so you do not fall behind while focusing only on other players.
faq: What is the goal of each game?
Each mini-game has its own goal, which is either to be the scorer or to be the first to reach the finish line. The game's start screen and scenario tell you which one applies.
How many players can play at once?
The game supports one, two, three, or four players, depending on the mode you pick. Each player has a separate set of keys on the keyboard.

evo-city-driving.intro: EVO City Driving is a 3D racing game where you pick from a range of super cars and explore the roads of EVO City at high speed. Use the WASD keys to drive, Space to brake, and C to change the camera.
tips: Learn the layout by driving slowly at first, then build speed as you recognise the roads you use most often.
Brake with Space before tight corners rather than mid-turn, so the car stays under control as you steer with WASD.
Try the C key to switch camera views and pick the one that gives you the clearest look at upcoming road and traffic.
Try different super cars in the variety on offer to see which handling and speed suit your driving style best.
If your goal is to explore every road, plan a route that covers unvisited streets in one direction before looping back.
faq: What is the main goal of EVO City Driving?
The game asks you to drive as fast as you can and explore every road in the town. Covering new roads while keeping speed up is the main challenge.
Which keys control the car?
Use W, A, S and D to drive, Space to brake, and C to change the camera view.

chibi-anime-princess-doll.intro: Chibi Anime Princess Doll is a dress-up game where you build your own anime princess doll. You pick her skin color, hair, eyes, mouth and costume, then compare your creation with friends.
tips: Decide on a theme before you start, such as a soft pastel look or a bold bright outfit, so your choices stay consistent.
Try changing one feature at a time and look at the doll after each change to see how it affects the overall style.
Pair hair and eye colors that complement each other, since these two features shape the face the most.
Save the costume choice for last, then adjust the skin color or mouth if the outfit makes the doll look off.
If you plan to show friends, give your princess a clear personality through her expression and outfit so she stands out.
faq: What is the goal of Chibi Anime Princess Doll?
The goal is to create the most beautiful princess you can by choosing her skin color, hair, eyes, mouth and costume.
How do I control the game?
Tap or click on the options to select each feature and costume for your princess doll.

obby-build-an-asmr-keyboard-tycoon.intro: Obby: Build an ASMR Keyboard Tycoon is an idle clicker where every key press earns cash. Build, upgrade, and hire workers to grow your keyboard into a money-making machine.
tips: Put early earnings into typing speed and money per key press, since both raise your income on every press.
Hire workers as soon as you can afford them, because they generate income automatically while you explore.
Check your upgrades regularly so you always know which one will grow your income the most.
Use the camera controls to look over your keyboard before you spend, so you can see what each change looks like.
Keep an eye on the global leaderboard to see how far you have to go to become the richest keyboard owner.
faq: How do I earn money in this game?
Every key press earns cash, so typing is your main source of income. Upgrades then make each press worth more.
Do workers keep earning when I am not playing actively?
Yes, the game says workers generate income automatically, even while you are busy exploring. Hiring them early means your money keeps growing in the background.

black-sphere.intro: Black Sphere is a logic puzzle where you aim a black ball so that it pushes a white ball into a highlighted cell. Each solved level earns points and unlocks the next one.
tips: Before you aim, find the white ball and the highlighted cell, and work out which direction the white ball needs to travel.
Pick the cell that lines the black ball up behind the white ball along the same line as the target cell.
Check the path between the black ball and the white ball for anything that could block or change the push.
If a level feels stuck, try a different cell for the black ball rather than repeating the same aim.
Stay calm and take your time on each level, since a single click decides where the black ball goes.
faq: What is the goal of Black Sphere?
You must move the black ball to a cell so that it pushes the white ball into the highlighted cell.
How do I control the black ball?
Use a mouse click or tap to choose the cell you want the black ball to move to.

christmas-night-of-horror.intro: Christmas: Night of Horror is an adventure shooter where you fight demonic creatures, including Slenderman, Momo, and Siren Head, to protect Christmas. Use your gun and movement controls to push them back to Hell.
tips: Use crouch and prone to lower your profile, and combine them with aiming to keep your shots steady.
Reload when you have a safe moment rather than in the middle of a fight, since you cannot shoot while reloading.
Keep your grenade for crowds or tougher enemies instead of spending it on single targets early on.
Use sprint to get distance from dangerous enemies, then stop and aim before firing again.
Holster your weapon when you need to move quickly, and draw it again before engaging enemies.
faq: What is the goal of Christmas: Night of Horror?

Your goal is to grab your gun and send the demonic creatures, including Slenderman, Momo, and Siren Head, back to Hell. The description does not list other objectives, so focus on defeating the threats around you.
Which controls do I need to know first?
Use W, A, S, and D to walk, the mouse to aim and fire, and R to reload. Left Shift sprints, Left Ctrl crouches, and Space jumps.

masked-special-forces.intro: Masked Special Forces is a shooting game set in a virtual combat arena. You fight adversaries with an arsenal of weapons, armor, and tools like dynamite and medkits. Use movement and cover to outplay your opponents.
tips: Switch weapons with keys 1, 2 and 3 based on the distance to your target instead of sticking with one gun the whole time.
Use right mouse click to aim before you fire at longer range, and fire in short bursts so your shots land more accurately.
Save dynamite with G for groups of enemies or spots you can't easily reach, rather than using it on the first target you see.
Use the medkit with H once you're hurt and it's safe to stop moving, since healing in the middle of a firefight can be risky.
Combine running, sliding with Q and jumping with Space to make yourself a harder target to hit while you move around the arena.
faq: How do I move and aim in Masked Special Forces?
Move with WASD or the arrow keys, and hold right mouse click to aim. Left mouse click fires your weapon.
How do I change weapons or pick up new ones?
Press 1, 2 or 3 to switch between weapons. Press E or F to interact and pick up a weapon.

foxy-eco-sort.intro: Foxy Eco Sort mixes waste sorting, match-3 and memory pairs in a story about Foxy and Raccoon cleaning up polluted places and stopping the rat Ratty's plans. It is aimed at kids and families.
tips: Learn the four waste groups (glass, plastic, paper and organics) early, since every sorting task depends on them.
In match-3, look for the three identical elements that are easiest to line up before you move anything else, so the field clears faster.
In the memory pairs, try to remember where each card is after you flip it, and focus on one area of the board at a time.
Pay attention to Foxy's messages, because they explain why sorting matters and make the story easier to follow.
Switch between sorting, match-3 and pairs as you go, so a hard puzzle in one mode doesn't slow your progress in the others.
faq: What is the goal of Foxy Eco Sort?
You clean polluted locations by sorting waste, clearing match-3 fields and matching pairs, while uncovering Ratty's plans through the story chapters.
How do I sort waste?
Drag each item to the category it matches, such as glass to glass or plastic to plastic.

sudoku-number-games.intro: Sudoku - Number Games is a logic puzzle where you fill a grid with numbers so that none repeat in any row, column, or 3 x 3 square. The levels get harder as you go, and you can replay earlier levels on an easier setting.
tips: Start with the rows, columns, or squares that already have the most numbers filled in, because they have the fewest empty cells to solve.
For each empty cell, list which numbers from 1 to 9 are already used in its row, column, and square. The number that is left over is often the answer.
Look for a number that can only fit in one cell within a square, row, or column, and place it there before guessing elsewhere.
Check each new number against its row, column, and square right after you place it, so a single mistake does not spread through the grid.
If a level feels too hard, go back to an earlier level and play it on an easier difficulty to practice the same logic before returning.
faq: What is the goal of Sudoku - Number Games?
The goal is to fill every empty cell so that each row, each column, and each 3 x 3 square contains the numbers 1 to 9 with no repeats.
How do I avoid getting stuck on a level?

Work through the grid one cell at a time, checking the row, column, and square for each candidate number. Going back to an easier difficulty on an earlier level is also a good way to practice the method.

lighthouse-mage-idle-defense.intro: Lighthouse Mage is an idle tower defense game on a small island. Your lighthouse fires magic bolts at waves of sea creatures and pirates, and you decide where to spend gold and when to aim the beam yourself.
tips: Spend gold on a balance of Attack, Defense and Magic rather than one card, since enemies arrive from every side and a weak lighthouse falls quickly.
Keep the beam moving toward dense groups of enemies, because aimed beam shots deal double damage compared with the automatic fire.
Save your spells for the moments when a wave is pressing in, and watch for the boss on every 10th wave so you can prepare before it arrives.
Pay attention to income upgrades early, since more gold during a run gives you more options for damage, health and armor later.
Use the Harbor after each run to spend pearls on permanent upgrades, then retry to push past your previous highest wave.
faq: What is the goal of Lighthouse Mage?
Survive as many waves as you can with your lighthouse. When it falls, you return to the Harbor and try again to reach a higher wave.
How do I aim the lighthouse beam?
Hold and drag on the sea with your mouse or finger to steer the beam. Aimed beam shots deal double damage.

bubble-smash.intro: Bubble Smash is a puzzle game where you aim and launch bubbles into the board, merging matching colors to pop them. Clear each level's goals before your moves run out.
tips: Before you launch, look for a spot where your bubble will land next to a matching color, since that is what starts a pop.
Aim for chains: when one pop drops other bubbles loose, you may get a bigger clear for the same shot.
Count your remaining moves against the level goal, and favor shots that bring you closer to the goal rather than small single pops.
Save power-ups for when you are stuck with no good shot, instead of using them early when the board is still open.
If a level is hard, pause your plan and look at which color appears most often, then clear that color first to open up the board.
faq: How do I aim and shoot a bubble?
Drag to aim and release to launch your bubble into the board. Watch the path before you let go.
What makes a bubble pop?
Land your bubble next to matching bubbles so they merge and pop. Larger groups and chains clear more bubbles at once.

zoo-run.intro: Zoo Run is an endless isometric runner where you keep an animal character moving as the difficulty rises over time. You steer with the mouse and pick from eight animal characters.
tips: Watch the background closely, since the scenery changes every fixed number of seconds and the layout can shift with it.
Expect the pace to pick up as you play, so stay calm and avoid rushing your mouse movements early on.
Try each of the eight animal characters once to see which one feels easiest to control for you.
Keep your mouse movements small and steady so you can react quickly when an obstacle appears.
Plan your next move a little ahead rather than reacting only at the last second.
faq: What is the goal of Zoo Run?
The goal is to keep running for as long as you can in this endless game. Each run continues until your character fails.
How do I control my animal?
Zoo Run is played with the mouse only, so move the mouse to steer your character.

gun-baron.intro: Gun Baron mixes factory management with real-time defense. You run a weapons business as a red panda, selling to customers while fending off raccoon raids to save up for a rocket.
tips: Keep your shelves stocked before customers arrive, since shorter queues are tied to bigger profits.
Watch customer demand and adjust what you craft so you are not building items nobody is buying.
Spend early earnings on production improvements first, then on weapons and upgrades once your income is steady.
Before each raid, check that your conveyor belts and warehouse are covered, because protecting them is what keeps your income flowing.
Use upgrades to strengthen your panda and better gear for shootouts, and keep a balance between production and defense rather than neglecting either.
faq: What is the main goal of Gun Baron?
The goal is to accumulate capital by selling weapons and then build a rocket to escape the planet.
How do I make money in the game?
Craft pistols, assault rifles, and dynamite, then sell them to customers who arrive automatically. Every gun sold brings you closer to the rocket.

elemental-rescue-adventure.intro: Elemental Rescue Adventure is a platform game where you guide Wade through a series of stages to free Ember. Each stage is harder than the last, so timing your jumps matters.
tips: Use the early stages to learn how far Wade jumps before you try the harder ones. Small test jumps near a ledge tell you more than rushing ahead.
Pause briefly before each jump to check the landing spot. Jumping on instinct is the most common reason to fall.
Hold a steady rhythm of move and jump instead of tapping randomly. Consistent timing is easier to repeat when a stage gets difficult.
If you keep failing the same spot, step back and watch the layout again before retrying. Changing your approach often works better than trying the same jump harder.
On touch screens, keep your thumbs on the buttons you need and avoid stretching across both at once. Clean presses make jump timing more reliable.
faq: How do I move and jump on a computer?
Use the WASD keys to move Wade, and use the jump control to leap between platforms. Practise short moves first to get comfortable with the controls.
What controls work on a touch screen?
Touch controls use on-screen buttons to move Wade and make him jump. Keep your touches clear and steady so each jump registers the way you intend.

mechangelion-robot-fight.intro: Mechangelion Robot Fight is a 3D arcade action game where you pilot a powerful mechanical warrior in a robot arena. Battle enemies in close, fierce fights.
tips: Start by watching how enemies move before committing to an attack. Learning their rhythm helps you pick better moments to strike.
Use the first few fights to get a feel for your robot's speed and reach, so your clicks or taps land where you intend.
Avoid rushing in every time. Short, deliberate actions often work better than constant attacking in a crowded arena.
Keep track of how your robot is holding up during a fight, and adjust your approach when you are taking heavy damage.
Play in short sessions at first. Staying focused helps you react faster to enemies in a fast-paced 3D arena.
faq: What is the goal of Mechangelion Robot Fight?
Your goal is to take on enemy robots in the arena and win your battles as a super robot. The game is built around fierce, close fights.
How do I control my robot?
You play with mouse clicks or taps. Use them to make your robot act during the fight.

trial-xtreme.intro: Trial Xtreme is a motorbike game about riding obstacle-filled tracks full of ramps, pipes, rocks, and barriers. Finish fast, stay balanced, and collect stars to unlock new tracks.
tips: Balance matters as much as speed, so ease off the throttle before big ramps and obstacles instead of arriving at them at full pace.
Use braking early to control your landing and keep the bike upright after jumps or rough rocks.
Pick up stars on each run where you can do so safely, since the stars you collect are what unlock new tracks.
Once you can finish a track without falling, go back and try to improve your time, because speed is part of the challenge.
Learn each tricky barrier or pipe on its own first, then string the sections together on later attempts.
faq: What is the main goal in Trial Xtreme?
Ride your motorcycle from start to finish on each track, avoid falling, and finish as fast as you can while collecting stars.
How do I unlock new levels?
Collect stars during your runs. The more stars you earn, the more new tracks you unlock.

mandala-meadow.intro: Mandala Meadow is a relaxing coloring game where you fill mandala designs with soft colors, one section at a time. There are no timers, so you can work at your own pace.
tips: Try the Brush mode for detailed areas and Fill mode for large sections that need a quick, even color.
Use the zoom slider or pinch to zoom when working on small, intricate parts so your strokes stay neatly inside the lines.
Choose a limited palette of two or three soft colors that go well together, which keeps the design calm and cohesive.
Start with the outer or larger sections, then work inward so you can judge how the colors balance across the whole mandala.
If a stroke goes wrong, use Undo right away rather than trying to correct it by painting over it.
faq: What is the goal of Mandala Meadow?
The goal is to relax and create a finished piece of art by filling each section of a mandala with colors you choose. There is no score or time limit.
What is the difference between Brush and Fill?
Brush lets you hand-paint freely within the lines, while Fill colors a whole section instantly with one click or tap.

100-monster-escape-room.intro: A horror escape room where you solve cryptic puzzles and unlock obstacles while racing against time to get away from a horde of monsters. Use WASD to move and the mouse to look around.
tips: Look around the room before you move on, since clues and interactive objects are the main way to progress.
Keep track of what you have already tried so you do not waste time repeating the same puzzle.
Use the mouse to scan each area slowly, because hints can be easy to miss when you are rushing.
Move with purpose and avoid running into corners where you can get trapped by a monster.
When a puzzle stalls you, step back, check your surroundings again, and look for a connection to something you have already found.
faq: What is the goal of 100 Monster Escape Room?
Your goal is to escape the room by solving its puzzles and unlocking each obstacle before the monsters catch you.
How do I move my character?
Use the W, A, S and D keys to move. Use the mouse to look around the room.

time-of-adventure-finno-and-jacky.intro: Time of Adventure: Finno and Jacky is an arcade adventure set in a snowy land. You play as Jacky and his dog Finno, avoiding the Snow King's soldiers while collecting crystals across 15 chapters.
tips: Check the in-game instructions first so you know which keys control movement and the Shift key before you enter snow land.
Keep an eye on where the Snow King's soldiers are before moving forward, since they are spread across the level.
Collect crystals whenever you can safely reach them, because they are part of your progress toward the end of each chapter.
Take the 15 chapters one at a time and slow down in harder sections rather than rushing through them.
If you use mobile controls, practice a few moves in the opening area until the on-screen buttons feel natural.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You need to collect crystals and reach the end of the game while staying clear of the Snow King's soldiers. The game has 15 chapters to complete.
Which keys control the characters?
The instructions list WASD and the arrow keys for movement, along with the Shift key. Read the in-game instructions for the full how-to-play details.

321-diferent-patch.intro: 321 Different Patch is a quick puzzle where you spot the one figure that doesn't match the others. You work through rounds with a short time limit, and the challenge grows as you go.
tips: Scan the whole group first, then compare the figures one detail at a time, such as shape, color, position, or small marks.
Don't trust your memory from earlier rounds. A figure that was wrong before can be the correct answer this time, so judge each round fresh.
In the timed mode, choose a quick scanning routine, like moving left to right across the figures, so you don't waste seconds searching randomly.
Use Relax mode to practice your method without pressure. It gives you more time to examine the figures closely.
When you feel comfortable, move to Extreme mode and keep the same routine, since the rounds are harder and you need to stay focused on small details.
faq: What is the goal of 321 Different Patch?
Your goal is to find the one figure that is different from the others in each round. Look closely, because the differences can be small.
How do I play the game?
Use mouse clicks or taps to select the figure you think is different. The game uses only clicking or tapping.

last-knight-kings-throne.intro: Last Knight: Kings Throne is a casual dodge arcade game where you guide a small character away from chasing monsters on a random map. Survive as long as you can to build up a higher score.
tips: Keep moving rather than staying still, since monsters chase you and standing in one place lets them close in.
Use the edges and open space of the map to circle monsters, which helps you buy time and keep your survival going.
Watch for the random pickups and grab speed boosts when you are being pressed from several sides to break out of encirclement.
Save the monster freeze pickup for crowded moments where several monsters are close, so it covers the most danger.
Expect monsters to spawn in greater numbers and move faster the longer you last, so plan your escape routes ahead of time rather than reacting at the last second.
faq: What is the goal of Last Knight: Kings Throne?
The goal is to survive as long as possible while monsters chase your character across a random map. Your score grows the longer you keep escaping.
How do I control my character?
Drag to move your character, and you can change direction at any time. On PC, mouse control works the same way.

rustlings-online.intro: Rustlings Online is a survival and building game played in your browser. You gather resources on an island, craft tools, and build a base that you can defend alone or with a squad.
tips: Gather wood and stone early by hitting trees and rocks with a tool, since you need both to craft your first tools and walls.
Start with simple wood walls for shelter, then plan your upgrades to stone and metal before night arrives, when danger rises.
Use the snap-point system when placing walls, floors, and roofs so each piece lines up cleanly and your base stays sturdy.
Check your health and gear often, especially before dark, so you are not caught unprepared by other players or island threats.
Team up with a squad of up to 3 players so you can split up gathering and defending your territory.
faq: How do I open the crafting menu?
Press Tab to open the crafting menu, where you can craft your first tools and walls for shelter.
What do the mouse buttons do?
Left mouse button uses an item's primary action, and right mouse button uses its secondary action, such as aiming.

madalin-stunt-cars-pro.intro: Madalin Stunt Cars Pro is a 3D driving game where you pick a car, from a sleek sports car to a police cruiser, and test your driving across three map areas. This guide covers the controls and some habits that help you drive more smoothly.
tips: Try both the sports car and the police cruiser early on, since switching with Ctrl lets you feel how each one steers before you commit to one for a run.
Use the Space handbrake sparingly to break traction in corners, and ease off it as you exit so you keep control instead of spinning out.
Save Shift nitro for straight stretches where you can keep the car pointed forward, rather than using it while you are still turning.
Tap M to check the rearview mirror before a drift or sharp turn so you know what is behind you and can plan your line.
Explore all three map areas to learn where the wide open spaces and tight sections are, and adjust your steering to suit each one.
faq: How do I steer the car?
Use the Arrow keys or the WASD keys to steer. Keep your inputs gentle on turns to avoid losing grip.
How do I drift?
Tap the Space key for the handbrake while turning. Release it as you come out of the turn to regain control of the car.

pop-it-pig-jigsaw.intro: Pop It Pig Jigsaw is a puzzle game with six images and three modes. Pick a mode, then drag and drop the pieces to rebuild the picture.
tips: Look at the full image before you start so you know what the finished picture should look like.
Pick a mode you feel comfortable with first, then try the others once you have the hang of dragging pieces.
Sort pieces by color or pattern, such as the pig's pink areas or the background, and build those sections together.
Work on the outer edges first to frame the picture, then fill in the middle.
Drag each piece to a spot you are confident about, and reposition it if it does not fit, rather than forcing it into place.
faq: What is the goal of Pop It Pig Jigsaw?
The goal is to solve the jigsaw puzzle by dragging and dropping the pieces until the image is complete.
How do I move the pieces?
Use the mouse to click and drag each piece to where you think it belongs.

monster-rush-evolution.intro: Monster Rush: Evolution is an arena action game where you start as a small monster and grow by eating smaller things. Stay away from bigger monsters and finish the timer as the largest one on the island.
tips: Check the number on each target before you commit. Only eat things with a smaller number than yours, and steer around anything bigger.
Pick mutations with a plan. Each draft is a chance to lean toward Predator, Glutton or Titan, and committing to one branch makes the golden apex mutation easier to aim for.
Save your form's ability for a real threat or a crowded moment instead of using it as soon as it is ready. Slam, dash, roar and fire breath each suit different situations.
Hunt the smaller rivals early while the arena is still busy, and keep track of where the bigger monsters are heading so you can slip away from them.
Pay attention to the round modifiers, such as night or meteors, since they change how safe each area is. Adjust your route to match the rule in play.
faq: What is the goal of Monster Rush: Evolution?
Grow by eating everything smaller than you and be the largest monster on the island when time runs out. Rival monsters are also trying to do this.
How do I move and use abilities?
Drag anywhere on the screen or use WASD or the arrow keys to move. Tap the ability button or press Space to use your form's ability.

cobraz-io.intro: CobraZ.io is a first-person shooter for online multiplayer matches. You customize your soldier and fight in Team Deathmatch, Free For All, or Capture The Flag.
tips: Use Space to slide while moving when you need to dodge fire or close distance quickly, and avoid standing still in open areas.
Hold Right Mouse to aim before you fire at range, and fire in short bursts so your shots stay accurate.
Switch between your weapons with the 1, 2, and 3 keys so you always have the right gun for the distance to your target.
Keep your G grenade for groups of enemies or for clearing a spot you cannot see into, rather than throwing it at a single target.
In Capture The Flag, coordinate with your team on who guards the flag and who goes on the attack instead of all rushing the same route.
faq: How do I move and aim my soldier?
Use WASD or the Arrow keys to move, and hold the Right Mouse button to aim. Fire with the Left Mouse button.
Which game mode is best for teamwork?

Capture The Flag is built around coordinating with your team, so it suits players who like planning together. Team Deathmatch also rewards team play, while Free For All is every player for themselves.

meow-sudoku.intro: Meow Sudoku is a logic puzzle where you place cats on a colored grid under a few clear rules. Use deduction and careful checking to find the exact spot for each cat.
tips: Before placing anything, check each row, column, and color block to see where a cat is already fixed. Eliminating spots this way often reveals the next safe move.
Remember that cats cannot touch each other, including diagonally. Mark the squares around each cat you place so you do not accidentally break that rule later.
Look for color blocks that fit into only one row or one column. When a color has just one possible spot left, that cell is a strong place to start.
Save your power-ups for positions where you are truly stuck. Use them to place a cat directly or to rule out color blocks when deduction alone is not enough.
Work through levels in order and take your time on the harder boards. Spatial thinking improves with practice, so a slower approach usually beats guessing.
faq: What is the goal of Meow Sudoku?
Your goal is to place the cats on the board so that every row, column, and color has exactly one cat. You must also keep cats from touching each other.
Can two cats sit next to each other?
No. Cats cannot touch each other, so keep empty squares between them, including on diagonals.

snow-rush-3d.intro: Snow Rush 3D is an arcade sledding game where speed and reflexes decide how far you get down a snowy track. You can play alone or challenge a friend in two-player mode.
tips: Steer early and gently so you are already lined up before tricky turns and obstacles appear.
Use jump to clear obstacles and to pass over ramps, but avoid jumping when a clear path lets you keep your speed.
Watch the track a few seconds ahead rather than the sled itself, so you can plan each left or right move in time.
Collect gifts when it is safe to do so, but do not swerve into obstacles or snowmen just to grab one.
In two-player mode, keep your eyes on your own sled and avoid copying your friend's line, since each track position is different for each player.
faq: What is the goal of Snow Rush 3D?
Try to reach the longest distance on the snow-covered track while overcoming obstacles and ramps. Collecting gifts along the way is also part of the challenge.
Which keys control the sled in Player 1 mode?
Player 1 uses A and D to move left and right, and W or SPACE to jump.

sky-rush.intro: Sky Rush is an endless flying runner where you steer a plane by holding your mouse or touching the screen. Collect golden stars, dodge enemies and missiles, and see how far you can fly.
tips: Keep your pointer or finger moving smoothly rather than jerking it, since your plane follows your input instantly and sharp moves can overshoot obstacles.
Scan a few steps ahead for enemies and missiles, and pick the open path early instead of reacting at the last moment.
Grab golden stars when they are on or near your route, but don't risk a collision just to collect one.
As the tempo rises, slow your decisions down and focus on finding the safest line through the sky rather than the shortest one.
Save your coins for the Shop when the speed starts to feel too high, since powerful buffs can make the flight easier to manage.
faq: What is the goal of Sky Rush?
The goal is to fly as far as you can without crashing into enemies or missiles. Each run is a chance to beat your own record and climb the leaderboard.
How do I control the plane?
Click and hold your mouse or touch and hold the screen anywhere. Your plane follows your cursor or finger, so you move by changing where you hold.

tile-match.intro: Tile Match is a puzzle game where tiles keep dropping from the top, and you need to match them before any reach the bottom. It rewards quick thinking and steady attention.
tips: Scan the whole screen often so you notice matching pairs before the lower tiles get close to the bottom border.
Clear tiles from the lower rows first when it is safe, since those are the ones closest to ending the level.
Keep the stack from building up in one area; spreading your matches out helps you avoid running out of room.
Focus on fast, clean matches, because the instructions say the faster you match, the higher your score goes.
If the tiles start piling up, slow down your decisions and check each pair carefully rather than rushing into a wrong match.
faq: What is the goal of Tile Match?
Match tiles to clear them before they move down and touch the bottom border of the screen. If any tile reaches the bottom, the level ends and you must start again.
How is the score calculated?
The faster you match tiles, the higher your score goes. Quick matches are the main way to build a bigger score.

christmas-nail-salon.intro: Christmas Nail Salon is a holiday nail design game where you work as a stylist. You create nail art for customers and aim to leave each one happy with their new nails.
tips: Take your time with each client's nails, since the goal is to leave every customer satisfied rather than to finish quickly.
Look at what each customer seems to want before you start, so the design fits the holiday theme and their own style.
Keep your nail work neat and even. Small mistakes can make a design look rushed, so slow down when details matter.
Use the same steady approach with every client to keep your results consistent throughout the session.
Use the mouse or tap controls calmly and deliberately, which helps you avoid accidental moves on the nails.
faq: What is the main goal of Christmas Nail Salon?
You design nail art for your clients and help them feel particularly satisfied with their newly designed nails.
How do I control the game?
You play with the mouse or by tapping the screen, depending on your device.

escape-tsunami-and-save-brainrots.intro: Escape Tsunami and save Brainrots is an arcade race against a giant wave. You run, collect Brainrots for coins, and spend those coins on speed and upgrades to stay ahead of the water.
tips: Keep moving. The game rewards momentum, so hesitating near the wave is what lets it catch you.
Spend your first coins on running speed. A faster character gives you more room to dodge the wave and reach more Brainrots.
Level up Brainrots you already own before you chase too many new ones. Their higher profit adds up over time.
Use the camera to look ahead toward the wave and obstacles so you can plan your route instead of reacting at the last second.
Log in every day to claim your daily reward of diamonds, money, or a Brainrot.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Your main goal is to escape the giant tsunami that keeps chasing you while collecting Brainrots along the way.
How do I earn coins and what do I do with them?
You earn coins from the Brainrots you catch. You can invest them in upgrades such as increasing your running speed, leveling up your Brainrots, or unlocking new base slots.

draw-and-pass.intro: Draw and Pass is a drawing puzzle game with 50 images that each have missing parts. You complete the pictures by drawing on the screen, and accurate drawings move you forward through the levels.
tips: Look at the whole image before drawing and note which parts are missing and where they connect to the existing lines.
Start with the lines that link to what is already there, such as edges or joins, so your new strokes line up with the picture.
Draw slowly and keep your strokes smooth and close to the shape you can see, since accuracy is what advances you.
If a drawing does not fit, try a different angle or proportion rather than repeating the same stroke.
Use the mouse with a left click to draw, or touch the screen if you are playing on a touch device.
faq: What is the goal of Draw and Pass?
Your goal is to complete the missing parts of each image by drawing accurately on the screen so you can advance to the next level.
How do I draw in the game?
Use the mouse and left click to draw on the screen. On touch devices, draw by touching the screen.

princesses-at-horror-school.intro: Princesses at Horror School is a dress-up and makeover game where you style Laura and Frankie, two monster students, for their day at school. Their looks blend classic princess style with creepy monster touches.
tips: Start with each girl's personality in mind, since the description says Laura and Frankie have their own fashion preferences. Choosing a direction first makes the rest of the makeover easier to finish.
Try combining princess elements with monster elements in the same look, because that mix is the theme of the game. A sweet outfit with a spooky detail often works better than going fully one way.
Work on hair and outfit together so the whole look feels consistent. Check the final image before you move on.
Use the same approach for both girls and compare them side by side, so you can see which choices stand out most.
When you are happy with a look, save it as a PNG image so you can keep your favourite combination.
faq: How do I control the game?
Click with a computer mouse, or tap the screen on a touch device. The instructions describe both options.
Can I keep the looks I make?
Yes. You can save your finished result as a PNG image.

truck-loader-5.intro: Truck Loader 5 is a physics puzzle where you steer a magnetic arm to pick up metal crates and load them onto a truck. You need to move all thirty cargo crates through the warehouse while working around obstacles.
tips: Look at the whole layout before you start moving crates, and plan which crate to grab first so the path to the truck stays clear.
Use the magnetic arm slowly and steadily, since fast swings can make a crate slip or knock into something you still need.
Some crates explode, so pay attention to where they sit relative to walls, other crates and obstacles before you use them.
When a crate is stuck, step back and try a different order of moves instead of repeating the same attempt.
Keep track of how many crates you have left to load so you can spot which ones are the hardest to reach and handle them earlier.
faq: What is the goal of Truck Loader 5?
The goal is to transport all thirty cargo crates from the warehouse onto the truck without any issues.
How do I control the magnetic arm?
On a computer, move the arm with the mouse and use W, A, S and D as listed in the instructions. On mobile devices, use the on-screen buttons.

flip-8.intro: Flip 8 is a press-your-luck card game where every flip adds to your round score, but a repeated number wipes the round. Decide when to cash in and when to keep flipping.
tips: Read the bust meter before every flip. It shows the exact odds, so decide in advance how much risk you will accept.
Cash in once your round score is worth protecting. A bust removes everything from that round, so banked points are the only safe ones.
Keep track of the numbers already in your hand. Each card you hold raises the chance that the next flip repeats one of them.
Save your single Peek Token for a moment when one card decides whether you keep going, not for an easy early flip.
In Blitz mode turns are timed, so settle on your cash-in point before the round starts rather than deciding under pressure.
faq: What causes a bust in Flip 8?
Flipping a number you already hold busts you, which wipes the entire round score. Points you have already banked are not lost.
How do I get the Flip 8 bonus?
Collect eight different cards in a single round and it banks automatically with a +20 bonus. Because the round ends at that point, you do not need to cash in.

zoo-mahjongg-deluxe.intro: Zoo Mahjongg Deluxe is a tile-matching puzzle where you clear the board by removing identical tiles in pairs. The goal is to collect every tile until the layout is empty.
tips: Before making a match, look at which tiles are blocking others. Freeing up tiles that are locked in place often opens more options.
Scan the whole board for pairs before you start clicking, so you can plan an order that keeps the layout from getting stuck.
Save tiles that have only one matching partner left on the board for later, since removing them early can leave you with unmatched singles.
Work from the edges of the layout inward when possible, as this tends to free up more tiles without boxing yourself in.
If you get stuck, take a moment to check each tile type again, because a pair you overlooked is often still available.
faq: What is the goal of Zoo Mahjongg Deluxe?
The goal is to remove all the tiles from the board by matching identical pairs. Each match clears two tiles of the same kind.
How do I play the game?
Use your mouse or touch screen to select two identical tiles that are free to move. If they match, they are removed from the board.

precision-parking-pro.intro: Precision Parking Pro challenges you to park a car accurately through tight city alleys and multi-level garages. Steer carefully, manage your timing, and work your way up from rookie to parking professional.
tips: Move slowly through narrow turns and tight spaces, since small steering corrections matter more than speed.
Use the R key to reverse when you need to back into a spot or correct a position, rather than forcing a turn that leaves you stuck.
Check your camera view before each move so you can see how close you are to obstacles and walls.
Take each challenge in short, controlled steps with WASD, stopping to reassess when the car is near an edge.
Keep practicing the same environments to learn how the vehicle physics respond, then apply that to harder garages.
faq: What is the goal of Precision Parking Pro?
The goal is to park your car with precision while avoiding obstacles in environments such as city alleys and multi-level garages. Each successful park helps you earn rewards and rank up.
Which keys control the car?
Use W, A, S, and D to move the car, and press R to switch into reverse gear.

kitchen-sorting.intro: Kitchen Sorting is a puzzle game built on ball and water sorting ideas. You move cooking ingredients between glass jars until each jar holds one kind, then pour them into the pot.
tips: Look at the top of every jar before you move anything, since you can only pick up ingredients from the top layer.
Empty a jar when you can, because an empty jar gives you a spare place to park ingredients that are in the way.
Group matching ingredients together early so that later moves do not bury one kind under another.
Tap a jar to pick up several matching ingredients at once, which can save moves when a run of the same kind sits on top.
Try swiping from the source jar to the destination jar if you find it quicker than tapping twice.
faq: What is the goal of Kitchen Sorting?
Sort the cooking ingredients into glass jars so that each jar holds only one kind, then pour them into the pot to cook meals.
Where can I drop the ingredients I picked up?
You can drop them on top of the same kind of ingredient or into an empty jar. Any other jar will not accept them.

rainbow-s-doctor.intro: Rainbow's Doctor puts you in charge of a dental clinic, where you examine patients' teeth, pick the right tool, and treat every problem tooth. Each patient brings a different challenge to solve.
tips: Look over the whole mouth before you pick up a tool so you know every problem tooth you need to treat.
Match the tool to the problem: use the cleaning tools for dirty teeth and the repair tools for damaged ones.
Work through one tooth at a time so none are missed before you finish the level.
Take your time with each procedure, since the instructions ask you to use each tool carefully.
Finish every treatment on a patient before moving on, because completing treatments is what unlocks new patients and challenges.
faq: What is the goal of Rainbow's Doctor?
The goal is to examine each patient's teeth, treat the dirty or damaged ones, and leave them with a healthy smile. You finish a level by treating all the problem teeth.
How do I know which tool to use?
Check the patient's teeth first to identify the problem, then choose the dental tool that fits that treatment. Each patient can need a different tool.

tornado-67.intro: Tornado-67 is an arcade game where you control a tornado that starts small and grows by absorbing objects. Move through a beach, a city, and a suburban neighborhood as you get stronger.
tips: Start by absorbing the small items like trash and road signs, since they build your size quickly and keep you moving.
Pick a clear path through the area so you can keep collecting objects without getting stuck around the same spot.
Use the mouse wheel to zoom out when you need a wider view of nearby objects before choosing your next target.
Hold the right mouse button to rotate the camera and check what is around you before you move toward larger objects like cars and buildings.
Try each of the three locations, since each one has different objects to absorb and can help you grow in a different way.
faq: What is the goal of Tornado-67?
Your goal is to grow your tornado by absorbing objects. As you collect more, you become stronger and can take in larger and heavier things.
How do I move the tornado on PC?
Use the WASD keys to move the tornado. Hold the right mouse button and move the mouse to look around, and use the mouse wheel to zoom.

clash-to-survival.intro: Clash to Survival is an action adventure where you fight relentless waves of spawning enemies with guns and special powers. Move through varied environments, take on bosses, and survive as long as you can.
tips: Keep moving with WASD and use mouse look to track enemies, since standing still makes you an easy target among spawning foes.
Switch weapons with Tab to match the enemy in front of you rather than sticking with one gun for every fight.
Save your skills for tough moments, such as a crowd closing in or a boss attack, instead of using them the moment they are ready.
Try different skill keys (1, Q, E, Left Shift) in calm moments so you know what each one does before a heavy fight.
Spend time upgrading your weapons when you can, because stronger guns will help you handle the harder enemies and bosses later.
faq: What is the main goal of Clash to Survival?
You fight against spawning enemies and bosses across different environments, trying to survive the battle for the future of humanity.
How do I move and aim?
Use the WASD keys to move and the mouse to look around and aim your guns.

the-high-climb.intro: The High Climb is a 3D adventure where you climb an endless vertical obstacle course. A single misstep can send you falling back to the start, so careful movement matters more than speed.
tips: Slow down before each jump and check where you will land, since a bad landing is the most common reason for a fall.
Use the mouse to look ahead to the next platform before you commit, so you can plan the route instead of reacting at the last second.
Time your spacebar presses carefully, and try short hops when a gap is small rather than a full jump that may overshoot.
Take a moment to steady yourself on each platform before moving on, because patience keeps you from making rushed mistakes.
Practice the tricky sections in short attempts to learn the rhythm of the jumps, and do not get discouraged by the falls back to the start.
faq: How do I move my character?
Use W, A, S, and D to walk, and move the mouse to look around. The spacebar makes your character jump.
What happens if I fall?
A wrong move sends you falling back to the start of the course, so you will need to climb those sections again.

path-control.intro: Path Control is a physics puzzle where you rotate platforms to guide a ball into a basket. The ball keeps rolling with little friction, so timing matters as much as placement.
tips: Make small rotations and watch the ball for a moment before adjusting again, since large changes can send it off course.
Plan the route from the ball to the basket first, then set the platforms along that path in order.
Remember that the ball keeps rolling after it stops touching a surface, so allow an extra second for it to settle before reacting.
Expect the ball to bounce off edges and barriers, and leave room for that bounce rather than aiming for a tight gap.
Work with several platforms at once, because the ball often needs a chain of rotations to get past the barriers.
faq: What is the goal of Path Control?
Your goal is to lead the ball into the basket to complete each level by rotating the platforms.
How do I control the platforms?
Click or tap on the screen to rotate the platforms and guide the ball toward the target.

falling-dummy.intro: Falling Dummy is a relaxing ragdoll physics game where you push a little dummy off a tall construction-site roof. Your aim is to break as many of its bones as possible during the fall.
tips: Watch the dummy's path during the fall and steer it toward solid objects rather than letting it drift into open air.
Aim for the floor, concrete structures, and construction cranes, since the instructions name these as places to direct the dummy for extra damage.
Try different angles on each level to learn how the body reacts to each obstacle before committing to a plan.
Take your time with each drop. The game is designed to be relaxing, so there is no need to rush through the levels.
Keep an eye on the surfaces around the dummy as it falls, and use the ones that look most likely to cause the most impact.
faq: What is the main goal of Falling Dummy?
The goal is to make the dummy break as many bones as possible by directing it into obstacles while it falls from a height.
Which objects should I aim for to break more bones?
The description points to the floor level, concrete structures, construction cranes, and other construction objects as good targets for extra damage.

deep-freeze-fishing.intro: Deep Freeze Fishing is a one-finger arcade fishing game under a frozen lake. Flick your lure through fish mouths, chain combos off the ice, and work through five zones to fill your Fishdex.
tips: Before each flick, drag your lure so it lines up with the fish's mouth. A clean, aimed flick catches more reliably than a fast, careless one.
Look for groups of fish you can sweep through in one motion. Combos multiply your coins, so a few well-placed sweeps are worth more than many single catches.
Check for mutant fish before you flick. If one is close to your lure, tap it to scare it away first so it doesn't steal your lure.
Bank your catch regularly by swiping up to the surface rather than holding everything, so a lost lure doesn't cost you a big haul.
Finish each zone's Fishdex before moving on. Completing it unlocks the Zone Challenge, and clearing that is what gets you the next lure in the shop.
faq: What is the goal of Deep Freeze Fishing?
Catch fish, fill the Fishdex in each of the five zones, beat each zone's Zone Challenge, and buy the next lure to reach deeper zones. There are 60 species to collect.
How do I catch a fish?
Drag to move your lure, then flick upward through the fish's mouth. Sweeping through several fish at once creates a combo that multiplies your coins.

adventure-time-finn-love.intro: Adventure Time: Finn Love is a one-player arcade platformer where the yellow dog searches for his human friend across 20 levels. Jumping is the only control you need.
tips: Use a single tap or click for each jump and avoid rapid tapping, so you keep better control of where the dog lands.
Watch the gold as you go and collect it on the way, since you need it to buy the flower.
Before each jump, look at the next platform or gap so you can time your jump to land safely.
Take a short break between levels if you find yourself rushing, because steady timing usually works better than speed here.
If you fall or miss a jump, restart the level and focus on the same pattern of jumps rather than trying to recover mid-air.
faq: What is the goal of Adventure Time: Finn Love?
Guide the yellow dog through 20 levels to find his favorite human friend. Along the way, collect gold, use it to buy a flower, and give the flower to your friend.
How do I control the dog?
Touch the screen or click the mouse to make the dog jump. Jumping is the only action you need.

sawblade-fest-run.intro: Sawblade Fest Run is a fast arcade racing game where you keep running and dodge obstacles such as iron sheets, walls, and giant fruit monsters. You play with mouse clicks or taps.
tips: Watch the path several steps ahead rather than the obstacle right in front of you, so you have time to react.
Keep your clicks or taps quick and steady, since reflexes are the main skill this game tests.
Pay attention to the different obstacle types, like iron sheets, walls, and fruit monsters, and notice which ones you can get past with a timely move.
Stay calm when the pace picks up; panicked, repeated clicks often cause more mistakes than a single well-timed input.
Play a few short runs in a row to learn the rhythm of the obstacles before trying to go as far as possible.
faq: How do I control my character?
You play with mouse clicks or taps, so use a single click or tap at the moment you need to react to an obstacle.
What is the goal of the game?
The goal is to keep running for as long as possible while avoiding deadly obstacles such as iron sheets, walls, and giant fruit monsters.
