shadow-stick-ninja.intro: Shadow Stick Ninja is a physics-based archery puzzle where you clear each level of hidden enemy ninjas using a limited supply of arrows. Precision matters more than speed, so plan each shot before you release.
tips: Study the whole level before your first shot and note where each enemy is hiding behind obstacles or structures.
Start with a regular arrow to test how far a small drag travels, then adjust your pull to learn the power and angle scale.
Save balloon arrows for enemies tucked in hard-to-reach spots, since lifting them into the air makes them easier to hit.
Use bomb arrows when several enemies sit close together or when an obstacle blocks a direct line to a target.
Because ammo is limited for each arrow type, count your remaining arrows before each shot and retry with a different plan if you run low.
faq: What is the goal of Shadow Stick Ninja?
Your goal is to eliminate every enemy ninja in the level using the arrows you have. If you run out before finishing, you need to try the level again with a different approach.
How do I aim and fire an arrow?
Click and drag with your mouse to aim, then release the button to fire. Pulling farther controls power, and the drag angle sets the direction, much like a slingshot.

color-the-room.intro: Color the Room is a cozy 3D coloring game where you bring fantasy rooms back to life with brushes, fills, and textures. Pick a room and start coloring objects one by one.
tips: Work through the room object by object, since every newly colored object earns points and the full room earns a bonus.
Try the fill tool with different textures like wood, tiles, or metal on large surfaces to cover them faster than painting by hand.
Use the eyedropper to match colors you have already used so the room looks consistent across different objects.
Rotate and zoom the camera often to spot small or hidden objects on the back and sides of the room before you finish.
Save a look in a slot once you like how a room is coming together, so you can go back to it if later changes don't work out.
faq: How do I earn points in Color the Room?
You earn points each time you color an object that was not colored before. Coloring every object in the room gives you an extra bonus.
Which controls should I learn first?
On desktop, the left mouse button paints and the middle button opens a color wheel. On mobile, one finger paints and two fingers zoom and rotate the view.

boxes-wizard-2.intro: Boxes Wizard 2 is a pixel art platformer puzzler where you play a wizard who uses teleportation and box-pushing magic across 40 levels. Your main goal is to find the right route through each stage using these powers.
tips: Before you act, look at the whole level and note where the boxes sit and where you need to reach. Planning the route first saves moves.
Use the swap ability on boxes to open new paths, especially when a gap or obstacle blocks the way forward.
If you get stuck, reset your thinking: try moving a box you have not touched yet, since many puzzles depend on the order of box moves.
Watch for how each new mechanic changes the level design. Later stages build on earlier ideas, so keep track of what each power can do.
Control your movement with WAD or the arrow keys in small steps, so you can correct a mistake before it locks you out of a path.
faq: What is the main goal of Boxes Wizard 2?
Move through each of the 40 levels by using your teleportation and box-pushing powers to get past obstacles and reach the end of the stage.
How do I move the wizard?
Use the WAD keys or the arrow keys to control your wizard.

tank-mayhem.intro: Tank Mayhem is a two-player tank battle where you face a friend or the computer. Collect bonuses during the fight to boost your firepower and deploy a drone to attack enemies.
tips: Pick up bonuses whenever it is safe, since they strengthen your firing power and can decide the round.
Save the Drone Mini Tank for a moment when the enemy is in reach, because it attacks fast and can dive in kamikaze style if it misses.
Keep moving rather than staying in one spot, so the opponent has a harder time lining up a shot on you.
Watch where the other tank is aiming and time your shots for when it is exposed or has just fired.
If you are playing alone, learn the computer's habits in the first few rounds before committing to a risky move.
faq: How do I control the blue tank?
Use W, A, S and D to move, and press V to fire.
How do I control the red tank?
Use the arrow keys to move and press M to fire.

magic-circus-match-3.intro: Magic Circus - Match 3 is a crystal-matching puzzle set in a circus world. You swap crystals to line up three identical ones, smash obstacles, and reach each level's goals.
tips: Look for moves that create four or more crystals in a line, since longer lines are how you set up bonuses with unique effects.
Clear obstacles when you can, because the level goals are tied to smashing them as well as collecting crystals.
Save your bonuses for tough spots where regular matches are not enough, such as when the board is crowded or an obstacle is blocking progress.
Before each swap, check whether a move also sets up a follow-up match, since cascades can clear more obstacles for free.
There are no time limits or lives, so take your time to plan moves instead of rushing through a level.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Each level has specific goals, such as smashing obstacles and collecting treasures and crystals. Check the goals at the start of the level and plan moves around them.
How do I make a match?
Swap two neighboring crystals so that three or more identical crystals line up in a row. Matched crystals are cleared and new ones fall into place.

space-painters-deluxe.intro: Space Painters Deluxe is an action-puzzler about drawing cosmic circles with paint while avoiding your own trail. Each click paints, so timing and spacing decide how cleanly you clear each star system.
tips: Look at where your paint line is heading before each click, since the trail is the main thing you must avoid.
Plan the shape of a circle before you start drawing so you do not box yourself in partway through.
Keep a clear path open around your current position so you always have room to turn.
Pace your clicks rather than rushing them; precision timing matters more than speed here.
Scan the whole play area often to keep track of open space, especially as your painted lines grow.
faq: What is the main goal of Space Painters Deluxe?
You construct colorful cosmic circles to clear dark star systems. The challenge is doing this without running into your own trailing paint line.
How do I control the game?
You paint with a mouse click. Use clicks to shape your path and time them carefully.

golf-cars-simulator.intro: Golf Cars Simulator is a browser car stunts game with three game modes, customizable cars, and a map built for stunts. Drive with WASD and use the handbrake to set up your drifts.
tips: Practice short drifts with the handbrake (Space) before attempting longer stunts. Learning how much the car slides at different speeds makes landings and turns more predictable.
Try each game mode before settling on a favorite, since each one may reward different driving habits. Note which mode you enjoy most and focus your practice there.
Experiment with different customizable cars to find one that suits your driving style. A car that handles well for your inputs will make stunts easier to repeat.
Press C to switch camera views and find the one that gives you the clearest view of your car's angle. A better view helps you judge jumps and tight turns.
Use Escape or Tab to pause when you need a moment to plan your next stunt. Stepping back between attempts can help you spot mistakes and adjust your approach.
faq: What is the goal of Golf Cars Simulator?
The game is a car stunts simulator, so the goal is to perform stunts and drifts on the map designed for them. Your progress depends on the mode you choose.
How do I control the car?
Use WASD to drive and steer, press Space for the handbrake, and press C to change the camera. Pressing Escape or Tab toggles pause.

stack-master.intro: Stack Master is an endless stacking game where you drop sliding blocks onto a growing tower. Each drop must line up with the block below to keep the tower going and climb higher.
tips: Watch the moving block for a moment before tapping so you can judge where it will land relative to the block beneath it.
Aim for near-perfect alignment early on, because every slight overhang shrinks the next block and makes later drops harder.
Tap at the moment the block is closest to the center of the block below, not when it first appears on screen.
Stay calm as the tower rises, since the blocks can move faster and require more precision at greater heights.
Practice short sessions to build timing, and check the leaderboard only after you have a steady rhythm to compare your tower height with others.
faq: What is the goal of Stack Master?
Your goal is to stack as many blocks as possible and reach the greatest tower height you can. Your height is your score.
What happens if my block doesn't line up perfectly?
Any overhanging part is cut off, so the block you keep is smaller. If the overlap is very poor, you can lose the block entirely and the game ends.

corona-virus-crazy-doctor-simulator.intro: Corona-Virus Crazy Doctor Simulator is a 2D adventure where you play a doctor. Move around, collect syringes, and help the AI people stay alive while keeping your distance from others.
tips: Use A and D to move and Space to jump, so you can get over obstacles and reach syringes that sit higher up.
Collect syringes whenever you can, since they are the main item the game asks you to gather.
Keep an eye on the people around you. The game is about how the virus spreads, so moving away from crowds is a good habit to practice.
Plan your route before you move. Jumping takes you off the ground, so check where you will land before pressing Space.
Take a short break and come back. Steady, careful moves usually work better than rushing through the screen.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
You play as a doctor who collects syringes and helps the AI people avoid dying while the virus spreads around them.
Which keys control the character?
Use W, A, S and D to move and the Space bar to jump.

zombies-ate-my-castle.intro: Zombies Ate My Castle is a tower defense game where you lead an undead army to hold off waves of attackers and protect your castle. Success depends on placing units well and using your resources wisely.
tips: Build your army around a few reliable zombie units early, then add others as you learn which enemies give you trouble.
Keep an eye on coins from each victory and spend them on upgrades before buying more units, so your existing army gets stronger.
Use zombie carriers to bring back fallen foes when you need extra fighters, especially after a tough wave has thinned your ranks.
Save powerful spells for dangerous moments, such as when a large group of attackers is close to breaking through.
Between waves, check which lane or area is weakest and reinforce it rather than spreading your units evenly.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You defend your castle against every wave of attackers and aim to save the zombie princess.
How do I select units and use buttons?
Use the mouse or a touchscreen to select units and press the on-screen buttons to act.

yenemy.intro: Yenemy mixes survival, crafting and clan battles with a farm island you build between fights. Your battle progress feeds back into farm development, so both sides of the game matter.
tips: Gather resources early and craft weapons before you head into fights with monsters or enemy players.
Keep an eye on your own clan temple, since defending it matters as much as attacking the enemy temple.
Work with your clan during large battles, because coordinated pushes on an enemy castle are how you reach their temple.
Use Space to jump or dash out of trouble when you are surrounded, then reposition with W, A, S and D.
Use the left mouse button to attack or gather, and try the right mouse button for automatic attacks when you want to focus on movement.
faq: What is the goal of Yenemy?
The goal is to destroy the opposing clan's Temple to win a battle. You get there by crafting weapons, fighting monsters and enemy players, and storming enemy castles.
How do I move and attack?
Use W to move toward the mouse pointer, S to move backward from it, and A and D to strafe. Left mouse button attacks or gathers, and right mouse button attacks automatically.

cooking-fever-happy-chef.intro: Cooking Fever: Happy Chef is a restaurant simulation where you cook, serve, and manage your own restaurant. You play with mouse clicks or taps, and the colorful graphics keep the kitchen lively.
tips: Use short, steady clicks or taps rather than rushing every action at once, so you don't miss the next step.
Keep an eye on the whole restaurant, not just the dish in front of you, so that cooking and serving stay in balance.
Finish one order completely before starting the next when you feel overwhelmed, since a clear sequence prevents mistakes.
Pay attention to what is happening on screen after each action, and adjust your pace when the restaurant gets busy.
Replay the game to learn how the cooking and serving steps flow together, which makes later rounds feel more manageable.
faq: What is the goal of Cooking Fever: Happy Chef?
The goal is to cook, serve, and manage your restaurant so that you grow into a successful chef. The game focuses on running the kitchen and dining area together.
How do I control the game?
You play using only mouse clicks or taps. There are no other controls to learn.

valentine-nail-salon.intro: Valentine Nail Salon is a nail styling game where you give a client a romantic manicure for Valentine's Day. You pick the nail length and shape, then paint and decorate her nails.
tips: Choose length and shape first, since the rest of the design looks best when the nail base suits the style you want.
Try a classic french manicure for a clean look, or switch to a single color or several colors if you want something bolder.
Pick colors that work together, such as soft reds and pinks, so the final set looks cohesive rather than busy.
Take your time with the painting step and go as fancy as you like, since the game encourages detailed work on each nail.
Compare your finished hands before moving on, and adjust any nail that does not match the romantic theme you are aiming for.
faq: What is the goal of Valentine Nail Salon?
The goal is to create a sweet, romantic manicure for your client on Valentine's Day that makes her hands look glamorous.
How do I control the game?
Use the left mouse button or tap the screen to play and make your choices.

find-the-correct-shadow.intro: Find The Correct Shadow is a puzzle game where you match a picture to the one shadow that fits it among three options. It offers Streak, Timed, and Learning modes to suit different play styles.
tips: Study the picture's outline and key features before looking at the shadows, so you know what shape to search for.
Eliminate shadows that clearly do not match first, which leaves fewer options to compare closely.
In Streak Mode, slow down on hard rounds, since one wrong answer ends your perfect run.
In Timed Mode, do not spend too long on a single round; if you are unsure, make your best choice and move on to keep your count up.
Use Learning Mode to get comfortable with the shapes and build your visual recognition before trying the timed or streak challenges.
faq: What is the goal of Find The Correct Shadow?
Your goal is to pick the one shadow that matches the picture shown in each round, out of three options.
How do I play the game?
Use mouse clicks or taps to select the shadow you think is correct.

needfor-race.intro: NeedFor Race is a 3D arcade racer where you compete in races, earn money, and improve your car across three maps. Steering and boosting are handled with simple keyboard controls.
tips: Save money from wins so you can afford upgrades before you need them in harder races.
Use the handbrake with Space to tighten sharp corners instead of braking hard and losing speed.
Save your NOS boost for straightaways or the final stretch, where it helps most.
Try the camera switch with C to find the view that lets you read upcoming turns best.
Learn each of the three maps so you know where the tight corners and open stretches are before racing on them.
faq: What is the goal of NeedFor Race?
Your goal is to win races, which earns you money to change or upgrade your car. The game offers unlimited races across three maps.
Which keys control the car?
Use WASD or the arrow keys to move, Left Shift for NOS, C to change the camera, and Space for the handbrake.

stacky-dash.intro: Stacky Dash is a relaxing 3D arcade game about guiding a character across platforms while gathering bricks. Drag to play and aim to reach the final platform.
tips: Collect bricks as you go, since the description recommends gathering all of them to earn more diamonds.
Plan your route before each move so you can pick up bricks without overshooting the platform.
Don't rush. Small, steady drags usually give you more control over where the character lands.
Repeated routes are allowed, so you can backtrack to grab bricks you missed before moving on.
Cross every platform on each stage rather than only heading for the end, so you don't leave diamonds behind.
faq: What is the goal of Stacky Dash?
Gather bricks and get to the final platform by controlling your character across the platforms. Collecting all the bricks also earns more diamonds.
How do I control the character?
You play by dragging. Drag to move the character across the platforms.

fat-hedgehog-boris.intro: Fat Hedgehog Boris is an arcade platformer where Boris gets fatter with every hit and his movement changes. Run, jump, and attack your way through each level while staying as nimble as you can.
tips: Keep track of how each hit changes Boris's movement, since a fatter Boris is harder to control and needs more room to stop and turn.
Jump early when approaching gaps or traps so you have time to adjust in the air before landing.
Use the downward attack from mid-air to defeat enemies from above, which gives you a chance to stay safe while you land.
Collect coins as you go, but do not take risks near dangerous traps just to grab them.
When facing a boss, watch its movement pattern for a moment before attacking so you can time your jumps and strikes.
faq: What is the goal of Fat Hedgehog Boris?
Your goal is to reach the finish of each level while running, jumping, defeating enemies, and avoiding traps and bosses.
How do I attack enemies?
Jump with Space, then press Space again while in the air to perform a downward attack. Defeating enemies from above is the main way to deal with them.

requiemnoire.intro: RequiemNoire is a fast reflex game where you press the correct arrow keys before the timer runs out. Each correct sequence keeps a deadly blade at bay, and your goal is to survive as long as possible.
tips: Keep your eyes on the sequence as a whole rather than one arrow at a time, so you can start your next press before the current one is finished.
Watch the timer closely and act early when it starts to drop, since a late press leaves little room for error.
Use the same finger placement on the arrow keys every round so your hands can move without you having to look down.
Stay calm after a mistake and reset your focus immediately, because one wrong press can make the next sequence harder to recover from.
Practice short runs first to learn the rhythm of the sequences, then aim to extend your survival time gradually.
faq: What is the goal of RequiemNoire?
Your goal is to press the correct arrow keys before time runs out, which restores your timer and helps you escape the blade. The longer you survive, the better your result.
What controls does the game use?
You play with the arrow buttons on your keyboard. Press the arrows that match each sequence.

crowd-runner-3d.intro: Crowd Runner 3D is a 3D arcade running game. Your goal is to pass the enemy crowd and reach the finish line to complete each level. It is controlled with the left mouse button.
tips: Watch the path ahead of you rather than only the crowd right in front, so you can react before you reach an obstacle or group.
Keep your clicks steady and rhythmic instead of rapid-fire, since the instructions only use the left mouse button and you want consistent timing.
Keep the finish line in view as you run so you can judge how much distance is left and whether you need to push ahead.
Play in short sessions at first and notice which parts of a level cause you to lose your pace, then focus your attention on those spots next time.
Stay calm when you are close to the enemy crowd; a steady approach usually works better than rushing in and losing your timing.
faq: What is the goal of Crowd Runner 3D?
The goal is to pass the enemy crowd and reach the finish line to complete the level.
How do I control the game?
You control the game with the left mouse button, using clicks as described in the instructions.

color-brawls.intro: Color Brawls is an online multiplayer game where you use bright colors to defeat rivals. Move through different locations, take on the challenges, and keep the action fast.
tips: Keep moving rather than standing still, since staying in one spot makes you an easy target for rivals.
Learn each location's layout early so you know where to retreat, find cover, and reposition quickly.
Aim with care and fire in short bursts instead of holding the shot button down, which helps you hit targets more often.
Use the pause key (Tab on PC) to take a breath and check your surroundings when a match gets chaotic.
On mobile, get comfortable with swiping to look around while using the joystick to move, so you can track rivals without losing your position.
faq: What is the goal of Color Brawls?
You compete against rivals using bright colors and try to defeat them. The game is built around fast-paced, engaging battles.
What are the controls on PC?
Use WASD or the arrow keys to move, left-click to shoot, and Tab to pause.

good-slice.intro: Good Slice is a casual puzzle game where you swipe across fruit to cut it into neat pieces. Each piece drops into the juicer, and cleaner cuts give you more juice.
tips: Aim for the middle of each fruit so the pieces are close to equal in size.
Make your swipe in one smooth, straight motion instead of a wobbly line, which helps the cut stay precise.
Check where the pieces will fall before you swipe so they land in the juicer rather than missing it.
Slow down a little on tricky fruit shapes; a precise cut is worth more than a quick one.
Use the mouse or a tap on the screen to make your cut, keeping your movement steady for the best results.
faq: What is the goal of Good Slice?
Swipe across each fruit to cut it into pieces that fall smoothly into the juicer. The better the cut, the more juice you collect.
How do I control the game?
Play with a mouse click or a tap. Swipe across the fruit on the screen to make a cut.

pumpkin-ninja.intro: Pumpkin Ninja is a fast Halloween arcade game where you slice flying pumpkins with quick swipes while avoiding bombs. Build combos, beat your high score, and try different modes.
tips: Keep your swipes short and quick so you can hit several pumpkins in one motion instead of slowing down between cuts.
Before each swipe, check for bombs in the path so you do not slice them by accident.
Build combos by staying focused on the pumpkins near the center of the screen, where a clean run of hits is easiest to keep going.
Try Zen Mode first to get comfortable with the swiping motion, then move to Classic or Arcade when you feel ready.
Use the Pause button when the screen gets crowded so you can reset your focus before continuing.
faq: How do I slice pumpkins on desktop?
Hold the left mouse button and drag across the pumpkins to slice them. Move the cursor in quick lines to hit several at once.
What should I avoid during play?
Avoid slicing the bombs. Hitting one ends your run, so watch for them before each swipe.

different-fashion-hairstyle.intro: Help Sofia and Zoe pick their favorite hairstyle and dress in this girls' dress-up game. You play with mouse clicks or taps, and the choice between curls and straight hair is at the heart of it.
tips: Try both curls and straight hair on each friend before you settle on a look, so you can compare them fairly.
Think about which hairstyle suits each girl's overall style, then choose a dress that goes with it.
Keep your choices consistent across the outfit so the hair and dress look like they belong together.
Take your time with each step and check how the full look appears before moving on.
Pay attention to what Sofia and Zoe say about popular styles, since their conversation hints at the look they want.
faq: What is the goal of Different Fashion Hairstyle?
The goal is to help Sofia and Zoe choose their favorite hairstyle and dress. You decide the final look for both friends.
What is the choice between curls and straight hair?
The game asks which type of hair you prefer, curls or straight. Your pick helps shape the hairstyle you give each friend.

circle-car-crash-3d.intro: Circle Car Crash 3D is a racing game set on circular tracks where you steer, dodge rivals and score points from near misses, drifts and crashes. Use the arrow keys to drive and aim for the finish line.
tips: Brake early before tight bends so you keep control of the car and can still take the next turn cleanly.
Use the near misses on purpose, since passing rivals closely earns points without the risk of a full collision.
Go after coins when the path is clear, because they unlock new cars and help you buy upgrades.
Spend your upgrades on the stat you need most: speed for straights, handling for tight turns, or crash power if you rely on collisions for bonus points.
Watch for barriers and rivals ahead rather than focusing only on your car, so you have time to steer around them.
faq: What is the goal of Circle Car Crash 3D?
Survive the circular track and reach the finish line to complete each level. You can also earn points along the way.
How do I earn points?
You earn points for near misses, perfect drifts and crashes with other cars. Collecting coins gives rewards as well.

harbor-dispatch.intro: Harbor Dispatch is an arcade flying game where you pilot a helicopter, pick up stranded people, and deliver them to hospital within each five-minute shift. Your aim is to rescue as many people as you can before time runs out.
tips: Plan each trip before you take off: note where the rescue circles are and where the H landing pad is so you are not wasting fuel searching for them.
Pick up passengers in the same trip when you can, since a fuller helicopter means fewer returns to the hospital.
Keep an eye on your fuel and stop at fuel pads before you run low, so you are not stranded far from a refuel point.
Spend your early upgrades on passenger capacity or speed, depending on whether your trips are limited by how many people you carry or by how long they take.
Use the brake by releasing your input when you need to stop precisely inside a rescue circle, rather than overshooting and circling back.
faq: What is the goal of Harbor Dispatch?
Pick up stranded people from rescue circles and land on the H to deliver them to hospital. Rescue as many people as possible before the five-minute shift ends.
How do I pick up passengers?
Fly into a rescue circle and stop inside it. Once you are inside and stationary, the people are picked up.

match-master.intro: Match Master is a memory and matching puzzle where you find pairs of 3D objects on the ground and clear the board. Each cleared level brings new objects to pair.
tips: Before you pick anything, scan the whole board to see which objects appear more than once and where their twins are.
Remember where you have seen each object, since the pairs are spread across the screen and a good memory helps you find the matching one quickly.
Choose objects that are easy to tell apart at a glance, such as a shiny 3D object versus an animal or emoji, to avoid mixing up similar-looking pictures.
Clear the board one pair at a time and check the screen after each move so you do not overlook a leftover object.
Take your time and stay relaxed, because the game is designed as a calm brain exercise and rushing can cause mistakes.
faq: What is the goal of Match Master?
Your goal is to find and pair all the 3D objects on the board until the whole screen is cleared and you win the level.
How do I make a pair?
Pick the first 3D object, then pick a second object, and move both of them to the circle in the middle of the screen.

snowball-dash.intro: Snowball Dash is a skill game where you steer a red ball down a snowy mountain. Dodge trees and rocks, grab crystals for points, and see how long you can last as the descent speeds up.
tips: Keep your moves small and steady. Constant small steering corrections usually keep you clear of obstacles better than sudden large swerves.
Look a few obstacles ahead rather than only at the ball. Spotting a gap early gives you time to line up before you reach it.
Pick up crystals when they are close to your path without risking a collision. They add to your score, but survival comes first.
Expect the game to get harder the deeper you go. Warm up your reflexes at the start so you are sharp when the speed increases.
If you play on a touchscreen, rest your thumbs on the left and right sides so you can react quickly to either direction.
faq: What is the goal of Snowball Dash?
Your goal is to keep the red ball rolling down the mountain for as long as possible while avoiding trees, rocks, and other obstacles.
What controls do I use to move the ball?
On a keyboard, press A or Left Arrow to move left and D or Right Arrow to move right. On a touchscreen, touch the left or right side of the screen to move in that direction.

squid-7-challenge.intro: Squid 7 Challenge is an arcade survival game built around mini-games from the Squid Game style. You take part in rounds, and your goal is to win by surviving each one.
tips: Treat each round as its own challenge. Clear one mini-game before worrying about the next, since the rounds are listed as a series.
Start with the games you find easiest to read, such as Red Light, Green Light, to get used to the pace and how the game responds.
Watch closely before committing to a move in timed or risky rounds like Glass Stepping Stones, where one mistake can end your run.
Stay calm and avoid rushing. Survival games reward patience, so slow, deliberate play usually beats fast, careless play.
Replay the rounds you struggle with. Repeating a mini-game helps you notice patterns and improve your timing.
faq: What is the goal of Squid 7 Challenge?
The goal is to survive the mini-games and win. The game is built around surviving a series of survival mini-games.
How many rounds are there?
The description lists seven rounds. It names Red Light, Green Light, Sugar Honey Combs, Tug Of War, Marbles, and Glass Stepping Stones, along with other challenges.

the-island-of-momo.intro: The Island of Momo is an adventure shooter where you wake up on a strange island and must search for ammo while fighting Momo and its sidekicks. Your goal is to stay alive as long as you can.
tips: Search for ammo as you explore, since you need bullets to fight Momo and its sidekicks.
Use Left Ctrl to crouch or X to go prone when enemies are shooting at you, so you present a smaller target.
Hold Mouse 2 to aim before firing with Mouse 1 to make your shots more accurate.
Reload with R during quiet moments rather than in the middle of a firefight, so you are not caught with an empty weapon.
Save your G grenade for groups of enemies or tough spots instead of using it on single targets.
faq: What is the main goal of The Island of Momo?
Your goal is to search the island for ammo, fight Momo and its sidekicks, and stay alive for as long as you can.
How do I move and aim?
Use W, A, S and D to walk, Mouse 2 to aim, and Mouse 1 to fire. Left Shift sprints and Space jumps.

shoot-and-sprint-warfare.intro: Shoot & Sprint: Warfare is a fast action shooter where your fighter runs forward on their own while you aim and fire at enemies coming from every side. Staying alert and managing your ammo are the keys to lasting longer.
tips: Keep your attention on the enemies coming from the sides, not only the path ahead, since they can appear from any direction.
Take short, accurate shots instead of spraying bullets, so your ammo lasts through the whole run.
Watch for ammo, first-aid kits, and temporary weapon upgrades on the level, and grab them when you can, especially when your ammo or health is low.
Use temporary weapon upgrades while they last, and aim for the enemies that are closest to you first.
After each level, spend time on the weapons you have unlocked and upgrade the ones you rely on most for more damage.
faq: Do I need to control my character's movement?
No. Your character runs forward automatically, so you can focus entirely on shooting.
How do I shoot?
Tap the screen or use the mouse button to fire in different directions. The game also mentions on-screen buttons for shooting.

romantic-match-tactics.intro: Romantic Match Tactics is a puzzle game where you clear the grid by lining up trios of identical items across 48 levels. You can play with a mouse or touch input.
tips: Before each move, check whether a trio of magical keys can be made, since matching keys unlocks locked items and opens up the grid.
Look for moves that free up several items at once rather than matching a single trio, so you have more options later.
Plan around the blocked tiles marked with crossed cupid arrows, and avoid moves that leave items stranded on the far side of them.
Save your moves when the board is nearly clear. Each level rewards a careful balance between moving items and unlocking the locked ones.
If a level stalls, scan the whole grid for items that can be moved into a row of three, and work out the order before you tap or click.
faq: What is the main goal in Romantic Match Tactics?
Clear the grid by aligning three identical items to form a trio, while unlocking locked items along the way.
How do I unlock locked items?
Create trios of magical keys to unlock the locked items on the grid.

coloring-book.intro: Coloring Book is a relaxed drawing game where you pick a picture of animals, flowers or mandalas and fill it with color. It is meant for both adults and children who want a calm, creative break.
tips: Start with a small area, such as one petal or one section of a mandala, so the page does not feel overwhelming.
Pick a few colors that go together and stick to them for one picture, which helps the finished page look balanced.
Work from the outside edges inward or from one side of the page to the other, so you do not skip areas by accident.
Try a mandala when you want a repetitive, soothing task, since the symmetrical patterns give you a clear path to follow.
Take breaks between pictures and come back later, so the activity stays relaxing rather than becoming a chore.
faq: What do I need to do to start playing?
Choose the mode you want, then pick a coloring book you like. From there you can start filling in the page.
What kinds of pictures can I color?
The game description mentions animals, flowers and mandalas. Pick whichever subject you enjoy most to begin.

daily-bento-organizer.intro: Daily Bento Organizer is a casual puzzle game about arranging food neatly in a bento box. You play by clicking or tapping to place items into the compartments.
tips: Look at the whole box before placing anything, so you can plan where larger items will fit.
Keep similar foods grouped together, which tends to make the arrangement look tidier and easier to read.
Try to balance colors across the box so the final layout looks appealing rather than crowded in one corner.
Work through the compartments steadily instead of rushing, since a single misplaced item can make the rest harder to fit.
Take a moment to compare your layout with the goal before you finish, and adjust any items that look out of place.
faq: How do I play Daily Bento Organizer?
Use mouse clicks or taps to select food and place it into the bento box. Keep arranging items until the box looks complete.
What is the goal of the game?
The goal is to create a delicious-looking bento box by arranging food and managing the limited storage space in the box.

loot-island-treasure-digger.intro: Loot Island - Treasure Digger is an adventure puzzle where you dig up treasure across island landscapes and fit it into your backpack. Your aim is to find as many items as you can and get the most value from them.
tips: Dig with a plan rather than at random, since the goal is to find as many precious items as possible while managing your digging effort.
Think about backpack space before you pick up big pieces, because the Tetris-style stacking decides how much loot you can carry.
Put higher-value items like gems where they fit best, so your backpack holds more profit rather than just more items.
Spend your earnings on tool upgrades when you can, since better tools help you dig deeper into each landscape.
Keep an eye on which maps you have unlocked and aim to unlock new ones as you progress, because each new map brings new loot to find.
faq: What is the main goal of Loot Island - Treasure Digger?
The goal is to find as many precious items as possible, stack them efficiently in your backpack, and maximize your treasure profit.
How does the backpack stacking work?
Loot is stacked Tetris-style, so you need to arrange each piece so it fits into the limited space of your backpack.

moon-potato-clicker.intro: Moon Potato Clicker is a clicker game where you grow a potato economy on the moon while defending your citizens from alien invasions, earthquakes and other threats. Tap or click to harvest crops and build your colony.
tips: Harvest regular crops steadily at the start, since they are the base that grows your colony.
Save up golden potatoes for the special abilities and rare upgrades they unlock rather than spending them as soon as you get them.
Keep an eye on threats like alien invasions and earthquakes so you can respond before they hurt your citizens.
Balance your spending between growing the economy and protecting your people, because a big colony is hard to keep if it is left unguarded.
Check your upgrades often and buy the ones that help your current situation most, especially when a threat is coming.
faq: What is the main goal in Moon Potato Clicker?
Your goal is to build the biggest potato economy on the moon while protecting your citizens from threats such as alien invasions and earthquakes.
How do I play Moon Potato Clicker?
Use simple touch or mouse controls to harvest regular crops and grow your moon colony.

bottle-bottle.intro: Bottle Bottle is an arcade jumping game where you guide a bottle across platforms using simple taps. Timing and rhythm decide how far you get before a bad landing ends the run.
tips: Plan your second jump before you leave the ground, since you only get two jumps in a row and the second one is best used to correct your landing.
Watch the gap ahead rather than the bottle itself so you can judge when to make your first tap.
Try short, steady runs at first to get a feel for how high and far each jump carries the bottle.
Keep your rhythm even from platform to platform instead of rushing taps, because consistent timing is what carries you furthest.
Use each attempt to learn one specific mistake, then try again to beat your best distance.
faq: What is the goal of Bottle Bottle?
Jump the bottle from one platform to another and go as far as you can. Each try is a chance to beat your best distance.
How do I control the bottle?
Tap the screen once to make the bottle jump. Tap again while it is in the air to perform a second jump.

beach-defense-merge-tower.intro: Beach Defense: Merge Tower is a puzzle tower defense game where you place towers, merge matching pairs into stronger ones, and hold back enemy waves. Each wave gets harder, so your setup needs to keep growing.
tips: Merge matching towers as soon as you can, since one stronger tower often holds the board better than several weak ones.
Spend coins between waves on towers or upgrades rather than saving them, because enemies scale up and your defense has to keep pace.
Keep some empty tiles open so you always have room to place a new tower and set up a future merge.
Save active powers for moments when enemies start reaching your defense, instead of using them on early, easy waves.
Try different tower combinations across runs to find which mix of towers works best for you.
faq: What is the goal of Beach Defense: Merge Tower?
The goal is to survive as many waves as possible by building and merging towers to defeat enemies. Each run is about building smarter and surviving longer.
How do I get coins?
You earn coins by defeating enemies. You can then spend them on new towers, upgrades, and improvements to your defense.

ultimate-obby-parkour-adventure-online.intro: Ultimate Obby Parkour Adventure is a parkour course across four colorful realms full of obstacles. You move through it, customize your character, and work toward becoming a parkour master.
tips: Use the mouse wheel to zoom the camera out before a tricky jump so you can see the platforms ahead more clearly.
Press Shift to bring up the cursor, then hold the right mouse button to rotate the camera and check the angle of your next jump.
Keep your jumps short and controlled with Space while steering with WASD, so you can land on small platforms without overshooting.
If you need a break mid-run, press TAB to pause, and avoid rushing through the course when you feel tired.
Use the T and Y panels for emotes and dances only when you are standing still, so you do not lose control of your movement.
faq: Which keys do I use to move and jump?
Use W, A, S and D to move your character. Press Space to jump.
How do I get a better view of the obstacles ahead?
Scroll the mouse wheel to zoom the camera in or out. To rotate the view, press Shift to show the cursor, then hold the right mouse button and move the mouse.

bubble-shooter-island-quest.intro: Bubble Shooter Island Quest is a tropical bubble shooter where you aim a parrot's cannon to match colored bubbles and clear the jungle canopy before it reaches the bottom. Each level has its own goals to reach within a limited number of shots.
tips: Look for chain reactions before you fire. Popping one group can drop loose bubbles and open up larger clusters.
Keep your 35 shots in mind and avoid firing single bubbles that match nothing. Each shot should aim to match 3 or more.
Check the star or trophy goal at the start of each level, such as collecting a set number of eggs, and plan shots that work toward it.
Save power-up barrels for tough spots where a large cluster or a difficult section is blocking your progress.
Use the pause button if you need a moment to study the layout, since the bubbles will not move while you think.
faq: How many shots do I get?
You have 35 shots in total, so you need to use them carefully. Plan each shot so it helps clear bubbles or reach the level goal.
How do I aim and fire the bubble?
On desktop, drag the mouse to aim from the cannon and click or release to fire. On mobile, drag or swipe to aim and tap or release to shoot.

toy-smash.intro: Toy Smash is a physics knockdown game where you fire a limited number of balls at a tower of toy blocks on a carnival stand. Your aim decides how much of the stack comes down with each shot.
tips: Aim at the lowest blocks in the tower. When the bottom supports fall, the blocks above them usually tumble off too.
Look for the spot where blocks are most crowded, since one well-placed shot can bring down several pieces at once.
Count your remaining balls before each shot and avoid spending several on a single block that is not holding anything up.
Watch how the tower wobbles after each hit before firing again, because it may fall on its own and save you a ball.
Save special shots for hard towers, such as glass gates or mixed piles, and use the shot badge on the side to select one before you fire.
faq: What is the goal of Toy Smash?
Knock every block off the stand before your balls run out to clear the level and open the next one.
How do I fire a ball?
Tap or click anywhere on the tower to fire a ball at that spot.

happy-valentines-day-coloring.intro: Happy Valentines Day Coloring is a Valentine's Day coloring game for girls. You color a picture to make a gift for someone you love, and you can print it out when you are done.
tips: Before you start coloring, look at the whole picture and decide which areas you want to fill with your main colors. Working from a plan keeps the result balanced.
Choose a small set of colors that suit Valentine's Day, such as reds, pinks, and whites, so the finished picture looks cohesive as a gift.
Work on one section at a time rather than jumping around. This helps you avoid missing small areas that could be left blank.
Check the picture for any spots you skipped before you finish, since gaps are easy to miss on a screen.
Once you are happy with the colors, use the print option so you have a physical copy to give to your partner.
faq: What is the goal of this game?
The goal is to color a Valentine's Day picture as a lovely gift for your boyfriend or girlfriend. The game describes it as a way to show how much you love them.
How do I play?
The game is played with a mouse or by tapping the screen. Click or tap on the picture to color it.

lollipop-escape-mania-kids.intro: Lollipop Escape Mania Kids is a simple platform game for kids. Collect the candies on each platform to raise your score while steering clear of the few enemy objects.
tips: Look at the whole platform before you move so you can plan a route that picks up every candy.
Keep an eye on where the enemy objects are moving and wait for a safe gap before you jump.
Avoid rushing across narrow platforms, since falling is one of the ways the run can end.
Collect the candies that sit close to enemies first while you still have a clear view of the danger.
Take short breaks between rounds so you can review which routes worked best.
faq: What is the main goal of Lollipop Escape Mania Kids?
The goal is to collect all the candies on the platforms to increase your score. You also need to avoid falling or touching enemy objects.
How do I increase my score?
Your score goes up as you collect candies. Clearing all the candies on the platforms is the main way to build a high score.

santa-gift-delivery-christmas-game.intro: Fly Santa's sleigh over snowy cityscapes and deliver presents to every house before Christmas Eve. This guide covers the controls and a few habits that help you stay on route.
tips: Ease off the acceleration before you reach a turn, so you have time to steer left or right without clipping obstacles.
Watch for traffic and snowstorms well ahead, and start dodging early rather than making last-second swerves.
Use the brake when you need to line up with a house, since slowing down gives you more control over where the sleigh goes.
Collect coins when you can do so safely, because they can be used to upgrade your sleigh.
On mobile, use short, firm swipes left or right to dodge, and keep your attention on the road between swipes.
faq: What is the goal of Santa Gift Delivery?
You fly Santa's sleigh and deliver gifts to every house before Christmas Eve while avoiding snowstorms and traffic.
How do I steer the sleigh on a keyboard?
Use the left and right arrow keys to turn, the up arrow to accelerate, and the down arrow to brake.

girl-bike-accident-love.intro: Girl Bike Accident Love is a story game about Zoe, who gets hurt in the park, and Zack, who treats her wound and then can't stop thinking about her. Click or tap to follow the story.
tips: Take each scene in slowly, since the story moves forward one step at a time and the early moments set up what comes later.
Pay close attention to the treatment scenes, because the game's doctor theme is central to how Zack and Zoe first connect.
Look for the small changes in how Zack behaves after he gets home, as these show how his feelings develop.
If you enjoy the Dress Up and Makeover tags, watch for any moments where the game lets you change Zoe's look, and try a few different choices.
Replay the game if you want to see how a different choice or tap changes the direction of the story.
faq: What do I do to play Girl Bike Accident Love?
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps. Click or tap to move through the story and see what happens next.
Is there a score or a way to win in this game?
The game description does not mention a score or a win condition. It is a story-driven game that follows Zoe and Zack's romance from the accident onward.

besties-on-wednesday.intro: Besties on Wednesday is a dress-up game set at a School of Magic. You style two very different roommates with makeup, hairstyles, outfits and accessories that suit their personalities.
tips: Start by looking at each girl's existing style, such as the dark gothic look or the bright colours, and build her image from that before adding anything new.
Try a few combinations for one girl before moving on, since small changes to accessories or makeup can change the overall feel a lot.
Keep both looks in mind at once so the two girls look distinct from each other, which helps show how different they are.
Pay attention to the hints in the girls' personalities, because the description says one of them has secrets, and an image that fits her may look different from first impressions.
When you are happy with the result, save it as a PNG so you can keep your favourite version of each girl.
faq: What is the goal of Besties on Wednesday?
The goal is to help two very different students at the School of Magic create unique images that match their characters. The game suggests they may eventually become best friends.
How do I control the game?
You use a computer mouse click on a computer or a simple touch on a touch screen to choose makeup, hairstyles, outfits and accessories.

guess-drawing.intro: Guess Drawing is a fast casual puzzle game where you watch a drawing appear and pick what it shows from the answer options. Speed and close observation both count.
tips: Watch the whole drawing before you decide, since details often appear as it develops.
Look for the main shape first, such as an outline or silhouette, then check smaller details to narrow the choices.
Rule out answers that do not match the shape you can see instead of guessing from the first clue.
Keep an eye on the round timer and commit to your best answer before time runs out.
Stay focused round after round, because quick, accurate guesses are what help you stay ahead of opponents.
faq: What is the goal of Guess Drawing?
Your goal is to recognize what each drawing represents and choose the correct answer from the options before the round ends.
How do I choose an answer?
Pick one of the available options on screen before the round timer runs out.

nubik-dungeon.intro: Nubik Dungeon is a 2D jumping adventure where you move through dungeons full of traps and riddles. Your goal is to survive each one and reach the exit.
tips: Watch each new dungeon for a few seconds before moving, since every one has its own set of traps and puzzles.
Use A and D to position yourself carefully before you commit to a move, so you are not caught off guard by a trap.
Use W to jump only when you can see where you will land, which helps you avoid hazards on the way.
Think through riddles before acting, because the right answer often matters more than moving quickly.
If you play on a touch screen, turn on mobile control in the settings first so the controls respond the way you expect.
faq: What is the main goal of Nubik Dungeon?
Your task is to get through each dungeon, overcome the traps and puzzles, and reach the exit.
Which keys control the character?
Press A to move left, D to move right, and W to jump.

do-not-enter-this-game-at-night.intro: A 3D horror maze puzzle where you guide a ball through many levels filled with puzzles and sudden screamers. Move carefully and expect frights along the way.
tips: Move slowly and steadily through each passage, since the maze is built around surprises that can catch you off guard.
Look at the whole layout before committing to a path so you can spot dead ends and puzzle elements early.
Use the WASD keys on a computer, or the joystick in the bottom left of the screen on a smartphone, and keep your inputs gentle so the ball stays under control.
Take short breaks between levels if the screamers are bothering you, and come back with a clear head.
Play with the sound on so you can hear what is coming, but turn the volume down if the jump scares become too much.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
You guide a ball through a 3D maze, solving puzzles and passing through many levels while avoiding the screamers you meet along the way.
How do I move the ball?
On a computer, use the W, A, S and D keys. On a smartphone, use the joystick on the screen in the bottom left corner.

cryptograms-secret-text.intro: Cryptograms: Secret Text is a word puzzle where you decode encrypted phrases by working out hidden letters. Pick a theme, then move through the levels one at a time.
tips: Start with short words and letters that repeat often, such as single-letter words, since they give you the most clues for the rest of the phrase.
Look for common word patterns like words ending in a double letter or words with the same letter pattern, and test your guesses against them.
Keep a mental note of mistakes so you do not repeat the same wrong guess, and reveal letters carefully rather than all at once.
Save your hints for when you are truly stuck, because coins are earned by completing levels and are needed to access them.
If a phrase feels impossible, fill in the letters you are sure of first, then let the partial words guide the rest instead of guessing at random.
faq: What is the goal of each puzzle?
You need to restore the full phrase by working out which hidden letters belong in each position. Once the whole phrase is correct, the level is complete.
How do I earn coins?
You earn coins for completing levels. Coins can then be used to access hints.

offroad-jeep-simulator.intro: Offroad Jeep Simulator is a 3D racing and driving game set off the beaten track. You steer a jeep with the WASD keys, and the game includes multiple game modes and multiple jeeps to try.
tips: Spend a few minutes learning how the jeep responds to W, A, S and D before you commit to a challenge. Smooth, short inputs usually give you more control on rough ground than holding keys down.
Try each of the included jeeps and note how they handle. Pick the one whose feel suits your style for the rest of your session.
Explore the different game modes one at a time rather than jumping between them. This helps you understand what each mode asks of you.
Slow down on uneven terrain and keep the jeep steady. Losing control on bumps is a common reason for slowing progress in offroad driving games.
Come back to a mode you found tricky and repeat it. Familiarity with the terrain and your jeep's behavior will make later attempts easier.
faq: What are the controls in Offroad Jeep Simulator?
You drive the jeep using the W, A, S and D keys. Use them to accelerate, steer and brake or reverse.
Which jeeps can I drive?
The game includes multiple jeeps, so you can compare how each one handles. Try a few to find the one you prefer.

fristailo-granny.intro: Fristailo Granny! is a funny skill game where you guide Granny through freestyle dance moves and stunts on a busy highway. Keep moving, chain your tricks, and climb the levels.
tips: Keep Granny moving at all times, since the game rewards constant motion with bigger combos and more points.
Use A and D on a keyboard, or the arrow keys on a phone, to start your freestyle and stay in rhythm with the action.
Try to chain moves together rather than pausing between them, because combos are where most of the points come from.
Spend time on the early levels to learn how the highway behaves before you move up, as higher levels are harder and more mystical.
If you are playing with friends, agree on a fixed run length so your freestyle scores are easy to compare fairly.
faq: What is the main goal of Fristailo Granny!?
Your goal is to freestyle with Granny on a busy highway and score as many points as you can. Staying on the move is the key to racking up a high score.
How do I start freestyling?
Press A or D on your keyboard to begin freestyle. On a phone, use the arrow keys instead.

bomb-pong-online.intro: Bomb Pong Online is a timing game where you hit a bomb back toward your opponent. You can practice against bots, play a friend on the same device, join a private room, or compete in Ranked matches.
tips: Practice against the bots first to learn when the bomb reaches your side before you try a live opponent.
Watch the bomb's path rather than reacting late, since a well-timed hit is what sends it back toward your opponent.
Keep your input steady and avoid mashing the button, because a single well-timed press works better than repeated presses.
Expect the action to speed up and get more chaotic as rallies continue, so stay focused and reset your attention after each hit.
If you play local two-player, agree on a fixed side and control key with your partner so you do not hit the wrong key during a fast rally.
faq: What is the goal of Bomb Pong Online?
Your goal is to hit the bomb at the right moment so it flies back toward your opponent. Keep the rally going until your opponent cannot return it.
Which controls do I use on desktop?
Press A or click the left mouse button to hit the bomb. In local two-player mode, Player 1 uses A and Player 2 uses L.

only-up-parkour-2.intro: Only Up Parkour 2 is an arcade climbing game where you guide a character up a vertical labyrinth toward a height of 500 meters. You dodge obstacles, time your jumps, and keep climbing as the challenges grow.
tips: Watch the next platform before you jump so you can plan the landing instead of reacting at the last moment.
Use short, controlled jumps when you are close to an edge, since overshooting is a common way to fall.
Pause your movement briefly on stable ground to check the layout above you before committing to a long climb.
Expect the jumping platforms and new obstacles that appear in later levels to need slower, more careful timing.
If you fall, try to notice where you misjudged the jump and adjust your approach on the next attempt rather than rushing.
faq: What is the goal of Only Up Parkour 2?
The goal is to climb the vertical labyrinth and conquer heights of 500 meters while avoiding obstacles and falling down.
What are the controls?
Use W, A, S, and D to move and the Space bar to jump.

slime-heroes.intro: Slime Heroes is a top-down survival arcade game where you pick a slime hero, fight waves of enemies, and build your abilities with upgrade cards. You can play alone or with up to three friends in online co-op.
tips: Keep moving. Enemies come in waves, so staying in open space and using dash to slip out of crowds helps you last longer.
Pick upgrade cards that work together rather than grabbing whatever is offered. Combining abilities is what makes a run strong.
Open artifact chests whenever you can, since they are one of the main ways each run changes and gets stronger.
Auto-aim is on by default and is a good choice while you learn. Switch to manual aiming with Shift only when you need to hit a specific target.
In co-op, spread out a little so you cover more of the screen and do not all get caught by the same wave.
faq: What is the goal of Slime Heroes?
Survive as long as you can by defeating enemy waves, collecting experience, and building stronger ability combinations. Each run gets tougher as the battles grow more challenging.
How do I attack enemies?
Attacks use auto-aim by default. Press Shift to switch to manual aiming, then left-click to aim at the cursor, or right-click to return to auto-aim.

warfare-area-3.intro: Warfare Area 3 is a 3D first person shooter where you explore an enemy base and take down all the guards. You shoot enemies, collect first aid kits, and spend earned money on better armor and guns.
tips: Use the pickups you find, such as first aid kits, when your health is getting low rather than waiting until you are in a firefight.
Reload with R during a quiet moment, not in the middle of a fight, so you are not caught with an empty weapon.
Move with the arrow keys or W A S D and use the mouse to aim, keeping the target in view as you strafe.
Explore carefully and note where guards are positioned so you can plan which area to clear next.
Spend the money you earn on armor or guns, choosing the upgrade that matches how you are losing health or struggling to hit targets.
faq: What is the goal of Warfare Area 3?
Explore the enemy base and take down all the guards in the area. Shooting enemies is the main way to progress.
How do I aim and shoot on a computer?
Use the mouse to turn and aim, and click to shoot. Press L to lock the pointer if you need to keep your aim steady.

cooking-in-the-city-of-winds.intro: Cook sweet dishes for a culinary festival in the Windy City, including smooth pudding, tapioca bubble tea and a marmalade dessert. Your dish should taste good and look elegant to win.
tips: Start with a recipe from the Windy City cookbook you feel comfortable with, then move on to the more unusual ingredients once you know the steps.
Judge your dish on both taste and looks, since the description says it must be beautiful as well as tasty. Leave some time for decoration rather than rushing to finish.
Keep the decoration simple and balanced. An elegant, uncluttered arrangement is a better goal than adding as many decorations as possible.
Try each of the three dishes, because each one trains a different skill and you may find one that suits your sweet tooth best.
When you are happy with the result, save it as a PNG image so you can keep a copy of your creation.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
You cook dishes from the Windy City cookbook for the culinary festival, aiming for a dish that is both tasty and beautifully decorated. Victory is the reward for a successful result.
Which dishes can I make?
The game mentions smooth pudding, tapioca bubble tea and the Hocus-Pocus marmalade dessert. Each one is a sweet recipe from the festival.

juice-tycoon.intro: Juice Tycoon is an arcade idle game where you harvest fruit, blend it into drinks, and serve customers to grow your juice business. Your earnings go back into new fruit types, faster machines, and staff.
tips: Move between harvesting, blending, and cashing out in a loop so your fruit never sits idle while machines are running.
Spend early profits on faster machines first, since processing speed determines how quickly your money grows.
Keep an eye on which fruit types you have unlocked and use the ones that move your stock fastest.
Hire staff once your income is steady, so the business keeps earning while you walk around the shop.
Check the glowing green areas before you walk over them, so you only step onto the spots you actually need to use.
faq: How do I move my character?
On desktop use WASD, the arrow keys, or click and drag with the mouse. On touch screens, touch and drag anywhere to use the virtual joystick.
How do I harvest, blend, or cash out?
Walk into the glowing green area of the object you want to use. Harvesting, blending, and cashing out all work this way.

funny-ear-surgery.intro: Funny Ear Surgery puts you in the role of an ear doctor treating a patient with ear problems. Work through each step calmly and enjoy the playful hospital setting.
tips: Take your time with each step, since the game encourages patience rather than speed.
Look at the whole patient before choosing a tool so you understand what the problem is.
Click or tap items one at a time and check the result before moving on to the next tool.
If you make a mistake, pause and look at the current state of the patient before trying again.
Use the buttons on screen to move between stages, and keep an eye on the patient's reactions for hints.
faq: What is the goal of Funny Ear Surgery?
You play as an ear doctor and help a patient get rid of her ear problems. Each treatment step is aimed at fixing the issue.
How do I control the game on a computer?
Use the mouse to click items, tools, and buttons to interact with the patient and the scene.

block-blast.intro: Block Blast is a block puzzle where you place pieces on the board to complete horizontal or vertical lines. Clearing lines opens up space and raises your score.
tips: Keep the board as flat as possible by avoiding tall stacks in one area, since uneven piles leave fewer places to fit new pieces.
Look at the pieces you have before placing one, and choose the spot that keeps the most room for the next pieces.
Aim to fill rows and columns that are already nearly complete so that a single placement clears several lines at once.
Avoid leaving small isolated gaps that only one shape can fill, because those gaps are easy to get stuck with.
When you have a choice, prefer moves that keep open space in the middle of the board, where lines are easier to finish.
faq: What is the goal of Block Blast?
The goal is to match and remove as many blocks as possible by completing lines on the board. The more lines you clear, the higher your score.
How do I place a block?
Use your mouse to drag the block onto the board, or use your finger on a touch device. Arrange blocks so they form complete horizontal or vertical lines.

supercar-battle-arena.intro: Supercar Battle Arena is a 3D bumper car battle where you steer modified cars, ram rivals off the map, or blow them up with rockets. Earn coins in each match to unlock stronger vehicles from your garage.
tips: Use rockets when an opponent is lined up ahead of you, and ram when they are close and you have the speed to push them out.
Learn the double-tap dash early. A quick dash or mid-air move can help you dodge an incoming car or line up a hit.
Keep an eye on your speed before you ram. Hitting an enemy at high speed is what pushes them off the map, so build momentum first.
Spend your coins on a stronger car in the garage as soon as you can afford one, since more powerful vehicles can change how you fight.
Use jumping to reposition yourself, not just to escape. Landing behind or beside an opponent gives you a better angle for a push or a rocket.
faq: What is the main goal of Supercar Battle Arena?
Your goal is to be the last car standing by destroying your opponents. You can do this with rockets or by ramming them off the arena.
How do I earn coins and what do I use them for?
You earn coins as you eliminate enemies during a match. You can spend them in the garage menu to buy stronger battle cars.

draw-save-puzzle.intro: Draw Save Puzzle asks you to protect Stickman from swords, bullets, bombs and other dangers using a single drawn line. Several solutions can work, so you can try different ideas.
tips: Study where each threat comes from and which way it travels before you draw anything. Blocking the path is easier than reacting once it reaches Stickman.
Plan your single continuous line in your head first. Since you cannot lift the pen, a clear plan prevents you from running out of room mid-stroke.
Keep your line away from Stickman himself. A line that touches or harms him fails the level even if it blocks the threat.
If one drawing does not work, try a completely different shape, such as a curved cover instead of a flat wall. There can be more than one answer to each level.
Watch how the physics system moves your drawing after it is placed. Objects may shift or fall, so leave some margin rather than drawing something that only just works.
faq: How many lines can I draw in each level?
You draw only one continuous line to complete the level task. You cannot split it into separate strokes.
Is there only one correct answer to each level?
No. The game says there can be more than one answer, and you can draw any shape that solves the challenge.

johnny-trigger-3d-online.intro: Johnny Trigger 3D Online is a 3D shooting game where you control the character with one hand and use guns and weapons to take down enemies. Each game is played with mouse clicks or screen taps.
tips: Aim carefully before you fire, since the game rewards hitting enemies with a single bullet.
Save your ammo by waiting for a clear shot instead of firing at every enemy you see.
Keep track of how many bullets you have left so you are not caught with an empty gun during a fight.
Practice clicking or tapping at a steady pace to get a feel for how accurate your shots are.
Use the weapons you pick up on your adventure, because different guns may suit different situations.
faq: What is the main goal of Johnny Trigger 3D Online?
You move through the adventure shooting and fighting enemies with your guns and weapons. The game encourages you to defeat as many enemies as possible.
How do I control the character?
The game is played with one hand, using mouse clicks or taps on the screen. Click or tap to shoot at enemies.

mustang-city-driver-2024.intro: Mustang City Driver 2024 is a 3D driving game set in a neon-lit city at night. Drive, customize your car, and complete the game's tasks to get affluent.
tips: Avoid hitting pedestrians if you want to keep police pursuits away, since striking them is what triggers a chase.
Hold G for slow motion when you need extra time to line up a turn or avoid traffic.
Save Boost (F) for straightaways or escapes instead of spending it early, so it is ready when you need a burst of speed.
Use Space for the handbrake together with A or D to take sharp corners more tightly.
Press L to switch your lights on or off, and use the mouse to rotate the camera so you can check your surroundings at night.
faq: How do I get affluent in this game?
You must accomplish all of the game's tasks to get affluent, so work through the tasks as you explore the city.
What triggers police pursuits?
Police pursuits start when you strike pedestrians, so driving carefully around people helps you avoid them.

monster-dinosaur-rampage-city-attack.intro: Monster Dinosaur Rampage: City Attack is a 3D action game where you play a dinosaur that rampages through a modern city. You move with WASD, attack with J, and dodge military fire while you destroy the city.
tips: Keep moving with WASD instead of standing still, since the military forces shoot at you and staying in one spot makes you an easy target.
Watch for incoming bullets and dodge them before you start attacking, so your health lasts through the fight.
Use the J attack when enemies are close, and reposition between attacks so you are not surrounded.
Clear the military forces you can reach first, because they are the main threat to your dinosaur.
Pay attention to the open areas of the city and plan your route so you can keep rampaging without getting trapped.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
You play as a dinosaur created from evil scientists' experiments and destroy the city for revenge while avoiding military attacks.
What do the controls do?
WASD moves your dinosaur around the city, and J performs an attack.

gt-cars-super-racing.intro: GT Cars Super Racing is a top-down arcade racer inspired by 1980s arcade games. You steer through 21 circuits, keep your speed up, and save the turbo for well-timed boosts.
tips: Learn each circuit's corners before you push hard, since precise car control rewards smooth steering over frantic corrections.
Hold a steady speed through turns rather than braking hard and accelerating again, which costs time on every corner.
Save your turbo for straights or a clear exit from a corner so the boost adds the most distance.
Watch for the surprises hidden on the circuits and pay attention to the track ahead so you can react early.
Use the pause key to take a short break and reset your focus if a circuit starts to feel overwhelming.
faq: What is the goal of GT Cars Super Racing?
Race around the 21 circuits while maintaining good speed and using your turbo strategically to get ahead.
How do I steer the car?
Use the Left and Right keys to steer. The car responds to precise input, so small, controlled movements work better than sudden turns.

noob-slingshot-monsters.intro: Noob Slingshot: Monsters is a physics slingshot puzzler where you launch Noob at block towers hiding monsters. Each of its 50 levels rewards careful aiming and efficient shots.
tips: Before you pull back, follow the dotted line and look for the lowest or most connected block in the tower, since one well-placed hit there can bring the whole structure down.
Save TNT crates for the moment when the monsters are clustered together or sheltered by blocks you need removed, because a chain reaction set off too early may leave the last monster safe.
Use glass for quick, light touches and aim harder shots at wood and stone, since stone needs two hits before it falls.
Since your shots are limited, try to plan a shot that breaks several blocks at once rather than taking small, scattered hits.
Keep an eye out for hidden bonus cards in each level, as they give extra shots when a stage is getting tough.
faq: How do I aim and launch Noob?
Pull the slingshot band back with one finger and follow the dotted aiming line to plan the trajectory before you release.
What is the best way to score points?
Points come from each broken block, so a clean shot that causes a big collapse usually scores more than many small hits.

zombiracer-speed-on-earth.intro: Zombiracer: Speed On Earth is a racing game set on a track during a zombie apocalypse. You merge vehicles and fight zombies while you race, using mouse clicks or taps to play.
tips: Merge matching vehicle parts whenever you can, since combining the same parts is how you raise your combat power.
Compare the special attributes of each vehicle before you commit to one, so you know which strengths suit your run.
Pay attention to the abilities each vehicle offers and use them at the moments when zombies are closest.
Keep your clicks or taps steady and deliberate, so your choices on the track stay under control as the zombies come at you.
Try the track a few times to learn where zombies gather and which merges are worth making before you push for a faster run.
faq: What is the goal of Zombiracer: Speed On Earth?
You race along the track while fighting zombies, and you use merged vehicles to get through the challenge.
How do I boost my vehicles' combat power?
Merge the same vehicle parts together, since combining matching parts is what raises your combat power.

find-the-rule.intro: Find the Rule is a number puzzle game where you study a sequence, work out the hidden pattern, and pick the correct number to replace the question mark. You can play through infinite levels or take on the Daily Challenge.
tips: Check how the numbers change from one step to the next, looking first for a simple addition, subtraction, or multiplication pattern.
Test your idea against every number in the sequence, not just the first two. A rule that fits only part of the sequence is usually wrong.
Compare the four options before committing. Plausible choices are often built around one common mistake, so ask which option breaks the rule you found.
On PC, use keys 1 to 4 to answer quickly once you have found the pattern, since the Daily Challenge rewards speed.
In Level Mode, use a hint or skip a tough level when you are stuck instead of guessing, so you can keep moving forward.
faq: What do I have to do in each puzzle?
Look at the sequence of numbers, identify the rule that connects them, and choose the option that correctly replaces the question mark.
How does the Daily Challenge work?
You complete 10 daily puzzles, try to beat your average time, and can compare your speed percentile with players around the world.

uphill-racer2.intro: Uphill Racer2 is a physics-based driving game where you climb hilly, rough terrain without flipping your car. Your goal is to go as far as possible while collecting coins along the way.
tips: Ease off the accelerator on steep climbs so the car keeps its grip instead of tipping backward.
Use brake or reverse briefly when landing after a steep downhill to keep the car level before you speed up again.
Pick up coins when it is safe to do so, but do not risk a flip just to grab one.
Watch how the car tilts on bumps and adjust your speed before the terrain changes, not after.
Expect the stretches to get harder as you travel further, so aim to beat your own best distance rather than rushing early.
faq: What is the main goal of Uphill Racer2?
Reach the longest distance you can across the hilly terrain without flipping your car. Collecting coins along the way is part of the challenge.
How do I control the car?
Press the right arrow key to accelerate and the left arrow key to brake or reverse. On-screen buttons can be used in place of the keys.

graveyard-wars-two-player.intro: Graveyard Wars is a two player race for flying pumpkins. Team up with a friend, pick the Mummy or the Pumpkin King, and be the fastest to collect the pumpkins.
tips: Agree on a character with your friend before you start, since you each pick either the Mummy or the Pumpkin King.
Each player moves with their own keys: WASD or the Arrow Keys. Make sure you are not both using the same set.
Grab the candy as you go to earn coins, since they add to your progress in the game.
Watch for balloons and plan a route to the treasure chest so you can bring them in without wasting time.
Keep track of how many pumpkins you have, because the first player to collect 10 wins the race.
faq: What is the goal of Graveyard Wars?
The goal is to collect pumpkins faster than your opponent. The player who collects 10 pumpkins first wins.
How do I move my character?
Player one can use the WASD keys and player two can use the Arrow Keys. Each player uses their own set of keys.

cowboys-duel.intro: Cowboys Duel is a Wild West action game where timing and quick reactions decide each shot. You can play solo missions or challenge a friend in a duel. Shoot at the right moment and be the first to three wins.
tips: Keep your eyes on the clock and wait for the 12 position before clicking to shoot. Firing early costs you the round, so patience matters more than speed.
Settle your rhythm by watching a few full turns of the clock before you act. A steady reading of the timing helps you avoid early shots.
When arrows appear, click them before time runs out and check that each one points in the direction shown. Acting early leaves you more time to focus on the next step.
Work toward the 20-target goal by staying accurate rather than rushing. Missed timing wastes the time you need to keep scoring.
In a duel, the first player to reach 3 wins takes the match, so stay calm after a lost round and focus on the next clock cycle.
faq: What is the goal of Cowboys Duel?
Your goal is to shoot at the right moment, hit 20 targets before time runs out, and in duels be the first to score 3 wins. The game rewards accurate timing and quick reflexes.
What happens if I shoot too early?
If you shoot before the clock reaches 12, you lose. Waiting for the correct moment is the most important habit to build.
