counter-craft-3-zombies.intro: Counter Craft 3 Zombies is a 3D shooter set in a Minecraft-style world. You switch between three weapons to shoot a set number of zombies per level while avoiding enemy soldiers and explosives.
tips: Learn which of your three weapons works best at different distances, and swap with the mouse wheel before enemies get close.
Keep moving with WASD instead of standing still, so zombies and soldiers have a harder time lining up on you.
Reload with R during quieter moments rather than in the middle of a crowd, so you are not left empty-handed.
Watch for explosives and keep your distance from them, since they can hurt you as well as enemies nearby.
Use Space to jump and get a quick view of where the zombies and soldiers are coming from before you commit to a fight.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You need to shoot the given number of zombies to complete the level. You also have to survive the enemy soldiers and explosives in the level.
How do I change weapons?
Scroll the mouse wheel to switch between the three weapon types. Left mouse button fires the weapon you have equipped.

tank-sniper-3d.intro: Tank Sniper 3D is a 3D shooting game where you aim from behind cover and take one shot at a time. Stay hidden, strike with surprise, and dodge incoming fire.
tips: Stay behind cover until you have a clear shot, since the game is built around hiding and then striking.
Hold to aim for a while before you release, so you can line up your shot carefully instead of rushing it.
After each shot, move back to cover quickly to avoid the enemy fire coming your way.
Pay attention to where enemy shots are coming from, so you know when it is safe to pop out and fire.
Focus on hitting targets efficiently rather than firing fast, because each shot is a single strike.
faq: How do I aim and shoot?
Hold the mouse or press button to aim, then release to fire. Your aim is set while you hold, so take your time before letting go.
How do I score points or win?
The goal is to hit as many targets as you can while you survive. Each target you hit moves you closer to a higher result.

idle-pop-merge.intro: Idle Pop Merge is a puzzle game where you merge identical cartoon fighters into stronger characters on a 3x3 grid. Build your team to conquer 120 enemies across arenas.
tips: Merge identical fighters as soon as you can, since each merge unlocks a stronger character and moves you toward the 32 warriors in the roster.
Think about where you place each fighter on the 3x3 grid, because position affects how your team performs in battle.
Tap during fights to boost attack speed when enemies are taking a long time to defeat.
Work through the single arena challenges before taking on double and triple arena battles, so your team has time to grow.
Keep a steady pace through the 120 enemies rather than rushing, since each victory unlocks new fighters to add to your team.
faq: What is the main goal of Idle Pop Merge?
The goal is to merge identical fighters into new, more powerful characters and use your team to defeat 120 enemies across several arenas.
How do I merge fighters?
Drag and drop a fighter into an available slot on the grid next to an identical one to combine them into a new form.

smashers-io.intro: Smashers.io is an arena action game where you swing a huge hammer to smash rival fighters. Stay on your feet and be the last fighter standing to win.
tips: Keep sliding your fighter around the arena instead of standing still, since you can't smash enemies or dodge hits from a stopped position.
Watch where opponents are heading and keep your distance from those who are close to you, because the main goal is not to get hit.
Pick your smashes carefully and go after fighters who are isolated or stuck near the edges rather than crowding into a group.
Use the early battles to learn how your hammer reaches enemies and how far you need to move to avoid their swings.
Expect the battles to get harder and more powerful after each win, so stay alert and adjust your approach as the opponents change.
faq: How do I move my fighter?
You move by sliding. Slide in the direction you want to go to reposition your fighter around the arena.
What is the goal of the game?
Smash other fighters with your hammer, avoid getting hit yourself, and be the last io survivor in the arena.

rumbox-designer.intro: Rumbox Designer is a calm 3D decorating game where you build cozy mini-rooms in a box. Arrange furniture and decor, then complete each room to earn rewards and unlock new themes.
tips: Place your largest furniture piece first, since it sets the layout and makes it easier to fit smaller items around it.
Move each object a few times before settling on it. Small shifts often change how neat and balanced the scene looks.
If an item makes the room feel crowded or off, remove it right away and try a different piece instead of forcing it to fit.
Step back and look at the whole mini-scene before finishing. A harmonious room should feel complete, not just tidy in one corner.
Keep collecting rumboxes from different furniture, decor and room details, because new sets are what unlock fresh room themes.
faq: What is the goal of Rumbox Designer?
The goal is to assemble a harmonious mini-scene by arranging furniture and decor in a room. Once the room is complete, you receive a reward.
How do I place and move items in a room?
Place objects in the room and move them until the composition looks neat and cozy. You can remove any item and try another one if it does not fit.

snake-brawl-merge-arena.intro: Snake Brawl: Merge Arena is an arcade snake game where you grow by merging numbered segments and bite rival snakes to steal their length. Steer through the arena, pick your fights, and race the timer to finish each round.
tips: Look at the ring color before you bite or pass another snake: a green ring means you can safely take it on, while a red ring means it is bigger than your head and you should steer away.
Chase orbs that match the number on your segments first, since merging them is the fastest way to grow stronger.
Pick off smaller snakes near the edges of the arena rather than diving into crowded areas where bigger snakes can corner you.
Keep an eye on the timer and count how many snakes you still need to defeat, so you can decide whether to target the boss or clear smaller rivals.
In Power Smash, tap steadily and quickly from the start, since the bonus coins depend on how fast you tap.
faq: What is the goal of each round?
Defeat the target number of snakes or the boss before the timer runs out. Then you can tap in the Power Smash bonus for coins.
How do I steer my snake?
Drag anywhere on the screen, and the snake will follow your direction.

math-driving-test.intro: Math Driving Test is a 3D driving game where you collect the requested number of unit cubes as fast as you can. Each level has to be completed with a medal to pass it.
tips: Read the requested cube count before you start moving, then plan a route that collects the needed cubes in one sweep instead of doubling back.
Keep track of your collisions. Hitting a tree, building, or fence three times fails the game, so it is safer to take slightly wider turns near obstacles.
Ease off the accelerator before sharp corners. Steering with control keeps you on course and avoids the wall and fence hits that cost you attempts.
Since medals depend on speed, aim for clean, direct lines between cubes rather than stopping to adjust. Replaying a level once you know the route can help you earn a better medal.
Use the drift mechanic only when it helps you turn quickly toward your next cube, so you do not lose speed or drift into an obstacle.
faq: What is the goal of Math Driving Test?
Drive and grab objects to collect the requested amount of unit cubes as quickly as possible. You need to earn a medal to pass each level.
How do I control the car?
Use the arrow keys or WASD to accelerate and steer. On touch screens, the arrow buttons on screen do the same job.

moto-x3m-pool-party.intro: Moto X3M Pool Party is a bike racing and stunt game set across challenge levels. Use the arrow keys to ride, balance and push through each course at high speed.
tips: Keep your speed steady through the early part of each level so you learn the track before pushing harder.
Pay attention to how your bike lands after jumps, since a bad landing is the most common way to lose progress.
Use short, controlled inputs with the arrow keys rather than holding a key down, which can make the bike tip over.
Replay levels you struggled with and note where the hazards appear, so you can prepare your timing on the next attempt.
Stay calm after a crash and restart quickly; repeated short runs usually teach you more than long, frustrated ones.
faq: What is the goal of Moto X3M Pool Party?
The goal is to get your bike through each challenge level at high speed without crashing. Progress through the different levels as you complete them.
Which keys control the bike?
The game is played with the arrow keys. Use them to accelerate, brake and balance the bike during jumps and stunts.

crashy-chasy.intro: Crashy Chasy is an arcade driving game about drifting through city streets, smashing rival cars, and staying ahead of cops, taxis, and other opponents. Tap or click the left or right side of the screen to control your car.
tips: Watch the road ahead rather than your car, so you can start turning before traffic and opponents reach you.
Use the left and right sides of the screen in small, steady taps instead of holding them down, which keeps your car easier to control while drifting.
Decide early whether you want to drift for thrill or crash into rivals, since both are part of the game and you can switch between them as the chase develops.
Keep track of the cops and taxis, as they are the main threats to avoid, and steer away from them before you get boxed in.
Stay in motion and look for open lanes, because survival is one of the game's main goals and standing still makes you an easy target.
faq: How do I start playing Crashy Chasy?
Click or tap anywhere on the screen to start the game. Then use the left or right side of the screen to control your car.
How do I steer my car?
Tap or click the left side of the screen to move left and the right side to move right. Short, controlled taps help you drift without losing track of the road.

water-city-racers.intro: Water City Racers is a 3D car racing game with several game modes and sports cars. You earn diamonds by racing other cars and by exploding vehicles in traffic.
tips: Save your NOS boost for straights or the moments right after a corner, when you can use it to pull ahead rather than spend it while you are still turning.
Use the handbrake (Space) to take sharp turns more tightly, but ease off it before you straighten out so you do not lose speed.
Press R to reset your car's position if it flips or gets stuck, so you do not waste time on the rest of the run.
Tap T to look back when a rival is close behind, so you can judge whether to block, hold your line, or speed up.
If you want diamonds from traffic, look for vehicles that are close to your path and hit them at speed, then keep moving so you are not caught in the blast.
faq: How do I steer and move my car?
Use W, A, S and D to drive, accelerate, brake and steer. Space is the handbrake for sharper turns.
How do I get more speed?
Press Shift to use NOS, the boost for your car. Use it when the road is clear so it gives you the biggest advantage.

dress-up-bean.intro: Dress Up Bean is a dress-up game where you build your own avatar from a large selection of fashion items. Clicking to play is all you need to get started.
tips: Pick a hairstyle and base look first, then layer clothes and makeup around it so the outfit stays balanced.
Try a few different combinations before settling on one, since the game offers hundreds of items to compare.
Keep your color choices consistent across clothing, makeup, and accessories to make the final look feel cohesive.
Check the latest and most fashionable options first if you want a trendy result, as the game highlights these styles.
Use the outfit preview to look at your avatar from every angle before you finish, so you catch any clashing pieces.
faq: How do I start playing Dress Up Bean?
Click to play and the avatar builder opens so you can begin choosing items right away.
What can I customize on my avatar?
You can change clothes, hairstyles, makeup, and suits, with hundreds of fashion items to choose from.

telekinetic-pumpkin.intro: Telekinetic Pumpkin is an arcade survival game where you play as a pumpkin that teleports and moves objects with its mind. Smash drones, collect power-ups, and pick upgrades to last as long as you can.
tips: Use teleporting to escape danger quickly, and double-click somewhere open before enemies close in around you.
Drag boxes and other objects into drones to clear threats, rather than only relying on your own movement.
Keep an eye out for power-ups and grab them when it is safe, since they help you stay alive longer.
Plan ahead for the 35-second upgrade timer so you are not caught in a bad position when a new upgrade or ability becomes available.
Choose upgrades based on what is causing you the most trouble in your current run, such as crowded areas or fast enemies.
faq: What is the goal of Telekinetic Pumpkin?
The goal is to survive as long as possible while destroying drones and collecting power-ups. Your pumpkin gets stronger through the upgrades you select.
How do I teleport?
Double-click on a location to teleport there. Use this to reposition quickly when enemies or drones get too close.

koenigsegg-jesko-absolut-slide.intro: Koenigsegg Jesko Absolut Slide is a sliding puzzle built around a Koenigsegg car picture. You rebuild the image by moving its pieces, with three grid sizes to choose from.
tips: Start with the 3x3 mode to learn how the pieces slide before you try the larger grids.
Study the full picture first and note the car's outline, colors, and background so you know where each section belongs.
Solve the outer edges of the picture first, then work inward. A finished border gives you fixed points to build from.
Move one piece at a time and check each placement before continuing, so you do not undo good progress.
In the 5x5 mode, focus on one row or column at a time, completing it fully before starting the next.
faq: How do I play Koenigsegg Jesko Absolut Slide?
Use your mouse to slide the pieces of the car picture into their correct positions.
How many modes does the game have?
There are three modes: 3x3 pieces, 4x4 pieces, and 5x5 pieces. Each one uses a larger grid than the last.

hotbath-simulator.intro: Hotbath Simulator is an arcade management game where you run a bathhouse with a cat. You collect water, prepare tubs, serve guests, and spend your earnings on upgrades and expansions.
tips: Collect hot and cold water early, since every bath depends on it. Keep your cat moving between the water sources and the tubs so nothing sits empty.
Stand near an object long enough to fill its progress bar before you leave. Walking away early wastes the time you already spent.
Watch which guests are waiting and prepare their tubs first. Keeping visitors happy is what brings in money.
Spend your first earnings on the upgrades that speed up your routine, such as new bathtubs. Faster baths let you serve more guests.
Plan expansions one step at a time. Worker cats and the tea shop can take jobs off your hands once your income is steady.
faq: How do I move the cat?
With a mouse, click and drag in the direction you want the cat to go. On touch screens, touch and drag in any direction.
How do I perform an action like filling a tub?
Stand near the interactive object and stay there until its progress bar fills. The action completes once the bar is full.

mind-games-for-2-3-4-player.intro: Mind Games for 2 3 4 Player is a collection of 27 multiplayer games, from Tic Tac Toe and Ludo to mancala and pop-it. You can play with two, three, or four players, sharing one keyboard or taking turns with the mouse.
tips: Before a match starts, check which keys belong to your player number, since each player has its own set of controls.
Ask everyone at the table to learn their keys during the first round so that turns move quickly.
If you are new to a game, play a quick round first to see how turns and moves work before trying to win.
Try the brain and matching games with younger players, as they are made for kids and are a good way to build focus.
When playing Tic Tac Toe or mancala, think about your opponent's next move, not only your own, to avoid giving them an easy win.
faq: How many players can play at once?
Most games can be played by 2, 3, or 4 players. Check the game's menu to see which player counts are available for the one you choose.
Can players take turns with the mouse instead of the keyboard?
Yes, you can use the mouse and left-click in turn. This is an option when several people share one computer.

big-smash.intro: Big Smash is a physics puzzle where you fire tennis balls from a cannon at towers of cubes. Each tower has to be toppled, and you win by finding the block that holds the structure up.
tips: Before you shoot, study the whole tower and look for the cube that the others seem to rest on. Hitting that one will usually bring down more than hitting the top.
Pay attention to the material of each cube, since stone, wood, ice, jelly, and cardboard all react differently when struck. Aim for the weaker or more load-bearing pieces when you can.
Use the drag-and-release aim to test small angles first. A short pull often shows you how the tower reacts before you commit to a stronger shot.
Watch for TNT blocks and think about where their blast will reach. They can help you clear a tower quickly if they sit near the key supports.
If a tower refuses to fall, try a different target instead of firing at the same spot again. Changing the point of impact often works better than more force.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You need to topple the whole tower of cubes, not just blast everything. Figuring out which cube is critical to the structure is the key to finishing each level.
How do I aim and fire the cannon?
On a computer, click and hold, drag to pull back and aim, then release to fire. On a phone or tablet, tap and drag to aim, then lift your finger to fire.

merge-happy-planets.intro: Merge Happy Planets! is a puzzle game where you throw planets and combine them as they collide. Watch out for meteor showers and mad planets while you aim for a high score.
tips: Before each throw, look at where matching planets sit on the board and aim for spots that let them meet and merge.
Keep an eye out for meteor showers and mad planets, and plan your next throws so they don't catch you off guard.
Save your Big Bang Bombs, Rainbow Planets and Black Holes for moments when the board gets crowded or a run starts to go wrong.
Take a short moment to plan each throw instead of clicking quickly, since a single careless throw can block future merges.
Play a few rounds to learn how planets behave when they merge, then try to beat your own best result.
faq: How do I control the planets?
You use the mouse. Click to throw planets, and they will move toward the spot you chose.
What should I watch out for?
Meteor showers and mad planets can disrupt your board, so stay alert for them and adjust your plan when they appear.

car-driving-simulator-3d.intro: Car Driving Simulator 3D is a racing game where you drive a BMW sports car through city roads, weaving past traffic on a range of challenging routes. Focus on smooth control and steady speed to get the most out of each run.
tips: Start by driving slowly through a few sections of the city to learn how the car responds to keyboard input before you try to go fast.
Keep an eye out for the city traffic cars and plan your line early so you can steer around them without sudden swerves.
Take corners at a controlled speed; braking before a turn usually keeps the car stable better than braking in the middle of it.
Pay attention to the route ahead rather than only the car in front of you, since challenging roads often change direction quickly.
Play several rounds in a row to memorize where the tougher stretches are, then aim to drive those parts more cleanly each time.
faq: How do I control the car?
The game uses keyboard controls, so use the keys listed in the in-game instructions to steer, accelerate and brake. Practise on open roads first to get a feel for the handling.
What is the goal of the game?
The goal is to drive your BMW around the city and complete the challenging routes while avoiding the traffic cars. Your racing skill is tested as you move through the city roads.

stickman-merge-2.intro: Stickman Merge 2 is a shooting game where you combine weapons to build stronger guns, then test them at a shooting range against enemy stickmen. Upgrade your pistol and collect bonuses as you go.
tips: Think about which weapon types work well together before you combine them, since the goal is to create more powerful cannons.
Collect the bonuses you pass, because they can help you build stronger weapons for the harder fights ahead.
Upgrade your pistol regularly so you are not relying only on your starting weapon.
Try a few different weapon combinations rather than sticking with the first one you make, and note which ones perform best against enemies.
Keep your aim steady and fire in short bursts so you can see how each new weapon handles before committing to the next upgrade.
faq: What is the main goal of Stickman Merge 2?
The goal is to combine different types of weapons to create more powerful guns, then use them to beat enemy stickmen at the shooting range.
How do I control the game?
On a computer you use the mouse. On touch screens you control the game with taps.

color-brain-test-games.intro: Color Brain Test Games is a colorful ring puzzle that spins in circles and is built to train your brain. Click to play and work through the spinning rings at your own pace.
tips: Before you act, look at how the colors line up across the rings so you can see the pattern you need to match.
Take a moment to watch the spinning rings through a full turn before committing to a move, since timing often matters in puzzles like this.
Focus on one ring at a time instead of trying to track every color at once, which keeps the puzzle manageable.
If you get stuck, step back and look at the whole circle again, because a fresh view often reveals the next step.
Play in short sessions to keep your focus sharp, especially since the game is meant to exercise your thinking.
faq: How do I start playing Color Brain Test Games?
Click to play, as the game's instructions say, and the puzzle will begin right away.
What is the goal of the game?

The game is a ring puzzle where you use colors and spinning circles to test and train your logic and brain. The description does not spell out a specific winning condition, so watch the on-screen prompts for details.

monster-slayer-merge-and-survive.intro: Monster Slayer: Merge & Survive is a puzzle game where you merge items on the lower grid to make weapons, potions, keys and coins, then use them to get through dungeon levels. Your merges directly decide how well your character copes with enemies.
tips: Merge weapon parts early and keep your strongest weapon in play, since weapons are what deal damage to enemies.
Keep a few potions ready to merge when your health drops, so you can recover without wasting a turn on the grid.
Save keys for chests when you can, because chests hold valuable loot that can strengthen your next levels.
Collect coin pouches steadily and spend them at the shop when you have a clear need, such as a missing item or more inventory space from a travel bag.
Before you move deeper, check which items you have ready for the enemies ahead so you are not caught with only the wrong tools.
faq: What is the main goal of Monster Slayer: Merge & Survive?
Your goal is to move your character through the dungeon level by level, using merged items to overcome challenges and defeat enemies as you go deeper.
How do I control the game?
Merge items by combining them on the merging grid in the lower part of the screen, and watch your character move through the dungeon in the upper part.

crosstile.intro: CrossTile is a relaxing word puzzle that mixes crossword solving with jigsaw-style placement. You drag letter fragments around the board and join the ones that belong together until the full crossword is complete.
tips: Read the theme at the top of each level before moving anything, since it tells you what kind of words to look for.
Start with fragments that clearly form a common word or ending, then build outward from those connected groups.
Pay attention to word intersections, where two words share a letter, because they often reveal where a fragment belongs.
Remember that connected pieces move as one group, so arrange loose fragments in open space before linking them to avoid tangling your board.
If you get stuck, use a hint rather than guessing at random, since the game has no timers or lives to penalize you.
faq: What is the goal of CrossTile?
The goal is to connect every letter fragment on the board so the full crossword is complete. Each level is finished once all the pieces have snapped together.
How do I connect letter fragments?
Drag a fragment next to a matching one. Correct connections snap into place automatically and form a larger group.

wall-of-danger-dash.intro: Wall Of Danger Dash is a side-scrolling 2D adventure where you play as Jack, who must cross traps and face monsters to rescue his friend Lily from Shadow Loomed. Move, jump, and fight your way through each challenge.
tips: Learn the jump timing early. Traps and monsters are the main threats, so practice short hops before committing to longer jumps over danger.
Keep moving steadily instead of rushing in. Pausing briefly to read where the traps and enemies sit can prevent many unnecessary deaths.
On Android, keep your thumbs on the on-screen buttons so you can react quickly. Moving and jumping in small, controlled bursts is easier than holding one direction for long stretches.
On PC, use the Left and Right Arrow keys for movement and the Up Arrow key to jump. Tapping the jump key at the right moment is often more reliable than holding it.
Deal with each enemy before pushing on. The goal is to defeat all the enemies, so clearing threats as you go helps you avoid being trapped between them later.
faq: What is the goal of Wall Of Danger Dash?
You play as Jack, trying to save his friend Lily from the monster Shadow Loomed. To do this, you must overcome the traps and defeat all the enemies along the way.
How do I move and jump on PC?
Use the Left Arrow and Right Arrow keys to move, and the Up Arrow key to jump.

grid-odyssey-nonograms.intro: Grid Odyssey: Nonograms is a logic puzzle where you uncover a hidden picture by filling squares that match the numbers along the edges of the grid. Each clue tells you how many squares to fill in a row or column.
tips: Start with the rows and columns that have the largest numbers, since long runs leave the fewest possible arrangements and often reveal several squares at once.
Look for clues that add up to nearly the full length of a line; these usually fix the position of most squares in that line.
Use the cross option to mark squares you know are empty, so you do not accidentally fill them and you can see your progress clearly.
Check each new square against both its row and its column before moving on, because one wrong fill can create conflicts elsewhere.
Work across the puzzle in small sections rather than guessing, and when you get stuck, look at a different row or column for a fresh clue.
faq: How do I place a mark on the grid?
Click or tap a square to place a mark. Use the buttons at the bottom to switch between filling squares and placing crosses.
What do the numbers on the edges mean?
Each number shows how many filled squares appear in a row or column, and consecutive numbers show separate groups of filled squares with gaps between them.

squid-stacky-maze.intro: Squid Stacky Maze is a puzzle-style maze game where you collect stacks, jump over them, and find the right path off the island. It has 30 levels to work through.
tips: Look at the whole maze before you move so you can spot the route that connects to the exit.
Collect the stacks along the way, since you need all of them to escape the island.
If a path leads to a dead end, step back early instead of pushing forward and losing time.
Keep track of how many stacks you are carrying, because the jumps depend on them.
Use your mouse or touchpad steadily and take short, careful moves on tricky sections.
faq: What is the goal of Squid Stacky Maze?
Your goal is to collect all the stacks on the island and use the right path to escape. Each level ends when you get out.
How do I control the character?
The game is played with a mouse or touchpad. Use it to choose your path and jump over the stacks you have collected.

paint-race.intro: Paint Race is a fast browser game where you jump through vibrant circles and avoid dark barriers across 50 levels. It tests both your speed and your accuracy.
tips: Use the jump input that feels most comfortable to you, whether that is click, tap, space or W, and stick with it so your timing stays consistent.
Watch the dark barriers ahead of you and time your jump before you reach them rather than reacting at the last moment.
Focus on accuracy first. Clearing the circles cleanly matters more than rushing, and speed will come as your timing improves.
If you keep failing at the same point, slow down and watch the pattern a few times before trying again.
Take short breaks between levels so you can stay sharp, since the game rewards precise timing over long sessions of mashing the jump input.
faq: What is the goal of Paint Race?
Your goal is to move through the vibrant circles while avoiding the dark barriers, progressing through all 50 levels.
What controls do I use to jump?
You can click, tap, press space or press W to jump.

little-city-merge.intro: Little City Merge is a relaxed building game where you grow a small town by merging matching buildings into bigger ones. Shops bring in coins, homes bring residents, and public buildings unlock more land as you work toward each city's goal.
tips: Keep an eye on your energy before each build, since every building costs energy and it refills slowly over time.
Merge identical buildings as soon as you can, because a higher-level shop earns more coins and a higher-level home brings more residents.
Build homes early so you have enough residents on hand when you want to merge public buildings.
Spend coins on Upgrades to earn more, build faster and get more energy, rather than saving them up.
Use the move and swap option to rearrange buildings when a lot is blocking a good merge, and use the trash bin to clear out buildings you no longer need.
faq: What is the goal of each city?
Grow your city and build a Public building of the level the city asks for. Once that goal is done, you can open World and move on to the next city.
How do I merge buildings?
Drag one building onto another of the same type and level, and they will combine into the next level. Public buildings also need enough residents before they can be merged.

sniper-clash-3d.intro: You play as a secret agent sniper who must infiltrate a desert area and seize a trophy relic from evil desert nomads. Aim carefully, take your shots, and search the level for hidden objects and secret weapons.
tips: Move with W, A, S and D, and use C to crouch and SPACE to jump so you can reposition quickly between shots.
Slow down before you take a shot. Sniping works best when you stop moving and line up your target first.
Explore the level thoroughly. Hidden objects and secret weapons can give you the edge you need to turn the fight around.
Keep an eye on the desert storm while you play, and plan your route so you are not caught out in the open when conditions get rough.
Use the palm trees and terrain as cover, and crouch when you need to stay out of sight between attacks.
faq: What is the main goal of Sniper Clash 3D?
Your goal is to infiltrate the area and seize the trophy relic from the evil desert nomads. Aim and shoot to eliminate the enemies in your way.
Which keys control the character?
Use W, A, S and D to move, C to crouch, and SPACE to jump.

stick-man-battle-fighting.intro: Stick Man Battle Fighting is a casual fighting game where you battle stickman enemies using different fighting styles. You choose a weapon and customize your hero before each fight.
tips: Try several fighting styles early on to see which one fits how you like to move and attack.
Pick a weapon that matches your chosen style, and switch it up if your current setup isn't working for you.
Pay attention to how each enemy moves so you can time your attacks instead of clicking or tapping randomly.
Take a moment to customize your hero before you start, so your look matches the way you plan to fight.
Since every move matters, slow down and make deliberate clicks or taps rather than rushing through each battle.
faq: How do I control my stickman?
You play by clicking the mouse or tapping the screen, which is the only control method listed for the game.
Does my choice of weapon affect the fight?
Yes, the game lets you choose a weapon, so picking one that suits your fighting style can change how you approach each battle.

streamer-simulator-phone-challenge.intro: Streamer Simulator: Phone Challenge! is an arcade game about flicking your phone with tricks to impress your audience. Earn likes, build combos, and unlock new phones as you go.
tips: Focus on finishing each trick cleanly, because only successful tricks earn likes.
Keep your combo going, since each trick in a row adds one more like to your reward.
Pay attention to how your viewers respond, as the likes you earn per trick depend on your audience.
Avoid letting the phone hit you without completing a combo, because that resets your combo counter.
Save up likes to unlock newer phones, and check the in-game phone screen to see your progress.
faq: How do I perform a trick?
Drag and hold the left mouse button or your finger across the screen to flick the phone with your foot.
How are likes calculated?
Each successful trick earns likes based on the number of viewers, and your combo adds one extra like per trick.

tennis-master.intro: Tennis Master is a sports game where you compete against the computer or a friend in 2 player mode. Collect power-ups and transformations as you play to get an edge over your opponent.
tips: Use the regular hit with X to keep rallies going, and save the smash with Z for a moment when your opponent is out of position.
Move with the arrow keys before each shot so you are set up to hit rather than reaching for the ball at the last second.
Watch where your opponent is standing before you choose a shot, and aim for the open side of the court.
Try to grab power-ups when they are within easy reach, instead of chasing them in the middle of a rally where you could lose the point.
If you are playing a friend, take turns trying different shots early on so you both learn how the power-ups and transformations affect the match.
faq: How do I move my player?
Player 1 moves with the arrow keys.
Which keys hit and smash the ball?
Player 1 hits the ball with X and smashes with Z.

screw-out-jam-puzzle.intro: Screw Out: Jam Puzzle is a nuts and bolts puzzle game with jam mazes across 1000 levels. You move through each maze using your mouse or your finger, and you can earn rewards and use boosters along the way.
tips: Look over the whole maze before you make your first move. Spotting the pieces that block others will save you from dead ends.
Work through the levels in order. Each one builds on the ideas of the last, so the early puzzles help with the harder ones later.
Save your boosters for levels where you are truly stuck. Using them on easy puzzles means you may have none left when a difficult one comes up.
If you stall, step back and try a different route instead of repeating the same moves. Trying something new often reveals a solution you missed.
Take a short break when your focus drops. Coming back with fresh eyes makes logic puzzles much easier to solve.
faq: What is the goal of Screw Out: Jam Puzzle?
The goal is to solve each nuts and bolts jam maze, working through 1000 levels. Each solved level moves you forward to the next challenge.
How do I control the game?
On a computer, use your mouse. On a phone or tablet, tap with your finger. The controls are simple, so most of the challenge is in the puzzles themselves.

jigrot.intro: JigRot is a relaxed jigsaw puzzler where you drag scattered pieces, snap them together, and merge clusters until the full picture appears. It is designed for calm play without time pressure.
tips: Start with the edge pieces and build a border first, since flat edges make the frame easier to see.
Group pieces by color or pattern before dragging them, so you can spot likely neighbors faster.
Work on one cluster at a time instead of spreading pieces across the screen, which keeps the picture easier to follow.
Check that edges line up before you release a piece, because matching edges snap together only when they align.
Take breaks between packs; the game is built for a relaxed pace, so there is no need to rush.
faq: What is the goal of JigRot?
The goal is to move the scattered pieces into place, snap them together, and merge clusters until the full picture locks in.
How do I move a piece on desktop?
Click and hold a piece or cluster, drag it to the spot you want, then release the mouse button to drop it.

ragdoll-rescue-physics-puzzle.intro: Ragdoll Rescue is a physics puzzle where you build a rescue setup to catch a ragdoll hero falling from a cliff. You place items and angle them so the hero bounces safely away from spikes and hazards.
tips: Before you start the simulation, check the path from the cliff edge to the ground and look for spikes or hazards along it.
Place a mattress or trampoline first near the landing zone, then add ramps or fans to steer the bounce toward it.
Use the rotate controls or Q and E keys to angle items before you place them, since small angle changes can redirect the hero a lot.
Run the simulation with Spacebar, watch the result, then pause and adjust only the item that caused the problem.
Number keys 1 to 9 let you select palette items quickly, which helps when you are testing several builds in a row.
faq: What is the goal of Ragdoll Rescue?
The goal is to build a rescue contraption that bounces the ragdoll hero to a safe landing while keeping as much health as possible.
How do I start the physics so the hero falls?
Press the Spacebar to start or resume the simulation. You can use it again to pause and adjust your setup.

mini-boxing.intro: Mini Boxing puts you in the gloves of Nick-Joe as he works through the Boxer Championship Tournament. Each of the six opponents fights in their own style, so learning their patterns is the key to winning.
tips: Watch each opponent for a few rounds before committing to a big attack, since every boxer has a different fighting style.
Use the light jab (Z) to probe for openings and keep pressure on, then follow up with the medium straight punch (X) when your timing is right.
Save the super heavy uppercut (C) for moments when an opponent is clearly open, rather than throwing it at the first chance.
Block with the Up arrow when an opponent winds up a strong punch, and get back to attacking once their guard has dropped.
Use the Left and Right arrows to move in and out of range so you can choose when to trade blows instead of standing still.
faq: What is the goal of Mini Boxing?
Your goal is to win the Boxer Championship Tournament by defeating all six boxers as Nick-Joe.
Which key throws the heavy uppercut?
The C key throws the super heavy uppercut punch.

western-fight.intro: Western Fight is a 3D western-themed fighting game with 8 characters. You can play against the AI alone or challenge a friend in two-player mode, and the goal is to win 2 rounds before your opponent.
tips: Learn the basic moves for both fighters first: punch and kick are separate buttons, so practice switching between them to find which one lands more often.
Watch the AI's movement before committing to an attack, since the game notes that the AI is harder than it looks.
Keep some distance between you and your opponent so you can step in with a punch or kick rather than trading blows at close range.
Try each of the 8 characters in a few matches to see how they feel, then stick with the one whose style suits you best.
In two-player mode, agree on a simple rule such as first to 2 rounds each time so the match stays quick and fair.
faq: What is the goal of Western Fight?
The aim is to win 2 rounds before your opponent. Each match is decided by who takes two rounds first.
What are the controls for Player 1?
Use W, A, S and D to move, V to punch and B to kick.

tank-fury-boss-battle-2d.intro: Tank Fury: Boss Battle 2D is a 2D shooting game where you control powerful tanks, upgrade your weapons and defenses, and face tough bosses. Strategy and quick action both matter.
tips: Use A and D to reposition before you fire, so you are not stuck in one spot while a boss attacks.
Adjust your aim with W and S in short bursts instead of holding them down, so you can hit targets accurately.
Spend upgrades on both weapons and defenses rather than only one, so your tank can deal damage and survive longer.
Watch how a boss moves and attacks before committing to a position, and fire when you have a clear shot.
On mobile, get comfortable with the on-screen buttons on a few early fights so your moves feel natural when the battles get harder.
faq: What are the basic controls on a computer?
Use A and D to move, W and S to aim, and the Spacebar to attack. These controls are listed for keyboard and mouse play.
How do I control the tank on a phone or tablet?
Use the on-screen buttons to move, aim, and attack. The game does not list any other touch controls.

swipe-swoosh.intro: Swipe Swoosh is a basketball skill game where you aim and set the power of each shot to sink baskets. Levels grow harder, with moving hoops and power-ups to help you through.
tips: Watch the hoop's movement for a moment before you shoot, so you can time your release to where it will be, not where it is.
Take small practice drags to judge how much power each distance needs before committing to a shot that matters.
Save power-ups for the levels that are hardest for you rather than using them early when you can still manage without them.
Keep an eye on your remaining attempts, since running out ends the level, and a careful shot is often worth more than a rushed one.
Use the daily challenges and achievements as extra goals to practice aiming and power control on shots you might otherwise skip.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Shoot the basketball through the hoop to score the required number of baskets before you run out of attempts.
How do I aim and set power on desktop?
Click and drag from the basketball to aim and set power, then release the mouse button to shoot.

purrfect-match.intro: Purrfect Match is a cozy match-three puzzle where you swap neighbouring kittens to line them up and clear each level's goals. Each chapter introduces a new challenge.
tips: Look at the level goal before your first move. Gathering cats, opening crates, thawing ice cages and breaking stones each need a different approach.
Aim for rockets, bombs and Paws when you can. A special cat clears more cats in one move, which helps when your moves are limited.
Set off a special cat next to the obstacles you need to clear. Stones can only be broken by blasts, so save a bomb or rocket for them.
Spend milk bottles on a booster before a hard level, then pick the one that matches the goal you are struggling with.
Take your time on most levels, since there are no timers. Plan a few swaps ahead so you do not run out of moves before the goals are done.
faq: What is the main goal of Purrfect Match?
Clear every goal on the level before your moves run out. Goals include gathering a set of cats, breaking crates, thawing ice cages and chipping away at stones.
How do I swap two cats?
Click or tap a cat, then click or tap the one next to it. On desktop you can also drag a cat onto its neighbour, and on mobile you can swipe it towards the neighbour.

hot-girl-shooter.intro: Hot Girl Shooter is a 2D shooting game where you control a girl with a gun and blast enemies. You can pick different characters, weapons, and modes.
tips: Try each girl before settling on one, since every character has her own style and that can change how you approach fights.
Test the different weapons early to see which one suits your pace and the way enemies come at you.
Use WASD to keep moving rather than standing still, so you are not an easy target.
Pick a mode you enjoy and play it a few times to learn how it plays out before trying others.
If you want a different feel, swap to another weapon or character and compare how you do.
faq: How do I move my character?
Use the W, A, S, and D keys to move around the screen.
What can I choose before playing?
You can choose from different girls, weapons, and modes, each with its own style.

moto-x3m-original.intro: Moto X3M is a bike racing game with 25 levels of off-road circuits, jumps, and obstacles. Your goal is to get through each course against the clock.
tips: Use the arrow keys to balance while you are in the air, so you land with the bike level rather than nose-down or tilted.
Watch the terrain ahead before a jump and pick up speed early enough to clear the obstacle without overshooting.
When you crash, press the spacebar to respawn at the last checkpoint instead of restarting the whole level, and keep track of where the checkpoints are.
Treat each level as a set of short sections. Learn the tricky jumps first, then work on a faster time once you can clear them consistently.
Don't rush every section. A clean run with no crashes often beats a fast run that ends in a wreck near the finish.
faq: How do I control the bike?
Use the arrow keys to drive and to balance the bike. Balancing matters most when you are in the air over jumps.
What do I do when I crash?
Press the spacebar to respawn at the last checkpoint you passed, so you don't have to start the level over.

mine-blogger-simulator-3d.intro: Mine Blogger Simulator 3D is a blogging management game where you record and publish videos to earn subscribers and money. Your aim is to climb to the top and complete every achievement.
tips: Before you record, compare the topic and location options and look for combinations that suit each other, since the description highlights finding the right mix for the best content.
Try recording at home and outdoors at different points to see which setting pays off, and keep notes on what worked.
Use the money and subscribers you earn to improve your character's skills, since stronger skills can help every video you make afterward.
Spend time talking with other bloggers in the game, as building relationships is part of reaching success.
Check your achievement list now and then so you can aim for specific goals alongside the long-term aim of becoming the number one blogger.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
The main goal is to become the number one blogger and complete all achievements. You do this by earning subscribers and money from your videos.
How do I publish a video?
Click the Record New Video button, choose your video parameters, wait for the creation process to finish, then click Finish Creation to publish it.

lows-adventures-3.intro: Low's Adventures 3 is a 2D pixel art platformer with 32 levels, new abilities, and unique foes. It builds on the earlier games with fresh challenges and a classic feel.
tips: Try out each new ability early in a level so you know what it does before you need it under pressure.
Watch how each unique foe moves for a few seconds before you approach, and plan your timing around that pattern.
Look at the whole visual layout of a level before moving, since the pixel art often shows where the path continues.
If you get stuck on a level, step back and think about which ability you have not used yet.
Collecting is part of the game, so keep an eye out for items as you go, especially in areas you pass through quickly.
faq: What is the goal of Low's Adventures 3?
You guide Low through 32 levels of platforming challenges, using new abilities and getting past unique foes.
How do I control Low?
You play with mouse clicks or taps, as shown in the game's instructions.

duck-hunter.intro: Duck Hunter is a shooting action game where you aim at ducks and try to hit enough of them to move on. Each round has 10 ducks, and you need at least 6 hits to advance.
tips: Track how many ducks you have hit as you go, so you know exactly how many more you need to clear the round of 10.
Watch the flight pattern of each duck for a moment before you fire, since a steady aim beats rapid, random shots.
Once you have reached 6 hits, you can ease off and focus on accuracy for the rest of the round rather than rushing.
Do not waste shots early in a round. If you miss several in a row, slow down and reset your aim before continuing.
Replay the early rounds to build timing and confidence before trying to push through the harder ones.
faq: How many ducks do I need to shoot to pass a round?
Each round has 10 ducks, and you must shoot at least 6 of them to move on to the next round.
What happens after I clear a round?
You advance to the next round, where you face another set of 10 ducks with the same goal of hitting at least 6.

fortress-of-the-sinister.intro: Fortress of the Sinister is a turn-based tactics game where you lead a squad of heroes across grid arenas and fight through four fortresses. Plan each turn carefully to keep your team alive.
tips: Read the visible enemy attacks before every move, and position your heroes so the threatened tiles are empty or occupied by units you can afford to lose.
Use push and reposition abilities to move enemies out of position, especially those that are about to attack your weaker heroes.
Start with smaller 3x3 arenas to learn how each hero's abilities work, then move on to the larger 7x7 battles once you are comfortable.
Spend the treasures, trinkets, and currency you collect after each floor on upgrades for the heroes you use most, rather than spreading them thinly.
Try different hero combinations as you unlock them, since the game rewards building a team whose abilities work well together.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Win turn-based battles on each floor with clever tactics and minimal losses, then work through the 10 floors of each fortress to defend the magical network.
How do I know what enemies are going to do?
Enemy attacks are shown on the grid before they happen, so you can plan your moves around them each turn.

boxing-gang-stars.intro: Boxing Gang Stars is a physics-based boxing game with funny characters. You can fight alone in 1 player mode or face a friend in 2 player mode, using punches and blocks to win each bout.
tips: Block with your block key when an opponent winds up a punch, then counter once their guard is open. Constant punching leaves you exposed.
Learn the three punch keys for your player and try each one, so you know which punch fits the moment.
In 2 player mode, agree with your friend on which keys each of you will use before the first round so you do not fight over the same controls.
Watch how the physics affects movement and knockdowns. Pushing an opponent toward the ropes or corners can set up your next attack.
Keep your movement steady instead of rushing in. Stepping back to reset your position makes it easier to time your blocks and punches.
faq: What is the goal of Boxing Gang Stars?
The goal is to defeat your opponent in the ring by landing punches and outlasting them. You can play against the computer in 1 player mode or against another person in 2 player mode.
Which keys control Player 1?
Player 1 moves with W, A, S, D or the arrow keys in 1 player mode, punches with F, G, or T, and blocks with E.

police-gangster-chase.intro: Police Gangster Chase is a 3D racing game where you drive as a police officer chasing dangerous gangsters through a busy city. You chase targets, dodge traffic, collect badges, and finish missions before time runs out.
tips: Ease off the accelerator before tight turns so you keep control of the car. Steering stays responsive, but braking early is safer than correcting a slide.
Watch traffic ahead and steer around it early rather than at the last moment. Hitting cars slows your chase, so plan your line a few seconds in advance.
Keep your eyes on the target vehicle and not only on the road right in front of you. Staying close to the gangster helps you keep the chase on track.
Collect badges when they are safe to reach, but do not let them pull you off the chase route. Finishing the mission matters more than any single detour.
Keep an eye on the clock from the start of each mission. Save braking and reverse moves for situations where you really need them, so you don't lose time you cannot get back.
faq: What is the main goal of Police Gangster Chase?
You play as a police driver hunting dangerous gangsters. Chase the targets, avoid traffic, collect badges, and complete each mission before time runs out.
How do I steer and control the car on a keyboard?
Use W or the Up Arrow to accelerate and S or the Down Arrow to brake or reverse. Use A and D or the Left and Right Arrows to steer, and click the game once first to focus it.

letter-layout-coloring.intro: Letter Layout Coloring is a word puzzle where you arrange colorful letters to form words. The layout changes as you move through levels, so each stage asks you to adjust your approach.
tips: Scan the whole layout before you click anything. Note which letters are available and which words they could spell.
Start with short, familiar words you can build quickly. Solving these early helps you spot patterns in the letters for harder puzzles.
Because the layout shifts from level to level, check the board again at the start of each new stage instead of reusing your last plan.
Use single, deliberate clicks or taps. Rushing through moves makes it easy to place a letter in the wrong spot.
Keep an eye on achievements as you play. Trying for them can give you a reason to explore different words and puzzle types.
faq: What is the goal of Letter Layout Coloring?
The goal is to arrange the colorful letters to form words and solve each puzzle. Completing puzzles moves you through the levels.
How do I control the game?
Use your mouse to click or tap on the letters and board. There are no other controls to learn.

red-and-blue-online-build-destroy-fight.intro: Red & Blue: Online is a voxel multiplayer shooter where you build, dig, and destroy terrain as you fight. Choose Sandbox to experiment, Capture the Flag for team objectives, or Team Deathmatch for direct PvP.
tips: Check the support under your structures before you rely on them, since any block that loses its connection to the ground will fall and break apart.
Use RMB to dig tactical paths through terrain so you can reach or escape from positions your enemies do not expect.
In Capture the Flag, focus on the route between your base and the enemy flag, and use blocks to shield your carrier on the way back.
Open the map with M and keep the minimap size set with J so you can track teammates and enemies while you move and build.
Switch quickly between your 1-5 item slots during fights, and reload with R when you have a safe moment so you are not caught empty.
faq: What is the main goal in Capture the Flag?
Seize the enemy's flag and bring it back to your base. Team tactics matter more than individual kills in this mode.
How does destruction affect the battlefield?
Buildings can collapse and debris changes the map. Any block that loses its connection to the ground falls and breaks apart, so a structure can be undermined by removing its support.

gold-miner-tower-defense.intro: Gold Miner Tower Defense blends tower defense with card strategy and upgrade combat. You play as a miner who must keep enemies away from your gold using a variety of defense towers.
tips: Look at where enemies enter and which route they take toward your gold, then place towers so they cover that path before enemies arrive.
Think about how each tower works before you commit to it, since the towers are meant to be different and suited to different threats.
Mix your defenses instead of relying on one type, so you can handle more than one kind of enemy.
Use upgrades on the towers that are already doing the most work rather than spreading them thinly across the board.
Play with short, deliberate clicks or taps so you can plan each placement calmly instead of rushing your decisions.
faq: What is the goal of Gold Miner Tower Defense?
You protect your gold from enemies by placing and upgrading defense towers. The game is about keeping your treasure safe.
How do I play the game?
Use mouse clicks or taps to select and place your towers and make your choices. There are no other controls to learn.

advanture-of-tommy.intro: Adventure of Tommy is a side-scrolling platformer where you guide Tommy through levels full of traps and dangers. Finish each level and collect gold coins along the way.
tips: Watch the ground and obstacles ahead before each jump, since the traps are described as mysterious and can catch you off guard.
Use short, controlled jumps when you are unsure of a landing spot, so you can adjust your position in mid-air.
Collect the gold coins when they are safe to reach, but do not risk a dangerous jump just for a coin if the level's goal matters more.
If you are playing on a touchscreen, practice the on-screen buttons on an early level so your timing feels natural before harder sections.
Take a moment to scan each new area before moving, because pausing to read the layout can prevent repeated mistakes.
faq: What is the goal of Adventure of Tommy?
Your goal is to play as Tommy, finish each level, and collect gold coins along the way. The game is built around exploring its quests and avoiding traps.
How do I control Tommy on a computer?
Press the Left Arrow to move left, the Right Arrow to move right, and the Up Arrow to jump.

zombie-apocalypse-tunnel-survival.intro: Zombie Apocalypse Tunnel Survival is a multiplayer shooter where you fight zombies and soldier AI, alone or with friends. It offers several game modes and gun customization with camo and attachments.
tips: Learn the controls early: WASD to move, the mouse to aim and shoot, and SPACE to jump so you can dodge incoming enemies.
Use SHIFT to run when you need to reposition quickly, but stop to aim before engaging so your shots land accurately.
Switch between guns as the fight changes instead of sticking to one weapon, especially when enemies come from several directions.
Try different game modes to see which suits your style, since survival rewards careful positioning while team deathmatch rewards fast coordination.
Play with friends when you can, since splitting up to cover more ground often helps you survive longer in the tunnels.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
The description says you play against many enemy AI, including soldiers and realistic zombies, across five game modes. Your aim is to outlast and outfight the enemies in whichever mode you choose.
How do I aim and shoot?
Use the mouse to look around and aim, and click to shoot. Use the TAB key to open the menu when you need to change settings.

soccer-strike.intro: Soccer Strike is a casual soccer game where you aim and shoot the ball into the goal using a pull-back control. Build your striker lineup to improve your shots as you play.
tips: Pull back slowly and watch how far you stretch before releasing, since the shot power changes with the drag distance.
Before every shot, look at where the defenders and obstacles stand and pick an open gap in the goal rather than the center.
Test a few shots at different angles early on so you learn how the ball curves and bounces before a close match.
Try to keep your aim steady and avoid rushing; a calm, deliberate pull usually gives more control than a quick flick.
Use your striker lineup changes to improve your performance, and experiment with different setups to find what suits your shooting style.
faq: How do I aim and shoot the ball?
Drag backward from the ball to aim and set the power, then release to strike. The farther you pull back, the stronger the shot.
How do I score goals?
Aim carefully to get the ball past defenders and obstacles into the goal. Choosing an open path matters more than shooting hard.

stick-duel-battle-hero.intro: Stick Duel: Battle Hero is a two-player fighting game where stickman superheroes battle in an arena using guns, fists, and kicks. The first player to score five wins.
tips: Pick up weapons as soon as they appear, since you can switch or drop them if they do not suit your style.
Keep an eye on shields and health power-ups and grab them when the fight is quiet, so you enter exchanges with more protection.
Use your fists and kicks when your opponent is close and your gun is low on advantage, rather than standing at range.
Try a few different costumes to see which hero feels comfortable to move and fight with, since all costumes are available to use.
faq: What is the goal of Stick Duel: Battle Hero?
The main goal is to score five by destroying your opponent. Whoever reaches five first wins the battle.
What are the controls for Player 1 and Player 2?
Player 1 moves with the arrow keys, shoots with L, and drops a weapon with O. Player 2 moves with WASD, shoots with F, and drops a weapon with R.

block-sort-puzzle.intro: Block Sort Puzzle is a color-matching game where you drag blocks onto tiles to group matching colors. Sorting quickly helps you build a tall tower and raise your score.
tips: Before each drag, check which color sits on top of each tile so you can plan moves that put matching blocks side by side.
Look for chances to set up a combine instead of moving blocks at random, since combining is what scores points.
Try to chain several combines in a row, because each combine increases your multiplier and boosts the points you already have.
Keep an eye on your tower height as you work, and avoid stacking blocks in a way that leaves no room for the next move.
Move slowly at first to learn the layout, then speed up once you are confident in where each color belongs.
faq: What is the goal of Block Sort Puzzle?
The goal is to sort the multi-colored blocks quickly, collect the highest tower you can, and multiply your points.
How do I combine blocks and score points?
Drag a block onto the tile you want, then place matching colors side by side so they combine and add to your score.

fallingman-io-winter-seasons.intro: Fallingman.io - Winter Seasons is a multiplayer game across three tracks. You race against 20 players on the first track, and the aim is to finish every track, collect Crowns, and win.
tips: On the first track, you are racing 19 other players, so keep moving forward steadily rather than stopping to look around.
On the second track, don't follow the picture on the screen, because a wrong step will drop you off the cliff and end your run.
On the third track, each step is permanent, so pause and check the path ahead before you move onto a new tile.
Practice the controls with the arrow keys and space button, or touch controls on mobile, so your movements feel natural before the tougher tracks.
Play through all three tracks rather than rushing one, since finishing every track is needed to collect Crowns and progress toward the titles.
faq: What is the goal of Fallingman.io - Winter Seasons?
Finish all three tracks, collect Crowns, and be the winner. On the first track you must beat the other 20 players to the finish.
How do I control my character?
Use the arrow keys and the space button on a computer, or use touch controls on a mobile device.

rageroll-io.intro: RageRoll.io is a multiplayer arena battle where giant rollers fight each other. You can play DeathMatch, where the goal is the most kills before time runs out, or Elimination, where you must outlast every opponent.
tips: Pick your mode first and play to it. In DeathMatch, look for targets you can finish off quickly. In Elimination, avoid unnecessary fights and stay alive.
Use Shift as a dash to get out of trouble or close distance fast, and hold Shift to brake when you need to stop quickly and line up a shot.
Use Space to float up when you want to avoid ground threats or get a better view of the arena. Keep an eye on where you are relative to other rollers.
Mix your attacks. Left Click bullets are for steady pressure, while Right Click missiles are better saved for when you have a clear line on an opponent.
Keep Q for shielding when you expect incoming fire, and try to time it rather than holding it constantly so you can still move and attack.
faq: What is the goal of DeathMatch?
In DeathMatch, you score the most kills before time runs out. Focus on attacking other rollers while staying aware of the clock.
How do I survive in Elimination?
In Elimination, you win by surviving longer than every other opponent. Stay mobile with WASD, use Shift to dash away from danger, and use Q to shield when hit is likely.

chop-up.intro: Chop Up is a relaxing logging simulation. You start with an axe, chop trees, deliver logs to the warehouse, and grow your camp with upgrades, helpers, and trade deals.
tips: Spend your first coins on carrying capacity so you can haul more logs per trip and waste less time walking back and forth.
Build a house before you try to hire a lumberjack, since each lumberjack needs one. Plan where you place it, because you can put buildings anywhere on the map.
Check your orders tablet regularly and deliver before each time-limited deal expires, so you don't lose the coins on offer.
Hire collectors to pick up loose logs while you focus on chopping and delivering, which keeps your warehouse stocked.
Keep your warehouse capacity in mind as your operation grows, and unlock new trade partners once you can supply bigger contracts.
faq: How do I earn coins in Chop Up?
You earn coins each time you deliver logs to the warehouse, and buyers' orders can offer extra coins for log deliveries.
What do I need before hiring a lumberjack?
Each lumberjack needs a house first. Build one through the buildings menu and place it anywhere on the map, then hire the lumberjack.

create-your-robot.intro: Create Your Robot is a puzzle and dress-up game where you build a robot from the parts provided. Use your mouse to combine pieces and see what kind of robot you can make.
tips: Look at all the available parts before you start, so you know which shapes and options you have to work with.
Pick a simple theme first, such as a tall robot or a round one, and choose parts that fit it. This makes the design look more consistent.
Try swapping one part at a time. Changing one piece lets you see its effect clearly and helps you decide what works best.
Experiment with unusual combinations. The game invites creativity, so a surprising pairing might turn out to be your favorite robot.
Take a moment to step back and look at the whole robot before you finish. Balance between the top, middle, and bottom often makes the design look better.
faq: How do I control the game?
You play the game with your mouse. Use it to select and place the robot parts you want to combine.
What is the goal of Create Your Robot?
The goal is to create your robot using the given parts and to make the best, most creative design you can.

two-ball-3d-dark.intro: Two Ball 3D: Dark is a 3D running game where you steer a ball along the track, collect diamonds, and avoid traps. Use the A/D or arrow keys to move and the number keys to trigger bonuses.
tips: Look ahead along the track, since the Dark version lets you see long distances. Spotting traps early gives you more time to move out of their way.
Keep your ball centered and react early to side-to-side moves so you are never forced into a trap at the last moment.
When you leave a ramp, the wings open to help you land more balanced. Plan your jumps so you come down in a steady position rather than tilting sideways.
Save your bonuses for the moments when you need them most. The keys are ARMOR on 1, MAGNET on 2, and DOUBLE COUNTER on 3, so press the right one when a difficult section is coming up.
Collect the diamonds you pass along the way, because they are used to unlock 6 different ball skins.
faq: How do I move my ball?
Use the A and D keys or the Left and Right arrow keys to steer the ball from side to side.
What do the bonus keys do?
Key 1 activates ARMOR, key 2 activates MAGNET, and key 3 activates DOUBLE COUNTER. The game also includes bonus shortcuts so you can use them quickly.

grass-cutting-mowing-game.intro: Grass Cutting Mowing Game is a relaxing lawn-mowing simulator. You drive a powerful mower, cut the grass, and complete tasks to keep each area clean and tidy.
tips: Read your current task before you start mowing so you know which area to clear first.
Work in neat, overlapping rows rather than random loops, so you don't leave patches of uncut grass behind.
Take your time on tight corners and edges, since careful mowing matters as much as covering ground quickly.
Check the area for any missed strips before you finish, so you complete the task fully.
Use the mouse to click the on-screen buttons whenever you need to move between menus or actions.
faq: What is the goal of Grass Cutting Mowing Game?
Your goal is to drive the mower, cut the grass, and complete your tasks to keep each area clean and beautiful.
How do I control the mower?
The game description says you drive the mower around the environment, and the instructions say to use the mouse to click buttons. Check the on-screen prompts for any other controls.

bomb-royale-online.intro: Bomb Royale Online is a multiplayer maze battle where you place bombs, clear blocks, and trap rivals. Last player standing wins the match.
tips: Before placing a bomb, check where you can run to afterward. Blasts can cut off your escape route as quickly as they clear an enemy's path.
Destroy blocks early to open up the arena, but keep a few walls standing so you have cover from enemy explosions.
Watch for chain reactions before you act. A bomb that sets off another one can catch you off guard, so keep track of where existing blasts are heading.
Use bombs to block escape routes, not just to attack. Trapping an opponent in a corner often works better than chasing them.
Stay mobile and keep an eye on the whole maze. Standing still for long gives opponents time to set a trap around you.
faq: What is the goal of Bomb Royale Online?
The goal is to survive longer than every other player in the match. The last player standing wins and can climb the leaderboard.
How do I eliminate other players?
Place bombs at well-timed moments so their explosions catch opponents. Blocking their escape routes makes it easier to finish them off.

z-machine.intro: Z Machine is a hypercasual arcade game where you drive a powerful tank through hordes of zombies. Destroy them, collect the money, and haul it back to the warehouse while upgrading your vehicle.
tips: Decide early whether you are fighting or hauling. Clearing zombies makes the route safer, but money only counts once it reaches the warehouse, so plan your trips around it.
Spend upgrades with a purpose. Combat upgrades help you clear hordes faster, while defense upgrades help you survive longer when zombies reach you. Pick based on which one is slowing you down.
Watch the crowd before you commit. Heading into a large horde with little money on board puts more at risk than a quick run through a thinner group.
Keep your tank moving rather than standing still in one spot, since staying put gives zombies time to close in.
Use mouse clicks or taps steadily instead of rapid spamming, and check the screen between actions so you can respond to new zombies as they appear.
faq: What is the main goal of Z Machine?
Destroy the zombies, collect the money they leave behind, and ship it back to the warehouse. Upgrading your vehicle along the way helps you do this more effectively.
How do I control the tank?
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps. There are no other controls mentioned in the instructions.

delete-it-erase-one-part.intro: Delete it is a puzzle where you swipe away parts of a scene to uncover a hidden clue. Each level asks you to find the right area to erase so the picture reveals its secret.
tips: Look at the whole scene before you erase anything, and note which objects seem out of place or oddly detailed.
Ask yourself what the picture is trying to show you, such as a hidden object or a clue sitting behind another object.
Make small, careful drags first so you can see what changes before committing to a larger erase.
If you are stuck, try erasing an object that looks like it is covering something rather than the background around it.
Once a level is solved, look at the revealed details, since they often show the story or joke the puzzle is built around.
faq: What is the goal of Delete it?
The goal is to erase the correct area of each picture to reveal the hidden clue and complete the level.
How do I erase parts of the image?
On mobile, touch and drag your finger across the image. On desktop, click and drag with the left mouse button.

grass-land.intro: Grassland is an exploration game where you use a grass cutter machine to clear dense grass, gather hidden resources, and grow your base. You move with arrow keys on desktop or a joystick on mobile.
tips: Cut through patches of grass steadily rather than rushing across the map, since resources are hidden beneath the surface and you need to sweep an area to find them.
Gather wood and coal early, because the description says each resource helps expand your base and unlock upgrades.
Keep your base growing in stages: start with the small base and add structures, markets, workshops, and storage as your resources build up.
Put early resources into upgrading your grass cutter's strength, speed, and fuel capacity, since these affect how efficiently you cut grass and find resources.
Explore outward gradually so you can find your way back and keep track of locations you have already cleared.
faq: What is the main goal in Grassland?
Your goal is to explore the grassy land, gather hidden resources, and expand your base while becoming the master of the landscape.
How do I move my grass cutter on desktop?
Use the arrow keys: Up, Down, Left, and Right move the machine in those directions.

body-race.intro: Body Race is a 3D arcade game where you control a character who keeps walking along a platform. Each level sets a calorie target, and you collect foods to reach it.
tips: Check the calorie requirement at the start of each level so you know how much energy you need to collect.
The first level requires 10,000 calories, so use it to learn how quickly food adds up before moving on.
Focus on high-protein and high-energy foods, since the game points them out as the best way to reach each level's target.
Slide to play, and keep your steering smooth so you stay on course while the character walks forward.
If you fall short of a level's target, try again and pay attention to which foods you picked up and which you missed.
faq: What is the goal of Body Race?
The goal is to collect enough energy, measured in calories, to reach the requirement of each level. The first level, for example, needs 10,000 calories.
How do I control the character?
The game is played by sliding. Slide to play and move the character as it walks along the platform.

baby-snack-factory.intro: Baby Snack Factory is a cooking game where you make treats in a little panda's kitchen. You follow recipes, mix ingredients, shape dough and bake your snacks.
tips: Read the recipe before you start so you know which ingredients you need, such as flour, eggs, fruits or sugar.
Add the ingredients in the order the recipe shows, since mixing the wrong combination may not give the treat you want.
Knead the mixture until it forms a smooth ball of dough before moving on to shaping.
Use the machine to shape the cookies evenly, then place them in the oven as the last step.
Take your time with each step, because the game is about following the process carefully rather than rushing.
faq: How do I play Baby Snack Factory?
Use your mouse or tap the screen to pick ingredients, mix them, knead the dough, shape the cookies with the machine and place them in the oven.
What is the goal of the game?
The goal is to make treats by following the recipes provided, from mixing the ingredients to baking the finished snacks.

spill-and-knock-down.intro: Spill & Knock Down is a physics skill puzzle where you drop balls to knock over glasses and spill the liquid inside. Success depends on careful aiming, timing, and using gravity and momentum.
tips: Before you drop a ball, look at where it will land and which glass it will hit first. Choosing the drop point carefully often matters more than speed.
Pay attention to the angle of your drop. A ball that bounces or rolls can reach glasses that a straight drop would miss.
Check for supports and obstacles between the drop point and the glasses. Make sure the ball has a clear path before you commit to a shot.
If a level has moving platforms, watch them for a few moments and time your drop for when the path is open.
Try to think about which glasses are easiest to reach first, and plan a sequence so one ball's movement helps with the next shot.
faq: What is the goal of Spill & Knock Down?
Your goal is to spill all the liquid from the glasses in each puzzle. You do this by using balls to knock over the glasses, either directly or by bouncing or rolling them into place.
How do I control where the balls go?
You can drop balls from certain positions, and in many cases you can aim or choose the drop point. Pick your position with the angle and timing in mind.

mahjong-tower-puzzles.intro: Mahjong Tower: Puzzles mixes mahjong tiles with three-in-a-row matching across three modes. Puzzles has a limited number of tiles, Board Clearing has a time limit, and Arcade goes on until the board gets too full.
tips: In Puzzles, count your remaining tiles before every drop, since you cannot afford to waste one on a spot that does not help clear the board.
Use the hint key only after you have studied the layout for a while, so you still get the satisfaction of working out the solution yourself.
If you get stuck in a level, restarting with the restart key is often quicker than trying to fix a messy board.
In Board Clearing, look for combinations that remove several tiles at once and save time rather than clearing one tile at a time.
In Arcade, keep the board from filling up by combining tiles as soon as you can, because difficulty rises the longer you play.
faq: What is the goal of the game?

The goal depends on the mode. In Puzzles you solve each layout with a limited number of tiles, in Board Clearing you clear the board before time runs out, and in Arcade you combine tiles for as long as possible.
How do I place tiles on the board?
On a computer, press the left mouse button to drop the tile. On mobile, use tapping and finger movement across the screen.
