chainsaw-3d.intro: Chainsaw 3D is an arcade woodcutting game where you cut logs by rotating a chainsaw up and down. Each new level asks for concentration as you work toward becoming the top woodcutter.
tips: Look ahead before you move the saw. Spot the obstacles on the path first so you can plan your cut instead of reacting at the last second.
Make small, controlled movements with the mouse or finger. Smooth adjustments are easier to keep on the line than quick, large swings.
Keep your attention on the cut line itself rather than the whole screen. Following the line closely helps you stay accurate as the saw moves.
If a level feels hard, slow down and focus on one section at a time. Concentration matters more here than speed.
Pay attention to how each new level changes the layout. Taking a moment to read the scene before you start can prevent early mistakes.
faq: What is the goal of Chainsaw 3D?
Your goal is to cut through the logs by following the lines while avoiding obstacles. Each level requires focus to complete.
How do I control the chainsaw?
Use your mouse or finger to rotate the chainsaw up and down. Smooth, steady movements help you stay on the cut lines.

stickman-sports-badminton.intro: Stickman Sports Badminton is a stickman badminton match for one or two players, with Normal and Hard CPU modes and a choice of 5, 7 or 9 sets. Each side uses its own keys to move, jump and swing the racket.
tips: Watch where the shuttle is heading before you move, since the ball physics are realistic and it will not always travel where you expect.
Start each set by testing how the Normal CPU responds, then move up to Hard once you can keep rallies going.
Pick the number of sets to match your time: 5 sets for a quick match, 9 sets if you want a longer contest.
Keep an eye out for the boosters such as the big racket, fireball and faster, and try to grab them when they are safe to reach.
In two-player games, agree on a swing timing with your opponent before the match so the contest stays fair and fun.
faq: How do I control my stickman?
Player 1 uses the W, A, S and D keys to move and jump and swings the racket with SPACE. Player 2 uses the arrow keys to move and jump and swings with M.
What is the difference between Normal and Hard mode?
Normal and Hard are the two CPU modes you can pick when playing against the computer. Hard is the more demanding choice for experienced players.

basketball-tap.intro: Basketball Tap is a fast arcade sports game where you time your taps to launch the ball toward the basket. Each well-timed shot can earn points, and a clean slam dunk is the goal.
tips: Watch the ball's movement before you tap, since the timing of your tap decides how the shot travels.
Focus on a steady rhythm rather than tapping quickly, because rushed taps usually send the ball off target.
Keep your eyes on the basket while the ball is in the air so you can judge whether your shot is on course.
If a shot misses, pause for a moment and note whether it went short or long, then adjust your next tap to match.
Aim for consistent, accurate shots first; building a run of good shots is a steadier way to score than chasing risky dunks.
faq: What is the goal of Basketball Tap?
Tap the screen to control the ball and guide it toward the basket. Make your best shots to score points.
How do I control the ball?
You control the ball with taps. The timing of each tap determines how the ball is launched into the air.

telekinesis-attack.intro: Telekinesis Attack is a first person shooter where you use thought-powered magic to grab enemies, throw them, and knock them into objects. Your goal is to defeat every enemy and take their weapons.
tips: Hold the mouse button on an enemy and drag in different directions to see how they move before committing to a throw.
Look for objects around the arena you can throw enemies into, since slamming a foe into something solid is a practical way to finish them.
Take weapons away from enemies when you can, so you are not left facing a armed opponent with nothing to fight back with.
Deal with the closest or most dangerous enemy first, then move on, so you do not get surrounded while you are busy with another target.
Experiment with different throw directions early on to learn which ones are most effective against different enemies.
faq: How do I pull an enemy towards me?
Hold down the mouse button on the enemy, then drag in the direction you want to pull or throw them.
How do I defeat an enemy?
Pull the enemy with the mouse and throw them in any direction to defeat them.

coin-color-sort.intro: Coin Color Sort is a relaxing color-matching puzzle where you sort colorful coins into stacks. It has many levels and is built around logic and color matching.
tips: Look at the whole board before you move anything, and find which color has its coins spread across the most places.
Only coins of the same color can stack, so clear the top coins of a column first to reach the ones underneath.
Pick a single color and gather all of its coins together rather than moving pieces at random.
If you get stuck, try moving a coin to a different spot to free up a column, since a blocked column is often the real problem.
Take short breaks between levels, which helps you come back with fresh eyes for the trickier puzzles.
faq: How do I move a coin?
Tap and drag a coin to where you want it. Only one coin of one color can be moved at a time.
When can I place a coin on another coin?
You can place a coin on top of another only when both coins are the same color. Aim to stack all coins of each color together.

neon-billard-pool.intro: Neon Billiard Pool is a two-player pool game where you take turns with a friend. One player is yellow, the other is red, and each plays a round using the mouse to aim and shoot the white ball.
tips: Before you shoot, use the mouse to check the angle carefully, since the white ball's path decides everything.
Use the walls to your advantage: because the white ball bounces off them, a well-angled shot can reach a target that looks blocked.
Take your time on each round rather than rushing, especially when the table is crowded with balls.
Watch what your friend does on their turn so you can learn which angles work well on this table.
Keep a relaxed pace and trade turns with your friend, so the game stays fun for both players.
faq: How do I control the white ball?
You use the mouse to aim and shoot the white ball, and it bounces off the table edges as it moves.
How do two players share a game?
Each player takes a turn in a round, with one playing as yellow and the other as red.

pixel-gun-apocalypse-4-zombie-invazion.intro: Pixel Gun Apocalypse 4 Zombie Invazion is a zombie shooter where you fight undead opponents across several maps with a range of weapons. Move with WASD, aim and shoot with the mouse, and use cover to survive.
tips: Stay behind objects when enemies are approaching, since the description says hiding behind things is a key part of surviving.
Keep moving with WASD instead of standing still, so zombies have a harder time lining up clean shots on you.
Use Space to jump when you need to reposition quickly, such as getting out of an open area or past a obstacle.
Open the menu with Tab to check your options between fights rather than trying to change things mid-battle.
Try the different weapons on offer instead of sticking with one, and keep the one that suits how you like to fight.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You survive zombie attacks while battling opponents across different maps. The description highlights fighting undead enemies while using cover and a variety of weapons.
How do I aim and shoot?
Use the mouse to look around and aim, then shoot with the mouse as well. Combine this with WASD movement to keep your position safe while you fire.

tower-colour-crash.intro: Tower Colour Crash is a 3D physics block game where you throw balls at towers. Only blocks matching your ball's colour can be destroyed, so aim carefully to bring every tower down.
tips: Before each throw, use a small swipe to line up your angle with the tower, and adjust until you are happy with the aim.
Check the colour of your ball against the blocks first. Plan your shots around the colour you have, since mismatched blocks will not break.
Look for blocks that support the rest of the tower. Hitting a key base block of the matching colour can make the whole structure fall.
Save your earthquake and shotgun power ups for towers that resist normal throws, since they can create big chain reactions.
Count your remaining balls before each shot, because the level only gives you a set amount to bring every tower down.
faq: How do I aim my throw?
Swipe right or left at the start of each level to choose the angle for hitting the tower.
What decides whether a block breaks?
A block only gets destroyed when your ball is the same colour as the block. Otherwise it stays in place.

brain-crazy-iq-challenge-puzzle.intro: Brain Crazy: IQ Challenge Puzzle is a logic game built around quirky riddles and brain teasers. Its puzzles reward unexpected thinking, so reading each prompt closely matters as much as the solution.
tips: Read every prompt word by word before tapping anything, since clues can be hidden in punctuation or phrasing.
When an obvious answer doesn't work, try the most literal reading of the prompt first.
Test on-screen objects by tapping, dragging, and holding them, because many items can be moved or combined.
Check the background and edges of the screen for hidden items or stickers that may reveal a key.
If you stay stuck for a while, use the lightbulb hint and work through the steps rather than guessing repeatedly.
faq: What is the goal of Brain Crazy: IQ Challenge Puzzle?
Your goal is to solve each riddle or brain teaser by finding the solution the puzzle intends. Many answers come from thinking outside the box rather than the most obvious choice.
What controls do I use to play?
You interact with the screen by tapping, dragging, swiping, shaking, rotating, or holding objects. Try different actions on items to see which ones respond.

shrinkzone-io.intro: Shrinkzone is a doodle-style battle royale where you start as a tiny blob, eat food to grow, and outlast other players as a shrinking safe zone pulls everyone together.
tips: Eat the food scattered around the early part of the map first, since you are most vulnerable while you are still small.
Keep an eye on bigger players and steer clear of them, because a larger blob can eat you on contact.
Watch the edge of the shrinking safe zone so you are not caught outside it when it closes in.
Hunt smaller players when you have a size advantage, but do not chase them into areas where bigger players may be waiting.
Move in short, controlled bursts with WASD or the joystick rather than running in straight lines, so you can dodge quickly when a threat appears.
faq: What is the goal of Shrinkzone?
The goal is to survive longest and claim the top spot by eating food, growing larger, and outlasting the other players as the safe zone shrinks.
How do I move my blob?
On a keyboard, use WASD to move. On mobile, use the on-screen joystick.

elip-adventure.intro: Elip Adventure is a one-player platform puzzle game where you guide an ellipse through tricky maps to collect stars and unlock its house. Each stage brings new obstacles and enemies to deal with.
tips: Learn how your jump and wall walking work before tackling harder stages, since most obstacles depend on precise movement.
Use the wall walking control to reach ledges or routes that look out of reach from the ground.
Scan each map for the stars before moving on, so you do not have to backtrack later.
When an enemy blocks your path, decide whether to go around it or deal with it directly, based on how much room you have to maneuver.
Take short, controlled jumps near hazards instead of long leaps, which are harder to correct in the air.
faq: What is the goal of Elip Adventure?
You move an ellipse through each stage to find the stars, which unlock the elliptical house. Each stage has its own set of obstacles and enemies.
How do I move and jump?
Use W, A, S, and D to move. Jump with the right mouse button or the X key, and use the space bar or Z to wall walk.

kick-and-run.intro: Kick & Run is an action runner where you sprint through colorful obstacle courses, dodge hazards, and knock enemies aside. Your goal is to reach the finish line and complete each level.
tips: Look ahead before each jump or turn so you can pick the safer path early instead of reacting at the last moment.
Keep moving rather than stopping to fight, since your run is what gets you to the finish line.
Save your punches and kicks for enemies that are about to block your route, rather than swinging at ones that are already out of the way.
When a course splits, compare the routes for hazards before committing, and choose the one that keeps your momentum steady.
Practice swipe or drag timing on the levels you find hardest, so your movement and attacks feel automatic when things get busy.
faq: What is the main goal in Kick & Run?
Reach the finish line and complete each level by racing through the course and clearing obstacles and opponents along the way.
How do I attack enemies?
On desktop, click and drag to attack, or use the Arrow key Right. On mobile, touch the screen to attack.

super-car-wash-3d.intro: Super Car Wash 3D is a colorful car cleaning game where you rinse, soap, scrub, and polish dirty cars until they shine. Follow the on-screen prompts to work through each step in order.
tips: Rinse off the mud first, before you soap or scrub. Loose dirt is easier to remove with water, and scrubbing over it can leave marks on the paint.
Cover the whole car in soap before you start scrubbing. Working in small sections makes it easier to spot spots you missed.
Scrub slowly and carefully, especially around corners and edges where dirt tends to collect. Rushing can leave patches that still look dirty.
Check the car from several angles before you move on. Missed spots are easier to fix while you are still on the same step.
Read each on-screen prompt before you switch tools. Doing the steps in the order the game asks keeps the process moving smoothly.
faq: What is the goal of Super Car Wash 3D?
The goal is to give each dirty car a complete makeover. You do this by rinsing away mud, covering the car in soap, scrubbing it, and polishing it until it shines.
How do I select tools and clean the car?
Use the mouse or touch controls to pick a tool and then use it on the car. Follow the on-screen prompts to know which step comes next.

freaky-monster-rush.intro: Freaky Monster Rush is a 3D arcade race where you build your monster runner limb by limb. Get through each obstacle course by dodging barrels, knocking back foes, and running through the right gates.
tips: Hold to move and slide to get under or past obstacles, and use short, controlled inputs so you can react to what comes next.
Watch the course ahead rather than your monster alone, so you have time to spot barrels before you reach them.
Check which gates are the proper ones before you reach them, since going through the wrong gate does not help you progress.
When foes are in your path, aim to knock them back rather than slowing down to deal with them, to keep your run moving.
Stay focused through the whole course, because each one you finish adds to the DNA merge for your monster.
faq: What is the goal of Freaky Monster Rush?
You race through obstacle courses and merge the DNA of each monster component, adding one limb at a time. Completing each course is how you keep building your runner.
How do I control my monster?
Hold to run and slide to move through the course. Use these two inputs together to steer past obstacles.

offroad-truck-army-driving.intro: Offroad Truck Army Driving puts you behind the wheel of military trucks on rugged mountain terrain. You complete army driving missions across three packs, covering steep hills, muddy trails and rocky ground.
tips: Try all three military vehicles early on to see which handles steep hills and rough ground best for you.
Ease off the throttle before steep climbs and keep a steady pace rather than flooring it, so you keep traction on the slope.
On muddy trails, avoid sudden direction changes and pick the firmest-looking line through the mud.
On rocky sections, take the route with the fewest sharp rocks under your wheels and go slowly through tight spots.
Work through the three packs in order so the terrain and missions get harder at a pace you can learn from.
faq: What do I use to drive the truck?
Use the W, A, S and D keys to drive. The game's instructions list WASD as the only control.
What is the main goal of the game?
Your goal is to complete the army driving missions across the three packs. The missions involve navigating mountain terrain, steep hills, muddy trails and rocky landscapes.

wood-hexa-factory.intro: Wood Hexa Factory! is a cozy puzzle game where you tap colorful hexa pieces to send them down a conveyor belt and fill the boxes. Each level tests your strategy and puzzle-solving skills.
tips: Before you tap a color, check which box it belongs in so the piece lands where you need it.
Keep your workspace in mind, since the game asks you to manage it while sorting the hexes into trays.
Focus on finishing one box at a time rather than spreading pieces across several boxes at once.
Spend the money you earn on new slots and upgrades when you can, as they help you manage the factory more easily.
The music adds to the mood but is not needed to complete levels, so play with sound on or off depending on what helps you focus.
faq: What is the goal of Wood Hexa Factory!?
Your goal is to fill all the boxes by tapping colorful hexa pieces so they travel along the conveyor belt into the right trays. Completing this moves you to the next level.
How does money work in the game?
Money is spent on unlocking new slots and upgrades. Use it to expand your setup so you have more room to manage the pieces.

bottle-battle.intro: Bottle Battle is a puzzle game where you pour water between bottles of different sizes. Each level asks for a specific amount, and you clear it by getting the water to match that target.
tips: Read the required amount for the level before you pour anything, so you always know what you are aiming for.
Compare the sizes of the bottles first and work out which combinations could produce the target.
Pour in small steps and check the water level after each click, since one pour can overshoot the amount you need.
Before each pour, think about where the water will go and whether you can still reach the target afterward.
If you get stuck, work backward from the required amount to figure out which bottle you need to fill first.
faq: How do I clear a level?
Pour water between bottles until one of them holds the exact amount the level asks for.
What is the main control?
Click a water bottle to pour its contents into another bottle.

mini-car-room-parkour.intro: Mini Car: Room Parkour is an arcade driving game where you steer a tiny car across the floors and furniture of everyday rooms. Climb ramps, cross chairs and tables, and find routes through each space.
tips: Approach steep climbs at a slow, steady speed, since going too fast makes it harder to keep the car balanced.
Look at the furniture before you start and pick a route that uses ramps or flat surfaces you can reach safely.
If the car starts to tip, ease off the controls instead of pressing harder, which often makes the wobble worse.
Try a few different routes through each room, because some paths may be easier to hold than the first one you find.
Use short, careful key presses on tricky sections so you can correct your direction without overshooting.
faq: What is the goal of Mini Car: Room Parkour?
The goal is to drive your tiny car through each room's obstacle course, climbing and crossing furniture, and see how far you can get.
Which keys control the car?
Use the WASD keys or the arrow keys to drive. On mobile devices, use the virtual controls shown on screen.

spider-bubu.intro: Spider-Bubu is a wall-swinging game set in a Halloween city. Swing between walls, collect the candies and pumpkins, and reach the portal while avoiding blades and spikes.
tips: Plan each swing before you release, since the jump from one wall to the next is the main thing you control.
Scan the path for spinning blades and spikes first, then choose a swing that keeps you clear of them.
Grab the candies along the way when they sit on a safe route, but do not risk a dangerous swing just for a pickup.
Save the giant pumpkin and the other pumpkins as a checklist, because the portal only matters once all three are collected.
If a route looks crowded with hazards, try a shorter, slower swing first to get a feel for the timing before attempting a longer one.
faq: What is the goal of Spider-Bubu?
Collect all the Halloween candies and the three pumpkins, then safely reach the portal that appears in the city.
How do I move Spider-Bubu?
Tap and release to swing from wall to wall on mobile, or click and release with the mouse on PC.

frost-land-snow-survival.intro: Frost Land - Snow Survival is a base-building survival game set in an endless winter. You use a flamethrower to melt snow, find hidden resources, and grow your shelter while staying alive against the cold.
tips: Melt snow selectively. Clearing a patch takes effort, so focus on spots that look most likely to hide resources you need right now.
Check your supplies before you head out into a frozen zone. Heading into a new area with low supplies leaves you little room to recover if things go wrong.
Plan which frozen zones to explore before you commit. Choose one area at a time and bring back what you find to strengthen your base before moving on.
Watch for blizzards and freezing winds. Rather than pushing through bad weather, time your trips and return to shelter when conditions turn harsh.
Use your resources to upgrade your base early, then take on quests. Quest rewards can help you unlock new adventures and build up your position over time.
faq: How do I move my character?
On desktop, use W, A, S, and D or the arrow keys to move forward, left, backward, and right. On mobile, drag the on-screen joystick in the direction you want to go.
What should I focus on to survive longer?
Balance exploring with keeping your supplies stocked and your shelter strong. Melting snow is useful, but spending all your time in unknown zones can leave you exposed to the cold.

fairies-heart-style.intro: Fairies Heart Style is a dress-up game where you help two best friends prepare as cupid fairies for a Valentine's Day challenge. You pick outfits, accessories, hairstyles and makeup, all controlled with the left mouse button or touch.
tips: Choose a theme first, such as light and airy or luxurious and fabulous, and keep the outfit, accessories and hair in that style so the look feels cohesive.
Use the heart-themed accessories to tie the cupid look together, since they match the Valentine's Day setting.
Try a few hairstyle options before committing, because the hair you pick can change how the whole outfit reads.
Apply makeup last or check it after the outfit is set, so you can judge the full look and adjust if needed.
Explore the wide range of cosmetics and clothing rather than settling on the first options, since the game offers plenty of variety to test.
faq: What is the goal of Fairies Heart Style?
The goal is to help the two BFF fairies get ready for their Valentine's Day cupid challenge by styling their outfits, accessories, hair and makeup.
How do I control the game?
Use the left mouse button or touch to select items, clothing, hairstyles and cosmetics as you dress up each girl.

save-your-girl.intro: Save Your Girl is a short puzzle game where you free a captured partner from a cage held by robbers. Your first task is to open the lock on the door and work your way forward from there.
tips: Start by clicking the lock, since the instructions say that is how you open the door and move the story along.
Take a moment to look over the whole scene before each click so you can spot what you can interact with.
The description says to use your wisdom, so think through each step rather than clicking quickly at random.
Keep an eye on the robber and the hound, because they are the main threats standing between you and your girl.
If you get stuck, pause and check which object or part of the screen you have not tried yet.
faq: What do I do first in Save Your Girl?
The instructions say to click the lock to open the door. That is the starting action of the game.
What is the goal of the game?
You need to free your girl from the cage, which means getting past the robbers and the robber's hound.

charge-my-phone.intro: Charge My Phone! is a one-player logic puzzle where you connect every plug to its matching socket. You move pieces by dragging them with touch or a mouse.
tips: Look at the whole board before you move anything, and find plugs that have only one possible socket first.
Drag each plug slowly and check that it lands fully on its socket before you let go.
If you get stuck, move the plug that is blocking the most others, since clearing one path often opens the rest.
Work in a calm, steady rhythm rather than rushing, because the game rewards careful planning over speed.
faq: What is the goal of Charge My Phone!?
Your goal is to connect all the plugs to a matching socket so that every plug is charging.
How do I move the plugs?
Drag each plug onto a socket using touch on a touchscreen or the mouse on a computer.

foodhead-fighters.intro: FoodHead Fighters is a 3D street fighting action game where you pick a character and battle opponents one by one. Each opponent is tougher than the last, so smart play matters.
tips: Learn what each button does early: z hits, x grabs, c kicks, and v defends. Mixing them up in a fight is a common way to lose.
Use the defend key when an opponent is about to attack, then counter once their attack has passed.
Use jumps to reposition yourself rather than jumping straight into an attack, since airborne moves can leave you open.
Earn your rewards in the early fights, then use them to build up your skills before you face the stronger opponents.
Beat each level before moving up in difficulty, because later levels are more dangerous and rush-ins are easy to punish.
faq: What is the goal of FoodHead Fighters?
Your goal is to beat each opponent on the street. Defeating each one earns rewards and unlocks higher difficulty levels.
Which keys control movement?
Use WASD or the keyboard arrow keys to move your character around the street.

candlebound-coven.intro: Candlebound Coven is a five-minute survivor-like roguelite where you guide Sister Mina, a nun cat, through dessert monsters while your rites attack automatically. Each run builds a new set of abilities.
tips: Stay on the move and steer toward glowing candle motes, since collecting them is how you level up and gain new rites.
At each level-up, compare the three offered rites and favor ones that work well together, so your build stays focused rather than scattered.
Keep an eye on the timer: bosses wake every 45 seconds, so plan your position before each one arrives.
Use your run-to-run progress wisely by spending Candles on the Moon Tree and in the Coven Shop between attempts.
Check the daily and weekly tasks for extra Candles to spend, which can help you prepare for harder dreams.
faq: What is the goal of a run?
You need to survive the five-minute dream, including its bosses, until morning arrives. Reaching the morning clears that dream and opens the next one.
Do I need to press any attack button?
No. Your rites cast themselves, so your job is to move Mina, collect candle motes, and choose upgrades.

thousand-suns.intro: Thousand Suns is a five-minute space conquest match where you race four AI rivals from a single homeworld. This guide covers the controls and a few habits that help you expand faster.
tips: Your homeworld builds ships on its own, so keep it from sitting idle by sending its fleet out to claim neutral planets early.
Use click-and-drag to connect your planets with ferry lanes so new ships flow automatically toward the front. This saves you from manually sending every wave.
Choose targets with a clear purpose: take neutral worlds that are easy to reach before attacking enemy territory, so your fleet grows while rivals are still expanding.
When a planet levels up, pick its upgrade with the pulsing arrow based on your current need, whether that is more Industry, Agriculture, or Research.
Keep an eye on the four rivals and reinforce planets that border them, since every new planet you take adds both production and pressure.
faq: What is the goal of Thousand Suns?
Your goal is to expand faster than the four AI rivals and bring the galaxy under your control before the five-minute match ends.
How do I send ships to another planet?
Left click one of your planets to select it, then left click the target planet. If the target is enemy or neutral your fleet attacks, and if it is yours your fleet reinforces it.

truck-jam-puzzle.intro: Truck Jam Puzzle is a 3D sorting puzzle where you untangle colorful trucks by sending them out in the right order. Match each truck to cargo of the same color before the timer runs out.
tips: Before each click, check which trucks have a clear route out, since only those can be selected.
Park trucks only in loading slots that help you reach matching cargo soon, and avoid filling every slot with trucks that cannot collect cargo.
Look for locked, frozen, hidden, and overheating trucks early and plan around them so they do not block your next moves.
Save the on-screen boosters for moments when you are truly stuck rather than using them at the start of a level.
Keep an eye on the timer and work quickly, because finishing faster earns more stars on each level.
faq: How do I move a truck in Truck Jam Puzzle?
Click or tap a truck that has a clear route, then click or tap an empty loading slot to park it. You can use the left mouse button or touch controls, and no keyboard keys are needed.
How do I win a level?
Match each truck's color to the waiting cargo and clear all trucks before the timer runs out. Fully loaded trucks leave the board, which frees space for your next move.

goodnight-my-baby.intro: Goodnight My Baby is an action game about stepping into a baby monster's home as night falls. Your goal is to put the little monster to sleep. You play with mouse clicks or taps.
tips: Take a moment to look around the home before you act, since the scene is the main reason to play.
Click or tap slowly and deliberately rather than quickly, so you can see how each action affects the baby.
Try different spots in the room to learn what the baby responds to.
Keep your attention on the baby monster, because the goal is to get it to sleep.
If you get stuck, pause for a few seconds, look at the scene again, and then try a different approach.
faq: What is the goal of Goodnight My Baby?
The goal is to go into the baby monsters' home at night and put the baby to sleep.
How do I control the game?
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps only, so you interact with the scene by clicking or tapping on it.

hugie-wugie-runner.intro: Hugie Wugie is learning to ride a bike on a hilly road. Your job is to keep him balanced as he speeds up over hills and down the other side so he does not fall off.
tips: Watch the road ahead rather than just the bike, since the hills and descents show up before the hero reacts to them.
Expect the bike to speed up gradually, so give your inputs in small, steady amounts instead of sudden large ones.
Pay extra attention as the hero goes over a hill crest and starts to descend, because balance can be lost quickly at that point.
If you fall and lose the round, take a moment to notice where the balance slipped so you can respond earlier on the next attempt.
Keep your mouse or finger relaxed and your focus steady, because small corrections are usually easier to manage than fixing a large tilt.
faq: What is the goal of Hugie Wugie Runner?
Your goal is to help Hugie Wugie keep his balance on the bike as he rides over hills and descends from them. If he falls off, the round is lost and you start again.
How do I control the bike?
You control the game with your mouse or by touching the screen. Use these inputs to keep the hero balanced as the bike speeds along the road.

street-racer-2d.intro: Street Racer 2D is a drag-racing driving game where you win races, upgrade your car, and buy new ones. It includes drag racing, off-road challenges, and arcade-style track action.
tips: Use the gear keys W and S to shift up and down as you go, rather than relying on acceleration alone. Keeping your gears matched to your speed helps you stay in control.
Save Shift for the moments when you need a burst of speed, such as the final stretch of a drag race. Using it constantly can leave you with no boost when it counts.
Learn how each mode handles differently before you enter it. Off-road challenges call for a different approach than fast street racing, so adjust your pace to the terrain.
Press P to pause and take a moment to plan your next move if a race is getting away from you. A short break can help you refocus before you continue.
Spend your winnings on upgrades that match the races you enjoy most. Build your car around the mode you play most often to make steady progress.
faq: What is the goal of Street Racer 2D?
Your goal is to win races, upgrade your car, and buy new cars. Each race you win helps you improve your garage over time.
What do the keyboard controls do?
A or the left arrow reverses, D or the right arrow accelerates, W or the up arrow shifts up a gear, and S or the down arrow shifts down. Shift activates turbo, R restarts, and P pauses the game.

moving-balls-going-sphere.intro: Go Ball – Race Balls is a 3D rolling game where you guide a ball along ramps and narrow paths using swipes. Stay balanced, jump over gaps, and reach the finish line quickly.
tips: Make small, steady swipes rather than large ones, since big movements can tip the ball off a narrow path.
Slow down before ramps and narrow sections so you can correct your balance in time.
Watch the path ahead for jumps and obstacles, and plan your swipes a moment before you reach them.
Look for power-ups and hidden shortcuts, as they can help you gain time or find a faster route.
Use the different worlds, such as forest trails and sky cities, to learn how each layout changes the way the ball feels.
faq: How do I move the ball?
Swipe left or right to balance and move the ball along the path. Small, controlled swipes are usually easier to manage than fast, large ones.
What is the goal of each level?
Your goal is to reach the finish line as fast as you can while avoiding falling off the path and dodging obstacles along the way.

halloween-is-coming-episode-10.intro: Halloween is Coming Episode 10 is a point and click escape puzzle set in a snow world. You play as John, who needs to find hidden objects and solve puzzles to get out.
tips: Click on every part of a scene, including edges and corners, since hidden objects can be easy to overlook at first glance.
Keep a mental or written list of items you have picked up and where you saw them, so you can match them to puzzles later.
When a puzzle stalls, look back at recently visited areas, as clues or items you skipped earlier are often the key to the next step.
Try combining items you have collected with objects in the scene before assuming you are stuck.
Take your time and read every clue closely, because the game is built around puzzles that reward careful observation over speed.
faq: What is the goal of Halloween is Coming Episode 10?
The goal is to help John escape from a snow world by solving puzzles and finding hidden objects.
How do I control the game?
You interact with the game using the mouse, clicking on objects and areas in each scene.

fishdom-online.intro: Fishdom Online is a casual puzzle game that mixes puzzles, merges, mini-games and collections. You play with mouse clicks or taps, and each task adds a new challenge.
tips: Try a few different activities before settling on one. The game offers puzzles, merges, mini-games and collections, so you can see which ones suit you best.
Take your time on puzzles and plan a few moves ahead instead of clicking quickly. Strategic thinking is part of what the game rewards.
Check your collections regularly so you know which items you still need. Working toward a specific collection gives your play a clear direction.
Use short sessions to enjoy the relaxed pace. Stepping away between tasks can help you come back with a fresh approach.
Work through the tasks and challenges in order and notice which ones feel hardest. Repeating them with a new approach is a good way to build your skills.
faq: How do I play Fishdom Online?
Use a mouse click or tap to interact with the game. Each puzzle, merge, mini-game and task is played this way.
What kinds of activities are in the game?
The game includes puzzles, merges, mini-games and collections. These are combined with a variety of tasks and challenges.

crazy-bob.intro: Crazy Bob is an arcade adventure where you explore floating islands, battle enemies, and get past traps and obstacles. Complete quests to unlock portals to new lands.
tips: Open the tutorial from the main menu before you head out, so you know all the controls.
Practice both attacks early: the punch is quick, while the spin attack is the one to use when you're surrounded.
Use jump to get past traps and obstacles instead of running into them, and watch the ground before each leap.
Explore each floating island fully so you can find quests and the portals that lead to new lands.
Keep moving with W, A, S and D rather than standing still, so you can dodge enemies and reposition for your next attack.
faq: What is the goal of Crazy Bob?
Your aim is to explore floating islands, overcome traps and obstacles, and complete quests. Finishing quests helps you unlock new portals to unexplored lands.
What are the controls?
Use W, A, S and D to move and the spacebar to jump. Punch with the red button or right mouse button, and use the purple button or R for a spin attack.

square-crusher.intro: Square Crusher is a cube-crushing puzzle where you tap unlocked cubes or boxes so their crushed balls match the front crates. Plan each tap so the conveyor belt never fills up.
tips: Before tapping, look at which crate is currently at the front and which colors it needs, then choose a cube or box that will produce those colors.
Only tap cubes or boxes that are unlocked; locked ones cannot be used, so check the board before each move.
Avoid tapping quickly in a row without planning, since mismatched balls can fill the conveyor belt fast.
Keep an eye on the conveyor belt space. When it starts to get crowded, focus on taps that send matching balls into the front crate.
Finish nearly full crates when you can, because once a crate is full the next one in the queue moves forward and the flow of matching balls keeps going.
faq: What is the main goal of Square Crusher?
Fill all the crates and finish all the boxes before the conveyor belt becomes full. Both must be done to complete the level.
Why does the game end?
The game ends if the conveyor belt becomes full and no ball can match the front crates. Careless tapping is the usual cause.

rotating-pomni.intro: Rotating Pomni is a platform puzzle game where you turn the world to guide Pomni to his lost stars. It has 40 challenge levels that test your logical thinking.
tips: Before you click, study the whole level and work out the route Pomni needs to reach the star. Planning the path first saves wasted rotations.
Rotate the world in small steps and watch how Pomni moves after each change. This helps you learn how each turn affects his position.
If you get stuck, reset your idea of the solution and look at the level from a different angle. Trying a new approach often reveals the answer.
Focus on one part of the puzzle at a time instead of trying to solve everything at once. Clearing each section step by step keeps the level manageable.
Play in short sessions so you stay precise. Tired eyes and rushed clicks are a common cause of mistakes in puzzle games like this.
faq: What is the goal of Rotating Pomni?
Your goal is to rotate the world so Pomni can reach his lost stars. Each level is a platform puzzle built around that aim.
How do I control the game?
You play with mouse clicks or taps. Use these to rotate the world and move the puzzle toward Pomni's star.

planes-dodge-and-go.intro: Planes Dodge & Go puts you in the cockpit of a fighter pilot during The Great War. Dodge projectiles and opponents in intense dogfights and see how long you can stay in the air.
tips: Keep your plane moving rather than sitting still, since a stationary plane is an easier target for projectiles.
Spot incoming shots early and make small position changes instead of sharp last-second dodges.
Pay attention to where opponents are pointing and move toward open sky away from their line of fire.
Use slow, steady drags to adjust your position, because overcorrecting with big movements can put you into danger.
Since survival is the goal, avoid chasing opponents and focus on staying out of harm's way.
faq: How do I move my plane?
Right-click and hold, then drag to move your plane. Movement only happens while you are both dragging and right-clicking.
What is the goal of the game?
The goal is to survive as long as possible while dodging projectiles and opponents in dogfights.

stickboys-xmas.intro: StickBoys Xmas is a two-player Christmas adventure where the red and blue stick boys must work together to reach the door. Collect keys, grab the candies, and avoid obstacles along the way.
tips: Agree on a order before you start, such as who goes first and who waits, so you do not block each other on narrow paths.
Use the double jump to clear gaps and obstacles, and time the second jump before you commit to a long leap.
Collect the keys before heading to the door, since you need to reach the exit together with your friend.
Keep an eye on your partner's position and wait for them when needed, because the goal depends on both characters arriving.
Watch for obstacles closely as you grab candies, and slow down near hazards rather than rushing to collect every item.
faq: What is the goal of StickBoys Xmas?
Help the red and blue stick boys collect the keys and candies, avoid obstacles, and reach the door together.
How do I control the two characters?
Use WASD for one stick boy and the arrow keys for the other, and double jump when you need extra height. Touch controls are also available for mobile play.

shark-attack.intro: Shark Attack is an online .io game where you compete with other players on the same server to become the biggest shark. Steering is done with your mouse or touch input.
tips: Keep your movements smooth and deliberate, since your shark follows your mouse or touch position and quick, jerky changes can make it hard to control.
Watch the other sharks on the server before you commit to a direction, so you can see where bigger and smaller players are heading.
Stay alert in crowded areas, because the server is shared with many other players and encounters can happen quickly.
Plan your route ahead of time rather than reacting only at the last second, which helps you stay on course toward your goal of growing.
Take short breaks to reassess the map if you notice you keep getting caught in the same spot, and try a different part of the arena.
faq: What is the goal of Shark Attack?
The goal is to become the biggest shark on the server. You are competing against other players in an online multiplayer arena.
How do I move my shark?
Use your mouse or touch input to steer. Your shark moves in the direction you point or touch.

space-strike-galaxy-shooter.intro: Space Strike: Galaxy Shooter is an arcade shooter where you pilot a spaceship to defend planets from alien attacks. Use the controls to dodge, fire, and unleash your ultimate at the right moments.
tips: Keep your ship moving rather than sitting still, since staying in one spot makes you an easy target for enemy fire.
Save your ultimate for a moment when several enemies are close together or when you are under heavy pressure, so it does the most good.
Use the gas control in short bursts to reposition quickly instead of holding it constantly, which helps you stay in control of your movement.
Fire in steady bursts and watch your aim, since holding the shot button without pause can make it harder to track incoming threats.
If a fight gets overwhelming, use Esc to pause and regroup your thinking before you continue.
faq: What is the goal of Space Strike: Galaxy Shooter?
You protect planets from alien threats by flying your ship, shooting enemies, and surviving intense space battles.
How do I control my ship on PC?
Use the arrow keys to move, the Up arrow to use gas, Alt to shoot, and Shift to use your ultimate. Press Esc to pause.

drift-master-3d.intro: Drift Master 3D is an endless arcade driving game where you hold to drift right and release to drift left. Time your turns through tight corners and narrowing roads to stay alive as long as you can.
tips: Keep your turns short and steady rather than holding for long stretches, so you can react to the next corner before the road narrows.
Watch the road ahead instead of your car, since corners are generated as you go and you need to start your input early.
Collect coins whenever it is safe to do so, because they are how you earn enough to unlock the other cars.
Chain drifts together to build combos, since linking turns is what multiplies your score and lifts you up the leaderboard.
Practice the release timing on the left turns, because letting go too early or too late is the most common way to clip the edge of the road.
faq: What is the goal of Drift Master 3D?
Survive as long as you can while drifting through endless corners, collecting coins and avoiding obstacles. Your score grows the longer you last and the more combos you chain.
How do I steer on a computer?
Hold the Left Mouse Button or the Spacebar to drift right, and let go to drift left. The timing of pressing and releasing is what controls every turn.

offroad-cargo-truck-2024.intro: Offroad Cargo Truck 2024 is a driving simulator set on forest trails, where you steer a rugged truck along winding, uneven paths. The controls are simple, so most of the challenge comes from handling the terrain.
tips: Ease off the throttle before sharp bends on the winding trails so the truck keeps its grip and does not slide.
Take uneven ground slowly. The advanced suspension handles bumps well, but going fast over ruts can still knock you off line.
Pick a steady line through the trail rather than cutting corners through thick greenery, which can slow you down.
Use short, controlled inputs with WASD instead of holding keys down, especially when you need fine adjustments on narrow paths.
Keep an eye on the cargo area's load and your speed together, since a heavier, faster truck is harder to control on slopes.
faq: What is the goal of Offroad Cargo Truck 2024?
The description focuses on driving the truck through forest trails and offroad exploration. Take your time to enjoy the route and keep the truck under control.
How do I control the truck?
Use the W, A, S and D keys to drive. The instructions list WASD as the only control.

flappy-halloween-game.intro: Flappy Halloween Game is a one-button flying game where you guide a Halloween-themed character through obstacles. The goal is to fly as far as you can and beat your previous high score.
tips: Use small, steady taps rather than holding down the input, since each press lifts your character and the drop between presses is what keeps you in the gap.
Pick a point in the middle of the upcoming gap and aim your character toward it, instead of reacting only when you are close to an obstacle.
Watch the spacing between obstacles so you can plan your rhythm early and avoid sudden corrections.
Stay calm during the first few obstacles, because the game gets harder as your score climbs and early habits carry over.
After a crash, restart right away and focus on one or two obstacles at a time to build a consistent rhythm.
faq: What is the goal of Flappy Halloween Game?
You fly your Halloween character through the obstacles to get the highest score you can. Each run is a chance to beat your previous high score.
How do I control the character?
Tap, click, or press to keep your character in the air. The instructions say to use the mouse to click any button in the game.

digital-circus-parkour-game.intro: Digital Circus: Parkour Game is a 3D adventure where you move through unique parkour tracks made by Caine. Your aim is to help Pomni find the exit and escape the circus.
tips: Look around with the mouse or right joystick before you start a jump, so you can see the platforms and the route ahead.
Use WASD or the left joystick for short, controlled moves near edges instead of running at full speed.
Press Space or the jump button only when you have lined up your landing, since a rushed jump is the most likely way to fall.
Try right-clicking to use Focus when you need to steady your aim for a tricky section.
Keep an eye out for the exit as you go, because each track is designed to lead toward it.
faq: What is the goal of Digital Circus: Parkour Game?
You pass the parkour levels prepared by Caine inside the circus and find the exit to escape. The game asks you to help Pomni get out.
How do I move and jump?
Use WASD or the left joystick to move and the mouse or right joystick to look around. Press Space or the jump button to jump.

stumble-boys-party-royale.intro: Stumble Boys: Party Royale is a multiplayer party game of chaotic mini-games that change every round. Races to a checkpoint, door hunts, and last-platform survival all test quick reactions.
tips: Expect a different mini-game each round, so reset your focus as soon as a new one starts instead of carrying over the last round's approach.
In checkpoint sprints, keep moving forward and use jumps to clear obstacles rather than stopping to adjust your path.
When you need to find the right door, scan the options quickly and pick a direction early, since hesitating costs time.
On the last-platform rounds, stay near the center of the platform where possible and avoid making sudden moves that could send you off the edge.
Use your jump sparingly and time it with your movement, so you land where you want without losing momentum.
faq: How do I move and jump on PC?
Use the W, A, S and D keys to move and press Space to jump.
How do I play on mobile?
Tap the on-screen buttons to move and jump during a round.

mega-sweet-fruits-popper.intro: Mega Sweet Fruits - Popper is a matching arcade game with 125 levels. Tap groups of matching fruits to pop them, and avoid the bombs hidden among them.
tips: Before each tap, scan the whole board for groups that run horizontally, vertically, or diagonally, and pick the one that looks safest.
Watch for fruits that might hide bombs, since each bomb costs you 1 life and you lose when your lives reach zero.
Spend your early upgrades on tap earnings or starting lives, depending on whether you want to score faster or have more room for mistakes.
Save pomegranates for levels where the board is crowded or the required fruit count is high, because one pomegranate clears every fruit on screen.
Keep an eye on the required fruit count as you play, since new fruits drop in if you have not cleared enough yet.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You need to pop enough fruits to reach the required count for the level. If you have not cleared enough, new fruits will keep dropping until you succeed.
How do I pop fruits?
Tap on a group of matching fruits that are lined up horizontally, vertically, or diagonally. Each pop earns you points.

arrows-out-3d.intro: Arrows Out 3D is a calm 3D puzzle about sliding arrow-marked paper blocks out of a solid shape. Each block must have a clear path in the direction its arrow points.
tips: Rotate the shape before you tap anything. Blocks often look free from one side but have an arrow blocked from another angle.
Look for blocks on the outer edges of the shape first. Their arrows usually point into open space, so they are the easiest to clear.
Work backwards from the blocks in the middle. Removing one that blocks several others can open up a whole section at once.
Save your hearts by checking the path before each tap. A bump costs a heart, so a short pause to read the arrow is worth it.
Use Hint when you are stuck rather than guessing. Coins are earned by clearing levels cleanly, so spending them on a wrong guess wastes them.
faq: What is the goal of Arrows Out 3D?
The goal is to clear every block from the shape. Each block must slide out in the direction of its arrow without hitting another block.
How do I move a block?
Left click or tap a block to slide it in the direction its arrow points. Click and drag or swipe to rotate the shape and see every side.

newbie-s-escape-from-blogger-prison.intro: Newbie's Escape from Blogger Prison is a 3D platforming adventure where you explore a prison, avoid traps, and outsmart patrolling guards on the way to freedom. Each level adds new obstacles to work through.
tips: Watch the guard patrols for a few seconds before moving. Note their route and timing so you can cross open areas when they are facing away.
Before crossing a laser trap or passing a surveillance camera, study its pattern from a safe spot. Moving in short bursts between gaps is usually safer than running straight through.
Use the mouse or the right-side swipe to turn the camera before each jump. Seeing the landing spot clearly helps you avoid falling off platforms.
Explore off the main route when a level feels stuck. Hidden paths are part of the game, and a side route may be the way forward.
Keep your jumps controlled instead of rushing them. Short hops are easier to time than long leaps, especially near obstacles.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Your goal is to get through each prison level, avoid traps and guards, and reach freedom. The levels get more challenging as you progress.
How do I move and jump?
On PC, use W, A, S, D or the arrow keys to move and the Spacebar to jump. On mobile, use the joystick on the left to move and the button on the right to jump.

soldiers-runner.intro: Soldiers Runner is an action running game where you gather troops, fight enemies, and push through to destroy a great wall. Steering your army left and right is the core skill.
tips: Keep your squad moving toward the gates and rewards that add troops, since a bigger group is what lets you handle tougher enemies later.
Steer early rather than at the last second so you have time to line up with gates and collectibles without clipping obstacles.
Pick up upgrades whenever they are safely reachable, as they make the run easier in the stages ahead.
Watch how many troops you have before each enemy group and avoid fights you cannot win, since losing your army slows your progress.
Aim for the wall at the end of each level with a full squad, because the grand prize grows with each level and rewards careful play.
faq: How do I move my soldiers on desktop?
Use the A and D keys or the Left and Right arrow keys to move left and right. Staying responsive with small adjustments works better than sharp, late turns.
How do I control the game on mobile?
Swipe left or right to move and turn your troops. Short, steady swipes help you line up with gates and avoid enemies.

cube-surf-online.intro: Cube Surf Online is a 3D arcade game where you grow a stack of cubes by collecting them while steering around walls. It is played with a mouse or your finger.
tips: Move in small, steady steps rather than sharp swings, so you can react to walls that appear close ahead.
Look a bit further ahead than your current position and plan your next move before a wall reaches you.
Only go after cubes when the path is clear; chasing one straight into a wall can end your run quickly.
Keep your attention on the walls more than the cubes, since avoiding a crash matters most for keeping your stack.
Take short breaks between runs to reset your focus, as steady attention tends to help more than rushing.
faq: What is the main goal of Cube Surf Online?
The goal is to grow your stack of cubes while avoiding the walls. Collecting cubes and staying clear of obstacles are the core of each run.
How do I control my cube?
Use your mouse or your finger to move. Steer smoothly so you can dodge walls and reach cubes.

bird-quest-adventure-flappy.intro: Bird Quest is a flappy-style flying game where you steer a bird through obstacles and monsters while collecting coins, stars and diamonds. Points add up as you grab items, and you can use them to unlock new legendary birds.
tips: Tap or click with a steady rhythm rather than mashing, so your bird rises in small controlled hops and you can react to what is coming next.
Look ahead to the next gap or monster before you commit to a climb, since your bird keeps moving forward and corrections need time.
Route your flight through coins, stars and diamonds when it is safe to do so, because grabbing items is the main way to raise your score.
Keep your bird near the middle of the screen when possible, which gives you room to dodge both high and low threats.
Use each run to learn the pattern of obstacles and monsters, then aim to beat your previous highscore rather than chasing every item.
faq: What is the goal of Bird Quest?
Fly as far as you can while dodging obstacles and monsters, and collect coins, stars and diamonds to build your points.
How do I control the bird?
Use mouse or touch to make the bird fly upward. Release the input to let it drop again.

3d-pool-mania.intro: 3D Pool Mania is a single-player billiards game where you aim, set power, and strike the cue ball. Realistic physics reward careful angles and well-judged shots.
tips: Before you shoot, look at where the cue ball needs to end up, not only where the target ball is going. Planning the next shot keeps you from leaving yourself a hard position.
Make small drag adjustments when aiming, since a slight change in angle can shift where the object ball lands.
Start with gentler power on shots you are unsure about. You can learn how the physics responds before committing to a hard hit.
Use spin carefully. Small amounts of spin change how the cue ball travels after contact, so test it on easy shots first.
Practise trick shots at a relaxed pace. Repeating the same angle a few times helps you judge how much power and aim you need.
faq: How do I aim my shot?
Drag to aim the cue stick, then adjust the power meter to set how hard you hit. Release to strike the cue ball.
How do I control how hard the cue ball is hit?
Use the power meter before you release. A stronger setting sends the cue ball farther, so match the power to the distance you need.

watermelon-fruit-2048.intro: Watermelon Fruit 2048 is an arcade puzzle where you drop fruits with your mouse and merge matching pairs into bigger fruits. Your goal is to create the biggest fruit, the watermelon, for 1000 points.
tips: Plan each drop so the new fruit lands on top of a matching fruit, since only identical fruits merge.
Keep the fruits you are building toward in one area of the screen so you can see which pairs are ready to join.
Drop fruits where they will collide with the matching fruit, because the merged fruit appears at the spot where they meet.
Work toward larger fruits step by step rather than hoping for a watermelon by chance, because each merge builds on the one before.
Take your time with each click or drag, since good placement matters more than speed in this relaxing game.
faq: How do I play Watermelon Fruit 2048?
Click or drag and drop fruits anywhere on the screen onto a fruit of the same type. Two matching fruits merge into a bigger fruit where they collide.
How do I earn points?
You earn points each time you drop a fruit onto a matching fruit and make a merge. Blasting the watermelon, the biggest fruit, gives 1000 points.

screw-jam-puzzle.intro: Screw Jam Puzzle is a colour-sorting puzzle where you unscrew boards, drop the pieces in order, and fill screw boxes with matching colours. There are no time limits, so you can take each move at your own pace.
tips: Before you unscrew anything, look at which colours are on each board and which boxes are open. Planning the order saves you from getting stuck later.
Clear the boards that sit on top of others first, since they are the ones blocking the rest of the puzzle.
Fill one screw box at a time rather than spreading matching colours across several boxes, so each box finishes sooner.
Because there is no clock, slow down when a level looks crowded and check your next move before you commit to it.
Save your boosters for levels where you have tried a few approaches and feel stuck, instead of using them at the start.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Unscrew the boards, drop them one by one, and fill each screw box with screws of the same colour. You win when every box is full.
Is there a time limit?
No. The game has no time limits, so you can play each level at your own pace.

fireball-and-waterball-adventure-3.intro: Fireball and Waterball is a two-player adventure where the brothers use their own powers to move through the level together. Each player controls one character with separate keys.
tips: Keep both characters close together so each one can help the other get past obstacles.
Use Waterball's ability to turn water into ice when you need a walkable path over water.
Use Fireball's ability to burn wood when wooden barriers block the way forward.
Decide who handles which part of a tricky section before you start, so you do not get in each other's way.
Practice jumping with both characters first to get a feel for the timing before attempting harder jumps.
faq: How do I control the two characters?
Player 1 uses A and D to move and W to jump. Player 2 uses the arrow keys to move and jump.
What is the goal of the game?
The goal is to move the two brothers through the adventure together, using their powers to get past obstacles.

3d-block-gladiator-sword-draw.intro: 3D Block Gladiator: Sword Draw is an arena fighting game where you draw lines on the screen to move, dodge, and attack. Timing and planning decide who survives each fight.
tips: Watch the enemy for a moment before you draw. Their next strike is easier to dodge when you have read their rhythm.
Keep your drawn lines simple and clear so your gladiator moves exactly where you intend.
Plan your dodge first, then your attack. Moving out of danger before swinging keeps you from getting caught off guard.
Since one wrong move can end your run, play cautiously when your health or position is weak and take safer openings.
Practice your swipes and slashes on easier moments to get a feel for how precisely your lines control the gladiator.
faq: What is the main goal of 3D Block Gladiator: Sword Draw?
Your goal is to outmaneuver your enemies in the arena and claim victory. You do this by controlling your gladiator's moves with well-timed attacks and dodges.
How do I control my gladiator?
You draw lines directly on the screen. The lines determine your gladiator's movement, dodges, and attacks.

your-obby-labyrinth.intro: Your Obby Labyrinth is a multiplayer maze adventure where you race to the end of tricky mazes. You can team up with friends, solve puzzles, and dodge traps and monsters along the way.
tips: Look for doors, levers, buttons, and keys before you commit to a path, since many routes need one of these to open the way forward.
Press E to interact with levers, buttons, and doors, and check whether a button or switch changed something nearby before moving on.
Jump carefully with the Space bar, especially near traps and narrow ledges, and pause with TAB if you need a moment to plan your next move.
Use the mouse wheel to zoom out when a maze feels crowded, so you can spot hidden paths, sneaky traps, and monsters coming from further away.
When playing with friends, split up to check different branches of the maze and call out what you find so the group reaches the end faster.
faq: What is the goal of Your Obby Labyrinth?
The goal is to get to the end of each maze. Along the way you can use keys, levers, and buttons to escape and move on.
Which keys control the movement and jumping?
Use WASD to move and the Space bar to jump. Press E to interact with objects such as doors, levers, and buttons.

animal-transform-race.intro: Animal Transform Race is a reaction-based racing game where you switch between animals that each suit different tracks. Good timing and quick animal choices help you take the lead.
tips: Learn which animals are fast on which tracks, since each one is strong in some areas and very slow in others.
Make your animal changes early rather than waiting, because quicker choices give you more advantages during the race.
Keep your eyes on the track ahead so you can switch to the right animal before you reach a difficult section.
Use the mouse or touch controls for solo play, and try the A, S, D keys or J, K, L keys if you are playing two player mode.
Spend the coins you earn from races in the market to unlock new animals, and try them to find the ones that suit your style.
faq: What is the goal of Animal Transform Race?
The goal is to lead the race by choosing the right animal at the right time. Each animal has strengths and weaknesses depending on the track.
How do I change animals?
You can click with the mouse or use touch controls. In two player mode, use the A, S, D keys or the J, K, L keys as shortcuts.

animal-merge.intro: Animal Merge is a puzzle game where you launch animal bubbles and combine matching pairs to grow them into fully developed animals. Your goal is to collect the required number of final animals to complete each level.
tips: Before you launch, look for two bubbles of the same animal that you can bounce into each other. Setting up a merge is often more useful than shooting at random.
Remember that a final animal needs two intermediate animals, and each intermediate needs two basic ones. Keep track of how many of each stage you have so you can plan the next merge.
Try to keep matching bubbles near each other on the field, so a single shot can start a new merge chain.
Take a moment to check your aim before releasing, since the bubble travels in the opposite direction of your drag.
You do not need to collect final animals yourself, because they are collected automatically once created. Focus your effort on building them.
faq: How do I aim and shoot an animal bubble?
Tap a bubble to select it, drag it backward to aim, and release to launch it in the opposite direction.
What makes two bubbles merge?
When two identical animal bubbles collide, they merge into an upgraded version of that animal.

robot-fighting-adventure.intro: Robot Fighting Adventure is a robot battle game where fights test both wisdom and strength. You explore the map as a robot warrior and unlock new levels as you go.
tips: Think before you act in each fight. The game says it tests wisdom as well as strength, so a careful plan can matter as much as raw force.
Try to read what your opponent does before you commit to a move. Watching a few moments first can help you choose when to strike.
Explore the whole map instead of rushing ahead. Looking around helps you find the paths and challenges that lead to new levels.
Take your time with each click or tap. Steady, deliberate input is usually better than fast, random clicking during a battle.
Use each fight to learn the rhythm of the game. Noting what worked in earlier levels can help you handle tougher challenges later.
faq: What is the goal of Robot Fighting Adventure?
You play as a robot warrior, explore the map, and win battles to unlock more levels.
How do I control my robot?
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps. Click or tap to perform actions in the game.

rotate-cups.intro: Rotate Cups is a physics puzzle where you turn cups into ramps so balls roll down the level and land in the blue cups. Every ball needs to end up in a blue cup to finish a level.
tips: Before rotating anything, watch where the ball starts and where it has to end up, then plan a rough path through the cups in between.
Rotate in small steps and pause to check the result, since levels are not timed and you can pause as often as you like.
If a level feels stuck, try skipping an intermediate cup or bumping the ball off the outside of a cup, which does not penalize you as long as the balls reach the blue cups.
On levels with a long reach, try a quick spin toward the destination first, then see whether a slight quick spin back as the ball leaves gives it the extra lift it needs.
Check how many balls each blue cup needs: larger cups can hold more than one ball, while each smaller blue cup needs at least one ball.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Get every ball into the blue cups lower on the screen. Larger blue cups can hold more than one ball, and each smaller blue cup needs at least one.
How do I rotate the cups?
On desktop, hold the left mouse button and drag to spin the cups. Drag left or down for clockwise and right or up for counterclockwise. On touchscreens, tap and drag your finger across the screen.

vehicle-transport-police-simulator.intro: Vehicle Transport Police Simulator puts you behind the wheel of buses, jeeps, and trucks to carry military personnel to their destinations. Missions involve varied terrain and obstacles, with the goal of delivering troops safely and on time.
tips: Learn how each vehicle handles before starting a mission, since buses, jeeps, and trucks differ in size and steering.
Use short, gentle steering inputs with W, A, S, and D to keep control on uneven ground and tight turns.
Scout the route in your head before you move, and slow down early for obstacles rather than braking hard at the last second.
Pay attention to the terrain changes, as a route that is easy on flat roads can be harder on rough or sloped sections.
Prioritise a safe arrival over speed, because the mission emphasises both timely delivery and keeping troops safe.
faq: How do I drive the vehicle?
Use the W, A, S, and D keys to drive. The game's instructions only mention these keys, so keep your inputs simple and steady.
What is the main goal of each mission?
Your goal is to transport military personnel to their destination safely and on time while navigating obstacles along the way.

demon-hunter-beat-em-up.intro: Demon Hunter: Beat Em Up is an illustrated arcade brawler where you fight through five chapters using melee combos, a shotgun, and Berserk. Mouse clicks or taps control all the action.
tips: Learn how your melee combos flow before pushing deeper, since landing attacks in sequence keeps enemies from recovering.
Use the shotgun on groups that are bunched together, and switch back to melee when enemies get close.
Save Berserk for tough moments, such as when several enemies are attacking at once, rather than spending it early in a chapter.
Watch enemy movements between attacks so you can time your clicks or taps instead of mashing them.
Replay earlier chapters to get comfortable with the rhythm of fights before moving on to harder encounters.
faq: What is the goal of Demon Hunter: Beat Em Up?
You fight through five chapters, defeating demons with melee combos, the shotgun, and Berserk. Progress through each chapter as you clear the enemies in it.
How do I control the character?
The game is played entirely with mouse clicks or taps. Click or tap to perform your attacks and actions.

merge-furry-monsters.intro: Merge Furry Monsters is a puzzle game where you drop fluffy monsters that combine with their own kind to form new, bigger monsters. Each merge creates a new character you can collect.
tips: Plan each drop before you release it, since matching monsters only merge when they meet their own kind.
Keep the middle of the play area clear so that new monsters have room to combine with matching ones.
Watch for pairs that are one step apart and try to set up the next merge rather than dropping at random.
Avoid stacking unmatched monsters high, because a full play area makes it harder to line up the next merge.
Take a short pause between drops to look at where each monster will land, which helps you keep the board organized.
faq: What is the goal of Merge Furry Monsters?
The goal is to drop monsters so they merge with their own kind and collect the new monsters that form. The game asks you to collect them and become the main Guardian of fluffy souls.
How do I control the game?
You drop monsters into the play area, and they merge automatically when they meet another monster of the same kind.

oil-rig-driller.intro: Oil Rig Driller is a top-down idle tycoon set in a desert oil field. You drill crude, refine it, stock your depot, and reinvest your cash to unlock all 19 upgrades.
tips: Keep your backpack moving: drill a rig, carry the load to its matching plant, then drop the barrels at the depot before walking back out. Idle time between trips costs you money.
Spend cash on upgrade pads as soon as you can afford them, starting with the upgrades that speed up your machines or add backpack space, since they pay back the fastest.
Fetch wrenches from the workshop regularly so your rigs stay in working order. Worn rigs slow your output, and the field never fully runs itself.
Check your yard during busy periods. Trucks take barrels from the depot and pay at the office, so stand on the green cash ring to collect the money they leave behind.
Before you leave the game, make sure your hired crew has enough rigs to work on. The crew keeps drilling while you are offline, so a well-stocked field earns more while you are away.
faq: What is the main goal of Oil Rig Driller?
Unlock all 19 upgrades and build the richest oil empire. Each upgrade adds new rigs, plants, workers, or better machines.
How do I move my barrels from the rig to the money?
Walk to a rig to drill it, carry the load to the matching plant to refine it, then drop the barrels at the depot. Trucks pick them up and pay at the office.

superhero-transform-change-race.intro: Superhero Transform - Change Race is a running race where you transform into different superheroes. Each hero has special abilities you use to avoid obstacles and pass opponents on the track.
tips: Watch the track ahead so you can see obstacles coming and plan when to use your hero's special ability.
Use each superhero's ability at the moment it helps most, such as just before an obstacle, rather than the instant it becomes available.
Keep an eye on the opponents around you, and use your abilities to get past them when you have a clear path.
Try each superhero and notice which abilities suit which parts of the track, then choose transformations to match the challenge ahead.
Click or tap with steady timing, since the game is controlled only by mouse clicks or taps, so quick, deliberate inputs help you react to obstacles.
faq: What is the goal of Superhero Transform - Change Race?
Your goal is to finish the race ahead of your opponents by running, transforming into superheroes, and using their abilities to avoid obstacles.
How do I control the game?
You play with mouse clicks or taps. Use your clicks or taps to run, transform, and activate your superhero's abilities.

not-before-bed-01.intro: Not Before Bed 01 is a cozy matching puzzle about tapping little monsters so they collect blocks of their color. Each board is cleared by collecting every block while managing a limited number of collection slots.
tips: Before tapping, look at which monsters are available and check which block colors are still left on the board.
Pick monsters that match colors you can finish soon, since a monster leaves after collecting three blocks and frees its slot.
Keep your collection slots open for colors you can complete, and avoid filling slots with colors that are spread across the board.
Watch the count of blocks each color still needs, so you can see which monster will leave next and plan the following taps.
If a board feels stuck, pause and scan the whole layout again before tapping, since a different order often opens up the rest of the blocks.
faq: What is the goal of Not Before Bed 01?
The goal is to clear every block on the board. You do this by tapping available monsters so they collect matching blocks.
How many blocks does a monster need to collect before it leaves?
A monster collects blocks of its color and leaves after collecting three. Its slot then becomes free for another monster.

cake-master-shop.intro: Cake Master Shop is a cooking and decorating game where you make sweet cakes step by step. Work through the levels to unlock new cake designs.
tips: Read each recipe step before you start mixing so you know which ingredients to gather first.
Put ingredients into the bowl before blending so the mixture comes together in one go.
Check the batter is ready before moving on to baking, so you do not have to start the cake over.
Choose fresh fruits that fit the cake you are making, since they are the final touch on many designs.
Try different kitchen tools to see which ones help you finish each step faster and more neatly.
faq: What is the goal of Cake Master Shop?
The goal is to make sweet, tasty cakes by gathering ingredients, mixing, baking, and decorating. Completing levels unlocks more cake types.
How do I play the game?
Use your mouse or tap the screen to pick ingredients, add them to bowls, blend, bake, and decorate. Follow each step in order.

echolocation-shooter.intro: Echolocation Shooter is a dark first-person shooter where you see only by firing. Clear neon enemies through endless waves while upgrading your gear.
tips: Fire a soundwave early in each new area so you can read the layout before enemies close in. Shots reveal the world, so use them to scout rather than to waste ammo.
Keep an eye on where the light has revealed enemies and where it has faded. Re-light areas you cannot currently see before moving into them.
Switch between your weapons with 1, 2, or the mouse scroll wheel based on the threat. Use the weapon that fits the enemy in front of you instead of sticking to one.
Save your grenade with key 3 for crowds or moments when you are surrounded. It lights up a wide area and can clear several enemies at once.
Use Shift to dodge when enemies get close, and jump with Space to reposition. Staying mobile helps you keep distance while you aim.
faq: What is the main goal of Echolocation Shooter?
Your goal is to eliminate the neon enemies and survive the endless waves. Each wave gets harder as you push deeper into the horde.
How do I see in the dark?
You can only see by generating soundwaves with your weapon. Left-click generates a soundwave, and every shot briefly reveals the world around you.

world-of-alice-the-bones.intro: World of Alice - The Bones is a puzzle game for children that teaches the bones of the human body and where each one is located. You complete the picture by choosing the answer that matches the missing bone.
tips: Before you click, look at where the empty box sits in the body, since its position is the quickest clue to which bone is missing.
Read every answer choice before selecting one, because some bone names sound similar and a quick guess can lead to a wrong pick.
Say the bone's name out loud as you choose it, which helps you remember it better than clicking silently.
