When you get one wrong, take a moment to notice where the correct bone is located so you can recognize it next time.
Play through again after finishing a round, focusing on the bones you missed, to build up your knowledge of the skeleton.
faq: What is the goal of World of Alice - The Bones?
The goal is to identify the bone that is missing from the box and learn where bones are located in the human body.
How do I play the game?
Click on the answer that corresponds to the missing bone shown in the box.

raven-estate.intro: Raven Estate is a fast-paced bullet-hell shoot-'em-up where you play a crow fighting through waves of monsters to reclaim a haunted estate. Weapons you place lock in the direction you pick them up, so positioning matters.
tips: Move with the arrow keys or WASD and keep your crow in motion so you can dodge enemy fire while you aim.
Think about direction before you pick up a weapon, since it locks to the way you collect it and cannot be turned later.
Place weapons so they cover the paths enemies take toward you, rather than clustering them in one spot.
Watch the incoming bullet patterns during each wave and move toward gaps instead of standing still.
Hold Space to confirm options in the menus, and take a moment to read choices before committing to them.
faq: What is the goal of Raven Estate?
You play a fearless crow reclaiming a haunted estate by blasting through waves of monsters and surviving the bullet-hell attacks.
How do I move my crow?
Use the arrow keys or WASD to move. You can also use these keys to navigate the menus.

tcg-shop-maps-toys-and-comics.intro: TCG Shop: Maps, Toys and Comics is a store management simulator where you stock shelves, serve customers and grow your business. Click on goods to place them on shelves and open new departments as your shop expands.
tips: Stock the shelves before you expand. Filling the goods you already have keeps the store working well before you spend on new departments.
Open new departments when you can afford them, since each one adds more items for customers to buy and more ways to earn.
Watch which products sell fastest and focus your restocking on those, so shelves are not left empty during busy periods.
Keep an eye on the cash register and deliveries so you always have enough money to restock and upgrade.
Try creating your own merch, comics and food as you progress, since these are unlocked through the game and can diversify your sales.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
The goal is to grow your store step by step, from a small shop to the level of a legendary marketplace, by selling goods and expanding your business.
How do I get goods onto the shelves?
Click on the goods to put them on the shelves. Keeping shelves filled is a key part of running the store.

wild-west-zombie-clash.intro: Wild West Zombie Clash is a 3D shooter where you play a gunslinger fighting off waves of zombies in a western setting. Survive each round to unlock new guns.
tips: Keep moving with WASD so zombies do not close in on you from several sides at once.
Use the right mouse button to aim when zombies are further away, since precise shots save ammo and time.
Switch weapons with the mouse wheel early, so you are never stuck with a weapon that is wrong for the current crowd.
Reload with R during a quiet moment rather than in the middle of a horde, so you are not left empty-handed.
Save grenades with G for large groups of zombies, where one throw can clear more of the horde than single shots.
faq: How do I unlock new guns?
You unlock new guns by surviving each round. Staying alive through the zombie hordes is the way to progress.
What is the best way to handle a large zombie horde?
Use grenades with G on dense groups and keep moving with WASD so you are not surrounded. Switch to a weapon that suits the crowd with the mouse wheel.

cute-family-shopping.intro: Cute Family Shopping is a supermarket and department store game where you help a baby shop by finding items and learning where they belong. It is built around recognizing products by color and appearance.
tips: Pay attention to the color and shape of each item, since the game asks you to identify products using these features.
Think about which area each product belongs in, such as the toy area or the daily necessities area, before you choose.
Use the questions about where things are as a chance to sort items into groups in your head, like food, toys, and household goods.
Take your time with each question instead of rushing, because the goal is to recognize and classify items correctly.
Play a few rounds in a row to get familiar with how the store areas are laid out and what kinds of products appear in each one.
faq: What is the goal of Cute Family Shopping?
The goal is to help the baby shop and learn to identify products and classify items into the correct areas of the store. Correct answers move the game along.
How do I play Cute Family Shopping?
Use your mouse or tap the screen to make choices. Pick the items and areas the game asks about.

santa-dungeon-of-doom.intro: Santa has to get through 100 dungeon levels full of bats, ghosts, monsters and traps. This Christmas puzzle adventure tests your quick reflexes and your problem-solving.
tips: Learn what each hazard does before you rush in. Spikes, guillotines and poison gas each call for a different response.
Keep an eye on the bats when they are chasing you. Plan your next move rather than reacting to the last one.
Ghosts may try to trick you, so don't assume the path that looks clear is safe. Pause to check what is ahead.
Use the jump button with care. Short, controlled jumps usually give you more control than jumping blindly.
If you play on touch controls, practise the left, right and jump buttons on a few levels first so your timing feels natural before the harder dungeons.
faq: What is the goal of Santa Dungeon Of Doom?
Your aim is to escape all 100 dungeons by getting through the monsters, traps and hazards in each level.
Which keys control Santa?
Use A to move left, D to move right, W to go up and Space to jump. Touch controls are also available.

zombies-vs-special-forces.intro: Zombies vs Special Forces is a third-person shooter where you clear territory of zombies. Pick a difficulty that matches your skill and move freely through each level.
tips: Start on an easier difficulty to learn how the aim and movement feel before moving up.
Keep moving with W, A, S and D so zombies cannot pin you in one spot, and aim with the mouse as you go.
Use the freedom to walk through levels to scout ahead and see where zombies are coming from before you commit to a fight.
Aim with the mouse cursor first, then fire with the left mouse button in short bursts rather than holding it down constantly.
Plan a route through each area so you always have a clear retreat path if a group of zombies closes in.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Your goal is to act as special forces and clear the territory of zombies to complete each mission.
How do I move and aim my character?
Use W to go forward, S to go back, A to step left and D to step right, and aim with the mouse cursor.

archer-super-hero.intro: Archer Super Hero is a 2D side-scrolling adventure where you guide an archer across Monster Valley. Each of its 30 levels asks you to collect every star as you fight and jump your way through.
tips: Use short jumps and steady running to judge gaps and platforms before committing to a long leap.
Attack monsters from a safe distance when you can, and step back to avoid their reach.
Before moving on, look around each stage for stars you may have skipped, since collecting all of them is part of the goal.
Pace yourself across the 30 levels by mastering the controls early, so the later challenges feel manageable.
If you keep losing to the same obstacle, pause and study its movement pattern, then time your jump or attack to match it.
faq: What is the main goal of Archer Super Hero?
Guide the archer across Monster Valley, get through each stage's challenges, and collect all the stars in every level.
Which keys control the archer?
Use D to run right, A to run left, W to jump, and K to attack.

tank-arena-multiplayer.intro: Tank Arena Multiplayer is a tank battle game where you fight other players online or practice against AI bots. Destroy enemies, collect power-ups, and progress through levels across multiple arena maps.
tips: Start with the AI bots on an easier difficulty to learn how your tank moves and aims before you join live matches.
Keep your tank moving rather than standing still, since staying in one spot makes you an easy target.
Pick up power-ups when it is safe: Speed Boost helps you reposition, Shield helps you survive a firefight, and Rapid Fire helps you finish off enemies.
Try both Primary and Secondary fire during bot matches so you know what each one does before a real fight.
Learn the layout of each arena map, since knowing where cover and open lanes are will help you aim and retreat.
faq: What is the goal of Tank Arena Multiplayer?
You battle against other players or AI bots, destroy your enemies, collect power-ups, and progress through the level system.
How many players can play online at once?
Real-time online multiplayer supports up to 4 players in a match.

sheep-sheep-duck.intro: Sheep Sheep Duck is a casual battle game with several scenes and scenarios. Defeat enemies to collect weapons and unlock new maps as you improve.
tips: Defeat enemies whenever you can, since doing so is how you collect weapons. Staying active in fights helps you build up your arsenal.
Try different battle scenarios and scenes to find the ones that suit your style. Switching things up can show you which setups feel most comfortable.
On PC, keep your movement keys (WASD) and attack keys (HJK) easy to reach so you can react quickly. Practice switching between moving and attacking.
On mobile, get comfortable with the on-screen buttons for moving and attacking before you take on tougher challenges. Smooth taps make it easier to stay in control.
Aim to unlock new maps by taking on bigger challenges once you feel confident. Pushing yourself a little at a time is the best way to progress.
faq: What is the goal of Sheep Sheep Duck?
The goal is to defeat enemies to get more weapons and show off your ability. Doing well also lets you unlock new game maps.
How do I move and attack in the game?
On PC, use WASD to move and HJK to attack. On mobile, tap the on-screen buttons to move and attack.

dark-ages-beat-em-up.intro: Dark Ages: Beat Em Up is an illustrated arcade brawler with five chapters. You fight using a flail, a Shield Saw, a parry, and a shotgun. Everything is played with mouse clicks or taps.
tips: Try each of the four tools early on so you know what each one does before the harder chapters.
Practise timing your parry, since it is one of the core defensive options and works best when you react to an incoming attack.
Do not rely on a single weapon. Switch between the flail, Shield Saw, and shotgun depending on how close or far enemies are.
Pay attention to how each chapter feels, as the pace and challenge can change as you move through the five chapters.
Stay calm and keep an eye on the screen rather than clicking rapidly, because well-timed inputs usually matter more than speed.
faq: How do I play Dark Ages: Beat Em Up?
You play by clicking the mouse or tapping the screen. Use these inputs to attack, defend, and switch between your tools.
What are the main weapons and moves in the game?
The game features a flail, a Shield Saw, a parry, and a shotgun. Learning when to use each one is the main part of the strategy.

unfamiliar-object.intro: Unfamiliar Object is a first-person horror inspection game where you search a silent night-shift office for the one object that does not belong. You photograph it and submit the evidence by fax before time runs out.
tips: Read the rules before you start moving, since the game expects you to follow them and they change between shifts.
Keep track of which rooms you have already photographed, because re-entering one is a mistake you can avoid by noting it early.
Raise the inspection camera only when you are lined up on the outlined object, so you do not waste time on a blurry or wrong shot.
Compare objects against each other as you walk, since the anomaly is usually something ordinary that looks slightly wrong rather than something obviously out of place.
Check the highlighted fax machine before you take your photo, so you can submit quickly once you are sure of your evidence.
faq: What is the goal of Unfamiliar Object?
Your goal is to find the one object in the office corridor that does not belong, photograph it, and submit it to the correct highlighted fax machine.
How do I take a photo of the anomaly?
Press Space to raise the inspection camera, aim at the outlined object, and left-click to take the photo.

the-hustler.intro: The Hustler is a management clicker where you start with nothing and grow a business empire. Move quickly, keep customers served, and reinvest your cash to build bigger.
tips: Spend your early cash on speed first, since moving faster makes every other task easier to keep up with.
Keep stacking supplies ahead of need so you are not stopped while customers wait in line.
Watch your queues and head toward the line that is getting longest before it backs up.
Carry more items when you can afford it, so you make fewer trips between supplies and customers.
Once you have the cash, unlock a new shop and check how well your current ones run before expanding further.
faq: How do I move around the restaurant on desktop?
Use the WASD keys or arrow keys, or drag the mouse to move around and complete tasks.
What should I spend my money on first?
Upgrades that help you move faster or carry more items are a good early choice, because they speed up every task you do after that.

topbike-racing-and-moto-3d-bike-2023.intro: TopBike Racing & Moto 3D Bike 2023 is a 3D racing game where you ride bikes across desert, swamp, and forest trails. You can race other players from around the world or take on the biker gangs of The City.
tips: Get comfortable with the keyboard controls before you start a race, since the instructions say the whole game is played with the keyboard.
Try each terrain type, desert, swamp, and forest, because each one handles differently and you'll learn which riding style suits you best.
Pay attention to the racers around you, especially in the City races against gangs, so you can anticipate their moves rather than reacting late.
Keep your speed steady through the trails instead of pushing hard into every turn, which helps you avoid losing control.
Use your early races to learn the track layouts, then focus on sharper, faster lines once you know where the turns are.
faq: How do I control my bike?
The game is played with the keyboard, as stated in the instructions. Spend a few minutes getting a feel for the controls before entering a race.
Where do the races take place?
Races happen on trails in the desert, swamp, and forest, and in The City, where you race against biker gangs.

crowdgate.intro: CrowdGate is an arcade runner where your stickmen run automatically. You steer them through number gates, grow your crowd, and build the army needed for the final battle.
tips: Look ahead before each gate so you can line up early instead of swerving at the last second.
Compare the numbers on paired gates and aim for the one that adds more to your crowd, since the choice matters as much as the reflexes.
Keep your crowd large before reaching enemy zones, because the side with the bigger crowd wins those fights.
Watch for obstacles and steer around them when you can, since hitting one costs part of your army.
Sessions are short, so try a few runs in a row to learn the layout of each level and when to make safe moves.
faq: How do I move my stickmen?
Drag left or right with your mouse, or press the A and D keys on your keyboard to change lanes.
How do I grow my crowd?
Pass through number gates to add to your army, and choose gates that give you the largest gain.

monster-trucks-sky-stunts.intro: Monster Trucks Sky Stunts is a racing game about launching monster trucks off large ramps and performing flips, spins, and mid-air tricks. You drive with the WASD keys and aim for speed and precision.
tips: Use the early moments to learn how the WASD keys control your truck before attempting bigger jumps. Small test movements help you understand how the truck responds.
Keep your speed up when approaching a ramp, since launch height depends on how you hit it. Build momentum before you leave the ground.
Plan your landing before you take off. Try to bring the truck down level and steady, because the description notes that landings are forceful.
Pick one trick at a time and practice it until you can control it. Trying several flips and spins at once often leads to a poor landing.
Stay patient after a crash or bad landing and reset your approach. Each jump gives you a chance to adjust your speed and angle for the next one.
faq: What is the main goal in Monster Trucks Sky Stunts?

The game focuses on sky stunts, where you launch off ramps and perform flips, spins, and mid-air tricks while landing safely. The instructions only list driving controls, so explore each jump to see what the game asks of you.
What controls do I use to drive?
You drive with the W, A, S, and D keys. Try each key on flat ground first so you know how the truck moves before you reach a ramp.

match-story-animals.intro: Match Story: Animals is a 3D match puzzle where you group three identical animal objects to clear the board. Each level has a timer, so quick, careful matching keeps you moving forward.
tips: Scan the whole board before you select anything. Finding all the matching sets first helps you pick the order that clears the most tiles.
Keep an eye on the clock from the start. Clearing the board before time runs out is the main challenge, so avoid spending too long on a single match.
Save power-ups for crowded or tricky boards. Use them to clear tiles faster when progress slows down, rather than at the very start.
Check that each set of three is fully placed together before moving on. Making sure your match is complete avoids wasted moves.
Earn rewards as you go and look at what new challenges they unlock. Progressing steadily through levels is the best way to see the full range of the game.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Find and select three identical animal objects, then place them together to make a match. Clear the board before time runs out to complete the level.
How do power-ups help?
Power-ups let you clear tiles faster, which is useful when the board is crowded or time is running low.

prison-survive-break-escape.intro: Prison Survive Break Escape is a 3D action survival game where you try to break out of a prison and survive in the city. You move through the level with WASD, run with Shift, and fight with the mouse.
tips: Use Shift to run only when you need to cover ground quickly, since moving at a steady pace with WASD keeps you easier to control.
Keep your attacks short and deliberate with the mouse rather than clicking rapidly, so you stay focused on one opponent at a time.
Pay attention to the other lock down criminals around you and decide early whether to fight or move past them.
Try the crouch control listed in the instructions when you are near enemies to see how it changes your approach.
Treat each stage as a survival challenge: keep moving, avoid unnecessary fights, and focus on your route out of the prison.
faq: What is the main goal of Prison Survive Break Escape?
Your goal is to escape from the prison and survive in the city, using your skills as you break out with other criminals.
Which keys move and run my character?
WASD moves your character, and holding Shift makes you run.

baby-panda-care.intro: Baby Panda Care is a pretend-play game where you take on the role of caring for a cute baby panda. It suits young children who enjoy copying grown-up caregiving.
tips: Use taps or clicks to explore the screen slowly, so you can see everything the baby panda responds to.
Treat the panda like a real baby by taking your time with each caring action rather than rushing through them.
Take turns with a child or talk through what you are doing, since the game is built around pretend play.
Ask questions like 'What does the baby need right now?' to keep the play thoughtful and encourage imaginative role-switching.
Play in short sessions so the caregiving stays fun and the panda does not feel neglected between visits.
faq: What is the goal of Baby Panda Care?
The game gives you the chance to care for a baby panda and take on caring responsibilities as if you were a parent. The description does not list a specific win condition.
How do I control the game?
The instructions say to tap or click. Use taps or clicks on the screen to interact with the baby panda and move through the play.

tick-tack-what.intro: Tick-Tack-What? is a Tic-Tac-Toe twist played on irregular boards against an AI that breaks the rules. Click an active cell to place your X and aim for a line of three.
tips: Before each move, check which cells are active and which are locked, since the AI can change the board shape and block squares.
Build threats that aim in two directions at once, so a single erased X or locked cell does not undo your whole plan.
After every AI move, scan the board again, because erased X's, bombs, or gravity shifts can change your best option.
When the AI claims a win, look at the board yourself to confirm that a real line of three exists before you accept the result.
Keep a little flexibility in your plan, since the board mutates and a strong opening may stop working halfway through.
faq: What is the goal of Tick-Tack-What?
Your goal is to form a line of three X's, just like classic Tic-Tac-Toe, while the AI uses tricks to stop you.
How do I place my X?
Click on any active cell on the board to place your X. Cells that are locked or not active cannot be used.

funny-rescue-zookeeper.intro: Amia had a rough day at the zoo and was hurt in a serious accident. Your job is to treat her so she can get back to caring for her animals.
tips: Click or tap every item, tool, and button you can find, since each one is there to help with treatment.
Look at Amia's condition before choosing a tool, so you can match the treatment to what she needs.
Try different tools when one does not seem to help, and watch how Amia responds before moving on.
Take your time with each step, because the game is about careful treatment rather than speed.
On a touch screen, tap to select a choice and then tap again to apply it, so you do not use the wrong tool by accident.
faq: What is the goal of Funny Rescue Zookeeper?
The goal is to treat Amia after her accident so she can return to taking care of the animals at the zoo.
How do I play on a computer?
Use your mouse to click items, tools, and buttons to interact with the game.

parking-bike-3d-game.intro: Parking Bike 3D Game is a motorcycle parking and racing game where you ride different bikes, including police and high-speed models, through challenging scenarios. Control is the main skill being tested.
tips: Ease off the throttle before you reach the parking area, then use SPACE for the rear brake to slow down while keeping the bike upright.
Press C to switch camera views when you need to judge the distance to the parking spot or the edges around it.
Use R to reverse when you have overshot a space, instead of turning the bike around in a tight area.
Try the Q, E, F and V keys to shift your rider's center of mass when the bike feels unstable at low speed or on a turn.
If the bike falls over or gets stuck, press T to reset it rather than wasting time trying to recover it.
faq: What is the goal of Parking Bike 3D Game?
You ride motorbikes through different critical scenarios and park them accurately, with the game focused on bike parking and riding skill.
What does the number 2 key do?
Holding 2 gives you power acceleration, which you can use when you need extra speed on open stretches.

car-park-simulator.intro: Car Park Simulator is a parking challenge with 72 levels full of obstacles and tight spaces. Your job is to steer your car into the target parking spot without hitting anything.
tips: Take a look at the whole layout before you start moving, so you can spot obstacles and the target spot first.
Move slowly and make small steering adjustments, since tight spaces leave little room for error.
Plan your route in reverse from the parking spot when a space is narrow, so you know where the car needs to end up.
If you get stuck or close to an obstacle, back off and reposition rather than pushing forward into a crash.
Use the cursor keys for finer control if you find the on-screen buttons too coarse for tight manoeuvres.
faq: What is the goal of Car Park Simulator?
Move your car into the target parking spot on each level. The levels get harder with obstacles and narrow spaces.
How do I control the car?
Use the cursor keys to move and steer, or use the on-screen buttons to navigate the car to the target spot.

box-journey.intro: Box Journey is a single-player platformer where you guide a plucky box through fantastical landscapes full of platforms, traps, and portals. Precise movement and careful observation are key to uncovering the story.
tips: Pause to study each new landscape before you move, so you can spot where the platforms lead and plan your route.
Watch traps for a moment before passing them, and move only when you see a safe gap in their pattern.
Approach narrow or perilous platforms slowly, since precise movement matters more here than speed.
Pay attention to the scenery and any mysterious portals, as they may hint at the secrets the story is leading you toward.
If you fall or get caught, take a breath and retry the section with a clearer plan rather than rushing back in.
faq: How do I control the box?
Use the keyboard arrow keys, or use touch controls if you are playing with touch input.
What is the main goal of Box Journey?
Your goal is to guide the box through each landscape on its quest to uncover the secrets of the fantastical world.

portal-hop.intro: Portal Hop is a platform puzzle where you carry a portal overhead and warp yourself onto higher platforms. Plan each jump carefully to reach the goal.
tips: Before you warp, look at where your portal sits above your head, since that is where you will land. Check the height first so you do not overshoot a platform.
Collect the plus and minus power-ups with care, because they change your portal's height. Think about which one you need before you grab it.
Use the A and D keys or the Left and Right Arrow keys to line up under a platform before you warp. Small adjustments in position can save a failed attempt.
If you get stuck or wander into a dead end, press R to reset the level right away. Restarting is faster than trying to recover from a bad position.
Plan the whole route before you move, not just the next jump. Puzzles like this often depend on setting up a later jump with an earlier power-up.
faq: What is the main goal in Portal Hop?
Your goal is to move through each level by warping yourself onto higher platforms until you reach your destination. Each level is a puzzle that needs planning.
How do the plus and minus power-ups work?
They adjust the height of your portal, which changes where your warp can take you. Collect them with purpose, because the height you end up with decides which platforms you can reach.

obby-mine-build-launch.intro: Obby: Mine, Build, Launch is a clicker where you mine blocks, collect loot, and upgrade your tools and base to grow your digging empire. Movement and mining are simple, so most of your progress comes from planning upgrades.
tips: Mine steadily at the start, since every collected resource feeds the upgrades that make later mining faster.
Check your tool upgrades first when you have spare resources, because mining quicker and carrying more speeds up every run.
Upgrade your base once you have enough resources to process, since it unlocks stronger boosts that raise your income.
Hire workers to handle routine farming so you can focus your time on the bigger upgrades.
Pick pets that help with mining if you want faster progress, and treat skins as a purely cosmetic reward after your main upgrades.
faq: How do I move and mine?
On PC, use W, A, S, and D to move and right mouse button to mine. On mobile, use the joystick to move and tap the right side of the screen to mine.
What should I upgrade first?
Start with tools so you collect resources faster and can carry more per run. Then move on to base upgrades and workers as your income grows.

obby-dig-it.intro: Obby: Dig it is a digging simulator where you dig deeper into unique worlds to find what lies below. Explore, collect, and keep an eye on the economy as you go.
tips: Sprint with Shift on a computer, or use the left thumbstick on a phone, to cover ground quickly between digging spots.
Rotate the camera often before you dig so you can see what is around you and avoid wasting time on the wrong spot.
Try both ability keys, R and T on a computer or the two buttons beside jump on a phone, early on to learn what each one does before you need them.
Keep an eye on your collected items, since the dynamic economy means their value can change and selling at the right time can help.
Work through the quests and collections as you dig, because they give you a clear reason to explore different parts of each world.
faq: What is the main goal in Obby: Dig it?
The game is a digging simulator, so your main aim is to dig deeper and discover what you can find in each world. Quests and collections give you extra goals to work toward along the way.
What are the controls on a computer?
Use WASD or the arrow keys to move, Spacebar to jump, and Shift to sprint. The R and T keys are used for abilities.

stickninja-mission.intro: StickNinja Mission is a fast 2D platformer where you fight monsters, dodge traps, collect keys and unlock doors to finish each level. Use WASD to move and the mouse to attack.
tips: Use the double jump to reach higher platforms and to correct your landing mid-air before you commit to a jump.
Look at a gap or trap before you move forward, since the levels are built around dangerous obstacles.
Practice your mouse attacks on weaker enemies first so you learn their timing before facing tougher ones.
Before heading for a mysterious door, make sure you have collected the key for it, so you don't have to backtrack.
If you are playing with touch controls, slow down a little on jumps so your inputs stay accurate.
faq: What is the goal of StickNinja Mission?
Your goal is to defeat the monsters, find every key, and unlock the mysterious doors to complete the mission. Each level has its own path to figure out.
Which keys control the ninja?
Move with the W, A, S and D keys, and use the mouse to attack enemies. Double jump is also available while you move.

grass-defense.intro: Grass Defense is a tower defense strategy game where you guard the wilderness from waves of creatures. You build and upgrade towers, manage resources, and adjust your plan as enemies get tougher.
tips: Plan your path with the left mouse button before committing, since the path shapes where enemies travel and where your towers can do the most damage.
Upgrade towers that are already covering the enemy route instead of spreading them out, so each upgrade adds more firepower where it matters.
Watch how each wave arrives and note which enemy types are strongest, then adjust your tower choices and upgrades to match.
Save some resources for emergencies rather than spending everything early, so you can respond when a harder wave appears.
Keep your base protected by checking the enemy path after each change; a small gap in coverage can let enemies slip through.
faq: How do I control the game?
Use the left mouse button to draw the path, and click a tower to upgrade it.
What is the goal of Grass Defense?
Destroy the enemies before they reach your base and keep protecting it through each wave.

zombie-virus-fps.intro: Zombie Virus FPS is a survival shooter set on a jungle map, with offline missions where each campaign has its own difficulty and number of enemies. You move with WASD and aim with the mouse.
tips: Start with the easier campaign to learn how the zombies move and how fast you need to aim before trying harder missions.
Use SHIFT to run between areas, but stop to aim before zombies get close, since shooting while moving makes accuracy harder.
Use SPACE to jump over obstacles or to reposition quickly when a group of enemies closes in.
Switch guns with the change gun control as soon as you see a new enemy type or a crowd, so you are not reloading or caught with the wrong weapon.
Open the menu with TAB to check your options between rounds, and keep your position covered so you can retreat from large groups.
faq: What is the goal of Zombie Virus FPS?
Survive the zombie virus and destroy the enemies in each mission. Each campaign has its own difficulty and number of enemies to clear.
Which keys control the game?
WASD moves your character, the mouse aims and looks around, and SPACE jumps. SHIFT runs, TAB opens the menu, and the change gun control swaps weapons.

jack-o-gunner.intro: Jack-O Gunner is a Halloween-themed arcade survival game in 3D. You fight off waves of skeletons, upgrade your skills, and try to last as long as you can.
tips: Keep your character moving by sliding your finger, so you are never standing still while skeletons close in.
Spend upgrades on the skills that help you survive longest, rather than picking at random each time.
Watch where the skeletons are coming from and shift position early to keep a clear line of fire.
Stay near the edges of the arena when enemies bunch up in the middle, so you have room to escape if they surround you.
Try short runs first to learn the enemy patterns, then aim for longer survival on later attempts.
faq: What is the goal of Jack-O Gunner?
Your aim is to kill all the skeletons, upgrade your skills, and survive as long as possible.
How do I move my character?
Tap and move your finger on the screen to move the character.

picture-jam-factory.intro: Picture Jam Factory is a block puzzle where you slide pieces to finish each picture before it ships off the conveyor belt. Keep the line clear and match colors as you go.
tips: Before you slide anything, look at the whole picture and note which colors and shapes appear most often. This tells you which pieces you will need early.
Work on one area of the picture at a time instead of spreading moves across the board. Finishing a section makes it easier to see what is left.
Check each move for jams before you commit to it. A move that looks helpful can block the path for pieces you still need.
Focus on connecting pieces that already fit together rather than forcing awkward matches. Clean connections leave more room to maneuver later.
Take a short break when you feel stuck and come back with fresh eyes. Many levels are easier to solve once you step back and look at the whole layout again.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Your goal is to slide blocks so the picture is completed. Once it is finished, it is boxed and shipped away, which clears space for the next order.
How do I move the pieces?
You slide blocks around the board. Match colors, fill shapes, and connect pieces to build the picture.

change-part-in-love-story.intro: Change part in Love Story is a story-driven adventure about a couple who get into funny situations. You solve puzzles and tasks by picking items and placing them in the right spots on each picture.
tips: Read each assignment carefully before you touch anything, since it tells you what the scene needs.
Look at the full picture first and note which spots look out of place or unfinished before choosing an item.
Check the suggested items at the bottom one by one, so you do not miss the piece that fits the task.
If you are stuck on a puzzle, scan the clues in the scene again, such as the safe question or what the character is hiding.
Work through the levels in order, because each one builds on the story and helps you understand the couple's problems.
faq: What is the goal of Change part in Love Story?
Your goal is to complete all the levels and help the couple get out of their funny situations. Each level gives you a task or puzzle to solve.
How do I control the game?
Select an element from the suggested items at the bottom of the screen and move it to the correct place on the picture.

giant-rush.intro: Giant Rush is an arcade action game where you grow stronger by absorbing people of your own color, avoid those of other colors, and then fight the boss at the end of each level. Drag to move your character.
tips: Steer toward crowds that match your color first, since absorbing them is how you build strength before the boss fight.
Plan your route a few steps ahead so you can slip around groups of a different color instead of running into them.
Watch the size of your group as you go; if you are getting weaker, change direction early rather than pushing through.
Keep your movement smooth and steady by dragging in small adjustments, which makes it easier to weave between people.
Save your focus for the final leader fight, and try to arrive at it with as large a group as you can manage.
faq: What is the goal of Giant Rush?
Grow stronger by absorbing people who match your color, avoid people of different colors, and defeat the boss to win the level.
How do I control my character?
Drag on the screen to move. The game is played entirely with this one control.

retro-run.intro: Retro Run is an arcade runner where you dodge obstacles, throw orbs at targets, and keep enough orbs in play to reach as far as you can.
tips: Keep track of how many orbs you have left before you commit to a risky move, since running out forces a restart.
Recall your orb with Space when it is far away or stuck, so you have one ready to throw instead of waiting with none.
Switch orb colors with 1, 2, and 3 before you reach an obstacle, so you are not changing colors in the middle of a dangerous moment.
Save your power-ups with F for the sticky situations where you have no other safe option, rather than using them the first time one appears.
Aim for the special crystals when you can, because smashing them is one of the ways to restore your orbs.
faq: What is the main goal of Retro Run?
Move left and right with A and D, use your orbs to smash through obstacles, and get as far as possible without running out of orbs.
What happens if I lose all my orbs?
You are forced to restart the run, so keeping a steady supply of orbs is the key to going further.

princesses-of-quadrobics.intro: Princesses of Quadrobics is a dress-up game where you style Eliza and the Little Mermaid for Quadrobics. You work through makeup, hair, outfits, jewelry, and finally animal masks.
tips: Finish one princess completely before switching to the other, so you don't lose track of which steps are done for each girl.
Choose the makeup first, since it sets the overall mood, and then pick a hairstyle that stays comfortable for active practice.
Pick the dress and jewelry together so the colors and styles match instead of adding pieces one at a time without a plan.
Don't skip the animal masks at the end, because the game treats them as a required part of the Quadrobics look.
Try a few different combinations for each heroine to see how small changes in makeup or accessories affect the final image.
faq: What is the goal of Princesses of Quadrobics?
The goal is to create a complete Quadrobics look for each princess, Eliza and the Little Mermaid, from makeup to animal masks.
What order should I follow when styling the princesses?
The game suggests starting with makeup and hair, then choosing dresses, jewelry and accessories, and finishing with the animal masks.

mushroomtarzan.intro: Mushroom Tarzan is a 3D jungle game where you guide Tarzan by leaping from one giant mushroom to the next without falling into the water below. It rewards timing, agility and quick reflexes.
tips: Watch the next mushroom before you commit to a leap, since your swing should line up with where you want to land.
Expect the mushrooms to get smaller and harder to reach as you progress, so slow down and aim more carefully as the jungle gets tougher.
Keep an eye on the monkeys, birds and other wild creatures, because they can pull your attention away from the next jump.
Stay calm and avoid rushing consecutive swipes; a short pause to reset your timing often matters more than speed.
Practice your swipe motion in the first few jumps so the movement feels natural before the mushrooms start shrinking.
faq: How do I control Tarzan?
You control Tarzan by swiping with your mouse. Use the swipe to launch him from one mushroom toward the next.
What is the goal of Mushroom Tarzan?
Your goal is to guide Tarzan across the jungle canopy by jumping from mushroom to mushroom. Avoid falling into the water below.

obby-saves-brainrots-from-tsunami.intro: Obby Saves Brainrots from Tsunami is a fast escape runner where you outrun giant waves, collect brainrots, and grow an idle tycoon empire. Speed and reflexes keep you ahead of the water.
tips: Keep moving forward during runs, since the tsunami is always closing in and every second matters.
Stay alert for dangerous zones and plan your route before you reach them, rather than reacting at the last moment.
Collect brainrots during runs, then turn them into money so your empire keeps growing between escapes.
Use E to interact with objects when you need to build up your setup, and check what each interaction gives you before spending your progress.
Save your best brainrots for crafting, since the description says the rarest ones come from building your empire over time.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Escape the tsunami by running, jumping obstacles, and surviving dangerous zones while collecting brainrots to grow your empire.
What do the computer controls do?
WASD moves your character, E interacts with objects, G throws a brainrot, and F turns on the cursor. On mobile, use the on-screen UI.

cheerleader-magazine-dressup.intro: Cheerleader Magazine Dressup is a fashion game where you build a cheerleader look step by step, from makeover and hair to outfit and photoshoot. Click or tap to pick items and style your character.
tips: Start with the makeover and hair before choosing clothes, so you can see how each outfit pairs with your overall look.
Try a few complete combinations before settling on one, since changing one item can change how the whole look reads.
Keep colors that complement each other, such as one bold piece with neutral accessories, so the final photo looks balanced.
Check the look from the photoshoot view before finishing, to make sure the outfit and hair stand out clearly.
Use the tap or click controls slowly and carefully, since each choice is quick to make and easy to undo by picking a different item.
faq: What is the goal of Cheerleader Magazine Dressup?
The goal is to design cheerleader outfits, apply makeovers, style hair, and create looks for photoshoots.
How do I control the game?
Use mouse clicks or taps to select items, colors, and styling options.

red-and-blue-stickman-spy-puzzles.intro: Red And Blue Stickman Spy Puzzles is a puzzle game where you control a blue stickman and shoot arrows at red monsters. Each level asks you to find the right shot to take the enemies down.
tips: Before you shoot, look at the position of each red monster and where your stickman stands, since both affect the shot you need.
Adjust your aim angle and distance in small steps so you can see how each change moves the arrow.
Watch for openings where a monster is exposed and take the shot when the path is clear.
If a level stalls, pause your shots and reconsider the angle rather than firing repeatedly.
Use your agility to dodge enemy threats, as the game asks you to evade as well as attack.
faq: How do I play the game?
Click or tap to aim and shoot your arrows at the red monsters. Adjust the angle and distance of each shot to defeat them.
What is the main goal of each level?
Your goal is to defeat the red monsters in each level using your archery skills. The description says you face enemies in every level.

mini-grand-thef-city.intro: Mini Grand Thef City is an adventure game set in a minimalist world inspired by GTA. You walk and run through the streets, steal furniture or sell it for money, and use that money to build new buildings.
tips: Explore the streets first to get a feel for the layout before you try to build anything.
Think about what you take from homes and businesses, since you can sell furniture to earn the money you need for building.
Save up money before starting a new building so you are not left short partway through.
Keep moving between areas rather than staying in one spot, so you can spot more homes and businesses to enter.
Try the controls with a mouse or touch screen for a few minutes to get comfortable with how movement and actions respond.
faq: What is the main goal of Mini Grand Thef City?
The game is built around walking and running through the streets, entering homes or businesses, and using money from selling furniture to build new buildings.
How do I control the character?
You play by using the mouse or touching the screen, so use whichever input your device supports.

money-empire.intro: Money Empire is a multiplayer board and clicker game where you roll dice, build businesses, and grow your fortune. Compete with other players to climb the leaderboard and become the most successful entrepreneur.
tips: Land on business tiles early to start earning, then spend money on upgrades to raise your income over time.
Invest in passive income options such as the bank so your money keeps growing while you focus on moving around the board.
Keep a cash reserve for taxes and random events so one bad turn does not stall your empire.
Check global news regularly, since it can change your income, and adjust your plans when it does.
Before taking risks with the casino or stock exchange, compare your position with other players on the leaderboard.
faq: What is the goal of Money Empire?
The goal is to build the most successful empire by growing your fortune step by step and outperforming other players.
How do I earn money in the game?
Roll the dice, move across the board, and land on business tiles to earn money, then upgrade those businesses to earn more.

topsy-turvy.intro: Topsy Turvy is a spooky-cute puzzler where you aim a steampunk cannon and fire orbs to match creepy eyeballs and skull orbs before they reach the drain. Clear the track and build combos to stay ahead of the crawling snake.
tips: Aim before you fire by clicking or tapping where you want the orb to go, so you can plan the shot instead of rushing it.
Look for groups of three or more matching orbs on the track, since matching them is how you clear the path.
Watch the front of the snake closely; when it gets near the drain, prioritise shots that remove the orbs closest to it.
Try to set up chain combos, because a shot that triggers a chain can clear far more of the track than a single match.
Keep an eye on the colour pattern of the orbs coming next so you can choose which shot to take rather than reacting at the last second.
faq: What is the goal of Topsy Turvy?
The goal is to shoot and match the creepy eyeballs and skull orbs so they are cleared before they slither their way to the drain. You survive as long as the snake does not reach the end.
How do I aim the cannon?
Click or tap wherever you want to send the orb from the cannon. The orb travels toward the point you chose.

tile-farm-story.intro: Tile Farm Story is a mahjong-style chip collecting adventure. Find identical chips on the field, collect them into the cells below, and clear the whole board across many levels.
tips: Before you tap, scan the field for matching pairs you can reach, so each pick moves you toward three identical chips.
Keep your collection cells as open as possible. Avoid collecting single chips that you have no match for yet.
When the cells are nearly full, look first for a chip that completes a set of three you already have.
Save your boosters for levels where you get stuck, rather than using them at the start.
If you get stuck, take a short break and look at the field again. A fresh view often reveals a match you missed.
faq: What is the goal of Tile Farm Story?
Find identical chips on the playing field and collect them. You must destroy all the chips on the field to win each level.
What happens when the collection cells fill up?
If all the cells are filled, the level is lost. Three identical chips in the cells are destroyed, which frees up space.

2048-cube-runner-3d-merge.intro: 2048 Cube Runner mixes a 3D obstacle course with 2048-style merging. You steer a chain of numbered cubes forward, collecting matching values to build bigger numbers while dodging hazards on the way to the finish.
tips: Steer early and in small moves so you can line up with matching cubes before you reach the gates or obstacles.
Prioritize collecting cubes that match your current chain values, since merging them is how your numbers grow.
Use helpful gates when they are within reach, but do not force a path that takes you into saws or spikes.
Watch moving obstacles for a moment before committing to a lane, since their timing decides when a gap is safe.
Keep an eye on the finish line and aim to arrive with as many high-value cubes as you can, not just with a long chain.
faq: What is the main goal of 2048 Cube Runner?
Reach the finish line while carrying as many powerful cubes as possible. Merging matching numbers helps build higher values along the way.
How do I steer my cubes on desktop?
Click to start, then hold the left mouse button and drag left or right to steer. Releasing the button is how you stop steering in that direction.

draw-flag-asmr-painting-games.intro: Draw Flag: ASMR Painting Games is a flag coloring game with two modes, Guess the Country and Make the Flag. You pick colors and paint each section of a national flag, with over 200 countries to explore.
tips: Before you start painting, look at the whole flag and note which colors appear and where they sit, so you are not guessing as you go.
Work through one section at a time and check each color before moving on, since you need every section correct to finish the level.
Use the color selector as a quick reference: tap a color, paint a section, then switch to the next color instead of repainting mistakes later.
In Guess the Country, compare the flag's colors and layout with flags you already know, such as Asian and European flags, to narrow down the answer.
Play a few flags from the same region in a row, since similar flags can help you remember color patterns across countries.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Your goal is to complete each flag by painting every section with the correct color. You need to get all sections right to finish the level.
How do I paint a flag?
Tap a color to select it, then tap a flag section to paint it. To change colors, tap another color and continue painting.

truck-cross-country.intro: Truck Cross Country is a 3D racing simulation where you drive a Jeep-style truck through levels, reaching every checkpoint. Steer with WASD and keep your route on the road.
tips: Keep your attention on the road ahead so you can react before the truck leaves the track.
Plan your line through each level in advance, since you need to reach all checkpoints rather than just finish quickly.
Ease off the throttle before sharp turns to keep the truck stable and on the road.
Remember that driving into the river uses your one free respawn, so play the next section more carefully after a recovery.
Use short, controlled key presses with WASD on tricky terrain instead of holding keys down constantly.
faq: What is the goal of Truck Cross Country?
You need to come across all the checkpoints at each level to move through the game.
What happens if my truck goes into the river?
You get one free chance to respawn from where you went off the road. If you go into the river again after that, you lose the game.

stickman-troll-thief-puzzle.intro: Stickman Troll Thief Puzzle is a casual puzzle game where you guide a clever stickman through unexpected traps to steal a target item. Each level presents its own challenge that tests your logic and creativity.
tips: Before you act, study the whole scene and note every object, trap, and obstacle, since many of them can be used to reach the target.
Try the most obvious solution first, then experiment with unusual ones. The game rewards playful thinking rather than a single correct path.
Watch what happens after each action, because traps often react in ways that reveal how the level is meant to be solved.
If you get stuck, reset your thinking by focusing on the stickman's goal and asking which object could help him get closer to the item.
Take breaks between difficult levels so you can return with fresh eyes to spot details you may have missed.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Your goal is to help the stickman steal the target item by solving the puzzle and getting past the traps in the scene.
How do I control the game?
Use mouse clicks or taps to interact with objects and move through each level.

village-of-colors.intro: Village of Colors is a drawing game where you defend your village by sketching barriers that keep enemies away from your villagers. Use your imagination to shape each defense.
tips: Draw barriers between enemies and your villagers before foes reach them, rather than waiting until they are close.
Pause time when a situation gets crowded so you can plan where your next barrier should go.
Check the store on the main menu early and buy abilities that make the game easier for the challenges you find hardest.
Open the Hero's Help to read about all the features, so you know what each part of the game does before you need it.
Watch which villagers are most exposed and focus your drawings on protecting them first.
faq: How do I protect my villagers?
Draw obstacles with your mouse or finger on the screen to block enemies from reaching them.
How can I make the game easier?
Buy abilities in the store on the main menu, which are meant to make the game easier.

merge-13.intro: Merge 13 is a number puzzle where you drag cells with matching values together to build higher numbers. Plan your merges ahead to reach 13.
tips: Before each drag, look at the whole board and check which cells share a value you could combine next.
Avoid dragging cells together at random, since a quick merge can block a better one later.
Hold back a cell that is useful for a bigger merge later instead of combining it right away.
Keep the positions of your cells in mind so that future matches stay reachable as the board fills up.
Expect the puzzle to get harder as your numbers grow, so slow down and plan more carefully at higher values.
faq: What is the goal of Merge 13?
The goal is to combine numbered cells step by step until you reach 13. Each merge creates a cell with a higher value.
How do I merge cells?
Drag a cell onto another cell with the same value. They combine into a single cell with a higher number.

cavern-of-gears.intro: Cavern of Gears is a 2D action-adventure set in a steampunk underworld. You fight through gear-driven caverns, collect weapons and power-ups, and defeat bosses to uncover a century-old secret.
tips: Switch weapons with R as you go to find which one suits each enemy type, rather than relying on a single weapon the whole way.
Use SHIFT to dash out of danger instead of standing still, which keeps you moving and makes it easier to reposition for attacks.
Save your power-ups for tougher fights, such as bosses or crowded rooms, so they have the most impact when you need them.
Learn each boss's attack pattern by watching it for a few moments before committing to close-range attacks with J or K.
Explore each cavern at a steady pace and pick up every weapon and power-up you find, since your arsenal grows as you travel deeper.
faq: What is the main goal of Cavern of Gears?
Fight through the caverns, defeat enemies and bosses, and clear all the stages to uncover the secret the bosses are hiding.
Which keys control attacking and switching weapons?
Use J or K to attack, R to switch weapons, and L to use a power-up. WASD moves your character and SHIFT dashes.

tung-tung-sahur-hidden-bedug.intro: Tung Tung Sahur: Hidden Bedug is a hidden object puzzle where you search lively sahur-themed pictures for 10 hidden bedug drums in each level. The game is played with the mouse only.
tips: Scan each picture in sections, such as top to bottom or left to right, so you don't miss drums in the corners or edges.
Look for shapes that don't fit the busy pattern around them, since a bedug can blend in with the other Tung Tung figures.
Keep a count of how many bedug you have found so far, so you know how many are left to search for.
Because the mouse is your only control, move your cursor slowly over details rather than clicking quickly at random.
If you play against the clock, stay calm and avoid rushing; a steady search usually finds more drums than frantic clicking.
faq: What is the goal of Tung Tung Sahur: Hidden Bedug?
Your goal is to find all 10 hidden bedug drums that are camouflaged in each level's picture. Once you have found all of them, the level is complete.
How do I control the game?
The game is played with the mouse only, so you search and select objects by moving and clicking the cursor.

africa-jeep-race.intro: Africa Jeep Race is a driving game set on dusty African roads, with 12 racing routes. You can race against the computer or a friend on the same keyboard.
tips: Learn the road layout on each of the 12 routes before pushing hard, since knowing where the turns are helps you keep speed.
Save your coins from early races so you can unlock new Safari Jeeps once you see which ones suit your driving style.
If you are playing two players, agree on which keys each person uses before the start so you do not both press the same controls.
Use your power-up key at a moment when it can help most, rather than pressing it as soon as it is available.
Spend your gold on a new car only after you have tried the jeeps you can already drive, so you buy one you will actually use.
faq: How do I move my jeep?
Player 1 uses W, A, S and D, and Player 2 uses the arrow keys. Keep both hands ready on the controls for the turns on dusty roads.
How do I play with a friend?
Open the vehicle selection menu and activate the second player there. Then both of you can race on the same screen.

log-splash.intro: Log Splash is a top-down log rolling duel where you and a rival share one floating log. Keep your footing, push your rival off, and empty their balance meter before they empty yours.
tips: Match the direction the log is rolling when you step. This keeps your footing and saves balance.
Save your shoves for moments when stepping against the log will actually turn it over. Shoving costs balance, so using it constantly can drain you.
Watch your own balance meter as closely as your rival's. Once it is low, focus on steady footwork instead of attacking.
Pick the skill draft with your playstyle in mind, since you will use your skills on the hotbar with keys 1, 2 and 3 in later duels. Practice firing them early so you do not hesitate mid-duel.
On touch screens, hold the up and down buttons to step and tap a hotbar skill to use it. Keep your thumbs ready so you can respond to the log's roll quickly.
faq: What is the goal of each duel?
Empty your rival's balance meter before they empty yours. Winning a duel lets you draft one of three skills and move on to the next opponent.
How do I move on the log?
Use W to step away from you and S to step toward you, or the arrow keys. Stepping with the log's roll helps you keep your footing, while stepping against it slows the log and can turn it over.

stick-duel-battle.intro: Stick Duel Battle is a stickman fighting game with realistic weapons and physics across many maps. One or two players compete, and the first player to reach 5 points wins.
tips: Learn how each map is laid out before you commit to a fight, since every map calls for a different approach.
Watch how the physics affects your stickman when you move and jump, so you can predict where you will land and where your opponent might end up.
Keep track of your weapon's behaviour and try a few shots early on so you know how it handles before the score gets close.
In two-player matches, stay aware of your opponent's position and avoid standing still in open areas where they can line up a clear shot.
Aim for steady point-scoring rather than risky moves, because the first to 5 wins and a cautious lead can be just as effective as a flashy one.
faq: What is the goal of Stick Duel Battle?
The goal is to be the first player to reach 5 score. The first to do so wins the game.
How do I control my stickman?
Player 1 uses the arrow keys and the L key. Player 2 uses the WASD keys and the F key.

draw-the-road.intro: Draw The Road is a physics puzzle where you sketch the path your vehicle drives on. Every line you draw becomes a real road, so plan each curve and climb before you reach the finish line.
tips: Start with gentle curves and shallow slopes to see how your vehicle reacts before adding harder shapes.
Draw slowly and steadily, since a shaky line can make the vehicle crash.
Be careful with steep climbs. If a ramp is too sharp, your vehicle may lose control, so try a longer, gentler incline instead.
Think of the whole route first: a ramp, bridge, or loop only works if the road leading into it is smooth.
If a attempt fails, look at where the vehicle crashed and redraw only that section rather than starting over.
faq: What is the goal of Draw The Road?
Your goal is to draw a road that gets your vehicle safely to the finish line. You control the layout using your finger.
What causes the vehicle to crash?
The game uses a realistic physics engine, so a shaky curve or a steep climb can make the vehicle crash. Smooth, deliberate lines help avoid this.

logical-ball-escape.intro: Logical Ball Escape is a physics-based puzzle where you guide a ball with a box to the door. The main rule is simple: keep the ball from falling, or the game ends.
tips: Before each move, look at how the ball and box sit on the platforms and think through what will happen after your next tap.
Test one action at a time and watch the result closely, so you can see how the physics responds before committing to a longer sequence.
If a ball is about to fall, stop and rethink your route, since a single fall ends the game.
Look for the box's position as a tool in the puzzle, not just an obstacle, and consider how it could support or shape the ball's path.
Take a short break when you feel stuck, then return to the level with fresh eyes to spot the solution more easily.
faq: What is the goal of Logical Ball Escape?
Your goal is to help the ball reach the door by solving physics-based logical puzzles. Each quest asks you to think ahead about how the ball and box will move.
How do I control the ball?
Use a tap or a mouse left click to interact with the game. The controls are designed to be simple, so most of your effort goes into planning the solution.

mr-and-mrs-santa-christmas-adventure.intro: Mr. and Mrs. Santa's Christmas Adventure is a Christmas care game. Santa and his pet are injured and his sleigh is badly damaged, so you help them recover before the celebration.
tips: Work on Santa and his pet one step at a time so you don't lose track of who still needs attention.
Look over the whole screen before each click so you can see what the game is asking for next.
Use short, steady clicks or taps rather than rapid tapping, which makes it easier to stay accurate.
Since the game mixes doctor, dress-up, and fashion elements, pay attention to which part you are on and finish it fully before moving on.
If you make a mistake, take a moment to check what changed on screen before trying again.
faq: What is the goal of Mr. and Mrs. Santa Christmas Adventure?
The goal is to help Santa and his pet recover from their injuries so Santa can go on his trip to share Christmas gifts with children.
How do I control the game?
You play with the mouse by clicking, or by tapping on a touch screen.

outside.intro: OUTSIDE is a grid-based puzzle about planning routes for a one-eyed character. Once you start moving, you keep going until you reach a wall, so each route has to be worked out before you commit.
tips: Before moving, find the key and the door, then trace the route between them, checking where each move will stop at a wall.
Look for spots where a wall will stop you exactly where you need to turn, and plan your path around those stopping points.
Avoid sending your character into corridors with no exit, since you cannot stop partway to back out.
If you reach a dead end, press R to restart rather than trying to fix the position, and try a different order of moves next time.
Use the Q key to return to the menu if you want to step away, and M to mute the sound while you think through a tricky layout.
faq: How do I finish a level?
Guide your character to collect the key, then move to the door to unlock it and advance to the next level.
Can I stop my character partway through a move?
No. Once you start moving in a direction, the character keeps going until it hits a wall, so plan each move in advance.

bunny-escape.intro: Bunny Escape puts you in the role of a bunny caught in different situations. Get out of each one by running, attacking and jumping through the worlds while avoiding enemies.
tips: Watch the enemies before you move, so you can decide whether to attack them or jump past them.
Use short, timed presses rather than holding the button, since the game is controlled with a single button.
Look ahead across each area to plan your jumps before you commit to them.
If you get trapped in a new situation, pause for a moment to read the layout and find the route out.
Stay calm and retry a tricky spot instead of rushing, because most escapes depend on careful timing.
faq: What is the goal of Bunny Escape?
Your goal is to escape from each situation the bunny gets trapped in, moving through the different worlds along the way.
How do I control the bunny?
On desktop, use the SPACEBAR or the left mouse button, or the A button on a gamepad. On mobile, tap the screen.

attack-super-hole.intro: Attack Super Hole has you control a hole in the ground that swallows soldiers before time runs out. Monsters grow more dangerous as you go, so every second counts.
tips: Start by heading toward clusters of soldiers so you collect as many as possible while the timer is still high.
Keep moving rather than standing still, since lingering in one spot gives soldiers time to scatter.
Watch for monsters early and plan your route around them, because they become more dangerous the longer you play.
Use your attack button or left mouse click at the right moment to take on threats instead of letting them reach you unchecked.
Check the remaining time often and adjust your focus, aiming for a steady pace rather than a rush that leaves you cornered.
faq: What is the goal of Attack Super Hole?
You play as a hole on the ground and try to consume as many soldiers as you can before the time runs out. Along the way you also battle increasingly dangerous monsters.
How do I move and attack on a computer?
Move with the keyboard and attack by pressing the left mouse button.

cliff-boi-trap-adventure.intro: Cliff Boi Trap Adventure is a 2D side-scrolling platformer where you guide a chibi boy across 25 stages of canyon cliffs, collapsing bridges, and funny traps. Run, jump, and climb your way to the GOAL sign.
tips: Keep an eye on the sky as well as the path, since falling anvils and lightning storm clouds can drop onto you from above.
Use the double-jump when you misjudge a leap across a chasm, as it can give you the extra height you need to reach the other side.
When you grab a cliff ledge, tap Spacebar steadily instead of mashing it, so you keep climbing without wasting time.
Pay attention to moving hazards like swinging wrecking balls, speeding soccer balls, and rock beetles, and time your steps around their movement.
Don't be discouraged by a trap. Press R to restart the stage right away and try the same section again with what you just learned.
faq: What is the goal of Cliff Boi Trap Adventure?
Move your character through each of the 25 stages and reach the GOAL sign while avoiding the traps along the way.
How do I jump and climb?
Use Spacebar, Up Arrow, or W to jump, and press it again in the air to double-jump. To climb, hang on a cliff ledge and tap Spacebar repeatedly.

mononinja.intro: Mononinja is a pixel arcade platformer where you guide a ninja through more than 30 levels of precise jumps and deadly obstacles. Timing each jump carefully is the key to reaching the goal.
tips: Jump height depends on how long you hold the jump input, so practise short holds for small gaps and longer holds for high ledges.
Before you jump, look at where you will land, not only where you are starting from, and release the button at the point that gets you there.
Take a moment to study each new obstacle before attempting it, since the layout of a level often shows the safe timing.
When you fail a jump, restart the section with the same rhythm in mind instead of rushing, because most deaths come from mistimed releases.
Watch the pattern of moving or repeating hazards and wait for a clear gap rather than trying to squeeze through early.
faq: What is the goal of Mononinja?
Guide the ninja through each level to reach the goal while avoiding deadly obstacles. The game has over 30 levels to work through.
How do I control the jump on desktop?
Press and hold the SPACE key to jump. The longer you hold it, the higher the ninja jumps.

jumper.intro: JUMPER is an arcade platformer where you hop from platform to platform to climb as high as you can. Set records, pick up bonuses, and avoid traps as you go.
tips: Keep your moves small and steady, since the game is meant to be played at a relaxed pace rather than in quick panic bursts.
Before each jump, look ahead to where the next platform is and start steering toward it early so you are not correcting at the last second.
Watch for traps near your landing spots and plan a route that keeps you clear of them.
Grab bonuses when they are safe to reach, but do not let chasing a bonus pull you into a trap.
Try to beat your own height record in short sessions, focusing on one section of the climb at a time.
faq: How do I move in JUMPER?
On a computer, use A or the left arrow to move left and D or the right arrow to move right. On a touchscreen, tap the left half of the screen to move left and the right half to move right.
What is the goal of JUMPER?
The goal is to climb to new heights by jumping between platforms, beating records, and avoiding traps along the way.

zombie-strike-2.intro: Zombie Strike 2 is a 3D shooter where you defend yourself on a farm against hordes of zombies. Survive five waves of increasing difficulty using a range of weapons to finish the mission.
tips: Keep moving with WASD instead of standing still, so zombies cannot surround you from several sides at once.
Switch weapons with the mouse wheel before a fight gets crowded, so you are not fumbling for the right gun when a horde arrives.
Reload with R during quieter moments between approaches rather than in the middle of a close fight.
Use crouch (C) and jump (Space) to reposition quickly when you need to get out of a tight spot.
Pause with P to collect yourself and plan your route through the farm before pushing into the next wave.
faq: What is the goal of Zombie Strike 2?
Your mission is to survive all five waves of zombies on the farm. Each wave gets harder, so staying alive through the end is how you complete the game.
How do I shoot and change weapons?
Left mouse button fires your weapon, and the mouse wheel lets you switch between the weapons in your arsenal.

rolling-in-gears.intro: Rolling In Gears is a physics platformer where you guide a ball through mechanical challenges by rotating gears and working around moving platforms. Precision and timing decide whether the ball reaches the end of each stage.
tips: Watch the ball for a moment before rotating anything, so you can see which way the platforms and gears are moving.
Make small rotations rather than large ones, since small adjustments are easier to correct if the ball starts to drift.
Time your moves to match the movement of platforms so the ball can roll onto them smoothly instead of falling off.
If a stage feels stuck, pause your inputs and trace the path from the ball to the target to find which gear controls the route.
Keep your inputs steady and deliberate; rushing through rotations is the most common reason the ball falls off course.
faq: What is the goal of Rolling In Gears?
Guide the ball through each mechanical stage and reach its target destination at the end of the level.
How do I rotate the gears on desktop?
Use the A and D keys or the Left and Right arrow keys to rotate the gears.

army-bus-driving-2024.intro: Army Bus Driving 2024 is a driving simulation where you transport soldiers and equipment in rugged army buses across deserts and mountains. Expect realistic physics, tight schedules, and a range of missions.
tips: Learn how the bus responds to input before you pick up speed, since the physics are meant to feel realistic.
Plan your route through the terrain ahead of time, especially on mountain roads where the bus can be harder to control.
Keep an eye on your schedule and avoid unnecessary detours, because missions are built around tight deadlines.
Use short, steady key presses with WASD rather than holding keys down, which helps keep the heavy vehicle stable.
Take each mission type seriously and adjust your driving to the conditions, as the environments change from deserts to mountains.
faq: What is the goal of Army Bus Driving 2024?
You take command of an army bus and transport soldiers and equipment across hostile environments while meeting the demands of each mission. The game focuses on delivering your cargo under pressure.
How do I control the bus?
You drive using the WASD keys. Practice with them early on to get a feel for steering and speed.

go-balloons.intro: Go Balloons! is an endless wall-running arcade game where a squirrel climbs pavilion walls to chase runaway balloons. Tap or press Space to leap between walls and see how high you can get.
tips: Since missing a balloon is safe, don't swerve into danger to chase one. Only collisions end the run, so prioritize staying clear of signs and pigeons.
Watch the wall ahead before each leap. Time your tap so you land on the opposite wall with room to react to the next hazard.
Treat gold balloons as a bonus worth routing toward when the path is clear, but skip them if the jump would put you at risk.
The pace speeds up as you climb, so expect less reaction time higher up. Keep your timing steady rather than rushing your taps.
After each fall, compare your height and balloon count with your previous run. Change one habit at a time, such as how early you jump, so you can see what actually helps.
faq: What ends a run in Go Balloons!?
Only collisions end a run. Hitting a sticking sign, a pigeon, or a ledge finishes the attempt, while missing a balloon has no penalty.
What controls do I need?
Tap the screen or press Space to jump to the opposite wall. There are no combos, so the whole game comes down to timing.

euro-truck-parking-game.intro: Drive large European trucks through tight spaces, narrow roads and busy truck yards, then park precisely in the marked area. Steady, patient driving matters more than speed.
tips: Move in short, small inputs rather than holding a key down. Tight spots are much easier to handle when you can stop and check your position.
Before each manoeuvre, look at where the truck's body and back end will sit, not just the front. Large vehicles often clip obstacles that look clear from the front.
On sharp turns and narrow roads, slow down early. Making a correction early is easier than trying to fix a bad angle close to a wall or obstacle.
Use the forward and reverse moves together to adjust your angle in small steps when lining up with the designated parking area.
If you get stuck or misaligned, pull back and reposition instead of pushing forward into the obstacle. Patience is the main skill in this game.
faq: What is the goal of Euro Truck Parking Game?
Your goal is to park your truck perfectly in the designated parking area while avoiding obstacles along the way. Navigating tight spaces and sharp turns is part of the challenge.
How do I control the truck?
Use W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move back, A or the Left Arrow to move left, and D or the Right Arrow to move right. Use the mouse to click any buttons on screen.

pirate-block-craft-monster-shooter.intro: Pirate Block Craft Monster Shooter is a survival shooting game set on a dangerous river. You must stay alive while blocky monsters, including Bambam and Chuu Chuu, hunt every survivor.
tips: Learn to recognise Bambam and Chuu Chuu early, since the description names them as the main hunters you will face.
Keep an eye on the river around you and note where threats appear from so you can react before they reach you.
Click or tap deliberately rather than rapidly, so each action is aimed at the most immediate danger.
Stay calm when the screen gets busy and focus on the closest threat first instead of trying to track everything at once.
Play a few short rounds to get used to the rhythm of the encounters before trying to last longer.
faq: What is the goal of Pirate Block Craft Monster Shooter?
The goal is to survive on the treacherous river while monsters hunt down the survivors. Staying alive against the relentless attacks is the main challenge.
How do I control the game?
Use a mouse click or a tap to play. The game is controlled entirely with this single input.

vehicle-parking-master-3d.intro: Vehicle Parking Master 3D is a realistic parking puzzle where you drive carefully into marked parking areas. It has Challenge and Parking modes, with a truck in the harder levels.
tips: Before you steer, use the mouse drag to switch camera views and check where the edges of the parking area are.
Move slowly and brake early, since the game rewards careful driving more than speed.
Use small steering adjustments near the parking spot so you do not overshoot and have to reverse.
Stay calm when handling the truck in the harder levels, and plan a wider turn before you reach the space.
Work through the levels in order within each mode, so the controls and vehicle handling feel familiar before the tougher layouts.
faq: What is the goal of Vehicle Parking Master 3D?
Your goal is to drive carefully and park your vehicle in the parking area. Each mode has 40 levels to play and beat.
How do I move and steer on a computer?
Use the WASD or arrow keys to move and steer. Drag the screen with the mouse to switch views.

spinner-clicker-2d.intro: Spinner Clicker 2D is a clicker about building up spin momentum on 2D fidget spinners. You click to spin, upgrade your stats, collect new spinners, and test your setup in battles against bosses.
tips: Keep clicking steadily rather than in short bursts, since momentum is what you are building up.
