Spend coins on upgrades as soon as you can afford them, because stat boosts are permanent and make every later click stronger.
Check the collection menu regularly to see which spinners are available and which rarities you are still missing.
Before starting a Battle Encounter, review your upgrades so your spin speed is as high as possible when you face a boss.
Bosses scale up in difficulty, so if you lose a battle, return to upgrades and build your stats before trying again.
faq: What is the main goal of Spinner Clicker 2D?
The goal is to grow your spin momentum by clicking the spinner, upgrade your stats, unlock new spinners, and win battles against bosses.
How do I spin the fidget spinner on PC?
Click the spinner repeatedly with the left mouse button to build up momentum. Use the mouse to move through menus and buy upgrades.

home-decor-clicker.intro: Home Decor Clicker is a relaxing idle game where you tap your house to earn money and spend gold on upgrades and decorations. Watch your home change from a simple house into a finished living space.
tips: Tap the house steadily from the start, since every early click brings you closer to your first upgrade.
Spend gold on upgrades that raise your income before buying decorations, so your earnings grow faster.
Check your income before each purchase and compare options, because the game says to invest gold wisely.
Keep the game open while you decorate, since your earnings keep building as you progress and the game rewards steady play.
Think about the look you want for each room, so your purchases follow a plan instead of random choices.
faq: What is the main goal of Home Decor Clicker?
The goal is to build your dream home by earning money from tapping the house, then using gold to upgrade and decorate it.
How do I earn money in the game?
Tap on the house to earn money, and as your income grows, you earn gold that you can use for upgrades and decorations.

impossible-cargo-track.intro: Impossible Cargo Track is a truck driving game where you steer a large cargo truck along a difficult track. Turning is the main challenge, and you need to keep the truck balanced so your cargo stays intact.
tips: Slow down before a turn rather than braking in the middle of it, since the truck is huge and needs room to swing around.
Use short, controlled key presses instead of holding a direction, so the truck does not tip from sudden movements.
Watch the cargo at the back of the truck as a balance indicator. If it starts to shift, ease off and correct early.
Plan each turn ahead of time by looking at the road curve before you reach it, and line up the truck for a wider arc.
If the truck loses balance, take a moment to recover rather than pushing on, because damaged goods are the main cost of a mistake.
faq: What is the main goal of Impossible Cargo Track?
You drive a powerful cargo truck along an impossible track and try to get through it while keeping the truck balanced. Losing balance can destroy the cargo items in the back.
Which keys control the truck?
You can use either the WASD keys or the Arrow keys to play the game.

car-makeup.intro: Car Makeup is a relaxed puzzle game where you decorate a car instead of driving it. Match the car parts to the style shown in each level and try to beat your opponent's score.
tips: Read the style requirement at the start of each level before you touch any parts, so you know exactly what to look for.
Work through the car in a consistent order, such as one area at a time, so you do not miss a part that the style calls for.
Compare your choices against the level's style again before finishing, since the score is calculated automatically at the end.
Keep an eye on your opponent's progress so you know how close the race is and whether you need to be more careful with each choice.
Take your time on the early levels to learn which part combinations match each style, then apply that knowledge to faster play later.
faq: What is the goal of Car Makeup?
The goal is to decorate the car by choosing the same car parts as the style set in each level. The player with the higher score at the end wins.
How is the score worked out?
The system automatically scores your car at the end of each level, based on how well your choices match the required style.

jewel-blocks.intro: Jewel Blocks is a puzzle game where you place classic block shapes on a grid to clear rows and columns. Planning each placement ahead of time is the key to building high scores.
tips: Look at the shape you are holding before you move, and check where it fits without leaving awkward gaps. Keeping the grid open for future pieces makes clearing lines easier.
Aim to fill rows and columns together so one placement can clear more than one line at once. This is a practical way to build a higher score.
Avoid scattering single empty cells across the grid, since they are hard to fill later. Try to keep the open space in one connected area.
Save your undo feature for a mistake that blocks your progress. Remember that it only charges up after 10 successful moves, so use it wisely.
Count your successful moves so you know when undo is ready again. Planning around that charge can help you recover from a tricky board.
faq: What is the goal of Jewel Blocks?
Your goal is to slide block shapes into the grid and create complete rows or columns so they are removed. The game is built around achieving high scores.
How does the undo feature work?
Undo charges up after you make 10 successful moves. Once it is charged, you can use it to reverse a move.

undercrown.intro: Undercrown is a top-down 3D dungeon brawler where you fight through three floors to the Underking, then escape before the mountain collapses. Choose a hero whose weapon suits how you like to fight.
tips: Learn your hero's attack pattern in the first room before you push deeper, since each hero fights very differently.
Use roll to escape fights you cannot win by trading hits, and keep an eye on spike traps so you can time your movement around them.
Break crates and barrels when it is safe, because they drop the coins and potions you need for healing and unlocks.
When you level up, pick the upgrade that covers your weak spot, such as survivability if you keep getting hurt or damage if fights run long.
Save your health for the escape. After the Underking falls, plan a route back to the mine lift and move before the doors on timers close.
faq: How do I unlock new heroes?
Heroes are unlocked with coins you bank between runs. Coins collected during a run are saved for later use.
What happens after I defeat the Underking?

Taking his crown starts the mountain collapsing, and you must run back to the mine lift through falling rock, collapsing rooms and monsters. The run is only finished when you reach daylight with the crown still on your head.

potato-shooter.intro: Potato Shooter is a roguelike survivor where a cursed potato fights through endless dungeon rooms. Your weapons fire automatically, so your focus goes to movement, dodging, and choosing upgrades.
tips: Keep moving, since standing still makes it easier for enemy projectiles and contact damage to hit you.
Save your dash for dangerous moments and use it to get out of tight spots instead of spending it on routine movement.
Put coins into upgrading the weapons you already have at the anvils, because improved damage and attack speed help in every room that follows.
Look for artifacts that work well together, since their effects stack and combining them can make a build much stronger.
Kill enemies quickly, because the sooner a room is cleared, the sooner you can reach the exit door and head deeper into the dungeon.
faq: How do I move on to the next room?
Defeat all the enemies in the current room to unlock its exit door, then pass through the door to move on.
Where do I get coins and what are they for?
Enemies drop coins when they are defeated. You can spend them at pedestals to buy new weapons and artifacts.

wizard-io.intro: Wizard.io is a top-down 3D action game where you duel foes in magical arenas. You move your wizard, cast elemental spells, and build up your home base over time.
tips: Learn which spells you can combine early, since combining spells is a main way to deal with tougher enemies.
Pick up magical orbs whenever it is safe, because they are the resource you need to strengthen your wizard's home base.
Spend time in the arena watching enemy movement before engaging, so you can position yourself where you have room to dodge.
Keep an eye out for powerful artifacts and use them when a fight starts going against you, since they can change the outcome.
Plan base upgrades around the advantages they give you rather than buying them at random, so each choice supports how you like to fight.
faq: What is the main goal of Wizard.io?
You duel enemies in magical arenas using elemental spells and enchantments to defeat your adversaries. Collecting orbs and upgrading your home base help you win those duels.
How do I move my wizard?
Drag with the left mouse button or use the WASD or arrow keys to move. The left mouse button is also used to interact with the in-game menus.

shopping-simulator.intro: Shopping Simulator is a clicker where you tap a hamster to earn game money, then spend it on items from store shelves. You raise your customer's level as you go.
tips: Tap the hamster steadily early on, since game money is what lets you buy anything else in the game.
Try the mini-games as well as tapping, because the instructions say they are a way to earn money for upgrading your level.
Check the store shelves regularly to see which items you can now afford, rather than spending everything the moment you earn it.
Work through the puzzles carefully, since completing them is part of earning as much money as possible.
Keep an eye on your customer's level and aim to unlock each new level, as the game is built around progressing through 200 levels.
faq: How do I earn money in Shopping Simulator?
Tap the hamster to earn game money, and complete the puzzles and mini-games for more. The money is used to raise your customer's level and buy items.
What can I buy in the store?
The store offers more than 500 unique items across categories such as anime, horror, food, pets, and household goods, plus hundreds of heroes.

project-survival.intro: Project: Survival is a first-person zombie shooter with waves of undead across two maps. Good aim, steady ammo use, and smart choices about when to push or hold back will decide how long you last.
tips: Keep your crosshair on the enemies that are closest to you, since crawlers can come from under wreckage and spitters can break through your cover.
Pick up ammo and medkits from fallen enemies as soon as it is safe, so you are never caught with an empty weapon or no healing.
Use X to switch guns when your current weapon is struggling against the enemy in front of you, rather than reloading into a losing fight.
Jump and move with WASD instead of standing still in the open, especially in tight hospital corridors where the horde can close in fast.
On mobile, try the customizable control presets and pick the layout that lets you aim and move without losing track of enemies.
faq: How do I move and shoot on PC?
Use WASD to move, the left mouse button to aim and shoot, and the spacebar to jump. Press X to switch guns and P to pause.
How do I restore health during a mission?
Collect medkits dropped by fallen enemies. You can also use rewarded revives to get back up after you die.

block-builder-jam.intro: Block Builder Jam is a physics-based puzzle where you drop floating blocks to complete a target shape. It rewards logical thinking and creative placement across each stage.
tips: Study the target shape before you drop anything, and picture which blocks will need to sit at the bottom to hold the rest in place.
Begin with the wider or heavier-looking pieces at the base so the structure has a stable foundation to build on.
Watch how blocks settle after each drop, since physics can shift earlier pieces and throw off the shape you planned.
If a stage goes badly, think about which block caused the problem and try a different order or position on your next attempt.
Try the new challenges after clearing a stage, because each one tests the same skills in a different arrangement.
faq: What is the goal of Block Builder Jam?
Your goal is to complete the specified shape on each stage using the blocks you drop. Clearing stages unlocks new challenges.
How do I drop a block?
Tap a floating block on the screen and it will fall into the play area.

big-wheels.intro: Big Wheels is a 3D arcade game about riding a bicycle and growing its wheels by collecting the wheels lying along the way. Bigger wheels let you drive through obstacles.
tips: Plan your route early so you can reach the loose wheels before you reach the obstacles that need them.
Collect every wheel you can see on the track, since each one helps you get through the next obstacles.
Keep an eye on your wheel size as you go, so you know when you are ready to drive through an obstacle.
Use short, steady clicks or taps to steer your bike rather than tapping rapidly, so you keep control while you collect wheels.
If you miss a wheel, focus on the next one ahead instead of going back, which keeps your speed up.
faq: What is the goal of Big Wheels?
Your goal is to collect the lying wheels along the way so your bike's wheels grow, which lets you drive through obstacles.
How do I control the bike?
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps, as shown in the instructions.

defenders-of-the-realm-an-epic-war.intro: Defenders of the Realm: an Epic War is a pixel arcade defense game. You place your knights to protect the castle from monsters that march in from the right.
tips: Watch which of the five lines the enemies are approaching on before you commit troops, since each line needs its own defense.
Place your knights early on the lines where enemies first appear so they can engage before the monsters reach the castle.
Keep some units back on each line rather than stacking everything in one spot, so a single breakthrough does not overrun your defenses.
Spend resources on new units and defenses steadily instead of all at once, so you can respond to whatever wave comes next.
Pay attention to the magic spells and powerful creatures in each wave, and adjust your placement to deal with the biggest threats first.
faq: What is the goal of Defenders of the Realm?
You must defend your castle and kingdom from the monster army by placing and commanding your knights. Stay in power as king by stopping the enemies from getting through.
Where do the enemies come from?
Enemies enter from the right side of the screen, traveling along one of five lines. You need to be ready to defend whichever line they use.

wander-wild.intro: Wander Wild is a fantasy card battler where you fight enemies with combined cards, build up your Super, and grow your hero, camp, and relics across a chapter of battles.
tips: Mix attack, defense, and ability cards in the same turn so you are not only attacking or only defending. Ask each turn whether you are closer to winning.
Keep track of which enemies are affected by Poison, Bleed, Burn, Stun, or Weaken. Layering several effects on one target often gives more advantage than spreading them out.
Plan your Super around the moment it will matter most, such as when an enemy is close to defeat or a tough hit is coming. Charging it without a clear use wastes the build-up.
Choose your four equipped Relics with your playstyle in mind, and test combinations that charge your Super faster or make it stronger.
Spend camp resources on upgrades that improve the stats you rely on most, since each chapter has 15 battles and stronger heroes handle tougher enemies later on.
faq: What is the main goal of Wander Wild?
You work through a chapter of 15 battles by defeating enemies, upgrading your hero, and pushing deeper into the world.
How do I use my Super Attack?
Build up energy during battle, and some cards and Relics can charge it faster or make it more powerful. Use it when the timing is right.

six-seven-count-fast.intro: Six Seven: Count Fast is a quick counting game where you decide whether a flashed pile holds 6 or 7 items. One wrong answer ends the run, so accuracy matters more than speed.
tips: Count the items in small groups rather than one by one, since the flash only lasts about a second and the time to answer keeps getting shorter.
Before each pile appears, decide which items match the main color and shape so you can skip the decoys that don't count.
On overlapping or drifting piles, look for a clear edge or row first, then count the rest from there.
Keep your eyes on the pile until it disappears, then answer quickly so the timer bar doesn't run out.
If you feel stuck, press P to pause and reset your focus before continuing.
faq: What is the goal of Six Seven: Count Fast?
Your goal is to count the items in each flashed pile and answer 6 or 7 before the timer runs out. Each right answer builds your streak.
How do I answer on a computer?
Press Left Arrow, A or 6 for six, and Right Arrow, D or 7 for seven. You can also click the on-screen buttons.

space-cleaner.intro: Space Cleaner is a mouse-driven arcade game where you destroy asteroids around your ship to earn money. Each round lasts as long as your fuel, and clearing the whole field completes the stage.
tips: Start each round by targeting the asteroids closest to your ship, since they are the ones you can reach while you still have fuel to spare.
Keep an eye on your fuel as you play so you can judge how many asteroids you can still realistically clear before the round ends.
Use the upgrade screen between rounds to strengthen the abilities that help you most, rather than spreading your money across everything.
Notice which asteroids are left in the field as you go, so you can plan a path that finishes the stage instead of leaving scattered targets behind.
Think of each return to space as a fresh attempt: if a round ends with many asteroids left, use what you learned about the layout on your next run.
faq: What is the main goal of Space Cleaner?
Your goal is to destroy every asteroid in the field. Doing so completes the stage and unlocks the next challenge.
How do I earn money?
Destroy asteroids with your mouse cursor to earn money. You can then spend it on upgrades for your ship.

letter-ball.intro: Letter Ball is a puzzle adventure where you roll and jump a ball to hit letters and build words. Collect the words in the correct order while avoiding obstacles.
tips: Move with W A S D or the arrow keys, and practice short rolls before attempting long stretches so you get a feel for the ball's momentum.
Use Space to jump over obstacles and plan your jump before you reach the danger rather than reacting at the last moment.
Before you hit a letter, check which word you are building so you only collect letters that fit the order the puzzle needs.
Each level is harder than the one before, so take your time on early levels to learn how the letters and obstacles are arranged.
If you miss a letter or fall into an obstacle, slow down and reread the target word before trying the section again.
faq: What is the goal of Letter Ball?
You control the ball, hit letters, and collect them to make words in the right order. Each level asks you to do this while avoiding obstacles.
Which keys control the ball?
Use W A S D or the Arrow Keys to move, and press Space to jump.

idle-warrior-tales.intro: IDLE Warrior Tales is an idle RPG where your heroes fight hordes of monsters and bosses on their own. Hire heroes, upgrade gear, and choose skills to push further into the adventure.
tips: Spend your gold on forge upgrades for the heroes already in your party before hiring new ones, so your current team keeps pace with tougher battles.
When a hero levels up, compare the enemies you face now with the ones ahead. Pick healing skills when your team takes heavy damage and attack boosts when fights end too slowly.
Check your team's health during long battles. If heroes keep losing HP, a healing-focused build will help them survive longer.
You do not need to watch every fight. Let the heroes run on their own and return to check progress, upgrades, and new recruits.
Prepare before boss battles by making sure your heroes have current equipment and a balanced mix of skills for the enemy group.
faq: What is the main goal of IDLE Warrior Tales?
Your goal is to keep your heroes fighting through monster hordes and bosses, growing stronger along the way. Reaching deeper into the adventure is how you earn rewards.
Do I need to control my heroes during battles?
No. Heroes fight automatically and choose their own spells, such as healing an ally or cursing a monster. You can use the UI buttons to hire heroes, upgrade equipment, and manage skills.

car-stunt-ramp-challenge.intro: Car Stunt Ramp Challenge is a driving game built around ramps, obstacle courses, and stunts like jumps and flips. You race against the clock, so smooth control matters as much as speed.
tips: Steer with A and D and drive with W, keeping your inputs gentle so the car stays stable on landing.
Before you reach a ramp, check your speed and direction, since a steep approach often sends you off line.
Try to keep the car level in the air, because a tilted landing is a common way to lose control.
Use the first attempts on each course to learn where the obstacles and landing spots are, then focus on clean runs for time.
Treat each challenge as a timing problem: a short pause to set up a jump can be faster than a fast but messy run.
faq: What is the goal of Car Stunt Ramp Challenge?
You race against the clock to complete each ramp and obstacle course challenge. The game rewards precise driving and well-timed stunts.
How do I control the car?
Use the WASD keys to drive. W and S control forward and reverse, and A and D steer.

flap-hero.intro: Flap Hero is a fast arcade game inspired by Flappy Bird. You keep your hero flying through red pipes using tap or spacebar presses, and the challenge is timing each flap precisely.
tips: Tap or press the spacebar in small, steady bursts rather than holding it, since each press gives the hero a short lift.
Aim for the centre of the gap between the pipes and adjust your height gradually as you approach each one.
Watch the upcoming pipes rather than the one directly in front of you, so you have time to plan your next flap.
Stay calm after a close call; rushing a second flap is a common reason to crash into the next pipe.
Practise short sessions to build a feel for the rhythm of the flaps, since consistent timing matters more than fast tapping.
faq: What is the goal of Flap Hero?
Stay in the air and fly through the red pipes without hitting them. The game is endless, so the aim is to keep going as long as you can.
What controls does Flap Hero use?
On a touchscreen, tap to flap. On a keyboard, use the spacebar.

hex-connect.intro: HEX Connect is a hexagonal take on Mahjong Connect. Link pairs of matching colored tiles on a hex grid until the board is completely clear.
tips: Before you click, trace the path between two matching tiles and confirm it bends no more than twice. A pair that looks close can still be blocked.
Look for tiles that are boxed in or sit in the middle of a crowded area. Clearing the tiles around them often opens routes for later pairs.
Work on colors that appear only a few times first. Fewer options for a color means fewer chances to get stuck later.
Try to clear tiles near the edges of the grid early, since they are often easier to reach and can free up space around them.
If you get stuck, scan the whole board for any pair with an open path rather than focusing on one area. Checking all options helps you find the move that keeps the board moving.
faq: What is the goal of HEX Connect?
Your goal is to remove every tile from the board by connecting matching pairs. Each level gets more challenging as you progress.
How do I connect two tiles?
Click or tap the first tile, then click or tap its matching pair. The tiles are removed only if a valid path exists between them.

paint-and-roll.intro: Paint & Roll is a color puzzle where you guide connected paint rollers across platforms to cover every surface. Plan each move carefully, because touching the water ends the level right away.
tips: Before you move, look at the whole platform layout and decide which surfaces each roller needs to cover.
Tap or click to switch between rollers only when you have a clear plan for the next few moves, so you do not lose track of which one you are controlling.
Keep your movements smooth and deliberate, since the instructions stress smooth switching and smart movement as the keys to finishing a level.
Watch the edges of the platforms closely. A single roller touching the water loses the level instantly, so slow down near gaps.
If a level becomes hard, step back and rethink your route from the start rather than pushing forward on a risky path.
faq: What is the goal of Paint & Roll?
Your goal is to roll the connected paint rollers across the board, cover every surface with paint, and reach the finish to win the level.
How do I control the rollers?
Tap or click to switch control between the connected rollers, then guide the active one across the platforms.

help-police.intro: Help Police is a turn-based logic puzzle where you move a police squad to trap a thief trying to escape from prison. Each move matters, so plan ahead before you act.
tips: Before each move, count the thief's free moves so you can see which squares still need to be covered.
Click a policeman first to see its available moves, and compare the options before committing to one.
Think one step ahead: consider where the thief can go after your move, not only where it is now.
Avoid rushing. Taking a little more time on each level usually prevents mistakes that force you to restart your plan.
When a new officer unlocks, which happens every 10 levels, test its available moves on a few positions to learn how it can help you corner the thief.
faq: What is the goal of Help Police?
Your goal is to arrange the police so the thief has no free moves left. Once the thief is fully blocked, you catch it.
How do I move my officers?
Click on a policeman to show its available moves, then click one of the available points to move it there.

penguin-adventure-2.intro: Penguin Adventure is a 2D platform game where you guide a penguin to the castle in each level. Explore three worlds, collect stars and hearts, and use quick reactions and planning to get through each one.
tips: Collect the yellow stars as you go, since you need enough of them to unlock the next world. Don't just rush to the castle.
Pick up hearts and stars on your route when they are safe to reach, because they affect your score and rewards.
Use the Up arrow to jump and the Down arrow to move down, and practise short jumps so you can land precisely on platforms.
Press J to throw bullets when something blocks your path, and keep an eye out for openings where a throw is worth the time.
Each world has its own challenges, so slow down at the start of a new world to learn its layout before trying to speed through it.
faq: How do I unlock the next world?
You need to collect enough yellow stars in the current world to unlock the next one. Gather stars along the way rather than only focusing on the castle.
What is the goal of each level?
Your penguin must reach the castle in each level. Collecting stars and hearts on the way affects your score and rewards.

the-cargo.intro: The Cargo is a 2D driving game where you use a crane to load your truck, then drive the cargo to the warehouse. Finish jobs quickly to unlock achievements and earn money for truck upgrades.
tips: Before you move the truck, use the crane to line up the cargo carefully so it lands where you want it on the truck bed.
Plan your route to the destination warehouse before you start driving so you do not waste time on wrong turns.
Practise attaching and detaching with the spacebar or on-screen button until it feels quick, since speed is what earns you achievements.
Keep an eye on how you handle the truck on bumps and turns so your cargo stays in place and the job goes smoothly.
Spend money on truck upgrades as you earn it, and aim for faster jobs to unlock achievements more often.
faq: What is the goal of The Cargo?
Load the truck with cargo using the crane, then deliver it to the destination warehouse. Finishing the job quickly unlocks achievements and earns money.
How do I control the crane and the truck on desktop?
Use the arrow keys or W, A, S and D to control the crane and drive the truck. Press the spacebar to attach and detach the cargo.

merge-beast-arena.intro: Merge Beast Arena mixes tapping for coins with merging animals into bigger beasts. Build your herd by tapping fast and combining matching animals up the food chain.
tips: Keep tapping in short bursts to keep your combo climbing toward x5, since the bigger multiplier pays far more per tap.
Merge as soon as you own two of the same animal, because a higher beast earns more per tap and moves you up the ladder.
Check your board for pairs before spending time on anything else, so no identical animals sit unmerged.
Work toward two dragons if you want the magma boss, since merging them is what awakens it.
Think of each merge as a step up in strength, so plan your early merges to build toward the bigger beasts rather than rushing one low tier.
faq: How do I merge animals?
Drag one animal on top of another of the same kind, and they will fuse into the next beast up the ladder.
What does the combo do?
Tapping quickly builds a combo up to x5, which gives much bigger coin payouts.

frogy-ninja-2d.intro: Frogy Ninja 2D is a turn-based action-puzzle game where a once-peaceful frog hunts the ninjas that hunted it. You play through many levels by clicking or tapping, and swiping to move.
tips: Look over the whole level before you act, and work out where each enemy ninja can go before you commit to a move.
Since the game is turn-based, take your time. Plan a sequence of moves rather than reacting to the first thing you see.
Pay attention to the surroundings, because the different environments can be used to trick or outmaneuver enemies.
If a level stops going to plan, try a different route through it instead of repeating the same moves.
Use the swipe controls with care, and make sure each swipe does what you intended before moving on.
faq: What is the goal of Frogy Ninja 2D?
Your aim is to outsmart the enemy ninjas and complete your mission in each level. The game has hundreds of challenging levels to work through.
How do I control the frog?
Use mouse clicks or taps to play, and swipe to move through the levels. The controls are meant to be intuitive.

cube-arena-2048-merge-numbers.intro: Cube Arena 2048 Merge Numbers mixes the snake format with 2048. Slide around a 3D arena, collect free cubes, and merge matching numbers to grow bigger than the other players.
tips: Pick up cubes that match your current number when you can. Two blocks with the same value merge into one block worth their sum, which is the fastest way to grow.
Watch the numbers around you before you move. You can eat players with a smaller number than yours, so steer toward them, but avoid anyone with a larger number.
Collect free cubes steadily instead of chasing a single target. Small, safe pickups keep your value rising while you wait for a good merge.
When your cubes bump into one another, the matching ones combine. Plan your route so that the blocks you collect line up with the values you already have.
Stay near the middle of the arena only when you are big enough to defend yourself. Smaller cubes are safer along the edges where fewer larger players can reach you.
faq: How do I grow my cube in Cube Arena 2048 Merge Numbers?
Slide around the arena and pick up free cubes. Collecting two blocks with the same number merges them into one block worth the total of both.
Can I eat other players?
Yes, you can eat players whose number is smaller than yours. Avoid players with a bigger number, since they can eat you instead.

poofruits-merge-the-fruit.intro: Poofruits is a merge puzzler where you drop fruits into a cup and combine matching pairs into bigger ones. Stack carefully, because one good drop can set off a chain of merges.
tips: Build from the bottom up by placing the largest fruits first, so smaller fruits have a stable base to land on.
Leave open space near the top of the cup so small fruits have room to find their matching pair before the line is reached.
Watch where each fruit will roll after you release it, since a dropped fruit can shove its neighbours into new merges.
When the cup gets crowded, swipe down to fling a fruit into the pile and open a gap instead of waiting for it to settle.
Save the bomb for a packed cup: dropping or tapping it scatters the settled fruits and can give you room to keep playing.
faq: What is the goal of Poofruits?
Merge identical fruits into the next size up, working toward the watermelon, while keeping the fruit below the line near the top of the cup. The run ends when fruit stays above that line.
How do I drop a fruit?
Drag your finger or mouse along the top of the screen to move the fruit, then let go to drop it into the cup. Swipe down instead if you want to fling it into a tight pile.

revoxel-3d-voxel-rpg-shooter.intro: Revoxel 3D is a voxel-style cyberpunk RPG shooter where you fight robots and monsters, upgrade your gear, and push through a city controlled by a tech corporation. Progress comes from clearing enemies and taking on bosses.
tips: Defeat enemies steadily, since leveling up comes from kills and it helps you unlock new areas and skills.
Open crates whenever you can, because they hold bonuses and upgrades that can strengthen you quickly.
Save your money for the things that move you forward, such as unlocking new territories and upgrading your character, rather than spending it all on clothing.
Bosses guard the entrances to new cities, so go into each boss fight with your current weapons upgraded and your health in good shape.
Mine resources and use them for crafting and base development, since these can support your upgrades over time.
faq: What is the main goal of Revoxel 3D?
You fight through hordes of enemies to complete levels, unlock new skills, areas, and weapons, and defeat the bosses guarding new cities.
How do I level up faster?
You gain levels by defeating enemies. You can also choose bonuses and find upgrades in crates to strengthen your character.

onet-puzzle-tile-match-game.intro: Onet Puzzle is a tile-matching game where you find pairs of identical tiles and connect them to clear the board before time runs out. Each level adds more grids and tile types, so the challenge grows as you progress.
tips: Before moving, scan the whole board for matching pairs and note which tiles are reachable from the open edges.
Start with tiles near the outer edges, since clearing them usually opens paths for the tiles behind them.
Check that your connecting line has no more than 3 inflection points, and plan the route before you draw it.
Keep an eye on the timer and work quickly on easy pairs, saving harder connections for when more of the board is open.
Save the four tools for moments when you are stuck with few visible connections, rather than using them early.
faq: What is the goal of Onet Puzzle?
Your goal is to connect two identical tiles with a line to remove them, clearing the whole board within the time limit.
How many turns can a connecting line have?
A connecting line can contain no more than 3 inflection points, so plan your route to stay within that limit.

kitty-kitty.intro: Kitty Kitty is a relaxed idle game where you care for kawaii cats in a snowy winter setting. You collect cat food, level up your felines, and build cozy habitats with a festive touch.
tips: Tap or click on cats and resource icons often, since collecting cat food is the core resource for leveling up your felines.
Check in every day through the CheckIn icon so you never miss your daily rewards.
Open the Challenges icon regularly, because completing tasks is how you unlock new features.
Use the bottom icons to visit the Toy Room, food bowl, and Kitty Wiki, and try each one to see what it offers your cats.
Let your cat food build up passively between sessions, then return to spend it on leveling up and raising Sweetness.
faq: How do I collect cat food?
Use the left mouse button on desktop or tap the screen on mobile to collect cat food and interact with cats or resource icons. Cat food also builds up passively over time.
What is Sweetness and how do I raise it?
Sweetness is a stat for your cats that rises as you level up your felines using collected cat food.

motorbike-drive.intro: Motorbike Drive is a driving game where you pick one of 3 motorbikes and one of 4 environments. Everything is controlled with the WASD keys, so you can start riding right away.
tips: Try all three motorbikes in the same environment so you can compare how each one feels to steer.
Spend a few minutes getting used to WASD before you push for speed, since every action runs through those four keys.
Try each of the four environments to see which one suits your riding style best.
Pick one bike and one environment you enjoy, then keep practicing there to build smooth control.
faq: What is the goal of Motorbike Drive?
The game is a fun driving experience with no specific objective listed, so the main focus is riding and exploring. Try different bikes and environments to find what you enjoy most.
How do I control the motorbike?
Use the W, A, S and D keys to control the motorbike.

desert-city-stunt.intro: Desert City Stunt is a driving game set in a desert city. You race through six timed levels, unlock new cars along the way, and can also practice stunts in a free driving mode.
tips: Use Free Driving mode first to learn how each car handles jumps and landings before you face the clock.
Each new level unlocks a stronger car, so treat the level you just finished as a chance to test the new vehicle's handling.
Save your Nitro for stretches where you need speed to clear the time limit, rather than spending it early on flat ground.
When you reach an obstacle, switch to an armored vehicle if you have one, since the game lists them as the way to cross obstacles.
If you get stuck or stop making progress, use the Respawn key (R for Player 2) instead of losing time trying to free your car.
faq: Is there a time limit in the main levels?
Yes, you need to complete each of the 6 levels before time runs out. Free Driving mode has no time pressure.
What are the controls for Player 1?
Use the arrow keys to move, N for Nitro, and B to look back.

santa-soosiz.intro: Santa Soosiz is a Christmas puzzle adventure where you guide Santa across a world shaped around his position. Use gravity to reach platforms and collect the missing gifts to save Christmas.
tips: Gravity keeps Santa on the ground, so pay attention to which way the landscape pulls before you jump. Plan your route around that pull instead of jumping blindly.
Look ahead for the next platform before you leave the current one. Choosing where to land is often more important than how high you jump.
Use short, controlled jumps when you are near an edge. Small movements help you land on the next platform rather than falling past it.
Make a habit of checking each area for gifts before moving on. Missing one can mean backtracking to finish the level.
If you play with touch controls, keep your movements steady and deliberate. Quick, repeated taps can make it harder to judge your jumps.
faq: What is the goal of Santa Soosiz?
Your goal is to move Santa from platform to platform and collect all the missing gifts to save Christmas.
How do I control Santa?
Press W to go up, Space to jump, A to move left, and D to move right. You can also use the touch controls if you prefer.

shred-the-meme.intro: Shred The Meme is an arcade game where you slice meme cards to score points. Build combos, collect power-ups, and avoid bombs while you chase your high score.
tips: Keep your slices flowing in one smooth motion, since slicing memes in a row is how you build a combo.
Learn to spot bombs before you swipe through them, because hitting one is the fastest way to lose a run.
Grab hearts when you can, since each one gives you an extra life to keep playing after a mistake.
Watch the edges of the screen so you do not let memes pass by, and aim to slice each card as it appears.
Pause with P or Esc when you need a moment to reset your focus, then return to the game with a clear head.
faq: How do I slice the memes?
Drag with your mouse to slice, or swipe with your finger on a touch screen. Each swipe through a meme card slices it and scores points.
How do I build a combo?
Slice memes in a row without breaking your streak. Consecutive slices build your combo.

polygon-flight-simulator.intro: Fly a small plane between airports in this browser airplane simulator. Use the keyboard and mouse to climb, descend, and steer while passing airborne checkpoints on the way to each destination.
tips: Start with short, gentle movements. Small mouse drags and brief key presses make it easier to learn how the plane reacts before you try sharper turns.
Climb with a steady mouse drag rather than a sudden one. This keeps the plane stable as you gain height on the way to your next checkpoint.
Line up with each airborne checkpoint before you reach it. Planning your heading a little early helps you pass through it cleanly instead of correcting at the last second.
Use the W, A, S and D keys to fine-tune your position while the mouse handles height. Splitting the controls this way keeps your flight path easier to manage.
Check your route before each takeoff. Knowing where the next airport is will help you plan your path through the checkpoints in order.
faq: What is the goal of Polygon Flight Simulator?
Your goal is to fly from one airport to another. Along the way you pass through airborne checkpoints on the route to your next destination airport.
How do I control the plane?
Press W, A, S or D to move the plane. Drag the mouse to go up, move the mouse forward to go down, and move it left or right to steer.

home-run-infinity.intro: Home Run Infinity is an endless arcade baseball game where you time your swing to launch the ball as far as possible. Every hit earns coins you can spend on new bats and fields.
tips: Watch the moving timing marker and wait for it to line up with the green zone before you swing, since that gives the most powerful hit.
Practise tapping or pressing Space at the same rhythm each time, so your timing becomes more consistent.
Treat the small red and orange zones as bonus targets. They are rare, so only aim for them when the marker is already close to them.
Because you earn one coin per metre, longer hits pay more. Focus on solid contact rather than trying to rush each swing.
Save coins for the bats that suit your timing. Unlocking stronger bats can add distance, so check what you can afford before spending.
faq: What is the goal of Home Run Infinity?
The goal is to hit the ball as far as possible in an endless run. Your best distances can be compared on the leaderboard.
How do I swing?
Tap or click the playfield, or press Space, to stop the moving timing marker and swing. The timing of your press decides how strong the hit is.

kings-defense-roguelike.intro: Kings Defense: Roguelike is a block-breaker style action game where you aim a cannon and bounce balls into advancing monsters to protect your castle. Survive 20 waves and defeat the final boss.
tips: Use the walls to your advantage: since balls ricochet off walls and enemies, aim at angles that bounce them through clusters of monsters before they return.
Pick chest skills with your current run in mind, and keep an eye on which ones add more balls or splitting, since these tend to clear waves faster.
Watch the combo meter and try to keep hitting enemies consistently, because filling it gives bonuses to both damage and healing.
Spend your coins in the main menu between runs on the upgrades that match your struggles, such as more damage if enemies are getting through or more HP if your castle takes too much hits.
Learn how each enemy type behaves, especially the dodging monsters, and adjust your aim or timing when you face them rather than firing the same volley every time.
faq: What is the goal of Kings Defense: Roguelike?
Your goal is to destroy monsters by launching chains of balls before they reach the castle walls. You need to survive all 20 waves and defeat the final boss.
How do I aim and shoot?
Move the mouse cursor left or right on PC, or drag your finger across the screen on mobile, to set the direction. Release the mouse button or lift your finger to launch a volley of balls.

number-merge-10.intro: Number Merge 10 is a math puzzle where you select rectangular areas of numbers. If the numbers inside the selected area add up to 10, they are all cleared from the board.
tips: Look for small groups of adjacent numbers first, such as two numbers that already add up to 10 or a pair like 4 and 6.
Scan the board in rows and columns before choosing a selection, since a rectangle can cover more than one line of numbers at once.
Before you select an area, add up its numbers in your head to confirm the total is exactly 10 and not close to it.
Clear numbers near the edges or corners when you can, because those spots are often harder to reach later.
If you are stuck, step back and check whether a different rectangle, wider or taller, can capture a combination that adds to 10.
faq: What is the goal of Number Merge 10?
The goal is to select rectangular areas so that the numbers inside add up to exactly 10. When they do, all those numbers are eliminated.
What happens if the sum is not 10?
The numbers in the selected area are not eliminated if their sum is anything other than 10. Choose a different area and try again.

voxel-atelier.intro: Voxel Atelier is a relaxing 3D logic puzzle where you read numbers on a block's faces to work out which cubes to remove. Clear away the extra voxels to reveal a hidden miniature object.
tips: Read the numbers on each face first, since they tell you how many voxels should remain in each row. Compare the faces against each other before you remove anything.
Rotate the block often to check each side. A cube that looks unnecessary from one angle may be needed for the object.
Mark a voxel with 1 when you are sure it stays, and remove it with 2 only when you are certain it is extra. Clearing a mark with 3 lets you change your mind without damage.
Use Q and E to move through layers one at a time, so you can focus on a single level of the block. Press Space to see the full block again when you need the overall shape.
Save the hint with C for when you are truly stuck, and use Z to undo any removal that turns out to be wrong.
faq: What is the goal of Voxel Atelier?
Remove every unnecessary voxel so the hidden object is revealed. You must keep the cubes that belong to that object.
How do I remove a voxel on desktop?
Click or use the on-screen buttons, or press 1 to mark a voxel and 2 to remove it. Press 3 to clear a mark.

shadow-strike.intro: Shadow Strike is a 2D platform adventure where you fight enemies, collect stars, and move through a dangerous enemy world. This guide covers the controls, the main goal, and habits that help you avoid traps.
tips: Check the ground and gaps ahead before you move, since deadly traps can end the game quickly.
Keep track of enemy weapons and approach each enemy carefully rather than rushing in.
Use the jetpack (J) or shoe-jet (K) to reach higher ground or cross difficult gaps when a normal jump is not enough.
Collect stars as you go, because they lead you toward the next destination in the mission.
On Android, practice the on-screen touch buttons on a calm stretch first so you can react quickly during fights.
faq: What is the main goal of Shadow Strike?
Kill the enemies to complete the mission and collect stars to reach the next destination.
What are the PC controls?
Press A to move left, D to move right, W to jump, J for the jetpack, and K for the shoe-jet.

luna-and-the-magic-maze.intro: Luna And The Magic Maze is an adventure game where you guide Luna through a mystical autumn forest. You solve mazes, collect magical artifacts, and uncover secrets across stages.
tips: Before moving, look at the whole maze layout on screen to spot likely routes and dead ends.
Pick up magical artifacts when you can, since they are part of the quest and the stages are built around finding them.
Take your time in each stage; the description says every stage brings fresh challenges, so what worked before may need a new approach.
If you get stuck, backtrack to a previous junction and try a different path instead of repeating the same moves.
Use WASD or the arrow keys with short, deliberate moves so you can react to what is ahead rather than overshooting turns.
faq: How do I move Luna?
Use the WASD keys or the arrow keys to move her through the maze.
What is the goal of the game?
Your goal is to solve the mazes, collect magical artifacts, and uncover secrets as Luna travels through the autumn forest.

zombie-wave-arena.intro: Zombie Wave Arena is a top-down survival shooter where you hold off endless zombie waves, spend coins between rounds on upgrades, and push as far as you can past your best wave.
tips: Spend coins between waves with a plan. Put them into the weapon you use most before buying new guns, since upgrades help every fight.
Prepare for the boss every 5th wave. Its HP doubles each time, so save some grenades and ammo before it arrives.
Use grenades on crowds rather than single zombies. Throw them when several enemies are bunched together, and use G to change grenade type before you need it.
Reload during lulls instead of mid-fight. Keep moving while you reload so zombies do not close in on you.
Learn the weapon number keys early. Switching quickly with 1 to 6 or Q lets you match the gun to the threat in front of you.
faq: What is the goal of Zombie Wave Arena?
There is no final level, so the aim is to survive as many waves as you can and beat your best wave and high score. Reaching Wave 50 is the game's biggest milestone.
How do I earn coins?
You earn coins by killing zombies during a wave. You can then spend them between waves on weapon upgrades, new guns, armor, and grenades.

chess-tactics.intro: Chess Tactics mixes turn-based chess movement with shooting in a roguelike where you control a lone king. Clear chambers, choose upgrades, and try a different approach each run.
tips: Every move, shot, and reload uses a turn, so check where enemy pieces can attack before you act.
Move your king onto a highlighted square that lines up a shot on an enemy while keeping you out of its path.
Reload when no enemy threatens your king, since reloading also costs a turn and is risky in the middle of a fight.
Save Dash for escaping a dangerous spot rather than using it for small repositioning.
Pick upgrades that support the weapons you already have so each run follows one clear strategy.
faq: How do I clear a chamber?
Defeat every enemy piece on the board. Once the chamber is clear, you can advance to the next one.
How do I shoot an enemy?
Select the enemy to aim at it, then click it again or press Space to fire.

chicken-and-crow-shoot.intro: Chicken and Crow Shoot is a 3D shooting game where you hunt crows on a farm with a pistol and a sniper gun. You aim, switch weapons, and shoot as the crows appear.
tips: Right-click to aim before you fire, especially with the sniper gun, so each shot counts.
Scroll to switch between the pistol and the sniper gun depending on how close or far the crow is.
Press R to reload when you have a moment of calm, rather than waiting until your weapon is empty mid-fight.
Keep your aim steady and fire in short, controlled bursts so you do not waste ammunition on misses.
Watch the whole farm area instead of fixing your eyes on one spot, since crows can show up from different directions.
faq: How do I shoot the crows?
Press the left mouse button to shoot. Hold the right mouse button to aim first for more accurate shots.
How do I change weapons?
Use the scroll mouse button to switch between your pistol and sniper gun.

brain-master-iq-challenge-2.intro: Brain Master IQ Challenge 2 is a puzzle game built around short brain teasers, including parking, connecting lines, and assorted logic tests. It is quick to pick up, with one click or tap to play.
tips: Read each puzzle fully before you move anything, since the description suggests some answers come from breaking the usual rules.
If a puzzle seems stuck, try a different approach, such as looking at the problem from another angle rather than repeating the same move.
For parking puzzles, plan the order of moves so that blocking pieces are cleared before you try to move the car out.
When connecting lines, trace possible paths on screen first and avoid crossing routes you will need later.
Take a short break if you keep failing the same puzzle; returning with fresh eyes often makes the answer easier to spot.
faq: What is the goal of Brain Master IQ Challenge 2?
The goal is to solve each puzzle, which can include parking cars, connecting lines, and other brain tests. The game encourages thinking outside the box.
How do I control the game?
You click or tap to play. The instructions do not list any other controls, so use the mouse or touch input on each puzzle as it appears.

rainbow-ice-cream-and-popsicles.intro: Rainbow Ice Cream And Popsicles is a cooking and decorating game about frozen treats. You can make dessert recipes such as popsicles, ice cream bars, sandwiches, and soft serve, with an ice cream truck theme.
tips: Take your time with each step, since the game is about enjoying the process rather than rushing through it.
Try the different frozen treats, such as popsicles, ice cream bars, and soft serve, to see which ones you enjoy making most.
Use decorating steps to add colour and personal touches, since the rainbow theme gives you plenty of room to experiment.
Keep your mouse or finger steady when placing items or toppings so your decorations look neat.
If you are new to cooking games, follow the on-screen order of steps before trying to create your own combinations.
faq: How do I control the game?
Use your mouse or tap the screen to play. Everything in the game is handled with these two inputs.
What kinds of desserts can I make?
The game features ice cream, popsicles, ice cream bars, ice cream sandwiches, and soft serve, along with other frozen desserts and dessert recipes.

noob-big-item-sorting.intro: Noob: Big Item Sorting is a calm matching puzzle where you drag items onto the bottom of the screen and pair identical ones. Clear each level by connecting every item.
tips: Scan the whole screen before you start dragging, so you can spot identical items that are far apart.
Place items at the bottom in an order that keeps one of each type easy to find, rather than dropping them at random.
Look for a match first when you have two of the same item in view, since matching clears space at the bottom.
Work steadily instead of rushing; the game is light and calming, and careful placement avoids mistakes.
Finish levels to unlock new items, avatars, and skins, which gives you a reason to keep progressing.
faq: What is the goal of Noob: Big Item Sorting?
Your goal is to arrange identical objects so that two matching ones end up next to each other and form a pair. You clear a level by connecting all the items.
How do I move items in the game?
Drag and drop items to the bottom of the screen. Match two identical items there to create a match.

3d-football-mania.intro: 3D Football Mania is a fast soccer game where you score more goals than your opponent before the 2 minute timer runs out. It is built for quick matches with simple controls.
tips: Use F to switch to the teammate closest to the ball so you can keep possession without running across the pitch yourself.
Pass with V before an opponent closes in, rather than dribbling into a crowd of defenders.
Save SHIFT for the moments that matter: a sprint to get past a defender or a tackle to win the ball back.
Shoot with SPACE when you have a clear angle on goal, since the match is short and each chance counts.
On mobile, get comfortable with the joystick first, then use the PASS and SHOOT buttons without looking down at them.
faq: What is the goal of 3D Football Mania?
Score more goals than your opponent before the 2 minute timer runs out.
Which keys control the players?
Arrow Keys move, V passes, SPACE shoots, SHIFT sprints or tackles, and F switches to the teammate closest to the ball.

zip-me-up-halloween.intro: Zip Me Up Halloween is a short clicker game where you click a zippo lighter to find out what you will get for Halloween. You play with the mouse or by tapping the screen.
tips: Keep your clicks steady and rhythmic rather than rushing, so each click is easy to track on screen.
Watch the lighter closely after each click so you notice any change before deciding where to click next.
If you are playing for a while, take short breaks between rounds to keep your focus sharp.
Try a few different tapping or clicking speeds to see which one feels most comfortable and gives you the best control.
faq: What is the goal of Zip Me Up Halloween?
The goal is to click the zippo lighter and see what you are going to get for Halloween. Each click reveals the next result.
How do I play?
Use your mouse to click, or tap the screen if you are on a touch device. The game is controlled only by clicking or tapping.

fluffy-jump.intro: Fluffy Jump is an arcade platform game where you keep moving forward by jumping from platform to platform. Miss one and the run ends, so the aim is to last as long as you can.
tips: Watch the next platform ahead rather than the one under you, so you can line up your jump early.
Settle into a steady rhythm of timing early on, since the speed rises gradually and small timing errors add up.
Judge the distance to each platform before you jump instead of reacting at the last moment.
Stay calm as the pace picks up; rushing usually causes more misses than the increased speed itself.
Practise short runs to learn how far each jump carries you before you aim for a longer score.
faq: What is the goal of Fluffy Jump?
The goal is to jump from platform to platform while moving continuously forward. Your score is based on how long you survive.
What happens if I miss a platform?
Missing any platform ends the run, so you need to land on each one to keep going.

santa-and-the-chaser.intro: Santa is being chased, and you need to help him escape by avoiding obstacles. Clear all 20 levels to get him back to the North Pole. The game is played with mouse clicks or taps.
tips: Watch the obstacles coming up ahead rather than the ones already behind you, so you have time to react.
Keep your clicks or taps steady and timed to the action, since rushing can make you miss a dodge.
Try to last as long as you can in each run, because the game rewards Santa for staying ahead of the Chaser.
Take short breaks between levels so you can come back focused for the harder stages near the end of the 20.
If you fail a level, try again with a clear plan for the spots that caught you, since each attempt is a chance to learn the pattern.
faq: What is the goal of Santa And The Chaser?
Help Santa escape from the Chaser by avoiding obstacles, and complete all 20 levels to return him to the North Pole.
How do I control Santa?
You play with mouse clicks or taps. There are no other controls mentioned in the game's instructions.

red-blue-forge.intro: Red-Blue Forge is a fast reaction arcade game where you rotate a core to match incoming embers. Each run lasts until you make a mismatch, so you play for as long as you can keep matching colors.
tips: Watch the incoming embers as they approach the center and start rotating your core early, so you are never rushing to match at the last moment.
Focus on chaining correct matches, since building a streak is how your score grows during a run.
Use the Ready gate to pause and reset your focus before each run begins, rather than starting immediately after the last one ends.
Spend your collected materials on the Forge Tree upgrades that support control and stability first, since a steadier core makes precise matches easier.
Once you unlock 4-core mode, practice tracking four colors at once before relying on it, because the x3 score multiplier rewards accurate play.
faq: How does a run end?
A run ends when you make a mismatch, so the goal is to keep matching embers correctly for as long as possible.
How do I control the core?
Tap or click left or right to rotate the core so its color matches the ember heading toward the center.

hide-from-school.intro: Hide from School is an adventure game about sneaking a schoolboy out of school while avoiding his teachers. You hide, disguise yourself, solve puzzles and open doors to find the way out.
tips: Watch where the teachers are looking and moving before you step into an open area. Wait for them to turn or walk away before you move.
Use disguises and hiding spots when a teacher gets close, rather than running, since staying still in cover is the safer choice.
Pick up and check items you come across, because some can be used to open doors or set traps, and you may need them later in the room.
Explore each room fully before heading for the exit so you know where the hiding spots and routes are.
Use WASD on desktop for precise movement in tight corridors, and move slowly near teachers so you can react in time.
faq: What is the goal of Hide from School?
Your main task is to get out of the school without being caught by the evil teacher. You do this by hiding, disguising yourself, and solving puzzles to escape each room.
How do I move my character?
On desktop, press the WASD keys or move the mouse with the left button held down. On mobile, move your finger across the screen.

slender-zombie-time.intro: Slender Zombie Time is a 3D shooter where you are alone in a cold, zombie-filled forest. Your goal is to find and kill the Slender Man while fighting off the undead.
tips: Keep moving with WASD so zombies cannot surround you. Strafing sideways while you aim is often safer than standing still.
Use the mouse wheel to switch weapons based on the threat in front of you, and keep an eye on which one you are holding before a fight starts.
Reload with R during a lull rather than in the middle of a group attack, so you are not left empty-handed when enemies close in.
Use Space to jump when you need to change position quickly or get out of a tight spot.
Press P to pause if you need a moment to plan your route through the forest before pushing deeper in.
faq: What is the main goal of Slender Zombie Time?
Your mission is to find and kill the Slender Man somewhere in the cold, zombie-infested forest. You must survive the undead while searching for him.
How do I shoot in the game?
Press the left mouse button (LMB) to shoot. Use the mouse wheel to change weapons between shots or fights.

baby-penguin-fishing.intro: Baby Penguin Fishing is a 2D puzzle game with two fishing modes, Fishing and Trawling. You earn progress by catching fish quickly and completing each level's objective.
tips: In Fishing mode, click directly on a fish's body to cast your line, so focus on the fish themselves rather than the empty water.
Scan the whole screen before you start clicking to plan which fish to catch first and in what order.
In Trawling mode, pick a spot where the most fish are grouped together before you release the net, since it captures everything within its area.
Keep an eye on the objective and aim to finish it fast, because the game rewards speed as well as skill.
If a level feels slow, switch your attention between the two modes' rhythms: quick, precise taps for Fishing and well-timed area choices for Trawling.
faq: What is the goal of Baby Penguin Fishing?
Catch fish quickly and complete the objective to advance to the next level. Speed matters as well as skill.
How do I play Fishing mode?
Click on each fish's body to cast your line and catch it. Try to catch fish quickly to move on.

bee-rise.intro: Bee Rise is an idle colony builder where you guide a queen bee, gather nectar and pollen, and grow your hive. Guards defend it from wasps and hornets as you spend honey on upgrades.
tips: Gather nectar yourself early on, since the queen's collecting is what starts your income before workers can help.
Hatch workers to bring resources home, and check your upgrade tabs regularly so honey goes toward the upgrades that speed up collection.
Recruit guards before invaders show up, so your hive is already defended when wasps and hornets arrive.
Finish quests and claim daily gifts when they are available, because they are easy extra progress for little effort.
Use prestige once your colony has grown well, since each new colony starts stronger and will move forward faster.
faq: What is the goal of Bee Rise?
You grow a lively hive by gathering nectar and pollen, hatching workers, training guards, and spending honey on upgrades. Quests and prestige help you keep growing.
How do I collect nectar?
Move the queen next to a flower, then press Space or J or tap Gather. On desktop you move with WASD or the arrow keys.

lantern-canals.intro: Lantern Canals is a calm sliding-path puzzle where you arrange stone tiles to guide water and a paper boat from the spring to the harbor gate. Each level rewards you for collecting its three lanterns.
tips: Before you connect the canal, look at the whole route and find where the three lanterns sit. Plan a path that passes them instead of racing to the gate.
Use the shortcut only when you are happy to lose the lanterns on that level. If you want full lantern collection, take the longer route.
Try the hint button when you are stuck on one stone arrangement, then work out the moves yourself so you learn the pattern.
If a plan fails, undo a few steps rather than restarting the whole level, since you keep the progress you made before the mistake.
With the keyboard, remember that arrows or WASD slide the stone on the far side of the gap, so think about which stone will move before you press a key.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Slide the stone tiles to build a canal from the spring to the harbor gate. The paper boat then sails the route you made.
How do I collect the lanterns?
Each level has three lanterns along the way. Pass your canal through them, because the shortcut finishes faster but leaves them dark.

bus-school-park-driver.intro: Bus School Park Driver is a bus driving game built around precise parking, smooth steering, and traffic in school zones. Each level sets a parking or navigation challenge you work through with mouse clicks or taps.
tips: Go slowly when you enter a tight school zone, since small mistakes are easier to avoid at low speed.
Before you move, look at the whole layout of the parking area so you know where the bus needs to end up.
Make gentle, smooth turns rather than sharp ones, especially when backing into a space.
If a parking attempt goes wrong, reset your approach and try again instead of forcing the bus into position.
Pay attention to the traffic around you and pause your move if something is crossing your path.
faq: How do I control the bus?
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps. Use the on-screen controls described in the game to steer and move the bus.
What is the main goal of each level?
Each level tests your driving skills with parking and navigation challenges, and you complete missions by handling them successfully.

foot-bomb.intro: Foot Bomb is a soccer-style action game where you kick a ticking bomb instead of a ball. Your aim is to kick it into the goal post before it explodes.
tips: Look toward the goal before you kick so you know which way the bomb needs to travel.
Move with W, A, S and D while keeping the bomb in front of you, so you do not have to chase it far.
Use the mouse to scan the field and check how far the goal post is from the bomb's position.
Watch the countdown from the start and plan your route early, since time is ticking the whole round.
Kick the bomb in a direction that keeps it moving toward the goal rather than away from it, so you spend less time running after it.
faq: What is the goal of Foot Bomb?
Kick the bomb and get it into the goal post before it explodes. The countdown runs the whole time, so speed matters.
How do I move my player?
Use W, A, S and D to move. Move the mouse to look around the field.

arrows-idle.intro: Arrows Idle is a clicker where you clear a grid of arrows by clicking them, set off chain reactions, and buy upgrades to keep the flow going. Skill buttons give you extra money to spend.
tips: Click arrows steadily and watch which ones set off chain reactions, since a single click can clear several at once.
Spend your money on upgrades as soon as you can afford them, because each upgrade helps every later click.
Use the skill buttons when you have a spare moment, since they give you extra money to speed up your progress.
Keep an eye on the grid as it fills up and aim to clear sections before they become crowded.
Check your upgrade options regularly so you can choose the ones that fit how you are playing at the moment.
faq: What is the goal of Arrows Idle?
The goal is to clear the grid by clicking arrows, trigger chain reactions, and upgrade your way to a smooth flow.
How do I play Arrows Idle?
Click on the arrows to clear them and click the upgrade buttons to improve your progress. You can also use the skill buttons to earn extra money.

zombie-defence.intro: Zombie Defence is a first-person shooter where you fight off zombie hordes from all sides while protecting your car. Survive as long as you can, using weapons, grenades and upgrades earned between battles.
tips: Keep moving with WASD and avoid standing still in one spot, since zombies attack from every direction and a stationary player gets surrounded quickly.
Watch the condition of your car as well as your own health, because losing the vehicle removes your chance of escape.
Use the E push-away ability when enemies crowd close to you, then step back to reload or line up your next shot.
Spend your earned currency on the weapon that suits how you fight, such as a shotgun for close groups or a sniper rifle for distant threats, and upgrade it before buying extras.
Save some currency for grenades and the car upgrades so you are not short when a later level brings bigger waves.
faq: What is the goal of Zombie Defence?
Your goal is to survive and protect your car from hordes of zombies that attack from all sides. The longer you last, the better your result.
How do I earn money to upgrade my gear?
You earn currency by completing quests and by killing zombies. Between levels you can spend it on weapons, car upgrades, grenades and super-powers.

american-truck-driver-game.intro: Drive large American trucks along challenging roads, complete delivery missions, and explore different environments. The game focuses on realistic truck handling and getting cargo where it needs to go safely.
tips: Use gentle steering inputs with A and D, since big trucks respond more slowly than cars and sharp turns can cause problems.
Ease off the W or Up Arrow before corners and keep your speed under control so you can keep the truck steady.
Make small corrections early instead of large ones late, especially on highways where the road can pull you off line.
Plan each delivery by checking the road ahead and the environment around you before you start moving.
Use the mouse to click menu buttons between runs, and keep your keyboard hands ready for driving.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Your main goal is to complete delivery missions by driving powerful trucks and bringing cargo to its destination safely.
Which keys control the truck?
Use W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move back, and A or D (or the Left and Right Arrows) to steer left and right.

bottle-color-match-challenge.intro: Bottle Color Match Challenge is a puzzle where you swap bottles until each color lines up in a single row. You can play at your own pace or race against the clock.
tips: Before you swap, look for which colors are already close together and focus on finishing one color at a time.
Plan each swap so it moves a bottle nearer to its matching color instead of trying moves at random.
Use a hint when you are stuck, but first look for the one bottle that seems out of place, since fixing it may be enough.
If the timer makes you rush, switch to your own pace until you are comfortable with the swaps, then try the clock.
Keep track of which bottles are already in the right spot so you do not undo good progress with a later swap.
faq: How do I move a bottle?
Select a bottle, then select another bottle to swap the two.
What is the goal of each level?
Arrange the bottles so that all the colors match within a single row.

super-girl-salon.intro: Super Girl Salon is a dress-up and makeover game where you play as a superhero with the Power Girls and their pets. Help Super City by catching monsters and turning them into friendly citizens.
tips: Read the story setup first so you know the goal: catch the monsters and turn them into friendly super citizens.
Take your time with each makeover, since the decorating and dress-up choices are the heart of the game.
Try different combinations of outfits and styling to see how each look changes the final result.
Keep your pets in mind as you play, because they are part of the team that helps save Super City.
Use the mouse or tap controls steadily rather than rushing, so each step is done carefully.
faq: What is the goal of Super Girl Salon?
Help the Power Girls save Super City by catching monsters and turning them into friendly super citizens.
How do I control the game?
You play with the mouse or by tapping the screen.

mine-obby-3d-minigame-world.intro: Mine Obby 3D is a collection of minigames where you move, jump, and compete for wins. Each victory earns golden apples and coins to spend on rewards, upgrades, and new skins.
tips: Use the camera often to check where you will land before each jump. Rotating the view helps you judge gaps and platforms in 3D.
Jump with steady timing rather than rushing. Pausing briefly before a jump can prevent a fall when the path is narrow.
Try several minigames to see which ones suit your strengths. Some depend more on agility, while others rely on attention, luck, or quick thinking.
Save your golden apples and coins for upgrades that help you most, instead of spending them on cosmetic items right away. Check what each reward offers first.
Watch your rivals in competitive matches and adjust your approach to their moves. Staying aware of the field can help you stay near the top.
faq: How do I move and jump in Mine Obby 3D?
On PC, use W, A, S, D or the arrow keys to move and Space to jump. On mobile, use the left joystick to move and the right button to jump.
How do I change the camera view?
On PC, move the mouse to rotate the camera. On mobile, swipe on the right side of the screen.

draw-cute-animals.intro: Draw Cute Animals is a drawing and coloring game for young children. Kids can draw and color animals such as kittens and pandas while practicing creativity and hand-eye coordination.
tips: Start with the guides first to get the basic shape of each animal right, then add your own details and colors.
Try a simpler animal before moving on to more detailed ones, so the drawing feels achievable and fun.
Pick a few colors and use them consistently on one animal, then experiment with new combinations on the next.
Take short breaks between drawings so the activity stays relaxed and enjoyable for little hands.
Let your child choose which animal to draw, since interest keeps them focused and helps them learn about different animals.
faq: How do you play Draw Cute Animals?
You play by clicking with a mouse or tapping the screen. Choose an animal, then draw and color it using the available options.
Do I need to follow the guides?
The guides are designed to be easy to follow, so they work well for beginners. You can also use them as a starting point and create your own version of each animal.

bandana-blitz.intro: Bandana Blitz is a fast retro run-and-gun shooter with a long campaign of operations, enemy squads, vehicles and boss fights. Clear each objective to reach extraction and build the loadout that suits your style.
tips: Read the objective at the start of each operation, since missions differ between defending positions, collecting intelligence, destroying supplies and defeating a boss. Knowing the goal tells you where to spend your time and ammo.
Keep moving while you shoot. Fast-paced runs get dangerous when you stand still in the open, so use jumps to dodge fire and reposition.
Save grenades for groups of enemies or tougher targets rather than single soldiers. Keeping one in reserve can help when a squad or boss pushes you into a corner.
Use checkpoints on longer operations to bank your progress. If a stage is hard, retry from the last checkpoint instead of restarting the whole campaign.
Think about your tactical module before a tough fight. Activating it at the right moment can matter more than shooting faster, so practise when it helps you most.
faq: What is the main goal in Bandana Blitz?
Each operation asks you to complete its objective and then reach extraction. Objectives vary and can include rescuing captives, destroying enemy supplies or defeating a boss.
Which keys do I use to fire and throw grenades on keyboard?
Use X or J to fire and C or L to throw grenades. Move and aim with WASD or the Arrow Keys, and jump with Z, K or Space.

pistonio.intro: Pistonio is a cozy 3D puzzle where you fire pistons to shove blocks and get the golden cube onto the goal plate. Each level rewards careful move order, and the fewest moves earn the most stars.
tips: Before firing anything, trace where the golden cube needs to end up and work backwards to find the piston that can push it there.
Watch for corners: a wrong shot can wedge the cube against walls, so pause and check the path before each tap.
Use Undo (or Z) freely to test ideas, since it costs nothing to step back and try a different order.
Remember that conveyors shift everything after each move, so account for their motion before planning your next shot.
Rotate the camera with the compass and zoom with + and − when a piston or block is hidden behind another, so you can read the board clearly.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Push the golden cube onto the marked plate using the pistons on the board. Clearing the plate completes the level.
How do I earn three stars?
Match the par move count for the level. Finishing in fewer moves than par is the way to aim for the full three stars.

jelly-matches.intro: Jelly Matches is a match-style puzzle where you drop pieces onto the board to break a set number of colored pieces. Special pieces like x2, -1 and shields change how you count your progress.
tips: Before each drop, check which special pieces are on the board, since x2 can speed up your progress a lot.
Avoid lining up groups where the -1 piece would be pulled into a match and cost you progress.
Save shield pieces for moments when a risky drop could otherwise hurt your count.
Aim your drops so the falling piece lands next to a matching color, which makes it more likely to break a group.
