Watch how pieces settle after each break, because the board changes and new groups can form on their own.
faq: What is the goal of Jelly Matches?
You need to break a specified number of colored pieces on the board by dropping pieces so they fall and match.
How do I drop a piece?
Drag with your mouse or touch to place a piece, and it will fall onto the board and be matched.

hungry-cars.intro: Hungry Cars is a 3D racing game where your car grows stronger by eating smaller cars. Pick your targets carefully, avoid bigger rivals, and use each run to unlock new customization options.
tips: Look at the power levels before you move. Only go after cars with a lower power level than yours, since those are the ones you can eat safely.
Keep an eye on stronger cars around you and steer away early rather than waiting until you are about to collide.
Stay clear of damage. Getting hit by stronger cars slows your progress, so play it safe when you are close to larger rivals.
Plan your route a few cars ahead. Moving smoothly toward the next weaker car usually works better than making sudden sharp turns.
Use each run to grow and unlock customization options. Even short runs help you get stronger over time.
faq: How do I get stronger in Hungry Cars?
You grow stronger by driving into cars with a lower power level than yours so you can eat them. Each eaten car adds to your strength.
What should I avoid while playing?
Avoid stronger cars, because colliding with them can damage you. Steer away from them early to keep your run going.

the-last-shot.intro: The Last Shot is a shooting game where you aim and launch a mystical orb through glowing platforms and obstacles toward a green goal. Precision and planning help you clear each level.
tips: Before you release, look at the whole path from the orb to the green platform, not just the first bounce or move. Small aim changes can make a big difference further along.
Use the blue platforms on purpose. Think about where they can redirect the orb so it reaches the green platform instead of hitting an obstacle.
Watch for obstacles near your route and aim with some margin, so a slight miscalculation does not send the orb into danger.
Try a few shots on each level to learn how the orb reacts to different angles. Adjusting gradually is often more reliable than rushing.
If a level keeps defeating you, step back and plan a different route rather than repeating the same shot. Strategy matters more than speed here.
faq: How do I aim and shoot the orb?
Drag your finger to aim the orb toward the platforms, then release to shoot it. The orb travels from where you launched it.
What is the goal of each level?
Guide the orb to the green platform while avoiding obstacles. Use the blue platforms strategically to help you get there.

bubble-stars-boxes-sirius-and-najia.intro: Bubble Stars Boxes: Sirius & Najia is a collecting and battle game where you open boxes to get new fighters and skins, then use them to win trophies. Progress comes from events and the season pass.
tips: Open boxes regularly, since they are the main way to get new characters and skins for your collection.
Upgrade the characters you use most often so your fighters stay useful in battles.
Try different game modes to see which ones earn you trophies most reliably.
Check the event challenges often and finish them when you can, since they add to your season pass progress.
Claim season pass rewards as you level up so you do not miss anything along the way.
faq: What is the main goal of Bubble Stars Boxes: Sirius & Najia?
Your goal is to open boxes, collect new characters and skins, and complete events. Winning battles also earns trophies.
How do I get new characters and skins?
You get them by opening boxes, which can contain character and skin drops. Collecting them builds your roster over time.

offshore-jeep-race-3d.intro: Offshore Jeep Race 3D is a 4x4 driving game set on mountain roads, jungle tracks and muddy water crossings. You steer with the arrow keys while managing speed, gears and the car's condition.
tips: Start by driving a few slow laps to learn how each Jeep handles on uneven ground before you push for speed.
Watch the revs and gear readout on the HUD, and shift down before steep climbs so the engine does not stall or lose grip.
Try the ABS, TC and ESP assists first, then switch them off once you understand the car, since the simulation becomes more demanding without them.
Switch between the available cameras to find the view that shows the road ahead on tight mountain bends and drops.
Remember that damage is realistic, so slow down before rough sections and avoid hard crashes into obstacles, which can make the Jeep harder to control.
faq: What keys control the Jeep?
You control the car with the arrow keys on your keyboard.
Can I turn off the driving aids?
Yes. The ABS, TC and ESP simulation can be turned on or off, so you can choose how much help the car gives you.

air-warfare.intro: Air Warfare is an endless shooter where you pilot a combat plane, shooting down enemies while staying alive and chasing a high score. Your plane moves and fires based on your clicks.
tips: Keep your plane moving rather than sitting still, since staying in one place makes it easier for enemies and their attacks to hit you.
Watch for incoming enemy fire early and shift position before it reaches you, instead of reacting at the last second.
Collect ammo whenever it is safe to do so, because running out of ammo leaves you with no way to fight back.
Pick your shots carefully and focus on the foes that threaten you most, rather than firing at everything that appears.
Stay calm and play in short, focused runs at first, so you can learn the enemy patterns and push your score higher over time.
faq: How do I move and shoot my plane?
Click or tap on the plane to move it and fire at the same time, according to the game's instructions.
What is the goal of Air Warfare?
The game is endless, so the goal is to survive as long as possible while shooting down foes and building a high score.

urban-farm-simulator-game.intro: Urban Farm Simulator is a relaxing farming game where you build and manage a farm in the city. You grow crops, care for your fields, and expand as you earn rewards.
tips: Use W, A, S, D or the arrow keys to move around your farm, and use the mouse to click buttons.
Plant seeds early so your crops have time to grow before you need to harvest them.
Check on your fields regularly to keep them cared for, since healthy fields are what turn your harvest into produce.
Work through the tasks in front of you, because completing them is how you earn the rewards that let you expand.
Spend your rewards on growing your farm rather than spreading out too quickly, so each part of the farm stays manageable.
faq: What is the goal of Urban Farm Simulator?
The goal is to turn a small urban farm into a thriving agricultural business by growing crops, harvesting produce, and completing tasks. Expanding the farm is the long-term aim.
How do I move around the farm?
Use W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move back, A or the Left Arrow to move left, and D or the Right Arrow to move right. Use the mouse to click any button.

christmas-land-adventure.intro: Christmas Land Adventure is a 2D platformer where you help Santa get through challenges across a snowy Christmas world. You move through each level, using jumps and snowballs to get past what stands in your way.
tips: Look at the next platform before you jump so you land safely and avoid falling off the level.
Press A to throw snowballs when you spot a threat ahead, rather than waiting until you are right next to it.
Move in short, controlled steps on slippery snow-themed sections so you can stop where you intend.
On mobile, get comfortable with the on-screen buttons on a few early moves before facing harder challenges.
If you lose progress, slow down and replay the tricky part calmly instead of rushing through it again.
faq: What is the goal of Christmas Land Adventure?
You help Santa overcome challenges as you move through the platformer levels. Reaching the end of each level and getting past its obstacles is the main objective.
How do I control the character on desktop?
Use the arrow keys to move your character. Press A to throw snowballs.

inner-city-drive.intro: Inner City Drive is a rain-soaked night racer where speed is automatic and you steer through dense neon traffic. Close near-misses build a combo that raises your score multiplier, but one crash ends the run.
tips: Pick your gaps early and commit to them, since last-second swerves are where most crashes happen at this speed.
Build your combo through close passes, but only take the ones you can recover from so one bad lane change does not wipe out a long chain.
Watch for a lane that is opening up ahead and move toward it before you need to, so you are not stuck in gridlock.
Use the tunnels and off-ramp launches as practice for judging distance, since they show you how much room your car really needs.
Try different cars once you unlock them, because each has its own speed and grip, and a car that feels stable may suit your steering better.
faq: How do I steer the car?
Use A and D or the Arrow Keys on a keyboard, drag with the mouse, or touch and drag on a touchscreen. Speed is set automatically, so steering is your only job.
What does the combo do?
Each near-miss adds to your combo, which raises your speed and score multipliers the longer you keep it going. If you play it safe for too long, the combo drops away.

mine-obby-3d-car-wash-tycoon.intro: Mine Obby 3D: Car Wash Tycoon is a clicker and tycoon game where you run a small car wash and grow it into a larger automotive complex. You serve cars, collect earnings, and expand your business step by step.
tips: Focus on serving cars and collecting the money they bring to the cash register, since that is your core income while you save for bigger purchases.
Upgrade your existing facilities before building new ones, because the description says each upgrade increases your income.
Plan your expansion in stages by adding the gas station, café, and repair shop as your earnings grow, so each new building gets used well.
Add more cars and improve their speed to keep traffic moving through your business, then consider unlocking the gold, emerald, and diamond roads.
Equip pets early to raise your character's running speed, which helps you move between your facilities and serve customers faster.
faq: How do I earn money in this game?
Serve cars, wait for them to reach the cash register, and then collect your earnings. Upgrading your facilities also increases how much you make.
What controls should I use on PC?
Use WASD to move your character, the right mouse button to rotate the camera, the left mouse button to interact, and Space to jump.

school-bus-simulation.intro: School Bus Simulation is a 3D parking game where you drive a school bus along the street to the school. The controls are simple, so most of your attention goes to steering and parking carefully.
tips: Start slowly and build speed only when the road ahead is clear. Bus steering is easier to control at a gentle pace.
Make small, short movements when lining up near the school. Large corrections at the end often overshoot the spot.
Check your position from more than one angle before you commit to a turn. Judging the bus's length helps you avoid clipping the curb or other objects.
Take a moment to stay calm between attempts. The game is meant to be relaxed, and steady inputs usually beat rushed ones.
If you struggle, reset your approach: slow down, pause your inputs, and line the bus up straight before making the final turn.
faq: What is the goal of School Bus Simulation?
You drive the school bus along the street to the school and park it there. Focus on bringing the bus in smoothly.
How do I control the bus?
Use the W, A, S and D keys to move the bus. Press gently at first to learn how it responds.

bridge-wars.intro: Bridge Wars is a tower-defense style game where you draw patterns to summon stickman soldiers that hold back enemy vehicles on a barricaded bridge. Upgrade your arsenal between fights to keep the enemy from breaking through.
tips: Plan your drawing before the timer runs out, since you only have 3 seconds to spawn your soldiers. Practice a few simple shapes you can draw quickly and reliably.
Watch which type of enemy vehicle is approaching and choose your pattern to match. Spawning the right defenders at the right moment matters more than spawning as many as possible.
Spend upgrades in the shop on what is failing most often, such as armor if your defenders fall quickly or weapons if enemies survive too long.
Save shields and landmines for the hardest waves instead of using them early. Keeping a few in reserve can stop a breach when the pressure builds.
Keep an eye on the barricades on the bridge, since they slow enemies and give your soldiers time to attack. Losing barricades early often leads to a fast breach later.
faq: What is the main goal of Bridge Wars?
Your goal is to stop enemy vehicles from crossing the bridge full of barricades. You do this by drawing patterns to summon soldiers who attack them.
How much time do I have to draw a pattern?
You have 3 seconds to draw a pattern and spawn your soldiers. Keep your shapes simple so you can finish in time.

cannon-ball-3d-big-boom-obby.intro: Cannon Ball 3D: Big Boom Obby is a physics puzzle shooter with 100 stages. Tap to fire heavy cannonballs and knock every block off the golden base plate before your shots run out.
tips: Study the whole layout before your first shot, and look for the weakest point in the structure. A well-placed hit there can bring down several blocks at once.
Watch how the blocks fall after each shot. Many stages can be cleared through chain reactions, so one good hit may save you several shots.
Try a ricochet or a glancing hit when a direct shot would be blocked or too hard to aim. Some blocks are easier to knock off from the side.
Aim for fewer shots, since each stage awards more stars the fewer shots you use. Wasted shots are the main thing that lowers your score.
On harder stages with awkward angles and few mistakes allowed, slow down and plan each tap. Clear the easy blocks first only if it does not waste shots.
faq: What is the goal of each stage?
Knock every block off the golden base plate before you run out of shots. The stage is cleared once the base plate is empty.
How do I fire the cannon?
Tap anywhere on the screen to fire at that spot. Each tap launches one heavy cannonball.

mr-stickman.intro: Mr Stickman is a shooting game where you aim and shoot enemies across a series of challenging levels. Your goal is to clear every level while making each bullet count.
tips: Take a moment to line up your aim before you fire, since the game is built around aiming to shoot.
Look at the whole level before shooting so you can plan which enemy to take out first.
Save your bullets for targets that matter most and avoid firing at random, because the game asks you not to waste them.
If you miss a shot, pause and reassess your angle rather than rapidly firing again.
Retry tougher levels with what you learned about enemy positions to improve your approach.
faq: What is the main goal of Mr Stickman?
Your goal is to aim and shoot all the enemies in each level and complete the challenging levels one by one.
How do I play Mr Stickman?
Aim at your enemies and shoot. The instructions focus on aiming to shoot, so accuracy is the key control to practice.

z-stick-duel-fighting.intro: Z Stick Duel Fighting puts you in control of a stickman warrior facing rival stickmen in one-on-one duels. Win by using skills, managing mana, and dodging attacks.
tips: Watch your mana bar before committing to a big skill, since running out can leave you unable to answer an attack.
Spend the first moments of each duel observing how your opponent moves so you can predict their next attack.
Dodge incoming attacks first and strike when the opening appears, rather than trading blows on every turn.
Try a few different skills and styles early on to find the approach that suits your speed and timing.
Save your strongest technique for when the opponent is weakened, since a well-timed fatal blow ends the duel.
faq: What is the goal of Z Stick Duel Fighting?
You fight other stickmen in duels, using skills and techniques to defeat each opponent with a fatal blow.
How do I play the game?
Use mouse clicks or taps to perform your actions during the duel.

field-of-blooms.intro: Field of Blooms is a garden harvesting game where you bring dry sprouts back to life. Sweep, fertilize, and gather across the map, then spend what you earn on upgrades.
tips: Sweep in steady, straight passes so the sprouts open in clean lines behind your cursor, which makes the next steps easier to follow.
Switch tools with 1, 2, or 3 as you move through the field, so you are always ready for the next stage instead of backtracking.
Spend your earnings on a wider spray first if you want to cover more ground in each pass.
Scroll ahead toward the edge of the screen to see what is coming, and plan your route before you commit to a sweep.
Use Space, Esc, or Tab to pause when the field gets busy, then look over the map before you continue.
faq: What is the goal of Field of Blooms?

Your goal is to revive the dried-out garden by opening sprouts, turning them into golden heads, and collecting them in the basket. Harvesting the whole map starts a new season that is permanently richer.
How do I control the watering can?
With a mouse, move the cursor to guide the tool and do not click or hold anything. On touch, hold and drag your finger, and drag near the edge of the screen to scroll the garden.

breinrot-bog.intro: Breinrot Bog is an adventure survival game where you gather glowing Brainroot clusters while a rising swamp floods the map. Each run ends with the swamp, but your upgrades carry over to make the next run easier.
tips: Keep an eye on the water level at all times and plan your route so you always have a clear way back to high ground.
Explore the dangerous, hard-to-reach areas early in a run while the water is still low, since those spots become impassable later.
Spend your first Brainrots on movement speed so you can outrun the swamp more reliably in later runs.
Use jump power to reach high points when the flood is closing in, especially if a path ahead is about to go under water.
Consider investing in income upgrades early, because resources keep coming in even when you are not actively collecting, which helps you build up between runs.
faq: What is the main goal of Breinrot Bog?
Collect Brainroot from glowing clusters around the map to survive and strengthen your character. You can spend what you gather on upgrades at your base.
What happens when the swamp catches me?
Your character dies but is immediately reborn at your base. Returning to flooded areas for new resources is part of the strategy.

ragdoll-arena-2-player.intro: Ragdoll Arena 2 Player is an action game with 14 short 2 player challenges, from fruit slicing to rooftop shooting. You can play alone or against a friend, and the first to score three wins each round.
tips: Learn the controls for each game before the match starts, since the challenges vary a lot and the same button may act differently in each one.
Watch your opponent's score closely, because the first player to reach three points wins, so one lead can decide the match.
Try single player mode first to get comfortable with each challenge before you play against a friend.
Spend coins on costumes only after you have tried several games, so you know which challenges you enjoy most.
If a game feels hard, switch to a different challenge for a while and return later with fresh timing and reactions.
faq: What is the goal of Ragdoll Arena 2 Player?
Each challenge has its own goal, but your main aim is to score three points before your opponent does.
How do I move and jump in the game?
Player 1 moves with W, A, S, D or the arrow keys, while Player 2 moves with the arrow keys. Jump and shoot use G for Player 1 and P for Player 2.

assault-on-squid-island.intro: Assault on Squid Island is a first person shooter where you fight through enemy troops on a mysterious island. Your aim is to destroy the enemies and find a way off the island.
tips: Use right mouse button to aim before you take a shot, since the combat is described as realistic and precise aiming matters.
Reload with R when you have a safe moment rather than in the middle of a firefight.
Press T to inspect your weapon when things are calm so you know its condition and state before a fight.
Use LSHIFT to run between cover and keep your movement under control with WASD, saving sprints for when you need distance.
Pause with P to check your surroundings and plan your next move, especially when the story or a new location feels tense.
faq: What is the main goal of Assault on Squid Island?
Your main goal is to destroy all the enemies and find a way to escape from the island.
How do I move and shoot?
Use WASD to move, the left mouse button to shoot, and the right mouse button to aim. Press SPACE to jump and LSHIFT to switch to running.

pixel-dino-run.intro: Pixel Dino Run is an endless runner where you keep a pixel dinosaur running and jumping while you chase a high score. The dinosaur speeds up as your points climb, so timing matters more the longer you last.
tips: Watch the ground ahead rather than the dinosaur, so you can start each jump before an obstacle reaches it.
Keep your taps steady and rhythmic instead of mashing the screen, since the dinosaur needs to land before it can jump again.
Use the quick fall when the dinosaur is high in the air to land sooner, which helps when a second obstacle is close behind the first.
Expect the run to get harder as the speed rises, and stay calm rather than rushing your timing.
Aim to beat your own high score in short sessions, so you can focus on one improvement at a time.
faq: How do I make the dinosaur jump?
Tap the screen with a mouse click or touch. Tapping while the dinosaur is high in the air lets you bring it down to the ground faster.
Why does the game get harder over time?
The dinosaur runs faster as your points increase, so the time you have to react gets shorter the longer you play.

hide-and-seek-blue-monster.intro: Hide And Seek: Blue Monster is a puzzle game built around a hide-and-seek adventure. You play by clicking or tapping, and you solve challenges as you move through its mysterious world.
tips: Click or tap slowly and look at each scene before moving on, since hidden things are the core of the hide-and-seek theme.
Treat each puzzle as a small problem to think through. Note what you have already tried so you do not repeat the same clicks.
Pay attention to details that look out of place, because puzzle clues in hidden-object style games are often subtle.
If you get stuck, step back and check the areas you have not yet clicked. Missed spots are a common reason for slow progress.
Keep a calm pace. The game mixes casual play with puzzles, so rushing tends to cause more mistakes than it saves time.
faq: What is the goal of Hide And Seek Blue Monster?
The goal is to get through the hide-and-seek adventure by solving the puzzle challenges along the way. Each puzzle moves you forward in the story.
How do I control the game?
You play with mouse clicks or taps only. Click or tap on objects and areas in the scene to interact with them.

pixel-color-flow.intro: Pixel Color Flow is a color matching puzzle where you clear a pixel cube board by sending pigs onto a conveyor. Each pig only hits cubes of its own color, so order and queue management decide how smoothly a level goes.
tips: Before tapping anything, scan the board and note which colors have the most cubes. Clearing those early can keep the board easier to read.
Look at the ammo number above each pig before sending it. A pig with low ammo will leave soon, so use it when it can finish a useful part of the board.
Use the 5 waiting slots to hold pigs that still have ammo. This lets you save a pig for a later moment instead of sending it too early.
Keep an eye on the conveyor capacity. If it fills up, you have to wait, so spread out your taps rather than sending many pigs at once.
If a color is blocking your progress, check whether a pig in the waiting slots can handle it before sending another pig onto the conveyor.
faq: What is the main goal of Pixel Color Flow?
Your goal is to clear all the pixel cubes on the board by sending pigs onto the conveyor so their balls hit matching colors. Finishing the cubes completes the level.
How do I send a pig to the conveyor?
Tap a pig to send it onto the conveyor. It will then shoot balls automatically at cubes that match its color.

rush-rivals.intro: Rush Rivals is an arcade car racer where you weave through highway traffic, grab pickups and try to beat rival cars for first place. Earn coins to upgrade your garage and unlock new rides.
tips: Keep your hold on accelerate steady and make small drags to steer, since sharp swerves can send you into traffic.
Scan a few cars ahead of you so you can plan your lane changes before you reach a gap.
Grab pickups when they are on your route, but do not swerve across several lanes to chase one if it puts you in danger.
Spend your early coins on upgrades that help the stats you rely on most, then save for new rides as the races get harder.
If you play with a keyboard, practice switching between A/D and the arrow keys so steering feels natural while you hold Space or Enter.
faq: What is the main goal in Rush Rivals?
Race along the highway, dodge traffic, collect pickups and finish ahead of the rival cars to win each race.
How do I control the car?
Hold the screen or mouse button to accelerate and drag side to side to steer. On a keyboard, hold Space or Enter and use A/D or the arrow keys to steer.

dragon-annihilation.intro: Dragon Annihilation is a tower defense game where you build turrets to stop waves of dragons before they reach your village. Your gold and turret placement decide how long you hold out.
tips: Spend your starting gold early on a few turrets that cover the main path, since the first waves give you the chance to set up your defence.
Watch which turrets you own and plan a fusion as soon as you have two identical ones, because the stronger unit is usually worth more than two weak ones on the grid.
Every dragon you eliminate pays out gold, so reinvest it steadily rather than saving it, to keep pace as the waves grow.
Position turrets so they cover the same stretch of the grid, letting several turrets hit each dragon as it passes.
Move turrets around the grid when a wave shows a new approach, and keep a close eye on each wave before deciding where to spend your next gold.
faq: What is the goal of Dragon Annihilation?
Your goal is to build turrets that destroy waves of incoming dragons before they reach your village.
How do I make a stronger turret?
Combine two identical turrets using turret fusion to create a stronger unit.

climate-activist.intro: Climate Activist is a hypercasual action adventure set in art galleries. You sneak past guards to get near the artworks and prepare small surprises for visitors.
tips: Watch where the guards are looking and moving before you step into the open, and plan your route around their line of sight.
Save L-SHIFT sprinting for short bursts when you need to cover ground quickly, since running around recklessly is more likely to draw attention.
Use the mouse to turn the camera before you move, so you can spot guards hiding around corners and doorways.
Use SPACE to jump when you need to get past an obstacle, and keep your movements steady rather than constantly changing direction.
Try different paths through each gallery room, and retry a section if a guard catches you, noting where you were spotted for next time.
faq: What is the main goal of Climate Activist?
You move through art galleries, avoid the guards, get close to the artworks, and prepare little surprises for the visitors.
How do I move my character?
Use W, A, S, D or the arrow keys to move, SPACE to jump, and L-SHIFT to sprint. The mouse controls the camera.

nail-stack.intro: Nail Stack is a 3D collecting arcade game where you slide across the screen to pick up white nails and make your finger longer. Colorful brushes and decorations add extra things to try along the way.
tips: Slide steadily and keep your path centered on the white nails, since a sideways drift can carry you past pickups you wanted.
Plan your route a few steps ahead so you can reach nails in a row rather than backtracking for them.
Aim for the colorful nails when you want to complete a level, because the game recommends collecting them to finish all levels.
Try the brushes and decoration steps when you have a moment to spare, as they are part of the game's extra play.
Don't worry too much about a missed nail, because there is no punishment mechanism and you can keep going.
faq: What is the goal of Nail Stack?
The main goal is to collect white nails to increase the final length of your finger. Collecting colorful nails is recommended for completing all levels.
How do I move my character?
Slide the screen to move. The game uses only this one control.

dark-war.intro: Dark War is a top-down role-playing action game where you play as an exorcist from an ancient order fighting evil in a modern setting. You hunt demons using swords, firearms, and magic.
tips: Open the task list before you move on, since each task has a written description that tells you what to do next.
Read the management instructions first so you know how to use your weapons and abilities before a fight starts.
Switch between swords, firearms, and magic depending on the enemy in front of you instead of relying on one weapon.
Plan your approach before each demon boss fight, because the game asks you to develop a strategy and use your unique abilities.
Keep track of your position from above so you can see incoming enemies early and avoid getting surrounded.
faq: What is the main goal in Dark War?
You play as a member of an order of demon hunters. Your task is to find and destroy the gatekeeper demons, following the task system in the game.
What weapons can I use?
You can fight with swords and firearms, and you also have magical abilities. Mixing these options gives you more ways to deal with different threats.

pet-maze-escape.intro: Pet Maze Escape is a puzzle game where you tap to guide a pet through colorful mazes. You dodge traps, collect hidden treasures, and reach the exit while each level adds new twists.
tips: Study the whole maze before your first move so you can spot the traps and the route to the exit.
Watch the timing of moving obstacles and only move when the path is clear, since a hit can set you back.
Grab the hidden treasures when they sit close to your route, but don't let them pull you into a dangerous detour.
Pay attention to what changes at the start of each new level, because the twists often change how you should approach the maze.
If you get stuck, pause your thinking and trace the maze backwards from the goal to find a route you may have missed.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Guide your pet through the maze and reach the end to clear the level. Along the way, pick up the hidden treasures and avoid the traps.
How do the controls work?
The game uses one-tap controls. Tap to move your pet's head or character through the maze, one step at a time.

pull-the-pin-much-money.intro: Pull The Pin - Much Money is a math puzzle where you choose which pin to pull to earn more cash. You play by clicking or tapping, and it tests both your thinking and your math skills.
tips: Look at the whole screen before you act, and compare the pins before pulling any of them.
Work through the numbers in your head before each move, since the puzzle rewards careful math more than quick clicks.
Pay attention to which pin choices have earned you the most cash so far, and use that to shape your next decision.
If a puzzle feels stuck, step back and recheck the layout instead of pulling pins at random.
Take short breaks between rounds so you keep your focus on the math rather than rushing.
faq: What is the goal of Pull The Pin - Much Money?
The goal is to pull out the pin that can make you earn more cash. Each choice you make affects how much money you collect.
How do I play the game?
Use a mouse click or a tap to select and pull the pins. There are no other controls needed.

sort-master.intro: Sort Master is a puzzle game built from many short mini-games. Each level asks you to organize, match, or arrange items until they are all in the right place.
tips: Read the goal at the start of each level first, since the order or match rule changes from one mini-game to the next.
Look for patterns such as size, color, or shape before you move anything, so you can plan a sequence instead of guessing.
Start with the items that are easiest to place, which clears space and makes the remaining choices clearer.
If a level is built around an image or a set of pieces, check the overall layout often to confirm each piece lines up with the rest.
Work calmly through each activity; a level ends only when everything is sorted or arranged correctly, so a quick check before you stop can save time.
faq: What is the goal of Sort Master?
Your goal is to sort, match, or arrange the items in each level. The level ends once everything is in the correct order or position.
How do I move items?
You can drag, tap, or move items to place them. The description lists these options as the ways to interact with each mini-game.

halloween-fruit-slice.intro: Halloween Fruit Slice is a fast arcade game where you swipe or move your mouse to slice flying haunted fruits. Slice as many as you can before time runs out, and avoid the bombs.
tips: Aim your swipes so one cut passes through several fruits at once, since multi-fruit slices earn extra points.
Before each swipe, check where the bombs are and trace a path that stays clear of them, because hitting one ends the game.
Give glowing fruits priority when they appear, since they are the ones that give bonus power-ups.
Scan the whole screen before you move so you can plan a line that catches more than one fruit.
Keep a steady, quick rhythm instead of pausing, because the round is limited by time.
faq: How do I get extra points?
Slice several fruits in one move. The game gives extra points when you cut many fruits in a single swipe.
What ends the game?
Hitting a bomb ends your game immediately, so keep your slices away from them.

kitten-never-dies.intro: Help a lost kitten find its way home by solving a unique puzzle in each dimension. The game is built around clever challenges that test your puzzle-solving skills.
tips: Look at each dimension's layout before you act and work out what the challenge is asking for. Each one is different, so a method that worked before may not work here.
Try whichever input feels comfortable, since you can tap a key, click with the mouse, tap the screen, or use a gamepad. Switching to a different method can make the controls feel more natural.
If you get stuck, experiment with small actions and watch how the kitten responds. Its reactions can show you which parts of the scene matter.
For a shared game, agree in advance who is Player 1 and who is Player 2, and pick different buttons so your inputs don't clash. Taking turns on tricky dimensions can keep things calm.
Take a short break when a puzzle frustrates you and come back with fresh eyes. Many puzzles become clearer after a pause.
faq: What is the goal of Kitten Never Dies?
Your goal is to help the lost kitten find its way back home. You do this by overcoming the challenge in each dimension you travel through.
How do I control the kitten?
You can tap a key, click with the mouse, tap the screen, or use a gamepad. The kitten will know what to do with any of these inputs.

war-truck-weapon-transport.intro: War Truck Weapon Transport is a 3D action driving game where you first match rocket pieces together, then drive a military truck to the marked spot before time runs out. Use WASD to steer and drive.
tips: Finish the rocket matching step carefully before you start driving, since the pieces need to fit correctly before the mission can move forward.
Check the marked destination at the start of each level so you know which direction to head and can plan your route early.
Keep an eye on the clock throughout the drive and avoid long detours, because each level must be completed on time.
Ease off and steer smoothly with WASD rather than holding keys down constantly, which can make the heavy truck harder to control on turns.
If a level feels tough, replay it and focus on one part at a time: matching first, then a clean, steady route to the marked position.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You match different pieces to build a rocket, then drive the truck to the marked position on time to complete each level's mission.
Which keys control the truck?
The game is controlled with the WASD keys, which you use to drive the truck.

shooterz-io.intro: ShooterZ.io is a 3D multiplayer shooter where you can create your own lobby or join one made by other players. It includes sniper and gun combat across several environments.
tips: Use the right mouse button to aim before you fire, especially when using the sniper, since a steady aim matters more than rapid shooting.
Press R to reload during quiet moments rather than in the middle of a fight, so you are not caught with an empty weapon.
Crouch with C when you are under fire or taking cover, which can make a quick reposition safer while you line up your next shot.
Switch weapons with the 1-9 keys as soon as the distance changes, so you are holding the right tool for close or long-range fights.
Try different environments and lobbies to learn where enemies tend to appear and which spots give you good sightlines.
faq: How do I shoot and aim?
Use the left mouse button to shoot and hold the right mouse button to aim. Aiming before you fire helps you hit targets more reliably.
How do I switch between weapons?
Press the number keys 1 through 9 to change weapons. Switching quickly lets you match your weapon to the distance of the fight.

soccer-championship-2023-html5.intro: Soccer Championship 2023 is an action football game where you play as a rising hero in offline matches. You compete in the Hero Tournament and the Club Football League Championship, focusing on striking, passing, and scoring.
tips: Use short passes with N to keep possession when a teammate is close and no clear shot is open.
Save SPACE for shooting when you are in a good position, and use M for long passes to move the ball across the pitch quickly.
Hold K to sprint when you need to get past an opponent or catch up to the ball, then ease off with WASD to control your touch.
Pay attention to how each match goes, since the game gives you a result after every challenge, and use that to adjust your approach for the next one.
If you play on a mobile device, get comfortable with the on-screen buttons early so you can pass and shoot without hesitating.
faq: What is the main goal of Soccer Championship 2023?
Your aim is to beat your opponents by striking, passing, and scoring goals in football matches. You can progress through the Hero Tournament and the Club Football League Championship.
Which keys control passing and shooting?
Press N for a short pass, M for a long pass, and SPACE to shoot. Use WASD to walk and K to sprint.

geometry-open-world.intro: Geometry Open World is a 2D action adventure where you steer a vessel through tough terrain, fight foes, and face bosses. Upgrades and skills help you push further.
tips: Move with A and D (or the arrow keys) to keep your vessel out of trouble while you read the terrain ahead before committing to a jump or advance.
Save the shield on Q for moments when enemy fire is coming at you, instead of holding it constantly, so it is ready when you need it most.
Use the cannons on E against foes that you can hit safely, and pause your fire when you are exposed or lining up a difficult shot.
Spend upgrades and skills on what your current run is missing, such as more defense if you keep taking damage or more firepower if fights drag on.
Before a boss fight, slow down and watch its pattern for a few moments, then act on the openings you see rather than reacting to every movement.
faq: What is the main goal of Geometry Open World?
You steer your vessel through challenging terrains, defeat the foes you meet, and confront the tough bosses along the way.
How do I move and fight?
Use A or the left arrow to move left and D or the right arrow to move right. Press Q to use your shield and E to fire your cannons.

idle-pong.intro: Idle Pong is a clicker where each tap sends a fast pong ball into colorful obstacles. Balls keep earning XP while you are idle, so you can tap and watch at the same pace.
tips: Tap to spawn balls while you are paying attention, then let them play out and watch what breaks.
Spend upgrades on power first if you want faster progress through stages, since stronger balls clear obstacles more easily.
Check the unlockable pong balls and their effects, and pick the one that suits how you like to play.
Keep the game open while idle so XP keeps building, then come back to spend it on upgrades.
Push through stages steadily rather than rushing, and look for chances to chain bounces into bigger combos.
faq: What is the goal of Idle Pong?
Your goal is to smash through colorful obstacles with pong balls and push through stages while chasing bigger combos.
How do I spawn pong balls?
Click or tap to buy and spawn pong balls. To look around the screen, click and drag to scroll up and down.

super-doctor-body-examination.intro: Super Doctor Body Examination is an educational doctor game about carrying out a physical examination. You play by clicking or tapping, and it teaches why regular checkups matter for your health.
tips: Go slowly and read each step before you click or tap, since the examination is about care rather than speed.
Try to notice what each part of the examination is for, so the steps make sense as you go.
If you find a step uncomfortable, keep your focus on the health reason behind it, as the game itself points out.
Replay the game to build familiarity with the order of the examination and the doctor's routine.
Keep your clicks or taps steady and deliberate, because the game is played entirely with the mouse or touch.
faq: What is the goal of Super Doctor Body Examination?
The goal is to carry out a physical examination as the doctor, which the game presents as being important for your health.
How do I control the game?
You play by mouse click or tap, so you only need a mouse or your finger on the screen to move through the examination.

pixel-paint-sort.intro: Pixel Paint Sort is a color puzzle where you sort tiles onto matching pegs to slowly reveal a pixel picture. Each completed color brings the full image closer to view.
tips: Look at the whole board before your first move to see which colors are grouped together and which are split up.
Tap a tile to select its connected group of the same color, so you can move several matching tiles at once.
Use the tray as a temporary holding spot when a tile is blocking a peg you need, then place it back once the way is clear.
Finish one color completely when you can, since clearing a peg frees space for the colors that are still mixed.
Check that each tile lands on its matching peg before moving on, because the level is only finished when every tile is placed correctly.
faq: What is the goal of Pixel Paint Sort?
The goal is to place every tile on its matching peg. Completing every color reveals the full pixel picture.
How do I select and move tiles?
Tap a tile to select its connected group of the same color, then move the selected tiles onto free pegs that match their color.

roll-to-riches.intro: Roll to Riches is a 3D arcade simulator where you train your rolling wheel, race as far as you can, and spend your earnings on upgrades, wheels, trails and pets. This guide covers the basic loop and how to get more out of each race.
tips: Train on the treadmill before you race, since Energy is what you build up there and it feeds into your rolling.
Use your Cash and Trophies on upgrades first, so each race you enter goes a little farther than the last.
Tap or press Space during races to build speed, and time your bursts so you keep up the momentum rather than spending it all at once.
Claim your daily and playtime rewards whenever they are available, since they add to your progress without extra racing.
Think about rebirthing once your progress slows down, because it is meant to help you advance faster in the long run.
faq: What is the main goal of Roll to Riches?
You train your rolling wheel, race as far as possible, and earn Cash and Trophies. Those rewards are used to unlock new wheels, trails, pets and new worlds.
How do I move and build speed on desktop?
Use WASD or the Arrow Keys to move, drag the mouse to rotate the camera, and press E to interact. During races, press Space to build speed.

backslash-slash.intro: Backslash Slash is a keyboard-only blade clicker where you strike a training dummy with / , \ , P or K. Build combo chains, learn the timing, and unlock new weapons as you level up.
tips: Try all four keys early on, since each one is tied to a different attack timing. Notice which keys fit the rhythm you find most comfortable.
Focus on keeping your combo going rather than rushing individual hits, because combo chains multiply your damage.
Pay attention to the feel of each blade. Knives, daggers and machetes have different speeds and combo patterns, so pick the one that suits your rhythm.
When you level up, check your unlocks and passive upgrades. Attack speed, combo window, crit chance and weapon power each change how you should play.
Practice the timing of special multi-hit moves on their own before relying on them during a long combo chain.
faq: What is the goal of Backslash Slash?
You strike a training dummy with knives, daggers and machetes by pressing the keys, building combos and climbing the ranks as you level up.
Which keys do I use to attack?
Use the /, \, P and K keys. Each one corresponds to a different attack timing and combo opportunity.

scratch-raw-stone-gem-master.intro: Scratch Raw Stone: Gem Master is a crafting game about buying rough stones and scratching them open to find gems. You decide whether to sell for cash or turn your finds into jewelry to grow your workshop.
tips: Scratch slowly and steadily across the stone, since each rock may hide rich color, hairline cracks, or nothing at all.
Pay attention to what you uncover mid-scratch before deciding. A promising color or pattern is a good reason to hold out rather than take the cash offer.
If a stone looks empty or heavily cracked, consider taking the dealer's cash offer instead of spending time crafting it.
When placing a gem in a jewelry slot, drag, resize, and rotate it until it fits the template neatly before you collect the piece.
Save finished stones with the collect button and double-click jewelry to add it to your collection, so you know which pieces are stored.
faq: How do I scratch open a stone?
Hold the mouse button and drag across the stone to scrape it open.
What is the difference between the dealer's offer and crafting?
You can take the dealer's cash offer partway through scratching, or hold out to craft rare gems into jewelry for bigger profits.

perfect-piano-magic.intro: Perfect Piano Magic is a one-player music game with shooting elements, played with a single mouse click or tap. It will feel familiar if you already enjoy Piano Magic games.
tips: Keep your clicks or taps light and steady so you can respond quickly to each moment of play.
Watch the screen closely before you act, since timing is what matters most in a music game like this.
If you already know Piano Magic, use what you learned there about rhythm and pacing to get started faster.
Practice for a few short rounds rather than one long session, so you can notice which moments you keep missing.
Stay focused on the beat rather than the score, because steady timing usually matters more than rushing.
faq: What do I need to do to play?
You play by clicking the mouse or tapping the screen. The game is controlled with that single input.
Is this game similar to other piano games?
Yes, the description says its gameplay is extremely similar to Piano Magic, so fans of that series should find it familiar.

egging-on.intro: Egging On is a physics-based climbing game where you guide a fragile egg up steep slopes and across tricky platforms. Each level adds new challenges, so balance and timing matter from the start.
tips: Pause with P before a tricky jump so you can study the angle and plan your move without rushing.
Use gentle, short inputs on steep slopes, since holding a direction too long can build momentum you cannot control.
Before you jump, check how the egg is tilted, because a crooked angle often sends it off target.
On narrow or sharp-edged platforms, slow down and line up your position first, then commit to the jump.
Treat each new level as a test of your control, and practice the basic movement on simple inclines before attempting complex platforms.
faq: What is the goal of Egging On?
Climb upward through each level and reach the top without falling or cracking the egg's shell.
Which keys control the egg?
Use W, A, S, and D to move forward, left, backward, and right, press Space to jump, and press P to pause.

weaponsmith-evolution-weapon-merge.intro: Weaponsmith Evolution is a merge puzzle where you combine identical weapons to craft stronger ones, then spend gold on upgrades to face tougher monsters and bosses. Each new weapon you make earns gold to fuel your progress.
tips: Merge identical weapons as soon as you have two of them, since higher-tier weapons earn more gold and push you toward the legendary ones.
Keep your board tidy by merging early so you always have room to drop new weapons and avoid getting stuck.
Save gold for upgrades that speed up merging when you have a steady supply of weapons, so you spend less time waiting between crafts.
Before buying a new weapon type, check how much gold you have and whether your current weapons can keep up with the next monsters.
When a boss appears, review your strongest weapons and upgrades beforehand, and try different upgrade combinations to see which raises weapon efficiency the most.
faq: What is the main goal of Weaponsmith Evolution?
The goal is to merge weapons from simple daggers into legendary ones, using the gold you earn to upgrade and defeat monsters and bosses as you progress through levels.
How do I merge weapons?
Drag two identical weapons onto each other to combine them into a more powerful version. Each new weapon also brings you more gold.

sniper-strike.intro: Sniper Strike is a first-person shooter where you pick off high-value targets across difficult missions. Precise aim and patience matter more than speed in every situation.
tips: Scan each area with the scroll wheel zoom before committing, so you can spot high-value targets from a distance.
Use right-click iron sight to line up your shot before you fire, rather than shooting from the hip.
Stay vigilant between shots and check your surroundings before moving on to the next target.
Reload with R during quiet moments so you are not caught empty when a target appears.
Press Tab to pause and plan your route and firing order before you move into a dangerous area.
faq: What is my goal in each mission?
You need to identify and eliminate the high-value targets to complete the mission. Take your time to confirm each target before you shoot.
How do I aim more accurately?
Right-click to use iron sight, and scroll the mouse wheel to zoom in or out. Combining both gives you a steadier and more precise shot.

two-impostor-squid-challenge.intro: Two Impostor Squid Challenge is a two-player adventure game for you and a friend. You play green light red light and tug of war together, with one player on the blue side and one on the red side.
tips: Decide before you start which of you will be Blue and which will be Red, so each of you knows your own keys from the first round.
Keep your eyes on the screen during green light red light and stop moving the moment the signal changes.
In tug of war, try to keep a steady rhythm with your input instead of pressing as fast as you can, and coordinate with your partner.
Agree on a simple way to call out signals or warn each other before a round, since both of you are reacting to the same moments.
If you are playing on touch controls, place your fingers before the round starts so you are ready to respond quickly.
faq: What are the controls?
The Blue player uses the A key and the Red player uses the P key. The game also lists touch controls for mobile play.
Can I play this game alone?
The game is described as a challenge for two players, with both players sharing the same screen. It is best played with a friend.

weight-puzzle-3d.intro: Weight Puzzle 3D is a physics puzzle where you lift weights and place them in the right sections of the road to balance them. Balance the weights to run to the finish line.
tips: Read the numbers on each weight before you pick it up, so you know how it will affect the balance.
Compare the weights on each side of the road before placing a new one, and aim for an even split.
Try to keep a running total in your head as you add weights, which helps you spot imbalances early.
If a placement looks wrong, move the weight to a different section rather than guessing again in the same spot.
Take your time with each move, since a single wrong placement can keep the road from balancing.
faq: What is the goal of Weight Puzzle 3D?
The goal is to lift the weights and place them in the correct sections of the road so the weights balance. Once balanced, you can run and reach the finish line.
How do I control the game?
You play by mouse click or tap. Click or tap to lift weights and to place them on the road.

jingle-jetpack.intro: Jingle Jetpack is a 2D action adventure where you help Santa deliver gifts by flying a bullet-powered jetpack. You dodge lasers, electric fields and missiles while collecting coins to buy power ups and skins.
tips: Watch the position of lasers and electric fields before you move, so you can plan a gap to fly through rather than reacting at the last second.
Keep track of missiles coming from behind or the side and adjust your height early, since small corrections are easier than sudden ones.
Collect coins whenever they are safe to reach, because they are what you spend on new power ups and skins.
Try a few short runs to learn how your jetpack responds to mouse or touch input before aiming for a higher score.
Stay calm when the screen gets busy; focus on the one hazard closest to you instead of trying to track everything at once.
faq: What is the goal of Jingle Jetpack?
The goal is to help Santa deliver all the gifts by getting through the dangers and staying alive for as long as possible. Collecting coins and reaching new scores are part of the challenge.
How do I control the jetpack?
The game is played with the mouse or by touch. Use your chosen input to steer Santa up and down while avoiding hazards.

ruthless-merciless-cards.intro: Ruthless! is a multiplayer crazy eights style card game where penalties pile cards onto rivals. Empty your hand first, or be the last player under 25 cards.
tips: Before starting a run, check the magenta badge on the first card to see how long it can get, then count how many cards you would empty from your hand.
Save COLD BLOOD for a moment when a big penalty is about to land on you, since it freezes that penalty and only one is available per match.
Keep an eye on your hand size so you can press LAST CARD as soon as you are down to one card, because a rival who presses CAUGHT! first makes you draw.
Use DOUBLE! when you are clearly ahead, and remember that rivals can fold before it reaches them, so it may cost them less than you expect.
On mobile, play with the two-tap or swipe method once you are comfortable, because a fast swipe up is quicker than tapping twice when cards overlap.
faq: How do I win a match?
Be the first to empty your hand, or be the last player who has not reached 25 cards and been eliminated.
How do runs work?
Tap the first card of the run, then tap the following cards one by one while the game highlights what fits. Swipe up or press PLAY RUN to drop them all at once, and the last card decides the colour.

fish-stab-getting-big.intro: Fish Stab Getting Big is a 2D arena action game set in the ocean depths, where knife-wielding fish try to stab each other. You can play alone or with a friend in 2 Player mode.
tips: Stay mobile rather than charging straight in, since your fish moves around the arena and quick repositioning keeps you out of trouble.
Use the boost key with purpose: a short burst is useful for closing in on a target or escaping a threat, but it is worth saving for those moments.
Each kill makes you and your sword bigger, so aim for kills when you can and watch how your size changes the way you move and fight.
In 2 Player mode, keep an eye on your friend's position so you can time attacks on opponents while they draw attention.
Pick a fish before you start and try a round or two to learn how it handles before going for the largest score.
faq: What is the goal of Fish Stab Getting Big?
Try to kill as many fish as you can and grow your fish into the biggest one in the ocean. Each kill adds to your score.
How do the controls work in 2 Player mode?
Player 1 moves with W, A, S and D and boosts with C. Player 2 moves with the arrow keys and boosts with L.

hidden-paint-3d.intro: Hidden Paint 3D is a relaxed hidden object game where you find the listed items and bring them to life with color. Each new location brings a fresh environment to explore.
tips: Read the list of required items before you start looking, so you know exactly what shapes and colors to scan for.
Scan the whole scene slowly, including corners and the edges of the screen, since items can blend into the background.
Color each item as soon as you find it so you don't lose track of which ones are done.
Look at the scene as a whole before clicking, so you can plan which objects you want to color first.
When you finish a location, take a moment to look at the new environment before searching, since each one changes the layout and objects you need to find.
faq: What is the goal of Hidden Paint 3D?
Your goal is to find all the specified items in each scene and color them by clicking. Once you finish, you move on to a new location with a new environment.
How do I color objects?
Click on the objects and they will turn into bright shades of color. Clicking is the only action the instructions describe for coloring.

money-factory-tycoon-idle-game.intro: Money Factory is a tycoon clicker where you build a money production system from a simple start. Tap to collect profits, then upgrade and expand your factory over time.
tips: Tap the screen regularly early on, since collecting profits by hand is how you gain money faster at the start.
Spend on production line upgrades first, because each one raises your profit output and helps fund everything else.
Improve your machines when you can afford it, as better efficiency makes every later upgrade and expansion more useful.
Unlock new sections only when your current setup can cover the cost, so you do not leave your income stalled.
Keep an eye out for bonuses that appear when you tap, and try to notice which moments trigger them.
faq: What is the main goal of Money Factory?
The goal is to grow a large financial empire by upgrading production lines, improving machines, and unlocking new factory sections. The game describes this as building a massive financial powerhouse.
How do I earn money faster?
Tap the screen to gather money faster and trigger bonuses, and boost your output with production line and machine upgrades. Expanding into new sections also increases your production capacity.

cat-robot-transform-war.intro: Cat Robot Transform War is a shooting game where you switch between a car and a cat robot to clear a city of enemy robots. Mix shooting, punching, and jumping to keep the fight moving.
tips: Switch forms with F depending on the situation: the car suits getting around, while the cat robot suits close-range fighting.
Use right mouse to aim before you fire with left mouse, so your shots land where you intend.
Keep moving with WASD instead of standing still, which makes it harder for enemies to line up their shots.
Press TAB to check the menu when you need a reminder of the controls, so you don't waste time fumbling during combat.
On mobile, learn where the on-screen buttons are before a fight starts so you can switch forms and attack without hesitation.
faq: What is the goal of Cat Robot Transform War?
Your goal is to clear the city of adversaries by fighting through a series of car and cat robot challenges.
How do I switch between the car and the cat robot?
Press F to change to the car, and press F again to change back to the cat robot.

car-stunt-races-mega-ramps.intro: Car Stunt Races: Mega Ramps is a physics-based stunt racing game where you drive muscle and sports cars over ramps, through obstacles and across challenging tracks. This guide covers how to approach the free mode and the challenges.
tips: Start in the free mode to learn how your chosen car handles jumps, landings and steering before you attempt the harder challenges.
Pay attention to speed before a ramp. Approaching too slowly can leave you short, while approaching too fast can send you past the landing.
Keep your car level in the air where you can, since a bad landing angle is the most likely way to crash and take damage.
Try different modes such as race, jump, soccer and bowling, because each one trains different driving skills and can help you get comfortable with the controls.
Retry a challenge after a crash to focus on one section at a time instead of trying to complete the whole track in one go.
faq: How do I control the car?
The game is played with the keyboard, so use the keys listed in the instructions to steer, accelerate and brake. Practice in the free mode to get a feel for the steering before starting challenges.
What is the goal of the challenges?
Each challenge asks you to complete a race or stunt course, which often includes jumping over dangerous ramps. Finishing the track and meeting the challenge's requirements is how you progress.

magic-water-sort.intro: Magic Water Sort is a relaxed color-pouring puzzle with a café twist. You tap flasks to fill glasses moving along a conveyor belt and complete mocktail orders to finish each level.
tips: Check the preview of upcoming glasses before you pour, so you can plan which colors you need next.
Look at the top layer of each flask first, since liquid pours from top to bottom and that layer is the one that moves.
Watch the glasses on the conveyor and tap a flask only when its top layer matches a glass that can be filled in time.
Keep an eye on the cups under the counter, because any liquid that doesn't match a glass collects there.
Glasses come in different sizes, so note which ones are large before you plan a pour, and fill them before they reach the exit line.
faq: What is the goal of Magic Water Sort?
Fill the glasses correctly before they reach the exit line and complete all required mocktail orders to win the level.
How does pouring work?
Tap a flask and its liquid pours into the glasses on the conveyor layer by layer, starting from the top layer.

obby-pizza-delivery.intro: Obby Pizza Delivery puts you in a maze as a delivery driver. Pick up pizza orders at the pizzeria, bring them to residents, and grow your reputation to open new zones.
tips: Plan each trip before you leave the pizzeria so the stops you make are close together and you spend less time crossing the maze.
Rent a scooter as soon as you can, since it lets you move faster between deliveries.
Upgrade to a bigger bag when you can, so you can carry more orders at once and cover more stops per trip.
Finish orders reliably, because completing them is how you raise your reputation and unlock new zones.
Study the layout of each zone before moving, so you know the route to the next resident and avoid wasted detours.
faq: What is the goal of Obby Pizza Delivery?
Your goal is to pick up pizza orders at the pizzeria, deliver them to residents in the maze, and raise your reputation to open new zones.
How do I move faster through the maze?
Rent a scooter to move faster. Using it early helps you reach residents sooner.

uno-online.intro: UNO Online is a card strategy game where the first player to empty their hand wins. You play by clicking or tapping, and you need to read your opponents while planning the order of your own cards.
tips: Pay attention to which cards your opponents play, since each play gives clues about what they might still hold.
Plan the order you play your cards rather than dropping them at random, so your hand empties as efficiently as possible.
Make a guess about each opponent's hand and update it as the game goes on, then adjust your moves to match.
Watch how quickly each opponent is getting rid of cards, because the first player to clear their hand wins.
Stay flexible: if your guess about an opponent turns out wrong, change your plan rather than sticking to it.
faq: How do I win UNO Online?
You win by being the first player to clear your hand of cards. Play your cards in a sensible order to get there before your opponents.
How do I play the game?
Use a mouse click or tap to play your cards. The game is controlled entirely with these single clicks or taps.

save-the-monkey.intro: Save The Monkey is a puzzle game where you drag parts together to build a rescue machine after a boulder traps a little man. The challenge grows with each level, so careful thinking pays off.
tips: Study the whole scene before you move anything, so you can spot which parts fit the rescue machine and where the boulder sits.
Try a piece in a few spots before committing to it, since a part that looks right in one place may block another.
Build the machine step by step and check how each addition changes the setup before adding the next part.
Expect harder levels as you progress, so note which approaches worked earlier and try them first on new puzzles.
If you get stuck, step back and try a different arrangement of the parts rather than repeating the same move.
faq: What is the goal of Save The Monkey?
You need to assemble a rescue machine from the parts provided to save the trapped character from under the boulder.
How do I move the parts?
Drag them with your mouse or pointer to place them where you want them in the scene.

furious-gt-drift.intro: Furious GT Drift is a 3D racing game about drifting high-performance GT cars through neon streets, mountain passes, and sunset highways. Steer with the arrow keys or A and D.
tips: Focus on smooth steering rather than sharp, sudden inputs, since every corner rewards precision and timing.
Study each corner before you reach it so you can set up your slide early instead of correcting at the last moment.
Chain drift combos where you can, because the game rewards new records earned through consecutive slides.
Spend your earnings on handling upgrades first, as better handling makes it easier to hold smooth slides and perfect angles.
Try your unlocked faster machines on tracks you already know to compare how each car feels through the corners.
faq: How do I steer the car?
Use the left and right arrow keys or the A and D keys to steer. Smooth, steady inputs usually give cleaner slides than quick jerks.
How do I earn rewards and unlock new cars?
The game gives rewards as you land drift combos and chase records. Use those rewards to unlock faster machines and upgrade your handling.

jhoney-revenge.intro: Jhoney Revenge is a single-player shooting game with adventure and arcade elements. You solve puzzle challenges and take aim at enemies while working through the underground mafia world.
tips: Read each puzzle challenge before you shoot, since the game mixes puzzles with combat and solving them is part of progressing.
Take your time with aiming. The description highlights accuracy, so steady, deliberate shots are usually better than rapid fire.
Watch where enemies come from and deal with the closest or most dangerous threats first to avoid being overwhelmed.
If you get stuck on a puzzle, step back and look at the surroundings for clues before trying again.
Play in short sessions and notice which parts you find hardest, then focus your practice on those moments.
faq: What is the goal of Jhoney Revenge?
The goal is to take down the underground world of the mafia by solving puzzle challenges and taking aim at enemies along the way.
Does the game require good aim?
Yes. The game is built around deadly accuracy, so careful aiming matters more than firing quickly.

slime-clicker.intro: Slime Clicker is an idle clicker where you tap or click your slime to earn points. Upgrades, new skins, and Mini Slime bonuses help your points grow over time.
tips: Keep clicking steadily early on, since every click adds to your total points and moves you toward new levels.
Watch for the Mini Slime, which only stays for a short time, so keep an eye on the screen while you play.
Buy passive upgrades such as AutoClickers as soon as you can afford them, because they keep earning points while you are away.
Mix active clicking with upgrade purchases so your points build up on both fronts.
Check your progress now and then, since new skins unlock as your slime evolves and each one is a nice goal to aim for.
faq: How do I earn points in Slime Clicker?
Click on the slime on desktop, or tap it on mobile. Each click adds points to your total.
What is the Mini Slime and how do I catch it?
A Mini Slime appears every so often for a short time. Click or tap it before it disappears to get a bonus added to your total points.

playful-cup.intro: Playful Cup is a physics puzzle about filling a sad, empty glass with liquid until it smiles again. Each level can be solved in more than one way, so experiment freely.
tips: Hold the screen only as long as needed, then release to stop the flow before the glass overflows.
Pause and look at the whole level before you start pouring to spot the shortest route for the water.
If a plan fails, try a different approach rather than repeating the same one, since the game rewards creative solutions.
Fill the glass in small bursts when you are close to the top so you can stop precisely at the right level.
Test ideas on early levels first to learn how the liquid behaves before tackling harder puzzles.
faq: What is the goal of Playful Cup?
Your job is to fill the empty glass with liquid without overflowing so that it smiles again. Each level has its own way to reach that result.
How do I control the water?
Hold the screen to make the water flow into the glass, and release to stop it. Be careful not to hold too long, or the glass will overflow.

solitaire-tile-match.intro: Solitaire Tile Match is a tile-matching puzzle where you send tiles to a small dock and clear them in sets of three. The challenge comes from limited dock space and layered tiles that hide new options underneath.
tips: Before every tap, check whether the tile you are about to send will give you a third match soon, or whether it will just sit in your dock taking up a slot.
Focus on uncovering tiles that match ones already in your dock, since that is the fastest way to clear space.
Keep a few slots open as a buffer. A dock that is almost full leaves you no room to recover from a bad pick.
Save Undo for a real mistake, and use Hint when you are stuck rather than guessing, so your power-ups last across harder levels.
Play short sessions when you are fresh. Planning taps carefully is where most runs are won or lost.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Clear the board by sending tiles to your dock and matching three identical tiles so they vanish. Avoid filling the dock before you can make a match.
What happens when the dock is full?
If the dock fills up before you can make a match, the level ends. Use a power-up or plan ahead to avoid this.

money-factory-earn-a-billion.intro: Money Factory is a clicker and tycoon game about building a money-making factory. You buy boosters, place them on the field, and combine them to grow your earnings toward a billion.
tips: Spend early earnings on boosters that multiply your income, since a stronger base makes every later step faster.
Plan your field before placing pieces, keeping identical boosters close together so you can combine them when the chance comes up.
Hold your finger or mouse button to reposition a booster, and only release once it sits where you want it, so you don't place it in a spot that blocks future merges.
Keep some space open on the field so you always have room to buy and place new boosters as your factory expands.
Check your progress regularly and adjust your layout when a new challenge appears instead of sticking to one approach.
faq: How do I combine boosters?
Hold your finger or mouse button on a booster to move it, then release it over another identical booster to combine the two.
What should I focus on first?
Focus on growing your earnings early with boosters, since the game says making money is easy at the start but gets harder to keep growing.

amigurumi-cozy-stitches.intro: Amigurumi: Cozy Stitches is a relaxed crafting game where you knit, stuff, sew, and decorate knitted toys. You sell your creations, fill customer orders, and grow your crafter skills over time.
tips: When knitting, keep your finger moving at a steady pace along the spiral so each row stays even and neat.
Check the gauge closely while stuffing and stop as soon as the piece reaches the perfect zone, rather than tapping past it.
Attach the paws, ears, and tails before you start on the face, so you can see the full shape and place the decorations evenly.
Take a look at customer orders before choosing a toy, and pick yarn colors that match what the order asks for.
Save some coins for new materials instead of spending them all at once, so you can try new yarn types as you level up.
faq: How do I know when a toy is stuffed enough?
Watch the gauge while you tap the piece and aim for the perfect zone. Stop tapping once the toy reaches that plump, even fill.
How do I earn coins in the game?
You earn coins by selling your finished toys and fulfilling customer orders. Use those coins to buy new materials for future projects.

dice-math.intro: Dice Math is a kids' game for practicing basic arithmetic with dice. It covers addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division, and you play by clicking or tapping.
tips: Say each answer out loud before you click or tap to lock it in. This helps you catch mistakes early.
Work through the dice values slowly before calculating, so a quick misread doesn't throw off the answer.
Focus on the operation that feels hardest. Spending extra time there will improve your overall skills more than repeating the easy ones.
For multiplication and division, memorize the times tables you use most often so you can answer faster.
Play in short sessions and come back regularly. Frequent practice builds speed and confidence better than one long session.
faq: What is the goal of Dice Math?
The goal is to practice and improve your addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division skills using dice.
How do I play Dice Math?
Use your mouse to click or tap on the screen to play.

restore-lab.intro: Restore Lab is a cozy idle repair tycoon. Start with one workbench and grow a restoration shop by tapping items, upgrading benches, and hiring helpers who keep working while you are away.
tips: Tap steadily during busy stretches to fill the rush meter, since it doubles your income while full.
Hire helpers early so your benches keep earning while you are offline.
Use Buy x10 or MAX when upgrading to save time on repeated purchases.
Check your benches and Tools before opening a new district, so your income is strong when the district multiplier applies.
Keep an eye on Goals, which give bonus coins that can help pay for your next upgrades.
faq: What is the main goal of Restore Lab?
You grow a restoration business by repairing items, upgrading benches, and opening new benches and districts. Each step increases how much you earn.
What happens when I reach level 25 or 50 on a bench?
At levels 25, 50, 100, 200 and beyond, the bench works twice as fast. Reaching these milestones is a good reason to keep upgrading your favorite benches.

happy-valentines-day-spot-the-difference.intro: A Valentine's Day spot-the-difference puzzle where you compare two very similar pictures and find every difference between them. You play with a mouse or by tapping.
tips: Compare the two pictures one area at a time, such as top left, then top right, moving across and down, so you do not skip any section.
Check small details first, like colors, patterns, and tiny objects, since differences are often subtle rather than large.
Look for missing items or items that have been added, as these are easy to overlook when you focus on the main subject.
Keep track of the ones you have already found so you can shift your attention to the areas that still need checking.
If you get stuck, step away for a moment and come back with fresh eyes, since a break often makes the difference easier to see.
faq: What is the goal of this game?
The goal is to find all of the differences between two very similar Valentine's Day pictures.
How do I play?
Use your mouse or tap the screen to select the spots where you think the two pictures differ.

zestful-match.intro: Zestful Match is a tile-matching puzzle where you collect three identical fruit tiles in a tray to clear the board. It is quick to pick up, with a tray limit that keeps each move meaningful.
tips: Before tapping a tile, check how many of that fruit are left on the board and in your tray, so you can aim to complete a set of three.
Keep the tray as empty as possible. With only 7 slots, a few unmatched tiles can fill it quickly and end the level.
Use Hint when you cannot see a match, since it points you to a set you can complete instead of guessing.
Save Shuffle for when the board is truly stuck, and try Undo first if you just made a move that caused a problem.
Work in short sessions and reset your thinking after each level, since focus is what the game rewards most.
faq: What is the goal of Zestful Match?
Clear every fruit tile from the game board by matching three identical tiles in your tray. Clearing all tiles wins the level.
What happens if the tray fills up?
If the tray reaches its maximum of 7 tiles without any matches, you lose the level. Keep an eye on the tray after every move.

hole-io-2.intro: Hole Io 2 is an arcade battle game in the .io style where you control a black hole that grows by devouring objects. Click or tap to play and try to grow as large as you can.
tips: Start by consuming smaller objects near you, since they are easier to swallow and help your hole grow steadily.
Keep your hole moving instead of standing still, so you can reach new areas and stay ahead of rivals.
Watch the larger holes around you and avoid getting caught where a bigger one can close in on you.
Plan a route through the map rather than chasing whatever is closest, so you collect more growth with less wasted time.
