Check your surroundings often and adjust your direction early, because quick reactions matter more than long pauses.
faq: How do I control my hole?
Use mouse clicks or taps to play, as the game's instructions describe. Keep your input steady so you can steer toward the objects you want to devour.
What is the goal of Hole Io 2?
The goal is to grow your black hole by devouring objects and outlasting or outgrowing the other holes in the battle. Keep expanding your size while staying out of danger.

brain-draw-line.intro: Brain Draw Line is a puzzle game where you connect every dot in a shape using one unbroken line. Each level adds more dots and more tangled designs to solve.
tips: Before you start drawing, look at the whole shape and find dots that have an odd number of lines leading to them, since these are often good starting or ending points.
Plan your route a few steps ahead instead of drawing straight away, because a move that looks fine early can trap you later.
If you get stuck, lift your attention off the current path and trace the remaining unvisited dots to see which ones are hard to reach.
Keep an eye on dead ends: a dot tucked into a corner must be visited at the right moment, so do not leave it for last.
Since you cannot go backward or overlap, treat each finished segment as permanent and only commit to a route you have checked.
faq: What is the goal of Brain Draw Line?
The goal is to draw one continuous line that links all the dots in the given shape without lifting your finger or overlapping any lines.
What happens if I cross over my own line?
You cannot overlap or retrace a path, so a move that crosses or doubles back is not allowed and you need to plan a different route.

card-sort-challenge.intro: Card Sort: Challenge is a colorful logic puzzle where you group matching cards and clear the whole board. Each level adds obstacles like fog, bombs, chains, and locks that change how you plan your moves.
tips: Before each move, check which cards will be freed up and whether that opens a useful match. Moves that reveal new cards usually matter more than moves that only tidy the current row.
Keep some free space open at all times. If the board fills up, you lose room to maneuver, so avoid stacking cards in spots that block your next moves.
Look for cards you might trap under fog, behind chains, or near locks, and move or match them early. Obstacles get harder to work around the longer you wait.
Plan a few moves ahead, especially on bomb levels, where a wrong order can leave important cards stuck. Think about what the board looks like after each step, not just the next one.
Save shuffle and undo for when the layout truly stalls. Using them to back out of a bad sequence is often more useful than trying to force a difficult position.
faq: How do I win a level in Card Sort: Challenge?
You win by grouping matching cards and clearing the entire board. Each move should bring you closer to freeing and matching the remaining cards.
What should I do when I get stuck?
Use a booster such as shuffle or undo to recover from a difficult layout. Undo is useful when a recent move blocked an important card.

moto-stuntman.intro: Moto Stuntman is a motocross racing game where you ride across tracks with changing terrain, environments and moving obstacles. Your goal is to reach the finish line as fast as possible while using stunts to save time.
tips: Use the gas and brake keys early to get a feel for how your bike handles on different surfaces before you push for a fast time.
Use the rotate keys in the air to line up your bike before landing, since a poor landing can cost you more time than a stunt gains.
Look ahead for moving elements and natural obstacles so you can adjust your speed before you reach them rather than reacting at the last second.
Try somersaults when you have a safe stretch of air time, because they are the main way to win extra seconds on a run.
Replay tracks you already know to learn where stunts are safe to attempt and where it is better to ease off the gas and stay in control.
faq: What is the goal of Moto Stuntman?
Reach the finish line of each track and set the best time you can. Stunts can help you win extra seconds along the way.
Which keys control the motorcycle?
The W key or up arrow is gas, and the S key or down arrow is the brake. The A and D keys or left and right arrows rotate the bike and perform a somersault.

we-not-survive.intro: We Not Survive is a tower defense game set in a zombie-infested, post-apocalyptic world, where you are the only defender of your base. Hold off waves of undead while upgrading weapons and unlocking skills.
tips: Click the "?" button early to read what each action icon does, so you know your options before the first wave arrives.
Spend resources on upgrades steadily rather than all at once, so your defenses keep pace with the growing zombie waves.
Use the zombie attack speed control to slow down fights when you need time to think, and speed it up once your base feels secure.
Check which skills you can unlock and plan toward the ones that help the defenses you rely on most.
Turn off music or sounds if the audio distracts you, so you can focus on watching the waves and reacting quickly.
faq: What is the goal of We Not Survive?
You act as the sole defender and must protect your base from waves of zombies for as long as possible.
How do I control the game?
The game is controlled entirely with the mouse, so click icons and targets to take actions.

ice-dash.intro: Ice Dash is an adventure game where you draw icy lines to guide Santa across levels. Collect the cookies, avoid traps, and keep him balanced as the challenge grows.
tips: Plan the whole route before you draw. Look at where the cookies, traps, and moving platforms are, then choose a line that passes them in a sensible order.
Keep your lines simple and short where you can. Santa slides automatically on what you draw, so fewer, well-placed lines are easier to control than many tangled ones.
Watch the moving platforms before you commit. Time your line so Santa reaches the platform when it is in a safe position.
Grab cookies on the way rather than detouring at the end. If a cookie sits near a safe path, draw your line so it passes right over it.
Use the pause button to take a breath when a level gets busy. Looking over the layout while the game is paused can help you plan your next line.
faq: What is the goal of Ice Dash?
Draw icy lines to guide Santa through each level, collect every cookie, and avoid the icy traps and obstacles along the way.
How do I draw the ice line?
On PC, click and drag to draw. On mobile, tap and drag. Santa then slides automatically along the lines you have drawn.

domino-camp.intro: Domino Camp is a puzzle game where you match domino tiles to clear the board across a range of levels. Plan each move so you can finish levels with as few moves as possible.
tips: Before tapping a tile, look at the target number at the bottom of the screen and check which tiles on the board can match it.
Think a step ahead: choose a match that leaves you with a useful tile for the next target, not just the one that clears the most right now.
Scan the whole board first to see which tiles are stuck, so you can plan an order that clears the awkward ones before they block you.
Aim for the fewest moves on each level, since the instructions say this is how you earn the highest score.
If you get stuck, pause and recount the numbers on the tiles you still have rather than trying random matches.
faq: How do I select and place a domino?
Tap or click a tile to select it, then match it with the target number shown at the bottom of the screen. A correct match clears the tile and moves you forward.
How is the score decided?
The instructions say you score highest by completing each level using the fewest moves possible. Fewer wasted moves gives you a better result.

monster-truck-supra-race.intro: Monster Truck Supra Race is a head-to-head monster truck racing game set across hills, valleys, and jumps. You drive with WASD and aim to win as many races as possible across several race modes.
tips: Pay attention to the next ramp before you reach it, since jumps are a big part of the course. Lining up your truck early makes landings more controlled.
Watch your competitors as well as the road. Knowing where rivals are helps you decide when to push for speed and when to hold back.
Use the hills and uphill sections carefully. Keep enough momentum to climb without losing control on the way up.
Try each mode, including Boss Battle Races, Ranking Races, and Daily Race, to learn how the courses and opponents differ. Practice in a mode you enjoy before moving on to harder ones.
Experiment with the truck customization options to find a balance between speed and performance. Choose a setup that suits how you like to drive.
faq: What is the main goal of Monster Truck Supra Race?
Your goal is to win as many races as possible and rise to the top of the leaderboards. Winning races across the different modes is how you prove you are the best monster truck driver.
How do I control the truck?
Use the WASD keys to drive the truck. Practice on a few courses to get a feel for steering and balance before entering competitive races.

coinbound-voodoo-nightmare.intro: Coinbound Voodoo Nightmare is a fast arcade runner where you dash through tight maze paths, grab coins, and dodge zombies. Each run is short, so every second matters.
tips: Learn the maze layout early in each level so you can plan your route before the zombies close in.
Use WASD to keep your moves precise, and avoid overcorrecting in tight corners where a small mistake can cost you the run.
Save sprinting with F for open stretches or escape moments, since it helps you get away but you need to keep track of when you use it.
Use crouch with X when you need to slip past a threat in a narrow path, rather than stopping to wait for it to pass.
Grab coins when they are on your way instead of making long detours, so you keep moving and your score keeps climbing.
faq: What is the main goal of Coinbound Voodoo Nightmare?
You run through maze paths, collect coins, and avoid zombies to push your score higher. The game challenges you to see how long you can survive the chase.
How do I control my character?
Move with WASD, crouch with X, and sprint with F. TAB is listed for switching between run and walk, and M opens the pause menu.

boat-merge-and-race.intro: Boat Merge & Race is a 3D arcade racing game where you merge identical boats into faster, stronger ones and race against AI opponents. Speed and strategy both matter.
tips: Merge two identical boats whenever you can, since the result is faster and stronger than either boat alone.
Watch the boats on your track before each merge so you know which pairs are matching and which will leave you with a weaker setup.
Collect gold coins along the route when it costs you little speed, because they add to your score while you race.
Keep your boat on the water at all times, as staying afloat is part of finishing each level.
Use your early races to learn how the AI opponents move, then time your merges so you pull ahead before the final stretch.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You need to join the race, beat the AI opponents, and finish the level. Collecting gold coins along the way is part of the challenge.
How do I make my boat faster?
Merge two identical boats to create a faster and stronger boat. You can also upgrade your props, of which there are 17 to choose from.

lane-clash.intro: Lane Clash is a tower defense game where you hold a fortress across five parallel lanes. Tap lane shields to send warriors and stop enemies before they reach your wall.
tips: Watch the cooldown on each lane shield and spawn warriors when it is ready, rather than tapping at random. Steady spawning keeps pressure on the enemies.
Remember that clashing units cancel their power, so a small defender can still save a lane by trading with a weaker enemy. Check which side has the bigger remaining power before committing.
Enemies that reach the wall cost your base HP equal to their power, so a strong enemy that gets through can be very costly. Prioritise the lanes where the strongest enemies are closing in.
Save Shield, Bomb, and Freeze for moments when the pressure rises across several lanes. Using them early can leave you with nothing when a wave gets hard.
Between rounds, spend coins on lane tier and power and gems on cooldown, and use wall repairs when your base HP is low. Pick the upgrades that fix your current weak spot.
faq: What is the goal of each wave?
You must defeat or block all enemies before your base HP drops to zero. Surviving the wave earns rewards and lets you move on to the next one.
How do I collect coins?
Tap coins on the field to collect them. Coins are used to upgrade lane tier and power.

tap-the-crop.intro: Tap the Crop is an idle clicker about growing a farm, starting with wheat and working up to the rare Golden Crop. Tapping earns crops, while hired helpers keep earning when you step away.
tips: Tap steadily early on, since your first crops fund the upgrades and automations that make everything else faster.
Buy automations as soon as you can afford them, because they earn crops while you are away from the game.
Keep an eye on combos, and try to keep taps going without long breaks so your clicks stay boosted.
Watch for events and aim to be tapping during them, since they give big boosts.
Compare the value of selling your farm with staying put; selling makes sense only once the meta upgrades it unlocks look worth more than your current progress.
faq: What is the main goal of Tap the Crop?
Your goal is to grow your farm by earning crops, moving up from wheat through corn, carrots, and tomatoes to the rare Golden Crop.
How do I earn crops faster?
Tap to earn crops, buy upgrades and automations, and hire farmers and machines, which keep earning while you are away.

fall-fu-panda.intro: Fall Fu Panda is a puzzle game where you rotate a shifting world to keep your panda falling onto the next block. Tap left or right to steer the fall and keep the run going.
tips: Watch where your panda is heading before each tap, since the next block is the one you need to land on.
Use the zoom-out view when you need a wider look at the world and the path ahead.
Keep your taps small and steady so the world turns in controlled steps rather than overshooting the next block.
Track your panda closely after each rotation, because a single missed landing ends the run.
If you are aiming for points, focus on landing on objects, and watch for enemies you can defeat along the way.
faq: What is the goal of Fall Fu Panda?
The goal is to land on objects to score points or defeat enemies while your character moves through the shifting world. Each successful landing keeps the run going.
How do I control the panda?
Tap the left side of the screen to rotate the world left, or the right side to rotate it right. The rotation makes your character fall onto the next block.

dashmash-io.intro: DashMash.io is a real-time multiplayer obstacle race for up to 10 players. Run, jump, and dash through hazard-filled stages to reach the finish line before everyone else.
tips: Watch the moving platforms for a few seconds before you jump, so you can time your landing instead of guessing.
Use your double jump to correct a bad jump mid-air, especially when you need to reach a platform just out of range.
Keep an eye on crumbling blocks and do not stop on them, since they can give way under you.
Study the start of each new map, because every round cycles to a different layout and you need to adapt quickly.
Save your dash for stretches where the path ahead is clear, so the speed boost helps you pull ahead rather than carry you into a hazard.
faq: What is the goal of DashMash.io?
The goal is to reach the finish line before the other players. Finishing first claims the top spot on the leaderboard.
How do I jump and double jump?
Press the Up Arrow, W, or Space to jump, then press it again in the air to double jump.

blocky-guns.intro: Blocky Guns is a first-person shooter where you collect colored blocks, build weapons, and fight through waves of enemies. This guide covers how to gather materials, choose gear, and move through levels.
tips: Collect blocks during every mission, not just when you need them. Each weapon needs two different colors, so keep a mix in stock.
Before entering a fight, think about which weapon suits the situation. Pistols, machine guns, rocket launchers, and grenades each work differently, so switch to the one that fits the battle.
Keep moving during combat rather than standing still. Staying in one spot makes you an easy target for waves of enemies.
Use your strongest weapons on the tougher enemies and save lighter guns for quick kills, so you don't run out of useful firepower mid-level.
Track how many enemies are left, since you must eliminate all of them to complete the level. Clear groups methodically instead of chasing one target across the map.
faq: How do I unlock a new weapon?
Gather blocks of two different colors during missions, then use them to create the weapon. Stronger gear requires enough materials, so collect as you go.
What do I need to do to finish a level?
You must eliminate all enemies in the level. Keep moving and use your weapons wisely while you clear them.

arrow-pop.intro: Arrow Pop is a fast-paced archery game where you launch arrows at colorful targets. You need to hit the right color to keep your run going through increasingly challenging stages.
tips: Check which color is required before you launch, so you do not commit to a shot that lands on the wrong section.
Stay accurate first. One wrong color can end your run, so a slower, careful shot is often better than a rushed one.
Pay attention to moving obstacles and tricky angles before you tap, since they change where the arrow needs to go.
Use short breaks to reset your focus, and build a steady rhythm of aim, tap, and check the color.
Try to notice how chain reactions play out, so you can line up shots that clear several targets at once.
faq: How do I launch an arrow?
Tap the arrow to launch it. Each launch uses a single tap, so timing your tap is the main control.
What ends a run?
Hitting a section with the wrong color can end your run. You must match the required color to keep going.

carvivor-ops.intro: Carvivor Ops is a driving action game where you control a weaponized supercar and try to survive waves of police within a limited time. Dodge the cops, fire rockets, and upgrade your gear as the chases get harder.
tips: Keep moving rather than sitting in one spot, since the police waves are built to pressure a car that stays still.
Focus on steering around the cops first and use your rockets when you have a clear shot, so you don't waste fire while in danger.
Pay attention to the time limit and plan your route so you are not trapped in a corner when the next wave arrives.
Spend your upgrades on gear that helps you survive longer, since the chases keep going and staying alive is the main goal.
Use the arrow keys or W, A, S, D for smooth, small steering changes, which make it easier to slip between police cars on desktop.
faq: What is the goal of Carvivor Ops?
The goal is to survive increasingly intense waves of police within a limited time while dodging cops and firing rockets. The longer you last, the harder the chases become.
How do I move the car?
On desktop, use the arrow keys or W, A, S, and D to move up, down, left, and right. On mobile, use the on-screen buttons to control the car.

extreme-thumb-wars.intro: Extreme Thumb Wars is a cartoon thumb wrestling game where you choose one of more than twenty thumb characters and battle a friend or the CPU. Win by smashing your opponent's finger until their power bar runs out.
tips: Try a few of the more than twenty thumb characters before settling on one, so you can see which one suits your style.
Keep an eye on both the health bar and the power bar, since the round is decided by the power bar running out.
Use a steady rhythm of inputs instead of frantic mashing, and stay focused so you don't lose momentum.
Play a few rounds against the CPU first to learn how your character responds before challenging a friend.
When playing with a friend, take turns choosing characters and try different matchups to find the one that gives you the edge.
faq: What is the goal of Extreme Thumb Wars?
The goal is to beat your opponent by smashing their finger until their power bar comes to an end. You can play against a friend or against the CPU.
How do I control my thumb?
You can use touch controls, or on a keyboard press W or the Up Arrow key.

3d-pyramid-maze.intro: Roll a glowing ball up a stepped pyramid maze from the base edge to the golden summit. A red chaser hunts you through the same corridors, so you need to plan your route as you climb.
tips: Learn the route up from the base before you commit to a long corridor, since the chaser moves through the same paths you do.
Head for the cyan beacon rings as you pass them, because a catch sends you back to the last one you reached.
Grab the coins that sit on your route when they are close, but think twice before a detour, since most coins are off the safe path.
Save coins for FREEZE when the chaser is closing in on a tight corridor, and use HINT when you lose track of the way up.
Pick Rookie or Scout while you learn the layout, then move to Ranger or Ace once you can plan a full route without stalling.
faq: What happens if the red chaser catches me?
You restart from your last cyan beacon, or from the base if you have not passed one yet.
Are coins worth more at certain heights?
Yes, coins are worth more the higher they sit on the pyramid, so the upper levels reward a risk.

killer-assassin.intro: Killer Assassin is a stealth game where you control an assassin who eliminates enemies one at a time. Use cover and shadows to avoid flashlights, then strike quickly and slip away unseen.
tips: Study where the flashlight beams point before you move, and wait for a gap in the light before advancing.
Use walls, objects and dark areas as cover to stay hidden while you plan your next approach.
Pick off enemies one by one rather than rushing into a crowd, since each kill should be done quietly.
Move in short bursts and pause often, so you can check whether an enemy is turning toward you.
After each assassination, look for an exit route before you act so you can escape without being spotted.
faq: What is the main goal in Killer Assassin?
Your goal is to control the assassin and kill the enemies one by one. You need to do this without being seen by the flashlights.
How do I avoid being spotted?
Use your surroundings and shadows to stay out of the flashlight beams. Staying in dark areas and behind cover helps you remain hidden.

squid-gamer-city-driving-gang.intro: Squid Gamer City Driving Gang is a driving game set in a large open 3D world inspired by the mafia streets of Las Vegas. You can drive cars, move on foot, take on duties, and face opponents.
tips: Press F near a car to get in, and use it to move quickly between districts instead of walking everywhere.
Use Space to brake before sharp turns so you keep control of the car, especially when you are being chased or confronted by opponents.
Open the menu with Tab now and then to check your current duties so you can plan routes that take you to the next objective.
Explore the points of interest, such as the military installation, the airport, the motorcycle stunt stage, and the spaceship, to learn where each one is before you need to find them in a hurry.
Stay alert in the gangster areas, since the game describes them as dangerous, and keep your character healthy before taking on a new confrontation.
faq: What is the main goal of Squid Gamer City Driving Gang?
The game centers on completing various duties and taking part in confrontations with opponents in the open Las Vegas-style world. Your success and fame are tied to how well you complete these tasks.
How do I control the car and my character?
Use WASD to drive the car or move your character, press F to enter or exit a car, and hold Space to brake while driving. Press Tab to open the menu.

sky-stunts-rolling-ball-3d.intro: Sky Stunts Rolling Ball 3D is an adventure where you steer a ball to its destination, collecting coins along the way. Reach the goal to finish and earn coins for unlocking new character balls.
tips: Keep an eye on the route ahead rather than only the ball, so you can line up coins and avoid overshooting the goal.
Make small, steady steering adjustments with WASD on a PC, since sharp repeated inputs can make the ball hard to control.
On a mobile browser, rest your thumbs on the on-screen buttons so you can react quickly without lifting your fingers.
Try to collect coins on the way instead of detouring for them, so you still reach the destination on your run.
Use the coins you earn after finishing to choose a new character ball, and pick one that suits how you like to drive.
faq: How do I control the ball on a PC?
Use the W, A, S and D keys to move the ball. These keys are the controls for steering it toward the destination.
How do I control the ball on a mobile browser?
Use the button interface built into the game on the screen. Tap or hold the buttons to move the ball.

my-city-hospital.intro: My City Hospital is a doll placement simulation with a doctor and hospital theme. You play by clicking or tapping, and the game invites you to imagine running a hospital to help others.
tips: Make one placement at a time and watch how the scene responds before you continue. This makes it easier to see what each choice does.
Look at the whole city layout before you start placing dolls so your arrangement feels planned rather than random.
Try different placements and compare the results. Noting what worked helps you repeat good choices in later rounds.
Keep the hospital theme in mind as you play, since the game is built around helping others and running a medical setting.
If you feel stuck, pause for a moment and reread the on-screen prompts. Small details often point to the next step.
faq: What is the goal of My City Hospital?
The game centers on placing dolls in a doctor and hospital setting, inspired by the idea of running a hospital to help others. Exploring different placements is the main way to progress.
What controls does My City Hospital use?
You play by clicking with a mouse or tapping the screen. No other controls are listed for this game.

mom-i-can-fly.intro: Mom I Can Fly is a flying game where you guide a kid to the highlighted area. Each level brings new obstacles and challenges as you progress.
tips: Watch your energy bar from the start and avoid spending it all on early moves, since you will need it for harder parts later.
Hold to dive and release to climb, and make small adjustments rather than long holds so you stay in control.
Slide to look around before you commit to a path, so you can spot obstacles and the highlighted area ahead.
Keep your eye on the highlighted area as your main target and plan your route toward it rather than reacting to each obstacle.
If you keep crashing at the same spot, slow your pace and practice that section until the timing feels steady.
faq: What is the goal of Mom I Can Fly?
Your goal is to fly the kid to the highlighted area. You move through levels by reaching that target and clearing the obstacles and challenges along the way.
How do I control the kid?
Tap and hold the screen to fly down, and release the screen to fly up. Slide on the screen to look around.

blasting-marbles.intro: Blasting Marbles is a 2D physics puzzle where you aim blasts at marbles to roll them into a hole. Your goal is to get the required number of marbles into the hole on each level.
tips: Check the number in the top left corner first so you know how many marbles must reach the hole before you start planning.
Before each blast, watch how the marble rolls and bounces. Small, careful blasts are often easier to control than strong ones.
Collect the boxes in the level to add extra marbles. Each box shows how many marbles it holds, so grab them when you can do so safely.
Use the arrow keys or A and D to switch between marbles. Move the marble that is closest to the hole first, then bring the others in.
Try to coordinate your marbles. One marble can clear a path or stop another from rolling off course, so plan the order of your moves.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You need to get the number of marbles shown in the top left corner of the screen into the hole. Marbles that miss the hole do not count.
How do I move a marble?
Left click near a marble to create a blast and send it rolling. Watch where it goes before you try the next shot.

merge-beasts.intro: Merge Beasts is an arcade merge puzzle where you combine matching creatures into stronger beasts. Plan each move, keep board space open, and work toward the goal of every level.
tips: Before every drag, look for the merge that opens the most room on the board, not just the one that makes a bigger beast right away.
Keep a clear lane or open space near the middle of the board so you always have somewhere to place your next beast.
Think a few moves ahead: check whether a merge will leave two matching beasts stuck apart from each other.
Use the pause button to step back and review the board when you feel boxed in, instead of rushing through drags.
Check the level goal at the start of each stage and let it guide which beasts you prioritise merging.
faq: How do I merge two beasts?
Drag one beast onto another beast of the same type and release. The two combine into a stronger creature.
What should I focus on to avoid getting stuck?
Leave room on the board for your next moves and avoid filling gaps with beasts that cannot merge soon.

city-cash-race.intro: City Cash Race is a single-player top-down car chase game. You race through busy city streets, grab cash, avoid the police, and upgrade your car as you go.
tips: Use the brake (S or down arrow) before sharp turns instead of braking mid-corner, so you keep control of the car and stay on the road.
Steer with short, light taps on A and D rather than holding the keys down, which makes it easier to weave between traffic and obstacles.
Keep an eye on where the police are before you go for cash. Grabbing a pile is only worth it if you can get away afterward.
Plan your route a few blocks ahead so you can line up for cash pickups without making sudden last-second swerves.
When you have money to spend on upgrades, think about which problem you are trying to solve, such as escaping pursuit or handling corners, and choose accordingly.
faq: How do I control the car?
Press W or the up arrow to accelerate and S or the down arrow to brake. Use A or the left arrow to steer left and D or the right arrow to steer right.
What is the goal of City Cash Race?
Race through the city, collect cash, and get away from the police. Use the money you earn to upgrade your car.

friends-pug.intro: Friends Pug is a two-player adventure where a brown dog and a grey dog collect food, get past obstacles, and reach the nest together. Each dog has its own set of controls.
tips: Keep both dogs moving toward the nest rather than racing ahead, since the game needs both friends to arrive together.
Collect the food for your own dog first, but check on your friend's food path so neither of you gets left behind.
Plan your route before you move through obstacles, and decide which dog should go first to clear the way for the other.
Grab the bone when you can, because it gives special powers that may help you get past tricky spots.
If you play alone, switch your attention between the brown dog and the grey dog so you keep both on track.
faq: What is the goal of Friends Pug?
Collect all the food with your dog friend, overcome the obstacles, and reach the nest together. Both dogs need to get there.
How do I control the two dogs?
Use the Arrow Keys to move the brown dog and the WASD keys to move the grey dog.

space-survivor-shooting.intro: Space Survivor Shooting is a shooting game where you play as an impostor. You plan your moves, move quickly, and use your shooting skills to take down enemies and protect allies.
tips: Plan your route before you move so you are not caught out in the open.
Move fast between targets, since the game rewards quick action.
Watch where enemies are heading and aim to take them out before they reach your allies.
Keep an eye on your allies and step in when one of them is in danger.
Use the mouse click or tap controls steadily rather than rushing every shot.
faq: What is the goal of Space Survivor Shooting?
You play as an impostor and must defeat enemies while saving allies. The game asks you to use planning and tactics to take out opponents quickly.
How do I control the character?
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps. Click or tap to move and shoot as the game prompts you.

dop-puzzle-displace-one-part.intro: DOP Puzzle: Displace One Part is a brain teaser built around funny cartoon stories. Each level asks you to drag items onto a picture to solve a clever puzzle.
tips: Look at the whole picture before you drag anything, and note which elements seem out of place.
Remember that you place three components, so think about both the right spot and the right order for each one.
You don't always need to use every item provided, so don't assume a piece must go somewhere just because it is on screen.
Try a move and watch the animation closely, since it often shows whether a placement is on the right track.
If you get stuck, step back and reconsider the story in the level, because the answer often connects to what is happening in the scene.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Your goal is to shift one part of the picture by dragging the specified elements onto the image so the puzzle is solved. Each level is a short funny story with its own challenge.
How do I move the pieces?
On a mobile device, swipe your finger across the screen, and on a PC, swipe the cursor to shift a piece. The controls are meant to be simple and clear.

3d-ball-pool.intro: 3D Ball Pool is a pocket billiards game shown from a 3D view, meant to feel like playing pool in the real world. You control the game with the mouse.
tips: Use the 3D view to check angles before you shoot, since the table depth can make a shot look different than it is.
Take a moment to line up each shot with the mouse rather than rushing, because small aim errors add up over a long distance.
Before striking, think about where the cue ball will end up so you can set up your next shot instead of just sinking the current ball.
Look for shots that send balls toward pockets along clear paths, and avoid crowded areas where the cue ball could be blocked.
Pay attention to how the balls behave after each hit, and adjust your aim based on what you observed on the previous shot.
faq: What is the goal of 3D Ball Pool?
The goal is to play pocket billiards by sinking balls into the pockets, following the rules of a real game of pool.
How do I control the game?
The game uses mouse control, so you move the mouse to aim and use it to take your shots.

pixel-shooter-puzzle.intro: Pixel Shooter Puzzle is a 3D color-matching puzzle where you fire cannons at a rotating voxel model to clear its blocks. The goal is to clear each model without filling your slots, across 200 puzzles.
tips: Before firing, rotate the model to check which blocks are exposed and which layers are hidden underneath. Pick cannons that open up the layers you can reach next.
Look at the front of the queue and avoid firing a cannon that will only reveal blocks you cannot match soon.
Keep your slots in mind at all times. Since slots are limited, each shot that fills a slot without clearing blocks makes the next puzzle harder.
Zoom in on tricky areas to spot small color differences before you commit to a cannon.
Use the optional boosts only when you are truly stuck, so you keep your options open on harder models.
faq: What is the goal of Pixel Shooter Puzzle?
Clear the rotating voxel model by matching cannon colors to exposed blocks, without filling your slots.
How do I choose which cannon to fire?
Pick cannons from the front of the queue whose colors match blocks you can actually reach. Planning ahead helps you avoid running out of room.

classic-number-puzzle.intro: Classic Number Puzzle is a sliding tile game where you use the empty space to put the numbers back in ascending order. It rewards careful planning and efficient moves.
tips: Work on one number at a time, starting from the top-left corner, and lock each finished number into place before moving on.
Before every slide, look ahead to see where the empty space will end up, so you avoid moving a tile you just placed.
Keep the empty space near the corner where your next tile needs to go, since that makes each move more useful.
If a tile ends up in the wrong spot near the end, slide the empty space in a small loop around it rather than starting over.
Aim to finish in as few moves as you can, because the goal is the fewest moves and shortest time, not just any solution.
faq: What is the goal of Classic Number Puzzle?
You slide the numbers using the empty space until they are in ascending order. The aim is to do this in the fewest moves and in the shortest time.
How do I move the tiles?
Tap or click the empty space to slide a neighboring tile into it. You move one tile at a time.

stickman-jump.intro: Stickman Jump is a fast platformer where a small stickman sprints forward and you must time each jump to clear gaps and obstacles. Levels get harder the further you go.
tips: Focus on the timing of the jump rather than rushing. Watch the edge of each platform and jump just before you reach a gap.
Use the spacebar on desktop or the on-screen jump button on mobile, and press it with a steady rhythm so your timing stays consistent.
Pay attention to obstacles ahead of you, since bumping into them is a common way to fail. Looking a little further ahead helps you prepare early.
Expect each level to ask for better coordination than the last. If you keep failing at the same spot, slow your reactions and try the jump at a slightly different moment.
Stay calm after a fall and restart with a clear focus. Short, repeated practice on tricky sections usually improves your timing faster than long, rushed attempts.
faq: What is the goal of Stickman Jump?
The goal is to run and jump across platforms, avoiding gaps and obstacles, to complete each level.
How do I jump in Stickman Jump?
On desktop, press the spacebar to jump. On mobile, tap the on-screen jump button.

bridge.intro: Bridge is a minimalist physics platformer where you build bridges of the right length to cross obsidian pillars over a chasm. Timing your release is what decides every crossing.
tips: Hold for a short moment, watch how far the bridge reaches, then release. Small hold-time changes make a big difference, so practice judging the gap before you commit.
Aim for the red center dot on each pillar. Landing there earns double points and bonus crystals, and it helps build your combo multiplier.
On crumbling towers, act quickly once the platform starts to break. Waiting even briefly can make you fall, so plan your bridge before you arrive.
If you make a near miss, try the edge-grab. Catching the ledge with your fingertips can save a run that would otherwise end.
Save your Second Chance (Revive) for a long streak. It works once per run, so use it when you have a high score you want to protect.
faq: What is the goal of Bridge?
Build a bridge that is just long enough to reach the next pillar. If it is too short or too long, it falls into the abyss and the run ends.
How do I control the bridge on desktop?
Click and hold the Left Mouse Button or the Spacebar to grow the bridge, then let go to drop it across the gap.

cozy-sort-theme-collect.intro: Cozy Sort: Theme Collect is a calm triple-match sorting puzzle. Arrange colorful, cute items into matching groups at your own pace, with no time limits.
tips: Take a moment to scan the whole board before you start tapping. Spotting every set of three matching items first helps you plan a clear order.
Since there is no timer, you can think through each move. Look ahead to see which item is stuck underneath or behind others.
Focus on one color or item type at a time. Finishing a group cleanly keeps the board easier to read as it gets fuller.
If a move does not look right, pause and check the other items around it. Matching in the right order often leaves fewer loose pieces at the end.
Play in short sessions when you feel like it. The game is built for a relaxed pace, so stepping away and coming back can make the next sort feel fresh.
faq: What is the goal of Cozy Sort: Theme Collect?
The goal is to sort the cute items by matching three of the same kind together. Each set of matching items is cleared from the board.
How do I play?
Use your mouse to click or tap the items you want to sort. The game is played entirely with clicks or taps.

king-rugni-tower-defense.intro: King Rugni Tower Defense is a classic tower defense game with 30 levels across different themed maps. You place and upgrade towers to stop waves of elemental enemies before they reach the end of the path.
tips: Spend gems early on new towers so you cover the path before the enemy count grows.
Save gold for upgrading towers you already have, since a stronger tower often does more good than a new one in the same spot.
Some enemies fly straight to the target instead of following the path, so check that your towers also cover the direct line to your base.
You have 10 lives and need to keep at least one, so do not let enemies slip through in the early waves while you learn the layout.
Prepare for the final boss of each zone by upgrading towers before that level, because a boss that gets through ends the run.
faq: How do you win a level?
You win by defeating the enemies and completing all waves while keeping at least one of your 10 lives.
Where do gems and gold come from?
Each defeated enemy gives you gems, which pay for building new towers. Winning a level gives you gold, which pays for upgrades and new purchases.

breakblock.intro: Break Block is an arcade brick-breaker where you aim each shot and smash numbered blocks before they reach the bottom. Build combos, collect extra balls, and try to beat your best score.
tips: Aim with a short, careful drag before each release, since every launch is your only chance to hit the blocks you need.
Focus on the blocks closest to the bottom first, because those are the ones that will end the run soonest.
Watch where extra balls appear and try to route your shots through them so you collect more balls quickly.
Keep your combos going by aiming for a steady rhythm of hits instead of rushing shots that might miss.
Save the charged rocket for a moment when the blocks are piling up, so it helps you survive longer when it matters most.
faq: What is the goal of Break Block?
Destroy the numbered blocks before they reach the bottom of the screen. The longer you survive, the higher your score can go.
How do I aim and launch the ball?
Drag with the mouse or your finger to aim, then release to launch the ball. Each release sends your shot toward the blocks.

duck-family-simulator-animal-games.intro: Duck Family Simulator Animal Games is an open-world adventure where you live as a wild duck, raising your family, hunting for food, and avoiding predators across islands, lakes, and forests.
tips: Keep your ducklings close while exploring, since the game focuses on protecting them from dangerous predators.
Hunt for food regularly so you can keep your survival stable before taking on longer missions.
Use flight to scout the island and find hidden locations, then return to the ground when you need to move more carefully.
Collect coins whenever you pass them, because they help you unlock new adventures as you progress.
Check the Info screen with the I key to review the controls before you start, so you can switch between walking, flying, and sprinting quickly.
faq: What is the main goal of Duck Family Simulator Animal Games?
You raise your duck family, hunt for food, protect your ducklings from predators, and complete missions as you explore the open world.
How do I fly and move around the island?
Use W, A, S, and D to move and click with U to fly, then use E to move up and X to move down while flying.

dark-assassin.intro: Dark Assassin is a platform adventure set in a dark castle full of traps. Move Zenith across platforms, avoid spikes, and find the key to open the door to the next level.
tips: Study each level before you move, especially the positions of fixed and movable spikes, so you know where it is safe to cross.
Time your jumps around moving platforms and wait for them to reach a safe position before stepping on them, since a fall ends the game.
Keep your steps short and controlled near spikes rather than rushing, because a single misjudged jump is enough to end the run.
Locate the key first in each level, then plan your route back to the castle door so you do not waste moves on the way.
Use the arrow keys or WASD consistently so your movements stay predictable while you handle tricky traps.
faq: What is the main goal in Dark Assassin?
Find the key in each level, which opens the castle door so you can move on to the next level.
What happens if Zenith falls off a platform?
The game is over if the player falls from a platform or a movable platform, so careful control is essential.

dispatch-panic.intro: Dispatch Panic is a fast arcade game where you run mail around a busy office, deliver to waiting desks, and avoid obstacles before the boss gets too angry. The goal is to last as long as you can while building delivery combos.
tips: Keep an eye on the boss's anger as you play, and prioritize deliveries that keep your combo going rather than rushing after distant targets.
Aim before you throw. Moving the mouse to line up a desk first helps you avoid wasted mail that counts as a miss.
Use Shift to dash when you need to slip past an obstacle or reach a desk quickly, but remember it only works while you are moving.
Plan your route around the obstacles so you rarely collide, since collisions raise the boss's anger just like missed deliveries do.
Grab coffee and power-ups when they are on your path, and handle urgent requests early so they do not pile up.
faq: What is the main goal of Dispatch Panic?
Deliver mail to the waiting desks and survive as long as possible before the boss's anger gets too high. Missed deliveries and collisions both push that anger up.
How do I throw mail?
Aim with the mouse, then click or press Space to throw. Your mail goes toward the spot you are aiming at.

dino-meat-hunt-new-adventure.intro: Dino Meat Hunt - New Adventure is a two-player cooperative adventure. You control a big dinosaur and a little dinosaur as you solve puzzles and gather meat to prepare for winter.
tips: Agree on roles early. The big dinosaur handles dangerous monsters with attacks, while the little dinosaur reaches high places, so each player should know which threats and routes are theirs.
Use the little dinosaur's double jump when a ledge is just out of reach. A quick double tap of W can get it up without a long search for another route.
Before moving on, look at where each dinosaur can go. Puzzles are hard, so a short pause to plan who goes first often saves time.
Keep your partner informed about what you see, such as a monster blocking the path or a high spot that needs the little dinosaur. Clear communication helps you finish levels together.
Gather the meat as you go rather than rushing past it. The game's goal is to build a meat stock, so collecting along the way prepares you for the later levels.
faq: What is the goal of Dino Meat Hunt?
You complete the game levels by working with your partner and prepare a meat stock for the dinosaurs before winter arrives.
Which dinosaur deals with the monsters?
The big dinosaur destroys dangerous monsters. Press L to attack, and move it with the arrow keys.

adventure-crazy-ramp-bike-stunt-game.intro: Adventure Crazy Ramp Bike Stunt Game is a 3D motorbike racing game built around ramp jumps, flips and stunt missions. You ride with the arrow keys, balance your bike in the air, and collect coins to unlock stronger bikes.
tips: Use the left and right arrow keys to lean back or forward while you are in the air, so your bike lands level instead of nose-down or tipped over.
Build speed with the up arrow before you hit a ramp, since a faster approach gives you more height and more time to set up a flip.
Ease off the up arrow on steep or tricky sections, and use the down arrow to reverse if you overshoot or land badly.
Watch for obstacles and traps ahead and time your jumps to clear them, rather than trying to correct after the fact.
Pick up coins along the way, because they are what unlock new and more powerful bikes as you progress.
faq: How do I balance my bike in the air?
Press the left arrow to lean backward and the right arrow to lean forward. Small, steady adjustments usually work better than holding a key down.
When should I reverse?
Use the down arrow to reverse when you need to back up, for example after overshooting a jump or getting stuck. Reversing is only needed occasionally.

car-driving-traffic-crazy-mobile.intro: Car Driving Traffic Crazy Mobile is a racing game played from a bird's-eye view of busy city streets. You weave through traffic to reach your destination quickly, earn money, and unlock new vehicles.
tips: Look a few car lengths ahead rather than at your car alone, so you can start steering around slower traffic before you reach it.
Plan your route early and take the faster path when the road is clear, since the goal is to get where you are going quickly.
Use the top-down view to spot gaps between vehicles before committing to a lane change, and avoid squeezing through tight spaces.
Save the money you earn and think about which new vehicle will help most with your driving before spending it.
Keep your steering smooth and short. Sharp, repeated turns are easy to overdo at speed and can send you into traffic.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You drive to your destination as fast as you can while staying out of traffic. Along the way you make money and can buy new vehicles.
How do I control the car on a PC?
Use the W, A, S and D keys to drive.

stickman-in-space.intro: You play as a lost astronaut stranded on the moon. Overcome space obstacles, deal with aliens and meteorites, solve puzzles, and find a route back to Earth.
tips: Look for two different ways off the moon, since the instructions say there are two successful escapes. If one route fails, try the other.
Watch the meteorites closely and move out of their path before you commit to your next step.
Treat the puzzles as part of the escape route. Solving them is what opens up your way back to Earth.
Keep an eye on the aliens and decide early whether to avoid them or deal with them, so you are not caught off guard.
Use slow, deliberate mouse or touch movements when timing matters, rather than rushing each move.
faq: What is the goal of Stickman in Space?
Your goal is to escape from the moon and find a route back to Earth. The game describes two successful ways to do this.
How do I control the game on a computer?
Use a computer mouse to play. The controls are designed around mouse input.

2048-x2-legends.intro: 2048 X2 Legends is a number puzzle where you shoot blocks to merge matching numbers into higher ones. Your aim is to reach the highest number you can before you run out of space, while building a higher score.
tips: Look for matching numbers before every shot, since joining two equal blocks is how you climb to higher values.
Keep an eye on the open space at all times, because the game ends once you run out of room.
Save your boosters for tight moments when space is running low, so they can help when it matters most.
Plan where each block will land so that identical numbers line up and merge rather than piling up separately.
Keep one area of your play field for your largest blocks so they can keep combining as the game goes on.
faq: What is the goal of 2048 X2 Legends?
Shoot blocks of the same number so they combine into a higher number, and try to reach the highest number possible before you run out of space.
How do I increase my score?
Your score goes up as you combine blocks into higher numbers, so making merges is the main way to climb the score list.

zasteroid.intro: Zasteroid is a top-down space shooter where your ship fires automatically and you focus on movement. Survive endless waves, level up for upgrades, and spend coins between runs in the Hangar.
tips: Keep your ship moving, since staying in one place makes it easy for enemies to hit you. Use the cursor or touch drag to weave between enemy fire.
Take survival upgrades such as shields or extra hull early, then add offensive upgrades once your run feels stable.
Collect XP crystals steadily so you level up often and get more upgrade choices each run.
Look at the bonus objectives shown each wave, since completing them is a reliable way to earn extra coins.
Save your coins for permanent upgrades in the Hangar, because they stay with you even after a death.
faq: What happens when I level up?
The game slows down and shows three random upgrade cards. You pick one to shape your build for the rest of the run.
Do I need to press a button to shoot?
No. Your ship auto-fires constantly, so you only need to move to dodge enemies and position yourself.

princess-halloween-boutique.intro: Princess Halloween Boutique is a dress-up game set in a busy Halloween store. You style girls for spooky costumes, parties, dates and trick-or-treating, aiming for the scariest look you can create.
tips: Decide on a spooky theme before you start, such as a ghostly, witchy or monstrous style, so each outfit feels like one look instead of a random mix.
Think about the occasion, whether it is a party, a date, an audition or trick-or-treating, and choose pieces that suit that event.
Try unusual combinations, since the game encourages unique ideas. Swapping in an unexpected piece can make a costume stand out more than a standard one.
Work in a steady order, starting with the main outfit and then adding accessories and finishing touches, so the look builds up clearly.
Take a moment to look at the full result before you move on, and make small adjustments to balance colors and details.
faq: What is the goal of Princess Halloween Boutique?
The goal is to dress the girls in Halloween costumes and outfits that look as scary and unique as possible for each event. There is no fixed score, so your own creativity decides the result.
How do I move items on the screen?
On desktop, click and drag with the mouse. On mobile, tap and slide with your finger.

offroad-mountain-jeep-challenge.intro: Drive a powerful offroad jeep over steep mountain roads, narrow bridges, and dangerous obstacles. Clear 15 challenging levels by keeping your vehicle balanced and reaching each finish point.
tips: Look at the route ahead before you commit. Choosing your path carefully matters on tracks with narrow bridges and obstacles.
Ease off the accelerator on steep climbs and downhill sections. Keeping the jeep balanced is what stops it from falling off the course.
Practice braking and reversing on rough ground. Small, controlled taps on the brake usually work better than holding it down.
Use the handbrake sparingly, mainly to help turn the jeep in tight spots. Steer with short, smooth inputs so the vehicle does not tip over.
If you are using mobile controls, use the on-screen driving buttons in the same smooth, steady way you would use the keyboard.
faq: What is the main goal in Offroad Mountain Jeep Challenge?
Your goal is to drive the jeep across each level and reach the finish point without falling off the course. The game has 15 levels in total.
How do I steer and control the jeep?
Use A and D or the Left and Right Arrow keys to steer, and W or Up Arrow to accelerate. Use S or Down Arrow to brake or reverse, and Space for the handbrake.

alpha-balls.intro: Alpha Balls is a word puzzle where you build words from letters on balls and earn coins to spend on hints. Tips below focus on using hints and the bin wisely while you solve each puzzle.
tips: Read the whole set of letters before you start tapping. Spotting a common word early often clears the board faster than guessing one letter at a time.
Save your coins for the hardest puzzles. Spend them only when you have checked the obvious options and still have no idea what the answer is.
Use the hint to reveal the first letters of an answer rather than the full word. That keeps the puzzle challenging while giving you a clear starting point.
Press the bin when extra letters are clearly misleading you. Removing them can make the real word easier to see.
Double-check your word before pressing the ball with a tick, since that is what confirms the answer and earns coins.
faq: How do I earn coins in Alpha Balls?
You earn coins by solving a puzzle and pressing the ball with a tick to confirm your answer.
What do I use coins for?
Coins are spent on hints. A hint can show you the first letters of an answer.

angry-bird-vs-pig.intro: Angry Bird vs Pig is a puzzle game where you knock down buildings so the bird can reach and destroy the pig. Each level is its own puzzle that rewards quick thinking and accurate aim.
tips: Before you act, look at the whole structure and find the supports that hold it up. Removing the right one often brings down more than you expect.
Plan your move before you click or tap. The game rewards strategic thinking more than fast guessing.
Watch how the bird moves after a hit, since its path can carry it to a new object you can use.
If a level stalls, try a different approach rather than repeating the same shot. Each level is a unique puzzle, so the first idea may not be the best one.
Aim with care. Good accuracy matters, so a small adjustment to your click or tap can make a big difference.
faq: What is the goal of Angry Bird vs Pig?
Knock down buildings so the bird can reach the pig and destroy it. Each level is a separate puzzle to solve.
How do I play the game?
Use mouse clicks or taps to play. Choose your shots carefully, since accuracy and timing decide how well each level goes.

extreme-rider-3d.intro: Extreme Rider 3D is an arcade bike game set on rooftops with 3D bikes and ramps. Your aim is to reach the finish line by clearing every ramp while keeping your bike on the track.
tips: Keep your speed steady before each ramp so you can land while staying upright on the track.
Watch the approach to every ramp and line up your bike early instead of correcting at the last moment.
Use small, controlled movements rather than sharp turns, since staying on the track is required to keep going.
If you fall off or lose balance, restart with a clear plan for the ramps that gave you trouble.
Practice the controls on the first stretch of track to get a feel for how your bike responds before the harder jumps.
faq: What is the goal of Extreme Rider 3D?
The goal is to ride your bike to the finish line by getting over all the ramps and staying on the track the whole time.
How do I control the bike on PC?
Use the W and D keys or the arrow keys to move the bike.

farm-clear-the-jam.intro: Farm: Clear the Jam is a calm 3D puzzle about freeing crowded farm animals from a pen. Each level asks you to work out the right order so every animal can leave without blocking another.
tips: Before you swipe anything, look at which animals are boxed in and which way each one can run. Starting with the animal that has the clearest path usually opens up the rest of the pen.
Plan two or three moves ahead rather than reacting to the first open gap. A move that frees one animal can trap another in the process.
Check each movement direction carefully before you release. Since one wrong move blocks the path again, a quick pause to confirm the route is worth more than speed.
When a level feels stuck, reset your plan and look for the animal that is blocking the most others. Clearing that one first often breaks the jam.
Keep sessions short and focused, since levels are designed for quick play. Coming back with fresh attention helps with the sharper logic in later levels.
faq: What is the goal of Farm: Clear the Jam?
Your goal is to free all the animals from the pen and clear the field. Each animal needs a clear path to run out.
How do I move the animals?
Hold the animal you want to move and swipe in the direction it needs to run. Release your finger or mouse button to send it forward.

plant-girl-defense-zombie.intro: Plant Girl Defense Zombie is a tower-defense shooting strategy game where you use cartoon plant girls to stop waves of zombies. Your goal is to defeat all of the zombies across 24 levels.
tips: Place your plant girls early, before the zombies get close, so you have time to set up your defense.
Look at where zombies enter the screen and position your plant girls so they can shoot them before they reach your side.
Spread your defenders to cover more than one lane or path rather than stacking them all in one spot.
If a level feels hard, pause to think about which zombies are coming next and adjust your placement before you continue.
Play the early levels carefully to learn how each plant girl behaves, since that knowledge will help you in the later levels.
faq: What is the goal of Plant Girl Defense Zombie?
Your goal is to defeat all of the zombies in each of the 24 levels. You do this by placing plant girls who shoot at the zombies.
How do I control the game?
You play by clicking or tapping with your mouse or touch input. Click or tap to place and use your plant girls.

marble-factory.intro: Marble Factory is a sorting puzzle where you release colorful marbles down a 3D production line and steer each one into the box that matches its color. Watch the belt, because overflow ends the run.
tips: Before releasing a marble, check which box it matches and whether that box still has an open slot. Each color has only 3 slots, so filling one early can cause trouble later.
Let physics do the work by watching how a marble rolls before you commit to a move. Tumbling marbles can land in unexpected spots, so small timing changes matter.
Keep an eye on the spinning conveyor belt and act before it fills up. Once marbles pile up with no matching box in sight, the game is over.
Spread your attention across the trays, the belt, and the bottom boxes rather than focusing on one marble. Planning two or three moves ahead helps you avoid blockages.
Take your time on the harder puzzles, since the challenge increases as you go. Rushing is the most common reason a run ends early.
faq: What is the goal of Marble Factory?
Your goal is to sort each colored marble into its matching bottom box, with 3 slots available per color. You keep the production line moving without letting the belt overflow.
What causes the game to end?
The game ends when the conveyor belt overflows and there is no matching box available for the marbles on it. Acting early on the belt helps prevent this.

slide-blocks-3d.intro: Slide Blocks 3D is a sliding puzzle where scrambled picture pieces must be moved back into their frames before the timer runs out. Levels get bigger and trickier as you progress.
tips: Before you move anything, scan the board to find which pieces belong in the corners and along the edges of the picture, and place those first.
Look for pieces that already sit in the right area and try not to move them out of place while you work on the rest.
Save Hint for when you are truly stuck, since it highlights the right spot and can help you avoid wasted moves.
Use Undo right after a move that makes the board harder to read, so you can try a different slide without losing much time.
Keep an eye on the timer and pick up the easy placements first, so you do not run out of time on the trickier pieces near the end.
faq: What is the goal of Slide Blocks 3D?
Reassemble every colorful picture in its frame by sliding the blocks across the board. You must finish before time runs out.
How do I move the pieces?
Drag a piece with your mouse or finger to slide it across the board. Each piece moves into place by sliding it into the open space.

command-strike-fps-offline.intro: Command Strike FPS Offline is a 3D shooter where you clear each map by eliminating enemies while staying on the move. Use aiming, movement, and reloading together to stay alive.
tips: Keep moving with WASD instead of standing still, since enemies are trying to shoot you before you finish them.
Use right click to aim before you fire, especially when you are playing the sniper style of the game.
Use Ctrl to run when you need to cover ground quickly between fights, and save your steady aim for close or distant targets.
Press R to recharge when there is a safe moment, so you are not caught with an empty weapon during a fight.
Use Spacebar to jump when you need to change position or shift angle, since the game rewards shooting enemies from every direction.
faq: What is the main goal in Command Strike FPS Offline?
You need to finish each level by eliminating the enemies you come across while staying alive. Each removal brings you closer to finishing the map.
How do I shoot and aim?
Left click shoots and right click aims. Aiming first is useful when you want more precise shots.

el-clasico.intro: El Clasico is a football game where you pick Real or Barca and take part in the famous rivalry. Your job is to set up each shot well enough to win the match.
tips: Decide where you want the ball to go before you tap or click, and choose a clear target inside the goal.
Treat height and curve as separate choices. Try changing one at a time so you can see how each affects where the shot lands.
Use curve when a straight shot is likely to be blocked or easy to read, since bending the ball can change its path.
Keep a note of which shots worked and which missed, then adjust your direction and height on the next attempt.
Think about the scoreline and how much time is left, so you know whether a safe shot or a risky one makes more sense.
faq: How do I control my shot?
Tap or click to set the direction, height and curve of your shot. Each of these settings decides where the ball travels.
How do I choose a team?
At the start you choose either Real or Barca, and that team is the one you play as in El Clasico.

mini-chess.intro: Mini Chess is a set of small-board chess variants on 4×4 to 6×6 boards. Beat the AI to unlock the next board and collect stars across four difficulty levels.
tips: Open the Rules card before your first move on each board, since pawn double-steps and draw conditions change from one layout to the next.
Tap a piece first to see its legal moves, and count how many squares the enemy can reach before you commit to a move.
Clear a board on an easier level first to unlock the next one, then return to earn the extra stars from harder levels.
On a small board every piece is close to the action, so look for forks and attacks on the king before developing slowly.
Use Undo to test a line when you are unsure, but try to play each move as if you cannot take it back to build better habits.
faq: What is the goal of each game?
Capture the enemy king or checkmate it to win. The Rules card on each board explains any extra conditions, such as what counts as a draw.
How do I unlock the next board?
Win once on a board to unlock the next one in its group. Clearing a higher difficulty on the same board earns you additional stars.

block-sculptor.intro: Block Sculptor is a 3D puzzle where you remove the gray cubes around a hidden colored shape. Rotate the block, study it from every side, and avoid tapping the shape itself.
tips: Rotate the block and look at it from several angles before you tap anything, since gray cubes can hide behind others.
Only tap blocks you are sure are gray, because every mistake lowers your stars and coins.
Start with gray cubes that are clearly exposed on the outside, then rotate again to find the ones that were hidden.
Slow down as shapes grow larger, since the margin for error gets smaller as you progress.
Check the colored shape's edges from each side so you know exactly where it ends before you remove the next cube.
faq: How do I finish a level?
Remove all the gray blocks without tapping any colored blocks, and the hidden figure will be revealed.
What happens if I tap a colored block?
It counts as a mistake, and fewer mistakes earn you more stars and coins.

ultimate-car-driving-simulator-3d.intro: Ultimate Car Driving Simulator 3D is a racing game set in a large open world, where each vehicle handles differently. You can explore cities, deserts and off-road terrain in cars ranging from racers to 4WD trucks.
tips: Try several vehicle types early on, since the description says each car has its own physics. Racing cars and off-road SUVs will likely feel very different on the same road.
Spend time in the open world before chasing a specific goal. Cities, deserts and off-road areas each offer different surfaces to practice on.
Start slowly on off-road terrain to learn how your vehicle responds. Build up speed gradually once you have a feel for its grip and handling.
Use the customization options to make your car easier to spot while you drive. Vinyls and car parts are mainly for style, so experiment without worrying about wasting progress.
Turn up the sound and pay attention to the engine noise. Each car has its own recorded sound, which can help you tell how hard the engine is working.
faq: What is the goal of Ultimate Car Driving Simulator 3D?
The game is open-ended, so you decide what to do in the large open world. You can drive, explore and customize your car however you like.
How do I control the car?
The game is played with the keyboard. Check the in-game instructions for the exact key layout before you start driving.

boxes-fright-night.intro: Boxes Fright Night is a Halloween puzzle adventure where you guide colorful Boxes characters to collect all the missing pumpkins. You move, jump, and rotate the Boxes using physics to get past obstacles.
tips: Before acting, look at the whole level and work out where each pumpkin is and which Box can reach it.
Experiment with small moves first, like a single jump or rotation, to see how the physics respond before committing to a longer sequence.
If a puzzle stalls, try a different Box or a different order of actions rather than repeating the same move.
Pay attention to how the obstacles are placed, since many levels hint at the route you need to take.
Take short breaks between tricky levels so you can come back and spot the solution with fresh eyes.
faq: What is the goal of Boxes Fright Night?
Your goal is to help the Boxes characters collect all the missing pumpkins in each level. Solving the puzzle and getting past obstacles is how you reach them.
How do I control the Boxes?
Use mouse clicks or taps to play. Clicks or taps are used to move, jump, and rotate the Boxes.

collection-shuffle.intro: Collection Shuffle is a summer-themed puzzle where you rearrange colourful items into matching groups. Each level gives you a limited number of moves, so every shuffle counts.
tips: Before each move, check which card will be pushed out of the bottom of the column, since it returns to the spot you selected.
Look at the whole board first and find the collection with the fewest pieces out of place, then build your plan around it.
Because one move shifts several cards at once, try a move on paper or in your head and check the new positions before you commit.
Keep your moves few and deliberate, since you cannot undo your way out of a wasted move on a limited count.
There is no time pressure, so take a break and come back with fresh eyes when a level stops making sense.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You need to complete every required collection of matching summer items before you run out of moves.
What happens when I insert a card into a column?
The new card pushes every card in that column downward, and the bottom card is pushed out and returns to the position of the card you selected.

valentines-day-couple.intro: Dress up a boy and a girl for a Valentine's Day date. This dress-up game uses any pointing device, so you can play with a mouse or a touch screen.
tips: Pick an overall look for the date first, such as a casual or dressy style, then build each outfit so the two characters match.
Try each option on both characters before settling on a final look, so the couple's outfits complement each other.
Use the pointing device steadily and check each change on screen before moving on to the next part of the look.
Work from one character to the other in a set order so you do not miss any part of either outfit before you finish.
faq: How do I control the game?
Use any pointing device, such as a mouse or a touch screen. The game is played by pointing and selecting.
What is the goal of Valentines Day Couple?
The goal is to dress up the boy and the girl for their Valentine's Day date. Your choices decide how the couple looks for the date.

pool-float-party.intro: Pool Float Party is a dress-up and cooking game where you help two friends get a private pool ready for a summer party. You clean the area, make mojitos, then style each girl and choose her look and raft.
tips: Finish the pool area and the cocktails before you start on the girls' looks, since the description suggests the styling comes once everything is ready.
Pick one colour direction for each girl early, pink shades for Blondie and red, black and polka dots for Marie, so her swimsuit, pareo and accessories match.
Try a few swimsuit and pareo combinations before settling on an outfit, because the options are varied and it is easy to pick the first one you see.
Choose the inflatable raft last, once the outfits are set, so you can pick a shape that suits the overall look of the party.
Look at the finished scene before you save it, since the result is saved as a PNG image and any adjustments are easier to make before you export.
faq: What is the goal of Pool Float Party?

The goal is to help Blondie and Marie get ready for a pool party by cleaning the area, making a mojito, styling their makeup and outfits, and picking a raft. The game ends with a finished scene you can save.
How do I control the game?
Control depends on your device. On a computer you use mouse clicks, and on a touchscreen you use simple taps.

connect-words-2026.intro: Connect Words 2026 is a word puzzle game with many mini-game types across 1,500+ levels. You connect letters to form words, fill in crosswords, and use hints when stuck.
tips: Scan the whole letter circle before you start connecting. Spotting common endings like -ing, -ed, or -er can help you find longer words quickly.
Work on the crossword grid as you go. Each word you solve can give you a letter pattern that helps with the words that cross it.
Save the light bulb hint for when you are truly stuck. Try a few different letter combinations first so you keep improving your word-finding skills.
Switch to a different mini-game type when one starts to feel slow. Variety is part of the design, so a short break from one style can refresh your focus.
Play in short sessions at your own pace. The game is designed to be relaxing, so a few levels at a time is an easy everyday habit.
faq: How do I play Connect Words 2026?
Connect the letters in the circle at the bottom to make words, then use those words to fill in the crossword. The game also includes other word mini-games.
What do I do if I get stuck on a level?
Tap the light bulb to get a hint. Try a few combinations on your own first if you want to keep practicing.

bee-colony.intro: Bee Colony is an adventure game about defending your territory from waves of monsters. You manage weapons, armor, and supplies in a limited backpack, and each choice affects how well you survive.
tips: Plan your backpack before each fight, since space is limited and every item you add takes room from something else.
Balance your gear between weapons, armor, and supplies instead of loading up on one type, so you are not caught without defense.
Drag items with the left mouse button to rearrange them, and try a few different setups to see which one holds up against the waves.
Pay attention to the kind of monsters coming in each wave and adjust your gear to match, rather than keeping the same setup throughout.
As you move into later chapters, expect stronger foes and new challenges, so review your loadout at the start of each chapter.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
The goal is to survive waves of monsters and defend your territory while progressing through chapters. Each wave brings tougher foes.
How do I move items around?
Press and hold the left mouse button while dragging to move items to where you want them.

rainbow-obby.intro: Rainbow Obby is a 3D arcade obstacle course where you guide a character across gaps, platforms and traps. Collect bonuses to jump higher and fly short distances past tough sections.
tips: Learn the jump timing early, since most falls happen when a jump is started too late or too short.
Use the mouse to look ahead before each jump so you can line up with the next platform.
Save power-ups for the hardest obstacles, such as wide gaps, instead of using them on easy sections.
Move slowly near edges and traps, then speed up once you are on solid ground.
If you fall, try the same section again with a steady rhythm rather than rushing through it.
faq: How do I move and jump in Rainbow Obby?
On a computer, use WASD to move and the space bar to jump, and use the mouse to control the camera. On mobile, use the movement and camera joysticks along with the jump button.
What do bonuses do in this game?
Bonuses act as power-ups that let you jump higher or fly short distances. They help you get past obstacles and avoid dangers.

kitty-cat-merge.intro: Kitty Cat Merge is a puzzle game where you drop cats onto a play area and combine matching ones to make bigger, fluffier breeds. Your aim is to keep merging and build the highest score you can.
tips: Before you release a cat, look at where it will land and whether it will touch a matching cat. Good placement is what turns a drop into a merge.
Keep the middle of the play area clear so your cats have room to meet and combine.
Merge as soon as a matching pair is available. Waiting too long can leave cats stuck in the way.
Spread different cat types out rather than stacking them in one spot, so you always have a legal place to drop the next cat.
Plan one or two moves ahead by checking which cats are most likely to appear next and where they could fit.
faq: How do I drop a cat?
Tap and drag to aim where the cat will land, then release to drop it. Aim carefully, since the cat falls to the spot you chose.
How do I earn points?
You earn points by merging matching cats into bigger, fluffier kitties. Keep merging to add to your score.

scrap-arms-neo.intro: SCRAP ARMS NEO is a pixel-art roguelite shooter where your weapons fire on their own. Collect weapons, pick upgrades at each level-up, and survive waves of scrap monsters and bosses.
tips: Your weapons attack automatically, so spend your attention on moving to safe ground and swapping weapons rather than aiming.
Watch your weapon stack for ones close to breaking, since a broken weapon explodes. Swap or drop them before they go off near you.
