Choose level-up upgrades that strengthen the weapons you already use most, instead of spreading picks across the whole stack.
Save Full Burst for a crowded wave or a boss fight, when a big burst of damage matters most.
Pick your character with their unique skill in mind, and try a few different ones to see which playstyle suits you.
faq: What is the goal of SCRAP ARMS NEO?
Survive waves of scrap monsters and bosses across the stages. Surviving weapons carry over so you can spend your score on the weapon gacha.
How do I drop a weapon I no longer want?
Press X, right-click, or drag its weapon slot upward. You can also switch weapons with the mouse wheel or by tapping a slot.

ninja-rabbit.intro: Ninja Rabbit is an arcade superhero game where you guide a rabbit on a journey to fight monsters and rescue the children taken from the village. Tap the screen to control direction.
tips: Read the direction you are heading before each tap, since every tap changes where the rabbit goes.
Keep your taps steady rather than rapid, so you can react to monsters as they come closer.
Watch the monsters' movement for a few seconds before acting, so you can plan a safe route.
Start each new attempt by getting comfortable with the tap controls, then focus on the harder parts of the journey.
If you get stuck, pause for a moment and look at the whole screen to find an open path.
faq: What is the goal of Ninja Rabbit?
You play as a ninja rabbit who sets out to fight monsters that have taken the children from the village. Your aim is to get through the challenge and reach the children.
How do I control the rabbit?
Tap the screen to control the direction the rabbit moves. Each tap sets where it goes next.

valentines-mahjong-deluxe.intro: Valentines Mahjong Deluxe is a classic mahjong puzzle with Valentine's Day tiles and multiple levels. Your goal is to match identical tiles in pairs until the board is cleared.
tips: Scan the whole board before you tap anything so you can spot matching pairs across the layout.
Start with tiles that look like they are blocking others, since clearing them can open up new options.
Tap a tile to select it, then check the second tile carefully before you commit to the pair.
Look for the Valentine's Day tiles and remember where their matches are, so you do not lose track of pairs as the board thins out.
Take your time on harder levels and avoid rushing, because a careless match can leave you with tiles you cannot pair.
faq: What is the goal of Valentines Mahjong Deluxe?
The goal is to eliminate identical tiles in pairs until you have collected all the tiles on the board.
How do I select a tile?
Tap the tile once to select it, then tap its matching identical tile to remove the pair.

construction-set-3d-builder.intro: Construction Set - 3D Builder is a building puzzle where you assemble 3D structures piece by piece. It is a calm game for planning and constructing at your own pace.
tips: Start with a wide, sturdy base before adding height, since the physics engine rewards stable foundations.
Keep heavier or larger pieces low in the structure so the upper parts have support.
Use zoom often to check that each piece sits level and fully supported before you move on.
Build in small sections and test each one, so a mistake doesn't force you to rebuild everything.
Try different themes to see how their structures vary, and use that to plan your own designs.
faq: How do I select a piece?
On PC, use the left mouse button to choose a piece. On mobile, tap the piece you want.
How do I zoom in to inspect my build?
On PC, use the right mouse button to zoom. On mobile, double tap and hold to zoom.

bonkhalla.intro: Bonkhalla is a survival battler where your weapons fire automatically and your job is to move, dodge, and build a strong loadout before the clock runs out. Each run plays out across three biomes and ends with a final boss.
tips: Keep moving and treat dodging as your main job, since your weapons already attack on their own.
When you level up, pick upgrades that fit your current weapons rather than grabbing something new every time, so your build stays focused.
Work toward level 5 on a weapon that has a matching tome, because that combination is what unlocks its evolution.
Break pots and open chests as you pass them for loot, and step into shrines when you need a temporary boost.
Plan around the 10-minute limit: deal with mini-bosses as they come up, because the Final Storm begins if you run out of time before defeating the final boss.
faq: What is the main goal of a run?
Survive for 10 minutes and defeat the final boss before time runs out. If you do not beat the boss in time, the Final Storm begins.
How do I unlock a weapon evolution?
Bring a weapon to level 5 and pick the matching tome when you level up. The Sword, Fireball, and Lightning each have a powerful evolution this way.

mad-truck-driving.intro: Mad Truck Driving is a 2D racing game where you drive a powerful truck through obstacles and challenges, smashing cars along the way. Your goal is to get through the levels.
tips: Use W, A, S and D to move in all four directions, so you can change course quickly when an obstacle appears.
Don't worry about cars ahead of you. Line up your truck with them and smash them, since they are the main targets in this game.
Scan the path ahead for obstacles and plan your route around them before you reach them.
Keep an eye on how you approach each obstacle. Slowing down a little before a tricky section can help you avoid mistakes.
If you get stuck on a level, try a different route or approach it from another direction instead of repeating the same move.
faq: What is the goal of Mad Truck Driving?
Your goal is to drive your truck through the different obstacles and challenges and complete each level.
How do I control the truck?
Use the W, A, S and D keys to drive in four directions.

narutovsbleach.intro: NARUTO vs BLEACH is a side-scrolling anime fighting game with smooth movement, recognizable character skills, and combos that flow together. Your attacks build energy toward powerful super skills.
tips: Keep your character active, since energy builds up as you operate characters, so standing still wastes chances to charge your super.
Watch your energy level and plan your super skill for the moment it is full, so you release it when you can land it.
Link skills into combos to keep your attacks flowing, which keeps pressure on and helps you build energy faster.
Practice each character's skills to learn which ones work best up close and which work at a distance.
Use movement to reposition in the side-scrolling space before attacking, rather than trading hits in one spot.
faq: How do I fill the energy needed for super skills?
Energy builds up at the same time as you operate your character and use skills. Once the energy is full, a super skill can be released.
What makes combos work well in this game?
The game is built around smooth movement and seamless combos, so chaining skills one after another keeps your attacks flowing.

mine-keeper.intro: Mine Keeper is a top-down kingdom simulation where you play as a dwarf lord. You build a town, feed your people, and send your dwarven army into the mines for stones and gems.
tips: Keep your people fed by collecting fruit and selling it early, since food is what lets your kingdom grow.
Upgrade houses as soon as you can afford them so more residents can move in and work.
Balance your spending between facilities and the military so you are not left without soldiers when monsters appear.
Bring troops with you before entering the deep mines, because monsters there can attack you.
Hire farmers before you need them so food production keeps pace as your population increases.
faq: What is the main goal of Mine Keeper?
Your goal is to grow your dwarven kingdom by building a town, caring for your people, and building up your military. Mining for stones and gems supports that growth.
How do I move around the map on PC?
Use the WASD or arrow keys, or drag with the left mouse button to move around. On mobile, use the in-game joystick.

pongoal.intro: PONGOAL mixes classic Pong paddle play with penalty shootout football. Defend your goal, outplay your opponent, and be the first to reach the winning score against AI or a friend.
tips: Start on an AI difficulty level that lets you track the ball comfortably, then move up once you can keep up with its speed and angle.
Move toward where the ball will be, not where it is right now. Starting early gives you time to set up a save.
On touch devices, hold the UP or DOWN button for long moves across the goal, and tap briefly when you only need a small adjustment.
In local multiplayer, watch which side your friend tends to leave open and aim your shots there.
Use the keyboard arrows or W and S for quick, precise paddle movement on desktop, and keep your paddle ready near the centre of your goal between shots.
faq: How do I win a match in PONGOAL?
The first player to reach the winning score wins the match. You do this by defending your goal and scoring past your opponent.
How do I move my paddle on a computer?
Press the UP ARROW or W key to move the paddle up, and the DOWN ARROW or S key to move it down.

tile-match-camp.intro: Tile Match Camp is a relaxed triple-match puzzle set in outdoor camping scenes. You clear levels by collecting three identical tiles at a time until the board is empty.
tips: Tap tiles with care, since each one you select moves into the collection tray. Before tapping, check whether that tile has a matching partner you can reach soon.
Keep the tray in mind at all times. It has limited space, so avoid filling it with single tiles that have no matches in sight.
Look for tiles that are close to being matched, such as a color you already have two of in the tray, and prioritize completing those sets.
Pause to scan the whole board before each move. Clearing some tiles can uncover new ones, so a quick look often reveals the best order to work through the level.
If a level starts to feel crowded, focus on finishing the colors you already have in the tray before opening up new ones.
faq: What is the main goal in Tile Match Camp?
Your goal is to match all tiles on the board to complete each level. You do this by collecting three identical tiles to remove them from play.
What happens if the collection tray fills up?
The tray has limited space, so if it fills with tiles that cannot be matched, you can run out of room to move. Choosing tiles carefully helps you avoid this.

find-visitors-99-nights.intro: Find Visitors - 99 Nights is a mouse-controlled hidden object game set in a forest refuge. You manage the refuge, welcoming forest creatures and spotting the hidden visitors among them.
tips: Open the Rules button early and check it often, since the game recommends reviewing it for a better experience.
Look closely at teeth. Perfectly white teeth and blood on the teeth are both signs of a visitor.
Check eyes and movement together. A red-white eye, a rapidly moving pupil, or a creature that is not moving can all point to a visitor.
Study the aura photo for a red spot, since that is another sign to watch for before you decide.
Do not rush a decision. Compare several signs on the same creature before you welcome it in or drive it away.
faq: What is the goal of Find Visitors - 99 Nights?
Your goal is to manage the forest refuge by letting forest dwellers in and driving visitors away. You do this by identifying hidden monsters that are visitors.
How do I control the game?
All actions are made with the mouse or a finger. The game can be customized to suit your preferred control method.

funny-ragdoll-wrestlers.intro: Funny Ragdoll Wrestlers is a physics-style fighting game for one or two players. Each fight is played until one wrestler scores 5 wins, so every point counts.
tips: Learn the controls for both players before a match starts, since each player uses a different set of keys for moving, punching and head hits.
Punching is split between the A and D keys for Player 1, so practice switching between them quickly to keep up your attack.
Use forward and backward movement to control distance, and avoid standing still in one spot for too long.
Try the head hit at different moments during a fight to see when it works best against your opponent.
If you are playing two player, take turns watching each other's movements to spot patterns you can use to score points.
faq: How do you win a match in Funny Ragdoll Wrestlers?
In each fight, the first wrestler to score 5 wins takes the match. Keep track of your score as you go.
Which keys control Player 1?
Player 1 moves forward and backward with W and S, punches with A and D, and does a head hit with E.

stack-sort.intro: Stack Sort is a colour puzzle where you rearrange a grid of mixed-up blocks until each column holds only one colour. It starts simple and gets harder as you progress.
tips: Scan the whole board before you move anything and note where each colour sits. Knowing the position of every block helps you plan a route to a clean column.
Look for a column that already holds mostly one colour and clear the stray blocks out of it first. Building on a nearly finished stack is easier than starting a new one.
Avoid burying a block you will need soon. When a colour is under several others, moving those blocks away first can save many extra moves.
Keep an empty or nearly empty column available as a spare space. It gives you room to set blocks aside while you reorganise the rest.
If you get stuck, stop and rethink the layout instead of making random moves. Spatial planning is what the harder puzzles reward.
faq: What is the goal of Stack Sort?
You need to reorganise the board so that every column, or stack, contains blocks of only one matching colour.
How do I know a puzzle is solved?
The puzzle is complete when each colour has its own stack and no column mixes colours.

bike-stunts-2024.intro: Bike Stunts 2024 is an action driving game where you choose a bike, complete levels, and earn enough progress to buy a new one. It includes 40 levels and is designed to be played in a mobile browser.
tips: Pick a bike you can handle comfortably before you start, since you will be driving through every level with it.
Finish earlier levels to work toward buying a new bike, so plan which levels you want to clear first.
Use short, steady inputs with WASD on a computer so you keep control of the bike on jumps and tricky stretches.
On mobile, get used to the on-screen buttons on a few easy levels before you try the harder ones.
If a level keeps ending the same way, pause and change your approach instead of repeating the same run.
faq: What is the goal of Bike Stunts 2024?
Your goal is to complete levels, which lets you buy a new bike. The game includes 40 levels to work through.
How do I drive the bike on a computer?
Use the WASD keys to drive. Keep your inputs steady so you stay in control during stunts.

paws-and-paths.intro: Paws & Paths is a match-style puzzle where you link matching cats, bears, and rabbits to hit goals across 50 levels. Each level asks you to finish the goals before your moves run out.
tips: Before you drag, scan the board for chains that can reach four or more animals, since those launch extra paws that can clear tricky areas.
Pay attention to the goals above the board and spend moves on the animals that count toward them first.
Clear the animals sitting next to numbered ice early, because breaking the ice opens up more space to work with.
Metal blocks never move, so plan routes that go around them instead of waiting for them to clear.
Use Undo when a move leaves you with a poor board, and save Hint for levels where you are truly stuck.
faq: What is the goal of Paws & Paths?
Collect the goals shown above the board by linking matching animals before you run out of moves. Each of the 50 levels has its own set of goals.
How do I make a match?
Click and drag across neighboring animals of the same kind, then release to collect the chain. New animals will drop in to fill the gaps.

box-tap-sort.intro: Box Tap Sort is a head-to-head 3D color puzzle. Tap exposed cubes that match your active color orders, avoid filling your holding bin, and clear more puzzles than your rival before the timer ends.
tips: Before each tap, check the three color orders at the bottom and pick cubes that match one of them. Taps on the wrong color fill your holding bin, so slow down and look first.
Drag to rotate the stack and scroll or pinch to zoom in. Turning the structure can reveal cubes hidden on the far side, so look for exposed cubes from several angles.
Keep an eye on how many slots of the 7 are filled. When the bin is nearly full, favor taps that clear matching cubes rather than risky guesses.
Use the count shown on each color order to plan. Focus on the color that needs the fewest remaining cubes so you can finish it quickly.
Remember that you must clear the whole structure to finish a puzzle. Work steadily through each stack, since rushing a puzzle to save time can cost you a reset.
faq: How do I win a match?
Clear more puzzles than your rival before the 90-second timer ends. Finishing a structure means removing every cube from it.
What happens if I tap the wrong color?
The cube goes to your holding bin, which has 7 slots. If all 7 slots fill, the current puzzle resets and you lose the progress on it.

rolling-cheese.intro: Rolling Cheese is a mouse-controlled puzzle game where you clear a path so the cheese reaches the hungry mouse. Each of the 24 levels rewards you for collecting strawberries and earning stars.
tips: Before clicking anything, look at the whole level and trace the path the cheese will take to the mouse.
Click breakable objects only when you are sure they are in the way, since removing the wrong one can block your route.
Go for the strawberries on each puzzle, as collecting up to 3 of them adds to your points.
If a level stalls, reset your thinking and try a different order of clicks rather than repeating the same move.
Aim for 3 stars on the earlier levels first so you can spot patterns that help with the harder puzzles later.
faq: What is the goal of Rolling Cheese?
Get the cheese to the starving mouse to solve each level. Clicking breakable objects clears the way.
How do I destroy objects in the way?
Click or tap the breakable objects to destroy them. You can use your mouse or tap the screen.

cutter-woodsman-game.intro: Cutter Woodsman is a casual adventure where you chop through forest areas with an axe. Cut down trees, gather wood, and finish each level as the challenges grow.
tips: Watch the rhythm of your cuts before you commit, since the game rewards careful timing over rushing.
Keep moving forward instead of lingering in one spot, because the goal is to work through the forest.
Collect the wood you cut each time, so you do not lose track of progress needed to complete a level.
Pay attention when you reach a tougher area, and slow down slightly to make sure your next cut lands cleanly.
Use single, deliberate clicks or taps, since the controls are simple and mashing input does not add anything.
faq: What is the main goal of Cutter Woodsman?
Your goal is to chop your way through the forest by cutting down trees and collecting wood. Completing each level moves you forward.
How do I control the axe?
Play uses only mouse clicks or taps. Use them to make your cuts at the right moment.

baby-taylor-bed-time.intro: Help Baby Taylor get ready for bed in this calm bedtime game. You will brush her teeth, give her a bath, set up her bed, and read a story before she falls asleep.
tips: Follow the bedtime order from start to finish: brushing teeth and bathing come first, then the bed setup, then the story. Going in order helps each step feel natural.
Take your time with the bath and teeth brushing, since these are the first steps of the routine. Rushing them can make the rest of the night feel out of order.
When setting up the bed, place Taylor's favorite toys at the sides so the room feels cozy. Look at the whole scene before you finish, so nothing is left out.
Pick a story that Taylor would enjoy, because the game lets you choose it before sleep. Think about which story fits a sleepy, relaxed mood.
Keep a steady pace and enjoy the quiet moments at the end, when Taylor is ready to sleep. Watching the calm finish is part of the experience.
faq: What is the goal of Baby Taylor Bed Time?
The goal is to get Baby Taylor ready for bed. You do this by brushing her teeth, bathing her, setting up her bed with her favorite toys, and telling a story of her choice.
How do I control the game?
Use a mouse click or tap on the screen to play. Click or tap the items and actions you want to use during each bedtime step.

mellow-escape.intro: Mellow Escape is a relaxed sliding puzzle where you move blocks to clear a path for a small blue character and guide it to the exit. There are no timers, so you can take each level at your own pace.
tips: Before moving anything, look at which blocks sit directly between the blue character and the exit, since those are the ones you need to clear.
Try to plan a few moves ahead so you do not have to shift the same block back and forth, which wastes moves.
Aim for fewer moves on levels you have already solved if you want more stars, but do not worry about it on first attempts.
If you get stuck, try moving blocks that are farther from the path first to see how the board opens up.
Collect coins as you go, since they help you unlock new themes and character skins.
faq: How do I move the blocks?
On desktop, drag blocks with the mouse. On a mobile device, touch and swipe the blocks across the board.
What is the goal of each level?
Clear a path for the blue character and guide it to the exit. Completing this finishes the level.

gun-and-roll.intro: Gun and Roll is a shooting game where you steer a rolling object, upgrade its shape, and improve your gun by picking doors and cards. Your goal is to pass each level by choosing the right upgrades.
tips: Steer with steady movements so your roller avoids obstacles while you collect upgrades.
Read each door before you pass through it, since choosing the correct door is how you improve yourself in a level.
Pick up cards that strengthen your gun early, so you can clear enemies and objects more easily later in the level.
Watch how your roller changes shape after an upgrade and adjust your movement to suit its new form.
If a level gets difficult, go back to basics: focus on dodging first, then shooting, and keep your upgrades in mind.
faq: What is the main goal of Gun and Roll?
Your goal is to pass each level by rolling your object, improving it, and using your gun to shoot objects. Picking the correct doors helps you move forward.
How do I control my roller and gun?
You use your mouse or finger to control both the roller object and the gun. Move to avoid obstacles and aim to shoot targets.

rat-s-house-nonogram.intro: Rat's House is a nonogram puzzle game where you fill in number-clued grids to reveal hidden pictures. Solved levels earn Cheese, which you spend on furniture for your rats' rooms.
tips: Start with the rows and columns that have the largest numbers or the fewest gaps, since those clues usually force the most cells.
Mark cells you know are empty with an X as you go, so you can see at a glance which spaces are still open.
Use the Spacebar to switch between painting and marking mode often, rather than clicking the wrong tool and undoing moves.
Check each row and column against its clue after a few moves to catch mistakes early, before they cost you a life.
Save hints for cells you are truly stuck on, since you have a limited number of lives and hints are there to help you avoid losing them.
faq: How do I win a level?
Fill in the correct cells according to the number clues until the hidden picture is revealed.
What happens if I make mistakes?
Three mistakes will cost you a life, so take your time and double-check your clues before filling cells.

jigsaw-puzzle-game.intro: A calm, classic jigsaw puzzle game for thoughtful play. Work through relaxing puzzles that build concentration, memory, and logical thinking, with clean visuals and smooth controls.
tips: Begin by sorting out the edge pieces so you have a clear frame to build from.
Group the remaining pieces by color or pattern before you start fitting them together, which makes matches easier to spot.
Focus on one area of the picture at a time instead of scanning the whole board, so your attention stays on a small set of pieces.
If you get stuck, step away for a moment and come back with fresh eyes. Patience usually works better than rushing.
Use the mouse to click any buttons in the game, so you can move through the puzzles without distraction.
faq: What is the goal of Jigsaw Puzzle Game?
The goal is to put the jigsaw pieces together to complete each picture. Each puzzle is a relaxing challenge designed to build focus and logic.
How do I control the game?
Use the mouse to click any buttons. The controls are designed to be smooth and simple to follow.

puppet-killer.intro: Puppet Killer is a 3D action game built around a gun and a simple goal: take out a puppet. It is designed as a relaxed way to blow off some stress, and the mouse is all you need.
tips: Use the mouse to get a steady aim before you fire, since precise aiming is what the game is built around.
Take your time between shots rather than rushing, so each action feels deliberate and the session stays relaxing.
Try different angles on the puppet to see how it reacts, which can make the experience more engaging.
Play in short sessions when you feel tense, since the game works best as a quick stress break.
Pay attention to the weapon mechanics, as the game is tagged with guns and weapons and handling them well is the core of play.
faq: What is the goal of Puppet Killer?
The goal is to kill a puppet. The game is described as a fun anti-stress experience centered on that action.
How do I control the game?
You control everything with the mouse. No other controls are listed in the instructions.

gang-brawlers.intro: Gang Brawlers is a 3D street fighting action game for one or two players. You clear the streets by punching, kicking, and picking up items, either alone or against a friend.
tips: Break boxes early on, since they are a source of items you can pick up from the ground for use in fights.
Collect coins whenever you can, because they are what you need to spend in the store on upgrades for your character.
Use Defend when an enemy is about to hit you, then counter with a punch or kick once the attack has passed.
In two-player mode, split up tasks: one player can focus on clearing enemies while the other grabs coins and boxes.
Jump is useful for reaching items and dodging, so practice mixing jumps with punches and kicks rather than standing still.
faq: What is the goal of Gang Brawlers?
You move through the dangerous streets destroying boxes, picking up items, and fighting evil enemies. You can also battle a friend in the 2P fighting mode.
How do I attack in the game?
Player 1 uses F to punch and G to kick, while Player 2 uses K to punch and L to kick. Defend is T for Player 1 and O for Player 2.

hexa-jump-asmr.intro: Hexa Jump ASMR is an arcade game where you guide a ball down colorful spiral platforms while avoiding traps and obstacles. One wrong move ends the run, and you start again from the beginning.
tips: Use short, deliberate clicks or taps so you can control when the ball drops through each gap.
Look ahead at the next section of the spiral before you commit, so you can plan your route early.
Stay calm and focus on one obstacle at a time instead of rushing, since a single mistake ends the run.
Pay attention to the colors and patterns of the platforms, which help you spot safe paths and traps sooner.
Practice short sessions to build a feel for the timing, then try longer runs once your reactions feel steady.
faq: What is the goal of Hexa Jump ASMR?
You guide a ball down colorful spiral platforms and try to get as far as you can without hitting a trap or obstacle.
What controls does the game use?
You play with mouse clicks or taps. The instructions do not mention any other controls.

baker-city-family-bakery.intro: Baker City: Family Bakery is a cozy cooking simulation where you run a bakery, merge ingredients into better treats, and fill customer orders. Growing your shop means balancing the kitchen, the city map, and your daily goals.
tips: Click your oven and other generators often early on, since flour, dough, and ingredients are the base for every merge.
Before merging, look at the customer orders so you know which higher-level treats you need and don't waste space on items you won't use.
Keep your kitchen space clear by merging small items into bigger ones regularly, so you always have room for new ingredients.
Check your daily goals at the start of each session and plan your merges around them to earn coins and fame faster.
Before starting a timed delivery, make sure you have the items it needs ready, so you can move quickly once the clock starts.
faq: What is the main goal of Baker City?
Your goal is to grow your family bakery into the city's favorite spot by completing customer orders and building your reputation.
How do I make higher-level treats?
Drag two matching items together in the kitchen to merge them into a higher-level treat.

mushroom-hunting-forest-search.intro: Mushroom Hunting: Forest Search is a calm hidden object game set in birch groves, spruce forests, and overgrown meadows. You search the grass for mushrooms, check their descriptions, and decide which ones to keep.
tips: Read each mushroom's description before choosing basket or pass, since poisonous species are mixed in with edible ones.
Tap any suspicious spot in the grass, because mushrooms can be partly hidden among leaves and blades.
Check the villagers' quests before you sell so you know which mushrooms to keep for them.
Sell your harvest at the market regularly, since selling is how you unlock new forest locations.
When you are unsure about a mushroom, pass on it rather than risk a poisonous find.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Your goal is to find mushrooms hidden among leaves and grass, decide whether to keep them, and use your harvest to complete quests and unlock new forest areas.
How do I avoid poisonous mushrooms?
Study each mushroom's description carefully before you decide. If a description leaves you unsure, choose to pass.

car-sky-stunts.intro: Car Sky Stunts is a racing game built around mega ramps and impossible tracks, where you drive several sports cars and try stunts. This guide covers practical habits for staying in control on the ramps.
tips: Before you attempt a ramp, try a slow approach first to learn how the car reacts to the launch and how far it travels.
Keep your car pointed straight before the jump, since a sideways landing is more likely to end your run.
Use the keyboard controls to make small, steady adjustments in the air rather than sudden large inputs.
Try different cars on the same track, because each one handles differently and some will suit the ramps better than others.
If you are chasing a high score in the endless racing mode, focus on clean landings first and let speed build from there.
faq: What is the main goal of Car Sky Stunts?
You race over impossible tracks and perform stunts on mega ramps, with the aim of driving through the course and completing each run successfully.
How do I control the car?
The game uses keyboard controls. Check the controls shown in the game before your first run so you know how to steer, accelerate and handle the car in the air.

art-n-ball.intro: Art'N Ball mixes classic tennis with a 3D platform adventure. You keep an Earth-ball in play through twisting gallery hallways until you reach the boss at the end of each three-act level.
tips: Watch the Earth-ball's trajectory early so you can choose the return angle that gets it past walls and obstacles.
Decide when to push the ball forward and when to stop for puzzles or screenshots, since a level can be finished faster or ranked higher depending on that choice.
Collect bonuses when they are safe to reach, because they help your score and level ranking.
Treat maluses as chances: completing the missing blocks of a puzzle or hitting a final screenshot can earn back an extra life.
Slow down in narrow sections of the hallway to plan your next return, and speed up where the path widens.
faq: What is the main goal of Art'N Ball?
Keep the Earth-ball in play by returning it with your racket, get through each gallery level, and defeat the boss at the end of the three acts to exit the gallery.
How can I earn extra lives?
Complete the missing blocks of an image puzzle or hit a final screenshot after a malus, since these can turn into a chance to retrieve an extra life.

grass-rush-adventure.intro: Grass Rush Adventure is a colorful clicker where you cut grass, collect treasures across six worlds, and sell your finds to grow stronger. This guide covers controls, upgrades, and habits that help you progress.
tips: Keep an eye on your backpack and sell when it gets full, so your swings keep collecting instead of stalling.
Spend your gold on upgrades that match how you play, such as cutting range if you clear areas slowly or pickup reach if you spend time chasing items.
Cutting starts automatically near grass, so position yourself in dense patches and move between them instead of standing still.
Try the Daily Garden when you have time, since it is described as treasure-filled and may be worth checking each visit.
Work through Magic Plant quests alongside normal cutting, because they can point you toward new areas and finds to pursue.
faq: What is the main goal of Grass Rush Adventure?
Cut grass, uncover rare treasures, and sell your finds to buy stronger tools and upgrades. Over time you aim to push further through the six worlds.
How do I sell the items I collect?
Open your backpack with B, then press S to sell all items while the backpack is open. Selling clears space and gives you gold for upgrades.

robot-wars.intro: Robot Wars is a puzzle battle game where you draw your own chariot with your finger and use it to fight an enemy. You can mix attack styles and switch the battle background before you fight.
tips: Before you fight, look at how your drawn chariot is shaped, since its design is what you bring into battle.
Try a few different drawings to see which shapes you find easiest to control in the physics-based fights.
Click the screen at different moments, because the game offers several ways to attack and you can learn which timing works for your chariot.
Switch the background to see how your creation looks in different settings, then pick the one you enjoy fighting in most.
Use each fight to test one change at a time, such as a different chariot shape or attack timing, so you can tell what helped.
faq: What is the goal of Robot Wars?
Draw a chariot with your finger, then use it to fight your enemy. Your design and your attacks decide how the battle goes.
How do I attack in Robot Wars?
Click the screen to attack your enemy. The game has several attack methods, so try different clicks to see what works best.

army-vehicle-transporting.intro: Army Vehicle Transporting is an action driving game about moving military vehicles such as tanks, armored personnel carriers, and jeeps from one location to another. The PC version uses WASD and C, and mobile players use on-screen buttons.
tips: Think of each vehicle's size and weight before you start moving, since the description notes these create unique challenges.
Take slow, steady steps with your controls at the start so you can learn how your vehicle responds before going faster.
Press C to change the camera when you need a better view of your surroundings, especially before turning or reversing.
On mobile, get comfortable with where each on-screen button is before you start driving so you do not hunt for controls under pressure.
Plan your route ahead of time, because careful planning is central to moving military vehicles safely.
faq: What is the goal of Army Vehicle Transporting?
The goal is to move military vehicles such as tanks, armored personnel carriers, and jeeps from one location to another.
How do I drive on PC?
Use the WASD keys to drive your vehicle on the PC version.

ninja-survival-simulator.intro: Ninja Survival Simulator is a 3D adventure through trap-filled levels with enemies, puzzles, zombies, and bosses. You move your ninja with WASD or by swiping across the screen.
tips: Study each new area before you move. Watch where the traps and mechanisms trigger so you can time your route between them.
Move in short, controlled steps rather than rushing. Speed helps, but careless movement is what usually leads to deadly mechanisms.
Pay attention to enemy patterns and take fights one at a time when you can. Learning how zombies and bosses move makes their attacks easier to dodge.
Treat puzzles as a pause point. Look at the whole room first, then plan the order of your moves before you act.
Upgrade your character and unlock new weapons as you progress. Think about which upgrade fits your play style, since later challenges get harder.
faq: How do I move the ninja?
Use the WASD keys on a keyboard, or slide your finger across the screen to control movement.
What makes the later levels harder?
The game describes increasingly difficult challenges, so each level asks for more focus and skill than the last. Slowing down to read the layout helps most.

indian-taxi-2020.intro: Indian Taxi 2020 is a driving game where you pick up passengers around a city and drop them at their destinations. You steer a taxi along city roads and up hills and mountains, using WASD or the arrow keys.
tips: Head to the parking area first and get into the car before you try to find a passenger, so you are ready to start the route as soon as a pickup point appears.
Check where the passenger wants to go before you set off, and plan a route on the city roads that keeps you moving toward the drop-off point.
Take the hills and mountains at a steady speed, since easing off before a steep climb helps you keep control of the car.
Try switching the camera view to find the one that shows you the road ahead most clearly, especially when turning corners.
Keep your attention on the road between jobs so you can spot the next pickup point quickly and keep the drives flowing.
faq: What is the goal of Indian Taxi 2020?
Your goal is to pick up passengers from the marked point and drop them at their destination around the city. The game describes proving yourself as the best cab driver in the city.
How do I control the taxi?
Use the WASD keys or the arrow keys to drive. You can also adjust the camera view while you play.

fashion-battle-dress.intro: Fashion Battle Dress is a 3D arcade game where you race through a track by matching your outfit to each section. Play with mouse clicks or taps.
tips: Look ahead to the color of the next track section before you reach it, so you can prepare the matching outfit in time.
Remember that a stylish outfit alone is not enough. Only an outfit whose color matches the current section will work there.
Watch for changes in track color, since each new section may need a different outfit.
Stay focused on color matching rather than on how the clothes look, because the game rewards the right match, not the prettiest design.
Keep your clicks or taps steady and deliberate so you respond to each section at the right moment.
faq: What is the main goal of Fashion Battle Dress?
You need to win the battle by moving through the track with outfits that suit each section. Beautiful clothes alone are not enough.
How do I decide which outfit to use?
Match the outfit's color to the color of the track section you are entering. An outfit only suits the section where its color matches.

lost-adventure.intro: Lost Adventure puts you in the role of a pilot whose plane crashed on an uncharted island. Gather resources, craft tools, and work through the wild grass to find and rescue every passenger.
tips: Scavenge the wreckage and mine resources before pushing deep into the wild grass, so you have materials ready when you need them.
Craft tools and weapons early, since hostile creatures are part of the wilderness and you will need them to survive.
Take time to explore the ancient ruins and solve the puzzles, because they are tied to uncovering the island's secrets.
Keep track of which passengers you have not yet reached, and use your makeshift signals to stay in contact with survivors separated by streams and dense vegetation.
Think about each choice, since the game says every decision matters and each crafted item brings you closer to reuniting your group and getting home.
faq: What is the main goal of Lost Adventure?
Your mission is to find and rescue every passenger from the crash, explore the island, and piece together a way off it. The game ends your journey when you have reunited your crew and escaped.
How do I move my character?
On desktop, use W, A, S, D or the arrow keys to move up, left, down, and right. On mobile, drag the on-screen joystick in any direction to move.

brain-tricks-brain-games.intro: Brain Tricks is a puzzle game of riddles and scenes where the obvious answer is often wrong. You drag objects into place, tap or swipe to interact, and use hints when you get stuck.
tips: Look over the whole scene before you move anything. Hidden clues can be in small details, backgrounds, or objects that seem like decoration.
Ask yourself whether the first answer that comes to mind is the intended one. Many levels reward a less obvious idea.
Try tapping and swiping on different objects, not only the ones that look important. Some items respond in ways that reveal the next step.
When you drag an object, test it in more than one spot. A placement that looks wrong at first may be the correct solution.
Use the hint option early if a level stalls for a while. Hints can help you move forward without losing track of the puzzle.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Your goal is to solve the puzzle in the scene by dragging and dropping objects to complete the level. The clues you need are part of the scene itself.
How do I interact with the objects?
You drag and drop objects, and you can also tap or swipe to interact with items in the scene. Try each method on different objects to see what happens.

kingdom-defense-mega.intro: Kingdom Defense Mega is a tower defense game where you build towers and cast spells to hold back waves of enemies across 12 levels. Upgrades and well-timed magic are key to protecting the kingdom.
tips: Spread your towers so they cover the path enemies take, rather than grouping them all in one spot where a single breach can get past them.
Save your spells for dangerous moments, such as a large group of enemies or a boss approaching, since you can summon them at any time.
Upgrade towers that are already working well instead of spreading your gold across many weak ones, so your defense gets stronger where it counts.
Watch which enemy types appear in each wave and adjust your towers to match, because different enemies can call for different defenses.
Plan for the boss at the end of each level by keeping a spell or strong tower ready, and expect harder fights at the super bosses closing each location.
faq: What is the main goal of Kingdom Defense Mega?
You protect the kingdom and its inhabitants by stopping enemies from getting through your defenses. Each level ends with a boss you need to defeat.
How do I get stronger during a level?
You can upgrade both your towers and your spells to increase their power on the battlefield. Choosing which upgrades to focus on is a key part of the strategy.

aberiel-church-jigsaws.intro: Aberiel Church Jigsaws is a relaxed jigsaw puzzle game where you rebuild images of churches from around the world. You can choose 12, 20, or 42 pieces and work through each church at your own pace.
tips: Start with the 12-piece puzzles to get a feel for how the pieces fit before moving up to 20 or 42 pieces.
Sort pieces by color or by edge first. Gather the border pieces together so the frame of the picture is ready early.
Use the church's main features, such as windows, arches, or stonework, as landmarks to place nearby pieces.
Work on one section at a time instead of scanning the whole board. Building a small area at a time keeps larger puzzles manageable.
Take breaks between puzzles. Since each church unlocks the next, there is no rush, so you can pick up the journey whenever you like.
faq: How do I pick up and move a puzzle piece?
Click and hold the left mouse button on a piece to select it, then drag it. On touch devices, tap and drag the piece with your finger.
How do I unlock the next church?
Complete the current church puzzle to unlock the next one in the journey.

popsortica.intro: PopSortica is an underwater sorting puzzle starring Mermaid Poppy. Move cubes between columns, match colors, and work through levels that grow harder as you go.
tips: Before you pick up a cube, check the top cube of the column you want to move it to. A move only works when the colors match, so plan the sequence before you click.
Look at the whole board before making your first move. Pulling a cube off a column can uncover a color you need to place next, so think a few moves ahead.
Try to keep each column to a single color where you can. Mixing colors in one column makes it harder to reach the cubes underneath.
Expect new obstacles and conditions as levels progress. Adjust your approach when the rules change instead of repeating the strategy from earlier levels.
Save boosters for levels where you are stuck or running low on good moves. They are there to help you get better results faster, so use them when a level becomes tricky.
faq: How do I move a cube?
Click a cube in a column to pick it up, then click another column to place it. The move only goes through if the colors match.
What happens if the colors don't match?
The cube will not be placed in that column. Pick a column whose top cube has the same color.

cube-surfer-fun-and-run-3d-game.intro: Cube Surfer is a 3D racing game where your character keeps moving forward while you collect diamonds and avoid danger. Quick reactions are the key to getting far in each level.
tips: Keep an eye on the path ahead so you can react before you reach an obstacle or gap.
Tap or click with timing in mind, since small delays can send your cube off track.
Go for diamonds when it is safe, but do not take risks that could end your run early.
Try the early levels a few times to learn how the movement feels before moving on.
Unlocking skins is a good goal to keep playing, so aim to finish levels steadily rather than rushing.
faq: What is the goal of Cube Surfer?
Your character moves forward constantly, and you collect diamonds while getting through each level. Reaching further along the course is the main aim.
How do I control the cube?
The game is played by tapping or clicking. Use taps at the right moments to steer your character through the course.

11-kisses.intro: 11 Kisses is a puzzle game about helping Angel-Girl and Demon-Boy reunite. You solve puzzles across different terrains by placing objects to build a path between them.
tips: Look at the whole path before placing anything. Note where each character starts and where they need to end up, so you can plan a route that connects them.
Check each terrain for gaps, height changes, and obstacles before you commit to an object. A piece that works in one spot may block the path in another.
Place objects one at a time and test the route after each change. This makes it easier to spot which piece is causing a problem.
If you get stuck, step back and ask which obstacle is stopping the characters from moving forward. Solving that one blocker often opens the rest of the route.
Try a different order or arrangement if your first idea fails. Puzzles like this often have more than one way to guide the couple together.
faq: What is the goal of 11 Kisses?
The goal is to build a logical path that brings Angel-Girl and Demon-Boy back together. You do this by strategically placing objects along the way.
How do I get past obstacles?
Work out which object or placement will clear the obstacle in front of the characters. Each puzzle is designed so that a logical path solves it.

eat-donuts.intro: Eat Donuts is a relaxing match-3 puzzle where you help a penguin collect donuts. Swap and rotate glowing rings on a 3x3 grid to make matches and reach the target score before time runs out.
tips: Before you move, look for a single move that lines up three matching rings, then check whether it also sets up another match.
Use the 3x3 grid's small size to your advantage by planning two or three moves ahead rather than reacting to each one.
Rotating a ring can line up a match that a simple swap cannot, so check both options before you commit.
Save your hammer and rotator power-ups for moments when the board has no easy matches left, so they can help you break a stall.
Keep an eye on the timer as well as the score, and aim for combos that add points quickly when time is running low.
faq: What is the goal of Eat Donuts?
Your goal is to reach the target score for each level before time runs out. Matching donut rings and building combos is how you raise your score.
How do I move the donut rings on desktop?
Click and drag a donut ring to swap it with another, or drag it to rotate it. A left click selects and moves a piece.

squid-poopy-sniper.intro: Squid Poopy Sniper is a first-person shooting game played from the assassin's point of view. You take out players who fall behind in the show's competitions, using only the mouse.
tips: Watch each competition closely before you act, since the players who finish last in games like red light, green light, and tug of war are your targets.
Study the playground scene for the cookie thief, and fire only once you are confident you have the right person.
Save your unlocked rifles and guns for the moments that matter most, because a precise shot is the core of the game.
Spend the rewards you earn on new guns, rifles, and guard uniforms as you rank up, so you have better options for later rounds.
Keep your attention on the clock, since every participant is trying to finish on top and hesitating can cost you a target.
faq: What is the main goal of Squid Poopy Sniper?
Your goal is to become the best sniper by eliminating the players who cannot complete the tasks. Each shot helps you move up the assassination ranks.
How do I control the game?
The game is played with the mouse. Use it to aim and take your shots.

road-fury-racing.intro: Road Fury is a 3D racing game where you aim to reach the finish line first. You overtake rivals, dodge obstacles and traps, and use nitro and upgrades to take the lead.
tips: Every collision damages your car and makes handling harder, so steer around obstacles early rather than clipping them at speed.
Save nitro for straight stretches or moments when you have a clear path, instead of spending it when you are about to hit something.
Ramps and sharp turns test your reactions, so ease off the speed before a corner and accelerate out of it once the car is lined up.
Watch the rivals around you and look for gaps to overtake, especially when a traffic jam of cars slows down ahead.
Spend what you earn on upgrades for your current car, or on a new vehicle, when the handling starts to feel difficult to control.
faq: What is the main goal in Road Fury?
Reach the finish line first while overtaking rivals, avoiding obstacles, and escaping traps. Staying in control of your car matters as much as speed.
How do I use turbo on PC?
Double-tap W to activate turbo. Use WASD to steer and control the car as well.

chernobyl-zombie-hell.intro: Chernobyl Zombie Hell is a 3D arena shooter where you clean up monsters across three areas, from a hospital to the tunnels under the reactor. Use your guns, grenades and movement to stay alive against zombies, dogs and rats.
tips: Use right mouse button zoom when you need to line up a distant target, then release it to keep your view wide for close threats.
Switch weapons with the number keys or the mouse wheel to match the enemy in front of you rather than sticking with one gun.
Save your grenades with G for groups of enemies, since they can clear crowds faster than firing at each one.
Use leaning with Q and E to peek around corners so you can shoot without fully exposing yourself.
Press F to pick up items as you go, and keep an eye on what you collect so you are ready when the hospital gives way to the streets and tunnels.
faq: How do I move and aim?
Move with the arrow keys or W, A, S and D, and look around with the mouse. Left click shoots, and you can hold Left Shift to run.
How do I switch between weapons?
Use the number keys 1 to 5 or scroll the mouse wheel. Choose the weapon that suits the enemy type you are facing.

beautiful-toenail-salon.intro: Beautiful Toenail Salon is a girls' dress-up game about summer foot care. You start with foot care, then add nail polish and accessories to make your feet look good for the beach.
tips: Finish the foot care steps first, since the polish and accessories look better on clean, smooth feet.
Pick colors that match the summer theme so the whole look feels consistent.
Try a few polish colors on each foot before settling on a final choice to compare how they look.
Add accessories last, and do not overload the design so the nails remain the focus.
Take your time with each step, because the game is about careful makeover work rather than speed.
faq: What is the goal of Beautiful Toenail Salon?
The goal is to care for the feet, then apply nail polish and accessories so the feet look beautiful for summer.
How do I control the game?
Use mouse clicks or taps to choose tools, colors, and items and to move through each step.

solitaire-match-puzzle.intro: Solitaire Match Puzzle is a food-themed card puzzle with dishes and desserts from around the world. Each game starts with many overlapping food cards that you clear by clicking or tapping.
tips: Scan the whole layout before your first click so you can see which cards sit on top of others.
Focus on the cards that are fully visible, since the ones underneath are usually harder to reach.
Clear cards in small groups rather than jumping around the board, so you can track what has been removed.
If you get stuck, pause and look again at the overlapping stacks, because a different starting card can open up new options.
Play at a calm pace; the food images are part of the fun, so take a moment to notice them between moves.
faq: How do I play Solitaire Match Puzzle?
You play by mouse click or tap. Click or tap the food cards on the board to make your moves.
Why do the cards overlap?
Each game starts with a large pile of food cards stacked over one another. Cards that are covered by others need to be cleared or uncovered before they can be used.

spaceman-escape-adventure.intro: Spaceman Escape Adventure is a 2D space action game where you guide an astronaut to collect a key, open a door, and reach the portal. Avoid the currents, because hitting one sends you back to the start.
tips: Look at the whole route before you move so you can spot where the currents are and plan a path around them.
Grab the key first, since you need it to open the door before you can head for the portal.
Move in short, controlled steps rather than long runs, which makes it easier to stop or change direction near a current.
If you get sent back to the start, take a moment to re-check the path you used before trying again.
Keep your movements steady with WASD or taps so you do not overshoot tight spots near the door and portal.
faq: What is the goal of Spaceman Escape Adventure?
Collect the key, open the door, and reach the portal to finish each level and escape.
What happens if my astronaut touches a current?
You are sent back to where you started the level, so you will need to try the route again.

pumpkin-fright-night.intro: Help Mr. Jack Lantern find and collect all the missing pumpkins in this Halloween puzzle. Mr. Jack moves and rotates using physics, so each jump and turn affects where he lands.
tips: Use small rotations with A and D before you jump to get a feel for how Mr. Jack's weight and balance respond.
Plan your route before you jump, looking at where each pumpkin sits and which surfaces you can land on safely.
Rotate Mr. Jack in the air to adjust his angle before he lands, since a tilted landing can send him off course.
Keep jumps short and controlled at first, then use longer jumps once you understand how far Mr. Jack travels.
If you get stuck, pause to study the layout and try a different sequence of jumps and rotations instead of repeating the same move.
faq: What is the goal of Pumpkin Fright Night?
Your goal is to help Mr. Jack Lantern collect all the missing pumpkins. Movement is based on physics, so you need to control his jumps and rotations carefully.
Which keys control Mr. Jack?
Press W to make a jump, A to rotate left, and D to rotate right. Use the rotation keys to adjust his angle while he moves.

subway-surfers-cambridge.intro: Subway Surfers Cambridge is an arcade dash game set across several city streets, from Mumbai to a Tokyo world tour. Your goal is to run as fast as you can.
tips: Keep your speed up from the start, since the game rewards players who dash as fast as they can.
Look ahead along the track so you can react to what is coming instead of reacting at the last second.
Pay attention to changes in the scenery and route, because a new area can shift the pace and what you need to avoid.
Stay calm after a mistake and restart quickly, as short runs are a good way to build speed and confidence.
Play a few runs in a row to learn the rhythm of the game, then try to beat your own best time or distance.
faq: What is the main goal in Subway Surfers Cambridge?
The main goal is to dash as fast as you can along the track. Going faster is the core challenge of the game.
What settings or locations does the game feature?
The game continues the adventures of the heroes in India and includes picturesque streets of Mumbai. It also presents a Tokyo world tour.

draw-line-stickman.intro: Draw Line Stickman is a physics puzzle where you sketch lines to shield a stickman from traps, enemies, and falling objects. Study each scene, plan a barrier, and let the physics carry out your idea.
tips: Look at the whole scene before you draw. Identify what is threatening the stickman and where it is headed.
Start with a simple barrier. A basic line that blocks or redirects the danger is often enough, and you can test it right away.
Pay attention to where falling objects will land. Placing a line so an object slides away from the hero can be more effective than blocking it head-on.
Experiment when you are stuck. Try different strategies to see how the physics responds, then keep the approach that works.
Watch the timing of each scene. Some hazards move or drop at specific moments, so think about when your line needs to be in place.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Your goal is to keep the stickman safe from the hazards in the scene. Completing the level unlocks new challenges.
How do I protect the stickman?
Draw lines to create barriers or clever solutions, then let the physics determine what happens. The game rewards creative thinking over a single fixed answer.

it-lurks.intro: IT LURKS is a horror survival game where you guard your house through 8 nights, from 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM. Watch the windows, check under your bed, and keep the lights off when something is near.
tips: Build a routine for each night: check the windows with Shift, then use the flashlight with Z to look outside before anything gets close.
Turn the lights off with X as soon as you spot something outside, since the description says this stops it from seeing you.
Check under the bed with Space when things go quiet, because something may be hiding there even if the windows look clear.
Expect the creatures to get stronger on later nights, so save your attention for the stretches when you have to act fast.
If you want upgrades, aim to finish games to earn points for the upgrade shop, and note that you can also get starter points from ads.
faq: What is the goal of IT LURKS?
You must survive all 8 nights, from 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM each night, while keeping watch over your home. Surviving every night completes the game.
What do the desktop controls do?
Space takes you under the bed or back to bed, Shift checks the window, Z turns on the flashlight, and X turns off the lights. You can also click on visual buttons and objects with the mouse.

world-war-iii.intro: World War III is a 3D action adventure set on Mars, where you fight robots using mouse and keyboard controls. Your mission is to destroy all 50 robots.
tips: Use the right mouse button to aim before you fire, so your left-click shots land on the robots rather than wasting ammo on empty ground.
Combine Shift with movement to cover ground quickly when robots are spread out, then slow down when you need to line up a precise shot.
Use Space to jump when you need a better angle or a higher view of the area around you.
Keep track of how many robots you have left, since your goal is a clear count of 50, and it helps you decide when to push forward or hold position.
Switch between WASD and the arrow keys based on what feels comfortable, and keep one hand near the movement keys so you can reposition quickly.
faq: What is the goal of World War III?
You win by destroying all 50 robots in the game. The game takes place on Mars.
Which controls do I use to shoot and aim?
Press the left mouse button to shoot and hold the right mouse button to aim.

food-sort-3d.intro: Food Sort 3D is a puzzle game where you sort food items into their categories across different eateries, from fast-food spots to upscale restaurants. Levels are short, and the colorful 3D graphics make each one easy to jump into.
tips: Before you start dragging, scan the whole board to see which food types appear most often. Clearing the most common items first can keep the board from getting crowded.
Use the press, hold, drag, and release steps from the instructions to move items cleanly. Dropping an item in the wrong spot can waste a move, so aim before you release.
Pay attention to the differences between eateries. Fast-food items like fries and hotdogs and upscale items like sushi may need different sorting habits.
Keep your sorting steady rather than rushing. Since levels are quick, a short pause to plan your next move often helps more than fast, random dragging.
Look for patterns in how each category is arranged on the board. Spotting where burgers, pizza, or desserts tend to pile up can help you clear them efficiently.
faq: What is the goal of Food Sort 3D?

The goal is to sort the various food items, such as burgers, sushi, hotdogs, fries, pizza, and desserts, into their correct categories. Completing this across each eatery helps you grow your food court.
How do I move the food items?
Move your cursor over an item, press and hold the left mouse button, drag the item to its new position, then release the button to drop it in place.

ball-bounce-try-it.intro: Ball Bounce is an arcade game where you steer a bouncing ball toward the portal while passing through obstacles. Stay focused, because the ball never stops bouncing.
tips: Watch the ball's bounce pattern for a few seconds before you start steering, so you can predict where it will land.
Make small, short movements with the arrow keys rather than holding a direction too long, since the ball keeps moving on its own.
Look ahead to the obstacles and line the ball up before it reaches them, instead of reacting at the last moment.
On mobile, remember that tapping the right side of the screen moves the ball left and tapping the left side moves it right, so check your direction before each tap.
Keep your eyes on the portal as your target, and adjust your path toward it each time the ball bounces.
faq: What is the goal of Ball Bounce?
Guide the bouncing ball toward the portal while passing through the obstacles along the way.
How do I move the ball on desktop?
Use the Left Arrow key to move left and the Right Arrow key to move right.

tower-necromancer-s.intro: Tower Necromancer's has you defending a tower against waves of attackers using dark magic. This guide covers how to manage summons, upgrades, and enemy types.
tips: Spend your early waves learning which enemy types arrive first, so you know what to prepare for before the pressure builds.
Mix skeletons and zombies rather than relying on one type, since different enemies may be easier to handle with different summons.
Upgrade and expand your tower steadily instead of spending everything at once, so you keep resources for responding to new threats.
Throw or launch enemies that are about to reach your tower, using the grab-and-throw control to buy time for your summons to act.
After each wave, check what damaged your tower most and adjust your next build to cover that weakness.
faq: What is the main goal of Tower Necromancer's?
You defend your tower against relentless waves of enemies sent by the kingdom. Keeping the tower standing through each wave is the core objective.
How do I pick up and throw enemies?
On mobile, press and drag with your finger to grab an enemy and throw it. On desktop, use the mouse to pick up an enemy and launch it into the air.

xtreme-offroad-jeep-2019.intro: Xtreme Offroad Jeep 2019 is a 3D driving action game with several types of play, including challenge missions, free driving on the map, and time checkpoints. You drive the jeep using the WASD keys.
tips: Start with free ride on the map to get a feel for how the jeep handles bumps and slopes before you attempt timed challenges.
Ease off the throttle when you approach rough ground so the jeep stays steadier and you keep control.
On time checkpoint runs, plan your route ahead of time and take the shortest safe line to each checkpoint.
Keep your steering gentle with the A and D keys; sharp turns on uneven terrain can tip or slow the jeep.
Retry missions that feel difficult, since each attempt helps you learn the terrain and the best path.
faq: What is the goal of Xtreme Offroad Jeep 2019?
The goal is to complete the missions, which include challenges and time checkpoints, while testing your driving skill on the map.
How do I control the jeep?
Use the W, A, S and D keys to drive the jeep.

fight-club-simulator.intro: Fight Club Simulator is a neon sci-fi boxing game where you start as a rookie and climb the ranks through training, quests, and fights. This guide covers controls and practical habits for progressing.
tips: Learn how each enemy moves before committing to attacks, since the game tests your reflexes, tactics, and timing.
Use WASD to reposition often rather than standing still, so you keep control of the distance between you and your opponent.
Press Space to fight, use items, or buy upgrades, and check what you can afford before spending on punches or abilities.
Practice new punch techniques and combo moves in fights to see which ones suit your style before relying on them in tougher matches.
Work through action-packed quests alongside fights to build up the upgrades you need for the harder opponents in later arenas.
faq: How do I move my boxer?
Use W, A, S, and D to move up, left, down, and right. On mobile, drag the on-screen joystick in any direction.
What does the Space key do?
Space is used to fight, use items, and buy upgrades, so it is the main button to press during play.

tiny-delivery.intro: Tiny Delivery combines food delivery with hill climbing. Your job is to carry food to the customer on each level without letting it fall off your vehicle.
tips: Before each level, check whether the truck rack is worth activating, since it keeps the food from falling out and makes the run easier.
Use small, steady movements with the left and right controls on hills so the vehicle doesn't tip and drop the food.
Try different car and wheel combinations in the store to find one that feels stable for you, then stick with it while you learn the levels.
Pay attention to the slope ahead of you and slow down before steep climbs or drops, since one fall loses the level.
If a level goes wrong, restart and try a slower approach rather than rushing, because the goal is to deliver the food intact.
faq: How do I control the vehicle?
On a keyboard, use the left and right arrow keys to move forward and backward. On a touch screen, use the left and right buttons on the screen.
What makes me lose a level?
If the food falls onto the ground, you lose the level, so keeping the food secure is the main goal.

archery-master-castle-battle.intro: Archery Master - Castle Battle is an archery defense game where you fire arrows from a castle tower at advancing enemies. Your goal is to destroy all enemies before they overwhelm your defenses.
tips: Aim carefully before each shot, since every missed arrow is a wasted opportunity against a larger enemy army.
Save your special arrows for tougher waves rather than using them on the first enemies you see.
Spend upgrades on your archers and tower early so your defense holds up as enemy troops grow stronger.
Consider recruiting mercenaries when you have the chance to add firepower to a difficult battle.
Try different arrow types and poisons on different enemies to see which combinations work best against orcs, humans, monsters and the undead.
faq: How do I control the archers?
You fire arrows by tapping the screen. Aim carefully first, because every shot counts.
Why do enemies keep getting through my defenses?
Enemy troops may outnumber yours and their projectiles hit harder, so focus on clearing the closest threats and upgrading your archers steadily.

summer-punch-party.intro: Summer Punch Party is a fast-paced first-person brawler where you punch waves of enemies across tropical islands. Learn how to aim, use nearby objects, and switch gloves to clear each level.
tips: Keep track of how many enemies you still need to defeat for the level, and focus on the ones closest to you so you do not get overwhelmed by the waves.
Look for objects near the crowd and launch them into enemies. This can clear several opponents at once.
Throwing enemies into the ocean is a valid strategy, so when enemies gather near the water, use punches to push them off the edge.
Open the weapon selection before a new wave starts so you are ready with the glove that suits the situation.
Complete levels to unlock new islands and boxing weapons, and try the new gloves to see which ones suit your playstyle.
faq: How do I complete a level?
Survive the enemy waves and defeat the required number of enemies shown for that level.
What is the basic attack?
On desktop, press the Left Mouse Button to punch. On mobile, tap the glove button.

cut-grass-for-brainrots.intro: Cut Grass for Brainrots is an arcade game where you slice through thick grass to uncover hidden Brainrots. Clear the field, grow your income, and unlock new areas as you go.
tips: Clear the grass in an area fully before moving on, so you don't miss hidden Brainrots in the patches you skipped.
Upgrade your damage before you reach tougher grass, since slow cutting in harder areas wastes time.
Collect Brainrots as you find them, because they increase your income and help you progress faster.
Use the camera rotation to check for uncut grass around you, especially when you're near edges or corners of a field.
Consider rebirthing once your progress slows down, since it gives you powerful boosts and a wider attack range for faster clearing.
faq: What is the main goal of Cut Grass for Brainrots?
Your goal is to slice through grass, uncover hidden Brainrots, and clear the field so you can unlock new areas to explore.
How do I move and aim on PC?
Use WASD or the arrow keys to move, and the mouse to rotate the camera. Press Space to jump.

shape-jam.intro: Shape Jam is a physics puzzle where you clear the board by collecting three matching shapes. Your holding slots are limited, so the order you pick shapes in decides whether you succeed.
tips: Before each tap, look at which shapes are already in your holding slots and aim to complete a set of three of the same shape.
Avoid picking a shape that matches nothing in your slots if you can, since a single unmatched shape takes up room you may need later.
Watch how the shapes tumble on the board and pick the ones that are fully exposed and easy to reach first.
Plan two or three moves ahead: think about which shape you will need next so your slots do not fill up with mixed shapes.
If your slots are nearly full, look for a shape that completes a triple to free up space before choosing anything new.
faq: What is the goal of Shape Jam?
The goal is to clear the board by collecting three matching shapes. Each set of three same shapes is removed once it forms in your slots.
What happens when my holding slots fill up?
The pick area is limited, so if the slots fill with shapes that do not form a set, you cannot pick more. Choosing the order of your taps carefully helps avoid this.

emoji-memory-find-a-pair.intro: Emoji Memory is a matching game where you flip cards to find identical pairs. Clear the board by opening every pair, either at your own pace or against the clock or move count.
tips: Flip one card at a time and try to remember where each emoji sits, since mismatched cards turn back over quickly.
Work across the board in a consistent order so you can track which cards you have already seen.
When you open a card that has no match yet, focus on its position before flipping a second card.
If you are playing the time mode, aim to make each flip count rather than opening cards at random.
In the minimum moves mode, plan your next flip before you tap so you waste as few moves as possible.
faq: What is the goal of Emoji Memory?
The goal is to open all pairs of cards on the playing field by finding two identical cards at a time.
What happens when I flip two cards that do not match?
They are automatically turned back over after a short moment, giving you time to memorize them.

halloween-shuffle.intro: Halloween Shuffle is a one-player puzzle game built around matching pairs of cards. Each level introduces new cards with their own special spook, and the tricks grow more mischievous as you go.
tips: Study the layout before you click, and note where each card sits so you can recall it later.
Pay attention to the special spook on each new card, since understanding how it behaves will help you plan your next move.
Expect the game to get trickier as you progress, so take a moment to reassess when a new twist appears.
Try to avoid rushing. Thinking one move ahead usually helps more than clicking quickly.
If a level feels confusing, slow down and check which cards you have already seen before trying a new pair.
faq: What is the goal of Halloween Shuffle?
The goal is to match pairs of cards as you work through the unique levels. Each level brings new cards and new challenges.
How do I control the game?
You play using your mouse. Click on the cards to select and reveal them.

car-driving-master.intro: Car Driving Master is a city driving game with realistic cars, traffic, highways, and missions. You steer through busy streets while following traffic rules and reaching your destinations safely.
tips: Keep your speed under control at busy intersections, since traffic there changes quickly and collisions are what you need to avoid.
Watch the traffic around you before each turn so you can react to other cars instead of braking at the last moment.
Follow the traffic rules from the start, because the game rewards safe driving as much as reaching the destination.
Try a few short drives on different parts of the map, such as parking areas, highways, and tight routes, to learn how each one handles.
Between missions, pay attention to where you are heading, because a clear route makes it easier to reach your destination without collisions.
faq: What is the main goal in Car Driving Master?
Complete missions, follow traffic rules, avoid collisions, collect rewards, and reach your destinations safely.
How do I control the car?
Hold the steering control to play, and keep holding it to keep driving through the city.

music-line-2-christmas.intro: Music Line 2 Christmas is an arcade game where you follow a line through snowy worlds while Christmas song melodies play. Tap to play and keep the line moving with the music.
tips: Listen to the melody before you focus on the visuals, since the song's rhythm shows you when the line will change direction.
Tap at steady, even moments with the music instead of rapidly tapping, which often sends the line off track.
Watch a little ahead of the line rather than just the spot it is on, so you can react before a turn arrives.
Play a few rounds with the sound on to learn how each song's melody is structured, then the timing will feel more predictable.
If you make a mistake, restart calmly and focus on the first few seconds of the song to get back into the rhythm.
faq: What is the goal of Music Line 2 Christmas?
The goal is to keep the line moving through the snowy worlds by following the melodies of the Christmas songs.
What is the only control in the game?
The game is played by tapping, so every move depends on when you tap in time with the music.

doctor-kids-3.intro: Doctor Kids 3 is a children's hospital simulation where you take on the role of a pediatrician and care for young patients. You play with a mouse or by tapping the screen.
tips: Read each patient's needs carefully before choosing a treatment, since the game rewards professional care rather than guesswork.
Be patient and gentle with every child, because the game puts weight on showing sympathy as well as medical skill.
Work through one patient at a time so you do not miss steps in their treatment.
Pay attention to how each child responds after treatment, and use that feedback to decide what to do next.
Keep your pace steady; rushing through cases can lead to mistakes in care.
faq: What is the main goal of Doctor Kids 3?
You act as a doctor in a children's hospital, providing professional treatment and taking care of your little patients. The game also invites you to grow into the role of chief of medicine.
What controls does Doctor Kids 3 use?
The game is played with a mouse or by tapping the screen. Use the same input to select tools, choose treatments and move through each step.

hole-and-collect.intro: Hole and Collect is a hypercasual game where you steer a cute black hole to pull in every object in the area before the timer hits zero. Plan your route so you gather items quickly and earn money for new black holes.
tips: Start by scanning the whole area so you can see which objects are clustered together before you move.
Group nearby objects and sweep through them in one pass instead of chasing single items across the map.
Keep an eye on the timer and leave small, scattered items for last if you are running low on time.
Use smart, short movements with WASD or the arrow keys rather than large sweeping turns that waste seconds.
Spend the money you earn on a new black hole when you can, since upgrading your hole can make later rounds easier to clear.
faq: What is the goal of Hole and Collect?
Your goal is to collect all the objects in the area with your black hole before the time runs out.
How do I move the black hole?
Use the WASD keys or the arrow keys to steer it around the area.
