set-the-box.intro: Set The Box is a physics-based stacking puzzle. Your goal is to build the tallest tower you can without it toppling over, and each new box makes the tower harder to balance.
tips: Hold longer when you need a box to land in an exact spot, since the description says a longer hold gives more precise placement.
Check the tower's balance after every drop and fix any lean before adding more boxes, because the higher you stack, the less stable it becomes.
Keep each new box centred over the one beneath it so the weight stays spread evenly through the tower.
Focus on a solid base, since the lower boxes carry everything above them.
Slow down as the tower grows, because small placement errors add up quickly at greater heights.
faq: How do I drop a box?
Tap and hold the screen to drop a box. The longer you hold, the more precisely the box is placed.
What is the goal of the game?
Stack the boxes on top of each other to build the tallest tower possible without toppling it over.

speed-chaos-crazy-race.intro: Speed Chaos: Crazy Race is a fast arcade racer with bonuses, short tracks, and unlockable cars. Steer, collect pickups, and use them on rivals to climb the field.
tips: Watch the time limit in Race mode from the first lap, since it gets shorter each lap. Take the most direct line when you can, and avoid wasting time on wide turns.
Collect bonuses as you drive, but save the ones that hit opponents for when a rival is close ahead of you. Using them at the wrong moment wastes them.
Keep steering smooth with A and D or the on-screen arrows. Small corrections help you avoid the crashes that cost you speed.
In Career mode, check your mission goals before each race so you can plan which bonuses to collect and when to use them.
Log in every day to collect your rewards, since they are how you unlock new cars.
faq: How do I win a race in Race mode?
You need to finish each lap before the time limit runs out, and that limit shrinks with every lap. Staying on the track and avoiding crashes keeps your time up.
How do I use bonuses?
On PC, click the bonus icons with the mouse. On mobile, tap the icons on screen.

cyberpunk-block-puzzle.intro: Slide glowing blocks across a neon circuit board and deliver each one to its matching colored connector. Plan several moves ahead, since blocks can only move along one axis and can block each other.
tips: Before you move a block, check which other blocks sit in its path, because moving one block can open or close the route for another.
Look at each connector's color first and find the block that matches it, then work out the order that frees the path to get there.
Try to plan two or three moves ahead rather than reacting to the block closest to you.
If you are stuck, wait a few seconds and the built-in hint will highlight your next move, so you can keep going without restarting.
Use the daily challenge as a regular habit to practice, since each day brings a new puzzle.
faq: What do I need to do to complete a level?
Move all of the glowing blocks into their matching colored connectors on the edges of the board. You must clear the entire board to finish the level.
How do blocks move?
Each block slides only along one axis, either horizontally or vertically. Blocks can block each other's path, so the order of moves matters.

zombie-sniper.intro: Zombie Sniper is a shooting game built around sniping zombies from a distance. This guide covers the goal, how to start, and a few habits that help you hit more targets.
tips: Take your time with each shot. A sniper game rewards patience, so avoid firing in quick bursts before you have lined up your target.
Scan the whole screen before you fire. Picking the zombie that is most urgent to deal with keeps your shots focused.
Watch the screen after each shot to see where your last hit landed, and adjust your next aim based on that.
Try to clear zombies in a steady order rather than jumping between distant targets, which can cause you to miss more often.
If you lose focus, pause for a moment before the next shot. Calm, deliberate aim is usually more effective than rushing.
faq: What is the goal of Zombie Sniper?
The goal is to snipe all the zombies. Each zombie you hit with a shot moves you closer to clearing the screen.
How do I start playing?
Tap to play. The game lists tapping as its only instruction, so use on-screen prompts for any extra details once the game begins.

railway-traffic-jam-untangle-the-trains.intro: Railway Traffic Jam! Untangle the Trains! is a casual puzzle about sorting tangled trains. Each train shows the direction it can travel, and you tap them in the right order to clear the track.
tips: Before you tap anything, look at the direction each train points and find which trains are blocking others.
Start with the trains that have a clear path, since clearing them often frees up the ones stuck behind.
If you get stuck, step back and map out the order of the remaining trains rather than tapping at random.
Pay attention to how the difficulty rises across levels, and expect later puzzles to need more planning ahead.
If you want a challenge beyond the levels, check the leaderboard to compare your results with other players.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
The goal is to sort all the trains on each level by tapping them in the correct order.
How do I know which train to tap first?
Each train shows the direction it can go, so look for trains whose path is already open before tapping ones that are blocked.

the-trendy-mermaid.intro: The Trendy Mermaid is a dress-up game where you style Ariel for her comeback. Pick clothes, makeup, and accessories with your mouse to build a dreamy, fabulous look.
tips: Choose a base outfit first, then add makeup and accessories so each choice fits the look you want.
Try a few different clothing combinations before settling on one, since the game offers a wide selection to compare.
Keep the makeup and accessories consistent with the outfit's style, such as a soft palette with a delicate necklace or a bold look with statement pieces.
Check the full look from each angle before you finish, so you catch any piece that clashes or looks out of place.
Work through one category at a time, like clothes, then makeup, then accessories, to avoid losing track of what you have already chosen.
faq: What is the goal of The Trendy Mermaid?
The goal is to help Ariel become the trendiest mermaid by choosing her clothes, makeup, and accessories. The game focuses on creating a look you enjoy.
How do I control the game?
Use your mouse to select and place clothes, makeup, and accessories on Ariel.

city-car-driving-simulator.intro: City Car Driving Simulator is a racing and simulation game set in an open 3D city with real traffic. You drive cars around the streets and chase your favorite car, using WASD to move.
tips: Ease off the throttle before sharp turns, since the car physics are accurate and a fast corner can cause you to slide or lose control.
Spend a few minutes just cruising the open world to learn how your car accelerates, brakes, and turns before you try to chase anything.
Keep an eye on the traffic cars around you and leave extra space when they change lanes or slow down, because the streets are busy.
Pick a steady pace instead of constantly tapping the controls, since smooth inputs make it easier to keep the car stable in traffic.
When following another car, stay a little behind it so you can react to its turns and stops rather than reacting late.
faq: How do I control the car?
Use the WASD keys to move your car around the city. The game's instructions specify WASD for all player movement.
What is the goal of the game?
The game centers on chasing your favorite car while driving through the detailed open world environment. Driving around the city streets with traffic is the main activity.

ghostly-night-harvest.intro: Ghostly Night Harvest is an action farming game where you grow pumpkins by day and fend off ghostly invaders at night. Success depends on balancing farm work with defense.
tips: Use the daytime to plant and grow your pumpkins, since the night defense depends on what you have prepared.
Move with WASD or the joystick so you can keep your position while you watch for ghosts approaching your crops.
Fire with the spacebar or slingshot button in short bursts rather than constantly, so you stay accurate on the ghosts closest to your pumpkins.
Watch for the key prompt that appears next to an object before you press it, so you interact with the right thing at the right moment.
Check how many crops remain after each night and adjust your daytime routine to protect the ones most at risk.
faq: What is the main goal of Ghostly Night Harvest?
You grow a bountiful pumpkin harvest during the day and defend it from ghostly invaders at night.
How do I shoot in the game?
Press the spacebar, or use the slingshot button on a mobile device.

dinosaur-dig.intro: Dinosaur Dig is a relaxing educational game where you work as a paleontologist. You pick excavation sites on a map, uncover bones, clean them, and assemble full skeletons.
tips: Work slowly when removing soil so you don't damage the bones underneath. Clearing each layer carefully is part of the job.
Take a moment to look at a fossil before you start cleaning. Knowing roughly where the bones sit makes it easier to find the pieces you need.
Switch between tools for different jobs instead of using one tool for everything. Each activity in a stage calls for a different approach.
When assembling a skeleton, place pieces one at a time and check the fit before moving on. Keeping the layout tidy makes the final shape easier to read.
Finish the activities at one location to unlock new excavation sites on the map. Progress depends on completing the work, so there is no need to rush through each stage.
faq: How do I start a dig?
Choose an available location on the map, then work through the activities at that site. New locations unlock as you complete activities.
What do I do with the soil and dirt?
Remove the layers of soil to uncover bones, then clean away the dirt from each discovery with the tools.

merge-shoot-run.intro: Merge Shoot Run! is a one-touch runner where you steer a growing crowd of shooters down a lane while they fire on their own. The main choices come from how you use your firepower on gates, towers and the horde.
tips: Keep your steering focused on collecting people along the ground, since a bigger crowd merges into heavier shooters and each one is worth much more.
Decide early how much firepower a gate deserves. Shooting it raises its number so you collect more when you drive through, but those bullets never reach the tower behind it.
Do not ignore gates completely. A gate left in the red takes people off your crowd, so it is usually better to charge it a little than to let it drain you.
Break towers when you can, because the riders on top drop down and join your crowd.
Remember that finishing the run is not the end. Attackers that reach your crowd kill shooters and lower your damage, so keep a healthy group through the final stretch.
faq: What is the goal of Merge Shoot Run!?
Your goal is to guide your crowd of shooters down the lane and cross the finish line. After that you must hold off the horde that attacks your crowd.
What is the only control in the game?
You drag left and right to steer. Your shooters fire automatically, so steering is the only thing you control.

tetra-challenge.intro: Tetra Challenge is a Tetris-style reverse puzzle game where you place moving blocks in the right spot to make matches. Use touch on Android or the mouse on PC to play.
tips: Watch the automatic moving block before you act, since it keeps filling the game area if you fail to place it correctly.
Focus on placing each block in the right position so the match is made, because a correct match is what earns the reward.
Plan a little ahead of each placement rather than reacting at the last second, which helps you avoid filling the play area too quickly.
Keep your placements tidy so the area does not get crowded, giving you more room to work with as the challenge goes on.
Use the quests as a guide to what to aim for, and play in short sessions to keep your focus sharp on each placement.
faq: What is the main goal of Tetra Challenge?
The goal is to place the blocks in the right position so they match correctly. Successful matches are rewarded, while failing lets the moving block fill the area and ends the game.
How do I control the blocks on PC and Android?
On PC, use the mouse to place the blocks. On Android, touch the screen to place them in the right position.

walk-master-stilt-walker.intro: Walk Master: Stilt Walker is an arcade game about balance and agility. You start out clumsy and build your skills as you travel through forests and fields, meeting unusual creatures along the way.
tips: Start slowly and focus on finding a steady rhythm before you try to move quickly.
On PC, alternate between each stilt step instead of pressing the same control over and over.
On a touchscreen, tap rhythmically rather than holding your finger down for long stretches.
Pay attention to how each new level feels, since the levels are described as unique and may need different approaches.
Keep your balance in mind after every stumble and reset your rhythm instead of rushing forward.
faq: What is the goal of Walk Master: Stilt Walker?
You walk through forests and fields on stilts, building your skills as you go. The further you progress, the more skilled your character becomes.
How do I control the stilts on PC?
Hold the spacebar or left mouse button to lift the stilt, then release to lower it. Alternate presses to step forward and keep your balance.

city-of-vice-driving.intro: City of Vice Driving is a 3D racing game where you drive different supercars across city roads. It focuses on high-end graphics and open driving through the streets.
tips: Spend a few minutes getting used to the WASD driving keys before you pick up speed, so you can control the car on turns.
Use the Space bar to brake before corners rather than braking mid-turn, which helps keep the car steady.
Press C to switch camera views and find the one that gives you the clearest view of the road ahead.
Try each available supercar to see how it handles, since the cars are the main difference between drives.
Take your time on city roads and watch for traffic and turns, because the streets reward steady driving over reckless speed.
faq: What is the goal of City of Vice Driving?
The game is about driving different supercars across the city roads. Explore the streets and enjoy the drive at your own pace.
What are the controls?
Use W, A, S and D to drive, Space to brake, and C to change the camera view.

15-halloween-games.intro: 15 Halloween Games is a collection of 15 mini-games, each with its own look and play order. You play by clicking or tapping, so you can jump into any round quickly.
tips: Read the first few seconds of each mini-game carefully, since the play order changes from one game to the next.
Expect the rules to shift between rounds, so do not reuse the same tapping pattern from the previous mini-game.
Keep your clicks or taps deliberate rather than rapid, especially in games where the order of actions matters.
If a round feels confusing, watch what the screen responds to first and adjust from there.
Play in short sessions so the variety stays fresh and it is easier to notice what each mini-game asks of you.
faq: How many mini-games are in this game?
The game includes 15 mini-games, each with unique graphics and a different order of play.
How do I control the game?
Use mouse clicks or taps. The same input works for every mini-game in the collection.

car-rush-super.intro: Car Rush Super is a racing game where you pick a car and race against others. Tap and hold to steer clear of other vehicles and reach the finish line.
tips: Watch the traffic ahead rather than the car right in front of you, so you have time to decide which gap to aim for.
Keep your input steady: holding too long can push you into a vehicle, so release and tap again when the lane clears.
Pick a car before you start that fits how you like to drive, since your choice is the only setup you make before the race.
Stay alert for cars merging from the sides and move early, because late dodges leave less room to recover.
Try a few short races first to learn the timing of the tap-and-hold controls before you aim for a longer run.
faq: What is the goal of Car Rush Super?
Race against other cars and keep dodging traffic until you reach the final line.
How do I control the car?
Use a mouse click or tap, and hold to avoid crushing other vehicles on the track.

fit-in-the-wall.intro: Fit in the Wall is a 3D arcade skill game where you steer a yellow cube through moving walls, lining it up with the one shape that fits each opening. Timing and quick adjustments decide how long you last.
tips: Watch the wall as it approaches and identify the matching slot early, so you have time to move the cube into position.
Make small, steady adjustments with the arrow keys rather than large sudden moves, which can overshoot the slot.
Keep your eyes slightly ahead of the cube so you can plan the next wall while you are still fitting the current one.
On mobile, tap the left or right side of the screen in short bursts and release once the cube lines up, instead of holding continuously.
Stay calm after a successful fit; the next wall can arrive quickly, so reset your focus each time before moving.
faq: What is the goal of Fit in the Wall?
Your goal is to score as much as you can by guiding the yellow cube into the matching slot of each moving wall. Every wall has only one correct fit.
How do I move the cube on desktop?
Use the arrow keys to move the yellow cube left and right. Adjust in small steps to line it up with the slot.

planko.intro: Planko is a physics puzzle where you guide a red ball to a green target. Clear blocking balls in the right order so the ball can roll, slide, or bounce onto the planks.
tips: Before you tap anything, follow the path the red ball would take once a blocking ball is gone. This shows you whether that tap helps or hurts.
Tap the removable balls in the correct order. Removing one too early can send the red ball the wrong way.
Notice which balls are holding others in place. Removing a supporting ball can shift the balance of the whole level.
Use the planks to steer the ball toward the green target, and watch where it lands on each one before you clear the next obstacle.
Each level is a different puzzle, so do not assume a solution from the last level will work. Study the layout first.
faq: What is the goal of Planko?
Get the red ball safely to the green target. Each level is a physics puzzle built from balls, planks, platforms, and obstacles.
How do I clear obstacles?
Tap the removable balls in the correct order to make them disappear. Removing a ball can change the balance of the level and let the red ball move.

animal-basketball.intro: Animal Basketball is a shooting game with animal characters, many special basketballs, and four courts. You drag to aim and shoot, and you can play a timed mode, a streak challenge, or a set of 200 missions.
tips: Drag gently and watch how the ball curves before you release, since the game uses a real physics engine and the same force can send the ball differently on each court.
In Road to the Championship, take your time on each throw, because one miss ends the streak and a longer run is the goal.
In Arcade Rampage, chain baskets quickly so your combo effects stack, and keep shooting while the 60-second timer runs.
Try different courts, since the description says every basket on them can play tricks, and learning each court's behavior helps your aim.
Check the mission list often and try shots with different special basketballs, because the 200 missions and medals reward trying a variety of shots.
faq: How do I shoot the ball?
On desktop, hold the left mouse button and drag to aim, then release to shoot. On mobile, touch the screen, move to aim, and let go to shoot.
What is the difference between Arcade Rampage and Road to the Championship?
Arcade Rampage is a 60-second challenge where combo effects build up as you score. Road to the Championship asks how many throws you can make in a row without missing.

syntagma.intro: Syntagma is a puzzle adventure with platforming. You jump across active platforms in the right order, collect keys, and open vaults to find crystals hidden around the world.
tips: Plan your route before you move, since you cannot go backward or diagonally. Each step is permanent, so look at the layout first.
Remember that traps and defenses start as soon as you begin moving. Watch the obstacles ahead before you commit to a path.
Use the spot jump at the right moment, either by clicking the hero, pressing the spacebar, or tapping the touch button. This is often easier than jumping toward an obstacle.
Make sure you collect every key on the platforms you cross, because the vault only opens once all of them are gathered.
If a level feels too hard, switch to the easier difficulty in the main menu settings and return to the harder one later.
faq: What is the goal of Syntagma?
Your goal is to find the five crystals representing the elements, which are scattered around the world. Each crystal is locked in a vault that opens after you solve the platform puzzle.
How do I move the hero?
You can click on platforms with the mouse, or use the arrow keys to move. Movement is allowed forward, left, and right only, so backward and diagonal moves are not possible.

car-madness-3d.intro: Car Madness 3D is a racing game for two players sharing one keyboard. Pick a random track in Quick Race or go for the 10-race tournament in Season mode.
tips: Learn both control schemes before the first race: Player 1 uses the arrow keys and Player 2 uses W, A, S and D, so keep each player's hands on their own side.
Watch the track ahead for obstacles and black holes, and steer early enough to avoid them rather than correcting at the last moment.
In Season mode, treat every race as part of the 10-race total, since winning the tournament depends on leading the races, not only winning one.
Try Quick Race first to learn how the random tracks behave before committing to a full tournament.
If the game runs slowly, open the gear button and lower the quality so steering stays responsive.
faq: How do two players control their cars?
Player 1 uses the arrow keys and Player 2 uses W, A, S and D on the same keyboard.
What is the difference between Quick Race and Season mode?
Quick Race puts you on a random track for a single race, while Season mode is a tournament of 10 races.

farmers-vs-aliens.intro: Farmers vs. Aliens is a farm herding game where you guide animals to their matching enclosures while keeping everything inside the green zone. Stay quick and watch the arrows.
tips: Before moving, check the green arrows and the matching images so you know which enclosure each animal belongs to.
Keep your character and the animals inside the green zone at all times, since leaving it lets a UFO come in and abduct them.
Gather animals early, before the game slows down at its turning point, so aliens do not arrive to take the ones you have not yet collected.
Use short, steady movements with the mouse, joystick, or left stick so you can keep your character close to the herd without overshooting the zone edge.
Keep track of how many animals you have lost, because taking more than two animals ends the game.
faq: What is the main goal of Farmers vs. Aliens?
Your goal is to lead the animals to their matching enclosures while keeping them and yourself inside the green zone. Gather them in time to stop alien abductions.
How do I move my character?
On PC, left-click to make your character follow the cursor. On mobile, drag the on-screen joystick, and on a gamepad, tilt the left stick in the direction you want to run.

micro-gt-racing.intro: Micro GT Racing is an arcade racer with compact GT cars on sharp, twisting circuits. It supports two players, with arrow keys for player 1 and WASD for player 2.
tips: Brake before the sharp corners rather than in them, since compact cars with realistic handling can lose grip if you carry too much speed into a turn.
On tight chicanes, focus on a smooth line through the first bend so you can get the car pointed toward the next one quickly.
Pay attention to how your car responds after each corner and adjust your inputs to match, rather than steering the same way every lap.
Try your customization choices in practice laps to see how they affect handling before committing to a setup for a tougher race.
Lower your speed slightly when rivals are close, because a small mistake in a tight section is often what costs you the most time.
faq: How do I control my car?
Player 1 uses the arrow keys, and player 2 uses WASD if you are playing a two-player race. Learn how your car reacts to each input in a quiet lap first.
What makes a good racing line here?

Circuits are packed with sharp corners and tight chicanes, so a clean line that keeps your car balanced through each turn usually beats fast but messy entries. Practise the sections where you lose time most often.

monkeysweeper-mines-puzzles.intro: MonkeySweeper is a Minesweeper-style logic puzzle where you open tiles, read the number clues, and find every hidden monkey without opening one. It rewards careful reading of the board over fast clicking.
tips: Start with the tiles that are clearly safe based on the numbers you can already read, and leave the uncertain ones for later.
Check each number against the tiles around it. If a number's count of nearby hidden monkeys matches the unopened tiles next to it, every one of those tiles is a monkey.
When a number is fully satisfied by flagged or known monkey tiles, the remaining unopened tiles beside it are safe to open.
Look at the board one area at a time, and compare neighbouring numbers to find patterns that show where the monkeys must be.
If you get stuck, step away for a moment and look again, since the next safe move is often right in front of you.
faq: What is the goal of MonkeySweeper?
The goal is to reveal all the safe tiles on the board, which wins the puzzle. Avoid opening any tile that hides a monkey.
How do the numbers work?
Each number shows how many hidden monkeys are on the tiles nearby. Use those counts to work out which tiles are safe and which must hide a monkey.

place-it-right.intro: Place It Right is a calm organization puzzle where you sort and arrange everyday objects into their correct spots. Each scene is solved by spotting the pattern behind where things belong.
tips: Look at the whole scene before moving anything, and check how objects relate to each other by color, size, shape, or category.
Start with the items that clearly match a group, such as books or kitchen items, so the rest of the layout becomes easier to read.
Check for symmetry. If one side of a scene is arranged a certain way, the other side often follows the same logic.
Compare sizes side by side before dropping an object, since some puzzles depend on placing items from smallest to largest or the reverse.
Move one object at a time and look at the result before continuing, so you can undo a wrong placement quickly by dragging the item back out.
faq: What is the goal of Place It Right?
Your goal is to place every object in its perfect spot so each scene looks neat and fits the hidden pattern. A level is complete once all items are in position.
How do I move objects?
On desktop, click and drag an object with the mouse, then release it to drop it. On mobile, tap and drag with your finger, then lift your finger to place it.

rescue-fairy-castle.intro: Rescue Fairy Castle is a pin-pulling puzzle game where you pull the correct pins to free the fairy and avoid obstacles along the way. Each level presents a different challenge to solve.
tips: Before pulling any pin, look at the whole screen and work out what each pin is protecting or blocking.
Pull pins in an order that keeps the fairy safe; a pin that looks harmless may open a path for a threat.
Watch the goblins closely, since the instructions warn about their attacks, and plan your moves to stay out of their reach.
If a puzzle does not work, reset your thinking and try a different pin rather than repeating the same move.
Aim to collect the treasure in the castle, as that is part of completing each challenge.
faq: What is the goal of Rescue Fairy Castle?
The goal is to pull the pins in the right way, avoid the obstacles, and save the fairy. Collecting the treasure in the castle is also part of the challenge.
How do I avoid losing in this game?
Pay attention to goblin attacks and obstacles before each pull. Think through the result of a pin before you move it.

seafloor-racing.intro: Seafloor Racing puts you behind the wheel of a car driving along the ocean floor. Race against several AI opponents on each level while dodging obstacles and keeping your speed up.
tips: Start by moving with WASD for a few seconds to get a feel for how the car responds before the race pressure builds.
Spot obstacles early and begin steering around them well before you reach them, since sudden changes of direction can cost you speed.
Keep your eyes on the path ahead rather than on the opponents, so you can react to obstacles in time.
Try to stay in a steady line rather than making many sharp corrections, which helps you hold your high speed through the whole run.
Use each level's AI opponents as a guide to the track layout, and notice where they slow down or get caught by obstacles.
faq: What is the goal of Seafloor Racing?
You race along the seafloor against several AI opponents on each level. Finishing ahead and avoiding obstacles are the main challenges.
How do I control the car?
Use the WASD keys to move. Keep your movements smooth so you can steer around obstacles without losing speed.

tile-harvest-3d.intro: Tile Harvest 3D is a stacking puzzle where you collect matching tiles into a factory belt and merge them into higher-tier items. Clear the whole 3D board to finish each level.
tips: Before each tap, rotate the board to see which tiles are hiding underneath, and prefer picks that uncover new options for other types.
Keep an eye on how many of each type are in your Factory Belt, since three identical items merge automatically and leftover single tiles take up space.
Avoid collecting a type whose matches are scattered, because a belt full of unmatched tiles is the most common way to lose a level.
Save the Magnifier for moments when you can't spot a matching set, and use Throwback to recover from a belt that is almost full.
Zoom in when the stack is crowded so you can read the tile types clearly before committing to a pick.
faq: What is the goal of Tile Harvest 3D?
Clear every tile from the 3D board to win the level. Tiles are removed by collecting sets of three matching tiles.
What happens when three matching tiles are in the Factory Belt?
They automatically merge into a new, higher-tier item, which clears those slots and frees up space on the belt.

paintball-gun-pixel-3d.intro: Paintball Gun Pixel 3D is a multiplayer shooting game where you compete against players from around the world in pixel-style paintball matches. Your aim is to win each match by outplaying your opponents.
tips: Use WASD to keep moving rather than standing still, since a stationary player is an easy target.
Aim with the mouse and take careful shots instead of spraying fire in every direction.
Use the space bar to jump when you need to change position quickly or get past cover.
Press Tab to open the menu and check your options between matches so you are ready when the next round starts.
Stay aware of where opponents are coming from and reposition often to avoid being caught in the same spot.
faq: What is the goal of Paintball Gun Pixel 3D?
The goal is to be the best player and win each match against other players around the world.
Which keys control movement and shooting?
Use WASD to move, the mouse to aim and shoot, and the space bar to jump.

throttle-rivals.intro: Throttle Rivals is a highway racing game where you dodge traffic, collect boosters and try to beat three rivals. Progress comes from 50 races, 20 unlockable cars and an endless mode.
tips: Steer early and in small amounts so you can slip between traffic cars without losing speed.
Grab boosters whenever they are safe to reach, since they help you pull ahead of your rivals.
Spend your first coins on upgrades for the car you already use, rather than jumping between cars too soon.
Watch the rivals' positions and push harder when you are close to them, especially near the finish.
In endless mode, focus on staying alive as long as possible, because your total coins decide your leaderboard place.
faq: What is the goal of Throttle Rivals?
Finish first in each highway race, beating three rivals while dodging traffic. You can also keep racing in endless mode.
How do I control the car on a keyboard?
Hold Space or Enter to accelerate and use A/D or the arrow keys to steer. Dragging with a mouse or touch also accelerates and steers.

halloweem-pumpkin-adventure.intro: Halloween Pumpkin Adventure is a Halloween-themed puzzle and skill game where you guide a pumpkin to the finish line. You control it with taps or clicks, so the challenge comes from timing your lifts.
tips: Use short, light taps rather than holding the mouse button down, so you can keep the pumpkin's height under control.
Watch the pumpkin's movement for a moment before pressing, and try to anticipate how far each tap will lift it.
Practice the early part of the level until your timing feels steady, then focus on the harder sections.
If you keep falling or missing the finish line, pause your attempts and try a slower, more deliberate rhythm instead of rapid clicking.
Stay relaxed and keep your mouse hand steady; small, consistent inputs usually work better than big, hurried ones.
faq: What is the goal of Halloween Pumpkin Adventure?
The goal is to guide the pumpkin safely to the finish line. Each attempt is about getting it all the way through the course.
How do I control the pumpkin?
Tap or click on the screen to lift the pumpkin up. Since you only use the mouse, every movement comes from when you click.

beadhouse.intro: BeadHouse is a calm color puzzle where you restore a bead picture by moving misplaced beads back to matching spaces. Study the design, plan your moves, and finish before time runs out.
tips: Look over the whole picture before you tap anything. Note which colors are in the wrong areas so you can plan a sequence instead of guessing.
Because the bead tray has limited space, avoid parking beads there without a clear destination. Place a bead as soon as you find its matching empty space when you can.
Start with areas where the correct color is easy to spot. Clearing those first gives you more room and a clearer view of the harder spots.
Save Fix Area, Clear Tray, and Magnet for moments when you are stuck or the tray is nearly full, rather than using them at the start of a level.
Keep an eye on the clock. Work steadily and avoid long pauses, since finishing before time runs out is what earns your stars and coins.
faq: How do I move a bead to the correct place?
Tap a misplaced bead to send it into the bead tray, then select it from the tray and tap a matching empty space. The bead will sit in its correct area once placed.
What happens if the bead tray fills up?
The tray has limited space, so you cannot hold unlimited beads at once. Plan your moves so you place beads quickly, and use a booster such as Clear Tray if you get stuck.

99-nights-in-the-forest-battle-squads.intro: Defeat forest monsters, rescue lost children, and work through 30 levels in order. Build a squad of characters with different abilities and upgrade them as you progress.
tips: Mix characters with different abilities in your squad so you can handle a wider range of monsters instead of relying on one style of attack.
Finish each level before moving on, since levels are played one by one and your squad needs to keep up with the harder monsters later on.
Save your rubies for the upgrades that match the way your squad fights, rather than spreading them thinly across every character.
Level up the characters you use most often so your strongest fighters stay useful as the monsters get tougher.
If a level is difficult, check which characters are weakest against its monsters and adjust your squad before trying again.
faq: What is the main goal of 99 Nights In The Forest - Battle Squads?
Your goal is to defeat monsters and rescue lost children across 30 levels. You complete the levels one by one, building up your squad as you go.
How do I improve my characters?
You upgrade your characters' abilities using rubies. You can also level up your characters to improve their skills.

emoji-solitaire.intro: Emoji Solitaire is a card puzzle that mixes classic solitaire with word association. You sort word cards into category piles based on their theme, such as Animals, Food, or Space.
tips: Before you move anything, look at the category foundations at the top of the screen so you know which themes you need to build.
Stack matching word cards on the tableau when you can, because this is how you reveal face-down cards underneath and open up new options.
Use empty tableau spaces to park cards temporarily, but avoid filling them with cards that block something you will need soon.
When you run out of useful moves, tap the deck to bring out fresh cards, and check the waste pile for any card that fits a foundation.
Keep an eye on your limited pool of moves and plan a few steps ahead, since wasting moves can make a level impossible to finish.
faq: What is the goal of Emoji Solitaire?
Your goal is to clear the board by grouping all the word cards into their matching category piles. Finishing this wins the level.
How do I move cards around?
Drag word cards onto a foundation that matches their theme, or drag them onto matching cards in the tableau to stack them. Stacking also reveals face-down cards beneath.

unicorn-chef-mermaid-cake.intro: Unicorn Chef Mermaid Cake is a cake decorating and cooking game where you build a mermaid-themed cake using a wide range of kitchen tools and ingredients. It is played with a mouse or by tapping.
tips: Look over the full set of ingredients and tools before you start, so you know what is available for the cake layers, frosting and decorations.
Work in stages: bake or prepare the base first, then add cream or frosting, and decorate last so your toppings are not disturbed.
Use the piping bags and spatula to smooth and shape cream before adding small items like sprinkles or candies.
Pick decorations that suit a mermaid theme, such as fruits, candies and cotton candy, and balance colors so the cake looks cohesive.
Try a few different tools, like the cream mixer or cake molds, to see how they change the texture and shape of your creation.
faq: What is the goal of Unicorn Chef Mermaid Cake?
The goal is to make a mermaid cake by cooking, assembling and decorating it with the tools and ingredients provided.
How do I control the game?
Use your mouse or tap the screen to pick up tools, add ingredients and move items around the kitchen.

creepy-spa-for-little-monsters.intro: Creepy Spa for Little Monsters is a makeover game set in a monster-themed beauty salon. You help two guests, Nefertina and Draculina, with skin care, makeup, hair, and outfits.
tips: Work through the treatments in the order they come up, starting with skin care, so the later makeup and hair steps sit on a clean base.
Try a few hairstyles and accessories on each character before committing, since the salon offers several options to compare.
Keep the two monsters' looks distinct: the mummy and the vampire have very different personalities, so a style that suits one may not suit the other.
Use the makeup step to test colors on the face before moving on, and adjust if something clashes with the outfit you have in mind.
Click or tap each item slowly to see how it changes the character, then pick the version you like best before moving to the next step.
faq: Who are the characters in this game?
The two guests are the mysterious mummy Nefertina and the glamorous vampire Draculina. You care for both of them during the salon visit.
What services can I give the monsters?
You can give skin care, makeup from a makeup artist, and stylist services that cover hairstyles, outfits, and accessories.

hexa-word.intro: Hexa Word is a relaxed word-sorting puzzle. You pick a themed group, then tap the hex tiles that belong to it, working through words that could fit more than one group.
tips: Before tapping, scan the whole board for words that could fit two groups, and leave those for last so the clear words lock in first.
Use the Hint on a tricky word only after you have tried to place it yourself, so you still get the satisfaction of solving it.
Save Reveal for a group that is truly stuck, since it completes the whole group at once and gives you less to think about.
If the board feels jumbled and you keep second-guessing the same tiles, try Shuffle to see the words in a fresh arrangement.
Since there are no timers, take a moment to read each word carefully before committing, because wrong taps only bounce back gently.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Sort every word tile into its matching coloured group at the top of the screen to solve the level and move on.
What happens if I tap a word that does not belong?
A wrong tap gently bounces back and does not lock in, so you can simply try a different group or tile.

pumpkin-wheel.intro: Pumpkin Wheel is an arcade game where you steer a big rolling pumpkin through 30 levels. Click or tap to play, and focus on smooth control to finish every stage.
tips: Use short, light taps for small adjustments instead of holding down for long stretches, since the pumpkin builds speed quickly.
Brake before you reach a tricky part of a level rather than after, so you have time to slow the pumpkin down.
Watch where the stars point and follow them, as the description suggests, to find the route forward.
If a level keeps defeating you, pause your speed and rethink your path before trying again, rather than rushing the same mistake.
Play in short sessions, because the game is built to be a quick time-killer and you will stay sharper between runs.
faq: What is the main goal of Pumpkin Wheel?
Your goal is to control the rolling pumpkin and complete all 30 levels. Each level is a step toward finishing the whole game.
How do I control the pumpkin?
Click or tap to play. You use acceleration and braking to keep the pumpkin under control as it rolls.

go-up-samurai.intro: Go! Up! Samurai is a samurai action game where you move through challenges and foes using quick reflexes and careful timing. Its controls are simple, so most of your skill comes from timing and positioning.
tips: Learn how far each jump carries you before you commit to a long leap, so you do not land short of a platform or foe.
Use the kick when enemies are close rather than running into them, since accuracy matters more than speed in this game.
Pause briefly on the ground to read the next challenge before you move, instead of rushing through it.
If you fall into a bad position, press R to restart quickly rather than trying to recover from a losing spot.
Practice short, controlled movements with A, D and W until they feel natural, then build up to faster sequences.
faq: What is the main goal of Go! Up! Samurai?
The game asks you to move through various challenges and foes, relying on quick reflexes and smart tactics to get through each one.
Which keys control the samurai?
Use A and D or the Left and Right Arrows to walk, W or the Up Arrow to jump, and S or the Down Arrow to kick. Shift is also used for a kick, and R restarts while Esc exits.

obby-up-parkour-run.intro: Obby Up: Parkour Run is a 3D platform course where you run, jump, and change your runner's size to climb a towering obstacle course. Reach the top by crossing platforms, avoiding traps, and using checkpoints to save progress.
tips: Activate each checkpoint as soon as you reach it, because a fall sends you back to the last one you activated.
Use the size slider before you reach a tight gap or a large obstacle, so your runner is already the right size when the route demands it.
Time your jumps carefully and pause with Escape if you need a moment to study the next platforms before committing.
Grab coins when they sit on your route, but don't risk a fall by stretching for them near dangerous edges.
Try side challenges after you have learned the main route, so you can focus on one thing at a time.
faq: What are the basic desktop controls?
Use WASD or the arrow keys to move and Space to jump. If double jump is available, press Space again in the air.
What happens if I fall off the course?
Return to the last checkpoint you activated and try the section again.

clue-hunter.intro: Clue Hunter is a crime-solving puzzle game for one player. You search scenes for hidden objects and clues, then use logic to work through five cases.
tips: Scan each scene slowly and systematically, moving from left to right or top to bottom, so small hidden objects don't get missed.
Pay attention to objects that look out of place, since they often point toward a clue.
Write down or remember what each clue suggests before moving on, because later cases can depend on details you noticed earlier.
If you are stuck, try a different area of the scene rather than repeatedly clicking the same spot.
Think about how clues connect to each other, since solving a case usually means combining several pieces of evidence.
faq: How do I play Clue Hunter?
You play by mouse click or tap. Click on objects and areas in each scene to find hidden items and clues.
How many levels are there?
The game has five levels: Help Mom, Save the Girl, Laundry Master, Loss Escape, and Strange Neighbors.

realistic-sim-car-park-2019.intro: Realistic Sim Car Park 2019 is a driving game focused on parking. You drive a car with the WASD keys and can choose from multiple cars, with steering wheel and button controls.
tips: Move slowly when you are close to other cars or walls, since small steering changes make a big difference when parking.
Use short taps of the forward and reverse keys instead of holding them, so you can stop and check your position before you move again.
Try each car you can pick, because cars may handle differently and you can find the one that feels easiest to control.
Line up the car before you turn in, so you are not trying to fix a bad angle while reversing into the space.
Practice the same parking move several times in a row to build a steady routine for steering and braking.
faq: What keys do I use to drive?
Use the W, A, S and D keys. W and S move the car forward and back, and A and D steer left and right.
Are there different cars to choose from?
Yes, the game offers multiple cars, so you can switch to whichever one suits your driving style.

car-stunt-racing-game-3d-car-games.intro: Drive stunt tracks full of ramps and obstacles, perform jumps and mid-air tricks, and reach the finish line without crashing or falling off the track before time runs out.
tips: Ease off the accelerator before a ramp so you land with control instead of launching too fast and losing balance.
Use small steering corrections in the air, since sharp turns while airborne can tip the car off balance.
Keep an eye on the time limit for each level, and avoid slowing down so much that you cannot finish in time.
Tap the brake with the Spacebar before tight turns or obstacles rather than braking late and skidding into them.
Pick a steady pace on the first run of a new track to learn where the jumps and obstacles are, then push speed on later attempts.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Your goal is to navigate the stunt track, perform jumps and tricks, and reach the finish line without crashing or falling off the track within the time limit.
How do I control the car on desktop?
Use the Up Arrow to accelerate, the Down Arrow to reverse, the Left and Right Arrows to steer, and the Spacebar to brake.

fashion-show-dressup.intro: Fashion Show Dressup lets you style six models with clothes, hairstyles, accessories, and bright backgrounds. Click or tap to build a look for each one.
tips: Pick the hairstyle first, since it shapes which accessories and outfits will look right with it.
Choose one or two bold pieces per model and keep the rest simple so the look stays balanced.
Try a few color combinations on the same model before settling, because small changes can make a big difference.
Match the background to the outfit's mood, such as a bright backdrop for a cheerful look.
Work through all six models in order so you do not forget to finish any of them before the show.
faq: What is the goal of Fashion Show Dressup?
The goal is to dress up six models with clothes, hairstyles, and accessories, then show off your creative styling with a background of your choice.
How do I control the game?
Use mouse clicks or taps to select items, change options, and move through the dress-up steps.

drone-dash-time-challenges.intro: Drone Dash - Time Challenges is a fast arcade puzzler where you bounce a small drone off walls and platforms to collect bullets before the timer runs out. Each level is short, so quick, precise bounces matter.
tips: Plan your bounce direction before you click or tap, since the drone keeps moving between surfaces and cannot jump or stop mid-air.
Aim to collect more bullets than the minimum, because each extra bullet can raise your star count, up to 3 per level.
Once you reach the minimum bullet count, look for the glowing crystal at the start point and head back to it to finish the level.
Keep an eye on the clock as you go, and avoid spending too long on one route, since running out of time sends you back to the start.
Pay close attention to traps and tricky tiles, especially in the tight spaces, because a single hit resets your progress to the start.
faq: What is the goal of Drone Dash - Time Challenges?
Collect as many bullets as you can before time runs out. Once you have the minimum required, reach the glowing crystal at the starting point to complete the level.
How do I earn stars?
The more bullets you collect, the more stars you earn, with a maximum of 3 per level.

draw-one-line-drawing-puzzle.intro: Draw One Line is a dot-connecting puzzle where you must join all the dots with a single continuous line. Each puzzle tests your planning and logic.
tips: Before you start drawing, look at the whole layout and find dots that have few connections. Those are often the best places to begin or end your line.
Trace possible routes with your eye first, so you do not commit to a path that leaves a dot stranded.
Since you can start from any point, try several starting spots if the first one does not work out.
If you get stuck, you cannot retrace your path, so think about which paths you need to keep open for the dots left behind.
Take a short pause between puzzles to reset your focus, then return to the next one with fresh eyes.
faq: What is the goal of Draw One Line?
Join all the dots with a single line without retracing any part of your path. You can begin from any dot.
Can I start my line from any dot?
Yes, the instructions say you can begin from any point, so you can pick whichever starting dot suits the puzzle best.

bridge-dash.intro: Bridge Dash is a physics puzzle where you draw a bridge so your car can safely reach the finish line. Each level has obstacles, so your bridge needs to fit the route.
tips: Study the whole level before you draw, and look for the gaps, obstacles, and the finish line so you know where the bridge must reach.
Start with a simple, low bridge shape and test it. If the car falls, you learn quickly what the physics does with your line.
Keep the bridge supported at both ends so the car has solid ground to roll onto and off of.
Avoid steep angles where the car could slide or tip, since a small change in slope can make a big difference to whether it stays on.
If you keep failing, change one part of your drawing at a time so you can see which change helped.
faq: What is the goal of Bridge Dash?
Draw a bridge that lets your car get across the obstacles and reach the finish line without falling.
Do I control the car directly?
No. You draw the bridge, and the car drives along it using the game's physics, so your drawing decides the result.

arcuz-treasure-hunters.intro: Arcuz Treasure Hunters is a retro fantasy JRPG about exploring underground caves, solving traps and puzzles, and building a team of companions. Dungeons mix fixed story areas with randomly generated ones.
tips: Search the scene components carefully before moving on, since hidden passages and clues are part of how you progress through a map.
Look at traps and puzzles closely and work out what the environment is telling you before you trigger anything.
Choose companions with different abilities so your team can handle a mix of puzzles, traps, and powerful enemies.
Coordinate your team's actions with the terrain in mind rather than advancing blindly through each room.
Expect randomly generated dungeons to vary between runs, so stay flexible and adapt your approach instead of relying on a single fixed route.
faq: What is the main goal of Arcuz Treasure Hunters?
The goal is to explore underground caves, uncover rare treasures, and fully explore each map. Progress depends on solving puzzles and finding hidden passages, not just moving forward.
How do I get past traps and puzzles?
Observe the environment and search the scene components for clues. Coordinate your team, since different companions may help with different obstacles.

save-the-fruit-draw-to-save.intro: Save the Fruit: Draw to Home is a drawing puzzle where you draw paths that guide stranded fruits safely home. Plan each route so every fruit reaches its home without colliding with others or hitting obstacles.
tips: Study the whole level before you draw, and note where each fruit starts, where its home is, and where the obstacles and villains sit.
Click on the leg of a fruit to start drawing its line, so make sure you begin from the correct spot for that fruit.
Plan the paths for all fruits together, since a route that looks fine on its own can cause a collision with another fruit.
Keep lines clear of obstacles and check that no fruit will get stuck along its path before you finish drawing.
If a level fails, remember that any collision between fruits ends the attempt, so try a different order or layout of lines next time.
faq: How do I start drawing a path for a fruit?
Click on the leg of the fruit you want to move, then draw its line from its starting point toward its home.
What makes a level fail?
The level fails if the fruits collide with each other, so every fruit must reach home without bumping into another one.

alphabet-kitchen.intro: Alphabet Kitchen is a cooking game where you bake letter cookies with Chef Elmo and decorate them. It helps kids practice vowels and blending letters into 3- and 4-letter words.
tips: Say each letter sound out loud as you add it, so the word you are building becomes clear before you finish it.
Start by looking for the vowel in each word, since vowels are the focus of the lesson and help you spot simple 3-letter words first.
Once the 3-letter words feel easy, move on to 4-letter words and check that each letter is in the right order.
Take your time with decorating, but keep an eye on the word you are making so the cookie matches the letters you chose.
Play in short sessions and repeat the words you find tricky, which helps the spelling patterns stick.
faq: What is the goal of Alphabet Kitchen?
You bake letter cookies in Chef Elmo's kitchen by blending letters into words of 3 or 4 letters. Then you decorate the finished cookies.
How do I control the game?
Use your mouse or tap the screen to pick letters, place them, and decorate the cookies.

hungry-warrior-fight.intro: Hungry Warrior Fight is a street combat action game where you move your fighter with a joystick or keys and use punches, kicks, grabs and blocks. This guide covers the controls and some practical habits to fight better.
tips: Learn the basic keys first: Z punches, X handles foot attacks, and V blocks. Practise switching between them so you do not hesitate mid-fight.
Use block with V when an opponent is about to strike, rather than backing away every time. Blocking keeps your position and lets you counter quickly.
Use SPACE to jump when you need to change position or avoid an attack, but do not jump constantly, since you can be left open when you land.
Mix your attacks instead of repeating one move. Alternate punches, foot attacks and grabs to keep opponents guessing.
On mobile, get comfortable with the joystick for movement and the on-screen buttons for attacks before starting a tough fight.
faq: What keys move my character?
Use WASD or the Arrow keys to walk. On mobile, use the joystick to move in any direction.
How do I attack and defend?
Press Z to punch, X for foot attacks, and V to block. Grab and push moves are also used with X, according to the in-game instructions.

pumpkin-blast.intro: Pumpkin Blast is a Halloween puzzle where you help Jack the pumpkin escape a dark prison by using explosives to move him toward the safe area. Each level rewards fewer attempts with a better result.
tips: Before you click, study the whole level and plan the route Jack should take to reach the safe area.
Pay close attention to the spikes, since they are the main danger and can end an attempt quickly.
Think about the direction of each explosion, because the blast is what moves Jack and you want him heading the right way.
Try to finish each level in as few attempts as possible, since the goal is to land Jack safely with the fewest tries.
If you get stuck, reset your plan and test a different sequence of explosions rather than repeating the same move.
faq: What is the main goal of Pumpkin Blast?
Your goal is to land Jack the pumpkin in the safe area using the fewest attempts possible.
How do I move Jack?
Use mouse clicks or taps to place explosives that push Jack in the direction you need.

city-minibus-driver.intro: City Minibus Driver puts you behind the wheel of a minibus in a busy city. Carry passengers to their bus stops on time in career mode, then spend your earnings on faster and more luxurious minibuses.
tips: Learn the route layout before you pick up speed, so you know where each bus stop is and can plan turns ahead of time.
Keep an eye on the clock for each mission. Staying on schedule matters because missions must be completed on time to earn money.
Use the look-back and camera controls to check your passengers' stops and traffic around you without losing track of the road.
If your minibus ends up in an awkward position, use the fix bus position control rather than struggling to recover manually.
Save money for a better minibus. A faster or more luxurious vehicle from the garage can make later missions and tournament races easier to handle.
faq: What is the main goal of City Minibus Driver?
Take passengers to the bus stops on each route within the time limit. Each successful mission earns you money.
How can I earn money in the game?
You earn money after each successful career mission, and you can also earn it in the minibus racing tournament.

colorful-cubes.intro: Colorful Cubes is a one-player puzzle game where you move a colorful cube to paint the required number of small white platforms. Watch out for spikes, tricky platforms, and platforms that slow you down.
tips: Plan your route before you move so you paint the needed platforms without backtracking into spots you have already covered.
Keep an eye out for spikes and avoid stepping near them, since a single mistake can cost you progress.
Be careful with platforms that look safe but are deceptive, and test them with a short, controlled step when you are unsure.
Pay attention to platforms that delay you, and try to move through areas with a steady rhythm instead of stopping on slow spots.
Use small, deliberate moves with the arrow keys or touch controls, because quick rushed inputs make it easier to land on the wrong tile.
faq: What is the goal of Colorful Cubes?
You use the colorful cube to paint the required number of small white platforms. Covering all of them is how you progress.
What controls does Colorful Cubes use?
You can use the arrow keys on a keyboard or touch the screen to move the cube.

nonograms-pixel-garden.intro: Nonograms: Pixel Garden is a logic puzzle where you fill cells using coloured row and column numbers to reveal a picture. There is no timer, and every puzzle can be solved by reasoning alone.
tips: Start with lines whose numbers nearly fill the row or column, since these leave the fewest possible placements.
Use the "×" marker on cells you know are empty, so you don't accidentally fill them later and can focus on the open cells.
Check the numbers of a crossing row and column together, because a cell that fits both lines is often the easiest one to confirm.
On a big grid, switch between the zoomed view and "Whole field" so you can read the numbers clearly and still see how the whole picture is shaping up.
Try Classic mode when you want to practise without checking, then switch to mistake checking when you want a safety net for longer puzzles.
faq: How do I know what colour a run should be?
The colour of each number is the colour of its run, so match the number's colour to the colour buttons below the grid.
What do the numbers mean when there are several of them?
Each number is the length of a run of filled cells, and they appear in order. Runs of the same colour need at least one empty cell between them.

neon-goal.intro: Neon Goal is a short physics puzzle about throwing a ball into the net while using a limited number of throws. Each level is a new layout with obstacles to work around.
tips: Before you throw, look at the whole level and find the route the ball needs to take, including any bounces off surfaces.
Drag to aim and watch the direction before you release, since every throw uses up one of your limited hits.
Try a gentle shot first when the layout is unclear, so you can see how the ball bounces and learn the physics.
Aim for a bounce off a wall or surface when a direct line to the net is blocked by obstacles.
If you run low on throws, stop and plan the rest of the level rather than shooting quickly, because each wasted throw makes the next one harder.
faq: How do I aim the ball?
Touch the screen and drag to set your aim, then release your finger to throw. You can adjust the drag before you let go.
What is the goal of each level?
Your goal is to throw the ball into the net or goal. You must do this within the limited number of hits or throws the level allows.

slinger.intro: Slinger is a minimalist grid puzzle where you guide a red square to the yellow door. Collect every yellow key first, then slip through to win each level.
tips: Before you move anything, check which yellow keys are needed and where the yellow door sits. Planning the route to the keys first saves wasted moves.
Look for the order that clears the path. Moving a block out of the way early can open a route you will need later.
Make small test drags and watch how the blocks and the red square respond. Learning how each piece slides makes the later levels easier to read.
If you get stuck, step back and trace the path from the red square to the nearest key, then from that key to the door. Breaking the level into short routes keeps the puzzle manageable.
Count the keys before you commit to a long path. Missing one key means the yellow door stays locked, so a quick check of the remaining keys can prevent a dead end.
faq: What is the goal of Slinger?
Move the red square through the grid, collect every yellow key, and reach the yellow door. The door only unlocks once all keys are collected.
How do I move the pieces?
Drag with your mouse or your finger to slide blocks and the red square. Each drag moves the piece across the grid in the direction you choose.

cow-cow-run.intro: Cow Cow Run is an arcade game where you guide a cow away from UFOs while collecting coins to buy its freedom. It plays somewhat like 3D Pac-Man across 10 levels.
tips: Clear the coins in a planned route rather than wandering, since you must collect all the coins on a level to finish it.
Keep an eye on where the UFOs are moving and change direction early so you are not trapped in a corner.
Spend your coins on upgrades and bonuses when you can, because the best buffs can make later levels easier to handle.
Watch for bonuses as you play, since they are part of how you improve your progress.
Try a few runs with the sound off first if you want to focus on movement, then turn it on to enjoy the music and sound effects.
faq: What do I need to do to complete a level?
You need to collect all the coins on the level while avoiding the UFOs chasing the cow.
What are the coins used for?
Coins are spent on upgrades and bonuses that help you during the game.

merge-fruit-monster-defense-tower-defens.intro: Merge Fruit Monster Defense mixes backpack merging, roguelike play and tower defense. You protect Tao from waves of zombie monsters that keep spawning and grow harder over time.
tips: Keep moving rather than standing still, since monsters chase you and any touch ends the game immediately.
Plan your route ahead of time so you do not get pinned against the edges of the map by approaching monsters.
Pick up the random buff items when it is safe, and save the Freeze skill for moments when several monsters are closing in at once.
Use the Speed boost to escape a tight spot or reach a buff item before the monsters do.
Use your silver coins and backpack space wisely, and merge fruits up to Tier 4 before crossbreeding them to strengthen your fighters.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Your goal is to protect Tao and stop the monsters from eating her by avoiding every chasing monster.
How do I move my character?
Control your character by touch or by dragging with the mouse to move around the map.

bump-i.intro: Bump.io is a multiplayer car battle with 16 cars competing at once. You need to stay clear of monsters and boundaries while hitting other vehicles to gain energy and grow in size.
tips: Keep an eye on the boundaries at all times, since hitting them is one of the main ways to lose.
Watch for monsters on the map and steer around them early rather than reacting at the last moment.
Choose your impacts carefully: hitting other vehicles is how you gain energy, so pick targets that are weakened or in a position where you can hit them cleanly.
Use your growth wisely. Defeating vehicles increases your size, so after a successful collision, check your surroundings before moving on.
Stay aware of the other cars around you, since with 16 vehicles competing, a crowded area can quickly lead to a collision you did not plan for.
faq: What is the goal of Bump.io?
The goal is to win the competition by avoiding collisions with monsters and boundaries while outlasting the other cars.
How do I gain energy in Bump.io?
You gain energy by impacting other vehicles.

halloween-monster-traffic.intro: Help little monsters cross busy Halloween roads by tapping at the right moments. Timing is the main skill, and the game gets more varied as you move through its levels.
tips: Watch the traffic pattern for a few seconds before you tap, so you can spot the gap your monster needs.
Tap with a clear rhythm rather than rushing, since a late or early tap is usually what sends a monster into traffic.
Pay attention to the different obstacles as they appear, and adjust your timing for each one instead of repeating the same tap.
If you fail a crossing, pause for a moment and reset your focus before trying again, as steady attempts tend to work better than rapid ones.
Play at a relaxed pace at first to learn how each level moves, then speed up your reactions once you feel comfortable.
faq: What is the goal of Halloween Monster Traffic?
The goal is to help the little monsters find a way across the busy roads by tapping the screen at the right time.
How do I control the monsters?
Use a mouse click or tap to play. Each tap is used to make the monster cross the road at the right moment.

trash-sort.intro: Trash Sort is an arcade game where you drag waste items into the matching bins. Each correct sort helps the scene recover from pollution.
tips: Learn the bin symbols and colors first, such as the bottle for glass and the leaf for organic waste, so you can sort quickly without second-guessing.
Look at the item's shape and material before you drag it. A bottle, a can, a paper scrap, and food waste each belong in a different bin.
Keep your attention on the bins you have not used recently, since a mistake often comes from rushing past a bin you have less practice with.
Drag each item in one steady motion to the correct bin rather than hovering over several bins, which keeps your pace even as items build up.
Pay attention to how the scene changes as you sort more items correctly. Watching that progress can help you notice which bins you use most often.
faq: What is the goal of Trash Sort?
The goal is to sort each piece of waste into the correct bin. Correct sorting helps the environment recover, and the scenes become cleaner and more colorful.
How do I move the items?
Tap an item and drag it into the bin that matches its type. Each bin has a symbol or color linked to a waste category.

heroic-knight.intro: Heroic Knight is a puzzle adventure where you guide a knight through dangerous terrain to rescue the princess or reach the gold. Each level is solved by pulling the right sticks in the right order.
tips: Before you pull any stick, look at the whole screen and work out what each one will change. Acting on a guess is the most common way to lose.
Pay attention to timing as well as order. Some stick pulls only work if you make them at the right moment, so pause to plan the next move.
Watch where the trolls are standing and what they can reach. Clear the path near them first, or make sure they cannot get to you before you move on.
Keep track of the lava. Know which routes leave you standing on safe ground and which ones drop you into it, and avoid any move that could send you there.
If a level stops making sense, reset your plan and retry from the start rather than pushing ahead with a broken setup. Test one idea at a time to see what each stick does.
faq: What is the goal of Heroic Knight?
Your goal is to reach the gold or get the prince to the princess, depending on the level. You do this by solving the puzzle with the sticks and getting past the obstacles.
How do I control the knight?
The main control is pulling the sticks in the right order and at the right time. The game does not list any other controls, so focus on reading each stick's effect.

craft-theft-war.intro: Craft Theft War is an open-world, pixel-style sandbox shooter with online multiplayer. You move with WASD, aim with the mouse, and shoot with a left click.
tips: Keep moving with WASD instead of standing still, since a moving target is harder to hit.
Use Shift to sprint when you need to close distance quickly or get out of a bad spot.
Reload with R during a quiet moment rather than in the middle of a firefight, so you are not caught with an empty weapon.
Use Space to jump over obstacles and get a better view of the sandbox around you.
Aim with the mouse before you fire, and take short, controlled shots instead of spraying constantly.
faq: What are the basic controls?
Move with WASD, aim with the mouse, shoot with the left click, jump with Space, sprint with Shift, and reload with R.
How do I reload my weapon?
Press R to reload. Doing it when you are not under fire helps you avoid running out of ammo at a bad moment.

elemental-barrage.intro: Elemental Barrage is an arcade volley shooter where you fire bouncing elemental balls at monsters marching down the board. Each turn you aim a barrage and try to clear rows before they reach the bottom.
tips: Pay attention to where your first ball lands, because the launcher moves there after each volley. Aim the opening shot so the rest of the barrage follows a useful path.
Use walls and monsters to ricochet your balls into spots you could not reach directly. Angled shots often hit more targets than straight ones.
Collect +1 pickups and let your ball tray fill so twin balls merge into stronger elementals. Build toward the merge instead of firing every ball at once.
Plan ahead for the boss that appears every 10 rows. Beating it sets a checkpoint, so it is worth preparing for that fight.
Check how close the monsters are after each turn, since they step one row closer every time. Clear the front rows first when the march gets close.
faq: How do I aim my shot?
Drag back from the launcher to aim, then release to fire your volley. The balls ricochet off walls and monsters, and every hit deals damage.
What happens when the ball tray overflows?
Twin balls merge into stronger elementals with effects such as burn, freeze and chain lightning. Collecting +1 pickups helps fill the tray.

dirt-bike-racing-adventure.intro: Dirt Bike Racing Adventure is a 3D offroad motocross game where you race over steep hills, gaps and obstacles. Keep your bike balanced, land cleanly, and aim for faster times.
tips: Use A and D (or the Left and Right Arrows) early and often in the air. Small corrections keep the bike level before you land.
Before a jump, ease off the throttle if the bike is tilting. Landing nose-down or sideways is a common cause of losing speed.
Save Left Shift boost for flat stretches or right after a clean landing. Using it while you are off balance can send you into a crash.
Brake with S or Down Arrow before steep downhill sections so you can keep control, then accelerate again once the bike is stable.
Replay a difficult stage to focus on one jump or gap at a time. Steady, repeated runs usually improve your time more than rushing.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Race across each motocross track, balance through jumps, and land smoothly while pushing for faster times. Unlocking new stages is part of the progression.
How do I balance the bike in the air?
Use A and D or the Left and Right Arrow keys to tilt the bike. Keep the front and back wheels level before you hit the ground.

punch-superhero.intro: Punch Superhero is a 3D action shooter where you play a superhero protecting city civilians from gangsters while completing the D-Day mission. Movement, running, jumping, shooting, laser and flying are all on separate keys.
tips: Keep track of where the innocent people are before you fire, since the battlefield is full of them and your job is to protect them.
Use WASD to keep moving so you are not an easy target while you shoot at gangsters.
Save Shift for running when you need to cover ground quickly, and use Space to jump over obstacles or to reposition.
Try switching between the left mouse button shot and the right mouse button laser to see which works better against different targets.
Use CTRL to fly when you need to get above the fight or move across the city faster, then come back down to ground level to take on enemies.
faq: What is the goal of Punch Superhero?
You play as a superhero who must save city people from city gangsters and complete the D-Day mission.
Which keys control movement?
WASD moves your character, Shift runs, and Space jumps.

popcats-merge-the-cats.intro: PopCats is a merge puzzle where you combine matching cats into bigger ones. Keep the cats below the top line and work toward the biggest cats to win.
tips: Look for matching cats before you drop a new one, so each merge builds toward a larger cat instead of leaving a crowded stack.
Keep an eye on the top line at all times. If cats get close to it, focus on merging pairs to lower the pile before you add more.
Save yarn for a cat that is blocking your next merge, since it is your tool for removing an interfering cat.
Use the bottom panel to check a cat's story if you want a break from the pressure, but keep your attention on the board.
If the next cat offered does not help your layout, you can change it by watching an ad, which can give you a better option.
faq: What is the main goal of PopCats?
Connect matching cats into larger ones and try to win by joining the two biggest cats. Collect points to climb the player rankings.
How do I make a cat merge?
Click on the screen with your finger or mouse to place cats. Identical cats connect into a larger one.

drone-vs-tractor-challenge.intro: Pilot a nimble drone over farmland, dodging tractors and obstacles while completing objectives. Precise flying and quick reactions are what keep you in the air.
tips: Move in small, controlled inputs with WASD or the arrow keys, since the controls respond quickly and big movements can send you into obstacles.
Before you chase an objective, scan the area for tractors and farm obstacles so you know where it is safe to fly.
Use altitude changes early to clear low obstacles rather than correcting at the last second.
Treat each colorful environment as a new layout: take a few seconds to learn where the hazards sit before pushing forward.
If a run goes badly, reset your approach and focus on one objective at a time instead of rushing through the whole area.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You pilot a drone through farm environments, complete objectives, and avoid collisions with tractors and obstacles.
How do I control the drone?
Use WASD or the Arrow Keys to move, and use the on-screen controls or the indicated keyboard keys to change altitude and perform actions.

unstack-tower.intro: Unstack Tower is a puzzle game where you take apart a tower of colored cubes without letting it fall. Placing and timing each move carefully is the key to lasting longer.
tips: Before each tap, check whether the block you are about to place or drop will sit evenly on the pieces below it.
Use rotation or repositioning when you can, since a block that sits flat and centered is less likely to shift the tower.
Look for matching colors that are close together so you can clear a group of three or more and open up space.
Pay attention to the material of each piece, because glass and wood can behave differently and change how stable the stack feels.
Avoid stacking pieces loosely on top of each other, as a wobbly stack is the most common way the tower collapses.
faq: What is the goal of Unstack Tower?
You need to dismantle the tower of colored cubes in the required sequence without causing it to collapse. Each level adds more difficulty.
How do I control the blocks?
Use clicks or taps to place or drop blocks. Some pieces can be rotated or positioned before you place them.

love-sheep.intro: Love Sheep is a relaxed physics puzzle about guiding bouncy, squishy sheep through stages. You bounce, stretch and slide your sheep past gaps and traps to reach the end point of each puzzle.
tips: Experiment with bouncing before committing to a jump, since the sheep's springiness is central to crossing gaps.
Before moving, look at the whole stage and identify the narrow passages where you will need to slide or stretch.
Plan your route around traps and obstacles first, then move the sheep step by step rather than rushing.
Try a stage again if you get stuck; small changes in how you stretch or drag the sheep can lead to a different result.
Keep an eye on the rewards you earn, as they unlock new sheep and custom items to play with.
