faq: What is the goal of Love Sheep?
Your goal is to guide your sheep through each stage and reach the end point to complete the puzzle. Keep the sheep on the safe path and avoid traps along the way.
How do I control the sheep?
Tap, swipe or drag to move and control your sheep through the stage. Physics affects how the sheep bounces, stretches and slides.

jelly-bros-red-and-blue.intro: Jelly Bros Red and Blue is a two-brother platform adventure where Red and Blue must both reach the royal crown. Their souls are linked, so if one brother is lost, both are gone.
tips: Keep both brothers in view at all times so you can see which one needs help before a mistake costs you both.
Move slowly when the two are far apart, and pause to let the trailing brother catch up before the next jump.
Save your double jump for the moments you need it most, since using it early can leave you without a way to correct a bad landing.
Collect the ores you pass along the way, but never let a detour take either brother into danger.
On mobile, use short, controlled touches instead of rapid taps so each brother lands where you intend.
faq: What is the goal of Jelly Bros Red and Blue?
Both Red and Blue must reach the royal crown. The level is only complete when both brothers get there.
What happens if one brother is hurt or lost?
Because their souls are one, if one of them dies, both of them die. You will need to try again from that point.

santa-holiday-adventure-game.intro: Santa Holiday Adventure is a festive 3D flying game where you guide Santa's sleigh over snowy towns to deliver gifts before sunrise. Collect coins along the way to unlock upgrades.
tips: Watch the sky and keep track of how much time you have, since every home needs its gift before sunrise.
Collect coins whenever they are on your path, because they are what you use to unlock new reindeer, sleighs, and boosters.
Save boosters for moments when you are falling behind schedule or need to reach a far-off house quickly.
Pay attention to the layout of each snowy village so you can plan a route that hits several homes in one pass.
If you are playing with a Fire Stick remote, make small, steady inputs rather than fast presses so Santa's flight stays under control.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
You fly Santa's sleigh across snowy towns and deliver gifts to homes before Christmas morning, which means before sunrise.
What do I use coins for?
Coins are collected in flight and can be spent to unlock new reindeer, sleigh upgrades, and power-ups.

mad-truck.intro: Mad Truck is a racing driving simulation where you balance your truck over platforms and ramps while heading for the finish line. Earning all three yellow stars means finishing each level within the marked time.
tips: Keep the truck stable on the sides of platforms and ramps before you try to speed up, since a tipped truck costs more time than a slow start.
Ease off the speed on steep ramps and let the truck settle before the next obstacle.
Watch the marked time on each level and work out roughly how fast you need to move to hit it.
In the challenge levels, read the obstacles ahead in the normal view and plan your approach before each jump or crossing.
Replay levels you almost finished, focusing on the spots where you lost balance, to pick up the extra stars.
faq: What is the goal of Mad Truck?
Reach the finish line of each level as quickly as possible. Finishing within the marked time earns you all three yellow stars.
How do I control the truck?
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps. Use them to drive and keep the truck steady as you move through each level.

playmusic.intro: PlayMusic is a set of music-driven runner games where each song shapes the obstacles, gems and difficulty. Each runner uses its own track, so the controls and challenge change from one game to the next.
tips: Play with sound on, since the beat is what sets the pace of the obstacles and helps you time your moves.
Watch the rhythm rather than just the nearest obstacle, so you can start your jump, slide or dodge before the beat hits.
In Taxi Drift, hold the drift control through turns and use tilt or arrows to steer, rather than making sharp, quick corrections.
In Clouscape, remember you have a double jump, so save it for gaps or obstacles you cannot clear with a single jump.
In the shooter runners, tap to shoot only when you have a clear line, and keep moving so you do not get caught in the middle of the action.
faq: What is the goal in PlayMusic?
Dodge obstacles, collect gems and stay alive as the rhythm speeds up around you. Each runner is played through its song.
Does difficulty increase over time?
The game adapts its difficulty to the music and your skill, so the challenge grows as you get better.

mr-one-punch-action-fighting-game.intro: Mr One Punch is an action fighting game where you take on a series of opponents to become the champion of the rings and streets. Move with WASD and punch with the left mouse button.
tips: Watch your opponent before you commit to a punch so you can time your attack when they are open.
Use WASD to reposition after each exchange so you are not stuck in one spot while an opponent attacks.
Keep your punches well timed rather than clicking rapidly, since the goal is to win each fight cleanly.
Pay attention to how each opponent moves so you can learn their rhythm and react to it.
If you lose a fight, retry and focus on one habit at a time, such as holding your position or waiting for the right opening.
faq: What is the goal of Mr One Punch?
Your goal is to beat all the opponents and become the fighting champion of the rings and streets.
What are the controls?
Use the WASD keys to move and the left mouse button to punch.

squeeze-n-slide.intro: Squeeze'n'Slide is an arcade runner where you steer a jelly through a colorful 3D obstacle course. Your job is to reshape it so it fits through each gate while collecting crystals and fruit.
tips: Watch the gate ahead and start reshaping early, since the jelly needs a moment to change shape before it reaches the opening.
Make small, steady drags instead of large swings so you can adjust the jelly's shape precisely as each gate approaches.
Keep your eyes a little further down the course than the jelly itself, which gives you more time to react as the speed goes up.
Pick up fruit when it is safe to do so, but do not chase it if it means lining up badly for the next gate.
Stay calm once the pace picks up; a short pause in your thinking often matters more than a faster reaction.
faq: What is the main goal in Squeeze'n'Slide?
Guide the jelly through each gate by changing its shape to fit, and keep moving along the course. Collecting crystals and fruit along the way adds to your run.
How do I change the jelly's shape?
Drag up or down with your finger or mouse to reshape the jelly. Use the drag to match the opening of each gate.

vacation-overload.intro: Vacation Overload is a 3D packing puzzle where you fit a steady stream of luggage into a trunk grid. Plan your placements carefully so the pile does not overwhelm you.
tips: Rotate a piece in several directions before placing it, so you can see which orientation sits flattest and leaves the fewest gaps.
Use the empty buffer slots to hold a piece that does not fit the current layout, so you can keep the queue moving.
Fill the corners and edges of the trunk first, so awkward gaps do not get trapped between larger pieces.
If a new piece has nowhere to go, click a placed piece to pick it up and reposition it to free up space.
Look ahead at the queue before committing to a placement, since a piece that fits well now may block a shape you need soon.
faq: How do I rotate a piece?
Use W or the Up Arrow to tilt forward, S or the Down Arrow to tilt backward, A or the Left Arrow to rotate left, and D or the Right Arrow to rotate right.
What happens if I cannot place a piece?
Click an empty buffer slot to store the selected piece, then bring it back out later when there is more room in the trunk.

pumpkin-dungeon-of-doom.intro: Pumpkin Dungeon Of Doom is a Halloween puzzle adventure with 100 levels of monsters, traps and hazards. You escape each dungeon by combining quick reactions with careful thinking.
tips: Look at the whole room before you move. Work out where the spikes, guillotines and poison gas are before you commit to a path.
Keep an eye on the bats, since they will chase you. Plan your route so you are not caught in a dead end while they close in.
Do not trust every route. Ghosts will try to trick you, so pause to check whether a path looks too easy.
Use the early levels to learn how each hazard behaves. Knowing the timing of each trap will help you on the harder dungeons.
Stay calm when danger appears around you. Quick reflexes help, but a short pause to think often saves a run.
faq: What is the goal of Pumpkin Dungeon Of Doom?
Your goal is to escape all 100 dungeons. Each level is filled with monsters, traps and hazards that you need to get past.
How do I control the character?
You play with mouse clicks or taps, so the controls stay simple and easy to learn.

commit.intro: Commit is a logic puzzle where a cat must cross every tile in each isometric level to reach its food. Each tile vanishes once you leave it, so every jump needs planning.
tips: Before your first click, look at the whole level and note which tiles are hard to reach, such as ones tucked into corners or behind others.
Work backward from the food. Figuring out where the cat must finish helps you choose a route that does not strand any tiles.
Count the tiles you still need to cross as you go. If a tile would be cut off from the rest of the path, reconsider your move.
Avoid stepping onto tiles that lead to dead ends until you are sure they are the last ones you need to visit.
Take your time. Since no move can be undone, a short pause to trace the route is worth more than a quick click.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
The cat must step on every tile in the level and reach the food to complete it.
How do I move the cat?
Click with your mouse on the tile you want to go to. The cat jumps there, and the tile it leaves disappears.

mini-car-racing-master-3d.intro: Mini Car Racing Master 3D is an endless highway racer where you steer through traffic, use nitro boosts, and collect coins to unlock and upgrade faster cars. Your run continues until you crash, so smooth driving matters most.
tips: Make small, early steering adjustments instead of sharp last-second turns, which helps you slip between traffic without losing speed.
Save your nitro boost for open stretches of road where you can use the extra speed safely rather than spending it in heavy traffic.
Scan a few car lengths ahead so you can spot traffic and obstacles early and plan a line through them.
Collect coins whenever the path is clear, since they are needed to unlock new cars and upgrade the ones you own.
Adjust your driving when the weather changes between sunny, rainy, and snowy roads, and give yourself extra space to react.
faq: How do I steer my car?
You can tilt your device or swipe to steer. The control scheme is designed to be easy to learn.
What does the nitro boost do?
Tapping the screen activates nitro, which gives your car a burst of extra speed to pass opponents.

jelly-color-sort-3d.intro: Jelly Color Sort 3D is a color sorting puzzle where you move colorful 3D jellies into matching sections before the timer runs out. Each level gets harder, so planning ahead matters.
tips: Before you tap, look at which jelly is on top of each stack and where it can go, so you do not block a color you still need.
Try to finish each section's color in one go when you can, since working in a rush often leaves a jelly stuck in the wrong place.
Save Freeze Time for moments when the countdown is low and you still have several jellies to sort, so it buys you the most thinking room.
If one jelly keeps blocking several moves, consider using Destroy Jelly on it rather than spending time working around it.
When every option seems blocked, Auto Shuffle can give you a fresh layout, so use it before you run out of time rather than after.
faq: How do I complete a level?
Sort all the jellies so that each color is in its matching section before the timer reaches zero. Finishing the puzzle advances you to the next level.
How do I select and move a jelly?
Tap a jelly to select it, then tap the section where it should go. The controls are simple taps.

buildemup.intro: BuildemUp is a physics puzzle where you drag colorful blocks onto a truck and stack them so they stay put while the truck drives. Your aim is to deliver every block and finish the houses.
tips: Place the heaviest or widest blocks on the bottom first, so the stack has a stable base before you add smaller pieces on top.
Keep the stack low and centered on the truck bed, since tall or off-center towers are the most likely to topple when the truck moves.
Before the truck starts, look at how each block rests against its neighbors and nudge any that look wobbly or balanced on a single point.
Try different stacking orders on harder levels rather than repeating the same arrangement, since the shapes vary a lot from one puzzle to the next.
Spend coins on a truck you like once you have some, and use power-ups when a level has you stuck rather than early on, so you save them for the tougher puzzles.
faq: What is the goal of BuildemUp?
Stack the colorful blocks onto the truck so they stay on when it moves, then deliver them to finish building the houses.
How do I move the blocks?
Drag each shape and drop it onto the truck. Place it where you want it before releasing.

bouncy-ball.intro: Bouncy Ball is an arcade platformer where you guide a bouncing ball across floating platforms and past spikes. Good timing of your taps decides how long you survive.
tips: Watch the ball's bounce for a moment before tapping, so you can judge where it will land next.
Focus on precision jumps early on, since a small timing error can send the ball off a platform.
Keep an eye on the spikes ahead and plan your bounces so you pass them cleanly rather than reacting at the last second.
Try to build combo chains by landing your bounces in a steady rhythm, since they earn extra rewards and higher scores.
Expect the tricky jumps to get harder as you progress, so stay calm and treat each new level as a fresh timing challenge.
faq: What is the goal of Bouncy Ball?
Your goal is to survive as long as possible, avoid falling down, and collect combo chains to earn more rewards and higher scores.
How do I control the ball?
Tap the screen to move the ball downward and control its bounce. Timing your taps is the key to staying on course.

traffic-racer-3d.intro: Traffic Racer 3D is a high-speed driving game where you steer a sports car through endless highway traffic. Survive longer, chase near-miss bonuses, and use your coins to unlock and upgrade faster cars.
tips: Steer early and in small moves so you can slip between cars without overcorrecting into a crash.
Aim for near misses on purpose, since brushing past oncoming traffic without crashing builds your combo for extra coins.
Keep an eye on the gaps several cars ahead rather than only the car directly in front, so you can plan your lane changes sooner.
Spend your first coins on upgrades for fuel, top speed, or armour based on what is causing your runs to end, then try the next car in the garage.
Work through the challenge levels to earn stars before moving on to endurance mode, where survival time is the goal.
faq: What is the main goal of Traffic Racer 3D?
The goal is to survive as long as you can on an endless highway full of traffic. The longer you last, the higher your score and the bigger your reward at the end of the run.
How do I steer the car?
Drag left or right to move your car between lanes. Quick, controlled drags help you weave through traffic.

troll-rider.intro: Troll Rider is an endless downhill bike ride where the road and its rewards can mislead you. Jump, flip, and collect Golden Gears as you descend, and learn each troll's trick after every crash.
tips: Treat anything that looks too helpful with caution, since a Gear trail or sign can lead straight into a trap. Slow down your reading of the scene before committing to a jump.
Land the X-bike smoothly, because a clean landing keeps your speed and builds your score. Sloppy landings cost you momentum that you will need for the next gap.
Grab Golden Gears when it is safe to do so, since they fill your Repair Meter and can restore lost hearts. Protect your remaining hearts by avoiding risky detours for Gears.
When a troll defeats you, watch the retry closely and note what caused the crash. The instant retry is your chance to change your approach and earn REVENGE.
Practice backflips in safe moments only, holding while airborne and keeping an eye on where you will land. Save big rotations for stretches where the path ahead is clear.
faq: How do I jump and perform backflips?
Tap, left click, or press Space to jump. Hold while airborne to rotate backward and perform a backflip.
How many hearts do I have, and what does a crash cost?
You start with 3 Hearts, and each crash costs one heart. Collecting Golden Gears can help you recover lost hearts.

randomation-racing-speed-trial-demolitio.intro: Randomation Racing Speed Trial Demolition is a single-player 3D racing game on asphalt tracks. You drive with the arrow keys, use turbo with B, and can switch cameras to judge your line.
tips: Learn the arrow keys first and ease off the throttle before corners so you keep control of the car.
Use the C key to switch camera views and pick the one that shows the track ahead most clearly for your driving.
Save turbo with the B key for straight sections where you are not steering, so it adds speed instead of pushing you wide.
Press WASD to look around when you need to check the road or your surroundings before a turn.
If a run goes badly, press R to restart quickly and try the same section again while you refine your approach.
faq: What is the goal of Randomation Racing Speed Trial Demolition?
The game is a racing game on asphalt tracks where you try to build your driving skill and race at high speed. The description frames it as a simulation of Grand Prix style racing.
What are the basic controls?
Use the arrow keys to drive, B for turbo, and C to change the camera view. Press Tab to open the menu, WASD to look around, and R to restart.

arkanoid-for-painters.intro: Arkanoid For Painters replaces the usual paddle with a barrier you draw yourself. Your goal is to keep the ball in play while clearing blocks and foes.
tips: Draw your barrier where the ball is heading, not where it currently is, so you have time to react.
Keep your drawn line smooth and steady, since a messy shape may leave gaps the ball can slip through.
Use the space above the ball's path to build a shape that bounces it toward the blocks you want to clear.
Pick up upgrades when you can, and think about how each one changes the way you should draw your barrier.
Try drawing angled barriers to redirect the ball, rather than only flat lines, to reach harder spots.
faq: How do I control the ball?
You don't move a board directly. Instead, you draw an obstacle with the left mouse button or your finger, and the ball bounces off what you draw.
What should I focus on to clear blocks faster?
Aim your barriers so the ball hits the blocks at useful angles. Watching where the ball travels helps you plan the next shape before it arrives.

arrow-free-3d.intro: Arrow Free 3D is a quiet logic puzzle where you spin a 3D cube and remove every arrow in the right order. Success depends on reading the arrow paths before you tap.
tips: Rotate the cube to check all six sides before making your first tap, so you know where every arrow points.
Look for arrows that have a clear, open path out. Removing these first often frees up others.
Think a few moves ahead and picture the chain reaction each tap will cause before you commit to it.
If you get stuck, stop and rotate the cube again. A different viewing angle can reveal a blocked arrow you missed.
Work slowly and steadily. The game is built around concentration, so rushing taps is the most common reason to get stuck.
faq: What is the goal of Arrow Free 3D?
Your goal is to remove every single arrow from the cube to clear the stage. You do this by tapping arrows in the correct order.
How do I avoid getting stuck?
Plan your moves by studying the arrow paths on all sides of the cube. Remove arrows that are not blocked by others first.

miner-dig-it-all.intro: Miner, Dig It All is a digging game where you have one tank of fuel to see how deep you can get. Plant dynamite, blast through layers, sell ore on the surface, and upgrade for the next dive.
tips: Your fuel is limited, so plan each dig before you start. Lay your dynamite line where it will clear the most useful rock instead of wasting time on small patches.
Clear a layer fully before moving on, since it collapses under you into a richer one. Leaving rock behind can cost you time and fuel.
Pay attention to what you spend on the surface. A harder bit, wider blasts, and a robot crew each change how fast you can dig, so pick the upgrade that fits your current problem.
Use the early-fire control on mouse or the Space key when your charges are planted and ready. Firing at the right moment keeps the dig moving.
Aim for the lava core at the bottom of the pit, since cracking it resets the pit with permanent gains. Each run is a chance to get a little further than the last.
faq: What is the goal of Miner, Dig It All?
Your goal is to dig as deep as you can with one tank of fuel. Cracking the lava core ten layers down resets the pit and leaves it permanently richer.
How do I plant and fire dynamite?
On mouse, click once to plant a single stick or hold and drag to lay a line. Right click or Space fires the planted charges, and on touch the charges fire on their own.

swap-the-pictures.intro: Swap The Pictures is a logic puzzle where you swap tiles on a grid so each image lands in the right row and column. Read the categories carefully before you start moving tiles.
tips: Start by reading every row and column category before touching any tile, so you know what each line is asking for.
Look for images that clearly fit only one category first, and place those before working on the harder ones.
Watch for tiles that could belong to two categories at once; these overlaps often tell you where a tile must end up.
Keep track of your remaining moves and avoid swapping back and forth, since each swap uses up one of your limited moves.
When stuck, check which rows or columns are already nearly complete and focus on the one with the fewest options left.
faq: What is the goal of Swap The Pictures?
The goal is to match each image to the correct row and column category and complete the whole grid before your moves run out.
How do I swap tiles?
Tap two tiles to swap their positions. Each swap is a move, so plan before you tap.

formula-apex-rush.intro: Formula Apex Rush is an open-wheel arcade racer where you steer through circuits, Grand Prix tracks, street events and night races against aggressive AI rivals. Your goal is to overtake the field and finish on the podium.
tips: Brake before corners rather than in them, then get back on the throttle as you exit so the car carries speed down the next straight.
Save your ERS/Nitro boost for long straight sections or moments when you are lining up a pass; using it early in a lap leaves you with nothing when you need it most.
Stay on the asphalt. Grass and off-road areas slow your car down significantly, so a small cut across a corner can cost more time than it saves.
Learn each circuit's corners on the first few laps, since consistent lines matter more than a single fast lap when you are chasing rivals.
Spend credits in the Garage on the upgrades that match your weak spots, so your car is better prepared for the harder events as the championship gets more competitive.
faq: How do I steer and accelerate?
Use W or the Up Arrow to accelerate and A/D or the Left/Right Arrow keys to steer. On mobile, use the on-screen steering and accelerator controls.
When should I use ERS or Nitro?
Use it on straight sections or when overtaking a rival for a temporary speed boost. Pick the moment carefully, because the boost is only available briefly.

brain-buster-multiplayer-math-puzzle-gam.intro: Brain Buster is a head-to-head mental math duel where you answer arithmetic questions faster than your opponent. Win the most of 14 questions to take the match.
tips: Scan the four answer choices quickly and look for the one that fits your quick estimate, rather than solving every problem fully on paper.
Wrong answers hand your rival a free shot, so only tap when you are confident. A slow correct answer is usually worth more than a fast wrong one.
Practise mental arithmetic across all four operations, since addition, subtraction, multiplication and division can each appear in any round.
Keep an eye on the 10-second timer. If a question is taking too long, remember that a draw holds your streak, while a loss breaks it.
Your level controls how fast and accurate the bot is and how large the numbers get, so expect tougher matches as you climb and adjust your pace to match.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Answer each question correctly before your opponent does, and win the most of the 14 questions to win the match.
What happens if I answer wrong?
Your opponent gets a free shot at the point for that question, so a wrong answer can cost you the round.

hill-ride-3d.intro: Hill Ride 3D is an arcade racer where balance matters as much as speed. You drive over hills, ramps, and bridges, and your landings and tilt control decide how far you get.
tips: Use A and D to tilt the truck before you land a jump so it touches down level instead of nose-first or tail-first.
Save nitro for flat or downhill stretches where you can hold speed, rather than spending it on a steep climb where you may flip.
On steep terrain, ease off the gas and use small tilt adjustments so the vehicle stays upright.
Spend coins on the upgrade that fixes your biggest problem: suspension for rough sections, grip for slippery ground, or engine for climbing.
Each run gets faster and more dangerous, so try to beat your own distance record by staying calm and steady rather than pushing hard from the start.
faq: What is the main goal of Hill Ride 3D?
Drive as far as you can while keeping the vehicle balanced over hills, jumps, and rough track sections. Your distance and coins are the main measures of a run.
How do I control the truck?
Use W to accelerate and S to brake, and A or D to tilt forward or backward. Press N for nitro and P to pause.

draw-and-drop.intro: Draw & Drop is a physics puzzle where you sketch a line that guides a ball into a basket. Each level adds obstacles, so you need to plan your route before the ball starts moving.
tips: Look at the whole level before drawing, paying attention to where the ball starts, where the basket is, and which obstacles are in the way.
Draw a simple route first. A shorter, cleaner line is often easier to control than a long, winding one.
Remember that the ball follows the line you drew, so make sure the line starts where the ball can reach it and points toward the target.
Use the start control in the top right or click the ball to run your line, then watch closely to see where the ball goes off course.
If a try fails, adjust only the part of the line that caused the problem instead of redrawing everything, which keeps your successful sections intact.
faq: What is the goal of Draw & Drop?
The goal is to draw a line that directs the ball so it hits the target in each level. The level passes when the ball reaches the target.
How do I start the ball moving?
After drawing your line, click on the ball or the start icon in the top right corner. The ball will then move along the path you drew.

maskinery-idle.intro: Maskinery Idle is a single-click clicker where you explore islands, fight red enemy tiles, and collect masks with unique abilities. Clear each grid to move through five stages and reach the Boss.
tips: Check your HP before clicking red enemy tiles, since they reflect damage back to you.
Return to the Village when you have gold to spend on Max HP or HP Regen, so you are less likely to get locked out of enemies.
Spend gold on Power in the Village to deal more damage per click and clear grids faster.
Use the energy you collect to level up your masks, and keep an eye on their abilities as you progress.
On stage 5, clear the tiles covering the 3x3 Boss first, then focus on defeating it to complete the location.
faq: What happens if my HP gets too low?
If your HP is too low to survive an enemy's hit, that enemy becomes locked until you heal. Healing through upgrades in the Village helps you keep fighting.
How do I defeat the Boss?
The Boss appears on stage 5 as a large 3x3 tile. Clear the tiles covering it first, then defeat the Boss to complete the location and unlock the next zone.

tilt-and-tumble.intro: Tilt & Tumble is a fast skill game where you guide a ball toward the finish line using tilt controls. Each level has a time limit, so you need to move quickly while avoiding hazards and picking up collectibles.
tips: Make small, gentle tilts instead of sharp ones so the ball stays under control on narrow paths.
Scan ahead for walls, spikes, and traps before you commit to a direction, and adjust early rather than reacting at the last second.
Collect coins and gems only when they sit close to your route, since the main goal is reaching the finish line quickly.
Keep track of the time limit on each level and decide early whether you can afford a short detour.
Replay a level once you know where the hazards are, because learning the layout will help you move faster and keep the ball intact.
faq: How do I steer the ball?
Tilt your device left or right to roll the ball in that direction. The game also mentions a joystick option for control.
What do collectibles do?
Coins and gems increase your score when you grab them. They do not replace the goal of reaching the finish line.

rebound-rascals.intro: Rebound Rascals is a peg-board roguelite where you aim a marble, let it bounce through the board, and use the damage it builds to stop rascals marching up the lane. Each run takes a different path through doors, shops and bosses.
tips: Watch the dotted line before you let go, since it shows the first bounce and helps you judge where the marble will go next.
Gold pegs make the whole shot a critical hit, so try to route your marble through them when you can.
Use Chompy at the bottom of the board to get your marble back for another shot, and plan shots so the marble reaches him.
Tap a rascal to pick your target before you shoot, especially when a bomb or a bigger threat is walking up the lane.
Hold the board to speed up a long shot when you want to save time without changing your aim.
faq: What is the goal of Rebound Rascals?
Beat the rascals walking up the lane before they reach your hero. Win fights, choose good doors on the path, and defeat the boss at the end of each of the three acts.
How do I aim and shoot?
Drag on the board to aim and watch the dotted line, then let go to shoot. With the keyboard, use the Left and Right arrows to aim and Space or Enter to shoot.

smash-the-blocks-puzzle-challenge.intro: Smash the Blocks! Puzzle Challenge is a relaxed logic puzzle where you clear the field by tapping blocks with arrows. Each level asks you to plan the order of your taps so every block can be removed.
tips: Before you tap, look at the arrow on each block and check whether anything sits in front of it. Only blocks with a clear path will disappear.
Start with blocks that have open space in their arrow direction, since removing them often opens up the blocks behind them.
If you get stuck, stop and try a different order of taps rather than repeating the same moves. Small changes in sequence can unlock a level.
Save boosters for levels that feel really tight, so you can use them when you have already tried the puzzle yourself.
Play at your own pace and take breaks when you feel tense. The game is designed to be relaxing, so there is no need to rush.
faq: How do I remove a block?
Tap a block that has an arrow on it. It disappears only if there are no obstacles in front of it in the direction the arrow points.
What should I do when I get stuck?
Try a different order of actions. Checking which blocks are blocking others often shows a new starting point.

fillblox.intro: Fillblox is a logic puzzle where you drag blocks onto a grid until every empty cell is covered. Boards grow larger and pieces more intricate as you progress.
tips: Start with the empty cells that have the fewest possible places a piece could fit, such as corners and narrow gaps, since these are the easiest to get wrong later.
Look for a cell that only one shape can cover and place that shape first, which often unlocks the rest of the board.
Remember that shapes cannot be rotated or flipped, so check each piece's exact orientation against the gaps before dragging it in.
Try to keep the remaining empty space in connected, easy-to-read regions rather than scattered single cells, so you can see which pieces still fit.
If you get stuck, use a hint to place one piece correctly, then reassess the board, since that single placement often reveals the next move.
faq: What is the goal of Fillblox?
Drag each block from the panel on the right onto the playing field so that every empty cell is covered. The level is complete once no cells remain empty.
Can I rotate or flip the blocks?
No, shapes cannot be rotated or flipped. You need to find the spot where each piece fits in its given orientation.

strike-bullet.intro: Strike Bullet is a ricochet puzzle shooter where you bounce bullets off metal walls to clear every enemy across 20 levels. Each level is a angle-planning challenge rather than a test of speed.
tips: Before you fire, follow the trajectory line and check where the shot will hit each wall before committing.
Look for the shot that clears several enemies in one bounce, since every shot counts.
Use the mouse or drag slowly to fine-tune your angle; small changes in aim can send the bullet far away from the target.
Pay attention to glass panels, explosive barrels, and portals, and try to understand how each one changes the path before using it in a plan.
If a level gets messy, press R or the restart button to try a fresh approach rather than continuing with a poor setup.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You need to eliminate all enemies in the level using your bullet and its ricochets. Each level is solved by planning a path that reaches every target.
How do I aim and fire?
On desktop, move the mouse to aim and left-click to fire. On mobile, drag on the screen to aim and release or tap to fire.

fisher-clicker.intro: Fisher Clicker is a fishing clicker where you catch fish, sell them, and upgrade your gear. Your earnings go toward better rods, a boat, and eventually your own fishing house.
tips: Sell your catch regularly so you have money ready for the next gear upgrade.
Think about which upgrade will help your catch rate most before you spend, such as a better rod or a float.
Save the dynamite for moments when you want several fish at once, rather than using it as soon as you get it.
Keep an eye on competitions, since winning first place is a direct way to earn money for building your fishing house.
Work in short, steady sessions so you can keep clicking to catch fish and selling without losing track of your progress.
faq: What is the main goal of Fisher Clicker?
The goal is to catch fish, sell them, and improve your gear. Over time you can win competitions and build your own fishing house.
How do I catch a fish?
Click on the fish to catch it. You can also drag fish to connect them and drag fish to sell them.

draw-one-line-bridge-puzzle.intro: Draw One Line Bridge Puzzle asks you to build a bridge with a single line so your vehicle reaches safety. Each level is a short puzzle that rewards careful planning before you draw.
tips: Study the whole level before drawing, including where the cars, cutters, and obstacles are. Plan the route from start to safety first.
Remember that you only get one line per level, so think about the shape of the bridge before committing to it.
Watch out for other cars and cutters along the path, and make sure your bridge keeps your vehicle clear of them.
Keep the vehicle's path gentle where possible. Damage to the car ends the attempt, so avoid sharp drops or impacts.
If a level seems stuck, step back and try a different angle or shape rather than repeating the same line.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You draw a single line to build a bridge that guides the vehicle safely to its destination. Each level must be completed with that one line.
What causes a level to fail?
You fail if the car is damaged or if you crash into other cars, cutters, or obstacles. Getting stuck on a level also keeps you from finishing it.

sheep-commotion.intro: Sheep Commotion is a path-drawing puzzle where you draw routes that guide each sheep to the pen that matches its color. Planning the whole route before you draw helps you clear each level cleanly.
tips: Match colors first: white sheep go to the white pen and black sheep go to the black pen, so check each sheep's color before you start drawing.
Scan the whole level for wolves, rocks and puddles before drawing, and plan a route that goes around each one with some room to spare.
Pay attention to greedy sheep and keep their paths away from apples, since they will head for them if given the chance.
Plan the order of your routes so that one drawn path does not block the path of another sheep.
Try to finish each level quickly, because faster completion earns more stars, so avoid long, wandering lines once you know the solution.
faq: What is the main goal of Sheep Commotion?
Your goal is to draw a path from each sheep to the pen that matches its color while keeping every sheep safe. Levels get trickier as they go on.
How do I earn more stars in a level?
Stars are earned by finishing a level faster, so a short, well-planned set of paths scores better than a slow one. Collecting stars along the way also counts.

resize-stickman.intro: Resize Stickman is an arcade runner where your stickman runs forward on his own. Your job is to switch his size at the right moment to get past each obstacle and set a new personal best.
tips: Look ahead for the next obstacle before it reaches your stickman, and decide early whether he needs to be big or small.
Resize with a clear, committed swipe rather than repeated swipes, so you do not change size at the wrong moment.
Watch the rhythm of the course. Obstacles that come in a sequence often call for alternating between big and small, so plan two or three steps ahead.
Use short practice runs to learn how each obstacle type looks, then focus on timing rather than reacting late.
Play for a higher distance each time and collect coins along the way to unlock new skins and achievements.
faq: What is the goal of Resize Stickman?
Guide your stickman as far as possible by getting past a variety of obstacles and achieving a high score. Completing more challenging levels is the main way to progress.
How do I control my stickman?
Swipe up to instantly grow him to a large size, and swipe down to instantly shrink him to a small size. He runs forward automatically, so you only control his size.

escape-from-the-crypt.intro: Escape From The Crypt is a maze adventure where you move through a series of crypt rooms while necromancers chase you. The necromancers are faster than you, so your route has to use the obstacles in each room.
tips: Look at the whole room before your first move, and find where the necromancers can and cannot go.
Since the necromancers will not avoid obstacles, lure them toward a dead end and then slip past them on the open path.
Use Backspace to undo a move when you see a trap forming, rather than committing to a route that leaves you cornered.
Press H for a hint when a room stalls you, but try working out a plan yourself first.
On mobile, check each move with the on-screen D-pad before pressing, since a wrong step can close off your escape.
faq: What is the goal of Escape From The Crypt?
You need to escape from the crypt one room at a time before the necromancers catch you.
Why can't I just outrun the necromancers?
The necromancers move faster than you, so you cannot simply race them. Instead, trick them into dead ends that use the obstacles in the room.

doodle-boba-bubble-tea.intro: Doodle Boba Bubble Tea is an arcade game about making bubble tea drinks for customers. You tap to mix ingredients and add just the right amount to match each order.
tips: Read the customer's order carefully before you start adding anything, so you know which flavours and toppings they want.
Add ingredients in small amounts first, then check the drink against the order. It is easier to add more than to fix an overfilled cup.
Aim for the right amount of each ingredient, not just the right ingredients. Getting the quantity right is what earns extra stars.
Work on one order at a time and finish it cleanly before moving on, so you do not mix up flavours between customers.
Use the shake step as a final check. Make sure the drink is fully mixed before you serve it.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Your goal is to make each customer's bubble tea order correctly. Nailing orders earns extra stars.
How do I earn extra stars?
Serve each order perfectly by adding just the right amount of each ingredient.

we-are-in-a-simulation-simulator.intro: We Are In A Simulation Simulator is a simulation game about obeying the crowd. Copy what the others do exactly, because any unwanted action is punished.
tips: Watch the crowd for a moment before you act, so you can see what the others are doing first.
Copy the group's actions exactly rather than trying to be clever, since the game punishes anything that differs.
Use W, A, S and D to move, and only move when the crowd is moving too.
Practise jumping with Space and crouching with C in calm moments so you are ready when they are needed.
Press P to pause when you need a moment to think, then return to the group's pattern before continuing.
faq: What is the goal of We Are In A Simulation Simulator?
The goal is to survive by copying the others exactly. Any action that does not match the crowd is punished.
Which keys control the character?
Use W, A, S and D for movement, C to crouch, and Space to jump. Press P to pause the game.

clawler-fight.intro: Clawler Fight is a strategy game where you survive a zombie apocalypse by using a crane claw to grab objects and launch them at waves of zombies. Build up your character through upgrades between battles.
tips: Swipe slowly to line up the claw before you release, since the drop point decides which items you grab.
Put early upgrades into grip strength or storage width, depending on whether you are losing items or running out of room to hold them.
Pay attention to each zombie type's abilities and strengths, and pick up items that suit the enemies on screen.
Use the choice between enemy waves to pick abilities that improve item grabbing, since that is the core of your attack.
Collect the resources and currency you find as you go, so you have enough to unlock upgrades in the card-based progression.
faq: What is the goal of Clawler Fight?
Your main objective is to survive the zombie apocalypse by picking up items with the claw and launching them at zombies.
How do I control the claw?
Swipe to aim the claw, then release your finger to drop it onto items. Items you pick up are applied automatically.

obby-upgrade-your-jump.intro: Obby Upgrade Your Jump is a clicker game where you tap to earn Jump Points and use them to jump higher. Pets can help your taps earn more points over time.
tips: Keep tapping steadily, since every tap adds Jump Points and more points mean bigger jumps.
Unlock pets early, because they make your taps stronger and give 2 or 3 points per tap depending on the pet.
Compare pets before you spend points on them, and favor the ones that give 3 points per tap when you can.
Check your height records after each session so you can see how much progress you have made and try to beat them.
Use the jump key and camera controls between taps so you can see where you land and plan your next climb.
faq: What is the main goal of Obby Upgrade Your Jump?
The goal is to jump as high as you can by earning Jump Points through tapping. Higher jumps come from using those points to upgrade your character.
How do pets help my progress?
Pets make your taps stronger and give 2 or 3 points per tap, depending on which pet you have. Unlocking them is one of the best ways to speed up your progress.

durak.intro: Durak is a shedding card game for 2 to 4 players, played with a 36-card deck. The goal is to get rid of all your cards before everyone else, and the last player still holding cards is the loser.
tips: Check the trump suit as soon as it is revealed, since any trump card beats cards in the other three suits.
Keep an eye on the lowest trump in your hand, because the player holding it makes the first attack.
Try to empty your hand quickly, since the last player with cards is the loser.
Pay attention to which cards have already been played so you can judge what is still likely to come up.
When defending, think about whether a trump card is worth spending now or whether a higher card of the same suit will do the job.
faq: What is the goal of Durak?
The goal is to play all your cards. The last player still holding cards is the one who loses, and the word durak means fool.
How many players can play Durak?
Durak is played by 2 to 4 players, and the game uses 36 cards from Ace down to 6 in all four suits.

even-odd-dice.intro: Even Odd Dice is a quick dice game for 1 to 4 players. Each player bets on whether the sum of the dice will be even or odd, then presses the dice to see the result.
tips: Choose your bet before the roll and stick to a clear reason, such as a pattern you noticed in earlier rolls.
Keep track of recent results, since the game rewards players who think about previous rolls rather than guessing at random.
In a multiplayer game, watch how the other players bet so you can judge how much tension each round carries.
If you are playing the win-streak mode alone, focus on making each prediction carefully, because one wrong guess ends your run.
Try a few short rounds first to learn the rhythm of the game before you commit to longer sessions.
faq: What is the goal of Even Odd Dice?
The goal is to predict whether the sum of the dice will be even or odd. Correct predictions earn you wins.
How do I play a round?
Each player chooses an even or odd bet, then presses the dice to roll and see the result.

try-to-count-the-boxes-brain-training.intro: Try To Count The Boxes Brain Training is a short counting game about memory and attention. You watch boxes appear, remember the total, and then submit your guess.
tips: Look at the whole group before the boxes vanish, and note how they are arranged so you can count them in a pattern rather than one by one.
Break the boxes into smaller clusters, such as rows or blocks, and add the clusters together to reach your total.
Keep your eyes on the boxes during the short viewing time, since they disappear quickly and you cannot check again.
When the boxes are gone, enter your answer calmly, and use the tap method if you find typing slows you down.
In single-player focus mode, track your accuracy as well as your time, because a fast but wrong guess does not help you improve.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Watch a set of boxes appear briefly, memorize the total, and then submit your guess once the boxes vanish. Accuracy and speed both matter.
How do I enter my guess?
Tap to increase your count or type the number directly, then press Done to submit your answer.

luchaball.intro: Luchaball is an arcade physics game where you knock masks off Luchaballs and equip them with green masks. Collect pickups as you go and see how far you can progress in this endless game.
tips: Aim with your mouse and remember that the further the mouse is from the mask, the harder the shot, so pull back further when you need more force.
Take short, controlled shots at first to learn how the physics react before committing to powerful ones.
Watch where each Luchaball is heading before you fire, since knocking masks off in a crowded spot can send others flying in unexpected directions.
Grab pickups when you can do so without risking a shot that would be hard to control, because they are part of how you progress.
Stay calm as the game goes on; the endless format rewards steady aim more than rushed clicks.
faq: How do I aim and fire in Luchaball?
Move your mouse to aim, then left click to fire. The further your mouse is from the mask, the harder you fire it.
How do I equip a Luchaball with a green mask?
Knock the various masks off the Luchaballs, and the goal is to equip them with green masks.

savage-defenders.intro: Savage Defenders is a tower defense strategy game where you protect a jungle village from an alien invader. You place warriors and shamans, spend resources wisely, and stop enemies from reaching the heart of the settlement.
tips: Mix your factions based on the enemies you face, since some warriors work better against light enemies and others against armored ones.
Hold back on spending until you have assessed the strength of the next wave, so your resources are not all used up on the wrong towers.
Watch the enemy routes early and place towers at points where several paths can be covered, so one group does not break through unnoticed.
Save your shaman spells for dangerous moments, such as a large group closing in, when slowing, stunning, or heavy damage will make the biggest difference.
Study each enemy type and note its weak points, then adjust your next placements to match what is coming.
faq: What is the main goal of Savage Defenders?
Your goal is to defend the village from alien invaders and stop them from breaking through to the heart of the settlement.
What are the four factions I can place?
You can place archers, spearmen, stone throwers, and shamans at strategic points on the map.

farm-business-saga.intro: Farm Business Saga is a farm management game where you grow crops, raise animals, and turn raw materials into goods to sell. It rewards careful planning of resources and steady expansion of your farm.
tips: Plant crops you can sell well, and keep a steady rotation so your harvests keep coming in while you handle other tasks.
Balance your livestock with your factory: raw milk, eggs, and other products are worth more once you process them into finished goods.
Check your inventory and sales menus regularly so you know which products are piling up and which are selling for profit.
Spend early profits on upgrades and new land carefully, choosing expansions that increase your output or efficiency first.
Plan your resources before each big step, since the game is built around balancing supplies against the profit you want to make.
faq: What is the main goal of Farm Business Saga?
The goal is to build a thriving farm business by growing crops, raising animals, producing goods, and selling them for profit. Success means becoming the most successful farm entrepreneur.
How do I interact with crops, animals, and buildings?
Use tap and drag to interact with crops, animals, and buildings on your farm. On-screen buttons handle inventory, sales, and upgrades.

mirrors-and-rays.intro: Mirrors and Rays is a relaxing laser puzzle where you turn mirrors to route a beam of light and charge every light bulb on the field. The goal is to light up the whole playing field one puzzle at a time.
tips: Start by finding where the beam begins and which light bulbs it needs to reach, then plan a rough path before clicking anything.
Click mirrors one at a time and watch how the beam changes after each turn, so you can see which mirror is causing a problem.
Look for bulbs that sit in corners or dead ends first, since they often limit how the beam can travel through the rest of the field.
If a route stops working, go back to the last mirror you changed rather than rotating everything at once.
Take breaks between puzzles if you get stuck; a fresh look often shows a path you missed.
faq: What is the goal of Mirrors and Rays?
The goal is to turn the mirrors on the field so the beam of light reaches and charges all the light bulbs. A puzzle is solved when every target is charged.
How do I control the mirrors?
Click on the mirrored elements on the playing field. Each click changes that mirror so you can guide the light along a new route.

draw-and-guess-online.intro: Draw and Guess is a fast multiplayer game where players take turns drawing a word while others race to guess it in the chat. Quick thinking and clear drawing both help you score.
tips: Start with the main shape of your word and add small details only if they make it easier to recognize.
Guess as soon as you feel confident, since faster correct guesses earn more points.
Because you also score when others guess your drawing, aim for a sketch that is easy to read rather than one that is detailed.
Watch the drawing as it develops and make early guesses, even if you are not yet sure, to get in before others.
If your version offers hints or drawing aids, use them to narrow down your guesses when the word is hard to pin down.
faq: How many players do I need to start a game?
A minimum of three players is required to start. You can join a public room or create a private one for friends.
How do I earn points?
You earn points for guessing a drawing correctly, with faster guesses worth more. You also earn points based on how many players successfully guess your own drawing.

bloxorz-color-block-roll.intro: Roll a painted cube across 60 levels of color-matching paths. Only tiles that match the face touching the ground will hold it, so every move needs planning.
tips: Before each roll, check which color is touching the ground, since that decides whether the next tile is safe.
Plan the route backward from the exit so you can see which color you need at each step.
Watch rotating, moving, and teleporting platforms for a few seconds before you commit, and time your roll to match them.
Move one step at a time and recheck the board after each step instead of rushing several moves in a row.
When a level stalls, try a different route rather than repeating the same moves.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Roll the cube to the exit tile. You must land only on tiles that match the color on the face touching the ground.
How do I move the cube?
Use WASD or the arrow keys, drag with the mouse in the direction you want, or swipe on touch screens. Each input moves the cube one step.

balls-pixel-art.intro: Balls: Pixel Art is an arcade game where you break a picture apart pixel by pixel using balloons fired from a cannon. Each level ends once the painting is fully removed.
tips: Count your shots before you fire, since you only get 15 attempts to clear each painting.
Each charge fires 16 balls, so make every volley count by aiming at areas that will open up the most pixels.
Start by clearing a path through the picture so later shots can reach pixels deeper inside.
Look for pixel groups that are isolated or nearly gone, and finish them off to avoid leftover pieces that cost extra attempts.
Pay attention to the shape of the image, since the outline and key details often show where a few well-placed hits will do the most damage.
faq: How many balls does the cannon fire?
Each charge fires 16 balls. Plan your shots around this count when you are trying to clear a section.
How many attempts do I get on a picture?
You have a total of 15 attempts to completely eliminate the painting. Use them carefully, since the level is passed only when the picture is fully broken.

robbie-tiktak-slot-machines.intro: Robbie: TikTak Slot Machines is an arcade game where you move between machines, finish mini-games and challenges, and collect tickets. Tickets can be traded for rare pets or used to unlock new machines.
tips: Finish the challenges on each machine before moving on, since they are the main way to earn tickets.
Decide early whether you want to save tickets for a rare pet or spend them to unlock new machines, so you do not run short on the one you care about.
Use the mouse to rotate the camera often so you can spot machines, prizes and hidden areas around you before you commit to a path.
Keep an eye out for hidden secret machines, because they hold exclusive prizes that regular machines do not offer.
Try the Wheel of Fortune whenever you have a chance, since it gives extra rewards on top of your ticket earnings.
faq: What is the main goal of Robbie: TikTak Slot Machines?
Your goal is to explore arcade machines, complete their mini-games and challenges, and collect tickets. You can then use those tickets to get rare pets or unlock new machines.
How do I move and jump on PC?
Use W, A, S and D to move and the Space bar to jump. Press Tab to hide or show the cursor, and move the mouse to rotate the camera.

gravity-speed-run.intro: Gravity Speed Run is a fast platformer where you flip your robot between the top and bottom of the track to dodge spikes and traps. One hit sends you back to the start, so timing matters more than speed.
tips: Watch the gaps ahead rather than your character, so you can switch gravity before an obstacle reaches you.
Stay relaxed and avoid tapping rapidly; a single well-timed tap is usually better than several quick ones.
Learn the pattern of each new obstacle group early, since levels get harder with more obstacles and higher speed.
When you restart after a hit, use the first few seconds to refocus on the sections that caught you.
Practice the early levels until the switching feels automatic, because reflexes are the main skill this game tests.
faq: What is the goal of Gravity Speed Run?
Run through each level by switching between the top and bottom of the track while avoiding spikes and traps. Reach the end of the level to complete it.
What happens if my robot touches a spike or trap?
One hit ends your run and you restart. There is no second chance within the same attempt.

candy-cats.intro: Candy Cats is a relaxed puzzle where you send hungry kitties around a conveyor belt to eat a tray of candies. Each kitty only eats candies of its own color, so the order you choose matters.
tips: Before tapping anything, look at which candy colors are most common on the tray and pick kitties that can clear them without blocking the others.
Keep an eye on the waiting cushions and free them up early, since a full set of cushions ends the level.
Think about which candy each kitty will reach first in its rows and columns, because it only eats the first matching candy it finds in each one.
If a level gets stuck, use the Paw booster to grab any candy or the Mint booster to see through candies for the whole level.
Ice-covered candies, chocolate walls and mystery kitties are the trickier parts of a tray, so plan those moves ahead to earn all three stars.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Eat every candy on the tray to clear it. Keep the waiting cushions from filling up while you do.
How do I choose which kitty to send?
Tap a kitty at the bottom to put it on the conveyor. Pick kitties based on the candy colors left on the tray and what the cushions already hold.

fishing-frenzy.intro: Fishing Frenzy is a fast fishing game where you try to catch as many fish as you can before the timer runs out. Quick reactions and smart use of bonuses decide how high your score climbs.
tips: Keep your eyes on the clock from the start, since every second counts and the session is limited.
Save bombs for moments when several fish are close together, so one bomb catches multiple fish at once.
Pick up extra bait when you can, because it helps you keep catching more fish.
Grab additional time bonuses early enough to extend your session before the round ends.
Plan your moves ahead rather than reacting only to the fish closest to your line, since better planning raises your score.
faq: What is the main goal of Fishing Frenzy?
Your goal is to catch as many fish as possible within a limited amount of time.
What bonuses can I collect?
You can collect extra bait to keep catching fish, bombs to catch multiple fish at once, and additional time to extend your session.

bomber-quest.intro: Bomber Quest is a 3D puzzle game where you work through levels, use bombs to defeat monsters, and manage the risks that come with explosive power. Planning each bomb carefully is the key to getting through.
tips: Look at the whole level before you move. Note where the monsters are and where the safe open spaces are so you can plan your bombs first.
Think about where an explosion will reach before you plant a bomb. Stay out of its path and make sure you have a clear way to step away.
Plant bombs with a purpose. Place them where they can catch monsters or open a route, rather than dropping them at random.
Move in small steps and check your surroundings often, especially in tight spots, so you do not get trapped between a bomb and a wall.
If a level feels stuck, pause to reconsider the layout. Puzzle levels often reward a slower, more deliberate approach over rushing.
faq: How do I move my character?
On a keyboard, use the WASD keys. On mobile, use the virtual joystick on screen to move in any direction.
How do I plant a bomb?
On a keyboard, press the Spacebar or click the bomb icon. On mobile, tap the bomb icon on screen.

paint-sponges-puzzle.intro: Paint Sponges Puzzle is a logic game where you guide a colorful sponge across a grid, painting every square of the maze. Each level gets harder as you progress.
tips: Before your first swipe, scan the whole grid and look for dead ends, since a square you can only reach from one direction is easy to miss later.
Plan a route that covers tight corners and narrow paths first, and leave open areas for last so you do not get trapped.
Trace the path with your eyes before swiping, checking that the sponge will stop where you expect on each move.
If you get stuck, restart the level rather than trying to patch a route, because a missed square often means the whole plan needs rethinking.
Solve the early levels slowly to learn how the sponge stops and turns, since those habits carry into the harder challenges.
faq: What is the goal of Paint Sponges Puzzle?
You must paint over all the squares in the maze to complete each level. The sponge leaves a colored trail as it moves.
How do I move the sponge?
Move the sponge by swiping in the direction you want it to go. Each swipe moves it through the grid.

color-blast-puzzle.intro: Color Blast Puzzle is a tap-to-clear matching game where you remove groups of same-colored blocks to meet each level's objectives. Each level gives a limited number of moves, so every tap counts.
tips: Before tapping, scan the whole board for the color that has the most blocks, since larger groups score more and clear more space.
Look at the level objective first and aim your taps toward it, such as clearing a set number of a certain color.
Avoid small two-block matches early if a bigger group is forming nearby, because waiting can set up a stronger move.
Watch how blocks shift after each clear so you can spot chain reactions that will form new matches for you.
Save boosters for difficult areas or the final moves of a level, when a single powerful clear is most likely to finish the objectives.
faq: What is the main goal of each level?
Complete all the objectives shown for the level, such as clearing a certain number of colored blocks, before you run out of moves.
How do I make a move?
Tap or click a group of two or more blocks that share the same color, and they will be cleared from the board.

pow.intro: Pow is a cozy pet care game where you feed, clean, and play with your Pow as it grows up. Keep its needs met, earn coins, and decorate its room.
tips: Check the vertical bars at the top of the screen each time you enter a room, so you know which need is running low first.
Before you spend coins, consider which need is lowest, since food helps your Pow and decorations only change the room.
Visit the games room to earn coins, then use them to buy food when your Pow's bars start to drop.
Follow the on-screen instructions closely, as they tell you what your Pow needs next and how to interact with objects.
Try the three minigames when you want a change of pace, and challenge your friends to see who can do better.
faq: What is the main goal of Pow?
Your goal is to take care of your Pow by keeping its needs met while it grows up and levels up. Feeding, cleaning, and playing with it all help.
How do I know what my Pow needs?
The vertical bars at the top of the screen show each room's needs. Keep the bars full by attending to those needs in each room.

block-party-obby-robby-mini-games.intro: Block Party is a multiplayer obby game where you compete against other players, face varied obstacle situations, and earn cups and coins. Learn the controls quickly so you can focus on picking the right path.
tips: Get comfortable with jumping and moving before you compete, since timing jumps is key to staying ahead of other players.
Use the camera to look ahead before each jump so you can spot the safest route instead of reacting at the last second.
Pay attention to which path looks most direct and check whether it is actually safe before committing to it.
Spend your coins with a plan, since you can use them for skins or character upgrades and both can be worth saving for.
Win as many victories as you can, because each win adds to your cups and coins and makes your character stronger over time.
faq: How do I jump on PC?
Press the Spacebar to jump. Use W, A, S, D or the arrow keys to move around.
How do I jump on mobile?
Tap the button on the right side of the screen to jump, and use the joystick on the left to move.

survival-tycoon-city-of-zombie.intro: Survival Tycoon: City of Zombie is an idle tycoon where you run a survivor camp, protect the barrier from zombie hordes, and grow your economy through traps, scavenging and upgrades. Plan your defenses while your camp earns income.
tips: Check the barrier before anything else, since keeping zombies out of the camp is the main goal. Place traps where the horde is pushing hardest.
Drag traps into the highlighted zones only, as that is where they can be installed. Spend your early resources on defenses that keep the barrier standing.
Follow the quest list closely, because completing quests is how you earn resources and grow the camp economy. Quest rewards can help you afford the next upgrade sooner.
Upgrade buildings and objects by clicking them, and watch which one gives the most benefit. Durability, damage and income upgrades each help in a different way.
Click zombies and objects on the map to actively assist your survivors during tough moments. Use this alongside your idle income rather than relying on it alone.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Your main goal is to stop the zombie horde from breaking into the camp by protecting the barrier. Gathering resources and growing the camp support that goal.
How do I place a trap?
Click and drag a defensive device from the bottom panel to a highlighted zone on the battlefield. Traps can only be placed in those zones.

emoji-math-quiz.intro: Emoji Math Quiz asks you to work out what each emoji is worth so that six equations come out correct. It is a short puzzle game that mixes basic arithmetic with logical deduction.
tips: Start with the equation that has the fewest unknown emojis, since solving it gives you a value you can reuse in the others.
Write down each emoji's value as you find it so you do not have to remember them across equations.
Check whether an emoji appears in more than one equation; a value found in one place often unlocks another.
Use the hint when you are stuck on a step, but try to reason out the next value yourself first so the practice sticks.
Enter your answer in the empty form only after you have checked the arithmetic, so you can spot mistakes before moving on.
faq: What is the goal of Emoji Math Quiz?
The goal is to figure out the numerical value of each emoji and solve all six equations correctly.
How do I enter my answers?
Click on the empty answer form and type your answer into it.

recoil.intro: RECOIL is a point-and-shoot platformer where each shot launches your player in the opposite direction. You move through trap-filled levels by using recoil to reach the goal while avoiding hazards.
tips: Aim before you fire. Your character flies opposite to the bullet, so check where the shot will push you before you click.
Use small, controlled shots when you need precision. A full-strength blast can carry you past a ledge or into a hazard.
Plan the route through each section before shooting. Look for the jumps and hazards ahead, then work out which direction you need to be pushed.
Expect deaths and use the instant restart to practice tricky timing. Repeating one section until the movement feels natural is often faster than pushing through.
Slow down near hazards. Hurrying a shot is a common reason for a bad launch, and one bad shot can end the attempt.
faq: How do I move my character?
You don't move with keys. Move the mouse to rotate the player and aim the gun, then left-click to shoot, which launches you in the opposite direction.
Why do I keep getting pushed into hazards?
Recoil sends you the opposite way from your bullet, so the push may take you somewhere you didn't intend. Check the direction of your aim before each shot.

colortrail-3d.intro: ColorTrail 3D is a fast arcade game where you guide a cube along 3D tracks, painting each path as you go. Fill every path while avoiding obstacles and traps as the levels speed up.
tips: Keep your hold steady and short-range in mind: movement only happens while you hold the button, so release early when you need to stop before a trap.
Scan the track ahead before you commit to a direction, since the levels get faster and reacting late is the most common mistake.
Plan your route so you cover side paths before you reach a dead end, because every path needs to be filled.
Watch the obstacles for a few seconds to learn their timing, then move through gaps when the pattern gives you room.
Focus on precision over speed in the early levels so your timing habits are ready when the pace increases.
faq: How do I move my cube?
Hold the left mouse button to move the player on desktop, or touch and hold the screen on mobile. Movement follows your hold, so letting go stops the cube.
What is the goal of each level?
You need to fill every path with color while avoiding dangerous obstacles and traps. Covering the whole track is what completes the level.

city-pilot-plane-parking-jam.intro: City Pilot Plane Parking Jam is a puzzle game set at a busy airport. Drag aircraft out of tangled parking areas, avoid collisions and obstacles, and clear each jam one plane at a time.
tips: Before you move anything, study the whole layout and find which aircraft is blocking the path of the others.
Free planes one by one rather than moving several at once, so you can see how each move changes the jam.
Pay close attention to cargo jets and bigger planes, since they take up more room and can block the most paths.
Keep track of the paths around buildings, fences and airport equipment so you do not drag a plane into a dead end.
Watch for the tighter spots that appear in later levels and plan your route out before you start dragging.
faq: What is the goal of City Pilot Plane Parking Jam?
Your goal is to clear the parking jam by moving each aircraft safely out of the way without causing collisions. Completing levels unlocks new puzzles and harder traffic jams.
How do I move the planes?
Tap and drag any airplane to move it. The game uses drag-and-move controls for all aircraft types.

quick-maths.intro: Quick Maths is an arcade runner where you solve math problems to clear obstacles and keep your stickman moving. It has 20 levels covering addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division, followed by an Endless mode.
tips: Read each problem once and pick the answer quickly; the timer is the main pressure, so practise recognising common results like 7 x 8 or 81 / 9 until they feel automatic.
Keep your attention on the next problem as soon as an obstacle clears, since a slow start on a new problem is where most time is lost.
Aim for three stars on early levels by avoiding mistakes first; mistakes cost stars, so accuracy matters more than speed when you are learning the operations.
If you find the answer buttons slow to reach, use the 1, 2, and 3 keys so your eyes can stay on the problem.
Finish all 20 levels before trying Endless, because one crash ends that run and it helps to already be comfortable with every operation.
faq: What is the goal of Quick Maths?
Solve each math problem before the timer runs out so the obstacle is cleared and the run continues. Each level is a set of these problems.
How do I answer a problem?
Tap or click the answer you think is correct, or press 1, 2, or 3 on the keyboard. A correct answer clears the obstacle.

keepie-uppie-paddle-pong.intro: Keepie Uppie Paddle Pong is an arcade game where you keep a ball bouncing on a paddle while collecting coins and working toward achievements. You steer the paddle with the mouse on a computer or by moving your finger across the screen on a mobile device.
tips: Keep your movements small and smooth so the paddle stays under the ball instead of overshooting it.
Every hit earns coins, so a steady rhythm of bounces is worth more than rushing around the screen.
Since each bounce moves you closer to your next achievement, focus on longer rallies rather than chasing a single big score.
Watch where the ball is heading before it reaches the paddle, so you have time to adjust your position.
Check your collection and achievements between sessions to see which goal is closest and plan your next run around it.
faq: How do I control the paddle?
On a computer, move the mouse to move the paddle. On a mobile device, move your finger across the screen.
What do I get for hitting the ball?
Every hit earns you coins. The more you bounce the ball, the closer you get to your next achievement.

head-jump.intro: Head Jump is a fast runner where your hero moves forward automatically. You jump, slide, and climb through tricky mazes to avoid hidden traps and obstacles.
tips: Watch the path a little ahead of your hero rather than only what is directly in front, so you have time to choose the right move.
Learn which obstacles call for a jump, a slide, or a climb, and respond with the matching move as soon as you see it.
Stay calm at sharp turns and surprises in the maze, since the layout changes direction often and quick reactions matter most.
Replay a level you find hard to memorize where the traps and twists appear, then use that knowledge to react faster the next time.
Complete each level before moving on, because the game is designed so that each finished level helps build your skills.
faq: What is the goal of Head Jump?
Your hero runs on its own, and your goal is to keep it moving through the maze without colliding with traps or obstacles. Finishing each level lets you continue.
What controls do I need to use?
You use jump, slide, and climb to get past obstacles. The hero runs automatically, so your timing with these moves is what keeps it safe.

crush-hour.intro: Crush Hour is an endless arcade runner where your truck drives itself through a zombie rush hour. Change lanes, hop the sidewalk, smash the undead, and chase a higher score on each run.
tips: Treat the sidewalk as an escape route. When both lanes fill up with traffic, hopping onto a sidewalk can keep your run alive.
Keep an eye on your HP. Cars cost a few points of HP, but trucks hurt more, so steer around the bigger vehicles first.
Pick up fuel cans before the tank gets low rather than waiting until it is almost empty. Running out is what ends the run.
Save the orange Rampage pickup for a crowded stretch of zombies so its smash frenzy can rack up combos quickly.
Stay close to traffic for near-miss rewards, but leave yourself room to change lanes. A clean pass is worth more than a crash.
faq: How do I steer my truck?
On desktop, use the Left and Right Arrow keys or A and D to change lanes or hop onto a sidewalk. On mobile, swipe left or right to do the same.
What ends a run?
A wreck ends the run, and there is no finish line. Your goal is to survive as long as you can and beat your best score.

up-jelly-up.intro: Up Jelly! Up! is a physics arcade game where you help little jelly creatures jump upward and avoid drowning. Each jump is made with a click or tap, so timing is the main skill.
tips: Wait for the right moment before each jump instead of tapping quickly, since mistimed jumps are the most common way to drown.
Pay attention to how far each jump carries you so you can plan the next one before you land.
Collect jelly bonuses whenever it is safe to do so, because you will need them to buy starting boosts and new skins.
Spend your bonuses on a starting boost if you find that the early part of a run is what keeps ending your game.
Stay calm and keep trying after a drowning, since each new attempt is a chance to jump a little higher and last a little longer.
faq: What is the goal of Up Jelly! Up!?
The goal is to help the jelly keep jumping higher and survive as long as possible without drowning. Each attempt is a new chance to improve.
How do I control the jelly?
Click the mouse in an empty area or touch the screen to make the jelly jump. Your timing decides whether the jump keeps you safe.

connect-monsters.intro: Connect: Monsters is a puzzle game where you aim, drop, and join monsters to build your score. Plan each move, because the field fills up and the challenge grows as you play.
tips: Before you drop a monster, check where it will land and which matching monsters it can join. Choosing the spot matters more than speed.
Keep the middle of the field open so you have room to maneuver when it starts to fill up.
Work toward the highest-ranked monster on the field. When it connects, it disappears and gives you bonus points, so setting that up can be worth a lot.
Look for chances to make several connections in one move, since the more you connect, the higher your score climbs.
If the field starts to feel crowded, slow down and focus on clearing space rather than chasing a single big score, because running out of room ends the game.
faq: What is the main goal of Connect: Monsters?
The goal is to score as many points as you can by connecting monsters. The more you connect, the higher your score.
How do I lose the game?
You lose if the field gets too crowded and there is no room left for your next monster.

zombie-merge.intro: Zombie Merge is a 90-second top-down duel where you hold the center and shoot a horde while racing your rival to a higher score. Killed zombies can fuse into bigger, more valuable ones.
tips: Keep an eye on the zombies behind you. They sit outside your gun's cone, so they can bite you without being shot unless you swing toward them.
Use drag-to-aim when a group is gathering on one side, then release so the gun returns to auto-aim and keeps firing on its own.
