Let zombies merge into bigger forms when you can. Higher-tier zombies are tankier and worth more, so they can be a good source of points if you can handle them.
Watch your health closely. Because a zombie that reaches you ends your run early, your rival keeps scoring until the clock runs out.
Since ties go to your rival, aim for a clear lead rather than an even score near the end of the 90 seconds.
faq: What is the goal of Zombie Merge?
Score more points than your rival before the 90-second clock runs out. If your health reaches zero, your rival keeps scoring until time ends.
How do I aim my gun?
Your gun auto-fires at zombies inside its forward cone of about 94 degrees. Click or touch and drag anywhere on screen to aim manually, and release to go back to auto-aim.

bone-throne.intro: Bone Throne is a one-click horde survival roguelite where you play the villain. Attack heroes as they storm your crypt, then raise their corpses to fight beside you.
tips: Keep an eye on where fallen heroes land, since each corpse you raise adds to your skeleton army and the more heroes fall, the bigger your horde grows.
Remember that attacking takes priority over raising when both are in range, so click a spot that is clearly closer to an enemy when you need to stop a threat.
Study each hero boss's attack pattern early in a run and move your attention away from its strikes so your army can keep working.
Think about your card choice after each boss kill, aiming for picks that support the kind of skeleton army you are already building.
Watch for wave modifiers that appear every few waves and adjust how you split your clicks between fighting and raising when they change the pace.
faq: What is the goal of Bone Throne?
Survive as many waves of soldiers and energy orbs as you can before your throne falls. Each run tests how long your undead army can hold out.
What controls does the game use?
The whole game uses one input. Left-click on desktop or tap on mobile to attack enemies or raise corpses as skeleton minions.

picture-shift.intro: Picture Shift is a sliding block puzzle where you rebuild hidden pictures from scattered pieces before the timer runs out. Each block only moves through empty space, so the order of your moves matters as much as the final layout.
tips: Before moving anything, think backwards and ask which block needs to move last. Clearing a path for that block first often saves you from getting boxed in.
Look for blocks that are blocking the most others and move those first, since opening a gap early gives you more options later.
Use the Hammer on a small 1×1 chunk when a block is stuck, because removing one piece is usually faster than rearranging the whole board.
Deal with bombs early, while their countdowns are still long, instead of waiting until the timer pressure builds up.
Focus on finishing whichever picture you can complete soonest, since each completed picture clears blocks and thaws frozen ice.
faq: What is the goal of Picture Shift?
You need to rebuild every picture at the top of the board before the timer hits zero. The pieces can be anywhere on the board as long as they line up correctly with each other.
How do I move the blocks?
Drag a block to slide it. Blocks can only move through empty space and only fit through gaps big enough to hold them.

edgefire.intro: EdgeFire is a fast online shooter where you battle real players from around the world, solo or with friends. Each round is a chance to show you are the top player on the battlefield.
tips: Keep moving with WASD instead of standing still, since a stationary target is an easy one to hit.
Press R to reload when you have a quiet moment, not in the middle of a firefight, so you are not caught with an empty weapon.
Aim before you shoot. Use left mouse button in short bursts to keep your shots accurate rather than spraying constantly.
Watch where enemies come from and choose your position carefully. Clever positioning can turn a losing exchange into a win.
If you are playing with friends, coordinate your moves so you cover each other and cut off opponents from different angles.
faq: What is the main goal of EdgeFire?
Battle real players in each round and become the top player on the battlefield. Work on your aim, reflexes, and tactics to win fights.
What are the basic controls?
Use WASD to move, the left mouse button to shoot, and R to reload. Press Esc to open the pause menu.

snake-out.intro: Snake Out is a colorful puzzle game where you guide snakes of different colors and lengths into their matching holes before time runs out. Each level adds a new layout to solve.
tips: Look at the whole board before moving anything, and find which snake can reach its hole with the fewest blocked paths.
Clear the snakes that sit closest to their holes first, since they free up space for the longer snakes.
Plan the route of a long snake before you drag it, because a long body can block other snakes if it stops in the wrong place.
Watch the timer, but do not rush every move; a few seconds of planning often saves more time than quick, careless drags.
If a level gets stuck, step back and look at which hole is hardest to reach, then work out the moves that open a path to it.
faq: What is the goal of Snake Out?
The goal is to guide each snake to its hole of the same color before the time runs out. You finish the level when every snake has reached its hole.
How do I move the snakes?
Use the drag and move mechanic to slide each snake along the board. Drag the snake in the direction you want it to travel.

summer-shore-hustle.intro: Summer Shore Hustle is a management game where you run a small beach shop to earn money by selling products, cooking food, and serving customers. The tutorial walks you through the controls and steps.
tips: Play through the in-game tutorial first, since it displays the controls and shows you how the shop works.
Use E to pick up items and Q to drop them, so you can move ingredients and food around without losing track of what you are carrying.
Press X to call customers when you are near nearby people, because it increases the chance they will visit your shop.
Keep your cooking and serving in order so customers are not left waiting while you handle other tasks.
Pause with P when you need a moment to plan your next step, then return to the shop when you are ready.
faq: What is the goal of Summer Shore Hustle?
You run a small shop on the beach to earn money so you can relax in the next summer. You do this by selling products, cooking food, and serving customers.
How do I attract customers to my shop?
Press X to call customers. This increases the chance that nearby customers will visit your shop.

push-the-box.intro: Push The Box is a puzzle game where you slide colored boxes onto stars of the same color. Plan each move carefully, because every push shifts a box only one square.
tips: Read the arrow on each box before you act. A box only moves in the direction its arrow shows, so check that path is clear first.
Plan the route for each box before you start pushing. Think about which box needs to reach which star, and avoid blocking another box's path.
Use the paint tiles on purpose. Passing over a colored dot changes a box's color, so you can route a box over one to match the star it needs.
Don't aim black boxes at stars. They keep their original color and cannot complete a star's color requirement, so treat them as pieces to work around.
Use undo when a move goes wrong instead of resetting the whole stage. Watching replays of solved stages can also show you a method you can reuse on harder levels.
faq: How do I win a stage?
You win by pushing every colored box onto a star of the same color. All stars must be matched with their boxes.
How do I move a box?
On desktop, click a box to push it one square in the direction of its arrow. On touch screens, tap the box to move it in the arrow's direction.

racing-online.intro: Racing: Online! is a browser racing game where you compete against players from around the world. It includes drift mechanics, collectible cars, and a local co-op mode for two players on one device.
tips: Tap the handbrake or drift control only when you need to scrape speed through a corner, since holding it too long can slow you down on straights.
Practice steering and braking in short bursts so you can keep the car stable before you try to drift.
Check your controls in the game settings early and remap them if the default keys feel awkward for how you like to steer.
Complete your daily quests each time you play, since they give you a steady reason to keep racing and progressing.
Try limited-time events while they are running, because their exclusive vehicles are only available for a set period.
faq: How do I steer and accelerate on desktop?
Use W to accelerate, S to brake, and A or D to steer. Space works as the handbrake and drift control.
How does local co-op work?
Player 2 uses the arrow keys to accelerate and brake and the left and right arrows to steer, with Right Shift for the handbrake and drift. Both players share the same device.

heroes-vs-monsters-idle-rpg.intro: Heroes vs Monsters: Idle RPG is a clicker where you build a team of heroes that fight monsters automatically while you push through zones. Your job is to keep damage rising so each zone and boss goes down faster.
tips: Click monsters yourself early on, since clicking adds damage while your heroes are still weak and gold is slow to come in.
Spend gold on hero levels steadily rather than saving for one big purchase, because each level-up adds damage to your whole team right away.
Prepare before each boss, which appears every 5 zones, by making sure your heroes are leveled up and your skills are ready.
Save your skills for boss fights or tough moments, since they give powerful bonuses that work best when you need a burst of damage.
Check your rewards when you return after being away, because progress continues offline and you can collect what you earned.
faq: What is the goal of Heroes vs Monsters: Idle RPG?
The goal is to push as far as you can through the zones by defeating monsters and bosses. The game has no set end, so you keep going as deep as your team allows.
How do I deal damage to monsters?
Click on monsters to deal damage yourself. Heroes you hire will also fight automatically, so your damage builds up over time.

numbers-match-2448.intro: Numbers Match 2448 is a number merge puzzle where you combine matching blocks to build larger values. Each level has a goal you must reach before the board fills up.
tips: Before placing a block, look for a pair you can merge right away, and check whether the move opens up a longer chain.
Keep some free space on the board. Crowded boards leave you few options and make it harder to reach the level goal.
Build chains in one area rather than spreading small numbers across the whole board, so merges stay easy to line up.
Save your boosters for when you are truly stuck. Try to find a move on your own first, then use swap, shuffle, or bomb if no good option remains.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Each level has an objective you must complete before the board fills up. Once you finish it, you move on to the next level.
How do I merge number blocks?
Match blocks that have the same value to merge them into a higher number. Drag and drop blocks with the mouse on desktop, or tap and drag with your finger on mobile.

helix-hover.intro: Helix Hover is a fast 3D arcade runner where you steer a hover ship through a twisting tube. Avoid the pink walls, jump the yellow barriers, and collect shards to build your score.
tips: Look ahead rather than at your ship, since the tube bends and you need time to line up before a turn.
Make small, steady steering adjustments instead of big sudden moves, which can push you into a wall.
Jump early when a yellow barrier approaches so you have time to clear it before landing.
Grab shards when you can do so safely, but never steer into a wall just to reach one.
As the tube gets harder, slow your reactions down in your head and focus on one obstacle at a time.
faq: What is the goal of Helix Hover?
Ride through the twisting tube without touching the walls, collect shards, and go as far as you can while building your score.
How do I steer and jump on desktop?
Use the left and right arrow keys or A and D to steer, and press the up arrow, W, or Space to jump. Press P to pause.

neko-s-adventure.intro: Neko's Adventure is a platformer where you guide Neko, a playful cat, through 20 levels to rescue his girlfriend. Jump across platforms, shoot fire at quirky enemies, and keep moving through this fast-paced cartoon journey.
tips: Get comfortable with the jump before you hurry. Short, controlled jumps are easier to land than full-height leaps made at top speed.
Once you unlock the Power Beam, use fire on enemies that block your path instead of trying to dodge every one of them.
Look ahead before each jump and check where you will land. Pausing for a second to plan a route can save a lot of retries.
Keep your movement steady across the level. Stopping and starting often makes it harder to time jumps and shots.
If a section keeps defeating you, slow down and watch how the enemies move. Learning their patterns usually works better than repeating the same attempt.
faq: What is the goal of Neko's Adventure?
You play as Neko, a cat trying to rescue his girlfriend, and you progress by getting through 20 challenging levels.
How do I shoot fire?
Press the Spacebar on desktop to shoot fire. On touch screens, use the on-screen buttons. You unlock this ability through the Power Beam.

stair-ball.intro: Stair Ball is a fast arcade game where you guide a small ball up an endless staircase covered in spikes and gaps. Stay focused, read the layout, and keep climbing as long as you can.
tips: Move early. The instructions recommend reacting to the spike pattern ahead rather than at the last second, so start shifting your ball before a spike reaches it.
Use short, deliberate touches. Press and hold to move left or right, then release and press again to switch direction quickly, rather than holding in one spot.
Scan the next stair before you commit. Each step can have black cone spikes, so look ahead to pick the safe side while your ball is still on the current stair.
Pick up rubies when it is safe to do so. They unlock new balls and styles, but a risky detour that puts you near a spike is not worth it, since one touch ends the run.
Expect the pace to rise. The higher you climb, the faster and harder it gets, so try to stay calm and keep your timing steady as the run goes on.
faq: What is the goal of Stair Ball?
Your goal is to keep climbing the endless staircase without touching any spikes. If the ball touches a spike, the run ends instantly.
How do I control the ball?
Touch and hold the screen to move the ball left or right across the stairs. Release and press again to quickly switch direction.

snakearmydefense.intro: Snake Army Defense is a 3D tower defense game where you place soldiers around the battlefield to stop waves of winding snakes from reaching your base. Build a squad, manage your gold, and upgrade between battles.
tips: Before placing a soldier, watch which way the snakes move and choose positions where their attack range covers that path.
Spend battle gold carefully. Keep some in reserve so you can respond when a new wave shows a different threat.
Combine attacking soldiers with support units, since a mix usually handles varied snake waves better than one type alone.
Between battles, focus your coins on the soldiers you use most instead of spreading upgrades thinly across the whole roster.
Use the drag controls to scout the battlefield and level map before deploying, and pause with the on-screen button when you need time to plan.
faq: How do I complete a level?
Defeat every snake wave and keep your base standing until the final wave is cleared.
Where do I get coins for upgrades?
Coins are used between battles to unlock soldiers and improve their stats, and optional rewarded videos provide extra coins.

dark-city-multiplayer.intro: Dark City. Multiplayer is an online open-world horror game where police and bandits compete for control of an abandoned city. Capture districts, hold them, and watch out for the horror beneath the streets.
tips: Pick a faction early and stick with it, since the police restore order and protect survivors while the bandits take zones and hide in shadows.
Focus on capturing districts you can hold, because income arrives every 30 seconds for each district you control.
Check the map often to see which zones are contested, and move toward areas your side is losing before the enemy takes them.
Use Game Chat with your faction to coordinate pushes and defenses, since the world is shared and enemies can appear at any step.
Keep an eye on your surroundings as you move, because a confrontation with an enemy or something worse can come up quickly.
faq: What is the main goal of Dark City. Multiplayer?
Join either the police or the bandits and capture as many districts as possible. Holding those districts is what earns you money.
How do I earn money in the game?
You receive money every 30 seconds for each district you control. Holding more districts at once means steadier income.

stonks.intro: Stonks! is an arcade platformer where you play an amoeba that clings to platforms and climbs higher with every jump. Each run gets harder as the stages change, so steady, controlled jumps matter more as you go.
tips: Before you release, check the length and angle of your pull, since both control how far and how high the amoeba travels. Small drag adjustments are often safer than full-power jumps.
Grab biomass when you can, because it strengthens your jump and makes the tougher sections easier to reach. Detours for biomass are usually worth it early on.
Pick your landing spot before you jump and aim for the platform's center where possible. Landing near an edge leaves less room for error.
Once you unlock the mid-air jump, save it for emergencies, such as correcting a trajectory that is drifting off course or reaching a platform you just missed.
Pay attention to how platforms change shape as you climb. Tighter routes call for shorter, more precise jumps rather than long leaps.
faq: What is the goal of Stonks!?
Your goal is to keep gaining height by landing on platforms and moving upward while avoiding falling into the abyss.
How do I control the amoeba?
Press and hold with your finger or the left mouse button on the game field, pull in a direction, and release to jump. The length and angle of your pull set the direction and power of the jump.

copy-the-drawing.intro: Copy the Drawing asks you to recreate a sample picture on a canvas. The closer your drawing matches the example, the higher your score and medal. The game has 300 levels across 18 categories.
tips: Compare the example and your canvas often, and check proportions and positions before adding details.
Start with the big outlines and shapes, then switch to a smaller brush for finer lines.
Use Undo to fix a single mistake instead of Clear, so the rest of your drawing stays intact.
Tap Check only when you feel the drawing is close to the example, since you can then see how close you are to the next medal threshold.
Try the Drawing of the Day to build a streak and see if you can keep improving on your own past results.
faq: How is my score decided?
You get a match score that shows how accurately your drawing copies the example. Your medal depends on that score.
What do the medals require?
Bronze needs a match of 50% or more, silver needs 70% or more, and gold needs 90% or more.

katana-flash.intro: Katana Flash is a one-button ninja game where the aim line spins by itself. Your timing decides every dash, so the goal is to tap when the line crosses the most enemies.
tips: Watch the line for a few turns before you tap. Waiting for it to cross a group of enemies usually clears more than tapping on the first pass.
Dash into incoming arrows to send them back at enemies. Look for archers early so you can use their arrows against them.
Shield bearers need to be cut from behind. Pick a dash that reaches their back side rather than the front of their shield.
Pause with P or the pause button when a wave gets busy, then resume once you have checked where each enemy is heading.
Try the daily challenge and the Dojo's endless waves to practice timing before you push further into Road to the Shogun.
faq: How do I know when to tap?
Tap when the spinning aim line crosses enemies you want to cut. Your ninja will dash along the line and hit everything in its path.
What do the arrows do?
When you dash into an arrow, it is sent back toward the enemies that fired it. This lets you use archers' own shots to clear them.

bouncepop-quest.intro: BouncePop Quest asks you to guide Jumpo, a jelly creature, through more than 150 colorful levels. Learn the jump timing early, since most of the challenges depend on it.
tips: Practice the press, hold, and release jump in an early level before tackling tricky platforms. Getting a feel for how long you hold affects where Jumpo lands.
Before jumping onto a moving platform, watch its path for a moment. Time your jump for when the platform is where you need it to be.
If double-side jump is active, use left and right taps for short hops to correct your position in mid-air. This helps you avoid falling short of a gap.
Collect stars when they are on your route, but don't risk a dangerous jump just to grab them. Staying alive keeps you moving forward.
When an enemy is close, approach it from a position where you can land on it safely rather than jumping in at a random angle. Pause and look at the layout first if a level feels crowded.
faq: How do I control Jumpo?
Press, hold, and release to jump. The length of your hold controls the jump, so practice on easy spots to find the right timing.
What does double-side jump do?
When it is active, tapping left makes Jumpo jump left and tapping right makes Jumpo jump right. This gives you more control when you are changing direction.

fish-factory.intro: FISH FACTORY is a cozy 3D fishing and production tycoon on a voxel island. You cast, reel in catches, process them on conveyors and grow a small pier into a fishing village.
tips: Catches depend on location, time of day, rod and tackle, so switch areas and check the day-night cycle when you want a specific fish.
Before each cast, pick a casting point that is clearly available, then confirm it so you do not waste time on a blocked spot.
While reeling, watch the moving bar closely and click as it enters the highlighted zone, since several accurate hits are needed to fill your keepnet.
Keep the route from catch to the receiving station short and clear, because fish are placed on an available conveyor and coins are paid after processing.
Follow the tutorial first to learn the full route from casting to your first rod upgrade, then spend coins on upgrades that help your next catches.
faq: How do I catch a fish?

Walk to the water, press SPACE on desktop or tap the fishing button on mobile, aim at an available spot and confirm the cast. Then click during reeling when the moving bar enters the highlighted zone.
Where do I get paid for my catch?
Carry your catch into the bright circle by the receiving station. Fish are placed on an available conveyor and coins are paid after processing.

horizon-racer.intro: Horizon Racer is a 3D arcade runner where you race a track that twists through barrel rolls, wall runs and ceiling sections while a black hole chases you. Your goal is to keep moving and survive as long as possible.
tips: Look a little ahead of your car rather than right at it, so you can line up for upcoming corkscrews and hills before you reach them.
Choose the control style that suits you: TAP mode is good for quick lane changes, while STEER mode gives finer control when you need precision.
Dodge obstacles early with small adjustments instead of late, large movements, which can push you into the next obstacle.
Use the rolls and wall or ceiling sections as chances to reposition, and settle back into a safe lane as soon as the track flattens out.
Keep your attention steady during long stretches, since the track changes direction quickly and a short lapse can cost you a run.
faq: What is the goal of Horizon Racer?
You race along a twisting 3D track while a black hole chases you, and you try to avoid obstacles and go as far as you can.
How do I steer the car?
Use A and D to steer. Touch controls also work, and mouse and controller support is included.

braveward.intro: Braveward is a voxel kingdom strategy game where you rule from the throne and never command heroes directly. You post bounties and let them decide whether the gold is worth the danger.
tips: Build a Market and a Tavern early so the gold your heroes spend returns to you as taxes.
Post bounties that match what your heroes want, since heroes who like the reward are the ones who will go for it.
When the messenger warns of a siege, raise watchtowers on that side of the castle before the night begins.
Save your spells for tough moments. Heal, Royal Shield and Rally are available from the castle, and a Mage Tower unlocks Lightning and Gold Rain.
Explore the ruins for loot during the day, then use the five phases of each day to plan bounties before night brings the dens and the Troll Warlord.
faq: What is the goal of Braveward?
Keep your castle standing until sunrise to win each day. Each win starts a new day that is harder than the last.
How do I control my heroes?
You don't command them directly. Tap a monster or a den and post a bounty, then heroes who like the reward will decide whether to take it.

sponge-strike-clean-and-smash.intro: Sponge Strike: Clean & Smash is a physics puzzle where you launch a sponge across the board to scrub away a dark coating and reveal a hidden picture. Each launch is a chance to clear objectives and collect coins.
tips: Test your aim with short pulls first, since the drag sets the launch power and you can see how the sponge travels before committing to a big shot.
Use the walls on purpose. Bouncing the sponge can reach coating and targets that a straight shot would miss.
Pay attention to the bombs and buttons early on, because they can open up or clear paths that make later shots easier.
Tap or click to stop the sponge when it slows down, so you can line up the next launch before it drifts into a spot you did not plan for.
Look at which objectives are left before each shot and plan toward them, so you spend your launches on the parts of the picture that still need clearing.
faq: How do I aim and launch the sponge?
Hold the left mouse button and drag backward to aim and set the power, then release to send the sponge forward. On mobile, touch and drag backward, then release.
How do I stop the sponge and prepare the next shot?
Click again when the sponge slows down to stop it. You can then aim and launch again from that position.

island-survival.intro: Island Survival mixes match-3 tile swapping with crafting toward a raft. Raw resources reset each stage, so the goal is to turn what you collect into items that last.
tips: Before matching, check the crafting menu and pick which recipe you are working toward. Resources you gather without a plan may be lost when the stage ends.
Spend raw materials on permanent items like ropes, planks, ingots, nails, and tools when you can, since those carry over to later stages.
Save some resources for recipes that need more than you can gather in one stage, but do not hoard raw materials you cannot use before the reset.
Look for 4-tile and 5-tile combos when possible. A 4-combo gives a bonus resource and a 5-combo gives a wild tile that can replace any material.
Plan around the stage progression, from campfire and stone knife to furnace, workbench, iron tools, and raft assembly, so each stage's crafts prepare you for the next.
faq: What is the main goal of Island Survival?
Complete all 6 stages, build a raft, and escape the deserted island. Each stage brings new challenges and recipes.
What happens to my resources between stages?
Raw resources such as stone, wood, food, water, leaves, fire, and ore reset at the end of each stage. Crafted items stay in your inventory.

starweave-star-puzzle.intro: Starweave is a calm space puzzle where you link stars by dragging to reveal hidden constellations in a dark sky. There are no timers or lives, so you can take each move at your own pace.
tips: Study the whole star layout before you drag your first line. Since the order matters, spotting the start and end of the pattern early saves rethinking later.
Plan each connection a few steps ahead. One wrong link means you may need to reroute, so avoid committing to a path that blocks the stars you still need.
Clear floating obstacles before they close off a route. Dealing with them early keeps your pathways open for the rest of the constellation.
Use the hint when you are stuck on a connection. It shows the correct link, which helps you learn the pattern for later levels.
Take breaks between levels. Since there are no timers, stepping away and returning with fresh eyes often makes the next route easier to see.
faq: How do I complete a level?
Connect the stars in the correct order to form the hidden constellation. Crush any floating obstacles that block your path along the way.
What happens if I connect the wrong stars?
A wrong connection means you need to rethink your route. Plan carefully, and use a hint if you get stuck.

origin.intro: Origin is a platform game where you collect orbs, reach the door, and escape. Move and jump carefully, because spikes are waiting and double jumps are limited.
tips: Collect every black orbs before heading to the door, since the door only opens once all of them are gathered.
Check the JUMP counter in the upper left corner before a big gap, so you know whether you have a double jump left to spare.
Use single jumps for short gaps and save your double jump for situations where you truly need the extra height or distance.
Watch the spikes closely when you land, and slow down near them rather than rushing across.
If you get stuck or fall into spikes, press R to restart the level quickly instead of working through a bad position.
faq: What is the goal of Origin?
Your goal is to collect the orbs, especially all the black orbs, so the door unlocks and you can escape.
How do I double jump?
In later levels, press W or Up twice to double jump. You only have a limited number of these, shown by the JUMP counter in the upper left corner.

cut-in-half.intro: Cut In Half is a slicing action game where you cut objects, obstacles, and elements in half to clear paths. Move the yellow ball, slice, and collect coins to grow your attack power.
tips: Collect coins as you go, since they feed the upgrade system and make your slices stronger for later obstacles.
Spend coins on upgrades when you have them, rather than waiting, so your attack power keeps pace with the stage.
Line up your position before slicing so the knife or sword crosses the object at a clean angle.
Use the boost control (Shift on desktop) to reach a path or a target faster, and save it for moments when you need to close distance quickly.
On mobile, keep the joystick drag gentle and steady so the yellow ball moves predictably between slices.
faq: What is the goal of Cut In Half?
You cut every object, obstacle, and element that crosses your path in half to clear the way and advance through each stage.
How do I slice on desktop?
Press the Spacebar to slice with your knife or sword, and use the arrow keys to move the yellow ball up, down, left, or right.

mole-in-the-hole.intro: Mole In The Hole is an arcade digging game where you guide a mole through layers of stone and sand. Pick the right tool for each block, collect gold, and use shop upgrades to raise your score.
tips: Switch tools before you hit a new layer, since stone needs the pickaxe and sand needs the shovel. Getting into the habit of toggling early saves time.
Scan ahead for gold-filled blocks and plan a route that reaches them. Breaking them clears your path and boosts your score at the same time.
Spend shop upgrades with your scoring goal in mind. Upgrades that raise the value of sand or stone tiles add up quickly across a run.
Read perk options carefully before choosing. Some perks change how you play, while others change block value, so pick the type that suits your style.
Use the Q key or Spacebar for quick tool swaps so your hands stay on the movement keys. A smooth rhythm of digging and switching keeps the mole moving.
faq: How do I move the mole?
Use the arrow keys (Left, Right, Down) or W, A and S to guide the mole's direction.
How do I switch between the pickaxe and the shovel?
Press the Spacebar or the Q key to toggle between the two tools.

nubik-courier-an-open-world.intro: Nubik Courier: An Open World is a delivery adventure where you play a pizza courier racing through busy city streets. You dodge obstacles and switch vehicles to finish each delivery.
tips: Look at the route before you move off. Spotting obstacles early gives you more time to react.
Try each vehicle you have available and notice how it handles, so you know which one suits which kind of route.
Switch vehicles when the road ahead calls for it, rather than sticking with one out of habit.
Keep the delivery in mind as you drive. Taking a path that gets you there sooner often matters more than speeding through the city.
Play in short sessions at first to learn the streets and obstacles, then push for faster deliveries once the layout feels familiar.
faq: What is the goal of Nubik Courier: An Open World?
Your goal is to complete each pizza delivery by racing through the city streets. Each delivery is a run you finish before moving on.
How do vehicles play a role in the game?
You can switch vehicles during a run. Choosing the right one for the road ahead can help you get through obstacles more smoothly.

astro-shooter.intro: Astro Shooter is a fast arcade shooter where you pilot a starfighter against waves of enemies coming from every direction. Steer with your mouse on desktop or the on-screen joystick on mobile.
tips: Keep moving rather than parking in one spot, since enemies arrive from all sides and standing still makes you an easy target.
Pick up power-ups during a run and use their temporary boosts to clear dangerous waves faster.
Watch the edges of the screen for incoming enemies so you can react before they close in.
Save the coins you earn between runs and spend them in the garage on core stat upgrades, since these carry over to future runs.
When a massive 3D boss ship appears, focus on dodging its attacks first and then concentrate fire on it while staying mobile.
faq: What is the goal of Astro Shooter?
Survive as long as you can against endless waves of enemies and take down boss ships. Each run ends when your ship is destroyed, but your upgrades remain.
How do I control my ship?
On desktop, move the mouse cursor to steer your ship. On mobile, use the on-screen joysticks.

chess-royale.intro: Chess Royale is a chess variant where kings have magical powers. Win by cutting down the enemy king, combining careful move order with three types of magical abilities.
tips: Plan your magic and your moves together, since a card can change the board in a way that opens a new line of attack. Look for a sequence where the card and the next move support each other.
Use the piece-change ability when it turns a weak or blocked piece into one that can reach the enemy king. Check which piece gives you the most useful threat before you drag the card.
Place new obstacles to block the enemy's routes toward your king or to cut off a piece they need to defend. Think about where the enemy will want to move next.
Use a new pawn to add support near the enemy king, where it can help you build pressure. A pawn placed close to the action is often more useful than one placed far away.
Before every turn, check the enemy king's escape squares and which of your pieces can reach them. Focus your cards and moves on closing those squares.
faq: What is the goal of Chess Royale?
The goal is to cut down the enemy king. You win by combining your queue of moves with magical abilities to trap and attack it.
How do I use a magical ability?
Drag the card onto an empty cell to create a new pawn or a new obstacle. To change a piece into another piece, drag the card onto that piece.

mystery-digger.intro: Mystery Digger is an idle clicker where you dig underground to find treasures and stories. You upgrade your drill with each click to reveal new finds.
tips: Click steadily at first to build up resources, then spend them on drill upgrades as soon as you can afford them.
Check the upgrade options regularly, since a stronger drill can speed up every future click.
Keep the game open for a while to let idle progress add up between active sessions.
Pay attention to each find, as the discoveries are tied to the story you are uncovering underground.
Balance your spending so you are not stuck with too little to buy the upgrade you want next.
faq: What is the goal of Mystery Digger?
The goal is to dig underground, uncover treasures and stories, and satisfy your curiosity with each discovery.
How do I control the drill?
Control is done by pressing the buttons on the screen, and this works the same way with a keyboard or on mobile.

timer-cannon.intro: Timer Cannon is a skill game where you aim and fire a cannon at approaching clocks. Destroy them before their hands finish a rotation to add seconds to your run.
tips: Watch the nearest clock first, since it is the one closest to finishing its rotation and needs to be hit before the others.
Track the clock's hand as it moves so you can judge when it is about to complete a full turn.
Time your tap for the moment your aim lines up, rather than firing as soon as a clock appears, to avoid wasting shots.
Keep an eye on the master timer, because every clock you destroy adds seconds back and gives you breathing room.
If you miss, focus on quickly re-aiming at the next closest clock, since the swarm closes the gap while you recover.
faq: What is the goal of Timer Cannon?
The goal is to keep your run going by destroying approaching clocks before their hands complete a full rotation. Each clock you destroy adds seconds to your master timer.
How do I fire the cannon?
Aim first, then make a single precision tap to fire. The cannon launches explosive rounds across the field toward the nearest approaching clock.

zigzag-snow-adventure.intro: Steer a bouncy red ball down a snowy mountain and dodge trees, rocks, and other obstacles. The goal is to survive as long as you can while the descent speeds up.
tips: Look ahead of the ball rather than at the obstacle right in front of it, so you can start moving before you need to.
Make small, early moves instead of large sudden swerves, since a big correction can send you straight into another obstacle.
Keep an eye on open gaps between obstacles and steer toward them early, especially as the ball picks up speed.
Watch how quickly the game speeds up and adjust your reaction time to match, because the pace is what makes later stages harder.
On a touchscreen, use short, deliberate swipes so you do not overshoot your target lane.
faq: What is the goal of Zigzag Snow Adventure?
The goal is to keep the red ball rolling down the snowy mountain for as long as possible without hitting trees, rocks, or other obstacles.
How do I move the ball?
On a keyboard, press A or Left Arrow to move left and D or Right Arrow to move right. On a touchscreen, swipe left or right.

one-man-army-battle-game.intro: One Man Army: Battle Game is a single-player defensive shooter where you hold off waves of enemy soldiers using reflexes and tactics. Earn points in each battle to rank up and upgrade your armory.
tips: Watch which type of attack is coming before you react. Arrows, cannon fire, and dragon flames each call for a different response, so reading the threat first helps you survive longer.

Spend your points on defensive upgrades such as shields and protective gear when you are taking heavy damage. Staying alive through a wave matters more than getting a stronger weapon you cannot survive long enough to use.
Treat each wave as a short tactical puzzle. Note where the enemies attack from and which ones are most dangerous, then choose your moves based on that pattern.
Think about your upgrades as a set rather than one at a time. Pairing a new weapon with armor or a shield can make a bigger difference than improving only one piece.
Stay calm during intense moments. Quick, deliberate movements usually beat frantic clicking, especially when several threats arrive at once.
faq: What is the main goal of One Man Army: Battle Game?
You defend yourself as a lone warrior against wave after wave of enemy soldiers and their attacks. Surviving each battle earns points that you can use to rank up.
How do I earn points?
You earn points by winning battles. Points are used to rank up and to buy upgrades for your armory and battle skills.

bound-to-defend.intro: Bound to Defend is an action survival game where you hold one outpost against endless waves. You choose a starting class, collect and upgrade gear, and build skills run by run.
tips: Since you cannot leave your spot, use A and D to scan the camera ahead of each wave so you see enemies coming before they reach the outpost.
Pick your starting class with your playstyle in mind, because your class shapes how you fight from the first wave of every run.
Save your potions for dangerous moments, using keys 1 and 2 when your health drops rather than early in a wave.
Merge and enhance gear as you collect it instead of holding onto it, so your stats improve steadily through each run.
Because every new game starts at level 1 and skill upgrades work like a roguelike, plan which skills to build toward and learn how each one works before pushing for a high wave count.
faq: What is the goal of Bound to Defend?
You defend your outpost against waves of enemies for as long as you can. Each run is a fresh attempt where you grow stronger through gear and skills.
How do I attack enemies?
Your character attacks automatically. Use your mouse to focus on a location, and trigger unlocked skills with Q, W, E, and R.

248-scribble.intro: 248 Scribble is a merge puzzle inspired by 2048. Connect matching numbers on a colorful doodle-style grid to build higher values and work toward the 248 tile.
tips: Look for matching numbers that sit next to each other horizontally or vertically before making a merge, since only adjacent matches connect.
Keep open space on the grid so you have room to make future merges and do not get boxed in.
Plan a few moves ahead instead of merging the first pair you see, because the order of merges can decide whether a higher tile is reachable.
Save coins for the tools you need most, since Undo costs 100, Hint costs 75, Shuffle costs 50, and Boost costs 200.
Use Hint when you are stuck to see a suggested merge, then check whether the board still leaves you room to keep going.
faq: What is the goal of 248 Scribble?
Merge matching numbers into higher values until you reach the 248 tile while managing the space on the grid. You also earn coins along the way.
How do I merge tiles?
Touch a tile and drag or swipe to an adjacent tile with the same number, moving horizontally or vertically. The two tiles then combine into a higher value.

chessvola-puzzles.intro: CHESSVOLA Puzzles is a chess tactics trainer with a large library of positions, daily challenges, and a training rating. Short, focused sessions work best for steady improvement.
tips: Before moving, check whether your opponent's last move created a threat, such as an attacked piece or a checkmate idea, and make sure your reply handles it.
Look for checks, captures, and threats first, since forcing moves often lead directly to the solution in tactical positions.
If a move feels wrong, pause and look at what each of your pieces can reach before clicking, rather than guessing and retrying.
Use the hint only after you have made a real attempt, so you practice spotting the pattern yourself.
Work through the 5 Daily Puzzles at a steady pace to keep your streak going, then spend extra time on a difficulty level that challenges you.
faq: How do I make a move?
Click or tap a piece, then click or tap the square you want it to move to. If the move is correct, the puzzle continues automatically.
What should I do if I get a puzzle wrong?
Try again from the same position, or use the Hint button to see the next correct move. The Reset button restarts the puzzle if you want a clean attempt.

zombie-terminator.intro: Zombie Terminator is a zombie shooting survival game set in a post-apocalyptic city. You fight waves of undead, collect drops, and upgrade your weapons to get through each level.
tips: Keep moving rather than standing still, since the instructions warn that being surrounded is the main danger.
Use the speed boost to break out when zombies start closing in from several sides, then turn back to shoot.
Pick up the coins and power-ups that zombies drop, and spend them on weapon upgrades before the harder waves arrive.
Watch for stronger enemies as the game goes on and adjust your position early instead of waiting until they reach you.
Aim and shoot while you reposition so you do not lose ground to the crowd during a fight.
faq: What is my goal in Zombie Terminator?
Eliminate all the zombies in each level and survive until the end of that level.
How do I move and shoot on a computer?
Use the arrow keys to move in four directions, press Space to shoot, and hold Shift for a speed boost.

on-fire-basketball-shots.intro: On Fire Basketball Shots is a physics-based arcade shooter where you chain basketball shots into moving hoops. One missed shot ends the run, so every swish matters.
tips: Use the trajectory guide before you release. Small changes in drag strength can send the ball far off target, so adjust slowly and check the arc first.
Focus on consistency over flashy shots. Since the game ends on your first miss, a steady, accurate shot is worth more than a risky one.
Aim for perfect swishes when you can. They earn bonus points and help your score climb faster.
Build your streak early. Reaching 'On Fire' mode doubles your points and makes each later shot more valuable, so protect the streak once you have it.
Spend the coins you earn on upgrades between sessions. Coins come from points, so higher scores also help you unlock more ball and environment skins.
faq: How do I aim and shoot?
Click and hold the basketball on desktop, or tap and hold it on touch screens. Drag downward to set aim and power, watch the trajectory guide, then release to shoot.
What ends the game?
The game ends when you miss a shot. Your goal is to keep your chain of successful shots going as long as possible.

knight-legend.intro: Knight Legend is an adventure where you fight monsters, upgrade your gear, and unlock new levels. Earn gold to buy armour and pets that fight alongside you.
tips: Spend your gold on armour when you can, since better gear helps you survive longer fights.
Check your equipment after each level and upgrade before you move on, so you do not face harder monsters with weak gear.
Use the pause key to take a breather and review your options between tough battles.
If you play on a keyboard, try the WASD keys if the arrow keys feel awkward, so you can move quickly while you fight.
Save up for a pet once you have covered your armour needs, since pets fight by your side and can help in difficult fights.
faq: What is the main goal of Knight Legend?
You move through an adventure quest, battling monsters and unlocking new levels as you progress. Along the way, you earn gold to upgrade your gear.
How do I move my knight?
On desktop, use the arrow keys or W, A, S, D (or Z, Q, S, D). On mobile, drag the on-screen joystick in any direction.

impossible-parkour-3d.intro: Impossible Parkour 3D is a 3D platform game with 25 levels of jumping challenges. Each level introduces new obstacles, so you will need to adapt your approach as you progress.
tips: Before each jump, pause briefly to judge the distance and height of the next platform, since small misjudgments are the most common cause of falls.
Keep your movement steady rather than rushing; short, controlled hops are often safer than long leaps across gaps.
Pay attention to how each new level changes the rules or layout, and spend a few attempts learning it before pushing for speed.
Use the in-game tutorial on mobile to learn the joystick and button layout before attempting the harder levels.
If you keep failing at the same spot, step back and try a different route or timing instead of repeating the identical jump.
faq: What is the goal of Impossible Parkour 3D?
The goal is to get through each of the 25 levels by moving across platforms and obstacles in 3D. The game is designed to be very challenging.
How do I move and jump on PC?
Use W, A, S, D or the arrow keys to move, and press Space to jump.

insect-exploration.intro: Insect Exploration is an animal puzzle game where you guide a bug through encounters with snails, spiders, grasshoppers and other insects. Your aim is to reach the targeted block and unblock the way.
tips: Before you move, look at where the targeted block is and plan a route that reaches it. Working backward from the goal often reveals the best first move.
Pay attention to how each insect moves, since snails, spiders and grasshoppers may behave differently. Learning their patterns helps you predict where it is safe to go.
Try each movement style you have, whether hopping, flying or bouncing, to see which one suits a given spot. Choosing the right style for each situation is central to progressing.
If you get stuck, reset your thinking and try a different path rather than repeating the same move. Small changes in order can open up a new route.
Take your time on early challenges to build a feel for how the bug responds. The game is simple to start but gets harder to master as you go.
faq: What is the goal of Insect Exploration?
Your goal is to guide the bug to the targeted block so you can unblock it. You do this while moving past snails, spiders, grasshoppers and other insects.
What movement options does the bug have?
The bug can hop, fly and bounce. Using the right movement at the right time is how you get through each level.

flag-learn.intro: Flag Learn is a geography quiz where you type the name of flags, capitals, and US states. It tracks what you struggle with and brings those back until you know them well.
tips: Answer each flag several times rather than once, since a flag only joins your collection after 3 correct answers in a row. A wrong answer resets that streak, so slow and steady works better than rushing.

Pay attention to the flags you miss. The spaced-repetition system brings them back, so reviewing the same trouble spots in your own head between rounds helps you answer them correctly when they return.
Watch your lives. Mistakes cost one, and lives refill over time, so if you are running low, it can help to switch to a lighter activity or come back later rather than guessing.
Use the challenge modes to test different skills. Blur Mode and Border Guess ask you to recognize flags and countries from less obvious clues, which is useful practice beyond plain naming.
For Highscore speedruns, focus on accuracy first. A quick wrong answer costs you a life and more time, so steady correct answers usually give a better score than fast guesses.
faq: How many correct answers do I need to master a flag?
You need to answer a flag correctly 3 times in a row. Getting one wrong breaks the streak, so you start counting again.
What happens when I make a mistake?
A mistake costs you one life. Lives refill over time, so you can keep playing after a short wait.

planet-destroy-idle.intro: Planet Destroy Idle is a clicker where you smash planets to collect resources and craft better tools. Each hit adds progress, and prestige lets you return stronger to face bigger planets.
tips: Check the upgrade and craft menus often so you can spend collected resources on stronger tools as soon as you can afford them.
Work through the quests, since they are a clear way to see what to aim for next and they count toward unlocking achievements.
Upgrade your existing weapons rather than only buying new ones, so each hit you make gets stronger over time.
Save prestige for when your progress has slowed down, because prestige resets your planet progress and gives you perks that help you smash bigger planets afterward.
Pick perks that match how you are playing, such as ones that help your hits or your resource collection, and build from there.
faq: How do I interact with the game?
Use the left mouse button to click on UI elements such as buying and crafting weapons, upgrading tools, completing quests, and choosing prestige perks.
What is the goal of Planet Destroy Idle?
The goal is to destroy planets, collect valuable resources, and grow stronger so you can smash larger planets.

cars.intro: Cars is a fast-paced racing game where you drive, overtake traffic, and try to beat your best score. Use the gas to pass other vehicles and the brake to avoid crashes.
tips: Keep your attention on the cars ahead so you can plan when to overtake and when to slow down.
Use the gas to pass cars when the lane in front of you is clear, rather than pushing forward into a tight gap.
Brake early when a crash looks likely, since reacting late leaves little room to avoid a collision.
Aim to pass as many cars as you can in each race, and keep track of your best result to measure your improvement.
Play a few short races in a row to get comfortable with the timing of gas and brake before going for a high score.
faq: What is the main goal of Cars?
Your goal is to pass as many cars as possible while avoiding crashes, and to show your best result in each race.
How do I control the car?
Press the gas to speed up and overtake cars, and press the brake to slow down and avoid crashing.

sticker-jam-peel-off-and-match.intro: Sticker Jam is a relaxed puzzle game where you peel off colorful stickers and match three identical ones to clear them. Clear every sticker in a level to unlock the next, more complex challenge.
tips: Scan the whole board before tapping anything so you can spot which colors appear in groups of three.
Work at a slow, steady pace rather than rushing, since the game is built around calm, unhurried play.
Keep track of colors you have already cleared so you do not waste time searching for matches that are gone.
If a level feels stuck, pause and look again at the stickers you have not touched yet, as a new match often appears from a different angle.
Watch for milestones and rewards along the way, as they are worth aiming for as you progress through the levels.
faq: What is the main goal of Sticker Jam?
Your goal is to peel off stickers and match three identical stickers or colors to clear them until every sticker in the level is gone.
How do I clear stickers?
Tap a sticker to remove it from the board, then find two more of the same color or design to match and clear them together.

slasty-candy-tower.intro: Slasty: Candy Tower is an arcade game where you tap or press space to fire candy at hungry monsters on spinning towers. Clear every monster in a stage to move on.
tips: Take your time with each shot. The platforms speed up, so a calm, precise tap usually does better than a rushed one.
Watch the rhythm of the spinning platforms before you fire. Timing your tap to the moment the target lines up is the core skill.
Aim for combos when you can. Landing shots in quick succession is how you build higher scores.
Expect later stages to be harder. Use the easier early stages to learn how each tower's platforms move before you push further.
Try a new tower once you are comfortable with the current one. Each tower has different platforms and mechanics, so the timing you learned may need adjusting.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Complete the stages in order by feeding all of the chewbrick monsters on the tower with candy from your cannon. Each stage gets harder than the last.
How do I make a candy shot?
Tap the screen or press the space bar at the right moment. Timing matters more than speed.

boba-blast.intro: Boba Blast is a fast head-to-head duel where you and a rival each clear a spinning mega-ball of boba pearls. Shoot matching colors to pop chain reactions and be the first to clear your cluster.
tips: Only matching colors pop, so check the color of your active shot before you drag. A wrong-color hit ricochets and wastes the throw.
Use Swap balls when your active shot is the wrong color or a poor match for the cluster, since the preview ball may give you a better option.
Shots are limited, so treat each one as a decision. Aim for hits that set off chain reactions rather than single pops.
Choose your arc to suit the shot: drag up for a higher lob, or drag down for a flatter line-drive. Check the glowing trajectory before you release.
Keep an eye on the clock and your rival's progress. If you may run out of shots, focus on popping as many pearls as you can.
faq: How do I win a match?
You win by clearing your mega-ball first. If you both run out of shots, the player who has popped more pearls wins.
What happens when I shoot the wrong color?
A wrong-color hit ricochets instead of popping the pearls, so the shot does not clear anything for you.

balls-animal.intro: Balls Animal is a colorful sorting puzzle where you move balls into matching tubes. With over 500 levels that grow harder over time, it suits players who like planning a few moves ahead.
tips: Before each move, check which ball is on top of every tube so you know what you can actually reach.
Avoid placing a ball on top of a tube that holds a different color if you can help it, since it may block the color underneath.
Look for a tube you can empty or one that already has the right color on top, and build your moves around those.
If you get stuck, try a few different moves in your head before clicking, because a sequence of small steps often solves a level that looks blocked.
Start each level by scanning the whole board for the colors that appear most, so you can plan where each group should end up.
faq: How do I move a ball?
Click the tube you want to take a ball from, then click the tube where you want to place it.
What is the goal of each level?
Sort the colorful balls so that each tube ends up holding balls of matching colors.

harvest-haulers.intro: Harvest Haulers is an idle clicker about running a fruit farm. You tap the hopper to drop fruit onto trucks, then spend the gold they earn on upgrades that speed up your production.
tips: Keep tapping the hopper steadily, since your tap rate is the main source of fruit early on.
Buy the fruit-per-tap upgrade first when you can afford it, because every future tap then gives you more fruit.
Watch the trucks on the belt and dispatch one early when it is nearly loaded but the belt is backing up behind it.
Save a little gold for bigger trucks or extra lanes when the belt starts to feel crowded, rather than spending everything at once.
Check the shop rail after each truck drives off, since new gold is the signal that an upgrade you were saving for may now be affordable.
faq: What is the goal of Harvest Haulers?
The goal is to grow your fruit operation by tapping the hopper, filling trucks, and using the gold they pay to buy upgrades.
How do I earn gold?
Gold comes from full trucks that drive off after being loaded with fruit from the hopper funnel.

block-sort-pirate-treasure.intro: Block Sort Pirate Treasure is a logic puzzle where you sort mixed stacks of gems, gold coins, and relics until each stack holds only one type of loot. The campaign has 5,000 levels that get harder as you go.
tips: Before you move anything, check which treasure type has blocks buried under other items, and plan to free those first.
Use an empty space as a temporary holding spot, but avoid filling every empty space, since you need room to shuffle blocks.
Look for stacks where moving one top block would let a matching type end up together, and prioritize those moves.
Think a few moves ahead, especially when a block you move could cover a treasure you still need to reach.
Save the undo and extra empty slot boosters for levels where you are truly stuck rather than using them early.
faq: How do I move a treasure from one stack to another?
On desktop, click a stack to pick up its top item, then click an empty space or a stack whose top item matches. On mobile, tap a stack to select its top block, then tap where you want it to go.
How do I know when a level is complete?
A level is complete when every column contains only one matching type of loot.

monster-tile-party.intro: Monster Tile Party is a triple-tile puzzle game where you clear a layered board by collecting three matching monster tiles in your tray. Plan each pick so the tray never fills up before the board is clear.
tips: Only uncovered tiles can be selected, so check which tiles are free before each move. Picking a tile often reveals new options underneath.
Look for tiles that already have a match in the tray. Grabbing a second or third copy of a monster brings a set to completion and frees up space.
Avoid spreading single tiles of many types across the tray, since this fills it quickly. Try to group your picks around one or two monsters at a time.
Save Undo for moments when the tray is nearly full and a pick has gone wrong. Use Shuffle when no good matches are visible, and Extra Slot when you need more room to work with.
Check your daily rewards each time you play so you can build up boosters before harder levels.
faq: How do I win a level?
Clear every tile from the board before your tray fills up. If the tray fills first, the level ends.
What happens when three matching tiles are in the tray?
They are removed automatically, which frees space in the tray. You do not need to do anything extra to trigger the match.

move-emoji.intro: Move Emoji is a matching puzzle where you swipe emoji boxes around the board to pair them up. Each level gives you a limited number of moves, so planning ahead matters.
tips: Before your first swipe, scan the whole board and note which emojis appear in pairs so you know your targets.
Look for moves that clear a match right away, since every swipe counts against your limited moves.
Avoid shuffling pieces without a plan; a swipe that does not bring you closer to a match is a wasted move.
If you get stuck, think about which box is blocking the path of a pair and move that one first.
Keep track of how many moves you have left as you go, and slow down on later levels where the board gets more crowded.
faq: What is the goal of Move Emoji?
Match all the emoji boxes on the board to clear the level and move on to the next challenge.
How do I move the emoji boxes?
Swipe an emoji box to move it. Matching emojis are cleared from the board.

spin-and-mow.intro: Spin&Mow is a skill game where you control a saw-chain robot and hop between grass islands over deep water. Cut enough grass to meet each stage's quota, then reach the flag.
tips: Before each swap, watch where the free gear will orbit and plan the landing point. Launching early or late is the most common way to fall into the water.
Use the mouse wheel or HUD buttons to adjust chain length before a jump, so the orbit reaches the next island instead of overshooting it.
Clear grass in a steady sweep rather than darting around. This helps you meet the quota without leaving patches you will have to return to.
On moving platforms, wait for a steady rhythm and time your swap to the platform's position as it arrives. Rushing these landings is a frequent mistake.
Watch for stumps, boulders and crystals as you orbit, and plan your path around them. Spend your coins on upgrades that suit your play style as you progress through the 20 stages.
faq: What is the goal of each stage?
Cut enough grass to meet the stage's quota, then move from island to island and touch the exiting pole or flag to escape.
How do I launch my robot from one island to another?
Click, tap or press space to swap which gear is anchored and launch the chain. The other gear orbits and carries you across the gap.

fruite-swipe.intro: Fruit Swipe is a match-3 arcade puzzle game where you connect matching colorful fruits to clear them. Its hundreds of levels offer a steady run of new puzzles to solve.
tips: Scan the whole board before you start a swipe, and look for chains that clear several fruits at once.
Keep your finger or mouse steady while you connect fruits so the path doesn't wander onto the wrong color.
Pay attention to which fruits are blocking others and aim to clear those first when you can.
Try to save power-ups for harder moments, when a single well-timed match matters most.
Take a short break when a level gets tricky, then come back and look at the board with fresh eyes.
faq: How do I make a match?
Press and hold the left mouse button, or touch and hold with your finger, then connect the same fruits. Release the button to complete the match.
How many levels are there?
The game includes hundreds of challenging levels, so there is plenty of new puzzle content to work through.

fill-the-heart.intro: Fill the Heart is a mobile-friendly browser game controlled by arrow keys or WASD on desktop, and by swiping on touchscreens. This guide covers the controls and some habits to help you get started.
tips: Learn the four movement directions on desktop first, using either the arrow keys or W, A, S, and D, so you can change direction quickly.
On mobile, use short, deliberate swipes and check where your character ends up before swiping again.
Use R to restart as soon as a run goes badly, rather than playing on from a poor position.
Press M to mute the sound if you want to focus on movement without audio distractions.
Use Q to return to the menu when you want to switch sessions or take a break, then come back with a fresh start.
faq: How do I move on a phone or tablet?
Swipe on the screen in the direction you want to move. The on-screen swipe control is the only movement method listed for mobile.
What do the R and Q keys do?
R restarts the game, and Q takes you back to the menu. These are listed as desktop controls.

stunsteval-siderollers.intro: Stunsteval Siderollers is a side-view arcade race where you try to outrun a helicopter, a biplane or a fighter jet. Rain and dark highways add to the challenge.
tips: Use W to shift up when you have speed to spare, and S to drop into a lower gear when you need more control.
Keep an eye on the pursuers, since the helicopter, biplane and fighter jet may approach from different directions.
Practice the double-tap D move for lowering the gear so you can use it quickly when the road gets tricky.
In rain or on the dark highway, ease off a little and focus on keeping the car steady rather than pushing for top speed.
Use A to ease back when you need to avoid a crash, then press D again to get moving once the path is clear.
faq: What is the goal of Stunsteval Siderollers?
The goal is to outrun the pursuers, which include a helicopter, a biplane or a fighter jet, while driving through rain or on a dark highway.
Which keys control the car on PC?
D moves the car forward, A moves it back, W shifts gear up, and S shifts gear low. Double-tapping D lowers the gear.

sway-tower-builder.intro: Sway is a one-tap stacking game where you drop swinging blocks onto a growing tower. Time each tap so blocks land on top of each other and the tower stays upright.
tips: Watch the swing for a moment before tapping. Tapping at the peak of the swing usually gives you a better chance of lining up the block.
Aim to place each block as close to the center of the tower below as you can. Small offsets add up and make the stack harder to balance.
Focus on consistency over speed. Keeping every drop steady matters more than trying to stack quickly.
Pay attention to how the tower is leaning after each drop and correct your timing on the next block if it drifts to one side.
Since three misses end the run, consider slowing down when you have already missed once or twice and take your time with the next drop.
faq: What is the goal of Sway?
The goal is to stack blocks as high as you can. A block swings from a crane, and you tap to drop it onto the tower.
What counts as a Perfect?
A Perfect is when you line the block up well with the tower below. Perfect drops make the tower grow steadily.

crusher-block.intro: Crusher Block is an idle clicker where you smash blocks, earn money, and upgrade your tools to build a stronger crushing machine. Here is how to get the most out of each session.
tips: Hold the left mouse button over the pickaxe and move the cursor to smash blocks, since this is your main way to earn money early on.
Spend money on tool upgrades as soon as you can afford them, because stronger tools make every smash more productive.
Check your upgrades regularly. Choosing which one to buy next matters more than buying whatever you can afford first.
Let the game run while you do other things, since the idle part keeps your machine working when you are not clicking.
Keep the interaction short and steady rather than rushing, so you do not miss the blocks and tools you can interact with on screen.
faq: What is the main goal of Crusher Block?
The goal is to smash blocks, earn money, and upgrade your tools until you have a powerful crushing machine. Progress comes from steady earnings and smart upgrades.
How do I smash blocks?
Hold the mouse over the pickaxe with the left mouse button and move the cursor to interact with the blocks. Use the left mouse button for other objects and interface elements too.

prasino.intro: Prásino is a survival simulation set in a world buried under trash, where trees are the only source of air. Plant magic seeds, restore barren land, and push forward while avoiding trash-born enemies.
tips: Collect magic seeds before you need them, since planting a tree depends on having seeds to use.
Pay attention to your breath throughout the run, because it is your lifeline and the reason trees matter so much.
Plant trees in barren zones to restore the land and open a safer path forward.
Watch for enemies as you move around, and use your attack when you need to clear a path or protect yourself.
Break loot boxes when you pass them, since they may hold useful items, and keep your route clear so you can return to them.
faq: What is the main goal of Prásino?
Your goal is to survive in a trash-filled world by planting magic seeds to grow trees, which provide the air you need to breathe. Restoring barren zones helps you carve a path forward.
How do I plant a tree?
On desktop, press Z to plant a tree. On mobile, tap the Plant button. You need magic seeds to grow trees, so collect them first.

merge-balls-shooter-2048-connect-fruits.intro: Merge Balls Shooter 2048 Connect Fruits mixes 2048-style number merging with billiards in a fruity setting. You aim fruit balls with matching numbers at each other to merge them and clear levels.
tips: Look for pairs of balls with the same number before each shot, since those are the ones that merge into new fruit balls.
Aim so that the matching balls collide directly, which gives you the best chance to earn extra balls.
Plan your next shot before you fire, so you do not run out of useful moves while the board is still crowded.
Keep an eye on where the new balls appear after each merge, because they can open up or block future shots.
Aim for high scores by combining merges in a chain when you can, rather than taking every easy shot right away.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Your goal is to merge fruit balls with the same numbers by aiming them at each other, which lets you get extra balls and complete each level.
How do I merge fruit balls?
Aim a fruit ball at another ball with the same number so they meet and combine into a new fruit ball.

shadow-node.intro: Shadow Node is a cyberpunk idle hacking game. You click to mine Data, spend it on bots and power-ups, and keep your Trace Level below 100% while your network grows.
tips: Keep an eye on your Trace Level from the start, since reaching 100% locks you out.
Spend your early Data on Bots and power-ups, because they boost your hash rate automatically and keep earnings coming while you do other things.
Check the Quests and Syndicate Ops in the Network regularly, as they are the main source of Intel and Dark Matter.
Come back after time away to collect your offline earnings, and check which upgrades you can afford at that point.
Hold off on Prestige until your current earnings are slowing down, so the permanent multipliers you gain are worth the reset.
faq: How do I earn Data in Shadow Node?
Click EXECUTE to mine Data. You can then spend it in the Market on Bots and power-ups.
What happens if my Trace Level reaches 100%?
You get locked out of the game, so watch the Trace Level as you progress.

latto-latto.intro: Latto-Latto is a timing game where you hold and move a handle to swing two balls so they keep hitting each other. Keep the rhythm steady, and see how long you can keep the balls going.
tips: Make small, smooth movements instead of large, sudden swings, since the description ties control to careful timing and movement.
Watch the balls for a few swings before you try to change anything, so you can feel the rhythm they naturally fall into.
Correct small drifts early. A minor adjustment is easier to recover from than a big correction after the balls have fallen out of sync.
Stay relaxed and keep your hand steady rather than gripping tightly, which can make the handle jerk and break the pattern.
Collect coins whenever you can, because they unlock new ball skins to personalize your game.
faq: What is the goal of Latto-Latto?
The goal is to keep the two balls swinging and hitting each other repeatedly for as long as possible. The longer you keep them going, the higher your score.
How do I control the balls?
Hold and move your finger to control the handle, and swing it to set the two balls in motion. Their movement follows the handle, so smooth control is key.

grand-escape.intro: Grand Escape! is an arcade platform game where you guide your character through vibrant levels filled with odd beings and challenges. Use the arrow keys to move and make your way to triumph.
tips: Use your double jump to correct mid-air, especially when you need extra height or distance to reach a ledge.
Pause briefly before each jump to judge the distance, since a mistimed jump is the most common reason to restart.
If you get stuck or fall into a bad position, press K to restart the level right away instead of wasting time trying to recover.
Finish each level before leaving, because progress is saved when you go back to the level selection menu after completing one.
Practice the movement on each level's layout, and keep your jumps short and controlled until you know the route well.
faq: What is the goal of Grand Escape!?
You guide your character through each level and reach its end to complete it and move on. The game is built around exploring a colorful world full of challenges.
How do I move and jump?
Use the arrow keys to move your character. You also have a double jump, which lets you jump a second time while in the air.

pop-the-band.intro: Pop the Band is a 3D puzzle where you snap colorful rubber bands off snacks, one at a time. Only a band with nothing crossing over it can be popped, so careful study matters.
tips: Before every tap, scan the whole tangle and find bands with nothing crossing over them. Those are the only ones that can safely pop.
Drag to spin the snack and check the back side before you start. Sneaky bands often hide there, and missing one can waste a mistake.
You only get three mistakes per level, so slow down and look twice before each snap. A quick check costs less than a reset.
Save powerups for levels that stall you. Try to work out the next move on your own first, then use Finder if you are truly stuck.
Use the Shield when you are unsure of a band you have already misjudged, since it forgives your next mistake. Keep it for a risky moment rather than an easy one.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Pop every rubber band off the snack to clear the level. You earn coins and stars for clearing it.
What happens if I tap the wrong band?
The band wobbles and you lose a life. Losing all three mistakes resets the puzzle, so you start the level again.

bank-robbery-puzzle.intro: Bank Robbery Puzzle is a logic puzzle where you pick a thief, plan the order of their tasks, and work your way into the bank to collect as much money as possible. Careful sequencing matters more than speed.
tips: Before sending anyone in, look at the whole heist and think about which character should go first, since the instructions say the order of tasks matters.
Pick each character for the job they are best suited to rather than using the same hero for everything.
If a plan fails, study exactly where it went wrong and change only that step before trying again.
Avoid guards by planning routes that keep your thieves out of their way, rather than rushing through and hoping for the best.
Take a moment to test small steps first, so you know how each character behaves before committing to a full run.
faq: What is the main goal of Bank Robbery Puzzle?
Your goal is to break into the bank and take possession of a large amount of money by completing the heist tasks in the right order.
How do I succeed in the heist?
Choose your characters carefully and send them on tasks in a specific sequence, because the path to the money depends on getting the order right.

nexus-override.intro: Nexus Override is a 3D horde survival game where you play a rogue AI escaping the mainframe. Hold out against waves of hostile programs, build defenses, and level up as you go.
tips: Use walls and turrets together: walls can slow enemies down while turrets handle the damage, so place them where enemies will funnel toward you.
Since shooting is automatic, focus your attention on movement and positioning rather than aiming.
Pick upgrades that match your playstyle early, because you choose a new upgrade every time you level up during a round.
Save your earned credits to upgrade your stats between runs, and avoid spending them on things you won't use in your next attempt.
In 2-player co-op, split roles so one player leads the enemies around while the other builds walls and turrets to cover the route.
faq: What is the goal of Nexus Override?
Your goal is to survive the waves of hostile programs and outlast the system. Each of the 6 sectors ends with a boss fight you need to get through.
How do I move and build in the game?
Player 1 moves with WASD and Player 2 moves with the Arrow Keys. Press 1 to build a wall and 2 to deploy a turret during battle.

fill-the-hopper.intro: Fill the Hopper is a relaxing 3D triple-match puzzle where you tap objects out of a tumbling pile to match three of a kind. Clear the goal objects shown for each level before your tray overflows.
tips: Before each tap, look for objects that are already partly visible or easy to reach, since pulling out a piece can shift the whole pile.
Keep your tray from getting crowded by sending a piece only when you can see a second and third match coming.
Spread your attention across the goal objects for the level so you do not end up with one kind left over and no way to finish the set.
