Save your boosters for tense moments: undo a bad move, use the magnet to pull a matching set, add a tray slot when space runs short, or shuffle when the pile is stuck.
Watch how the physics settles after each tap, and wait a moment for the pile to stop moving before choosing your next object.
faq: What is the goal of Fill the Hopper?
Collect the goal objects shown for each level by matching three of the same kind. Clearing all the goals wins the level.
How do I lose a level?
You lose if your tray fills up with no match. Keep the tray clear by sending only pieces that help build a set.

geek-escape-run-for-survival.intro: Geek Escape is a running game where a nerdy hero races away from bullies. You dodge obstacles, throw trash cans at pursuers, and use speed boosts to stay ahead.
tips: Keep moving with the arrow keys and watch ahead so you can steer around obstacles before you reach them.
Save your trash can throws for when bullies are lined up or closing in, so each throw counts.
Use the Shift speed boost to gain distance when you need a safe gap, rather than holding it the whole time.
Plan your route before you commit to a direction, since changing lanes late often leads to a collision.
Practice combining movement, throwing and boosting, because the game rewards quick decisions under pressure.
faq: What is the main goal in Geek Escape?
You control a nerdy hero who is running away from bullies, so your aim is to keep escaping and survive the chase.
How do I throw trash cans?
Press the Spacebar to throw a trash can at the bullies chasing you.

underground-heroes.intro: Underground Heroes is a tower defense game where you swing a hook to pull trapped heroes up to the battlefield. Rescued heroes fight enemy forces and help destroy the enemy towers.
tips: Time your swings carefully, since each pull of the hook decides which heroes join the battle.
Spend your upgrades on the hook so you can reach more heroes underground.
Pay attention to each hero's unique features and pick the mix that suits the fight in front of you.
Keep your heroes strengthened, because later arenas get much harder.
Aim before you pull, and take note of where the enemy waves and towers are attacking.
faq: What is the main goal of Underground Heroes?
Your goal is to rescue enough heroes with the hook to build an army that can destroy the enemy forces and their towers.
How do I rescue heroes?
Use the hook to capture heroes trapped underground and bring them up to the battlefield, timing and aiming each swing carefully.

arrows-make-it-cozy.intro: Arrows: Make It Cozy! is a puzzle game where you tap tangled arrows to slide them off the grid before time or lives run out. Each level is a sequence puzzle, so the order you clear arrows matters.
tips: Before you tap anything, scan the board and look for arrows that have a clear path to the edge. Clearing those first often opens up the rest.
Watch for arrows that block each other. Clear the one at the front of a line so the arrows behind it have room to leave.
Save the Hint booster for a moment when you are truly stuck. It shows one arrow that can safely leave, which is useful for working out the next move.
Use the Compass booster when a level has many crossing paths. It reveals every arrow's route, so you can plan the full order at once.
To build combos, keep your moves quick and clean. You have 10 seconds between moves to keep a combo going, so avoid long pauses while you plan.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Free all the arrows from the grid before you run out of time. Each collision costs one of your three lives.
How do I move an arrow?
Tap or click an arrow and it slides straight in the direction it points. If the path is clear, it leaves the board.

prisoners-run.intro: Prisoners Run is an action escape game set in a harsh prison. Find the key, reach the exit elevator, and free fellow prisoners as you make your way out.
tips: Locate the key before heading for the exit elevator, since you need it to advance to the next level.
Scout the area around you before moving on so you know where guards are patrolling and can plan a route past them.
Take time to rescue and escort the other prisoners, keeping them close as you move toward the exit.
Use your strength to smash doors when a direct path is blocked, but check what is behind a door first.
On mobile, make small, steady joystick drags for precise movement, and use larger drags only when you need to cover ground quickly.
faq: What is the goal of Prisoners Run?
Find the key, then reach the exit elevator to advance to the next level. Rescuing and escorting fellow prisoners to freedom happens along the way.
How do I move my character?
On desktop, use the arrow keys or WASD. On mobile, drag the virtual joystick in any direction to move.

snaky-jam.intro: Snaky Jam is a 3D sorting puzzle where you place containers into slots to match the snake's colors. Clear every snake before the timer runs out or a snake reaches the end of the path.
tips: Keep at least one slot open whenever you can, because every placement uses up space and a full board leaves you with no moves.
Before you select a container, look at the snake's colored layers and check which container colors you need next.
Plan two or three moves ahead on harder boards, since frozen, locked, and burning containers can block the piece you want.
Save your boosters for moments when the board is nearly full or the timer is low, rather than using them at the start.
If a snake is getting close to the end of the path, focus on that snake first to protect the rabbit.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Match the container colors to the snake and clear its colored layers. You must clear every snake to win the level.
How do I place a container?
Click or tap a container to select it, then click or tap an available slot to place it. On desktop use the left mouse button, and on mobile tap the screen.

exploring-the-galaxy-1-andora.intro: Exploring the Galaxy 1: Andora is an adventure game about building up a planet. You gather resources, craft materials, and unlock new land as you explore its biomes.
tips: Start by chopping trees, breaking rocks, and collecting ore near you, since every later step depends on having resources in hand.
Take your haul to processing and workshops regularly so your materials are ready for upgrades and crafting.
Upgrade your tools before spending on new land, because faster tools make every later gathering run quicker.
Keep an eye on creatures nearby and deal with them early so they do not interrupt your building.
Check your quests when you visit new biomes, since completing them gives rewards and can help you find new materials.
faq: What is the main goal of Andora?
Your goal is to build up the planet by gathering resources, crafting, and spending them to unlock new land tiles and unexplored areas.
How do I move and gather in the game?
On PC, use WASD and the mouse. On phone, use the joystick and touch controls. Walk over to trees, rocks, and ore to gather them.

furry-kung-fu.intro: Furry Kung Fu is a cartoon fighting game where you play as Catsei or Kung Fu Cat, punching opponents while dodging flying objects. This guide covers the controls and some habits that help you last longer in battle.
tips: Keep moving and dodge incoming balls, comets, fire and pots rather than waiting to block them. Staying out of their path gives you more time to attack.
Use combos by repeatedly pressing in the direction of your target, since a steady string of punches is the main way to damage opponents.
Try the uppercut, which is a squat followed by a jump (down then up), when an opponent is close. It is a useful way to change up your attacks.
Pick up weapons during battle when you can, because new weapons help you handle the crowds of pigeons, rats, aliens and crocodiles.
Spend the coins you collect on new skins and weapons, and keep an eye on which maps you have unlocked so you can plan which one to play next.
faq: What is the goal of Furry Kung Fu?
You fight opponents and crowds of animals by landing punches while avoiding flying objects. Collecting coins, weapons and skins, and unlocking maps, adds to the fun.
How do I control my character?
On a PC, use the arrow keys: left and right to move, up to jump, and down to sit down. On a smartphone, use swipes and taps on the screen to do the same actions.

police-chase-gate-runner.intro: Police Chase Gate Runner is a lane-switching arcade racer where you flee pursuit cars for as long as possible. Drive through blue gates to build speed, dodge red gates, and spend cash on upgrades between runs.
tips: Treat blue gates as your speed source and plan lane changes a few gates ahead so you are never stuck with only red options.
Keep an eye on your speed. If it falls too low, the police catch you, so grabbing blue gates matters more than staying in your current lane.
Save nitro for moments when the police are closing in or traffic is crowded, since it is the tool for breaking away.
Between runs, put your cash into the upgrades that help you survive longer, and try a different setup if your last run ended quickly.
Each run is also a chance to beat your previous distance, so focus on one improvement at a time, like cleaner lane changes, to see the results clearly.
faq: What ends a run?
A run ends when your speed drops too low, which lets the police catch you. Avoiding red gates and keeping your speed up is the main way to last longer.
When should I use nitro?
Use nitro to break away from pursuing police when they get close or when the road ahead looks crowded. Using it too early can leave you without it when you need it most.

zombie-hunter-survival.intro: Zombie Hunter: Survival is an action shooter where you fight endless waves of zombies while upgrading your gear and weapons. The longer you last, the tougher the enemies get.
tips: Spend upgrades on the weapon or gear you use most often, so your gains compound rather than being spread thin.
Collect loot whenever it is safe to do so, since it helps you keep pace as difficulty rises.
Save your special abilities for dangerous moments, such as when a crowd closes in or a stronger enemy appears.
Keep moving rather than standing still, so you are not surrounded by the zombies coming at you.
Check your upgrades regularly and adjust your loadout as the enemies change, so you are not falling behind the difficulty curve.
faq: What is the main goal of Zombie Hunter: Survival?
Your main goal is to survive as long as possible while the zombies keep coming. Progress depends on staying alive as the difficulty rises.
How do I get stronger during a run?
Upgrade your gear and weapons and pick up useful loot. These upgrades help you keep up with stronger enemies.

my-little-kingdom.intro: My Little Kingdom puts you in charge of a realm under monster attack. You explore, buy land, gather resources, and turn gold into a stronger, more prosperous kingdom.
tips: Gather resources early so you have materials to sell while you build up your gold.
Spend gold on developing and strengthening your domain before threats get harder to handle.
Keep an eye on where monsters are attacking and head there when your lands or people are at risk.
Explore nearby areas before buying new land so you know what resources each one offers.
Use WASD or the arrow keys for smooth movement on desktop, and the touchscreen on mobile, so you can react quickly during attacks.
faq: What is the main goal of My Little Kingdom?
Your goal is to protect your lands and people from monster attacks while building a great and prosperous kingdom. Gathering, selling, and developing are the core parts of that.
How do I earn gold?
Gather valuable resources and sell your materials. The gold you earn can be used to develop and strengthen your domain.

quick-draw-cowboys.intro: Quick Draw Cowboys is a reaction-based western duel game. You wait for the draw cue, then pick the correct direction faster than your opponent.
tips: Keep your eyes on the centre of the screen so you spot the draw cue the moment it appears instead of looking for it.
Do not react before the cue. Acting early is a fast way to lose a duel, so stay patient and let the signal set the timing.
Learn the direction controls before you enter tougher duels. On desktop use W, A, S and D; on mobile tap the matching arrow button.
Use Campaign duels to practise your timing against escalating enemies before you try Local or Online PvP.
Spend coins on stronger guns and upgrades as you win, since each duel reward helps you handle tougher opponents.
faq: What is the main goal of Quick Draw Cowboys?
Your goal is to be the fastest cowboy in the duel by choosing the correct direction after the draw cue before your opponent does. Winning duels earns coins.
What are the desktop controls?
Use W to shoot upward, S to shoot downward, A to shoot left and D to shoot right. In Local PvP, Player 2 uses the Arrow Keys.

color-match-rush.intro: Color Match Rush is a fast, one-thumb reflex arcade game. Rotate the spinning ring so the segment under the gate matches each incoming colored dot before it reaches the gate.
tips: Watch the dot as it moves inward and start rotating the ring early, so you are not rushing the final moment.
Pick the rotation direction that gets the matching segment under the gate with the fewest taps.
Keep your eyes on the gate rather than the ring's edges, since that is where the match has to happen.
Expect the pace to change: every 10 points adds a new color, so re-check the colors each time one is added.
Keep your taps steady and deliberate, because one wrong color ends the run and there are no second chances.
faq: What is the goal of Color Match Rush?
Rotate the ring so the segment under the gate matches the color of the incoming dot. Each correct match raises your score.
How do I rotate the ring?
On desktop, click with the cursor to rotate the colors. On mobile, tap to rotate them.

equal-cut.intro: Equal Cut is a one-swipe balancing puzzle. You aim a single straight cut through each food, and the scale shows how close your two halves are to equal.
tips: Before you swipe, study the whole shape and picture where its weight sits, since irregular foods often hide a balance point away from the middle.
Start your drag from one edge and check the aim line before you release, because a small change in angle can shift the split a lot.
Pay attention to thick or bulky sections, which tend to pull the balance toward them, and angle your cut to account for them.
Use the scale result as feedback: note whether one half came out heavier and adjust your next attempt in that direction.
Take your time, since there is no timer, and redraw the cut as many times as you need to build a feel for each shape.
faq: How do I earn three stars?
Aim for a clean, even cut so the two halves land as close to a 50/50 split as possible on the scale. The closer you get, the more stars you earn.
Is there a time limit?
No. There is no timer, so you can study each food and aim carefully before you tap Cut.

moto-obby.intro: Moto Obby is a motorbike obstacle course where you dodge swinging hammers and sharp spikes across several levels. Your reflexes and timing decide how far you get.
tips: Watch each hazard for a moment before you commit, especially swinging hammers, so you can see when the gap opens.
Adjust your speed to the situation. Some sections call for slowing down, and others need you to speed up to win.
If you are not sure what to do in a tricky spot, try a different approach rather than repeating the same move.
When your bike gets stuck, press the left or right arrow (or A or D) to hop free instead of pushing forward harder.
Use the spin controls carefully so your bike stays balanced before you reach the next hazard.
faq: What is the goal of Moto Obby?
You aim to win each level by getting your motorbike past hazards such as swinging hammers and sharp spikes.
How do I move and spin my bike?
Use the up and down arrows (or W and S) to move, and the left and right arrows (or A and D) to spin.

about-a-frog.intro: About a Frog is a puzzle game where you guide a frog past a series of obstacles. Clearing them activates the sail on a small raft so you can keep moving forward.
tips: Look over the whole obstacle before you move, and work out the order you need to pass things in.
Move in short, deliberate steps so you can stop and correct your position before you reach a hazard.
If you get stuck in a bad spot, press R to restart the attempt instead of trying to recover from an unsafe position.
Take a moment to think through each step before committing, since puzzles like this reward planning over quick guessing.
If you use a gamepad, try it for finer control, since it is supported alongside the keyboard and on-screen buttons.
faq: What is the goal of About a Frog?
Your goal is to get the frog past the obstacles so that the sail on the small raft can be activated, letting you advance further.
How do I move the frog?
On desktop, use the arrow keys or W, A, S, and D to move up, left, down, and right. On mobile, use the on-screen buttons.

mine-jump.intro: Mine Jump is an arcade parkour game where you move diagonally across cells, collecting slugs and upgrading your hero as you search for the edge of an alien planet. Each jump takes you further into the mystery.
tips: Plan your next move before you click, since each jump is committed once you make it.
Collect slugs whenever they are within easy reach, because they are the resource you use to pump up your hero.
Use the option to go back after a mistake to recover, but do not rely on it for every error.
Slow down in tricky sections and focus on the cells directly ahead of you rather than rushing through.
Try a few short runs first to learn the rhythm of left and right jumps before aiming for a long distance.
faq: What is the goal of Mine Jump?
The goal is to get as far as you can across the alien planet and uncover its secrets. Collecting slugs and upgrading your hero help you go further.
How do I control my hero?
Click on the left or right side of the screen to move diagonally to the next cell. Each click sends your hero in that direction.

dunjun.intro: Dunjun is a fast action game where you slide across 60 hand-built rooms, racing the clock to recover 12 Relics of Power while dodging traps and enemies.
tips: Since you keep moving until you hit a wall, plan each slide before you commit. Check where you will stop, not just where you are heading.
Pick the stopping points carefully. Walls are your only brakes, so use them to set up your next move instead of sliding into danger.
Keep an eye on the clock as you go. Spending too long on one room can cost you the time you need to reach the next relic.
Watch enemy and trap positions before each move. Their paths are the main threat, so a short pause to read the room can prevent a costly mistake.
Treat each room as a puzzle of routes. Try to find a path that collects what you need while keeping clear of hazards.
faq: What is the goal of Dunjun?
Your goal is to recover the 12 Relics of Power hidden in the cursed dungeon while racing the clock and surviving traps and enemies.
How do I move my character?
On desktop, use WASD or the Arrow Keys. On mobile, swipe in the direction you want to go. Your character will keep moving in a straight line until it hits a wall.

tiny-arena.intro: Tiny Arena is a one-thumb dungeon crawler where you clear monster-filled rooms, choose upgrades at each door, and push as deep as you can. Its controls are simple, but dodging and shooting pull against each other, which takes practice.
tips: Plan each move around the auto-fire. Standing still lets your hero shoot the nearest enemy, so pause briefly when you need damage and keep moving when enemies crowd in.

When a door opens with three upgrades, pick one that fits your current build and stick with it. Carrying a consistent build into later rooms is more useful than grabbing whatever looks strongest each time.
Clear the room before rushing the door. Enemies left alive keep attacking while you move toward the exit.
Spend coins on permanent upgrades in the meta-shop between runs so each attempt starts a little stronger.
In Endless mode, survival is the goal, so play cautiously in early rounds and save your revive for a run you are close to beating.
faq: How do I move and shoot in Tiny Arena?
Hold anywhere on the screen to move with the on-screen joystick. Stop moving and your hero auto-fires at the nearest enemy.
What happens after I clear a room?
The door opens, and you pick one of three upgrades before moving on to the next room.

cars-challenge.intro: Cars Challenge is a car racing game with several modes, including arena fights, obstacle races, and falling-tile challenges. You can race against bots, complete missions, and buy and tune new cars.
tips: In Spinning Wheel, watch the wheel before you commit to a path, since the goal is to reach the finish faster than the other cars without falling into the abyss.
In Hexagons, tiles drop as soon as a car passes over them, so keep moving forward and plan your next jump before you land on a tile.
In Arena, avoid staying in one spot for long. Stay mobile, watch where the other cars are heading, and look for openings to survive.
Use the Spacebar to jump and practice timing your jumps in a safe area before you need them in a harder mode.
Try airplane mode (double Space) in a low-pressure moment to see how it changes your movement, then use it when you need extra control. Press C to switch camera views so you can see what is ahead.
faq: What is the goal of Cars Challenge?

The goal depends on the mode. In Arena you need to survive, in Spinning Wheel and Insane Track you need to reach the finish line faster than the other cars, and in Hexagons you need to stay last on the arena to win.
How do I steer and jump?
Use WASD to move, and press Spacebar to jump. Double tap Space to enter airplane mode.

mr-drifter-car-chase-simulator.intro: Mr. Drifter is a top-down chase game where you race through a low-poly city, dodging police, traffic, and roadblocks. The goal is simple: keep moving and stay free for as long as you can.
tips: Keep your car moving at all times, since the one rule is never to stop. Stopping gives the cops time to close in.
Look ahead for traffic and roadblocks and start steering early, rather than reacting at the last second.
Save Slow-Mo, Freeze, and EMP Blasts for moments when several threats are close together, not for the first sign of trouble.
Grab power-ups when it is safe to do so, but don't swerve into more danger just to reach one.
Use the chaos to your advantage: smashing through obstacles and roadblocks can clear a path when you are boxed in.
faq: What is the goal of Mr. Drifter?
The goal is to survive the chase for as long as possible while police and traffic keep coming. The game asks how long you can stay free.
How do I steer on desktop?
Use WASD or the Arrow Keys to move your car around the city. Steering is the only control needed to dodge threats.

save-the-balloon-road-to-the-stars.intro: Save the Balloon: Road to the Stars is a space-themed game where you keep a floating balloon safe. Move your protector to deflect obstacles, collect stars, and use superpowers to stay in the fight.
tips: Keep your protector positioned under the balloon's path so it can block obstacles before they reach it.
Watch the balloon's movement early and move smoothly rather than making sudden large jumps, which can leave gaps.
Collect stars whenever it is safe to do so, since they give bonuses that can help you keep going.
Save your superpowers for dangerous moments, such as when several obstacles approach at once, instead of using them immediately.
Unlocked skins change only how the balloon and defender look, so focus on staying safe rather than chasing them.
faq: What is the goal of Save the Balloon: Road to the Stars?
Your goal is to keep the balloon floating upward by moving the protector to deflect obstacles and rescue it from traps.
How do I control the protector?
Move the protector with your mouse or your finger. It deflects obstacles that come toward the balloon.

create-youre-obby-skin.intro: Create Your Obby Skin is a clicker game where you recruit Robux, unlock items for the skin editor, and build your own avatar. Spin the wheel to try your luck for codes and skins.
tips: Click steadily to build up your Robux early, since that is the currency you need to recruit and unlock items.
Check the skin editor often so you know which unique items you are working toward before you spend anything.
Use the Wheel Spin when you have a spare moment, and keep track of which rewards you have already collected so you can spot new ones.
Try different looks in the Avatar Creator before settling on a final skin, so you can see how each item changes your character.
Save your Exclusive Codes for the items you want most, and claim them as you go rather than letting them sit unused.
faq: What is the main goal of Create Your Obby Skin?
The goal is to recruit Robux, unlock unique items for the skin editor, and build the avatar you want. Codes and wheel spins help you collect more options.
How do I earn Robux in the game?
You earn Robux through the Robux Clicker by clicking to recruit it. Keep clicking to build up enough to unlock new items.

spaceball-jump.intro: Spaceball Jump is a physics-based arcade game where you guide a glowing astronaut ball from planet to planet. Collect the stars, avoid the hazards, and time your jumps to reach the portal.
tips: Watch the spin of your current planet before every jump, since its rotation direction and speed change where you will land.
Use the planets' spin to slingshot across gaps instead of jumping straight off, especially when the next planet is far away.
Plan your route so you collect all 3 stars in a level, because the escape portal only opens once you have them.
Slow down near spinning spike walls and death stars, and time your jumps so you pass them between their movements.
On the tight precision jumps and moving platforms, make small practice leaps first to learn how far each jump carries you.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Hop between planets, collect the 3 golden stars in the level, and reach the escape portal to warp to the next sector.
How do I jump?
Press the Spacebar or Up Arrow, or left-click anywhere on the screen. On touch screens, tap anywhere to jump.

noodle-pull.intro: Noodle Pull is an arcade cooking game about hand-pulled noodles. You hold to pull the dough and release when the tension marker hits the green zone, then decide whether to serve or risk another pull.
tips: Watch the tension marker closely and release only when it reaches the green zone, since a mistimed release snaps the dough and fails the order.
Serve as soon as you have enough strands to complete a customer's order, especially when the order is close to done.
Use Pull Again only when your current strands are safe enough to risk for a bigger reward, and stop pulling once a mistake would cost you a lot.
You need at least 10 stars in a level to unlock the next one, so focus on completing orders well rather than rushing through them.
Check the menu between levels to buy kitchen upgrades and improve recipes, which can make the pulling and serving easier to manage.
faq: What is the goal of Noodle Pull?
Serve each customer enough noodles to earn stars, and collect at least 10 stars in a level to unlock the next one.
How do I pull the dough?
Hold the left mouse button anywhere in the play area or hold Space, then release when the tension marker reaches the green zone.

radial-3d.intro: Radial 3D puts you in control of a black hole as you explore space. Absorb celestial bodies, avoid dangers, and climb through the cosmos.
tips: Keep your movements smooth and steady, since the black hole follows your mouse and sudden jerks can carry you into danger.
Scan the space ahead before you move so you can spot dangers early and plan a route around them.
Look for celestial bodies that are within easy reach first, and build a route from one to the next rather than chasing distant ones.
Take short breaks from the chase to check where you are relative to hazards, so you do not get caught off guard.
Play a few short runs to learn how the black hole responds to the mouse before pushing for a long run.
faq: What is the goal of Radial 3D?
Your goal is to absorb celestial bodies, avoid dangers, and ascend through the cosmos as far as you can.
How do I control the black hole?
Move the mouse to move the black hole through space.

stellar-shot-gravity-puzzle.intro: Stellar Shot is a space puzzle where your probe curves under gravity from planets, heavy masses, repulsion fields and wormholes. Your goal is to reach the portal in as few shots as possible.
tips: Before you aim, watch how nearby planets and heavy masses pull on the probe so you can predict the curve of your path.
Use the drag length as well as the direction: a small change in power can send the probe past a planet or short of the portal.
Look for a route that uses gravity to bend the path toward the portal, since a straight shot is often not the cleanest option.
Keep repulsion fields in mind as places to avoid, or as a way to push the probe onto a better course.
If a level stalls, try the Hint button or press R to retry, since fewer shots earns more stars.
faq: What is the main goal of each level?
Launch the probe and guide it into the portal using the gravity of nearby bodies. Clearing the level in fewer shots earns more stars.
How do I aim and fire the probe?
Click and drag with the mouse, or drag on a touchscreen, to set direction and power. Release to shoot.

parking-journey-car-puzzle.intro: Park Journey is a parking puzzle where you move every car into the bay matching its color before the timer runs out. You draw each car's route yourself, so planning ahead matters.
tips: Before moving anything, trace the path of the car you need and note which cars block it. Clearing those blockers first usually saves the most time.
Use empty spaces as temporary holding spots. Parking a car in the wrong bay for a moment is often the cleanest way to open a route.
Keep an eye on the timer early instead of waiting until the clock is low. Moves that look fast can cost time if they force you to backtrack.
Try a few moves ahead on paper in your head, and check that each move does not block a car you still need to free.
Save Undo for when a move clearly traps a car. Use Valet when you are stuck on which move comes next, and Extra Time when you are close to finishing but short on seconds.
faq: What is the main goal of each level?
Park every car in the parking bay that matches its color before time runs out. The level is complete only when all cars are parked correctly.
How do I move a car along a specific path?
Select a car, then draw the route you want it to follow. The car will drive along the line you drew. You can also tap an available position to move the car by a shorter route.

samurai-survivor.intro: Samurai Survivor pits a group of samurai warriors against hordes of monsters pouring out of a mysterious portal in ancient Japan. Survive the waves, level up, and upgrade your skills to close the portal.
tips: Keep moving constantly so you don't get boxed in by the crowd. Open space gives you more room to react when new enemies arrive.
Use the arrow keys for precise steps, or drag with the left mouse button for quick changes of direction. Pick whichever feels more controlled for you.
Spend level-up choices on skills that suit your warrior's strengths. Each warrior has unique abilities, so build around what they do well.
Check the edges of the screen regularly to see where enemies are gathering. Moving away from big clusters early can prevent sudden damage.
Play a few short runs to learn the enemy patterns and how fast the waves ramp up. Each run teaches you when to push forward and when to hold back.
faq: What is the goal of Samurai Survivor?
Your goal is to survive against hundreds of enemies while leveling up and upgrading your skills. The story aim is to fight through the monsters and close the portal.
How do I move my samurai?
Use the arrow keys to move up, down, left, or right. You can also hold the left mouse button and drag to move in any direction.

veggie-harvest.intro: Veggie Harvest is an arcade farming clicker where you drag across ripe vegetables to harvest them, then spend earnings on upgrades. Build an idle farm that keeps producing while you play.
tips: Focus on harvesting only ripe vegetables, since dragging over unripe crops wastes your attention. Watch the grid and plan your drag path through the ready ones first.
The game rewards faster harvesting, so practice quick, smooth drags across rows of ripe crops rather than slow, single clicks.
Buy upgrades in the right panel with a plan. Growth speed helps crops ripen sooner, sale price raises what each harvest earns, and planting frequency keeps the grid full.
Check the bottom tabs regularly. Crop upgrades, passive bonuses, and crop properties each affect your farm differently, so spread your spending across them instead of only one.
Let the idle side of the farm work between sessions. Set up growth and planting early so your crops keep ripening while you are away, then return to harvest in bursts.
faq: How do I harvest vegetables?
Hold the left mouse button, or a finger on mobile, and drag across ripe vegetables on the grid. Harvesting faster gives you more bonuses.
What should I buy first in Veggie Harvest?
Start with the upgrades that speed up your progress, such as growth speed or planting frequency, so your grid refills faster. Then add sale price to earn more from each harvest.

the-fill.intro: The Fill is a one-line logic puzzle where you draw a single continuous path through every block. Each puzzle is a step up in challenge as you progress.
tips: Before you draw anything, scan the grid for blocks with only one or two neighbors. Those awkward spots often need to be the start or end of your line.
Plan the route from the hard-to-reach areas first, then work toward the open space, so you don't leave isolated blocks behind.
Remember that you can't go back over a path. Check each move so you don't seal off a section of the grid you still need.
If you've tried a few routes without progress, tap the hint icon to reveal part of the solution, then carry on solving the rest yourself.
Keep sessions short and focused, such as during a commute, and return to a tricky puzzle later with fresh eyes.
faq: What is the goal of The Fill?
The goal is to fill every block in the puzzle using one continuous line. Your line must pass through each block exactly once.
Can I lift my finger or mouse while drawing?
No. You need to draw the line in one go without lifting your finger or mouse, and you cannot backtrack over blocks you have already passed.

driftbound-race-in-the-grip-of-drift.intro: Driftbound is an arcade racer where you swing your car through turns using magnetic hooks on the road. Learn the hook timing, then race in Solo or Rivals mode.
tips: Watch for the glowing magnet before a turn and hold the hook control as you approach it, so the hook connects in time.
Keep holding the hook to swing the car around the corner, and release only when the car is lined up with the road ahead.
Use steering to stay on the track while you swing, since drifting too wide can lead to a crash.
Collect cash while you race, because it can be spent to upgrade your car and unlock new vehicles and control modes.
If you find the controls hard, try the directional steering option in Settings instead of the on-screen wheel, or the reverse, to see which feels more comfortable.
faq: What is the goal of Driftbound?
In Solo mode, you travel as far as possible and try to beat your distance record. In Rivals mode, you overtake the AI drivers and cross the finish line first.
How do I use the magnetic hook?
On desktop, hold Spacebar or the mouse button to activate the hook and release it to let go. On mobile, touch and hold the screen to activate the hook and release your finger to let go.

ninja-dash-cozy-tactic-puzzle.intro: Ninja Dash: Cozy Tactic Puzzle is a stealth and strategy game where you eliminate foes by planning each move carefully. Use your surroundings to make every action count.
tips: Adjust the camera before you act so you can see where foes are and how the area is laid out.
Rotate your ninja to line up your position before pressing the action button, so each move starts from a spot you have chosen.
Think through the sequence of moves before you commit, since careful planning is the core of the game.
Look at the objects around you and consider how they might help you reach or remove a foe.
Zoom out with the mouse wheel when you need a wider view of the scene, and zoom in when you need to check details.
faq: What is the goal of Ninja Dash: Cozy Tactic Puzzle?
The goal is to eliminate foes using careful planning and by making good use of your surroundings.
How do I rotate my ninja on a keyboard and mouse setup?
Hold the right mouse button and move the mouse to rotate your player.

quackventure.intro: Quackventure is an arcade chase where you guide Quack the duck through a magical forest, escaping a giant purple monster while dodging obstacles and collecting treasure.
tips: Keep moving with W, A, S and D so the monster never gets close, since staying still gives it time to catch up.
Try the Spacebar early on to learn what it does, then use it deliberately when you see an obstacle coming.
Look ahead for hidden treasures and power-ups, but don't let grabbing them pull you into danger.
Pay attention to the landscape ahead and plan your route around obstacles rather than reacting at the last second.
Pick up power-ups as you go and use them when the duck's abilities will help most in a tight spot.
faq: What is the goal of Quackventure?
You guide Quack the duck to safety by escaping the giant purple monster chasing it through the magical forest.
How do I control the duck?
Use the WASD keys to move Quack and the Spacebar for its other action, while dodging obstacles along the way.

bucket-brigade.intro: Guide a rescue convoy across a sunny beach to clear away toys and sandcastles before the summer heat melts your plastic vehicles. Work through the beach carefully and keep your vehicles moving.
tips: Switch between the ambulance, crane, and dump truck often with keys 1, 2, and 3 (or X / Square on a gamepad) so you always have the right vehicle for the job in front of you.
Use the crane's claw with care: close it on an item, then lift and move it slowly so you don't drop it on the way to its destination.
Plan your route before you drive so the convoy doesn't waste time backtracking across the beach, since the heat is always a pressure.
Use Q and E (or LB and RB on a gamepad) to rotate the crane cabin and line up the claw before extending the arm, which saves adjustments later.
Keep an eye on the heat as you play, and clear the nearest items first so your vehicles stay on the sand longer.
faq: What is the goal of Bucket Brigade?
You guide a rescue convoy across a sunny beach and clear away the toys and sandcastles left behind. The beach must be cleared before the summer heat melts your plastic vehicles.
How do I control the crane?

Use Q and E to rotate the crane cabin, Mouse Up and Down to move the crane arm, and the left and right mouse buttons to close and open the claw. On a gamepad, use the left stick to move the arm and A / Cross to close the claw.

sky-kingdoms-castle-siege.intro: Sky Kingdoms: Castle Siege is a 3D physics puzzle where you launch magical familiars from a slingshot to topple enemy fortresses above the clouds. Each level asks you to defeat all guards using as few shots as you can.
tips: Use Overview mode to study the fortress before your first shot, then switch to Flight to follow how the towers fall.
Pick your ability for the layout: dash through supports, split into multiple projectiles, unleash chain lightning, or dive into a courtyard.
Hold your ability until the shot is in the right position, since each shot allows only one ability use.
Aim at supports that hold up several parts of the castle, so one hit can set off a chain reaction.
Replay levels you cleared with extra stars in mind, because stars are never spent and fewer shots earn more of them.
faq: How do I launch a familiar?
Drag a familiar back from the slingshot, aim, and release. Adjust your aim before releasing, since you cannot change the shot once it is in flight.
How do I use a familiar's ability?
On mobile, tap during flight. On desktop, click or press Space. Each shot has one ability use, so choose the timing carefully.

sky-blocks-falling.intro: Sky Blocks Falling is an idle Arkanoid-style game where you catch falling blocks to fill platforms and earn money. Upgrades, critical hits, and prestige help your sky-falling machine grow over time.
tips: Check your upgrade options regularly, since speed, platforms, income, and critical hits each affect how quickly you earn.
Add more platforms when your capacity becomes the bottleneck, so caught blocks have room to fill.
Prioritize speed upgrades early if you find you are missing falling blocks, because catching more blocks is the core of progress.
Work toward critical hits for bonus rewards once your basic catching is steady.
Consider prestiging when your progress slows, since it is meant to speed up future progress.
faq: How do I move the bar?
Drag with the left mouse button to move the bar. If you turn off drag mode, you can move the bar simply by moving the mouse.
What do platforms do?
Platforms increase your capacity, which is how many blocks you can fill at once.

voxel-master.intro: Voxel Master combines block-by-block 3D puzzles with a free sandbox for building your own models. Puzzle mode offers hundreds of levels, and sandbox lets you build on grids of different sizes.
tips: Rotate the camera around a model before placing blocks, since parts hidden from one side can be hard to judge.
Zoom in to check colors and positions on small details, then zoom out to confirm the overall shape still matches.
When you get stuck in puzzle mode, use the hints rather than removing many blocks at random.
Build the outer shape first, then fill in the interior, so you can see how each block fits the model.
In sandbox, save your creation at useful stages so you can return to an earlier version if a later change doesn't work out.
faq: What is the goal in Puzzle mode?
You are shown a model and must recreate it block by block. Levels become harder as you progress.
How do I place and remove blocks on PC?
Use the left mouse button to place or remove a block. Drag to rotate the camera and use the scroll wheel to zoom.

ice-slide.intro: Ice Slide is a sliding puzzle where you swipe a block until it covers every empty tile. Each level is a short logic problem that rewards careful planning.
tips: Before you swipe, trace the full path the block will take, since it keeps moving until it hits a wall or obstacle.
Look for tiles that only one slide can reach, and plan those first so you don't block your own route later.
Think about where the block must end up to reach the target tile, and work backward from that spot.
If you get stuck, stop and count the empty tiles in each corner and along the edges, because those are often the hardest to cover.
Try a different order of slides rather than repeating the same moves, as small changes in the sequence can open up a new route.
faq: What is the goal of Ice Slide?
Slide the block so that it covers every empty tile on the board and reaches the target tile to win the level.
How do I move the block?
Swipe in any direction (up, down, left or right). The block then slides in a straight line until it hits a wall or an obstacle.

assemble-factory-puzzle.intro: Assemble Factory Puzzle is a logic game where you arrange assembly machines in the right order to build car parts. Each level brings a new layout that gets harder as you go.
tips: Look at the finished car part before touching anything, and note which features it needs so you know what each machine must contribute.
Work backwards from the final part. Identify the last step first, then figure out which step must come right before it.
Pay close attention to sequence, since the instructions stress placing machines in the correct order. A correct machine in the wrong spot can still block the line.
Spot the machines that appear in several steps and plan where they fit best, so you don't waste a placement on a step that another machine could handle.
Stay calm when a level feels hard. Test one idea at a time, and if a layout clearly fails, change one part of it rather than rebuilding everything.
faq: What is the goal of Assemble Factory Puzzle?
Your goal is to place the assembly machines in the correct sequence so the line produces the perfect car parts for each level.
How do I solve a level?
Study the target part, then work out which machines are needed and in what order. Place them so the assembly line completes the part from start to finish.

catch-it-santa-the-toy-rescuer.intro: Help Santa rescue falling toys by moving a basket to catch them as they roll in from four directions. Miss three toys and the game ends, so keep your basket ready.
tips: Keep your basket near the centre of the play area so you can reach any direction quickly.
Watch all four directions rather than focusing on one, since toys can arrive from any side.
Move the basket as soon as you see a toy heading your way, instead of waiting until it is close.
Keep track of how many toys you have missed, because the game ends after three misses.
Stay calm and steady, since quick, controlled movements usually catch more toys than rushed ones.
faq: How do I move the basket?
Press the key for the position you want: Q, A, E, D, or Q, A, P, L on a computer. On a phone or tablet, tap the arrow buttons.
How does the game end?
The game is over when you miss three toys. Catching toys before they fall keeps you in the game.

cake-ready.intro: Cake Ready is a relaxed merge puzzle where you combine matching ingredients and kitchen tools to fill customer orders and rebuild a cake cafe. Each merge moves you closer to new recipes and story chapters.
tips: Before merging, look at what the open customer orders need and aim your merges toward those items first.
Tap producers when you have space on the board so you always have raw items ready to combine.
Keep the board tidy by merging identical items as soon as you can, since a cluttered board makes it harder to find matches.
Watch your energy and pace your actions so you do not run out in the middle of a busy stretch of orders.
Spend earned rewards on the renovations that help your cafe most, and check the shop and menu buttons regularly for new unlocks.
faq: What is the main goal of Cake Ready?
Your goal is to merge matching ingredients and kitchen tools, complete customer orders, and use your rewards to renovate the cafe. Completing tasks unlocks new recipes, areas, and story chapters.
How do I merge items?
Drag one item onto an identical item. On desktop, click and drag with the mouse; on touch devices, tap and drag.

roll-king.intro: Roll King is an arcade game where you steer a sticky ball through colorful worlds, picking up smaller objects to grow. Hit each size goal before the timer runs out to clear the stage.
tips: Start each stage by heading toward the smaller objects nearby, since everything you touch sticks and adds to your size. Save bigger targets for later, when your ball can carry them.
Keep an eye on the size goal and the timer together. If the goal is close, a short detour to grab a few more objects may be worth it.
Save power-ups for the moments you get stuck, such as when the path is blocked or the remaining objects are too large to pick up yet.
Pick up stars when they are on your route, but don't let them pull you away from reaching the level goal in time.
If the clock hits zero, you can watch a short ad to continue, so the stage is not lost right away. Don't rely on this, though, and try to plan your rolling so you finish with time to spare.
faq: How do I grow my ball?
Bump into objects that are smaller than your ball and they will stick to it, making you bigger. Larger objects can only be picked up once your ball is big enough.
What happens if the timer runs out?
You must reach the level goal before time runs out. If the clock hits zero, you can watch a short ad to continue.

pop-it-master.intro: Pop It Master is a relaxing clicking game where you pop bumps to open toys. Collect all 150 Pop It and Simple Dimple toys to unlock a secret mode.
tips: Work across each toy in a steady pattern, such as row by row, so you don't miss any bumps and waste time going back.
Play in short sessions when you want to unwind, since the game is designed as a simple stress reliever.
If you're aiming for the full set, track which shapes and colors you have already collected so you can focus on the rest.
If you want to compete on the number of bumps pressed, keep a steady clicking rhythm rather than rushing and making mistakes.
Aim to collect a few toys each session instead of trying to finish all 150 at once, which keeps the game relaxing.
faq: What is the goal of Pop It Master?
The goal is to click all the bumps on a toy to open the next one, and to collect all 150 Pop It and Simple Dimple toys.
How do I unlock Secret Mode?
You unlock Secret Mode by collecting all 150 toys in the game.

my-clearn-robot.intro: My Clean Robot is a side-scrolling action game where you guide a brave robot through an apartment, fighting off nasty viruses. Each level brings new challenges and upgrades to help you progress.
tips: Get comfortable with turning using A and D before you fight, since facing an enemy quickly matters in a side-scrolling fight.
Try both the hand attack and the leg attack in early levels so you learn which one works better against different viruses.
Keep moving rather than standing still, so you can keep an eye on incoming viruses from both sides of the screen.
Pay attention to the upgrades you earn and test them in a safe moment to see how they change your attacks and movement.
When a level gets harder, slow down and reposition your robot before attacking instead of rushing in.
faq: What is the goal of My Clean Robot?
You control a robot fighting off viruses in an apartment as you move through the levels. The game is about pushing forward while defeating the viruses you meet.
How do I control the robot on a keyboard?
Use W, A, S and D to move and turn. Press J for a hand attack and K for a leg attack.

only-jump-rpg.intro: Only Jump RPG is a fast-paced action runner where every jump doubles as your attack. You move along one road, dodge spikes, chasms, ghosts and enemy attacks, and grow stronger by unlocking heroes and upgrading skills.
tips: Treat each jump as both movement and attack, so time your jumps to land on enemies rather than jumping at random.
Watch the patterns ahead of you: spikes, chasms, and ghosts usually come with tight timing, so slow down your decisions when a hazard appears.
Check your skill buttons regularly, since cooldowns and energy depend on your hero and perks. Use a skill when it is ready instead of waiting until you are in trouble.
Spend coins on the skill upgrades that match how you like to play, because perks are unique to each hero and a focused build is easier to improve.
Complete quests when you can, since they help you unlock new heroes and collect the items and coins you need for upgrades.
faq: What is the goal of Only Jump RPG?
You run along a single road, jumping over or striking hazards and enemies while you dodge traps. Each run is short, and your progress carries over through upgrades and new heroes.
What controls do I use?
On PC, use A and D or the left and right arrow keys to move, and the jump also attacks. You can also use the on-screen left and right buttons, and tap the on-screen skill buttons to use skills.

catoom-bomb-barrel.intro: Catoom! - Bomb Barrel is a physics game where you roll a barrel and use bomb explosions to build speed. Timing and placement decide how far you get.
tips: Aim your bombs at spots close to the barrel, since the game says explosions near it are what speed it up.
After each explosion, keep rolling the barrel yourself so the momentum you gained does not fade.
Use explosions to break through destructible tiles when a path is blocked, rather than only using them for speed.
Watch enemies before throwing: their positions can make a bomb better used on them, or on the ground beside your barrel for a boost.
On PC, practise steering with WASD between throws so that moving and bombing feel like one routine.
faq: How do I throw a bomb?
Tap and release the screen at the spot where you want the bomb to land. On touchscreens you can also drag the area to reveal a joystick for movement.
How do I speed up the barrel?
Explode bombs near your barrel so the blast pushes it forward. Then roll the barrel yourself to keep that speed going.

neon-snake.intro: Neon Snake is a fast arcade game where you steer a glowing snake across a dark grid, eating orbs to grow and build your score. Chaining quick eats raises your combo multiplier.
tips: Plan your route a few cells ahead instead of reacting to each orb, since one wrong move ends the run.
Keep eating quickly to protect your combo multiplier, but avoid rushing into tight corners where your snake can trap itself.
Save speed boosts for moments when you have plenty of open grid space, because the extra speed makes mistakes more costly.
Use slow orbs to recover control when the board gets crowded, rather than waiting until you are almost boxed in.
Go for the rare bonus stars when your route is already safe, and treat them as a bonus rather than a reason to take a risky turn.
faq: What is the goal of Neon Snake?
Eat orbs to grow your snake and rack up points, while avoiding any move that ends the run. Your score rises faster when you keep your combo going.
How does the combo multiplier work?
Chaining quick eats builds your combo multiplier, which can reach up to x8. Missing a quick eat is a good time to slow down and rebuild your route.

zip-zap.intro: Zip Zap is a one-touch physics puzzle where you guide mechanical beings through intricate levels using taps and releases. Each level is cleared by touching the white circles or reaching the target zones.
tips: Tap in short bursts rather than holding for long, so you can control how much each hinge contracts.
Watch how your structure tips before you release, since gravity will carry the parts in the direction they are already leaning.
Build momentum gradually by timing your releases with the swing of the structure instead of firing them at random.
Plan the route to the white circles first, then work out which hinges you need to contract to reach them in order.
If a level stalls, reset your thinking and test one small movement at a time to learn how each part reacts to gravity.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You need to touch all the white circles or reach the targeted zones to complete the level and move on.
What controls does Zip Zap use?
You tap to contract the hinges in your mechanical structure, and release to activate movement.

fake-ninjas.intro: Fake Ninjas is a ninja skill game where you hunt down impostors in town to restore your master's honour. You move by clicking the ground, and your goal is to reach every fake ninja.
tips: Scan the whole town before you start moving so you can plan a route that covers the fake ninjas in one trip.
Pick a nearby target first and work outward, which keeps your path short and avoids backtracking.
Watch where the fake ninjas are positioned relative to you, since the goal is to reach each one rather than fight them in a set order.
Click the ground in short, deliberate moves instead of long jumps so you can adjust quickly if a fake ninja shifts position.
On a touch device, tap with a steady rhythm and check the screen after each move to confirm where you are heading.
faq: What is the goal of Fake Ninjas?
Your goal is to find the fake ninjas in town and move to each of them to eliminate them. Doing so proves yourself to your master.
How do I move my character?
Click on the ground to move. On touch devices, tap the screen to move.

parkour-run-3d-runner.intro: Parkour Run is a fast 3D runner where you race to the finish line by chaining wall-runs, slides, jumps and ledge grabs. Time is what counts, so smooth routing matters more than stopping to think.
tips: Keep moving straight forward whenever the path allows, since the description says maximum speed comes from moving straight ahead.
Use wall-runs to keep your momentum up instead of slowing down between platforms; hold toward the wall and jump off it to continue.
Watch the level layout a moment ahead of you and plan your line before you reach a laser or trap, so your reactions are a choice rather than a panic.
Slide under obstacles and steer while sliding to stay on course without losing speed.
Use the Level 1 tutorial to learn each mechanic, then replay levels to shave time and aim for the 3-star rating.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Reach the finish line as fast as possible while overcoming the obstacles along the way.
How do I keep my speed up?
Move straight forward when you can, and use wall-runs and jumps to carry momentum rather than stopping between sections.

onigiri-demons-wrath.intro: Onigiri - Demons Wrath is a samurai tower defense campaign where you lead a clan through hostile territory. Build barracks, send warriors into battle, and use spells when enemy waves break through.
tips: Spend Honor between battles on upgrades that strengthen your wall, since a wall that holds gives you more room to react when waves push forward.
Build and upgrade barracks early so you can field more squads before the tougher encounters arrive.
Mix your units, using Hatamoto, Yumi archers, cavalry, and other warriors together rather than relying on one type.
Save your spells for moments when enemy waves break through your defenses, because they are most useful when the line is under real pressure.
Pick your path on the campaign map with the next boss fight in mind, and make sure your permanent upgrades are ready before you commit to hard encounters.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Your aim is to lead your clan through the campaign map by winning battles, pushing deeper into enemy territory, and defeating boss fights along the way.
How do I control my army?
Use the mouse or touch controls to select map nodes, build and upgrade barracks, manage squads, cast spells during battle, and click buttons to buy upgrades and start encounters.

clown-fiesta.intro: Clown Fiesta is a shooter where you fight mobs, bosses, and other players, collect weapons, and upgrade your character. This guide covers the desktop keyboard and mouse controls.
tips: Use Space to dash out of danger. Dashing toward your aim while standing still is a quick way to reposition during a fight.
Match your attack to the weapon. Right mouse throws Baseball Bat and Meteor Maul, and pokes with Sword and Tempest Glaive, while gun weapons only fire with the left button.
Keep F for emergencies. A grenade can be thrown and then detonated early by pressing F again while it is still in flight.
Spend stat and skill points as you earn them. The U and I menus only open while you have unspent points, so check them after each level-up or pickup.
Switch slots with 1 and 2 or the mouse wheel so your melee and ranged weapons are ready for the situation. Walk over orbs to collect them and stay mobile between fights.
faq: How do I aim and shoot?
Move the mouse to aim the weapon at the cursor. Left mouse button attacks with your current weapon, and holding it keeps firing at the weapon's fire rate.
What do the spell keys do?
Once you have learned the skill, Q casts Repel, E casts Shield, R casts Haste, and C casts Fire Breath.

hi-fi-snake-groove-driven-arcade-challen.intro: Hi-Fi Snake puts you in control of a robot on a disco dance floor. Collect glowing pellets to open the exit door while staying ahead of the lava that chases you through each room.
tips: Check the number on the door before you start moving, so you know exactly how many pellets you need to collect.
Keep your trail in mind as it grows. Plan turns in open space so you don't box yourself in and leave no safe path to the door.
Pick up pellets in a route that also moves you toward the exit, so you aren't forced to backtrack when the lava gets close.
Keep an eye on the lava's position and make decisions early. Waiting too long to change direction leaves you with fewer options.
Watch the moving obstacles and enemy robots for a few seconds and learn their patterns before committing to a path through them.
faq: What is the main goal in each room?
Collect the number of glowing pellets shown on the exit door to unlock it, then reach the door before the lava catches your robot.
How do I keep the lava from catching up?
Don't stand still. Move efficiently between pellets and head for the door as soon as you have enough, since the lava keeps advancing.

brick-breaker-chipi-chipi-chapa-chapa-ca.intro: Brick Breaker Chipi Chipi Chapa Chapa Cat is a meme-themed brick breaker. Use the bottom paddle to keep the balls in play and clear every green block in each level.
tips: Aim your returns toward the spots where green blocks are thickest, since clearing a cluster opens up paths to the rest of the level.
Watch the balls closely and move the bottom paddle early, so you can catch a ball before it drops out of reach.
Grab falling bonuses when it is safe to do so, because they add balls and can give you an extra life.
Once you have more balls in play, use them to hit several blocks at once and speed up the level.
Try to beat your own best score on harder levels to build skill, and replay easier levels to practice your angles.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Destroy all the green blocks by hitting the balls into them. The level is complete once every green block is gone.
How do I control the paddle?
You control the paddle at the bottom of the screen to bounce the balls back up toward the blocks. Keep it positioned under the incoming ball to avoid losing it.

smash-and-merge-balls.intro: Smash & Merge Balls is an arcade game about starting chain reactions. You move a character, strike colorful balls, and score points when balls of the same color collide and merge.
tips: Hit balls so they travel toward other balls of the same color, since matching collisions are what earn points.
Use the dash with Space to reposition quickly so you can reach a ball before it drifts away from the group.
Watch the colors on the arena floor and plan your hits so that a new ball from a merge is likely to meet a matching color.
Aim for a chain of merges rather than single collisions, because each new ball created can keep the reaction going.
Keep your movement steady with WASD or the joystick instead of rushing, so you stay in position to strike the next ball.
faq: How do I score points in Smash & Merge Balls?
You earn points when two balls of the same color collide and merge. Longer chains of merges give you more points toward your high score.
What happens when two balls merge?
The merge creates another ball of a random color, which can then collide with other balls and continue the chain.

2048-knights.intro: Slide knights across the board, merge matching numbers, and reach the Goal in as few moves as you can. Each stage rewards fewer moves with more stars, so planning ahead matters.
tips: Before each swipe, check which tiles will merge and which will get stuck. Choosing a direction that combines matching numbers early keeps the board open.
Try to beat the par for each stage, since fewer moves earn more stars. Count your moves as you go and notice when a move did not help.
Keep your highest-value knights near one edge or corner so they stay together and can keep merging. Scattering them makes later merges harder.
Use Undo when a move leaves the board in a bad state, rather than restarting the whole stage. Reset is better when you have already lost the plan.
Save the Hint for a stage that stalls after you have tried a few different approaches. Watching the solution once can show you a pattern to use later.
faq: What is the goal of 2048 Knights?
Slide tiles in one direction at a time and merge matching numbers until you reach the Goal number shown at the top of the stage. Doing it in fewer moves earns more stars.
How do I earn all 3 stars on a stage?
Finish the stage in the par number of moves or fewer. Every extra move above the par costs you a star.

build-and-run.intro: Build And Run is a 3D arcade game about racing through levels, building missing parts of the course, and fighting foes with weapons. This guide covers the controls and some habits that help you progress.
tips: Look at the level before you move and find the missing parts first, so you know whether you need a platform, a ramp, or a slope.
Use Q for a platform, W for a ramp, and E for a slope, and try each one early to see how they behave in the level.
Keep an eye on your route ahead, since building the right piece at the right moment keeps your race moving.
Press R to use your weapons when foes are in your path, and switch your attention between building and fighting so neither slows you down.
On mobile, get comfortable with the on-screen buttons before a level gets busy, so your builds and weapon use are quick under pressure.
faq: What is the goal of Build And Run?
You race through levels by building the missing parts of the course and defeating foes with weapons along the way.
Which keys do I use to build?
On PC or desktop, press Q to build a platform, W to build a ramp, and E to build a slope. On mobile, use the on-screen buttons.

yeti-run.intro: Yeti Run is an endless skiing game where you steer down a mountain with one finger, weaving between gates to build a combo while avoiding obstacles and a chasing yeti. Your goal is to get past your best-distance flag.
tips: Make small, steady steering movements instead of big swipes, since overcorrecting is a common way to clip a tree or miss the next gate.
Look ahead to the next paired gates before you reach them so you can line up early and keep your combo going.
Treat the combo as the thing to protect: one missed gate resets it, so it can be worth slowing your line a little to make a clean pass.
Keep an eye on the yeti's position and stay ahead of him, because being caught costs you your combo even though it does not end the run.
Use snowmen you collect to unlock skins, and check the missions for bonus snowmen to help you build up currency faster.
faq: What is the main goal in Yeti Run?
The main goal is to ski past the flag marking your best distance from your last run and plant it further down the mountain. Since the run is endless, distance is what you are chasing each time.
What happens if I miss a gate?
Missing a gate resets your combo, but it does not end your run. Hitting a tree, rock, or lift pylon is what ends the run.

open-to-offers.intro: Open to Offers! is a flipping game where you buy mystery boxes, list the finds for sale, and haggle with buyers of many different personalities. Your job is to pick the right prices and deals.
tips: Price items near the market value when you want fast sales, and go above it only when you can handle a haggling buyer. Higher prices pay more but take longer to close.
Don't accept the first counteroffer by reflex. Try declining once, since the instructions say a refusal can make a buyer raise the offer.
Learn the buyer types, such as the stingy ones and the ones in a hurry, and adjust your price and patience to match each person.
Work toward finishing collections early, because they give price bonuses that make every later sale on those items more profitable.
Treat any buyer who sends a payment link as a scammer. Block them right away to earn the vigilance bonus.
faq: What is the main goal of Open to Offers!?
You earn revenue by opening boxes, selling items and haggling with buyers. You then reinvest that money in upgrades and collections.
What should I do if I run short of money?
Tap the laptop on the home screen to start a side hustle that brings in cash. Daily bonuses can also help.

traffic-puzzle-game-linky.intro: Traffic Puzzle Game Linky is a logic puzzle set in a forest meadow. You connect pairs of numbered construction blocks with road segments, aiming to link every city and clear the board before time runs out.
tips: Count each pair's number before drawing anything, since every connection must use exactly that many road segments.
Start with the blocks that have the fewest possible routes, because they limit your options and leave less room for mistakes elsewhere.
Plan your roads on paper or in your head first, then draw them, so you don't have to undo large sections later.
Use the undo feature to test a route you're unsure about instead of restarting the level.
Keep an eye on the timer and pause to rethink your layout if you've been stuck, since a clear plan saves more time than rushing.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Connect every pair of numbered blocks with the exact number of road segments shown, linking all cities and clearing the board within the time limit.
How do I earn stars and trophies?
You earn stars and trophies by completing levels, and the game tracks your progress as the puzzles get harder.

arrow-parking.intro: Arrow Parking is a relaxing puzzle where you place arrow tiles to build a route for the car to reach the garage. Each level gets harder as you go.
tips: Look at where the car starts and where the garage is before placing anything, so you can plan the full path first.
Work backwards from the garage: think about which tile must point into it, then which tile leads to that one.
Check every arrow's direction after you drop it, since one wrong turn can send the car off the route.
Try a route in your head before committing tiles, especially in later puzzles where the path has more turns.
If you get stuck, move a tile back to the side of the board and rebuild the route one step at a time.
faq: What is the goal of Arrow Parking?
Place arrow tiles on the board so the car follows a route all the way to the garage.
How do I place an arrow tile?
Drag and drop each arrow tile onto the board with your mouse, or with touch on a touchscreen.

noobik-arena-99-nights.intro: Noobik Arena - 99 nights is a 3D survival arena where you fight waves of monsters, collect coins and experience, and build defenses between waves. This guide covers controls and habits that help you last longer.
tips: Keep moving during fights. Use WASD or the arrow keys to stay out of enemy paths while you aim and shoot with the mouse.
Save dashes for emergencies. Space or Shift can get you out of a bad spot, but using it constantly leaves you without an escape when a wave closes in.
Use the building phase to plan. Place turrets and fences where enemies approach, and check a building's stats after placing it so you know which ones to upgrade first.
Spend upgrades on what you use most. Pick shop cards that match your main weapon and playstyle instead of spreading points across everything.
Use grenades on crowds. Throw them with G when several enemies are bunched together, and switch weapons with Q when a different weapon suits the next threat better.
faq: How do I shoot and aim?
Move the mouse to aim and press the left mouse button to shoot. On mobile, use the on-screen shooting button instead.
When can I build defenses?
Building happens between waves. Choose a turret, fence, or barracks, then click the arena to place it.

panellka-build-a-tower.intro: Panellka is an arcade stacking game where you release swinging floors from a crane to build a tower. Each miss shifts the balance, so careful timing and small corrections keep the tower standing.
tips: Release the floor a little before it is directly above the tower, because it keeps the cable's momentum and will keep moving after you let go.
Watch the tilt after every floor. If the tower leans one way, aim the next floors shifted the other way to bring it back toward centre.
Pay attention to how far a floor hangs past the edge. Once it passes halfway over the edge it falls and costs you a life, so it is often better to stop a bad drop early than to gamble on it.
Choose ability cards with your current build in mind, since you pick one of three each time you reach a new level.
Spend the gold from each build in the Workshop on permanent upgrades, and use the special sections like concrete, magnets and counterweights as you unlock them to help with balance.
faq: How do I release a floor?
Tap the screen, or press Space or Enter, to release the floor from the crane. Timing decides where it lands.
What makes the tower collapse?
The tower collapses if it tilts too far. Placing the next floors shifted the opposite way helps straighten it again.

hook-king-runner.intro: Hook King Runner is a physics-based runner where you swing on ropes and hooks through wild obstacle courses. Timing your release and keeping your momentum are the main skills to build.
tips: Watch the swing arc before you release. Letting go at the lowest point usually sends you forward with the most speed.
Tap and hold to launch the hook, then keep the swing going rather than rushing to release. Small, steady swings often give you more control than big ones.
Scan the course ahead for traps and enemies so you can plan your next hook point before you reach the danger.
Grab coins when they sit on your natural path. Going out of your way for them can cost momentum you need for the next jump.
Play each level a few times. Learning where the rope points and jump gaps are makes timing easier on later attempts.
faq: What is the main goal in Hook King Runner?
Use your hook and momentum to get through each obstacle course and reach the finish line while avoiding traps and enemies.
How do I move through a level?
Tap and hold to launch your hook and swing forward, then release at the right moment to jump from the rope and continue.

spore-guard.intro: Spore Guard is a survival defense game where you protect a living spore core from waves of animated microbes. The core fires on its own, so your taps decide which enemies get focused and when.
tips: Tap the enemy types that are most dangerous to the core first, such as fast or acid enemies, rather than whichever is closest.
Collect glowing biomass whenever it appears, since it feeds your mutation and upgrade progress.
Save the defensive burst for a crowded wave or a boss rather than spending it early, when the meter is ready.
Read each mutation choice with the enemies coming next in mind, especially if you keep facing shield or tank enemies.
Between runs, put your permanent upgrades toward the weaknesses you noticed in your last run to get further next time.
faq: What is the main goal of Spore Guard?
Survive as many waves as you can while protecting the spore core, aiming for the highest score.
Does the spore core shoot on its own?
Yes. The core fires automatically, and your job is to tap priority targets to direct its shots.

merge-rush-attack.intro: Merge Rush Attack is a tap-and-merge runner where you build a crowd, fuse units into stronger tiers, and break the boss wall at the end of each run. Plan your merges and tapping pace to keep your squad strong enough to win.
tips: Before you reach the wall, check your squad's power against the wall's HP, since you need equal or higher power to win the level.
Tap steadily instead of frantically, because you can spawn units on demand but tapping too fast fills the heat bar from level 5 onward.
Spend coins between runs on power upgrades and merge unlocks, so each run starts with a stronger crowd.
If a run fails, use the retry option to adjust your approach, and consider the optional ad boost when you are only a little short of the wall's HP.
Keep an eye on the Merge button and merge matching units as soon as three are available, so your squad steadily moves up to stronger tiers.
faq: What is the goal of each run?
You need to build a squad whose power is equal to or higher than the wall's HP at the end of the run. Beating the wall wins the level and earns coins.
How do I control the squad?

Tap or left click the screen to spawn more units, and use the Merge button to combine three matching units into a stronger tier. The squad runs forward automatically, so there is no keyboard movement.

eco-block-puzzle.intro: Eco Block Puzzle is a classic block puzzle where you fill the grid to clear space and help restore a valley after an ecological disaster. Clearing puzzles earns eco coins, which you can use to expand the cleaned land and bring in animals and lifeforms.
tips: Keep the board as flat as you can, since stacking blocks high in one spot leaves you with fewer places to fit the next piece.
Look at the shape you are holding before you place it and check which gaps it can actually fill.
Clear full rows and columns whenever you can, because each clear is what moves the cleanup forward.
Save your eco coins for the purchases that matter most to you, such as expanding cleaned land, rather than spending them as soon as you earn them.
If the board starts to feel crowded, focus on opening up one area at a time instead of trying to clear everything at once.
faq: What is the goal of Eco Block Puzzle?
The goal is to solve block puzzles to clean up the environment after an ecological catastrophe. As you clean, you can expand the restored land and add animals and lifeforms.
How do I earn eco coins?
You earn eco coins by solving puzzles. Use them to expand cleaned land and purchase animals and lifeforms.

mouse-survivor.intro: Mouse Survivor is an endless 2D running game where you guide a brave mouse through changing tiles, dodge snakes and explosive obstacles, and collect cheese to unlock new tile types.
tips: Watch the tiles ahead of you, especially ones with lower alpha, since a single touch on those can be dangerous.
Use short, timed jumps to clear snakes and obstacles rather than jumping early and staying in the air too long.
Grab the cheese you pass along the route, since every piece raises your cheese count for later upgrades.
Save up cheese for new tile types once you have a few spare, because each tile has its own features and challenges.
Stay near the middle of the screen when possible so you have room to react to snakes that appear suddenly.
faq: What is the goal of Mouse Survivor?
The game is endless, so the goal is to keep your mouse running as long as possible while dodging snakes and obstacles and collecting cheese.
What are the keyboard controls?
Use W, Arrow Up, or Spacebar to jump, A or Arrow Left to move left, and D or Arrow Right to move right.

container-auction.intro: Container Auction is an arcade auction game where you bid on mysterious containers against rivals. You inspect what is inside, decide how far to bid, and aim to sell what you win for profit.
tips: Peek through the door gap on each container before you commit, so you know roughly what you are bidding on.
Compare all three containers before choosing one to auction, since you can only take one into the auction.
Decide your maximum bid before you start negotiating with the bots, and pass once bidding goes past it.
Pay attention to rarity, from common up to legendary, when judging whether an item is worth keeping or selling.
After you open a container, check which items could be restored, because restored pieces may be worth more when you sell them.
faq: What is the main goal of Container Auction?
