You win auctions for containers, open them to find items, and sell those items for profit.
Does the level I choose affect my results?
Yes, the description says higher-level locations have more valuable containers, so you may want to choose the level carefully.

live-round.intro: Live Round is an eight-player arcade game where you deflect incoming meteors away from your city and toward your opponents. Last player standing wins, and you stay in the fight even after your city falls.
tips: Move your deflector toward incoming meteors early instead of waiting until the last second, so you have time to make a clean deflection.
Watch your ammo in modes where you can shoot. Save missiles for meteors that are heading straight for your city rather than firing at every one.
Choose upgrades between rounds that match how you like to play, since each one changes your approach for the rest of the game.
Once your city is wiped out, use your sabotage on players who are still alive. Think about where a sabotage will cause the most trouble before you deploy it.
As the arena gets more chaotic, focus on the meteors that threaten you most and let the others pass by, rather than trying to stop everything.
faq: What is the goal of Live Round?
Protect your own city by sending meteors toward your opponents, and be the last player standing.
How do I control my paddle?
Move your mouse to move the paddle. In modes that allow it, click to shoot missiles, but keep an eye on your ammo.

supermarket-manager.intro: Supermarket Manager is a management game where you build your store from the ground up. You stock shelves, serve customers, and reinvest your earnings into staff, better products, and bigger shelves.
tips: Stock your first shelves yourself, since that is how you start earning. Load products from the warehouse before you carry them over, so you are not making extra trips.
Spend your earnings on the next shelf or cash register once you can afford it, then keep the new shelves filled so they keep producing income.
Use the computer in the warehouse area to check the management menu regularly. It is where you improve product quality and hire staff.
Hire stockers when restocking becomes the slowest part of your day, and hire cashiers when customers start waiting. Staff take over tasks so you can focus on expanding.
Upgrade product quality before buying more expensive shelves, because better quality raises your store's prestige. A wider range of goods then gives you more to sell per customer.
faq: How do I move my character?
On PC, use the left mouse button or the WASD keys. On a smartphone, hold your finger on the screen and drag it in the direction you want to go.
How do I buy a new shelf or cash register?
Stand on the marked area on the game field that corresponds to the shelf or cash register you want. You need to have enough earnings saved up first.

happy-coloring-book.intro: Happy Coloring Book is a relaxed coloring game where you pick a drawing and fill it in with virtual crayons. Try different colors and techniques to make your own artwork.
tips: Start with a light base color across large areas before adding darker shades, so your details stand out more.
Pick a small palette of three or four colors that work well together, then use one or two accent colors for highlights.
Work on one section at a time and finish it fully before moving on, which keeps the drawing looking tidy.
Try a few different strokes or techniques on a scrap area first to see how the crayons behave before committing to your main drawing.
Save your creation when you are happy with it, so you can come back to it or share it with friends.
faq: What is the goal of Happy Coloring Book?
The goal is to pick a drawing from the coloring book and color it in however you like. There is no set winning condition.
How do I color a picture?
Select a drawing, choose a virtual crayon, and color in the areas of the picture. You can experiment with different colors and techniques as you go.

speedmatch-competition.intro: SpeedMatch Competition is a fast-paced arcade tile-matching puzzle. You stop tiles by clicking or tapping, then match and clear them before your opponents do.
tips: Watch the whole board before you act, so you can plan a match instead of stopping tiles at random.
Decide early whether you are playing for speed or accuracy, and keep that choice in mind as the pace picks up.
Aim for matches you can finish cleanly. A wrong match can cost more time than a slightly slower correct one.
Keep your eyes moving across the board so you notice new matches forming while you work on another one.
Pay attention to your opponents' progress, and push harder when you see them getting close to clearing their tiles.
faq: What is the main goal of SpeedMatch Competition?
Your goal is to match and clear all the tiles before your opponents do. You can focus on speed, accuracy, or a mix of both.
How do I stop the tiles?
Click or tap on the screen to stop tiles. Once they are stopped, you can match them.

hex-mine-2d.intro: Hex Mine 2D is a relaxed logic puzzle played on a hexagonal grid. You mark each orange cell as blue or black by using the numbered clues, with no time limit and no guessing needed.
tips: Start with cells next to a 0 or a 6 clue, since those give certain answers: a 0 means every neighbor is black, and a 6 means every neighbor is blue.
Compare clues that share neighboring cells. If two overlapping clues differ by exactly the number of cells that only one of them touches, you can often fix those cells.
Work out the possibilities for each clue on paper or in your head before marking anything, so you only commit to a cell when every option agrees.
Use the undo option (U or Ctrl + Z) freely to test a deduction, since clicking the same cell again also removes its mark.
Read the special clue symbols carefully, because they change what counts as a valid pattern, such as consecutive, separated, or directional blue cells.
faq: How do I win a level?
You win when every orange hexagon has been marked as either blue or black. Each mark must agree with all of the numbered clues.
What do the numbers in the dark cells mean?
A number shows how many of the adjacent cells are blue. For example, a 3 means exactly three neighboring cells are blue.

lanternward.intro: Lanternward is a logic puzzle where you place lanterns so every street is lit, without any lantern shining on another. Each puzzle has one solution that you can reach by reasoning alone.
tips: Start with numbered roofs where the count of neighbouring lanterns is already full or leaves no room, since those cells are the easiest to settle.
Use dots to record streets that cannot hold a lantern. Marking them keeps your reasoning clear as the board fills up.
Before placing a lantern, check its whole row and column for other lanterns, because a lantern that would shine on another is never allowed.
Look for a dark street that can only be lit from one possible position. Placing that lantern early often unlocks several others.
Four stars depend on your time against each level's target, and there is no countdown, so take time to deduce rather than guess. Save hints for when you are truly stuck, since each one costs a star.
faq: What is the goal of Lanternward?
Light every street on the board. A lantern lights its row and column until a rooftop blocks it, and no lantern may shine on another.
What do the numbered roofs mean?
A number on a roof tells you how many lanterns must stand beside it. Use these clues to narrow down where lanterns can go.

square-sort.intro: Square Sort is a colour puzzle where you swipe cubes across the board to line up matching colours and clear them. Each level limits your moves, so every swipe counts.
tips: Before you swipe, look for a colour you can line up in a row or column with the fewest moves, then build from there.
Because each level has a set number of moves, avoid swipes that only shift a cube without bringing it closer to a match.
Plan two or three swipes ahead, since moving one cube can block or free the path for another.
Keep an eye on the colours that are hardest to group, and move them early while the board is still open.
When a new level adds more colours or a larger grid, slow down and scan the whole board before your first swipe.
faq: What is the goal of Square Sort?
The goal is to sort the coloured cubes by aligning cubes of the same colour in a row or column so they clear from the board.
How do I move the cubes?
Swipe a cube in any direction to move it across the board.

blocky-set-3d-brick-constructions.intro: Blocky Set is a 3D brick-building puzzle where you are shown a finished model and must rebuild it by placing each piece in the right spot. It rewards careful looking and patient placement.
tips: Study the complete model from several angles before you move anything, using the camera controls to check hidden sides and depth.
Look for the largest or most distinctive pieces first, since they often anchor the structure and make the remaining placements easier.
Press R to rotate a piece before dropping it, and check its orientation against the model so it fits the correct location.
Build the model layer by layer from the bottom up, so each new piece has a solid base beneath it.
Move the camera often with A, W, S and D to confirm that each piece lines up properly from the side, not only from the top view.
faq: How do I move a piece?
Click and hold a block with the mouse, drag it to the position you want, then release it to drop it in place.
How do I rotate a block?
Select the block and press R to rotate it, then check that its orientation matches the model before placing it.

draw-and-save.intro: Draw & Save is a one-shot drawing game where you trace a boat's route across the water and then watch it play out. Your route cannot be changed once you let go, so planning matters more than speed.
tips: Plan for where the sharks will be when your boat gets there, since they keep moving while you draw. Aim for the gap they are about to leave, not the one they are in now.
Keep your route a little away from rocks and shark loops rather than hugging them, because one touch ends the run.
Check the timing bars before you release. All clocks start together, so a bar that is still low means that swimmer will go first, and you should look at the order they reach the water.
Remember that every swimmer must be rescued. Leaving even one behind fails the level, so plan a route that gets everyone out.
Take your time drawing the route in your head before you touch the screen, because there are no brakes, steering, or takebacks once you release.
faq: What is the goal of Draw & Save?
Your goal is to draw a route for your boat that rescues every swimmer on the beach. The level fails if you leave even one swimmer behind.
What happens if my boat touches a rock or shark?
Touching either one ends the run right away, and the count is reset to zero. Rocks stay still, but sharks keep moving in loops, so their path changes over time.

shape-ascent-roguelite.intro: Shape Ascent is a merge puzzle on a 5×5 grid where you combine matching shapes to climb toward the Ascent Crown. Each run mixes swipe planning with power card choices.
tips: Before every swipe, check which identical shapes will collide, and choose the direction that brings the most matching pairs together.
Keep open space in the corners and along one edge so new tiles have room to land and you don't get stuck with a full board.
Save your Undo charges for real mistakes, such as a swipe that blocks an important merge, rather than using them on routine moves.
When offered Power Cards, favor abilities that match your current board, like Spawn Block when the grid is crowded or Emergency Save when you're close to filling it.
Use the Remove Tile tool only once the board is tight and a single stray piece is blocking merges, since it's unlocked at Triple Star.
faq: What is the main goal in Shape Ascent?
Merge identical shapes to create higher tiers, working up to the Ascent Crown (8128). The game ends when the board fills with no possible merges.
How do I move the tiles?
On desktop, use the arrow keys or W, A, S, D to move all tiles in a direction. On mobile, swipe in the four directions.

bullseye-idle.intro: Bullseye Idle is an idle shooting gallery. You tap targets to shoot them, while your guns keep firing on their own as you build up the firing line.
tips: Spend your coins on new guns as soon as you can afford them, since your firing line does the work even when you are not tapping.
Keep tapping during busy stretches to fill the FEVER meter, because double damage is worth timing around.
Try to mix in a variety of gun types, such as SMGs, assault rifles, snipers, and rockets, so your firing line covers different kinds of damage.
Push deeper when your current setup clears targets easily, since tougher targets and bosses reward a stronger line.
Save your attention for timed trials, which are the way to earn permanent trophy upgrades that carry over.
faq: What is the main goal of Bullseye Idle?
The goal is to build up a firing line of guns that eventually all fire at once. You do this by shooting targets and spending coins on more guns and more power.
How do I shoot targets?
Tap or click a target to shoot it. Press M if you want to mute the game.

magic-kingdom-hex-match.intro: Magic Kingdom: Hex Match is a management game where you gather six types of resource hexes to build a magical kingdom. Collect enough of each resource to unlock every building.
tips: Click a scaffold to see how many more of each resource you still need before you can build it. This helps you choose which resource to focus on next.
Keep an eye out for the hammer icon above a building. It means you have enough resources, so click it before collecting more.
When you place a hex stack, let the top tiles overlap so they flow over each other. This is how you can group matching hexes together.
Aim to build up a stack of 10 or more hexes of the same type, since that is what turns into a collected resource.
Check the counter at the top of the game screen to see how many hexes you still need to finish the level, and plan your moves around it.
faq: How do I build a new building?
Wait until a hammer icon appears above the building, then click it. The icon only shows once you have collected enough resources for that building.
How many hexes do I need to collect a resource?
You need a stack of 10 or more hexes of the same type. When that happens, the stack disappears and you collect that resource.

minimight-fantasy-rpg.intro: MiniMight is a casual fantasy RPG where you lead a small team of adventurers through monster-filled floors. Hire fighters, upgrade gear, and push deeper into the dungeon by defeating bosses.
tips: Spend gold on upgrades for your current party before hiring new fighters, so the team you already have stays useful.
Pick a mix of warriors, archers, and mages so your party can handle different enemy types.
Check your equipment after every fight and upgrade whatever is holding back your weakest hero.
Learn new skills as they become available and use them during tough battles rather than only basic attacks.
Before fighting a boss, make sure your whole party is healthy and well equipped, since bosses unlock the next floors.
faq: What is the main goal of MiniMight?
Your goal is to lead your party through dangerous floors, defeat bosses, and unlock deeper levels of the adventure.
How do I attack enemies during battle?
Select a character, then choose an attack or skill to use against an enemy.

match-story-weapons.intro: Match Story: Weapons is a 3-match puzzle game with a timer. Find three identical weapons on the board, place them in the box, and clear the matches before time runs out.
tips: Scan the whole board before you pick anything. Note which weapon types appear most often so you can plan which sets to finish first.
Pick weapons that are easy to reach first. Clearing the open ones can reveal the pieces underneath and open up more options.
Keep an eye on the box as you fill it. Avoid placing a single weapon of a type that you cannot match soon, since it can block your next moves.
Watch the timer, but do not rush every move. Quick, accurate matches usually save more time than hasty picks that leave you stuck.
Expect new weapon types and busier layouts in later levels. Practice spotting identical weapons quickly, since this is the skill the harder stages test most.
faq: What is the goal of Match Story: Weapons?
Your goal is to match three identical weapons from the board in each level. Clear all the matches before the timer runs out to finish the level.
How do I make a match?
Select weapons from the board and place them into the box. When three identical weapons are together, they match and disappear.

game-mania.intro: Game Mania is a hand-drawn ballpoint arcade run through one long night. You play a string of very short micro-games, lose hearts when you fail, and try to last until morning.
tips: Read the on-screen instruction at the start of every micro-game, since each one uses its own action and the rules change quickly.
Work out the control type first: mashing, timed taps or clicks, and slice-and-pull-and-release games each need a different approach.
Because each round lasts only a few seconds, stay calm and reset your attention after every result instead of carrying frustration into the next game.
Protect your three hearts by spending them carefully; one early mistake costs as much as a late one, so do not rush through games you are unsure about.
Save your focus for the boss, where the hearts matter most, and treat it as a longer test of the same skills you practised in the micro-games.
faq: What is the goal of Game Mania?
You try to survive the night of micro-games and the boss on three hearts until the morning sun rises.
How do I control the mini-games?
You use the mouse or touch controls, and each mini-game explains its own action on screen, such as mashing, timed clicks or taps, or slicing and pulling and releasing.

greenpeak.intro: GreenPEAK is a calm online parkour climb up a lush green mountain. Explore paths, streams, caves and forest hideaways, collect memes, and make your way to the peak with friends.
tips: Watch your stamina bar while sprinting. If you keep running without a break, it will run out, so ease off or stop for a moment to recover it before a long jump sequence.
Save your progress often by standing inside the torch-lit checkpoints. After a fall you respawn at the last checkpoint you reached, so passing one before a hard section keeps setbacks short.
Slow down and look around the scenery. Streams, caves and forest areas often hold the meme collectibles, so scanning each area as you go helps you find them.
Plan your jumps before you commit. Pause on a ledge, check where you will land, and then move, since the game rewards careful movement more than speed.
Play online with friends at your own pace. Walking together and sharing routes makes it easier to spot paths and enjoy the climb without rushing.
faq: What is the main goal of GreenPEAK?
Climb to the top of the green mountain, explore the world, and collect all the meme collections you can find along the way.
How do I save my progress?
Stand inside a checkpoint, which is an area surrounded by torches. After falling or dying, you respawn at that checkpoint.

cartoon-traffic-racing-paper-derby.intro: Paper Derby is a traffic racer set on oversized stationery and cardboard roads. Weave between rival cars, use ramps and obstacles, and fight for first place in every race.
tips: Use A and D early to pick a clear lane before traffic bunches up, since sudden steering near busy cars is where most crashes happen.
Save F nitro for a straight stretch where you can keep your speed up, rather than spending it while you are still turning.
Look for ramps and obstacles on the track and plan your route so you can use them to get ahead of opponents.
Tap B to look behind you when a rival is close, so you know whether it is safe to overtake or better to hold back.
Try C to switch camera views and choose the one that gives you the clearest view of upcoming traffic on each map.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Each race is a battle for first place, so your aim is to finish ahead of the other cars on the road.
What do the main controls do?
W or Up accelerates, S or Down brakes, A and D or the arrow keys steer, Space is the handbrake, and F activates nitro.

paws-and-pals-diner.intro: Paws and Pals Diner is a cozy management game where you run a diner full of animal staff and customers. You serve food, unlock new dishes, decorate, and take breaks to fish by the lake.
tips: Hire staff early so the diner can keep up with customers as more animals arrive.
Pay attention to each customer's quirks and preferences, since serving what they like keeps them coming back.
Unlock new dishes as you go and rotate your menu so you always have something new to offer.
Spend some of your earnings on themes and decorations to make the diner feel cozy and attract more visitors.
Check the achievements list now and then, since rewards for serving food and catching fish can guide what to focus on next.
faq: How do I play Paws and Pals Diner?
Use your mouse or tap the screen to interact with buttons and items in the diner. Serve customers, manage your staff, and head to the lake when you want a break.
What is the goal of the game?
The goal is to run a successful diner by keeping customers happy, unlocking new foods and animal patrons, and building a cozy space. Achievements track your progress along the way.

ball-path-through-obstacles.intro: Ball: Path Through Obstacles is an arcade course where you roll a ball past traps and collect coins. Coins can be spent on new skins for your ball.
tips: Use short, controlled taps or nudges on the movement keys or joystick near tricky sections instead of holding a direction, so you can stop before a trap.
Look ahead before you move. Spotting gaps and traps early gives you time to adjust your line rather than reacting at the last second.
Time your jumps with the space bar on PC or the lower right jump button on touch devices, and land with some room to spare before the next obstacle.
Collect coins when they are safe to reach, but do not risk a fall for them. Progress through the course matters more than any single coin.
Check the improvements on the left side of the screen and the store in the menu once you have some coins, so you know what you are working toward.
faq: How do I move the ball on a computer?
Use W to move forward, S to move backward, A to turn left and D to turn right. Press the space bar to jump.
How do I control the ball on a touch screen?
Use the virtual joystick in the lower left part of the screen to move, and tap the jump button in the lower right part to jump.

colors-and-forms.intro: Colors&Forms is a browser puzzle game where you move pieces along tracks to match falling elements. Each level has missions to complete, and you can pick a game mode by speed.
tips: Before you start, pick a speed mode you can keep up with. A slower mode gives you more time to line up each piece before the next element lands.
Keep your eyes on the falling elements rather than the pieces. Moving early toward the track they will land on saves time.
Check the mission at the start of each level so you know what you are working toward. Some levels may require different actions, so a quick look helps you plan.
Watch the whole screen for objects you can click. Ignoring them can cost you progress, so scan for them between matches.
If the game feels too fast or too busy, try switching game types with the castle button or adjust sound and language in settings. Changing these can make the screen easier to follow.
faq: What is the main goal of Colors&Forms?
Move the pieces at the bottom of the tracks to match the falling elements and complete the missions on each level. Progress through the levels to reach new challenges.
How do I choose how fast the game is?
Before you start a game, select the game mode that matches the speed you want. The mode you choose sets how quickly the elements fall.

merge-mushroom.intro: Merge Mushroom is a puzzle game where you drop mushrooms onto matching ones to create new kinds. Your aim is to collect as many different mushrooms as you can.
tips: Before each drop, look at the board and find which mushrooms are alike, so you can combine them without leaving gaps.
Drop mushrooms where you want them rather than in a rush, because the placement of each one affects what you can merge next.
Keep some open space on the board so you still have room to make new combinations as the board fills up.
Try to plan a few moves ahead, since merging the right pair early can open up better chains later.
Check which mushrooms you have not collected yet and aim your merges toward them, since collecting all possible mushrooms is the main goal.
faq: How do I play Merge Mushroom?
Drag your finger or mouse cursor to choose where a mushroom drops, then throw it onto a matching mushroom to create a new one.
What is the goal of the game?
The goal is to collect all possible mushrooms by merging them into new types.

crash-control.intro: Crash Control puts you in charge of traffic at busy intersections and train crossings. Tap cars to stop or start them and keep everything moving without collisions.
tips: Tap a car to stop it early if you see another vehicle heading into its path, rather than waiting until the last second.
Watch the train crossings closely, since trains cannot stop, so plan your car movements around when a train will pass.
Look at the whole intersection before tapping anything, and identify which cars are about to enter the same space.
Start cars again only once the path ahead is clear, so you do not create a new crash right after stopping one.
Expect harder traffic scenarios as you complete levels, so stay calm and practice spotting patterns early in each level.
faq: What is the goal of Crash Control?
The goal is to manage traffic flow at intersections and train crossings so that no crashes happen. Keeping cars safe as traffic grows more complex is the main challenge.
How do the controls work?
The game uses one-tap controls. Tap a car to stop it, and tap it again to start it moving.

night-racing-drag.intro: Night Racing - Drag is an arcade drag racer where you shift gears at the right moments, dodge traffic and rivals, and collect coins to upgrade your car. Winning places earns more coins for your garage.
tips: Focus on a clean start, since a good launch helps you take an early lead in each race.
Shift gears at the right moments rather than holding one gear, so your car keeps accelerating smoothly.
Watch the road ahead for traffic and rivals, and adjust your line early so you are not forced into a costly slowdown.
Grab coins when it is safe to do so, but do not swerve into danger for a small reward.
Spend coins on upgrades that match how you race, and remember that finishing higher earns you more coins to spend.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Win races by getting off to a strong start, accelerating with timely gear changes, and finishing in first place.
How do I earn coins?
Collect coins on the track during a race, and earn more by winning places in races.

magic-potion-school-for-witch.intro: Magic Potion School for Witch is a puzzle game where you aim a magic wand and launch bouncing balls at numbered bubbles and shapes in a cauldron. Clear the enchantments before time runs out to brew each potion.
tips: Before you fire, check which numbered bubbles and shapes are easiest to reach, and aim for those first to clear the board faster.
Watch how your ball bounces off the walls and the bubbles so you can plan shots that hit several targets in one go.
Keep an eye on the timer and avoid spending too long on a single aim, since the level ends when time runs out.
Take a moment to look at the whole cauldron before each shot, because clearing the top or edge targets can open paths to the rest.
Expect later levels to be harder, so use the early ones to get comfortable with aiming and the bounce angles.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You need to clear all the enchantments in the cauldron before time runs out to brew the potion successfully.
How do I aim and shoot?
On desktop, move the mouse to aim the wand and click to cast a spell and launch the magic ball. On touch screens, drag to aim and tap to cast.

blade-hit.intro: Blade Hit is a mouse-controlled knife-throwing game. Throw knives at logs to break them, collect coins, and unlock new knives as you aim for higher records.
tips: Throw one knife at a time and check where the previous knives are stuck before you release the next one. The goal is to avoid hitting them.
Pay attention to the gaps in the log and the space left between your knives so you can judge where the next throw should land.
Keep your clicks or taps steady and deliberate. Rushing throws makes it easier to hit an earlier knife.
Collect coins when you can, since they are needed to unlock new knives in the collection.
Try different knives as you unlock them to see which ones suit your throwing style best.
faq: What is the goal of Blade Hit?
Throw all of your knives at the logs without hitting the knives you have already thrown. Breaking logs and collecting coins are also part of the game.
How do I throw a knife?
Left-click the mouse or tap the screen to throw a knife.

cube-crushers.intro: Cube Crushers is a colour-matching sorting puzzle. You tap cake slices off the grid, and each cube crusher only eats slices of its own colour, so the order of your taps matters.
tips: Before tapping, check which cake slices are uncovered and which ones are hidden under others, since removing a slice can reveal a hidden crusher.
Look at the colours of the crushers you have already unlocked and plan your taps so the matching slices reach the conveyor in a useful order.
Avoid tapping slices at random. Each tap changes what is possible next, so take a moment to compare a few options first.
Watch for a colour that appears many times on the grid; clearing those slices early can open up space for the rest of the puzzle.
As levels get harder, slow down and think a few moves ahead rather than trying to finish in a rush.
faq: What is the goal of Cube Crushers?
Clear all the cake slices from the grid to complete each level.
How do I play each turn?
Tap a cake slice on the grid and it moves to the conveyor. Your taps decide which crushers come into play.

shikaku-puzzle.intro: Shikaku is a logic puzzle where you split a grid into rectangles and squares. Each piece must hold exactly one number, and that number must equal the piece's area.
tips: Start with the largest numbers, since they have the most possible rectangle shapes and can narrow down the layout around them.
Look for numbers that are prime, such as 5 or 7. Their only possible rectangles are 1 by n or n by 1, so the shape is nearly forced.
Count the empty cells around each number before drawing. A rectangle can only grow into cells that no other number claims.
Pay attention to cells that sit between two numbers. They must belong to one rectangle or the other, so eliminate options that would leave a gap.
Draw rectangles one at a time and check that each one contains exactly one number before moving on. Undoing a wrong shape early is easier than fixing several at once.
faq: What is the goal of Shikaku?
Divide the whole grid into rectangles and squares so that each piece contains exactly one number. The size of each piece must match its number.
How do I make a rectangle?
Click and drag across the grid to draw a rectangle over the cells you want. Each rectangle should cover one number and no others.

pop-sweet-fruits.intro: Pop Sweet Fruits is a fruit-popping shooter where you start with two fruits, pop more to unlock new ones, and upgrade your shots. It is played in seven languages, with quick reflexes at the heart of the action.
tips: Pop fruits steadily early on, since popping them is how you unlock new ones and build your strength.
Decide which upgrade to buy first: bullet speed, fire rate, or earnings. Each one helps in a different way, so pick the one that fits how you are struggling.
Spend your earnings on upgrades as soon as you can afford them, because stronger shots make later fruits much easier to pop.
Stay focused on each fruit as it appears. Quick reflexes matter more here than rushing through the screen.
Check the language options in the menu if the instructions are hard to follow, so you do not miss any game details.
faq: What is the main goal of Pop Sweet Fruits?
The goal is to pop fruits, unlock new ones, and boost your power so you can collect them all. Upgrading your bullet speed, fire rate, and earnings helps you do this.
How do I earn more money in the game?
Earnings can be increased through upgrades, so putting some of your early earnings into that upgrade can help you gather more over time.

roll-rush.intro: Roll Rush is a fast 3D runner where you steer a rolling ball along a track full of platforms, gaps, and traps. Collect coins, unlock new ball skins, and see how far you can roll.
tips: Steer small and early. Make gentle left and right movements well before an obstacle reaches the ball rather than sharp corrections at the last moment.
Watch the gaps ahead, not just the ball. Spotting a gap early gives you time to line up so you stay on the platforms.
Keep your momentum steady. Avoid overcorrecting after each dodge, since drifting off the line can put you right into the next trap.
Grab coins when it is safe to do so. Only move toward a coin if the path is clear, because a risky detour can cost you the run.
Expect the pace to rise as you go further. Stay calm and focused in the later stretches, when the course is at its fastest and most demanding.
faq: What is the main goal in Roll Rush?
Your goal is to stay on the course, avoid obstacles, and survive for as long as possible. The further you roll, the higher your score.
How do I steer the ball?
On mobile, drag left or right to steer. On desktop, move the mouse left or right to control the ball.

tanknarok.intro: TANKNAROK is a top-down multiplayer arena shooter where you drive a tank, aim its turret, and fire at rivals in fast, competitive battles. Steering and aiming are split between the keyboard and mouse.
tips: Keep your tank moving with WASD instead of standing still, since staying in one place makes you an easy target.
Use the mouse to aim the turret while your tank drives, so you can track an opponent without changing your route.
Press R in the lobby to ready up. If the game doesn't start in host mode, try shared mode as the instructions suggest.
Watch for destroyed surroundings and use the cover they leave behind or create to protect your tank.
Press Esc to pause and check the menu when you need a moment to reset, especially if you switch tabs and the game pauses on its own.
faq: How do I move my tank?
Use W, A, S and D to steer and move your tank forward, backward, left and right.
How do I aim and shoot?
Move the mouse to aim your turret, which turns a full 360 degrees around the tank. Press the left mouse button to fire your current weapon.

miner-jam.intro: Miner Jam is a puzzle game where you click or tap to match colored pickaxes with the ores that share their color. Clear boxes and mine your way through the levels.
tips: Before you tap, check which pickaxe color matches each ore so you pick the right one the first time.
Look at the whole board before acting, and find the matches that open up the most space first.
Keep your taps deliberate rather than rapid, since a wrong match can make the next move harder to plan.
Pay attention to which boxes are blocking others, and clear the ones that unlock the most progress.
If a level stalls, step back and scan the colors again, because a fresh look often reveals the match you missed.
faq: What is the goal of Miner Jam?
The goal is to match each colored pickaxe with the ores of the same color, mine them, and break boxes to advance through the levels.
How do I play Miner Jam?
Click or tap a pickaxe to match it with the ore of the same color and mine it. Keep matching colors to clear the board.

mini-chess-3d.intro: Mini Chess 3D is a set of short chess puzzles in 3D. Each board asks you to capture target pieces or deliver checkmate within a limited number of moves.
tips: Before you move, check how many moves the puzzle allows and plan a full line to the goal instead of reacting one move at a time.
Select each piece and look at its highlighted legal moves first, so you know exactly what it can reach before committing.
Scan the enemy pieces for threats and captures they can make, since predicting their reply is a key part of these puzzles.
Look for checks that force the enemy king into a narrow position, because forcing moves often shorten the solution.
Use Undo to test a line you are unsure about, and save Hint for a position where you are truly stuck after trying your own ideas.
faq: What is the goal of each puzzle?
You win a puzzle by capturing the target pieces or delivering checkmate within the allowed number of moves. The move limit is what makes each board a challenge.
How do I move a piece?
Click or tap a piece to select it and reveal its legal moves. Then click or tap a highlighted square or enemy piece to move or capture.

flag-merging-game-puzzle-game.intro: Flag Merging Game is a puzzle where new flags drop from above and you must match identical pairs to clear target flags before the clock runs out. Across 75 levels, it tests your planning and quick reactions.
tips: Before each drop, check which flags you already have that match. Pairing them quickly keeps your options open for the next flags that fall.
Focus on merges that help you reach the required flag goals, not just any merge. Clearing flags you don't need can waste space and time.
Watch the timer closely in the early moves of a level. If you are running low on time, look for the fastest merges available.
Save your coins for the upgrades that matter most to you. Choose between more coins per merge to grow your savings or extra starting time if you find levels tight.
Keep an eye on the achievements as you play. Some may come from habits you naturally form, so note what you do when you unlock one.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You need to complete the required flag goals before time runs out. Once you meet them, you advance to the next level.
How do I merge flags?
Drag and drop flags anywhere with your finger, then merge two identical flags to clear them and earn coins.

vikings-an-archer-s-journey.intro: Vikings: An Archer's Journey is an endless runner and shoot 'em up where you play as Nott, a Valkyrie archer, on a quest through the Underworld to rescue her wolf, Oder.
tips: Learn the simple controls in the first few runs so you can focus on the monsters and obstacles instead of your inputs.
Keep an eye out for power-ups and grab them when it is safe, since they can help you in the tougher parts of the run.
Watch the enemies coming from ahead and time your shots so you take out threats before they reach Nott.
Pay attention to when your Viking allies can help you, and use them to deal with monsters that are hard to handle alone.
Because the game is an endless runner, stay alert and keep moving forward rather than stopping to fight every monster you see.
faq: What is the goal of Vikings: An Archer's Journey?
Your goal is to guide Nott through the Underworld and rescue her wolf, Oder, by defeating monsters from Nordic legends along the way.
What kind of game is this?
It mixes a shoot 'em up with an infinite runner, so you move forward continuously while shooting at enemies and collecting power-ups.

worms.intro: Worms is a relaxing tile puzzle where you guide colorful worms across small boards. Collect every dot and reach the goal to finish each short level.
tips: Look at the whole board before your first move, noting where the dots and the goal are so you can plan a route.
Think a few moves ahead, since puzzles get trickier at each stage and a wrong move can leave you boxed in.
Collect the dots along the way rather than leaving them for last, so you don't have to backtrack across the board.
Try a level a second time if you get stuck; a different order of moves often reveals a clear path.
Play in short sessions, as the levels are bite-sized and easy to pick up again after a break.
faq: What is the goal of Worms?
Move the worms across the tile board, collect all the dots, and reach the goal to complete each level.
How do I move the worms?
Use the arrow keys on your keyboard or swipe on the screen to move them across the tiles.

bus-jam-pick-up-them-all.intro: Bus Jam is a traffic puzzle where you clear a crowded parking lot so your bus can leave. Colorful buses pick up passengers of matching colors, so you need to plan which bus gets out first.
tips: Look at the whole parking lot before moving anything, and find which vehicles are blocking your bus's exit path.
Move the blocking vehicles that are easiest to shift first, so you do not create new jams behind them.
Check which passenger colors are waiting before you send a bus out, since each bus only picks up matching passengers.
Tap or click a bus only when it is ready to leave, because selecting it sends it to the slot to pick up passengers.
If you get stuck, step back and look for a different vehicle to move rather than repeating the same move.
faq: What is the goal of Bus Jam?
The goal is to help the bus escape the parking jam by moving the other vehicles out of the way. You also need to help every bus pick up all its passengers.
How do I control the buses?
On desktop, click a bus to select it and send it to the slot for passengers. On mobile, tap the bus to do the same thing.

draw-the-snake.intro: Draw The Snake is a grid-based puzzle where you guide a snake along a path to collect apples and clear the board. Each level adds tricky routes and ice blocks that need careful planning.
tips: Look at the whole board before your first move and trace a full route to the last apple in your head.
Plan your path so the snake does not trap itself, since getting stuck is the main way a level goes wrong.
Break ice blocks and clear obstacles early when it opens a clear route, rather than leaving them for later.
If you reach a dead end, consider restarting the level and trying a different route instead of forcing the current one.
Take a moment to study new layouts; the puzzles reward slow, deliberate thinking more than quick moves.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Guide the snake along the correct path, collect the apples, and complete the level objective without getting stuck.
What makes levels harder as you progress?
Later levels add trickier paths, ice blocks, and more clever puzzle layouts that require more planning.

hex-mine-3d.intro: Hex Mine 3D is a relaxing logic puzzle played on a spherical board of hex tiles. You rotate the globe, study the layout, and clear the correct tiles to finish each level.
tips: Rotate the globe slowly and check the back side before you make a move, since patterns wrap around the sphere.
Study the whole layout first and look for tiles that clearly belong together before clearing anything.
Think one or two moves ahead, because a single wrong clear can make the rest of the level harder to finish.
Take breaks between levels when a pattern feels confusing; a fresh look often reveals the next step.
Use short play sessions to build pattern recognition, since later levels use larger patterns and trickier tile placement.
faq: What is the goal of Hex Mine 3D?
Clear the correct hex tiles on the globe to complete each level. The aim is to finish the puzzle without mistakes.
How do I rotate the board?
Rotate the hex globe to view its tiles from different angles, then choose your moves once you have studied the layout.

donut-art-puzzle-diamond-game.intro: Donut Art is a color sorting puzzle where you move donuts between stacks to group each color together. As the stacks get organized, a hidden pixel picture gradually appears.
tips: Look at the whole shelf before your first move, and find which stacks hold the most of each color so you know where they should end up.
Keep one stack mostly empty when you can. Free space gives you room to move pieces around when a color is buried under others.
Before moving a piece, check what sits underneath it in its stack, since clearing a stack often means digging out the pieces below.
Try to finish one color at a time instead of spreading a few donuts of every color across many stacks, which can block your options later.
On harder levels, plan a few moves ahead and avoid placing a donut on top of the color you will need next.
faq: How do I move a donut in Donut Art?
Tap a stack to select it, then tap another stack to move the matching pieces onto it.
What is the goal of each level?
Sort all the colors into separate stacks, and the artwork will be revealed once the puzzle is complete.

criss-cross-colors.intro: Criss Cross Colors is a color-matching puzzle where you drag blocks from the bottom palette into a grid. Every row and column must end up with matching colors to clear the level.
tips: Before dragging anything, check which rows and columns already have colors placed and work out what each empty square needs.
Test each block against both its row and its column, since a placement that fits one direction can clash with the other.
Levels are timed, so scan the whole grid first and fill the squares you are most sure about before tackling the harder ones.
Save hints for squares you cannot work out after checking the rows and columns around them.
Keep your drags smooth and release only over the empty square you intend to fill, so each block lands where you planned.
faq: How do I win a level?
You win by filling the entire grid so that every row and every column has matching colors.
How do I place a block?
Click or tap a colored block in the bottom palette, drag it onto an empty square, and release to place it.

cards-in-fool.intro: Cards in Fool is a turn-based online card game with 36 cards and a trump suit chosen at the start. Players take turns attacking and defending, aiming to empty their hand first.
tips: Check the trump card at the start of the match, since its suit beats every other suit. Remember which suit it is for the whole round.
Save your trump cards when you can. A trump can beat a card that a normal card cannot, so use it when you really need the win.
Attack with low, less useful cards first. This makes your opponent spend their cards to defend, and it keeps your stronger cards for later.
Keep an eye on how many cards are left in the deck and in each player's hand. Knowing this helps you judge who is close to finishing.
Watch the leaderboard after each match to see how your points compare with other players, and try to play steadily rather than risking everything on one turn.
faq: How do I win a match?
You win by getting rid of all your cards once the deck is empty. The player who still has cards at the end is the one who does not win.
Who goes first?
The player with the smaller trump card goes first. This is part of the classic rules of the game.

skyfall-siege.intro: Skyfall Siege is a fast action tower defense game where you defend your base from waves of enemies falling from the sky. Move, shoot, and build defenses to hold your ground.
tips: Keep moving rather than standing still, since enemies descend in relentless waves and staying in one spot leaves you exposed.
Spend your money on defensive facilities early, so your turrets are in place before the waves get harder.
Check the upgrade screen with TAB on desktop or the Build button on mobile whenever you have money, and prioritize upgrades to structures that are already working well.
Use short, precise bursts of fire when enemies are in line, rather than wasting shots on targets that are about to be handled by your turrets.
On mobile, rely on auto-fire so you can focus your attention on positioning your character left and right.
faq: What is the goal of Skyfall Siege?
You defend your base by defeating enemies falling from the sky and protecting it from the waves. Your turrets and defensive structures help you survive as long as possible.
How do I move and fire?
On desktop, use the Left and Right Arrow keys to move and the Spacebar to fire. On mobile, tap left or right of the character to move, and use the fire button, which auto-fires.

cargo-path-puzzle.intro: Cargo Path Puzzle is a logic-driven platformer where you collect every key, then reach the exit portal. Each level has a single correct solution, so careful planning matters more than speed.
tips: Before your first move, study the whole level and trace a full path from start to the portal, including every key. Because each level has only one correct solution, planning ahead saves a lot of restarts.
Watch out for collapsing blocks: they can leave you stranded, so check whether you can still reach the keys and exit after stepping on one.
Think about how trampolines and ice slides carry you past tiles, and plan where you will land before you commit to the move.
Use the jump carefully. It sends you in the last direction you moved and skips over one tile, so make sure the direction you face is the one you want.
Pay attention to directional blocks, since they can redirect your movement. Test a single step in a safe spot if you are unsure how one behaves.
faq: What is the goal of Cargo Path Puzzle?
Collect all the keys in the level to unlock the exit portal, then step onto the portal to finish it.
Which keys do I use to move?
Use the arrow keys or WASD to move up, down, left, and right. Press Spacebar to jump.

wednesday-s-battle-monster-symphony.intro: Wednesday's Battle: Monster Symphony is an endless action game where you switch lines to aim your shots at monsters. Each defeat is quick to retry, so you can keep playing for one more round.
tips: Watch which enemy types are coming and decide early which line you need to be on, rather than reacting at the last second.
Difficulty rises gradually, so use the first rounds to learn how quickly you can switch lines and where your shots land.
Make small, steady line changes instead of rapid switching, which can leave you out of position when a new enemy appears.
After each defeat, think about what caught you off guard, then restart right away while that lesson is fresh.
On mobile, keep your thumbs near the left and right sides of the screen so you can switch lines without delay.
faq: What is the goal of Wednesday's Battle: Monster Symphony?
The game is endless, so the aim is to survive as long as you can by hitting enemies and avoiding defeat. Each round ends when you are defeated, and you can try again straight away.
How do I change the direction of my shots?
On a keyboard, use the arrow keys to switch lines. On mobile, tap the right or left side of the screen to switch.

mochi-rescue.intro: Mochi Rescue is a physics puzzle where you draw one line that turns into a real object. Pick the right ink, release the line, and guide Mochi, the rock, or the strawberry to safety.
tips: Match the ink to the danger. Wood floats and burns, stone sinks and survives lava, and jelly springs things back up, so think about what each obstacle does before you draw.
Look at where the falling rocks or cannonballs will land first, then decide whether a shield, a bounce or a bridge is needed.
Aim for the fewest ink you can. Because less ink earns more stars, try one clean line before adding extra strokes.
If your line goes wrong, press R to restart right away instead of working around a bad layout.
Use the hint only after you have studied the scene for a while, so you still get to figure out the logic yourself.
faq: What is the goal of each puzzle?
You win by protecting Mochi until the timer ends, getting Mochi home, or delivering the strawberry to a hungry friend, depending on the level.
How does scoring work?
Stars are earned by using less ink, so a single well-placed line gives you the best result.

build-the-bridge.intro: Build the Bridge is a physics puzzle where you control both sides of a bridge to guide an explorer across gaps. Each level asks for careful timing and a stable path to the finish flag.
tips: Move the two sides of the bridge in small steps and watch how the path changes before you commit to a longer extension.
Plan the whole crossing before you start: work out where the bridge needs to meet and which side should extend first.
Use the left and right controls together, since the explorer only needs one stable path, not two separate halves.
Pay attention to timing, because the explorer moves across the bridge and a sudden change can cause a fall.
If a level goes wrong, use the level restart and try a different approach rather than repeating the same moves.
faq: What is the goal of Build the Bridge?
Your goal is to guide the explorer safely across each gap by adjusting both sides of the bridge and reaching the finish flag.
Which keys control the bridge?
Press A to extend the left side and S to retract it, and press L to extend the right side and K to retract it.

the-last-company.intro: The Last Company is a 3D fantasy strategy RPG about recruiting heroes, building a party, and keeping your company alive as long as possible. Battles play out automatically, so your preparation decides most outcomes.
tips: Before each battle, check your party and decide who goes where on the 3x3 grid, since you cannot move heroes once combat starts.
Gold is scarce, so spend it carefully and think about whether an upgrade or purchase will actually help your next fight.
Choose your next battle with care. Taking on a harder fight before your heroes are ready can end your run quickly.
Use the pause and speed buttons during battle to watch closely when you want to understand what is happening, then speed up when the outcome is clear.
Remember that fallen heroes are gone for good, so protect the ones you have built up rather than treating them as replaceable.
faq: What is the main goal of The Last Company?
The goal is to see how long your company can survive as enemies grow more dangerous. Each decision you make in the village and before battle affects how far you get.
How do I place my heroes for battle?
Drag hero portraits onto the 3x3 grid, or click a portrait and then click a square. Your positioning is the main way you influence combat.

garden-pals-idle.intro: Garden Pals IDLE is a cozy clicker where you grow kawaii plants that earn coins, even while you are away. Tap, merge, and expand your garden at your own pace.
tips: Merge identical plants by dragging two of them together, since a merged plant is stronger and boosts your income.
Start seeds in the Greenhouse before you step away, because they grow on a timer and then appear in your garden.
Spend coins in the Shop on permanent income upgrades early, so every tap and idle minute earns more over time.
Try to collect every plant in a garden, since a full collection gives you a permanent Artifact bonus.
Plan your prestige: earning Fame Stars unlocks new themed gardens with fresh plants, which is a good way to keep the collection growing.
faq: Do my plants earn coins when I'm not playing?
Yes. Your plants keep earning while you are offline, and you get a reward when you come back.
How do I make my plants earn more?
Drag two identical plants together to merge them into a stronger one, and buy income upgrades in the Shop.

cooking-letters-word-search.intro: Cooking Letters is a word search puzzle set in a kitchen. You connect letters on the board to find every word on the list, and faster completions earn more points.
tips: Scan the word list first and pick the longest word to hunt for, since long words are easier to spot once you know their starting letter.
Look for unusual letter combinations like Q, X, J or Z, which often sit at the start or end of a hidden word and narrow your search quickly.
Work across the board in one direction at a time, checking rows, then columns, then diagonals, so you do not miss words hidden at odd angles.
Remember that words can zigzag, so if a straight line does not spell the word, check whether the next letter bends in a new direction.
Cross off each word as soon as you find it, because a shorter list makes the remaining search faster and helps you keep up the pace that earns more points.
faq: What is the goal of Cooking Letters?
Your goal is to find all the words from the list hidden on the game board. Finishing faster earns you more points.
How do I select a word?
Swipe your finger or use your cursor to connect the letters in a line. Words can run horizontally, vertically, diagonally or zigzag.

cube-smash.intro: Cube Smash is a browser game where you break colorful cubes by choosing projectiles and aiming carefully. Earn currency, unlock new ammo, and take on harder challenges as you progress.
tips: Pick your projectile before each shot, since the game rewards choosing the right ammo for the cubes in front of you.
Use the touchscreen on a phone or the mouse on a computer to aim slowly and steadily rather than rushing each shot.
Spend earned currency on upgrades you will use often, so your progress builds up over several rounds.
Save unlocked ammo types for tougher cubes and use basic shots on easy targets to conserve them.
Watch how each shot affects the cube layout, and plan the next shot around what remains standing.
faq: How do I aim and shoot in Cube Smash?
On a smartphone, use the touchscreen to aim and shoot. On a computer, use the mouse for precise aiming and to select projectiles.
How do I earn currency in Cube Smash?
The game gives you currency as you break cubes, and you can use it to buy upgrades and unlock new ammo.

meow-captcha.intro: Meow Captcha is a cat puzzle game where you solve short, CAPTCHA-style challenges by finding hidden objects, spotting differences, and sorting cats. Between puzzles, you can care for a virtual kitty.
tips: Look at the whole scene before you tap. Small details and hidden clues often hold the answer.
If the obvious choice does not work, try interacting with other parts of the scene. The right solution is sometimes unexpected.
When a puzzle asks you to move something, press and hold the item first, then drag it to the spot you want.
Try a different way of looking at the puzzle if you are stuck. Some answers are right in front of you, while others need a new angle.
Take a break from the puzzles to feed, pet, or play with your virtual cat when it needs attention.
faq: How do I finish a level?
You solve the puzzle by taking the correct action, and then the game moves you on to the next level.
How do I move an item in a puzzle?
Press and hold the item, then drag it to the spot on the screen where it belongs.

monster-merge-legends-alive.intro: Monster Merge: Legends Alive is a puzzle game where you drop monsters onto a playing field and combine identical ones to score points. Your goal is to keep merging as the field fills up.
tips: Hold to aim, then watch where the monster lands before you release. A small change in position can decide whether it touches its match.
Early on, drop monsters next to matching ones so they connect quickly and keep the field from filling too fast.
Spread your drops across the field instead of stacking everything in one spot, so you keep room for future merges.
Look at the monsters already on the field before each drop and plan where the matching one should go.
Try to set up merges of higher-ranking monsters when you can, since the highest-ranking merge gives you more points.
faq: How do I drop a monster?
Press and hold your finger or mouse button inside the playing area to choose the fall path, then release to drop the monster onto the field.
How do monsters combine?
Drop an identical monster on top of another identical one to connect them. The highest-ranking monster disappears when it connects and gives you more points.

blind-box-master.intro: Blind Box Master is a relaxed collecting game where you buy and open mystery boxes to find 100 hand-drawn collectibles. This guide covers how to make your coins and luck go further.
tips: Sell duplicates instead of keeping every copy, since the coins you earn can fund better boxes and luck upgrades.
Check your daily and weekly tasks before opening boxes, because completing them can be an easy source of coins.
Put some early coins into Lucky Charm upgrades before chasing Legendary items, so your odds improve over time.
Try haggling when selling to see whether you can get a better price than the first offer.
Keep an eye on items you have multiples of, and consider synthesizing three of them into a higher rarity to fill gaps in your collection.
faq: What is the main goal of Blind Box Master?
The goal is to collect all 100 collectibles by opening mystery boxes, selling duplicates, and completing tasks and achievements along the way.
How do I play the game?
Tap or click to pick a box on the desk, buy it, and open it. All controls use mouse clicks or taps only.

cubic-coil.intro: Cubic Coil is a 3D take on the classic Snake game. You steer a green-black voxel snake while rotating the cube it moves through, collecting fruit to grow and score.
tips: Rotate the cube before you need to turn the snake, so the path ahead lines up with a clear direction.
Keep an eye on the snake's own body, since running into it is the main way the classic Snake rules end a run.
Plan your route a few squares ahead rather than reacting only to the fruit directly in front of you.
Rare big fruits are worth bonus points, so it can be worth a small detour when the path is safe.
On mobile, use small, steady swipes: left side to turn the cube, right side to steer the snake, so you do not overcorrect.
faq: What is the goal of Cubic Coil?
Guide the snake to collect voxel fruit squares and rare big fruits for points while avoiding crashes, as in classic Snake.
How do I control the snake on PC?
Use the Arrow Keys to steer the snake and the WASD keys to rotate the cube.

capyballra-capybara-ball-collector.intro: Capyballra is a skill game where you twist a maze to roll Capybara balls into a pipe. Drag to rotate the maze, complete levels, and spend coins on new skins.
tips: Before each drag, look at where the Capyballras will roll once the maze turns, and plan the rotation around that path.
Small, controlled drags are easier to predict than large spins, so adjust the maze a little at a time.
Pay attention to the pipe's position at the start of each level so you know which way the balls need to travel.
When a bonus level appears, use it to collect as many Capyballras as you can, since it offers extra points.
Save your coins for the designs you like most, and remember that classic, seasonal, and rare animated skins are all available to unlock.
faq: How do I complete a level?
Rotate the maze so all the Capyballras roll out of the maze and into the pipe. Finishing this goal completes the level.
How do I rotate the maze?
Drag with your mouse on desktop or with your finger on mobile to turn the maze clockwise or anticlockwise.

palkovil-the-way-home.intro: Palkovil The Way Home is a New Year adventure where you help bring the Christmas tree back home while aliens try to spoil the holiday. You solve riddles, complete quests, and fight through a laboratory full of monsters.
tips: Turn on the lights in each room before you try to move through it, since the game says this is how you get around the laboratory.
Complete the aliens' tasks when you can, because that is how you earn toys.
Pay attention to the paintings, since looking at them is how you collect cards, and it may give you clues for the riddles.
Look for connections between objects, characters, and places, because the riddles and quests are built around finding them.
Save your sword fights for the bosses and tougher monsters, and collect toys, squirrels, dogs, and cats along the way to build your collection of souvenirs.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Your main task is to bring the Christmas tree back home before the aliens can spoil the holiday. Everything you do in the game works toward that goal.
How do I move around the laboratory?
You turn on the lights in the right rooms to move around the laboratory. Lights you have not switched on may block your way.

fit-master-3d.intro: Fit Master 3D is a puzzle game where you arrange food items into matching boxes. Each level adds a new twist, so you need to pay attention to every item you place.
tips: Before you drag anything, look at all the food items and boxes on screen to see which pieces match which spaces.
Start with the pieces that have the fewest possible places to go, then work toward the more flexible ones.
If a piece does not fit, drag it back out and try a different box rather than forcing it into place.
Read each level's twist carefully at the start, since it can change how you should approach the arrangement.
Take a moment to check your placements before moving on, especially when several items look similar.
faq: What is the goal of Fit Master 3D?
Your goal is to fit each food item into its matching box and complete the feast on every level.
How do I move the food items?
On a computer, click and drag an item into a box with your mouse. On a mobile device, drag and drop the item with your finger.

puzzle-candle.intro: Puzzle Candle is a platform puzzle game where you solve tricky puzzles and precise jumps to light every candle in each stage. Its 50 levels cover different environments.
tips: Look at the clues before you touch anything, since they show how the candles should be arranged.
Tap or click each puzzle object once to see what it does before trying combinations, so you can rule out options quickly.
When a stage stalls, check whether you have missed a candle that needs lighting, because every required candle must be lit to clear it.
Save your helpful items for the levels where the obstacles are hardest instead of using them early.
Treat the platforming sections as a separate challenge: slow down, plan your jump, and retry calmly rather than rushing.
faq: What is the goal of Puzzle Candle?
Reach the end of each level by solving its puzzle and lighting every required candle. The game has 50 levels across different environments.
How do I interact with objects?
Tap or click the candles and puzzle objects to use them. Arranging the candles correctly is needed to complete each stage.

cars-vs-blocks.intro: Cars Vs Blocks is a color-match puzzle where you clear blocks to free stickmen and send each one into the car of its matching color. Plan each move so the road stays open.
tips: Before you clear anything, look at which stickmen are trapped and which car each one needs. Working toward a specific match keeps your moves purposeful.
Check what sits in front of a block before you remove it. Clearing the wrong block can leave a stickman boxed in or block a road.
Watch the cars as well as the stickmen. Keep the path to each car clear so every car can drive away safely.
Early levels are simple, so use them to learn how the colors and spaces fit together. Later levels add tighter spaces and more colors, so good habits matter more.
When a level gets crowded, slow down and map out the order of your moves. Thinking a few steps ahead helps you avoid traffic jams.
faq: What is the goal of Cars Vs Blocks?
Free every stickman by clearing the blocks around them, then get each stickman into a car of the same color. Every car needs to drive away safely.
How do I move blocks in Cars Vs Blocks?
Use your mouse or finger to tap or drag the cubes on the board, as the instructions describe. Pick the moves that clear a clear route for the right stickman.

kinetic-puzzle.intro: Kinetic Puzzle is a sliding block brain teaser where you clear red, yellow, and blue blocks off the board through orange edge portals. Gray obstacles stay put, so plan around them.
tips: Before every move, check which block can line up with a portal. Blocks only leave through a portal they are aligned with, so look for clear rows and columns to the edge.
Remember that a block keeps sliding until it hits a wall, obstacle, or another block. Count where it will stop before you release, and use blocks as stoppers when you need a precise landing.
Look at yellow blocks first. They only move and exit in their arrow direction, so they often need to leave early or they may get stuck.
For blue blocks, find the prerequisite block that unlocks them and clear that one first. Working out the dependency order is usually the key to the harder levels.
Use undo freely to test ideas, since each push counts and experimenting is part of the puzzle. Use the hint button only when you are truly stuck.
faq: What is the goal of Kinetic Puzzle?
Remove every red, yellow, and blue block from the board through the orange edge portals. Gray obstacle blocks stay where they are.
How do I move a block?
Drag or swipe a block in an up, down, left, or right direction and release. It will keep sliding until it hits a wall, an obstacle, or another block.

numorapuzzle.intro: NumoraPuzzle is a number-merging puzzle where you tap connected groups of matching tiles to build higher numbers. Work toward the goals in the GOALS panel before your moves run out.
tips: Read the GOALS panel before every move so you know which target numbers to aim for.
Look for larger connected groups first, since bigger merges build higher numbers faster than tapping small pairs.
Think about where new tiles will fall after each merge, and avoid moves that leave isolated tiles with no matches.
Save the hammer and +3-moves boosters for tricky boards where you are close to a goal but short on moves.
Use Endless mode to practice planning chains, then bring that habit back to the handcrafted levels.
faq: What is the main goal of NumoraPuzzle?
Create the numbered tiles shown in the GOALS panel before you run out of moves. Completing every goal wins the level.
How do I merge tiles?
Tap or click any group of two or more connected tiles with the same number. The group combines into one tile with a higher value.

king-of-pirate.intro: King of Pirate is a short adventure where you play a brave pirate defending against attacking zombies. Quick reactions and steady attention to both sides of the screen will help you hold your ground.
tips: Watch both halves of the screen at all times, since zombies can approach from either side and you need to know where to respond.
Remember that each tap both moves you and attacks in that direction, so think about where you will end up before you tap.
Keep your taps deliberate rather than rapid, because a mistimed tap can move you into a worse position.
Focus on the zombies closest to you first, so the nearest threat is dealt with before others gather on that side.
Practice reading the rhythm of the attacks early on, so your reactions become more natural as the game goes on.
faq: How do I attack a zombie?
Tap the left half of the screen to move and attack to the left, or the right half to move and attack to the right. Attacks go in the direction you tap.
Which side of the screen should I tap to face a zombie coming from the right?
Tap the right half of the screen. This moves you to the right and attacks in that direction.

ashfall-industries.intro: Ashfall Industries is an idle tycoon game where you build a wasteland economy from a single pump into a network of industrial operations. Run, upgrade, automate, and reset to grow faster each time.
tips: Keep your Run buttons active early on, since producing Scrap is what funds every upgrade and new operation.
Spend Scrap on upgrading operations you already own before buying expensive new ones, so your income grows steadily.
Hire Crew Chiefs for the operations you run most often, because automating them frees you to focus on expanding.
Watch for Lucky Finds and collect them when they appear, as they give boosted payouts and quick bursts of progress.
Consider using Reclamation once your income starts to slow, since the Reactor Cores and Recovery Protocols you earn make the next rebuild stronger.
faq: What is the main goal of Ashfall Industries?
The goal is to turn a battered wasteland into a thriving industrial empire by building and upgrading operations, collecting Scrap, and growing your business over time.
How do I start producing Scrap?
Buy your first operation, the Rustwater Pump, and click its Run button. Scrap is produced from there and you can spend it to level up operations and unlock new ones.

stack-swipe.intro: Stack Swipe is a color puzzle where you swipe to slide plates across the grid and stack matching colors. Build stacks of five or more same-colored plates to blast them and work toward the level target.
tips: Before each swipe, check which same-colored plates line up in that direction, since plates only move and stack when a matching plate is in their path.
Look for rows and columns that already hold a few matching plates, and swipe along them to grow a stack toward five.
Try to build stacks in one spot rather than spreading several small ones, so a single swipe can push a stack to the blast point.
Use Serve carefully, because new plates can land on top of existing ones and may disrupt a stack you were building.
Plan a few moves ahead and aim for chain reactions, where one blast can leave plates in positions that set up another match.
faq: What is the goal of Stack Swipe?
Your goal is to work your way toward each level's target by blasting stacks of five or more same-colored plates.
How do I move the plates?
Swipe in any direction to move all plates across the grid. Plates will only move and stack if a same-colored plate is in their swipe direction.

toytopia.intro: Toytopia is a cozy merge puzzle where you combine art items to make the materials needed to repair broken toys. Each toy brings its own challenge.
tips: Before you merge anything, look at which broken parts the toy needs, so you know which art materials to aim for.
Work backward from the required material to the items that can combine into it, and plan a short path instead of merging at random.
Keep the board tidy by merging items as you go, so you still have room to make the next material.
Some toys are harder than others, so if one stalls, try a different merge path rather than repeating the same moves.
Drag items with a steady motion, and check the drop spot before you let go so you don't move an item you meant to keep.
faq: What is the goal of Toytopia?
The goal is to fix the broken parts of each toy. You do this by merging art items to produce the art materials the toy requires.
How do I move items on the board?
On desktop, use the mouse cursor to drag and drop items. On mobile, use your finger to drag and drop them.

bblaster.intro: BBlaster is a fast 3D arcade battler on a neon court, where you pilot a B-Bot that fires marbles automatically. Positioning, reflexes, and timing your Special decide each fight.
tips: Keep your bot where it can intercept enemy marbles while staying in line to fire at the puck, since both matter in every exchange.
Clash your marbles with enemy fire often, because each clash charges your Drive meter and brings your Special closer.
Watch the puck's path across the court and aim to knock it past the enemy goal line, as a PUCK GOAL deals heavy damage.
Save your Drive for a moment when the battle is turning against you, since the full-screen Special can swing the whole fight.
Before a boss stage, spend gold and parts in the Workshop on upgrades you can actually use, and try fusing gear to build a loadout that suits how you play.
faq: What is the goal of BBlaster?
Win each stage by out-battling the enemy on the neon court, using marbles, the puck, and your Drive Special. Defeating the boss on every 5th stage earns gold and rare parts.
How do I move and shoot?
Drag anywhere on the screen to move your bot, or use the A and D keys or arrow keys. Your bot fires its marbles automatically, so your focus can stay on positioning.

snakes.intro: SNAKES is a relaxing puzzle game where you guide several colorful snakes across the board until every empty space is filled. Levels grow trickier as you move forward, so planning ahead pays off.
tips: Before moving anything, look at the whole board and note which empty areas are hardest to reach. Small pockets and narrow corners are often the first thing to plan around.
Avoid leaving isolated gaps behind a snake. If a spot can only be reached from one direction, make sure a snake can still get there before you commit to a long path.
Work on one snake at a time and check the board after each move. Seeing the result clearly helps you spot mistakes early.
If you get stuck, step back and trace the route of each snake on paper or in your head. Changing the order of moves often opens up a new path.
Play at a comfortable pace. The game has no need to rush, and calm, deliberate moves usually lead to a cleaner solution.
faq: What is the goal of SNAKES?
Your goal is to move the snakes so they fill all the empty spaces on the board. Each level is complete when the whole grid is covered.
Do levels get harder?
Yes. The layouts are designed to become trickier as you progress through the game.

slide-and-divide.intro: Slide And Divide is a number puzzle where you place numbers beside values they can divide. Clear tiles through valid divisions and plan ahead to keep the board open.
tips: Before each placement, check which neighbouring numbers it can divide evenly, so you know what a move will clear.
Prioritise moves that free up space, since a fuller board leaves you with fewer options later.
Avoid placing tiles in spots that block your own future divisions, especially in tight areas of the board.
Look a few moves ahead and think about which tiles will still have a valid partner after your next move.
Keep an eye on the number of open spaces, and when it starts to shrink, focus on moves that clear tiles rather than fill gaps.
faq: What is the main goal of Slide And Divide?
The goal is to keep placing numbers for as long as possible. Your run ends when no more placements are possible.
How do I clear tiles from the board?
Place a number next to a value it can divide. A valid division makes the tile disappear or reduces it, depending on the result.

grill-match-sort-food.intro: Grill Match: Sort Food is a sorting puzzle where you tap grilled foods to move them between slots and match three identical items. Clear the whole grill to finish each level and work through new food combinations as you go.
tips: Before you tap a food, check whether moving it will line up a set of three identical items. Good moves usually bring matches closer together.
Look for foods that have only one or two matching pieces on the grill, and plan how to gather the rest before moving unrelated items.
Avoid stacking unmatched foods in the same slots when you can, because crowded slots make later matches harder to reach.
Take a moment to scan the whole grill at the start of each level, since new ingredients and tricky combinations can change how you should order your moves.
If a level feels stuck, try clearing the easiest set first to free up space, then work through the harder combinations.
faq: How do I complete a level?
You clear the entire grill by matching three identical foods until no items are left. Each level is finished once the grill is empty.
How do I move food on the grill?
Tap a food item to move it between grill slots. Plan each tap so that matching foods end up together.
