good-knight-story.intro: Good Knight Story is an adventure about a hero who wakes in a dungeon with no memory of the night before. You solve connection puzzles, fight monsters and piece together what happened.
tips: Check the task shown in the upper right corner before you start each level, so you know what you need to complete.
Scan the whole board for identical elements before connecting anything, so you can plan which pairs to link first.
Spend your upgrades on your character and weapons as you go, since stronger gear will help in the tougher battles.
Keep your Special Boosts for levels that stall you rather than using them on easy ones.
Claim your Daily Gifts each time you play, since they can help with your quest.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You find combinations of identical elements and connect them. The task shown in the upper right corner tells you what you must complete to finish the level.
How do I get stronger over time?
You can upgrade your character and your weapons. Upgrades help you handle the monster fights and Boss battles later in the game.

tap-think-save-the-kitten.intro: Tap the arrow boxes in the correct order to build a colored weapon, then shoot the snake before it reaches the kitten. Matching colors and working quickly are the keys to saving the kitten.
tips: Read the arrow directions before you tap, so you can plan the full sequence instead of guessing one box at a time.
Pay attention to the snake's color, because the weapon you build has to match it to shoot the snake effectively.
Since every second counts, keep your taps steady and avoid pauses that give the snake time to get closer to the kitten.
Look at the sequence as a whole and plan the next few arrows ahead, so you are ready when your colored gun needs reloading.
Watch how the snake shrinks after each hit to see how close you are to saving the kitten and keep the same rhythm going.
faq: What is the goal of Tap, Think, Save the Kitten!?
The goal is to stop the colorful snake that is stalking the kitten. You do this by solving the arrow puzzle, reloading your colored gun, and shooting the snake until it shrinks away.
How do I make a weapon?
Tap the directional arrow boxes in the right order. Solving the sequence creates a weapon in the same color as the arrows you tapped.

raised-knight.intro: Raised Knight is an endless runner where you keep moving forward and try to cover as much distance as possible. Success depends on dodging obstacles with quick, precise use of the controls.
tips: Use A and D early to shift lanes before an obstacle is close, rather than reacting at the last second.
Hold Space only as long as you need to clear a height; hold it to float when you need extra air time to get past a hazard.
Save Ctrl for low obstacles. Slide as soon as you see something you cannot jump over, and release quickly so you can keep advancing.
Watch for openings between obstacles and plan your next move while you are still in the air, since air control matters.
Practice short runs to learn the timing of each control before pushing for a longer distance.
faq: What is the goal of Raised Knight?
The goal is to run as far as possible through a world full of obstacles without being caught by one.
How do I avoid obstacles?
Use A and D to move left or right, Space to jump or float over higher dangers, and Ctrl to slide under low ones.

animal-blocks.intro: Animal Blocks is a relaxing block puzzle with cute animal designs. Match three or more animals to earn points and build up your score.
tips: Look for matches that set up a follow-up match, since consecutive combinations multiply your points many times over.
Scan the whole board before each move so you can spot chains you might otherwise miss.
Expect the game to get harder as your score rises, so it helps to build a steady rhythm early instead of rushing.
Shorter sessions work well for this game, so stop and come back with a fresh view if the board starts to feel crowded.
Focus on clearing groups of three or more rather than single moves, because bigger matches add up faster.
faq: What is the goal of Animal Blocks?
The goal is to match three or more animal blocks to earn points. Your score keeps growing as you make more matches.
How do I get the most points?
Create consecutive combinations, since these multiply your points many times over. Planning moves that lead into the next match is the best way to boost your score.

merge-emoji-arena.intro: Merge Emoji Arena is a clicker where you buy emojis, merge matching pairs into stronger units, and send them into battle lanes to defend against waves of enemies and bosses.
tips: Merge as soon as you have two identical emojis, since each merge makes a unit with greater damage and frees up board space.
Keep your strongest emojis on the front lines, using the three battle lanes so no single lane gets overwhelmed.
Spend gold regularly on new units and upgrades so your army keeps growing as enemy waves get harder.
Keep the board from filling with unmerged basic emojis by merging pairs early, so you always have room for new purchases.
Let your deployed units fight and earn gold in the background, then check back to spend what you collected.
faq: How do I make a stronger unit?
Drag one emoji onto an identical one to merge them into a higher-level unit with greater damage. Repeat this to keep building stronger fighters.
How do I start a battle?
Drag your strongest emojis from the merge board into one of the three battle lanes. Once deployed, they attack enemies automatically.

shadow-ninja-rpg-enemy-legends.intro: Shadow Ninja RPG: Enemy Legends is a browser action RPG where you pick a ninja, fight through levels of dark enemies, and upgrade your skills as you go. Use the mouse to move and attack.
tips: Keep your distance from enemies that carry weapons, since they attack as soon as you get too close. Approach one at a time when you can.
Move quickly between fights so you don't get surrounded by several enemies at once.
Pay attention to how each enemy type behaves, such as skeleton armies, devil ninjas, and bosses, and adjust your approach to each one.
Spend your upgrades on skills that suit your play style, and check new powers as they unlock so you can use them in the next level.
Expect each level to be harder than the last. If you struggle, take a moment to reset your timing before moving on.
faq: What is the goal of Shadow Ninja RPG: Enemy Legends?
Your goal is to defeat every enemy in each level, working your way through the shadow-filled worlds to face the enemy legends.
How do I move and attack?
Use your mouse to move around the environment and to fight enemies.

jelly-merge-dooper.intro: Jelly Merge: Dooper is a puzzle game where you slide colorful jellies across a board and combine them into one. Each level rewards careful planning and finishing in as few moves as possible.
tips: Before your first swipe, look at the whole board and note where every jelly sits and which obstacles are in the way.
Think about the final jelly first. Decide where you want everything to end up, then work backward to plan the moves that get you there.
Watch for obstacles that block movement, and plan routes around them so a jelly doesn't get stuck in a bad spot.
Avoid moves that scatter jellies without a purpose, since every extra move lowers your score on a level.
If you get stuck, reset your thinking and count the remaining jellies and their paths again before making another swipe.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Merge all the jelly elements on the board into one single jelly to complete the level.
How do I move the jellies?
Swipe up, down, left, or right to slide the jellies across the board.

panda-go.intro: Panda Go! is an endless arcade game where you tap to flap your panda upward and fly through glowing rings. Pass cleanly through rings and avoid walls and obstacles to climb the leaderboard.
tips: Since the panda moves forward on its own, focus on controlling height. Use short, steady taps rather than rapid tapping, which tends to overshoot.
Aim for the center of each ring. Perfect passes are what build your combo multiplier, so one clean pass is worth more than a sloppy one.
Keep your revive for a run that is going well. Using it early wastes the one chance you get per run.
Collect coins where it is safe to do so, and use the magnet to pull in nearby coins without drifting into danger.
Save a shield for tricky sections with obstacles. It protects you from a single collision, so it is best kept for moments when you cannot avoid a hit.
faq: What is the goal of Panda Go!?
There is no set end. The aim is to survive as long as possible, collect loot, and reach the top of the leaderboard.
How do I control the panda?
Tap anywhere on the screen or click the left mouse button to flap and fly upward. The panda moves forward automatically, so your taps control only its height.

swarm-miners.intro: SWARM MINERS is a cozy mining idle game where you smash gem-rich rocks, sell ore for coins, and build a swarm of pets that mine and fight beside you across 40 worlds.
tips: Let your backpack fill up, then walk to the merchant and sell your ore. Selling in batches keeps you moving between rocks instead of stopping often.
Spend your coins on stronger tools and bigger backpacks first, since both help you gather ore faster and carry more before each trip to sell.
Use the 1-9 keys to switch hotbar items, then place dynamite with E inside the mine when you want to blast a larger area of ore at once.
Collectible pets mine and fight alongside you, so pick up new pets as you go and keep your swarm growing.
Keep an eye out for treasure rocks and check the Wheel of Fortune when you have a spare moment, then prepare for bosses by upgrading your tools before you challenge them.
faq: What is the main goal of SWARM MINERS?
Your goal is to unlock all 40 worlds and build the strongest swarm of pets. You do this by mining ore, selling it for coins, and spending those coins on upgrades.
How do I move and mine?
Move with WASD or the arrow keys. Walk up to a rock and your miner swings automatically, so you mostly need to position yourself next to the rocks you want to mine.

cruel-fable.intro: Cruel Fable is a dark storybook action roguelike. You survive waves of twisted creatures, collect gold, and build weapon combinations to defeat bosses and climb the global ranking.
tips: Spend your gold between waves on upgrades that support the weapons you are already using, rather than spreading purchases across many options.
Use Dash with Shift to get out of crowded spots, and save it for moments when enemies are closing in on you.
Keep Heavy Attack with Space for tougher enemies and bosses, since it is best suited to targets that take more punishment.
Save consumable items for emergencies and use them with the number keys when your health is running low during a wave.
Once you defeat King Slime, try Hard Mode, but first build a stronger character with more upgrades, because its timed waves and continuous enemy spawns leave less room for mistakes.
faq: What is the main goal of Cruel Fable?
Your goal is to survive each wave, collect gold, buy upgrades between battles, and defeat bosses to move forward.
How do I unlock Hard Mode?
Hard Mode unlocks after you defeat King Slime for the first time. It features timed survival waves with continuous enemy spawning.

solve-the-maze.intro: Solve the Maze is a puzzle game with 100 levels where you move a ball across the screen to paint every square of a maze. Difficulty rises gradually as you progress.
tips: Plan your route before you move, since every square needs to be colored and a missed square can leave you stuck.
Before you finish a level, scan the maze for any square you have not painted yet.
Use the arrow keys on a computer or swipes on the screen to move in short, deliberate steps so you can check your path as you go.
If a level becomes frustrating, try a different route from the start instead of pushing through the same dead end.
Save the crystals you earn from completed levels for the items you want to unlock, and aim to collect the whole set.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You must move the ball around the maze so that every square is colored in. The puzzle is only complete when the whole maze is filled.
What happens if I miss a square?
If you leave at least one square unfilled, you can get stuck in the colored maze forever, so check the whole grid before finishing.

a-block-too-many.intro: A Block Too Many is a block-stacking game where you play an alien building a tower high enough to escape a mysterious planet. Each block you place can make or break the stack.
tips: Before each drop, check where the ship is aiming and where the block will land, since a small misplacement can start a collapse.
Pay attention to the unique properties of each block type, and plan which ones to place low in the tower and which ones to save for later.
Use the stars you earn to buy temporary updates, such as seeing the next block in advance, so you can plan two placements ahead.
If you are new, try sandbox mode first to test how different blocks stack and balance before you attempt challenge levels.
In endless mode, focus on keeping a wide, stable base rather than stacking as fast as possible, because one mistake can bring down the whole tower.
faq: What is the goal of A Block Too Many?
Your goal is to build a tower tall enough to reach the height needed to escape the planet. Challenge mode asks you to reach set heights to unlock new levels.
How do I control my ship and place blocks?
On mobile, use the onscreen controls. On PC, use the keyboard. Either way, you move your ship to decide where each block is stacked.

cat-box-merge.intro: Cat Box Merge is a relaxing merge game about opening boxes, finding cats, and combining matching cats into rarer ones. This guide covers the basics and a few habits that help you move through the worlds.
tips: Keep your coins for buying new boxes when you have spare coins, since boxes are how you find more cats to merge.
Put cats on beds as soon as you can, because they help you and gradually bring new boxes for further progress.
Check the boxes on your cat beds regularly so you do not miss rewards waiting to be collected.
Before merging, look at your collection and pick identical cats that move you toward the rarer ones you still need.
Track how many cats you have found in your current world, since finding all 10 is what unlocks the next world.
faq: How do I unlock the next world?
Discover all 10 cats in your current world. Once you have them all, the next world becomes available.
How do I merge cats?
Drag one cat onto an identical cat to combine them into a cat of the next level. On mobile, use a drag gesture; on PC, use the mouse.

cat-snack-defense.intro: Cat Snack Defense is a tower defense game where you place cat cards to guard a goldfish cracker from waves of hungry animals. Survive every wave and defeat all attackers to win.
tips: Before each wave, think about which cats you need, since each cat has different abilities, attack styles, and roles.
Click or tap a deployed cat to check its stats, and use that information to decide where it works best.
Place cats with placement in mind, not just in any open spot, because position is essential to your defense.
Spend the rewards you collect on unlocking new cat cards so your team can handle a wider range of enemies.
If card text is hard to read, use the language button to switch between Chinese and English.
faq: How do I win Cat Snack Defense?
You win by defeating all attackers before they destroy the goldfish cracker. You lose if the cracker is destroyed.
How do I place a cat on the battlefield?
Select a cat card, then drag and drop it onto the battlefield. Clicking or tapping a deployed cat shows its stats.

baroho.intro: BAROHO is a 3D skill game where you tilt a platform to roll balls into the correct holes. One wrong move sends the ball off course and restarts you from the beginning, so steady, precise control is essential.
tips: Make small, gentle tilts instead of big swings, since one wrong move can send the ball flying off course.
Plan your route before you move: check where the ball is heading and which hole you need to reach, then adjust early.
Keep an eye on your ball count, because you need every ball to win and losing one early makes the rest harder to spare.
Look for holes with yellow rims and glowing arrows as your targets, and steer toward them before the ball gains speed.
Collect coins along the way but avoid dropping them into the hole, so you keep your coins for buying new ball skins.
faq: What is the goal of BAROHO?
Guide the balls into the correct holes using the platform, and keep enough balls to win. Holes with yellow rims and glowing arrows are the ones to aim for.
How do I move the platform?
Use WASD or the Arrow Keys to tilt the platform and roll the ball left or right. With a gamepad, each analog stick controls one side of the platform.

funny-rescue-gardener.intro: Samantha, a gardener, has had an accident and needs help. Your job is to rescue her and treat her wounds, step by step.
tips: Look over Samantha's injuries before you pick anything, so you know what needs attention first.
Click or tap one item, tool, or button at a time, and watch what happens before you move on.
Try different tools on each wound to see which ones fit the injury you are treating.
Take your time and check each stage of recovery, since rushing can make it harder to tell what is working.
Keep an eye on every part of the scene, because items you use early may matter later on.
faq: What is the goal of Funny Rescue Gardener?
The goal is to rescue Samantha from her accident and help her recover from the wounds she has received.
How do I interact with the game?
On a computer, click items, tools, and buttons to use them. On a touch screen, tap to select and apply your choices.

hexholm.intro: Hexholm is a turn-based hex strategy game where you start with one province, expand hex by hex, and defeat rival AI factions. Each battle is a compact tactical puzzle that rewards careful planning.
tips: Capture neutral and enemy hexes early, since expanding your territory is what raises your income for later turns.
Spend your gold each turn rather than letting it sit, and look for chances to merge matching units into stronger ones.
Before you push into enemy land, check which hexes your units can reach and make sure the ones you leave behind still protect your territory.
Avoid overextending. Push forward in steps so your newly claimed hexes stay connected to the land you already hold.
If a turn goes badly, use UNDO to roll it back and try a different plan instead of pressing on with a weak position.
faq: How do I win a map?
You win by eliminating every rival faction on the map. Keep expanding your territory and building up your units until no AI factions remain.
How do I earn gold?
You earn gold at the end of each turn based on how much land you hold. Capturing more hexes raises your income.

sleepwalkers.intro: Sleepwalkers is a maze-style adventure where colorful characters need your help finding their beds. Move carefully through each route while avoiding the dangers along the way.
tips: Before you move, look at the whole maze to spot where the beds are and which paths lead toward them.
Move in short steps rather than long runs so you can react quickly when a danger comes into view.
If you get stuck, step back to the last junction you passed and try a different route instead of pushing forward.
On a keyboard, use one set of keys consistently (WASD or arrows) so your movements stay predictable.
On a touchscreen, keep your finger steady on the screen and move it gradually, since the character follows your finger's direction.
faq: How do I move the sleepwalkers?
On a keyboard, use the WASD or arrow keys. On mobile, hold your finger on the screen and move it to guide the sleepwalkers.
What is the goal of the game?
Help the colorful characters find their beds while navigating challenges and avoiding dangers along the way.

pim-path.intro: Pim Path is a maze-style skill game where you guide your character across platforms to reach the trophy at the end of each level. Spikes and blades make every step count.
tips: Watch the spikes and blades for a moment before you move, since one wrong step ends the game.
Move in short, controlled steps instead of rushing, because the game rewards calm, careful play.
Practice your jump timing with Space on each platform before you commit to a longer route.
If you feel frustration building, take a short break and come back calmer, as the game itself suggests staying calm.
Play the levels in order and focus on one section at a time, working toward the trophy at the end.
faq: What is the goal of Pim Path?
Reach the trophy at the end of each level and complete all the levels to finish the game.
Which keys do I use on a computer?
Use WASD or the arrow keys to move your character and the Space bar to jump.

1-pickaxe-break-blocks-3d.intro: Mine blocks in 3D zones with a pickaxe that spins around your character. Earn rewards, upgrade your gear, and work your way toward the farthest zone.
tips: Stand where the spinning pickaxe can reach the block, then stay in place while it hits. Repositioning costs time you could spend mining.
Watch the durability indicator on each block. It tells you how many hits remain, so you can decide whether to keep mining or move to another target.
Spend your rewards on upgrades that raise your mining speed before buying new pickaxes. Faster hits help with the sturdier blocks in later zones.
Gain experience to level up, since higher levels make your gear stronger. Check your character's stats after each level to see what has improved.
Before moving to a new area, mine the nearby blocks for rewards. Saving up gives you enough to unlock new workbenches and pickaxes.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Your goal is to follow the game path, unlock one zone after another, and reach the farthest zone. You do this by mining blocks, collecting loot, and upgrading your gear.
How do I know when a block is about to break?
The durability indicator on each block shows how many hits are left. When it reaches zero, the block is destroyed and its loot is sent to your character.

unravel-eggs-puzzle.intro: Unravel Eggs Puzzle is a logic game about moving tangled eggs until no connecting lines cross. Start with easy levels and build up to harder tangles.
tips: Before you drag anything, look for the egg where the most lines meet. Moving it first often clears several crossings at once.
Drag one egg at a time and check after each move whether the number of crossing lines went down. If it went up, move that egg back.
Try to spread the eggs out so that lines run around the outside of the group rather than through the middle.
Watch for the moment the eggs and lines turn green. That is your signal the level is solved, so you can stop adjusting.
If you get stuck, move one egg far away from the cluster to see how the lines reshape, then bring it back into a clearer position.
faq: How do I move an egg?
Touch and drag an egg to move it around the screen. Let go when it is where you want it.
How do I know when a level is solved?
The eggs and the lines turn green once no connecting lines cross each other. That color change means the level is complete.

rotcalypse-idle.intro: Rotcalypse Idle is a satirical idle tycoon where you turn digital decay into profit, growing from simple RotToks to a global Brainrot VR-machine. The game is built around steady expansion, so smart spending and timing matter more than quick reactions.
tips: Click to Launch early on to build your starting capital, since every upgrade and branch depends on earnings.
Compare Business Upgrades and Skill Improvements before buying, and favor the ones that raise the efficiency of every action.
Unlock new Business Branches once your income allows it, because they diversify your portfolio and raise your profit ceiling.
Hire Managers when you want income to keep coming without clicking, as they turn manual cycles into passive income.
Consider a Prestige Reset when your progress slows, since the permanent Prestige Multipliers help you reach higher milestones in the next run.
faq: How do I earn my first money in Rotcalypse Idle?
Click to Launch manually triggers production cycles, which generate your initial capital. Keep clicking until you can afford your first upgrades.
What do Managers do?
Managers automate production cycles, so your income keeps building without manual clicks. Hiring them is the main way to shift from active play to passive income.

rough-ball.intro: Rough Ball is a physics platformer where you guide a smiley ball through rocky caves to the red flag. Roll, bounce, and slide your way past pits, slopes, and tricky jumps.
tips: Use short taps on the roll controls rather than holding them down, since the ball builds speed on slopes and can overshoot a landing.
Before a jump, look at where the ball is rolling and whether it is already moving fast; a slower approach often gives you more control in the air.
On slippery slopes, ease off the roll input and let the ball slide, then correct direction once it has settled.
Pay attention to the skull warnings; they signal dangerous spots, so slow down and plan your route before you reach them.
If you keep falling at the same spot, pause your rhythm and try a different timing for that jump rather than repeating the same input.
faq: What is the goal of Rough Ball?
Your goal is to reach the red flag in each level without falling into the deadly pits. You do this by rolling, bouncing, and sliding carefully through the caves.
How do I control the ball on desktop?
Use the Left Arrow key to roll left, the Right Arrow key to roll right, and the Spacebar to jump.

knife-slice-3d.intro: Knife Slice 3D is a one-tap skill game where you flip a knife between platforms, slice through objects, and avoid hazards on the way to each level's finish platform.
tips: Watch the moving traps and spinning saws for a few cycles before you tap, so you can pick a gap instead of guessing.
Focus on landing the knife upright, since that is what keeps you moving forward. Short, controlled flips are easier to land than long ones.
Slice objects that block your path first, then plan the next flip from the cleared route.
Pick up apples when they are on the way, not at the cost of a risky flip, because they are what unlock new knives.
Take a short pause before each tap to judge timing. Rushing is the most common reason to miss a landing.
faq: What is the main goal in Knife Slice 3D?
Your goal is to flip your knife from platform to platform and reach the finish platform to complete each level.
How do the controls work?
You only need one input: tap or click to flip the knife to the next platform. Timing the tap is what makes the difference.

turnline-relaxing-puzzle.intro: Turnline is a calm puzzle where you rotate tiles to connect lines into one complete network. There is no timer, so you can take each level at your own pace.
tips: Start by looking for tiles with only one obvious connection to the network, since their rotation is usually the easiest to confirm.
Check how each tile's lines meet its neighbours before rotating it, so you do not undo a connection you already made.
Work outward from a section that is already matching, one tile at a time, rather than rotating random pieces.
Pay attention to branches and tiles that appear in several paths, as these often decide the layout of the whole level.
If a puzzle stalls for a while, use a hint and then keep going, since the hints are there for the harder layouts.
faq: What is the goal of Turnline?
Your goal is to connect every required section of the network so the entire set of paths is complete. The level is finished once all required paths are connected.
How do I rotate a tile?
Tap a tile to rotate it. On desktop, click with the mouse; on a phone or tablet, simply tap the tile.

never-by-color.intro: Never by Color! is a calm 3D sorting game where you clear a pile of colorful parts by sorting them by shape. Color never counts, and the red trap box stays empty.
tips: Look at each part's outline before you tap it, since color is designed to mislead you.
Select several identical shapes at once before tapping their box to move more parts in one go.
Work through one shape at a time when you can, so you are less likely to drop a part in the wrong box.
Check the red box in your mind every time you sort, because one wrong placement there breaks your run.
There are no timers, so scan the tray fully before choosing parts to keep your sorting accurate.
faq: What is the goal of Never by Color!?
Clear the whole pile by sorting the parts into the boxes for their shapes. When the pile is cleared, a new model is built for your collection.
Does color matter when sorting?
No. You sort only by shape, and the red trap box must stay empty.

pop-balloon.intro: Pop Balloon is an arcade game where you aim and launch bouncing spikes to burst balloons scattered across the screen. It rewards precise aim and quick reactions.
tips: Before each launch, look at how the spike will bounce off the walls and track its path to hit clusters of balloons.
Aim for balloons that are close together so one spike can pop several in a row.
Pay attention to the spike's bounce angles and plan shots that carry through multiple balloons.
Keep your reactions quick, but avoid rushing shots that miss, since each launch is a chance to clear more balloons.
Scan the whole screen before you fire to find the balloons that are hardest to reach and clear them while the path is open.
faq: What is the goal of Pop Balloon?
Pop as many balloons as possible by aiming and launching bouncing spikes so they hit and burst the balloons on screen.
How do I play Pop Balloon?
Aim your spike and launch it so it bounces around the screen and hits the balloons.

bloop.intro: Bloop is an isometric maze puzzler where you roll Bloop across small grids, collecting every red diamond before reaching the exit. Each step drains energy, so planning the route matters as much as moving.
tips: Before your first move, trace the whole path in your head: find every red diamond and the exit, then work out an order that connects them.
Count your steps as you go, since each move costs one energy and running out restarts the level.
Do not assume the most direct path is correct. Check whether a longer detour collects diamonds you would otherwise need to backtrack for.
If you get stuck or run low on energy, restart early and try a new route rather than pushing a plan that is already wasting steps.
Use the same planning habit across all four worlds, since the puzzles get harder but the core goal of collecting every diamond stays the same.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Collect every red diamond to unlock the exit, then step onto the exit to finish the level.
How do I move Bloop?
Use the Arrow Keys or WASD to move Bloop around the grid.

recycle-game.intro: Recycle Game is a calm waste-sorting puzzle where you drag items into the correct bins. It teaches real recycling categories while you play through progressively harder levels.
tips: Look at each item's material first, whether paper, plastic, glass, or metal, before you start dragging. Identifying it quickly keeps the pace steady.
Start each level by scanning all the items so you can spot the ones that are easy to confuse. Handle the clear ones first to reduce mistakes later.
Drag with slow, controlled movements so you can see exactly which bin you are aiming for. Smooth moves help you avoid dropping items in the wrong place.
Use the early, simpler levels to learn the sorting rules before the puzzles get harder. Knowing the categories well makes the later levels much easier.
If you are playing on mobile, tap and hold the item, then drag it to the bin, keeping your finger steady until you release it.
faq: How do I play Recycle Game?
Drag each item with your mouse and drop it into the correct bin. On mobile, tap and drag each item instead.
What materials do I need to sort?
The game focuses on paper, plastic, glass, and metal. Levels start with simple tasks and become more challenging recycling puzzles as you progress.

blocks-adventure-jungle-saga.intro: Blocks Adventure Jungle Saga is a block puzzle where you drag shapes onto an empty grid and clear full rows or columns. Smart placement and planning ahead help you keep the board open and build points.
tips: Before placing a shape, look at which rows and columns are already nearly full so you can finish them and clear them.
Keep open space in the middle of the grid, since a crowded board leaves few spots for the next shapes.
Check the whole current set before you start placing, so you can arrange pieces that fit together instead of placing them one by one.
Use the pocket to rotate a piece when it does not fit the gap you have in mind, rather than forcing it into a poor spot.
Plan a few moves ahead, because the game ends as soon as none of the available shapes can be placed on the board.
faq: How do I score points in Blocks Adventure Jungle Saga?
You earn points by completing a full row or column, which clears it from the board. Clearing more lines at once is a good way to build your score.
What happens when I place all the shapes in the current set?
Placing every shape in the current set unlocks a new set. You can then keep placing pieces on the grid with the new shapes.

time-puzzle.intro: Time Puzzle is a relaxing picture puzzle game. Drag pieces into the right places to rebuild beautiful photos, then unlock new puzzles as the levels gradually get harder.
tips: Start by finding the edge pieces and any pieces with clear parts of the picture, such as sky or a distinct color, and place those first to build a frame to work from.
Group pieces by color and texture so you can spot where they belong more quickly.
Check the picture often rather than staring at the pieces, so you remember how each area of the photo should look.
Use hints when you feel stuck on a section, then return to the rest of the puzzle with fresh eyes.
Play at your own pace and finish one level before moving on, since the puzzles grow more challenging step by step.
faq: How do I move a puzzle piece?
Drag a piece with the mouse, or touch and drag on a touch screen, to swap it with another piece's position.
How do I finish a level?
Arrange all the pieces correctly so the full picture is complete, and the level will end.

close-ads.intro: Close Ads is a fast arcade game where you click or tap close buttons on moving ads. Each stage brings more annoying ads, so quick reactions matter.
tips: Keep your eyes on the close button rather than the whole ad, since the button is what you need to hit.
When you move the mouse or finger, aim ahead of the ad's path so you catch it while it is still moving.
Watch for levels that require a double click or double tap, and switch to that rhythm as soon as you see the change.
Stay calm when ads start changing every few levels, and reset your focus on the first target before going after the next.
If you fall far behind, use the Restart From Level 1 button, which resets your progress, so only use it when you are ready to start over.
faq: What is the main goal of Close Ads?
Your only goal is to close ads. Every few levels the ads become more annoying, so the challenge grows over time.
How do I play on a PC?
Move the mouse to aim and chase the ads, then press the left mouse button on the close buttons. Some levels require a double left click instead of a single click.

happy-farm-1-line-puzzle.intro: Happy Farm 1 Line Puzzle asks you to draw one continuous line that connects every water pipe on the farm so the water flows. It is a calm logic puzzle where planning the path matters more than speed.
tips: Before you start drawing, look at the whole level and find pipes with only one or two possible connections, since those points limit where your line can go.
Plan your route on paper in your head first, then draw it in one smooth stroke rather than experimenting with many short attempts.
Work through dead ends early: if a branch of the farm can only be reached one way, make sure your line covers it before heading elsewhere.
If a level stops working, release and start again from the beginning instead of trying to fix a messy line, which often makes the path harder to follow.
Take breaks between harder levels so you can come back with fresh spatial thinking, especially as the puzzles become trickier.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Draw one continuous line that connects all the water pipes on the farm so the water flows. You win by finishing the whole route in a single stroke.
How do I draw the line on desktop and on mobile?
On desktop, hold the left mouse button and drag to draw, then release to finish. On mobile, tap and drag across the screen in one smooth motion.

fun-toy-pals.intro: Fun Toy Pals is a merge puzzle set on a colorful playroom carpet. Combine matching toys to create higher-level toys, build your score, and unlock achievements as you play.
tips: Scan the carpet for matching toys before you start dragging, so you can plan a sequence of merges instead of making random ones.
Merge whenever a match is clearly visible to keep the carpet from filling up with unmatched toys.
Since the score rises with each merge, aim for moves that create more merges over time rather than one-off combinations.
Check which achievements you are close to and let them guide which toys you focus on.
Drop each toy squarely onto its match, since a small misplaced drag can waste a turn on the wrong toy.
faq: What is the main goal of Fun Toy Pals?
Your goal is to combine toys of the same type by dragging them onto each other to create new, higher-level toys.
How do I increase my score?
The more you merge, the higher your score becomes, so frequent merges are the main way to climb.

ghost-guard.intro: Ghost Guard is a shooting game where you must destroy every ghost before it reaches you. Aim with the arrow keys on a computer or by tapping screen quadrants on a phone.
tips: Watch the paths of incoming ghosts before you fire, since some of them change direction partway through.
Keep your attention on the ghosts closest to you first, because they are the ones that will reach you soonest.
Pick a steady rhythm of aiming and shooting rather than firing wildly, so you do not miss and leave openings.
If you play on a phone, tap the quadrant you need calmly and avoid rapid guessing, since each shot should be placed deliberately.
Track where ghosts tend to come from at the start of a round so you can anticipate and react faster.
faq: What is the goal of Ghost Guard?
The goal is to shoot all the ghosts before they reach you. Each ghost that gets through brings you closer to losing.
How do I aim on a computer?
Use the arrow keys to aim your shots at the incoming ghosts.

hand-daily.intro: Hand Daily is a card roguelite built around one shared 52-card deck. Build five-card poker hands, chain joker effects, and clear five antes within a single five-minute run.
tips: Before each play, check which poker hand your cards form and which ones score best against the ante's target. Lining up a stronger hand is often worth more than playing the first thing you see.
You only get four plays per ante, so plan them early. Avoid spending a play on a weak hand when a discard could set up a better one.
Use discards to improve your hand rather than to dig for a single card. Swapping up to five cards can change the whole hand, so decide which cards are holding you back first.
Buy jokers that match the cards you already build with. Since joker effects stack, a joker that boosts your common hand type will pay off across every later play.
Keep your run short. Each run is limited to five minutes, so make quick, clear decisions instead of over-thinking every play.
faq: What is the goal of Hand Daily?
Beat each ante's target score within four plays to win that ante, then clear all five antes to win the day. Each day's deck is the same for every player.
How do jokers work?
After you win an ante, you earn coins and can buy a joker that boosts every play after it. Multiple jokers stack, so their chip, mult, and suit or rank bonuses add together.

miki-oath.intro: Miki Oath is a story-driven precision platformer with 106 levels across ten magical worlds. Guide Miki past spikes, saws, and moving platforms as she works to save Luna.
tips: Study each new hazard before you jump. Watch how saws and moving platforms repeat their paths, then time your move for a safe gap.
Use quick, short jumps when precision matters. Holding a jump longer can carry you past a platform's edge or into a hazard.
Treat falls as practice. Restarts are fast, so try a tricky section several times in a row rather than stopping to rethink everything.
Pay attention to springs and teleporters. Plan your landing before you use them, since they can send you somewhere unexpected.
If a level keeps defeating you, step back and retry it later with a fresh focus. Rewarded ads are optional, so you only need them if you choose to skip a level.
faq: What is the goal of each level in Miki Oath?
Your goal is to reach the flag at the end of each level while avoiding hazards such as spikes and saws. Falling does not end your progress, so you can keep trying until you make it.
Which keys control Miki on desktop?
Use A and D or the Left and Right Arrow keys to move. Press Space, W, or Up Arrow to jump.

sum-sum.intro: SUM+SUM is a number logic puzzle where you clear extra numbers from a grid so that each row and column adds up to its target. It rewards careful checking of sums and steady, deliberate clicks.
tips: Start with rows or columns that have only one or two numbers left to consider, since their remaining choices are limited.
Check the target total for each row and column before clicking, and work out which numbers must stay to reach it.
Keep track of what you have already kept or removed, so you do not accidentally change a number you have already settled.
Use the reset option (3 clicks on a number) if a row or column gets tangled; starting that part again is often faster than fixing it piece by piece.
After each move, re-check both the affected row and the affected column, because one change affects both sums at once.
faq: What is the goal of SUM+SUM?
Keep only the numbers that make each row and each column add up to its specified sum, and remove the rest.
How do the clicks work?
One click keeps a number, two clicks deletes it, and three clicks resets it. Use these to set each cell to the state you need.

towers-505.intro: Towers 505 is a tower defense game where you place crossbow towers and stone fortifications along a winding orange path to stop waves of monsters. Each wave calls for a different approach, so plan your placements and upgrades carefully.
tips: Spend your gold coins on a mix of towers early, then upgrade the ones that cover the path where monsters bunch up most.
Watch which enemy types are coming next, since ground green slugs and fast white flying monsters may need different defenses.
Save your magic spells for tough moments, such as when a large group is close to your main tower, rather than casting them at the start of a wave.
Keep an eye on your heart counter: you have ten lives, and each monster that gets through costs you one.
When rain starts, expect enemies to be stronger, so consider adding or upgrading towers before the next wave arrives.
faq: What is the main goal of Towers 505?
Stop the waves of monsters from breaking through your line and reaching your main tower. You lose the stage if all ten of your lives are used up.
How do I get more gold to build and upgrade towers?
Gold coins are earned as you play, and you spend them on building towers and upgrading existing ones. Use the gold counter at the top of the screen to track what you can afford.

love-archer-hero.intro: Love Archer Hero is an archery puzzle where you play a Cupid aiming magic love arrows at creatures to pair them up. Each level asks you to match two characters using barriers and angles.
tips: Before you shoot, check whether the arrow can reach the target through the gap you see, since glass, ropes and wooden planks can block or redirect it.
Use the dashed trajectory line to test your angle before releasing, and adjust small amounts rather than dragging far each time.
Remember that the goal is to make two characters fall in love, so hitting only one of them may not be enough to finish a level.
Look for objects you can use to guide the arrow, such as ropes or planks, instead of aiming straight at the target every time.
Complete levels in order to unlock new ones, and expect each level to bring different characters and challenges, so adapt your approach as you go.
faq: What is the main goal of Love Archer Hero?
Your goal is to make two characters fall in love by hitting one or both of them with your magic arrows. Each level is a matchmaking puzzle.
How do I aim and shoot the arrow?
Drag with your finger on a touchscreen or with the mouse on a computer, then release to fire. A dashed line shows the path your arrow will take.

mem-brawl-merge-simulator.intro: Mem Brawl: Merge Simulator is a merge and clicker game where you buy meme fighters, combine matching characters, and build a squad for arena battles. Plan your merges and upgrades to grow your coins and team strength.
tips: Merge identical characters as soon as you can, since each merge creates a stronger fighter and higher levels bring more income.
Keep clicking the screen for manual coins early on, then let your farm memes handle passive income while you do other things.
Check the upgrade menu regularly and put your coins into the multipliers and passive earnings that grow your income fastest.
Before entering the arena, pick the three memes that are strongest, because your team strength decides the rewards you earn.
Return to the arena after you improve your squad, since stronger teams earn bigger rewards and help raise your ranking.
faq: How do I make a stronger character?
Buy two identical characters from the store and match them. Matching two identical characters combines them into a stronger one.
Where do coins come from?
Coins come from farm memes earning passive income over time and from quick clicks on the screen. You can spend them in the store and the upgrade menu.

capybara-let-s-go-zombie-rush.intro: Capybara Let's Go: Zombie Rush is a casual merge and auto battle game. You place pets on a limited grid, merge matching ones into stronger versions, and watch your team fight zombies in waves.
tips: Merge identical pets of the same level whenever you can, since one upgraded pet is usually worth more than two weaker ones on a crowded grid.
Plan your layout before starting each wave, because the grid space is limited and every pet you place takes up a spot you cannot use for another.
Use the pet pool refresh when your current options do not help your team, rather than filling spaces with pets that do not fit your plan.
Choose level-up skills with your overall team in mind, such as healing or area attacks, so your skills support each other instead of overlapping.
Save some gold for upgrading the units you already rely on, since stat upgrades for attack, defense, and speed strengthen your whole squad over time.
faq: How do I win a battle?
Deploy your capybaras, press Start, and let them attack automatically. Clear the enemy waves while keeping your camp's health above zero.
How do I lose the game?
Your camp starts with 100 base health. If enemies reach your camp, they reduce that health, and the game ends when it reaches 0.

broomcraft-mystic-evasion.intro: Broomcraft Mystic Evasion is an action game where you fly on a broom, battle waves of enemies, level up, and unlock new spells and brooms. Two modes offer leveled play with bosses or endless waves.
tips: Collect experience from defeated foes early on, since leveling up is what makes your character stronger for later fights.
Pick spells that work well together, because each one belongs to a different element and combining them is how you find your winning approach.
Spend your coins on a faster or more agile broom when your current one makes it hard to dodge, then upgrade it to raise its power.
Use the leap or rush move to escape crowds rather than standing still, since you are fighting hordes and need room to move.
In leveled mode, use your training time to learn new enemy types before you face the bosses, and in endless mode, plan to evolve your spells before the waves get harder.
faq: What is the main goal of Broomcraft Mystic Evasion?
You fly on a broom and battle hordes of enemies to gain experience, level up, and defeat challenging bosses. In endless mode, your goal is to survive wave after wave of monsters.
How do I move and use the leap or rush?
On PC, use WASD or the arrow keys to move and press Space for a broom leap or rush. On mobile, use the joystick to move and the Rush button to leap or rush.

dive-deep.intro: Dive Deep is an underwater treasure-hunting adventure. You explore a sunken world, avoid patrolling sharks and spiky pufferfish, and use a balloon gun and a hook gun to bring loot to the surface.
tips: Use the balloon gun on heavy chests first, since balloons that make a chest float are the easiest way to lift it up.
Use the hook gun's hold option for a quick grab when the treasure is close, and save the tow rope for longer hauls.
Watch the patrol paths of the sharks and pufferfish for a few seconds before you move, then pick a route that keeps a safe gap between you and them.
Keep the tow rope in mind when you are carrying loot, because you can release it with a second right click if you need to change direction quickly.
Pause with P or Esc to plan your route through a busy area, then resume when you know where the hazards are.
faq: How do I get heavy treasure to the surface?
Shoot balloons onto the treasure chest with the left click so it floats, which lets you lift it up. You can also use the hook gun to grab treasure and reel it in.
What is the difference between holding and tapping the right click?
Hold the right click to grab and pull treasure toward you. Tap it to lock a tow rope onto the treasure so you can drag it wherever you need to go.

monster-slayer-idle-clicker.intro: Monster Slayer is a clicker where you battle quirky monsters, gather resources, and build up your hero. Use the left mouse button to interact with objects and menus as you push toward tougher foes.
tips: Spend your Flame Shards on rare relics only after you have checked what each one offers, since they are your main trade currency.
Put your upgrades into the skills and spells that help you most in the fights you are currently facing.
Capture monster souls whenever you can, because a bigger collection gives you more to work with over time.
Use Inlay Stones and potions to boost your abilities before you take on a harder monster, not after you have already struggled.
Check your menus often with the left mouse button so you do not miss new options for your hero.
faq: What is the main goal of Monster Slayer?
You battle monsters, gather resources, and strengthen your hero to take on ever-stronger foes. Progress comes from building up your abilities over time.
How do I control the game?
Use the left mouse button to interact with objects and UI elements. Every action in the game, from fighting to managing upgrades, is done this way.

safari-merge.intro: Safari Merge is an endless merge puzzle where you combine matching animals up a real food chain. Keep the board clear, chain merges for bonuses, and see how high a tier you can reach.
tips: Before each drag, look for every pair you can merge and pick the one that frees the most space on the board.
Avoid letting the board fill with single animals that have no match, since they block room for new spawns.
Try to chain higher-tier merges in quick succession, because combos multiply your score and reward bonus.
Read the fact that appears with each new tier, since it helps you remember where each animal sits in the food chain.
If you are new, start on the easiest difficulty to learn how fast the board fills before moving to harder settings.
faq: What is the goal of Safari Merge?
There is no fixed win. The aim is to reach the highest tier and score you can before the board fills completely.
How do I merge two animals?
Click and drag one animal onto a matching one. Two matching creatures combine into the next animal up the food chain.

king-dungeon.intro: King Dungeon is an adventure survival game where the king, trapped after a cave collapse, must explore, mine, craft and build to find his queen. Fights with dwarves and orcs add pressure along the way.
tips: Use WASD, the arrow keys or a joystick to move, and get comfortable with the controls before you head into unfamiliar areas.
Gather resources by approaching the stones, and keep an eye on what you need before you start crafting or building.
Explore new areas of the dungeon, since this is one of the listed ways to level up faster.
Visit the forge to upgrade your character, and craft more advanced tools to speed up resource gathering.
Spend your coins on special resources or items that help your progression, rather than buying things you don't need yet.
faq: What is the main goal of King Dungeon?
The goal is to find and rescue the queen. You do this by exploring, crafting, mining, building and surviving in the dungeon.
How do I gather resources?
Move your character up to the stones to collect resources. Mining these is a core part of building your mine.

mole-kingdom-defense.intro: Mole Kingdom Defense is a tower defense game where you recruit mole heroes, arrange them into a team, and hold off waves of enemies and bosses to protect your kingdom. Progress comes from battles, upgrades, and idle rewards.
tips: Mix fighters, archers, and mages in your team so you can handle both close and long-range threats.
Spend coins on upgrades for heroes, weapons, and skills rather than spreading them thinly across everything.
Check your team layout before each wave and place your strongest heroes where they can reach the most enemies.
Collect the coins and resources you earn after every battle, since they are what you need to get stronger.
Before a boss stage, make sure your key heroes are upgraded, and use idle rewards to build up resources between sessions.
faq: What is the main goal in Mole Kingdom Defense?
Your goal is to defend the Mole Kingdom by defeating waves of enemies and powerful bosses, then unlock new stages.
What kinds of mole heroes can I recruit?
The game features fighters, sharp archers, and powerful mages, each with unique abilities. Choosing a mix helps your defense cover different situations.

robot-unicorn-dash.intro: Robot Unicorn Dash is an endless running game where you keep your Robot Unicorn alive across rainbow roads filled with gaps and dark crystals. The game gets faster and harder the longer you run, so timing is everything.
tips: Use the double jump as a backup rather than your first move, so you still have a second jump available if you misjudge a gap.
Watch the rainbow road ahead instead of the unicorn itself, so you can plan your jump before a gap or crystal reaches you.
Keep a steady rhythm of taps. Jumping too early often leaves you short of the next rainbow.
Grab stars when they are on your path, but never risk a crash just to reach one, since staying alive is what keeps your run going.
Expect the pace to increase over time. Practice short runs first to build reflexes before aiming for a new high score.
faq: What is the goal of Robot Unicorn Dash?
Keep your Robot Unicorn running for as long as possible while avoiding gaps and dark crystals. Your run ends when the unicorn is hit or falls.
What controls does the game use?
Tap once to jump and tap again while in the air to double jump. Timing these taps is the main skill in the game.

mega-ramp-car.intro: Mega Ramp Car is a driving game built around giant ramps, big jumps, and stunts. You pick a car, race through levels, perform tricks, and complete missions to unlock tougher challenges.
tips: Keep your speed under control before each ramp, since going too fast can make a landing harder to recover from.
Focus on landing your jumps cleanly rather than chasing the biggest air time, because a clean landing keeps your run on track.
Read the missions for each level before you start so you know what to aim for while you drive.
Use the rewards from finished missions and events to buy new vehicles, then try them on levels that felt too hard before.
Replay a level you finished to see whether you can complete it more successfully, since the game asks you to finish each one as well as you can.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Race across the giant ramps, perform jumps and tricks, and finish the level as successfully as possible. Completing the missions is also part of the goal.
How do I get new cars?
Earn rewards by completing missions and events, then use them to buy new vehicles. New cars help you take on greater challenges.

epicrolla.intro: Epicrolla is a one-tap isometric roller where you guide a ball across a diamond grid by flipping its direction. Survive the hazards long enough to reach each stage's tile goal.
tips: Watch the ball's path a few tiles ahead, not just the tile under it, so you can time your next tap before a gap, lava or box arrives.
Use the bounce off the edges to your advantage: a well-timed tap can keep you on safe tiles when the path ahead gets crowded.
Save Invincibility or Dodge for dense stretches with several hazards in a row, since a single power-up is most useful where you have the least room to react.
Use Slow-Mo when spinning portals or moving obstacles make the timing hard to read, then return to normal speed once the section clears.
Collect coins steadily and think about which permanent upgrade or the repeatable Second Chance will help your current problem most before spending them.
faq: What is the basic control in Epicrolla?
Click, tap or press space to change the ball's roll direction. Every press flips its heading left or right.
How do I clear a stage?
Travel the number of tiles the stage requires without falling into a gap, hitting lava, or crashing into an obstacle.

jade-toss-arrow-challenge.intro: Jade Toss: Arrow Challenge is a calm 3D skill game based on pitch-pot, the ancient East Asian game of tossing arrows into a jar. Pull back, aim, and let the arrow fly into the jade pot.
tips: Use the power drag to find a consistent pull length for each distance, since a longer pull throws farther and the pot moves away as you score.
Watch the wind before you throw and aim slightly to the side to counter it, rather than adjusting after the arrow has already drifted.
Aim for the centre of the mouth when you can, because landing there earns a Perfect bonus.
Protect your lives by taking a little extra time on each throw, since every miss costs one of your 5 lives.
Build toward three hits in a row to enter the zone and double your points, and try to keep that streak going as the pot gets farther and the wind gets stronger.
faq: How do I throw the arrow?
Hold the left mouse button or touch the arrow to grab it, drag down to set power, drag left or right to aim, then release or lift your finger to throw.
How do I earn more points?
Each hit scores points, chaining three hits in a row enters the zone for double points, and landing in the centre of the mouth earns a Perfect bonus.

bicycle-mountain-xtreme.intro: Bicycle Mountain Xtreme is a mountain biking racer where you ride trails, balance your bike, and perform stunts for points. Smooth, controlled riding is the key to going further and scoring well.
tips: Ease off the speed before bumps and steep slopes, since the physics are realistic and a hard landing can throw you off balance.
Keep your bike level in the air during jumps so you land stable and can keep your momentum going.
Chain stunts and clean landings together rather than rushing, because riding clean is what earns the points.
Spend the points you earn on stamina and strength once you have enough, so you can ride longer and feel stronger on tougher trails.
Watch how the weather and day/night cycle change the trail as you ride, and adjust your speed to match the conditions.
faq: What is the goal of Bicycle Mountain Xtreme?
The goal is to ride the mountain trails, perform tricks and stunts, and earn points. Points help you unlock new trails and upgrade your stamina and strength.
How do I keep my bike balanced?
Control your speed and ride smoothly, especially over bumps and slopes. Because the physics are realistic, sudden movements make it harder to stay stable.

bouncy-arrow.intro: Bouncy Arrow is a color puzzle where you aim arrows so they bounce and pop matching orbs. Each level rewards planning your shots in the right order.
tips: Study the full color pattern before your first shot so you know which orbs need to be popped first.
Trace the bounce path in your head before tapping, since the arrow can change direction and hit orbs you did not expect.
Think about move order: clearing an orb that blocks a path can open up the shot you need next.
Treat every arrow as valuable and avoid firing just to see what happens, because wasted shots make later levels harder.
If a level stalls, pause and re-check which colors are left and which direction still reaches them.
faq: How do I win a level in Bouncy Arrow?
Pop the orbs in the correct way and complete all the level goals. Once they are done, you move on to the next challenge.
What controls does Bouncy Arrow use?
Choose the arrow direction and tap to shoot. The arrow bounces on its own and pops the matching colored orbs it hits.

stick-master-teleport.intro: Stick Master Teleport is a ninja game about stealth and precise strikes. You jump across walls, throw weapons, and teleport to enemies to take them down in one hit.
tips: Take your time with the aim. Holding the button and moving to line up your shot before you release gives you the best chance of a single-strike kill.
Approach enemies quietly, since the goal is to eliminate them before they notice you. Plan your route before you act.
Pick your weapon to suit each mission. The game offers knife, sword, boomerang, and club, so think about which fits the situation.
Use walls and your jumps to get into position. Good positioning often matters more than a fast shot.
Treat the tricky puzzle levels as a chance to experiment. Try different approaches if a first attempt does not work.
faq: What is the main goal of Stick Master Teleport?
Your goal is to defeat enemies with a single strike, ideally before they notice you. The game combines stealth puzzles with teleportation to reach that goal.
How do I aim and shoot on PC?
Hold the left mouse button and move the mouse to aim. Release the left mouse button to shoot.

archer-madness-crystal-defense.intro: Archer Madness: Crystal Defense is a tower defense game where you place Arrow Towers to stop endless waves of monsters from reaching the Crystal Core. Build a defense that can handle every wave.
tips: Place your Arrow Towers at strategic spots along the enemy path so they can hit monsters for as long as possible.
Defeat enemies to collect coins and resources, then spend them on upgrades instead of building new towers right away.
Mix towers with different skills and attack styles so your defense can handle both weak and tougher enemies.
Watch which enemy types are coming and adjust your formation to match, rather than using the same setup for every wave.
Upgrade your archer's abilities and talents early, since stronger skills make it easier to survive the later, more dangerous waves.
faq: What is my main goal in Archer Madness: Crystal Defense?
Your goal is to protect the Crystal Core by stopping monster waves that keep coming. The game has endless waves, so you keep defending as long as the Core survives.
How do I earn resources to upgrade my defense?
You earn coins and valuable resources by defeating enemies. Use them to upgrade your towers, weapons, and talents.

doodle-rpg-survivor.intro: Doodle RPG Survivor is a notebook-themed survival game where you move through waves of classroom doodles while your spells fire automatically. Your main job is staying alive and choosing good upgrades.
tips: Since attacks cast on their own, spend your attention on movement first and keep your character away from the thickest groups of doodles.
Use Space to reroll when the offered upgrades do not fit your current spells, so you can build toward a combo instead of settling for a weak pick.
Open the backpack with B after picking up gear and equip anything better right away, since gear can be stacked and upgraded over time.
Pause with Escape when a wave gets crowded to check your options and plan your next move before continuing.
Pay attention to which spells you already have, and favor upgrades that work with them, since the game features spells with strong combos.
faq: How do I move my character?
Use WASD or the Arrow Keys. Because attacks fire automatically, most of your effort goes into dodging enemies.
How do I equip items I find?
Press B to open the backpack, then right-click or drag an item to equip it. You can also use point-and-click to move around the menus.

okay.intro: Okay? is a minimalist puzzle where you clear every object on the screen with one drawn line. Each level is a single move, so planning matters more than speed.
tips: Study the whole screen before you draw, and note where each block, line, and object sits.
Picture the bounce path in your head before you release, since the line keeps moving after you let go.
Pay attention to where your line starts, because the starting point decides the route it takes.
In harder levels, small changes in angle or timing can change the result, so adjust your drag slightly rather than making big changes.
If a layout seems impossible, look for an angle that hits two objects in a single bounce instead of trying to reach each one separately.
faq: What is the goal of Okay?
You must clear all the lines, blocks, and other objects from the screen. The level is solved when the screen is empty.
How do I draw a move?
Touch the screen, drag a line from a starting point, and release. The line then bounces around the screen and interacts with the objects.

tile-stack.intro: Tile Stack is a puzzle game where tiles fall from the top of the screen and you clear them by stacking matching tiles together. Each stack removes tiles and earns points as the difficulty rises.
tips: Scan the whole screen before you click, and look for tiles whose arrows point toward another tile you can reach.
Pick the stack that opens up space or clears a tile blocking others, rather than the first one you see.
Watch the arrow direction on each tile carefully, since moving a tile the wrong way can waste your turn.
Keep the stacks small and clear them early so the screen does not fill up as new tiles fall.
Slow down when difficulty increases and plan two moves ahead instead of reacting to each tile as it lands.
faq: What is the goal of Tile Stack?
Stack tiles together by moving a selected tile onto another tile in the direction its arrow shows. Each completed stack disappears and adds to your score.
How do I select and move a tile?
Click or tap a tile to select it, then move it to the tile that the arrow indicates. The tiles stack together and disappear when the move works.

hooked-panya-fishing.intro: Hooked! Panya: Fishing is a tap-timing game set on Bamboo River. Cast your line, keep the indicator in the green zone, and reel in 13 fish with different fight styles.
tips: Watch the indicator's rhythm for a few seconds before you start tapping, so you can time your reel taps to the green zone.
Fish with calm or heavy fights usually give you more time to correct your timing, while aggressive and erratic fish need quicker, steadier taps.
Use the Fish Scanner before you cast when you want to know how rare the next fish is, and save it for the moments that matter.
Use Lucky Bait when you are short on new species in Panya's Journal, since it guarantees your next catch is one you haven't seen yet.
Keep an eye out for junk on your line, and build streaks carefully, because a missed reel can end the chain that feeds into Endless Mode.
faq: What is the main goal of Hooked! Panya: Fishing?
Your goal is to reel in each fish by keeping the indicator inside the moving green zone until the catch is landed. You also work to fill every silhouette in Panya's Journal.
How do I control the reel timing on desktop?
Press Space to cast and to reel in rhythm. Click to use Steady Hands, Fish Scanner, Lucky Bait, or Pause.

crazy-emoji-blast.intro: Crazy Emoji Blast is a match-3 puzzle game with 10 levels. Swap neighbouring emojis to make lines, then use the bigger blasts and hidden bombs to hit each level's score target before you run out of moves.
tips: Look for moves that make a match of 4 or 5 instead of 3, since these create row, column or cross blasts that clear far more of the board.
Save larger matches for when you need them most, such as when the score target is still far away or the board is crowded.
Keep an eye out for bombs, and try to set up matches next to them so the explosion can reach as many surrounding cells as possible.
Count your remaining moves before each swap and aim for moves that score points and clear space, rather than small matches that do little.
Plan a chain reaction when you can: a blast that clears cells may leave new matches behind, so check the board again after each one.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Each level has a score target that you must reach within a limited number of moves. If you hit the target in time, you move on to the next level.
How do I make a match?
Tap or swipe two adjacent emojis to swap them. Three in a row or column makes a match and blasts those emojis.

magic-aim.intro: Magic Aim is a real-time arcade artillery game where a chibi magician fires arcing elemental blasts at waves of monsters. Read the wind, charge your shots, and clear each layout before the next one gets tougher.
tips: Check the wind gauge before every shot, since wind pushes your blast mid-flight and changes every few seconds. Adjust your aim to compensate rather than aiming straight at the target.
Hold to charge for power and release at the right moment. Test a few shots on each layout to learn how far your charged blasts travel.
Try splitting your shots at the apex so they spread into a fan. This is useful for clearing groups of monsters at once.
Raise your shield just before an enemy shot lands. Timing it well earns a perfect block, which refunds mana and gives you a speed burst.
Use dash-warp and movement to get a better angle when your current position makes a shot hard to line up. Keep an eye out for item drops that buff your next shots.
faq: What is the goal of Magic Aim?
Survive escalating waves of monsters and score as high as you can. Clear every monster in a layout to warp to the next, tougher one. Your run ends when you are defeated.
How is the score calculated?
Score rewards kills, speed, accuracy and style. Style includes splitting shots and perfect blocks.

hook-arena-3d.intro: Hook Arena 3D is a fast action fighter where you throw hooks across a river to pull enemies in or escape from danger. Keep moving, aim carefully, and use your escape skill when a fight turns against you.
tips: Aim with the mouse on PC or the right joystick on mobile before you throw, since a well-aimed hook is the fastest way to eliminate an opponent.
Hook enemies one at a time when they are close to the edge of the river or near a support, so a single pull can take them out of the fight.
Watch for physical supports like poles, and hook yourself to one when you are under pressure to get out of a bad position.
Save your shift (escape) skill for emergencies rather than using it at the first sign of trouble, so it is ready when you really need to get away.
Before a match, spend time on your upgrades and weapon choice, since your loadout shapes how you approach each fight.
faq: What is the main goal in Hook Arena 3D?
Hook enemies to eliminate them one by one across the river. You can also pull in rune bottles or hook yourself to a support to escape.
How do I throw a hook?
On PC, press Space or left-click. On mobile, tap the hook button on the right side of the screen.

nine-to-wonderland-card-duel-rpg.intro: Nine to Wonderland is a card duel where a standard deck works as your weapon. Build combinations, manage your mana, and reduce your rival's life to zero before they do the same to you.
tips: Check the preview before you commit. It shows the damage, healing and mana a combo will produce, so you can compare options before ending your turn.
Don't ignore small cards. They produce the most mana, so playing them can fund Blade, Shield or Swap for later turns.
Look for bigger combinations. A pair, flush or run hits harder than single cards, so it's worth holding cards that can join a larger hand.
Spend mana with a plan. Save it for Shield when a big hit is coming, and use Blade to sharpen a strike when you can finish your rival.
Use Swap when your hand is weak. It lets you trade up to three cards, which can help you reach a stronger combination next turn.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Reduce your opponent's life to zero to win the duel. Every card you play can strike, heal or burn your rival's mana.
How do I play a combo?
Click or tap a card to select it, then add more cards to build a single card, a pair, a flush or a run. Press Play to commit the combo and end your turn.

binary-drop.intro: Binary Drop teaches binary numbers through a block puzzle. Light up the right columns to match a target, or add up the lit ones and type the total.
tips: Work from the left column. Start with the 8, and turn it on only if the target is at least 8, then subtract and move to the 4.
On lime rows, subtract the largest value that fits from the target each time, and switch on the matching column. This is faster than trying random combinations.
On violet rows, add the lit values from left to right in your head before typing. Checking the total against the column values helps you avoid mistakes.
From level 3, scan the board for the row closest to landing before solving anything else. A landed row costs a heart, and you only have three.
Use the keyboard if you can: number keys to type, Backspace to fix a mistake, and Enter to confirm. Press P or Esc to pause and reset your focus when the board gets busy.
faq: What is the goal of Binary Drop?
Clear 40 rows to finish a level and unlock the next one on the level path. The round ends if you lose all three hearts.
How do I solve a lime row?
Tap the lights so the lit columns add up to the number shown on the right. Each column is worth 8, 4, 2 or 1.

rolling-cube-3d.intro: Rolling Cube 3D is a 3D obstacle course where you guide a cube through many levels to the finish line. You need to avoid traps while testing your agility and reaction time.
tips: Before you start rolling, look at the whole route to the finish line and note where the traps are.
Swipe in small, controlled movements so the cube stays clear of obstacles instead of overcorrecting.
Pay attention to the 3D layout, since the depth of a path can make edges and gaps harder to judge.
Stay calm and react early to obstacles rather than waiting until the last moment.
Use the first levels to learn how the cube responds to your input, then apply that to harder stages.
faq: What is the goal of Rolling Cube 3D?
Your goal is to lead the cube through each level's obstacles and reach the finish line while avoiding traps.
How do I start the cube moving?
Click and hold the mouse to make the cube start rolling.

merge-builders.intro: Merge Builders is a merge puzzle where you combine matching tools, upgrade them, and hand them to builders who construct a house step by step. Each new project asks more of your merging.
tips: Merge identical tools whenever you can, since upgrading efficiency is what helps your builders work better.
Give your strongest tools to the four builders so they keep working while you organize the rest of the board.
Keep some slots clear by merging or moving tools, so new boxes you buy have room to be useful.
Save Efficiency x2 and Auto-Open for stretches when you have a lot to merge or open, so the boosts count for more.
Read the requirements for each new building before you spend coins, and check the limited-time gift events for extra rewards.
faq: How do I merge two tools?
Drag one tool onto an identical one, and they will merge into an upgraded tool.
Do I have to keep tapping to build the house?
No. Once you drag a tool to one of the four builders, they start building automatically while you focus on the board.

talking-veggies-meme-merge.intro: Talking Veggies: Meme Merge is a physics-based merge puzzle where you drop vegetables into a jar and combine matching pairs into bigger ones. The aim is to build up toward the Boss Watermelon while keeping the jar from overflowing.
tips: Aim your drops toward the side of the jar where a matching vegetable already sits, so the two can touch and merge quickly.
Keep the middle area clear and build outward from the bottom so the stack stays low and stable.
Watch the top of the jar closely; a vegetable that rises near the rim is a warning to make room by merging nearby pairs.
Spend earned coins in the shop on upgrades when you have spare coins, since jar upgrades can make the board easier to manage.
Use crystals to open boxes only when you are ready, and check which meme skins and buffs they offer before opening more.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Drop vegetables and merge two identical ones to evolve them into larger ones, working up toward the Boss Watermelon. Each merge adds to your score.
How do I drop a vegetable?
On desktop, left-click anywhere above the jar. On mobile, tap anywhere on the screen. The vegetable falls under physics and lands where it hits.

the-sort-agency.intro: The Sort Agency is a 3D matching puzzle where you sort fruit, cakes and toys. Find three identical items to clear them from the playing field, and work through 1000 levels.
tips: Read the list at the top of the screen before you start each level so you know exactly which items you need to clear.
Scan the whole playing field for sets of three identical items before choosing, so you can plan which groups to remove first.
Work on the items you can see most easily first, and leave for later any item that seems hard to reach behind others.
Keep an eye on item types that appear only a few times, since they can be the last ones left and cause you to get stuck.
If you are stuck, look again for any set of three you may have overlooked before deciding a level cannot be solved.
faq: What is the goal of The Sort Agency?
Your goal is to remove all the items listed at the top of the game screen to pass each level.
How do I make items disappear?
Choose three identical items, and they will be removed from the playing field.

cockroach-tower-defense.intro: Cockroach Tower Defense is a top-down survival strategy game where you hold your base against waves of roaches. Your weapons fire automatically, so your main job is choosing upgrades and spending wisely.
tips: Spend mid-run upgrades early on whatever keeps your defenses firing longest, since small early gains compound over the waves.
Pay attention to which enemy types are getting through, and pick upgrades that answer that threat rather than buying at random.
