Keep an eye on the boss waves and plan ahead for them so you are not caught with an underpowered base.
Use your Public Support between runs on permanent stat boosts that match the way you lost last time, such as durability or damage.
Treat each run as a learning attempt: note which enemy variants caused problems and adjust your permanent boosts before the next run.
faq: What is the goal of Cockroach Tower Defense?
The goal is to defend your base against roach swarms for as long as possible, surviving increasingly difficult enemy variants and boss waves.
How do I play with mouse or touch controls?
Click on PC or tap on mobile to interact with the in-game buttons. Your weapons fire automatically during the run.

nummerge-clash.intro: NumMerge Clash is a number puzzle where you merge matching cards on a shifting board. Your aim is to reach the highest score and last as long as you can.
tips: Before each tap, look at the upcoming card queue so you can plan where new cards will land.
A tap merges a card with every matching neighbor at once, so look for groups that clear several cards in one move.
Keep some energy in reserve. The game ends when you have no moves left and no energy for tactical actions, so energy can rescue a stuck board.
Use swap to move a card next to a match when no direct merge is available, rather than waiting for a deadlock.
Long press a card to check its description and properties before you commit to a merge.
faq: How do I merge cards?
Tap a card (or left click on desktop) to merge it with all adjacent cards that have the same value. The merged card increases in worth.
When does the game end?
The game ends when there are no available moves left and you do not have enough energy for tactical actions.

happy-swing.intro: Happy Swing is a timing game where you jump and swing through the world to find a lost soul. Each well-timed move brings you closer, while one mistake can send you back.
tips: Watch the swing for a moment before you jump so you can judge its rhythm instead of guessing.
Focus on the release as much as the grab, since letting go at the right moment is what keeps your momentum going.
Stay calm and steady rather than rushing; a single mistake can send you backward, so one careful move is worth more than a fast series of attempts.
Use the same input method every time you play, whether that is mouse clicks on a computer or taps on a phone, so your timing becomes consistent.
Practice the rhythm in short stretches and notice which swings feel easiest to time, then apply that pattern to harder sections.
faq: What is the goal of Happy Swing?
Your goal is to find a lost soul by swinging and jumping through the world. You reach it by timing each jump and swing correctly.
How do I grab a swing point?
On a computer, click the mouse button to jump and grab onto points. On mobile, tap the screen to leap and grab onto swing points.

dicey-chickens.intro: Dicey Chickens is a tower defense game where your chicken heroes roll dice automatically to shoot monsters coming down the battlefield. Clear five waves per stage to protect your castle.
tips: Watch which faces your hero's die has before each run, since every roll decides what attack fires. Plan around the attack types you can see on the die.
Use the tap-to-reroll on a hero's die when a wave is pushing through and you need a hit right now, rather than waiting for the next automatic roll.
When you level up, favor spell upgrades that improve the faces you already roll often, so your strongest side becomes more reliable.
Pick spells with status effects like bleed, poison, freeze, or knockback when enemies are reaching the wall, because slowing or holding them back protects castle HP.
Spend coins, crystals, and weapon shards between runs on the hero you use most, so each run starts stronger instead of spreading upgrades thin.
faq: What is the goal of Dicey Chickens?
Clear all five waves in a stage to win and earn rewards. You lose if your castle HP drops to zero.
Do I control my heroes' attacks manually?
No, heroes roll their dice automatically. You can tap a hero's die at any time to force an instant reroll.

acox.intro: Acox is an arcade platformer with 30 levels. Your goal is to move your character past obstacles and reach the finish in each level before moving on to the next.
tips: Study each level's layout before you start moving, so you can spot the safe route and the spots where obstacles appear.
Make short, deliberate moves rather than holding a direction for too long, which makes it easier to stop in time near hazards.
If you fall or hit an obstacle, try the same section again with a slightly different approach instead of repeating the exact same move.
Take breaks between levels when you feel frustrated, since steady focus tends to matter more than speed in a game like this.
Remember that each level unlocks only after you complete the previous one, so it is worth taking your time on tricky stages.
faq: What is the goal of Acox?
Complete all 30 levels by reaching the goal in each one while avoiding obstacles. Finishing a level unlocks the next.
Which keys control the character?
Use the WASD keys or the Arrow keys to move. On mobile devices, use the on-screen touch controls instead.

bridge-bounce-jump-challenge.intro: Bridge Bounce: Jump Challenge is a fast 3D runner where you jump across a high bridge over water. Time your jumps to clear barriers, gates, and gaps while collecting coins and staying on the bridge.
tips: Watch the obstacles ahead rather than the ones right in front of you, so you have time to set up each jump.
Jump at a steady rhythm and try to keep your momentum going instead of stopping to wait for openings.
Learn the timing of gates and barriers early in the run, because a single mistake ends your attempt.
Grab coins when they are on your path, but never change your jump timing just to reach a coin if it puts you at risk of falling.
Practice short runs to get comfortable with the jump timing before you aim for a longer distance.
faq: How do I jump in Bridge Bounce?
You can click or tap, press the Spacebar, or use the W key or Up Arrow. All of these controls make your character jump.
What ends a run?
One mistake ends your run, such as hitting a barrier or falling into a gap above the water.

fruits-into-baskets.intro: Fruits into Baskets is a relaxed sorting game with no timer. Tap fruits to send them into place and clear the whole field to finish each level.
tips: Look at the field before you tap and find fruits that are not covered by others, since those can fall right away.
When a fruit is stuck, work from below by removing the fruits that block it first, rather than tapping at random.
Pay attention to your baskets. Collecting three matching fruits opens a new basket, so grouping similar fruits can help you make room for more.
If a fruit has no matching basket yet, it will wait on the temporary plate, so keep an eye on the plate as well as the field.
Take your time, since there is no timer. Pausing to check the layout between taps can prevent blocked fruits from piling up.
faq: What is the goal of Fruits into Baskets?
Your goal is to clear every fruit from the field and sort them into the right baskets. Clearing the whole field completes the level.
What should I do when a fruit is stuck?
Remove the fruits blocking it from below first. Once the way is clear, the stuck fruit can fall.

castle-claw.intro: Castle Claw is a fast arcade strategy game where you drop a claw into a capsule field to summon troops and push them toward the enemy castle. Each capsule pull can change how the battle unfolds.
tips: Line up the claw over a capsule before dropping it, since empty capsules do nothing and you want unit capsules that summon troops.
Watch which capsules are close to the claw's path so you can plan a quick sequence of drops instead of reacting late.
Your troops and the enemy troops fight on their own, so focus your attention on where and when you drop units rather than on micromanaging fights.
Spend coins between attempts with a clear plan, weighing claw size and speed against army health and damage based on how your runs are going.
Use pause with P or Esc when a level gets busy so you can check the field and decide your next drop calmly.
faq: How do I clear a level?
Destroy the enemy castle to clear the level. Your troops and enemy troops fight automatically, so your drops decide how well you press the attack.
How do I summon troops?
Move the claw left and right with Left/Right or A/D, then drop it with Down or Space. Unit capsules summon troops, while empty capsules do nothing.

mochi-mochi-tower.intro: Mochi Mochi Tower is an arcade stacking game where you drop moving mochi onto a growing tower. Your goal is to build as high as you can without letting pieces slide off.
tips: Watch the moving mochi for a moment before you tap, so you can judge when it lines up over the top piece.
Aim for the center of the tower. A piece that lands near the middle gives you a steadier base for the next drop.
Stay calm as the tower gets taller. Timing errors add up, so keep your taps steady rather than rushing.
Pay attention to the edges of the top mochi. If a piece hangs far over the side, the next drops have less room to land well.
Collect coins whenever you can, since they are used to unlock new mochi packs and mascots for later play.
faq: What is the main goal of Mochi Mochi Tower?
The goal is to stack mochi as high as you can by dropping each moving piece onto the tower. The taller the stack, the better your run.
How do I control the game?
Tap the screen or click anywhere to drop the moving mochi. The game uses only this single action.

buttons.intro: Buttons is a physics-based plinko adventure set in a hand-drawn scrapbook world. You launch a ball, watch it bounce through the board, and battle grumpy felt monsters as you move forward.
tips: Watch a few bounces before you commit to a second launch, since the ball's path depends on how the pegs and surfaces push it.
Read each upgrade choice carefully and pick the one that helps the way you already play rather than chasing every option.
Use the included tutorials early on so you understand how launching and the battles work before the harder stages.
Take short breaks between runs to reset your focus, as the physics can reward patience more than quick repeated launches.
If a monster is hard to beat, try a different launch angle or upgrade path on your next attempt instead of repeating the same shot.
faq: What is the main goal of Buttons?
You launch a ball down a plinko-style board, battle the felt monsters, and progress through the adventure by using the upgrades you pick.
How do I control the game?
Use the left mouse button to launch the ball and make your selections.

balls-ricochet.intro: Balls: Ricochet! is an arcade shooting game where you aim a ball so it bounces off walls and blocks to clear the level. Each shot can knock out several blocks at once, so planning the angle matters.
tips: Before you shoot, look for angles where the ball will bounce off a wall and then hit a cluster of blocks.
Aim at the spots where bounces can reach several blocks in one path, since one shot can clear more than one block.
Watch how the ball reacts to each surface so you can predict where it will travel after a few bounces.
Take your time with each shot, because the ball physics are the core of the game and a small change in direction can change the result a lot.
Try to beat your own previous score, or a friend's, by clearing levels with fewer wasted shots.
faq: What is the goal of Balls: Ricochet!?
Your goal is to destroy the blocks on each level by setting the direction of the ball. The ball uses walls and blocks to ricochet, so one shot can knock out several blocks.
How do I control the ball?
You set the direction of the ball before each shot. The rest of the movement comes from the ball bouncing off the walls and blocks.

pop-them.intro: Pop Them! is a color matching puzzle where you link groups of emojis of the same color to pop them. Clear your goal within a limited number of moves, using power-ups when they help.
tips: Look for groups of three or more matching emojis before you link anything, and pick the connection that clears the most of the goal at once.
Remember that links can run in any direction, so check vertical and diagonal paths as well as the rows across the board.
Plan around the move limit: a move that sets up a chain reaction is often worth more than a small single pop.
Pop the bubbles around boxes and evil emojis early when you can, since they are the targets you need to destroy to complete the mission.
Save power-ups for boards where the goal is hard to reach with normal links, rather than using them on the first easy move.
faq: How do I pop emojis in Pop Them!?
Link three or more emojis of the same color by connecting them. Links can go in any direction, and the connected emojis will burst together.
What is the goal in each round?
You must reach the goal shown for the round within a limited number of moves. Popping the bubbles around boxes or evil emojis is part of completing the mission.

bounce-td.intro: Bounce TD combines tower defense with physics puzzles. Your towers only fire after an energy ball hits them, so you protect your base by planning how the ball travels.
tips: Before you launch, follow the likely path of the energy ball, including where it will bounce. Planning the route matters more than reacting quickly.
Use ricochets to reach towers that the ball cannot hit directly. A single bounce can activate several towers at once.
Look for setups that start a chain reaction, where one activated tower leads the energy to the next. These often clear waves faster than isolated shots.
Watch how each new level changes the layout and enemy waves. Adjust your approach instead of reusing the same shot, since difficulty rises over time.
Keep your aim steady and take your time. Precision is the core skill, so a careful shot is usually better than a rushed one.
faq: What is the goal of Bounce TD?
Your goal is to protect your base from endless waves of enemies. You do this by getting the energy ball to hit your towers in the right order.
What makes the towers different from normal tower defense?
Your towers only activate when hit by a special energy ball. You need to plan the ball's trajectory so it reaches them.

sledding-hills.intro: Sledding Hills is an arcade sliding game with several worlds, including deserts, snowy mountains, and forests. You push off, steer your sled down the hill, and collect coins to upgrade your ride.
tips: Use the push at the start to get your sled moving well before you reach the first slope.
Steer in small, steady moves with A and D on desktop, or the joystick on mobile, rather than sharp turns that can slow you down.
Collect coins whenever you can, since they are used to upgrade your sled and personalize your character.
Try the mini-games when you want a different challenge, and aim for a high score to place on the leaderboard.
Explore the different worlds and keep an eye out for secret skins, which can be unlocked as you play.
faq: How do I start a run?
Use the on-screen joystick to push your sled at the start, then slide down the hill. Building a good start helps you move through the run more smoothly.
How do I steer my sled on desktop?
Press A to move left and D to move right. On mobile, use the on-screen joystick for turns.

laser-slasher.intro: Laser Slasher is a casual puzzle-arcade game where you aim laser turrets at blocks to destroy them. Clear every block to finish each level, using one-tap controls and buffs along the way.
tips: Watch where the lasers are heading before you click, since a single click reverses their direction and you can easily send them back over blocks you already cleared.
Use the hold control to freeze the turrets when they are lined up on a cluster of blocks, then release to keep the beams hitting that spot.
Collect the buffs that drop from destroyed blocks, because gathering them makes your turrets stronger and helps you finish the level faster.
Look for buffs that add more lasers or more damage first, and go after them even if it means changing your aim for a moment.
Take short breaks between levels, since the game is designed for relaxed play and can be enjoyed in quick sessions or longer ones.
faq: What is the goal of Laser Slasher?
Your goal is to destroy all the blocks on each level by aiming and reversing the direction of your laser turrets.
How do I change the direction of the lasers?
On PC, click the left mouse button or press Space. On mobile, tap and release. Either action reverses the direction of the turrets.

trap-the-bear.intro: Trap the Bear is a turn-based puzzle where you move penguins across an Arctic ice floe to box in a polar bear. Each of your moves is followed by a move from the bear, so plan ahead.
tips: Before every move, check the bear's possible jumps. A penguin standing next to the bear with an empty space behind it can be caught, so avoid leaving that gap open.
Use cracked ice to your advantage by luring the bear onto it. It breaks after something steps off, which can remove a path you would otherwise have to block.
Whale holes cannot be crossed, so treat them as permanent walls when counting the paths left open to the bear.
Keep the seal in mind as a blocker, since the bear cannot jump over it. Placing it between the bear and an open landing spot can shut down a jump.
For three stars, focus on not losing any penguins first and then on fewer moves. Use Undo to test an idea, and use Hint only when you are truly stuck.
faq: How do I win a level?
You win by blocking every path so the bear has no legal move left. Surrounding it completely ends the level.
How do I lose a level?
You lose if the bear catches too many penguins or if your penguins run out of legal moves. Watch the penguin count as well as the bear's position.

puzzle-fight.intro: Puzzle Fight mixes block puzzles with automatic battles. Place blocks to clear rows and columns, and each clear makes your cat knight Fluffy stronger for the fights ahead.
tips: Clear lines whenever you can, since every cleared line gives Fluffy experience and makes her stronger for the battle that follows.
Keep open space on the grid so you always have room for the next block. Running out of space ends the puzzle round.
Before placing a block, check which rows and columns it will complete. Setting up near-full lines lets you clear several at once.
Spend coins and crystals on chests, then equip and fuse weapons and amulets in the Inventory to strengthen Fluffy.
Use the x2 button to speed up battles once you are confident your heroine will win easily, and slow down when a boss or tougher wave is ahead.
faq: How do I win a puzzle round?
Drag block shapes onto the grid and fill a whole row or column to clear it. You win the round by clearing lines before you run out of space for new blocks.
How does the puzzle affect the battles?
Between puzzles, Fluffy fights enemies automatically. The more lines you cleared in the puzzle, the stronger she is and the easier the battle becomes.

carmania-io.intro: CarMania.io is a fast car racing and stunt game where you race down ramps, dodge moving obstacles, and land jumps to reach the finish. You can run the solo obstacle-course campaign or race other drivers online.
tips: Use Q and E to air roll while you are in the air, so you can line up your car before you land.
Brake with S before tight turns, then tap Space for the handbrake to help your car swing around the corner.
Keep your momentum by avoiding hard, last-second steering. Start weaving with A and D early when you see moving obstacles ahead.
Try the solo obstacle-course campaign to learn where the jumps, shortcuts, and braking points are before you race other drivers online.
Spend a few runs on each course focusing on clean landings rather than speed, since a bad landing can cost you the run.
faq: What is the main goal in CarMania.io?
Reach the finish line of each course without flying off the track. Every run rewards speed, balance, and precision.
How do I keep my car balanced after a jump?
Use Q and E to air roll left or right while airborne, then land with your car level to keep your momentum.

mercenary-keep-siege-defense.intro: Mercenary Keep: Siege Defense is a castle defense action game where you hold your keep against waves of bandits, undead and witches. You focus fire, time your shield and spend gold to grow stronger as the waves get harder.
tips: Watch the red-marked enemies closely and save Shield (W) for their heavy blows, since it only lasts 5 seconds before it needs 5 seconds to recharge.
Use Fire Pots (E) when enemies bunch together at the right side of the screen, because they hit dense groups far more effectively than single targets.
Tap or click the enemy closest to breaking through to focus your crossbow fire where it matters most.
Read each boss's wind-up animation before reacting, then press the matching button rather than guessing, since every boss has its own move you can see coming.
Spend gold steadily on upgrades and new floors early so your defenses keep pace as the waves grow, and save Crown's Wrath (R) for a moment when it can turn a dangerous push around.
faq: What is the goal of Mercenary Keep: Siege Defense?
Your goal is to hold your keep against enemy waves coming from the right and survive as many waves as you can.
How do I attack enemies?
Your heroes fight on their own, and you can tap or click an enemy to focus your crossbow fire on it.

dicey-paws-idle.intro: Dicey Paws Idle is a calm idle arcade game where cube animals roll across a board, smash tiles for coins, and keep working while you watch. Merge matching animals, clear sectors, and push through the 16 worlds.
tips: Roll an animal yourself when you can, since manual play pays more than letting the team work alone. Use idle time for check-ins rather than constant play.
Merge identical animals as soon as you have a pair, because each new species brings its own trick, such as treasure or an earthquake, that can speed up your progress.
Spend coins on upgrades steadily instead of hoarding them, so your board keeps pace with the sector goals.
Watch for the new biome that arrives every five sectors and read its special rule before you start, since it changes how the board plays.
When sectors start to drag, begin a new expedition to earn shards and permanent bonuses that make the next run stronger.
faq: How do I move my animal around the board?
Touch the board and drag, and a joystick appears to steer your animal. On a computer you can also use the arrow keys or WASD.
How do I get a new animal species?
Drag two identical animals onto each other in the Animals tab to merge them into a new species. Available species include kitten, fox, panda, piglet, and bear cub.

wooden-blocks-3d-take-it-apart.intro: Wooden Blocks 3D: Take It Apart is a calm 3D puzzle about removing wooden blocks from sculptures one piece at a time. Each block slides out only along its brass arrow, and only when its path is clear.
tips: Before tapping anything, rotate the sculpture and check each piece from a few angles to see where its arrow points.
Look for pieces with open space in front of their arrow and remove those first, since blocked pieces cost an attempt when tapped.
Work from the outside of the sculpture inward, because the central pieces are often held in place by the ones around them.
Keep an eye on your remaining attempts and use the magnifier to highlight a free piece when you are unsure where to start.
On rush orders, pick the easiest free piece each time rather than searching for the perfect move, so you keep the clock moving.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Remove every piece from the sculpture to clear the level. Each block must be slid out along its own brass arrow.
What happens if I tap a piece that is blocked?
The piece stays pinned and you lose one attempt. Rotate the sculpture to find an open path before tapping again.

animal-royal.intro: Animal Royal is a player versus player battle game where you place animals and birds to protect your meat and eat your opponent's. Each unit has its own strengths and weaknesses.
tips: Learn what each animal and bird is good at before you commit to a plan, since every unit has different strengths and weaknesses.
Keep some of your meat protected rather than sending every animal out at once, so your opponent cannot quickly reach it.
Use the merge feature to combine two animals into a higher-level card when you have duplicates, as this makes your army stronger.
Pay attention to what your opponent sends into the battlefield and react by adjusting which of your animals you deploy next.
Check the daily challenges and rewards regularly, and aim to win battles to collect more cups.
faq: What is the main goal of Animal Royal?
Protect your own meat from being eaten by your opponent's animals while sending your animals to eat as much of their meat as possible. The player who does this best wins the battle.
How do I move my animals on the battlefield?
Use drag and drop with your mouse: hover over an item, press and hold the left mouse button, drag it to a new position, then release the button to drop it in place.

lanternborne.intro: Lanternborne is a dark fantasy survivor-style action game where Ilan, the last lamplighter, walks a cursed road through demon-filled lands. Your weapons fire on their own, so your focus is on movement and positioning.
tips: Keep Ilan moving in wide loops rather than standing still, since your weapons aim at the nearest demon and you need space to keep them in range.
Relight the street lamps you pass on the way, as the description says the dark cannot spawn in lit areas, which makes lamps a safe zone to retreat toward.
Spend coins between levels on upgrades that improve the weapons you already have rather than buying many weak new ones.
Check the Chained Merchant and chests when they are close, because they only trigger when you walk up to them, so plan a short detour for them.
Use the pause key P to step back and look at the map layout before you push forward into a crowd.
faq: What is the goal of Lanternborne?
Walk the Lamplighters' Road to the exit of each level, relighting lamps along the way, and push through 100 levels across 10 lands until you reach Lucifer.
How do I control Ilan?
On touch screens, drag one finger to steer him. On desktop, use WASD or the arrow keys, or hold the left mouse button to walk toward the cursor.

arrowshift-classic.intro: ArrowShift:Classic is a 3D arcade puzzle where you free every arrow on a cube to clear the stage. You start with small cubes and move up to huge ones, and you can unlock cube skins along the way.
tips: Rotate the cube before you act and look at every face, since arrows on hidden sides are easy to miss.
Zoom out with the mouse wheel or a pinch gesture on larger cubes so you can see the whole shape at once.
Before sending an arrow, check that its path out of the cube is clear, and start with the arrows that can leave right away.
Use Esc on desktop to pause when you need a moment to plan your next moves without rushing.
Take a quick look at the whole cube after each clear to spot the next arrows you can free.
faq: What is the goal of ArrowShift:Classic?
The goal is to free every arrow on the cube to clear the stage. Each stage must be fully cleared before you move on.
How do I send an arrow?
On desktop, left click an arrow to send it. On mobile, tap the arrow.

mine-block-breaker.intro: Mine: Block Breaker is a physics-based arcade game where you launch a sword-wielding hero into an arena of breakable blocks and enemies. Aim well, bounce around the battlefield, and let your spinning sword do the fighting.
tips: Use the drag-and-release aim to think about where your hero will bounce before you launch, since each shot sets up the next one.
Save your Dash for moments when you are close to enemies or need to reach a cluster of blocks quickly, rather than using it at random.
Pay attention to which blocks and enemies remain after each bounce, and aim your next launch at the areas with the most targets.
Between runs, look at your upgrades and buffs with your overall strength in mind so you build toward the challenges of later Arena waves.
Open chests and check the equipment you collect, then compare options before choosing one, so your hero grows in a consistent direction.
faq: What is the goal of Mine: Block Breaker?
Your goal is to launch your hero around the arena, break blocks, and defeat enemies while your spinning sword fights for you. As you progress you face increasingly challenging Arena waves.
How do I aim and launch my hero?
On desktop, hold the left mouse button on your hero, drag to aim, and release to launch. On mobile, touch and drag your hero to aim, then release to launch.

milord-we-have-a-zombie-problem.intro: Milord, We Have a Zombie Problem is a medieval tower defense game where you hold your keep against a huge undead horde. Build towers beside the road, aim them by hand, and use spells to stop the dead before they arrive.
tips: Place towers on walls or raised ground near the road so their sweep covers the same stretch where enemies pass. This gives each tower more time to fire.
Set each tower's aim point before you press Space to start, so the first wave meets your strongest coverage.
Save the Royal Fireball for dense groups of zombies, since holding the click keeps it casting on the crowd.
Press Space to pause during a battle when the horde is closing in, and use the pause to adjust aim or cast spells calmly.
After each battle, compare what you earned in the War Council and choose upgrades that strengthen the towers you already rely on.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Keep the dead from reaching your keep until the whole horde is gone. Each battle is won by stopping every enemy before it breaks through.
How do I build and aim towers?
Pick a tower from the bottom bar or press keys 1-7, then click the walls or raised ground beside the road. Click or drag to set the aim point, since towers sweep around it.

chicken-farm-3d.intro: Chicken Farm 3D is a relaxing farming sim where you start with an empty plot and grow it into a working egg business. Raise chickens, sell eggs, and expand your coops over time.
tips: Keep the trough filled before you do anything else, since well-fed hens are what keep your egg income going.
Sell eggs as soon as you have a batch, then spend the coins on one clear goal such as another hen or a bigger coop instead of spreading them thin.
Check the egg orders and missions regularly, because completing them raises your reputation and earns extra coins.
Build a coop before buying a lot of hens so you have room to grow your flock without crowding.
Walk your farm between tasks with Shift to run and E to interact so you can cover ground quickly while you collect eggs and tend the trough.
faq: What is the main goal of Chicken Farm 3D?
Grow your farm from an empty plot into a thriving egg business by raising chickens, selling eggs, and completing missions. Coins and reputation show your progress.
How do I earn coins?
Collect eggs and sell them at the market, and complete missions and egg orders to earn more coins. Use those coins to buy chickens, buildings, and upgrades.

prison-escape-push-the-guards.intro: Prison Escape: Push the Guards is a 3D action game where you push police officers off platforms to reach the finish. Each section adds more guards, so positioning matters as much as speed.
tips: Before you push, drag to line up several guards in a row so one shove can knock back a whole group.
Keep your own prisoner well away from the platform edge, since one bad move can end the run.
Look for an angle that clears a path to the finish rather than pushing straight into the nearest crowd.
Keep moving between shoves so the guards do not close in around you.
Spend coins on the weapons and customization options you find most useful for your playstyle.
faq: What is the goal of Prison Escape: Push the Guards?
Clear the required enemies in each section and reach the finish without falling off the platforms.
How do I push the guards?

On desktop, move with WASD or the arrow keys and press Space to push, or hold the left mouse button, drag to move, and release to push. On mobile, touch and drag to move, then release your finger to push.

dumpling-clicker.intro: Dumpling Clicker is an idle game where you tap a dumpling to build your count, then spend dumplings on upgrades and steamer cases. Progress keeps going while you are away, so a few focused sessions can add up.
tips: Use the BEST DEAL badge in the right panel as a quick guide, since it marks the upgrade that gives the most return for what it costs.
Keep an eye out for the golden dumpling when it appears and tap it, since it is a limited chance to gain extra dumplings.
Check the CASES tab regularly and open steamers when you can afford them, because each new dumpling you collect has its own passive ability.
Try equipping different dumplings in the wardrobe and compare their passive abilities to find the mix that suits how you play.
Claim your daily gifts and achievements whenever you visit, since they add to your collection without extra effort.
faq: What is the goal of Dumpling Clicker?
The goal is to grow your dumpling count by tapping, buying upgrades from Grandma, and collecting new dumplings from steamer cases. Over time you work toward the Dim Sum Galaxy.
Can I play with the keyboard?
Yes. Space or Enter will tap the dumpling, so you can keep playing without using the mouse.

relax-box-asmr-mini-games.intro: Relax Box is a calm collection of 21 ASMR-style toys in a pastel world. There is no losing and no timer, so you can take each toy at your own pace.
tips: Start with the hand demo on any toy you haven't tried, then use the Next button in the top right to move through the collection without going back to the menu.
Check the relax tasks under the zen panel when you're unsure what to do next, since they point to the next thing to try.
In Spa Day, follow the glowing tool in the tray before choosing an accessory, so each client is cleaned up in the right order before you take a photo.
In Power Wash, switch to the next tool once one has done its job, rather than repeating the same tool until the whole car is covered.
In Pop It, if you are playing vs Bot, leave the last bubble alone, because popping it is the losing move.
faq: What is the goal of Relax Box?
There is no goal to reach or score to beat. Each toy is simply something to play with at your own pace, and the zen tasks suggest what to try next if you want direction.
Can I lose any of the games?
No. The game has no losing state and no timers, except that in Pop It vs Bot you should avoid popping the last bubble.

frostport.intro: Frostport mixes a snowboarding run, a snowmobile chase and a town to build up between missions. Early habits like tucking for speed and keeping your vehicles close will make the story missions much easier.
tips: Use Shift to tuck on the board when you are racing an avalanche, since speed is what keeps you ahead of the snow.
Hold the jump button for a grab when you ollie, and land it cleanly so you keep your speed for the next jump.
Keep your snowmobile or car nearby with the call key before a chase, because you will need a ride quickly after getting out of a fight.
Check the map before each run to find cash stashes and side jobs, and to choose a route that avoids the police when you are on foot.
Set up your businesses before you leave the valley, since they earn money while you are offline, and save your Fresh Powder run for the first descent of the day.
faq: How do I get out of a vehicle that has tipped over?
Press R to flip a stuck vehicle back onto its wheels. Use it whenever a snowmobile or car gets stuck on the slope or in the snow.
What does the ice axe do?
Throw the ice axe to climb ice and rock, and to catch the lift cables for a zipline ride down the mountain. It is the way to reach places where a police car cannot follow.

save-the-puppy-remove-the-screws.intro: Save the Puppy: Remove the Screws is a colorful puzzle where you tap screws to take them out, match colors, and clear obstacles to free the puppy. Each level builds on the last.
tips: Before every tap, check which screws are blocking others. Removing a blocking screw first often opens up several moves at once.
Look for pairs of the same color that sit next to each other in the bottom area. Clearing a matching pair is the main way to make progress.
Avoid filling the bottom area with mismatched colors. Keeping matching screws close together makes it easier to clear them.
Save your boosters for levels where you are truly stuck. Try the board on your own for a few moves first to see what you can solve yourself.
When a new construction or obstacle appears, study how it is arranged before you act. Early levels teach the basics, so use what you learned there.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Your goal is to remove screws and clear obstacles until the puppy is freed. Each level ends once the puppy is saved.
How do I remove a screw?
Tap a screw to remove it. Choose each tap carefully, because some screws are held in place by others.

hexlands.intro: Hexlands is a relaxing 3D adventure where your hero works automatically, so you can focus on exploring. Buy new hexes, cross islands, and make your way toward the Lost Crown.
tips: Hexes cost you to unlock, so spend on land that gives you access to the resources you need most, such as trees and rocks near your village.
Before heading to a new island, check that your tools, sword, armour and lantern are upgraded at the Forge, since the next island may be harder.
Turn raw materials into planks, bricks, bars and gems at the workshops, because the higher-value items are what you will need for upgrades.
Hatch pets at the Nest and pick ones whose jobs match what you are short on, since each pet has its own role.
Keep your lantern in mind before dark. At night you only see what it lights up, and monsters get bolder, so plan to be back on safe ground by then.
faq: What is the main goal of Hexlands?
Your goal is to reach the Lost Crown on the far side of the world. To get there, you explore islands and defeat the guardian on each bridge to enter the next one.
Do I need to control my hero during fights?
No. Your hero chops trees, mines rocks and fights monsters automatically when you stand next to them, so your job is mainly to move and choose where to go.

tricky-queue-logic-puzzle.intro: Tricky Queue is a logic puzzle where you put a line of festival animals into the right order. Read each clue, swap animals until every rule holds, then check your answer.
tips: Start with the clue that fixes one animal's exact spot, since it gives you a fixed point to build the rest of the queue around.
Before swapping, compare two or three clues side by side to see which animals they both affect.
Use the clue cards as a checklist: after each swap, re-read the rules that involve the animals you moved.
If you make a move that leads nowhere, use Undo right away instead of trying to fix it with more swaps.
Save Hint for a puzzle that has stalled, so you can still work through the logic yourself on the easier ones.
faq: How do I swap two animals?
Drag one animal onto another, or tap or click two animals one after the other. Their places will switch.
How do I know when a puzzle is solved?
Once the order follows every clue, press Check Order to confirm your answer.

zone-breaker.intro: Zone Breaker is a 3D destruction game where you blast cars, houses, castles and skyscrapers into bricks. Collect the bricks, sell them for coins, and upgrade your rockets, bombs and backpack to smash bigger things.
tips: Aim at the base or supports of a building, since breaking what holds it up makes the whole structure collapse and gives you more bricks faster.
Keep an eye on your backpack and press SELL when it fills up, so you are not stuck waiting while bricks cannot be collected.
Spend early coins on a larger backpack when you can, because it lets you carry more bricks before you need to sell.
Head to newer areas once you reach the level needed to unlock them, since each new area gives more bricks per block.
Use the 1 and 2 keys or the mouse wheel to switch between rocket and bomb, so you can match the tool to the target without opening menus.
faq: What is the main goal of Zone Breaker?
Destroy structures to fill your backpack with bricks, sell them for coins, and use those coins to upgrade your gear and level up. Reaching level 55 lets you Rank Up for more coins per brick.
How do I get more coins from each brick?
Unlock new areas, since each one gives more bricks per block. Reaching level 55 and using Rank Up also increases the coins you earn per brick.

sheeps-herd-them-all.intro: Sheeps: Herd Them All! is a cozy puzzle where you tap animals so they run to the pen. Each level requires finding the right order of moves to free every animal.
tips: Before you tap, look at which way each animal faces and which animals are in its path. Start with an animal whose route is already clear.
Work backwards from the blockers. If an animal is stuck behind another, free the one in front first.
Save your boosters for hard spots. Use Flip when one animal is facing the wrong way, Remove when two animals are jamming a route, and Shuffle when the field has no clear opening.
Keep track of bomb sheep. They explode after 3 collisions, so avoid sending other animals into them.
When a timer sheep appears, free it first. It explodes if you don't get it out in time.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Free all the animals by sending them to the pen. Each level is a puzzle, so the order of your taps matters.
How do the animals move?
Tap an animal and it runs straight in the direction it faces. If the path is clear, it escapes; if another animal is in the way, they collide and stop.

lacoria-castle-defense.intro: Lacoria Castle Defense is a 3D tower defense and idle game where you protect a citadel from waves of mythical beasts using elemental mages, castle upgrades, and rune crafting. This guide covers useful habits for surviving longer and getting a higher score in Endless Trial Mode.
tips: Check the three upgrade tabs regularly with J, K, and L so you do not leave Power, Survival, or Control upgrades unbought for too long.
Use R to cycle target priority and switch to Boss First when a boss phase begins, so your attacks focus on the threat that matters most.
Combine runes in the Forge to add Freeze, Lava Burn, or Chain Lightning to your attacks, then choose the effect that fits the beasts you face most often.
Turn on auto-cast for your ultimate with A if you want to free up your attention, and keep manual Space for moments when a wave suddenly gets dangerous.
Use the T or Tab speed boost once your defense is stable, since higher speeds process waves faster but leave less time to react to problems.
faq: How do I use the hero's ultimate skill?
Press Space to unleash the Hero Ultimate Skill. You can also press A to toggle auto-cast so the ultimate fires on its own.
What does Endless Trial Mode ask of me?
Endless Trial Mode sends infinite, escalating monster waves, so the challenge keeps increasing. Your goal is to survive as long as possible and push for a high score.

avocado-yard-ragdoll-sandbox.intro: Avocado Yard is a ragdoll physics sandbox where you place toys, push avocados around, and cause chain reactions. You can also work through challenges and missions to earn stars.
tips: Build a small test setup first, such as a crate stack or a plank ramp, and drop an avocado onto it to see how the physics behave before you add more pieces.
Use Freeze on heavy objects like anvils or crates while you arrange the scene, so nothing shifts when you place the next item.
For mission runs, plan your moves before you start, since each mission gives you a limited number of actions and you need to earn the full three stars.
Keep red barrels and bombs away from the parts of the scene you want to keep, because one blast can set off a chain reaction across the whole yard.
In Rampage, focus on high-impact setups like barrels, trampolines, and explosions, since you have only 60 seconds to build your score.
faq: How do I earn stars?
You earn a star for each challenge you complete, and missions give up to three stars depending on how well you finish them. Stars unlock premium toys like the homing rocket and black hole.
What is the fastest way to throw an avocado?
Press on the avocado, drag in the direction you want, and release to throw it. Lining up the drag before you release gives you more control over where it lands.

obby-mini-games-vs-1000.intro: Obby: Mini-Games VS 1000 is a Squid Game-style obby where you face a series of challenges, from hammers and math spikes to rolling balls, and try to outlast the other players.
tips: Watch the timing of the Savage Hammers and rolling balls before you move, and step out of their path rather than trying to run past them.
On Math Spikes, work out the answer calmly before you move. Rushing a wrong answer can cost you the run.
On Falling Tiles, keep moving instead of standing still, since staying on one tile too long can make it collapse.
In Dancing Tiles, pay attention to the music and be ready to change position quickly when it stops, so you are already on the right color.
Use Spacebar to jump and C to crouch to get past obstacles, and combine them with WASD for quick movement. On mobile, use the on-screen controls in the same way.
faq: What is the goal of Obby: Mini-Games VS 1000?
You need to get through each challenge and be one of the strongest players left out of 1,000. The last players standing are the winners.
How do I attack in the game?
Press the left mouse button to attack. On mobile, the attack control appears on the screen.

midway-malarkey.intro: Midway Malarkey is a 2D arena shooter set at a 1930s carnival, where rascals pour out of every tent. Your weapons fire on their own, so your job is mainly moving, dodging, and picking the right upgrades.
tips: Spend most of your attention on movement and dodging, since your weapons already fire automatically. Keep moving rather than standing still in one corner.
Save your Dash (Space) for emergencies, when enemy shots are closing in around you. Using it too early can leave you exposed when you need it most.
Between waves, plan your tickets before you enter the Prize Booth. Look for upgrades that fit the weapons you already have so you can merge them into stronger ones.
Pay attention to weapon families, since collecting related weapons unlocks bonuses. Build toward one family instead of picking up a random mix.
In the Endless Show, the difficulty keeps climbing, so focus on staying alive over clearing every rascal. In the Daily Show, read the twist before you start and adjust your plan to it.
faq: What is the goal of Midway Malarkey?
The main goal is to survive the waves of rascals while collecting tickets and building stronger weapons. In the Endless Show, you keep going for as long as you can.
How do I move and dash?
Move with WASD, ZQSD, or the arrow keys. Press Space to dash, and press Esc or P to pause.

sea-restore.intro: Sea Restore is a clicker where you fill a meteor crater with water and build a seaside town. Tap the pump, grow your stations, and keep the sea working while you are away.
tips: Spend your early coins on a stronger pump and a few workers, since water is what drives everything else in the game.
Check which goods your collectors are carrying to the store, and keep your stations supplied so the town buildings always have materials to craft.
Look at the delivery truck orders before selling goods, because filling an order can bring in more coins than selling the same items one at a time.
Tap trash whenever it appears in the water, and watch for glowing eggs so you can catch them and hatch more sea monsters.
Fill the tide meter when you can to get a high tide with extra water, and remember the sea keeps working while you are away, so check back to collect your progress.
faq: What is the main goal of Sea Restore?
The goal is to fill the dry crater with water and turn it into a living sea. Once the sea is full, you can start a new cycle and climb the leaderboard.
How do I earn coins in Sea Restore?
Sell goods or fill orders for the delivery truck to earn coins. Workers and collectors help move goods to the store so you can sell them.

squishy-clicker.intro: Squishy Clicker is a cozy idle game where you squeeze a 3D squishy to earn coins. Squishies you buy keep earning while you are away, so you can build up steadily over time.
tips: Buy squishies steadily, since they earn coins every second and keep working when you are not playing.
Try to own 25, 50 or 100 of one kind, because each of those milestones doubles that squishy's income.
Tap quickly in short bursts to fill the bar and trigger a mega squeeze.
Keep an eye out for the golden squishy floating by, and tap it when it appears to get coin rain and frenzies.
When your progress starts to slow down, consider rebirthing on the Stars tab, since each star adds +10% income permanently.
faq: How do I earn coins fastest?
Tap or click the squishy to earn coins, and buy squishies on the Squishies tab so they earn coins every second. Upgrades on the Upgrades tab can boost both your taps and your squishies.
What does rebirth do?
Rebirth on the Stars tab gives you softness stars, and each star adds +10% income forever. The description says these stars make every new round faster.

demolition-foreman.intro: Demolition Foreman is a first-person demolition simulator where every board, brick and panel reacts to how it is held up. You bring buildings down by choosing where and how to strike, and you earn stars for the share you demolish.
tips: Before you swing, look at what holds the structure up. Knocking out a wall that carries the roof or cutting a post can bring down the parts around it without extra work.
Start with a small job such as the old fence to learn how wind-up and release affect the blow before you move on to bigger buildings.
Use right mouse button to aim where the blow comes from. A strike from a different angle can break a joint or fixing that a straight hit would not.
Switch tools with 1-9 or the mouse wheel as the job changes. Save the heavier tools for structural parts and use lighter ones for nails, boards and trim.
Check how much of the building is still standing now and then, since you are paid for the share you bring down, not for the number of swings.
faq: How do I earn stars on a job?
You are paid for the share of the building you bring down, and each job gives up to three stars. Stars can then be spent in the research tree.
How do I hit things with the tools?
Hold the left mouse button to wind up and release it to strike. Use the right button with the mouse to set where the blow comes from.

trick-paws.intro: Trick Paws is a platformer where the floors, platforms and traps can be fake. Guide a small cat through 100 levels across four worlds, shooting or stomping enemies and racing to the yellow flag.
tips: Watch for platforms and floors that look solid but may crumble or turn out to be fake. Test suspicious ground with care rather than committing to a long run across it.
Use the double jump to correct a bad landing or reach a higher ledge, and keep it in reserve for moments when a single jump is not enough.
Stomp enemies from above when you can, and save the blaster for enemies you cannot safely reach by jumping on them.
Collect gold coins in quick succession to keep your combo multiplier growing, and pick up gems when they are on your route without taking big detours.
Expect a boss fight at every 5th level, so use the levels before it to practice your timing and build up your coin combo.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Reach the yellow flag at the end of the level. The game also rewards you for finishing with zero fails.
How do I score more points?
Collect gold coins quickly to build combo multipliers, and grab the shiny gems you find along the way.

contra-jungle-breach.intro: Play as Mara in this fast 2D run-and-gun rescue mission across ten areas. Move, aim and jump your way through jungle outposts, frozen facilities and an alien lair.
tips: Practice aiming while you move, since most fights require you to keep running and shooting at the same time.
Watch enemy shots before you commit to a jump, and time your jumps so you clear incoming fire instead of landing into it.
Save your dash for emergencies, such as when you are cornered or surrounded, because it is most useful as an escape tool.
Reload during a quiet moment rather than in the middle of a fight, so you are not caught with an empty weapon when enemies arrive.
If a section keeps wearing you down, choose an easier difficulty to learn the enemy patterns, then move back up once you feel comfortable.
faq: How do I move and shoot at the same time?
Use WASD or the arrow keys to move and aim, and press J or X (or use the mouse) to fire while you keep moving.
What happens if I lose a life?
You can return to a checkpoint after losing, and you can press R to retry. Pressing P or Esc pauses the game.

crumple-rumble.intro: Crumple Rumble is a stickman fighting game drawn on notebook paper. You pick a doodle fighter, string together punches and kicks, and use weapons and special moves to beat your rival.
tips: Chain punches and kicks into combos rather than throwing single hits, since a steady string of attacks keeps the pressure on your rival.
Keep an eye on your power bar and save it for a moment when the opponent is open, so the special move lands when it counts.
Watch for the dizzy state. When your rival is dizzy and the announcer shouts Wrap it up!, your next hit decides the ending, so make it a strong one.
Use Block when your rival starts a combo, then counterattack once the chain ends, rather than trading hits blindly.
Try the four arenas in different modes to learn how each one changes the rules, and use the dark mode and low gravity switch to test how your moves feel.
faq: How do I win a fight?
Knock your rival down with combos and special moves until they are dizzy, then land a final hit once the announcer calls Wrap it up!
How does the special move work?
Charge your power bar and then press I to fire a special move. Save it for openings instead of using it the moment it fills.

jelly-bottle-sort.intro: Jelly Bottle Sort is a colour-sorting puzzle where you pour jelly between bottles until each bottle holds one colour. Earn stars by solving the 100 fixed puzzles efficiently.
tips: Before each pour, check which colour sits on top of every bottle, since you can only pour onto an empty bottle or one with the same colour on top.
Try to empty one bottle completely early on, because a free bottle gives you more room to rearrange the other colours.
Use Undo when a move leaves you stuck, and use Restart to test a different route rather than undoing many moves one by one.
Save hints for levels where you are truly stuck, since hints cost coins and using an extra bottle caps that attempt at two stars.
If you want the most stars, plan a few moves ahead so each colour is finished in as few pours as you can manage.
faq: How do I win a level?
Fill every bottle so that each one holds only a single colour. Tap a bottle to select it, then tap an empty bottle or one whose top colour matches.
How are stars earned?
Stars are awarded for solving a level efficiently. Using an extra bottle as help limits that attempt to two stars at most.

hit-masters-rush.intro: Hit Masters Rush is a running action game where you guide a little hero across rooftops, jumping and shooting bandits and their weapons. Each run is a chance to beat your previous score and unlock new avatars.
tips: Watch the rooftops ahead so you can decide early whether to jump or shoot the next enemy.
Use the spacebar to slow down time when a crowd of bandits or weapons gets dense, giving you room to react.
Keep your shots aimed at the threats that are closest to the hero, since they are the ones most likely to stop your run.
Try to keep moving forward rather than stopping to fight every enemy, because distance is the main goal.
Play several attempts in a row and focus on one skill at a time, such as timing jumps or aiming, to steadily raise your score.
faq: What is the main goal of Hit Masters Rush?
The goal is to get the little hero as far as possible by eliminating bandits and their weapons on the building roofs. Each attempt is also a chance to improve your score.
Which keys control the hero?
Press W to jump, press the spacebar to slow down time, and use the left mouse click to shoot. On screen, you can also tap the buttons to shoot and jump.

nuts-bolts-sort.intro: Nuts Bolts Sort is a brain game where you sort bolts and nuts by type. The rules are simple, but the levels get harder as you progress.
tips: Before each move, check which colors are on top of each bolt, since only matching colors can be stacked together.
Keep at least one bolt with free space when possible, because a move needs enough room on the target bolt.
Avoid burying a color under other nuts early on, since it can block the rest of the level.
If you notice you are stuck, restart the level instead of making many more moves that may not help.
Save the free props for harder levels where you have run out of clear moves.
faq: How do I move a nut?
Click on a bolt to move its nut to another bolt. Choose the destination carefully, because the move must follow the color rule.
Can I stack any colors on a bolt?
No. Only nuts of the same color can be stacked and sorted together on a bolt.

rope-chef.intro: Rope Chef is a physics puzzle where you cut ropes so ingredients swing or float into a pot in the order shown on the recipe card. Getting the order right serves the dish.
tips: Read the whole recipe card before your first cut so you know which ingredient must land first.
Use the ghost line to preview where an ingredient will swing before you commit to a cut.
Watch for the twist in each world, such as bounce pads, fans, or a moving pot, and plan your cut timing around it.
Aim for the spice and the par time as well as serving the dish, since those extras decide your stars.
If you get stuck on a dish, skip it and come back later with fresh timing rather than repeating the same failed cut.
faq: What is the goal of Rope Chef?
Cut the ropes so each ingredient enters the pot in the order the recipe card shows. Serving the dish in the correct order completes the level.
What happens if I drop the wrong ingredient first?
Dropping the wrong one first, or missing an ingredient, makes Nibbs swoon and the dish fails. You can try the level again.

besties-halloween-fashionista.intro: Besties Halloween Fashionista is a dress-up game where you style four best friends for a spooky party. Each bestie has her own level, and you build looks from several wardrobe categories.
tips: Fill every wardrobe tab, including Dresses, Hair, Shoes, Accessories, Necklaces and Earrings, because that is what earns the 3 stars.
Use the arrows to move between categories so you don't miss a tab before pressing Done.
Try "Surprise me" for a starting outfit, then swap out any single piece you don't like instead of rebuilding the whole look.
Watch the pumpkin meter as you add items, since it fills by picking one item from every tab.
If a look isn't working, tap "Take everything off" and start again with a clear idea, such as a theme you want to match.
faq: How do I earn 3 stars for a bestie?
Fill every wardrobe tab by choosing an item from each one, then press Done to show off her look. Filling every tab is what earns the full 3 stars.
How do I unlock the next bestie?
Earn 3 stars on the current bestie to unlock the next one. You can then choose her from the level select.

build-obby-world.intro: Build Obby World is a cozy obby where you start on a tiny island, gather resources, and build pieces of other islands to reach new places. Crafting, exploring, and collecting slimes and pets are all part of the fun.
tips: Gather resources on your starting island before you try to build outward, since you need materials to construct the pieces that reach new areas.
Stand near a resource and wait, because your character starts mining automatically. This lets you focus on planning your next build.
Spend gold on better tools for faster gathering, such as an improved pickaxe, so you can collect materials more quickly.
Keep an eye on your crystals, since they can be exchanged for gold to buy improved tools.
Use the camera rotation to look around before you jump, so you can line up platforms and avoid falling during obby sections.
faq: How do I move forward in Build Obby World?
You open new ports and locations by building pieces of other islands. Gather resources first, then use them to construct the path to the next area.
What are gold and crystals used for?
Gold and crystals can be spent on essential materials like an axe or an improved pickaxe. Crystals can also be exchanged for gold to buy better tools for faster resource gathering.

streetracer-realistic-destruction.intro: StreetRacer: Realistic Destruction is a driving sandbox with a open world, car customization, and physics-based damage. Drive, crash, tune, and explore at your own pace.
tips: Press B for slow motion during a crash to see how parts break off, which helps you learn how the damage physics work.
Try Wheel and suspension tuning before a run, then compare how the car handles on flat roads and on ramps.
Use the C key to switch camera angles so you can follow debris and wheels from the best view after a collision.
Use K to repair when your car is badly damaged, so you can keep testing crashes or driving without starting over.
Use the interactive press and ramp areas to launch the car on purpose, then experiment with different speeds and angles to see the results.
faq: How do I drive the car?
Use W, A, S, and D to drive. Hold Space for the handbrake and Shift for a boost.
How do I repair my car?
Press K to repair the car. Use it when damage is slowing you down or when you want to try another crash.

super-car-driving-3d-simulator.intro: Super Car Driving 3D Simulator is a racing game set in an open world city. You drive, drift and do burnouts with a physics-based sports car, with no traffic or police to worry about.
tips: Learn the car's handling on open roads before you attempt tight turns, since the physics engine makes weight and speed affect how the car slides.
Build up speed gradually before drifting. Entering a drift too fast can make it hard to recover control.
Use the keyboard controls listed in the game's instructions and practice switching between acceleration, steering and braking until the inputs feel natural.
Try burnouts in a clear area first to see how much the rear tires slip, then apply the same idea when you want to show off a stunt.
Explore the whole city to find wide roads and open spaces, which give you more room to practice drifts and long, smooth runs.
faq: What is the main goal of Super Car Driving 3D Simulator?
The game is about driving freely through an open world city. You can drive, drift, perform stunts and do burnouts at full speed.
Do I need to worry about traffic or police?
No. The game removes the need to brake for traffic or race rival cars, and police do not chase you while you drive.

swat-cats.intro: SWAT Cats is a multiplayer cat shooter with fast-paced maps. You start as Private Nine-Lives and can team up with friends or chat with other players during matches.
tips: Keep an eye on your weapons: keys 1 to 5 switch between the general gun, pistol, knife, bomb, and heal, so switch before you need one.
Press R to reload between fights so you are not caught with an empty gun when an enemy appears.
Use aim mode with the right mouse button when you have time to line up a shot, and fire with the left mouse button or Lctrl.
Open the map with M early in each match to learn the layout of the area, since the maps are built for fast action.
Team up with friends and use the in-game chat with T to coordinate movement and call out positions.
faq: How do I switch to a different cat fighter?
You start as Private Nine-Lives. The description says you can switch to other fighters in later online matches.
Which keys change weapons?
Press 1 for the general gun, 2 for the pistol, 3 for the knife, 4 for the bomb, and 5 for the heal option.

snowy-adventures-with-noob-and-pro.intro: Snowy Adventures with Noob and Pro! is a two-player co-op game for one shared screen. You grow and decorate a Christmas tree by playing mini-games, throwing snowballs, and collecting toys.
tips: Agree on roles before you start. One player can focus on the mini-games that earn Bucks while the other handles snowball battles or delivery tasks.
Spend Bucks on the tree and ornament upgrades that give boosts, since boosts make later mini-games easier to earn from.
In the falling-Bucks mini-game, keep an eye on the bombs and move out of their path before going for the next coin.
Claim your daily bonuses every time you play, since gifts and freebies add up over time and help you buy decorations.
Check your crafting options regularly. Combining items can produce legendary decorations, so keep duplicate or spare toys rather than discarding them.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Grow and decorate your Christmas tree by earning Bucks and Gifts from mini-games. A larger tree brings more rewards, and a higher tree and collection place you higher on the leaderboard.
How do the two currencies differ?
Bucks are used to water the tree, upgrade ornaments for boosts, and level up mini-games. Gifts are used to buy more Christmas tree decorations.

dreamy-home.intro: Dreamy Home is a calm 3D puzzle where you unpack boxes of personal items and decide where each one belongs. You work room by room at your own pace to build a cosy space that tells a story.
tips: Open a box and look at the item before you move it, since small objects and heirlooms often hint at where they fit in the room.
Work one room at a time so you can see how the space is filling up and avoid placing items that block others.
Save the Hint booster for an item you have tried in more than one spot, so it is used when it really helps.
Use the Freeze booster when the timer is running low and you need a moment to think about where a few items should go.
Try the Compass when several items are hard to place, since it reveals the locations of any four items at once.
faq: What is the goal of Dreamy Home?

The goal is to unpack boxes of personal items and place each one in a suitable spot, room by room, until the space feels like a cosy home. The game describes the process as relaxed, with no need to rush.
How do I move an item on a computer?
Click on an item with the mouse, hold the mouse button down, and drag the item to where you want it. Release the button to place it.

citadel-fortress-defense.intro: Citadel: Fortress Defense is a first-person medieval strategy game where you build a town and defend it from raids that grow stronger each day. You play as the Lord, managing resources, building defenses, and fighting alongside your soldiers.
tips: Build walls and gates before the raid arrives, since enemies such as goblins and bandits can break through weak points.
Keep your town hall protected above all else, because if it falls the game is over.
Gather wood, stone, gold, and food steadily early on so you can afford defenses and soldiers when raids get harder.
Prepare for the boss that arrives every fifth day by strengthening your defenses and upgrades beforehand.
Use renown to buy upgrades and raise stone walls as the raids intensify, and use Q and E to switch soldiers when you need to fight directly.
faq: What is the goal of Citadel: Fortress Defense?
The goal is to survive as many days as possible in endless survival. The game ends if your town hall falls.
How do I build structures?
Press B to enter build mode, pick a building with keys 1 to 9 or 0, place it with left mouse button, rotate with R, and cancel with right mouse button.

sky-balls-3d.intro: Sky Balls 3D is a two-player sports game where you roll a ball along a narrow track high in the sky. Keep the ball on the path, dodge obstacles, and collect coins and keys along the way.
tips: Do not coast in the early rounds. Practise small, steady corrections so you are ready when obstacles start appearing.
Watch for changes in the track ahead, such as missing guardrails, narrowing roads, curves, and steep inclines, and start adjusting before you reach them.
Road barriers should be avoided or gently steered around. Make small direction changes early instead of sharp turns at the last second.
Pick up coins and keys when it is safe to do so, since they unlock new ball skins, sky-boxes, and scenery upgrades.
In two-player mode, keep your eyes on your own ball. Looking at your opponent can cost you focus and send your ball off the edge.
faq: What is the goal of Sky Balls 3D?
Keep your ball on the track and avoid falling off while collecting coins and keys. These let you unlock new ball skins and sky-boxes.
Which keys control the ball in each mode?
In 1-player mode, use WASD or the arrow keys. In 2-player mode, Player 1 uses WASD and Player 2 uses the arrow keys.

drift-city.intro: Drift City is a 3D driving game where you burn tires around busy city traffic to earn drift points. Use the points to buy new cars and climb toward the top of the drift rankings.
tips: Use the handbrake (Space) to start a slide, then steer with A and D or the arrow keys to hold the drift. Holding a steady angle usually earns more than short, sharp slides.
Keep an eye out for drift bonuses in the city. They only appear for limited periods, so plan your route to pass through them while they are active.
Collect bonuses to raise your drift score, and try to chain them together in one run rather than stopping after each one.
Nitro (F) gives you a burst of speed, so save it for long, straight stretches where you can set up the next drift without losing control.

Switch between the 4 cameras with C to find the view that helps you judge distance to traffic and walls. Traffic is part of the challenge, so avoid crashing into it when you want your drift to keep going.
faq: How do I earn points in Drift City?
You earn drift points by burning tires and drifting through the city. Collecting drift bonuses also raises your drift score.
What can I spend my drift points on?
You can buy new cars with the points you earn. The game has 6 different cars to purchase.

sandlab.intro: SandLab is a falling-sand sandbox where over 270 materials react to each other on their own. Pour, mix, heat and cool materials to see what happens, and use the goals to guide your experiments.
tips: Press G to open the goals list, which gives short challenges like boiling water or growing a plant. They are a good way to learn how materials interact before you experiment freely.
Use the pause key and the step-frame key to advance one frame at a time. This makes it much easier to see exactly which material triggers a reaction.
Switch views with V to check the temperature or flammability of your setup before you add fire or heat. This helps you predict what will ignite or melt.
Change the brush size with [ and ] so you can draw fine details for small reactions and wide strokes for filling large areas.
Undo with Ctrl + Z after a mistake, and save to one of the three slots before a big experiment so you can return to a setup that worked.
faq: How do I know what I have discovered?
Open the goals and reactions window with G. It lists the reactions you have found out of the 199 total.
How can I change the conditions in the room?
Press R to open room settings, where you can change temperature, gravity, wind and heat flow. Presets such as Moon, Arctic, Inferno and Upside down are also available with one click.

super-frog-adventure.intro: Super Frog Adventure is a classic-style platformer with 8 levels of obstacles, enemies and coins. Guide the frog to the finish line and collect every fruit to clear each stage.
tips: Collect all the fruits in each level, since the level only lets you pass once you have them all. Keep an eye out for them while you plan your route.
Use the double jump to reach high platforms or to correct a jump that falls short. Press jump again while in the air.
Look at each obstacle before you commit to a jump. Watching an enemy's movement for a moment will help you time your move.
Coins are worth picking up along the way, but don't take risks that could cost you the run. Focus first on getting safely to the fruits and the finish.
If you are new to the game, start with the easier difficulty level to learn the jump timing. Move up once you can handle the obstacles without stopping.
faq: What is the goal of Super Frog Adventure?
Guide the super frog through 8 levels to the finish line. You must collect all the fruits in a level to pass it.
How do I control the frog on a desktop?
Use the Left and Right arrow keys or A and D to move. Press the Up arrow or W to jump.

f-e-a-r-silent-facility.intro: You play response officer Ada, cutting off a signal that predicts deaths in a troubled research complex. This 2D horror shooter rewards careful movement, patient aiming and steady use of cover.
tips: Watch for enemy aim warnings before you move into an open lane, and step back into cover until the threat passes.
Fire single shots rather than rushing, since each shot is precise and you only have seven rounds before a reload.
Reload during quiet moments, such as when you are behind cover and no enemy is in view, so you are not caught empty.
Save focus energy for dangerous crossings or tight rooms, where slowing time gives you the most value.
Check terminals and interact with them when the area is clear, and use local checkpoints as a safe point to return to after a tough scene.
faq: How do I move and jump through the facility?
Use A and D or the arrow keys to move, and Space or W to jump. Use S or Space to drop through catwalks when you need to go down.
How do I aim and fire?
Press J or left click to fire a single shot. Shots are precise, so take your time to line up each one.

ragdoll-survivor.intro: Ragdoll Survivor is a physics-based stick fighting game set in a war zone. You punch, kick, block and grab your way through enemies and falling hazards across 100 missions.
tips: Watch for the red warning from soldiers and press block (C) before their attack lands, rather than trying to dodge late.
Use dash (Shift) to close distance or get out of danger quickly, especially when bombs, rockets or saw blades are falling.
Keep an eye on your SUPER bar and save it for a tough moment, since filling it lets you enter RAGE mode.
Learn each boss before pushing forward. Each chapter ends with one, so take your time to read their patterns and use your block and dash to stay safe.
Spend coins on new fighters and gear once you find a style you like, and try Boss Rush or Endless to practice your timing outside the story missions.
faq: What is the goal of Ragdoll Survivor?

Your fighter is stuck in a war zone and must stay alive by beating enemy soldiers, knife fighters, riot shields and tanks. Progress through 100 missions across 10 chapters, each ending with a boss fight.
What controls do I need to know on the keyboard?
Use A and D to move, W to jump, S to duck, F to punch, G to smash, C to block, Shift to dash, E to grab and R to use SUPER. Gamepad is also supported.

craftsman-land.intro: Craftsman Land is a farming and crafting game about restoring a flood-damaged town. You rebuild your inherited farm, grow crops, look after animals, and help townsfolk through quests and trading.
tips: Gather or craft your own materials early, such as chopping wood and firing clay into bricks at the campfire, so you are not held back by shop purchases.
Before you click to build or craft, check that you have the required items and resources, since actions run automatically once you start them.
Feed your chickens and cows regularly so you can collect eggs and milk, which you can use for crafting or trading.
Finish the quests from townsfolk to earn rewards and move the story forward. When they run out, check the bulletin board at the crossroads for new tasks.
Pick a few favorite activities and focus on them to improve your skills faster, since the game rewards specialization.
faq: What is the main goal of Craftsman Land?
Your goal is to rebuild the inherited land after a flood, expand your farm, and support the local community. Restoring your farm and helping the townsfolk are central to the game.
How do I find new tasks once I finish the quests?
Head to the crossroads where the bulletin board offers an endless supply of new tasks. You can check it whenever you run out of quests.

obby-parkour-with-ragdoll.intro: Obby: Parkour with Ragdoll is a parkour course game with three maps, lava, ice, and moving obstacles. You can also punch other players off the map for rewards.
tips: Learn the jump timing on Map 1 before moving on, since one wrong step drops you into the lava.
On Map 2, watch how the rotating obstacles and moving blocks cycle before you commit to a jump.
Do not stop on disappearing platforms. Keep moving so you cross them before they vanish.
On the ice map, make short, controlled moves and plan your landings, because slippery surfaces carry you past your target.
Use LMB to punch opponents near edges or hazards, and collect crystals and coins along the way for rewards.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Complete each parkour map and reach the finish. Along the way you can collect crystals and coins and earn rewards.
How do I earn rewards from other players?
Push or punch opponents off the map using LMB, and you earn rewards for knocking players off.

football-soccer.intro: Football - Soccer is a sports simulation where you control a player on a 3D pitch in realistic stadiums. You can join championships and tournaments against teams from around the world.
tips: Learn which keys do what when you have the ball and when the opponent has it, since the Left, Up and Right arrows change function depending on possession.
Use WASD to position your player before you act, so your pass or kick starts from a clear angle rather than a rushed touch.
When the opponent has the ball, use the Left arrow to switch to a different player who is closer to the ball, then press Up to try to win it back.
Hold the Right arrow to accelerate when you need to outrun a defender, but keep an eye on your stamina so you are not slow in the later minutes.
On mobile, check the on-screen text hints on each button early on, so you know which action each one performs before a match gets fast.
faq: How do I score a goal?
When your player has the ball, press the Up arrow to kick towards the opponent's goal. Line up your player with the goal first to improve your chances.
How do I take the ball from an opponent on PC?
When the opponent has the ball, press the Up arrow to take it. Use the Right arrow to follow the player with the ball and keep up the challenge.

horizon-flight-into-the-light.intro: Horizon: Flight Into the Light is a 3D runner where you glide toward the setting sun, steering between white towers and chasing blue crystals to keep the light alive. Every 3 km brings a new world with fresh obstacles.
tips: Keep an eye on the sun's height as well as the path ahead, and start steering toward blue crystals before it gets low.
Building shadows make the sun set faster, so favour lines that keep you out of them when you can.
