The game is about stealing birds from other players in the 3D world. Becoming the king is the stated aim, and the leaderboard with G shows how you rank.
How do I move and jump?
Use W, A, S, and D or the arrow keys to move around. Press Space to jump.

sort-it-out-category-sort.intro: Sort It Out: Category Sort is a 90-second head-to-head card sorting duel on a 5×4 wooden grid. Drag cards from stacks into the matching gold category slots before your rival does.
tips: Scan the top cards of every stack first and note which ones match the three gold category slots, so you know where to start.
Only completed categories score, so it is usually better to finish one category fully than to leave several half filled.
When a needed card is buried, move the top card to a free shelf slot or a blank grid cell to reach the one underneath.
Keep a few shelf slots open, since they are your main tool for digging through stacks.
Wrong drops snap back without penalty, so you can test a card on a category, but avoid wasting seconds on repeated guesses.
faq: How do I win a match?
Complete more categories than your rival before the timer hits zero. Each completed category is worth 1 point, and ties go to you.
What happens if I drop a card on the wrong category?
The card is rejected and snaps back to where it came from. You only need to drag it to the matching gold slot.

sheep-simulator-animal-games.intro: Sheep Simulator Animal Games is an open world adventure where you play a wild sheep, build your sheep family, and explore the city. This guide covers the controls and a few habits to help you get through missions and dangerous animals.
tips: Check the Info screen (I) early to confirm what each control does before you head into the city.
Use Sprint (Shift) to get away from dangerous animals, and save your normal movement for exploring and finding coins.
Use the Attack key (E) only when you need it, and keep an eye on the dangerous animals before you move in close.
Use the Actions key (F) when you are near something you can interact with, such as missions or family members, so you do not miss a step.
Pause (P) when you need a moment to plan your route, and use the camera controls to look around before you move into unfamiliar areas.
faq: How do I move my sheep and look around?
Use the AWSD keys to move and use the mouse to move the camera. On mobile, use the joystick to move and drag the screen to move the camera.
How do I pause the game or change settings?
Press P to pause the game and press Ctrl to open the settings.

night-order-pick-and-pack.intro: Night Order: Pick & Pack is an arcade game about gathering the items on each order and fitting them neatly into a box. Work through the selection stage first, then pack carefully to earn more stars.
tips: Check the full order before you start tapping, so you know exactly which items to collect and do not pick up extras.
Place heavier or larger items in the box first, then fill the gaps with smaller ones to keep the packing compact.
Try a spot, and if an item does not fit, rotate it before moving it somewhere else; this often solves a tight spot faster.
Return an item to the tray when you see it blocking a better arrangement, rather than forcing it into a poor position.
Use a hint only when you are truly stuck, and restart the layout if the box has become too messy to repair.
faq: What is the goal of Night Order: Pick & Pack?
Your goal is to select the items shown in each order, place them on the tray, and pack them into the box.
How do I select items during the selection stage?
Tap the items shown in the order, and they will be placed on the tray.

fruit-slicer.intro: Fruit Slicer is an arcade game where you swipe the screen to cut flying fruit while avoiding bombs. It offers Classic, Time and Arcade modes, so you can pick the pace you enjoy.
tips: Slice several fruits in one swipe whenever you can, since multiple fruits cut at once give the biggest point boosts.
Watch the bombs closely before each swipe and leave them alone, because cutting one ends your run.
In Arcade mode there is no clock, so take a moment to plan each slice rather than rushing.
In Time mode, focus on fruits that are easy to reach in one motion so you keep scoring while the clock runs down.
Try out the power-ups such as Blast-fruit and Bomb-deflect early, and learn what each one does so you can use it when a tough moment comes.
faq: How do I play Fruit Slicer?
Swipe your screen across the flying fruits to cut them. Avoid slicing the bombs, which are the main risk in the game.
What is the difference between the game modes?
Classic is a relaxed mode where you just slice, Time is a race against the clock, and Arcade lets you plan your slices with no time limit.

loopvival.intro: Loopvival is a survival adventure set in a world swallowed by Darkness, where a bonfire is the only light. Each cycle resets the world, but your campfire's progress persists, helping you push further into the Darkness.
tips: Treat each cycle as a chance to plan ahead, since the world resets and only the bonfire's progress and key improvements carry over.
Gather resources with purpose and decide early which ones you need for boosting your fire and rebuilding the ruins.
Use Q to switch between resources before adding them to the ruins, so you don't waste materials on the wrong one.
Keep an eye on your surroundings and retreat to the bonfire when minions of Darkness become too much to handle.
Explore the ruins as you go, since rebuilding them is how you learn the story of the lost world.
faq: What carries over from one cycle to the next?
The campfire's progress and key improvements persist, while the rest of the world resets to the beginning each cycle.
How do I add resources to the ruins?
Press Q to choose which resource you want to add, then use E to interact with the ruins.

heist-escape-city-lockdown.intro: Heist Escape: City Lockdown is an arcade chase where you drive a getaway car through a city, collect cash, and avoid being boxed in by a team of police.
tips: Keep your car moving at all times, since standing still makes it easier for police to close in around you.
Scan the road ahead for open gaps and steer toward them before the SURROUNDED warning appears.
Gold $100 bundles pay more but sit in riskier spots, so only chase them when you can still see a clear exit.
Use the handbrake drift to turn sharply when a junction or gap is tight, rather than braking hard and losing speed.
Try to let the capture meter climb past 70% before escaping, because breaking out at that level earns the Escape Bonus.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Collect as much cash as you can while staying mobile and avoiding being surrounded by the police.
How do I avoid getting busted?
Keep driving and look for a gap your car can fit through. You can also push weak patrol cars aside or reverse out of a trap.

soak-and-squeeze.intro: Soak & Squeeze is a bouncy 3D slingshot platformer where you play as a squishy sponge. Soak up water, then squeeze it out to launch across floating islands and reach the far-away goal.
tips: Plan your launch before you release. Pulling back longer sends you farther, so aim for a landing spot before you commit to the full pull.
Keep an eye on your water level. Blue OASIS islands refill it, so try to land on one before your tank runs dry in a long gap.
Save a jump for mid-air. You can pull again while you still have water, which is useful for correcting a short jump or reaching a distant platform.
Use trampolines, cannons and water slides to cover the big gaps instead of relying only on your own pulls. Smashing walls and flying through rings also earns extra drops.
Spend drops on upgrades after a failed run. A bigger tank, more power or more income can make the hardest jumps in each world much more manageable.
faq: How do I launch my sponge?
Press anywhere, pull back and let go, and your sponge flies in the opposite direction like a slingshot. On keyboard, hold Space to charge and release to fly, using the arrow keys to turn.
How do I refill my water?
Land on the blue OASIS islands to refill your water automatically. Running out of water sends you back to the start, so plan your route around them.

sorcerers-refuge.intro: Sorcerers Refuge is a dark 3D horror adventure where you wake in a room with no doors and must uncover the Sorcerer's secrets. You will solve riddles, explore hidden rooms, and fight to escape.
tips: Open your diary with Q whenever you are unsure what to do next, and use H for a hint when a riddle stalls you.
Play with sound on. The game's whispers and atmosphere are part of how you find your way through the level.
Collect the spells tied to the storyline, since that is how your character levels up.
Use F to heal before you enter unexplored corridors or a boss fight, and check your inventory with TAB before you go in.
Pay attention to your dialogue choices, because they affect the story and the way bosses react to what you do.
faq: What is the goal of Sorcerers Refuge?
You need to solve the mystery of the Sorcerer's Hideout and fight to escape before you become another soul in his collection.
How do I level up faster?
Collect the spells that are related to the storyline, since leveling comes from gathering them.

elska-dog-vs-zombies-multiplayer-co-op.intro: Elska is a top-down zombie shooter where you guide a dog through round-based waves of infected animals. Pick a class, switch between your weapons, and use your abilities to survive across two maps.
tips: Switch weapons with keys 1 through 5 before a wave gets crowded, so you are never stuck reloading a weapon that is wrong for the situation.
Learn what each class's ability keys do (E, Q, or G) and use them early in a fight instead of saving them until you are almost overwhelmed.
Keep moving with WASD and aim with the mouse so you can shoot while staying out of the path of the zombies.
Try different accessories on your dog and check what effects they give before you start a run, since they can change how you play.
Use the time between waves to think about which abilities and gear suit your playstyle, and adjust your loadout as the second map gets harder.
faq: What is the goal of Elska?
You fight round-based zombie waves of infected animals, trying to survive each round as the waves get more intense. Progress across the two maps is the main challenge.
How do I shoot and aim?
Use left click to shoot and move the mouse to aim. Keep your aim steady while you move with WASD to stay in control.

adventure-squad.intro: Adventure Squad is a tactical RPG where you build a party from many classes and guide it through waves of monsters on a campaign map. Heroes fight on their own, while you decide when to use their abilities.
tips: Keep tanks in front and archers and mages behind them, since enemies can target the back line.
Watch which enemy traits appear in each wave, such as poison, summons, healing, or heavy armor, and adjust your formation to match.
Save active abilities for key moments, like when a wave is overwhelming your front line or when a boss is low on health.
Use Auto mode for steady fights, but remember each automatic cast uses one AutoCoin, so spend them where they matter most.
After a defeat, change your formation or upgrade a weak hero before retrying the mission rather than repeating the same setup.
faq: What is the goal of each battle?
You defeat the enemy waves in a mission to earn gold and progress across the adventure map. Clearing battles also lets you recruit new fighters and upgrade your hero classes.
How do I place heroes on the battlefield?
On the squad screen, drag heroes onto empty slots and between slots to arrange your party. Put defenders in front and keep archers and mages further back.

stickerball.intro: StickerBall is an arcade game about aiming a bouncing ball to collect stickers before they vanish. Each turn you have a limited window to gather as many as you can, and triggers can change the rules to boost your rewards.
tips: Watch where the arrow points before you commit, since the ball bounces off walls and a well-angled wall bounce can reach stickers that a straight shot would miss.
Charge the power gauge with a steady hold and release it with care, because striking too early cancels the shot and wastes the turn.
Save Magnet and x2 for turns where stickers are spread out, so the combined effect pulls in more stickers at double value.
Aim for Holo-stickers first, since they grant double coins and are worth grabbing before ordinary stickers that might disappear.
Use Freeze or Bonus when the field is getting empty, since these help increase the number of stickers on the field for your next collection.
faq: How do I aim and launch the ball?
Move your cursor to set the direction shown by the arrow on the ball, then hold the left mouse button to fill the power gauge and release it to launch.
What happens if I release the shot too early?
Striking too early cancels the shot, so hold the power gauge until it is properly charged before you let go.

wobble-run.intro: Wobble Run is an arcade balance runner where you auto-run with a leaning stack of wet-ink cans through three worlds. Keep the stack upright, because tipping is the only way to fail.
tips: Watch the lean of the stack, not just the path ahead. Start correcting as soon as it tilts, since small early steers are easier than large late ones.
Steer into the lean to recover. Moving away from the direction the stack is falling usually makes the wobble worse.
Catch cans and coins whenever you can, but treat balance as the priority. Height grows as you collect, so a taller stack will be harder to keep steady.
Use short, steady inputs rather than big swings. Whether you use touch, mouse, or A/D and arrows, small corrections keep the stack under control.
If you want a Perfect, plan each level around collecting every can and coin. Learn the layout of each stage on the first attempt so you can grab items safely on later runs.
faq: What is the goal of Wobble Run?
Run through each level with your stack of wet-ink cans and avoid tipping it over. Catching more cans makes the stack taller, but balance is what keeps you in the run.
How do I steer and recover from a wobble?
Use touch or drag, the mouse, or A and D or the arrow keys on desktop to steer. Steer into the lean to bring the stack back toward balance.

offroad-jeep-driving-mountain-climb.intro: Mountain Climb Jeep Driving is a 3D off-road racing game where you drive 4x4 vehicles over steep hills, muddy tracks, snow, and mega ramps. Complete missions, pass checkpoints, and collect coins to unlock new vehicles and tracks.
tips: Ease off the throttle before sharp turns and narrow roads so the jeep keeps its grip instead of sliding off the path.
Use the brake on steep descents and before ramps to control your speed and keep the vehicle stable on landing.
Check the adjustable steering sensitivity in the settings menu (E) and lower it if small inputs send you off course on uneven ground.
Spend your collected coins on upgrades for the tougher climbs, since the game ties upgrades to handling harder challenges.
Watch for checkpoints and plan your route around them, because passing them is part of completing each mission.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Your goal is to drive your jeep through mountain roads and tracks, complete missions, and pass checkpoints without losing control. Each level tests your driving over climbs, ramps, and obstacles.
How do I steer and accelerate on desktop?
Use W or the Up Arrow to race forward, S, the Down Arrow, or Space to brake, and A/D or the Left and Right Arrows to move left and right. Press P to pause the game at any time.

seven-down.intro: Seven Down is a rolling-die puzzle game where the number that counts is the face touching the ground. Roll across boards, mazes and stages while using the hidden opposite faces to stay in control.
tips: Before each roll, work out the hidden face by subtracting the visible top from seven, so you always know what the ground face will be.
In puzzle boards, reaching the pad is easy, so plan backward from the face the board asks for and choose your route to set that number up.
Press V for the overview on puzzle boards to see the whole layout before you commit to a route.
In maze levels, only nearby tiles are visible and walked tiles stay uncovered, so keep a mental map of where you have been to avoid doubling back.
In action stages, holding a direction keeps the die rolling, so release the key as soon as you reach a safe tile. Save the shield for moments when a hit cannot be avoided.
faq: How do I know which number counts?
The number that counts is the face touching the ground, which you cannot see. Because opposite faces always add up to seven, you can work it out from the face you can see.
What is the goal in the puzzle boards?
Reach the pad, but the real challenge is arriving on the face the board asks for. Your number depends entirely on the route you took.

idle-cookie-tycoon.intro: Idle Cookie Tycoon is a clicker where you bake cookies by hand, then turn them into money to build auto ovens, shops, and investments. Early choices in upgrades and conversions shape how fast your empire grows.
tips: Spend your early cookies on click upgrades first, since the guide notes they compound over time and make every later click stronger.
Convert cookies to money only when you need to buy something, because 10 cookies equal 1 dollar and holding cookies lets you choose the best moment to spend.
Buy the Simple Auto Oven as soon as you can afford it so cookies keep coming in while you do other things.
Check each shop's rotating bar and keep the shops filling, since money is added to your account every time a bar completes.
Read the tutorials before investing, and only put money into the 15-second investments when you have studied the candlestick charts, because wrong predictions can cost you.
faq: What is the fastest way to start earning in Idle Cookie Tycoon?

Click the giant cookie button to produce cookies, then use the Upgrades menu to raise your cookies per click. Once you can afford it, buy the Simple Auto Oven so production continues without manual clicks.
How do the investments work?

Each investment lasts 15 seconds and uses candlestick charts with green and red candles. You buy or sell based on your prediction, and a correct call can double your money while a wrong one can lose it.

dragon-hunter.intro: Dragon Hunter is an idle clicker RPG where you pick a hero, roll the dice, and push through locations by clicking monsters. Your goal is to reach every location and take on the legendary dragons along the way.
tips: Keep clicking steadily, since defeating enemies is the main way your hero grows stronger and moves forward.
Open chests when you can, because they are one of the two ways the instructions point to for leveling up faster.
Spend the money you earn on skill upgrades, as that is what it is used for, and pick the upgrades that help your current playstyle.
Check your journal of tasks and achievements now and then so you know which goals are close to completion.
Play with sound on, since the game is designed to be more atmospheric that way, and listen for cues that help you track fights.
faq: What is the main goal of Dragon Hunter?
The goal is to visit all the locations, defeating monsters on your way through each one. Bosses are much tougher than regular enemies, so expect the dragons to be the real test.
How do I level up my hero faster?
Defeat enemies and open chests, as these are the two ways to gain levels. Leveling up also gives you random skills to build your hero.

cube-trap.intro: Cube Trap is a 3D platformer where the room looks simple but the floor, ceiling, controls and door all turn against you. Every trick is fixed, so each death teaches you what to expect next.
tips: Treat your first death as information. Every trick fires the same way each time, so note where it happened and what came right before it.
Don't stop moving under a suspicious ceiling or in an open room. The ceiling drops the moment you stand still, so keep traveling.
Hold jump longer when you need height, and time the jump before you reach a platform edge, since the ground can slide away when you leap.
Use the camera rotation to check the layout around you before committing to a route. Rotating the view can reveal where the door is going to move.
Restart quickly with R instead of pausing. Death costs nothing, so a fast reset helps you repeat the sequence and learn it.
faq: Does the level change between attempts?
No. Nothing is random, and each trick fires the same way every time, so the same sequence repeats on each try.
What happens when my cube dies?
The cube breaks apart and returns to the start after about half a second. Death is instant and does not cost you anything.

beastforge-rival.intro: BeastForge Rival is a real-time tower defense battle game where you place units from your deck into the arena to destroy enemy towers. Matches against live players or AI bots last a few minutes each.
tips: Watch your elixir before every placement, since spending it all at once can leave you unable to answer a sudden push.
Learn the rock-paper-scissors pairings between the 20 units so you can drop a counter when you see an enemy unit approaching.
Time your drops to the moment the enemy commits. Placing a unit just before their attack lands is often more useful than placing early.
Try the AI bots to practice matchups and timing before you climb the ranked arenas against live opponents.
Check which units you have upgraded and try combining units that support each other, since the game rewards synergy.
faq: What is the main goal of a match?
Use your units to destroy the enemy towers before they destroy yours. Matches are real-time and usually last about 3 to 5 minutes.
How do I place units in the arena?
Drag and drop a unit from your button deck onto the arena, or tap and place it if you are using touch controls. Timing the placement matters as much as the unit you choose.

watermelon-falling-animals.intro: Watermelon: Falling Animals is a merge puzzle where you drop animals into a container and combine matching pairs into bigger, rarer ones. Your score rises with each merge, and the game ends if the container overfills.
tips: Before each tap, look at where the matching animal will land so that identical animals meet on top of each other.
Keep the pile low and spread out. Stacking animals too high is the fastest way to end the game.
Plan a few drops ahead instead of dropping on impulse, since a well-placed animal can set up the next merge.
Save your powerful bonuses for moments when the container is nearly full or when a bigger merge is within reach.
Aim for combos where one merge sets off another, because these earn you more points than single merges.
faq: How do I play Watermelon: Falling Animals?
Tap the screen to drop an animal into the container. When two identical animals touch, they merge into a new, larger animal and you earn points.
What ends the game?
The game ends if the container becomes overfilled with animals. Keeping the pile from rising too high is the main way to keep playing.

tasty-out-arrow-puzzle.intro: Tasty Out! is a logic puzzle where you tap arrows on food-shaped boards to launch them off the board before your moves run out. Clear every path using as few steps as you can.
tips: Before you tap anything, scan the whole board and find which arrows point toward open space. Those are the ones that can leave right away.
Arrows bounce back when another piece blocks their path, which wastes a step. Work out the order of launches so that each arrow has a clear route when you tap it.
Start by looking for the piece that is blocking the most others, and clear it first. Freeing one central piece often opens several routes at once.
Since minimum steps earn bonus Gold and Trophies, try to solve each layout perfectly once you understand it. Replaying a level with fewer steps is a good way to build up Gold for the Elite Vault.
If you get stuck, stop and plan the sequence in your head rather than tapping at random. Random taps use up steps quickly and make the level harder to recover.
faq: What is the goal of Tasty Out!?
Your goal is to clear every arrow from the board by launching them off one at a time. You must finish before you run out of moves.
How do I launch an arrow?
Tap or left-click an arrow that points outward toward an open edge of the board. It will fly off the board and be removed.

escape-the-monster.intro: You wake at the bottom of a monster's lair and must find the green door on each of fifty maze floors. Four monsters hunt in different ways, so you will need to read each floor carefully before you move.
tips: Keep moving, because the monster speeds up the longer you stay on a floor. Lingering is the fastest way to lose a heart.
On dark floors you cannot see the monster, so listen for the music change and treat it as a warning to move away.
Collect gems on the way to the exit, since they buy hearts on the safe floors that come every ten floors.
If an exit stays locked, search the floor for the crown before you spend time on anything else.
When you pick up a mask, save it for a monster that is about to reach you, because it stuns that monster instead of costing you a heart.
faq: What do I need to do to escape?
Clear all fifty floors by reaching the green door on each one before the monster catches you. Once you clear floor fifty, you escape into the garden.
Why does the monster seem to get faster?
The monster speeds up the longer you stay on a floor, so you should keep moving rather than waiting. Staying put makes each floor harder.

logic-storm-animals-puzzle.intro: Logic Farm is a grid puzzle where you place animals so that each row, column, and colored region holds exactly one. Relax Mode has no time pressure, while Challenge Mode adds lives and a timer.
tips: Start with the rows, columns, or colored regions that have the fewest open cells, since they limit your choices the most.
Use the cross-out feature on every cell that cannot hold an animal, so the remaining options stay easy to see.
When you place an animal, immediately rule out its row, its column, its color region, and its neighboring cells.
If you are new, go through the interactive tutorial first to get used to the cross-out method before moving on to harder levels.
Save the Hint or Find tools for a real dead end, and try a few more deductions first so you still do the reasoning yourself.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You must place the required number of animals on the grid so that each row and column has exactly one animal, each colored region has exactly one animal, and no two animals touch.
What is the difference between Relax Mode and Challenge Mode?
Relax Mode has no lives limit and no time pressure. Challenge Mode limits your lives, shown by the heart icon, and gives you a time limit to finish the layout.

wheelchair-parkour-no-limits.intro: Wheelchair Parkour: No Limits is an endless rooftop runner where you build speed, jump wide gaps, and try to go as far as you can. One wrong move ends the run, so timing matters.
tips: Build up speed on the flat sections before a big gap, since your momentum is what carries you across.
Start your jump with enough room to spare, and avoid jumping at the last second near the edge.
Hold the jump key or button only while in the air when you want a frontflip, and keep your eyes on the landing spot so the trick doesn't distract you.
Collect coins when they are on your route, but don't risk a dangerous obstacle just to grab one.
Learn the rhythm of the early obstacles, because they get harder the farther you go and your early timing is what keeps a long run alive.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Travel as far as possible across the city rooftops to set a new distance record. The farther you go, the harder the obstacles become.
How do I move and jump?
On desktop, use the left and right arrow keys or A and D to move, and press Spacebar to jump. On mobile, drag the on-screen joystick to move and tap the jump button to jump.

twisty-planet.intro: Twisty Planet is a one-button arcade game where you tap to rotate a planet and dodge obstacles while collecting items. Your score grows the longer you survive and the more items you gather.
tips: Watch where obstacles are heading before you tap, since each twist moves them into or out of your path. Reacting early is easier than correcting late.
Tap in small, steady rhythms rather than rapid bursts, so you keep control of the position of your hero.
Plan your moves a short distance ahead. Obstacles that look far away will reach your hero sooner than you expect after a twist.
Grab collectible items when you can do so safely, but don't chase them into danger. Surviving longer also adds to your score.
If the game gets harder over time, slow down your decisions and focus on the next obstacle only, not the whole screen.
faq: What is the main goal in Twisty Planet?
Your goal is to survive as long as possible on the rotating planet while dodging obstacles. Collecting items also increases your score.
How do I control my hero?
Tap the screen or press a key to twist or rotate the planet. This changes where obstacles appear relative to your hero.

unstoppable-brawler.intro: Unstoppable Brawler is a 3D arcade fighter where you punch, guard, and dash through waves of enemies in a neon arena. Each cleared wave lets you pick an upgrade to shape your fighter's build.
tips: Keep moving instead of standing still, and circle around groups of enemies so you don't get surrounded.
Grab red potions as soon as you can, since they restore health, and blue potions, which refill your dash energy.
When a heavy enemy charges its attack, hold Guard to take the hit, then counter-attack while it recovers.
If your health is low, pick Full Heal or Health Boost. If you want to move faster, prioritize Movement Speed and Energy Regen.
If none of the three upgrade cards suit your build, use Reroll Cards to see a new selection.
faq: What is the goal of Unstoppable Brawler?
Survive as many waves of enemies as you can. Your highest wave is saved as your record.
How do I deal damage and defend?
Spam the punch button for rapid combos, and hold the guard button to reduce incoming damage by 80%. Use dash to evade strikes and traps.

obby-throw-an-egg.intro: Obby Throw an Egg is a clicker where you throw an egg across ten biomes, race it home before the boss catches you, and hatch it on your farm to collect earning creatures.
tips: Aim for a perfect throw by releasing your throw inside the white zone, since the further the egg lands, the rarer it is.
Train Strength with the dumbbell by pressing Space in the green zone, and time each press so you stay in it.
Keep an eye on the biome boss while you run your egg home, and pay attention to where it is before you slow down.
Check the booster pads near the spawn for x2 Speed, x2 Strength, or a rare egg, and choose the one that fits what you need most.
Hatch and place eggs on your farm with E as soon as you get them home so your creatures start earning cash.
faq: How do I get a rarer egg?
The further your egg lands, the rarer the egg, so focus on throwing as far as you can and release in the white zone for a perfect throw.
What does Strength do?
Lifting the dumbbell with Space in the green zone gains Strength, which helps you throw further across the biomes.

obby-cut-the-grass-for-egg.intro: Obby Cut the Grass for Egg is a 3D adventure where you cut grass to grow stronger, find hidden eggs, and carry them home past a boss. You can also hatch creatures, buy upgrades, and play with others online.
tips: Keep clicking on grass as you explore, since cutting is how you gain Strength and Strength helps you handle the boss.
Follow the arrows toward eggs when you want a clear route, and look around the meadow for any you might otherwise miss.
Spend gold on better blades when you can, because a stronger blade makes cutting grass faster and more rewarding.
Use the booster pads near spawn when you need a quick boost to Speed or Strength, and choose the one that fits what you are doing next.
Return to base with B when you have collected enough or need to reset your route, and check your farm and shops with E before heading out again.
faq: How do I gain Strength in this game?
Click or tap on grass to cut it, and each cut adds to your Strength.
What do I need to do with the eggs?
Find the eggs hidden in the meadow and carry them home, getting past the boss on the way.

pocket-tile.intro: Pocket Tile is a number and color merge puzzle played on a 5×5 board. Place tiles, connect three matches, and merge them into higher tiles across Daily Puzzle, Adventure, and Rank modes.
tips: Check the Next preview before each placement so you can decide where the current tile helps most. Leaving clear lines of matching tiles makes later merges easier.
Remember that the upgraded tile stays where you tap, so choose the glowing tile whose position leaves the most room on the board for future merges.
Keep some empty spaces open. Matching tiles only connect horizontally or vertically, so crowding the board can block the groups you need.
Use Change Color tiles when a nearby number is one color short of a match. Their effect is consumed once used, so save them for a merge that needs it.
In Adventure, look at the displayed goal tiles early and keep them together on the board as you merge, since the level is only complete when they are all present at once.
faq: How do I merge tiles in Pocket Tile?
Connect three tiles with the same number and color in a horizontal or vertical line. When they glow, tap any glowing tile to merge the three into a higher tile.
Do diagonal tiles connect?
No. Only tiles that touch horizontally or vertically count as connected, so diagonal matches will not merge.

haystack-works.intro: Haystack Works mixes hand digging with factory building. Gather hay, sell it at the dock, then automate production to fill orders and find six hidden needles.
tips: Dig by hand early to build up cash, then spend it on conveyors and machines so production runs while you work elsewhere.
Carry hay to the sale dock in batches rather than selling one piece at a time, so you spend less time walking back and forth.
Check the research tree (T) regularly and pick upgrades that speed up the parts of your setup that are slowest right now.
Before placing a machine, plan the conveyor path so hay reaches it without backtracking. Use R to rotate pieces and PageUp/PageDown to adjust height before you commit.
Keep an eye on open orders and build toward the ones you can fill with your current machines, since completed orders are a steady source of progress.
faq: How do I gather hay and sell it?
Hold the left mouse button on the hay to gather it, carry it to the sale dock on the left, and press E to sell.
How do I get a machine running?
Open the build catalog with B, place the machine, and use F to load hay into it. Conveyors need two clicks to place, and Q cancels a placement.

potion-kitchen.intro: Potion Kitchen is a cozy crafting puzzle where you run a potion shop, read guest orders, and brew the right potions before patience runs out. Each shift builds your recipe book one potion at a time.
tips: Read the hints below each order before touching the shelf, since they narrow down which potion is wanted.
For riddles, work out the effect the guest describes first, then look for an ingredient that matches it.
Remember that the ingredients of a potion share one element, so when you find one ingredient that fits, look for others that share it.
Use the recipe book and hint key only when you are stuck, and try reasoning through a recipe before brewing guesses.
Spend coins between shifts on kitchen upgrades, such as the third cauldron slot, to make more complex potions possible.
faq: How do I know which potion a guest wants?
A direct request names the potion, while a riddle describes its effect. The hints shown below the order help you narrow it down.
Do I need a perfect match to earn money?
No. An exact match is rated Perfect, but any real potion still sells and earns coins and reputation.

wordaire-word-solitaire.intro: Wordaire is a calm word solitaire where you sort cards into categories such as Fruit, Pets and Kitchen. There is no timer, so you can take your time planning each move.
tips: Open a category card as soon as an empty foundation slot is free, so its words have a clear place to go.
Stack words from the same category in the columns to uncover hidden cards, since this can open up new options.
Watch the counter on each category card to see how many words are still missing before you commit your moves.
Your moves per level are limited, so use double-click or double-tap to send a card straight to its category when you can.
Save Hint, Undo and the Star wild card for levels that feel stuck, rather than spending them early.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Put every card onto a foundation. You do this by placing a category card on an empty foundation slot and then moving that category's words onto it.
How do I free cards that are covered?
Stack words of the same category on top of each other in the columns. This can uncover hidden cards beneath them.

obby-break-an-egg.intro: Obby Break an Egg is a clicker and tycoon game where you smash giant eggs with a pickaxe, carry the animals inside back to your farm, and grow your earnings. This guide covers the basic loop and a few habits that help you progress.
tips: Stay close to the egg and keep swinging until it breaks, since you need to finish each one before you can carry its contents home.
Plan your route before you pick up an animal, because you have to get past the guardians on the way back to your farm.
Spend your cash on pickaxe upgrades early, so each egg takes less effort to break as you move into harder biomes.
Check the booster pads near the spawn when you need a boost, since they give x2 Speed or x2 Power for a short video.
Look at the shops after each trip to see which upgrade improves your progress most, rather than buying at random.
faq: What is the main goal of Obby Break an Egg?
Break giant eggs with your pickaxe, free the animals inside, carry them home, and place them on your farm with E. Use the cash you earn to buy stronger pickaxes and upgrades.
How do I move and aim the pickaxe?
Move with WASD and look around with the mouse. Click to swing the pickaxe at an egg until it breaks.

special-ops-go.intro: Special Ops: GO is a modern browser FPS built around quick, competitive matches. You pick a loadout, drop into an arena and fight real players in up to 5v5 battles, or take on single-player missions if you prefer to play solo.
tips: Match your weapon to the map: SMGs and pistols suit close-quarters fights, while rifles and sniper rifles pay off on long sight lines.
Try Deathmatch first to warm up your aim, then move to Team Deathmatch or Ranked once you know the maps.
Keep moving between shots. Matches reward sharp aim, movement and smart decisions, so standing still makes you an easy target.
Use the single-player missions and survival challenges to practise against enemies without the pressure of a ranked match.
Log in daily and finish quests to collect rewards and credits, which help you unlock weapon skins and climb the ranks.
faq: Can I play Special Ops: GO alone?
Yes. Besides online PvP it has a single-player mode with missions and survival-style challenges.
Which game modes are there?
The game offers Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, Ranked and Custom Rooms for online play, plus single-player missions.

pixel-conquest.intro: Pixel Conquest is a territory strategy game where you race AI opponents to claim as much of the grid as you can. Leave your own area, draw a trail and close the loop to capture land, while your city grows automatically inside your borders.
tips: Make small, quick loops at the start. A short trail is safer because you spend less time outside your own territory.
Never run into the outer walls or an opponent's established territory; both end your run instantly.
Watch rival trails: cutting off and eliminating opponents is one of the fastest ways to boost your score.
Grab the Shield power-up before a risky move, since it lets you survive one fatal collision.
Save the Bomb for a crowded spot, because it instantly claims a large circular area around you.
faq: How do I score points in Pixel Conquest?
Houses and skyscrapers are built automatically as your territory grows and earn points over time. Conquering enemy land, destroying their buildings and eliminating opponents also raise your score.
What power-ups are there?
Speed makes you move twice as fast, Shield survives one fatal collision, Ghost lets you pass through enemy trails and Bomb claims a large circle around you.

block-zero.intro: Block Zero is a third-person action game set in an open low-poly city. You play a blocky mutant who runs up walls, glides between rooftops and takes on missions across three zones, from quiet residential blocks to the infected quarantine and the corporate base.
tips: Sprint straight into a building to run up its wall, then hold jump to glide across the street to the next roof.
Use the air dash mid-flight to correct your landing or reach a roof that is just out of glide range.
When your health is low, weaken an enemy and absorb it: you heal, gain biomass and can take its appearance.
Disguise yourself as security before entering guarded areas, because security will not shoot at one of their own.
Try the yellow pillars between missions for medal challenges; a restart is one press away, so keep retrying for gold.
faq: How many missions does Block Zero have?
After the tutorial there are 12 missions, including nest bosses, a courier chase, a convoy and a final mission called the Source.
What are the medal challenges?
Yellow pillars start rooftop runs through a chain of gates and 60-second Smash arenas. There are 6 runs and 3 arenas, each with bronze, silver and gold medals, plus a daily challenge with a twist.

flippin-coins.intro: Flippin' Coins is an idle merge game that mixes a little luck with planning. You tap coins to flip them for cash, drag matching coins together to reach higher tiers and spend your earnings on new coins to grow faster.
tips: Flip coins often in the early game; each flip has a 75% win rate, so the odds are on your side.
Merge two matching coins as soon as you can to free up space on the board and unlock the next tier.
Reinvest your earnings in new coins rather than saving everything, so you have more coins to flip and merge.
Aim for higher tiers, because each new tier brings bigger rewards than the last.
Keep a few free spots on the board so newly bought coins always have somewhere to go.
faq: How do I merge coins in Flippin' Coins?
Drag one coin onto a matching coin of the same tier. Two Tier 1 coins become a Tier 2 coin, two Tier 2 coins become Tier 3, and so on.
Can a flip lose money?
Every flip is a gamble, but the game gives each flip a 75% win rate, so most flips pay out.

my-perfect-hotel-html5.intro: My Perfect Hotel HTML5 is a fast time-management game where you start a hotel from the ground up and grow it into a lodging empire. You run the place as manager, deciding when to invest in staff and when to upgrade the property.
tips: Serve guests quickly early on: in a time-management game, speed is what keeps money coming in.
Spend your first earnings on upgrades that help you serve more guests, then expand once the basics run smoothly.
Hire staff when you can no longer keep up alone, so you can focus on the jobs that need you most.
Balance spending between staff and property improvements instead of pouring everything into one side.
Everything is done with a mouse click or tap, so keep your cursor close to the busiest part of the hotel.
faq: What is the goal in My Perfect Hotel HTML5?
Build your hotel from its foundation into a large lodging empire by investing wisely in staff and property upgrades.
How do you control the game?
Click with the mouse or tap the screen to play.

jewel-loop-color-sort.intro: Jewel Loop Color Sort is a sorting puzzle where colorful jewels travel around a looping conveyor and you fill matching spaces to reveal sparkling pictures. The belt has limited space and a clock is ticking, so every click counts.
tips: Look at the whole board before you click: send jewel groups whose matching spaces are open right now.
Keep an eye on belt capacity. Sending too many groups at once can jam the loop with jewels that have nowhere to go.
Work against the clock, but do not rush blindly; a wrong group on the belt costs more time than a short pause to plan.
Save boosters for levels where you are stuck or running out of time rather than using them on easy boards.
On mobile, pinch with two fingers to zoom in on the board when groups are hard to tell apart.
faq: How many levels does Jewel Loop Color Sort have?
The game has 1,478 puzzle levels.
Is my progress saved?
Yes. Progress is saved automatically.

tricky-prank-annoying-quest.intro: Tricky Prank: Annoying Quest is a funny puzzle game built around clever pranks, tricky situations and unexpected twists. Each level is a new scene with its own little story, hidden clues and surprising interactions.
tips: Think differently: the obvious answer is often not the right one in a prank puzzle.
Click and drag objects around the scene to see how they react; some solutions only appear when you experiment.
Search the whole scene for hidden clues before you start trying things at random.
Some levels need actions in a specific order, so if one step does nothing, try another object first and come back.
Read each level's setup carefully, since the funny storyline often hints at the prank you need to pull.
faq: What kind of game is Tricky Prank: Annoying Quest?
It is a puzzle game where every level is a funny scene. Some levels play like a quick brain test, others need you to experiment with objects to find the right sequence.
How do you play?
Click and drag to interact with objects in each scene.

stage-show-designer.intro: Stage Show Designer is a 3D collecting game where you gather clothes and decorations that match the performance you are shown. Pick up the right items, avoid the wrong ones and finish each level with a stage-ready look.
tips: Check the performance theme at the start of each level so you know which clothes and decorations to aim for.
Drag to steer toward correct items and away from ones that do not fit the theme.
You need more than 75% correct items to complete a level, so skipping a doubtful item is often safer than grabbing it.
Look ahead down the track instead of only at the item right in front of you, so you can line up your next pickup early.
faq: How do you complete a level in Stage Show Designer?
Collect more than 75% correct items for the shown performance.
What are the controls?
Drag to move and collect items. The game runs in the browser on PC, Mac, phones and tablets.

forever-dunk.intro: Forever Dunk looks like a simple drop-and-draw game, but every line fades after a second and a half, so the real skill is deciding where the ball should be rather than where it is.
tips: Draw short lines close to the ball instead of long ones across the screen. A short line gives a cleaner bounce and you still have time to draw the next one.
Aim for a swish. A Perfect Dunk that misses the rim is worth two points, and three in a row start Rage Mode, which doubles everything that follows.
Treat bumpers and trampolines as free speed. Let them do the work and save your line for the last steer into the hoop.
Keep an eye on the hoop before you draw. The ball follows your line, so plan the angle that drops it straight down rather than across.
Spend coins on power-ups you will actually use. Magnet rescues bad angles, Shield saves a life on a boss round, and Long Line helps in the wide zones.
faq: How long does a drawn line last in Forever Dunk?
About a second and a half. It fades on its own, so draw it just before the ball reaches it rather than far in advance.
What starts Rage Mode?
Three Perfect Dunks in a row — baskets where the ball goes through without touching the rim. Rage Mode doubles your points while it lasts.

ball-ball-away.intro: Ball Ball Away cannot kill your ball, only the clock can. Once you stop worrying about crashing, the game becomes about drawing the fewest, best lines to reach the portal in time.
tips: Time slows down while you are drawing, so take the extra half second to pick a good angle instead of panicking a line into place.
Only three lines stay on screen and a new one replaces the oldest. Draw where the ball is about to be, not where it already passed.
Aim through the centre of the portal. A Perfect keeps your combo climbing, and a combo is worth more than any single lucky bounce.
Watch for the golden portal on every fifth stage — it pays triple, so it is worth spending a +10 seconds pick-up to be sure you reach it.
Let bumpers and spinning bars carry the ball forward. Fighting them with a line usually costs more time than it saves.
faq: Can the ball be destroyed in Ball Ball Away?
No. Nothing in the game kills the ball — you only lose a life if the timer runs out before you reach the portal.
How do I get a higher combo?
Pass through portals without losing a life and go through the centre for a Perfect. The combo climbs to x4 and multiplies every point you score.

bubble-wrap.intro: Bubble Wrap rewards two things that pull in opposite directions: popping fast without a pause to build a combo, and saving your coins for the weapon that actually suits the world you are on.
tips: Sweep across the globe with the button held down instead of tapping one bubble at a time. An unbroken sweep is what keeps the combo alive.
Rotate the globe before you run out of bubbles on the side you are facing. A pause to look around breaks the combo you just built.
Buy one weapon and upgrade it rather than owning several weak ones. Upgrades compound, a second weapon does not.
Fill the Rage ring before you start on a fresh side of the globe, so the burst lands where there is the most to pop.
Leave the game for a while on purpose. Progress keeps growing while you are away, so you come back with coins to spend.
faq: What is the core at the end of a world?
Once the globe is cleared you reach a boss core. Breaking it opens the next world, with new bubbles and a higher payout.
Does Bubble Wrap keep going when I close it?
Yes. It is an idle game, so your weapons keep earning while you are away and you return to collected coins.

wall-of-riddles.intro: Wall of Riddles is a real escape room built by people who run one. The nine chests are not independent: several of them hide the item or the clue that opens another, so the order you work in matters.
tips: Open every chest you can reach first and read what is inside before touching a padlock. Some chests hand you the key to others.
Check the bag at the bottom after every find. Tapping an item shows a closer look, and the detail you need is often on the back.
Write the codes down. Several puzzles use the same symbols in a different order, and it is easy to lose a digit you already solved.
Look at the room, not only the chests. A stopped clock, a row of flags and a compass are all part of the puzzle.
Use the hints. Each chest has up to three, and spending one is better than brute-forcing a padlock.
faq: How many puzzles does Wall of Riddles have?
Nine locked chests, each with its own puzzle and a gem inside. Collect all nine gems to beat the wall.
Can I play Wall of Riddles with friends?
Yes. It works well with several people around one screen, which is how a real escape room is usually played.

save-my-pet-game.intro: Save My Pet Game is a logic puzzle where each level puts a cute pet in danger and you have to work out the safest way to protect it, usually by drawing a path or a barrier before the hazard reaches it.
tips: Look at the whole level before you start drawing. Note where the danger comes from and where your pet is standing.
Think about timing as well as shape: a solution that is too slow or leaves a gap lets the hazard through.
Keep your drawing simple. A short, solid line usually holds up better than a long, complicated one.
If a level fails, change one thing at a time so you can see which part of your plan did not work.
Later levels add new obstacles, so expect each one to need a slightly different idea rather than repeating the last solution.
faq: How do you play Save My Pet Game?
Everything is done with the mouse: click the buttons and draw your solution, then watch whether it keeps the pet safe from the obstacles in that level.
Does Save My Pet Game get harder?
Yes. Each level brings a new challenge, and as you progress they ask for more careful thinking and more creative solutions.

blade-merge.intro: Blade Merge mixes merging strategy with spinning blade duels: combine your blades into stronger weapons, then send them in to cut down an enemy bot's health before it wears down yours.
tips: Merge before you fight. Two matching blades combine into a stronger one, so a few merges usually beat many weak blades.
Watch both health bars during a duel so you know whether you are winning the exchange.
Protecting your own health matters as much as hitting hard; a stronger blade helps on both counts.
If a level feels too tough, go back to merging and bring a higher-level blade into the next duel.
The game is played with the left mouse button only, so it works the same way on a laptop touchpad.
faq: What are the controls in Blade Merge?
Use the left mouse button for everything: merging blades and playing the battles.
How do you win a level in Blade Merge?
Reduce the enemy bot's health to zero with your spinning blades while protecting your own.

bloom.intro: Bloom is a small arcade .io-style game across multiple levels, played in the browser with WebGL and steered with the keyboard or a swipe of the mouse.
tips: Move with W, A, S and D, or swipe with the mouse if that feels more natural to you.
Try both control styles in the first level and stick with the one that gives you finer control.
Take the early levels slowly to learn how your character moves before going for speed.
Each level is a fresh start, so if one goes badly simply try it again with what you learned.
The game uses WebGL, so if it runs slowly, close other heavy browser tabs.
faq: What are the controls in Bloom?
Use W, A, S, D on the keyboard or swipe with the mouse to move.
Does Bloom have more than one level?
Yes, it features multiple levels with io-style gameplay.

sneaky-spikes.intro: Sneaky Spikes is a troll platformer drawn on notebook paper, where floors drop, spikes pop out and even doors bite. A sarcastic narrator comments on every death, and each page ends with a Death Parade that replays all your failed runs at once.
tips: Treat your first attempt at a page as a scouting run: expect a trap and watch where it triggers rather than rushing to the door.
When a floor drops or a spike appears, remember the exact spot. The traps are part of the page design, so the same place will catch you again.
Use the pause key (P on desktop) when you need a moment to plan the next jump.
Go back to earlier pages for the stars once you know the traps; it is easier than collecting them on a first run.
If you want to speedrun, finish a page cleanly first, then use the timer to shave seconds off a route you already know.
faq: How many levels does Sneaky Spikes have?
There are 60 levels, each drawn as a notebook page, plus stars to collect and a speedrun timer.
What are the controls in Sneaky Spikes?
On desktop use the arrow keys or A and D to move, Space, W or Up to jump, and P to pause. On mobile there are on-screen arrow and jump buttons.

traffic-go.intro: Traffic Go is a quick arcade crossing game: guide your way across busy streets without getting hit by the cars and reach the goal. It is played with the mouse, so it is easy to pick up.
tips: Watch the gaps between cars for a moment before you move instead of going at the first opening.
Cross one lane at a time and stop in a safe spot when the next lane is busy.
Look at the speed of each lane, not just the distance to the nearest car. A far car can still arrive quickly.
Do not rush near the goal. Most crashes come from hurrying on the last stretch.
If you keep getting hit in the same place, wait one extra cycle of traffic there before crossing.
faq: What is the goal of Traffic Go?
The goal is to cross the streets and reach the finish without hitting any of the cars.
How do you play Traffic Go?
Traffic Go is played with the mouse. Time your moves so you cross when there is a gap in the traffic.

truck-coloring.intro: Truck Coloring is a relaxed coloring game for kids where you pick virtual paints and fill in pictures of different trucks. Each truck looks a little different, so every page is a new picture to color.
tips: Choose a color first, then tap or click the part of the truck you want to fill.
Try a different color scheme on each truck, such as a fire truck in red or a dump truck in yellow.
Color the large parts like the cab and the trailer first, then add details like wheels and windows.
On a phone or tablet, zooming the browser out a little can help you see the whole truck at once.
There is no wrong answer, so let younger players pick whatever colors they like.
faq: Is Truck Coloring good for young kids?
Yes. It only needs a mouse click or a tap on the screen, so it suits young children who like trucks and coloring.
Can I play Truck Coloring on a tablet?
Yes. It runs in the browser on phones and tablets as well as on computers, and you color by tapping the screen.

tug-the-table-classic.intro: Tug The Table Classic is a simple physics tug-of-war where two sides pull a table in opposite directions. You can play it alone against the computer or with a friend on the same keyboard.
tips: In two-player mode, Player 1 tugs with the Up arrow key and Player 2 tugs with W, so sit at opposite ends of the keyboard.
Tap your key rapidly and steadily; a constant rhythm usually beats short bursts.
Keep an eye on the table's balance and push harder when it starts to tip your way.
Play a few solo rounds first to get a feel for how fast you need to tap.
Agree on a best-of-five match with a friend to make the games more exciting.
faq: Can two people play Tug The Table Classic?
Yes. It has both a 1 player mode and a 2 player mode on the same device.
What are the controls in Tug The Table Classic?
Player 1 tugs with the Up arrow key and Player 2 tugs with the W key. You can also tug by touching the screen.

a-mother-s-grief.intro: A Mother's Grief is a first-person horror exploration game set in a remote cabin in the winter of 1892. You play an investigator of places with dark histories who has to explore the house and photograph proof of what happened there.
tips: Search every room, including the hallway, kitchen, bedroom, fireplace nook and the evidence room, because the eight haunted objects are spread across the cabin.
Watch your camera's battery and shot counter, and only take a photo when the object is clearly in the viewfinder.
Open the journal with TAB to read the cabin's history and pin each photo to the evidence board.
Use the flashlight in dark corners and listen to the audio; the whisper gets closer the longer you stay.
Use crouch and sprint to move carefully around tight spots and get away quickly when you need to.
faq: What do you do in A Mother's Grief?
You explore an 1892 cabin in first person and photograph eight haunted objects as evidence, then pin them to the evidence board in your journal.
How do I open the journal in A Mother's Grief?
Press TAB to open the journal, where you can read the cabin's history and pin your photographs as proof.
